comment:
I recently did the foodie tour with my husband and 2 daughters (10 + 12) and had a 10000/10 experience. The lovely ladies that guided us could not be faulted. None of us had been on bikes before and they made all of us feel safe and comfortable. I saw my girls yapping away with their guides the entire time. I have good allergies and they were all over it.
We also loved that they included sightseeing style stops. And the ladies made sure I met the XO Tours tiktok stars 😜

Thank you so much ☺️
Such a fun food tour. As each person gets their own drivers you get to find out a lot about Vietnam and the day to day life here. The host ladies were amazing and the food was great too.
An unreal experience learning both about Vietnamese culture and food as well as a great insight to Ho Chi Minh City. Thank you to the group lead by Pham had such a fun time
Excellent tour, felt safe and the food was great. We had an awesome time. Thank you XO Tours

Such a great way to see the city. I was feeling a bit down only being in the party district 1, but during the tour Nhu Nguyen with XO made it feel like a family member was showing me around their city. Nhu was extremely knowledgeable of the many different zones we visited. She also gave me great tips on shopping and ideas on what districts and cities to visit next. I have a deeper respect for Hcmc now and I am very thankful to Nhu.
Our family of 4 including two teen boys did the XO foodie tour and had a great night. Food was amazing and we always felt safe.

I have been on many food tours across the world, but this company by far put on by far the best I’ve ever been on. Such a thoughtful tour that really allows you to explore the city like a local. It was incredibly fun going around on motorbikes, and the food the tour guides picked out for us was all delicious. I truly felt like I was seeing the authentic Saigon for locals, rather than touristy locations.

My sister and I LOVED our XO foodie tour so much that we did the sights of Saigon tour two days later! All the XO girls are so sweet, friendly, and knowledgeable. They really took the time to talk to us, answer questions, and make us feel welcomed. Absolutely recommend this company for any of their tours!

What an incredible tour and experience! These ladies were so lovely, the food was incredible and despite being nervous on the bikes, I felt so safe the entire time! If you want a great night with great food, I totally recommend this tour!

We throughly enjoyed our experience with XO Tours from start to finish. The communication throughout the booking, confirmation and pick-up process, all the way to the follow-up email including wonderful pics of our time on the tours - makes it clear that this company is well-organized, customer-focused and professionally run. We are very glad that we booked with XO and loved both, the evening Foodie Tour and Sights Of Saigon the following day. Seeing and experiencing the city on the back of a motorbike is absolutely the way to go. And in the hands of the WONDERFUL women who drive, guide and share what their city has to offer, makes it a very fun and engaging experience. We always felt safe and learned a lot about the culture & history whilst filling our bellies to the brim with delicious local food.
*And they go the extra mile: My husband accidentally hurt his leg (his mistake) mid-tour and when we arrived at the next location, one of the tour assistants had gone to the pharmacy and gave us some ointment to make sure it was taken care of quickly and properly. This is the kind of attentive service that makes XO special and shows that they truly care about their customers and our experience.
We can’t recommend these tours enough, so if you’re considering it…go for it. We did and it was one of the highlights of our time in Vietnam. A big THANK YOU again to the smart, funny, engaging and caring ladies who took us around town - we truly appreciate your hard work and the memories we made with you. Cam on!

The XO Foodie Tour was genuinely the highlight of my Saigon trip! Thank you Ngoc and Linh for driving us around, being so knowledgeable and friendly, and showing us so many awesome places. I’m still thinking about that Bánh Canh Cua… 🦀

This tour really was exceptional. I don’t often write reviews but this tour was such a standout experience for our family.

While I was I initially nervous about our kids (aged 10 & 13) being on scooters, our guides kept them very safe and the kids absolutely loved every minute of it. The guides were all so friendly, smart, funny and knowledgeable and went above and beyond to ensure everyone was happy.

If anything, I wish we had done the tour earlier in our stay because we got to see, taste and learn so much about the different districts of HCMC - things we never would have come across on our own. Well also would have done the morning tour with XO if he had more time - next time for sure!

This tour ended up being one of the absolute highlights of our entire Vietnam trip. By chance, it was just our family of eight—ranging from my 11‑year‑old daughter all the way up to my mother (age politely withheld). Most of us had never been on a motorbike before, and certainly not in the kind of wild, exhilarating Saigon traffic you get to experience on this tour.

We originally booked it hoping for some tasty local food and a bit of city exploring. What completely blew us away was the guides’ energy, enthusiasm, and genuine warmth. From the moment they picked us up, they clearly explained the plan for the night and walked us through how to ride safely, making sure anyone feeling nervous was paired with a guide who’d keep them comfortable.

By the time we zipped through traffic to the first stop, everyone was buzzing—not just from the ride, but from how friendly and fun the guides were. Then came our first dish: a crab tapioca noodle soup with a rich, deeply flavoured broth and chillis on the side so everyone could dial in their preferred heat level. It was absolutely delicious. One member of our group had dietary restrictions, and the team accommodated them seamlessly.

As the night went on, we rode to a few more spots—and then the rain arrived in full force. The guides handed out ponchos, and we splashed our way through Saigon, eating, laughing, and soaking up the chaos and charm of the city together.

Do yourself a favour and book this tour. The food was fantastic. Riding through Saigon at night was unforgettable. And the tour guides were simply exceptional.

This evening food tour ended up being one of the highlights of our Vietnam trip. Neither myself or my wife had been on the back of a bike before & to do it in Saigon evening traffic was daunting. The trip was awesome. Our tour guides were chatty, interested in our trip and where we were from, and full of knowledge of the areas we were travelling through. The food was fantastic & accommodating with plenty of options. Not the cheapest food tour around, but we thoroughly enjoyed it and consider it highly recommended.

Absolutely the best tour we had in Vietnam by a large margin. The team were so natural and friendly- they genuinely seemed to have fun themselves.
We visited several suburbs with different food (all very tasty).
The experience on the back of the scooters was amazing.
An easy 5 stars!!!!

We had an amazing food tour, cruising through the night-time streets on motorbikes with Wolfie and his team! We sampled so much amazing food and great talks! Thank you Pie for keeping me safe on the back of your bike!

The XO Tours foodie tour was an absolute highlight of our time in Saigon. Our guides, Dieu and Anh, were brilliant: fun, knowledgeable and great company all night. The food was fantastic, and the barbecued beef was amazing. We tried dishes and places we'd never have found on our own.

Our drivers were 10/10. They navigated the Saigon traffic with skill and made us feel completely safe, and our conversations with them made the experience even more interesting. The group we were with was awesome too, which added to the fun.

We had an absolutely amazing time. A must-do in Saigon.
Tran , Loren 3.28.2025 - Tran was amazing. Could not have asked for a better guide, driver, and overall awesome human. That whole experience was great!. điểm tuyệt đối recommend.
Our family (2 adults, 14 and 16 year old) had such a fun time on the XO Vespa food tour. We felt safe and enjoyed lots of amazing food. Highly recommend

Our team were in Vietnam for a conference and had previously booked this tour. A few people at the conference raved about this tour so we were excited for the day of the tour.
Our team of 10 had the best time. Our guides were lovely knowledgeable and lots of fun. The experience itself was a highlight. The food and the places went to to were great.
Highly recommend doing this tour.

We took a private scooter tour of Saigon with Linh and Phuong - it was a fabulous time! They were friendly, knowledgeable, and great scooter drivers. I really appreciated the historical context they provided at each site that we visited and enjoyed spending time with them!

Do not miss out on this fabulous experience in Ho Chi Minh City!! This was one of my absolute favorite things we did on our 3 week trip. Booking manager Thao Nguyen took excellent care of us to be sure we could still join the tour last minute (we booked the day before) and tour leader Yen Tran was so knowledgeable, professional and fun! We were lucky to have Autumn and Daisy as our drivers and they were so kind, accommodating and kept us safe throughout. I highly recommend the xo foodie tour....great value and so much fun!!

This was one of our best experiences in Vietnam. We did the XO Foodie tour, and hoped it would never end... Our drivers were amazing. They made great conversation (like... real conversation, not a list of stories they studied) about the city, food, Vietnam, our culture, etc.

We would definitely recommend anyone to book this tour!

I booked the XO Saigon by Night tour, and had the pleasure of being shown around by Tour Leader Jasmine, and my guide Binh. The tour was fantastic and all the girls are very knowledgable and one of the major highlights of my trip to Ho Chi Minh City.

Thank you very much Ladies and XO Tours for a truely memorable evening.
One of the best experiences!! Such a good group activity to do with friends and family we had the best time and the girls were amazing 💗💗💗💗💗 …

Fantastic tour! This is such special experience. Sitting on the back of a motorbike being expertly driven through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City, seeing great sites and eating great food. Thank you for an unforgettable experience.

We had an awesome experience and cannot recommend this highly enough. We took a private tour by car and they customised the tour to our food and sightseeing requirements which was amazing and much appreciated. Love that this is women led but did not make it uncomfortable for my male partner at all. Went to private home of Vietnamese as well as fabulous food outlets and sightseeing. Definitely must do in Saigon - you will not regret!

Absolutely a fantastic night. Food was great and plentiful as with the beer. You always feel safe with the girls doing the riding. All the girls were great fun and we all had a brilliant night. Highly recommended.

We had so much fun on our XO Foodie Tour! Our tour guides were excellent: friendly and knowledgeable, good drivers and with good English language skills. We tasted some delicious food and learned a lot about Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnam. Highly recommended!

Best food tour in Ho Chi Minh City. Had an amazing time touring multiple districts on the back of a scooter and getting to see different parts of the city. The locals and people were amazing, the different foods were delicious, and girls were wonderful. Our guides / drivers Vy and Anni and group leader Sunny were fantastic. First time on a scooter and we had a blast.
We had a great time on this tour with Katee and Tracy. We would highly recommend.

We had such a wonderful experience on our food tour in Vietnam! 🇻🇳❤️ The two ladies who hosted us were absolutely amazing—so warm, friendly, patient, and welcoming. They made us feel comfortable right away and went above and beyond to make the experience special.
Even though I’m not the most adventurous foodie 😂, they were so encouraging and made trying new Vietnamese dishes fun and enjoyable. We learned so much about the local food, culture, and traditions along the way.
We had the best time on our food tour with XO tours. Autumn and Vy were our guides. They were caring, informative and lots of fun. Tried amazing food in different districts. Highly recommend.

An XO Food and City Tour with this amazing company is a MUST DO in Saigon.  We had walked the streets the days before and been amazed by how the cars, buses and scooters all work seamlessly together.... it was more amazing to be part of it on the back of a scooter with a competent and informative driver in control...Hands down the best tour we have ever done. We felt completely safe and learnt so much about the city and food.  The tour consisted of 5 stops to different city districts.  Stop 1, 3 and 5 were to eat local food.  Stops 2 and 4 were to give you time inbetween eating whilst showing you another part of the city.  We walked through China town and the Korean area, both were very interesting and very different from each other.  The woman running the tour have thought of everything.  They had clearly thought about who they sat myself and my husband with to eat, the conversations they had with us, the food we ate, they cooked food at the table for us, even retrieved the crab meat from the shells for us.  There were people taking photos throughout and it was wonderful to received a dropbox file with all photos which included us.  Overall a fantastic, exceptional experience.
Best night out! This was either my 2nd or 3rd tour with XO, will go again if the opportunity arises. Thanks to the young ladies (names escape me) for your hospitality. See you again

This was one of my favorite food tours I’ve ever experienced. The motorbike ride was a really fun way to see the city and I really enjoyed being able to talk to and get to know my driver. The food was incredible and the tour was set up so that there was a history/culture break in between food stops so we could digest. I will be booking with them again next time I’m in Ho Chi Minh City!

We booked the Saigon by night tour. Our guides, Spring and  Nhiên, were so kind and fun. They took such good care of our family. They checked in constantly to make sure our son was comfortable and kept engaging with him and including him in everything. And the food spots they took us to…. Delicious! We wanted to book more tours with them but sadly ran out of time in Saigon. Thank you xo tours! Our night with you was the highlight of our trip.

What a wonderful tour. Jasmine and Ana were amazing, super knowledgeable, heaps of fun, kind and friendly.
We felt super safe on the scooters the whole time and thoroughly enjoyed every minute.
We did the Saigon at Night tour. We have done similar tours in Sapa, Hanoi and Bangkok and this one was easily the best.
Thank you Jasmin, Ana and the XO team.

Well my expectations were not just met, they were totally exceeded from the moment I met my XO superstar Ngoc P. Thanks again Ngoc I had so much fun and still have a smile from the experience....might just be the best part of my month long trip and thats says it all. I would even do it all again.

XO tours is the only tour you should consider. From seeing Saigon from the back of a motorbike (including up alleyways), the local food and to the stops to see Saigon from all angles, XO hit the bullseye. To experience Saigon I reckon it can only be done on the back of a motorbike with a local who gives 110% effort and passion.

I can only recommend the XO tour girls to one and all. Dont hesitate, just do it and book.

We didn’t foodie tour and it was great.
The girls mare extra effort to make our son feel included.
Tour was amazing, food was amazing and the host were exemplary.
If we had more time in HCMC we would be booking more tours.

We chose XO food tours after researching highly rated food tours to try during our stay in Ho Chi Minh city. Our tour was during the evening of 01/09/2026 for about 4 hours.  My wife and I were impressed with the prompt, clear communications with the company during bookings and lead up to the tour. Tour arrangements were seamless, communications prompt, informative and relevant.

Our guides were two exceptional ladies, Hoang and Hang (4). Both ladies arrived punctually, were very well presented, articulate, had great senses of fun and humour and made us feel very comfortable and at ease from first meeting.

Hoang and Hung introduced us to Saigon traffic and the ever present scooters. My wife and I are complete novices on motorbikes but right from the outset felt safe and in good hands thanks to some sound advice and the professionalism of the guides. Before long we were looking around and enjoying the hustle, bustle and sights, smells and sounds of Saigon.

There were 9 guests, 9 guides, a group leader and 3 support gentlemen making up the tour. Tours were exceptionally well organised, food stops were curated to provide an authentic, delicious and varied sample of Vietnamese delights and guests participated in some fun, competitive games.

The vibe throughout the night was one of fun, laughter, great food and beverages and shared experiences.  We saw that all of the XO guides treated their guests like VIP's and went the extra mile to make the tour experience a great one.

The reviews we relied on gave it 5 stars. I would rate the XO food tours higher if I could! Very highly recommended and absolutely worth doing.
Amazing experience! Nicest and most knowledgeable tour guides.

Wonderful experience of Saigon city with the food to match the friendly culinary of what Vietnam has to offer. Our tour guides were extremely careful and safe on the bikes and the knowledge of the city and its connection with food and culture was something I will take back with me to Australia and tell all my friends to make sure they experience this delightful night of fun and laughter

Such an excellent food tour. You will NOT leave hungry. The girls are all great drivers, and know how to put you at ease as they navigate the busy Ho Chi Minh traffic. The food is delicious and plentiful, and off-the-beaten-path. You won't get pho and banh mi, but plenty of other delicious Vietnamese food.

These ladies are professionals. They will make sure you have a great time on your tour.

Excellent experience I would definitely recommend as a solo female traveler ! I have been to places and eaten authentic meals I would not have tried otherwise. Great way to explore the city, local culture and food. Safe and secure driving, entertaining and interesting comments. A must do !

We did this tour in mid August as part of a work conference. There were 18 of us, and it was truly a highlight of our conference. It was really well run, we all felt very comfortable riding around on the bikes, the food was great and the female tour guides lovely and easy to understand. They also kept the night fun with a little friendly competition between us.

I did the XO Sights of Saigon and the XO Saigon by Night tours. They were truly the best way to see Saigon. The morning tour truly brought the history of Viet Nam alive. It was wonderful to understand the significance behind the different styles of buildings etc. It is always amazing to see the places that significant historical events took place and to take a moment to reflect. What I truly love about Viet Nam and its people is there endurance and positivity.  The love the ladies have for their country is obvious and to be honest they made me love the country and its people too.

The XO at night tour was also very good I love walking through fruit and veg markets and they didnt mind explaining what some of the produce was. What I truly loved was they bought some of the different fruits so we could try after our dinner.

I have a severe shellfish allergy and the ladies were absolutely wonderful in both the am and the evening tour to ensure I could safely partake and eat my fill. Go hungry the amount of food was immense and very filling.

In the day tour we also got to try different drinks which was so good. Although I was very sugared out at the end. If you like sweet drinks you will be smiling all the way.

I really loved the home vist to the apartment to see how people tend to live in HCM in Viet Nam and something as incredible as a smooth cement ramp in the staircase for motorbikes was incredible to see I still havent grasped how peoole can drive up and down it without smashing into the wall on the midlanding as that turn is tight.

The ladies themselves are friendly inclusive and take photos for you so you can truly just have a blast and be present in the moment.

One of my faves was definately the Pagoda with all the Buddhas.

The ladies keep a good pace but you dont feel rushed which I appreciated. I must have looked a bit overheated it was hot and no problem. Out comes the best little portable fan.  No comment etc just turned on and quitely given. Those little kindnesses go a long way and my extremely sweaty red face was most thankful for the cooling.

Definatly do these tours there are some hidden gems I would never have known about and would have never seen.

Thanks XO for everything, that was a morning and night of the most treasured memories for me. Thank you for sharing your beautiful Country and City with me I will treasure this experience.

I had a really great time with Uyen and Linh from XO tours and it was my first tour in Vietnam. Amazing hospitality and both were brilliant at their jobs.I absolutely loved roaming on their bikes to the most important places in Vietnam’s History 😌😊😊😊 and learning about what happened and how resilient people were was truly amazing.

Thank you Uyen and Linh 😌😊😊

Tien was the best driver. She easily helped calm my fears. She was funny and energetic, like all of them. The food was amazing. I loved that they all worked together to prepare it. It was nice to go to more local restaurants than super touristy places.  It was just overall an excellent tour!  I highly recommend this company over others. It is worth every penny.

What a life changing tour! The city tour was such an amazing experience. The women were so accommodating, fun, and friendly, and took us around so many different districts that we would never have visited otherwise. You get to try food and drinks along the way and truly get a feel for how Vietnamese people live. Would recommend this tour to anyone!!

This all girl tour company is awesome!! They were fun informative and very capable and safe drivers !! My driver Happy was very friendly and talked a lot about culture in Vietnam which was fantastic!! The tour leader Yin was fun and also informative! There were 10 others on our tour group which made it also a fun experience The food was delicious and so much of it !! We enjoyed the tour so much and highly recommend it Thank you XO Tours
I did this tour with my daughter, we chose the Saigon by night tour and it was absolutely awesome. We really got a better feel of actual life in Saigon. Well worthwhile doing.

Such a fun and memorable evening on the Saigon Food Tour with the XO girls!! My driver Vy was such a badass and a sweetheart all at once, and same for my Mom’s driver ♥️ We felt super safe the entire time, and the food was just incredibly tasty! We loved the little stroll in the Chinatown market, the little games during dinner, and all the great information about the culture and history of Saigon on the way.
I would absolutely recommend this tour and this company to anyone interested in eating local, tasty dishes and share great moments with amazing people.

Thank you XO tours, thank you Vy, gặp lại sau em gái của chị ♥️

From our booking to following up with photos after the tour, XO were amazing.
I have been on a motorcycle food tour before and this and it was quite different.  We got to see a lot of Saigon on the bigger roads which was great.  The other food tour I did was more restricted and we seemed to spend more time in little side streets.
The food was delicious at each stop although I did feel that the emphasis was on seafood which was a little overwhelming if you aren’t a big seafood eater.
The highlight of this tour is absolutely the tour guides.  They are beautiful people who shared an amazing knowledge of their home including food, customs and way of life.  Their enthusiasm for meeting new people and putting their customers at ease on the bikes was first class.

What an amazing tour!   The Saigon by Night tour was definitely the highlight of our time in Ho Chi Min.   Myself, my husband and our 13 year old son!   The ladies amazing ladies treated us to a wonderful ride, amazing food and markets and especially the tour of a family apartment.   Our next trip to HCM we will definitely do one of their other tours.
Best trip ever!! Everybody was so so nice! Traditional Saigon in a few hours!

We did the Saigon by night tour with XO Tours and it was totally amazing and definitely worth the money. It was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam and we cannot thank the girls enough.

We went to areas and places we would never have visited or even found on our own and we got to taste some culinary delights and visit the XO founder’s apartment that she grew up in.

I had been watching all the blogs posted by the XO girls for months before we got to Vietnam so I was excited to finally meet them in person. They did not disappoint and were knowledgeable, made us feel very safe and were as lovely, funny and friendly as I had hoped they would be!

Do yourselves a favour and do a tour with XO Tours - you will be forever glad you did 🫶

Just a wonderful experience of inner city sights and taste’s. The travel guides were very knowledgeable and friendly and I would choose this tour over others which some were very disappointing and lacking.

An amazing experience in Saigon! My driver Han was so safe, informative, and friendly. The food spots were delicious and definitely introduced us to new Vietnamese dishes and other districts. Thank you also to Yen our tour lead. Would recommend to anybody visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

I have just done my second tour with the girls and it was great fun!!! My tour guide May did a fantastic job, she was very informative and good fun! I highly recommend using XO tours as a different way to see Ho Chi Minh City.

We only had one full day in Saigon and I’m so glad we did this tour. We got to see so much of the city and try foods that we never would have found or ordered on our own. The guides were very kind and shared a lot of great information about the city. Highly recommend!

An absolute 10/10 experience! I booked the XO Foodie Tour and it was hands down the best street food and motorbike tour I’ve ever experienced.From the moment they picked me up at the Caravelle Hotel, everything was incredibly professional and seamless. The female drivers dressed in beautiful traditional Ao Dai were not only amazing hosts but also highly skilled, safe, and confident riders in HCMC’s traffic.The food was top-notch—premium, hygienic, and entirely all-you-can-eat with an amazing variety of local seafood and street delicacies. The tour took us beyond the tourist spots into real local districts, giving a true taste of the city's culture.The organization was perfect, the vibes were fantastic, and the entire team was so warm and welcoming. If you are visiting Ho Chi Minh City, this tour is a must-do. Absolute value for money and a premium experience from start to finish. Thank you XO Tours for an unforgettable night!

I went on the evening food tour and I I absolutely will recommend it to everyone I know coming to Ho Chi Minh City. They provide a really local experience and teach you a lot about Vietnam and it’s culture along the way. They are also fantastic at catering for dietaries. I don’t eat seafood and any time seafood was on offer for the other guests they provided me with my own custom meal.

Plus you get a one on one motorbike guide that makes you immediately feel at ease. I was very nervous to get on a bike for the first time and now I take them everywhere. I was also a solo female traveler but I felt so safe the whole time and met some really great people on the tour.

I am sure all of the guides are great but I had Han and if you get her as your guide I think you will consider yourself very lucky! She has been so accommodating, even going as far as to text me personalized recommendations for the rest of my trip.

The street food tour was awesome! After seeing the traffic in HCMC the idea of riding around town on a scooter is a little terrifying. Our guides were great drivers. Out of all of our experiences in the city this was our favorite. Also the guides here spoke the best English (advance conversational level) compared to any other interactions we had during our trip. The food spots they chose were delicious. If we had more time we would book them, for the other tours they offer.

We went on the XO Foodie tour on 9 August and had the most amazing time. The weather started off a bit wet but it didn’t stop us or the girls from having a great time. The tour is so excellently run. The girls are all amazing and the laughs and fun we shared on the bikes and at all our stops made it such a memorable experience, The food is amazing and the places we stopped were so good. The knowledge of Vietnamese life is an added bonus and getting out of the tourist areas to experience local Saigon life is what sets this tour apart from others. It’s well worth the price and we’d have no hesitation recommending XO Tours to anyone heading to Vietnam. Thanks to Sunny and the girls for an adventure we’ll never forget. Even the duck egg!! 😊

For the last couple years I've been following XO Tours on instagram, and they absolutely live up to their claim of being the best motorbike tour in vietnam. I loved the foodie tour so much in fact, I booked their Saigon by Night and Sights of Saigon tours aswell. The guides are all well educated on the history of the locations you visit, and the food spots you go to are so delicious you'll want to go back on your own time.

I think the best part of the tours is how personal it feels, with each guest having their own personal driver who will accompany you in the markets and some food stalls. All of my drivers were very conversational, and the guides were very engaging with questions during the tour, keeping me interested the whole time. It never felt like I was just standing around getting talked at, it was always a conversation.

The itinerary for each tour is packed with interesting locations, delicious food/snacks, and rich history. Despite being such a full itinerary, it never felt rushed or crammed. You will have time at every stop to breathe and take in the sights.

Most of the spots you visit are outside of the main tourist areas, and you'll actually get to experience and see true local life. This is especially highlighted in the Saigon by Night tour, where you will visit a local home, meet the couple that lives there, and learn the history of that home. However, every tour gives you a taste of real local life. I personally loved being able to view the streets of Saigon on the back of the notorbike, it really gives the city a whole new perspective.

XO Tours has absolutely earned their 5 star rating and I highly recommend it for anyone visiting Saigon, even if it's not your first time.

We absolutely loved the foodie tour with XO Tours! A special shout-out to Chi, Anh & Dung, who drove us around Saigon on their scooters for more than four hours, taking us to some fantastic local food spots. Their team leader, Sunny, was also great. They were all incredibly friendly, attentive and full of interesting information about the food, the city and local life.

I’ve done a foodie tour with another company in Saigon before. It was cheaper, but honestly, it wasn’t great. They took me to places serving food that you can easily find in Sydney, Australia. At one point, I actually told them, “I’ve had better Bánh mì and Phở in Sydney!” 😂 Not exactly what you want to hear on a food tour in Vietnam!

XO Tours costs a little more, but it is absolutely worth it. The food was much more interesting and varied, with plenty of seafood, fresh fruit, local dishes and, of course, beer... because apparently eating your way around Saigon is thirsty work. 🍻😂

The girls were fantastic and made us feel welcome from start to finish. It was a great way to explore Saigon, eat some seriously good food and discover places we definitely wouldn’t have found on our own.

I highly recommend the XO Tours foodie tour. I’ll definitely be trying some of their other tours next time I’m in Saigon — although knowing how good the food was, I might just end up doing this one again!

Thanks again, Chi, Anh, Dung & Sunny, for an awesome evening and a very full stomach! 😆

One of the best things we did on our trip to Vietnam and probably the best tour I've ever been on!! The woman running this tour are knowledgeable, safe drivers, wonderful facilitators, funny, warm, talented, and lovely to spend time with! I enjoyed talking with my guide as we drove around on our scooter and got to see different districts in Saigon. It is also VERY exhilarating be driven around on the scooters!

The food was incredible and well-paced, although because the first soup was so delicious and I ate it all, I was very full by the end. The portions are good in the second and third food stops, adapted to the fact that you've been eating more. We tried fresh local fruits, all kinds of different meats and seafood (some freshly grilled for us by our guides), etc. I tried everything and everything was DELICIOUS.

I really appreciated the commentary on life in Saigon/HCMC these days, what gentrification and inequality looks like, and how the Vietnamese people are adapting to these realities. I always appreciate some real talk and Sunny (our leader) did a great job of balancing more difficult topics with a lighthearted tour -- this is hard to do and I really admire how she navigated the conversation. She and the other guides are rock stars! Do this tour, you will not regret it!! !

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My brother and I had such a great time on the XO Foodie Tour in Ho Chi Minh City! The whole experience was incredibly fun and a great way to explore the city while trying lots of delicious Vietnamese food.

Trinh and Yen, thank you for being our guides, caretakers, scooter racers, and friends for the evening. I really do hope that fate somehow has you visiting Los Angeles so we can repay the favor.

For those wondering, “Which tour do I take?” I have your answer. XO.

This is a wonderful, woman-owned company. Yes, we ate amazing food and drank to our hearts' content, but I’d be doing a disservice to those deciding what to do if I didn’t explain why XO is the right tour, beyond just the food.

We explored Saigon. Its history. It’s people. It’s architecture—the stories of those people, and wonderfully, our guides. The women of Vietnam are amazing with each on their own personal journey and blending of an ancient culture and modern world.

We heard about their backgrounds from the rural areas. The mountains, for one. The Mekong Delta for the other. Their dreams, stories, hopes, and dreams. It was beyond beautiful. But it’s easy to tell stories, you feel that they want to know ours. Who we were. What we did back home. What we thought of their country and the city we explored. At the end, we wanted more so much so that we will return.

If I have to pick a favorite spot we ate at, it would be Mafia Town (district 4, if I remember correctly) and the amazing seafood. It was beyond cool to be with the locals and see them just be together. All that said, I’d say the best was being on the scooter and having great discussions with Trinh. My wife felt the same about Yen. Their personal friendship, smiles, laughter, and overall joy in their own experiences left me…fulfilled. Corny, I know, but I’m left with tears in my eyes as I write this and remember.

To those who come next to this great experience, enjoy! Embrace it with everything you’ve got. You will not be disappointed. I’m jealous.

Trinh, Yen and the entire XO family. A million thanks. May you enjoy long life and wealth.

If you’re in Ho Chi Minh City and you don’t do a night scooter tour with XO Tours, you’re missing the city entirely. This wasn’t a tour, it was an immersion and one of the best things we did in Vietnam.

Within minutes, you’re on the back of a scooter, slipping like a fish into the vast shoal of scooters and traffic that feels like chaos and choreography at the same time.

And the riders? Absolutely fabulous. Smart, funny, stylish, completely in command of their bikes and their city. There’s something quietly radical about an all-female team doing this with such confidence and flair - not as a statement, just as a fact. We talked about everything from food to relationships to life in Vietnam, and it never felt like a script. Just real conversation, real connection, and a lot of laughter. You don’t feel like a customer. You feel like you’ve been temporarily adopted by a group of brilliant women.

My guide (who patiently fastened my helmet every single time) carried me through the city like I belonged there.

And then it opens up.

A local market with no tourists. Chinatown alive with stories. Street food I wouldn’t have known how to find in a million years. Drinks that were gloriously, unapologetically too sweet.

But the real moment, and the one I’ll never forget, was visiting Tiny Uncle's small apartment, once home to 14 people. Every inch of space negotiated, every surface used. And yet, we were welcomed with water, seats, and genuine warmth. No performance. Just life, shared.

On the way in, our guide quietly helped an elderly man who’d run out of fuel. No fuss. No drama. Just kindness as a reflex. And that’s what XO Tours does differently. They don’t just show you a pretty version of HCMC, they show you a real one. Complex, generous, resilient, and alive.

I laughed, I learned, I nearly cried, and yes, I sang Born to be Wild on the back of a scooter in Saigon traffic.

Unforgettable.

Do it!

The part time drivers primary purpose is to drive you around, but they are not tour guides themselves. This is not the case for XO. XO was also more detailed oriented with asking for our passport info to register for insurance. This did not happened with other tours I joined. Basically, it's one of those you get what you pay for kinda thing. Other tours are not necessarily going to provide you a bad experience perse, but with XO you are much more likely to get a good experience because they are doing everything properly.
All in all, if you're clueless about Saigon and are overwhelmed by the amount of info out there like I was, try booking the XO Tours. More than that, one of the rewarding parts in traveling in my opinion is the privilege to have others share their stories with you. We had a blast talking with Như and Uyên throughout the tour I think we actually went over the scheduled tour time? 😂 Obviously I wouldn't do the same tour again if the itinerary is identical, but I definitely would look at other XO Tours themselves if I found myself back in Saigon again and you should too.

A Must-Do Culinary Adventure!

If you are looking for an unforgettable way to experience the heart and soul of Vietnam, look no further than XO Foodie Tours. This wasn't just a food tour; it was a deep dive into the rich culture and history of the city, led by a team that is clearly passionate about what they do.

The Food
The selection of stops was incredible. They took us to hidden gems we never would have discovered on our own, including:
• Bánh Canh Ghẹ BÀ DUYÊN Hùng Vương: Absolute perfection in a bowl.
• Quán Ốc Ngọc & Ốc Loan: These spots offered some of the freshest and most flavorful seafood/shellfish dishes we've ever tasted.

The Expertise
Our tour leader and brand ambassador, Thy, was phenomenal. Her knowledge is vast—she didn't just tell us what we were eating; she explained the "why" behind it. We learned so much about the wet market in Chinatown and the fascinating economic contrast in the districts with luxury apartments. Her insights into the city’s development and economic factors added a layer of education we didn't expect but truly appreciated.

The Atmosphere
The energy was high from start to finish thanks to Nhi and Huong. They are expert hosts who ensured there was never a dull moment. They kept us laughing with ice-breaker games, and even after losing a particularly competitive round of the "peanut chopsticks game," they kept those huge smiles on their faces!

Verdict
XO Foodie Tours provides a perfect balance of education, adventure, and pure fun. You’ll leave with a full stomach and a much deeper understanding of Vietnamese life. Huge thanks to Thy, Nhi, and Huong for making this the highlight of our trip!

XO tour was so cool. The food stops were delicious and there is nothing like cruising around Saigon at night on a motorbike. Our guides Thao and Heiu were charming and knowledgeable, also great drivers!
Great experience, delicious food, and beautiful sites. The drivers were so awesome, knowledgeable, and fun!!

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié ce tour pour la qualité de son équipe , son  dynamisme  et son professionnalisme.  Ce circuit nous a permis de découvrir Saigon autrement . What a great company. I did two tours, a half day tour to see a bit more of Saigon in the morning and an evening food tour and I would do them both again. I can't say enough good things about this experience. The XO ladies are an absolute delight! My food tour with XO was my favorite experience in Saigon. Well organized, professional, fun and memorable. We had the most amazing experience on XO's Foodie Tour. We opted for the private tour and I am so glad we did. Small group of 5 of us and 5 drivers, making it easy to get to know each of the drivers. Look no further for you scooter tour - go with XO!

I just finished my tour (Feb.14, 2026) and could not wait to write this review. This tour of Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City was absolutely awesome. I had a great experience to look at Saigon By Night lead by XO.

Thank you
We had a fantastic evening with the girls from Xo Tours. We absolutely loved the Saigon by Night tour and can't recommend it enough. It's definitely an experience worth doing.

This was one of the best evenings I have ever had!  The tour was amazing. We had incredible food, great group, super energy and I learned quite a few things. This is a woman operated business and it was perfect. Everything was done well and well done. Could not have been better and I will do this again next time I am in HCMC. Thank you XO!!!

This tour has been the highlight of our holiday in Vietnam. Love from Gary & Debra
I highly recommend this tour for anyone who is looking for a really fun and informative way to learn about Saigon and experience some wonderful food. The guides are simply amazing!!

Had an amazing experience with XO Tours! We did the Saigon by Night tour and loved every second of it. Fabulous! On all levels. My wife and I had so much fun whilst learning about Saigon and its people and culture.

This tour was incredible! All the guides were so welcoming and knowledgeable. We got to experience a lot of the city on scooters, toured a night market, ate amazing food, and got to see how people live in this amazing city. I highly recommended this tour!!

Did the tour a couple of hours after I arrived in Saigon. I did the food tour which also included to go to different districts. It’s perfect. Perfect initiation to the city. Highly recommend, save space for the last stop.

Excellent all around. We did the foodie tour and could not have been more happy. The guides were amazing and friendly. Highly recommend.

We did this tour on recommendation from a family member. It was an absolutely fabulous experience. One of the best tours you can do in vietnam!! Everything about this company is fabulous. We had an amazing foodie tour with XO Tours. More than just a food tour, this should be listed as a life requirement on anyone's list if you are looking to experience Ho Chi Minh and Vietnam! Best bang-for-buck activity ever! Thank you so much for letting me join & will make a point to do this again!

Amazing tour! Personal tour guide who took us around many places to try so many different dishes. It was great to be driven around and to areas that we wouldn’t have gone to without a local guide. All of the food was delicious!

XO Tours was an early highlight of our Vietnam trip. The guides were friendly and informative (and great fun all around), and the food we tried on the tour was great. They even organised a cake at the end for us once they found out we were on our honeymoon. Fully recommend :D

Cette excursion a été l’une des meilleures que nous ayons faites à Saïgon — si ce n’est la meilleure, et même l’une des expériences les plus marquantes de tout notre voyage au Vietnam.

Ce tour a aussi été l’occasion de découvrir Saïgon à scooter, au cœur d’une ville de près de 9 millions d’habitants et des millions de scooters. Être accompagné dans ce flot impressionnant, en toute confiance, par des pilotes exclusivement féminines, a rendu l’expérience à la fois unique, sécurisante et incroyablement inspirante.

Nous avons vécu une vraie connexion avec la culture locale, mais surtout avec les personnes qui nous ont accompagnés. Ces jeunes femmes nous ont fait découvrir Saïgon à travers des districts dans lesquels nous ne serions jamais allés par nous-mêmes. Cela nous a permis de comprendre que Saïgon ne se résume absolument pas au district 1, bien au contraire.

Côté gastronomie, ce fut une succession de surprises : nous avons goûté des plats que nous n’aurions jamais osé commander seuls… et nous les avons dévorés tant tout était délicieux.

Ce tour a également été un magnifique moment de partage avec d’autres voyageurs internationaux venus d’Espagne, de Singapour et d’Australie, ce qui a encore enrichi les échanges et l’ambiance.

Découvrir Saïgon à travers le regard des Vietnamiens, entendre leurs récits et leurs parallèles sur l’évolution du pays, de son histoire à ses transformations actuelles, a donné une profondeur rare à cette expérience.

Sur les quinze jours de notre voyage — de Ben Tre à Can Tho, Phu My Tho, Hanoï et Ho Chi Minh Ville — ce tour a été de loin l’expérience la plus forte en termes d’émotions, de partage et d’humanité.

Un moment joyeux, festif, instructif et profondément humain, que nous garderons gravé très longtemps dans nos mémoires.

👉 À faire sans hésiter. Réservez sans la moindre hésitation.
Nous ne pouvons qu’encourager chacune et chacun à réserver ce tour de découverte de Saïgon, de nuit, autour de la street food, tant il est exceptionnel.
Une expérience précieuse, authentique et inoubliable 💛

This food tour was so fun, and had so much good food! This was the only chance we had to ride around on scooters during our trip, and it was awesome to see the city from that vantage point. I liked that the whole thing wasn't just stuffing us with food- we ate a little, explored a little, ate some more, and it was perfect.

We had an amazing night with XO Tours, chaperoned by Jun & Julie. Having spent a few days in HCM City and being amazing by the scooters it was equal parts thrilling and terrifying to get on one. Once on, you feel incredibly safe and see the city in a whole new light.

Tried some lovely dishes, and could rest easy knowing they were safe to eat. Go with an empty stomach as there is no shortage of food!

Amongst the food you learn about 5 of the districts you visit, what makes them distinct, both from a history and food perspective.

Highly recommend
An absolute highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. Ngoc and the girls were amazing.

Amazing & Personal.  The XO team were fun, full of energy and so proud to share their personal side of Saigon.  We met some awesome locals, visited their homes and shared wonderful food.  We left with a fondness for the people of Viet Nam you don’t get from most tours.

May my guide picked me up at my hotel. She was super friendly,  knowledgeable and a great driver. She was also early! Which I loved. Her knowledge of history and navigating the streets of HMC was excellent!

Had the best time with Cam/Giang Ho and the girls. This is a really special tour and would recommend it to anyone (regardless of gender) who wants to explore the city but especially good for women. All the drivers are superstars and the stops/added extras the team go to are so lovely.
Fantastic tour with the gorgeous ladies, had so much fun and food was fabulous, great tour

This was a great experience and chance to see the real Ho Chi Minh City and learn about the people and culture.
The tour was well organised and the girls were very knowledgeable, fun and polite.

A friend suggested this tour to get a feel for Vietnam and we were not disappointed.  We really enjoyed our first night in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh) riding around on the back of vespas behind three very knowledgeable and friendly guides.  Nga, Lam and Binh were excellent hosts and clearly had a great understanding of how to make international guests feel welcome in their city.  We felt safe throughout the tour and enjoyed a range of local cuisine whilst getting an idea of the layout and topography of the different districts in the city.  Would definitely recommend this tour for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Amazing tour, a highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh City. The tour takes you off the beaten path to the places outside of normal tourist areas. It is designed to show very different sides of the city - from the old historical parts to the high-end expensive neighborhoods to the night market in Chinatown.

The food is also a not the standard combination of Pho and Banh Mi, but rather things you would not see in an average Vietnamese restaurant outside of Vietnam. From different soups to BBQ to seafood to snails and other exotic dishes (if you are brave enough to try them :)

The guides are very experienced drivers. We were somewhat anxious to take the tour on a scooter, after seeing how crazy the Saigon's traffic is, but we felt completely safe after a couple of meetings of driving. It is actually an attraction by itself to experience the traffic from within.

The organization of the tour is top notch. At every stop there was a person waiting and helping with the scooters, the was never any wait time in the restaurants. Everything moved as a well-oiled machine.

The routes are also very well designed, taking you through the night Saigon full of lights and night life. The time on the backseat of the scooter was actually more magical than the food tasting itself.

Overall, one of the best tours I've taken in my life. Lots of thanks to our wonderful drivers and to the tour organizers. Highly recommend!

We went on the XO Foodie Tour on 2 Jan. The 4.5 hours whizzed by so quickly as we were brought around 5 districts in HCMC with stops for tasting local food and for sightseeing. Through the hard work and effort of Ngoc Tran (Nora as we call her) and her team, we saw the different 'faces' of HCMC- in one moment, we are in a noisy, crowded wet market overflowing with fresh fruits and live poultry. In another instance, we are in a quiet, clean and posh residential area with a huge park and waterfront. The tour guides are amazing- they are always engaging you in conversation while riding their bikes and navigating the infamous traffic conditions! Just trust them and enjoy the experience!
10/10 experience! We loved seeing so much of Ho Chi Minh by scooter and trying amazing food. XO Tours is both professional and fun and I can’t recommend the experience enough!

We’ve just come back from our incredible holiday across Vietnam and we can certainly say that the XO Foodie tour in Saigon was a highlight of our trip.  This tour was super special. What is great about this night was the opportunity to see other less accessible Districts and to learn from the locals about what makes this city fantastic.

100% recommend this for any visiting tourist to maximize your experience in this wonderful country!
Amazing experience! Well organised, delicious food, fantastic tour guides with great banter

I have done many food tours across the world so when I was doing some research about the vietnam food tours, I came across XO tours. Had a really enjoyable tour with XO tours, the food was really tasty and the guides were all very kind. We got to try a variety of really interesting dishes that I wouldn't have been able to try just traveling on my own. I'm really glad I joined this tour.

We did a tour with XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City and it was excellent. The company is run entirely by women, which gives the experience a distinctive character. Each guest rides on the back of a motorbike with a driver, navigating the busy streets of Saigon. It is exciting and feels safe throughout.

The tour combines street food, local restaurants, and clear explanations of Vietnamese culture, daily life, and the city’s history. We tried a wide range of dishes and learned why they matter, not just what they are. The guides were knowledgeable, organised, and easy to talk to.

Moving through the city, stopping to eat, and listening to stories about Saigon made this one of the best ways to understand the city in a short time.

My family and I had a fantastic time on XO Tours! It was such an incredible way to see the city, and eat a lot of delicious food. Our family loved the city sights and night food tour-they were the highlights of our time in Vietnam!

We had a great time on the tour! We went with our 6 year old and our drivers Chi & Tran were great with him. The food was great and we learned a bit about the city. Definitely recommended for kids and grownups alike!

We booked 2 tours with XO Tours all in one day on our first day in Vietnam. We thought it was best to immerse ourselves and learn about the culture from Day 1. Just an amazing experience. While riding a moped in HCMC is an intense experience, it was also thrilling and the drivers gave me confidence.

The food was great, as I expected. I hadn’t expected the tour guide to be so insightful on non-food cultural topics! Ours was Hong. She was super engaging and informative about the Vietnamese economy,
Such an amazing tour! My husband and I did this food tour and everything was great. Highly recommend

Our family agreed this was the absolute highlight of our 2.5 weeks in Vietnam! Absolutely highly recommend this tour to see different parts of Saigon and taste less known and delicious Vietnamese dishes. You’ll go home exhilarated and with very full bellies!

This was the highlight of HoChi Minh for my 2 sons and I. We did the Sights of Saigon on New Years Eve! It was awesome seeing sights we may not have seen had we explored on our own or heard about the history without Phuong. All the guides were friendly and welcoming.
Thank you for a wonderful experience and the photos will be remembered with fondness!

This was the up there for one of the best thing we've done in Vietnam.  We just got to Ho Chi Minh and had this booked.   The girls are amazing fun and great knowledge.
