This tour combines so many wonderful elements that help you discover the true Saigon. Hong and her team pick you up from your hotel and whisk you safely through the busy Saigon streets.  You sample treats from authentic markets and experience a locals perspective! I cannot say enough good things. This tour was my favorite experience of my trip!  Book now: thank me later!

An absolute must! An incredible way to see the city at night and try out some local dishes. The guides do a great job at making it a fun and social environment. It’s so nice to talk with your driver as you drive around the city.
Our eight-year-old daughter called this tour "the best night of her life," and we and our son (who is six) were equally delighted. Would heartily recommend!

Absolutely incredible experience — hands down the best tour in Vietnam.

The food was phenomenal, the pacing was great, and every stop felt thoughtfully chosen rather than touristy. Riding through the city at night, sampling dishes we never would’ve found on our own, and learning the stories behind the food made this tour truly special.

Giang and the entire team were outstanding — warm, knowledgeable, fun, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They made us feel completely taken care of while still giving us an authentic, local experience. You can tell they love their city and love sharing it. Could not recommend XO Tours more highly.
The tour was very nice and the guides were awesome! It was a perfect ending for our trip to Vietnam

My guide (Linh) and driver (Becky) were both amazing. This was the highlight of my Vietnam holiday. I’ve never been on a motorbike ever and it was so much fun and I felt safe the whole time. I would highly recommend this company !
It was great! The girls were super and learned us about the culture in Vietnam. It was a great way to see Saigons different districts and fun to go by motorbike.

Tran, Taylor 30th December 2025. I would highly recommend XO Food tours to anyone. I felt safe the entire time and the food was amazing. It was amazing to have someone with you on a 1 on 1 basis the entire time and to be able to explain everything. We had so much fun!!

Foodie tour with Thu4 on 30 December
Good tour, highly recommend!

My two boys and I had a fantastic experience on the XO food tour and I’d do it again. We were greeted at our hotel by the courteous guides who drove us away in their motorbikes, expertly handling the chaotic traffic and always making sure we were comfortable. Trying the different foods was so interesting, but honestly the fun part was zipping around in different areas of the city we would never have seen. Will always remember this tour with my family.

This was a great tour. My tour guide, Khloe, was amazing. She really looked after me and gave me loafs of information about HCMC. I'm a pescaterian, and was accommodated to the fullest. I would definitely recommend the tour to my friends and family.
Foodie tour with Thu4 on 29th Dec was wonderful. She was a great driver and very friendly. Food was amazing and the group was fun. Highly recommend this tour.
Great tour - friendly and knowledgeable young women drivers, tasty food, interesting info

XO Foodie Tour on 26th December 2025
After a lot of research on which were the best things to do in HCM city, this XO Foodie Tour stood out the most in almost all must-do activities. And without a doubt, it was an amazing experience. We had the most memorable and delicious tour that one can ask for. The highlights were the 5 key stops they make during the tour - 2 sight seeing and 3 food stops (and my favourite was the barbecue stop where the beef and goat were superb). But, what makes the tour a stand out is the warmth, friendliness, hospitality and courtesy of the local guide rider who takes you pillion on her motorbike. I was paired with my rider Tran who was an amazing person, very knowledgeable, very helpful and also very passionate.
Would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon and must ask for Tran as your tour guide 😊

Going on an XO Tour was the HIGHLIGHT of my Vietnam trip. I loved every bit of it -- riding on the back of a motorbike, getting to know my tour guide, learning about the people, the history, the culture, and trying different foods/snacks. This is an experience beyond any of the other tours my group went on. XO is the tour group that I will recommend to anyone traveling to HCMC.

XO tours gave us a memorable ride around Saigon with excellent food stops.    My GPS recorded 22 miles of cycling through multiple districts, starting and ending at our hotel.  Two of my friends were hesitant about bike safety but were soon at ease with the safe driving and skills these women exhibit.    While riding and eating, we learned so much about Vietnamese life from their life stories.  Our evening was during some downtime during a Viking river cruise and was definitely a highlight of our 3 week trip.   I highly recommend to others.

I did the XO Foodie tour on December 16th 2025, and I have to say that this tour is a MUST do in Ho Chi Minh. Dieu came and picked me up from my hotel, and she was so sweet, gave me a great breakdown of the night and safety notes for the bike as well. I had the best time, and really appreciated that we went to places in various districts and got to try so many types of food. Everything was delicious and I was so full at the end of the night. The lead guide Giang was also very knowledgeable and brought great energy throughout the night. I attended the tour as a solo traveller, but really felt included. Dieu and I had great conversations and she gave me great insight into everything. I am grateful Dieu was my guide, she really made my experience way better then I imagined! I also really enjoyed the bike ride and being able to see the city this way as well. I also appreciated the little booklet they gave us at the end of the night with various recommendations and some key Vietnamese words and phrases. They also shared the pictures that were taken throughout the night with us, which was a nice touch. I could not stop telling my friends and family about this tour and definitely recommend it to any one that wants to try a bunch of yummy food and of course to all foodies! Thanks again Dieu and XO Tours! Sally
Fantastic tour. Everything was perfectly arranged. My tour guide Linh and driver Vy were outstanding. This is the best historical tour of HCM City you can ever have.

Found this tour while looking for things to do on Reddit, this definitely did not disappoint! Was a fun little way to explore HCM city on motorbikes and learn some cultural facts along the way! The group and all the employees were a ton of fun and added another great layer to the night. I came with my friend on 24/12/25 and my guide for the night was Tran. She was absolutely lovely and answered all of my questions as we moved on through the night. Would recommend to any of my friends!

XO Tours delivered one of the best experiences I had in Ho Chi Minh City! This women-led initiative pairs you with local women who take you around the city on their bikes, and it was absolutely fantastic.

I opted for the vegetarian food tour and was blown away by the variety. We started with delicious vegetarian phở chay, followed by an amazing array of dishes including lotus stems, sautéed greens, and with mung bean rolls. Everything was paired with plenty of local bia from Tiger and Saigon - the perfect way to experience the local drinking culture!

Our route took us through fascinating neighborhoods, including the local Koreatown area and bustling food markets. Our bikers were incredibly friendly, professional, and made us feel completely safe through the evening. You can tell they genuinely loved sharing their city and culture with visitors.😊🇻🇳

This tour gave us exactly what we were hoping for: authentic local cuisine, real cultural immersion, and the chance to connect with local people. It was a highlight of my trip.

Highly, highly recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting HCMC who wants to experience the city like a local!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

From the moment we were picked up from our hotel, our guides were super friendly and accommodating. Very outgoing personalities which made the experience so much better. Incredible food and a very fun night, absolutely recommend!

My family and I did the Saigon by Night tour with XO. We didn't really know what to expect and my parents were a bit scared of going in the Saigon traffic on bikes. It turned out to be a really worthwhile, safe and fun experience and a personal highlight of our trip.
Our drivers, Ai, Truc, Y and Phung were lovely and very easy to talk to. They made us feel very safe on the bikes. Ai was out tour leader and did a great job at teaching us all about the culture and different districts throughout the city.
We had a delicious dinner and XO was very accommodating of my mum's allergies which was appreciated.
Highly recommend this tour :)

Had the most incredible time on the XO foodie tour!! My brother and I went on the tour on the 18th of December and could not recommend it more! The food was unbelievably good and not your typical tourist food, the motorbike tour around the city was incredibly beautiful but most of all the girls were such amazing guides! They really made the experience a 10/10 and went above and beyond for us. Chi and Diem2 in particular were so wonderful! From beginning to end they were so much fun, such great guides and really made this the best food tour my brother and I have ever been on. They were so attentive, had answers for all of our questions, taught us so much about Vietnamese food and culture and were so much fun! If you’re in Ho Chi Minh this is a tour that you do not want to miss!

Paul was our guide, he has been amazing with explaining us parts of the history along with describing the food we were eating. His English is amazing and we had so many laughs!! I would 10/10 recommend having Paul as your tour guide. Thank you so much Paul and team!!

Amazing tour! Our tour guides Ngoc and Ly were absolutely wonderful. We learnt many fun facts about Vietnam and so five different districts of Ho Chi Minh. Doing it on a bike in the traffic makes it so much more authentic.

Just walked in the door from this tour, in an absolute food coma, overcome with joy for this amazing tour. My husband and I are visiting Vietnam for our honeymoon and a friend recommended this tour, saying it was the best thing they did while visiting the city and the tour did not disappoint. It made us fall in love with Ho Chi Minh City. My guide Thanh was the loveliest, kindest tour guide for the night. It was my first time on a motorbike and she made me feel safe and excited the whole night. Please please please do yourself a favor and go on this tour!

It was so fantastic! I had this great guide called Chi, she was so awesome, full of amazing energy, had so many fun and interesting stories to share in perfect english that made all the food and driving even more incredible. Can't recommend highly enough!

One of the BEST experiences I’ve ever had in all of my travel! Hong and her team have developed such an amazing and fun tour experience. I was a solo traveler and they put so much thought into seating other solo travelers together, and focusing on details ensure we got to know each other. My driver Mina was absolutely amazing and was so kind and intelligent when it came to explaining things about the city to me! This tour is absolutely perfect!
Very friendly, educational, and overall fantastic for travellers looking to see more of Vietnam’s capital

This tour was one of our best experiences in Ho Chi Minh and a great way to taste local food. I went with my boyfriend and both of our drivers (Han and Lin) were friendly, knowledgable and made the experience one to remember.

Make sure you come hungry! You get loads of food and drink included and an opportunity to try many different local dishes. It is also a great way to learn about Vietnamese culture and the girls are happy to answer any questions.  There are even some fun games!! I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting the city!

As a family ( Dad + 3 boys- 20 ,17 &12yrs) we did the Saigon at night tour and it was excellent.  We saw a side of the city we would never have seen by ourselves. You get a real feel of how the locals live , eat and commune .  The tour guides were amazing and we always felt safe , we learnt lots along the way and were always entertained.  I would highly recommend the XO tour to anyone visiting  Ho Chi Minh City, preferably do it early in your stay as you get lots of shopping and eating tips from the girls who run the tour. My boys and I will remember this special experience for ever. Thank you XO girls!
Absolutely exceeded our expectations - super energy from our guides and very entertaining throughout!

One of the absolute highlights of our trip to Vietnam, on our second night in HCMC. Our guides were so informative and enthusiastic about their culture and food. We had such a fun time riding through the outer districts of the city and learning about Vietnamese food and way of life. Felt really safe as well, despite the traffic.

Worth the money! I did the foodie tour with Thu4 on 19 Dec and it was awesome. The drivers serve as your own personal tour guide in addition to the overall group guide leader, and they were all so friendly and knowledgeable! I really appreciated that the tour took us to many different non-touristy parts of the city to eat a lot of lesser-known and tasty foods. As a solo traveler it was awesome to have that one on one connection with my driver, which really made it all the more enjoyable. I learned a lot from her! I highly recommend doing the foodie tour with them.

I booked the Saigon by Night tour with XO Tours and had an excellent experience. The tour was conducted by Miss Trang and covered multiple districts, provided clear insights into Vietnamese culture, food, and local traditions.
Miss Trang demonstrated strong knowledge, clear communication, and a genuine passion for sharing the city’s story. The experience went beyond sightseeing and offered meaningful context about everyday life in Saigon. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an authentic and well-structured evening experience in Ho Chi Minh City.
Couldn't recommend the Saigon Food Tour with XO Tours enough. The girls were fun, helpful, insightful, and the food was absolutely delicious. Our favourite experience during our time in HCMC

The XO Foodie tour was easily one of the highlights of my trip. It felt very authentic because they actually take you out to explore different districts instead of just staying in the touristy District 1. It was actually drizzling right from the start during hotel pickup, but the team was totally prepared and it didn’t dampen the mood at all.

There was so much variety in the food and everything was incredible, but the staff really made the experience. My guide, Khloe, was an absolute gem - she was professional, easy to talk to, and constantly checked in on me to make sure I was doing okay. I was traveling solo and never felt like an outcast; the group dynamic just felt very natural and inclusive from the beginning. Khloe and the tour leader, Yen, also shared some really interesting nuggets of info regarding Vietnamese history and culture, which added a lot of depth to the stops. The other ladies and guides were also incredibly friendly and informative throughout the night.

We also had a fun mini-game during one of the stops, which was a nice touch to keep the energy up. Another huge plus is that they took photos of us throughout the night and sent them to us afterward, so I didn't have to worry about missing any memories. If you want a fun, well-organized way to see the real Saigon, this is worth every cent.

The first tour my son and I did after arriving in Vietnam was a XO tour and truthful it was the best of all we experienced! All the ladies were amazing! The food tour is a must to experience with so much variety of food drinks and the genuine sharing of culture and experiences by all was so enlightening and appreciated. I’m going back to Vietnam and will be 100% be  booking again for the experience again. Thanks ladies .

We had no idea what we were in for on this tour! We thought it was just about food. We were met by 4 lovely young ladies who picked us up on their motorbikes. They reassured us it was very safe. “Like fish swimming”. Because Saigon has A LOT of motorbikes! And cars and van and buses. We were whisked off to our first stop where our education began. Not only did we learn about the local food, we also learned about the city structure and life for the locals in Saigon. We walked around at stops between food stops to stimulate the appetite. We walked through a night market, and our guides bought local fruit. At one of our food stops, they cut up the fruit and we were able to try fruit I had never seen before. But it is easy to recognize, and I I would be comfortable buying during the rest of my trip to Vietnam.
Overall, this was an amazing experience. I learned so much and ate so much! The food was excellent and our guides were excellent. Everyone in my group agrees. This was a 10/10.

Christopher - 14th December - Truc4

My wife Tess and I had the most wonderful tour with Truc and Tien. They were so friendly and kind to us and really made us feel welcome in Saigon.

They are so knowledgable about the culture, the language and the beautiful gems that make Ho Chi Min special.

Thank you ladies. A perfect end to our time in  Vietnam!

Tessa 14th of December with Tien. I had the best XO foodie tour with my husband through Saigon. We loved trying all the delicious foods and visiting interesting places. Tien made me feel very safe and taught me so much about this beautiful and unique city. Thank you so much, we can’t wait to come back!

Had an amazing experience on the XO Foodie Tour! The food was delicious, but what truly made the tour special was the warmth and care shown throughout. My guide, Vy, made sure I felt safe, comfortable, and well taken care of at every stop. She shared so many interesting insights about Saigon, its culture, and its food, which made the whole journey even more meaningful!  I’m really grateful for the wonderful experience and highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon! :)

Foodie with Thu4 on 12/12. Best tour ever! Delicious authentic food. I felt so well taken care of, they told us all of the ingredients and how to eat each dish properly. We also stopped at a local food market to explore all of the different fruits and vegetables available. I felt extremely safe. Booking the tour was so easy. Best night I had in Vietnam. I highly recommend this tour if you are looking for a one of a kind experience.
- Carli Alexander

I cannot say enough good things about our experience with XO Tours! We did the Foodie tour and everything was phenomenal - the food, the exploration by motorbike, and especially our guides. We were fortunate to have a small group  and the guide to participant ratio was actually 5:4, not including the support staff who tagged along to make sure there were no issues with the scooters and to help with the restaurants which was also a nice feature of the tour. This made for a very personal experience and all the guides were soooo fun and friendly, not to mention very knowledgeable. It was also a good balance of time between restaurants with cultural stops breaking it up so we didn't feel like we were constantly eating and overly full - we could truly appreciate the food at each stop. We were so sad for it to end!

We had an absolutely outstanding tour with XO Tours. Our guides Thy and Ngoc (Ngoc #5) were absolutely amazing. They were super informative, funny and absolutely focused on making sure we were enjoying ourselves. It’s great they have a support person that goes ahead so when you arrive at each stop they a space all set up for you.

The tour was unique in that there were food stops but also a couple cultural stops to learn about the people which we really enjoyed.  While we had PLENTY of food we weren’t stuffed which we appreciated. We’ve done some food tours in other cities that had so much food you were uncomfortable by the end of the trip.

Great that it’s a woman owned business and all the guides are women. A way to give more woman a path in the hospitality industry.  We even ran into the owner and her daughter at our last stop. We’ve done a lot of food tours and this one stands out. Highly recommend.

My boyfriend and I had such an amazing time on our tour! Our girls(Dim and Ngan) who took us to the meeting point were so sweet and personable- they made us feel super comfortable. Ai, who was our lead tour guide, was so much fun to be with. She was energetic, explained things in full detail, and was full of warmth. We highly recommend!
It was so much fun. The food was amazing and riding on the back of a Scooter through Saigon at night time a real thrill.
Brilliant tours and led by knowledgeable and extremely friendly ladies. Highly recommended for sure

That was our best experience in Saigon with my girlfriend. This is a MUST TRY! The feeling when you’re cruising on motorbikes through the city is fantastic. The variety of the food was great. We could try so many traditional dishes.

Our drivers were super kind and lovely, and they spoke perfect English. Thank you, girls, from here too! :)

Emil and Jenni from Hungary

The best tour my wife and I did in Vietnam! What differentiates it from other tours is that it does not only focus on a specific touristic area of town or only the most famous dishes. There is a genuine showcase of what food Vietnam has to offer. Not only that, the girls make sure they show you the whole city, with all it has to offer. Our girl drivers were very funny and enthusiastic and we spent the whole evening laughing. Last but not least, when they got to know it was our honeymoon, the Team surprised us with a cake, wishing us happy honeymoon! Until now we do not understand how did they managed to pool that one but it was greatly appreciated! So thanks again to all!

XO Tours was the absolute highlight of my trip to Saigon. I joined their Night Foodie Tour, and it was phenomenal from start to finish. The ladies who guided us were amazing—warm, knowledgeable, and incredibly hardworking. They gave us a fun, detailed rundown of each district, each food stop, and the culture behind everything we were experiencing.

What impressed me the most was how well-prepared they were. In the middle of the tour it suddenly started raining, and without hesitation they pulled out rain covers for us so we could stay dry and keep enjoying the night. That level of thoughtfulness and professionalism really stood out.

Every food stop was delicious and authentic, and riding through Saigon at night felt magical. I always felt safe on the motorbike, and the guides made the whole experience feel personal and unforgettable.

If you’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City, this tour is a must-do. XO Tours delivered the best experience I had in Vietnam. Highly, highly recommended!

Tour was very good. Food recommendations were the best ive eaten throughout my trip in vietnam. The guides were also very knowledgeable and super friendly. One of the best tour I have attended. Highly recommended

If you are looking for a unique experience that is fun and educational, book XO Tours!! Previously, we did the XO Foodie Tour which was so fun and full of delicious food. This time around we did the XO Saigon by Night tour, where we got to learn more about how locals live. It was extremely insightful, like no other tour I’ve done before, and our family had an amazing time with our wonderful tour guides. An unforgettable experience, 100% recommend XO Tours!

We did the XO Foodie tour which was amazing. I was a bit skeptical about the price before we went as there are cheaper tours, but must say it was well worth it. Seamless experience, very well organised - Absolutely delicious and interesting foods, off the beaten track and not touristy. The food presented was much more akin to what families would order when eating at a local restaurant, great variety in the meals - all stuff I wouldn't know how to order if I was by myself. Our guides Binh and Chi were amazing, super friendly, knowledgeable and spoke perfect english. Hadn't been on the back of a motorbike before and they were super helpful and made sure I was comfortable. Thank you again ladies and wouldn't hesitate to go back.

A wonderful adventure through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City with the delightful Nhi, eating our way from one hidden gem to the next and sharing great conversations along the way. We tried dishes we’d never have discovered on our own, each stop offering something unique and delicious. Highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting an authentic taste of the city.

I wont get into the details because they already have 5 stars as the score. But they're great. You get to experience a bit of life as a local, you get to learn a bunch in regards to their culture. And me and my wife got Ha and Win as tour guides, the most welcoming and energetic tour guides i've met. For sure will come again another time just for the company and overall experience.

An absolutely phenomenal experience! The team at XO Tours provided an unforgettable, authentic journey through Saigon's (HCMC) best food and sights. Highly recommend this tour for a safe, fun, and truly delicious adventure.

What a fun experience! This was our third food tour and third motorbike tour in Vietnam and this was a standout. Our drivers (Hang and Thanh 2) met us at our hotel to meet up with the rest of the group. I was a little nervous at how large the group size was compared to our earlier tours, but our guide (Giang 2) made everyone feel included and my fears were unnecessary.

The night ride was beautiful and the stops were unique. Wide variety of food and activities. I suggest doing this on your first day in Saigon to give you a good overview of the city and the different districts. Hang and Thanh 2 were fantastic drivers and great guides while we on the bikes, and Giang 2 had impeccable English and boundless enthusiasm. Such a fun evening - not to be missed!
Absolutely brilliant tour, would highly recommend

XO tours is one of the rare spots I’d happily write a review for of my experience and have this be a real review. I did the Saigon by night, led by Giang, and can highly recommend both the tour, and the almighty leader, Giang. Giang brought an energy to the tour unlike many other tour guides, and it would have felt boring and disengaging otherwise.

The group of ladies are nothing but kind, professional, and engaging. Safe at all times and well taken care of. Food is good and spots are unique and get you out of the basic district 1 (as fun as it is).

The time flies by and I’d encourage anyone to go with XO tours. It is also an ethical group who also ensures there is insurance too.

This tour was the best tour we did in Vietnam!  The girls were amazing hosts and the food selections were perfect.  Being on the back of the scooter was a lot of fun as we navigated the crazy traffic.  I felt totally safe the whole time.  I would recommend this tour to anyone!!

This tour was an incredible experience that felt so personalized.  You essentially have a private tour guide who walks you through everything and answers all your questions.  I could hear surprisingly well on the back of the bike and felt safe the entire time.  Sunny, Lam, and Ann were our guides and i cannot say enough good things about these women.  Their English was precise and clear.  We made multiple spots in a lot of districts at places i doubt I would have ever found or chosen on my own.

This is my favorite food tour that i have ever been on.  I would recommend a thousand fold.

I had a fantastic time on this tour. Our guides were extremely knowledgeable about the city, especially its food. The tour was the perfect length, with just the right amount of delicious dishes to try. It offered a great balance of food and culture. I can’t recommend it enough!
Loved XO Tours!!!!!!!!!!!!! Can't wait to do another one when we visit Vietnam again!

We booked the half day Sights of Saigon tour - it’s a wonderful way to see the city highlights. Linh 3 and Hoang, our drivers, were excellent. Both were very capable drivers and, although I was nervous to start with (not having been on a scooter for 30 years!), Hoang made me feel safe. Saigon traffic is crazy and to be a part of it was so memorable, if a bit scary!  A really fun way to get around.

They were friendly, articulate and very knowledgeable about their city and its history, and answered all our questions.  8 stops on the tour and we had time to walk around each one and take photos. We even stopped for Vietnamese coffee which is a must-try drink.

Overall, this tour is great value, great fun and we’d definitely recommend.
this is the tour you want to do - Local life in Saigon. Very laid off, tasty dinner, lot of new information from locals. Ngoc was an amazing guide (and a driver)!

This is probably the best tour that we have ever done, such a unique experience . Our guides Thao1  Duyen2 were amazing, extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Best thing about this experience was it felt more like a few friends having a locals nights out in the city instead of a tourist experience.

I did the XO Foodie tour, and it was an excellent way to experience Saigon. I tried countless dishes beyond the standard pho and banh mi, and I appreciated how accomodating they were of my dietary restrictions. Thu 4 was an excellent driver and made me feel at ease, since I'd never been on a motorbike before. The whole team was engaging and ensured that our plates and glasses were always full. Finally, I apprciate how they took us to lesser known areas of the city, and we got to see several different districts outside the tourist center. My one suggestion for improvement would be adding a food/snack stop in District 7/Koreatown--seemed like a far ride for just a walk around. But I would absolutely take this tour again and would recommend to anyone visiting Saigon!

This was a fantastic experience. There were 5 of us, each on the back of a moto with very experienced female riders to explore the culinary delights of Ho Chi Minh. Our hosts were very friendly and personable, and chatted with us we rode and at each stop as well. This really helped us to understand where we were going, the food we were trying and the different areas of the city that we passed through. It also made us feel more comfortable on the back of their bike. And the food was delicious!

Leading up to the tour XO were also very informative, giving great instructions so we couldn’t mess it up (even if we tried).

Overall, this was an awesome way to experience Ho Chi Minh!

Loved this tour so much! Not only did we eat delicious food, but zipping around to parts of the city you don’t normally see as tourists plus the perspectives shared by the team gave a really interesting insight into what daily life is like for young people in HCM. Highly highly recommend.

One of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam. The girls were so knowledgeable and personable. It was so much fun being part of the scenery riding on a scooter and learning so much of the history. They were on time, kept us hydrated and took pictures for us.  💯recommend this to anyone going to Saigon. …

This was a highlight of our entire Vietnam trip. We loved everyone we met from the company. Vy and Thank were our drivers and were so chatty and easy to talk to it felt like we were hanging out with friends. They were wonderful drivers and I felt safe in their capable hands! Sunny, our tour guide, was hilarious and shared so much insight about the food we were eating, Saigon, and Vietnamese culture. They encouraged a fun, party atmosphere and took us to the most delicious places. The food we had on this tour was the best we had during our entire vacation. I can’t recommend this tour enough!

Our XO Food Tour on November 29th was one of the best — if not the best — tours we’ve ever done. It became an absolute highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We were amazed by how much delicious and incredibly diverse food we got to try. But what truly made the experience special was that we also saw so many different parts of the city and learned cultural insights we never expected to get on a food tour.

The girls guiding the tour were all so friendly, fun, and full of energy. They made the whole evening unforgettable. I was a bit nervous about the traffic and riding on the back of a scooter beforehand, but from the moment we were picked up, I felt completely safe. Sophie (Thu4) took such great care of me — she was warm, attentive, and wonderful to talk to throughout the entire tour.

I would recommend XO Food Tours to absolutely everyone. It’s an amazing way to experience Ho Chi Minh City, its food, and its culture.

What a great experience from the moment we meet iiii & Becky. We screamed around Saigon Friday 5 o’clock rush hour . Mad is not the word. All we can say it was a fantastic time for a few hours. Ending in Region 4 Gangster land until only a few years ago. It’s a must !!!!. Only in SIAGON
I had a great time with XO Tours. The ladies are a lot of fun and the food was amazing. We got to see some the districts which tourists often miss.  i highly recommend this tour.

Do this tour!!! One of the guys on our tour had done it 3 times it was that good!

We did another food tour a few nights prior and although the food was good (all Michelin restaurants) the tour was underwhelming and we left disappointed.

This tour was the opposite!
From the word go all the girls were professional, we got clear instructions on how to ride the scooters, where we were going and in what order (restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant), where there would be bathrooms, confirmed any food allergies or dislikes we had and then we were off.

Both Becky and Katie were great drivers, calmly and safely navigating rush hour traffic all while chatting away to us. Every guide was bubbly and genuinely interested to talk with us about life in Vietnam and our lives and countries as well.

The girls all spoke fantastic English, were very bright and well educated which made for interesting conversations.

The “sightseeing stops” were in unusual areas of the town, specifically chosen to highlight Saigon’s history and future and to give you a glimpse into the lives of the people that live here.

Alongside the drivers/guides, they had a lead guide for our group of 10 with no passenger who organised the group and spoke to us at each stop with information about the area, people and traditions. They also had 4 support guys who went to the restaurants in advance to ensure they were ready for us and to support them. This ensured the night flowed very smoothly.

At the restaurants the girls ensured we were all having fun, the drinks and food were free flowing (the boys had 4 dishes of scallops they were so good!)
We loved that they sat with us and were involved during meal times, it meant we got a lot more interaction and made the evening a lot of fun.

This was an exceptionally well organized tour, great guides, good food and a lot of fun, you’ll love it.

Omg. I can’t say enough great things about this tour. The women are beyond fabulous. I had the privilege of riding with Tien on November 16th. She was great!!! The food is of course great but nothing beats riding through all the wards of Ho Chi Minh City on a motorbike!!

XO Tours is a quintessential experience, whether you are new or already experienced with Saigon. This all-female company is a gem of the city. One of my favorite experiences during our time in Vietnam! Our tour leader Yen, and drivers Ha and Anh, were absolutely wonderful. I truly believe we had the best drivers of the night! We had a blast riding as passengers on a motorbike, which I feel like should be the main reason you choose this tour. Note, the company provides travel insurance for the motorbikes, which shows attention to customer safety. Our drivers were constantly engaging us in conversation, sharing their knowledge and experiences while also asking questions to show their interest. All the food we had were dishes that locals would eat and not your typical pho, banh mi, etc. I appreciated that our tour was followed by a handful of male employees that made sure we were safe and looked after. I was also absolutely floored that Yen remembered every single one of our 15 tour members’ names from the beginning to the end of the tour! I really felt the passion and dedication of all the XO employees. My favorite stop of the 3 food destinations was the last seafood place, where we were allowed to order more of whatever dishes we tried and enjoyed. Our drivers sat next to us and made sure we were well take care of the entire time.

Overall, I was surprised we only stopped at 3 places to eat. The other 2 destinations were a wet market and a short stop at a neighborhood. While the detours between the food stops were fun and insightful, I think only 1 stop is really needed. I do understand its purpose though, since you’re not really walking between destinations so you do need time to digest. I just felt it wasn’t a necessary part of the tour and could have been replaced with more food destination. We also did not receive a final list of the places we visited, which is a shame because we wanted to revisit the seafood eatery again.

Overall, I would still highly recommend this food tour to any first time visitor of Vietnam interested in experiencing being on a motorbike and trying local cuisine! A lot of tourists we met did the same tour and were equally delighted with their experience. I would definitely be interested in checking out their other tour options in the future! I do appreciate the response from the company and our tour guide did reach out after, as I had misplaced the business card they provided at the end of our tour and forgot they did mention we could message them afterwards with any questions. Thank you Yen!

We had a great experience with Giang and the XO Tours team on the XO Foodie Tour, riding on the back of scooters across five districts of Saigon. The girls did a fantastic job making us feel safe and welcome throughout the night. My guide, Becky, was especially great — she was really engaging, shared lots of interesting information about the city, and asked insightful questions that sparked good conversation. She was also an expert scooter driver, which made the whole ride smooth and enjoyable. As a cultural experience, this was excellent — we got a great background on the city, saw parts of Saigon we’d never have visited on our own, and the attention to detail from the guides was impressive.

However, as a food tour or culinary experience, I found it quite disappointing. The restaurants and dishes felt randomly selected and not particularly exciting. In my opinion, most tourists with a bit of a sense of adventure could find better food on their own just by exploring District 1 or other tourist areas and trying food from street corner restaurants, barbecue spots and roadside stalls. Even while we were at the restaurants, the focus was mostly on explaining life in the city and activities rather than the food itself. That made it harder to enjoy the meals or feel like the food was a highlight of the tour.

I’d still highly recommend XO Tours as a company  the experience was fantastic, but I think the Saigon by Night tour might offer better value overall. If you're booking the XO Foodie Tour, go in with the right expectations, it's more about the city and culture than the food.

XO writes that their drivers are excellent and take precautions to make the driving safer. They are absolutely excellent drivers. I'm not convinced they take that many extra precautions!!!! We were nipping in and out of traffic, going at speed, and generally driving like everyone else. Our trip started during sunlight, but we spent most of the night driving in the dark. We visited 4 restaurants, a market and someone's home. The food was overall good, but having eaten in about 30 local restaurants by that time, I think it should be rebranded as a street food tour. We were offered any amount of extra food and drinks and we were pretty stuffed after restaurant 2 but powered on bravely through the evening. It's expensive, so don't be afraid to ask for what you want.

The guides speak to us whilst on the bikes, asking questions and telling us about the city. Likewise, whenever we reached a destination, we were given lots of interesting facts and history as a family. We were lucky to be able to visit a typical local apartment which I think opened up the eyes of our children to a bit more to 'the real world'.

I think we spent over 3.5 hours. This was easily the children's favorite part of the entire trip - quote: 'absolutely amazing, slightly petrifying crossing the wave of 1000 bikes'. It was exhilarating. I felt it was a bit too dangerous an activity overall for children however...

...so we did the day tour a couple of days later...idiots that we are

Again, it was fun, felt dangerous, probably was dangerous and really interesting. The reason I am giving two stars is that the next day I woke up with intestinal issues, let me leave it at that. I have a strong stomach and don't often get sick. I know that it was from the food on the tour because it was the only food I ate that day saved two hot lattes. Needless to say it ruined the next day. I realize they have thousands of positive reviews so I must have just gotten unlucky.

A Must-Do in Saigon! - We absolutely loved the foodie tour with XO Tours! A special shout-out to Chi, Anh & Dung, who drove us around Saigon on their scooters for more than four hours, taking us to some fantastic local food spots. Their team leader, Sunny, was also great. They were all incredibly friendly, attentive and full of interesting information about the food, the city and local life.

I've done a foodie tour with another company in Saigon before. It was cheaper, but honestly, it wasn't great. They took me to places serving food that you can easily find in Sydney, Australia. At one point, I actually told them, “I've had better Banh Mi and Pho in Sydney!” 😂 Not exactly what you want to hear on a food tour in Vietnam!

XO Tours costs a little more, but it is absolutely worth it. The food was much more interesting and varied, with plenty of seafood, fresh fruit, local dishes and, of course, beer... because apparently eating your way around Saigon is thirsty work. 🍻😂

The girls were fantastic and made us feel welcome from start to finish. It was a great way to explore Saigon, eat some seriously good food and discover places we definitely wouldn't have found on our own.

I highly recommend the XO Tours foodie tour. I'll definitely be trying some of their other tours next time I'm in Saigon — although knowing how good the food was, I might just end up doing this one again!

Thanks again, Chi, Anh, Dung & Sunny, for an awesome evening and a very full stomach!

Book this amazing food and fun experience - Had an amazing food tour on Friday August 7 in
HCMC. Our family of two older adults and younger adults who had never ridden motorcycles before had the best time exploring cause of wonderful food from all the restaurants and our great drivers Nthung? (mark) Chi (Debbie) Dienz(poppy) Huong? (Ethan) it was small tour with 10 guests from all over the world but with fish restaurants, BBQ, dessert and lots of choices whenever we stopped for food, night market visit and party games (parents Team won) and amazing amount of information about the city, history and food imparted while traveling I know this is going to be one of our holiday highlights thank you XO and all your Staff

THIS IS THE ONE! - We (68 and 63 yrs old) booked this tour, with my wife being reluctant to jump on the back of a scooter with a stranger, submerged in the chaos that is Ho Chi Minh City traffic!....Well, within two blocks, it became clear that we were in the hands of the safest, most caring, entertaining drivers in the city - and before the end of the night, they were no longer strangers! Our drivers, Linh#4 and Dung, (along with all of the other female drivers) were kind, curious and informative, sharing insight to Vietnamese culture that many tourists would not have access to...each of the 5 food stops was of a different character, with tasty samplings of foods and surroundings full of roadside life, music and simple joy! The group of 12 tourists from all over the world made for great conversation at the food stops, and the XO Team had fun, competitive games for all...A special shoutout to the tour leader, Yen, a tiny powerhouse of Vietnamese national pride...I would not be surprised to see her one day on TV, giving a speech at The United Nations!
So, if you want to have a special evening in Ho Chi Minh City, this is the one...you will have an exponentially enhanced experience, one that you will remember for the rest of your life...

Best experience in Saigon - This was my second time doing the foodie tour with XO Tours. Both times were excellent. My first time was with a student group of about 15 people thirteen years ago. This time it was with my wife. We had a wonderful time. The XO ladies are wonderful and professional. It was the highlight of our time riding the streets of Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City and sampling some great cuisine. My advice? Try it, you will love it and recommend it to all your friends.

BEST MORNING HISTORY TOUR - I had the most amazing morning tour with Lin as my guide. I was the only one on the tour and she was so knowledgeable about all of Vietnam's history. Highly recommended - We had an absolutely fantastic scooter tour through Ho Chi Minh City with our family!

We were traveling with three kids aged 4-15, and every one of them loved it. The tour was incredibly family-friendly, engaging, and educational while still being exciting and full of adventure.

If you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City, this is an experience we can't recommend highly enough. Without a doubt one of the highlights of our trip!

Amazing - a must do when visiting HCM - Amazing! The food tour was a highlight of our holiday in Vietnam. The girls were fantastic and we always felt safe on the bikes. Fantastic opportunity to try new foods and experience life like the locals. Highly recommend!!

Saigon by Night - We did the Saigon by Night tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh City and it was fantastic. The best food tour - The highlight of our time in HCM city. The tour was expertly organized, the guides were super friendly and knowledgeable, and the food experience was unforgettable. 10/10 would absolutely recommend.

Do this food tour! It is soooo worth it! - I would recommend it for everyone visiting Saigon! I did the XO foodie tour and the food is amazing and the cultural knowledge is even better! If I had more time in the city I would 100% do another of the tours. Couldn't have asked for a better experience! No wonder everyone loves it!

Highlight of our time in Ho Chu Minh - Highly recommend this tour is definitely a must do. We had several friends recommend to us and they were not wrong. Family-friendly and adaptable - Worth the time and money! They adapted based on food preferences and made my 14 year old feel comfortable. We don't typically do tours but this was recommended by a local and happy we gave it a shot! Great group size and makes you feel like old friends.
Best food tour ever! - Amazing experience, saw many districts, markets and tasted so many local dishes. Tx Tine, Julie, Sam and V

Perfect City Tour - I got to XO Tours thanks to a suggestion of a tourist who made the tour with them the day before. I confirm the choice. Professional service, nice people, on time and still flexible. Go for it.

Put XO Tours on tour MUST do list - This is a MUST DO if you visit Ho Chi Mihn City. Amazing experience, led by incredible group of women! - Truly the best experience I had in my 2 weeks of visiting Vietnam! Best way to experience HCM city - The tour with the girls on scooters in Ho Chi Minh city was the maybe most amazing time we have had on any vacation. THE BEST TOUR IN TOWN! - Thanks to Thao & Ngoc - Thao and Ngoc were our tour leaders last week. Sean and Sarah

Very satisfactory experience - We took the night Saigon, if you want to discover the history of some neighborhoods this is what you need, the guides are smiling and drive very well on scooters. So much fun, a MUST in Saigon! - My boyfriend and I had the absolute best time on this Saigon By Night tour - its a must do on a visit to Saigon. This tour was personal, joyful, fun and funny and took us to places we may not have had the confidence to travel to on our own in Saigon - well worth every cent. Must do food tour in Ho Chi Minh - XO Tours are amazing - the food tour was incredible and the best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh. The reviews are correct this is the best food tour in the world. Family trip to Saigon - Absolutely the best way to see and experience central Saigon. The guides were super knowledgeable and super enthusiastic. Amazing must-do in Ho Chi Minh City - An amazing experience to explore the city, the food and the culture. Highly recommend - our riders were simply amazing and Nghi did an incredible job leading the team.

Best Food Tour Ever! - This was an incredible tour all the way around! Amazing Food Tour - For me this was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The ladies brought us up to speed with life in the city and were full of fun. Great tour - Our food tour was great. Sunny is a friendly and informative tour leader who makes everyone feel included. Our drivers, Chloe and Han, were also amazing and made sure we had lots of fun and plenty to eat.

Fun experience! - We did the XO tour Saigon by night. The tour guides/drivers were all very informative and educated young women. We enjoyed getting out of the tourist areas and learning more about the local people. Being on the back of the bikes was fun!

Fabulous, as expected!! - My husband and I live in Vietnam and regularly recommend XO Tours to our visiting friends and family however this was only our 2nd time joining the tour ourselves. The tour was once again absolutely fantastic, thanks to Sunny and the girls.

XO bike tour. AWESOME!!!!!! - My friend and I went on the XO bike tour not expecting that much but WOW, the 5hrs or so went in a flash because we had so much bloody fun. Incredible solo experience - Had an awesome time! I went solo and everyone was so nice. The food was incredible as were the historical stops. Couldn't recommend more!

Best Food Tour Experience - Go XO Girls! - A work colleague in Australia highly recommended the XO Foodies Tour to us and we were very pleased with the quality and experience. Great night out! - Great food, extremely fun night. Very well managed. Made some special memories and learned a lot. Excellent tour of the city.

An exhilarating way to experience Ho Chi Minh City! - I went on the XO Foodie Tour on a lovely evening in June. It was a peak experience for me. Riding around HCMC on a motorbike was an exhilarating vantage point for seeing the city, and the food was great! My driver Duyen was extremely pleasant and professional, and she made me feel like I was in good hands. The tour leader, Yen, was great as well, and had many interesting things to tell us. I have been on lots of food tours around the world, and this one really stands out!
My best experience in Ho Chin Minh City - The girls were punctual,pleasant,knowledgeable and skillful motorbike riders

The BEST tour I’ve been on - You want to know a little bit of history? See the sites where you would probably never go, unless you have relatives? Then this is your local tour. I was a little taken back at first, as the transportation is on scooters, but then that’s part of the fun and excitement to see how they drive. Do not worry as safety is always their utmost concern but the thrill of ridding like a local was fun, especially in the back alleys where our group ventured. We clearly were the only ones not from Vietnam. Talk about substance, my tour guide Thankfull was clearly well educated in not only the history of Vietnam but about many different sites we visited and the many more that we zoomed past. I enjoyed my first tour so much (Saigon by night) that I signed up for a second tour (XO Foodie). Do not worry you’re not going to be served the usual phò, like they say, “you can get that anywhere”…I won’t ruin the surprise of which local dishes are served, but rest assured the food was delicious and filling. They made sure we were all stuffed before the tour ended. (You eat at a few different locations in different parts of the city which is fun, better than a pub crawl). Make sure to save room for desert. What I appreciated about the tour the most, is each and every tour guide upon reaching the next destination had a clear family value of where they worked and how they treated each of their guests making you feel as if you were part of their family and not just another tour. This was perhaps one of my most memorial tours I have ever experienced and I am sure each tour guide is equally knowledgable and caring. If you’re lucky like I was, you’ll get Thankful!! If you do, tell her Mike sent you!!

Amazing food tour must do - Very very good operators and very organized! They came prepared for rain, for different food allergies, and very helpful and cooperative

They will make you play games, very flexible and love what they do. We were a group of 9 and their service was impeccable!

XO foodie tour. It's a must ! - We did the foodie tour and it was such a fun experience. It's a must do if your in Ho Chi Minh. Must-do tour in HCMC - So worth doing when visiting HCMC. Learn so much about the city, meet amazing people and guides, and eat delicious food. Must do!

One of the highlights of my week in Siagon - Had a blast exploring Ho Chi Minh with the tour! The food was excellent, my guide was interesting and personable, and exploring by bike was fun. I learned about the various districts and about Vietnam in general. Highly recommend!

Amazing experience - My husband and I had an awesome time on this tour. I was quite anxious about being in the traffic on the bike, however my guide Jasmine, was understanding and keeping my nerves at bay. The food stops were superb with lots of laughs thrown in.
I would highly recommend Yen and her team of amazing guides.

Wonderful Tours - I can't say enough wonderful things about the tours I went on! I would have never been able to see HCM City like I did without XO. The guides and drivers were all wonderful. Well worth the experience - I'd used their services on a visit in 2024 for the night tour. This time me and my daughter did both night and day (history) tours.

Best Night in Saigon – Thanks XO Tours, Forbes Was Absolutely Right - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding experience with XO Tours!

If you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City, this tour is an absolute must.

Highly recommended! 🇻🇳🏍️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

XO motorbike tour, Vietnam - A truly incredible experience, the highlight of my trip to Vietnam! XO Foodie Adventure! - We booked this tour with friends on our trip in HCM. It was amazing, not just foodie tour, it was like a small adventure!

Big thanks to amazing Xo tour girls!!☺️

Totally recommended for small group of friends.

The highlight of our trip - Despite having done such scooter tours twice previously and knowing roughly what to expect, I still enjoyed every single minute of our night tour with XO Tours. A must-do tour! - This tour was amazing! The ladies were so much fun and cruising around on the back of a scooter was thrilling! I enjoyed my guide's commentary about sites as we drove around. A Treat - Our family of five (including three college age kids) absolutely loved our XO Tour with Autumn and her team—safe, fun, and super informative, with some of the best food we had in Vietnam! A treat.
Excellent! - Wonderful experience and tour guides! They are smart, friendly and eager to help clients understand Saigon. Will definitely book more tours.

Fantastic tour of the city - The XO tour was excellent, whizzing around the city on the bikes with the XO girls was brilliant. They are excellent, confident drivers, the varied stops were spot on and the food was another level especially the last stop with the seafood.

A great night out in Saigon - My wife and I both went on the night time food tour, my wife had some dietary restrictions. Well done XO tours, you have incredible and talented staff, and we will recommend you to all our Aussie friends.

Wonderful 🤩 - I spent a beautiful weekend with my family.
Thank you very much, Laert🙏

Best Experience in Vietnam - I did the Saigon by Night tour, and as a solo traveler I was a bit nervous about how it would go. It's safe to say that this tour was one of the top highlights of my 3 week trip. From hotel pick up to drop off, I had such a wonderful time. Thank you again ladies!

They are top-reviewed for a reason. - Great experience from start to finish. We felt safe and well looked after during the whole trip. Excellent! - Absolutely loved this trip! I was a little skeptical because I had never ridden a scooter. However I pushed myself to do it and I am so glad I did. What a wonderful time. Tour and food were amazing. Loved it all. Please book this tour, you will not regret it.

Gold standard tour from XO Tours - After doing some research I chose XO Tours for a final tour before completing my vacation. I couldn't be more impressed!
Google XO Tours and you will easily see why they are the first choice for top quality tours in HCMC. Highly recommend.

The XO foodie tour was an absolute highlight - An incredible tour and easily the best way to experience Saigon — riding through the city on the back of motorbikes like the locals do made it unforgettable. The XO Foodie Tour was an absolute highlight of our trip. We explored several different districts, sampled so much amazing local food, and got a real taste of the city's culture. The tour was also very accommodating to dietary requirements, which made the experience even better. We felt completely safe and comfortable on the motorbikes, and our guides were fantastic throughout the experience.
Great food tour - Such a great way to spend our first night in HCMC !!!

A morning with the ladies - Set up was easy and included insurance. I booked the 1/2 day Sights of Saigon. My guide and driver were May. A sweet intelligent young woman. And great motorbike driver. She navigated the busy streets of HCMC like a champ with this 113 kg guy at her back. We joked she would be a to deliver refrigerators after this experience. May was in gauging and thoughtful. I always leave safe. Our lead, Uyen, was a knowledgeable woman that shared with us wonderful interesting stories and insights about Saigon history. A city she clearly loves. She was fun quizzing us on topics she had just shared. I need to say the two most powerful and interesting stops were the Burning Monk Memorial and the 10,000 Buddhas Pagoda. Two lesser known events in Saigon history. One other extremely enjoyable stop on the tour was a stop at the Tan Dinh Market. We walked through the market single file on our right as our lead requested for our safety. We took in the sights and sounds of this market clearly for local people. We sat at the edge of the market to enjoy a snack and tea. We sat 3 customers and 4 XO guides as friends sharing and joking about coffee, food and the city. Wonderful tour to truly appreciate this beautiful city and its people.

Exceptional - What a night, thank you to XO and our beautiful riders that made this experience truly wonderful. Exceptional food and the genuine enthusiasm. Thank you for sharing a special part of Ho Chi Ming city it's history and your lives to our group.

We thought it was a food tour. It was so much more. - We thought it was a food tour…it was so much more.

Candidly, when I booked XO tours, I thought I was booking a cool way for my wife and me to eat around Saigon/Ho Chi Minh. That’s not what I got, and I am beyond grateful. What we got was laughter, great food, story telling, history and life long memories.

Trinh and Yen, thank you for being our guides, caretakers, scooter racers, and friends for the evening. I really do hope that fate somehow has you visiting Los Angeles so we can repay the favor.

For those wondering, “Which tour do I take?” I have your answer. XO.

This is a wonderful, woman-owned company. Yes, we ate amazing food and drank to our hearts' content, but I’d be doing a disservice to those deciding what to do if I didn’t explain why XO is the right tour, beyond just the food.

We explored Saigon. Its history. It’s people. It’s architecture—the stories of those people, and wonderfully, our guides. The women of Vietnam are amazing with each on their own personal journey and blending of an ancient culture and modern world.

We heard about their backgrounds from the rural areas. The mountains, for one. The Mekong Delta for the other. Their dreams, stories, hopes, and dreams. It was beyond beautiful. But it’s easy to tell stories, you feel that they want to know ours. Who we were. What we did back home. What we thought of their country and the city we explored. At the end, we wanted more so much so that we will return.

If I have to pick a favorite spot we ate at, it would be Mafia Town (district 4, if I remember correctly) and the amazing seafood. It was beyond cool to be with the locals and see them just be together. All that said, I’d say the best was being on the scooter and having great discussions with Trinh. My wife felt the same about Yen. Their personal friendship, smiles, laughter, and overall joy in their own experiences left me…fulfilled. Corny, I know, but I’m left with tears in my eyes as I write this and remember.

To those who come next to this great experience, enjoy! Embrace it with everything you’ve got. You will not be disappointed. I’m jealous.

Trinh, Yen and the entire XO family. A million thanks. May you enjoy long life and wealth.

Saigon by night XO tour - We had the most wonderful experience with xo tours on the 20th April 2026.

As a 65 year old grandmother I was very nervous about getting on a motorcycle, I hadn’t been on one since I was 14 years old and when I saw the traffic in Ho Chi Min, I thought… no way am I doing this, but I did, along with my husband and our 2 cousins it was the highlight of our first trip to Vietnam.
Meeting “Aunty” was a very emotional experience one I will never forget.

Tasting traditional street food, mixing with the locals, all great experiences.

Getting to experience the REAL Vietnam under the guidance of Ngoc and her wonderful team was a pleasure, Ngoc was so good at calming my nerves and I felt very safe riding the motorcycle with her.

A truly wonderful tour that I would highly recommend you do whilst in Ho Chi Min, we did the Saigon by night tour.
I would do it all again in a heartbeat.

An Amazing Way to Experience the City!!! - My teenage sister and I went to Vietnam for her Spring Break and we went on an XO tour our first night in Ho Chi Min City. Thoughtful, safe, and unexpectedly exceptional — two completely different (and equally fantastic) experiences - I booked two tours with XO Tours Vietnam—a morning history tour and an evening food tour—and both exceeded expectations in completely different ways.

The morning history tour felt almost like a private experience with our guides, Linh and Chi. It was incredibly well done—thoughtful, balanced, and nuanced in a way that’s not easy when covering complex and sensitive history. It struck exactly the right tone: informative without being heavy-handed, and deeply respectful of different perspectives.

The evening food tour was the opposite energy in the best possible way—lively, social, and so much fun. We were in a group of about fifteen (mostly Australians), and our guides Thanh and Thuy kept the energy high all night. The food was outstanding, and there was a lot of it—we left completely full. They also took tons of photos throughout the evening and send them afterward for free, which was such a thoughtful touch.

I’ll also share something I almost didn’t admit: I initially hesitated to book. I wasn’t sure how a company with all-female guides on scooters handled safety, particularly with male tourists. That concern turned out to be completely unfounded. The professionalism, clear boundaries (including no-contact rules), and overall structure made it obvious that the company takes the safety and wellbeing of their team seriously. That peace of mind made the experience even more enjoyable.

Our tour leaders, Linh and Yen, were especially impressive—fun, confident, and natural leaders. They genuinely made me excited about the next generation of Vietnamese women. I couldn’t help but think how proud my own Vietnamese family would be to see women like them thriving in these roles.

One small practical tip: tipping can be a bit tricky logistically since there are multiple people supporting each tour (drivers, leaders, etc.). I’d recommend bringing smaller bills so you can tip everyone individually without awkwardness.

Overall, this is a company that delivers not just a great experience, but a thoughtful and well-run one. Highly recommend.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't hesitate—book XO Tours. It's an experience you won't forget.

Highlight of Vietnam - The Food Tour of Ho Chi Minh City by XO Tours is rated by Forbes as one of the 9 Best Food Tours in the World and after experiencing it for ourselves we can wholeheartedly agree. Our adventure started off and all of us were immediately very comfortable with how skillfully the girls navigated the crazy (to our outside eyes!) Ho Chi Minh traffic! The USP of XO Tours is that they take guests to the local specialty places, not the tourist traps, and sure enough, everywhere we saw only locals enjoying the food. There were a total of 5 stops, with three for food, including more than 10 different dishes, and two for glimpses of life at a traditional wholesale wet market and other such places.
Not just for our Vietnam trip, but I can honestly say that I've never had a more enjoyably guided tour anywhere in the world on all my various holidays. The whole concept itself we thought was unique. But it's the girls who are the absolute stars, their enthusiasm, knowledge, attention to detail and patience with all our queries was remarkable. We were also impressed with their own curiosity about our lives, and the places we came from, asking us detailed and intelligent questions. Truly, we all feel like new friends for the four hour duration of the trip and hopefully we will stay in touch with Sunny, Ly, and their other two colleagues, who's names sadly escape my memory now! These young ladies are truly worthy cultural ambassadors of their city and country and all of us are sure that we will go back to experience this trip again!

Great tour - I did this tour on international women's day. It was a great tour. All of the guides were very friendly and enthusiastic. The food and drinks were delicious and abundant. I would highly recommend this tour.

The MOST FUN thing we did on our trip to Saigon. Maybe the most fun night of our lives! - WOW WOW WOW was this amazing! These gals are fantastic and show us parts of the city we will have never seen in our own. Driving through the streets on the back of a Vespa was thrilling and was the closest thing to 'being a local' that I can imagine doing. The guides are not only great drivers, but fantastic conversationalists as well. Such intelligent, warm people…total pleasure to spend an evening learning about their lives, the food scene, local markets and customs. Can't say enough about this tour. BEST TOUR EVER!!

Amazing Tour & Kindness Connects us All - Amazing tour and best tour we have ever taken! It was led by Thao Truong and Ngoc for XO Tours. They picked us up at our hotel on scooters and we rode on the back of the scooter with them to see diverse markets ie fish, fruit, vegetable markets as well as visited a home of a Vietnamese family. We also ate and drank the foods of Ho Chi Minh City. It was an amazing and safe experience due to the care and kindness of our tour guides. By the end of the tour we made two future, young friends that we will stay in touch with. We also learned the true character of Vietnamese people and their philosophy of "where there is a will, there is a way." We also learned that cultures may be different but kindness connects us all as human beings. Very well done Thao and Ngoc! Your wisdom, care, consideration and kindness will never be forgotten!

The best way to see Saigon! - Super fun tour experience — I highly recommend! This is the best way to see Saigon—on the back of a scooter! We got to experience the crazy traffic of Saigon, and zoom around the entire city. Our tours (we did both the Foodie tour and the City tour) were very fun, very safe, and extremely well-organized. We got to see much more of the city than we would have if we did a walking or car-based tour.

Always a pleasure! Always something new! - I had the absolute pleasure of taking the XO Foodie Tour for the fourth time this past Valentine's Day, just before the Tet Holiday this year, and I'm sure I will do it again and again.

I was first treated to the tour back in 2016 by a friend who thought I might enjoy it, even though I'd already traveled extensively in Vietnam. He was not wrong! I've since brought my mothers-in-law and their Goddaughter, another good friend and first-time visitor to Vietnam, and most recently my wife, son, and his best friend. It's a perfect introduction, I believe, to Ho Chi Minh City.

The tour takes you to and through parts of the sprawling metropolis the average tourist might never experience, all on the back of a scooter that is driven by a gal barely half the size of your average westerner, and in traffic that often shocks and intimidates those of us from other parts of the world. The drivers' impressive skills are equally matched by their wealth of knowledge. They love their home, their culture, and their food, and they love to share them all as much as possible over the course of a leisurely evening.

The experience is not at all like any other tour I'd ever taken. It's like being a part of a rolling celebration of humanity, and a night on the town with new friends who seem as eager to learn about you as you are likely to feel about them.

On this trip, as well as others, XO went the extra mile to accommodate various dietary preferences of my traveling companions, all while treating us to some of the most adventurous and delicious dishes ever. This time around, they even worked in a surprise dessert to honor the anniversary of the day I met my wonderful wife, which was 33 years ago on Valentine's Day.

Hoang, Anh, Duong, and Nhi were our drivers this time around, and they were all wonderful!

Already looking to the next time!

Motorbike food tour of Ho Chi Minh - Fantastic evening with XO exploring the most amazing parts of Ho Chi Minh that we would never have discovered ourselves. All the girls drove expertly and were charming and informative about the city and the food we were eating. They made it such a fun experience and would highly recommend.

You can't miss this!! - They're incredible! Incredibly good! Unbelievable how the ladies drive you safely and friendly through the traffic chaos of Saigon. A real experience! Well organized, top friendly, good English and the night tour really something different.. from the restaurants to visiting a family to get an impression of life. 10 of 10

Outstanding experience in Saigon by night - This extraordinary tour was one of my best experiences in Vietnam. Never participated before a foodie tour & motorriding together and seeing the traffic in Saigon I was a bit worried. But as we departed from our hotel, everything has changed in my mind :) I felt totally safe and excited, my guide was a professional driver, really lovely and her English was perfect! We are not the real fans of seafood, but the food vendors showed that it is reqlly worth to taste new dishes, so now I have new favorites :) Don't miss this tour if you are in Saigon ;)

Great tour - XO Tours were great from the off. Comms were spot on. Guides are very knowledgeable and fun. Felt safe being whizzed around Saigon on the back of a moped. Food was lush too. Well worth doing.

We had good experiences - It was a super tour. The girl was very kind and frendly, I enjoyed all the time with them. If you stay in Saigon, let go with them to a memorable trip on the streets if Saigon.

If you visit HCMC, take this tour!! - This was a great night out!
The food was excellent, our lovely guides were very knowledgeable and engaging as well as kick ass motorbike riders in the most insane traffic I've ever seen.
There were 5 stops. Three were for eating and two for sightseeing with detailed explanations about everything from ingredients to history. Pay attention! Questions WILL be asked.
A big shout out to Ny, Han and Giang for an excellent night and our first port of call next time we're in HCMC.

XO food trout - A very unique and fun experience All of drivers were excellent at driving and knowledge of Ho Chi Minh food and market scenes The price was quite good We especially liked that the business was established and run by women There was a lot of cultural information that helped us to better understand Vietnam Cudos to XO food tours Highly recommended as one of the best Saigon experiences !

highlight of our trip! Must do - Me and my wife did this tour on 13th feb 2026 and it was a definite highlight of our trip! i would recommend to anyone visiting as its a must do, and it will be first on our to do list when we next visit. The food itself was outstanding. Every stop introduced us to something different and exposed us to dishes we would never have had the confidence to order on our own, but secretly wished we did! The variety was impressive, and each place felt authentic rather than curated purely for tourists. We also got to see and explore large parts of the city we wouldn't have done. Lots of tourists dont really get out of district 1, and this would probably have been us, but through this tour we got to see districts 1, 4,5,8 and 9 and probably others on the way.

Something i really enjoyed that elevated the tour beyond the food was learning about the realities facing young Vietnamese people today. Hearing about the pressures of rapid development, long working hours, family expectations, and the cost of living gave us a much deeper understanding of modern Vietnam. It added a human dimension that you simply do not get from guidebooks or casual sightseeing.

My wife was a bit scared about being on the back of a bike and the traffic but her lovely guides (Lee and Nhi) made us feel really safe and it was really fun.

We left not only full, but better informed and truly grateful for the experience. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCMC who wants to understand the city through its food and its people.Was definitely worth the money, and my only regret was not doing the other tours they did too, we will be back!

A nice option to visit Saigon. - We decided to opt for a different way to find out more on the Vietnamese culture by choosing a Saigon by night tour.
We're a retired couple and the XO drivers were absolutely great with the driving in the traffic. We felt safe throughout the entire tour and greatly appreciated their comments and explanations. In addition, everything was well organized and interesting. They even take pictures throughout the whole night so that you'll be sure not to miss anything.
The girls were nice and friendly to us. Book without hesitation!

Best Food tour in Saigon - XO food tour is the best experience we had in Saigon, Vietnam 🇻🇳. The entire staff was fabulous, friendly, knowledgeable and good bike drivers. It was my first time on a bike but my guide put me at ease very quickly. This is not an “all food” tour. It's a combination of food tasting and education about Vietnam. We enjoyed this experience. The team lead was very good. All of them are professionals. We highly recommend them. You will have a great time. Trust me!!

Best experience we've had so far on our Asia holiday!! Must do with XO tours - To experience riding in the absolute chaos of traffic in Ho Chi Minh riding on the back of motorbike was an absolute blast even for us 55+ year olds.

Norah, Lam, Sam and Bamboo were absolutely delightful gals that enjoyed taking us to the hidden locals only areas and sharing everything about their wonderful city. Visiting a local's apartment was enlightening.
We didn't want to say goodbye to them at the end of the night.

Best tour I have ever experienced - This tour was exceptional. Our tour leader, Hong, found just the right balance of professionalism and friendliness. Excellent female drivers took us to a variety of eating places as well as the flower market, all the while providing informative, interesting conversation. The tour was kept vibrant with a few simple little games/quizzes. We laughed, and at times almost cried, so special was what we experienced. An unforgettable evening. Thank you so much to Hong, lovely Hung and all the XO crew.

Best tour in Vietnam - This was the best tour we've had in all of Vietnam and it's because of the tour guides. Our guides Nhi and Dieu were kind, friendly and we had great conversations. They made the tour.
All the guides are really nice, thoughtful, funny, energetic, and wonderful. There's time to get to know them, ask them questions about Vietnam's culture/history/personality,

The food was delicious and riding around on a motorcycle in HCMC is great. Riding around felt like I could get to know the city more than taking a car around. The food places the picked felt really local and authentic.

Would absolutely do this again. And will book tours through XO exclusively next time we're in HCMC.

Night bike tour of Saigon - We had a fabulous evening tour with Trang (Jasmine) and Chung. Expert driving navigating all the crazy traffic but we felt safe and it was exhilarating. Thanks also for the birthday cake!

Great food tour on scooter - On my very first night in Saigon, I jumped straight into the deep end — on the back of a scooter with the XO team — and what an unforgettable introduction to the city it was!

The tour whisked us through the buzzing streets to a vibrant night market in Chinatown, a fantastic street food stall near the Gia Tua apartment block where we sampled a whole lineup of local dishes, and finally… dessert heaven. And when I say heaven, I mean a place with over 100 desserts to choose from. Decision paralysis has never been so delicious.

My personal driver and guide Ly spoke excellent English and was an absolute star. She was knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and incredibly helpful — sharing not just facts about the food, but stories and local insights that made everything come alive.
