As if the evening hadn't already exceeded expectations, we ended with a thoughtful surprise: the XO Survival Guide and phrase book — the perfect welcome gift for a newcomer to Ho Chi Minh City. It instantly made me feel more prepared (and slightly less like a confused tourist!).

I even followed one of their recommendations and visited Cat Moc Spa (https://catmocspa.com) — and it turned out to be the best spa experience I've ever had.

If you want to kick off your time in Saigon with great food, great people, and a big dose of fun, this tour is the way to do it.

excellent tour - You can efficiently visit everything from famous landmarks to local market snacks and sites related to history and war, all with a knowledgeable guide. In addition, you can enjoy the rare experience of riding double on a scooter in Ho Chi Minh City. For people who understand some English, I think it's truly an excellent tour.

Super fun Foodie Tour - We had the most amazing experience on XO's Foodie Tour. We chose for the private tour and I am so glad we did. Small group of 5 of us and 5 drivers, making it easy to get to know each of the drivers. They are extremely knowledgeable about food, culture, history, and of course, navigating the crazy city streets on their comfortable and safe motorbikes. All of us relax while on the motorbikes, even with a little rain. Superb drivers. As important as all that is, the best part was really that they made the tour a fun and hilarious experience. Look no further for you scooter tour - go with XO!

Excellent experience - Our two scooter guides did an extraordinary job showing us different districts and the real Vietnamese life. We learned so much from them about Vietnamese culture and had just the best time!

Must do in Saigon - Must do in Saigon!
We had a wonderful experience - personable and professional. The food was phenomenal and ladies are wonderful!

XO Sights of Saigon and XO Foodie - Took 2 tours with XO on first day in Saigon. Sights of Saigon in the morning and XO foodie in the evening. I would recommend both. The tours were well organized and insightful, you gain an insight into Vietnam, its culture and history. On both tours my driver guides were knowledgeable and spoke excellent English. The tours were fun. You do of course have to take a view on whether you want to be on 2 wheels.
Just clean - The best thing to do in HCM. Great drivers, great food, interesting restaurants.

Amazing! - What an amazing experience with our incredible guide! Cannot recommend this enough. On January 26, we had the privilege to join this awesome night tour with our amazing guide, Chi. She and the rest of the XO team, including team lead Hong, were so nice, thoughtful, and informative and they really showed us a whole different side of Saigon. We got to ride on the motorbikes, eat local street food, and even had the honor of visiting a local residence. Truly unforgettable experience.

If you can only do one thing in HCM, do this tour!! - We booked this tour after stumbling across videos from other travelers on YouTube. So glad we did. We were met by Thanh, Autumn, Lin and Hun at our accommodation promptly. Immediately they were amazing with introductions and a brief about the scooter. Then we were off…..whizzing through the busy Saigon streets. My sister was a little nervous but Hun made her feel comfortable.
We stopped for Bun Bo Hue and we met the tour leader Sunny. Like the other girls, she was great. Happy and welcoming and explained the food and the tour.

Great food and then onto the next of 5 food stops. I was with Thanh, she was funny, clearly very intelligent and declared she loved her job! Very knowledgeable about the city and made the chaotic traffic seem easy. My wife, sister and brother in law all had similar things to say about their guides.

The tour is not just about food, it delves into HCM and some history. Very interesting.

We booked our son onto the tour the following weekend as he will pass through.

To XO Tours I say your staff are great, they earn every penny and should be highly regarded by you!!

Number one for a reason - The pre tour organization sets the tone for the tour. It was first rate with any queries promptly answered.
We were picked up outside our tour by two delightful young ladies. Good English, lots of smiles, and beautifully dressed. Once we had sorted helmets, and who got the short straw with me at 6'3" and 92 kilos, riding pilion we set off. The night time ride in Saigon was very exciting. The total chaos of the traffic makes it so.
The evening was a mixture of laughter and good conversation. Good food and an education in what typical Vietnamese in a big city is like.
My wife and I had a cracking time and would definitely do it again if we came back. Many thanks to Ai and the girls.

Sights of Saigon - I got to experience "XO Sights of Saigon Tour". My guides for today were Hong and Ly. I got to experience Saigon with very knowledgeable guides who took my group around the city. We got to see, and learn about Saigon from a historical and local perspective. Some of the places we visited are not on guidebooks and would be difficult to find on your own.

I'm so glad I was the passenger on the bike. My guide Ly navigated the organized chaos of Saigon. It was a lot of fun to see how the locals get around.

The guides help to filter what's important to see and what wasn't. The routes we took avoided tour groups. There was enough time at each location. During the trip, we had time to have some snacks and drinks. There is no admission fees for the sites today. The snacks and drinks are covered by the guides.

I would highly recommend these guides and these tours to everyone. This is one of the best ways to immerse yourself into Vietnamese culture.

Keep up the amazing work ladies!

Amazing food tour in Ho Chi Minh - Sunny, Vi and the team were amazing, making this not only a food experience but also a sightseeing and cultural one, with loads of tidbits discussed regarding the country's history.

Great Food Tour - What a great night. The bike was equal parts thrilling and terrifying! The traffic is insane. All the girls put us at ease and kept us laughing all night. As well as the interesting food, it was a great way to see the city beyond district one. Thank you all, a highlight from HMC.

XO Foodie Tour - The Undisputed Highlight of our Saigon Trip! - If you are visiting Ho Chi Minh City, definitely do an XO tour. We booked a private tour for our group of seven, and it was easily the best decision of our trip. We would have never experienced all of this on our own; we simply wouldn't have known where to begin.
The experience started with seamless communication via WhatsApp. The team was incredibly prompt and professional in answering our questions well in advance.
The tour traverses five distinct districts (Districts 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8) that most tourists never see. Our guide leader, Giang Do, was exceptionally competent, engaging, and professional. She led a team of "XO Girls"—all-female guides in traditional Ao Dai who were funny, knowledgeable, and, most importantly, very safe drivers. We also had male security staff with us to ensure everything went smoothly, and we felt completely secure navigating Saigon’s chaotic traffic.
The food philosophy is "No Pho and No Banh Mi"—they take you much deeper into Vietnamese cuisine. Highlights included:
- A spicy Bun Bo Hue to start.
-A market walkthrough where we sampled exotic fruits we’d never even seen before.
-A seafood feast with grilled scallops and fresh crab claws. The guides actually cooked over small charcoal grills at the table and even cracked the crab for us!
-A Vietnamese BBQ where they explained exactly how to eat the different foods and how to use the various condiments.
Everything was included in the $82 price—food, drinks, and even photos they took throughout the night. It is a premium experience that is worth every cent for the safety, the culture, and the incredible food.
Special thanks to Giang Do for being such a pro leader. This tour is a masterclass in tourism. 10/10!

No regrets - Was told about this tour and booked it on the day I arrived in Ho Chi Minh. Great way to see the city and learn more about the area and local food. They also made it fun with various games . My driver, Truc, was lovely and very knowlegeable.
A must do tour, you wont regret it !

Incredible private “Saigon by Night” tour - My husband and I had an incredible private “Saigon by Night” tour with Ai Tran and Ngoc. We visited several local districts, outside of the main tourist area. It was great getting the authentic feel of the city. Being on the back of the scooters during the crazy rush hour traffic was a bit overwhelming at first, but these ladies are experts and we were soon at ease. This tour was so much fun, so informative, and the highlight of our short visit in Ho Chi Minh City. Highly recommended!!

Fastest way to eat and see the city. - So much fun! I'm about 90 kg and they were still able to drive around ho chi min city with ease. All the restaurants were awesome and we would have a tough time trying to find ourselves! Would do again.

Fun, informative and entertaining - a great adventure - What a great experience this was! We got to see all kinds of parts of Saigon. We did it on the backs of scooters, which is truly a unique but appropriate local way to see the city, and we had delicious food at some incredible hidden gems.

My daughters loved it, my wife loved it, and I loved it. It was incredibly informative. There was a lot of fun, laughter, and whimsy. We always feel safe, taken care of and informed.

I'd highly recommend this as a family activity my teen girls absolutely loved it hot tip. Do it early in your trip so that you can take what you learned in terms of different cuisines and even specific places and apply it the rest of your trip.

Special callout to Ha, Mi, Yu, Phoebe and Yang as terrific operators

Absolute must do in HCMC - We enjoyed 2 tours with Xo, sights of Saigon and the Xo foodie tour. Both were fabulous. All 4 of our guides were so informative, funny, great drivers … they think of everything!! Extra staff driving ahead to next spot to organize food and drinks… the girls are so knowledgeable of the city.. the food tour was fantastic as we tried lots of new things … not just food designed for tourists..I cannot recommend Xo tours enough. I was a little nervous of being on a scooter but the girls are such great drivers there is no need to be scared.
Thank you again Vy, Nhu, Noc and one more lady.., I'm so sorry I have forgotten your name!!
Both tours are a must do in HCMC.

I loved our private tour! - We LOVED this trip! There was a group of 9 of us, guys and girls, and we had the best time. The food was great, the guides were amazing, and riding through the city on a motorcycle was so cool! I would recommend this trip to anyone

A must-do food tour! - This tour was so much fun! At first, riding through the city looked scary, but once you're actually in the madness, it's awesome! The ladies were so friendly, exciting, and informative. The food was amazing! A great way to see the city and enjoy local food & restaurants. I would highly recommend doing this tour if you are in HCMC- you won't be disappointed! :)
Super fun night - Let's you see a great variety of districts, rather than just staying in D1 as we would've without the tour, everyone is lovely, making sure you have a great experience

XO Bike Tour WOW! - This was a fantastic way to see the various districts of Ho Chi Minh and experience the diverse culinary delights of Ho Chi Minh. The tour guides were extremely knowledgable and willing to answer all of our questions. Riding those motorcycles through busy city streets was exhilarating. Those girls can drive! I highly recommend this tour.

Best Tour in Saigon - This women-led tour was one of the best experiences of our trip. First, all the women leading us were so friendly and nice, treating us like old friends right away. Second, the food we ate was some of the best I've had during my trip. Third, the stories we heard and sites we saw were deeply moving and showed a side of the city that I don't think many get to see. It's a deeply personal tour that I will do again. October 11

An absolute MUST for anyone with an adventurous spirit! - This was the BEST tour I've ever taken, anywhere! Truly, I've traveled all over the world and I usually like to kick off my first day of arrival with a local tour to get a vibe for the city and a lay of the land as well as historical and cultural information for context as I explore the city on my own the rest of the time. I have to say this was hands down the best tour I've ever taken, in any country, anywhere! The drivers spoke perfect English, and were funny and engaging as well as informative. I feel like I learned a lot and ate DELICIOUS food at places I would never have missed on my own. From start to finish this was a top notch tour. We met awesome fellow travelers in our small group and felt just the right amount of adventure on the backs of the motorbikes. I was never nervous or worried for a second on the bikes as the girls were super confident and comfortable and put me right at ease. They really know what they're doing! I HIGHLY recommend this tour to anyone with an adventurous spirit. An absolute MUST!

Fun evening eating all over HCMC - This evening tour was the highlight of our trip to HCMC. We had a blast riding to different parts of the city on motorbikes and eating delicious food at locations we could never have found on our own. Our “drivers” Vi and Phi were a lot of fun engaging, as well as very good drivers. I highly recommend this tour to anyone interested in local food and seeing the city.

Xo Foodie Tour - It was the funnest thing I did in Vietnam. The guides were fabulous they were so kind and told me so much about their culture. It was an incredible experience on the back of a motorbike. The food was brilliant.

Worth every penny - Wow ! What an incredible experience. Did the XO foodie and had such a blast. Riding on the back of a bike through Saigon was once in a lifetime experience. Guides where so friendly , knowledgeable and fun. The food was delicious and my family voted this the best tour we did all of our time in Vietnam.
Highly recommended !!

11/10 experience with XO! - Absolutely brilliant experience. Our guides were amazing, the food was delicious, our teen kids voted it the best experience they've had. Running around on the back of a motorbike through HCMC traffic and feeling totally safe was a total highlight. Absolutely recommend this experience.

Streetfood and scooters in Saigon! - The girls are phenomenal! Riding in our scooters, they showed us the authentic Ho Chi Minh, made us laugh nonstop and the food was to die for! Walking around the markets and seeing livestock by the side of the road was a real eye opener. As for the fish markets, definitely stinky 😂. Visiting a real Vietnamese home was humbling but such an amazing experience. For us that was the cherry on top!

Authentic Ho Chi Minh City - This is an amazing tour, presenting a true and real perspective of life in Ho Chi Minh City. You get a real sense of the community spirit and growing economic prosperity of residents. Highly highly recommended!

A whistle stop view of the real Vietnam - I read about OXO Tours before Covid and the wait was worth it.. My driver was Autumn.. and she was lovely. The whole crew were lovely. The places we went to were interesting and were at the right pace.

This is a life requirement and must do in Ho Chi Minh! - More than just a food tour, this should be listed as a life requirement on anyone's list if you are looking to experience Ho Chi Minh and Vietnam! Best bang-for-buck activity ever! Thank you so much for letting me join & will make a point to do this again!

What a cool and unique food tour! - This food tour was such a unique and memorable experience! The dishes were incredible, and I loved trying foods I'd never had before. The hosts were extremely friendly and welcoming—they truly felt more like friends than guides. The main host was very knowledgeable about the city's culture and shared interesting insights throughout the tour, which added so much depth to the experience. They were also incredibly attentive to each customer, making sure everyone felt included and well taken care of. The fun games along the way added an extra layer of enjoyment and made the whole experience interactive and lively. I would highly recommend this food tour to anyone looking for great food and an unforgettable experience.

A real highlight - Great guides who put a lot of energy and effort into making sure everyone is having a good time. Fun to be in the Saigon traffic on the back of the motorbike (and felt very safe and relaxing). Food options were chosen to be a little different to those you might normally try as a tourist - so great if you've already had your fill of banh mi and pho.

XO Tours a must to do while in Ho Chi Minh City! - Highly recommend XO tours! We went in December 2025. The tour guides were excellent, sharing their expertise, experience and knowledge. These tours are a must if you have never been to Vietnam before!

A night to remember - We had an incredible night time foodie tour with XO. I never thought I would get on the back of a motorbike, let alone in Saigon! The whole experience was exciting for all of us (parents and teens), I felt safe throughout, the food we tried was delicious and definitely not what we would have discovered ourselves. Overall it was a wonderful experience.

An authentic look at local life - We had an incredible experience with XO Tours. They took us through the streets of the city on scooters and always made us feel very safe. The street food was amazing and thoughtfully selected, and one of the most special parts was being welcomed into a real home where they shared stories about their childhood and daily life.

The guides were incredibly kind, hardworking, and clearly grateful for what they did, which made the experience feel very personal and authentic. XO Tours is also a women-run company, which made supporting them even more meaningful. This tour went far beyond sightseeing. It gave us a real connection to the culture and the people. I would 100% recommend this to visiting anyone.

Safe, experience-packed and unforgettable way to enter the flow of Saigon - We had two phenomenal experiences with XO tours in Saigon/HCMC. Did the Saigon by Night tour which was so great that we canceled a cooking class to be able to do their Cultural tour. Our initial concerns about bike and food safety were quickly settled and we were so impressed by the knowledge, capability, and devotion to duty that we experienced with each and every one of our guides. Plus they were just plain funny and really good at creating an easy relationship with us. Fantastic English, both for casual conversation and more serious discussions of war, religion, social issues.
The tours are designed for a personal, somewhat off the beaten path introduction to Saigon. We were fascinated by what we saw and were profoundly translated by the love our guides had for their city and their culture.

Awesome!!! Fun! New Friends! Family! - Amazing & Personal. The XO team were fun, full of energy and so proud to share their personal side of Saigon. We met some awesome locals, visited their homes and shared wonderful food. We leave with a fondness for the people of Vietnam you don't get from most tours

Highlight of HCMC - We took a wonderful Saigon by Night tour with Trang and her colleagues with two kids. Weaving through all the motorbikes at peak hour was so much fun! We've been to Saigon many times and watched it, and walked through it but never before had been part of that crazy flow of traffic. It was terrific! The girls made us and the children feel very safe and welcome and they worked hard to get the (fairly shy) children engaged too. For us adults the trip was informative about different parts of HCMC beyond District 1 as well as just good fun. The Chinatown markets and visit to a home were interesting and the two food stops were terrific. One of the kids was recovering from a stomach issue from Phu Quoc but we all ate everything, including ice, salad leaves and seafood with zero problems. They are obviously very careful in selecting providers who take care to avoid any food preparation issues and more to the point, it was all delicious - and catered for a vegetarian just fine.

Zipping along , whether it was over the main highway bridges or the back alleys was very cool, and the guides were unfailingly enthusiastic, fun and made us all feel very safe.

Can't recommend enough, it's by far the best thing we did in Vietnam, not kidding!

Excellent tour company, Saigon - I did two tours with XO while I was in Saigon. Loved them both. The tour leaders and drivers I had were excellent.
On the 'Sights of Saigon' morning tour, it was a good selection of the main places of interest and some I had not heard of before. Spread over several districts, history and culture was covered and of course being a passenger on the back of a motorbike in Saigon traffic is an experience not to be missed. Same for the evening Foodie tour. Night driving all over the city was great fun and then the food. There was plenty of it, it was varied and delicious. The vegetarian options were amazing. I highly recommend XO tours.

Great experience of the real Ho Chi Minh City - This was a great experience, seeing the real Ho Chi Minh City. The tour was well organized and spent the right amount of time in each location.

The girls were fantastic, very friendly, knowledgeable and polite.

We learned so much about the culture and people. We wish we had chosen this tour for the start of our trip and not the end.

Would recommend their tours.

Great way to get a taste of life in Ho Chi Minh City in just 4 hours. - Excellent tour with Nga, Lam and Binh. Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh as it introduces the food and culture of South Vietnam in a fun and entertaining way.

The best tour in HCMC - Fantastic experience and a must when visiting HCMC. This isn't just a food tour but a food extravaganza!! We had two fantastic tour guides Julie and June who were very knowledgeable and lots of fun! Cannot recommend highly enough, zipping through the city on the back of a bike gives you a whole new perspective of HCMC.

Food tour - 5 star tour
Lovely guides, so friendly and always felt safe even with crazy traffic
Great riders
Awesome food
This is a must do tour

Excellent Motorbike Tour of Saigon! - The XO guides led by Linh were excellent! We really enjoyed the thrill of being driven on a motorbike in the crazy Saigon traffic while learning about the complex history of Saigon. It is definitely an out of the box way of learning about a city that is not only fun but you also get a sense of how the locals commute around the city for everyday life.

XO foodie tour - We had such a great evening on the XO foodie tour. We throughly enjoyed experiencing the different foods, exploring different areas of the city and we most enjoyed the moped ride/company of the hosts. We highly recommend this tour to others.

Don't miss this tour! Worth every penny - We did the tour on our first night in Vietnam and it was a highlight of the whole trip, I can't recommend it highly enough. We took our 8 year old daughter and the guides were absolutely amazing at encouraging her to try new food, keeping things fun all the time and constantly making small adjustments so that she was engaged. The food selections were varied and authentic and the guides were all knowledgeable and had excellent English. It's more pricey than other tours but worth every penny.

Great way to See HCMC and Eat Delicious Food!! - My family and I had a fantastic time on XO Tours! It was such an incredible way to see the city, and eat a lot of delicious food. The drivers were so kind and attentive to our every need, and made us feel extremely safe on the motorbikes. The tour was extremely well organized, and at every stop, our food was ready for us, and we were provided information about what we were eating. The guides answered all of our questions, and we also learned a lot about the City and really felt that we got to see a large part of it. Our group had some dietary restrictions, and XO was extremely accommodating. 10/10 would recommend as a great activity in HCMC!

A trip highlight - An absolute trip highlight! XO Tours is a fun, unique way to see different districts and enjoy delicious local food. The all-girl crew were amazing—friendly, knowledgeable, and made us feel completely safe the entire time. Such a great night. 10/10, highly recommend!

Book this tour now! - The girls are wonderful, the food is amazing and if you are worried about the bike part - don't be! I felt very safe on the back of Linh's bike despite the usual traffic. The team also took fantastic care of me when I started having a headache and took amazing pictures during the tour, which they sent me later (included). At XO they go above and beyond - so book this tour now! :)

Could recommend this more - This was up there for one of the best things we've done in Vietnam. We just got to Ho Chi Minh and had this booked. The girls are amazing fun and great knowledge. They take you round the different districts. Brilliant wizzing about on the back of the bikes. Food is really really good. Great way to settle in to the city. This is well worth the money. Had great fun with all the girls and the other people on our tour. Book it. You won't regret it!!! Shirley and Clive

Don't miss it or be worried about being on the back of the scooter it adds to the night for sure! - Absolutely brilliant night. We really felt safe whizzing around the city with our 2 fantastic lady drivers and the other staff,.
Everyone was friendly, chatty and provided us with a fun evening full of wonderful experiences, fantastic food as well as a lot of general information about the city and culture. 10/10

Must-Do!! - We did the historical tour of Saigon and then the Good Tour the next day. Both were amazing. From riding with the gals on scooters to the sites and foods…everything was top-notch. We loved our guides: Vy6, Phuong, Ann, and Xuan. They asked questions, were accommodating, and we felt like family by the end of the tours.

XO is a MUST! - Going on an XO Tour was the HIGHLIGHT of my Vietnam trip. I loved every bit of it -- riding on the back of a motorbike, getting to know my tour guide, learning about the people, the history, the culture, and trying different foods/snacks. This is an experience beyond any of the other tours my group went on. XO is the tour group that I will recommend to anyone traveling to HCMC.

Fantastic Sights of Saigon tour - through XO tours. - Fantastic tour. Everything was perfectly arranged. My tour guide Linh and driver Vy were outstanding. This is the best historical tour of HCM City you can ever have.

Incredible experience! Highly recommend!! - Had the most incredible time on the XO foodie tour!! My brother and I went on the tour on the 18th of December and could not recommend it more! The food was unbelievably good and not your typical tourist food, the motorbike tour around the city was incredibly beautiful but most of all the girls were such amazing guides! They really made the experience a 10/10 and went above and beyond for us. Chi and Diem2 in particular were so wonderful! From beginning to end they were so much fun, such great guides and really made this the best food tour my brother and I have ever been on. They were so attentive, had answers for all of our questions, taught us so much about Vietnamese food and culture and were so much fun! If you're in Ho Chi Minh this is a tour that you don't want to miss!

Best Night in Saigon 🙌🏾 These Women Rock!* - Hands down one of the most fun things we did in Vietnam! XO Food Tour was the perfect mix of *delicious street eats*, *local insight*, and pure *girl-power energy*. The food? *Incredible.* The stops? *Well-paced and full of character.* The vibe? *Unmatched.*

Riding through the city at night with our amazing (and badass) guides felt like a foodie adventure crossed with a mini city tour. We saw sides of Saigon we never would've seen on our own — all while laughing, learning, and eating like queens.

It was the perfect balance of food, culture, and fun. These women are absolute pros — warm, smart, confident, and so cool. A must-do if you're in town.

XO ladies, you crushed it. 💥🍜🛵

Exceptional - Exceptional experience, we had 3 kids with us from age 12 to 16 and 2 adults, they went out of their way to keep the kids engaged and we all felt safe. Would definitely recommend the tour.

A well organized tour with an exceptional tour guide - I booked the Saigon by Night tour with XO Tours and had an excellent experience. The tour was conducted by Miss Trang and covered multiple districts, provided clear insights into Vietnamese culture, food, and local traditions.
Miss Trang demonstrates strong knowledge, clear communication, and a genuine passion for sharing the city's story. The experience went beyond sightseeing and offered meaningful context about everyday life in Saigon. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an authentic and well-structured evening experience in Ho Chi Minh City.

Single best thing you can do in Saigon - Really such a great night out! The kids loved it. We will remember it forever and was an amazing introduction to HCM. My 10 year old is a very picky eater and was quite scared of the mopeds and ended up trying everything and loving almost everything. She loved going on the mopeds and we got a real taste (pun intended) of what life is like in Saigon.

Perfect first day activity in Ho Chi Minh City - This was a very fun experience for the whole family. We did this on our first day in HCMC, and it was a perfect introduction to the city, the roads, some key sites, some food and drinks, culture and history of the city. Zooming around like the locals on motorbikes was a great way to get around, and the kids loved it. We all felt surprisingly safe with the drivers who did a great job. They were also friendly, informative and great to spend time with learning about HCMC.

Vy8 and Nghi are SUPERSTARS! 10/10 tour. - One of the best tours we've ever done! Worth every cent. We got to see Saigon in a different light, outside of the tourist areas - tasting incredible food and sharing stories with our guides. Our guides Vy8 and Nghi were absolutely amazing - providing us with an unforgettable experience and such wonderful humans. A night we won't ever forget!

Interesting and fun tour - Most fantastic experience. The company owned and operated by women who all speak English and are very good scooter drivers. The food part of the tour was amazing. Learning about Saigon was so interesting. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Food and scooter tour - Huong was my driver. She was fantastic. So full of interesting stories. We saw so much of Saigon and the food was delicious. A business started by women and all women drivers. I can recommend this enough. Riding on the back of the scooter was super fun.

A "wheely" great way to have a taste of Saigon! - The XO Foodie tour was easily one of the highlights of my trip. It felt very authentic because they actually took you out to explore different districts instead of just staying in the touristy District 1. It was actually drizzling right from the start during hotel pickup, but the team was totally prepared and it didn't dampen the mood at all.

There was so much variety in the food and everything was incredible, but the staff really made the experience. My guide, Khloe, was an absolute gem - she was professional, easy to talk to, and constantly checked in on me to make sure I was doing okay. I was traveling solo and never felt like an outcast; the group dynamic just felt very natural and inclusive from the beginning. Khloe and the tour leader, Yen, also shared some really interesting nuggets of information regarding Vietnamese history and culture, which added a lot of depth to the stops. The other ladies and guides were also incredibly friendly and informative throughout the night.

We also had a fun mini-game during one of the stops, which was a nice touch to keep the energy up. Another huge plus is that they took photos of us throughout the night and sent them to us afterwards, so I didn't have to worry about missing any memories. If you want a fun, well-organized way to see the real Saigon, this is worth every cent.

Lovely Experience and Well Organized Tours - Excellent experience trying a variety of delicious Vietnamese meals, and in different parts of the city. What stood out for us was riding throughout the busy city on the back of a scooter, and being able to chat with our guides about their lives. Highly recommended!

High Five to Anh 5 - What a great experience! Got to learn about Saigon, went to see the actual side of how Vietnam is. My tour guide Anh 5 is the best guide out of the 25 different cities and countries that I have visited. Great driver, amazing connection w the city and very personable. Highly reccomend for anyone interested in seeing parts of the city that you wouldn't by yourself.

Great way to see the city - Amazing experience with a lovely group of young ladies. Despite my inexperience riding a motor bike and the crazy traffic of Saigon, I felt completely at ease. We enjoyed seeing the various sights around the city and tasted a few delicious treats along the way. The presentation was informative but not overwhelming, and we had a great time just talking and getting to know a little about each other. They also took photos and sent them to us a few days later.

Night out on the town - 2nd time on this tour and introduced my friend for her first try. Loved it! Great, informative and friendly guides. They handle the motorbikes just fine. We went to the same stops as my first trip but they asked at the beginning if I was okay with it or wanted something different. I liked the food spots so didn't mind going back. The primary hostess is very engaging and all of the girls are great. Part of the whole experience is getting to know the culture and they do a wonderful job sharing information. Its fun getting to know your own driver as they are very inquisitive and curious about so much and by the end you feel like they're friends. I would absolutely do this tour again and refer anyone to go too.

The BEST tours in HCM - If you are looking for a unique experience that is fun and educational, book XO Tours!! Previously, we did the XO Foodie Tour which was so fun and full of delicious food. This time around we did the XO Saigon by Night tour, where we got to learn more about how locals live. It was extremely insightful, like no other tour I've done before, and our family had an amazing time with our wonderful tour guides. An unforgettable experience, 100% recommend XO Tours!

Awesome!! 10/10!! - Hello! This was probably one of the best food tours I have had. I never once felt lost and the whole event had a very good flow with it. I loved that the team really had a great communication and no hassle. They all had a very positive and welcoming attitude. If you are looking for a friendly out doors/experience street food this is the tour. I cannot express how much I enjoyed this!

Loved XO tour - A wonderful adventure through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City with the delightful Nhi, eating our way from one hidden gem to the next and sharing great conversations along the way. We tried dishes we'd never have discovered on our own, each stop offering something unique and delicious. Highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting an authentic taste of the city.

Fun Night Out in Saigon - What a fun experience! This was our third food tour and third motorbike tour in Vietnam and this was a standout. Our drivers (Hang and Thanh 2) met us at our hotel to meet up with the rest of the group. I was a little nervous at how large the group size was compared to our earlier tours, but our guide (Giang 2) made everyone feel included and my fear were unnecessary.

The night ride was beautiful and the stops were unique. Wide variety of food and activities. I suggest doing this on your first day in Saigon to give you a good overview of the city and the different districts. Hang and Thanh 2 were fantastic drivers and great guides while we on the bikes, and Giang 2 had impeccable English and boundless enthusiasm. Such a fun evening - not to be missed!

Night Scooter Ride - What are wonderful experiences. My scooter driver was Khoi. She was charming and a very experienced driver. This is something that I would recommend to all visitors to Vietnam. It is very humbling to see how the Vietnamese people live from day to day. Congratulations to XO Tours.

Kind regards
Rose Hall

XO Tours: The best food tour ever! - Loved this XO tours for food tours!! my 2 friends and i each had our own personal tour guide that drove us around on the motorbike! it was a lot of fun and we got to see the different areas of the city. I would highly recommend this amazing group of girls!!

Wonderful tour - We booked the half day Sights of Saigon tour - it's a wonderful way to see the city highlights. Linh 3 and Hoang, our drivers, were excellent. Both were very capable drivers and, although I was nervous to start with (not having been on a scooter for 30 years!), Hoang made me feel safe. Saigon traffic is crazy and to be part of it was so memorable, if a bit scary! A really fun way to get around.

They were friendly, articulate and very knowledgeable about their city and its history, and answered all our questions. 8 stops on the tour and we had time to walk around each one and take photos. We even stopped for Vietnamese coffee which is a must-try drink.

Overall, this tour is great value, great fun and we'd definitely recommend.

XO And Away We Go! - Very fun experience. Would highly recommend, especially to do it when you first arrive. It will immediately catch you up to speed on what Saigon is all about. The guides were all very nice, very intelligent, and were constantly quizzing us about the things we were learning. All the drivers are great, and make you feel at ease in a large group. Thanks a lot Becky and Giang Do!

A brilliant night in Ho Chi Minh - We had a fabulous night with the ladies from XO Tours. They drove skillfully and showed us many districts of Ho Chi Minh. We ate well (so much food) and had so many laughs with the ladies who spoke English perfectly. We would recommend anyone visit this amazing city to go on one of these food safaris- it was so memorable

This tour was amazing! - This was a fantastic experience. There were 5 of us, each on the back of a moto with very experienced female riders to explore the culinary delights of Ho Chi Minh. Our hosts were very friendly and personable, and chatted with us we rode and at each stop as well. This really helped us to understand where we were going, the food we were trying and the different areas of the city that we passed through. It also makes us feel more comfortable on the back of their bike. And the food was delicious!

Leading up to the tour XO were also very informative, giving great instructions so we couldn't mess it up (even if we tried).

Overall, this was an awesome way to experience Ho Chi Minh!

Fun experience - One of the highlights of our trip. Learned a lot of the history and felt like a local zipping around town in a scooter. We were kept safe, hydrated, and informed all while having fun. Highly recommend!!!

The best food tour in Saigon! - Do this tour!!! One of the guys on our tour had done it 3 times it was that good!

We did another food tour a few nights prior and although the food was good (all Michelin restaurants) the tour was underwhelming and we left disappointed.

This tour was the opposite!
From the word go all the girls were professional, we got clear instructions on how to ride the scooters, where we were going and in what order (restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant), where there would be bathrooms, confirmed any food allergies or dislikes we had and then we were off.

Both Becky and Katie were great drivers, calmly and safely navigating rush hour traffic all while chatting away to us. Every guide was bubbly and truly interested to talk with us about life in Vietnam and our lives and countries as well.

The girls all spoke fantastic English, were very bright and well educated which made for interesting conversations.

The “sightseeing stops” were in unusual areas of the town, specifically chosen to highlight Saigon's history and future and to give you a glimpse into the lives of the people that live here.

Alongside the drivers/guides, they had a lead guide for our group of 10 with no passengers who organized the group and spoke to us at each stop with information about the area, people and traditions. They also had 4 support guys who went to the restaurants in advance to ensure they were ready for us and to support them. This ensures the night flows very smoothly.

At the restaurants the girls guarantee we were all having fun, the drinks and food were free flowing (the boys had 4 dishes of scallops they were so good!)
We loved that they sat with us and were involved during meal times, it meant we got a lot more interaction and made the evening a lot of fun.

This was an exceptionally well organized tour, great guides, good food and a lot of fun, you'll love it.

3 hours of thrilling scooter ride in HCMC + food - 3 hours of fun and getting to experience how HCMC people really live. Jasmine Trang and vy were amazing hosts and enthusiastic towards clients and also the culture. + good food en route.

Don't be afraid ……… just do it. - What a great experience and our hosts Phoebe and Jasmine were fantastic. This is a great way to absorb the city, exactly the way the locals do. Worth every penny and I wouldn't hesitate to do it again.

Fun and different - Great fun whizzing around the streets of Saigon. Felt very safe but just with a hint of danger! Very knowledgeable guides and very well organized. All female drivers. One of the highlights of our trip!

Ho Chi Minh Food Tour - Our food tour with XO Tours was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. I cannot recommend it enough. It was exhilarating sitting on the back of a motorbike riding through the streets of Ho Chi Minh. Our drivers Sam and Vee were highly skilled drivers and we felt completely safe. We loved learning about the culture, visiting the various districts and night markets. We were given so much food during the tour and it was all delicious and varied. Thank you so much for such a fun evening in Ho Chi Minh. It is an absolute must if you visit the city.

A fantastic way to experience Saigon! - XO Tours is an outstanding way to get a feel for Saigon and the incredible street food that makes the city so special. Seeing the diversity and vibrancy of the city from the back of a motorbike is the perfect introduction to the energy, rhythm and flavors of Saigon.

The knowledge, professionalism and enthusiasm of the XO riders/guides really sets this tour apart. They are skilled and truly passionate about sharing their city. We felt completely safe the entire time, and more importantly, we felt like we were being shown around by local friends rather than guides.

The food stops were delicious, authentic and well-chosen, giving us the chance to try dishes we may never have found on our own.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Saigon.

What a way to experience Saigon! - What a way to experience Saigon! My family and I had a fantastic time on the XO tour. Our tour guides were friendly, knowledgeable and made as feel comfortable while we saw some key sites by bike of Ho Chi Minh City. My tour guide “Bamboo” was exceptional! I would highly recommend doing an XO tour.

The real Vietnam - The scooter tour in Saigon was unforgettable.
The two wonderful women who rode with us were not just guides, they opened a window into real life in Vietnam. With their kindness, patience, and big smiles, they show us how people live, how they truly support one another, and how mutual help is simply a natural part of daily life.

They also introduced us to street food that was incredibly fresh and delicious, a taste of Vietnam we will never have discovered on our own.

The adrenaline was high, yet at the same time, we felt completely safe riding with them, thanks to their confidence and calm presence.

I was deeply impressed by the founder of this amazing women's group. Knowing that 120 women work together with such strength, solidarity, and shared purpose makes the whole experience even more meaningful.

It was a special moment of connection, learning, and genuine warmth.

Great experience, definitely recommend 👌 - Just got back from an amazing night of food, fun and touring of Saigon City.

5 stops, plenty of food (too much in fact)

Very knowledgeable and friendly team, special thanks to our drivers Hoang and Thanh 2
Tasting local flavors - Real street food spending time with locals, our hosts Ngoc and Dieu are pretty cool, sharing with us all their good bives! Good experiences provided by XO

Fun, friendly, unique dining and riding experience. - Very well organized evening. If you are not used to riding as a passenger in a scooter it can be a little daunting but the women that ride them are very good at making you feel at ease - it is great fun just jumping in the back of a bike and being taken somewhere in the city in convoy for you next round of food. Zoe and Khoi were great companions for the evening. Always chatting, asking questions, telling us things about the city and then making sure we had enough to eat and drink before we moved in to the next place. Sunny was the overall guide for the evening and, together with al the women involved, always had a smile on her face and seemed sincerely pleased to spend the night with us.

I wound thoroughly recommend this to anyone who wants a fun and unique experience, which feels very professional throughout but still very informal. We did this on our first night in Ho Chi Minh and it was a wonderful introduction to the city.

Scooter tour - What an absolutely fantastic experience The girls are great, we felt safe on the bikes (zipping in and out of traffic and down back lanes was a hoot) and the visit to the family home was interesting and humbling. Would recommend this tour to everyone

The Best Way to Experience Saigon – Worth Every Penny! - This tour was absolutely fantastic! I'll admit, I hadn't been on a motorbike in over 40 years, and the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City looked like complete chaos at first. But my guide was incredible – within minutes I felt completely safe and relaxed.

The food was amazing, the company was great, and the whole experience just flew by. We were out for around five hours but it felt like no time at all. Every stop brought something delicious and different, and the guides made it all so much fun.

A big shoutout to Sunny, our tour leader – she was brilliant! The whole team was friendly, organized, and clearly love what they do.

Yes, you can find cheaper tours, but if you want something truly memorable, go with XO. Safe, fun, delicious, and one of the best things you can do in Vietnam!

Highlight of Vietnam - This was the best thing we did in Vietnam! Linh and her partner were great tour guides - took us to places we wouldn't have otherwise seen, talked about the history, answered our questions. Felt very safe even in crazy traffic. Bikes were a fun way to get around! Morning stop at the markets for local Bahn Mi was so good. Linh then sent through food/activities recommendations along with photos. Highly recommend this!!

Amazing food tour of Ho Chi Minh City - This women owned and operated tour company is top notch all the way. My friends and I did the food tour by scooters and it was incredible. Our guides were amazing drivers, making us feel safe in the chaos of Saigon traffic, incredibly informative and the food stops were varied and delicious. So happy we didn't miss this during our visit.
Book it, you won't regret it. - Brilliant tour guides and fantastic service all round. Highly recommended. We went to markets and ate fab food. Thank you. From Natalie and Charlie Joyce.

Motorbike tour in Saigon - This evening bike tour through the highways & back streets of Saigon was fabulous. The young ladies who drove us were competent & fun. The food experiences (including a fruit market) were in districts we would never have found on our own. We highly recommend this women run business.

A real highlight! - My absolute highlight of Vietnam!!! The whole experience was the best fun, our drivers were so lovely, the food was incredible and we learned so much about the culture and city as well. 100% would recommend this to everyone, it's worth every cent!

Fantastic food experience and a great way to see the city and learn about Vietnam - A fantastic food tour through the streets of HCM. Being scootered through the chaos to the far corners of this vibrant city was an amazing experience. Nga and her colleagues were fantastic chatting about their culture, the food and Vietnam. We learned so much and had a great food experience at the same time. Amazing experiences off the tourist trail - a Pho place, a BBQ meat place, a seafood place with stopovers in between including a market in china town. Highly recommended!

Xo food tour - Ho Chi Minh - food tour with xo girls. A wonderful experience even the sudden downpour and poncho not fitting added to the experience. Most enjoyable was zooming the Saigon streets with my speed racer of a guide. Always first at every stop 🤣

The best experience in HCM city - This was by far the best experience we had in HCM city
So much amazing food and an insight into a few different districts in the city
Our guides were happy and vibrant
So glad we did this tour and would recommend to all that visit

Great tour with delicious food - We had an amazing time on the XO Foodie Tour! We felt completely safe on the scooters, and the food was absolutely delicious.

It was great to see so many different parts of the city and to gain insight from local guides about what life is really like there.

All the guides were incredibly friendly and made us feel welcome and part of the group.
They did an excellent job driving us around — we always felt safe, and it was such a fun way to see the city from a whole new perspective we probably wouldn't have tried on our own.

We enjoyed a variety of dishes, including soup, barbecue, and seafood — everything was delicious!

All in all we would definitely recommend this tour to our friends!

Best foodie tour - The highlight of my trip in Vietnam, a must do. We booked the foodie tour from a recommendation & it was more than we hoped for. Nhi & Huong were fantastic drivers & hosts, any doubts we may have had were quickly evaporated. Even when the heavens opened up both Nhi & Huong displayed excellent driving skills. Food delivered on our tour was superb & we got to see many parts of Ho Chi Minh which we wouldn't have on our own. To top the night off the tour surprised my wife & myself with a cake for our anniversary which made the night even more special. Highly recommend

XO Tour guides are the best-!- Seeing the Sights of Saigon with Ms Nhu - This was my third XO tour having previously taken Saigon by Night tours on previous visits and this time, the subject of this review, The Sights of Saigon. All I can say is: they just keep getting better and better! With each XO tour I take I learn something new about Vietnam and delve deeper into its history and culture.

The strength of XO is, quite simply, their guides. This time, I had a wonderful guide, Ms Nhu Nguyen who was knowledgable, articulate and fun (she kept giving me little quizzes which was really fun). I always felt that she was listening to me and giving thoughtful responses to my questions and opinions about what we were seeing and not just reciting from a "guide script". And she is an excellent moto bike driver-- essential in the chaos of HCMC streets! I always feel safe with Ms Nhu driving.

So if you want an informative and fun way to see Saigon I highly recommend taking an XO tour. You won't regret it!

Unique good experience I won't forget in a hurry - This was one of the best experiences we've had on this trip, we got to ride around to areas of HCMC that we wouldn't have got to see otherwise, and eat at local places where we were the only tourists.

I especially loved that all the guides were female, they were all very knowledgeable and friendly and so helpful when it started bucketing with rain (all part of the experience).

Must try! - The best thing I did in Ho Chi Minh, my driver were simply delightful and very friendly, her nick is Linh3 and absolutely recommend this tour to all my friends.(tour on October 10, 2025).Hope to go on other XO Tours in the future.

A must - An excellent tour! The food was fantastic, and we got to explore much of the city, discovering food spots we likely wouldn't have found on our own. My driver, Teng, kept me laughing the entire time. Highly recommend

Cu Chi Tunnel Tour - Did the Cu Chi tunnel tour with Liam. What a fantastic young man. So knowledgable and fun. A remarkable young man who gave us personal knowledge about Vietnam from his father and grandfather and what they went through. Highly recommend tour and especially Liam.

Great Vietnam tour experience - We had such an amazing tour with Nhu and An. We had the private tour. These two were really friendly and informative during the trip making it fun. Showed us different parts of Saigon. I would definitely recommend this as it's a cool experience to learn some history of Vietnam and try local food and dessert. The two ladies were also sweet and polite with us and engaged in conversations during the whole trip

Best way to spend your birthday! - We had the best time on the tour!we booked the tour for my birthday - 2nd October 2025, it was the best way to spend our evening. Our drivers Anh (Anh5) and Sam (Huong) were awesome! Can't wait to come back again!

wonderful and unforgettable night tour in Saigon - We had a wonderful and unforgettable night tour in Saigon with XO Tours.
Hong and her amazing team of drivers took us on a fun and exciting ride through the city, with delicious tastes, fascinating hidden corners, and family-friendly explanations that gave us a real sense of local life.

One of the most memorable highlights was visiting the home where Hong grew up and met her lovely family – a truly unique and personal experience.

The tour was excellent from start to finish – professional, safe, friendly, and so much fun!
Highly recommended for families and anyone looking for a special way to explore Saigon at night.

Thank you so much!

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh City! - Don't hesitate, book this tour! It has to be one of the highlights of our stay in HCM. From start to finish, this was a very well planned and organized tour. The girls at XO Tours really make the effort to make you feel welcome, engaged and above all else, safe. Zipping through the streets of HCM on a motorbike gives you another perspective of the city. The food is great, but it's so much more than just a food tour. The XO team are really passionate about what they do and we decided to book the tour as it's an all female crew, which we wanted to support. It's a great way to meet other travelers too. Friendly and full of information. I'd like to say a special thanks to our riders V and Autumn. Amazing experience, one I'll never forget

Ride Through Saigon's Soul – Culture, History & Hidden Gems on Two Wheels - If you want to truly understand the heart of Saigon - not just see it, but feel it - this 4 hour motorbike tour with XO Tours is the perfect introduction. We had a small group led by Linh along with Cam and Ngoc. We rode pillion behind the girls which felt very safe, allowing us to focus on the scenery and stories. The pace was perfect, fast enough to cover ground, but slow enough to take it all in. Our guides share incredible insights into the real Saigon—past and present—far beyond what you'd find in a guidebook.
Our guides were exceptional, they were very knowledgeable, passionate, and truly proud of their city's complex history. This tour is perfect for history lovers, culture enthusiasts, and anyone looking to connect with Saigon beyond the tourist trail. Highly recommended as a first activity when you arrive in the city — it sets the tone for everything else.
Thank you for a wonderful morning, we even liked experiencing the sudden downpour of rain towards the end of our ride!

Amazing experience - The Saigon by Night tour with XO Tours was an amazing experience! My driver Ngan was great, very friendly and happy to answer any questions I had. I also felt very safe on the motorbike as I could see she was an experienced driver. It was super interesting to see the local side of HCMC and I really appreciated being invited into Ms Hong's family home. Also, despite the tour not being a food tour, we were given so many delicious dishes to try! I hope to go on other XO Tours tours in the future.

Having fun in Ho Chi Minh - The best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh by far. Our drivers were simply delightful putting us at ease. We are older travelers that are young at heart and we absolutely recommend this tour to all age groups.

A must do - Highly recommend. It was the highlight of my trip to Ho achieved Minh City. The food was delicious and I got to try so many different things. I went places I wouldn't have found if I'd done it myself. The ladies were amazing! I had Hien as my driver/guide and Sunny as the tour leader. They were friendly, kind, and shared so much about life in Vietnam and the food. You should definitely do this tour. I already want to do it again

The highlight of our Saigon visit - A friend had recommended XO tours and we were glad we took their advice.

I did the Saigon by Night tour with my 14yo daughter. Our guides met us at our hotel and were fabulous. My daughter loved the evening and the experience of seeing sights that you don't normally see as a tourist.

Saigon traffic is a unique experience on a bike but we felt very safe with our guides.

Certainly a highlight for our Saigon visit.

Best Food Tour Ever! - Best food tour ever!! Make this experience a priority on your visit to Saigon - the staff team was exceptional and make you feel comfortable on the motorbike - in addition to the food, you see so many diverse areas of the city and they share so much information about everyday living in Vietnam - a trip highlight for sure! My driver Nun was lovely and we chatted during the entire trip. If it rains, don't worry - they are prepared!

My favorite experience in Ho Chi Minh City! - Hands down the best experience I had on my trip to Ho Chi Minh City! I was traveling alone as a woman and looking for something safe to do at night. When I saw this women led motorbike foodie tour I thought it was perfect! Although I was still a little nervous before, my nerves instantly vanished when I met my guide and the group of women the run the tour. They are all amazing at their job and sweet as can be. Additionally, the group has a male bodyguard that follows everywhere so that also helps. The tour itself was so fun and informative. I feel like I truly got a local and authentic Ho Chi Minh experience. I love that the tour took me to places I never would've found on my own. The food was amazing and I had such a fun time riding around town on the motorbike. I was apprehensive at first because the streets of Ho Chi Minh City seemed chaotic, but I can tell the guides knew exactly how to navigate the traffic and after 5 minutes on the bike I wasn't worried at all. I highly recommend doing this tour to anyone and everyone!

Top Ten Vacation Experience - I took the XO Sights of Saigon tour in September and it was one of my top ten vacation experiences! It was amazing to see the city from the back of a motorbike - a truly unique experience! We stopped at some of the main Saigon sites during the tour and my tour guide, Nhu provided some great information at each stop including insights into Vietnam and Saigon. We also stopped at the local market where we enjoyed some snacks. A helmet was provided and I felt extremely safe on the motorbike the entire time, Nhu was a great driver!

A definite must do - Excellent tour - the girls had excellent English and soooo chatty, informative and informative. Ngoc was a great leader. The food was excellent and cruising the streets and learning about the different districts at night was super fun. A definite must do.

It has to be a must-do! - What an enjoyable exhilarating experience! Enjoyable because the ladies are so fun to be with, exhilarating because of the wild ride through the city and an overall great experience trying some of the better food we've eaten in Vietnam.
Thanks to Ngoc, Tin, Ying, Sophie, Bamboo and my awesome driver Sam!

Lovely friendly girls that can really ride bikes and chat in good English at the same time! - Lovely Friendly girls that speak good English. Sophie was my guide and favorite 😊. Would love to have stayed a couple more days.

Best nighttime food tour! - This is a must do food tour! The best we did in Vietnam. Our drivers spoke incredible English and zipped us around the streets safely. The food was amazing - so much lovely seafood and shellfish. The girls were chatty and informative and fun!!! We had so many laughs. The Ngoc, Ying, bamboo, tin, Sam, Sophie - you guys were awesome!

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - The XO Foodie tour definitely lives up to and even surpasses its reputation. The tour could easily be an entire reason to come to HCM City. My Tour Guide Ngoc was absolutely phenomenal, and all of the staff were fully engaged, informative, and professional. The food was great and the camaraderie amongst all the guests made for a great experience. I wanted to keep the momentum going from the wonderful time I had on the foodie tour so the following night I went on the “Saigon by night” tour with Tour Guide Ai. It was absolutely wonderful and just as intriguing as the foodie tour. It's a great way to keep the momentum from the foodie tour and see a different side of Saigon within the same standards and energy of the legendary foodie tour. I highly recommend it as it made for even more wonderful memories. I will definitely go on the tours again when I return to HCM City.
Absolute must do!!! - If you're going to Saigon, this tour is an absolute must. Shows you the real highlights of the city and was the highlight of our Vietnam trip! It's fantastic value.

Fun, friendly, safe, informative - We booked both the Sights of Saigon and Foodie tours and they were fabulous. Our drivers and guides were very kind, friendly and informative. I was nervous about riding a scooter but our drivers were excellent navigators who made the experience feel safe…it was a fantastic way to experience the city and I'd highly recommend giving it a go. It was interesting learning about the history of the city and the food was all very delicious. Many thanks to the XO Team, especially our lovely drivers (Thy, Nguyen, Tu, Ngan - sorry if I have missed your names!) and our enthusiastic guides (Nhu, Thao and photographer Thao)…you have all made our first visit to Vietnam all the more special and memorable.
xoxo Jen + Kane

Saigon XO Food Tour - August 27, 2025 - Loved the experience! The tour showcased 5 districts and highlighted the contrasts and different flavors that locals enjoy within these specific areas.

I enjoyed the banter and interactions while learning the unique characteristics of different types of street food. It was great seeing recommendations outside of District 1. On top of that, we got to experience how the locals embrace street food culture.

The girls showed me different parts of HCMC that I wouldn't have seen, nor would've ventured to. It felt like it added a mini adventure to my trip--trekking and exploring the next unknown food coma spot. The scooter experience was also fun and chaotic.

Y'all are awesome. Keep doing what you're doing. I'll be back to try other tours 😂.

And thanks for making my birthday a memorable one. Much love ✌🏾.

Raph.

So much fun! - We had a wonderful night with the girls. I felt so safe as I was confident my rider knew what she was doing. She was also so lovely to talk to and shared her insights about living in HCM city with me. We covered a lot of the city and the food, whilst great, was almost a bonus. We had 5 stops with 3 for food & beer (& that was enough as we were full). My husband who is actually a motorcyclist really enjoyed it too. Yes it was more expensive than others but I think it was worth it.

XO Foodie Tour - We gad a great time traveling around the city to the various districts sampling the wonderful flavors. Our drivers/guides were extremely good at navigating the city safely. I learned so much from Hoang she was very knowledgable about the culture and the food she spoke perfect English. My partner had a similar experience with her driver Hien2. We would recommend XO tours for the ultimate food tour and it was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

Truly Awesome Food Tour - I can't recommend the XO Foodie Tour highly enough for anyone looking for an authentic Vietnam street food experience. The food was fantastic and we got a wonderful overview of Saigon. Sunny and her team of young women were friendly, fun, and just lovely. There's something truly special about zipping through the hectic streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter on a warm evening with all the sights, sounds and smells. An unforgettable experience for all the family.

Exciting, interesting and unforgettable! - Best experience in Ho Chi Minh! So glad we booked this tour. Every aspect was great - our tour guide was a volcano of happiness and all the other girls were just so lovely. The food was great, the tour interesting and so well balanced - my personal favorite aspect was the visit to the Vietnamese home. But also just zooming through the big city by night was incredible. We felt completely safe with the girls. Don't miss this tour!

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh City - XO Foodies Tour was one of the best things we have done in Vietnam! It was so much fun hanging on the back of a scooter, weaving in and out of the busy HoChiMinh traffic. Our guides Diem and Chee were amazing! Be prepared to EAT! Sooo much delicious food. Thank you XO Tours for a fantastic night ❤️

Best Tour of HCMC 10/10 - You have to do this tour.
We traveled with our children aged 21 & we all agree it's been one of the best tours we have done in Vietnam. The girls were so professional, skilled riders, happy, friendly, knowledgeable and made us feel very comfortable the entire time. Everything about this tour is world class first class. Tuyen and the girls were amazing in every way. Loved it from start to finish & didn't want it to end.
Thanks so much & we highly recommend XO Saigon by Night Tour.

Fabulous Foodie Tour in Ho Chi Minh - A truly fabulous, entertaining and informative tour. Nga was knowledgable, fun, accommodating and the girls were so friendly and couldn't have made more of an effort to make sure we had a wonderful night, which we did. We were taken off the beaten track, all food restrictions were catered for and we got to see more of the real Ho Chi Minh. Despite the chaos of the roads we all felt completely safe on the back of the mopeds and loved it. A highlight from our holiday and definitely a night to remember. Thank you again Nga and all the OX Tour team

A brilliant trip - We were lucky to go on a private tour. They took care of our complex dietary requirements and selected restaurants that met our needs. The drivers were careful, and even though it started to rain, we always felt safe. It was a unique way to see the city - combining. old and new.
Would recommend without hesitation

Amazing - don't hesitate! - A fabulous experience. Very well organized and superbly executed. All of the young women are very personable and knowledgable. The selection of food was delicious and I was introduced to dishes that I may not have tried otherwise. Additionally, I felt very safe on the back of the moped, despite the busy nature of Ho Chi Minh! Highly recommended.

The best tour ever! - I'm in love.
What can I say, Chen, Autumn, Nung and Yang were the best tour guides and hosts we have ever come across. Their energy, engagement, enthusiasm and love for their home is infectious. We (husband wife and 16 year old daughter ) were picked up outside our hotel, presented with a few passenger rules and a helmet then we were off! We completed 5 stops throughout the night, 3 food and 2 site seeing. First we met up with our other tour companions and were introduced to our tour lead Yang and had our first dish. Talk about packed with flavor 😋. Each spot we ate at was better than the last. It really gave us a flavor of Vietnamese food that the locals eat. Not a sign of any other tourists which was nice. The tour was packed with cultural and food information. During our ride from spot to spot we all had engaging conversation with our "drivers", very friendly indeed. All the staff were very attentive and really provided a personal touch and insight to Vietnam. We were unaware that they did more than one tour and would be completing them all when we returned. PS for those who are worried about being a bike passenger my wife thoroughly enjoyed herself, she was very hesitant at the thought of it but thanks to her "driver" ended up having an amazing time. I might even be able to get my bike license now 😂

Best way to explore the food, people and culture of Ho Chi Minh. - I can't picture a better way to explore the vibrant and storied city of Ho Chi Minh than zipping around on motorbikes with such knowledgeable, courteous and always helpful tour leaders. Uyen and Hoang always shows kindness and care for safety while showing us local markets, food and dessert, and the cultural norms and how some of the happy locals live. I was particularly impressed with their genuine willingness to get to know their customers, and their knowledge and appreciation for cultural differences among tour running from different countries.

The best way to experience the delights of Hanoi. Highly recommended! - The XO evening foodie tour of Hanoi was one of the best experiences we've had whilst traveling. It was fun, educational and a gastronomic delight. The women who conducted the tour were what made it so special and memorable. We loved every minute of it!

Culture, coffee, and connection - My friend and I signed up for the joiner day city tour thinking we'd be in a big group but it ended up just being us and one other tourist. Honestly? Best surprise ever. It felt more like a fun day out with new friends than a formal tour. Our guide was super friendly (and funny!!) and their English was so good that everything was easy to follow and way more interesting. We got the perfect mix of Vietnam's culture, history, food, and religion all in half a day. 10/10 would do it again in a heartbeat!

A fun way to explore Saigon! - Had a fantastic experience with XO Tours' Saigon city tour! The guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and made the ride feel safe and fun. Loved the unique local insights and hidden spots we visited — a great way to see the real Saigon!

Amazing! - We had such a brilliant night on the night food tour with XO tours! As a family of three, Yen and the girls made the whole evening so fun, seeing some amazing parts of the city and trying wonderful dishes at places we wouldn't have known to visit otherwise. Our 10 year old son said it was the best part of his holiday!

This is the best foodie tours in Ho Chi Minh with the best Tour Operator! - I was looking for a foodie tour in Saigon and was recommended the XO Tours (more pricey but well worth it)!
The girls are top drivers and have been fully trained as tour guides and drivers so no worries about getting on the back of their Vespa, you are safe!
They will take you to areas in Saigon you will not even know about.
The food tried was delicious. Do not look further and book this tour, you will not regret it... and follow XO Tours on Instagram as they have great information on Vietnam.

The most memorable tour ever! - We have traveled as a family of 5 parents and 3 teenagers. We have traveled from Hanoi down to Ho Chi Minh and done a few tours along the way: Jeep tours, cookery school etc. they have all been fantastic but this one stands out as the best, most fun and interesting tour of the whole trip.
The girls picked us up from our hotel and the next 4-5 hours flew by as we raced around and saw parts of Ho Chi Minh City that we would never have seen on our own. We love food and we always want to eat like the locals but as a tourist it's hard to know which places serve good food and are hygienic. They took us to some brilliant places where the food was delicious. We were so full by the end of it! Yes it's a food tour but they also gave us loads of other information and saw other places. Not to mention the thrill of racing around Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a moped !! Kids loved it. We felt very safe even in such a busy city. I guess the highest praise has to go the girls themselves. They couldn't have been more friendly, attentive and knowledgeable (incredible English too!). Plus they were really good fun! It might seem expensive but honestly 100% worth every last Dong - it has been an amazing way to end our holiday and we would wholeheartedly recommend this company- thank you Sunny and the rest of the team ! X

Good times were had - Did the XO Foodie tour on our first real night in Ho Chi Minh and it was a great introduction to the city. Our drivers Ahn and Kathy were safe, friendly and informative. Our guide Duong kept the energy up and helped ground the delicious food in Vietnamese culture. We ate a lot and learned a lot. This was professional operation with a maintenance team attending just in case. Although they weren't needed, it was good to know they were around. It was a great adventure zipping all around Saigon and taking in all the sites. I definitely recommend XO.

This tour is so worth it- Saigon by Day - This was such an amazing tour. It was my first time on a bike, and Becky made it so safe. I learned a lot about the history of Vietnam, we went to so many places touristy and not touristy, including, but not limited to the secret CIA, building the reunification palace, and even had a traditional Vietnamese lunch in a market

OX Tour - Fabulous tour… Ann and Sam made us feel very safe, they're scooter driving was excellent.
All guides spoke perfect English.
Was very insightful in how the locals live in the suburbs of the city.
Delicious meal and drinks included.
Highly recommend.

Worth girls - A wonderful experience. Lucy was an enthusiastic and well-spoken guide who spoke knowledgeably and made the experience fun and informative. The pacing was excellent and the places in-between the featured stops were well chosen. Thao was a cautious driver who took very good care of me and made the experience so enjoyable. Highly recommend
A must do while in Ho Chi Minh City. - Very knowledgeable and friendly tour guides. We got to see a side of Saigon that most tourists wouldn't normally have access to.

Great tours! Don't miss them when in HCM!! - I did all 3 tours that XO Tours offered and I'm really glad that I had the opportunity to try the whole range.

Xo Tours offers tours off the beaten track and that's why I loved all 3 tours (Sights of Saigon,Saigon by Night and the Foodie Tour)!

The girls who run the tours and the riders are top class!

I did the Sights of Saigon Tour with Linh 3 as leader and Mia as rider. Both were great!

I did the Saigon by Night Tour with Ai as leader and Sarah as rider! I also enjoyed this tour very much and found the visit to Mrs. Mai is very interesting!

Today I did the foodie tour. With Vi as leader and Nghi as driver! And also this tour I can highly recommend!

Xo Tours does a great job and I will never forget these tours! You guys are great! Keep on going!!!

MAKE THIS TOUR #1 PRIORITY - This was the highlight of my entire Vietnam trip. I went on the 26/07 and was picked up from my hotel around 5.15pm. We went on a 4 hour tour around the city. Vy was so amazing and accommodating and my new bestie Nhi was THE BEST TOUR GUIDE EVER. She's so sweet and friendly and we had great chats scooting around Ho Chi Minh City. This is a definite MUST DO if you're visiting the city. Thank you XO tours!! X

Moped tour - first class - Today we were picked up from our hotel by 3 ladies - T, Jenny & Phoebe fabulous on their mopeds. We then met with the group leader Lynh where her knowledge of the city was first class. We had numerous stop offs including a traditional food and a drink stop letting us try local delicacies.
Our drivers woven within the traffic and never once did I feel scared - they were in complete control.
Thank you for a great tour

Brilliant - Brilliant

We were unsure about this tour, but we're glad we did it. This has to be one of the best tours we've done while visiting Vietnam.

XO is a well-organized tour that guides you through many different parts of the city. You will taste various styles of authentic cuisine while being driven around by an incredible group of girls. Spring, my driver, was such a fabulous chick with excellent English. It was a pleasure to meet her and spend four hours together. Vivian, our tour leader, was fantastic. Her knowledge, enthusiasm, and engagement were inspiring.

Thanks again. We'll tell anyone visiting your beautiful city to book a tour!

Great mix of sight-seeing and windows into ordinary life in Vietnam - I did both their Sights of Saigon and Saigon by Night tours on a Saturday and was really happy with both -- they combined site-seeing and windows into ordinary life really nicely. I think the best parts were (1) the home visit to the tour group founder's childhood home on the Saigon by Night tour (a neat mix of politics, history, and daily life) and (2) the amount of 1-on-1 time with the tour guides we got. I had done another Mekong Delta tour with a different operator that was rated highly on Trip Advisor and this was much better.

What an amazing experience! - What an amazing experience! As my 50th birthday celebration, my partner and I spent 2 weeks in Vietnam (North, Central, and South)

We took the "Sights of Saigon" tour with XO tours on July 20, 2025. I rode with the tour leader, Linh3, and my partner rode with Thu. Both ladies were super friendly and excellent drivers. Linh3 described each place with clarity, fun and humor, while taking so many great pictures of us.

The tour was well paced, well planned and lots of fun! We learned so much about the history of Saigon. Experiencing Saigon in the back of a motorbike is the most real and unforgettable feeling. We would've done another evening tour if we had more time. They even got me a cake to celebrate my birthday. So thoughtful!

Thank you, Linh3 and Thu, for a beautiful memory! Highly recommend! 👍👍
We had a fabulous time with the girls from XO the tour was great fun and the food was exceptional, I can highly recommend this when visiting HCMC
