The Best - Researched this before we came on holiday and have to say that it did not disappoint,

Hotel collection the 4 girls were prompted and ready for us. Yen, Mai, Phuong & Xuan were as excited as we were.

From the moment we got on to the moment we got off lots of Laughs, amazing food, games and stories. They even accommodated a fussy eating kid, which was greatly appreciated. This was a perfect way for us to star let and get the kids to understand the food.

Thank you all for a wonderful evening
Sights of Saigon and Evening food tour - Great fun, very personable riders/ guides, Nhu and Thao Vu. Highly recommend. Interesting places, unique, enjoyable.

Was a great experience. The women were talented in their riding skills, knowledge and enthusiasm. This was one of the highlights of my 16 days in Vietnam and would highly recommend for those wanting an authentic experience in HCMC.

Don't say YUM when you're eating, say YUMMY or Delicious 😆🤣 (ask the girls why 😆) - What a fun way to see & taste the sights of Saigon/Ho Chi Minh! We thoroughly enjoyed the scooter ride, the food, the information the girls shared with us & the energy they brought to the event. Well done girls.....you were FABULOUS. We have recommended it already to other Aussies/tourists touring Vietnam & will definitely recommend it to family & friends who are planning to go to Vietnam in the future.
Awesome part of our trip!

Best toor - The most amazing team and guide I have ever met. The tour was well-organized with great stops and excellent guidance throughout. Their work is very professional and well-coordinated, and they are so kind and helpful that the whole experience was fantastic. I'm truly grateful to have met them, and I wish them many more great tours ahead!

A Must Do, for every Foodie... - Our three-week family vacation of Vietnam was always going to end in Ho Chi Minh City. One final food tour to go, the highly anticipated food tour for the family, chauffeured by five extraordinary young women while on the back of motorcycles, exploring the hectic, bustling city of Saigon.
The unique way XO Tours honors their guests, not only through the city's culinary delights but the city's cultural evolution is a must for everyone.
In the words to my daughter from her mother, who has traveled the globe, "That must be, the best tour I've ever been on"
Thank you XO Tours.
Paul Newson

Best in HCMC - XO tour was legitimately the highlight of my VN trip. It was so fun/entertaining. The guides were all so friendly and knowledgeable. I had the pleasure of biking with Thieu (I think this is how it's spell. Sorry if I got it wrong). Bless her soul. She was attentive, generous, and so outspoken. I never once felt unsafe on her bike, and the chats we had made me feel more personal, like we had been friends for a long time.

Get your fill of food and facts! - The XO team did an excellent job touring us around Saigon, filling us in on history and facts, and bringing us to so many delicious bites. My 10-year-old nephew discovered his love of crab AND mopeds on this tour. The XO ladies even graciously deal with my disgruntled dad.

10/10, we will absolutely do it again when we are back in town! Thank you!

Can't recommend enough! - Saigon by night tour was super! Thoroughly enjoyed it, our guides Tuyen and Sophie were so good and helpful and really contributed to the whole experience. Also- auntie Mai (sorry if I've missedpelt) was very sweet and kind to let us into her home. Can't recommend the trip enough.

Extraordinary tour guides - This was an amazing tour and a great way to see many sides of Saigon. The food was great but it was the staff (ladies) that really made the tour so good. They were knowledgeable, very safe riders and so happy to help in any way. We chose XO because of the safety aspect and the insurance included. We would have chosen them for the 4 ladies that assisted us alone, they became part of our family for 4 and a half hours. Will definitely do another XO tour.

The best food tour in Saigon - Amazing tour with women only drivers all with great knowledge of the city. This tour gets you off the beaten path and gives you a whole different perspective of the city. Worth every cent

Highlight of our trip - Amazing tour. Our guides were so friendly and fun. They were great drivers and very social and informative. It was a brilliant way to see all the different areas of Saigon and to eat great, different food along the way. Highly recommend. Was probably the highlight of our 2 weeks in Vietnam.

Fantastic foodie bike tour in HCMC! - We had an amazing time, the girls made the tour so much fun. We ate so much delicious local foods and saw so much of HCMC while on the bikes. Thank you Duong and girls, we had a blast!

Fun kind amazing girls to be with! Best time ever, learned so much! - We had so much fun! The girls are amazing, excellent motorbike drivers! I learned so much and enjoyed every minute! They were so accommodating, kind, fun, chatty! I feel very safe with the girls they are very experienced!

Best food tour ever! - This is truly the best holiday tour we have ever done, our beautiful Vietnamese tour guides and riders were delightful, knowledgeable, and went to every effort to ensure that our evening was filled with good food and laughter. This is an absolute must do if you had to visit Ho Chi Minh City.

Exciting motorbike tours - I did three tours offered by XO tours. Each tour was an amazing experience. The staff are very friendly, knowledgeable, lots of fun and speak English.

Each person is assigned one driver but everyone in the group ensures the comfort and safety of all the guests.

The food offered was delicious and abundant. I highly recommend doing at least the foodie tour, if you don't have time to do all three tours.

If I am in Ho Chi Minh again, I will definitely book another tour.

Thank you to all the staff.

A must do! - We had the most informative and inclusive tour with Uyen and Anh from XO. Uyen, our tour leader, was very accommodating and considering my dietary needs, being a vegetarian and having a nut allergy. It was such a privilege to visit the home Ms. Hong, and meet her aunty who lives there. We feel so welcome. The all of the Vietnamese street food was DELICIOUS, and the experience of riding around on the back of the scooters felt safe and so much fun! Our Saigon By Night tour felt personal and immersive. Uyen and Anh, thank you for educating us and for laughing and chatting with us! The highlight of our trip to Saigon.

Saigon return - Had an amazing night with XO Tours. The girls were so friendly and knowledgeable. I felt so safe on the back of the motorbike. The food was exceptional and it was great to visit places away from the usual tourist areas. Highly recommend.
To do! - I had a very nice time and was able to discover the city in its authenticity. Our 2 companions were very nice and caring. Thank you both! I recommend without hesitation!

Excellent! - Had a great time on foodie tour with Lauren and Tuy (two) and our leader Yin on June 8! The girls were lovely to chat with and super safe drivers. I was nervous at first but no need at all! the food was delicious and they always asked if we'd like some more. It was a fantastic way to get out of district 1 and love the concept of woman operated!

There's also two sightseeing stops to pace eating, and i wasn't expecting much from them but ended up being some favorites from the trip. Excellent way to have a more personal touch of understanding the growth Vietnam has gone through in the last few decades

This will be the best thing you do in Vietnam - Love the concept of this company that was started to give women the opportunity to participate in the tourism sector. We did the Saigon by Night tour. Drivers and guides were amazing. Very friendly, enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Whole tour is very well thought through and takes you to places you will never come across as a tourist. Can't sing its praises enough. Thank you Giant Do and the team.
Just amazing! - Absolutely amazing from start to finish. One of the highlights of our trip. Our guides were extremely friendly, knowledgable, and fun. Can't recommend this tour strongly enough.

Top Marks! Amazing! - We cannot rave about this experience enough! A definite highlight for my husband, brother and sister in law, and myself. This group of delightful and skilled young women are amazing. Ive never been on a motorcycle before and Ho Chi Minh is a big bustling city yet I felt safe and cared for the entire time. Maybe a crazy city to first learn how to ride pillion but I will never forget this wonderful experience. The entire evening was so memorable... from a night market, to a super yummy meal, to visiting a local's house, to learn some fascinating history, and to learn how to ride pillion, I seriously cannot recommend XO Tours enough. Best ever!

Believe all the great reviews. - I did two tours with XO during a week I was in HCMC for work--sights of Saigon and night food. Both tours were highly educational and a total blast. These tours massively enrich my visit to the city. The people who lead the tours are wonderful and the excursions are extremely well planned with wonderfully curated information. Highly recommend.

The Best Tour Experience in HCM City - We had the best time on this tour with Nhu, our guides and the rest of the people on our small group tour. The highlights of the tour had to be the visit to one of the oldest apartments in a local district. This being the first time our child was on a bike in the local traffic, he was well taken of and felt very reassured and safe. If only we had experienced this tour earlier on our trip! We would then be able to do another one with XO Tours!

Best night ever - We had a fantastic time and highly recommend this tour to everyone. Our two guides were just the best, Yen and How. They were super friendly, fun and so informative. Great drivers, we felt safe the whole way round and saw sooo much of Saigon City. The food was great too with the most delicious deserts. What a great way to spend an evening. Thank you so much!

XO Foodie night tour - We everything loved about Vietnam, but this was without a doubt the highlight of our trip. We had such fun with XO tours! Our 2 ladies - Autumn & Tinh were so very friendly we were completely at ease, even when it was raining we felt safe. Cannot recommend highly enough - everyone should book at least one of XO's offerings. You won't be disappointed!!
Ca'm o'n XO Team ❤️

A fabulous experience. - Honestly one of the best things we have ever done. With over 38 years experience of traveling all over the world, this experience on our first night in Ho Chi Minh certainly made sure our trip began with a bang!!
The drivers were brilliantly safe drivers, charming, interesting, intelligent, funny wonderful hosts and the food was delicious and surprising.A fabulous way to experience different parts of Ho Chi Minh and immerse yourself in this vibrant city and its culture. If we could give it 6 stars we would! Thank you all.

You absolutely must do this tour - This tour was brilliant! Highly recommend.
Small group tour, which was great.
Yen our tour group leader was informative, passionate and funny. The food stops are delicious and riding in between the districts was exhilarating. I was lucky enough to ride with Vy. I felt so safe with Vy. We talked about the districts, the culture, the food and so much more. From my interactions with the other tour ladies, they were all lovely ladies, who not only enjoyed their role in riding us around, but we're very good at it. Did I mention how funny they were? Such great humour.
I will definitely do this tour again if lucky enough to be back to Saigon.
We 🖤 love your guts ladies xo
Best Tour Total - Amazing tour! So well organized and a great team of drivers, guides and helpers. It was an amazing tour - interesting varied and fun. A must do if in Ho Chi Minh!!

Simply the best tour and worth every cent - We had the best Foodies tour with XO. Our fearless, friendly and fun guides Ngoc 3 and 5 were amazing and put us at ease even though we were freaking out at being on a scooter in the crazy traffic!!! They chatted to us throughout the ride and then sat with us at each food stop and made it so much fun!!! Our overall tour leader Giang was awesome too - this is really a well run company and well worth the money for this tour. We had delicious food and were not just given rice and boring food. It was all so good and in between food stops we did some short walks to get us ready for the next course!!!
A number one in my book - I enjoyed the xo tour. The staff are all very friendly and customer service is the best. Lucy did a fantastic job leading the tour discussion.

Good times! - Just a fantastic Vietnamese experience! Great food, safe drivers, so much fun! I especially like the fact they have extra insurance as often motorbikes are excluded from Travel insurance policies. The English was excellent and the drivers so attentive.

Don't miss the Saigon at Night Tour - My friend and I only had 24 hours in Saigon and we took the Saigon at Night Tour. It was one of the most special things we did in our entire 2 week visit in Vietnam. Our drivers were an and Nhung and they were not only amazing drivers, but tons of fun and so sweet. They really made it extra fun for us and had such helpful knowledge and comments, it was like hanging out with two new friends. This particular tour is very unique and special--I will remember visiting Ms Hong's apartment and meeting her family for the rest of my life. We covered so much area in the city--so much beyond the usual tourist neighborhoods. I can't imagine a better way to see so much of the city and experience so much culture in such a small amount of time. It has been the first thing I've been telling people about my trip. HIGHLY recommend.

Great way to enjoy the city and the food! - Such a great way to see the city and so much fun!! We tried food we never would have tried before and went to some great places in the city! Many districts! The ladies looked after us so well, we loved it!!

Truly incredible - I'm not sure what to say that hasn't already been said…this was simply one of the greatest and well organized tours I've ever been on. For the price it might legitimately be the best value tour of all time. My driver was Sophie and she was truly amazing! To glide seamlessly through the chaotic traffic that is Saigon is just a special experience. The hospitality and care is another level! What an amazing experience.

Highly Recommended - I went on 2 tours with XO Tours: The Foodie Tour and the Sights of Saigon. Both were excellent. The ladies were so knowledgeable and fun to talk to. I also appreciated that they took photos (good photos) throughout the tours and emailed them to me later.

A happy evening - This was a fantastic trip - everything was arranged seamlessly from start to finish. We had a very enjoyable time with our very friendly and informative hosts - and of course, lots of great food in places we would otherwise never have been to. Was really a happy evening. Highly recommended for visitors of all ages.

XO girls rule the city!! - Wow! Hands down the best tour we have been on!! Hong you are so good at what you do - the training that all the XO girls do makes them equally as amazing! There are no waiting times - so you get absolutely the best value for money.
Special shout out to Anh and Ha - thank you for sharing your city with us.

AMAZING!! - The tour was absolutely amazing and I couldn't recommend it more! The women were so lovely and I always felt very safe. We did the Saigon by night tour and loved every minute of it. We learned so much about their lives and culture, even going into an apartment to see how they live - it was incredible to see first hand. The food served was really good, and they are also very accommodating to any food preferences/allergies. I did this tour in 2014 and came back in 2025 and somehow it was even better, and I will definitely do it again. I couldn't fault them and would urge anyone to book!

Brilliant Experience - We have just finished this tour and OH MY GOD, it's one of the best experiences of my life. We had so much fun, ate so much good food and laughed so much. It was more like hanging out with your friends rather than strangers. These girls are very knowledgeable about their country, their city and culture. They're also funny and kind and we had some amazing chats. It was brilliant to taste all the local foods but also very informative to learn about what has been and is going on In Saigon. If we ever have the chance to come back here then we are booking with XO again. Thank you to all of you for an unforgettable experience.
XOXO.

A wonderful experience. - This tour was recommended to me by a friend. I booked directly with the company and had a really positive feel from the start. They provided all the necessary information about the tour so we knew what to expect and also some great tips about HCMC and Vietnam.

On the evening of the tour our two drivers picked us up promptly at our hotel and drove us to the first foodie stop where we met the rest of the group.

We explored areas of the city we would never have seen on the regular tourist route and there was a mixture of food stops and walking around which made an interesting experience.

Our beautiful drivers Y and V 4 were fabulous. They make us feel safe even in the madness of the busy traffic. They also gave us so much information about the city and their lives. By the end of the evening they felt like friends.

The tour leader, Lucy, kept everything moving on time and also told us plenty about HCMC. Even the peanut game was fun as we are usually not keen on group activities.

I would absolutely recommend this tour. Make sure you do it with XO and not one of the copycat tours.

XO Tours - Amazing 5 stars - XO Tours is an incredible way to see Saigon by motorcycle and experience authentic Vietnamese street foods. My driver Lam picked me up from my hotel and she was awesome. I highly recommend you try XO Tours when you are in Saigon.

Best reason to visit Ho Chi Minh - I had the best time with the ladies from XO. They are knowledgeable, entertaining, and such fun. I couldn't recommend them highly enough. 10/15
Oh, and the food was good too 😂

Most kindness I've ever had traveling - Wonderful experience very unlike anything else I've ever had! Hong and all the guides are incredibly kind, experienced, and earnest. It is clear they've put years of effort and heart into iterating on the tour and sharing their lives with us, and it shows. The most entrepreneurial and kind people I've met.

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City - Cannot rate this tour company highly enough! We did a private XO Foodie tour and it was absolutely amazing. Food was delicious and interesting, the tour was well organized, and the guides gave us a wonderful insight into how actual Saigonese live and eat in different areas of the city. The highlight was definitely getting to know our guides Ngoc and Truc, they were such lovely girls, so knowledgeable and really intent on making sure we had a great time. It's a bit more expensive than some of the other tours we did in Vietnam, but given the level of organization and care that goes into the experience, it's worth it. Would do it again in a heartbeat. Thank you so much Ngoc and Truc for making our visit to Ho Chi Minh City special <3

Best Tour in HCMC, even for kids! - My family and our friend's family went on a private food tour with XO Tours and we had the best time. It was truly the highlight of our Ho Chi Minh stay. We were with our kids, ages 10, 5, 2, and 1 and they went above and beyond with even entertaining them at the restaurants. All the girls were so friendly and drove very safely. Couldn't recommend this tour more, even for families with small kids!

XO Foodie Tour - ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ - The XO Foodie tour was a real highlight of our Vietnam trip. Not only do you get to try lots of different local & delicious dishes, but you get to experience multiple districts, with a local guide, on the back of a scooter!

Exhilarating and perfectly organized tour - This tour was nothing short of spectacular and a highlight of our 2.5 weeks in Vietnam. It was such an incredibly organized, well-oiled machine (an advance team getting things ready before your arrival at restaurants, high attention to detail with respect to dislikes and allergies, etc.), that I immediately felt at ease about everything, whether it was riding around in a motorcycle (not my thing!) and trusting that I was extremely unlikely to get sick from anything I ate. They are soooo good that I just couldn't see it happening. I should add that everything we ate was absolutely delicious, not to mention interesting, and this was soooo much more than a “food tour”. It was a tour of Saigon outside of the usual tourist core, with great commentary on life in Saigon from ultra-friendly, charismatic guides. We loved it.

Fantastic food tour in Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) - Great way to see the city with some fantastic people and gorgeous foods. Foods range from crab noodle soup to scallops. They cater for all dietary requirements. We would never have seen these places without this tour. On the back of a moped is a great way to do it too. Suits everyone from children, teenagers, adults and those young at heart. Organization was seamless from start to finish and we felt very well looked after. Do it you won't regret it!

XO Food Tour - A Night to Remember - What an unforgettable night! Swept up by a group of amazing ladies, we hit the streets of Ho Chi Minh City on a whirlwind food adventure that fed our stomachs and our souls. From bustling wet markets to secret lovers' lanes, from the sleek streets of District 7 to the gritty charm of District 6 (where we half-joked about spotting the Mafia), every stop brings a new laugh, a new flavor, and a deeper appreciation for local life.

Led by the incredible Suny and her vibrant XO crew, we feel more like a group of old friends on a wild ride than tourists on a tour. By the end of the evening, we had fuller bellies, sore cheeks from laughing, and hearts overflowing with joy. This wasn't just a food tour—it was a celebration of connection, culture, and good times.

Highly recommend! One of the best nights ever x

Highly recommend - This was one of my favorite tours ever. A great way to see lots of parts of the city and not to mention tasting great food. Myself andy partners tour guide were fantastic. I just wish I did it sooner so I could try out all the recommendations of places to eat.

Don't miss this! Highlight of HCMC - This was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. Our guides were incredible, kind and generous with answering our questions and making sure we tried delicious foods we would never have found on our own. We felt completely safe on the motorbikes despite heavy traffic and got to see so much of the city. 10/10 experience!

Fantastic evening cruising the city and eating good food - What a fantastic way to see Ho Chi Minh City, I loved the whole tour! Kudos to Vy 8 for being my pilot on the bike and Yen for being our tour leader. Both ladies made it such a fun and informative night. I never felt unsafe on the bike, Vy was great navigating the traffic and talking about everything from food (of course) to number plates and cats! Yen shared plenty of information about the food we tried but also about Vietnam and HCM City. The mix of stopping for a bit of sightseeing in between food stops was perfect for letting our bellies rest and getting to know the city just that little bit better. I highly recommend this tour!

Fun and delicious way to get to know Saigon! - I took this tour along with a friend, and we both had a blast! We joined a group of about 10 others, and we each had a dedicated driver/guide who expertly drove us to our various stops. Yes, traffic in Saigon can be hectic, but I felt safe with my super friendly guide, Ngoc and enjoyed chatting with her as we scootered between stops. Not only did she give me details about the foods that we were sampling, but I learned more about life in Vietnam. Our charismatic lead guide, Giang coordinated our overall group and helped us understand the districts we visited and foods we sampled. We saw more of Saigon than I expected and ate so many delicious things. Don't miss this tour, and be sure to show up hungry because you will be served A LOT of wonderful food!

I felt very safe and the food was amazing! Would definitely do this again! - Highly recommended ! I was nervous about being on a bike after about 40 years but felt very very safe, even with the crowds of reunification day! Food was diverse and delicious. The girls did an amazing job and I would absolutely do this again. To top it off we now have some fabulous snaps that the girls took of us along the way.

Exhillarating, interesting trip - For an extra 5usd we were picked up near the airport and off we went.
We were wisked around on the back XOsgirls motorbikes , across town,down alleys, markets, street food, and old apartment blocks to experience a feel of real Saigon.
Great exhillarating trip.
I highly recommend you try it

Amazing experience - Unbelievable loved every minute and the girls were friendly and spoke great English totally worth the cost the experience and knowledge and feeling safe on the back of the bike would highly highly recommend this experience

Best Vietnamese practice! - Great experience! The food was good and the girls are very positive and conversational!
My highlight was probably being able to practice by very basic Vietnamese with my rider and learning more of it!

Absolute highlight of our Ho Chi Minh visit - If you do one thing, do this!!! My husband told me he had booked a food tour, as we do… later I found out it was on motorbikes and freaked but it couldn't have been safer or more fun!
We were picked up by our lovely guides - one bike each - Hang2 and Ngoc5 couldn't have made us more comfortable! They were safe, chatted throughout, practicing their English that was great and looked after us at each stop!
We met the rest of the group at the first stop and I can still taste that crab broth!!!!
Food, eateries that we will never have seen on our own, visited areas beyond district 1, saw sides of HCM we will not have seen, games to bring us together and laugh all made for such a fun evening!!!
Kudos to the team for perfecting this!!

Fabulous Foodie Tour! - One of the main highlights of our Vietnam visit was the XO Foodie Tour in Ho Chi Minh City. It was an experience I will never forget. We were a group of 12 and each one of us had our own female guide who drove us around on a motorbike. I have to admit that I was concerned to be on a motorbike in what appears to be chaos on the roads of Vietnam.
On March 14, 2025, my husband and I were joined by our guides Vy 10 and Tien. They were fabulous! They immediately put us at ease by talking and chatting with us while they drove their motorbikes. They were calm and maneuvered traffic beautifully. Our concerns switched to pure enjoyment. We felt completely immersed in the culture. The local food was amazing and we had sightseeing stops in different districts.
If you want a taste of the wonderful culture of Vietnam, I highly recommend this tour led by women. Our entire group enjoyed their guides and I feel especially grateful that we spent time with Vy 10 and Tien!
Amazing fun - If there's just one thing you do in Ho Chi Minh - do this one! It's amazing and so much fun! It was really well run, food was great - and everyone loved it!

Outstanding food tour - XO food tours in Saigon - Exceptional experience led by our two guides Duong and Ngan and complemented by their group leader Lucy.
Choice of restaurants was varied and really good, the guides spoke very good English, very professional and friendly and curious about different cultures.
This is one experience that you should not miss when in Saigon!

The only way to see Saigon! - I did the 'Sight of Saigon' tour. Absolutely fantastic! Great way to visit some very interesting places. Tour guide was very knowledgeable and engaging. You have your own personal motorbike rider (shout out to Uyen!) who is happy to engage in conversation and part with helpful, local knowledge. Being a solo female traveler, it was even more comforting knowing I was traveling with a female led group. My only regrets? The Night tour was fully booked and I was leaving Saigon that same day. I plan to return to Vietnam next year with my husband, and I will definitely be taking him on the XO tours. Fond memories to hold onto until then. Well done XO Girls!

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City - This tour is amazing. They accomodate for allergies/food dislikes. I was really worried about riding on the scooter in the traffic but they were fantastic at explaining what to do. So much food and it was all so tasty. A well organized and enjoyable night out

Spectacular Adventure for Foodies! - XO Tour is hands down the best foodie bike tour in Saigon! The experience was made even more special thanks to the amazing, all-female team of tour guides who were knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about sharing their city. They took us through various districts in Ho Chi Minh City, each offering a rich, immersive look into local culture and daily life. The food was absolutely incredible—authentic, diverse, and something you'd never find on your own. Highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting a deeper, tastier experience of Vietnam!

Fantastic food tour - We had the best evening with the XO girls in HCM! We were taken to various food spots around the city as well as a couple of sightseeing stops. This is such a fun way to see the city and to try the local food (which there's plenty of). The girls are safe drivers, knowledgeable about the city and culture and really look after you. We really can't recommend them enough. Thank you for making our time in HCM so fun and unforgettable!

Best Saigon tour!! - Best Saigon Tour !! Great food, great guides and wonderful tour across various districts and different neighborhoods. Useful and up to date information about trends in the city and background information about people, culture and traditions.

Fantastic food tour especially for foodies - Really fantastic tour. Recommended not only for food enthusiasts (as you try different non touristy food) but also if you have any doubts about crossing the road or the insane traffic in HCMC you will be put at ease with how the riders filter in turn. It was really enjoyable getting to know our two riders (Truc and Lin) and learning about their lives and their brilliant and safe driving. I was really relaxed! Everything was impeccably organized and I bowed down to the tour leader Vy (2) who remembered all our names! Amazing! It's not a cheap tour but I think worth every penny. ❤️

Amazing! - While the XO evening food tour may be more expensive than other similar food tours, but in my opinion it is worth every penny. Starting with the drivers (Vy was excellent - I had never been on a motorcycle before so I was a bit nervous but she made me feel at ease really quickly and drove very safely), the punctual pick up from your hotel, the way the tour leader makes everyone in the group feel welcome and included right from the start, the excursion outside of District 1 to get a very interesting glimpse into how local people live in other districts, and of course the abundant delicious (and) food that you will taste - the 5 hours fly by very quickly and I strongly recommend this food tour. My only regret is not to have also booked the other two tours which XO Tours offer - I really wish I had!

Best Bike Tour of Saigon - It was one of a lifetime experience that I only found in this country. The XO girls will take you to 'experience' Saigon like a friend and not your regular guide. Its too much fun. I did Sights of Saigon tour in the day to learn and understand Saigonese history and saigon by the night tour to see a part of the city tourist can not reach. The tour was very well paced and managed. The group size is small and perfect. The XO girls will make sure that tour is delivered at full quality, its just their work ethic. All in all must try!
Incredible tour - We did the xo motorbike foodie tour and I can't recommend it enough. The guides were incredibly professional and informative. Go on this tour.
Highlight of Saigon!!! - Amazing experience!!!! Loved the XO girls and had such an amazing tours!!! I did the sights of Saigon in the morning and the food tour at night!!! Both were exceptional!!

A must-experience in Saigon! - The tour was fantastic, we visited a local market, ate local food, visited a local's house. The ladies who rode with us were so energetic and enthusiastic, they could also speak English very well. This tour is a must to experience. Thank you Vy4 and Ty for the wonderful experience ☺️

Must-do tour - We had a wonderful tour with Vy and her colleagues a few days ago. As we were wrapping up our 3-week visit to Vietnam, we did not really expect to taste anything new on this tour, as we thought we had tasted everything. Boy were we wrong. We ate everything from yummy stuffed crab soup to grilled goat to fruits we'd never seen before. All delicious! The best part of the tour, though, was motoring through the different districts of Saigon and learning about their history and transformation. This was definitely a highlight of our trip.

Great tour with Kids - We did 2 tours with the ladies of XO and they were both great. The Sights of Saigon was our favorite with a lot of history, culture and religion wand some food thrown in. The Foodies tour was also fun and they were great with providing options for dietary requirements.

Great tour with excellent guides! - We really enjoyed this tour - if you're worried about the traffic and being on the bikes, the girls were super safe! We feel very comfortable in their skills navigating the traffic and also great company!

Awesome Food Tour - A friend recommended this tour and I'm so glad she did. Amazing!
The girls picked us up at hotel, first time on the back of a bike in this crazy city of traffic and not once did we feel nervous. The girls are so friendly, chatty, and such amazing riders - very professional! The food was incredible, so much of it and the stops along the way were interesting and fun. This is a fabulous night out and a must do if in Hoi Chi Min, October 11!

Family fun on the back of a motorbike- the only way to see Saigon! - Family fun on a night cultural tour in Saigon! From booking to farewell, this motorbike tour was pure professionalism. Our kids were looked after and enjoyed being on the back of the motorbikes (totally safe!) while we zipped through Saigon like locals. Our amazing guides weren't just tour operators - they were cultural gurus and wanted to ensure we learn about the traditional ways of the Vietnamese which we loved learning about. We went to a night market and tasted fruit, and then enjoyed an authentic street dinner that was kid friendly with tea and beer. We then went upstairs inside a Vietnamese family's apartment and learned about how they lived. Then we drove for final dessert through back alleyways and home after a tour we will never forget! This was hands down the best way to see Saigon - from the back of a motorbike with your kids squealing with delight. Thanks to Vy and her team of lovely ladies for making core memories for our family.

Ten out of ten!!! - Me and partner joined to tour on our first night in Ho chi min city. I could not recommend this enough!!
Such a great idea combining food, meeting people. explore and learn about the city. The girls were so kind and fun especially my girl V nai 10/10! (Sorry if spelled wrong!). They will just be your besties for the day😆

If you're feeling nervous by the chaos of the city I'd recommend to do this tour first. It gets you comfortable with the people, the streets and most importantly the bikes.
- Agata 😚

The Highlight of our Trip To Vietnam! - I took the XO Foodie Tour with 5 of my friends. Each and every one of us felt that it was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. This was my third time that I took the XO Foodie Tour in Saigon and I had just as much fun as my first two times! It never gets old.
The XO Tours company is very organized and easy to work with. Booking was very easy through their website and the support leading up to the tour was excellent. And the tour was a blast from start to finish. The 4 ½ hours went by so fast! Our guides picked us up at the hotel as scheduled and greeted us with smiles. We conducted introductions, chatted a bit, had a safety briefing, and got on our motorbikes for an amazing evening. The food and drinks at each of the three stops were delicious and abundant. We had noodle soup, Vietnamese BBQ, an assortment of seafood, local fruits and desserts, and a lot of beer. I like the fact that we went to local restaurants off the beaten path and were offered unique dishes that we would not have normally ordered.
But the best part of the tour was our guides. The feedback from my 5 friends were all the same. Their guides were all fun, engaging, and entertaining. All the guides have wonderful personalities, extremely friendly, intelligent, and fluent in English. In addition, all the guides are excellent motorbike drivers. Everyone felt very safe on the motorbike and thoroughly enjoyed the exhilarating ride through Saigon. I feel the best way to see the city is by motorbike.
My guide and driver Giang or “Cam” (nickname) did a fantastic job and made the evening so much fun. Cam was also the Tour Leader for the group and expertly executed the tour with confidence, excellent leadership, and professionalism. She provided informative discussions along the way about the food, Vietnamese culture, life in Saigon, and the history. It was so interesting. Cam was very articulate and enthusiastic when she spoke. She also took photos of us at key locations during the tour and sent them to us after the tour. It was nice to not have to worry about taking our own photos during the tour and just focus on enjoying the experience and conversations with our guides. When Cam learned that I took the XO Foodie Tour before, she took the initiative to make slight changes to the itinerary to create new experiences for me. She had the ability to do that since my friends and I were the only ones in the group. She asked if she could substitute one of the regular stops to an alternate location and we agreed. Cam also went out of her way to purchase a dish from a restaurant that wasn't on our stop since I mentioned that I wanted to try it. I didn't expect her to go out of her way to do that and it was a pleasant surprise. This completely exceeded my expectations! This is an example of elite customer service that sets XO Tours apart from other tour companies.
We also purchased the option to have an XO Tours employee film our night out and create a video with soundtrack to remember our fun evening. You can choose the songs that you want for the soundtrack or leave it to the video team to choose. We let the video team choose the songs and they did great. The final video was really done well and something we will always cherish.
I highly recommend this tour! This is the top tour in Saigon in my opinion. I would even take it a fourth time!

XO Tours Saigon 👍 - If you travel to Saigon, you really have to do this tour. It is a genuine reflection of the city traffic madness and its food traditions. The XO staff are incredibly friendly and very experienced, you feel safe and secure at all times. You get to see areas of Saigon that you will likely never enjoy with full explanation from the XO ladies. This is the tour we enjoyed most above all others. Thanks XO…

A must do experience in Ho Chi Minh City - Of all the amazing things we did and saw in Vietnam, this was up there as one of the best. The girls were fantastic guides and made our family feel so comfortable. We did the sights of Saigon tour as we are not big eaters. I would highly recommend it, well worth the money.

Highly Recommended - This was our favorite tour in our travels throughout Vietnam. Our scooter drivers, Tram2 and Saun, were the best!! They both shared so much knowledge of the city while they safely drove us around Ho Chi Minh City. Nhu, our tour guide, was also great in providing us knowledge and made sure the tour went smoothly. The food places we visited were delicious and we had a great group in which to enjoy our meal. I highly recommend!!

Best tour I've ever done - This tour was incredible and an experience that I'll never forget.

All of the girls were so friendly and welcoming, and the food stops they took us to were authentic and very tasty.

Riding through the city at night was so much fun too.

I'd go as far as saying it's the best tour I've ever done!

I've already recommended it to many other people, and will continue to do so for anyone who's visiting Saigon.

Thanks so much once again to all the team at XO!

As good as the reviews say - We went on 2 of the XO tours, the HCM City sights and the foodie tour. If you really want to learn about HCM City, you need to do so on a scooter. Both tours were excellent. The women who drove the motor scooters and guided us were intelligent, thoughtful, knowledgeable, and personable. We especially like the foodie tour because if brought us to at least 5 different districts of Saigon (as locals still call it), and wonderful local restaurants with excellent (really excellent) food. The ladies took good care of us and shared stories of living in the city, whic help you understand the value of eating out for locals.

Hands down the best food tour group in Vietnam - This was easily the best food tour we did in Vietnam. The food was amazing as they make sure to take you to places you otherwise wouldn't go. Our drivers and guides were so kind and informative as they made it more about just the food. An absolute must do!

Best part of my trip - I'm from the US and spent about a week in Ho Chi Minh. The absolute highlight of my time in the city was taking the food tour with this group through several districts. They got us out of the touristy parts of the city, made us feel at home, and provided us with several new food experiences over several hours.

My guide Lam was the best moped driver in the city, was so welcoming, and taught me a lot of interesting things as we drove district to district.

If you are spending time in Ho Chi Minh this should be at the top of your list.

Highlights of our trip! - From start to finish, the team made everyone feel comfortable and safe including my 10 year old son! The guides were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, sharing fascinating insights into the city's rich history and vibrant culture. The food stops were absolutely delicious, offering a true taste of Saigon's culinary diversity. Riding through the streets on the back of a motorbike was thrilling thanks to the professional drivers. This tour is a must for anyone wanting to explore the authentic side of Saigon in a fun and unique way! Highly recommend!

Great loss - The drivers and guides were really lovely. The guide was engaging and informative and our drivers chatted about other aspects of local life. We went to some unusual places, local markets etc. Also, it was great to get a bit of a breeze on the bikes! Would definitely recommend

Exciting night food tour on scooters with exceptional young women. - This was probably the best tour we have ever done. Pan and Doung, two very nice young women picked us up on their scooters and whisked us away for a fun and educational night.
These women navigated the city superbly, and are masterful drivers.
There were three food stops and two sights stops. I don't eat seafood and that was catered for.
We were part of a group of ten and at every stop we met up with Nhu, our charming and funny Tour Leader.
These guides have to do extensive training which only 40% pass and all are university educated. Our guides clearly love their job and I really appreciate their efforts. Amazing! Recommend highly.

Unforgettable Sightseeing Tour with XO Tours! - My experience with XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City was absolutely amazing! I took the Saigon Sightseeing Tour and was impressed by the professional organization, the friendly atmosphere, and the overall safety throughout the ride.

The female drivers were not only incredibly kind and attentive but also spoke excellent English, making communication easy and enjoyable. The tour was well-structured, and since we were in a small group, it felt very personal and engaging.

What stood out the most was how safe I felt on the scooter – we were provided with helmets and rain jackets, and the drivers were highly skilled in navigating the busy streets of Saigon. Another great touch was that they took plenty of photos of us during the tour, which we later received as a wonderful keepsake.

If you're looking for an authentic, well-organized, and fun way to explore Saigon, I highly recommend XO Tours. It's the perfect mix of adventure, culture, and excitement!

The Best Tour Ever! - This was the best tour we did in our 3 weeks in Vietnam and, honestly, one of the best tours I've done anywhere! It was excellent from start to finish. Seeing Saigon from the back of a bike is a must do! We saw parts of the city we would have never made it to on our own and the food was abundant and delicious. The stops are well thought out and the pace is perfect. Highly recommended!

Must Try! - Fun, excitement, and knowledge all in one Tour must join. You get to enjoy the Saigon traffic in real life with safe driver. Local food & culture are part of this tour. My friend and I got to know the local life style more. I am glad I joined this XO Tour. I joined the night tour.
Wonderful way to spend an evening - Fantastic tour - hosts were wonderful, food was lovely and enjoyed exhilarating scooter rides around several Ho Chi Minh districts.

Most fantastic motorbike tour of HCMC - We went on two XO tours today. One in the morning to see the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City and one in the evening for the food tour. Both tours were fantastic and I highly recommend them.

Our final stop was in district 4 for some seafood (crabs, scallops, rice cakes, clams in soup). Everything was delish and it was so fun because we had the opportunity to try some new dishes.

I rate both these tours a 10/10. I especially liked that this is a woman runned business employing woman tour guides. All the drivers seemed highly qualified and genuinely happy with their job.
