This tour took us through so many districts within Saigon. We would have never been able to see all of this on our own! And the food was delicious!

XO Tours, the very best! - If you want a tour with a difference, look no further than XO tours. We did the sites of HCM in the morning which was very good, and then the excellent Foodie tour that same evening. “Ha” was my driver, funny, very good English, and a great host. Wife and I had a wonderful time on both tours. Very safe travel, they were brilliant at negotiating the busy streets and you felt safe at all times. Thank you XO tours for a memorable day!

XO for pre-Valentine's tour - We jumped into this tour within 30 mins of arriving in Saigon (late flight, slow bags) and it was a great way to get a sense of the scale and diversity of Saigon. Our guides, Tu, Pan and Nhe (my spelling may be off) were fabulous, fun and knowledgeable. Food options should suit everyone and more were offered. It was also great to meet and learn from other travelers. We both felt very safe on Saigon's busy streets with our skilled guides. Well worth the time and fee!

Best tour ever! - Literally the most fun I've had on a tour anywhere in the world. It's a simple food tour on motorbikes but you get to talk all night to delightful hosts, learn about them and their culture and feel like a local on the bike. Just do it! Our guides Nhu and Tram - 6 stars!!!

This is a 'MUST DO' Tour in Ho Chi Minh City - Our private foodie tour with Lucy and Grace was the most fun and best tasting tour we have ever been on! We really enjoyed getting to visit many districts of Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a scooter and the various food stops (for noodle soup, barbecue, then seafood and dessert) gave us food experiences we had not found in restaurants. Lucy and Grace are smart, fun, and interesting and made us feel like locals for the evening. This was an evening we will always fondly remember for the fellowship and great food - it’s a ‘must do’ tour in Ho Chi Minh City.

Way exceeded expectations - You’ll see/do many motorbike food tours. You’ll question if this is worth the price. You’ll leave the tour with it far exceeding your expectations.

They clearly this down to a T, with everything taken care of in advance, but willing to completely cater to your desires while you go. I mentioned I had been considering trying Balut egg and they made it happen. In addition to the amazing tour guide who kept things upbeat but real the entire time, your driver also speaks perfect English and stays with you through the tour so it’s like having a private guide too with the benefit of the other guests to interact with as well.

It was the fastest 4.5 hours of my time in Vietnam and I enjoyed every minute, with excellent pacing for the food and opportunities to see parts of Saigon I never would have made it to if I had been in my own. If you are even considering this food tour, definitely do it, it’s so much more and you won’t regret it!

We almost missed the food tour so glad we made it! - Due to a 5hr flight delay we nearly missed our food tour. However the administration were super helpful and rearranged our tour to start later.

I was slightly apprehensive about being on a scooter, however the delightful girls were great drivers and excellent company.

We enjoyed all the food, my only problem was by the time we reached the last seafood stop I was just too full to eat!

We also did the city tour the following morning which again was excellent.

Don't hesitate to book with this company you won't be disappointed

Saigon must do - Fantastic tour for entire family. 3 kids aged 8,11, &13 and parents absolutely loved it. The girls are very friendly, knowledgable, and safe in the hectic traffic. We gained an insight into Saigon that we would never have seen if not for booking with XO.
I highly recommend this great value for money service.

A MUST DO ❤️ - This was such a highlight of our visit here, the girls where great fun to be with and we felt really safe and cared for, the food was great and finding out about their culture was so interesting. 5 stars from us

Great food tour in Ho Chi Minh City - I loved our food tour. Amazing Vespa drivers/guides , thrilling ride and well organized tour. Got to see and taste out of the way places and eat really delicious food.XO ensures high food quality and puts a premium on safety .
Fun Food Tour - We loved our time with XO. Fabulous fun and perfectly executed tour. The team is what makes it so special. Professional but not stuffy. Can't praise them enough.

Wonderful tour! Best ever Drivers. - My Wife and I did the Foodie Tour with XO Tours. I can honestly say it was the highlight of our time in Vietnam.
Uyen and Tram were both safe and expert drivers. Their knowledge of local life was so informative.
Both of them made our tour one we will never forget. I would recommend both of them very highly certainly more than 5 Stars!
You must do this tour if you ever visit Saigon, you will not regret it.

Best good tour - We had the most incredible experience with this agency, which organized a fantastic motorbike food tour for us. The tour was led by a group of young Vietnamese girls who took us around the city on motorbikes, stopping at authentic Vietnamese restaurants and food spots.

The ride itself was an adventure, full of excitement and positive energy. The girls were absolutely amazing – friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about showing us the real Vietnam and its traditional cuisine.

Each stop offered a unique taste of Vietnam, and we truly felt submerged in the local culture. Their dedication to making sure we had a great time was unmatched, and we were all absolutely thrilled with the experience.

We highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to explore Vietnam in a fun and authentic way. It was an unforgettable experience! 😊

A must-do in Saigon! - We booked the 'XO Foodie Tour' and it was a great way to settle into night life in Saigon as first time visitors to Vietnam. Our Tour Leader Giang and our lovely drivers were informative, engaging and very personable. We had a great time chatting and getting to know each other! The tour itself was set out where we visited a variety of food spots in Districts that we would have not known about on our own. The tour also had some sightseeing stops in between meals which helped break up the tour and gave us historical insight of the city.

Our Tour leader also took photos of the tour throughout the night and provided them to us via email a couple of days after the tour. Thank you Giang! The tour was the highlight of our trip!

Great night around town, locals style. - Did the XO tour with my friend with no expectations, but after the tour we were absolutely blown away. The guides were very informative, attentive, our guides Trang and Thao went well above and beyond. Highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to experience the locals lifestyle, seeing different districts. Well worth the money, this 5 hours just flew by with different experiences in foods, drinks, local culture.

Best Ho Chi Minh tour! - Stop looking! And start BOOKING! Family of four with 2 kids aged 14 and 12. Could not recommend more highly. Super fun and yes….super safe. The ladies are fantastic scooter riders and even better tour guides. Don't look anywhere else. These ladies are the best for a reason. We did the Saigon Night tour. Plenty of food. Lots of laughter. Love, love. Xx

Great, definitely worth that few euros more! - Fantastic!! Food you don't run into yourself or know where to find nice small group with great food and top tour guides. Super cozy back on the scooter with the ladies tearing around Saigon!
Could try the duck embryo in the egg for the daredevils.
Dikke 10

Highlights of our trip! - The XO Food tour was the highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh - our drivers were lovely and chatty and made it a really fun experience. The tour leader in particular, Nhu Nguyen, was very knowledgeable and clearly communicated at each stop.

We had so much delicious food - we particularly liked the crab at the last stop, so they ordered more for us to eat once we'd finished the initial plate.

Would 100% recommend to anyone in HCMC!

A must-do experience - I've visited Vietnam twice 17 years apart and this may well be the highlight of both trips. The tour guides are engaging, funny, well informed, great drivers, speak perfect English and all happen to be women in their mid-twenties.

We went with a group that included several teenagers and younger children and never had any concerns for their safety.

My guide, Gnoc #3, was very informative and has a top class attention to customer service. Her knowledge of Vietnam, Saigon and its districts and the various foods we tried was impressive.

So much more than a “food tour”, this is a MUST DO experience.

Amazing top foodie and sightseeing tour with lady drivers !!!! - We did this week the amazing XO foodie tour in Saigon. Very well organized, friendly professional lady drivers (Ngoc and Thu) and a top tour leader (Lucie). We highly recommend the XO foodie tour if you go to Saigon and want to explore more than district 1. It was top and all XO staff speaks very good English!!! 🛵😋🤩

Book it, don't think twice. - An absolute must-do in Saigon. The ladies are fun and engaging. You will get a taste (literally and figuratively) of the city that you wouldn't have experienced on your own.

Great way to explore sights around the city, while getting interesting history! (Sights of Saigon Tour) - We did the Sights of Saigon tour.

It was a great way to see many parts of the city - in the common form of transportation!

My wife and I really enjoyed this tour. The guides are knowledgeable and friendly (Ha, An, and May). You see 7+ sights and get history along the way.

The ride is safe and was a fun way to be like a local.

Would recommend!

The best bike tour ever - This is the best tour you will ever go on. We learn so much information and the ladies speak very good English. I was very nervous to get on a bike but they made me feel at ease and talk to you during the ride to take your mind off being scared. By the end of the ride I was sitting on the bike confidently like a local. 100% would recommend

Highlights of our trip! - We thoroughly enjoyed our day and evening tour of Saigon with XO Tours. The friendly ladies made us and our 4 and 7 year old feel incredibly safe on and off the bikes. Both tours were very well organized with lots of information throughout and the offer of further support once the tour ended. We appreciate that they took photos of us throughout the tour and sent them to us afterwards. Looking forward to seeing our completed 'music video' which is an optional add on to have our tour filmed. Thank you again, highly recommend!

Probably the best tour in Saigon! - We did the food tour. Excellent organization great fun and a real attention to detail to our safety and our well being.
It lasts 5 hours but passed very quickly; 3 excellent meals, 2 sight-seeing places and fun drives in between.
It is also a great social event; we exchange numbers with another British couple.
We traveled as a convoy of 20 customers each allocated a scooter and a driver + main guide and security ; all very professional.
I really enjoyed the personal attention from the staff at XO tour.
Highly recommended!

Highlights of our trip. - My family was here for my son's wedding. I had been watching XO Tours on instagram to learn more about Vietnam. 12 of us went on the tour. It was amazing. We saw so many parts of the city, learned about the history and culture of HCMC and had amazing food. The guides were friendly and knowledgeable. All of my family said that it was their favorite part of the trip besides the wedding.

A very tasty and fun night out! - XO Tours in Saigon was a brilliant night out full of good food, fun and learning. I went solo and had a great time meeting the other XO guides as well as the others traveling on the tour. My guide Nghi was especially friendly and informative, as well as a great driver!

I'd highly recommend these tours for groups or solo travelers interested in seeing more of Saigon and trying some very tasty food in locations you likely wouldn't get to otherwise. Check it out!

One of the best tours ever - One of the best guided tours we have ever done. Firstly, it is a lot of fun to be driven safely through Saigon on a moped, secondly, both the drivers and the main guide are very well informed and all speak good English. You can exchange ideas with the female drivers on the way, the guide has chosen great places to illustrate the history and culture of Vietnam. We've learned a lot more than we knew. There is no rush on the tour, there is enough time in all places, even for the toilet, if necessary. The company is run only by women and we can highly recommend it. The groups are small, with a maximum of eight people. The guides also take their own photos on the way, which you will then receive by email.

Amazing travel experience, not to be missed. - Firstly, the booking process is very easy and the communication from the XO booking team is great. My tour guide met me at my hotel on time and was a pleasure to meet with her. We ran through safety requirements of being a bike passenger before getting on the bike, wearing my XO helmet. My guide shared lots of information with me during the rides. We met up with the rest of the tour & other XO guides and our guide leader. Their spoken English is incredible, all fluent. We visited various districts, markets, street food stalls and an apartment. This tour is soo much fun & interesting. The XO guides keep you safe & entertained, they are a real credit to XO and Saigon. If I was staying longer, I would have booked another tour. I could write soo much more. When you visit Saigon/HCMC, I highly recommend a tour with XO.

XO tour Ho Chi Minh City- Highly Recommended!!!! - Wonderful tour! The XO tour was a highlight of the trip for me and my family. The guides were fun, knowledgeable, and engaged. The selection of stops at historical sites, markets, and pagodas was perfect. And, riding around the city on the back of a scooter was FUN! XO tours is highly recommended.

Just do it! An absolute highlight for us - This was undoubtedly one of the best things we did in Vietnam! Thy and her team were wonderful hosts and made us feel so welcome. Safety was a key consideration when booking this tour, and the girls were expert drivers. None of us (a family of four) felt anxious or unsafe being driven by the girls.

Experiencing the local food was superb. With a well-considered selection and all tastes catered for, it was great to have the inside track. I did a lot of research to find the best food tour possible and was keen to find one that didn't offer food readily available elsewhere (no Banh Mi, please!). This one ticked all the boxes!

An unexpected highlight of this tour was learning so much about what life is really like in Vietnam. The two sightseeing stops and so much insight from the girls (chatting with us as we drove from one stop to another) about day-to-day life were hugely informative and engaging and we left with a much greater appreciation of what life is like behind the tourism.

Honestly, don't hesitate to book this tour. Great team, great food, wonderful experience :)

Delicious family fun with incredible hosts! - What a ride!!
Watching the crazy busy streets we felt a little nervous, but our incredible hosts reassured us and made us feel completely safe! We had kids aged 10, 12 and 14 who rated this as their fave adventure on our SE Asian holiday, it’s seriously that good!
The food variety was incredible and took us off the beaten track of Saigon to experience far more of the city.
We played games in between courses and meals, sightseeing along the way with our super hosts Hang, Anh, Thao, Ngan and Tran!
Thanks for an unforgettable experience.

Not Your Usual Food Tour - One of the best food tours we've ever done anywhere. The guides made us all feel so comfortable and safe from the start. They were friendly and knowledgeable. The tour was well-organised and interesting. This wasn't your usual Pho and Bhan Mi. We experienced parts of Saigon we would never would have found on our own including a really quirky outdoor BBQ restaurant with a live band! We loved the pace of a food stop interspersed with a bit of walking/site seeing. We would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC.

An excellent food excursion - A fun-filled tour of the city with three interesting and substantial food stops and some interesting social commentary thrown in along the way. The XO girls are great riders and terrific hosts. And as promised, loads of food I'd never tried before.

Best way to see (and eat!) HCMC! - My husband and I did the XO Foodie tour as part of our honeymoon trip to Vietnam and it was easily the best part of our time in Ho Chi Minh City! Hong was the lead of our 15+ person group, and Jenny and Hazey drove myself and my husband. All 3 women were just the best! Hong led the tour with ease, making us feel welcome and informed throughout the whole evening, and Jenny and Hazey drove us safely around the city, even during a rainstorm. Thank you to all the XO staff for making sure we had such a fun night and tasted all the best food of HCMC!

FUN, FUN, FUN - XO Tours were brilliant!
Cam and her group of girls were so enthusiastic, fun and engaging which in turn kept our teens and us engaged. It was so much fun.
We did the Saigon By Night tour. These girls can really ride motorbikes! Our family liked to go fast so they made that happen, zipping in and out of traffic, showing us different districts markets, local cuisine and we even visited a typical home. (They won't go fast if you don't want to)
It was up there with our favourite tour.
Thoroughly recommend.

Must do in HCMC - This was the highlight of our visit to HCMC! As someone who eats Vietnamese food regularly, I was really happy that the tour included well loved but less popular dishes as well as new ones I had never had before. The tour also did a great job of highlighting interesting aspects of local life style and culture. I left with a new appreciation of how people live in HCMC and their outlook. What really stood out more than anything though were our tour guides. They were the utmost professional and extremely personable. We were non stop chatting the whole time and they took extra care to make the tour fun for our kids, ages 7 and 9.

While the tour initially felt expensive compared to other tours we’ve done in SE Asia, the level of organization and quality made us realize it was totally worth it. Would strongly recommend to anyone visiting!

Great way to tour Saigon and try new foods! - Had an awesome timing exploring Saigon and discovering delicious foods with the XO tours. The drivers were all extremely friendly and knowledgable, and their english is excellent. I've been on other similar tours and often only the main tour guide provides any information, but on this tour - all of the drivers actively engaged with us. It's definitely worth doing if you're in Saigon!

Tour of ALL Tours - Just return from our two week voyage to Vietnam with stops at Saigon, Da Nang, Hue, and finally Hanoi. Our experience with alot of Vietnam tours ranks the Saigon Food Tour the BEST for our family. Having older kids and being foodie, we just had a blast to experience Saigon's hidden food gems PLUS driving in that controlled insanity of scooter driving!!! I would recommend this tour to everyone in the states that is thinking about coming over to Saigon. If we come back, we would even do this tour again because of how much fun our family had. Awesome Job!!!

The perfect food tour - On December 28, 2024, I participated in the FOOD TOUR ON SCOOTER with XO in Ho Chin Minh. I have only good comments. The organization was perfect. The idea of ​​​​riding on a scooter in this city can be scary, but the drivers are professional and responsible. Kloé, who was my guide among all the others was an experienced and safe driver. During the transport between the stops, Kloé was fantastic as a guide. If you do the tour, I recommend you to ask for Kloé. Kind and calm, she made me appreciate this tour a lot. The whole team is fantastic and dynamic. This tour allowed me to discover parts of the city that I would have never seen. The food stops were all different, good and allowed us to learn more about the local culture. I recommend, it's a must! I hope you will have the chance to be paired with Kloé! Thank you XO for this fantastic experience.

Must do - On a scooter zipping in and out of the traffic and down alleyways, visiting interesting sites, eating and drinking delicious local food and drinks, with really cool locals who spoke excellent English. This was a highlight of my stay in Vietnam

Like visiting the city with local friends - We did the Saigon by Night tour. Our experience was excellent! We highly recommend it. The itinerary took us to different districts of Ho Chi Minh City with stops for street food, light shopping and a home visit.
It started off with a very puncture pickup at our hotel and 2 friendly and chatty drivers taking us to the meeting point. History and culture highlights of each district were provided along the way. Without this tour, we don't think we would have opportunities to visit all these districts. Even though the traffic was hectic, we felt totally safe with our drivers.

The most memorable stops were the street food and home visit. We had delicious food and drinks, and opportunity to chat with our fellow travelers. From the home visit, we learned how the locals live and their generous and resilient spirits. The tour lead and founder shared her humble beginning in that neighborhood. It was very educational and fun at the same time.
With this immersive tour, we felt we were visiting Ho Chi Minh city with local friends.
Every activity in this itinerary is organized very smoothly and seamlessly. Their efficiency in organization, friendliness and attention to details deserve high marks!

Highly Recommend Our Tours - My husband and I did two tours: Saigon by Night and XO Foodie Tour and highly recommend both! Uyen and Yen (and the other 2 guides who accompanied them) were all engaging and friendly and really made us feel like we are traveling with locals and not just guides.

For those nervous about being on a scooter, I am scared about everything and have only been on a scooter once previously. I was initially very tense about the first 10 minutes, but felt safe with them. They drive slow and carefully and really understood how to navigate the crazy traffic!

In the Saigon by Night, it was a sobering experience to visit the former home of the owner (currently occupied by her relatives) in the old apartment section. They took us to parts of Saigon that large tour buses wouldn’t visit, making the experience feel authentic.

In the Foodie Tour, we visited many different districts that I also think most tours wouldn’t go to (especially the ‘trash’ market area), trying dishes that were all excellent!

If you want a local experience with great guides and food, I highly recommend these tours!

The XO Foodie Tour was fantastic. The girls could not have been more attentive. Highly recommended - The XO Foodie Tour was fantastic and highly recommendable
It was my first motorbike ride and I was a little nervous but the XO girls put be at ease and assured that they would take good care of me. The team could not have been more attentive. They are so sweet and genuinely wanted us to have a fantastic experience. The food was great and the ride through Ho Chi Min was very informative
I can highly recommend this tour
Thanks girls for a memorable evening we will never forget

Great introduction to the history of Ho Chi Minh City - I did The Sights of Saigon tour, and can highly recommend it, especially if it’s your first time in Ho Chi Minh City.
The different stops were very interesting, either historically, culturally or concerning religion, and our guide Lucy was very knowledgeable. When you finish the tour, you feel like you’ve learned a lot, but at the same time you want to learn more, which is the best way to being introduced to the city.
The tour group isn’t to big. We were 6 guests, each with our own personal scooter rider.
My rider Thu was great. I felt completely safe when we drove in the city traffic, and it was almost a highlight driving and talking with her between the stops. I learned a little bit about daily life while experiencing the daily traffic.
This was a great experience even for a third time visitor.

Incredible! - We did the Sights of Saigon tour & it was wonderful! A mix of history & getting to experience and learn about local life. Top notch service, super knowledgeable & fun. 100% worth it & highly recommend!

You won't go wrong with XO tours - Had a wonderful experience with the ladies. Very professional and they pay attention to detail. Also very knowledgeable and accurate on information/travel related advice.
The pictures taken and sent after the tour are well thought of and really good.
Having limited time in Ho Chi Minh City I did the City Tour and night food tour with them. Both were of very high standard and very particular!

If you do nothing else in Ho Chi Minh - take this food tour! - This was the best food tour I have ever taken. The girls and guides are fantastic, engaging and knowledgeable. The food stops were all delicious - balancing the right amount of adventurous and comfortable and riding on the scooters around the city was so much fun! It is a must do in Saigon!!!

Living up to the hype and even more!!! - If you are looking for a unique experience that brings you out of the traditional tourist areas, I STRONGLY recommend you to book with Xotours without any hesitation!!

My friend and I booked the night time food tour where we got to enjoy not only very tasteful Vietnamese dishes, but also great company, beer, walking and driving with our lovely guides. Hong, the driver’s leader is without a single doubt an exceptional and genuine guide. My driver, Thao, was simply the best! She was lovely, friendly and was even nice enough to patiently teach me some Vietnamese basics even though I was definitely a slow learner haha…! I really enjoyed the city riding with her.

This was by far the highlight of my time in Saigon and I must say, definitely kick started my Vietnam adventures in the best way possible. Their recommendations were spot on, as the phở they are suggesting was the best I had in the city, as well as being situated in a district full of locals having a good time (which is what I was seeking for).

They are really trying to show you as many parts of Ho Chi Minh without any filters, which I really appreciated.

I will remember and cherish every moments of this special and unique evening together for a very long time. Thank you from the bottom of my heart to the Xotours team’s devotion and kindness. Special thank you to Thao and Hong that have been very professional but more importantly, very human and sincere with me. Cảm ơn, tôi sẽ nhớ bạn!

- Thierry (Thie) from Canada

Delicious food great company - highly recommended - I will never forget driving through Saigon on the back of scooter - chatting with a local, seeing the bright crazy city lights, tummy full of delicious food. We are a family of 5 - 2 adults and 3 teenagers and we all agree it was one of the highlights of our whole trip to Vietnam. The food was plentiful and delicious. We stopped at a couple of non food stops in the city - including a night market. They accommodated food intolerances, and the ladies were so funny and charming and informative. The teenagers were thoroughly entertained (no easy task!). I learnt so much, had so much fun. I can't recommend more highly.

Great intro to Saigon - The Saigon Sights tour is a fun way to get an introduction to the city and see many of the key sites. First time on scooter and loved the experience. The lady drivers, Mei, Tran +1 and were friendly, chatty and very attentive to your safety. The tour was well led by Giang who provided plenty of information on the sites visited. Included a couple of snack stops to introduce you to some Vietnamese dishes. Highly recommend, great way to start visit to Saigon.

Great way to experience HCMC - We had such a great time with Lucy and the other members of our half day scooter tour. It was a great way to kick off the HCHC segment of our trip to Vietnam. Gave us a nice overview of the history and culture of the city, and helped orient us for the rest of our stay. Scooter traffic in HCMC is pretty chaotic, but my spouse and 11 year old son and I all felt safe and taken care of by the women driving us around; actually my son loved it, he wants to do more scooter tours now.

Incredible Night Food Tour by Motorbike ★★★★★ - This XO Tours evening food tour was absolutely worth the higher price point. You get your own guide/driver on motorbike, which is hands down the best way to experience Saigon's crazy nightlife and food scene. We zipped through multiple districts and neighborhoods that would be impossible to cover otherwise, with zero stress about navigating the intense traffic yourself.
The food lineup was impressive - tons of local spots serving everything from street snacks to full dishes. I can see from the photos we had fresh fruit (rambutan), some great grilled dishes, and ended up at what looks like a big group seafood feast. The guides are super skilled drivers and really personable, making you feel safe and comfortable even if you've never been on a motorbike before.
What makes this tour special is how you get to experience the city like a local - weaving through the back alleys, seeing the street life up close, and eating at places you'd never find on your own. Having one guide per person means you get lots of personal attention and can really chat about the food and culture.
You'll definitely get your money's worth in both food and experience. Just wear comfortable clothes and be ready for an adventure!

The Highlight of our Trip to Vietnam - This is the most fun that I’ve ever had on a food tour and a great way to start our trip in Ho Chi Minh City. Our drivers, Thu, Tien and Tuyen, picked us up at our hotel, and we were off on a fantastic adventure on the back of their scooters. They were the best drivers, and we all felt completely safe as we motored around the city at night. We made five stops and the food was amazing. After a start with noodle soup, we were off to barbecue and finally seafood. We stopped at a night market and were served fruit that was purchased there after enjoying our barbecue. If I had to pick a favorite, it would be the seafood at the end. Save room because like everything else, it was delicious. Our guides really took care of us throughout the night, and there was also a lead guide, Nhu Nguyen, who also provided us with so much information about the city and Vietnam. This was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam, and I can’t recommend it highly enough, If you go, ask for Thu, Tien, Tuyen and Nhu. They were the best!

Incredible experience! - There were 8 of us, ranging in age from 16 to 59. All of us loved the tour and considered it the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The guides were fun, and more importantly, drove safely and confidently. Loved the sights we saw and the food we tried.

Terrific tour, terrific food, terrific traveling with XO - XO Tours did an incredible job zipping us around Saigon safely, while introducing us to some great dishes and exposing us to different parts of the city. The tour was very well-organized: they picked me up on time, and accommodated my schedule when I had to finish a bit early to catch a flight. They also have staff on hand in case of emergencies (bike break downs, etc.). Each person gets a driver and mine was the lovely Vy, who was helpful, informative and enthusiastic. The food they picked was delicious, including an amazing soup that was not pho but was layered with flavors and unusual ingredients you could add (banana flour noodles?!). I also ate goat, scallops and crab legs. It was a real bonus that it wasn't the typical Vietnamese fare you could get anywhere. And I enjoyed the non-food stops to neighborhoods I hadn't seen before: the Chinese market and district 7. The latter was a really interesting contrast from the rest of the city, showing how Saigon can encompass such widely diverse neighborhoods. I'd highly recommend the tour - a highlight of my time in Saigon.

Highlight of our time in Saigon! - Our experience with XO Tours was 5/5; it was our group’s favorite part of our time in Vietnam. We did the XO foodie tour, which took us to multiple districts for both sightseeing and food. The five hours flew by because we had such a great time exploring the city with our guides. If there’s one thing you need to do when in Saigon, it is this tour!

Veggie friendly, very safe driving, very fun! - The XO tours are top notch!! My scooter driver Vy 4 drove safely at night and in the rain - I felt very safe! They even had ponchos for when it started raining and we wore helmets the whole time. They toured us all around Saigon - and I got such a nice taste of the city! I learned a lot!

My favorite part was the market tour and seeing all the fruits and veggies! Bring a little bit of cash to buy some fruit for the road!

XO tours accommodated my vegetarian diet and asked detailed questions before the tour to get it 100% right! All of my food options were delicious!!!!!! I got a mushroom soup when everyone else got crab soup and I loved it! I got many several unique and even new to me dishes too! There was a monk bread fried and dusted with cheese powder? It was great!! I was very happy and impressed with this!

Ps - tons of cute pictures!

XO'llent Tour - This was a fantastic tour! Even though we had been to a number of the locations the previous day the tour gave us much more information and context including a personal story from the guide (Linh - fabulous job!). Although nervous on the scooter at first the lovely drivers were so confident and great at negotiating the traffic and felt really comfortable very quickly and by the end wanted it to keep going. Best Tour EVER!!! - This literally was THE most fun and exciting tour I’ve ever been on!! We were met at our hotel by Nhu, Vy 4, Vy 5 and Lam 2 dressed in their adorable matching Ai Daos (traditional Vietnamese dresses) and their scooters. Nhu greeted us and introduced us to the gang and gave us a quick run down of the does and don’ts on the scooters. Then we hopped on and off we went! Here we had these tiny little young ladies driving us around with these big westerners on the back of their scooters through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City. We thought it might be a little dangerous, but these ladies controlled their scooters with us on the back like it was absolutely nothing. They drove us through all the streets and little back alleys and took us to, a local night market, where they walked each of us along and introduced us to all of the different things that were for sale. It was so exciting and we got to see a part of the city that we would normally never knew even existed. After this, we hopped back on the scooters and they took us through different districts to show us different streets, such as the flower, the Shopping St., Chinatown. Then we stopped at a little street side vendor where we got to sit down and experience true street food. We all sat down at a little table, and the girls explained each and every dish to us. The food was absolutely delicious and so flavourful they were even very attentive to my sister-in-law who is a celiac, after this, we walked over and got to experience a true locals apartment and learned of their living environment and how the local truly live. we met the resident who was so kind and smiley and gracious and shared a bit of his life with us. After this, we hopped back onto the scooters and went to a different street vendor for our dessert. We had a lot of laughs and took lots of photos and had the best night ever! It was sad that the tour was ending the memories and experience that we had will be with us forever.

A food tour with a wonderful difference - A delicious, informative and entertaining evening. I am a motorcycle rider and would not normally ride pillion, my pilot Xuan was fabulous. A very confident young lady, chatted as we moved from venue to venue and made sure we enjoyed the experience completely. I would without hesitation recommend you embark on this tour with this inspiring group of young ladies, don't miss out, book it!

XO foodie tour - Fabulous evening on the 'foodie tour'. The food was exceptional and it gave us the opportunity to see different areas of Saigon. The young ladies were all so professional. Tour leader Giang was full of fun & enthusiasm.
It may seem daunting going on the back of a motorbike in Saigon but I had every confidence in my guide Duyen. Competent and caring to ensure we had the best time.
If in doubt go for it, loads of fun.

A truly memorable food tour in Ho Chi Minh City - Wow! What a wonderful food tour the best we've ever done anywhere in the world. If your looking to submerse yourself into the truly authentic Vietnamese food then look no further then XO Tour the moped & drivers felt exceptionally safe my partner was apprehensive to start with however loved every moment ours drivers were such lovely ladies super friendly and informative big shout out to my driver Nhu she was group leader & was so lovely & helpful. The food had variety we particularly loved the bbq meats & seafood as tourists we would never think to travel outside the main districts & into local restaurants so this tour is great to get you out of your comfort zone so to speak. Would highly recommend. Thank you all again XO Tours!

Saigon Highlights - My wife and I really enjoyed our XO Sights of Saigon motor scooter day tour of the city's main highlights on November 7, 2024. Linh3 was our exceptional tour leader. She provided all the information and answers we needed to gain a valuable and informed experience of the city during our short visit. We never would have been able to arrange or see all these sights on our own over the course of 4 hours. We always felt safe riding behind our guides on their scooters as they carefully rode through Saigon's exhilarating and amazing traffic flows. We were also treated to well timed refreshments, snacks and breaks throughout the tour. The entire experience is not to be missed, and is highly recommended.

A MUST-DO in HCMC!! - What an incredible tour- our motorbike guides took excellent care of us, we felt super safe and had such a great time seeing SO much of the city this way! The food was INCREDIBLE- seriously don't think we ate as much on our whole trip as we did in this one night, it was amazing. They were so amazingly accommodating to me as a vegetarian and I had so many amazing dishes. Can't recommend enough, and it's simply an added bonus that it's all female owned and run- we love it!!

What a tour!! A must do in Ho Chi Minh - A great experience from start to finish. Amazing food & didn't expect a tour of the city too.

Lucy was a great host & our drivers Jam and Jen were fantastic, they all had a lot of knowledge of the city and made the experience. Thanks:)

Thank you, Zoey! - This food tour was amazing! The tour guides were so knowledgeable and friendly. We had such a great time with them. The leader was articulate, very knowledgeable and friendly. We felt very safe on the bikes. The tour took us through several of Ho Chi Mihn's diverse districts. The variety and quality of the local food was impressive. But it was my driver who impressed me the most. Hien AKA “Zoey” was a darling. She was a great advocate for the city. Thank you, Zoey, for a wonderful time! See you at the Mercury. 😊

XO Tours is a must!!! - XO Tours is the only all female motorbike tour company in Ho Chi Minh City. Over five hours, the girls took us across the City's Districts to 8 separate street food locations, sampling some of the classic dishes this wonderful City has to offer. It's more than just food though. Giang and her team provided us with so much broader context relating to day to day life in this City, as well as valuable insights for travelers. Above and beyond all it was so much fun!!!
Beautiful experience - Great experience with two great escorts, very comfortable in traffic, they will have made us discover unlikely places!!!

Support a Woman Run Business. - A wonderful experience with the Ladies, who are all delightful! The two girls who drove my wife and I were very competent drivers and we always felt safe. I am about twice the size of my driver but she easily maneuvered through the traffic with me on the back. The food was interesting and always decent portions. All in all a fun night with one of the few woman empowered businesses in Saigon. There are many and cheaper imitators, but these are the originals. Highly Recommended.

High recommendation - This was a great way to experience the various districts of Ho Chi Minh. I was nervous about getting on the back of a scooter but my anxiety soon disappeared. We did the Saigon by night tour.
Visiting the local markets was a great experience. The highlight of the tour though was visiting Ms Hongs house and getting some insight into how locals live.
Highly recommend this tour.

Amazing Food Tour - I did this Tour because I read a lot of positive reviews and the reviews definitely lived up to the hype. The tour was amazing, the guides were fun and very informative. I would like to say a special thank you to my driver Thanh as she had a great personality and was full of information. Most importantly, the food was amazing and the experience gave me a better insight into Vietnamese dining

The best time - We booked a "foodie" night tour, the night we arrived in Ho Chi Minh. There were 8 of us in our group. The ladies arrived on time to our hotel, they were all happy friendly and totally capable of navigating through the unreal traffic. They took us to a few places to sample local food, they engaged us in talking about us and our country. They were absolutely wonderful, they took pictures of us as a group and individuals and forwarded them via email. We saw markets, parks and feel like we saw the whole city. We all had the best time, Totally recommend this tour. Our tour was on 28 sep 24 8 people @ sofitel saigon plaza.

A perfect fun way to experience the food of Ho Chi Minh City! - My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the XO nighttime foodie tour. The guides were smart, friendly, informative, and fun!. It was a great way to see the city and experience different parts of the city. The food was excellent and a great way to taste some of the local fare! Riding the scooter at night is the only way to go. I especially enjoyed the barbequed dishes! Make sure to bring a big appetite.

XO Tours are excellent! - From the start of this tour it was very obvious the XO Tours team knew what they were doing. Friendly, competent, engaging and knowledgeable as we set off on the back of their scooters to the first stop - fresh fruit and vegetable markets. We are 3 Australian couples traveling together, each with a scooter pillion seat on this tour. The first stop followed a journey through Saigon traffic for around 30 mins and at no time did anyone feel unsafe. The girls have grown up in that environment and they just simply handled it with ease. We had a walking tour of the markets, sampling fruit along the way and then jumped back on the scooters to a local resident's building where we were welcomed into their small lounge to chat about Vietnamese life. Fascinating! Dinner followed and our scooters made their way through back alleys to a shop for dessert. All the way, our scooter pilots chatted about their culture comparing there's to ours. Then go back to the hotel. Definitely a huge highlight of our two week stay in Vietnam.

An Incredible Tour!! Such a great way to explore! - I highly recommend XO tours!! I did the Saigon Foodie tour and had an amazing time! The tour leaders were very friendly, knowledgeable, and made for an incredible experience!! I loved riding around the city with them, plus the food was incredible! Awesome experience all around!

One of the best local tours - This is an unforgettable local tour experience which one must take.

It differs alot from the other tours and the most important point is that, you experience it like a local !!!! Dashing through local traffic on a motorcycle like a local….

I would very much recommend anyone to take up the tour with experienced lady rider and knowledgeable tour guide.

NO REGRETS !!!!

Must do experience, awesome evening in Saigon. - Awesome night. Thanks to Tuc and Dim our super bike ladies and to Lucy for her expert leadership and knowledge. We love how you girls LOVE your city and what you do. The food was excellent and venues great. Really really wonderful evening……thanks from Robyn and Tim from Sydney

Fabulous food tour with Truc! - An awesome moped food tour with the lovely Truc, Tue, Jenny and Rosy. Started out dry, then it rained…A LOT! Nothing stopped us though and the ladies driving through knee deep water was nothing short of brilliant! Truc's information on the city and food was brilliant and the food was amazing - crab, clams, goat, beef, beer!

On the back of the scooter with the ladies! - It was a great experience. On the back of the scooter with a student of (in my case) 21 years old. But confidently enjoyed every second of this adventure. Because of the crowds in the city, past several restaurants, a Chinese market..... how do you get to know the city even better than this way!
Definitely recommended!

A memorable way to explore Saigon - This is a wonderful tour - we did the Saigon at Night tour and the lovely Yen was my “super driver”. I was put at ease immediately on setting off from our hotel into the rush hour traffic. Being on a bike is more relaxing that trying to cross the street!
The tour included visiting a wet food market in Chinatown, eating tasty street food and a glimpse into what life is like for locals. It ended with dessert in District 4 and being dropped back to our hotel. The night time lights were vibrant and we got to see more of the city than we would have otherwise.

Professional, fun, great tour! - This was one of three motorbike tours we took in Vietnam and they were the most well organized and professional tour. They were right on time, planned out a ton of information but never felt rushed. Our guides were so friendly and kind. They also took some photos of you and sent them to you afterward. It's not a food tour but you do get to snack along the way and we ended up skipping lunch because we were quite satiated. Would definitely recommend this tour!

The one tour to not miss - especially with kids! - The best experience of our Vietnam tour with kids
We booked the XO foodie tour for 7 of us - including 3 kids (9yo, 9yo, 11yo)
The girls went above and beyond with their tour and it was the one tour our three kids still said was their favourite tour in Vietnam - and we saw A LOT!
The food was incredible and dishes we would never have chosen. Wandered through markets teaching the children about the fruits and other things to see. They played games with the kids and even stopped off at this little play area where the kids were able to ride little light up scooters. They raved about that for DAYS begging to go back. They taught us so much about the culture, way of living for the Vietnamese in HCMC and it was eye opening. I cannot recommend this tour enough to anyone and even more so people with children wanting to experience Saigon in a fun and immersive way. Thank you for taking such great care of us.

Bewildering sight seeing - The girls were amazing. Punctual, knowledgeable, friendly and very accommodating. I personally had a bewildering experience being on the back of a motorbike sight seeing Ho Chi Min at it's finest thus learning the history and stories of the stunning country. It is highly recommended to just jump on and go with the flow.

A not to miss activity while in Saigon - Our tour with XO tours was for sure the highlight of our stay in Saigon. Very well organized tour, easy booking procedure and clear communications after that.
The start of our tour was conveniently at our hotel, spot on time our 'drivers' were there. We got on the back of the scooters of our very capable lady drivers and from that moment the fun and excitement started. We were part of the intense scooter traffic of Saigon without any effort from our site. Besides the fact that the ladies are skillful drivers they also were good company during the whole tour. We had 5 stops during our tour, 2 for sightseeing and 3 for food. So we saw a lot of Saigon and also got a lot of inside information about the city and its people. But more important the food stops were amazing, a large number of different dishes, all well prepared and tasty.
All in all, I can only recommend the XO Foodie tour!

Well worth it - best thing we've done in Vietnam! - Amazing experience! Our drivers: Giang, Ha and Hoang, were knowledgeable, funny, spoke outstanding English and just had such incredible energy. The food was delicious and so different to anything else we have tried in Vietnam. Each district they took us to they were passionate about and it really felt like they were opening a curtain into a totally different world. I went with my 7 year old daughters and my 64 year old mother and every single one of us enjoyed it. I want to do it again!

Amazing experience with NGA and Chan - Nga and Chan were amazing. Such friendly, informative and fun. They kept us entertained and made us feel so comfortable and safe. The places we visited were amazing and such a good way to experience the real good of Saigon. Loved the tour, couldn't recommend it enough, especially with the ladies we had.

Don't think -- just book it! - I can't recommend this tour enough! One of the best tours I've been on recently. The experience is so well curated -- The food was incredible and the hosts do an amazing job making sure you're comfortable and have a great time. Riding on a motorbike through other districts in Saigon made the experience special. Highly recommend!

Bike ride Vietnam with Che 2 (Mei) - Dear Chi 2 (Mei). Thank you so much for taking me around Vietnam. It was my first experience to explore a city on a bike. Your hospitality, safe driving and explanations during the trip was really fantastic. You really have excellent customer centricity, Empathy and excellent English communication was really admirable. Wish you all the best, you are the best rider :) all the best Harish

Must do! - Had the best time with the XO ladies. We were 2 families of 4 with teens and one 6 year old. We all had a wonderful time and enjoyed the ride, the food, the information and entire journey. Highly recommend!
Scooter ride - The tour was amazing and we had a wonderful experience. Our partners were great and we had a good time with them. A must experience if you are in Saigon.

A must do! - What a great way to see the city and learn more about the Vietnamese Culture. Our hosts were magnificent. Very knowledgeable and friendly. I thought riding on the back of a bike was going to be scary given the amount of traffic in the city but I felt completely safe. I'd highly recommend this tour for anyone interested in exploring the sites and eating some delicious food.

10/10 Tour - Truc was a breath of fresh air. A lovely guide, and most importantly a safe driver, for this first time rider. I can't say I'm ordering a Grab scooter anytime soon, but it was a fun experience and a good way to get a more expansive view of the city. It's also safer than trying to cross a HCMC street! We did three food stops with two sightseeing stops in between to allow for digestion. The food was excellent and I definitely left stuffed - there were leftovers and they offered to get us more/as much as we wanted. At the last stop we were given scallops that I'm going to try to replicate when I get home. 10/10, this was a favorite must-do.

XO Foodie - Absolutely amazing experience! It's one of the best things I did in Vietnam. It was fun, it was good and it was exciting. I got good food, I got to laugh, I learned things about the country. My Guide for the Evening, Xuan... WOW!!! So good at driving a moped in the crazy traffic and I felt safe all the time. Are you in Saigon, JUST DO IT!

Best Scooter Tour Hands Down! - This tour was absolutely incredible! We did the night food and culture tour and it couldn't have been curated any better! All of the women were absolutely wonderful and so cute and professional in their outfits! Expert drivers and a really beautiful way to get to know the city the people and the food! It was really wonderful to see the way they live and how they share their stories was eye opening and really honorable the people that live there. I couldn't recommend this tour enough! If I had more time I would've done every tour they had! Thank you to Lam and V our drivers and the wonderful Uyen! :) amazing truly experience!

Food, fun, and Chi: the perfect Ho Chi Minh foodie adventure! - My wife and I had the best time on the XO Tours foodie tour in Ho Chi Minh! My rider, Chi, was an absolute star—funny, engaging, and her English was spot on. She really made the tour special. She spoke animatedly about Vietnam and gave me insights I would never have gotten otherwise. But it was a food tour, so how was the food? Amazing! We hit spots you'd never find as a regular tourist, and everything we tried was delicious. Plus, zooming around on the bikes was such a blast. If you're after a fun, authentic food experience, this is definitely the way to do it!

Fun introduction to HCMC - Great introduction to HCMC with basically a one on one tour guide, the drivers were safe, knowledgeable and great with our teenage girls. Great insight into night life in the city

The best way to experience Saigon and try the local delicious food. - What a way to see the city and eat local, delicious food! It's really something to be on a scooter in Saigon with a very competent and fearless driver! There were five stops in total, three at restaurants and two "sight seeing" stops, and across quite a few districts. Our drivers were friendly and keen to share their knowledge of the city and Vietnam. We were so impressed that we've booked the city tour. I highly recommend this tour.

XO Tours is the only way to experience Saigon - If you only have time for one tour of Saigon, XO Tours is the best option. Their website describes what to expect. The first tour I recommend is the XO Foodie. Driving thru Saigon on the back of a motorbike is quite an experience in itself. Can't go wrong with this option. The second tour I recommend is Saigon by Night. I learned so much about the culture and how people live. The third tour I recommend (I had lots of free time) is the Sights of Saigon. Saw the top tourist sights along with their history.
Their drivers are awesome. Thank you to each driver Giao, Uyen, and Ngoc!! Thank you to each tour guide Vy, Linh, and Tran!! The guides give their business cards, to message if you have any questions, whether related to the tours or Saigon in general. The first stop of Saigon by Night is apparently the same as a stop on the Foodie tour. Recognizing that I had already taken the Foodie tour, XO tours treated me to a different first stop on the Saigon by Night tour. Very much appreciate the attention to detail!! Recognizing I had taken all 3 tours, XO Tours also treated me to a lovely and thoughtful gift to remember them by!! That's why they consistently get 5 stars. They're customer service exceeds all expectations and small gestures, like those above, ensure you will remember their tours for years and years to come!!

Awesome experience! - Awesome tour facilitated by wonderful guides. I had a great time and got to try out so many food options. My guide had some cool stories and gave me a nice insight into what home life in Vietnam is like. Thanks for the fun evening!

Sensational Fun Foodie Tour with the XO Girls - This tour is a must do if you want to experience fabulous hospitality, interesting food that you probably wouldn't order and visit places you don't even know about…. as you zoom along with the chaotic traffic!

The 5 of us which included 3 teenagers had a blast! Being on the back of a motorbike chatting with the friendly, gorgeous girls as they navigate chaos is just bloody brilliant!

On back streets, down narrow streets, across bridges, hooning on highways, crazy roundabouts and cutting across oncoming traffic is scary but wow sooo much fun!! You get to see so much and learn lots of interesting tid bits.

Thank you so much Spring & the girls xxx
And remember…… “who let the dogs out? … woof woof woof, …. woof!!!”

Just do it! - An incredible and insightful way to see the city. The riders were top notch and made navigating the traffic seem a breeze. We went on the evening city sights tour and the 3 hours just flew by. The riders chatted while we moved between locations and the tour guide was very knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend and wouldn't hesitate to do another tour. Thank you XO 🫶🏻

Heartfelt trip in Saigon - This was a very down to earth personable experience in Saigon. A special shoutout to Anh1 who was a great tour guide. She was a very sassy, ​​friendly, and skilled motorbiker. And, It helped that she was short because I had a great view of the city over her head.
The tour introduced the history of the buildings and the people living in it making me appreciate the way of living for the Saigonise. They have very little living space, but they try to live to their fullest which is something I do not see too much in America. I can see their attitudes for each other in the way that they drive and, while it looks chaotic, it was very steady and it felt very safe for me at least. *Disclaimer* If you're cell phone gets stolen, I am not responsible. I was able to steal my friend's cell phone from his pocket so don't make it too easy for anyone else.

Best Bike Tours - Awesome time on both the XO Foodie Tour & the Sights of Saigon Tour. I was picked up from my hotel at the time advised & from there on had the best time. I joined a small group of tourists on bikes & tried different Vietnamese street food, the street vendors catered extremely well with my dietary requirements. We also visited different city sights & had great commentary from our female drivers. I would highly recommend XO Tours.
Great tour day - Wonderful Tour Guide (Giang Do). Friendly, friendly and knowledgeable. I had an amazing time, I learned a lot about Vietnamese history 🇻🇳!

Great trip through HCM with many special impressions - We really had a lot of time visiting such a variety of different locations sampling delicious food. My guide Tram (Jenny) was a very good and safe driver. Simply amazing and impressive very!
Fred

Highlight of our trip to Vietnam! - XO Tours is a must do if you visit Ho Chi Minh City. I have spent almost 3 weeks in Vietnam with my husband and 19 year old son and taking the foodie tour with XO tours 2 nights ago has certainly been one of the top highlights of our trip.
Little did we think when we arrived into the traffic jams in Hanoi at the beginning of September that we would be whizzing around through the traffic of Ho Chi Minh on the back of a motorbike! The girls put us at ease from the minute we met them and gave us an amazing trip around the city showing us and explaining sights we would not otherwise have seen!
The food was amazing - as was the trip around the city especially the food market in China town. Thank you so much Nhu, An and Zen? (Hope I have spells right). You truly gave us a memorable experience.
Mary William and Alex

Best first night highlight - Best thing I did on my first night in Saigon. Did the 'Saigon by Night' tour with the lovely Ngoc who jokingly said it was her first night but 5 mins in I knew I was good hands. Love the diversity of the tour and mix of experiencing local food and culture. Worth it just for cruising through the narrow alleyways and districts. Would definitely recommend XO Tours. I'll be booking the 'Foodie Tour' next. And if you get Ngoc you're in good hands.
Book it! - Do yourself a favor and book this tour...safe and professional and most important so much fun!!! Highly recommended!

Trip Highlight! - An absolute trip highlight - thank you XO tours! We cannot more highly recommend this tour - all of the girls were so lovely and warm, the food was delicious and the motorbikes were so much fun! We felt very safe and cared for the entire tour! Would definitely do again if returning to Ho Chi Minh!

Fun night out - We had a great experience with the XO food tour with our hosts Yen and Lin. As we were the only two booked for the evening we got a “private” tour. Yen and Lin picked us up at our apartment, and after a quick safety lesson we were on our way on the back of a scooter in the crazy Ho Chi Minh City traffic. Even though it rained for most of the night we had lots of fun, and felt as if we got the real “wet season” experience. The actual scooter ride, and the amazing driving skills of Yen and Lin were definitely the highlight of the night (we always felt safe). We traveled to several districts and saw many different sides of the city. The food ranges from noodle soups to bbq goat and beef, to snails, to a variety of seafood, many different fresh fruits, and finished off with Vietnamese che. Overall it was a memorable night with lovely hosts that taught us about the varied way of life in HCMC.

The Highlight of our Vietnam trip! - I cannot find anything of negative, or even neutral to put in this review, only gushing praise. Joanne and Lucy were the perfect guides, and made us laugh and gave amazing insights into day to day Vietnamese life.

It's more than the other tours, but worth every penny.

Oh, and the food is fantastic too!

10/10

XO tours are a must, an amazing experience. - This tour is a must do when visiting Ho Chi Ming City. It is a fantastic night with a great tour guides, great food and a chance to experience the city by night on the back of a scooter. You visit amazing places to eat, and districts tourists will not usually see. The girls are extremely knowledgeable and friendly.

The best experience! - This tour was amazing, one of our highlights for sure. These wonderful women took us around to all the places a tourist would never see, fed us incredible food, allowed us to walk some of it off in places we never would have visited otherwise - like local markets we never heard of, or districts we never thought to explore - and then fed us some more. We got to learn things about Vietnam and the culture we otherwise would not have had access to as well. And we had a hilarious time! Ten stars.

Highly recommend - Yen was a wonderful young lady that took me on this tour . It started bucketing rain prior to the tour so expected it to be canceled but the young ladies turned up and provided us with ponchos etc and off we went. These young ladies are fun very knowledgeable about the culture of Saigon and so accomplished in their driving skills. I highly recommend this tour very professional but also great fun. Thanks Yen for a fab experience 😊

Best tour even done - This is one of the best tours we have done. There was 5 of our age starting from 16. All of the drivers speak great English and make you feel safe while having a lot of fun. What a great way to see Saigon. Variety in the food and very accommodating if someone didn't eat something.
The kids even did a little bit of karaoke.
Highly recommend this group.

Ao Dai Knight Tour Saigon - The tour guides have very good riding skills. The leader of our group, Hang Lam, has also come to Taiwan to study. He is a top student at Beijing University of Science and Technology. He is also very good in Chinese and English. He explained to us some of the development history of Saigon City and also took us with him. We went to eat pho, barbecue and seafood. What impressed me most was that they helped us peel off the crab legs and see Saigon City from a different perspective. It is highly recommended to everyone who comes to Saigon City and must experience it.

Amazing - Was an amazing experience.
Even though this was my second time, I still found it to be so fun and enjoyable.
The tour leader suggested some new local dishes which I found refreshing and delicious.
Thoroughly enjoyed the tour and would recommend to all.

Best way to see and eat your way through an evening in HCM - Gotta be one of the most fun tours i have ever done. These young women are bright, happy and really love Vietnam and share their experience with touring parties. The time flew and food was excellent

XO tours - The Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - Firstly I did the night tour with my driver / guide - V2 who was amazing, very knowledgeable and was a very good driver. She showed me the Vietnamese culture which most tourists wouldn't see which was very eye opening. I highly recommend this tour to see the 'real' Vietnamese culture.
Thank you V2!
Secondly I did the tour around Ho Chi Minh city by day with Lucy, it turned out there was only me on the tour so it was even more special. Lucy drove around and explained the history of the city, the religion and also more of the culture of the country. We had many good talks about local history which was very interesting.
Thank you Lucy!

This company is the best tour company I have found in Ho Chi Minh city and you will not regret booking XO Tours.

Thanks guys!

A must-do in HCMC - This is the best experience my friends and I had in Vietnam. The attentiveness to each of us as individuals was outstanding. I feel incredibly fortunate to have had the opportunity to be shown around HCMC by these tour guides.

These young intelligent wonderful conversationalists were the highlight. I was feeling a little apprehensive not being much on a motor bike but they handled their scooters so well and we all felt safe.

Our team leader was entertaining and spoke so well. A special shout out to Ngoc who was my tour guide for the whole time. She was genuine and kind and together with all her colleagues made for a wonderful experience. Thank you again.
XO Tour - Ho Chi Minh City - Today food tour was amazing. Thanks to Nguyen Dinh Thuy Duong [sunny] been such great tour guide. Would recommend her. 5 stars

5-Star Experience on Two Wheels - XO Tours Exceeds Expectations! - If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! XO Tours in Saigon offers an experience that combines the luxury of a 5-star hotel with the service of a business class flight - all while zipping through the extremely busy and chaotic streets of Ho Chi Minh, Saigon City on scooters!

The all-female crew of drivers were not only skilled riders but also knowledgeable guides with excellent English. They took care of every detail, truly spoiling us tourists. The tour leader, Vy Tran, supervised everything with great attention.

My personal driver, Vy, was incredibly kind and attentive. Despite Saigon's chaotic traffic, I felt completely safe on the back of her scooter.

This tour is perfect for anyone visiting Saigon, especially women travelers looking for a safe and caring experience (I was the only man in our group). You'll discover amazing street food and hidden gems of the city in style.

Don't miss this opportunity - XO Tours is a must-do in Saigon!

Loved this would highly recommend - 10/10 Such an amazing night. We did the Saigon by Night Tour. The guides were amazing, so kind, so fun and had so much knowledge about Saigon and its culture and history. They were excellent drivers making us feel very safe on the road. We loved the authentic street food, so yummy! Best of all was having an insight into the apartment living - it was truly a once in a lifetime experience and was so heart warming.
Best tour in Vietnam - Best tour in Vietnam by far! Highly recommend, such an authentic and personal experience. Staff are the best, see you next year!

Worth every cent plus more!! - There are not enough stars for the quality of this tour. We have been on many tours in our 2 weeks in Vietnam but this is by far the best! It's worth every cent plus more! We loved the behind the scenes experience that money can not buy, it was an absolute privilege being able to go into a saigonise apartment. The stories shared by our tour guide Yuen bought Vietnam life alive for us and our teenage daughters. We took this tour on our last night in Vietnam and our only regret is not having more time to do the xo day time tour. We felt safe, the entire time, wizzing through the streets of Saigon under the care of the incredible drivers was so much fun. We finished the tour feeling like we had made friends - Thank you to the entire team at XO. You are the highlight of our Saigon stay.

Highly recommend the food tour - We really enjoyed the food tour with XO tours.
We went to different districts and ate really delicious food.
The riders were really sweet and told us alot about their culture and were interessed in European culture aswell. We really enjoyed our night and highly recommend it. Definitely worth the money.
Great time had on XO Foodie Tour - I had a great time on the XO Foodie Tour. Great food, friendly, knowledgeable staff and they took me to some interesting locations.

Best experience in Vietnam by far! - My boyfriend and I did the private XO Foodie tour at night and it was incredible! Best experience we have had in Vietnam. We were collaborating with Nga and Ngoc (#3) these ladies were amazing, they spoke perfect English which was great to communicate and ask loads of questions, they drove very safely and we had so many laughs along the way. Very professional ladies that we became good friends by the end of the tour. The girls took us to 5 different districts and tried lots of local food that wasn't bahn mi or pho. We ate Crab noodle soup, snails, bbq goat, Vietnamese fried chicken and lots more! They took us to a local wet market, fruit market and showed us the rich area in saigon which is very different to the main area in district 1. We learned so much about food, culture and the Vietnamese way of living. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone of any age, your guaranteed to have a fun time and eats lots of yummy food! Thanks to the girls for sharing your stories and making this the best time ever for us!!

Highlights of our Vietnam trip - Hands down this was one of the highlights of our Vietnam trip. The riders were great and the food was absolutely exceptional. Added to this was the tour guide who did a wonderful job of showing us around different areas and explaining all things Vietnamese. I would recommend this tour as an absolute MUST DO in Saigon!!

An absolute must do adventure! - What a brilliant night!

Our group of five includes my children (10yrs and 12yrs) absolutely loved it.

I had been recommended this tour by various different people and am so glad I spent the money. It has been, without a doubt, the best tour we've done over our two weeks traveling in Vietnam.

Our tour guides, led by Yen, were amazing - their English was impeccable and they pointed out all the sights as we drove along. I feel 100% comfortable with my children on the back of their bikes.

We also got to see a side of Saigon that we would have never discovered on our own, visiting Districts other than just District 1. And the food was delicious and different to what we'd eaten already.

Honestly, I cannot recommend this tour enough.

A perfect night! - Everything perfect! The girls are very kind and very prepared, a pleasant evening that I would do again on the fly if I could.
There was nothing that didn't go well!

XO Saigon by night tour - The family and I took the XO Saigon by night tour. I would highly recommend this tour, we all had such fun. It was the first time my son and daughter had been on a scooter and they were a little nervous, especially traveling on the streets of Saigon. However, with the help of the amazing girls they settled into it straight away and had the most amazing time. It is a truly cultural tour, where you get to experience typical Vietnamese cuisine and how the locals live. Very eye opening and a great opportunity to see the contrast between the districts. We have traveled Vietnam from north to south and enjoyed many tours along the trip, but everyone agrees this tour was a highlight. My son has a particular taste in food and they arranged a special dish especially for him. Thank you to the XO girls for making us feel comfortable, safe and for all the happy memories.

A highlight of our trip! - We loved this tour! We didn't have long in Saigon at the end of our holiday and this was a great way to see the sights and learn more about the history. Lucy and her team were amazing, drinks stopped exactly when we needed them, and great snacks pre arranged in a local market. She even ensured our son with his allergies was catered for. Traveling around by moped felt safe and fun, and Lucy took photos of us along the way which is sending over. They really did think of everything and delivered it with such enthusiasm. I highly recommend this tour!

This tour is a must, the girls are amazing! - Fantastic, we couldn't have asked for anything more. Fun, friendly, enthusiastic and so informative. The girls were all just such a wonderful group. They were happy to chat with us navigating the traffic in HCM and did it so well. All of the places we stopped were interesting and just the right amount of time at each. The visit to the apartment block was just special. And the food (as you would expect) was amazing. Thank you, we haven't stopped talking about our tour!!

The night tour gave us a glimpse into local life. - I went on a morning tour a few years ago, and it was fun, so now I went on a night tour. Last time, it was a tour of historic places, but on a night tour, we felt local. It is a short but well-designed tour where you can buy fruit at the market, eat at food stalls and visit local apartments to hear about the lives of those who live there. The Guide is also a qualified person who explains fluently. In addition to the Guides who drive the motorcycles, there are also men who support the tour, and I think one of the good things about this tour is that it is organized and does not depend too much on the individual skills of the Guides, such as getting ahead of Things to do and preparing for the tour to go smoothly.

They will also provide photos after the tour.
Riding a motorbike through the wind in the hustle and bustle of Saigon night and the heat of summer is the best experience and almost makes me habitual.

Great tour even for young kids… - We absolutely loved our food tour of Saigon with XO Tours. It was something we really wanted to do and it didn't disappoint. We had some concerns as we had a nine year old with us and she had to go on a motorbike with a driver but we needn't have worried. She had the time of her life racing through each district and felt safe the whole time. The girl drivers are fabulous and very good fun. The food was excellent and the tour took us to a lot of different areas to try different foods. We did this at the start of our trip to Vietnam and are glad we did as it gave us confidence to order different foods and we even went back to district 4 the next evening alone! If you like seeing lots of a city and trying different food and meeting people then book on XO as you won't regret it.

Fabulous evening in Saigon - Thanks again to the amazing XO tours for a fabulous night in Saigon….amazing food , excellent drivers and we saw life in Saigon in different parts of the city…thanks Jenny for making my last evening fantastic Margaret and Kim
What a ride! - This was the most exhilarating thing I have ever done and we had such an amazing time. The food was excellent and the knowledge of the tour was next level.

The BEST tour guides in Saigon! - Excellent tours and guides. I did all three of their tours - day tour, night tour, and foodie tour - and they were all awesome. Tour leaders Nhu (Lucy) and Vy were so kind and eager to share their culture. All the other tour guides / drivers were wonderful and expert motorbike drivers. It's very safe and the absolute best way to see Saigon by day or night! Highly recommend.

The best thing you will do in Ho Chi Minh - As a couple from Australia, we had the absolute best time on XO Tours' food tour and day tour in Ho Chi Minh City! From the moment we hopped on the scooters, we knew we were in for an unforgettable adventure. The tours were so well thought out, blending history, culture, and, of course, incredible food into a seamless experience.

We learned so much about the city and its vibrant culinary scene, all while enjoying each bite of the delicious dishes. Our guides were knowledgeable, fun, and made us feel like locals. We couldn't recommend XO Tours enough! If you're looking for an amazing way to explore Ho Chi Minh City, this is it. 🌟🍜🛵 #VietnamAdventures #FoodieHeaven

Highly recommended food tour - This is one of the first things that you should put if you are planning a itinerary for Saigon. The kind of planning and hard work the team puts in to give you a great experience and pur you at ease, is admirable.

All the riders are rockstars, but Duyeen my rider was a mega rockstar. She was super friendly, knowledgeable and a pleasure to talk to. Vivian who was our trip leader was immensely passionate and a great communicator.

Great way to experience the best of Saigon cuisine, meet new people and zip around the city.

Great fun seeing some of Saigon's historical sights - We had a great time with Layla and Ha our scooter drivers and Lucy our tour guide. A small group of 6 of us met at our first stop after being picked up at our hotel. Lucy was great throughout talking us through the different sights and the historical and cultural context. It was a great way to see most of central Saigon with the added fun of zipping around the streets on a motorbike - we felt very safe throughout our journey. T
Although we didn’t do it, we heard the food tour of the evening is also fun!!
Thanks again - Tom and Bon

OK tour. Motorbikes were fun. Guides needed more experience and training. - OK tour, but not the amazing tour experienced by others. Riding the bikes in the rush hour and down narrow alleys was fun. The guides thought needed help to develop their knowledge and skills. The drivers told us that they are students (in spite of XO's website stating that they don't use students). The girls told us that they were following instructions telling them to be chatty on the bikes. They tried, but were struggling to tell us about Saigon, or about the market. The girls ended up asking odd questions and making some pretty strange comments (feedback provided at the time). Perhaps, more training needed around providing information about Saigon, the market or the food, or just listening and figuring out if clients want to chat all the time?

Amazing tour operators and experience. - An incredible experience, there simply cannot be a better way to see and learn about Ho Chin Minh than with the knowledgeable, engaging and lovely team at XO Tours.
