We felt safe and completely at easy the whole time we were on the motorbikes. The guide and our drivers were amazing. I don’t think we’ve ever done a better tour.

Best way to fill in time - 15hr layover - Thanks Duyen Tran, Tour Leader at XO Tours We
recently booked a VIP Our guides had prepared an itinerary based on our needs an tweaked along the way as they got to know us. Highlights were the noodles, Bo La Lot and the rainy crab ride back to base. The smiles on the kids faces heralded a new age of travel for us as a trio, adventure beckons!!

Best tour in Saigon - Went on a food tour yesterday with my wife and two teen boys. Despite the madness of Saigon traffic the ladies made it feel really safe on the bikes (I ride but my wife is paranoid!). And they were so friendly to be with. The tour itself and the food were great, so thanks to V and her team and especially the lady that biked me around. Oli

Absolutely fantastic foodie adventure! - Duyen and Nga were absolutely wonderful guides. They were personable, friendly and welcoming. They showed us the authentic side of Saigon and enthusiastically answered all our questions, giving us deeper insight into Vietnamese culture and society. They did a fantastic job highlighting the stark contrasts between the traditional markets and gleaming new malls and apartments in District 7.

The food was delicious - the crab noodles were a real highlight! The grilled goat breast meat was also a surprise winner. We have done food tours all over the world, and XO Tours is a winner. Kudos to Duyen and Nga!

Best foodie tour - We booked a private tour with @xotours

Voted...one of the top 9 food tours in the world....one of the 10 best city tours...best food tour in Vietnam...one of the top things to do in HCMC

It was bloody brilliant one of the best things we've ever done.

We were picked up by Lucy and Nga from our hotel and the adventure began.

These girls don't mess around as we weaved in and out of traffic on our scooters all over the city going to parts of the city you just wouldn't normally do where locals eat.

We can't rate #xotours high enough if you travel to HCMC book them.

The food and the girls knowledge of the food and different districts that we visited we couldn't ask for more.

Highly recommend and we will definitely do again next time we're in Vietnam.

Absolutely, the best thing to do in Saigon - Genuinely, the best thing we did in Saigon.
Got to see parts of the city we would never have found ourselves and to do it on the back of a moped with an enthusiastic, friendly and knowleadgeable guide was a real privilege.
Food was basic but good quality and plenty of it. My son didn't like some of the seafood dishes so they replaced them with several alternatives.
The tour itself was well organized with support staff at the restaurants helping get things set up and well paced through the evening with well spaced breaks for sightseeing.
Most important, felt safe all of the time as a group with no experience of riding mopeds.
Have to thank all the XO team for a fantastic experience.

Family friendly and fun! - Super great. I was unsure but booked anyway, tours aren't really our thing, but I'm so glad we did it. My 2 boys (13 and 11), loved it, my mum, loved it, and my husband and I, loved it. Super organized and safe, would highly recommend and absolutely would do it again.

Fascinating tour, fun guides, a MUST do while in Saigon - This is by far, the best tour I’ve experienced while traveling. It was an in depth tour, great
guides, and a blast riding scooters. Nhu was my driver and guide, and she was very engaging, sharing personal stories, and riveting history of Vietnam. I felt like we were all friends after the tour. I opted for the day tour (history), and enjoyed the several stops as well as the delicious snacks and drinks provided along the way. I enjoyed it so much, that I was a little sad to say goodbye, and will definitely be back for a night tour during my next visit. Thanks for making my trip so memorable!

One of my best ever tour experiences on a scooter with XO Tours! - Initially I had planned to go on one of the many generic scooter tours that were on other platforms for my first ever visit to Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam. I then happened to see on Tripadvisor that XO Tours was being highly recommended, along with similar recommendations from friends who had went for their tours before, so I decided to make down bookings for both "The Sights of Saigon" & the "Saigon by Night" tours.

Coming from someone who had never ridden on a scooter for my entire life until the day of the tour itself, my XO tour guides (Giang & Yen respectively) were great at driving their scooters and I felt very safe and confident riding on their scooters. This was even so when it started to rain rather heavily during the night tour and they provided a poncho to cover me from the heavy rain while riding.

As a history buff, I enjoyed going to many of the places that they brought us to, which often are places outside District 1 that many tourists and travelers would not usually go and are on the hidden trail. Places such as the hidden Vietnam War era tunnel with weapons caches and an insight into how the locals lived their daily lives in one of the local apartments dating back to the 1960s were an eye opener for me! My XO tour guides were proficient in English and were very informative of the places we visited.

The Vietnamese food that we were introduced and ate along the way was delicious and I gained a greater understanding of Vietnamese cuisine.

If you wish to choose a scooter tour in Saigon, one definitely cannot go wrong with XO Tours. I am so glad that I went with XO Tours as it was easily one of my best ever tour experiences to look back upon fondly. I hope that I may be able to return to Ho Chi Minh City one day to try their signature "XO Foodie Tour"!

This is a must do when visiting Ho Chi Minh City! - This was a real highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Great way to really experience and learn about the city and customs, traveling around the different neighborhoods quickly by bike. First time on a bike for my daughters, they felt safe at all times and loved it. The women are really knowledgeable, spoke excellent English and were such fun. We had a great selection of food, and they even catered separately for my daughter who has allergies.

What an incredible experience! - Out of all the food tours in HCM city, we chose this tour and we were not disappointed. In fact, it exceeded our expectations and gave us a very memorable experience. All the food tastings were not the usual Vietnamese street food but they were all yummy (and unlimited). The tour leader Vy was very knowledgeable and provided a lot of interesting information. We were impressed with our lady motor bike drivers who were all professional, courteous and friendly. We felt safe throughout the ride. We highly recommend this tour and suggest you do this at the start of your visit in HCM city as it will give you a deeper insight of the food and local culture. Enjoy, we did!!!

Best thing we did in Saigon - Such an awesome experience! I came to Saigon think I'd only be eating lots of pho and banh mi and not venturing out of district 1, but this tour introduced me to new delicious dishes and we explored 5 different districts away from the tourist. Vy and my driver Yen were so friendly, made me feel safe on the scooter and very I formative. I was a little worried getting in a scooter in such a busy city, but my worries were gone instantly. It was SO much fun!

Amazing guides, amazing tour - I booked the Saigon by Night tour for my first night there. It's a great way to get started in the city — the traffic was hectic but the girls really know what they're doing. My guide Lam was amazing, really chill, easy to talk to, and super nice as well! We saw so many things that night, and definitely some that you won't see unless you travel with a local. You also get well fed even though it's not a food tour. Giang did a great job as tour leader — she was super passionate, had great energy, and really brought everyone together. This is an amazing company run by amazing people, and I wouldn't hesitate to book another tour with them the next time I'm back in Saigon!

XO the only way to go. - Simply an amazing experience. The XO girls made the tour fun, safe, informative and truly memorable for our whole family.
I can't recommend this highly enough for anyone who is traveling to Ho Chi Minh.

Exhilerating Ho Chi Minh City Scooter Food Tour for Elderly Australian Couple - We had been recommeded this tour by foodie friends in Australia but as a 71 and 66 yo couple were initially hesitant about the scooter aspect as neither of us had ever driven or ridden on a scooter or motorbike before. The scooter riding, by very competent and professonal young women, turned out to be the highlight of the tour. All all times we felt very safe among the throngs of bikes and scooters which seemed to move in perfectly synchronized harmony; quite amazing and somewhat different to say the seems more chaotic Kuala Lumpur and Manila traffic. The quality and quantity of food was very good and the wifes aversion to eating red meat was very well catered for.
The tour included some sightseeing activities between meals which was appreciated as it was our first time in the city.
We had considered a private tour but were glad we chose the small group (of 10 in our instance) tour option as everyone shared their Vietnam experiences and travel advice. Highly recommended.

Amazing tour with XO Tours! - We did the Saigon By Night tour on July 2 as a group of 8 with 4 kids (ages 11 to 16) and it was THE BEST. The tour was led by Uyen who was incredibly friendly, informative, knowledgeable and accommodating. Her tour companions were equally as good and every one of us had a fantastic time with our guides. The tour was fun and interesting and really good for the kids - I would HIGHLY recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon.

Just do it. It's totally worth it. - Been traveling for 3 straight weeks around Asia, booking XOTOURS was the best thing I did. Wonderful experience, beautiful night with lovely tour guides and good food. Wll do it again and fully recommend for everyone to try. Thank you for the memories.

XO Foodie Tour - the BEST! - What a way to finish our adventure with our travel buddies - an AMAZING Foodie Tour of HCM City with the amazing girls from XO Tours. Hands down the best tour we have ever done and I highly recommend this as a MUST-DO. The tour leader was so knowledgeable and engaging as she shared insights and history of the 5 districts we visited. Our guides were incredible as they chatted with us (both on and off the bikes), eager to share the sights and their culture with us AND also interested in learning about our culture. We ate incredible food that we would perhaps not choose to eat and the aim was to avoid the mainstream spring rolls and bahn mi to experience traditional dishes that the Vietnamese like to eat when they go out for dinner - this included goat, scallops, clams and prawns, to name just a few (and a guarantee that nobody will leave hungry)! We were in such safe hands as we zoomed across the city for over 5 hours. And our team won the chop-stick race too!. To adventure with this company, promoting incredible women and an incredible city was the highlight of our trip. Thanks XO Tours and the gorgeous drivers who looked after us all!

An awesome time on the XO Foodies tour - highly recommended - The XO Foodies tour of Ho Chi Min was awesome! The entire family (even the teenagers) had a great time, this was one of the best parts of our holiday! Cruising through the streets and different districts of Ho Chi Minh was excellent and a great way to see beyond district 1, the scooter drivers/guides were excellent both in terms of comfort/safety on the road, engaging with all of us and teaching us all a bit more about the city. We have already recommended this trip to other family friends. Its a great way to get exposure to real Saigonese food!

XO foodie tour - This food tour was amazing! The tour guides were so knowledgeable and friendly, we had such a great time with them. We felt very safe on the bikes and the variety and quality of the food was impressive. Highly recommend this tour if you're interested in learning more about Saigon culture and eating some great food! Thank you XO yours!

Must do foodie tour, with baked in fun! - Took a recommendation from an expat who has been living in Ho Chi Minh City for the last 10 years that we had to do an XO Tour, and he was not wrong! Our guide V2 and her gang were amazing. We felt like we were being expertly guided across a spectrum of districts by Charlie's Angels. The food stops were scrumptious, the sight seeing stops informative and contextual, and the scooter ride was a blast. This tour encapsulates the chaotic joy that Ho Chi Minh City delivers in spades. Don't miss.

A very special way to see Saigon with the most delightful team, you have to do this XO Tour, it's worth every minute!!!! - We have been traveling from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) for 12 days and have had some absolutely amazing experiences. Because some of our extended family had been on an XO Tour last year we thought we'd book a ride with the XO Tour team on our second to last night in Vietnam.

It turns out that this was one of our highlights of the whole trip. And the whole family agreed on this. The wonderful team, of Uyen (Tour Leader) and her team of drivers, Thao, Ai, Anh, and Doung. From the first greeting at our Hotel, through to the final photo together it was just a cheer pleasure and joy.

We felt safe on the back of the scooters, with very experienced drivers, who chatted with us along the way. They took us to a market to buy some food ingredients then to a local district for a meal together with delicious local cuisine, on to a visit with a local resident so we could gain an insight into behind the tourist scene, how these wonderful Vietnamese people live. The residents welcomed us openly and warmly, and it was a privilege to be there.

From there we went through the backstreets for a local dessert treat, and then back to our Hotel.

We learned so much on the tour, with information that gave us a welcome insight into the people of Saigon in particular, it's history, their day to day living and accommodation, and their own meals.

Honestly this was a truly amazing experience, and again a very, very big thank you to Uyen and her beautiful team of drivers, Thao, Ai, Anh, and Doung. I think you have to try this Tour, you'll love it, like we did!!!!

Can't Miss Tour! - My wife and I went on this tour during our honeymoon and could not have had a better time. The guides are very talkative and are excellent conversation makers, and took their time explaining the dishes we were trying and some of the interesting cultural aspects of present day Vietnam. We can't rate this experience highly enough! Thank you to XO tours for an incredible time.

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - XO tours were easy to contact, updated promptly and simple to set up the booking with and complete the payment. The tour was on time and delivered by an excellent tour guide (Lucy) and great team of drivers.

A Wonderful Experience with XO Tours - We had a fantastic time on the Sights of Saigon tour with XO Tours. We really enjoyed riding round the city in the back of the motorbikes and stopping to see the sights with Lin and her team and would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an immersive experience in the city.

***Best Tour in the World*** - Best tour in the world!!!

Having traveled around the world I must say that exploring Vietnam with the XO Tours was exciting, safe, and informative.

I enjoyed joining a food tour to learn about Vietnamese food and also learn about the history, culture and economic trends in the city and country. What's also fascinating is that I met amazing friends from the tour and we explored the country together after the tour. Definitely made life long friends from XO Tours! Highly recommend. :)

Great food experience - The team last night were absolutely amazing.
Lucy as the tour leader was articulate and very knowledgeable to all of our questions.
My driver Ao Dai was equally fantastic and such a great advocate for this phenomenal city.
The food was so good and site seeing was insightful to the many hidden gems.
The tour has been the highlight of our trip and my 79 year old father and 15 year old nephew felt safe and secure the whole time.
5 stars!!
Loved this XO tour! - Excellent tour. Well taken care of and was able to learn about Saigon culture, people and the food. Interesting, tasty and fun. Even in the rain!

I will never tire of taking the XO Foodie Tour! - I've taken the XO Foodie Tour three times over the last few years, and I still think it's one of the best things to do in Ho Chi Minh City! It's a brilliant thing to do on your first night in town on your first visit to Vietnam, and maybe even cooler to do again with friends or family who've never visited before.

I'm not sure what was more exciting; jumping on the back of a motorbike and being spirited away to parts of the city I might never have gone to otherwise, trying foods I might not have tried on my own, or experiencing it all again through someone else's eyes!

The Foodie Tour is so much more than an exhilarating motorbike ride and some incredible dining experiences. It's an opportunity to learn about the history, personality, and culture of this amazing country! It's a great way to get out of your culinary comfort zone (if you're up for it!), but they can also tailor the evening toward just about any dietary limitations, even picky mother-in-laws!

As this was my third time taking the tour, I was able to see how it has evolved over the years to become an even better experience. They've put a lot of thought into both what one should experience, and what will appeal to a broader spectrum of travelers. I've also seen that there are new tour operators that seek to imitate what XO Tours worked so hard to create. I can honestly say that XO Tours is the best!

Insightful and fun must do food tour - Thank you to Vy and tour guides for making us feel very safe and for the wonderful experience of your food tour. This was very insightful and lots of fun and highly recommend as a must do.

Fully recommended! - Awesome experience and really well run.
I did a daytime tour focused on sightseeing and a night tour focused more on food. Both were great and the young women drivers made everyone feel safe.

Saigon By Night - My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience. We felt safe at all times on the bikes and the insight into Vietnamese urban culture was informative and heartfelt. Five stars. Would recommend to anyone visiting Saigon.

MUST DO TOUR OF SAIGON - you MUST go on this tour if you are in Saigon!! Truc and the ladies made us feel so welcome and demonstrated some of the safest driving skills despite the torrential rain. Driving through the city we got to see some places off the beaten track that most tours wouldnt get to see such as the wet market! The food we had at the vaious places was amazing and despite my fear of street food no gastro symptoms the next day.

Fantastic night tour that exceeded expectations - We were a group of 6 adults and 6 children and we had the most amazing time with XO! The drivers were knowledgable, kind and so safe driving with our kids. They showed us parts of Saigon we wouldnt have seen by ourselves and gave us the opportunity to see how the residents in district 5 live. It was an honor to be invited into their homes. I am truly unforgettable experience. Highly recommend to families and groups. XO were professional, well organized and delightful!

Amazing Foodie Tour - Absolute highlight of our 3 Night stay in Ho Chi Minh City. Very professional, friendly and knowledgeable. The girls were all amazing and a special shout out to our guides. Couldn't recommend this tour and company highly enough. Thank you

Fantastic night, highly recommended. - Our family of four had a great time on the Saigon Foodie Tour. Getting around on scooters was fun and it was fantastic so each has our own personal guide. The food was excellent and we got a lot of insights to Vietnam and Saigon. Highly recommend this trip.

Our teenagers especially loved bonding with the guides over their shared interests of photo poses and bubble tea!

We felt safe at all times, even through the crazy traffic!

Great to explore other districts and learn more about Vietnamese culture - XO Tours was recommended to me by a friend before I came to HCMC and it did not disappoint. I had a fantastic time, tried some amazing foods and explored areas I wouldn't have otherwise ventured into. Riding on the back of the motorbike is great fun! Ngoc was a wonderful guide and spoke perfect English! Thank you XO Tours for a brilliant evening!!

Top Tour of Saigon - Absolutely the best thing to do in Saigon. Any of their 3 tours will give you the very best local experience with professional, expert, and friendly drivers and guides. An amazing night out to experience the vibrant city. Scooters are in excellent condition and the OX women are safe, confident drivers. Bravo and thank you!!

Exceptional Saigon Adventure with ladies of XO!! - I had an amazing experience with XO Tours in Saigon! This woman-led business is truly impressive, with all the tour guides being smart, engaging ladies who balance their university studies or jobs with guiding tours. Riding behind them on motorbikes through the vibrant streets of Saigon at night felt incredibly safe.

The tour was a perfect blend of a food and sightseeing adventure. Not only did we get to taste a variety of delicious Vietnamese foods that we wouldn't have discovered on our own, but we also learned a lot about Saigon's history and culture as we zipped around the city. Despite the rain, the tour remained fun and organized; the guides provided us with raincoats so we could continue enjoying the experience without any issues.

The booking process was incredibly fast and efficient. I contacted them via WhatsApp and was able to book a tour on the same day. Overall, XO Tours offers an exceptional and unique way to explore Saigon. Highly recommended!

Saigon Sights, Stories, and Food - Second time in Saigon and made a last minute decision to book tours for the next morning and night after. XO was able to accommodate the short notice booking without issue.

Saigon Sights Tour: Linh was an amazing storyteller regarding the various locations we visited. Her command of English was very strong and I'm slightly convinced her storytelling is better in English than in Vietnamese. Either way, its equal or greater. Lots of photo opportunities here where she will help you photograph the memories. She also adds some flair of personal stories to help connect to the cultural aspects. Ask her about her request for help from her grandpa on winning the lotto. While I could have gone to these sights on my own, having someone explain a bit more of the history with personal stories really added to my experience. Like the story about the man who translated letters by hand for the general public at the post office (ie viet to french) who recently passed away.

Saigon Food Tour: Giang was the tour leader of our tour group making sure everyone was comfortable, safe, and most importantly well-fed. This was definitely a fun food tour that takes you into various districts where tourists are likely not to venture. More than the food, you definitely get a good feel of what evenings are like across various spots in Vietnam. Uyen (forgive me if I forgot) was my XO partner/rider for the tour. She offered great insight into what post college life/culture is like and despite some good mannered jokes (invited) was very hospitable. In fact, I would all the staff I encountered were capable of friendly banter and made it feel easy going. If you're keen and want to drink, she will definitely get you the beer (w/ice if requested). Overall, fun tour. Would recommend even for first-timers and those who don't get out of D1. Do watch out for Giang. Jk. She's awesome.

A great night around Saigon - This was great fun and an excellent tour. Was driven by Linh who was so friendly and informative. Our tour guide Truc was lovely and made sure everyone had a great night. The food was excellent and delicious and all the beer you want was provided to wash it down. But what really elevated this tour was; one being able to visit outlying districts of HMC tourists usually don't see so you get a glimpse of how people here really live. Two; all the tour girls were so friendly, interesting and helpful. You couldn't but have fun. Also riding on the back of a moped in rush hour traffic in a monsoon is an experience I won't forget soon :D

XO night out - Nhu and Linh were our drivers. We were a bit nervous about getting on the back of bikes in Ho Chi Minh but they soon made us feel at ease. They were very knowledgeable and took us on an amazing cultural tour. I cannot rate these girls enough. It was our favorite tour while in Ho Chi Minh City. We will look you up when we return next year.

Gentlemen from Taiwan - Had an amazing time with Lucy another 7 young ladies. Lucy is very patient and brings us with good energy with her big friendly smile in tge morning. The english tour in the HCM city about the Vietnamese War was very interesting and a good learning and playing experience!

Amazing, fun, exciting, safe that will leave your hearts and tummies full! - We joined the XO Foodie tour and it was truly worth the time and money.

Our girls Duyen 2, Linh 2 and Thao 9 were all amazing, caring and looked after my family who were first time motorcycle riders. While we all thought that riding a motorcycle in Vietnam is dangerous and crazy, we never felt unsafe or at risk of any danger. Probably the best experience to see Ho Chi Minh city as you get taken to different districts and provided information while on route and during stops, all taken cared for by our tour leader Hong.

The food stops were amazing, street food that you'd only experience because you are hanging out with locals and carefully planned by the tour operator.

The team and family games made the experience even special with prizes that would make the tour worth and memorable.

Finally, your photos are taken, including the food and route of the tour so need to worry about documenting it unless you want to do so.

Amazing, fun, exciting, safe that will leave your hearts and tummies full!

Experience the hustle and bustle of Saigon with great food and guides that teach you about the city and its customs - The XO foodie tour was great from start to finish. The booking was easy as was the pickup from the hotel with the drivers arriving on time and giving us a good safety briefing.

From there we traveled to several restaurants and districts getting great food and service and learning about life in Saigon.

Our host for the evening V was entertaining and informative and made us feel welcomed as special guests. My driver Hung was very attentive making sure I was looked after with food and drink and told me about the food.

At all times we felt safe, despite the chaotic nature of the traffic around us. You are truly immersed into Saigon life as you ride around and eat over the 4 hours of the tour.

We would highly recommend this experience. Tomorrow is our last day and we will “miss Saigon”

A highlight of Ho Chi Minh City. - A truly unique experience whizzing through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City at night with a talented tour guide and stops at one-of-a-kind eateries. Everyone gets their own driver and scooter and comes together at designated points. My driver was phenomenal and the group leader, Vy, was exceptional. Stopped at the Chinatown night market and three other places in addition to three restaurants. None of the food was "touristy," it was all authentic. One of the highlights of Ho Chi Minh. Well worth the price as you're out for about 4 hours with all-you-can-eat and free beer.

Explore Saigon and eat like a local. - Had a truly amazing time on the Foodie Tour with XO Tours, zipping through the streets of Saigon on the back of scooters with some fantastic (and fearless) tour guides and eating some delicious dishes at restaurants that we would’ve never found on our own. If you’re in Saigon, this really is a must-do experience.

Great first time experience! - This was the best experience to tour around Saigon and to eat great food in the city! These girls are amazing! I never rode around on a motorcycle before and that was the greatest experience of my life! The girls are also very fun to hang around with and also very funny and smart! They taught us the history of ho chi minh city as well too. I highly recommend this tour group!

Really fun ! Must do in Ho Chi Minh - 5/5 for XO tours ! I did Saigon by the night tour, 6-9 pm with Vy Tran and loved every bit of the experience. XO tours has 4 different tour options, all hosted by amazing young women bike riders, who are very knowledgeable and want to impart the cultural heritage and food experience with visitors.

Saigon by the night tour is a cultural tour - local markets, street food, old apartments etc. The women riders drive on their bikes through the busy streets of Saigon and show you around. The ride is absolutely safe and fun. Vy2 was a fantastic guide - she was smart, friendly and had lots of good stories to tell. I’d definitely want to do the foodie tour the next time I am in Ho Chi Minh.

Amazing XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City - My husband and I went on the XO Saigon by Night tour and had an amazing time! I was nervous about riding the scooters in traffic but as soon as we took off I felt very safe. The next morning I went on the XO Sights of Saigon on my own and enjoyed it immensely. The tours were a wonderful way to visit the highlights of Saigon and see parts of the city we otherwise would not have been able to see. I almost signed up for the same tour again the same week because I liked it so much. We were in good hands the entire time - the XO team is very organized, knowledgeable, and kind. We highly recommend taking a tour with them while you’re in Ho Chi Minh City!

An amazing food tour!!!! - One of the best food tours I’ve been on!!!! My family and I enjoyed every minute of our food tour. The food on all stops was delicious and the portion size was huge. The drivers were safe, experienced and friendly!!

An absolute must in Saigon - The highlight of my trip to Vietnam. My colleague recommended the XO Foodie Tour for my stay in Saigon. My driver Hang picked me up right outside the hotel and took me on her motorbike to the first stop, where I met all the other participants. The first course, so to speak, was a tasty soup and a refreshing drink. The onward journey to the next stop as a passenger on the moped is super exciting, as you can immerse yourself in the evening traffic of the metropolis of Saigon. However, I didn't feel unsafe for a second, as Hang drove very safely. After a short stop at the market, we continued on to the BBQ, beer and games. I really enjoyed the company of all the participants and (female only) drivers. This was followed by a detour to Koreatown and a final seafood course in another district. Many thanks also go to Yang, who led the whole tour. I can highly recommend a food tour with XO Tours.

A "must do" in Saigon! - We did three moped food tours while we were in Sai Gon, and this was the definitely best one. The experience is thoughtfully curated -- a good mix of food and culture. Food was great, and we left with a deeper understanding of Saigonese life. Our tour guides were AMAZING -- I chatted with Vy, a lead guide, about the hiring process and it seemed quite competitive. My group of 7 really enjoyed this family-friendly experience. It was a highlight of our time in Saigon. I'd recommend this to friends and family as a must do. Don't hesitate to book with XO tours and support a woman owned and operated business!

An unforgettable and delicious tour with the best guides! - This was an absolute highlight of our trip! The team is so professional, warm, friendly, and truly makes you feel special. Their expert navigation of the streets of Saigon allows you to marvel at the different districts all while feeling comfortable on the back of the motorbike. I especially appreciate that this tour is more than just food. Our leader, Vy, shares many facts and figures about the city as well as the history of many of the districts. All of the dishes were so delicious and not the traditional items you read about, making the culinary portion unique. My driver, Ngoc, was the best part! She was engaging, charismatic, and treated me so well. I cannot wait to do this tour again when I return to Saigon!

Nice tour to be driven around Saigon by ladies in Ao Dai. - I had a nice time with XO Tours. The Girls were cute, young and friendly.
An awesome tour. A fabulous way to see Saigon on the back of a motorbike.

Sooooo good!! - I loved the night tour with Nhu and Hao. Every bit of it was safe and professional. I laughed and smiled so much this night and learned a lot. I feel so grateful to these two women for their energetic, kind and incredibly joyful night out around the streets and foodie spots of HCMC. You gotta do an XO tour if you visit Saigon.

A fun night full of food and great conversation - It was a really fun night where the girls showed us the sight and sounds of Saigon along with some great food tasting along the way. They knew there stuff inside out and gave us a view into Saigon from different perspectives showing us the extremes that form this in your face city. Loved every minute particularly due to my guide Ngan.

Fantastic experience on scooters around Saigon - The girl team we had were fantastic, wealth of information spoke perfect English, made us feel at ease in the crazy traffic.
Thank you hue, Ai, and Hao

Marvelous city-tour by motorbike - We had a magnificent half day with Linh and her college, Sophie. We had a marvelous time together. Linh is a very safe and skilled driver and guide. It was more of an off-track-tour. Very interesting and helpful to understand the recent past of South Vietnam. The explanations were playful and knowledgeable. Thank you!

Just fabulous! We loved this night so much - I cannot express how glad I am that I found and booked the XO foodie tour. Initially they were full, but they were so very helpful in explaining I could go on the waiting list and I got lucky. From start to finish those ladies were just fabulous, so kind, so patient, good fun, gracious …. we had such an amazing night and in all my travel agent years that had to be up there one of my favourite tours. A truly great experience allowing us to see and learn so much more about Ho Chi Minh City and the districts (we never would have got to see all of that). Also the food was amazing, and so much of it, absolute it brilliant value. My sister had a birthday cake from them and everybody sang, it was a magical night we won’t forget. Absolutely brilliant in every way! 1st class. Thank you so much to Rosie and Lyn our truly wonderful drivers and beautiful souls, and Yan who co-ordinated and gave us all the info, and Ha who was another driver but truly such a spirit and made me smile and laugh all night. 👏👏

Best food tour in Vietnam - Easily best tour we did throughout our over 2 week trip to Vietnam. The girls were all so kind, so fun and so knowledgeable. As someone who was initially a bit scared to go on the motorbikes, they instantly made sure we felt safe and were excellent drivers. I rode with Anh and she was so lovely and such great company!

Great experience. Highly recommend it. - Great fun. Very safe drivers. Excellent command of English. This is a fantastic way to see the different districts of Saigon, to learn about the culture, and to enjoy the local cuisine.

Amazing tour company, I can't recommend enough! - I done two of the XO tours provided, firstly I did "The XO Foodie" and secondly I did "The Sights of Saigon."
In regards to the first tour "The and the staff just wanted you to have a good time, there's a constant refreshments and there's context to each dish served, it was very clear than in a group of 12 people everyone was having an amazing time, I'd highly recommend this tour to anyone considering it!
The second tour I did with XO was "The Sights of Saigon." this was a just me and one other on this tour and it was amazing, I had done what I felt was a fair amount of research on tourist attractions in Saigon and they took me to some amazing places I'd never heard of, this was an amazing tour with friendly staff and also staff added who their own personal context on the events that unfolded in the 20th century which makes it all the better in my opinion.
I'd recommend getting these tours booked early on in your trip as they will allow you to have an idea of ​​other stuff you may want to see on your trip!
On both tours they collect you from your hotel and drop you off there, the communication in the build up to the tour is very clear and they are always happy to help.

Another way XO went above and beyond I with 24 hours notice wanted to move my sights of Saigon tour to the following day and with a quick WhatsApp they arranged this free of charge no hassle which I greatly appreciate.

Love XO Foodie Tour. - Not much that hasn't been said about the XO Foodie Tour, it's simply awesome and a must do when in HCMC. Great guides, very well organized, great food and a great evening tour around HCMC moving from restaurant to restaurant . Special shoutout to our guides: Miss Maya & Miss Thao, thank you so much for creating such special memories for & with us. ❤️🇻🇳

I highly recommend this XO tour. - We were recommended this tour, out of all the other options - the ladies that whizzed us around drove very professionally on their scooters, making us feel safe. We rode through the busy city traffic, dark narrow alleyways, and a short time on the city motorway. We had a wide range of food included in our tour. We went to a historical apartment of a local lady, who kindly showed us her small home and living conditions, a tiny space shared with many other family members. Our guides were informative, and funny, always laughing and we all had a great night out. The next day, our guide sent through the many photos she had taken.

Don't miss out on this one!!! - My husband and I just returned from a 3 week trip through Thailand and Vietnam. We went on XO Foodie tour the day after we arrived in Saigon. It was on of the absolute highlights of our trips and one we've relived often since returning! In addition to trying many dishes from five districts, we learned much about the culture. Our guides, Duyen and Vy made it particularly memorable. They were quite knowledgable and welcomed all our questions. But beyond that, they were absolutely delightful. We enjoyed every minute of time that we spent with these delightful ladies. I highly recommend this tour.

You absolutely 100% have to do this tour when in HCMC, VN!!!! - I think they forgot a 0 in the price. $100/person????? Worth so much more. It was one of the best experiences of my life. A can't miss when in Ho Chi Minh City!!!

An absolute must! A brilliantly unique experience - This trip was quite possibly the highlight of an amazing holiday! We were collected from the front of our hotel by Truc & Mi and got onto the scooters and straight away we knew this was a one of a kind experience!!

Travelling around Ho Chi Minh City by scooter is an experience I’ll never forget, but the food just put it to a new level. We visited 3 different food stops with stops in between which were needed to try to digest the food…there’s so much food! The food was so tasty (like all the food we had in Vietnam) as well as learning about the city and the many different districts and the way they are all different. None of the food we had on the trip had been tried at any point during our 3 week holiday and the places we went to are not places easily found by your average tourist.

We had booked a private tour, so it was just the 2 of us & it felt like a very personalised experience.

If you’re going to HCMC, then this is a must!!

Amazing experience - Thoroughly enjoyed our group's XO foodie tour - what an amazing experience! All the tour guides were kind, professional, fun, hospitable and engaging. Loved getting to tour districts that are not usually part of the tourist beat. Needless to say, tasted some incredibly delicious food along the way! Just saw our video and it's making me hungry!

Especially enjoyed meeting my driver, Hong, and hearing about her life story and the company backstory - it is really inspiring that part of the company's mission is to provide opportunities to girls who are starting out in the tourism industry and the lengths they go through to make this the best possible experience. Highly recommend if you enjoy trying new foods, seeing new sights and experiencing a side of Saigon that is less touristy!

An Amazing Night Out - We were glad we did this tour after recommendations from family and it didn’t disappoint 10/10. Our guides navigated thru the organised caos of Ho Chi Minh City traffic making everyone feel 100% safe. Food selection was amazing with many different styles and flavours including a Balut egg.
Huge shout out to our Guides
Trang3 Thao7 Quynh & Nhu

Discover street food as you drive through the streets of HCM - A memorable food tour experience! It was so fun being able to go through the streets of Ho Chi Minh on scooter, explore different districts, and eat delicious food! The women who organized the tour and drove us around were so kind— we had wonderful discussions which added to the ambience. Would do it again if I come back!

Very fun and well-organized food and culture tour - Awesome experience from booking to finish. We did The XO Foodie tour and we definitely were full of the amazing foods at the end, but not the terribly over-stuffed feeling that you can get on other food tours where you're constantly eating non-stop for hours.

We got to check out HCMC in a way that, honestly, we wouldn't be able to do on our own.

I think the other glowing reviews speak for themselves. If you're at all on the cusp of booking the tour, do it. You'll have lots of fun and learn more of the city in a way you wouldn't be able to.

Amazing tour - This was one of the best things we did in HCM. All run by women. It's great to do on your first night in the city as they go to around d 5 different districts so you can get a really good feel of the city!
The bun bo hue we ate at the first stop was the best soup we ate the whole trip!
Was so much fun cruising around on the motorbikes felt bet safe with Chau and Nghi and had some great conversations while we were riding! Highly recommend!!

A uniquely excellent experience - One of the best tours I've ever been on. A really unique experience to go around the city by motorbike and eat food besides the typical things like pho and banh mi. The tour guide Lucy and my motorbike driver Nga were both great, super informative and friendly. Definitely will be recommending this tour to my friends who visit Vietnam.

So worthwhile - We had an amazing time on the Saigon by night cultural tour. You really feel you get an insight into the REAL life of Saigon on their tour. The girls are amazing and happy to share personal stories with you which is a real treat. This is a “must do” experience.

A great experience! - This a fantastic tour to see sights of Ho Chi Minh you won't see on the tourist trial. The traffic is wild and at no time did we feel unsafe on the scooters. The girls are exceptional drivers and very knowledgeable. The tour was great fun, the only thing that let it down was the food. The food was a bit unremarkable and at times you didn't have time to finish a meal as it was time to play a game or move onto the next venue.
This tour is a true experience and well worth doing.

Best experience - Myself and family just did the night tour, it was amazing. Girls were friendly, entertaining and professional. Bike riding skills are second to none and although I am 60 and not very flexible anymore I had no problem and felt very safe and comfortable. Do not eat before doing this trip as the food is amazing and abundant. Could not recommend this experience enough, loved by all in our group. Thank you ladies again for a wonderful experience.

100/10 - Last minute booking on the final day of our time in Saigon. Great experience right from beginning to end. The tour guides were so friendly, had endless knowledge, both local and national. Such a fun memory. Don't think, just book!

Best tour ever! - Our sightseeing experience with XO Tours exceeded our expectations! The fantastic and knowledgeable ladies made the tour incredibly enjoyable. In just four hours, we learned a great deal about Vietnam's history. Our 11 and 14-year-old kids completely shared our enthusiasm, not only about the thrilling scooter ride, but also about the way Lucy was telling about all the places we visited! I highly recommend to book XO tours when visiting HCMC!

Wounderful tour - A wonderful bike tour in Ho Chi Minh at night. We enjoyed every moment of it. Very nice market, wonderful food and drinks, special meeting and friendly people. We saw a side of the city that tourists usually don't see.

A must do! - An absolute highlight of the trip, and cannot recommend the Saigon by Night tour enough. The guides Hao and Thu were excellent, so knowledgeable and we got to experience a lot of “off the beaten track” type things which were fantastic. Excellent value for money. Loved every second!

Great Tour Saigon - We had a fantastic evening with XO Tours and highly recommend them. We loved the journey on the back of the bike and the food was excellent. It was also so interesting to see different parts of the city that we wouldn't have seen otherwise. Our bike drivers had fantastic English and were great drivers, we felt safe and in good hands at all times. Thank you XO Tours.

Fantastic - This was our second tour with the XO girls, previously did the foodie tour this time, Saigon by night. Amazed all over again. Took friends who were first time visitors to Vietnam and a little hesitant about the traffic but they loved it. The girls are engaging and make you feel so safe. This tour was particularly interesting and learning about how some people live in Vietnam. The food was also great. If you want to do a back of bike, definitely do not go with anyone but XO, you will not regret this decision.
Saigon by Night Tour - Not to be missed! Informative, engaging and a truly unique experience in a local setting. None of that generic stuff. All in all a great fun with Hong Tong and her team.

A Great Night in Saigon - Wow! Just wow!

We were in Saigon for 2 nights, and we wanted to see as much of the city as possible in that time, so we decided to go on a food tour. There are many different tours to choose from, and most are cheaper than this one - but it is 1000% worth every single penny.

We were picked up at our hotel by our hosts, Mai and Chi, and by the end of the night, I felt like they were my best friends. They were funny, engaging, entertaining, and spoke perfect English. They were very knowledgeable and, most importantly, drove very safely. I felt at east the entire time, while on the motor bikes.

Before this tour, we had spent just under 3 months in Vietnam, so we weren't interested in a tour that was going to have us try typical Vietnamese food, and this tour had us tasting things we never heard of - and all were absolutely delicious. We are not big seafood eaters, but everything loved we tried. It was a fantastic way to enjoy the Vietnamese culture.

Riding on a motorbike throughout Saigon was also a blast. We covered so much ground and learned so much. It was great to see so many different districts. Had we not done this tour, we probably wouldn't have seen much more than districts 1 and 2, and the city is so much more than that.

Finally, a special shoutout to Lucy who was the group guide. She was an amazing guide who educated on us so many interesting parts of this great country. I feel so fortunate to have had the experience we did. It's something we'll be talking about for years to come.

A+ tour! - These girls are amazing! Knowledgeable, professional, personable. They give a great glimpse into hidden areas of Saigon. I did the night tour and it was really a must do and gave me a great intro to the city and some less touristy districts

An experience not to be missed. - A fantastic experience not only for the different delicious (and abundant) food we were given but talking to the girls and zipping around the different districts learning about life in Ho Chi Minh made a very special evening. Worth every cent!

Giang is the best tour guide! - I had the BEST TIME! I had stumbled across XO tours on Instagram and I could see by their posts it was an authentic experince to explore the sights of Saigon.
I did the Sights of Saigon tour Led by Giang. It was so great to meet Giang we are a similar age and it was nice to hear her experiences and talk about cultural differences we have etc.
she had a wealth of knowledge about the history and being a history geek, she answered all my questions in depth.
I thoroughly enjoyed getting to know her when we ate some delicious food at an authentic street market.
Notably, the tour steered away from the main tourist hotspots and Giang took us to spots I didn’t even know existed !!!
Additionally, another XO team member cam along with us. He looked after our stuff/bikes whilst we explored the sights. This made me feel super safe and more relaxed.

Once again, thanks Giang you are a great tour guide and fab driver!! 😁

AMAZING!!! - AMAZING! This was my girlfriend and I's first night in Vietnam and it was the best way to get kick off our vacation. The food is delicious, the rides are super fun, and the guides are incredibly knowledgable and great to hang out with.

This one is a must!

Do not miss out on an XO tour whilst in HCM City! - Three friends and I did both the “Sights of Saigon” and “XO Foodie” tour. Our recommendation would be - if you do anything in Saigon, do at least one tour with XO!!!! We had THE BEST TIME with Giang and the drivers (thank you Nguyen 😉). They are clearly knowledgeable, have a great way of delivering the information and really involve you in the tour to the point we did not want go back to the hotel. A key point I should make is that they are very skilled drivers and none of us felt remotely unsafe on the back of the scooters, on the contrary - it was a great experience and great fun!! THANK YOU XO!!!

Awesome scooter tour of Saigon by Night - Saigon by Night tour was the highlight of our 2 week trip in Vietnam. We had read reviews and thought the tour sounded good but it was far better than we were expecting. Our guides, Hao, Lam, Ngan and Huie were so much fun. Their local knowledge, excellent English language and thirst for learning about our culture was wonderful. We felt very safe on the back of their scooters even in the busy Saigon streets. We enjoyed walking through the market and learning about the varieties of fruits, vegetables, meats etc. We had a delicious meal and really enjoyed visiting Aunty Mai's home in a poorer District that tourists don't generally get to see. To learn about her family life and see her home was very humbling. Then a stop for dessert before heading back to the hotel. It was a perfect mix of food and culture and sightseeing. Would highly recommend.

Fantastic way to see must see sights in Saigon - We went on the Sights of Saigon Tour with Hang, Linh, Giarg, and Hien, who were excellent hosts. They were friendly, welcoming, and very knowledgeable. The tour was excellent, and we can highly recommend it. It included visits to key sights and lots of interesting information without overloading you with too much. Plus, the excitement and thrill of riding as a pillion passenger in the chaos and madness of Saigon traffic, which should have been terrifying, but the girls were such great drivers that we were completely relaxed and enjoyed every minute of it.

Amazing tour with XO Girls - We just returned from our two weeks holiday in Vietnam where we had the utmost pleasure to have booked a „Saigon by Night“ Tour with XO Tours. We were two families and truly enjoyed every minute of the thrilling ride at the back of the XO Girls' scooters. The ride was pure fun … and most important we always felt super safe! We were picked up by the XO Girls at our hotel and after a quick tour and safety briefing, the amazing fun started. Passing by a market, riding along large avenues and narrow alleys, the XO Girls point out the different aspects that make Saigon such a captivating city. We stopped at a Streetfood stall where we had the best streetfood during our whole trip through Vietnam. The food was so yummy and delicious. The memorable highlight was visiting an old residential area which was really touching and where we and our children learned that life is only about being happy with what you have and not about complaining. Many thanks to all XO Girls Uyen, Vy7, Ai, Ha, Han2, Thao6, Nghi & Ngan. With your extraordinary enthusiasm you made this evening really special and truly memorable!

Exhilarating tour of the City - We went on the Saigon By Night Tour with Tao, Han, Anh, and Thinh. It was exhilarating, brilliant, and exciting. It was a lovely mix of seeing the sights, China Town street market, tasting some delicious food, and seeing how ordinary people of Saigon live. A highlight was the visit to see Auntie Mai who kindly let us look around her apartment which is in the run-down block that the government wanted to knock down but the tenants campaigned to remain. The girls who drove us around were brilliant, friendly, and welcoming, and although we were driving through the chaos and madness of Saigon traffic, we never felt worried.

An amazing tour not to be missed - As part of our amazing explore Vietnam tour travels our travel agent booked us on this amazing HCMC tour. We started at 5.15pm with two local Saigon young women dressed in traditional dresses collecting us from our hotel. Meeting up with the rest of the tour group - approx 10 we spent the next 4.5 hours exploring HCMC's districts and local food spots sampling amazing delights as well as many laughs and great memories had

We had a great time with XO - glad for the experience - My wife and I really enjoyed our evening tour with XO. They had been recommended by friends - I was initially skeptical when my wife mentioned it, but we both had a great time. Our hosts, Nhu and Trang, were interesting, interesting, and also very good drivers! This was definitely a side of Saigon we wouldn't have experienced otherwise.

Fun, informative, friendly, and professional tour experience! - Thank you so much for an amazing tour of Saigon. The entire team was very professional, informative, and friendly. This was such a great tour for a first timer in the city. Special thanks to Hang, my motorbike driver and to Hao and the entire team for unforgettable experience.

An absolute must with kids!! Faultless - This was one of THE best things we have ever done.. faultless. Never been on mopeds before and had our children with us aged 11 and 14. The ride on the moped was completely safe. The women were amazing and the food stunning. We saw some fab sights and really felt like we explored the city..I promise you that you will not be disappointed with this your. Well done XO ladies - superb!

saigon by night tour: culture + food, the best of both worlds!! - xo tours was one of my favorite memories of our entire trip to vietnam. i’m vietnamese american and it was my first time in the motherland so i thought it was only appropriate to explore the city on motorbike like the locals. we chose the saigon by night tour and it was such a wonderful experience with the xo tour girls. i was a bit nervous since it was my first time on a motorbike, but my sweet driver made me feel safe and comfortable the whole time. i truly enjoyed talking to and getting to know her and learning different tidbits about the city.

there’s really no feeling like being on the back of a motorbike taking in all the sights, sounds and smells of the bustling city of saigon, with the hot, humid air blowing through my hair, all while my driver expertly weaves in and around the chaos of hundreds of motorbikes. i had the biggest smile on my face as i soaked in the feeling of riding around in the same city my parents once did ☺️

the tour itself was such a different and eye-opening experience than any tour i’ve been on. our wonderful, energetic tour guide Hao took us to the lesser visited districts like 5 (chinatown) and 10 to show us a different perspective of how some locals currently and used to live. as a tourist, i’ll be the first to admit that we don’t usually venture out to areas of a city that aren’t as popular or widely known. which is why i appreciate that xo tours gave us a raw and real glimpse of saigon that many people don’t get a chance to see.

this experience reinforced my belief of how strong, resilient and fun-loving the people of Vietnam are. i definitely left feeling even more proud of my heritage and culture. the only thing i regret was not getting the tour video option 🥲

thank you to all the lovely xo tour girls we got to meet! we learned so much from them and truly left with more than what we came with 🫂🤎 so excited to do the foodie tour the next time we’re back!

A Unique Experience in Saigon - Went on the "Saigon by Night" tour in April 2024 on recommendation from a local business partner, and loved it so much that I came back the next day for both "Sights of Saigon" and the Foodie Tour.

I can't say enough good things about the experience. The staff - tour leads, scooter drivers, help/security, and online team - were all amazing and helpful in their unique ways. The drivers in particular make the entire experience feel personalized and welcoming.

The tours themselves are unique and non-overlapping. It wasn't just Pho, Banh Mi, and showing you the Ben Thanh Market...you really got a more nuanced taste of life, history, and food in the city.

There is also no better way to experience Saigon than on the back of a scooter, especially at night. With wind in your hair and a 360 degree view as you cruise down a city of lights and street vendors, you feel infinite.

Truly a special experience. I don't usually enjoy tours, especially group ones, but this was different. I applaud the team and thank them for making my trip feel special.

A must do tour in Ho Chi Minh City! - This was truly one of a kind experience and tour. Linh and her team were exceptional tour guides and scooter drivers. We saw eight different places of interest and all within a nicely balanced timeline of scootering and sightseeing. Very informative as well. Thank you again, my wife and two boys loved it!

Must do while in Ho Chi Minh - Highly recommended, we thoroughly enjoyed this and it is our highlight of Ho Chi Minh. The food was outstanding, but the tour guides made the tour. They were all so friendly and we had great fun with them. We were expecting the food element of the tour, but we we were also brought to various contrasting areas of the city and gave an insight into Vietnamese culture and economics. We really found this interesting and would suggest not missing this to add to your HCMC experience. Big shout out to the tour guides and their leader Vee.

6* - Best Experience - Must Do - Food Tour with Genuine Care - The night food tour was spectacular. The best of the best. The founder and owner is so genuine and dialed in creating such a one of a kind experience every step of the way.. Excellent experience - would highly recommend! - This tour was recommended to us by many people who had been to Saigon in the past few years and it still exceeded our expectations and we thoroughly enjoyed it! Our lead guide V was extremely welcoming and enthusiastic and we had lots of fun and felt very comfortable with our drivers/guides Mai and Thow. So many my "first times" at once! - I really appreciate the professional approach from the organizational perspective. I received direct, helpful, kind and clear WhatsApp communication from the very beginning, thus felt totally calm about the tour and its details.

Cảm ơn!
