Amazing tour! - Highly recommend this tour. My guide Lucy was amazing, super friendly and knowledgeable. We went to key sites in Saigon on a motorbike. This was such a cool experience. Lucy also helped me take amazing photos! Thank you for making this tour so memorable and wonderful!

Safe, fun and friendly evening exploring HCMC - Though initially a bit apprehensive about safety, our female drivers from XO made us feel completely safe and comfortable while they threaded their way through the mad HCMC evening traffic! 😊. They took us to a number of districts and gave us a feel for life in Vietnam/HCMC across different segments of society. The most wonderful thing for us was the caring, fun and friendly hospitality of the girls who drove us around (Nhu and Truc) and their team leader (Vy). Thank you for a fun, memorable experience! 🙏😊

Brilliant tour with great friendly and authentic guides - This was the highlight of our entire holiday. Hao and Nhu showed my husband and I how to get on and off the scooters, ensuring our helmets were on properly and then took us on our tour of Saigon by night.

They were both experienced drivers and very chatty. They talked about Saigon, the company and themselves. They were also interested in us and our experiences. We went to some local markets and they explained what we were seeing. We then went to a local street restaurant where they showed us how to eat the local food. We went a tour of various districts and even went inside an old local apartment block where the company's founder used to live and her aunt now lives - what an eye opener! We stopped at another local street restaurant to have dessert on our way back.

They also took photos of us and actually emailed them to us afterwards too.

I'd never been on the back of a scooter or motorbike before and so was quite nervous but they made me feel very safe. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone. An added bonus is that all the drivers are female.

A must-do in Saigon! - We had so much fun on the XO tour! It is a must do. It made us love Saigon! Saigon is so big and can be overwhelming that this is a great way to explore the city, see places you wouldn't normally see, try new foods, learn about the culture, and get to know the women drivers as well as the other people in the tour group. It was so fun and we would 100% recommend it. The food was great but the women really made this tour. Thanks ladies!!

A must-do while in Saigon - Booked this tour as we were impressed by the fact that the tour was run by all women. With some trepidation, we met our guides put on our helmets and climbed aboard our motorbikes. Once we're among the Ho Chi Min traffic, we felt strangely at ease and completely safe. Our riders were very experienced in the city traffic. We visited eight iconic sites of the city, had bah mi and Creme Burleè in coffee for lunch. It's a fantastic tour, and I would highly recommend it while you're in Saigon.

BEST Tour I've Ever Been On (Truly) - WOW - Incredible experience!!! I am an American 🇺🇸 , and I did this tour with my friend James and my Mexican friend, Beto. We did it the end of February. I have traveled to 17 countries, and been on countless tours, I can honestly say this is the BEST tour I have EVER been on. I enjoyed my time in Saigon, Vietnam, but if this tour was the only thing I did, my time there would've been worth it.

It's also not just a food tour, it's a sightseeing tour, and they teach you history - It's a fully woman owned, and run business. All the girls speak good English, so you can communicate (If you're an English-speaking native like me). All the girls are in university/college and working as tour guides outside of their studies. There is a tour leader, but every single member of the tour gets their own personal guide! You will ride on the back of a motorbike with an assigned woman, and she acts as your personal guide. Our guides were V, Queen, and Thao - they were all so wonderful. And I really do not think there is a better way to see the city of Saigon than riding on a motorbike, it is just invigorating, so exciting, such a unique experience.

Do yourself a favor, and don't miss this tour! You will be very grateful you signed up
~Nick from USA 🇺🇸

Hi Chi Minh City Tour - CO Tours does a phenomenal job with the city tour that I did. The girls are very knowledgeable and very friendly. I would recommend them to family and friends without reservations.

XO Saigon by Night - Awesome!! - Our family of four did the Saigon by Night tour and it was truly awesome! The girls were so lovely and such good riders we all felt safe on the motorbikes through the crazy streets and back alleys of Saigon. We had stops for amazing food, a stroll through local food markets, a visit to a Vietnamese home. It was a real highlight of our trip. Highly recommend.

Best food & city tour - We had the best time in Saigon on the XO Foodie tour with our amazing tour guide Cam and her awesome crew of very skilled women!! It was my mums first time on a scooter/bike and they made her feel so comfortable and confident! I cannot recommend this tour more highly!

Don't make a mistake on your trip to Saigon - The XO food tour was not only an amazing activity for the evening, it has made our entire trip so much better. So much so, I want to warn you: do not pass on this tour. We had a private tour and to say our guides were the most friendly, inviting and fun people would be an understatement. They showed us around some of the most amazing spots in the city and it didn't feel like a presentation, we were just chatting the whole time. The food was amazing, and our guides also asked about other foods which we would like to try so they could give personalized recommendations on everything we wanted from our trip. Truc and Xuan obviously really took care that our overall trip to Vietnam was as good as it possibly could be and did everything to make it so. Since the tour we tried their recommendations and they were fantastic. Do not miss this opportunity while visiting Saigon, book this tour for the first day you are here.

LOVED THIS - My family and I absolutely LOVED this tour! The girls on our tour were so lovely and we became instantly comfortable with them! The tour took us around the city, as well as had some local cuisine which was delicious and took us to a 50+ old apartment that really showed us the insights. Would 100% recommend this tour to anyone !
fantastic experience - SO INCREDIBLE! The tour guides were helpful, informative and showed us a really interesting side of Vietnam i wouldn't have seen otherwise.

Best tour of the holiday - This was the best tour we did on our holiday to Vietnam. The Saigon by night tour enables us to see parts of the city that we will never have got to. Our drivers were amazing and took us on highways, through markets and down alleyways. As someone who had never been on a motorcycle I felt completely safe with my driver.

Best part of our trip so far, would absolutely recommend! - We booked the half day, Sights of Saigon tour and we were not disappointed! From the moment we met our riders outside our hotel we felt we would be in safe hands. Trang and Thanh greeted us warmly, explained how to be a passenger on a bike, made sure we had our helmets on correctly and we set off into the buzz of bikes and cars. They were excellent drivers, chatty and pointed out facts on the way to each site. The tour leader, Linh, was exceptional, full of interesting facts, amusing, always in control of the group, she really worked hard to make sure we got the most out of the tour. Great value for money, included water, a snack & cold drink, and the all important loo break! The time flew by! It was brilliant to part of the traffic, blending around people, cars and other bikes, Trang and Thanh were confident drivers, you never felt in any danger. We were staying in District 1, so they picked us up and dropped us back. Best part of our trip so far. Would absolutely recommend.

Best tour in Vietnam - This was the best tour in Vietnam, professional friendly extremely organized and the food was amazing. The best part of the tour was our wonderful lady guides and their expert knowledge and driving skills, would highly recommend 👌

Best tour in Saigon on a back of a motorbike - If you want to see the Ho Chin Minh experience book your tour with this company. The first company to start tours on a motor bike and supporting employment for the females.
We have done the foodie tour and Saigon by night , both excellent , great food , communication the list could go on .
Please book your money to support the local community!!
Excellent Barry and Lorraine

Highlight of our trip - Vy, who led our tour and the team of women guides were absolutely fabulous. Booking the trip, communication about pick up, food preferences, punctuality and road safety were all excellent. Our group of 10 had a wonderful time and all agreed it was a highlight of our Ho Chi Minh stop over. It was worth every dollar and I would recommend XO as a very professional business.

Fantastic experience with XO Tours - Fantastic experience all around with XO tours and a highlight of my trip to Vietnam!

I went on a 14 people private foodie tour where the entire group with varying levels of adventurousness and dietary restrictions - all enjoyed their experiences. Really appreciate the thoughtfulness and details XO tours put into the planning that made everything feel so organized. Starting at time of booking XO tours was incredibly responsive in communicating out the details. Throughout the tour we had the extra "security" staff to take pictures and help with the logistics / inspect food safety. All of the food we had from Bun Bo Hue to BBQ to seafood were delicious. All of us felt really pampered with the XO ladies helping to prepare the food including helping to crack the crab legs.

I enjoyed the foodie tour so much that I booked a solo Saigon at Night tour for the next day and also really enjoyed my experience. There was less food (one stop for street food and one stop for dessert) with more emphasis on learning about the daily lives / culture.

Both trips were incredibly fun! The XO ladies were all great drivers and I felt very safe riding a motorbike for the first time. Everyone spoke English very well and it really felt like going around the city with new friends!

The XO girls are the best - I have Vietnamese heritage. Until very recently, I wasn't super interested in visiting. I had begun planning this trip with a partner at the time. We broke up a few weeks before the trip, and I had thought of canceling it entirely, but several friends told me I should just go alone.

I've never really traveled alone, so I balked at the idea, but my friend Kathleen mentioned this tour. I don't naturally gravitate toward tours, but as Saigon was the first leg of my trip, and one of the cities I'd be alone in (I was meeting up with friends and family in Central and North Vietnam), and it was run by women, I was in.

I booked three tours. Maybe that was overkill, but I enjoyed each and every one of them. The tour leaders were fantastic, and my drivers even more so. Maybe not even more so, as everyone was lovely, but the drivers spend time making sure you are comfortable on a motorbike, and talk to you about your trip. It truly is the best way to see the bustling city that my parents grew up in. Since two of my visited tours the same neighborhood, my driver customized mine and took me to a different neighborhood so I could see something new.

You obviously see the sights, but they take you to lesser known neighborhoods, too. Growing up, I always knew Chinese Vietnamese people, the Chinese population, and they encompass four of Saigon's neighborhoods. I love seeing Chinatowns no matter where I go, and this was no exception.

Truly the best experience. I overlapped my trip with my younger sibling and BIL, and as Saigon is the tail-end of their trip, I hyped this up so much that they booked two private tours with the company.

Book it, you'll love it too! - One of the best tours of my life (and I've been on a lot of tours!!)
Smoothly gliding through Saigon traffic on the back of a scooter, stopping every now and then for delicious food, seeing so many different neighborhoods and learning something about the life of the average person in Ho Chi Minh City made me feel that I'd really visited Saigon even though I'm on a cruise ship.
I'm 70 years old so you can do it too! Book it! You won't be sorry!

XO Tours Saigon: Where Safety and Fun Meet - XO Tours Saigon delivered an absolute riot of an experience that left us clinging to our seats with excitement and laughter as we zoomed through the chaotic streets of this bustling city. Riding on motor scooters was like being in our own action movie, but with the added bonus of feeling completely safe in the hands of our skilled and surprisingly zen female drivers.

Forget about the stereotypical aggressive drivers—our ladies were the epitome of cool and collected, weaving through traffic like seasoned pros while we held on for dear life (but with big grins plastered on our faces, of course).

And let's talk about our guides' English skills- not only did they navigate us through the maze of Saigon's streets, but they also entertained us with hilarious stories and quirky facts about the city.

Exploring Saigon with XO Tours was like being on a rollercoaster of fun, thrills, and cultural insights—all rolled into one hilarious adventure. If you're looking for a side-splittingly good time in Saigon, XO Tours is the way to go!

Evening City & Food Tour - We took a private Wednesday night tour with XO tours. At 6 pm we hopped on bikes with Vy and Thao and after a quick introduction we were off into the sea of ​​scooters. They were both great drivers, funny, and knowledgeable.

It was wild to be on a scooter in this crazy traffic but both ladies were amazing at weaving and winding through. We ate some incredible meals, toured many interesting markets and districts, and met many kind and hard working people.

Being on the bike you really feel like you are part of the pulse of the city. Although it was warm, riding the bike cooled us off. Vy gave us so much information on current and past issues affecting the city and its people. Thao was funny, informative, and helpful. Both ladies were open to discuss all things on and off the bike.

Best tour of our trip! Recommend the private tour as you take full time with the ladies. We had a lot of fun, learned a ton, and saw so much more of the city. Thanks to Vy and Thao for making our trip to Ho Chi Minh! Happy International Women's Day!

An amazing cultural and food tour!! - The XO Food Tour was a highlight of our Vietnam trip. Our tour leaders, Duong and Lam showed us a wonderful time! We felt safe riding the motorbikes with them. Duong and Lam were knowledgeable and friendly. They cooked some food on a tabletop grill that was so unique. We also went to Districts that we would not have seen without them.
I would highly recommend this cultural and food tour. It was amazing!

A Highlight Experience - What a fabulous cultural and food tour. We are a family of 7 and each driver is completely attentive to our needs as well as super friendly and most lovely to spend time with.

Getting to know Saigon - This tour was a highlight of my time in Saigon. The women were professional and so much fun! They made the trip extra special. Our guide, Hong, was so friendly, charisma and knowledgeable about her city. She gave us such a personal tour in which we got to see the home in which she grew up and met her aunt and uncle. My driver Hua was so sweet funny and took the time to get to know me. I highly recommend XO for all. The food was amazing as well. Three of the seven in our group are vegetarian and 3 of us had different food allergies. They worked with us to ensure we had delicious food!

Worth every penny plus more - We had a blast with the XO team of drivers. They were very safe and all seven of us agreed it was the best time we had in Saigon. The lady drivers were fun, knowledgeable, friendly and truly cared about each of us. They shared their lives with us which was more than we expected. Little did we know that our food tour on Vespas would also be a true cultural experience. Three days later and we are still talking about our drivers, where we went, the food and the fun. If there is any tour you take in the city, be sure to take this XO tour. It was will worth the extra money.

The most fun experience in Saigon! - Initially I was bit apprehensive but XO had such wonderful recommendations from family that I decided to go for it. The drivers were superb and they spoke English. They were very engaged and engaging. The tour was extremely well organized and enjoyable. The food was amazing and so different from the regular stuff. This is the food local people eat and we had an opportunity to enjoy it. I highly recommend this company over other food tours.

Night Tour - XO Tours - Excellent Tour with great Guides!!!

Very cool to be driven around to the hidden gems through narrow alleys and bustling streets :)
The best food tour ever - Wow!!! The XO Foodie Tour is amazing! I would give it 6 out of 5 stars if that were an option. If you're considering booking a tour with XO, stop thinking and DO IT NOW!

Highly Recommend, Outstanding Food Tour! - The women that conducted our XO Tour food tour were fantastic and we enjoyed every minute of it! I am disenchanted of riding scooters and the chaotic traffic in Vietnam, and they make me feel comfortable and safe. I also trusted that they were careful drivers and they provided us with helmets. They took us all over HCMC to food places and neighborhoods that we would not have found on our own, and there was a wide variety of food and it was all very good. This is the best food tour I have been on anywhere in the world!

A fantastic finish to our vacation - This was a great way to see Saigon and feel apart from the life of the city. I feel very safe on the motorbike. The food was fabulous. All our guides were informative and friendly. This is a must do!!!

A well-organized fun night. - Defiantly a "must do" in Ho Chi Minh City!
The girls were very friendly and made sure we had a safe and authentic experience on our Saigon by night tour. The thrilling Bike ride really makes you feel like a local.
If you want to discover the real Saigon this tour is for you..

Fabulous tour with Thao - It was an absolute joy to spend an evening with Thao - she made me feel at ease right from the start and made my first evening in Vietnam (ever!) into exactly the experience I was hoping to have. The tour was fun, informative, and took me to parts of the city I never otherwise would have seen. Plus zooming around on the back of a motorbike is just so much fun :) 10/10 recommend!
Food night tour - A different tour to your usual foodie one, you experience a better understanding of how the locals live in Vietnam. The food was amazing of course.

Best experience during our trip in Vietnam 🇻🇳 - Best experience on our trip in Vietnam 🇻🇳🤩 we had amazing young girl guides Cam and Maya (Tour leader Guang Ho) and they showed us typical life in Saigon and we tasted all the best foods 😊 Also they told us lots of interesting things about Vietnam and life in Vietnam 😊 They were driving like professional drivers and we felt safe with them ☺️ Both of girls speak perfect English and they are very kind and smiling 🤩

We would like to thank you to Cam and Maya for such a great experience and we very much appreciate their work 🤩
We really recommend XO Food tour with those girls 😊

Thank you 😊

XO tour- the highlight of our trip - Our group of 10 friends all agree that our night out with XO tours was the highlight of our trip. All 10 riders were beautiful young ladies, very safe riders and did so much to make our night a memorable one. Nhu was my rider and by the end of the night she felt like a friend. WOW! Thank you! - Great tour with the most wonderful and interesting young ladies, they knew so much not just about food but they are great cultural commentators.
I have visited 16 times, starting in 1968, and this tour was one of the best things I have ever done. Thanks Cam and crew.Love Frank and Elisa

DO NOT HESITATE TO BOOK THIS FOODIE TOUR! - A great foodie tour offered by all women motorbike/scooter drivers. They interspersed the food offerings with fun and games to allow for digestion before the next meal. All the food was wonderful. I feel very comfortable being on the back of a bike with my driver, Ihn. I highly recommend XO Tours. So much fun!!!

A great experience - I had an absolutely fantastic time on both the Foodie Tour and the Sights of Saigon tour.
They are more than tours, they are enjoyable and educational outings.
My riders Truc and Le were great. Both spoke excellent English and rode well. I have been riding motorbikes for 33 years and

I thoroughly recommend XO Tours and I would do the tours again.

Just book it! So much fun! - This tour was recommended by a friend and I'm so glad I booked it.

Our guides (who were our scooter drivers) met us at our hotel. They were super excited to show us Saigon, share food, and talk about their culture.

We went to places in Saigon that I would not have thought to visit.

This is one of the most fun, organized, and well planned tours I have ever been on.

Excellent trip around HCMC - This is a great tour, it is a combination of 1:1 private tour and group tour. Food was good and the tour introduced things i wouldn't have known to order without some guidance. Easily one of the best tours I've done.

Good food and amazing guides! - The food was delicious and our guides were amazing. Despite the crazy traffic we felt saved on the back of the motorbikes. We had such a good time on the tour and enjoyed exploring the different parts of Saigon that we would not have seen otherwise.

Food and culture tour of Saigon - This was a fantastic food and culture tour of Saigon. You get to experience the amazing traffic of Saigon on the back of a motorbike expertly driven by a charismatic young local guide. The food is fantastic and you will come away with a deeper appreciation of this fantastic city and country.

Don't miss an XO tour! - I loved this tour- it was so fun zipping around HCMC on a motorbike! My driver was very safe and fun-she provided tidbits on HCMC and Vietnamese culture as we traveled from stop to stop. I saw the areas outside District 1- we went to a wet market and a war-era apartment building, and stopped for a few of the most popular HCMC street eats. XO tours are VERY well organized-they managed a group of 8 with ease. At the end of the tour, the tour leader Vy asked for feedback and offered her contact information - for any purpose! I took her up on the offer the next day - to ask about a US first aid product I was struggling to find. Highly recommend this tour!!
Must Do - What a fun and entertaining way to see more of the city and try amazing food. Loved the entire experience! Highly recommend!

Food sensation - The girls from XO Tours were amazing. They spoke very good English and had a wealth of knowledge of the city of Ho Chi Minh and its people and food. We traveled on the back of their motor scooters zipping through the traffic stopping to visit & taste the local street food. Had a fantastic time and the food was excellent. A definite must do on a trip to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Thank you girls.

Brilliant way to see and eat Saigon! - The XO tour was a highlight of our family trip to Saigon. It was sooooo good!!! The hosts were amazing, so helpful and so informative and so funny!! The food was great! Not the standard Vietnamese staples, but different things you wouldnt usually try. We cannot recommend XO tours enough. You feel safe and got to see allllllll of Saigon. 100% recommend.

The best part of our visit to HCMC! - Nhu and her team (Vy2, Duyen2, Lam2) were superb!
