The ladies were well informed, friendly and excellent motorbike drivers. My terror of HCMC roads and traffic disappeared with Vy2 driving me!

Outstanding Trip - do not miss it - We spent an amazing 3 hours touring around HCMC with our fantastic guides Nhu, Vy2,Lam2 & Duyen2 (my favorite). They were able to point out the sights as we rode around. Their knowledge was excellent and they brought everything to life visiting a local food market and eating authentic Vietnamese street food. A visit to an apartment and meeting Auntie Mia was very illuminating. Overall a great experience. Highly recommended. If runs a great team.

XO Foodie Tour - My son and I took the XO Foodie tour in Ho Chi Minh City and it was great!
The guides were really fun and enthusiastic and nice. Riding around in the traffic on the back of a scooter was so much fun and we got to see several areas of the city in one evening. They picked a nice assortment of restaurants and dishes. I am a vegetarian and they accommodated me with a lot of options and guaranteed I had enough to eat.
We can't recommend this enough - we loved it!!

Excellent women - We did XO's food tour and Sights of Saigon tour. Both were really excellent. Well organized, with great stops, information and food and amazing service from our tour guise and (more importantly) our riders. A much more personal experience than I suspect you get with a lot of these tours, and the fact that this is a company run by young women is impressive. Would highly recommend.

THERE IS A REASON IT IS THE TOP TOUR IN SAIGON - The food was amazing, the views were spectacular, and the tour guides were worth their weight in gold. It is not an exaggeration to say that this was the highlight of our time in Saigon and possibly Vietnam. In particular, Jen and V, our guides, were wonderful, informative and considerate. 10/10.

XO Food Tour - The XO food tour is great. All the ladies provided excellent service. Our motorbike drivers, Van and Chau, were both safe drivers and enjoyable to be around. The tour group leader, Vy did a great job explaining things. We were pleasantly surprised by the inclusion of sightseeing in the tour. Highly recommend this tour to enjoy some Southern Vietnamese cuisine, as well as see some sights in Ho Chi Minh City outside of District 1.

Best day in Vietnam!!! - We did the History Tour during the day then their Foodie Tour in the evening. We absolutely loved it! The women that drove us around gave us one of the best touring days on our time here in Vietnam. Thank you for being so attentive and kind to us. Highly recommend.

Saigon by night is a must tour while in Saigon! - We chose the Saigon by night tour fairly last minute but were not disappointed!! If you want to not only sample some Vietnamese food, visit some parts of Saigon not on the tourist map and really learn something about the culture and history, then this is the tour for you!!
It was our first time riding on the back of a motorcycle through the streets of Saigon, but these women are amazing, so friendly and welcoming, truly knowledgeable and so great at what they do.
Highly recommend!!!

THE BEST tour - Amazing way to see the city and get comfortable! Must do! - Our experience with XO tours absolutely blew our expectations out of the water!!! So many reasons to go with XO, but most importantly it was an amazing way to learn about the city and get more comfortable navigating as a tourist.

Throughout the tour, you learn so much about all the districts of Ho Chi Minh. You gain an understanding of where you might want to go next, reputations/cuisines/attractions at each district, places to avoid, etc. They even end the tour by giving you a “tourists crash course” pamphlet that has common phrases you might need to know in Vietnamese. After our tour, navigating the city was a breeze.

The food on the tour had some of the most unique and delicious dishes we had on our entire trip through Southeast Asia. They do a fantastic job of showing you food you might not find on your own (no pho or banh mi, but they give great recs!). Our favorite was the noodle soup with tapioca crab noodles.

Finally, the service is top notch. All the women leading our tour were very funny, nice, and attentive, with everyone speaking fluent English. Hong was a fantastic tour guide and did an awesome job everyone kept entertained and happy. Can't wait to come back!!!

Fantastic! - Absolutely fantastic. This tour is typical of Ho Chi Min. The scooter ride through the city streets (including the not-so-touristy parts), in the middle of the traffic of this beautiful city, is even more interesting than the food stops. There are two stops that are just for meeting the locals, without restaurants.
As for the professionals who ride the motorcycles, friendliness, education and total enthusiasm. The tour is also very organized, with places to stop the motorbikes and tables to sit at each destination. Very very well organized!
Fantastic tour!

Wonderful! - I would give it 6 stars if I could! I did the sight seeing tour in the morning with a couple of other travelers, and it was both fun and informative - the lead guide Linh was so well prepared and gave some personal stories to make the tour more relatable. The guides were more than accomodating making sure we were comfortable and well fed/hydrated throughout - we felt pampered and spoiled throughout lol. My scooter driver Vy (4) was amazing, she was great giving me a glimpse into life in HCMC as we rode through the streets on a scooter, an experience in itself! I was a bit apprehensive at first but she couldn't have made the ride feel safer (and fun!), so much so that I did the foodie tour at night with her. XO tour lives up to its reputation, highly recommended!

Highlights of our trip! - XO was recommended to me by a friend and it did not disappoint.

The booking process was straightforward and efficient and the tour itself was informative, safe, well run and highly professional. To top it all off the food was amazing.

You get a 1:1 service from your English speaking driver pointing out all the sights on your route and they take you to areas of the city and restaurants it is unlikely you will visit as a tourist. Riding around the city on the back of a scooter is a great way to see things and a fantastic experience.

The team were very careful to take care of my partners food allergies and made sure there was a suitable alternative for him. You will definitely not go away hungry...the scallops were to die for!!

At first the tour seemed expensive compared to what we had been paying for tourist attractions and food elsewhere in the country but it was absolutely worth every penny and the highlight of our trip around Vietnam and Cambodia! We would not hesitate to recommend V and her first class team of girls!

Highly Recommended - This tour was amazing! The drivers were very nice and informative and great drivers! It was a really fun way for my friends and I to see the city and try some good food! I recommend going at the beginning of the trip to get some recommendations of places to check out as well.

What a fun, great way to experience Saigon - The original and the best scooter tours in Saigon (HCMC)!! We took the day tour followed by the evening food tour. The girls are just fantastic hosts and have wonderful knowledge of Saigon and Vietnam and its history.

My wife and I simply loved the girls that we met on both tours. You will not be disappointed in choosing either tour or like us both tours!

Don't worry, you won't leave the food tour hungry!

Food and scooter tour of Ho Chi Minh City - Our son lives in Ho Chi Minh City, we came over to see him and get an idea of ​​his life here. He arranged this scooter tour for us as he felt this is the best way to see and taste real Ho Chi Minh.
Boy was he so right, firstly the girls were all so friendly and spoke very good English, secondly they were able to tell us all about life in this vibrant city.
The tour leader, Hong Tong then also took us to see her home where she lived with her family. It is a fascinating story about real life here.
The food was sampled at real local restaurants where you saw the real life for the locals.
I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see real life in Ho Chi Minh.

A Not To Be Missed Food Tour! - This is a Not To Be Missed experience! The communication from XO from the moment we signed up right up to the day of the tour was excellent. And the tour it self is so much fun - and SO filling (don't eat lunch the day of your tour so you'll have plenty of room for the delicious food). And in addition to the amazing food, the tour includes a coupl of cultural stops along the way to give you some insight into the daily lives of Siagon residents. Finally, they were so accommodating with a couple of food preferences. Overall, our experience was a 10!

More than a Food Tour, so much information on Saigon. Excellent Food - This is more than a wonderful food tour, our amazing tour guides Ngan and Thao 4 made us feel so safe and comfortable on the scooters. Throughout the tour our guides informed us about each district and their local knowledge on Saigon was amazing. As for the local food we loved it all and rolled back to our hotel that night feeling so full. We really enjoyed the tour of the night market to see how local people buy their food. This tour exceeded our expectations and we would also like to thank the Tour Leader Uyen Nguyen for her patience answering all our queries and questions. Excellent

A night of food, fun and adventure - Without doubt this was the highlight of our stay in HCMC. This was an exciting adventure of fun, food, information, laughter and an overall unforgettable experience. Vy and her team are so nice and friendly and certainly can navigate their way through the crazy traffic of the city. The food was amazing and we sampled new tastes that we would never have chosen from a menu in places we would not have visited . If we could stay one more day we would do it all again!!

Wow! - such a fabulous evening with XO tours - Such an amazing tour. This was our second visit to HCM City and we were looking forward to experiencing this tour. The tour is exceptionally well organized with perfect hosts. If you are nervous about riding pillion on a motorcycle - don't be. The riders are very experienced and safe. You will see a completely different side to the city and we will remember this experience for a long time. Well done team XO Tours!

A must do! - So much fun! We had Nhu, Hieu, Hai and Anna ride us through town on motorbikes. They were all skilled riders and very communicative. My kids (15 & 13) were riding for the first time and I never felt they were unsafe through the wild streets of Saigon. We had good food and conversation, but I really enjoyed getting to see how a local lived. Co Mai (auntie Mai) welcomed us in to her home and let us see the space. It's amazing so many people can live in such a small home. I suspect most Americans would never live like that but, Co Mai was so proud of her home and full of smiles. Thank you to our girls, but also to our bodyguard in black who followed behind all of us to keep us safe and take pictures. I highly recommend this tour.

Older lady had fun night out with XO - I was very apprehensive as I am an older lady who has never been on a scooter, but I had the best time, my driver Hgu was fabulous, so kind and her English was amazing. We went to parts of Saigon we will never have seen and Vy gave good information about life in Saigon. The food was amazing and it was fun!

Insightful, fun adventure through HCMC - This tour was recommended by a friend who lived in HCMC for 4 years. It did not disappoint! We chose for the cultural experience tour - it was a tremendous value. We learned a lot about daily life in HCMC, toured a Chinatown market, ate a delicious meal and visited an apartment complex to meet a local and see the reality of life beyond District 1 (aka, the tourist zone).

The drivers were very safe and really nice! So much fun to scoot around the city and be part of the traffic instead of trying to cross it on foot.

AP - Wow. Great experience. The girls were friendly and informative. We went to a variety of places covering 5 districts. We saw a traditional market aswell as one of the premier residential areas which gave a wide perspective on the City as opposed to the central districts. While the tour is more expensive than many advertised the quality of the route, the information from the moped girls and the fact they are escorted by 2 security people means this tour is worth every penny. They also sent us various photographs and videos of our trip. Finally we were a group of 8 so definitely a small group tour.

Do This Tour - Do this tour!! You will be riding off the beaten path by the very capable and knowledgeable women of XO Tours. I am 74 and was a little apprehensive but no worries my guide made sure I was always safe and of course had plenty to eat at the end.

Best experience in Saigon :) - You are in for a real treat!!! It was our favorite experience of SaiGon. The ladies are truly amazing, knowledgeable, and very funny! In particular An and Thao that drove us around the city with safety and made sure we enjoyed our tour to the max. It was so enjoyable and informative and mainly took us to places we would never go ourselves, eating and drinking among the locals. The whole experience was more than worth it and a must if you are in Saigon.

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - Had an amazing time on the XO foodie scooter tour! Probably one of the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City. They accommodated vegetarian food for us. We stopped at 5 places, 3 food places and 2 stops for sight seeing. They take you into a number of districts that tourists wouldn't normally wander into so was an excellent experience to see how locals shop/live/ go about their daily life! You can speak to the girls while they're riding the scooter and they were great to talk to about their life/education in Vietnam! Certainly a must do in Ho Chi Minh! It's a bit expensive but it's safe as you have 2-3 security guys following the group around and are there for your own safety too. My rider was Nok who was excellent! Even at the food stops she was full of energy and great fun!

Definitely do this tour! - This was one of the coolest experiences we've had on our trip to Vietnam. Riding on the motorbikes was so fun and seeing the different districts of Saigon at night was amazing. We our loved drivers (Rosie and Vy!) - they were so nice, smart, funny and gave us a ton of information about the city and the food we were eating. We also loved all the food - it was unlike other food we've tried on other experiences in Vietnam. The pacing of the food was also great because we didn't get too full. We get to see places that tourists do not typically get to see in Saigon and learned a lot about everyday life for the locals. My husband and I are travelers and while we appreciate tourism and know that we are also tourists, it was amazing to be on a food tour that takes you away from the typical crowds and lets you just be in the moment. 100% recommend doing this tour - we'll be recommending to all our friends who visit Vietnam and we'd do it again next time we are in Saigon!

Foodie Tour was not just good food, but great sightseeing also! - Saw XO Tours on a lot of our social media feeds and it turned out to be as advertised. Fun, educational and tasty (food tour)

I really appreciated the safe scooter-ing, and insights from all of our family member's tour guides.

Each member of our family of three was assigned their own guide but we all learned something from the three of them together. It felt like we were just hanging out with a group of friends.

I firmly believe this is the best way to see and learn about HCMC!

Fantastic Experience - Did the scooter night food tour with Xo Tours.
Great food, very well spoken ladies, extremely safe riders and very informative.

A 'must do' Street FoodTour in Vietnam - Our family had a wonderful experience with the XO girls and Truc Huynh as our Tour Leader. Truc was wonderful....warm, engaging and very informative. The food stops were great, especially the seafood stops. The rest stops were really interesting and gave us an insight into local life. Riding the bikes and chatting with the guides was magic! This tour was the highlight of our Vietnamese holiday. Thank you Truc and XO tours!

Funnest tour we did in the city - Such an amazing time riding on motorbikes through the city...it was not only delicious places they took us to eat...but also a very educational experience as well..our guides were very easy to chat with along the way, and V was a funny and knowledgeable tour leader...10 out of 10 would recommend...I know I'll be doing this again if and when I'm back in Saigon

Amazing!! A must for your trip to Ho Chi Minh City - Fantastic experience!! Our guides Cam and Hou were fabulous. You got to see all parts of Ho Chi Minh that you didn't see on a traditional tour. Plus, you were able to taste a variety of local dishes. In addition to tasting food, we were able to visit an open market. I would highly recommend this tour. A must for your visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

A thrilling, eye-opening, delicious and super personal adventure. If you only do one tour due to this. - Summed up in a few words, it was a thrilling, eye-opening, delicious and super personal adventure.

At the end of our 10 day family trip in Vietnam everyone was unanimous that this was the most enjoyed activity of the entire time.

If you want to feel like your part of Saigon / Ho Chi Minh, taste some great dishes and see less explored parts of the city this is the tour to take.

Our family of 5 (from 16-65 in age) took to mopeds with these amazing young women and flew threw the streets of Saigon. We soaked up the organized chaos of Saigon traffic, exploring 5 different districts and experiencing the food, culture and color of Saigon by night. Our guides, Vy 2 and the rest of the girls, made us feel immediately welcome and cared for. The ride on the back of their scooters was thrilling but we always felt safe too. The girls were warm, witty, intelligent and brilliant at introducing us to new places, foods and gave us some real insight into the daily customs and life of Saigon locals. We took a private tour and it was worth every penny. Just do it! I'd give it six stars if I could.

Fabulous experience that exceeded all expectations - Absolutely excellent, I don't have the words to express who wonderful the Saigon by night tour was. The drivers are skilled and competent and deal with the madness that is Saigon traffic with ease. They are friendly, informative and speak good English. The tour shows you a whole side of Saigon that most tourists have never seen. It concentrates on how typical Saigonese people shop - a local market, the food they eat - a street food meal that was delicious, how they live - a tour of the apartment the tour leader grew up, followed by a stop for a delicious desert. In between each stop your driver takes you through different areas of the city. Overall the tour was excellent. I highly recommend

Great night out on XO foodie tour - This experience exceeded our expectations, which were already high based on the reviews we read when we were doing our trip research. We had no prior experience on motorbikes so we were a bit concerned about how secure we'd feel sitting in back, but our lady guides were excellent riders, and soon, we were chatting it up with them while they weaved us through the chaotic Saigon traffic to our various destinations. The food was quite good and what locals would eat when having a night out on the town. We went all over the city, well beyond District 1, to both eat and see some local culture, which was a great way to experience the city. Highly recommend this tour!

XO tours provides a great outdoor experience in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam. This experience introduced us to the real Vietnam - De best outside activity you can do in Ho Chi Minh.

These girls gave us a perfect foodie tour with the experience of getting introduced with the Vietnamese culture, lifestyle and people.

This was great and recommended by my family. Girls you're doing great. Keep on going and succeed with your great formula.

Thx scooterteam and special Ngoc Phung as tourleader with all the interesting stories about Vietnam.

Ruud, Marlou, Kelly, Kevin and Geraldine. January 14, 2024

XO Food Tour - Wow, this tour was so much fun! It was the last tour we did after traveling through Vietnam for 2 weeks and what a way to finish! These young women do an amazing job. I never felt unsafe on the bike and the food and tour were brilliant too! Don't hesitate...do it!

Worth every penny! - I'm a Vietnamese American, and my husband is not. I stumbled on these tours via Instagram reels before we booked our vacation in Vietnam. My husband looked into their website and really appreciated all the travel-tips that they had so he looked further into booking the food tour. The booking process was very simple, and they even had a section to let the guides know if there are any foods you simply do not like or wish to avoid. The day of the tour, our guides showed up at our hotel and picked us up via moped. We are well acquainted with riding but they went over the safety procedures just in case. We were dropped off at the first eating-location and that's where the main tour guide explained the entire trip for us. They took us to several different districts in Saigon where we got to explore the markets and were given a little bit of history for each area. Along the ride to each district, I got to know my tour guide a little more and we both shared personal stories about ourselves. I think I enjoyed that the most of the entire tour -- just being able to listen to someone tell stories of what it's like growing up in Vietnam along and how much it differs from the States. She was incredibly sweet and well-spoken in both English and Vietnamese. I am extremely impressed by all the ladies on this tour! It truly doesn't matter if you're Vietnamese or not, the food tour was a lot of fun and I highly recommend you come with a very empty stomach because they will feed you non stop!!
Awesome tour with great food led by an exceptional group of women. - Awesome experience. All the women were so kind and made it so much fun while also teaching us about Vietnam. The food was amazing.

Excellent city tour with Lucy! - I had an excellent city tour led by Lucy. I was super lucky to have her as my motorbike driver. She was engaging and had very interesting details about the city. She provided excellent history of the city with well chosen stops on the tour. Furthermore, she was an excellent driver. I had mentioned that I had already tried some Vietnamese food earlier in my trip and she carefully inquired about that so that she could treat me to drinks that were different from the ones I had already tried. Her grasp of English was excellent as well. 100% recommend this tour for anyone hoping to get a thorough history of HCMC and 100% recommend Lucy as a tour guide!

Amazing Experience! - This experience was amazing! The girls were so conversational and very nice. The food locations were great opportunity to taste the local cuisine and the tour went above and beyond for all of the guests.

The energy was fun and exciting! I'd definitely do this experience again and recommend to everyone!

The tour also had multiple employees to keep guests safe during the experience. This is a well established business.

Xo food tour - The trip was one of the best I have been to. The scooter rider was very helpful and friendly and very good and self confident and safe on the motorbike. The team leader was excellent. English was fluent from all the staff. Food and venue were very good. Memory for a lifetime

A Fabulous Experience with XO Tours Saigon - The XO Tours looked like a worthwhile thing to try when I searched for things to do in Saigon; the fact that it was owned and operated by women was one of the appealing features. And we were not disappointed! It turned out to be one of the best food tour experiences we've had. Our family of 5 adults chose for the Van tour instead of the usual scooter tour, because my wife fractured her wrist a week before our trip, so she had a cast on her left arm. However, that decision made our experience even better, because we had more time to chat with the 3 wonderful tour guides who were assigned to us. Ms. Duong Nguyen, Ms. Truc Huynh and Ms. Nhu Nguyen all spoke excellent English; they were friendly, curious, above all eager to show us things that we haven't yet experienced in Vietnam. The decided on 3 restaurants for us to try, after asking about what we've already tried in the previous 2 weeks in Vietnam. Throughout the over 3 hour tour, the coordination with the driver and support staff (who coordinate with the restaurants so the tables and food will be ready when we arrive) were flawless, the conversations were fun and interesting and the foods were all delicious! We walked away feeling that we were enriched by having learned a lot more about the Vietnamese people, their culture and their cuisine. If you have an opportunity to try the XO Tours, don't miss it!

So much fun!! Book it! - This vespa foodie tour was one of the most fun tours I've ever been on. Vespa was so fun, felt completely safe (and I can be a wimp!). The women who drive, and run the tour are the most engaging, bright, funny and knowledgable hosts. You are treated to an amazing array of food, all local yet safe for foreigner's to eat, and you are taken on a tour of almost every district in Saigon! Wish we'd done the first night. Just thinking about it makes me smile. Truly unique and fantastic. Highly recommend.

Delicious food and amazing tour guides! - Me and my husband booked the tour for our last day in Ho Chi Minh City and it did not disappoint. We had the most amazing time trying new foods, learning about the city and the people and most of all, we had a lot of fun!

Even as a pick eater, my husband still tried everything they presented which made me really happy. He honestly had an amazing time which was important to me, as I was the one who suggested the tour and brought him to the country for a trip in the first place!

Great Tour, blown away - I booked this tour by recommendation of friends who already toured with XO before.

Highly, highly recommend this tour! Hong was our main tour guide. Mya, Tall Thao and short Thao were very personable and fun to hang out with. Loved learning about the history of the different districts and enjoyed the food choices. Seriously, this tour blew us away & have recommended it to others as well. Don't hesitate to book, you won't be disappointed.

The Best So Far - My girlfriend and I just finished the XO Foodie tour and it was fantastic. The tour leader, Hong Tong, was incredibly engaging and was full of interesting information about the districts we visited. The tour itself was well organized and hits a great balance between sightseeing and eating amazing food. We certainly got to try several dishes that were new to us, all of which were delicious. Our drivers, Nhu and Thu, were friendly, safe, and simply a lot of fun.

We have been on several food tours in Asia and we both agree that this was the best. I highly recommend the XO Food tour.

Fantastic!!! - What a fun street food tour, really enjoyed the food experience, hosts are super friendly, it was like being on a film set whizzing round Ho Chi Minh City on the back of scooters but we also felt very safe. Informative and enjoyable tour, definitely enhanced our Ho Chi Minh experience and wouldn't hesitate to book again.

Just brilliant all round. Don't go with anyone else! - Excellently run. Very safe. Fun, delicious, professional, unique and of course food. I was very anxious getting on a bike in the crazy traffic but my driver Vee was a pro and made me feel very comfortable. What a fantastic experience for my family. My 14 year old daughter was in a bad mood as she had broken her toe a few days earlier and did not want to be dragged out on 'another tour', but the girls managed to snap her out of it and got her smiling, chatting and even singing to Taylor Swift as her driver was also a 'Swifty' lol. My daughter thoroughly enjoyed it which is saying A LOT. My daughter doesn't talk to anybody! Haha. Totally loved every part of this tour. The scenic stops were a great way to learn more about HCM whilst our food digested ready for the next stop. Our tour leader Truc was a delight and had a beautiful energy. All the girls were amazing. 10/10. I'd love to upload photos but for once I actually forgot to take them because I was so engaged in our tour! Even hubby (designed photographer) forgot to take some.

Incredible low - We had the most amazing time on the foodie tour, tried some incredible dishes and our hosts were super attentive and informative about both the food and the places we visited.

Cannot recommend highly enough!

Highly Rated - I had a great time on the trip!! I live in HCMC, but we went to places where I haven't been in the city, and I learned a bunch of new information. I planned the trip with some visiting friends, and they felt completely safe and happy on the back of the bikes as well. I prepared the journey with them as a wedding present, and they had a fantastic time. XO made it special for them with many personal touches (a small congratulations cake) and answered their questions. My friends (and I were pleased, and we will recommend it to others. Thank you to Ai (my driver) and Vi for everything

A Must - This experience far exceeded our expectations. We booked this as a group of 9 (two families traveling together with teenagers). Communication from the very start was amazing, with very clear instructions and responses to questions I had.

As expected, you will eat amazing food and get to visit parts of the city you could not head to on your own. What was unexpected what the high attention to detail by the team, the amazing conversation and the insights you get about the city. We had Uyen Nguyen as our team leader, and we couldn't speak more highly of her and the ladies in her team. They were all very considerate, truly interested in how we were finding it and wanted to make sure we were having a good time.

It was great to see our teenagers, really get into the experience too. Their dietary requirements were catered for, and even one of our pickiest eaters was trying out new foods! Our kids all commented on how much they loved it, and how it was a highlight. This was quite amazing as a few were a bit unsure about what it was all about.

Thanks to our amazing team for what was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

Highlight of HCM - The highlight of our trip to HCM. Don't be weary of being on a scooter. Although the traffic within HCM can be intimidating, the drivers are PROS and I feel safe the entire time. We learned a ton about food by traveling throughout different districts, and learning about the culture of Vietnam and meeting new friends was a big bonus.

Food tour - Excellent communications. We were promptly picked up from our place and taken to the first restaurant. We met up with other people and the whole experience was fun and food was delicious. We were well taken care of.
Unforgettable - The trip was very well organized and the riders were all very well informed. Enjoy the trip. We saw a different part of HCMC and was told of the history

The real HCMC experience from the back of a bike - We went on the daytime tour and had a fantastic time! Our guide, Linh was knowledgeable and engaging sharing factual information and personal anecdotes about Districts 1,3 and 5 of Ho Chi Minh City. As this was my first time on a motorbike in HCMC, I was a bit nervous, but my driver Li was very professional and safe. Participating in a tour from the back of the bike made it that much more authentic and memorable.

Can't miss activities in Saigon. - This was one of the best things we did in Vietnam during our 2 weeks visit. Make sure to ask for Vy as tour leader and Van as your guide, they were exceptional.
This is more than a food tour, of course they make sure you get to eat some amazing and authentic cuisine, but they also give you lessons on day to day living for people in Saigon and expose you to many different districts.

Fantastic blend between food and history - There is no doubt that the service on this trip is exceptional. Getting a private guide around Ho Chi Minh as you explore both the food and the history of the city is unparalleled. The girls are incredibly well-informed and the quality of the tour is fantastic. I also loved supporting a business that pays their workers above minimum wage and makes an effort to employ women. I learned so much about the city and especially the part about the economy was super fascinating to me. The food itself was nice, although not my favorite that I've tried in Vietnam. I will say though that the food they have is certainly not what you would get ordering on your own. A fantastic experience and well worth the money for the quality, safety and informative guides you get with it.

Wonderful screw - We really enjoyed our foodie tour, our drivers were charming, interesting and knowledgeable, the food was interesting and tasty, and the evening ss a whole was so fun. We learned lots about the city and Vietnam in general, we saw many parts of the city we hadn't yet seen, and we enjoyed new food. Thank you

Great way to explore the city! - This tour exceeded our expectations! Staff were so friendly, plus the food was abundant and delicious. We really enjoyed exploring the city and seeing the different districts, and learning unique insights about the city and culture.
We were a little worried about fitting on the bikes (my husband is 6'4” and I'm 6') but we didn't need to worry, they brought a big helmet for him and were very skilled drivers. Definitely a highlight of our trip!

First day in Vietnam!! - AMAZING! The XO tour was the best way to meet the city and culture of Vietnam on our very first day. We had 4 drivers, all were wonderful and we felt safe despite crazy traffic. Our tour guide Linh was engaging and fun, gave us a great overview of important sites and events around Saigon. If we had only another day in the city I would have booked another tour with them. We'll definitely use this company again!! It feels like we have real friends to visit now.

Fantastic - Our tour was amazing! Could not think of a better way to see Ho Chi Min. Our tour guides were excellent- super friendly and professional! The tour was well curated and all of our stops felt very well coordinated. I would highly recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting Ho Chi Min!

Best thing to do in Ho Chi Minh City!!! - Our family (parents & 2 teenage kids) did the XO Saigon by Night tour and it was amazing. Riding on the bikes was exhilarating. We drove to outside districts & ate various meals at a local food stall, which were delicious. We visited a housing block and were given a perspective of local life, it was very informative and a real eye opening experience. We all loved it & would absolutely recommend this tour & company.

Awesome scooter and food tour! - Such an awesome experience to get a true taste of Saigon! We were warmly welcomed and encouraged on the abc's of being a passenger on the scooter and then set off for a delightful five hour adventure. The Tour was an intimate group of 10. Large enough to enjoy getting to know the others but small enough that you didn't feel lost. The food was delicious and they went to great pains to make sure everything was to your liking and with a 1:1 ratio we all had plenty of attention for any questions we had. Highly recommend this great group of ladies to welcome you to a wonderful place!

#1 choice hands down! - Best tour of 8 we did on our trip thru South Asia. Tour guide Lin knowledgeable and sights they chose were a great summary of the area. History religion and culture explained. Bike tour drivers were very safe and also explained areas along the way and answered all my questions. Pagoda in China town was beautiful. All female guides - girl power 💪

Wonderful experience! - We couldn't rate this tour highly enough! It was recommended to us by another traveler, and whilst slightly more expensive than some other tours, it was well worth it. The girls are all incredibly knowledgeable and gave us a good insight into their city. The tour leader spoke to everyone about the history of each destination that we stopped at. We visited many places that just wouldn't be on most tourists lists. AND, the food - just delicious! Local dishes to tantalise the taste buds. We felt incredibly safe on the back of the scooters, the team was a great deal of fun, and we had a terrific night. Such a wonderful experience! Thanks V4 and Duyen.

XO Tours - Food, fun and adventure! - XO Tours was a fantastic experience!
I had a wonderful time, enjoying the safe motorbike ride with Rosie, tasting delicious food, sightseeing around Ho Chi Minh City!
The girls were so welcoming, friendly and full of fun and plenty of food tips as well!
A must do experience when you are visiting Vietnam!!
Thank you!

An experience not to be missed. - Like it seems everyone else who has done this tour, we would whole-heartedly recommend it to others. The concept is wonderful and it really delivers. We visited several HCMC districts on motorbikes driven by young women, from this all-female company. Our guides were incredibly knowledgeable—and good, safe drivers too—and we were able to explore a range of topics, from food to politics to ours and their individual lives. It's an experience not to be missed.

Great food and fun rides - So much fun zipping thru the chaotic traffic of Saigon under the steady hands of the XO girls. Food choices are excellent and unexpected and well spaced out. We covered 5 districts that night so a lot of territory.
Lots of food including beers and fun facts and games.
Highly recommend

Ho Chi Minh City's Premium Experience - Just do it! - Unbelieveably fun experience that was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. Thanks to our amazing guide, Thao Truong and her team, who absolutely made this so memorable. We did the XO Saigon by night tour. This was a beautiful blend of motorbiking around the parts of the city during peak hour traffic (which actually moves at a lovely pace), eating dinner and dessert, and being exposed to the culture, people, and markets of Ho Chi Minh City. Having a family with young teenagers, we were a little unsure at first. Our son, who was afraid initially, found himself completely comfortable after we were on the move. The level of English from our main guide and each bike rider was awesome, which made for fun and interesting conversation while riding the bikes and eating. This 3-hour experience was priceless (worth every cent).
Great night out with the XO team - What a fantastic night out. There is no way you can see this on your own in one evening and the XO team is very professional.

Saigon by night scooter tour - Very nice cultural experience with this visit to Saigon in the evening, by scooter. Discoveries of authentic neighborhoods, tasting street food, and other great surprises at the meeting. Rich and warm exchanges with our 2 guides, Lucy and May.

A must-do in Saigon! - I am forever grateful that we did this tour - what a beautiful and fun way to experience the city! The food was great, and I love how they also mixed sightseeing into the tour, so you have time to digest, haha. You learn a lot, about the culture as well as the food, but more importantly, the staff is beyond wonderful - so kind, fun and welcoming. I would recommend doing this tour 10/10, and would love to do it again. A special thanks to Truc, Rose and Vy who made this tour memorable for me and my friend - but everyone on the team was really lovely!

An Unforgettable Tour Experience - This was my first solo trip to HCMC (Saigon), VN. I had booked two tours (XO Foodie and Saigon by Night) with XO Tours , a woman owned business. Both tours were well-organized, well-coordinated, and everything was punctual. With XO tours, for a few precious hours, I got to understand what a typical day in the life of locals was like. My XO Tour leaders and guides were friendly, sweet and engaging that I learned a great deal and because of them, I want to learn more about everything VN. I experienced the wonderful cuisine and culture of Vietnam. I had so much fun. It was an experience that I will never forget. I highly recommend XO Tours for your tours in Saigon. Great job ladies! Wishing you all the best in 2024!

A food tour not to be missed! - The foodie tour was a great introduction to Vietnam for us!
We also received lots of useful information previously via WhatsApp and any question was answered quickly!
It was also interesting to hear about Vietnamese history as well as how people live and interact with each other in Ho Chi Minh City, especially from a young girls perspective.
The food was yummy too!

It doesn't get any better!! - A quick note to say how much my family enjoyed our foodie tour. I was very nervous about having my daughters on motorbikes but the ladies made it's so EASY and we all felt incredibly safe and comfortable with each of our drivers.
Our drivers wanted to get to know us personally, aspects of our home country and our world travels, while showing & teaching us wonderful highlights of this beautiful city. We all laughed, had wonderful conversations, and we enjoyed great company and great food (food comatose afterwards). Thank you so much for an evening that we'll be talking about for years to come. I am more than happy to recommend this tour to others and hope one day we can return to experience it again.

Definitely worth it - fun, safe, delicious! - Very, fun and safe scooter ride around the city with delicious food. saw a huge amount of the city and a generous food portions! Tour leader and our personal scooter guides were caring thoughtful and superb service. Highly recommend!

You can not miss this oportunity while in Ho Chi Minh City - This Food tour is simply a Blast. You must do it. The food is amazing!!! But more important the people are astonishing. The XO tours team is so lovely, I learned a lot about the Vietnamese culture and had tons of fun. I highly recommend them.
Sights of Saigon on a Scooter ! - The trip was amazing - saw wonderfull things we'd otherwise have missed in this great city. Nhu Nguyen And the Girls were great !

A must-do experience - This tour is beyond compare! The XO team are simply excellent! For a person who was apprehensive about hopping on a bike, I was made to feel at ease from the very beginning by Miss Trang. The food, my fellow travelers and the XO team made for a trip full of memories! Thank you to the entire XO team

A great experience! - We loved the Foodie tour. Great for our teenagers. Lots of delicious foods. Tour guides went above and beyond to make it enjoyable for all. Very safe and professional. Highly recommend!

Motorcycle tour of Ho Chi Minh - After convincing my elderly parents to take a motorcycle tour around Ho Chi Minh (children didn't need convincing), we embarked on a fantastic morning tour of the historical and relevant sites in HCM. Our hosts were amazing, adding some food and coffee stops along the way. This tour was the collective highlight of our stay. Motorcycles, the only way to explore with great guides.

Amazing tour - It was just a perfect trip, we learned many many things, the team was just incredible,
thank you for that,
The food was so good, and the tour was really well organized

A really interesting, thoughtful tour with great food and fabulous hosts. - This was a wonderful experience and lots of fun. The girls are marvelous, truly committed to making sure you have a good time. They really take good care of you. The food was excellent especially the last stop with all the seafood. Equally impressive was the personal insight into Vietnamese life and how it plays out for young women in particular. You also get a flavor of the different districts including the newer more affluent area which is the polar opposite of District 1.

Fantastic. Great food, such nice drivers... Do it!!! - A perfect evening foodie tour (10 participants). Several restaurant stops. Some sightseeing, eg a local market in Chinatown and very interesting background information. Food: Brilliant. (Ever grilled goat meat marinated in cola...?) No frogs, dogs, duck embryos or other screeching that other providers advertise.
The drivers are absolutely confident in the traffic chaos.
And on the occasion of my wife's birthday that day, there was even a serenade - and a cake. A very attentive group.
This tour is highly recommended. We will do it again anytime.
It couldn't be more professional. You never have the feeling of mass processing or bored routine, even though the tours take place daily.

Expanded and improved our Vietnamese cuisine and HCMC experience - From start to finish the girls from XO were a delight. We each had a personal driver who we quickly befriended and enjoyed spending a fun, entertaining and delicious 5 or so hours with. We enjoyed lots of dishes we hadn't tried before (& we enjoy lots of Vietnamese food) and even our slightly fussy teen enjoyed tasting everything on offer. The ride felt so safe in busy HCMC and we explored parts we never would have alone. It's an amazing experience and I just wish we'd done it sooner.

Adrenaline fuels gastronomy on 2 wheels - XO Foodie Tour Saigon - on the back of a scooter piloted by women guides in the traditional “Ao Dai” dress. If you have been in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC)/Saigon as a visitor, the idea of ​​riding on a scooter in the chaotic traffic would seem like a death wish or at least a decent chance of requiring a skin graft at some point. The scooter pilots of XO Tours Saigon are all highly skilled women who put you at ease with their ability to simultaneously weave through the flowing traffic and discuss the latest fashion or specialties of the multiple districts you experience on this tour. The history, food and life in Saigon seen through the eyes of young local women is fascinating, educational and delicious. One of the best tours, food or otherwise, I've ever experienced. Truc, our XO tour leader was knowledgeable, wise of group safety and a hoot to be with. Highly recommended and definitely a “must-do” for any visitor to Saigon!!

Fantastic experience - everyone should do it! - We were a family of 4 - 2 adults and 2 kids aged 12 and 15. This tour could not have been more fun. Our kids absolutely loved it! Giang Nguyen was our tour leader and from the outset the evening was set up to be safe and fun. The four lady drivers were delightful with excellent English and so good with the kids. We saw parts of Saigon we would never have seen and tasted good at restaurants we would never otherwise have experienced. So much food! So much fun! Thank you XO tours.

Great Experience on Motorcycle and Street Food - Our family of 3 (Me, Wife + 18 year old son) had a wonderful time with the XO Tour Motorcycle street food tour. We were brought to 3 "eating" stops and 2 "non-eating stops". The "Eating Stops" covered places which we would not have gone by ourselves. The first stop was a beef noodle shop (not pho but Bun Ba Hue). The second stop was a Market in Chinatown. The third was a BBQ stop where we even tried BBQ goat (which wasn't too gamey). The fourth stop was in District 7 (a very posh district). And finally Stop #5 was Seafood and Dessert. All the food were delicious.

The guides were all very professional and were taking care of us personally.

The motorcycle ride was also very safe. This was the first time my wife has rode on a motorbike and she thoroughly enjoyed it!

Excellent experience 😃 - Superb! Every part of our city tour was just wonderful, full of history shared by very knowledgeable guide Linh and fabulous riders Maya, Venessa and Han. Grateful for Han for taking extra care in ensuring safety of my 9year old daughter during the tour with heat, water, lollies and traffic😁. Thumps up to all of them and my fab rider Maya....we had a great experience.
Super safe with children of all age group and a must experience to tour the city with these wonderful women riders. 10/10 from us.
You go girls 👍

Amazing nighttime Foodie tour: incredible food, wonderful guides, and a fascinating peek into local culture - Amazing nighttime Foodie tour to get to see much of Ho Chi Minh City that you would never get to explore as a tourist and try delicious food that you would never have thought to order (and probably have never heard of before)! You’ll also get an interesting quick history lesson and facts about Vietnamese culture.

The experience of having the women drive us around on a motorbike to each stop was thrilling and so fun - a bit nerve-wracking a first but you get used to it very quickly and the guides as all very experienced drivers navigating the hectic traffic of the city. I felt very safe actually, as drivers in Ho Chi Minh City are very aware of their surroundings and conscious of other drivers.

We stopped at three local restaurants as well as a nighttime market where our guides pointed out all of the foods and items on sale - so much produce I have never seen before! The dishes that were ordered for us were all incredible!! Amazing soups and grilled meats and seafood. We loved everything we ate.

We also loved that the business is female-owned and operated. We were each assigned a guide as a driver, but they also were sort of our personal companion during the experience to ensure we were comfortable and having an enjoyable experience. The girls were so friendly and kind to us to explain more about the parts of the city we were driving around and about the culture of the city and of Vietnam in general, and to share about themselves and their life in Ho Chi Minh City. It was very cool to learn from the locals. Yao and Mai (I’m probably spelling these names wrong, sorry) were the guides for my husband and I and both were so wonderful!

We would highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

Thrill ride (with food!) in Ho Chi Minh - Our guides were wonderful and, on a scooter with a guide, we saw Ho Chi Minh City in a way that most tourists wouldn't be able to. The tour provides a food experience off the map and delicious. You see many different districts in Ho Chi Minh outside of the main Old French Quarter. The experience of being a part of the intricate street dance of the scooters in Ho Chi Minh was exhilarating. Our guides were engaging, highly educated and fluent in English.

Absolutely brilliant - Absolutely amazing trip. So well organised. Yummy food. Girls were so full of information and loved the evening like we did. They made our ten year old son so comfortable and he had a ball. Fully recommend this tour
XO Food Tour - I had the best time going around the city on the back of a scooter. The food and views were lovely but I particularly loved chatting with my guide/scooter driver. It was so fun!

Highlight of our stay in Saigon - This was hands-down the highlight of our stay in Saigon. We booked a private tour for 4 for an evening food tour and loved every minute of it. It was the first time on a scooter for many of us and the women made us all feel comfortable and safe on the motorbikes. Cam was our tour lead and her energy and passion was contagious!!

We loved trying local dishes that we wouldn't have otherwise tried or visited local spots we wouldn't have known about. A friend and I had food allergies, and the team were generous in accommodating to our needs-- in fact there was always too much food to try to consume. Definitely pace yourself. :)

Though the entire experience is owned and led by women and love that that men are also involved as allies. Each group has several men as 'bodyguards' who go ahead of each location to reserve tables, ensure there are parking for the tour's scooters, and even help the women tour guides fetch water, napkins, dishes, etc. At the end of each location, they prep the scooters for each tour guide and ensure that the street is safe for the entire group to get together to the next location. The coordination and logistics are seamless and you wouldn't notice it if you weren't looking for it.

We loved the food and overall experience, but what stood out to us was the passion, love, and energy of Saigon from each of our tour guides. We loved chatting with them, learning about their city and culture-- the food was great, but the personal connections, sharing stories, and laughter is what is the most memorable for us!

If you only book one tour in HCMC, this is it! - We were recommended XO Tours as a "must do" by our friends who had visited Ho Chi Minh City a few years ago.. and they were absolutely right! We were a little nervous as it was near the end of our trip to Vietnam and we had experienced the organized chaos that is their traffic, but we had not been so brave to go on a scooter/moped ourselves. Well we shouldn't have worried as the ladies of XO are absolute experts. Beyond their great driving skills they made sure we were comfortable and also that we had a great time! Our Russian & English drivers along with our host Hong were absolutely sensational. It was so much fun learning about their lives in Vietnam, the local culture and how Vietnam is changing. A special thanks to Nga who also accommodated me (with ease) as I'm larger than the average tourist at 6ft4 / 194cm!

All that without evening mentioning the amazing food and variety of places our guides took us to. It was a fantastic selection covering traditional food from the North to South Vietnam, away from the touristy center and they were even accommodated dietary restrictions. I must say the food we ate was easily some of the best of our whole trip. To break the evening up and give us time to digest there were some side trips and entertaining games which were really appreciated - and this comes from someone who doesn't always enjoy those kinds of things.

In short, if you are in Ho Chi Minh City just book this tour, or any of their tours, or all of their tours. I'm positive you won't find a better organized tour, so you won't be disappointed!

Great food tour with new friends - A fabulous evening that felt like you were out with new friends! We enjoyed our guides safe riding, the carefully selected food choices and a chance to experience more of Ho Chi Minh City than we otherwise would have found ourselves.

Best HCMC experience - What a fantastic experience
It's like two tours at once. My wife and I ate at places we wouldn't have gone on our own in districts other than touristy number one and we got to see sights we definitely wouldn't have seen. Let's not forget we were on the back of separate scooters driven by unbelievably experienced drivers. It's a must do in our opinion!

World Class Tour - I've been lucky enough to go on many tours in countries all around the world and this was one of the top two I've ever done. Very impressive and worth the price. They gave us a tour of 8 districts on the bikes so just a phenomenal view of Ho Chi Minh pointing out many sites, and information on each area. Each stop for food felt very authentic with many locals and not tourists. Food was delicious!! Each girl driver in our group was world class and tour leader impressive. Took all the photos for us and sent a catered drop box link later! Thank you!

Night Foodie Tour - The night foodie tour was amazing for our family of 5 as it gives a peak into the night life, food, local information from the girls and its fun being driven through the crazy traffic in HCM city! Our drivers were great, Vy, nock nock, Linda 4, and can't remember other names but would definitely recommend doing this tour. The meals were really interesting and tasty.

Would recommend this to everyone! - We booked this for our first night in Vietnam and have no regrets! I was nervous of being on the bikes but felt completely safe and had so much fun being able to explore the different districts. The girls were great hosts, made the group really fun and we tried amazing food. Would recommend this to everyone!

Most interesting tour in Saigon - XO tours was run by an amazing bunch of savvy young women. I cannot stress how different from the same old run of the mill tour this was. It was interesting, fun and safe for any woman solo traveler

Awesome fun food tour - This is an awesome tour. V the tour leader and all the girls were fantastic. It was fun and very informative. You try a lot of different delicious dishes and visit different districts on the back of the bikes.
Lauren my guide was fantastic, she did a great job. she was fun to be around and explained the food and areas we visited.
I highly recommend this tour when in Ho Ci Minh.

Super smiles and meals on wheels! - Our family, parents plus 2 teen boys took this tour on a recommendation from a friend and we are so glad we did.
Our guides (Spring, Ai, Anh and Thao) were amazing - safely scooting us around town in and out of the traffic to places we would never have found providing excellent information on the food, the city and their own lives and culture. They evidently enjoy their jobs - so welcoming and a great laugh.
The delicious sights were great and the food was throughout but it was the guides that made the trip so special - thank you for the wonderful memories!
Don't miss this while you're in Saigon!

Memorable, special, incredible - My young adult son and I participated in the “XO Saigon by Night tour”. It was, without exaggeration, one of the best things we did in the three weeks we spent in the delta. The scooter ride was exhilarating and we have memories and images that we will forever treasure. Our drivers were skilled at driving our tour of seven through hectic HCMC nighttime streets and we saw parts of Saigon we would never have seen without XO and our excellent guide Hong. Hong could not have been a better guide. She was informative, personable, charming, down to earth, and funny! Perhaps the best part was when she welcomed us into her former childhood neighborhood--and home!--where we met family members and got a close up and personal view of humble and close knit living in HCMC's 1968 era apartments. THANK YOU XO, scooter drivers, and, especially, Hong for an unbelievably wonderful experience.

Fun on Two wheels in Ho Chi Minh - The tour was brilliant lots of fun , very safe, took us too lots of areas we would not have ventured by ourselves , Nhu was very knowledgeable of the area , answered lots of questions , great English and she & Anna we lots of fun , would highly recommend to anyone wanting a bit out of the normal touristy stuff.. Thanks

A great mix of local food and culture - WOW! - What a great way to explore the city on the back of scooters. Our hosts and drivers were so friendly and very experienced at navigating the traffic. The food stops were off the beaten track and really authentic tastes of Vietnam. We really appreciate the insights into Vietnamese culture, and personal experiences shared by our drivers. Highly recommended!
Excellent - This tour got recommended to us from a friend and I have to say it was one of the best things we did in Saigon. Would recommend this tour as a must do for Saigon
Tasty tour! - Exciting way to taste many things and see different parts of Saigon, highly recommend! The guides are very knowledgeable and will take great care of you!

The best food tour in Saigon - This was the most amazing food tour. The young lady who was my guide handled my extra large frame with ease on her scooter. The food was second to none. All the young ladies involved made the night something to remember. Thank you

Amazing tour with great hosts and food - I did the Saigon by Night tour and it was absolutely amazing and well thought through. We went through different districts of Saigon, met some amazing people and had really great local food (not the usual Pho or Banh Mi).
Highlight of the tour was my excellent tour guide Huyen, she showed me around and had all the information to share about the places we visited.
Would definitely recommend this if you're looking for night in Saigon but can't do the foodie tour.

The XO Foodie tour - This company and this tour were amazing!! We have done a number of different types of tours of the years and this is one of the best tours we've ever done! I was a little hesitant at first, due to the craziness of the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City, but the ladies are amazing. My driver feels so safe. By the end I was having so much fun I didn't want the tour to end! As well as the fun on the scooter, the food on this tour was also delicious. This sightseeing was also great, as we got to see a lot more of the city than just District 1. We were traveling on our honeymoon and Nhu (our tour leader) also organized a special surprise for us! We absolutely loved this tour and if you are going to Ho Chi Minh City you have to do this tour!!!

The best way to see Saigon and eat amazing food - My friend recommended this tour to me... and I'm so glad she did! I'm not usually into a 'group tour' , but this was THE BEST way to try some great food and see around Saigon without any hassles. It was super fun to ride on the back of the scooters, our guides were SO lovely and spoke excellent English and gave us a bit more insight into life in Vietnam. And the food was AMAZING, really good way to try a range of different options - there was a severe food coma afterwards!

A wonderful experience! - My family has such an enjoyable and enriching time with the XO bike team led by Nhu (Lucy). The bike rides are so fun and we learn so much about Vietnam history from Nhu. The places they brought us to are interesting and some are not places that tourists know. Nhu and all the guides are very professional and attentive to our needs. We feel safe and well-taken care of throughout. We will highly recommend this bike tour.

The original Saigon foodie tour on bike - This tour offers a great balance of food tasting and sightseeing/cultural experience. The drivers are so skillful and make you feel safe the whole time. They picked amazing food spots and gave us insights about the life in Vietnam. Would recommend anyone who loves food and wants an authentic experience. 💯 (special thanks to my driver and guide Yuen aka Bee 🐝)

Book it! You will love it! - ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
This was one of our favorite things we booked on our Vietnam trip!
The ladies were polite, informative, friendly, and very safe riders.
The food was excellent!
The games we played were so fun!

And the tour leader emails you photos and videos of your night a few days later to you.

I would do this again plus any other tours XO has upon our return to Saigon

An amazing way to see different parts of HCM - There's so much to say about how wonderful the XO foodie tour. Each of the XO ladies were very accommodating, shared expert local knowledge, friendly and knew how to make each stop memorable. A great way to see the different districts of HCM. Please make sure you book with them, the original XO tours and not the copycats!

The Best Food Tour! - I have been on food tours in many countries around the world, but the XO Tour was the best one anywhere! The main tour guide, Ms. Giang, did a wonderful job of explaining about the food and also about Vietnamese culture. Since the tour is by motorbike, each guest is assigned a personal guide/driver. All of them seemed great, but mine was Ms. Hua, and she was fantastic! I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to have an awesome evening when visiting Saigon.

Must Try For First Timer ! 5 Stars Hospitality! - Had a great time with XO scooter. Particularly, Lin, Bee and Chau, who were hosting and riding us throughout the tour.
They were professional, friendly and very safe riders. They speak good English and interact very well with our family. They brought my child for BoBo ice cream when we were in D7 area. Highly recommended especially for first timers!

Highly recommend when arriving in Saigon for the first time. - We booked the Saigon by Night Tour on the day we flew in. We were pleasantly surprised to have just a private tour for the evening. Thao made us feel very comfortable and ran through an route of the evening ahead and a safety demonstration on the bikes (my girlfriend had never been on one before). We went to many places in Saigon we would never have gone to on our own, and tried some fantastic street food in District 5. Felt safe and well informed the entire evening, a real credit to Thao and the XO team! Thanks for a great evening!

Best food tour - This was such an unusual (in a fantastic way) food tour. You explore Aaigon by night (5 districts) with knowledgeable, friendly and very driven women.
The tour was more than the food which was phenomenal. It was a brief and frank exploration of Vietnamese society in Saigon. You learn about the joys and the hardships people like the tour guides live through.
We asked so many questions and learned so much from these ladies.
Also they take photos during the tour so you don't need to pull out your phone and send photos directly to your email and they don't spam you with photos of everyone else in the tour, they go through the trouble of selecting the photos relevant to you and your group. This was very thoughtful and genius!
If you're reading this and have not booked your trip, I recommend doing this tour in the middle or end of your trip because you won't be struggling with jet lag and travel fatigue. For us, it was our last day in Vietnam and we were fully adjusted and took every advantage of the food, the scooter ride and the tour leader's expertise and knowledge. We had a blast.

Saigon by Night - valuable and worth it - I’m so grateful that I attended the Saigon by Night experience with XO Tours. As an overseas Vietnamese, I’ve visited Saigon many times but never explored it through a tour. The XO team did a fantastic job to capture the spirit of the city - I learned so much and had heaps of fun.
The tour reflects the city - at first, things may not look so significant, but after a second look (and with some explanation from the tour team), you can really appreciate the history of the city and understand the people, how they live and how they are the beating heart of the place. Thanks to everyone from XO tours!

XO evening food tour - SUPERB!! - A truly amazing experience, which was perfectly organised and executed.
The food at each stop was outstanding and was in places you wouldn't really venture to. They also included a couple of stop offs to highlight interesting points around the city and let your food digest before going again.
The tour guides were so friendly and made the experience.
It was my first time on a motorcycle - but at no point was I worried - the traffic is crazy but the women are professionals and ride accordingly.
If you are even considering this tour, BOOK IT, you will have no regrets.

Excellent Informative Scooter tour - Linh and her colleague ‘V’ provided my husband and I with a wonderful informative scooter tour through Hồ Chi Minh City. Linh’s command of the English language was excellent and she had a great deal of knowledge about the history of the city while also adding a few personal insightful stories. Also surprisingly we felt very safe on the back of our Scooters in the crazy traffic.

BOOK IT and Have an unforgettable evening! - The evening was amazing! It is worth the time and cost. We loved the tour for the food but also all the districts and cultural/lifestyle information that was shared. It is MORE than JUST a food tour. After being in the city and eating a lot - the food was still amazing and much of which we had not had yet. The team was wonderful, and it was truly special to get to know them and hear their stories and viewpoints.

Fun and safe way to discover Saigon by bike - I can highly recommend the evening foodie tour with XO. It was a unique way to experience the city, learn about the culture and enjoy some delicious dishes. V was an amazing guide - really knowledgeable and a super driver. It was a fun and memorable evening.

a good ride with XO Tour - for the 2nd time I went on an XO Tour and again it was so much fun but also very informative. Those girls drive you cool and save through HCM city traffic, just relax and enjoy! Each stop os full of new facts about Vietnamese culture and history. On our food tour we tasted of course delicious local dishes, not just the wellknown stuff.
Highly recommended!

Lived up to our highest expectations - We had the best time on the night foodie tour. Zipping through the streets of HCMC, eating great food, chatting it up with fellow travelers - what more could you want out of an evening! Highly recommend!

XO Foodie tour - Loved this experience. It was very unique. The ladies were all very friendly, knowledgeable, and safe drivers. The food was so delicious. They gave good portions and allowed you to have more of you want. I booked the tour same day so that was very convenient. It is a great way to see and learn about the city. I will recommend this tour to anyone that visits the city

Highly recommended Saigon by night tour with XO Tours! - The Saigon by night tour was one of the best tours we have ever done! Truly local experience, with the most delicious Vietnamese street food, great insight into Vietnamese life and best of all such a funny and friendly evening with the ladies from XO Tours.
We had so much fun driving around Saigon with our two drivers & guides Nhu and Chau - they provided us with so much information and insights on Vietnamese life, while safely driving their scooters through the traffic of Saigon - a truly amazing experience! Thank you so much Chau and Nhu for this wonderful evening, we had a blast! Big thank you also to Tour Leader Thao who so kindly guided us through the evening and told us stories, gave us information and took us to places we would never have got to without her and her colleagues.
If you want to see the real Saigon, book your tour with XO Tours!

Amazing way to see Ho Chi Minh City and get to taste some local food. - Hong and Yen, our tour guides on our private XO foodie tour were amazing. We got to try some delicious food and see some great sites on the back of the scooter. We felt safe at all times and found it a lot of fun. Would recommend this as our top highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh if not for the whole of our Vietnam trip.

Highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh!!! A MUST DO! - This tour was one of the biggest highlights of our trip to Vietnam, and will be an experience we won’t forget in a hurry!!!

The amazing ladies than ran this tour completely and utterly made it! Myself and my partner did the tour together with a group of others that we hadn’t met before. We were each assigned a driver/personal assistant for the tour and myself and my partner were over the moon with our guides. They were both so professional with a genuine care for us the whole time, to make sure we were enjoying ourselves and felt safe on the motorbikes at every moment.

The tour consisted of a lot of knowledge sharing about history, and general facts, as well as of course, the information about the food we were eating at each stop, which was delicious!

The main tour guide was also phenomenal at keeping the enthusiasm for the tour on point the whole time, with a great sense of humour!

The tour also included a few really fun games which ended up being hilarious and a great way to get the whole group having a laugh and getting to know each other.

Outstanding service, we left the tour on a complete high and thankful that we’d done it!!

Overall this is a MUST do when visiting Ho Chi Minh and I will be recommending it to anyone who is thinking about visiting Vietnam!
A great night out. - The XO Foodie Tour is a definite must do when in Saigon.Thu,Van and Giang were great guides and have exceptional scooter skills.

A unique tour not to miss ! - We had a great time with the girls on this Night Tours. It was just amazing to be part of the traffic with them. Unique experience led by woman ! Each of them are really interested, they answer your questions, they have questions for you also, you end up the evening really feeling that you bonded with a new friend. I never felt insecure, they really are attentive, experienced and knowledgeable.

Bucket list experience. A must do!! - Outstanding and unique experience. We did the 3 hour night tour. Riding through the streets and laneways beyond the tourist district was an absolute thrill and super fun. Our teenage boys were absolutely delighted. We felt absolutely safe at all times and the tour guide girls were so informative and gracious. We were so grateful to have the privilege of visiting into a typical home of a Vietnamese family too. You simply must do this tour- you will not regret it.

XO Food Tours, accept no substitutes! - I would give more stars if I could. Vy and all of the girls were super fun and influential. They took us to 3 food stops, a trip to the market in Chinatown and an economics lesson in D7. The food stops were definitely local joints and delicious- everyone in our group had a different favorite dish. Everyone felt safe on the scooters and really, really enjoyed themselves. A true highlight of our entire trip.
Great Tour By Great Girls - The tour was nice and the girls were polite. It was fun and educational, learning about the backstory of things I will never realize.

Informative and very good fun! - We went on the morning city sights tour. As well as being a really good tour of Saigon, it was really good fun! The XO team are cheerful and very competent on the bikes with the passengers on the back. We felt safe and comfortable as we zipped around Saigon. All in all, a terrific experience and we felt we had seen the key sights of the city.

Memorable Rides - This tour is a MUST when you visit Ho Chi Minh City.

We did the 'XO Saigon by night' and 'XO Sights of Saigon'.

The girls were lovely and such a pleasure to be with as our riders.

Our tour guide (Linh and Hong) were both very well informative with the history or their city and country.

Food was delicious.

They all speak English very well.

We will definitely stay longer in Ho Chi Minh City next time we visit and hopefully hop on one of their other tours around Saigon.

Thank you for a memorable time and showing us your lovely city.

Wow, an incredible experience! - This is much more than a tour; it is a complete experience.

We did all three tours, and they are fantastic, each different in their own way, no real repeats, so I recommend doing all to get the food, sites and culture of HCMC.

The energy and enthusiasm from the drivers and the tour leaders were incredible.

On all three tours we chatted all the way!

The drivers are fluent in English and so knowledgeable on the sites.

The conversation along the way was wholesome, as much a highlight as any other part and felt genuine.

We saw so much of the city in 4 hours, it would have taken us 2 days to find all the locations, so this is ideal if you don't have much time.
We then tried foods we wouldn't have been confident in trying by ourselves.

This was the first tour after arriving, so was a bit nervy on the bike, but with a bit of instruction and 2 minutes later was fine, the girls could drive and soon i was enjoying slicing through the traffic, or as Linh says "Fill the gap" is the methodology for driving.

Ngoc was incredible on the Foodie, as was the tour leader*
Linh on the sites tour.
Thao on the cultural tour and Giang as leader.
*sorry i can't remember all the names

They introduced you to the others, so don't worry about doing it solo, you won't be alone for long.

Also a shout out to the MIB [men in black] who are ever present in supporting the tour, but silent and almost invisible. You barely notice your drink being refilled and they go ahead to set up, look behind the bikes and get them out when we move, but look for no attention at all. Great job.

Others may copy but this is the best.

5 stars only because i can't do 6 stars.

Great experience for an evening - Amazing tour to some of the districts, where you wouldn't end up on your own. I loved the food - it was all new to me but still easy to eat and delicious. Impressive for me was the part, where we visited a relative of one of the company's founders to see how the people actually live in that district. And last but not least I simply had a great time with my guide Vy!

Best way to see & experience local Saigon-the motorbike ride is a kick! - Ai, my motorbike driver & guide & Vy we're amazing. First their driving skills are excellent, they are very knowledgeable about HCM City/Saigon & passionate about their heritage & culture.

I did the Hidden Saigon tour & I highly recommend it if you want to immerse yourself into the local culture. The food we had was yummy, the experience was amazing & I couldn't ask for better tour guides & drivers!

Thank you Ai & Vy!!!

HCMC with a Local - There is no other better way to see Ho Chi Minh than on the back of a motorbike. My daughter and I had a blast seeing the city through a locals eyes. Death-Defying Fun and Good Food - Motorcycles and scooters are everywhere in Ho Chi Minh City. They carry anywhere from 1 to 5 passengers and/or a starting amount of cargo through traffic that is constant and chaotic. XO Tours gives you an opportunity to join in the fun, eat good and authentic food, and see sections of the city far from the usual tourist areas. The drivers and tour leaders are all women, and they will pick you up at your hotel. After issuing you a helmet and some brief instructions, you're off. I must admit, the first few minutes were harrowing. But after the initial shock, I was able to relax and trust my expert driver. There may not seem to be any rules in HCMC traffic, but there is a certain logic to it — and in the five days we spent there we never saw a single crash. There were three or four stops for food, with rides and some sightseeing (on foot) in between. They have a "no-limits" policy on food and drink — including beer — so you won't leave hungry or thirsty. The drivers and guides speak very good English and will engage you in conversation during the rides. Each of our party (of 3) received different interesting facts about the places were driven through and about life in the city. One tip: The guides will take several pictures of your party, but if you want any without the drivers you have to take them yourselves.

It felt safe despite traffic looking like chaos in order to drive through. We visited districts 5, 8, 7, 4 at minimum (there may be more that I missed). We had food stops that were interspersed with sites stops which were great to let us digest between eating. Other travelers we met along our Vietnam trip had told us to book XO Tours when we got to HCMC and I'm glad we listened to their advice!
