Would highly recommend if you're looking for a fun, informative street food experience. 😋

Simply the best tour - A highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. We did the Saigon by night Tour as a family of four. The girls on the motorbikes are amazing young women. They made the whole family feel welcomed and comfortable on the motorbikes. We loved everything that we saw. Even though it rained for the majority of our Tour itdidn’t take away from the experience at all. Highly recommended.

You Have to do This Tour! - We did the “Sights of Saigon” morning tour our first morning in Saigon, and it was the best thing we could have done.

We got to see the principal sights of District 1 with fun, informative guides, all from the back of an exhilarating scooter ride! Our guides were all wonderful: funny, kind and interesting. We had many stops along the way for light refreshments and going inside some of the locations. It’s a great way to decide which places you want to go back to later in your stay.

The drivers were all very safe, but they didn’t hang back either - you are right in the mix of the famous Saigon traffic. The ride is smooth enough that you can take pictures or videos as you go.

You absolutely won’t be sorry if you take one of their tours, and it will be one of the highlights of your trip.

Fun and educational introduction to Saigon and the experience of motor biking - Very fun tour with the nicest chauffeurs and staff. A good introduction to downtown and historical
Saigon. We had arrived late the night before and wanted to get a guided experience in the am, while trying to stay awake and reset our inner clocks.

A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!! - I feel that it's difficult to write reviews for experiences that are truly amazing and extraordinary! My wife and I had an absolutely amazing time zipping around Ho Chi Min on the back of motor scooters, and trying all types of Vietnamese dishes! Also enjoyable, and appreciated, was that they had us do some activities, like games, or walking in less-touristy places to help us walk off our previous meal before moving on to the next one! Our guides were very conversational both on and off the scooters, sharing useful information of the city, it's districts, food and culture. There's a reason this tour was recommended in the New York Times, so don't hesitate, you will not be disappointed!!

XO Tours - The absolute BEST thing to do in Saigon!!! - I spent 14 days in Vietnam (Hanoi, Hoi An, Saigon) in Sept2023 and out of everything I experienced, this was - by far - my absolute favourite thing to do. My group was expertly and passionately led by Uyen Nguyen and I was expertly and safely driven around by Bee (sorry did not catch her full name). I originally went on this XO Tour for the food experience, but the food (as amazing as it was) actually came second to hanging out with Uyen and her passionate team and actually experiencing Saigon as a "local". The Night "Food" tour was almost as much a history tour of Saigon and experiencing the city from the perspective of a local, as it was about the food. The adrenaline rush of zipping through Saigon traffic on the back of a scooter and seeing the city from a different perspective was amazing. All the girls on the Xo tour were warm, accommodating and an absolute blast to hang out with. This tour is one of the biggest reasons why I am already planning a return visit to Vietnam. Thank you Uyen, Bee and the team!!
Unforgettable - An amazing experience, professional from start to finish. I was travelling with my teenage son, it was a great evening spent doing something fun. Highly recommend.

A must do experience - Thank you to Hong & Cam for an absolutely brilliant tour. The food was amazing, the locations we would have never found ourselves and they added a lot of extra information about culture and the different districts. The scooters are very safe and it was a lot of fun being part of the Saigon traffic.
Thank you again and if we could give more than 5 stars we would.

An absolute MUST DO foodie tour. - If there had been 10 stars to rate we would have used all 10 of them for this experience. It has been a highlight tour of our 3 week holiday in Vietnam. Customer service and friendliness of our ‘girls’ was outstanding. (Thank you Van and Nhan!) Quality motorbikes to ride and support staff included on the night to go ahead and prepare for our next stop and to be on hand in case a motorbike needs attention. Delicious food and an exceptional tour leader- Vy!
Every aspect of this tour was well organised and implemented. We hope others will support this company with their endeavours to offer an exceptional and different concept for a foodie tour. Congratulations Team XO!! Rosemary and Paul.
The best Ho Chi Minh City food tour - Hong and her colleagues were knowledgable, friendly, great drivers and left us with an understating of HCMC em we couldn’t get anywhere else. Not to be missed.

A night out in Saigon - This was an absolutely fantastic experience. The girls were friendly, funny as well as being excellent riders.
Our massive thanks to the XO ladies.
Jason, June, Lachlan and Neave.

Really fun experience - Very interesting take on touring HCMC on a bike in the evening. Appropriate proportions of history, fun facts and great food mixed into a safe and relaxing bike ride. Probably the best way to experience the city if all you have is an evening or even more.

Best tour! Would highly recommend! - Hands down a brilliant experience for our family of 4!
The ladies were friendly, knowledgeable, excellent English… accommodating (with food & comfort zone with riding on the scooters & walking through the markets) for a Miss 13 & older teenage lad.
Absolutely brilliant! Thank you ladies!

Amazing authentic Saigon experience 🍜🛵 - Our XO foodie tour of Saigon was the highlight of our visit to the city. Our expert drivers were so friendly and we felt really safe in their hands (and on the back of their bikes!)

We visited places you simply could not get to without local knowledge and tasted food that we would’ve never have been able to order ourselves. It was an amazing, exhilarating experience and I would highly recommend it to anyone who is visiting the city.

Just make sure you don’t eat anything the day before you go to make sure you have room for all the fantastic food you’ll be eating!
Great Experience - The Experience was great. I definitely had a good time and The Food was great and amazing. I definitely appreciated, thanks again

Amazing experience - We had an absolute ball on our Night Tour on two wheels. Our two guides were fabulous , drove us around very safely in the crazy traffic, we saw a different side of Saigon visiting China Town markets and a local home, eating tasty street food with the locals. Thank you Thao and Le. We would definitely recommend this tour

Just fantastic - we opted for private tour as my wife won't get back on a motorbike so a car was organised for us we did have 2 guides a driver and also a security guy following us which was all round fantastic the tour gave us more then what we expected between the restaurants and sites they also showed us was fantastic and the team made us feel safe and informed

Amazing cultural experience - The ladies were simply delightful and full of knowledge and enthusiasm about their local Vietnamese culture. 30th wedding anniversary, high excitement night tour - Our guides, Yang and Truc (we are so sorry to get it wrong) They were wonderful and so friendly. We are in our 50s and felt very safe on our first time as a pillion passenger.
The variety of food was perfect. The sight seeing stops were informative with much laughter and also helpful cultural and economic history.
It was the perfect introduction to Saigon on our second night in the country.
We also received a bought of roses as it is our 30th wedding anniversary, which was above and beyond and made me cry!

Exciting, interesting & delicious! - We had a brilliant time! The ladies who drove us were fantastic, and it was really fun being on the back of the mopeds in the crazy traffic!

Would definitely recommend :)
Exceeded all expectations - Fantastic experience. Don’t hesitate, just do it. You won’t be disappointed. Thanks XO and your amazing team.

Amazing XO your motorcycle street food tour - Awesome experience, the girls were amazing, enviable motorcycle skills and of course the food was exceptional. We would recommend anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City to book a tour with XO tours.
Awesomeness - We had an awesome time on this tour. The foodie experience was incredible and delicious. The girls were so knowledgeable and fun to be with. Highly recommend you go on the tour.

The only way to see Ho Chi Minh City. - What better way to see Ho Chi Minh City than on the back of a motor scooter, the same way millions of Vietnamese do. Our lovely guides took us on a five stop tour of the city with a focus on local cuisine and the diversity of this bustling town. I felt safe from start to finish. These young ladies can negotiate the crazy traffic with ease. The food was sensational and we were treated like kings. Definitely a must do in Saigon.

Best food tour in the city - What an amazing night and food tour with XO. Had the opportunity to try so many different foods and in between these delicious bites got to learn about some of the different districts in Saigon. All the girls were very knowledgeable and funny and their English was perfect. They made sure we all had a wonderful time and left with very full stomachs. Highly recommend, definitely go on this tour!

Great way to see much more of Saigon! - What a fantastic way to see the city on the back of mopeds! So exciting and fun my kids absolutely loved this tour! Thank you so much to our fabulous guides, it was a highlight of our stay in Saigon.

Perfect trip at HCMC - We joined the day trip and the XO Foodie in night time.

XO tours are the best! - Wow! What an experience. If you’re reading this and thinking about taking a tour with XO…do it! The team are amazing and so friendly. XO night food tour - This was brilliant, such fun. I almost enjoyed zooming around Saigon on the back of the motorbike more than the food. Both were excellent. The tour guides are amazing young women who are informative and fun.

The food tour is the best and most authentic Saigon experience! A must do! - Tonight I had a totally awesome experience with the girls in XO tours for the food trip around Ho Chi Minh City. 5 hours on the back of a motorbike as the locals, visiting several districts for different kind of food experience and lots of sightseeing. So much fun! - If you are travelling to Saigon you should definitely book this in! A great experience. The food was amazing. Our drivers were safe, friendly and pointed out sights along the way. Would definitely do this again. Thank you!

A great introduction to Ho Chi Minh City! - This was quite a bit of fun! Highly recommended!

Memories to last a life time! - Our experience with XO tours was amazing. We went on the Ho Chin Minh sightseeing tour and the Foodie tour as soon as we arrived in the city. I fell in love with a very simple dish called ‘Morning Glory’ whilst hubby especially loved the seafood! There were only 6 of us on the tour and after playing silly games with the girls we all knew each other. The girls were amazing drivers and made us feel safe in the chaos of the streets. They even have a ‘body guard’ who follows the tour to make it easier for the girls to park their bikes etc etc.

Must Do - Literally the best thing to do in HCMC! I can't imagine having gone without doing this; My whole group had a blast and the food was incredible. XO girls Nailed it!! - We are well pampered on this tour as they help cooked / cracked the shells of the crab claws.
Love the itinerary as it is well thought out. From the humble markets to the upscale areas of Saigon.

10/10 will reccomend and I will return to explore the other tour packages!

One of the Best Experiences in Saigon. Must Try! - My wife and I took embarked on an XO Foodie Tour on the evening of 6 Sep and it was simply one of the best experiences we had in Saigon. XOXOXO to XO Tours - We loved this experience. Amazing thrilling exhilarating delicious informative. We did this on our first night in Saigon and it was a great way to explore this city. Our tour guides definitely made our tour extra special.

Best way to tour Saigon - It was great, no feeling of danger, very well organized and the girls driving the motorcycles were super nice and friendly.

A big thank you to my tour guides - Vy (V2) & Linh . You are the best!

Trip trough Saigon full of interesting impressions, yummy Vietnamese food and nice people - Dear Team XO-Tours, dear Nhu, thank you so much for the special evening in your city. Best thing to do in Saigon - I was in Saigon for 48hrs and this tour was by far the best thing I did. A must if you’re in Ho Chi Minh - One of the best tours I have been to! Was so much fun to ride on scooters and explore Ho Chi Minh city’s various districts. The food was amazing! Got to try many different Vietnamese dishes.

Great food experience with amazing drivers - This was an amazing experience, our guides were friendly, informative and went out of their way to make our experience perfect

The food was delicious and sitting and chatting with our drivers while eating made us feel more like locals and not tourists being shipped from place to place

I was only in Ho Chi Minh for 3 days, this tour took us all over the city and I saw much more than I would've if I had of just stuck to district 1 near the hotel

Must do in Ho Chi Minh City - Hubby and I booked the private tour had the most amazing time with our two tour guides Hong and Truc zipping around Ho Chi Minh City. Group tour also looked like it would be fun but was worth if for the private tour to get to know more about our guides one on one. Highly recommend!!!

Amazing and fun XO Saigon scooter tour - The views are very amazing and a lot of fun! I felt very safe on a scooter ride with the XO ladies in the sights of Saigon and the Saigon by Night, thanks to my prayers from the Mass and the Rosary. My lady rider tour guide in the sights of Saigon is Ms Hao, and in Saigon by night is Ms. Lam. The food that I taste is also amazing and great! XOXOXO! Ride safe always and best of luck!

Fabulous way to see and learn about HCMC - The highlight of our visit to HCMC! The drivers/guides were amazing at driving and conversation, we saw and learned a ton, and we had fun! Thanks so much for making the city and the history more accessible.

magic ride - There is no better way to see and enjoy Saigon. The best travel experience we have had in a long time. The guide team is fantastic, very friendly and they also drive very well! I recommend it to anyone who wants to do something outside from the common!
Wow - The best food tour ever!! I would definitely recommend it. They show you a different side of ho chi ming and feed you the most delicious dishes.

Vy2 and Yen were a delight! Thank you for allowing us to experience your city, culture and culinary delights. Recommended by colleagues in Melbourne.

Incredible experience and highly recommended - An incredible and super authentic experience. Completely recommended to see an authentic Vietnam and to really feel the city traffic. The girls are fantastic, super fun and you learn a lot with this tour. 10/10 completely safe and entertaining.

XO Foodie Tour! Highly recommended! - Amazing tour, the ladies are so attentive but don't be fooled, they ride a mean scooter and definitely know what they are doing. You get to learn about the history of Ho Chi Minh and try delicious Vietnamese food. Highly recommended!

A night to remember - This night was so enjoyable. They took us to alot of different places to eat that you wouldn't normally eat. A MUST DO - Lovely girls . Good value . Great foody experience but also saw a lot of different districts . Good knowledge & proud of what they do . Well done girls . Highly recommend .

Great scooter tour! - The ladies of the XO tours were great! The food was amazing too! Vy was our main guide and she was funny and entertaining. This is a fabulous tour and I highly recommend it! We all felt very safe and enjoyed seeing the city on scooter!

Best tour ever - Amazing night tour with Thao. Her knowledge of the city and ability to impart it was fantastic! Fab experience - Our guide Thao Truong and her team gave us a fun time driving through various districts and alleys to see the delights of Saigon. Thank so much - we enjoyed it and learnt lots. Highly recommend XO tours.

XO Foodie Tour - I took the XO “Foodie Tour" on Tuesday, August 15th, 2023. Wow.,,what a great experience. My driver/guide was timely, informative and most importantly a safe driver. The booking process was seamless and very efficient.

Excellent. Stop reading reviews, just book it. - This is a must do in Ho Chi Minh! Don’t miss out! This is a women-owned and run business. These ladies are so amazing and professional. Awesome experience - Really nice tour with friendly and knowledgeable guides. Perfect for a solo traveler or groups. Zip around the organized chaos of HCMC and eat to your heart's content. See the real city at a great pace.

The best tour in HCMC! - Excellent tour. it was the highlight of our stay in HCMC.

worht any dime!

Must book! best tour ever - The best tour I’ve ever been on. So fun and informative — not only was the food amazing, but all the guides were so sweet, personable and friendly. It was like chatting with a friend while learning a lot.

A tour for women, by women! - I wish I could give this a million stars. Every single thing about this core was amazing. The guides are super friendly and informative. Thrilling food tour - The food tour was an amazing experience!!

Amazing! - What an amazing experience. This is a must do while your in Ho Chi Minh! Our beautiful guides Hang and Giang were absolutely wonderful. We had great food and met gorgeous people from other countries.

A different way to sightsee - We decided to see Ho Chi Minh City a different way. We could have done the typical bus tour or the hop on hop off bus, but we decided to do it by motorcycle. We learnt more about the City history and life in the city than what we had researched on Google.

An amazing way to fully experience Saigon - We went on the "XO Foodie Tour." This was a great way to see Saigon away from the hustle and bustle of the city center, and experience Saigon's unique food culture first hand. I would highly recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting Saigon. Thanks again to the XO Tours team!

Fun, different experience - This was fun all around!

Staff is fantastic, the girls drive very well, even under the pouring rain. You get to see 5 different districts, all while having fun. The food is good and quite unique.

Amazing ride - Timely pick up at our hotel. Amazing experience. Wonderful guide and friendly lady bikers. Will definitely call on them again when in Ho Chih Min.

See Saigon sights from the back of a motorbike - the only way to see it! - We went round key sights in Saigon on the back of motorbikes with lady drivers and it was a great experience, plus we got to see a bunch of sights that we may not have visited otherwise, also learning about the history, especially the recent history, of the places. It can also be hard to find things that will appeal to teenagers these days but this was a big win! Many thanks to our drivers - Lin, My, Cam and Tan - who were brilliant, lots of fun and spoken superb English, making our whole morning on the bike a very memorable experience.

Best way to experience the city. - The tour was amazing from the moment it started. The pick up was on time right outside our accommodation. Linh our guide had lots to share with as we toured sites. It was obvious that both our guides are passionate about sharing their love for their city and country.
It was the best was to see the city, learn about its tumultuous history, experience being on the bike in such crazy traffic. At all times we felt safe while moving between sites.

A wonderful experience learning all about Saigon - A fantastic tour seeing the sights of Saigon. Our xo guides snd tour leader Linh were amazing. Best Saigon food and city tour !! 10/10 - Our tour was amazing, highly recommend it to anybody visiting HCMC!!

Perfect tour of Ho Chi Minh City by amazing guides - XOXOXOXO!!! - Amazing day and night tours. The guides Nhu and Duyen were such fun and informative. Sights of Saigon- brilliant - Riding around to the sights of

Awesome tour - The two girls Jen and Knock were both so friendly and kind

An absolute must in HCMC - the best cycle tour to go with! - This was an absolute highlight of our trip to Saigon. This all female tour group are just truly amazing. Must do tour! - Absolutely amazing experience riding around Saigon and stopping at sights, eating local food and seeing a snippet in to how some of the locals live. Both the girls were super informative and lovely and Thao our tour leader was amazing!

An amazing experience - The XO tour guides were so friendly and so much fun to be around. A highlight of my trip - Amazing experience and worth every penny. The Saigon Foodie tour is what every tourist is looking for: value, safety, and adventure. Our tour guide leader Vy, my personal guide Hang, and the rest of the girls (including the male security) did a wonderful job making us feel comfortable. They went above and beyond in making the food approachable and appealing (such as peeling the shrimp and crabs, grilling our protein, and peeling the fruit). I felt very safe on the scooters, as someone who is not used to it from a western country. This tour was a highlight of my trip, and left me seeking out similar experiences in other cities.

Best HCMC Activity - So much fun! Even in the rain! The girls were very knowledgeable & attentive & catered to our individual requests. Included lots of information about the city itself. Felt safe too

Highly recommend Sights of Saigon Tour for families - Highly recommend the Sights of Saigon tour. This was a great tour for our family. Fantastic!!! - Great tour, taking us to parts of Ho Chi Minh City that we wouldn’t have gone to. Are good we wouldn’t have tried and even provided a poncho when it rained.

The REAL way to see Saigon - Wow! What an amazing experience! This has been the highlight of our trip in Vietnam. Thank you so very much for this truly wonderful evening. Don’t miss this opportunity - For our last night in HCMC we did the cultural tour with Ngoc and Lam which was so much fun. Best food tour ever! - I booked the XO foodie tour months ago for my family (2 adults & 2 older teens), and it far far exceeded all expectations! XO Food Tour 5 Star! - What a great way to see parts of the city that don’t appear in any tourist brochure. A must do tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh City - What an amazing tour. Loved seeing Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a motorbike and tasting authentic Vietnamese food. What a great team of ladies. Very professional and friendly. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City💗

Great evening with these lovely ladies - We did the evening food/bike tour with XO Tours after reading all the great reviews. They were excellent. July Food Tour - An all round great experience. We were a family of six ranging from 10 - 50 years old and each and everyone one of us thoroughly enjoyed the food tour experience. A wide variety of different food was on offer, a lot which we hadn’t tried before in Vietnam. Based on the professionalism of this operator and the variety on offer, I would highly recommend and wouldn’t waste your time in trying to research any other tours.

PS. We’re a hard to please, we’ll travelled family, so we don’t give praise easily

Scooters, Food and Adventure - Being immersed in the flow of the city and seeing it from the perspective of a local is an unforgettable way to experience Hi Chi Minh City in an exhilarating, delicious and authentic way while supporting women in business. A cultural and gastronomic delight,!

Unforgettable experience - Absolutely unforgettable! We all loved it, from the 25 year old to the 50 year old. The motorbike drivers were very experienced and I felt 100% safe despite it being our first day in Vietnam and the amount of traffic being quite over-whelming. The history lesson was fascinating as well as the charming stops into the food market for ban mi and the other credible experience in the China town pagoda. We are going back to Ho Chi Min so we can do another tour.

One of the most unique tour - Highly recommended tour. We had an amazing guide with awesome drivers who also shared with us many local tips and knowledge during our rides. Best day ever! - We loved every minute of our XO Tour. The guides were so friendly and knowledgeable and took the time to put my daughter at ease when she was scared. Thank you XO
Fun and fascinating - We loved both the foodie tour and sights of Saigon tour. Very different tours but both great fun with very knowledgeable guides to destinations we would never have found.

Incredible tour, amazing way to see non touristy parts of Saigon! - We had a fantastic experience with our two lovely guides! The time flew by as we had so much fun but nothing felt rushed and despite being very full at the end there were good breaks in between to walk around markets and suburbs which was very well thought out. Couldn’t recommend this tour any more! Brilliant value for money given they had two staff person. Really friendly and made us feel safe on the bikes. Highly recommended! - My wife and I took both the XO Sights of Saigon Tour and the XO Foodie Tour. This is an experience not to be missed, and one of our favorite tours ever. This tour is a great way to get a feel for this amazing city. city. - Thank you Vy and your team for a special night. The tour gave me a true insight into life in Ho Chi Minh city. The variety of food we tried was delicious and a lot of fun.

Amazing Tour! - An amazing and authentic tour run by women who were so knowledgeable, friendly and fun. Definitely the highlight of our whole Vietnam trip, an experience that will not be forgotten!

Great night in Saigon - We had an awesome time on the Saigon by night tour. The guides were gorgeous and friendly and great with our 2 kids We loved going out to District 10 and visiting our guides Uncle and seeing how some Vietnamese live. The food was delicious.

highly recommended! - We had such a fun filled night doing the XO foodie tour, led by Vy and accompanied by Hoa, Duong and Van. One of the best tour - XO TOURS - One of the most unique and fun tour I have ever been to! Got to ride on a motorbike on the chaotic street of HCMC, visiting less touristy districts, trying many different Vietnamese foods and got to interact with the locals! ❤️

Thank you XOTour for this amazing foodie tour - ensuring our safety and making sure we are full at all times! Will definitely recommend everyone to join when you are in Ho Chi Minh City! Cant wait to be back and book another tour with you guys 🫰

BEST TOUR EVER! - Great Tour overall! All ladies super knowledgeable, friendly, funny & skilled - just outstanding!

Superb! Highly recommended - the staff made the real difference. Special shoutout to the best navigator and driver Ms. Lynh but also of course Tao, V and V-Hole! 😎

Highly recommended - We had the most amazing, special night food tour with XO tours. Our guides spoke English exceptionally well and showed us round the city with insight and intelligence. They catered for our every needs and made us feel safe. A highlight of a Saigon adventure.

Greatest Food Tour Ever! - The XO Foodie tour was the highlight of our time in Saigon. The guides were great fun, spoke perfect English and were great with our two children (10 and 12). We got to explore a number of districts outside the central tourist region which we would never have explored independently and try a range of great food. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

A fun and educational trip in Saigon - We took the Saigon by Night tour in february. Our drivers were very informative, and one of them also recommended a great place to eat near our hotel. We really enjoyed travelling on motorcycles in the traffic and alleys of Saigon.

The food on this tour was excellent. The guide that showed us around on location did a great job, and it was interesting to see how people live in District 10/11.

We also got the tour video, which was well cut together. If you go to Saigon, we would definitely recommend XO Tours. We certainly had a great time!

10/10 motor bike food tour - Had the best time on this tour! The ladies were incredible and so friendly! I would have never gone to many of these restaurants or districts if it weren’t for this tour. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone going to Ho Chi Minh who want to travel on motor bikes trying different restaurants and sight seeing!

Our Best Tour in all of Vietnam! - This is an amazing tour, great value for the price, and was our favorite tour in all of Vietnam!

We were at the end of a two week trip across Vietnam. We took numerous tours and culinary experiences during this time. Boking the XO tour was easy! We even had to change or date of the tour once and it was no problem for XO!

The food was amazing, motor scooter safety impeccable, but what really makes this tour great are the young ladies driving the scooters and hosting you! They were all amazing, friendly, spoke great English, and very knowledgeable!

We hope the owner knows what wonderful employees he/she has, and how they are the heart and soul of the tour. The girls made this the best tour we experienced in all of Vietnam!

Thank you Ladies of XO Tours!!!!

Must do experience in Ho Chi Minh City - I cannot say enough about this tour! We chose it for our first night in Saigon and it was a wonderful introduction to the city and its delicious food. The tour schedule is well thought out, the food was amazing, and the information provided was invaluable. I initially thought the price was a little high, but it was worth every single penny. This is a must do if you’re visiting!

A wonderful tour - A wonderful trip. They were able to easily accommodate our vegetarian needs without it feeling like weren't getting as much.
Gives a great sense of the city

An Unforgettable Tour in Ho Chi Minh - I went on XO Saigon by Night private tour in Ho Chi Minh with Nhu and Nam, and it was an unforgettable experiences of my life.

The tour guides were friendly, knowledgeable, excellent in English, and passionate about sharing their city's culture and history with me.

It was my first time travelling with motorbike, and they sure us felt safe and comfortable throughout the tour. We visited the suburb outside the CBD, visit the local residences, which was a great way to immerse myself in the local way of life.

One of the highlights of the tour was the food. Nhu took us to a local eateries, where I tried some of very delicious Vietnamese dishes, and i cannot find these in the CBD.

Overall, I highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience in Vietnam. Nhu and Nam were fantastic guides, and I couldn't have asked for a better way to explore Vietnam.

Thank you for a truly amazing tour!

BEST tour in Saigon - food and neighborhoods - This was one of THE best things we did in Vietnam. A friend who lives in Saigon recommended it to us and my husband and I did the private scooter tour from 6-10PM. The tour guides were fun, charming, super knowledgeable and we had a blast riding on the back of their scooters. We always felt safe and got so much information in these 4 hours. It was a great balance between food stops (the food was amazing) and also a few stops to just walk and talk and learn more about the culture and history of the city! I just wish we had taken our 8 years old as well. He would have loved it. We will highly recommend this to ANYONE coming to Saigon. Thank you Haum and V(2). xo B&B

If you want to experience a motorbike ride in Ho Chi Minh City, this is the way! - We took a Saigon by Night tour with Giang and Hûe and it was one of the coolest tours I have ever done. I really enjoyed the ride around the city. I’m not brave enough to drive a motorbike in Vietnam traffic and this tour was the perfect way to experience it up close and personal.
We had a great street food dinner in a district that we wouldn’t have ventured to on our own. I enjoyed the rice cake, I hadn’t tried it before. On this tour you also visit a local family (so be prepared to spend time on that and to take off your shoes.)
Giang and Hûe were fantastic guides and showed us such a good time. We like to support other women on our travels and this was a fantastic way to do it. I’m so glad that I came across this tour!

We did all 3 tours, Day Tour, Night Tour and Food Tour! - All 3 tours in within the first 2 days of being in Saigon!

What a way to see Saigon and with one of the best, "XO Tours".

We did the Food tour first which was fantastic, food was great and this tour gave us a great insight into some of the great food in Vietnam.

Second was the day tour, yet again another great tour but so different from the Food Tour as it focused on the history of Saigon. On this tour you get a number of insights into historical moments in Saigon's past. Even more memorable as June was the 60th Anniversary of the burning of Thích Quảng Đức. It was humbling to see the commemoration of the event.

The last tour was the night tour, and if you're wondering if it's a tour of the city lights then you will be disappointed. This tour takes you into the heart of Saigon and you get to see how the true locals live. There is also an opportunity to eat where the locals eat with some wonderful food being provided.

We cannot speak more highly of the 6 ladies that rode around with us on the back of their motorbikes, each one different but always great interaction, very knowledgeable and a huge smile. Would do all 3 tours again in a heart beat!

Excellent night! - This was an excellent tour! The girls were so friendly and knowledgeable and made a real effort to engage us all. It was so awesome to be part of the thousands of motorbikes driving around in the traffic at night. We enjoyed seeing the food and flower markets, learning about local family living and trying local food. We couldn’t recommend this tour more highly!

Absolute must do in Saigon - I can absolutely understand why this is ranked as one of the world's best food tours, it's a total must do. A fully female owned business, on the XO Foodie Tour we are taken around Saigon on scooters by friendly, knowledgeable local women who stay with you one on one throughout the experience, explaining not only the food we are eating but also a lot of local insights and history about the city. There was a LOT of food and so much variety throughout the five hours and scootering through the insanity of Saigon with expert riders wearing beautiful Ao Dai is a hoot!

Very nice tour! - Very interesting and fun tour! My guide (Linh) knew a lot of interesting things to tell about the city of Saigon. She spoke fluent English and it was great to discover the city on the back of her scooter. Highly recommended!

The best thing we did in Vietnam - I can't recommend this highly enough - the food was amazing, the sights were unforgettable and the concept is incredibly fun. But really the thing that elevated this experience above any of the other tourist events we've done was Hong and her team of scooter guides.
While travelling from one food site to another, you really get to know your rider on a personal level (by the time the trip was over I knew all about my guides family, her Dads concerns about her boyfriend, her great Grandma's experience in the war, her favourite movies, thoughts about the rest of the world - and she was equally curious about myself and New Zealand).
At each stop there's always something a little different (and I'm not just talking about the food) and I don't want to spoil the surprises but suffice to say, you will feel like you've seen Saigon from many different angles and will have your mind opened about the lives that the locals lead.
Hong is an absolute legend and I only wish the best for her and her team as she tenaciously pursues females empowerment in a country that hasn't fully embraced equality yet. She's a fierce, fun, intelligent business owner who may end up having a statue built of her around Saigon one day!

Wonderful evening exploring and eating! - Spent a great evening on a foodies Tour with the ladies from XO Tours. Highly recommended.

Each meal is beautifully described and makes it so interesting. The meals are nicely spaced out which gives each meal time to settle before moving onto the best meal. The ladies are safe and considerate drivers but i would appreciate a little less constant conversation whilst driving from one destination to the next. I really enjoyed driving through the different districts and the descriptions of each districts

Night bike tour Wow what a night . exceeded all expectations. The ladies were great drivers . We felt safe. 11/10 🤩 - Great fun. Felt very safe . ladies were very attentive, took us to great spots, food was awesome. A must to do - at night - cooler, and very pretty sites whilst riding through the breeze on the bikes . Went to a few districts seeing the true city from all aspects . Highly recommended.

XO tours with 2 top chicks - Giang & Thanh we’re the most pleasurable young ladies that took us on our tour. They went above and beyond and gave us an insight of their culture, as well as asking us about ours. We truly had an amazing experience. Do yourselves a favour and go on the night foodie tour and be prepared to eat the most delicious flavoursome food and be educated on Ho Chi Minh City and much more. Thankyou ladies. Jim & Ily - Australia

A must do in Ho Chi Minh city - A great night out, much more than just the food. Got picked up on time by the girls. Their English was excellent and they presented themselves beautifully. Very professional throughout the evening. Whilst our night out had heavy rain, the girls had quality ponchos for us that kept us dry. The rain did not spoil our fun. We felt completely safe and in good hands on the back of the motorbikes.

The food throughout the tour was delicious, the company of the other guests and our hosts was equally as good.

One of the features of the tour was venturing out of District 1, and seeing and learning about Ho Chi Minh city.

A night my wife and I will never forget.

I will most definitely recommend you to friends and family.

Thank you,
Warwick and Petrina

Many MANY Tastings! - Gotta say that doing this on a bike was daunting. My bike driver was amazing! At no time was I worried. Visiting different places to eat different styles of foods from Vietnam was awesome. I certainly wouldn't have found most of the stops by myself. Talking to our guides about their lives in V. also made the night more interesting. Come VERY hungry for this tour!

Booked for the food, LOVED it for the experience. Best tour ever - One of the best tours i've ever been on - and i'm not saying this lightly. The best food tour! - What a great food tour! Our guides/drivers were fun, enthusiastic and engaging. Amazing experience - essential in HCMC - An amazing experience - and a must do in Ho Chi Minh City. One of the best experiences we've ever had - This entire experience was exceptional. From booking to delivering our tour video. The best food tour in Ho Chi Minh! - We loved our evening street food tour with the girls around the city. Incredible! - XO Saigon by Night Tour is fantastic. The ladies are brilliant and look after you extremely well. The hustle and bustle of main roads to back street alleyways. Delicious and FUN taste of SAIGON - My wife and I took the XO Foodie Tour in April and it was fantastic. Our motorbike drivers, Chen & Laura, met us at our hotel as scheduled. They led us through the well-known (Pho), the lesser known (table top barbecued goat, and the more unusual (balut or duck eggs) parts of Vietnamese culinary traditions. And each stop was delicious. Fun tour of Saigon on a motorbike! - We took the XO Sights of Saigon Tour in April of this year. What a terrific tour for us on our first day in Saigon. Best tour in Ho chi Minh City - 100% would recommend to anyone visiting!!! - Honestly one of the best toure we‘ve done so far. Would 100% recommend this tour. Very well organized. Totally worth, best experience in Ssaigon! - Amazing experience, got to visit different parts of Saigon that I would never have visited by myself (including local apartment) and try some local food. Must Do Tour - We did this tour April 23. Having done it a few years ago I knew what to expect, but it still excited and thrilled. The highlight of my Vietnam trip! - I don't frequently leave reviews, but these ladies deserve it. I didn't know much about this food tour before going on it - I just thought it'd be a fun and simple tour where we sampled food and a guide would talk about it. We got so much more and it exceeded my expectations.

I was staying in a different district than the other people in my party and the guides can only pick up in certain ones, so I took a Grab to the other district to meet up. The 4 guides came on time at 5:15 pm, introduced themselves very politely, and covered motorbike riding safety for those who had never ridden one before, which was very reassuring for a first-time rider like me. In many ways, I feel the way they drive and ride motorbikes in the city is safer than places with strict traffic laws because all the drivers are forced to pay attention to one another at all times - I didn't feel unsafe riding on the back of the bike at all.

We hopped on the bike and off we went! It was an exhilarating ride to the first stop to meet the other participants and guides in our tour group and eat Bún bò Huế, which was even more delicious with the lime and chili I added. At the restaurant, the head guide introduced everyone, including the guests (very impressive since we probably had about 15-17 people), and explained that 1) we could eat as much as we wanted on the tour to feel satisfied and 2) there were safety measures in place like bodyguards to prevent strangers from coming up to our tables. This put to rest any concerns about feeling hungry after the tour or about getting our stuff stolen/interacting with people soliciting things. She explained that there would be 5 stops total: 3 food stops with 2 stops in between for sightseeing/information (and pauses to digest).

We stopped by the city's Chinatown to stroll along the night market where vendors were selling meat and fresh produce. Our 2nd food stop was for marinated grilled goat meat and garlic sauteed morning glory, both of which were delicious. We also got to try starfruit and water apple, which are tart and great with salt. Do note that at this location, the toilet in the women's bathroom was not the cleanest and the flush was broken, so you had to squat and then flush by filling a bucket of water and pouring it in the bowl a couple times. This method is common in certain cultures, so I was not surprised, but just warning foreigners who aren't used to it. We played 3 fun games as a group and got super loud with it screaming and laughing! I'm sure we got stares from the other patrons, but I think they also enjoyed watching the fun.

Our 4th stop, we entered the quiet, but swanky District 7 to learn about the economic disparities between the Vietnamese wealthy and poor + digest. I know the tone change at this stop wasn't the favorite of some people in our party since it was quite educational, and at times personal when getting into the struggles of our guides and the working class Vietnamese people, but I really enjoyed being informed because I expect tours to be truthful and authentic - not all fun and games. I don't want to be ignorant of the places I visit - my family country is also ridden with poverty and strife and pretending like it doesn't to foreigners who only want to see the world with rose-colored glasses, would be a disservice.

Our 5th stop, we congregated to eat in-shell scallops, some rice paper + meat rolls, and sweet, milky tofu for dessert (which was my favorite).

Water, tea, soda, and beer were available as beverages. The guides were all very amiable and chatted with us the whole way during the rides + accompanied our sides whenever we ate to help prepare our food and give food facts. My guide, Bee, matched my energy perfectly and I had fun getting to know her, sharing jokes, and singing pop songs on the bike; she definitely deserved her tip! They dropped us off at our pickup point around 9:15 pm, so around 4 hours for the activity total, but it was super fun way to spend half the day.

Highly recommended! - We had a fantastic time on our evening food tour - it was lovely chatting to our guides, they were very friendly and welcoming, and they were excellent drivers so we felt very safe with them even in the crazy traffic. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this tour, even if you're like us and normally do your own thing rather than going on tours - it gave us experiences we could have never got on our own, and it was well worth the money.

Excellent Tour Guides and a Wonderful Time - I did both the Sights of Saigon day tour and the XO Foodie tour at night. Pickup was on time for both tours. The tour guides were knowledgeable and friendly. The XO Foodie tour was amazing and the pacing was good, with breaks to allow you to digest. They fed us far more than we could easily eat - a large variety of foods as well.

The drivers are safe and both tours were outstanding - don't hesitate to book.

Saigon by Night - a highlight of our Vietnam trip. - Just wow. The Saigon by Night tour was an absolute highlight of our Vietnam trip.
