We learnt so much about the city, ate some fantastic food and saw sites we never would have. Amazing, definitely recommend XO Tours, could not fault a thing!

More than the food - Loved the concept of this business. The girls collected myself and my husband from our hotel and the group of nine guests met at the first restaurant. The girls were exceptionally good hosts. So fun and friendly, excellent drivers and they provided a window into Vietnamese lives by sharing their stories. A special thank you to our drivers Hang and Liang. We chatted and laughed as we rode the streets on our way to locations and restaurants.
Thao, our guide walked us through the different foods, she talked about the history of different districts and the current economic challenges for people in Saigon today. Very intelligent and lovely woman. Being on the back of bikes was fun and really gave us a different perspective to walking or driving. Strong recommendation and great way to explore Saigon beyond District 1.

Great insight into Ho Chi Minh not just about food. - We chose the evening Saigon Food tour and could not have been happier it was exactly what we wanted and it exceeded our expectations. Our guides Vy(3) 😉 Nhu and Vu were friendly, attentive, professional and helpful. My wife was a nervous pillion and they were very accommodating.
The format is great, 3 generous food stops and 2 fascinating sightseeing stops. They are constantly surprising by introducing Vietnamese food dishes that are delicious, very good quality but not the mainstream or what we had tried before.
The 2 stops were also not the usual tourist fare, so not likely to overlap with with other plans, whilst, with the guides offering insight very interesting.
The scooters are a great way to get around and are an important part of the experience as is the unique business model.
Highly recommended.

The best tour you can do in Saigon (maybe even Vietnam) - This was the best thing I have ever done in Vietnam! The tour guide Nhu was so lovely and my drive Anh was so informative. I would 100% recommend, it gives you a new understanding of Saigon and where to go

Must do for first time visitors! - Fiona and I had the best time on this tour! Every moment during the tour was amazing. The feeling of riding passenger in a scooter through the bustling streets of Ho Chi Minh is very memorable!

We booked the foodie tour and the food were amazing and unique! The XO team were very friendly and also provided great service for us! Even small things such as helping us with utensils added to the experience!

We also learnt alot about Ho Chi Minh and each of the unique characteristics of the districts!

We definitely recommend this for first time visitors and will sure book again on our next visit!

Thank you Uyen and my driver Trang for the amazing night!

XO Food Tour - XO was a spectacular way to eat our way through Saigon! My tour guide Yu went above and beyond at each stop. The entire staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the entire evening so much fun. The entire staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the entire evening. So much fun. This is a must do if you were visiting Vietnam.

Xo tours rule the night in Saigon! - Awesome to ride in Saigon traffic with locals! Our guides were really good at making us feel safe, informed and involved as we went through the crazy night traffic in Saigon city.

Night food tour . - We did the Night food tour on motor bikes and our drivers , Nhu and Cately made the night even better than it was . The bikes were modern and safe , the girls were competent and safe , the food was plentiful and delicious and the side tours to other parts of Saigon were interesting. Just before our last stop we’re had a heavy thunderstorm (very heavy) and despite the rain our ponchos kept everyone (almost) dry although at no stage were you cold , just wet. They handled the storm with confidence and professionalism and the whole thing added to the fun of the night . Highly recommend this tour and this company.

Great experience, worth it price - '- delicous food
- felt save while driving threw the chaotic trafic with the scooter
- very friendly and nice drivers/guides
- interesting information about the city and the people
Highly recommend! - Saigon by night was an Incredible experience. I would never have seen those parts of the city or found those delicious street snacks without the XO crew. highly recommend!!
Like riding through history. - Great tour around Saigon. The tour guide and driver were very knowledgeable about the city and its famous historic landmarks.

A great tour experience where we experienced different types of Vietnamese food in a safe and clean environment. - Well what can I say except this was an exceptional experience with Uyen as our guide and Jao as one of our drivers. The professionalism of everyone involved from XO Tours made us feel safe and welcomed. The food was great, the riding outstanding and the information supplied informative. A great time and highly recommended. Great to see different districts in Saigon.

Fantastic foodie tour! - Fantastic experience! Our family really enjoyed the foodie tour. The food was amazing, the girls have the best sense of humour and know so much about Vietnamese food and traditions. Highly recommended.

Best highlight of our whole trip - We were recommended the XO Foodie tour by a friend and although we were a little anxious about being on the back of a bike in the chaos that is the traffic in Ho Chi Minh, it ended up being the best experience of our 15-day Vietnam holiday. It was so much fun and shows you Ho Chi Minh from a local's perspective, which we simply wouldn't have experienced on our own. The food was awesome, I'm not a big seafood eater and at every stop different dishes were sent my way, and I strongly advise skipping lunch cause there's so much to try (p.s the seafood was fantastic according to the wife). The guides were super friendly, very informative and awesome riders. The whole tour felt super safe, and we would 1000% do it again in a heartbeat.

Excellent foodie tour - Brilliant experience. Great to try different local food with very knowledgeable guides.
Would definitely recommend going on this as an introduction to Saigon.

Everything was incredible - don't miss out on this! - Don't miss out on this tour! Better than all the rest. Start with an empty stomach - this food tour is just perfect from start to finish. We had the opportunity to share tons of great conversation with our drivers, both named Tu (spelling?), and felt like we got to know them and the city so much better than we ever would have without their generous sharing. They were so kind and careful to be sure we were having a great time. The motorbike rides alone were so fun - getting to see districts of HCMC that might've taken us months to get to if we were alone - skip the tour van and do this. Hong Tong, our tour leader, was super informative, telling us not only about the incredible food we were eating but also the history, context, and current changes happening in HCMC. And the food! It was some of the best seafood ever - my favorites were the blue crabs and the scallops; my partner's was the bun bo hue - but all was just incredible. Many thanks to XO Tours, Tu, Tu, and Hong for really being the highlight of our visit.

Can’t miss experience! - This was one of my favorite experiences in Vietnam. Our guides were fun, funny, knowledgeable, helpful, and just so good at catering a fun night out. The riding felt safe. The places we went were interesting and the food was delicious! I would say this a can’t miss if you’re visiting Saigon. Put on a helmet and go have a great night out!

FABULOUS FUN - We were escorted by the most delightful ladies. The tour was so much fun (even for 55-60 year olds) The sights, the food on point. Our evening was absolutely crazy (due to hectic rain just before our last stop) but they were as prepared as could be. This is a must do if you’re visiting Ho Chi Min. Thanks XO tours 💙

Fabulous time for both me and my 7yr old daughter! - We loved XO tours so much! We felt very safe (30yr female and 7yr female) the whole time, they really took care of us both. We learned a lot and loved every minute. Highly recommend!

Must do in Saigon!!! - An excellent way to discover more of Saigon and learn about the local culture and way of life! Food was delicious, drivers and tour guide were so knowledgeable and friendly and every effort was made to ensure we were having a good time. I would do this tour again and recommend it to anyone!

Amazing experience - Amazing experience! We did the cultural tour of Ho Chi Minh (which also included a fabulous dinner) and was a definite highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The fabulous girls had me at ease on the back of the scooter (I just never looked to the side and only focussed straight ahead!!). They confidently took us through peak hour traffic and up and around alley ways to see parts of Saigon that the average tourist would never get to see. Thoroughly recommend - the young women were absolutely delightful!

Best Food Tour Ever - I have been on food tours around the globe and must say XO Foodie Tour of Saigon is the best one yet!

5 excellent food stops off the beaten path and the tour leader and drivers kept us all entertained with games and interesting details about Vietnamese life. My driver Song was amazing-funny, friendly, and very engaging! Plus, who can beat flying around Saigon on the back of a scooter?

Highly, highly recommended!!

Scott N, Toronto Canada

Must do when in HCMC - I did Xo Foodie private tour. Amazing tour on scooters with my kids 10 and 13. I booked private tour and waa absolutely worth it..you feel like VIP, girls took care of my kids and helped with crossing street etc. Great conversation also. Although i felt unsure about safety, girls drive really good and traffic is somehow logical and slow, so i felt reassured pretty quickly. It is experience not to be missed and XO tours definetely know what they are doing and are very professional. And yes..food is amazing and places very nice and local. You learn a lot about city, see parts you would otherwise not visit Well done!

Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh - We did the XO foodie tour which was an amazing way to explore the city (getting away from the tourist areas) and taste delicious food! The tour was well organised, and the guides were knowledgeable and great fun! By far the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh.

Great Day with XO Tours in HCM - This tour was one of the best things we’ve done in Vietnam. Really safe and friendly riders and a very fact finding tour where we visited several none touristy sites. I would highly recommend this tour. Special thanks to our awesome riders Hoang, Vy5 and Linh3… you were fabulous and made it a great day.

XO Food Tour - I highly recommend this food tour if visiting Ho Chi Minh City. This was an amazing way to see all the different districts by back of bike and the amazing foods the City has to offer. Shout out to V! She was very informative and had some wonderful stories between stops.

Awesome time - We did the sights of Saigon tour in the morning and it was well worth it!! Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about the city and the girls were not only great drivers but also had great personalities which made it a lot of fun. The snacks and refreshments timing was perfect and they took photos of us throughout the tour and sent them after which was awsome. I would recommend this tour as you get a lot of information from touring with these local experts that you wouldn’t know otherwise.

Unforgettable experience! - We had an amazing time! The girls were so friendly and knowledgeable. We had some dietary restrictions and every single one of them was accommodated. Our leader Hang was very friendly and made us feel comfortable immediately. The food was amazing! I would never have looked at a menu and chosen what they offered us but it was all incredible. I cannot recommend XO tours enough. It was an unforgettable experience.

A must do in HCM City - My wife and I booked this tour going by all the reviews we'd read and we certainly weren't disappointed. It was very well organized. The ladies were very knowledgeable, caring and engaging. The food experience was excellent. Highly recommended!

The best experience tasting great food but also having so much fun. Such a great experience that is a mush for all . - A must do tour to see and eat your way around Saigon. Myself, my mate and his 21 year old son did the Foodie night tour. It's 5hrs of unlimited food and alcohol but is so much more than a food tour. We were in a group of about 16 and was such a fun experience as there are 16 tour guides not including support staff and the amazing tour host Hong who was informative, funny and just a joy follow around the sites. Hong also told us all about Vietnamese Culture and also commerce including barriers and benefits to living and investing in Vietnam. It was such a holistic tour that included great food. Their moto was than if you are still hungry or thirsty at the end please speak up and they will order more food. We were so full. They also surprised my mates son with a 21st Birthday cake and everyone sung to him. It was so much fun. I can't recommend an XO tour highly enough.
Terrific experience - What a delight! This tour has it all. Engaging, enthusiastic and knowledgeable guides, Adrenalin rush on motorbikes and delicious food. And see life beyond district one.

Amazing tour! - This was the highlight of my trip! My first time on a motorbike but my guide made me feel so comfortable and safe. We experienced a range of food and it was amazing to see so many different areas of the city. It was a personalised experience, with your guide being on hand for the whole night to answer any questions. Can’t recommend this enough!

Amazing night in Saigon - Our family (2 adults and a teenager) took the XO Saigon by Night tour and had an amazing time. Communication from booking through to pick up was exceptional - clear, responsive and with all the information you need.

All three of the girls spoke fantastic English and much to our surprise there's alot of opportunity to have a chat on the back of the bike while weaving through the traffic. We all had interesting conversations along the way where we could understand more about vietnamese life and share personal interests and backgrounds with the girls.  Despite that I'm a bit of a scardy cat the traffic isn't as scary as it looks for anyone who's a bit hesitant.

The tour takes you through a maze of little back alleys and markets that a visitor would never get to by themselves plus a local home. At no point was there the common "come into this shop and get souveneirs" stop which is really refreshing. 
The dinner is a lovely selection of food in an eatery on the street with lots of locals and later on dessert was at a different spot. XO have a support person at each stop to help the girls stow the bikes away, take photos and organise food. Effectively each booking gets treated as it's own group so while we saw others on XO tours at a couple of points each group did it's own thing.

At the end of the tour we received an itty bitty little phrase and tips book which has some great info in it. I'd also looked at the XO website which has some really good info that's far more location specific than the general generic information on most travel sites.
After travelling in a number of different places in both Europe and Asia this would have to be the best tour I've ever gone on.  Thanks so much to Nhu, Lam and Vi for a fantastic night (and apologies for probably spelling your names incorrectly). Angela, Zane and Caleb

Can’t miss tour in Ho Chi Minh - The XO foodie tour by night was the most fun we had during our stay in Ho Chi Minh. It was quite the experience to be part of the scooter traffic and see so many parts of the city! We were a little hesitant to put our 9 year old son on the back of a scooter, but after a few minutes our fears all disappeared. Our drivers/guides were all so caring, fun and professional! They really made us feel safe and went to great lengths to make sure our son had just as much fun as the adults. They got him involved in the games, tried to find foods he would like and even took him to race cars! There was more food then we could eat and each stop had a fun activity planned that really made the evening that much more enjoyable. This tour exceeded all our expectations and shouldn’t be missed!

Vietnam Food Tour - This tour was beyond amazing. The guides were knowledgeable and the tour was off the beaten path and took us to the non touristy destinations. The food was delicious and the guides informed us of what we were eating and how to combine the ingredients for the best bite possible. I wouldn't hesitate to book this tour again! The ladies did a great job navigating through traffic. I was a little concerned since traffic was so heavy BUT these women did an outstanding job and I was very comfortable on the back of the scooter after a few minutes!

The best team and leader ! - Amazing ! Thoughtful, fun, delicious, very informative and definitely above average on all levels ! I would recommend it to all my friends of all ages and food interests. A must !
Must do in HCM - A must do when you're in HCM. Very enjoyable and a great way to see and learn about the city. We did the city tour and much preferred it to a foodie one. Would go again.

Hands Down the Most Fun in Saigon! - The greatest experience of our entire trip! Riding the scooters was a blast (even though I was terrified beforehand) the ladies are so much fun, great to talk to and we learned so much about the different areas of Saigon. The food was terrific and not the usual tourist fare.

Great way to see and taste Saigon - It was a great experience. They picked us up on time at the hotel and we got to try a lot of different dishes. BBQ with goat was great. We also got more seafood than we could eat. My wife don’t eat shellfish but they had prepared really good alternatives, and enough for the rest of the table to try as well. We got to see different parts of town and the guides were happy to tell us about it as well as ask questions about where we are from.

I would definitely recommend it for anyone that would like to try some other foods than just Bahn mí and spring rolls.

AN ABSOLUTE MUST IN SAIGON! - This was the absolute highlight of our trip! The girls were so fun and informative. We went to five different districts and three different restaurants on our Foodie Tour. We loved that we were not at the usual tourist places, eating the usual tourist food. GO!!

An amazing night with lovely people and interesting food. - Meeting the people who showed use their amazing city
Fantastic food. So much history was explained.
We got to see different parts of the city.
Amazing experience - A great experience. My son and I found it very informative and the food was amazing! Our guides were friendly and knowledgeable.

Fabulous evening, well organised! - Fabulous evening on our foodies tour in Saigon. Girls looked after us very well and a great selection of food to try. Loved the market visit too. Sorry can’t recommend the duck embryo, the little bit I tasted was ok but the thought not so good!

A must do ! A highlight of our trip! - The girls were brilliant- good fun, knowledgeable and we felt very safe riding pillion.
As non meat eaters we were catered for exceptionally well and couldn’t eat all the food put in front of us!
We saw quite a few sights in areas we would never have visited and once we got used to being in rush hour traffic it was exhilarating!

Awesome Foodie experience - An awesome experience made so easy by the fantastic crew at XO tours. I was apprehensive about riding on the back of a motorbike through the busy city streets, however was completely at ease almost immediately and found it liberating. Food and guides were great. Highly Recommend to anyone looking for a Foodie adventure.

Excellent value for money tour - Fantastic guides who were incredibly friendly and knowledgable. The tour was value for money and the places we visited were great. It was the best tour we did in Vietnam

Put it on your Must Do list - My friend and I did the XO foodie tour last week. If you've never been to Ho Chi Minh city before, this is a must do! The food was excellent. It's much more than a food tour though. Our XO guides scootered us through at least five different districts of the city, exposing us to much more than the District 1 impression of the city that most first time tourists probably get.
Our drivers/guides Uyen and Truc spoke excellent English and gave us a personal tour as we moved between our eating. All the drivers/guides are extremely engaging and make you feel very welcome. I had never ridden on a scooter before and was holding on to the seat with both hands to start. By the end, Uyen had me relaxed enough to go no hands!
Traveling HCMC by scooter really gets you into the vibe of the city. A testament to how successful the tour was is that my friend and I went back to District 4 on our own the night after for supper!
I can't reiterate enough how great this tour is, especially for anyone unfamiliar with HCMC!! Thanks to all of the ladies for a great experience!

What an excellent experience - Our guides led by Thao were excellent. They took our safety very seriously and were very knowledgeable and good fun. What a wonderful way to explore HCM and sample the local dishes and learn more about the area. Would definitely recommend this company.

Saigon trafic and way of living from inside, together with delicious street food - Excellent starting point after landing in HCMC, as you

- are picked up and welcomed by an enthusiastic local guide who is knowledgeable and communicates just perfectly.

- get to experience what navigating the trafic on a bike is like - it feels really safe and it's great to see such an "organised chaos" from the inside.

- get to see first hand what living is Saigon actually is - visiting an actual home was just mind blowing.

- share a local meal with the guide, with explanations about what you are having and how to eat it - even though I didn't choose the food tour, I got more than enough food for a proper dinner, including dessert. By the way, I was the only tourist in the street food place, the food was delicious and it did sit perfectly well with me.

Overall, it is a great experience and I'd highly recommend it for solo travellers. Thanks Thao for being such an amazing host.

Saigon Must-Do - We did an evening food tour with two of our friends. It was the BEST evening. Would do this tour over and over again. Absolute must-do for those visiting Saigon and looking for a great way to see the city, learn about the local culture, and enjoy great food.

Awesome evening for the family - Amazingly friendly, helpful guides who had great English and a real enthusiasm for what they are doing. Very informative, lots to see and great activity with kids as well. We felt safe the whole time and got to try some great food. Our guides helped us a lot with other plans for our visit to Ho Chi Minh as well. Highly recommended.

Amazing value and family friendly not to be missed! - We were apprehensive booking a scooter food tour when travelling with a 7 year old and a 69 year old however this was the best decision we made on our travels. Xo food tours were amazing they were so accomodating made everyone feel safe and comfortable and ensured we had bucket loads of fun plus the food was delicious. The girls and the support crew were so attentive and gave us a wonderful tour of the city visiting so many districts. The perfect welcome to Vietnams, food, culture and hospitality.

A must do in Saigon! - We did two tours with XO, the sites tour and the evening foodie tour, and both were great experiences! Our guides were all great drivers, very friendly and engaging, and fun to get to know and learn a bit about every day life in Vietnam. The pace of both tours was the perfect mix of activity and resting time and we loved getting to see parts of the city we otherwise wouldn't have. There's nothing quite like zooming around such a big and bustling city on the back of a motorbike. We spent 10 days in Vietnam and our tours with XO were hands down the highlight of that time.

Excellent and well worth doing - A superb evening. Such a brilliant tour. We were met at our hotel, the riders were waiting for us 5 minutes before our start and after a brief introduction we set off. It was rush hour and very busy but the riders were professional and very careful. We had a great selection of food which were all local dishes and not just food to fill you up, a variety and catering for all needs, dietary requirements were checked before we started, luckily we were able to eat everything, which was beef, goat, crab, clams and pork. The riders were great fun and gave us so much information. We were very impressed. And as non bikers in late 50s we cannot recommend this tour highly enough. Thank you Nhu and Nguyen.

Fun and Insightful Tour - highly recommended. - I took the Saigon by Night Tour and it was a phenomenal experience! My tour guide, "Jou-l" (my Vietnamese spelling isn't great) was very knowledgeable, had a great attitude, and was an excellent driver. She arrived at my hotel on time and quickly whisked us away to go meet the rest of the tour. The tour was very insightful and the food we had on the tour was amazing. The tour was well paced, not too fast & not too slow, and it gave me an insight into Saigon that I definitely wouldn't have gotten otherwise. I highly recommend this tour and will make sure to take another XO tour the next time I'm in Saigon and it was the highlight of my time in Vietnam!
A must - I did this solo tour and so glad I did! The hosts are super friendly, impressive scooter drivers, and speak fantastic English. We visited some wonderful districts of Saigon. Food was 10/10.

Xo Tours Foodie Tour - Absolutely amazing tour! I enjoyed every minute of it, from the unique foods, history lessons of past and present Vietnam, to what I loved most which was the infectious personalities of the hosts.

Your money will be well spent and your taste buds fulfilled no doubt. Thanks again to Xo Tours and specifically Linh and Trang.

A great tour - I did the night tour and it was worth it, not only for the food but the people that you met (drivers and travelers). Uyen also gave us a great explication about the evolution of the city in the last 10 years.
Next time, I will try the day tour 😁.

A premium experience that's worth the price! Lovely and personable drivers and tour hosts. Quality meals! - We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves on this tour on Mar 27, 2023. We felt completely safe with the expertise of both Nga and Ngoc, our drivers. Their skill and expertise in navigating the traffic was never in doubt. For me personally, it was exciting to have a first hand and close up view of how motorbike riders can cross oppose traffic; like opposing schools of fishes in the ocean.

The meals were fantastic; progressing in quality. From a very local soup noodle (not pho) to meat to seafood.

We rode about 30km through several districts, seeing first hand the differences. The walk through Chinatown market revealed a diversity of fruits, etc. Hong Tong & 'V' gave excellent talks about life, Vietnamese culture and society. Such talks provided a glimpse into the realities of Vietnamese life.

We had great talks with our drivers as we rode our motorbikes. They were trained to converse on a broad range of topics, and share their own stories, Both were university students and this opportunity allowed them to offset their tuition and board expenses.

We loved the fact that XO Tours was set up to benefit the ladies! And that in a small way, we are helping riders like Ngoc and Nga in their educational and eventual life pursuits. We didn't bother price shopping with other ride companies, and perceived that we received full value for the price we paid. We loved to tip our two drivers too!

XO Tours: It's 100% Worth It - This was such a cool experience, and I can't recommend it enough. This team of ladies knows what they're doing, and will go above and beyond to make sure you have an amazing time.

A tour to discover real life, real tastes and out of tourist paths: an excellent intro to Saigon - We took a private tour and it was worth any penny. This flooding tour is one of the highlights of our 3-week trip to discover Vietnam.
Super drivers and we feel no fear in this 7 million scooters city
Good choices of local restaurants to present real tastes enjoyed by Vietnamese
Plus visit of out of tourist path districts.
So 4.5 hours extremely fun and tasty
Many thanks XO

XO Street Food Tour - Saigon - Went on the XO Street Food Tour in Ho Chi Minh City in a small group of 8 one evening. We all had our own scooter driver and personal guide. My guide was Truc and the tour leader was Vy. All of the girls were wonderful guides and great company for the tour. We couldn't fault their driving. I felt very comfortable and safe among the crazy Saigon traffic. We visited places off the beaten track as well as the city's main attractions. We had so much food over several stops and it was all delicious. It was mainly traditional food with some very unusual dishes as well. We learned so much about Vietnamese daily life and the guides were very interested in our lives as well. We had lots of fun and lots of laughter. It was a highlight of our Vietnam trip and a must do. Thanks Ladies - you were a hoot xxx

The best way to see Saigon at night!Wow - An amazing evening with the most delightful, entrepreneurial young women. The ride, what can I say, if you have seen the traffic in Saigon, so exciting yet so safe, places you wouldn't normally see or experience, street food excellent, the home we visited, all truly cultural eye opening , a really "must do" in Ho Chi Min, especially at night, well done girls!

Excellent! - We took an evening tour with these amazing ladies Ngoc, Thu, Huong and Ai, one of our party was a little nervous, but not for long, they were amazing at putting you at ease, we went to several districts outside the main ones, and even took a look round an apartment to see what life was really like, it was the highlight of our time in HCM and cannot thank them enough. There are several copy cat tours, but this one is fully insured and the ladies are so professional. If you only do one thing in HCM pick this one!

Thank you ladies!

Fantastic taste of Saigon - We only spent 1 day in Saigon and this tour was the perfect taste of the city and its historical context. The tour was very well organized and the guides took very good care of us. They even took photos and sent us an album afterwards!

Best part of our HCMC trip leg - We LOVED our XO Tour! It was really hot when we visited, so getting to tour Ho Chi Min on motorbike in the evening was such a nice treat. We got to see so much of the city we wouldn't have gotten to otherwise see. The food was excellent, the tour guides were great, and we were so impressed with the tour leader. We even felt completely comfortable and safe on the motorbikes :) The little things matter- knowing which sauce on the plate to eat with which skewer, getting help purchasing fruit, all of it. Thank you for an amazing tour!

Exceptional Food experience, Great Tour - We signed up to the food tour which started in the afternoon. As a professional (tourism industry) I can be very critical and I was curious how will be our experience. I really enjoyed that girls were our guides, and woman's sometimes can be underrated in Asian countries. I'm glad to see that is changing, became I found Vietnamese women are extremely hard working and they did more than excellent job on this tour. VY, the main tour guide, she was one of the best and personable professional I have seen in my life. She was able to talk to every person in the tour and personalize their experience. I think this type of attention is the main key for the success and plus the tour was also exceptional. Not a usual tourist trap, it does give you many perspectives of the daily life in Saigon and of course the main reason, the food. Be ready to eat, so pace yourself.
Thank you for all the girls the tour and the safe driving, it was really memorable...and VY you are a superb person 😉
Krisztian and Csilla

Unforgettable Experience. Kudos to XO Tours - Great Tour not only involves excellent food, but also a superb experience to be part of the chaotic traffic that just seems to work smoothly despite the chaos. Could not believe how relaxed i was on the back of the bike! Excellent Riders and Local Guides. Worth every cent and a must do for all visitors.

Fantastic, fun, informative - What a fun tour. The drivers were amazing - calm and in control in the insane Saigon traffic. The food was delicious and abundant (definitely come hungry!). The tour took us to parts of the city we would not otherwise have seen. And most importantly, they were VERY accommodating of my being vegan!

Top Class Saigon Night Motorbike Ride - If you have the time in Saigon..I strongly recommend this tour & company. The girls are so friendly and chatty. They're also great drivers through the crazy traffic. You are taken for 3 hours to non tourist locations for food and culture. All done with a smile, loads of information and a few photos sent later. This is just great fun..Well done ladies👍

Food tour & sites of Saigon - We did two tours with this company, in the morning we did the sites of Saigon motorcycle tour and in the Evening we did the motorcycle food tour both were fabulous tours. The tour guide and the drivers were very informative and wonderful to be around. They made sure you were comfortable and enjoying your ride through the city. The food was very good with a lot of verity. I would not hesitate to book with this group again. Being on the motorcycles gives you a great feel for the city and fist hand look into life in Saigon. Thanks for the great time.

Doug

Highlights of our 14-Day Trip - This was a highlight of our 14 day Asia Trip.
I learned about XO Tours from a Youtube video from a travel blogger. I immediately booked the tour based on that video. This was a fantastic tour and a great value. Two guides met us at our hotel and drove us to the inital meeting point. There, we met up with two more drivers and guests as well as a few other staff.

The ride on the back of the motorbike was a little intimidating at first, but I got comfortable in no time. They really don't go too fast and are careful and safe drivers.

The food was fantastic and they took into account my special diet of no meat or poultry.

We visited several areas of HCMC, definitely saw much more that District One.

I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. We did it on our first night and it was a great introduction to this wonderful city.

Best time in Ho Chi Minh City - We spent the day (city tour) and evening (foodie tour) cruising through the streets of Ho Chi Min with XO guides (ladies) and Vu. The city tour was a fantastic way to see all the important Ho Chi Min sites. The foodie tour was one delicious dish after another. We had so much fun with the XO guides, they were not only friendly, they made sure our adventure was safe. What an amazing experience that shouldn't be missed. Special thanks to Vu for making our day in Ho Chi Min a memorable experience

Top Experience in HCM - We'll organized and fun!

Riding a motor bike in the streets of Saigon/HCM is an experience on its own. Paired with series of stops most tourists don't see, makes this a must do for those traveling to the area!

Fantastic experience - We had a fantastic time on the private night food tour with Ngoc and Duong. We thoroughly enjoyed their charming company, great food and of course seeing all different parts of Saigon from back of the motorbike :
We hope XO tours continue such a great work and we highly recommend tour.

XO foodie tour - We spent a wonderful evening zooming around the streets of Saigon. An amazing tour with a wonderful group of guides, led by the wonderful Uyen. Thank you for taking such good care of us!

My favorite part of our visit to Saigon! - Easily one the highlights of my visit to HCMC. Booking was very easy with XO, Van came and picked my wife and I up from the hotel. They were punctual. I wish I could remember my wife’s guides name but I forgot. they both did such a great job. We felt safe on the motorbikes and they spoke English very well.

There were 5 stops. 3 food stops and 2 informative stops where Uyen, the group leader, taught us about some of the history of Saigon’s Chinatown and current economics for the younger generation. She also explained that we have a couple guys with the group as body guards, but I never felt unsafe during the tour.

The food was great at each stop and they have an all you can eat and drink policy (including alcohol) so don’t hold back and feel free to ask for more. It was cool to eat at some of the same places as the locals.

I would highly recommend this tour, well worth the time and the money spent. I just wish they still had the branches in other cities so we could do one at each of our stops throughout Vietnam!

Best Food Tour Vietname - This was a fantastic food tour, we got to see some beautiful sights of Saigon and our lady drivers were amazing. Much love to the XO Food Tour crew and cannot wait to go back and do it again.

What a food tour! - Wow! What a fantastic tasting tour of HCMC. Being able to tour around that bustling, vibrant metropolis on the back of a motorbike gave the tour a genuine sense of life in the city for locals. Each person is assigned a personal host to ferry them around from place to place and I found them all very engaging, with excellent English language skills. Even introverted people like me will enjoy themselves as the host/driver will make conversation and share their knowledge of the food and the city with you The food was interesting and more than enough for the night. I came back to hostel buzzing after the tour and would highly recommend this tour group for anyone keen to try genuine Vietnamese food.

Amazing, and so well done!! - This was an exceptionally great experience. Everyone we dealt with at XO was professional, personable and just great people. We were so well looked after and experienced so much of Saigon - it was amazing. This is an 11/10 experience and I cannot recommend it highly enough. Shout out to our host, Vu who was a delight to be with and told us so much about the city that we would not have been able to find out without him. Just a fantastic experience!!

Absolute must do! - This tour was totally amazing/epic/unbelievable/crazy/sensational and so much fun. Our guides were lovely and knowledgeable and we loved how all the guides and the host worked together to ensure everyone was having their best time. It was so much more than a food tour, weaving through 20 deep traffic with no rules/lanes or signals was just the best thing we’ve ever done. All you could do was trust 100% and love it!
Oh and the food was delicious too.
We highly recommend this tour

Best food tour ever! - XO Tours, which is entirely run by Vietnamese women, has an evening street food tour in Ho Chi Minh City that is absolutely fabulous, from the food to the women themselves. My wife and I were picked up at our hotel by motorcycle and they did the driving while we did the eating and partying. All of the ladies spoke great English, were loads of fun and we saw places and ate food in HMC that we would never have experienced otherwise.

I never thought I would get on the back of a motorcycle in the chaos of HMC traffic but I felt safe the entire time. I highly recommend this tour. Great food and a fun time.
Highlight of our visit to Saigon - Authentic, bubbly, well prepared and better executed. Must do when in Saigon. Nhu and the team saw us their local perspective of their hometown.

Best tour So Far! Cheng was AMAZING! - The tour was AMAZING!!! 👍5⭐From start to finish we were looked after like royalty. Cheng is a very beautiful person who is very caring and kind. She absolutely made me feel comfortable with the ride!
The food experince was fantastic with fun games packed in too. This is one of the BEST tours I I have ever done and we have made a NEW friend who we call family.😎
Tim & Lisa
Queensland
Australia

Fantastic way to explore Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnamese cuisine - This is a fantastic tour. The female guides / drivers were really personable, great scooter drivers and very knowledgeable of Vietnamese culture and cuisine with very good English. We were especially happy with our guides Vivian and Hailey(?) and the group guide Thao was fantastic. Great way to explore parts of the city and food you otherwise might not experience and a good way to meet other people in the group.

Exceeded my expectations! Highly recommended - Spent a memorable evening cruising the streets of HCM, riding from one destination to the next, feasting and drinking til my belly was content, while also learning a bit of history and culture. Super friendly, engaging staff that went above and beyond to provide everyone on tour with personalize care and attention. Special thanks to my driver Ngà for showing me a great time! I’m sorry I forgot your name by the end of the night (I guess I was having too much fun) 🤭

Scooter food adventure to remember! - The young women drivers and the group leader were amazing. They made us feel comfortable and we had a lot of fun. Their knowledge and planning added to the experience! Highlight of our stay here. A must do with this company.

A perfect experience of Saigon - This was truly a special night. My husband and I got picked up by our tour guides (I'm so sorry we forgot their names!) who made the night. They were so lovely, friendly and made us feel really comfortable on the back of their motorbikes! The tour was great. The food we ate and the unlimited drinks were great but it was the additional bonuses which made it so special. The chopstick challenge, the insight to districts we would never have gone to otherwise, the phrase book, and of course the really lovely tour guides! If you're in HCMC I 100% recommend doing the foodie tour!

Great experience! - One of the best tours I’ve been on! Vy was great and took us to different districts to experience what living situations are like for Vietnamese people - it was really informative and our group learnt lots! We also got to try lots of food and everything was super delicious. I would definitely recommend this tour if you’re in Saigon. I also love how this tour is run by woman :)

A top choice for a food tour in Saigon - A really great motorcycle food tour in Saigon! Professionally done but still feels low-key and personal. The rides were my personal highlight but of course all the food was fantastic and the girls were a great company. Highly recommended!
Fun night out - We had so much fun with these ladies! They were funny and friendly and really knew how to drive! Great experience!

XO Food Tour, the best tour you could do in Saigon - XO Food Tour. Best tour I did in Saigon. They took us through all Saigon, trying delicious local food that is not normally advertised, and sightseeing both the rich and poor parts of the city. It opens your mind and palate to the local culture.
The staff were super friendly, professional, and helpful. They are also accommodating if you have any food restrictions. 5 star service and food, will definitely book again!

Best ever bike food tour - Wow! This bike good tour was fantastic.
I felt slightly apprehensive about riding on the back of a motor bike in the manic traffic of Saigon ( Ho chi minh). Upon collection the girls made us feel at ease and informed us of the basics about the bike and safety ( getting on and off etc) . The traffic was Indeed insane but their driving skills are second to none..
The tour it's self is well planned and executed ,the food was fantastic.
At the sight seeing stops we was given information about areas we probably wouldn't have seen.
.The guides really made you feel you are part of the team , they are truly enjoying giving you knowledge about their beautiful country, areas, ways of life and food. Throughout the tour our guide and leaders asked Us if we was enjoying the time on the tour and if we would change anything
Book this tour if you like trying different foods away from the main tourist areas. We got to eat meat and seafood dishes, which we would never had ordered for ourselves, strange looking fruits and fresh juice / tea.
There are many tours like this usually a bit cheaper but don't settle for less No banh Minh , pho or the usual additions that you could order for yourself . Every aspect of the food was explained to us from growing or sourcing, cooking and even how to eat it in perfect English. This is one of the best tours i have gone on , I totally recommend it and would go on it again if I come back to Saigon in the future..
Well-done xo tours you have raised the bar for the standard I will now expect from tours In the future
Thank you 😊

THE BEST! - Fabulous tour! It has been a unique experience to travel around the city and see places that tourists usually do not see.

The guides where kind, fluent in English and let us know soooo many details! Absolutely worth it.

The food was delicious and absolutely safe!

All together an experience that I will remember for the rest of my life! And if I come to spend time in HCM again….. I will join the XO tour again!

Best Day 1! - What a great lesson in Vietnamese culture! The food, the conversation and the scooters were such a fun experience. The all-women guides were fantastic! They were very engaging ...and also very competent drivers. While driving in Saigon can be crazy, our guides had each of us (7 adults) feeling comfortable as we zipped along with traffic (sometimes within 6 inches of other scooters/ motorbikes!) while asking and answering all kinds of questions. We ended up going to 4 different districts and stopped at 3 restaurants (soup, BBQ, seafood - allergies can be accommodated) and an outdoor market in about 5.5 hours. What a perfect way to start our adventure! The XO Foodie tour should not be missed!

Best tour during a 60 day trip to SE Asia - Based on a recommendation from a friend in Sydney who had taken XO's food tour, I contacted them and was able to schedule their tour in Saigon on March 3. A friend and I (both of us are in our 70's) were a bit nervous at first about riding around the City on the back of a motor scooter being driven by a young person who was substantially smaller than either of us. That concern disappeared within minutes after we started out. The were excellent at making us feel relaxed and were both excellent drivers and guides. The tour turned out to be the highlight of our visit to Saigon but it was also one of the best tours I have taken and I am presently on a 60 day cruise sailing from Melbourne to Osaka. We got to see Saigon in a very different light and went away feeling that we had seen and experienced more of the city than we would have on any other tour. Overall, an outstanding tour!

Great safe fun with a true Vietnamese food and city experience - We did Ho Chi Minh City evening food tour. We were driven on the back of mopeds around some areas you would not normally visit like the night markets , Chinatown. It was great fun the food sampling was fantastic and the young ladies who drove us around spoke really good English , were great company and really knowledgeable . I can recommend XO wholeheartedly to anyone wishing to experience an authentic Vietnamese evening tour of this amazing city . Thanks Vu and team !

Amazing tours, fantastic staff, delicious food, great information about Vietnam! - I did two tours - the Foodie Tour and the Saigon by Night tour. Both were fantastic. As a non-bike rider, I felt very safe in the crazy traffic. The foodie tour had delicious food stops (catering for gluten free!) but also trips to the food markets and various districts around the city - the information was great and it was wonderful to see spots you wouldn't normally have time or make the effort to get to.
The amazing staff made sure the Night Tour didn't overlap with anything I'd seen on the Food Tour which was really, really thoughtful. They took me individually to a roadside flea market, and then we joined the main group to see Aunties apartment, the flower markets and have more street food - a real insight into how people live in Saigon.
The photos and videos that were taken are a really good memory of both tours.
Very highly recommend!

Rock Star Women Guided Tour! - Hong and her flock of informed, enthusiastic, local bi lingual women provided a wonderful and energetic tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Having been in the country for several weeks and witnessing the scooter culture only from a minivan or sidewalk, it was hysterical to be on the back of one! The driver/guides were attuned to personal safety. Warm and genuine they shared their passions with us. We enjoyed the back-street scooter tours and hitting up some non-touristy food establishments for tasty treats. Truly a local and unforgettable! One of the memorable highlights of our trip and not to be missed.

Best fun! - We loved this foodie tour on scooters. The gals were terrific, knowledgeable and safe (as much as can be on the back of a scooter) I particularly loved that we didn’t visit all the tourist eateries.

Highlight of my visit! - This tour was a highlight of my trip to Saigon! The food was great (good variety and quality, and lots of it) but even better was the motorbike ride and informative tour. I was especially impressed and happy with my guide/driver (Jew). She was knowledgeable, safe, and personable.

Absolute Must! - An absolute must in Saigon! We've been on cruise and all-inclusive excursions, but this tops any of those. This tour is far more than just a food tour. You get to experience Saigon from the perspective of the residents of the city. The girls are all excellent drives and connected with all of us from the start. It was well planned, and the time flew by as we ate at fantastic non tourist stops, walked thru markets, visited a local apartment complex, learned about the city all while traveling across multiple districts outside D1.

A five stars experience - It was an amazing experience from different standpoints, first we have appreciated a lot our two drivers Sing & Line, both were very kind, spending all their time with us teaching us everything we should know about ho chi minh. And from a driving standpoint, we felt confident at all time . The food (3 stops ou of 5) was fantastic, food we'll not have ordered by ourselves but through the tour it was a good opportunity to discover new and amazing dishes.

Perfect Saigon Tour - Honestly, the greatest experience we had in Saigon!
The whole night was planned so well, we could see the different districts and try things my partner and i have never experienced before. Our guides were so nice and the motorbike tour was an amazing way to capture the city!

XO scooter tours is a fantastic way to see Saigon, enjoy great local food, and navigate the Saigon traffic thrill ridee - We spent a very enjoyable 4 hour tour commencing around 6:00pm. Drivers were all super friendly, very knowledgable, and skilled drivers. We went to some great "local" places off the tourist route and had great local food and fun conversation. This is a fantastic way to see more local centric parts of Saigon!!

Taste Saigon in one night - This is probably the best way to see the wonders of Saigon. I loved everything about this tour; the efficiency of booking, the fantastic tour guides (shoutout to Neu and Thao), the transportation around the city and of course the amazing food too. As a solo female traveller this was a great way to explore parts of Saigon I may not otherwise have gone to. All of the guides were so kind and friendly and had tonnes of knowledge on the history, culture and foods of Saigon and Vietnam. I’ve been fortunate to do food tours in many cities globally but this is by far one of the best- do not miss!

Loved the Saigon by Night tour - We loved the Saigon by Night tour! It was one of our favorite activities of the whole trip. Our guides, Nhu and Vy, were so nice and made us feel safe the entire time.

The tour gave us a real look into how locals live and helped us explore outside of the touristy district. We also loved riding on the back of the scooters because you don't have to worry about navigating the roads yourself and can just enjoy the ride.

The guides brought us to a wet market where locals do their daily food shopping and we learned about and tasted Vietnamese fruit. We also tried some street food and visited local apartments. It was was an extremely eye-opening, unique experience that we could never have had without XO Tours.

I definitely recommend doing the Saigon at Night tour if you're looking for an authentic experience that goes beyond just tasting food!
Fantastic Time - Had a fantastic time on this tour. I am Great fan of supporting an all woman’s company and they did not disappoint. Everyone was super friendly and I would highly recommend.

Foodie night tour - The charming hosts. Variety of Vietnamese food and the districts covered was excellent. Bike ride was a lot of fun and safe. The ladies were most engaging and delightful. Not the cheapest food tour on offer but I felt was outstanding value. Highly recommended

Scooting around the city - The entire trip was fun & exciting. Nothing like being on a scooter and exploring the city to get you immersed in the culture of the
city. Our drivers were delightful and really gave us an experience we will never forget. We especially loved the street food experience and visiting a local resident’s home. I would highly recommend this tour, it was one of the highlights of our trip

Great way to feel immersed in Saigon’s culture! - The motorbikes were so fun and the sites we visited helped me better understand the rich culture and history of Saigon. My driver, Mai, was awesome and made me feel very comfortable/ safe my first time getting onto a motorbike. Sang was an extremely knowledgeable and passionate tour guide.

Excellent attention to detail - I can’t begin to explain how exceptional this tour was. My wife and I are early 50s and had an amazing time. We’ve done a lot of travel and tours but our drivers/ guides Hoang and Giang 3 were so good at making sure we were safe and kept us up on all the sights around us. Our tour leader Hang Lam was brilliant and passionate about her culture. The food was more than I can imagine. I’m not too fussy but not sure I would have tried some of these items if not for the guides. I highly recommend this tour

Don’t hesitate book it. - We have enjoyed a few food tours whilst in Vietnam but this was the best! I loved being on a scooter with calm experienced drivers especially as I had not ridden on one before. Manoeuvring in and out of HCMC traffic was exhilarating. The whole team including support scooters were excellent. It was professional and efficient without losing the fun element. I also appreciated the company seeking your full names for insurance purposes which is not offered by all
other food tours. We ate lots of lovely food and we taken to Districts we had not seen before. We had a great guide who explained not only the dishes but also the history of some of our stops. The food was varied and interesting. We tried many different dishes and styles of cooking. We were looked after and driven by Dang and Lin who were engaging and knowledgable with excellent english. They made our evening even better. Don’t hesitate book it. You won’t regret it.

Best food tour ever - Saw the tour on you tube & thought this was a must do. Did the tour on 18th Feb 2023 - it was the best food tour I’ve been on.
Well organised & planned throughout the night which gave reassurance.
My driver, Cam Cam, was amazing - she was funny yet knowledgeable and so enthusiastic- she totally made the whole night.
I was on my own (as were a couple of others) but it didn’t feel like it - everyone was made to feel involved
Best a Saturday night!!

Must do activity in HCMC - What an adventure! This food tour on scooters is an amazing way to get to know the city, the people and the food! A very well organized activity that was fun, safe, and delicious. Each scooter driver was so great - they were friendly and chatty. Love that all the drivers are women! We got to learn about them and their city and eat great food along the way. Sajgon is such an exciting city - seeing it at night, on the scooter, is the best. Highly highly recommend this tour.

The best food and city tour in HCMC! - An outstanding tour that was amazing and eye-opening for us local expats as well as our visiting friends. The tour guides kept the energy up all night with wonderful conversation. We were beyond stuffed by the end of the evening, both in our stomach as well as in our mind with their deep insights about the city. Always safe and protected, always informative, I can't wait until more visitors come so I have an "excuse" to go on another tour!!

Fantastic - not to be missed! - Wow. Wow. Wow. What a FANTASTIC experience!! We are so glad they were able to fit us on the foodie tour! We loved it so much fun, the ladies were so friendly and had a great sense of humour. The food was delicious and it was so nice to be able to get out of district 1!! Great initiative and great way to be able to see the city! To top it off, they take photos of you touring around so you can just enjoy being in the moment! Thank you XO Tours!

XO motorbike food tour - Interesting experience to see the city on a motorbike rather than dodging the motorbikes as you walk the streets. The female tour guides were quite delightful! Always felt safe with them. Interesting food experiences. Try this if you want something more than the typical food tour. Also a great way to empower these young women.
WOW. Amazing - This was one of the best tours I have ever done. Linh was friendly, knowledgeable and I felt completely comfortable and safe with her.

Amazing City Tour - Just finished my second tour with XO Tours. Have previously done the foodie tour and it was excellent but today was the city tour with Sang and V. I was very fortunate to be the only one so ended up with a private tour. What a great morning seeing the sights of the city, learning the history. Sang was very knowledgeable. I enjoyed it immensely. V was my lovely and kind driver for the day. Very polite. Thank you both.

Just an fantastic experience. XO Tours “Saigon by Night”. - It has been a few years since I visited Vietnam due to Covid but I was not disappointed at all. I booked the Saigon by Night tour well in advance as from past experience I know that the XO Tours fill up fas. I have been using XO Tours for 11 years. I met the owner Tung when he was just starting the business 11 years ago. While wandering around Saigon he approached me and my friend and wanted to know if we were interested in a Sightseeing tour by scooter with ladies being the drivers. Tung advised that he has 2 ladies working for him and he would be happy so show us around Saigon by scooter. We thought for a minute and said sure, lets give it a try. Well that night 11 years ago sold me on XO tours. It is a well organized professionally run business. The ladies arrived as scheduled on their scooters dressed in their Blue and White Traditional Ao Dais. We had a wonderful night back then and tonight was just as thrilling as the 1st tour. Our drivers tonight were
Nhu, Ngoc, Lam. All were fluent in English and extremely safe drivers. We opted for the Video option and Hien was the Video man tonight. There was also two support staff Lan & Phuc who accompanied us throughout the night making sure there was no issues and provided assistance at each stop and security although we had no issues with anyone of us being harassed etc. I must say that the Saigon by Night tour tonight was just as thrilling as the 1st tour I had many years ago. There were several stops along the way for photos at local markets selling, assorted Meats, Seafood, Vegetables, Flowers, Fruit etc. We also visited a local Electronics Flea market set up on the sidewalks. Some of the items being sold were most likely 25-30 years old maybe even older. We stopped at a couple of places to try some local food delicacies such as Bahn Xeo a crispy fried pancake along with various other Beef, Pork and Shrimp and som local beer, same was included in the tour price. We also had the opportunity to actually go inside one of the local apartments and see how some people are living today. We met one elderly home owner and she invited us into her home where she has lived all her life. The history and detailed commentary by the tour leader was a complete shock and eye opener. Some of these small apartments are smaller than my bathroom at home in the USA and I do not have a big home either. I have been traveling all over the world for over 50 years and the XO tours have always been the Highlight each and every time I visit Saigon. I am very fortunate to have met Tung quite by accident 11 years ago and have enjoyed the XO tours with different friends from time to time over the years. My friends have always said that this was the best and thrilling experience ever and even after I explained a little about the XO tours initially they really did not appreciate the extent of what the tour encompasses and the detailed information and history as told by the tour leader. You really need to experience the tour to truly appreciate what these Vietnamese people have lived through and some to this day still live with 8-12 other family members in some cases.

I can and do highly recommend XO Tours. You get what you pay for and XO tours offers the the safest, and best tours completely insured withno hidden costs whatsoever. You will have the opportunity to enjoy your tour with the friendliest drivers and support staff. The communications is directly through the XO Tours office is prompt and direct. They are a very reliable independent company not affiliated with any 3rd party wholesalers / vendors. You deal directly with XO tours, no one else. If you want the BEST experience then XO Tours is the one you will want to choose for the most thrilling time and the best memories possible.

God willing I will be able to return for a few more times in the not too distant future.
A huge “Thank You” to Tung and all the staff at XO Tours from Ron, Lisa and Por.

Professional, Prepared, Punctilious = Perfect - First things first. For those of you concerned about getting aboard a moped - you will be safer riding pillion with any of the team than you will be walking on a footpath in HCMC. The exemplary team included Xuan, Linh, Chau, Vu and Hang plus many more - even a couple of (passengerless) guys on bikes just making sure everyone feels safe along the way. They were all a joy to spend time with. Three food stops and two viewing stops in between to give you time to digest. Can say no more than the food was brilliant and ALL the staff were even better. Non-stop chat and information from start to finish and the three of us had the greatest time all the way round. Don’t think twice - just book it. And finally - enjoy the egg. One Two Three Cheers!

Incredible 10/10 food tour Ho Chi Minh City - The team at XO tours were fantastic from start to finish. We met in front of the Saigon Opera House and were greeted with massive smiles and an explanation of how to sit on the bike we would spend our evening travelling on. Our drivers for the day were called Xuan, Linh and Chau, they were amazing and drove very well making you feel safe. The knowledge they provided of each district, local experience, and food we were about to eat was second to none they could not have been more friendly. Each rider was funny and extremely helpful to myself and my parents. I couldn’t recommend them enough. We ate incredible food which was also authentic as they place an emphasis on giving you the local experience. Every dish we tried was exceptional and there is no restriction on food or drink, once your food or beer is finished another one will be put down straight in front of you!

Also a special shout out to Hang and Vu who were the tour guides. They were very knowledgeable and happy to answer any questions you had on the city. They made the tour run super smoothly. We were also accompanied by ‘bodyguards’ who were local guys keeping an eye on everything as well as taking pictures of the evening (which will be sent to you within 2 days (less than 24 hours for us!)).

It is a tour I would recommend strongly to anybody visiting the city.

Thank you very much guys we really appreciated your work!

Best streetfood tour in HCMC - We did the XO Foodie Tour a couple of weeks ago and it was one of the highlights of our Vietnam trip. Already the initial communication was quick, informative and friendly. And then we had the best time on the evening itself! Our drivers and the tour leader were very kind, we saw a side of HCMC we otherwise would not have seen and we ate some amazing food! Throughout it all we learned so much about Vietnam, the people and their culture. We felt safe throughout the entire trip, also on the back of the motorbikes. If you're going to do a (street)food tour in HCMC then you should do this one!

Amazing experience! - From the moment our group of 9 was greeted by team leader Vu Nguyen and the drivers we knew the trip would be great fun.

After a safety briefing and introductions outside the hotel we were off into the chaotic streets of Saigon for what we later learned was approx. 40km drive around the city.

The first few minutes were a bit scary, but my advice is just relax and trust your driver and you will enjoy the trip, as the young female drivers spoke excellent English and were very competent drivers.

At each food stop, Vu provided some interesting facts about that District and explanation of the local dishes being served. All the food and drink (alcoholic or soft drinks) were included in the price.

In addition to Vu and the drivers, there was a support team of security and mechanics who drove ahead to meet us at each stop, and ensure food and drink was ready and waiting to ensure a seamless experience.

After 4 hours of driving around the city with several food and sightseeing stops we would have been returned to our hotel but asked to be dropped off nearer to some bars.

So overall an excellent tour and great way to experience more of the city than the average tourist would get to see.

Many thanks Vu and the team for a lovely evening of fun and food.

2026-10-10T00:00:00 - Absolutely 10/10 experience. The best way to get a local perspective and try foods you wouldn’t have normally ordered. The hosts are extremely knowledgeable and you feel very safe while riding around.

Incredible experience for food and culture! - An absolute must do activity! Most tourist aren’t able to see HCMC beyond the tourist district 1. This tour allows you to visit several districts including 5,8,7, and 4! A perfect introduction to Vietnam, people, culture, and food! Our guides were friendly, spoke great English, and drove skillfully through traffic while teaching you all about Vietnam. Don’t be concerned about being on the back of a moped- the girls are all very safe drivers and navigate well. The food was incredible with the opportunity to try soup, fresh fruit, goat, new vegetables, beef noodles, not to mention seafood including shrimp, scallops, crab, and more! There’s something for everyone and it’s the perfect opportunity to learn what you like. They ensure no one leaves hungry! Also helpful that they take pictures for free and email them within 24 hours so you can share with others! 110% recommend!

Well worth the price for a standout food and culture tour - This is probably the best food tour I've been on, period.

Before booking I'd questioned the price and whether it was worth it - let me put your mind to rest: it is. It's a 4+ hour tour through five different districts of HCMC, a bucket load of food/drinks and an introduction to the cultural and historical aspects of the city.

XO care about the little details which make for a seamless 'wow' experience: Our lovely bike drivers called in at the hotel to let us know we arrived. Hong, our guide, learned our names instantly. XO had spare motorbikes and additional people as both bodyguards (even thought HCMC feels perfectly safe) and pre-bookers for each street food place, so there's never a queue or a wait for food. The tour includes tonnes of food, but also a good amount of time on the details of different districts from rich to poor, capturing the essence of life in the city. We ate at places that I'd never go to alone, and tried food I'd never do without a guide.

During the tour XO are your photographers, guides and pretty much friends for the few hours you're there. Afterward there's information on everything you ate, recommendations, a booklet about the city and a helpful guide for some basic Vietnamese.

Please go support this women-led business!

Great experience - Without a doubt this is a must do tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh. My wife and I did the foodie night tour yesterday and it really exceeded our expectations. They soon put my wife's fear of being a passenger on the scooter to rest, she ended up loving the experience and hasn't stopped talking about it. These guys make you feel like part of the XO family, sharing their passion for Vietnams culture, history and it's all experienced through food. You'll go to parts of Vietnam and see sights you most likeley wouldn't see and it's great fun. Its easy to give XO five stars and I would highly recommend their tours. You've help create some great memories...

Brilliant and unique tour around the city - This was an amazing tour and the highlight of our trip to HCM. I'd really recommend it. The girls are fantastic; their English is brilliant and they are soooo knowledgeable. We did the Saigon by night and got to visit someone in their home in one of the oldest building blocks of the city - I don't think any other tour does this so was a real experience!

Must do in HCMC - This was the Highlight of our visit to HCMC, best experience! We fehlt very safe on the motorbikes and had great conversation with the drivers. Vegetarian options were not a problem.

Brilliant food tour of Saigon - The XO Tours team ensured we had an enjoyable, safe and interesting tour to places in Saigon that we would otherwise not have seen and trying foods that we would never have ordered. We didn’t have to do anything except relax, eat and enjoy ourselves…..it was great fun! A special mention to Dung and Ngoc who drove us around and shared their local knowledge with us. We highly recommend this tour to other independent travelers who, like us, wouldn’t normally go on a tour.

Excellent foodie tour - My wife and I along with another couple did a motor bike food tour with XO on Feb 5. Four young ladies picked us up at our hotel and we headed off to our first stop where we met up with a larger group. These young ladies are very experienced with the traffic. We visited multi districts during the tour and away from the touristy district 1. Lots of stops and lots of food and all the while getting a first hand lesson from the guides. Everyone was super nice and knowledgeable. XO was extremely organized. I would highly recommend the tour to anyone who wants to have a great Saigon food and site experience. Thanks!!

Saigon like a local.. - What an awesome and well organised whistle stop tour of Saigon and its sights and history. Firstly we were met by our female drivers dressed in their traditional Ao dai ( pronounced Alzy ) who spoke perfect English with a wicked sense of humour also. Sing was our perfect guide with a wealth of knowledge about the sights and its history and a few surprises along the way. I have lived in Saigon for a number of years and booked this to give my daughter a real life Saigonese view of the boulevard lined streets and sights from the back of a scooter like the locals. She and I both thoroughly enjoyed this awesome tour with safe and fun drivers and great guides . If you want to see the sights of Saigon with a fun bunch of XỔ guides this is for you !!! We loved it.

Super friendly tour drivers and guides - A 2 1/2 hour trip being whisked by motorbike to cool and unusual sites all over HCMC, Vietnam.

There's some pride, some teaching, some history, and lots of friendly gestures at making the visitor feel welcome in their fair city!

Knowledgeable and with great English skills. There's no doubt as to why this is a top-ranked tour in all the world -- these gals (and guys) know how to do a tour of the city. Don't wait. Sign up.

Simply incredible!! - Such an awesome experience. 100% recommend. The girls make you feel super safe on the bikes and take you to such awesome places. Such an insightful tour not just about food but about the city and its history.
Thu and Nhu were incredible, so kind and knowledgeable, made us feel super safe and welcome.
Food was delicious, tour was super fun with games and sight seeing added in.
It was the perfect way to spend our first night in Ho Chi Minh and I highly highly recommend that everyone do this tour to introduce to the Vietnamese food and culture

XO tours - Best foodie tour ever. Felt extremely safe on the motorbike and the women drivers made sure we were comfortable at all times. Everyone had an outstanding command of English.

The food was outstanding and extremely delicious. Great memories for me and my wife. We are also senior citizens and would recommend this tour to anyone.

The city tour was a great way to learn history and get a feeling for the city. Highly recommend it to see the major landmarks to determine what you may want to focus your tour.

The nightlife tour is a must do as you get to see how regular Vietnamese individuals live and work in the city. Very informative and enlightening.

Exceeded our expectations - XO Foodie Tour was the highlight of our trip and exceeded all our expectations. Definitely worth the money and not a tourist trap. We felt extremely safe on the back of all their scooters despite the busy traffic in Saigon. Service was impeccable and we felt very looked after. They take you to a variety of local spots throughout different districts and the experience was more than just food.

Thank you to Hang and her team, they were very professional and friendly throughout the entire experience.

Ho Chi Minh City Weeee - Ngoc and Lam were wonderful tour guides. We really had a blast going around with them - they felt like old friends. I would highly recommend taking a tour with them. I wish we could try the foodie tour with them too!

The best food tour ever - I am writing this review slightly later than promised, so apologies XO.
I did the food tour on Tuesday 31st Jan 2023.
I was picked up by mu driver/personal tour guide ( I have fogotten her name and so sorry). We then made our way to the first restaurant and met the rest of our group.
I have to say from the off, all of the staff at XO made every single guest feel special.
The tour was run by a lovely lady Hong, who spoke perfect english. Hong is a star and was providing lots of commentary throughout.

We stopped at various different restaurants, markets and visited lots of different districts in HCM. This is something lots of tourists wouldnt do when visiting HCM.

The food was amazing, the staff incredible, the tour was fun, and incredibly good value for money.

Best tour ever. If thinking about doing a food tour when visiting this amazing city, the only place to do it through is XO
Ho Chi Minh Highlight - The only and best way to see the sights of Saigon. Fun, informative guides. Convenient hotel pickup + drop-off.

The perfect way to experience Saigon by night! - A really great and authentic Saigon adventure! A good mix of getting to see the city for real (away from the touristy parts of town) combined with a lot of good, local food at genuine places. The XO staff where amazing, both very friendly and made sure to guide you through the different areas while being on the motorbike.

The tour included stops in many of the districts - both stops to explore and stops to eat. I would really recommend you to take this tour - I am very happy that we did!

Interesting and fun - Did a city tour with XO yesterday. Absolutely loved it. Very informative and took me to places not seen on bus tours. Guide was excellent. My motorbike driver ( who’s name I have shamefully forgotten) was also very informative and a very safe driver. Recommend to anyone visiting Ho Chi Min City

Terrific Experiece - Thirteen of us were in HCMC as part of a two week study tour. As our schedule was filled with meetings, our WaterBuffalo Tours travel agent (also deserving of five stars) suggested we add in some fun by taking XO's food tour. We are SO glad we did, as it stood out as a highlight of the whole trip. During the intro to our young, petite, female drivers, the men in the group looked somewhat dubious about what was to come. But by the first stop, all were having the time of their lives, and all doubts were completely erased by the warmth, professionalism, expertise, etc. of the terrific XO team. Not to mention the great food. (Two of us had dietary restrictions and XO took great pains to work around those.) Its well worth the time and money!

Highly recommend XO Tours! - This tour was one of the best things we did in a Vietnam. Our motorbike guides, Lam and Thun, were amazing. They were fun, knowledgeable, and well-organized. We felt very safe with them. We took the 6-9pm tour and there was some great street food. We also visited non-tourist districts of HCM City and saw the hard work and kindness of the Vietnamese people. I highly recommend this tour!

A wonderful experience - So glad we chose to do this food and sightseeing tour with XO tours. We tried many foods which have not had in HCMC and also got to do some sightseeing and went round on the back of a motorbike which was a new experience for us .
All the drivers are really friendly and spoke really good English.
The food was great and our tour guys explained the different foods.
Special thanks to my tour guide Vw, I think I chewed her ear off with all the talking I did ! Would highly recommend this tour with XO. If we had not done this then I don’t think e would have left district 1, this tour covered around 4 districts .

Just do it. Seriously. You won't regret it. - Just book the tour. I would give it 7 stars out of 5 if I could. It's 5 hours long but it's run so well it felt like two. I didn't want it to stop. You get what you pay for and you're paying for a luxury tour. It's all you can eat, youre encouraged to order more of what you like, they take photos and video and send them to you after. They pick you up from many hotels and drop you off after. They have men in uniform to protect and serve food to you and the girls as well as taking pictures and video so you can focus only on the food, culture, and your personal guide.
