I had the pleasure of being led by one of the co founders and it went flawlessly. Ms. Hong(?), if you are reading this, bravo, absolutely *stupendous*. Keep up the good work and constantly improve as you have been doing!

Also read the FAQ. As stated on the FAQ, this tour is for people that want authenticity and hidden gems. You won't find phở, chả giò or any common Vietnamese foods, you will only get things that locals eat on the daily and for nights out with their friends. We were the only group of foreigners at all the stops.

Why it is 3x the price of other tours

-Fully insured against accidents
-All you can eat and drink(you are in fact encouraged to order more of what you like)
-VERY considerate of dietary restrictions
-Very difficult and formal vetting process for employees
-Expertly paced
-Photos and videos taken for you and sent to you so you don't have to yourself
-guides take care of everything for you, craving shells, peeling shrimp etc
-off the beaten path food stops
-culture and sightseeing between meals
-a lot more

Make this the first thing you do in Ho Chi Minh! - My husband and I make it a point to always book a food tour first-thing when we visit a new country. Our night with XO tours was hands down the best food tour we have ever been fortunate to experience!

We were picked up directly from our hotel by a personal motorbike driver, then each given helmets and instructions for safe riding. Over a period of 5 hours, we made 5 adventure-packed stops full of eating, history, and culture!

I want to write about each stop but I think it's best if you just book! Take our word for it - you will have an unbelievable night and will return home more sated!

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh!!! - Amazing experience! We had the best time on the XO tour, it was the highlight of our time in Ho Cho Minh by far. My partner and I had amazing drivers Van and Truk take us around, the whole XO team were lovely to chat with over food and during the rides. The tour was both informative and exciting, we felt completely safe at all times and were well taken care of.

The only way to see Saigon - Such a memorable experience. I was very nervous about getting on a scooter and heading into the Saigon traffic- but Yung (Sunni) made me feel very comfortable. I very quickly realised it was the only way to see the city!

I tasted food I would never have ordered on my own and got to see different parts of the city outside the tourist areas. It was the highlight of visiting Ho Chi Minh- I will be recommending it all my friends that visit Vietnam.

First time visitor to Ho Chi Minh City - The tour was fabulous! Our lovely drivers arrived at our hotel early and made us feel very comfortable getting on a bike for the first time. The food stops were delicious and the sightseeing stops were so interesting. The drivers and the guide were full of fantastic information. And of course the experience of driving through the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City was exhilarating. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCMC.

Dreams come true in Saigon - It was the most exciting tour we have ever had! If you want to feel the city of Ho Chi Minh and taste the real Vietnamise food, just do it. Riding a motobike in this city is just an incredible experience. Crowded streets, speeding locals around you while you're safe in hands of XO rider girls, which are real motobike masters. It is must have experience when visiting Saigon. We would definitely do it again. Top class in every aspect.

Must do in Ho Chi Minh - Absolutely amazing tour! The staff are so lovely and good to talk to. The food you eat is authentic Vietnamese food that you wouldn’t get anywhere else. They also show you other areas of Ho Chi Minh. I would suggest to do this on your first or second day of your trip because if you want to explore different districts you will have a good idea of where to go.

Can’t miss experience! - The XO tour was unforgettable! It was thrilling to be able to see the difference districts by motorbike. The restaurants chosen had incredible food. The young ladies were great hosts with relevant information and warm personalities. Truly a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!!!

Happy New Year Experience - These women are my role models for life! They are entertaining while being very safe on the highways. The experience with them was thrilling. I would do this with them every day if we could!

Remarkable Tour by Remarkable Women - This was, without a doubt, the best tour I've ever experienced. All of our drivers were smart, witty, funny, relatable, knowledgeable, and safe. All had excellent command of English. They were expert drivers and seemed to have endless insights into daily life (and food) in Ho Chi Minh City. XO is truly a remarkable company staffed by remarkable women. For anyone interested in exploring the city and sampling its various cuisines, there is no better option.

Great People - Delicious Food - XO Food Tours in Saigon is probably the best food tour you will ever experience in this vibrant city; offering the best combination of sightseeings and delicious food tours across different districts.

You get to see mesmerising sights of colonial past with the modern , experience manic sound of the seemingly endless flow of traffic spiraling in & out of the city and enjoy delightful melting pots of Saigonese cuisines along each stop.

My guide, Hằng, was amazing. She made the ride relaxed and comfortable. She was fun, very friendly and took the time to explain every question asked.

Our group truly enjoyed the tour tremendously. It was one of the highlights of my VN trip.

Thank you, Hằng, for making the tour so such fun and memorable experience.
Eric T

Best Tour in SE Asia! - We have been in SE Asia for three months and taken several tours. XO Tours is at the top of the list! We had so much fun! Just the ride on the back of a motor bike was worth it. If you are looking for banh mi, spring rolls and pho, this is NOT the food tour for you. If you want to experience Vietnamese food at a few different locations and tour several HCMC districts, this is it! And there is no shortage of cold beer if you are so inclined.

Amazing Way to See Saigon! - XO Tours was recommended to me by a friend who lives in Saigon, and it was amazing and honestly a must-do. The drivers were great - I always felt safe - and it was a truly authentic way to get around the city. Our guide (Vu) at the various stops was very informative, could answer all of our questions, spoke great English, and was fun to have as a guide. Highly recommend this!

Motorbike tour through Ho Chi Minh - We had a wonderful private bike tour with XO tours for our family through the bustling streets of Saigon. It was the first time our teenager daughters had been on motorbikes and they loved it. The girl drivers were so friendly and made our daughters feel very welcomed and relaxed. Highly recommend this experience

Best tour ever !! - One of the best tours I did in my life, highly recommended it if you want something special and see a real Saigon ! Big love to the guides that made it so special with their knowledge and attention to detail

Best tour in the city - What a great experience! This is such an amazing tour run by some very professional tour guides. The ladies were exceptional and provided us with a very safe and fun tour of Ho Chi Minh. The food stops were delicious and our young kids had the best time.

A must do in Saigon - Previously did the food tour back in 2016 and couldn’t wait to do it again when we visited in December.
Definitely a must do in Saigon/HCMC, great way to see the city and eat some great food.

Well worth the money! A must-do in Saigon! - This was such a fun tour! Would highly recommend. We ate so much food and it was all delicious. The girls are so kind and made the experience! My mom had her first experience riding on the back of a motorbike and she felt so comfortable with her guide. Thank you for giving us such a fun night!

XO Tours - simply the best!!! - We took two tour with XO - the morning HCMC History Tour and the night time Foodie Tour. Both were outstanding. The drivers and guide were top notch.

First - the History Tour - very well planned out mixing in the history of the country, religion, and over course - the war. They took us to key sites and a couple that we would never have known about or found with out their guidance. I would recommend this at the front end of you visit to HCMC - it really helps get you get orientated to the city and districts.

Second - Night Foodie Tour - just outstanding. The food was fantastic and the variety amazing. We rode from one end of the city to the other. It was with out question the highlight of our entire trip. Can't recommend this tour and this group enough.

As for the idea of getting on a scooter in HCMC - the XO staff makes it extremely safe and fun. We never felt in danger at any point in time. Very good drivers who care about you and your experience.

And a shout to our drivers - Vy3 and Truc1 - they were the best. My wife and I got to know then and what it's like to grow up and live in Vietnam. They made our experience very special.

Thanks XO for making our time in HCMC so great. Brian

10/10 must do - I did the Sights of Saigon tour with the video option by myself and the XO Foodie tour with friends. What an INCREDIBLE team! Professionalism, flexibility when a friend had a family emergency and we had to reschedule, and deep knowledge and sincere friendliness from everyone involved. This was a great way to learn how to use a motorbike before getting used to calling Grab bikes on my own, I always felt so safe. And a great way to see and learn anything and everything about Saigon as someone new to the city. My friend lives in Saigon and also found the foodie tour new and fun. Big shout out to Hoang and Linh - the best driver (and funniest and kindest) and group guide!!

Fun, memorable and well worth the spend - Our family of 4 did the XO night foodie tour. We have 2 girls aged 10 and 13 and they LOVED ripping through the different districts of HCMC on the back of a motorbike. They felt completely safe and comfortable due to the wonderful care of their female drivers. Experiencing Bun Bo Hue, evening local markets, BBQ, fresh seafood and the diversity of the districts was the best experience we’ve had on our 3 week trip through Vietnam. Learning from each other through chats on the bike was a highlight for me. Our guides Mai, V, He and Huang absolutely made the adventure one to remember. Although comparatively expensive, it was worth every cent. Highly recommend.

Our highlight in Vietnam. - Absolutely the best tour in Ho Chi Minh City. The whole trip was extremely organized- from the pre-tour location pick up coordination, to security briefing, and the tour itself.

The food is sooo delicious. But guess what... the highlight is actually the whole tour itself. The tour guides give you very comprehensive overview of the city when you're on the bike. Dad and I laughed so much during the trip. Chau and Xuan are the best guides! The whole team really worked very well under the leadership of Thao Le.

Lastly, they surprised my dad with a birthday cake. Like, imagine the whole restaurant's lights are off, and the staff brought out a cake with birthday song in the background!

Now I hope XO can expand beyond Vietnam so I can stay with this company everywhere else I go!

Amazing experience and went way beyond just food - All of the guides were incredibly nice and the tour was well organized and thought out to make sure we had a fun and well rounded experience. While all of the food was great, the tour was also meant to educate us about the history and real side of Saigon that we would never see as tourists. There was even a very special portion where my guide, Hong, showed us around her childhood home. I would love to return with other friends and introduce this tour to them.

XO Food Tour - The best! - Great tour - local food was very good, tour guides very informative and thoughtful, everything was extremely pleasant and convenient!

Each person gets their own personal tour guide you can speak with throughout, so a great experience, educational and good food!

Don't miss this fun and fantastic experience! - What a fantastic way to see the different districts of Ho Chi Minh City and experience some highlights of delicious Vietnamese cuisine (that's not pho or bahn mi). The XO staff were so friendly, professional, well-organized, and fun. As someone not accustomed to riding on motor scooters, I was immediately put at ease by my driver, who was very cautious, and I felt safe the whole time. If my partner's 70-year old mother can do it, you can too! This was more than worth the money and I can't recommend it enough!!!

Highly recommend Saigon by night tour - We took the Saigon by night tour as we wanted to get a taste of the food but also see more of the city from a local's perspective and we were not disappointed.

From meeting our drivers/guides at our hotel to the drop off at the end, we loved every minute. The guides were friendly and we learnt a lot about Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City organically from the conversations we had while driving and walking around. The food stop was very good, while the market stop was interesting to see the kinds of food available. The opportunity to see inside the former apartment of one of the founder's, which was typical for many in the city, was interesting and a unique part of the tour.

Highly recommend the XO tours and the guides!

Must-do night tour - Highly, highly recommend!! If you are up for a really fun, well-organised, authentic tour on motor scooters, well off the beaten path, this is for you. XO is the original that everyone else copies. Female only drivers supporting small, local business.

Best experience in Vietnam! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ - We had the best time with the XO foodie tour. From pickup to drop off, the women were courteous, friendly, great drivers, incredibly knowledgeable, and so fun!

The food was fantastic and you got to see many parts of the city that normally you may not have thought of going to. I highly recommend booking a tour with XO tours!

Great! a must do in HCMC - A highlight of our travels in Vietnam, easy to book, collected on time, the most wonderful ladies driving us and explaining life and food in Vietnam, it's great to chat to your driver on the route. We visited a few different places which were out of District 1 which we would never have found by ourselves. Food was delicious. Drivers are great at getting you to interact with others on the tour aswell. Expensive but well worth it in my opinion.
One of the best experiences in Vietnam - This was one of the best things we did in Vietnam. Totally unique experience and fantastic guides. Highly recommend - don’t hesitate to book.

Must experience for 1st timers - Joined this motorcycle tour where you ride at the back of a female rider, toured the streets of ho chi minh, went to a local market, chinese pagoda, went to an underground bunker, the post office, the French Church and much more, my kids had a blast on the motorcycle, had some local desert and coffee too

Good food, great guides, you will enjoy yourself. - I decided to do this tour my first night after a 30 hour flight, so I was a little more tired than I expected to be. It's saying something that I had a great time and was awake the whole time. My guide/driver Cham was very nice and explained things about Saigon as we rode from location to location. Hong was very informative and told me somethings about modern Ho Chi Minh that I didn't know and found quite interesting. I was a really entertaining evening and the food was all very good. My only regret is that I was so tired I forgot what the soup from the first place we went was called...it was really good. If you're want to see a lot of different parts of the city, have some good food, and learn somethings you probably don't know, then you should sign up.

Outstanding motorbike tour - This tour was so much fun - a food tour is a great way to see a city. It was great to see parts of Saigon outside of District 1. The women were fun and personable - curious about our lives and generous with sharing their culture with us. The food was terrific. Our tour leader Thao and my driver Thu were outstanding and they added so much to the tour. Highly recommend!

Best food tour ever, and a great way to see the non-touristy side of HCMC - It was a ton of fun to go through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City to try all the different food on the scooters. The kids really loved it since it was a very different way of seeing the city. What I also really enjoyed was that Hong and the XO Tours ladies really showed up a different side of the city, including the wet market at night in Chinatown, and the glitzy District 7 with all the modern buildings and condominiums. It was not just one of the best food tour, but it was an education on what the city is really like outside of the touristy parts. I cannot recommend this enough - go for it, you won't regret it!

Amazing. Must do. - Amazing amazing amazing. Our family of 5 originally booked in the foodie tour group and then was able to secure a private tour. The private was great but after seeing the group cross us in a few locations, that would have also been great. The guides were safe and really cared about us and our experience. Their English was amazing. The food was best we’ve had in our 2 week trip in vietnam and a healthy mix of local items which included desert.

Also booking process was simple and the emails were quick with strong English skills so there was never any misunderstanding. After having exchanged emails with several 5 star hotel concierges I can say this was the easiest.

Highly recommend. It’s no surprise why Forbes includes XO in their top 9 food tours in the world.

Great Way To See The Sights In Saigon - I always do a few tours whenever I travel to a new location in the world, so we decided to do a See Saigon tour by motorbike, and are glad that we did. I would highly recommend paying the extra few dollars and doing a private tour. Our two motorbike drivers (Kim and Chau) were fantastic, as was our tour guide Vu. We really enjoyed getting around the City by motorbike (which is really the only way to get around the City easily), which gave us a real feel for the City. Kim and Chau met us at our hotel, and away we went to various locations around the City. At each location we were met by Vu, our tour guide, who had a wealth of information. Best of all was the personal touch Kim, Chau and Vu gave. By the end of the tour we felt we had met three new friends in Vietnam, and not just some tour guides. We had such a good time we booked another tour called Saigon By Night. The tour was fantastic and I would recommend it when coming to Saigon.
Saigon HCMC on a scooter - Great insights into Saigon HCMC, I loved the story telling. A perfectly paced tour, with drink and toilet stops and felt super safe. A must do!

The Highlight of Our Stay - Indeed, our tour with the wonderful ladies at XO Tours was the highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. As all of the other reviews state, the ladies are smart, friendly, have a great grasp of English, and are excellent scooter drivers to boot!

My husband and I participated in the Saigon by Night tour, and as a result, we were given an inside look at how locals live their lives in Ho Chi Minh City. We met our hosts in District 1 and then hopped on back of our scooters for an exhilarating ride to Chinatown, where we experienced the bustling night market. We then rode to District 10 for dinner which consisted of four street food dishes (the banh xeo was my favorite!). After dinner, Nhu led us on a tour of the oldest apartment complex in District 10. She emphasized that despite the relative poverty of the residents in the building, what they lacked in wealth was more than made up for by the close-knit community—the residents all know each other and regularly help each other in times of need. I was greatly made aware of all the privileges I have from being born in the United States, but Nhu cautioned us against feeling sorry for the residents. The residents don’t see their lives as something to pity, so such sentiment is unwelcome and rather condescending. While touring the apartment complex, we were privileged to meet Uncle T, who is the uncle of one of the co-founders of XO tours. He graciously invited us into his home, and we even got to meet his two cats. After departing from Uncle T’s home, we had another wild ride to district 4 for dessert.

The wonderful ladies of XO tours made sure that we were safe and comfortable at all times. Between my husband and I, we have allergies to nuts, dairy, and eggs; plus, I don’t eat red or white meat. Our food restrictions, though, we’re not at all a problem. We were accommodated easily, and we had a wonderful meal!

Most of all, we were touched by the ladies’ generous spirit and genuine desire to share their culture. As my husband remarked afterward, the tour had a lot of heart and soul. To anyone reading this too long review, I highly recommend that you book a tour with XO tours. Not only will you experience an inside look at Saigon, but you will be supporting a woman-owned and operated business.

The Best Food Tour! - This is by far the best food tour we have ever done. We actually did this tour 8 years ago when we were last in HCMC and we enjoyed it so much we decided to do it again during our recent visit. It did not disappoint. Knowing that we were return customers, Vu and our wonderful drivers went out of their way to make the tour unique. The food was fantastic, the beer flowed and riding on back of scooters in HCMC traffic was quite an experience! We always recommend this trip to friends visiting Vietnam and will continue to do so. Thank you!

Outstanding tour with XO! - We did the XO Foodie tour and would resoundingly recommend this to any traveler to Saigon. The entire experience was organized, seamless, and well-designed. Aspects we specifically liked:

1. Spaced out food stops: A potential pitfall of food tours is getting too full but XO cleverly avoided this but alternating eating with ~1 hour between each restaurant for sight-seeing (see below). They also fed us the more unique dishes, e.g., not Pho or Banh Mis

2. Unique sight-seeing: We visited less-travelled districts (Quan 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8) and were able to learn more about the culture and dynamics of Vietnam as it evolves as a country (as opposed to isolated facts)

3. Thoughtful guest experience: Having Hong take care of all picture taking, mixing up the activities (we played some fun games as a group), having body-guards that allowed our personal guides to focus on us, and keeping the same guide for the entire tour created an environment that was extremely relaxing and allowed us to make the most of the tour for ourselves. Additionally, being on a motorbike gives you an authentic Vietnam experience!

Special shout-outs to Hong as our tour leader and Minh Thu and Thang as our personal guides for being so warm, inclusive, and informative. We were sad to see the tour and our time with them come to an end!

Best tour for newbies to Saigon! - I did the XO Foodie tour and the XO Saigon by day tour and thoroughly enjoyed both. For the Foodie tour, it's a great way to see districts outside of district 1 and try delicious, authentic Vietnamese food other than banh mi and pho. For the day tour, I found it to be very insightful and I learnt so much about Vietnam's history and culture.

Highly recommend both tours for first timers to Saigon!

Thank you so much to Van, Nao (pronounced now!) and Sang!

Highlight of Saigon! - Tour leader Linh was super friendly and our personal guides were both super personable and warm. So fun getting to zoom around Saigon at night and try local cuisine! Highly recommended

Fabulous night out. - This is the most fun tour in Saigon. Whizzing around on scooters driven by beautiful and smart young women, all of who speak good English and are keen to show off their city, all dressed in traditional Ao Dai: what's not to love? The food was really interesting and good, the places out of the way and interesting, the rides to get there terrifying and exhilarating. You need some bottle to get on the back of the bike but once underway, it is so much fun. We are well past 60 and my partner loved every minute of it too - and they catered for her easily as a vegetarian. The girls are charming university students mostly, so you get a chance to find out how life is for them and their families - really great to be able to talk for long periods with them.

Fabulous - We had a fabulous time with our tour group and the XO ladies on our food tour! They were very organized, bright, pleasant and really helped you understand the culture and food. It was wonderful to buzz around the city and feel safe too. Really enjoyed our time, well worth it,

Wonderful tour! Even for people who don't like tours! - My family of three (parents and one 9 year old) enjoyed this tour so much! Even more than we thought we would! We've never been to Saigon, usually like to find our own way around cities, and had a lot of special requests. A vegan, a kid, and an adventuring eater were all so happy with this tour. It was incredibly well organized and made it so easy to see many parts of the city. After a day of dodging scooter traffic in Saigon it was super fun to ride on the back of scooters. I wasn't sure how my son would do riding with a stranger and no parents, but he loved it! Tour guides were knowledgable and excellent English-speakers, but also super funny and able to explain a lot of things about Saigon we found puzzling. How can there be so many cafes?! Days later we're still quoting what each guide told us to each other!

Also, I had read closely and known there would be a few games and that they would take photographs I would've thought that was silly, but it was actually super fun! I also appreciated the light girl power vibe! This tour group really has an excellent experience to offer.

Fantastic tour! You won’t regret it!!! - We enjoyed the night foodie tour with XO so much! They picked us up from our hotel and gave us a city tour while also making sure we ate our fill of local dishes! The ladies were phenomenal- they made us feel so comfortable and we spent the entire tour laughing and conversing about almost everything! The 3 restaurants we visited were off the wall, truly local places that allowed us to feel apart of the “real” Ho Chi Minh culture! We also visited two other districts where we learned about local culture and politics. This tour was beyond perfect and I can’t recommend it enough. One of the top experiences from our time in HCMC!

Highly recommend XO tours!!! - This tour was very organized and the girls went above and beyond!! We had so much fun on the scooters and it’s a great way to see the city. The food was fantastic. We went with this company because they provide insurance for the rides. We loved that it was a female led company as well!! Highly recommend if you are visiting!!! It will exceed your expectations.

The XO Tour was so much more than expected! - This tour is was so much more than I expected. On the back of a motorbike, not only did we get to taste and experience the street food of Saigon, but we toured almost the entire city! It was a blast!

I got to see and learn about parts of Saigon outside District 1 that I never would have visited otherwise.

The staff is fantastic and I was impressed by how efficiently the tour is run. Clearly Hong Tong, founder and tour leader of XO tours, knows what she is doing after 11 years in business. The ladies guided our group of 6 around the chaotic streets of Saigon and at every stop whether for food or to visit a particular area of town, there were 6 guys to meet us, park the bikes and make sure everything ran smoothly.

I highly recommend XO tours for an unforgettable food and history tour of Saigon. It was a highlight of our month long visit to Vietnam.

Amazing Foodie tour!!! - We had a fantastic and memorable time on the Foodie night tour. The girls were so friendly and helpful, great riders and felt safe all the time. Food was amazing with a variety offered.we got to see places of Ho Chi Minh we would never have seen on our own. Highly recommended for all ages.

Professional, fun and tasty...the best tour - The whole trip was fabulous! Professional, fun, informative and tasty
I was initially worried about the motorbikes....but the women are safe and confident drivers a d I had a blast

Exceptional in every way! - We did the evening food tour.
This female owned and managed company provides probably the best tour we have done in our travels. Our experience was amazing and I think that would be the general consensus. Not only have they managed to attract exceptionally friendly and smart employees who ride scooters like nobody's business, they have found wonderful food outlets who represent Vietnamese cuisine authentically and deliciously. Everyone on our tour, from all over the place, had a great time together!
Finally, I have to say that the value for money on this tour is insane! So much great food and drinks with interesting fun and knowledgeable people - I think an evening like this is priceless!
Don't miss out!

Fun, excellent and interesting tour - Took the Saigon@Night tour and it was terrific! The women who run this trip (it’s a women-owned and all women drivers) are not only knowledgeable but they are sweet and their English is excellent!!! Really fun way to tour this big and busy city. We went to a night market, had dinner and saw the recasting alphabetic public housing learning the history of the building we see today.

Perfect night tour of Saigon & great food! - My partner and I enjoyed the Saigon by Night tour - all of the tour guides were fantastic. Very friendly and knowledgeable of the fun local areas we went to - particularly Vu, Ann and Van.
We ate some incredible foods and got a really humble insight into how people of Saigon live.
Would most certainly recommend to everyone!
Such a great way to see the city

Great experience - Friendly tour guides, very informative and great energy, made the whole tour very enjoyable, surprised my girlfriend with a birthday cake as it was a tour for her birthday. Recommend this tour for a great experience when in Saigon.

XO Scooter Tours - An unforgettable way to experience HCMC - Our Saigon by Night XO Scooter Tour was the highlight of our stay in HCMC! From pick up to drop off the evening with Nhi, Ngoc, Lam, Thu and Nguyen will be a night we will continue to talk of, and remember fondly for years to come.
Experiencing the city from the back of the scooters, as the team transported us expertly through the streets was an amazing way to feel a part of this wonderful city. The tour took us from the busy streets of District 1, as people streamed by finished with work for the day, to the highway traffic, to wind our way through small alleyways, we truly felt like we saw it all.
We enjoyed the cultural aspect as well, with Nhi taking us to an authentic apartment block in District 10, to explain and show us how the people live.
Dinner at Thao Vy Banhxeo was scrumptious! Our new friends expertly prepare the various dishes for us and explain how to eat them and what they contain. Our final stop of the tour was for dessert in District 4, in a hidden food market. The team really went over and above producing a birthday cake for my daughter, who was celebrating her 15th birthday!
All too soon the 3 and a half hours had flown by and with a heavy heart we were making our way back to District 1 to say goodbye to our new friends. This was an incredible experience with an amazing group of young ladies showing us the city 🛵 I wish we could do it all over again.

All thumbs up…Fantastic tour, enjoyed all of it! - XO Tours was fantastic. It was the highlight of my stay in Saigon/Ho Chi Min City. My driver was great…our hostess was perfect. I was able to see parts of the city that I would not have otherwise been able to see. Definitely make XO Tours part of your trip!

The BEST food tour in Saigon! - The beautiful ladies at XO tours took my partner and I on the most amazing food tour in Ho Chi Minh! They went above and beyond for our enjoyment and had such a personable touch to the experience. We highly recommend XO tours to anyone looking to explore Vietnamese food in Ho Chi Minh. We had the best night of our whole Vietnam journey with these lovely women. 10/10!
Thank you XO! From India

A great scooter tour - This was a really fun tour - the best thing we did in the city. Our guides were lovely, and you feel very safe. The food was abundant and a good variety. The best part for us was being on the scooter and chatting with the guides. You go to many districts and the karaoke is like no other!

You should take this tour! - Great experience. The drivers were lovely and very kind . Saw parts of Saigon that a regular tourist wouldn't normally see . Food was very good and abundant. Highly Recommended! The motorbike ride is an experience not to be missed. Very safe and great fun!

Best way to experience the city in one night. - The young lady tourist guides are great on the scooter, I had a blast riding around town, safer than walking!!They're so much fun and we chatted away. Don't forget to get the video.

A must if you visit HCM - This was my second time going on the foodie tours (first time in 2019) and I would recommend this to every single person visiting HCM. This was the best way to experience the many districts, and different types of food! Also, the tour guides are the friendliest & kindest women. They were extremely knowledgeable, great drivers and made the experience overall so incredible.

I will do this again every time I visit & will also try their other tours!

The best food tour! - Fantastic food tour of Saigon. The guides were absolutely were very friendly and accomodating to any requests. Great opportunity to see some more local districts as well. Couldn't recommend more!

An exhilarating and tasty tour - don't miss! - This is fantastic and exhilarating tour that we are so glad we booked on. Our drivers, Hua and Thien, were fabulous. Friendly, safe and knowledgeable and really gave us an insight into Saigon life. The stops for food (all delicious) and visits, well, we would never have gone to ANY on our own, or probably ventured out of district 1. It was super fun, eye opening and a delicious evening that was professionally run but first and foremost lots of fun!

Zip around the city like a local - XO tours was an early highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. The guides are friendly, caring, and knowledgeable. The food is delicious and authentic. Couldn't recommend enough.

We had a fantastic time! What a marvelous memory! - The ladies were very organized, polite, professional and spoke very good English.
The food was nice, yum and in varieties.
I am a Vietnamese origin (Viet Kieu), but I still find the trip exciting, amazing and wanted to go again...

This XO food tour is a good way to see Sai Gon by night as well!

Super fun evening out - We had a blast! After seeing the traffic in HCMC, I was a bit nervous about getting on a scooter. The young women were excellent drivers and very safety conscious. They took us away from the crowds of tourists and out of District One. The tour was a perfect balance of tasting interesting foods, seeing different districts of HCMC and learning about the characteristics of each. The food was excellent. Each restaurant and the dishes they served were unique. Our hosts were lovely, warm welcoming and very professional. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.
We are active 60+ year olds. HCMC was our first stop in Vietnam. The XO scooter ride had the added benefit of giving us the confidence to cycle in Can Tho in the Mekong Delta, hop on the back of scooters in Hoi An and cross the busy streets of Hanoi. Another added benefit is that they refer us to the best cooking school in Hoi An - The Green Bamboo. Simply the best.

Very organized, very interesting tour and informative.Friendly and professional.Great food and very entertaining. - The xo team were very professional and happy to explain things along the way. The tour was well executed, the food was great and the service was excellent.

Amazing tour - We are a family of 4 (including our 8-year-old boy) that did the evening food tour and loved every second of it. What an amazing way to see Saigon and all the stops were excellent and for just the right amount of time. We all agreed it was the best tour we did while in Vietnam. The girls who took us were wonderful and it was great riding around and conversing with them about Vietnam and other things. They even surprised our 8-year-old boy (and us) by bringing out a cake and singing him happy birthday at the last stop!
Fun, tasty, interesting, professional - It was fun, interesting and with a lot of nice food to taste, the moto trip was safe and fun as well. I highly recommend it
Awesome tour - Great way to experience Vietnam's local night-life and meet other travelers. Staff were extremely friendly and fluent

Best food tour in Ho Chi Minh City! - Tom and I had a wonderful time with XO tours! It's more expensive than the other tours but it is 100% worth it! Lam and Nam/Nora were excellent hosts and this was one of the best run tours I've ever taken. Every detail was perfectly planned with special spots in a wide variety of districts with of course, delicious foods along the way 😁 Would highly recommend for those who appreciate food and want to invest their time in understanding the city.

Surprising and Genuine experience in Saigon - We booked this tour on our first day expecting a good introduction of Saigon's street food and culture. What we got is more than that. A genuine experience of Vietnamese food and also the realities of their lives. The tour guides are so friendly and eager to talk and connect. At the end of the tour they also provided detailed recipes of some of the tour's dishes which I am very grateful. Overall the experience is a hi light of our trip to Saigon and solidified our decision to return and see more of Vietnam!

Highly recommended tour! - Didn't know what to expect from the tour as motorbike congestion can be tricky in Saigon. The guides were very safe conscious and were very accommodating. The tour itself was fantastic as we got to explore areas of Saigon that we would not have seen if not for the tour. The food was amazing as they really catered to our tastes and feedback. Can't say enough of our guides, Ngoc and Vee. They were awesome and created such a memorable experience for us. Overall…great experience, great value, and very memorable! Can't wait to visit and book another tour.

Delicious Food Off the Beaten Path and Support Women Run Business! - One of Highlights of my trip to Vietnam!

Let me start by saying I’m not a tour kind of person. I’m a solo, independent experienced world traveler. I love going at my own pace and discovering local gems on my own but the XO tour was one my favorite experiences in Vietnam!

We had delicious dishes that I haven’t seen before, it was such a treat to have my taste buds invigorated by new unique dishes.
I was all pho, bun cha, ban xeo, cao Lao, bahn me’d out- thankfully XO tour doesn’t serve those dishes (they’re all delicious but after 3 weeks in Vietnam I was craving something new)

Yes, it’s pricier than other Foodie Tour cause it’s worth every penny. You have 1 XO female guide per person who will pick you up and drop you off at your hotel on a motor bike and bring you to the restaurants as well explain as instruct you on the local delicacies, there is a support team of male “bodyguards”who will keep vendors from trying to sell to the tour group (after pushy street vendors going into restaurants in Hoi An trying to diners items this was so welcomed) who travel with us as our our tail in case there’s any issues with motorbikes/on the road so we wouldn’t be stranded, We went to local places where we were the only tourists. XO takes you off the beaten tourist path.

Our guides speak fluent English are so personable and welcoming. Ann was my XO guide and Nhi our tour leader and these ladies are wonderful. I felt safer on the back of Ann’s motorbike in the pouring rain then I did trying to cross the street in Shanghai. Locals drive their motorbikes in the rain every day and the XO ladies handle their bikes super well.

Oh and you’ll be supporting a business with all female tour guides. Most Vietnam tour companies in general discriminate against female tour guides thinking women will eventually leave to start families so they’ll prefer to hire men and that shuts out women from jobs. Not XO!

Joie de Vie - XO tours showed me the fun and happy side of Saigon.
I was hesitant about going on a scooter tour, until I learned about the drivers training regime. It is one month long and they have to pass 2 tests. I never doubted my guide on the bike or at the restaurants.
I enjoyed the night food tour so much that I signed up for the Saigon by night tour the next day.

Highly recommended and did not disappoint - I did the night food tour. This tour was highly recommended by many friends so I decided to book and it did not disappoint. Not only did you get to try multiple dishes of not so common foods, you drove around on the back of a scooter allowing you to see and lean about different areas of Siagnon, walk through a market, learn a bit about the culture, quite much had a personal guide while also on a group tour where you had the opportunity to chat to others and meet new people while enjoying great food and having a laugh. All staff were so lovely and we were all taken care of. Special mention to my driver Hoa! (Yes I remember your name….eventually)! Thankyou all so much

Fantastic Team Building Trip! - The entire tour, from booking experience and of course the tour itself was top class. It is such unique way to see Saigon and experience other parts of the city. I would recommend to both residents and visitors.

Great food tour on motorcycle, good food and culture - Just done with the tour, and it was great. The food is good. Thank you Vu & Hong and the team.

I am not going to say much about the tour better (better call them), but whether you are solo traveler or a group of friends, you will have a great time. I think we traveled to China town, Phu My Hung, district 7,8,4 ...

The only requirement is that you can sit on the motorbike and be driven by a pretty lady without loosing your ego :)

i enjoyed meeting other travelers besides the food.

Thank you the XO team.

Highly recommend

So Much More Than a Food Tour - I was born in Vietnam and appreciate the regional diversity of Vietnamese food. I recently experienced the XO Foodie Tour while in Saigon and not only was the food excellent but the tour was so much fun. The team took care of all the logistics and the communications before the tour - efficient and easy.

Our tour guides arrived via scooter to pick us up at our hotel and took us to multiple districts to taste culinary specialties such as wonderfully seasoned BBQ, complex noodle soups, fresh rolls, and outstanding seafood. I also appreciated the tour to a few of the markets to learn about the different seafood and produce in season. There were also some fun and easy games.

So much more than a food tour - If I was living here, owned a scooter, and knew of all these great dining spots across this large city, perhaps I could do this on my own - but when visiting Saigon this is an awesome way to see the city at night, meet fellow tour participants, taste high quality authentic food, and learn about Saigon life all in one fun evening! I highly recommend the XO Foodie Tour the next time you visit Saigon!

Highly informed, valuable valuable experience - Big fan of this tour operator. Done the Saigon sights and sounds tour. Very warm and professional guides. With topics expertly narrated. Leave me with plenty to ponder also.

XO obviously has a wealth of experience running tours and operates at the highest level in this area.

Felt comfortable with their content, professionalism and safety aspects. Something a smaller operator wouldn't have is the multiple support staff on hand to run around to ensure smooth sailing.

Would 100% recommend and book again.

Hands down, the absolute highlight of our trip! - This wasn't just your regular old food tour, this was an eye opening cultural experience. We left this tour feeling so grateful and happy that we got to experience something so different.

If you want to try some delicious Vietnamese food but you also have an interest to understand the culture and see how Vietnamese people live and survive, this is the tour for you!

We were taken through the city on the back of the bikes, shown the local markets and districts, and were fed with the most amazing food. The true highlight of this tour though, was being taken into a local home and having the immense opportunity to meet said locals and chat with them and be with them in their home.

Our guides Ngoc and Anh were absolutely hands down amazing. They were so refreshing and sweet, they answered so many questions and and really let us into their lives and shared some personal experiences. Their knowledge of the area is fantastic and they made us feel completely safe on the bike.

I really couldn't recommend this tour enough, and I hope that when you do it you also get Ngoc and Anh! 🤩

Thanks XO!

MUST DO! - Before my trip to Vietnam, my uncle had told me that I HAD TO do the XO foodie tour, and I am so happy that he recommended it to us.

- Communication from the moment I booked was excellent. I was asked to provide any food allergies or dislikes, which were noted and accommodated on the evening.

- Safety was great. I felt incredibly safe the whole time with my guide by my side. Plus we had security for the whole group, and the cost of the trip includes insurance. Our guides took us through how to safely get on and off the bikes, too.

- My guide Hoang was so much fun! I want her to be my best friend, and sing karaoke with me every night! 😂 She made me feel so so welcome and safe, and made sure I had enough food and drink the whole evening. She also had so many interesting facts to tell me throughout the tour.

- V was my fiance's guide, and was also super friendly and informative. She made sure he was looked after too and also had a lot of info

- Linh was the group leader, and she was amazing. She was so on top of things and made sure everyone's food requirements were met. She even made sure a few of our meals were modified to accommodate our preferences. She has a wealth of knowledge!

- The tour was organised and ran so well. They really thought of everything, and it made the whole experience so much better

- Unlike walking food tours, the girls took us to so many different districts, which allowed us to see so much more of the city.

- Finally, the girls arranged a surprise birthday cake for my partner, which was SO sweet and a great surprise.

I cannot explain how amazing this tour is. If you can only do one thing in Saigon, do this tour! Worth every penny.

Thank you so much to the girls for an unforgettable experience. Special shout outs to Hoang, V, Now and Linh ❤️

Thanks for a great time! - Foodie Tour: friendly, capable, English-speaking guides really made the tour a safe, easy and enjoyable evening out. Learned a lot about Saigon and had a blast zooming across the differenr Disrricts. Wife and I had a good time, despite the rain. They provided rain gear and made accommodations so that the tour could continue safely. Great job! Would highly recommend.

Super Saigon Food and more tour! - Pick up at the hotel bij Hang2, a perfect englisch speaking girl who drove me to the rest of the group. In Lin we found a very good guide who told a lot about the bit of the beaten track places ghey took us. Food was gooed, great way to enjoy Saigon! Keep it up girlz!! Regards Robert

Great food tour! - So I've done a ton of food tours and I have some experience with them. The girls were great and the tour was fantastic - good food, good guides and the scooter allowed us to go to all parts of Saigon. Overall I think was a good tour. Maybe not the best but definitely a good one!

The only real way to experience Saigon! - I saw the video on YouTube (on What the Pho) of how Hong started XO Tours and was so inspired I had to book the tour immediately. It was great to see Saigon as the locals do. I thought the motorbike would be kind of scary but it wasn't at all as traffic just seemed to go with the flow. My driver and guide Hang spoke excellent English and was an excellent guide! Totally enjoyed the experience!!

Great way to get a better feel for Saigon and see the city with a very friendly team of guides - Really loved the Saigon by night tour. It took me to a number of places that I would not have known to visit so we got to see a few interesting sides to the city and try some great food. Alongside the food, the highlight for me was exploring a Vietnamese apartment block and seeing one of the apartments which gave a good feel of how some of the locals live. Felt very safe on the bike with my driver Duyen, who along with Linh and the rest of the team was very friendly and helpful with answering any questions. Thanks XO!

Saigon by night tour.. in very safe hands! - What an awesome experience. We were both nervous of getting on the motorcycles but both girls were fabulously reassuring and wonderful in making us feel safe and looked after. The tour was the highlight of our trip - we were given the opportunity to experience food, culture and a home life of a local Vietnamese citizen. It couldn't have been more perfect for our need. The information shared was given in detail and with sensitivity- it was so good!

Amazing tour - a must-do! - My husband and I just did this tour today. It was so good I'm writing this review on the same night! Originally I was skeptical of the price as this is a more expensive package for a tour in Vietnam but it was definitely worth it for the experience!!!

We had Minh Nhu and Truc Phuong as our drivers. These girls were absolutely amazing!!! They were very friendly, kind, entertaining, chatty and kept the whole tour so fun. Mind you they didn't even once ask us to leave them a review, this was all me actively taking their names down as I truly felt their hard work and care needed to be recognized. They guaranteed at all times we were well taken care of. Thank you both - you made this tour so great for us!

Now onto the food - we tried so many dishes we otherwise wouldn't have had the opportunity to try - many local dishes! My husband is vegetarian and they ensure he always gets to try different vegetarian dishes, and there was always more than enough which we really appreciate.

The tour is very smartly planned out - between the meals, the girls drive you to different parts of saigon and give you some history of the place. These places we again definitely wouldn't have seen had we not been on this tour as it's in different districts - most of which most tourists wouldn't even think to go. It also allowed us to digest the food from the previous place and gave us enough time to work up our appetite again.

Thank you for a very well organized tour - great food and great company. It's been one of the best activities of our trip so far! A special thank you to our tour guides - Minh Nhu (my driver), Truc Phuong (my husband's driver) and Linh Troung (the tour leader).

Shahana & Sachin

Amazing Experience! - This is an amazing experience! We did a motorbike tour around Ho Chi Minh City and it was so worth it! The guides are super knowledgable and friendly and we had a great time. If you are in Ho Chi Minh City and thinking about doing a motorbike tour, this is the one to do.

Best foodie tour ever! - Taking the XO Foodie tour with my daughter was the first thing we did on arrival into HCMC. It was truly amazing and I would highly recommend it to anyone. We toured various districts and appreciated the food most preferred by locals. The education we received from our wonderful guides V and Rosa was so interesting. It sets us up for the rest of our travels as we could now be confident in ordering street food. The evening was so much fun and I was surprised how comfortable we were on the back of the scooters in rush hour traffic. We will do it all over again! We also have some terrific photos that were sent to us soon after so we could truly enjoy the night without having to be taking our own. Just fabulous.
XO Cultural Tour - We had a fabulous, informative, fun night with XO Tours. Linh and Chao were wonderful guides and showed us their city with grace and style.

Really Fun Tour! - I did the XO Foodie Tour and it was really fun! They picked you up on a moped around 5:30pm and you go to three different restaurants and two touristy areas before getting dropped back at your hotel around 11pm. The food was all really good! We had different kinds of BBQ, bon bo hue and a lot of seafood. The drivers are all really friendly and very good drivers, I always feel stable on the moped and you chat with the drivers while you are riding in between locations. It's a really fun tour! Highly recommended!
Take the XO Tour - What a great team at XO! Kind, informative, hospitable, safe and all around fun gals! We had a wonderful tour and highly recommend :)

XO Foodie Tour - Had an incredible experience with XO tours. Riding around in Saigon on the back of a motor bike gives you a totally different experience and words can't express how much fun it is. More importantly, I felt really safe riding around in the crazy traffic. Culture shock for me how different the roads are compared to America. The tour leader Linh does a great job explaining what's going on at each stop. You get to try a variety of different Vietnamese cuisine. I also appreciate that it was things that tourists don't usually try. My tour guide Lahm (I hope I spelled that right) was a pleasant host showing me around and was very engaged with me throughout the tour and answered all my questions.

All in all, a fantastic time and if you are in Saigon and thinking about booking a motor bike tour. I don't think you can do much better than XO.

Get amongst the traffic and learn a lot about Saigon! - Even though I have been to HCM City a few times this was a great way to learn new things and have an entirely different experience. Sang was a great storyteller. Very professional, informative and passionate about his knowledge. Vy was my wonderful driver and she looked after me and was entertaining and respectful as well as being a delightful, yet safe driver. I recommend this tour for both first timers and seasoned visitors as it gives you a unique perspective and a great historical snapshot. XO Tours are very professional, safe and provide an overall wonderful experience. I would be happy to go again!

XO night food tour - Great experience eating the foods and seeing the different districts from a local's perspective! The all female motorbike drivers and team leader were great and personable! We can see why they're highly rated. If you're looking for a fun and unique food tour experience, we highly recommend booking with XO!

Day tour in HCMC - Great experience.
The day began when the young lady was waiting for my our my Airbnb apartment.
When we reached the meeting point, I realized I was the only one.
The tour guide was very knowledgable, I was brought to places which was less visited.
The bike lady was very nice and she made sure I was safe when riding with her.
I would recommend to join the night foodie adventure.

Saigon night scooter tour 🛵 - This tour was outstanding : I've been to Saigon 4 times & by far this is the best tour 👌 I did the Saigon by night scooter tour & it had a bit of everything : insight into Vietnamese life was amazing , the look at Aunty Mai's apartment was interesting & very humbling : the street food was delicious & more than enough : the insight from the sweet Linh was excellent & scooting around Saigon was so fun😀 & I felt safe . You really must include this tour on your planner: it was 👍👍👍, a must do!

Not to be missed HCMC learning experience - I can't say enough about how much I enjoyed such tour. A fun introduction to food, life, and culture of HCMC. The people running are so very organized, welcoming, entertaining, and knowledgable.
Excellent tour! - I had a great time on the saigon by night tour!! I really would highly recommend it. The food was excellent and my tour guide Nhi Dao was amazing.

Best time ever! Lots of yummy food - I had the best time!! I was staying in a hostel and was picked up by Thu . Then we rode to a nearby restaurant and met the rest of the group. She made it so much fun! It ended up pouring rain for probably a solid hour and she had the poncho's ready and it was still so much fun maybe even more because of the rain. We were introduced to so much amazing food and she helped me figure out where to get custard apple because that fruit turned out to be my favorite ever. We won a chopsticks game, and we were all taken to different districts in Saigon thought the night. I think we started at 530 pm and ended around 10pm . Thu and I had great conversations and were friends now. Next time I come back to vn were going to actually hang out outside of a tour so that's how you know the tour is amazing when you also make an actual new friend. Yeah if you can request a person to be your guide/driver ask for her !!

Best tour in Saigon! - Absolutely amazing bike/food tour. Great way to try some lesser known Vietnamese dishes. Tour guides are all knowledgeable, friendly and safe drivers. Well worth the price, very professional from start to finish. My guide was Vy3 and she was awesome!

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - This is an absolute must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! There's nothing like seeing the city from the back of a motorbike, just like the locals do- it's exhilarating and really gets you deep into the heartbeat of the city. This is definitely not your air-conditioned mega-bus and that is exactly the point. The girls driving the bikes were so friendly and welcoming, and I felt so safe in their hands. They expertly navigated the crazy traffic and always made sure I was doing okay. In addition to the tour guide, Sang, who was so knowledgeable and so proud of his culture and city, they were also fantastic friends for the day. This was an unforgettable way to see so many things as a solo traveler in just half a day- what a highlight!
Highly Recommended - The best time ever in my life. They were very cooperative and friendly. I cannot forget in my entire life.

Amazing tour and excellent guides - You absolutely have to do this. I signed up for the food which was amazing.. local and authentic.. but the scooter ride through Saigon was just as awesome. Was a little nervous at first about the traffic but it was perfectly safe and the guides / drivers did a great job with everything. Very safe, knowledgeable about the food and culture. Everyone was professional and friendly and just fun to be around. An outstanding experience.
Best tour in Saigon - the best and most authentic way to get to know the city. Bike girls are super nice, the tour guide hat a lot of knowledge. It was a 10 experience, highly recommended!
So Much Fun - So Much Fun. An experience never to be forgotten. Great Guides. Felt very safe. Great food stops. Not just for the young. I am 73 and had a great time.

Tour unlike any other - An absolute must do if you are new to HCM. Excellent guides and riders taking care of your well being, safety, knowledge and history of various districts, the food culture (very tasty and safe food) of HCM. Michelin star worthy experience and 3 course meals served in a very unique method. Local flavor at its best. Loved it and very well organized and punctual. Excellent team they have and great communication and language skills. Good sense of humour. Cant think of anything that they can further improve on to be honest.

Excellent way to get around HCM and sample new dishes - I highly recommend this tour if you want to experience different dishes rather than your usual pho, banh mi and spring rolls. The tour was informative and the ladies were very nice.

Great Experience - I highly recommend XO, the ladies are so kind, knowledgeable, and can't do enough for you to make your experience perfect. The evening was so much fun. This is the best way to see the city on a scooter without having to drive yourself. The stops were well thought out and the opportunity to try lots of local food was fabulous. All the ladies speak excellent English. We felt well cared for and very safe in their capable hands!!

Best food tour ever! - An incredible finale to our last night in Saigon!
Seeing the traffic there at first made me a little nervous about getting on a motorbike, but our drivers made us feel at ease immediately with the instructions they gave and how careful/slow they drove. It became one of the most exhilarating parts of the tour and added extra depth to our experience-being ability to zip through the city (as locals do) and learn about parts of the city that we would've never experienced otherwise.
Everything was perfectly planned and organized-from how they spaced out the dishes to the places we stopped at and the education that was provided.
I had already known I would enjoy the tour based on everything my friend had told me but I was surprised at how much I LOVED it. My boyfriend and my experiences were further enriched by our drivers Nhu and Trang who were so attentive to us and so easy to talk to. We couldn't have asked for better tour guides.

A well deserved tour of its 5 star rating. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Great experience with XO tours - Brilliant safe and educational with great food and conversation with the professional team at XO. The team provided a safe journey around the various districts in Saigon along with different food experiences along the way. Highly recommend this tour

Fantastic, informative and fun! - What a fabulous tour we had. The drivers Hoa and Hung were superb. Excellent not only at driving but very informative and funny as well. The tour takes you to places that you wouldn't normally see if you stay in District 1 and gives you an insight to everyday life in the city. If you are planning a visit to Ho Chi Minh, I can thoroughly recommend this professional tour operator and all the lovely staff they employ. Go on, do a tour, you won't regret it.
I don't work for this company, I'm just a tourist so don't think I'm trying to give them a great review in return for something, just look at the other reviews.

Foodie tour - Had such a good evening with this tour eating amazing food and was a great way to see bits of Ho Chi Minh city and it's different districts which we otherwise wouldn't have seen. All the guides were lovely and would definitely recommend this tour as a must for anyone visiting the city.

The best of the best tour in Saigon!!! - Tour was well planned and executed as advertised. Beautiful lady tour guides spoke perfect English and were excellent safe drivers. We learned many things about the city and people of Saigon. I cannot recommend XO tours highly enough. On a scale of 1-10, they are a 10+. Even their motorbike's were spotless and in excellent shape. I must give a special thanks to V and Cho our special guides for going above and beyond what we expected. We hope to see you again on our next trip in May. Stay safe till then.

Mike Brown
Deputy_7@yahoo.com
Florida, USA

Precious off tracks tour with the best team - What a magnificent tour we had !
Thanks to Nhi Dau who is a wonderful guide, such professional and enthusiastic and to her amazing team of drivers, who are really nice and driving carefully while talking to you in Saigon's traffic.
In a few hours we could discover off tracks corners of Saigon, very nice food and also a neighborhood and part of history we would have clearly missed without this tour. We are really glad we had this glimpse of the city and Vietnam.
Thank you XO tours! Giulia & Marion

XO Foodie tour at night - It was our first night in Saigon and these lovely Ladies brought us to one of the best restaurants around town. Seeing the city of Saigon come alive at night while riding motorbikes is one of the most unique and great experiences we have had. 5 stars and would recommend every time. Thank you for our tour guides Hang, Thu and Lam.

Great motobike food tour with XO in Ho Chi Minh City - We had a great time on our XO food tour by motobike. The guides could tell us a lot, their English was good and they showed us many different districts. We also had a variation of Vietnamese dishes on three spots. Our guides were really capable motorbike drivers and the group of 9 tourists were nice.

XO is A+ - I had the good fortune to take two Tours with XO Tours in Saigon and they were exceptionally great. My first was the evening food tour and everything about it was perfect. My Driver V3, as they have three ladies named V showed up at my hotel a few minutes early, spoke perfect English and we left promptly to meet up with the others. Every food stop was well orchestrated and the food was delicious. The second tour was the morning sightseeing tour and my driver Hang was also very punctual. We met up with Sang at Book Street, near the post office opposite Norte Dame Cathedral. It was just the three of us and to my good fortune, I was the only one that had booked the tour that day. For me, this was the best tour of Saigon I could have imagined. Hang and Sang were professional and very knowledgeable about this amazing city and spoke English perfectly. I loved this tour and recommend you support this wonderful company that directly supports Vietnamese Women and Men.

Fun! - Really enjoyed the foodie tour!
It was a fun way to spend an evening! It felt very safe on the motorbike and the girl-drivers are so friendly and chatty and speak amazing English. The driver you are assigned really looks after you.
We had great food in the form of soup, bbq meat and other bits like some tofu I really liked, seafood and dessert - in 3 different places. Definitely a lot of food and very tasty. We also had other stops without food to visit some areas like Chinatown (market) and a modern area just to show us another side of the city. The price of the tour is not exactly cheap but I felt it was adequate because there really is a lot going on, it lasts several hours, and it is well planned out, professional and safe.

At some of the food places, I would have liked more time to chat and chill, but I understand we had a schedule and it wasn't like too rushed or anything. At some point we also played some games, not something I generally love but it wasn't too many games or too difficult so it was only a small thing and I appreciate that they even thought of ways to entertain their guests.

Overall, I liked the way it was all thought through and how strongly the group leader felt about the point of empowering women through this job, among other things (as a solo female traveler, I get the importance of the topic!).

Go girls! - An amazing way to discover districts of HCMC you will never visit on your own! The girls took us to street food places we probably wouldn't have dared to come in. And the food was of course great :)
We are really happy we chose XO tours !
Special thanks to my driver Sophie for her patience and her safe driving. This was the first time I ever was on a scooter, and she paid really good attention to my fear to make me enjoy the trip !

Coolest tour ever - I am very happy that I decided to take this tour. A woman owned and driven company, the attention to detail, how friendly the tour guides were, the food, the experience, I absolutely loved it. My driver was so safe and she and I got along so well, I can't say how much I enjoyed myself.

Best Things We Did In Asia - We are near the end of a 25 day tour of Asia and the XO food tour was the most fun we've had. The drivers were friendly and safe and took us on a ride all over Saigon. I recommend you book a tour. Be sure to skip lunch. You need to be hungry when you start because I guarantee you won't be when they drop you off.

Knowledgeable & professional tour guides - Knowledgeable & professional tour guides who are great to talk to and help you learn a lot about Saigon's history, present and future. Would recommend the foodie tour.

I loved it! - We LOVED this tour. Ten stars! Our drivers were a blast (and safe) and the tour guide was very knowledgeable. We went to most so the 'must see' attractions as well as some off-the-beaten-path locations. This was the highlight of our visit to Saigon.

My favorite Ho Chi Min experience - This was my fourth XO tour, I did the first in 2012 and have done one on every trip to HCM since. I always highly recommend to first time and even repeat visitors to the city.
Fantastic hosts who will have you conversing about the cities delights within minutes of welcoming you on the tour.
Culturally and historically fascinating insights into one of my favorite Asian destinations. You will feel safe even if you have limited or no experience on the back of a bike in a teeming, vibrant environment. Plenty of stops and highlights on all the tours. Worth every cent. Congratulations to this business for operating for over a decade and maintaining such an incredible culture that permeates through its employees.

A must-do food scooter tour! - An exciting and delicious tour around Saigons fantastic food spots. Hop on for a fun time buzzing through the city's crazy traffic with some skillful riders. The food stops are brilliant, as is the company and tour guides. Honestly, do this tour and get out of district 1 to see the real Saigon.

Saigon City Tour is a must - Saigon City Tour was fantastic. The girls from XO are so friendly and kind. We felt so safe. The history of Saigon is amazing, they took us to places where there were no other tourists. The Tour guide was very knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend XO tours

Must go tour - I joined the night food tour, exceeding all expectations. Exciting to travel with happy guides during their rush hour with the sun setting down and into the night. Highly recommend to anyone reading this. All dishes served were great as well. Its a party night.

An enjoyable food & cultural experience - We loved this tour. Our drivers were great and we chatted the whole time. We felt safe and the food was delicious. It was great to understand more about the Vietnamese culture and taste the different foods. They have all of the correct insurance too! We highly recommend XO Tours.

A great food tour - My partner and I had an amazing time with Nhi and Sophie. It was great zipping through peak hour Saigon traffic on scooters, as well as eating foods we hadn't tried before.

Visiting different District's and learning about Saigon history, economics, housing, and of course the FOOD was great.

A++. A must for everyone!

A must-have when visiting Saigon - Amazing experience. The foodie tour is a must if you really want to try local food that you would never experience otherwise. Highly recommend. It was fun, great experience and very safe.

New experiences! - My mom and I went on a foodie tour on our first night in Saigon! Our drivers with V1 and V3, (double Vs, double Js!). From the moment we were greeted at our hotel, we were laughing and smiling with the Vs! We felt safe the entire time riding through the city and all of the food was delicious!!! I am not a big fan of seafood, but with the guidance and support of the XO ladies, I tried new things and enjoyed everything I ate. This was a great way to experience different areas of the city and learn about the culture and history. We will recommend XO tours to anyone we know coming to Saigon. I miss my new friends already!

Intimate way of experiencing the city through the eyes of locals - A great experience. The tour was well organized and professionally done with each stop thoughtfully planned and excuted. All on a rainy evening to boot! There was great history and other informational tidbits given by tour guides. I really enjoyed the company of my driver Anh who was very engaging in conversation and extremely courteous. I'm tempted to do this tour a second time given the great fun and amazing group we had that evening. Definitely recommended!

A great night out in Saigon - We had an excellent time got to see districts that we would have never got to see on our own, excellent tour guide and our riders were beautiful girls with great local information.

Fabulous foodie tour. - The favorite but was all if it! Linh and Nugn (I think spell that way) we're fabulous. So friendly and informative. They also arranged for a surprise cake for our anniversary. We never felt rushed or bored and felt very safe on their bikes with them. A really brilliant night and would highly recommend them.

A great night out! - The XO Foodie tour was amazing.
Delicious food! The women were friendly and made us feel safe! We got to see parts of HCM City that we wouldn't have seen!
Great tour! - Nhi was excellent guide. Great experience to visit places that wouldn't be visited in any other tour. XO even gave us a cake to celebrate our honeymoon!

One of the highlights of our Vietnam trip! - 100% recommend if you're visiting Saigon. We had such a fun evening; the girls were fantastic hosts, taking us to locations we would've never found otherwise. The scootering around with a local was a highlight and also visiting districts we probably wouldn't have otherwise. A great activity to whip around the city, try delicious street food and learn more about the districts - particularly good if you're short on time.

Amazing time! - There were three of us in HCMC for the weekend. With limited time, we chose XO Tours for their foodie tour at night and we were not disappointed. Our tour leader was Linh. It was an amazing time to learn about the food and other insights into the city. Plus, riding on the back of motorbikes throughout the city adds into the fun. Our drivers were all amazing. Shoutout to Yun and Hang! My driver Anh was also super awesome. I highly recommend this tour when visiting HCMC!!

Delicious way to experience Siagon (HCMC)! 100% recommended - 100% recommended! Fun, exciting, and delicious way to see Saigon (HCMC). Well organized, the food was different than what you normally find on the street, and a really cool way to experience the city. I participated in a wedding in Vietnam, and only had one night to do the tour so they were accommodating enough to arrange a private tour for me and it was definitely worthwhile. My guide Thao was knowledgeable, friendly, and a good biker:) the food was delicious (best tasting and most beautiful scallops ever), and I love the fact that they are a woman-owned, and operated business. If you've ever spent any time in Vietnam (or any SE Asian country for that matter) - this is a pretty cool model for empowering women. So it's a win-win-win as far as I'm concerned, local businesses benefit, women employees benefit, and I get to eat delicious food. Don't hesitate, just book it!

A MUST in HCMC - The best time that we have ever had on a group tour! There is no way that you will find these locations and foods without the help of the XO tour girls 😀 lots of laughs and good company and will be recommending to all my friends and family

Fantastic family experience - We all loved our XO tour. Amazing experience and wonderful guides. Our kids (12 & 9) had the time of their lives, trying new foods and riding on a motor bike. We all felt extremely safe and relaxing. We had high expectations from all the great reviews but it exceeded even those! Thank you for an excellent experience we will never forget.

Perfect way to start a Ho Chi Minh trip - We found this group on tripadvisor but they only take reservations through their website. We did both their Sights of Saigon by day tour & their XO foodie tour right when we got to Ho Chi Minh and it was the best start to our Vietnam vacation. We also signed up for their personalized video and it was well worth it. They picked us up and dropped us off at our hotel, and took care of us the entire time. I was nervous about being on a motorbike in such a crowded city street, but they get you comfortable on it pretty quickly.

The girls are so nice, sweet and funny. Super helpful too. They helped us with buying fruits while we were looking through that area and even gave me a surprise birthday cake (I was shocked to find my birthday to be the same as their independence day and so I excitedly told my husband. Well, they were so thoughtful as to get me a cake and it was such a surprise!).

XO foodie tour: they will take you to try Vietnamese dishes and en route you will be able to speak to your personal motorbike driver about the sights and whatever you want really. They take you to see a wet market (hence the fruits, which you have to get in Vietnam btw), take you from one district to another, teach you things you would only know from a local, etc. They also play fun games and you get to have a good time.

Sights of Saigon: this tour will open your eyes to the places you would otherwise miss. They will show you places that are in history books and give you a quick outlook on what makes Saigon so special. I didn't know beforehand but they also fed us dessert, which was a pleasant surprise considering this was a sightseeing tour.

Tips:
1) book them as early as you can because they can book up.
2) book them on the first day or 2 of your trip to get the most out of their information.
3) Pay for the video
4) Learn from our regrets and bring extra cash for tips.
This group deserves it! Let's not forget their entourage, which are a whole bunch of guys on motorbikes escorting you throughout the city and doing the videotaping and the logistics and planning. They deserve their reputation as the best motorbike tour group in Ho Chi Minh. Thanks you guys! (ps: VU, we will never forget your name now).

Saigon night tour - I did this tour a couple of nights ago. My driver was Hazel and Thao was on the other bike. Both of them had good knowledge of the places we went to and the food we ate. We were taken into someone's home which was interesting insight into how some people live. Just as important, I felt quite safe on the back of Hazel's bike.

Excellent experience. I would recommend it for the first time visitor to the city - Three of us just arrived from California and we wanted to see the beautiful city of Ho Chi Minh City, so we hired XO tours. The three young ladies that showed up did an excellent job showing us around the city of Saigon including the old parts of Saigon that date back a very long time. We also stopped at several places along the way including an open market for foods, and we stopped and had local food and drinks.

We all felt secure and that we were in good hands with their driving through the sometimes chaotic traffic of Ho Chi Minh City.

BRILLIANT!! - Incredible experience. This is a must do when visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Not only was ALL the food amazing, it was also equally amazing to visit different districts to learn and experience the real Vietnamese culture.
