All of the women are incredibly knowledgeable, fun, kind and caring. My partner and I feel very safe with our drivers. A special mention to the amazing tour manager, Hong, she made the tour even more memorable.

Thank you XO tours! :)

Highlights of our trip! - We absolutely loved this tour and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh. The tour takes you outside of the tourist areas and shows you a glimpse of how the Vietnamese people live and you get to experience some of the local food that isn't the usual Bahn Mi or Pho.

All of the women were amazing guides, especially tour manager Hong. They all made us feel extremely safe and welcomed. They taught us many incredible facts.

This is a must do!!

Thank you XO!

Such a brilliant experience - We absolutely loved this tour! It's such a brilliant way to experience the city. The tour guides are wonderful - insightful, friendly and fun. They're also great drivers - so don't be nervous about getting amongst it.
We particularly loved the diversity of the places we visited, learning some lesser know facts about the city. And the food is all awesome - would definitely recommend skipping lunch on the day you head out. Highly recommended.

Fantastic experience - Our XO foodie tour was a definite highlight of our 2 week holiday in Vietnam. We loved Ho Chi Minh City but it was a little overwhelming at times. To have the opportunity to chat with my own personal host and scooter driver for the night was really special. It gave me so much insight on a personal level into what it's like to live in Vietnam with details that would otherwise have escaped me. Super fun on the back of a scooter and felt very safe (definitely felt safer than it looks!) with my excellent driver Van. Our leader for the night, Nhi was also fantastic, so attentive and charismatic. I'm vegetarian and was extremely well catered for. I did the tour with my partner and found the tour to be inclusive and definitely LGBTQI+ friendly. Loved it!

Great Experience - Last August 29, a group of 20 Don Bosco Makati Batch 78 seniors from the Philippines went for their very first trip together abroad. We booked a package tour for 3 nights to HCM and had a lot of fun!
The highlight of the trip was on our last night with the XO Foodie Tour. 20 young lady riders and tour guides at the same time were just great! Aside from the all you can eat food and drinks, these ladies entertain us a lot making sure each and everyone of us enjoy! It was just beyond our expectations. The cost may sound expensive but it was all worth it!

The Best way to explore the unexplored. - I was initially a bit hesitant, given that it is on pricier side and also I like exploring myself. However the tour was the BEST THING i did in Saigon so far. Highlights of the trip :

1. Great guide, who tells you about the culture, the city and life of the people as we drive to different places.

2. Personal attention to dietary preferences and attention. I was late to a food stop, so they ensured my food was packed and given to me later to ensure I don’t miss even one bit, even though I told them it was not required.

3. Great group of people, the tour size was optimum with different walks of life, we interacted and they made us play a few games with us as well.

4. As a tourist, I was convinced that Saigon was limited to only District 1. They took us to 7-8 different districts, showed us how big Saigon is and how varied the life is.

The tour was more expense than my ticket to Saigon. However it was worth every penny. I hope everybody takes this tour. It’s the true Saigon experience.

Absolutely Amazing Sights and Food tour of Saigon - I did the XO Sights of Saigon and the XO Foodie Tours on the same day. It was an exciting way to experience the history and food culture of this city that no other tour groups could have done. My tour leader for the Sights of Saigon, Sang, had in-depth knowledge about the war history sites in Saigon which I found fascinating. For the Foodie Tours, the tour leader Linh, gave valuable insights about the different districts of Saigon. Both my drivers: Ngoc (Sights of Saigon) and Vy (Foodie Tours) were amazing guides and safe drivers. For me, the highlight of the tours was seeing Saigon by motorbike. I felt that I got a view of the city that only a local would have been able to see. I highly recommend both tours and give XO Tours 5 Stars!

Best thing we did in Saigon - This is the best way to get around and see the sights of HCMC. The drivers were excellent, we felt very safe. The tour guide was very knowledgeable. Dealing with XO tours has been a pleasure very professional, responsive and friendly. I would highly recommend this anyone visiting HCMC.

XO Saigon by Night tour - highly recommended! - A big shout out to the girls at XO Tours in Saigon. A few days ago we did XO's Saigon by Night tour. It's a bit different to their (original and best 😁) Foodie Tour: this one concentrates more on Saigon's culture.

We were picked up at our hotel by Nhi and Trang, and visited the night market in Chinatown, checked out a bustling street selling lanterns for the upcoming Mid Autumn Festival, stopped for dinner at a street food place in District 10 - and also got to visit the auntie of an XO rider in her apartment.

This is our 5th trip to VN, and we've stayed in the small hems in Saigon several times. But actually getting to see how someone lives, and being invited in, is another thing entirely. Nhi has a huge amount of knowledge on the history of the area and we really appreciated this part of the tour. And Auntie was so lovely!

The tour finished off with dessert at another local place, and we were then dropped back home. Nhi and Trang were wonderful hosts and excellent riders 😁, and as with every tour that XO offered, it was a great night! 💜
Great value! - Very nice tour, with young but really passionate and expert guides. Sightseeing and first person experience of the true Saigon!

Outstanding Evening with XO - Phenomenal evening with XO Tours. My husband and I didn't know what to expect heading in and we're completely blown away. We did the Saigon by night tour where you received two course dinner and a dessert. They picked us up from our hotel. And drove us to a market in China town. What an experience to be driven in the back of a motorbike through the city! Such an unique perspective and although it may be a shock to anyone who hasn't seen traffic flow in Vietnam, we feel extremely safe and well taken care of. They guided us through a market and picked up some fruit for us to try. Then they drove us to another district for dinner, which was excellent. Then we were given a guided tour of the neighborhood and met a relative of the founder of the tour company. What an honor to be welcomed into her home. Finally, we were driven to another part of town for dessert before being taken back to our hotel. The guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and super nice to answer all our questions. We highly recommend that everyone who travels to Ho Chi Minh take time to do the tour provided by XO. You won't regret it. Nhi and Lam, if you somehow read this, please know your tour is still one of the highlights of our trip. Thank you yet again for everything.

The best street food tour in Saigon - This tour was nothing short of spectacular. Lin, Sophie & Clover made our time spent in the districts experiencing Vietnamese street food an experience we will never forget. The tour in itself was extremely professional & organized. We loved every moment of it and would 1000% recommend. The highlight other than the food was our personal guides Clover and Sophie- such beautiful souls who made our time so much more enjoyable. If you ever make it to Ho Chi Minh do yourself a favor and take a tour with the beautiful XO ladies.

Awesome Food & Culture Experience!! - Had an amazing food tour experience with XO Tours! The endless food spread really opened my eyes to Vietnamese food and culture!

Thank you Vu for introducing Saigon to us! Your sharing and insider tips were interesting and insightful!

And of course Ms. Hang, the most important person of my tour. Skillful and professional driver - hands down no doubt. We were like a bumblebee zipping down the streets. Thank you for being an engaging, attentive and funny guide!

Thank you for the experience! Will definitely return for another tour!

Thank you very much!

Ho Chi Minh City Tour - For someone like me who's traveled a lot around the world, this tour was simply one of the best. For a short time, I learned a lot, not just about Ho chi Mihn, but Vietnam as a whole. My tour guide(leader) Sang, was great. This guy is filled with a lot of historical knowledge about the place. He thought me about things you would normally not be drawn to as a tourist. Vy, my motorbike rider was very friendly and kind. This is the sort of things you want to do and feel like you gained a lot out of. I certainly did.
Of course, spoiling me with local fruit at one of stops, was amazing.
I leave the city knowing I have added something great to my travel experience.

Definitely recommend these guys, good value for money.

More than just a food tour! - Our drivers Ann and Vi were so wonderful and we learned so much about HCMC just by talking to them. The ride through the streets and stops in different districts helped us to grasp the layout and vibe of each area. Vu was so kind and knowledgeable, an excellent leader. Oh, and we tried many different delicious foods as well- items we definitely would not have found on our own. I cannot recommend this tour company highly enough, I'm confident that any tour you take with them will be a memorable one and a terrific learning experience.

Not to be missed! - Ended up being a private tour since we were the ones who booked the Saigon by Night tour. Our tour guides were very skilled drivers, even in heavy rain! The stops on the tour were informative and interesting, definitely our favorite tour to date in Vietnam. English was not an issue also.
Loved the food choices that were included in the tour as well, one of my favorite meals in Saigon by far! Also enjoyed seeing so many different districts.

The only thing we didn't like was the stop in the co-founders old childhood home, she had family still living there and it was weird sitting in their living room while they showed us how they lived. Felt a bit like “poverty porn” which I am NOT a fan of at all. Also didn't like that the aunt was either streaming us live on Facebook or taking a video (to share with others later) as soon as we sat down. VERY uncomfortable…especially as a Black woman. Hopefully stop will be made optional in the future so one can opt out and just get information on the building while standing in common areas.

Other than that, I hope they don't change a single thing!

Excellent Tours - My partner and I had our first tour about two weeks ago and we had the pleasure of Linh and Nhu, who took us on the back of their scooters for our foodie tour around Saigon. We enjoyed our private foodie tour so much that we immediately booked the Saigon by Night tour which was, surprisingly, even more fun! Firstly, the foodie tour was jam packed with food at vendors/restaurants that you can imagine only locals would go to, and locals that eat good food! It was interesting, tasty and certainly not just your stereotypical Vietnamese staples! We were introduced to lots of new things and we enjoyed every moment. The second tour we did with Linh and Nhu was even better, but perhaps that was because we already felt like long time friends catching up! We are already planning a return trip to Vietnam, and a lot of that is because we went on these tours; it's such an amazing way to see the town outside of tidy District 1 and immerse with the citizens of Saigon. Each tour is backed by additional male staff who ride in our shadows and assist the ladies with ordering food ahead of arrival, keeping an eye on us and just general backup if required which we thought was so thoughtful and sets them apart from the rest. I would totally trust bringing children and families on this tour too. The ladies and gentlemen at XO Tours deserve lots of recognition because they are just the loveliest and sweetest group of people, truly. Linh and Nhu were super chatty and just incredible and we hope that this review will help their hardworking company gain even more traction as it really should. We can't wait to book a third tour when we return!

Amazing night food tour for foodies or not - I'm a big foodie and love to travel. Our experience with XO tours surpasses our expectations. Lucy and Vee were our guides who kept us well informed and safe in our travels throughout the evening. Vu was excellent manager who made sure everything ran smoothly. Highly recommended and would love to do it again.
Amazing food tours- look no further - Just fantastic. Amazing food, fantastic guides, such an incredible value for money authentic experience.
