knowledgeable about the city. They gave a local insight into life in Saigon and explained many interesting facts about the city. The tour is quite expensive for Vietnam but definitely worth what you pay. We will do the tour again next time in Vietnam.

Awesome tour - Great experience! Seeing Saigon at night and visiting all these different districts with all it's contrasts was just great. Very professional and nive tour guides and a great choice of foods.

Perfect tour - even for vegetarians and kids! - XO Tours was an absolute highlight of our trip to Saigon. They went above and beyond to tailor the tour for our 2 young kids, ages 4 and 7 - helping them feel safe on the motorbikes, bringing them to some special spots just for them. They also made sure that our vegetarian diets were well accommodated, and we didn't feel like we were missing out at all. This is truly the best way to get to know Saigon! The trip was well paced, we saw so much, learned so much, and ate so much food.

Foodie Fun and some Serious Girl Power - We had the most wonderful time with Chau and the ladies at XO Tours exploring Saigon by night on the Foodie tour.
XO tours bring you perfect English, amazing personalities, great knowledge of the city, the history, the economy and of course the food. We giggled throughout, challenging ourselves to try new things and met some amazing women.
Worth every penny, you won't regret it.

Great evening street food motorbike tour thru Saigon - We had a fantastic tour through some of the culinary hotspots in Saigon that we would never have gotten to know without XO. Super tour guides Nhi and Thao

Awesome first day experience in Saigon - It was my first day of my first time in Vietnam, and I booked the Saigon by Night tour. I was a little apprehensive about weaving through Saigon on a scooter at night, but I felt very comfortable from the beginning. My guide, Chau, was very welcoming and created a good rapport. She knew the city very well and explained what we saw and where we went, but in general the focus was on experiencing Saigon - not just hearing about it. I loved the route we took, because it really gave me a good overview of the city outside the easily accessible tourist areas. I felt like I got deep into Saigon, and saw the contrasting cityscape that it is known for. I highly recommend XO tours, and the Saigon by Night tour in particular, for newcomers or returning travelers to Saigon.

My Favorite Food Tour! - This was the best food tour I've ever been on. I had so much fun riding on the scooters and the food was incredible. The team was excellent and everything was very well coordinated. I would do this again in a second. Highest recommendation.

Great Time in Saigon! - The tour was great - riding on the back of a scooter through the streets of Saigon is mind blowing - we started about 5 and the roads were packed - it took a while to settle in - so crazy not to be in control as the driver wizzes by others with inches to spare - the driving through the traffic was a quite unique experience. Fun to get out and about in Saigon as well and enjoyed the restaurants - the bbq joint was fun and seemed to be quite popular with the locals. Definitely recommend doing a scooter tour!

Superb evening with XO Tours - The team at XO Tours are fantastic. We had an incredible evening filled with excellent food, superb scenery and great company.
The ladies are fantastic drivers and share their knowledge of the city with enthusiasm.
The tour opened our eyes to different sides of Ho Chi Minh we would not have seen without this experience.
I would definitely recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting Vietnam.
Well done guys and thank you.

definite highlight! - the team was just par excellent! even my mum, who threw out the idea of ​​"Scooters?!", was keen as keen can be for a second tour! The whole op was well planned and executed, the guides they were beyond any apt description of professional, esp led by teamleader Ms Lam.
2 very young toddlers,1 x 70yos - us 5 were so thrilled !
You gals and guys should be so proud of what you are doing for the tourism of Vietnam! stay safe and hale and bless all, til we meet again.

Fabulous and Fun Evening - The night was run extremely well, so well co-ordinated, there was nothing for us to do but sit back, eat and drink. Everyone was very friendly, well versed in English, knowledgeable, considering the amount of traffic on the roads we felt extremely safe on the bikes. I would highly recommend this tour and if given the opportunity would do again with the same company in a different city! Thank you for an amazing adventure in Ho Chi Minh! <3

I loved the scooters. - For me the highlight of this tour was being whisked around HCMC on the back of a scooter. This was an experience in itself and not to be missed. The tours are very well organized, you will have your scooter and drive meet you at your hotel and whisk you off to the meeting place. I think there were a total of about 10 on the tour. Although it's a food tour a number of the stops are just to show you different aspects of the city. I'm a big fan of food tours as not only do you get to eat fantastic food, but you get to meet loads of new folks. These tours have the bonus that you get to meet your drivers who can provide insights into life in Vietnam (as well as the food). I think we had about 3 food stops in total, with no shortage of food. I have had food tours with more stops/variety, but the quality of the food was great. Would highly recommend.

Highlights of our Vietnam trip - We love food tours when we travel but this has been the best I have ever been on.

Interesting concept with the guides taking you on motorcycles, you really do get a feel for the city on the back of the most used transport. Being taken to the best food places, a fresh produce market (fruit, vegetables, meat & seafood) and restaurants with such a diversity of dishes Noodle soup (Bun Bo Hue), BBQ (Beef, Goat, Frog - Jumping Chicken, Prawns) and Seafood (Scallops, clams, crab) and the traditional duck embryo with tamarind sauce.

Our guides Nom & Jen were amazing cooking the food at the BBQ place, making sure our food experience was second to none but another great part of the tour was talking to the guides while traveling on the back of the motorcycles hearing about their lives and their love and knowledge of their City / Country was fantastic.

Was my birthday and the team took the time to celebrate this which was an unexpected surprise and a bit embarrassing...

Amazing experience that I would recommend and would do again in a heartbeat.

A highlight - Fantastic night spent with the crew from XO tours. Our guides Jen and Nom were amazing, just lovely girls and so informative. The food was brilliant just what we wanted. Felt safe at all times. I cant recommend this tour enough if you want to get amongst the real Ho Chi Min City. They even presented my husband with a cake for his 50th birthday. We will definitely be doing antoher tour with them on our next trip to Vietnam. Thank you all so much.

Amazing night, totally unforgetable - If like us you have a limited amount of time in HCMC but want to get a real feel for the place this is a must. There were a few things I was hesitant about when booking so will focus on those....the booking was handled very promptly and professionally. We were notified of exactly when we would be picked up. A note was taken of any allergies and intolerances and this was handled very well, there was always an alternative available for us when appropriate. At no time was there any attempt to sell you any extras, what we paid covered the whole evening.
Then the evening itself. The girls were waiting as promised outside our hotel. They are the highlight of the evening, Nga and Nhung(2) were so impressive. They are charming, intelligent smart women and it was a pleasure to spend an evening in their company. The way in which they negotiate the traffic is a sight to hold. I was really apprehensive as to what it was going to be like on the back of the scooter in the traffic but they are such confident riders I ended up loving it. The tour involved meeting up with 6 others at the first food stop. The food at all the stops was good (the bun bo hue was superb) and whilst there were some interesting local delicacies on offer there were explained to you and there was no pressure to try if you didn't want to. There are a couple of non food stops to show you different aspects of HCMC. Quang the tour lead did a great job of explaining where we were and what its significance was. The Chinese food market was fascinating. It says a lot that the tour lasted about 4 1/2 hours but it flew by. As a bonus we were sent some photographs of the evening the following day. Oh and bye the way no dodgy tummy the following day!
Thanks to Nga, Nhung and Quang for such a memorable evening.

XO Food Tour through HCMC - As everyone else states: This is a fantastic tour. The young ladies who took us around were probably the best part. Energetic, bright and great conversationalists. Food was very good with a lot of variety and volume. The ability to venture out in the traffic and also to visit neighborhood eateries was phenomenal. Never in our driving around did any of our group feel unsafe with our driver/hosts. They made the traffic seem like nothing. I could write more but all I can say is don't hesitate to book a tour!

What an adventure! A delicious way to see HCMC! - This is such a great way to see Ho Chi Minh City and taste the incredible Vietnamese food! Our lovely guides spoke impeccable English and were friendly and knowledgeable. Driving along the streets of HCMC on a motorbike is such a fun and unique adventure. They were excellent drivers, and it felt very safe as we navigated the traffic-clogged streets. We went to the local places that the Vietnamese really go, where food in beautiful colors and textures has been influenced over the years by Chinese & French culture. Also, the booking process was easy and secure. Ms. Thao Nguyen, the booking manager at XO Tours provided amazing customer service and information!

Unbelievable experience! - One of the best decisions of our vacation was to go on this street food tour. Given the incredible traffic chaos with all the scooters I was nervous at first, but "Tiny", my driver put me at ease with her skilled driving ability. I never would of had the experience riding a scooter otherwise. Liked how we enjoyed food in local environments. There was soooo much food too...Tiny also continued to engage with my while driving, telling me stories and information of the areas we drove by. Definitely do not miss this experience!!!

Best tour in Vietnam - Best decision we made was joining the “XO Foodie Tour”. Before I come to Vietnam i was not keen on Motorbike tours as you always here the horror stories, but the XO girls were great riders and extremely professional. I am 6’4” and was surprised on how well they could handle a scooter with me on the back. From start to finish the girls were funny and engaging. It was such a great experience that we booked another tour “Sights of Saigon” for our final day. Once again the tour was exceptional. If you want to have a heap of fun and the best experience in Ho Chi Minh you only need to book a tour with one company “XO Tours”

Fantastic Tour and Epic Start to the Holiday - XO tours are amazing - experienced and knowledgable guides, great food and exploring one of the great cities of Vietnam using the mode of transport all the locals use.

If you are a lover of street food and adventure, the XO tours of Ho Chi Minh City are amazing and our family of four had a great time being guided around the city and trying a range of foods that our teenage boys had never seen before.

We felt safe and very well looked after the whole ride and created fantastic memories.

Highly recommend this experience.

So much fun! - We did the XO Foodie Tour in Saigon and had a great time! Le and Tien were our drivers and they were amazing. We felt completely safe on the motorbikes with them and it was really fun to ride on the back. They were incredible guides to the city - we really enjoyed talking to them! Quang Tran was a great group leader guiding us through the night. We saw districts that we never would have gone to otherwise. Highly recommend when in HCMC!

XO Foodie Tour - We had a wonderful evening on the XO Foodie Tour! It was an awesome experience and the guides were terrific!!
A must tour there!! 🇻🇳

Nu & Le are the best!! - OK...you clearly see all the rave reviews, so you already know this tour group is great. I just wanted to shout-out Nu and Le who were incredible guides and gave us the best time in HCMC.

My partner and I booked the XO Sites of Saigon tour which is typically a small group, but we lucked out and got a private tour. I rode with Nu and she was soooooo much fun! She's from HCMC and drives like it - which I loved. I always felt safe in her care, of course, but it was probably the most fun I've had on a motorbike tour. Nu is hilariously sassy and we had some really interesting chats on the ride while she was pointing out all the sites from the bike.

My partner rode with Le and said she was hands down the nicest person and a fantastic guide.

Oh also special mentions for Wang who gave all the good history and took some sweet shots of us with his camera.

Overall we loved this tour and would do again!

An amazing night in Saigon - We spent 18 days In Vietnam and we did a couple of activities but this one was the highlight of our trip. The team that took us around was highly professional with a great command of English and passion about the city and their job. We cannot recommend this tour enough. Thank you again for the nice memories and experiences. Alex, Panos, Stefanos

Fun tour with the wonderful staff! - The staff were super nice! They all spoke good English and drove very safely. It was great to experience riding on the back of a scooter and enjoy the view from it. My driver told me a lot about Vietnamese culture during the ride and I really enjoyed it!

Amazing sites and food!! More than a food tour! - Just finished night foodie tour with Jen “double jenn!” Was absolutely the highlight of ho chi min. They take you on perfect trip to see the other districts, which by night is amazing and beautiful! The 10 dishes are very fantastic. And to have such professional personable service is well worth every penny! I will definitely do it again! Thanks to the whole team for a wonderful evening!

XO Night Food Tour - What a fantastic introduction to HCM and Vietnamese culture. Must do for first time visitors to Vietnam. the tour took away al the fears of street food and eating off little plastic tables and stools. The tour guides were excellent drivers, what fun being on the back of their scooters zooming around HCM. Very exciting and trilling. I felt completely safe at all times. (I am 62 yrs. old) The ladies are professional, educated, speak perfect English and are a lot of fun. Hang Lam and Nga our tour guides explain the culture, districts and food. They keep everything interesting and speak of the history as well as current events of Vietnam. I would absolutely do this tour again

Saigon Street Food Tour - We enjoyed the tour however it perhaps didn't fully meet out expectations and was we felt overpriced compared to another similar (but personal tour) we had done in Hanoi.
The positives were , the ladies who drove the bikes were all really friendly and personable and drove really well in the chaotic Saigon traffic.
It was great to see Saigon from the back of a bike and be part of the traffic throng (which has to be seen to be believed). The tour also catered efficiently to my husband and I who don't eat meat.
Negatives were that firstly it was overpriced for what we got, we paid almost half for a similar tour of similar length with food in Hanoi.
We personally didn't enjoy the big group thing and would have preferred a smaller intimate group size.
We didn't actually think the food was as good as a lot of the street food we had already had during our couple of weeks in Vietnam.
Didn't think the 2 stops that weren't at restaurants were that interesting .
It may be that based on previous reviews our expectations were just too high, an enjoyable evening out but definitely not the highlight of our trip.

Great Tour, Average Food - ThIs is a great way to see Saigon. The girls are amazing: friendly, polite and full of pride in their amazing country. The food however was a disappointment, just not the best street food, and with so much choice I was surprised this wasnt better.

If you visit Saigon....this is a MUST DO! - We did the street food tour and while the food was great, the actual tour was even better! These women know the streets of Saigon! Their English was incredible and they were just so much fun to be with. My husband and I both agree it was one of, if not the highlight of our 23 day trip in Vietnam.

Great night out - We did this tour as our last night in HCMC and Vietnam. It was a great way to finish our visit. There may be cheaper options but these ladies made the night.
The professionalism of the tour and particularly the drivers were exceptional.
We rode with Ming, Na and Jen. The tour leader was also Ming (but the male version).
The girls made huge effort to connect with us individually as well as the group and were fun, gracious hosts who made us feel that we weren't just a number. The food was also excellent and abundant. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this tour.

Best activity we did in Saigon! - The girls came to our accommodation to pick us up, and greeted us so nicely. They remembered all our names all night long, and made us feel very safe and comfortable. It was a great way to explore different districts of Saigon while eating a lot of delicious foods. We feel like locals!! Great value with pictures taken by the tour guide all night and shared with us later. Would recommend to anyone visiting Vietnam!

Great way to see other sides of Saigon - We loved our XO Foodie experience. The girls were fun, friendly, great drivers and fab hosts. The food was excellent and the commentary was really interesting. We definitely learnt a lot about the city and saw a side of Siagon we jsut would not have discovered on our own. Also enjoyed meeting othe other travellers. Highly recommend.

The best tour - The best tour, the food is a bonus. The hospitality is amazing along with the food. They really look after you and take you to some remarkable places. Don't be afraid if your travelling solo, they cater for everyone. Highly recommend, will do again.!!

One of a kind tour through Saigon - My wife and I chose a personal tour (no one else in the group) and did the "Tour By Night" package. We had an incredible and memorable experience, thanks to our tour guides Chau and Lam. At the end of the evening, we both agreed that it was an amazing way to remember our time in Vietnam.

My wife was a little apprehensive about zipping through traffic on the back of a scooter but that eased after a few minutes on the road. We felt safe and well taken care of from the moment our tour started. Hours later, it felt so natural being on a bike that it felt strange going back to being just pedestrians.

Chau and Lam were engaging, conversational hosts. I've heard the XO Girls described as "sassy" - and there were definitely a lot of humorous moments, with Chau in particular demonstrating a dry wit. We weren't always sure when she was joking or being serious! I had a ton of fun just chatting over the bustle of the traffic as we went from district to district. The discussion around the economics between Districts 2, 6 and 7 were particularly palpable.

Finally, I would be remiss if I didn't mention the food stops were delicious and varied. It was just the right amount to give us a "snapshot" of the local cuisine. For us at least, we got a tasty meal and didn't necessarily miss the more extravagant "Food Tour" package.

XO Foodie Scooter trip - Highlight of our stay in hcmc. Riding through the city gives you a totally different perspective.The three different restaurant’s were way off the tourist path. Food in all was outstanding. My personal favourite was the seafood stop.( my partner doesn’t eat seafood but was lavished with her own little banquet)We saw so much of the city that we would have otherwise missed. The girls who rode us around were fantastic company and really made it a great night. Big thank you to all at XO.

A great taste testing tour - When our guides showed up on scooters the first few minutes were a bit scary in the crazy Saigon traffic but our drivers were so skilled it was exhilarating to be on the back riding. We really enjoyed all the tasty stops but also enjoyed visiting and learning about the various districts that made up the city of Saigon. Would highly recommend this tour.

Trip of a lifetime - a CANNOT miss experience! - My husband and I did an XO food tour in Ho Chi Minh city, during a 2 week trip to Vietnam. This was absolutely the highlight of our entire trip. We were taken around the city by Nhung and Ngan.

They showed us parts of the city we otherwise could not have visited. They introduced us to traditional / popular local dishes we otherwise wouldn't have known about. Most importantly, both Nhung and Ngan were SO fun, kind, and enthusiastic. We had fantastic conversations and learned all about Vietnamese culture, while zipping around the city and enjoying food/drink together.

I wish we had more time to do this tour multiple times. We will be recommending this tour to anyone visiting Vietnam, and hope to do it again soon! Thank you!!

One of the best things we did in Vietnam - Their 5 hour food tours was one of the best things we did while in Vietnam!! They were amazing drivers, great to talk to and answered all our questions and the food was unbelievable. We had a vegetarian and someone who didn’t eat fish in our group and they ensured these people always had great food in all the locations. So much fun to see Saigon by moped at night- you see so much more than you would on foot and get a really interesting experience seeing all the different districts and trying food local to that area. Could not recommend more!
Best food tour in HCMC - It is so much fun! Food is great. Girls are funny. Bike ride is safe. Should be on your to do list in Saigon.

Anniversary Trip - XO Travel provided most of our tours and all airport transfers. Excellent driver and guides at all locations made the itinerary smooth, effortless and without any problems. All pickups arranged through the guides and could not fault them. A big thanks to them.

XO Foodie Tour - This was a fun tour. Good variety of food. Driving through the different districts was a great way to see other parts of the city. Quang Tran was the tour leader. He was organized and explained the tour very well. My favorite was the scooter drivers. Very adept at navigating the city traffic. The girls all spoke English very friendly and informative. Nhung 3 (because they have two other Nhung’s) was my driver. I felt completely safe on the scooter with her driving. She answered any and all questions I had about the city and food we ate. I would do this tour again.

Food tour - Backpacking around the world so we are on a tight budget. We decided to splurge for this food tour after reading reviews and it did not disappoint. After being in Vietnam for over 30 days we were sure we would try food that we have already eaten, yet it was all new cuisine and delicious. Not only that but the tour guides are all amazing and make the experience 100 times better. Could not recommend more!!!

Food tour by Night - We took this tour on our first night in Ho Chi Minh City it was excellent, although your on the back of a scooter between locations through the Vietnamese traffic at no time did we feel unsafe, the girls driving were excellent and experienced drivers, the food was great and the company was good. If you are planning a trip to Ho Chi Minh City this is a must.

Excellent Guides - My guide (Anh?) was excellent. I felt very safe on the back of the motorbike even though the traffic was crazy. She showed interest in my background and was very attentive throughout the evening. The food was good though I would have liked a few more vegetable dishes.

Top nutch experience - just go - One of the highlights of our trip in Vietnam. Great to experience the city and traffic for the bag of a scooter. We had our son who is 6 years old with us. He loved to sit in the middle between his father and the guide who drove the scooter. The guides made sure to bring a helmet also for him - despite it is optional in Vietnam (which seems to be crazy). The guides were terrific. Well educated, and perfect in English. The food we had was great, the tour in the city was great. And we felt very sure, despite the traffic is quite different from Europe... If you fancy to see Saigon - you should go on one of their trips.!
Absolute blast—2 tours - We did both the motorbike tour and the food tour and they were both so fun and amazing. Son and her crew were professional and so fun!

One of the highlights of our trip - Me and my boyfriend got the foodie tour recommended by a couple we met in Vietnam. We were a bit unsure if we should do it, because it was a bit expensive. But we do not regret doing it. It was such a good night, and it went by too fast. My driver Lam, was really sweet, and very welcoming. We talked a lot, and it was so interesting to hear about Vietnam-life and culture from her. All the drivers were very good at maneuvering in the traffic and I felt safe the entire trip. The food was also very good. I would highly recommend going on this trip.

A memorable experience - highly recommended. - Friends had done this tour and recommended it highly. The foodie tour was fun, well organised and a wonderful introduction to HCMC, it's food , traffic and night life.The guides spoke excellent English, were delightful, very informative and great company. Most importantly confident and competent drivers.
This is a"must do" when in the city.

Best Part of My Trip! - My partner and I did the XO Foodie Tour and it was wonderful. Our tour guides were Thu and Nhi and they expertly took us on motor bike to different districts in Ho Chi Minh City and were genuine pleasures to meet! The food was delicious - they made sure to give us a taste of Vietnamese cuisine outside of pho and banh mi - and the sights were great. There was also a guide who gave us a history of the different districts at each stop. Finally, the motor bike rides were incredibly fun! I was initially hesitant about going on a motor bike tour as someone who sees a decent amount of facial trauma and injuries back in the United States, but I am so glad we did it (they made sure we had our helmets on securely before each ride).

If you only do 1 thing at night in Saigon, make it this food tour - The tour, on the back of a Vespa, lasts about 4 hours and takes you all across the city. Not only do you gain an appreciation for the diverse food of Vietnam, you also get a feel for the varied neighbourhoods of this fascinating city.

It goes without saying that you'll experience some incredible food. You'll also be delighted by your hosts who are ready to answer any question about the food and their hometown.

This is also a great way to get amongst the legendary Ho Chi Minh scooter traffic safely!

Fantastic way to eat you way through HCM! - We did the foodie tour and it was fantastic. No wonder they have so many five star reviews. What a first class operation. The scooter drivers were all delightful and the trip was so well organized. The food was diverse and delicious. I can’t recommend this outing enough.

Well curated tour - So i was called at the saigon opera house as the pick up point. I went on the 'Saigon by night' tour. And it was just excellent. I had fun seeing Saigon come to life during the night. It wasnt the typical touristy places , we went to the off beat districts which arent covered by a tourist on their own. And the guide also gave me 2 cute little gifts in the end. The dinner ( pork and rice) was the best i had during my entire stay of 8 days. The girl driver nhung knew english well and was trained well enough for driving a bike in vietnam. She made me feel comfy all along the way and made sure the cab driver knew where to drop me. Highly recommended .

How do they not crash! - A motorcycle/food tour around Saigon. How on earth they avoid crashing I don’t know as there seems no rules. Felt extremely confident and comfortable on the back of the bike and visited places that without local knowledge we would never have got to. All the riders speak excellent English and are genuinely interested in talking to you. Good food, good company and an really memorable experience.

Lots of fun - Great foodie tour. Guides are knowledgeable and very proficient English speakers. Traveling on motorbike is a great way to see Ho Chi Minh City. The best part of the tour was being able to visit the districts outside the tourist zone and get exposure to how people live and what and where the eat. Lots of fun, very informative, and just a great experience

Super foodie tour - We had the foodie tour with our two super nice guides Nga and Anh.

Thank you girls for explaining us some parts of the culture and showing us the great food of Vietnam that only locals know about.

Riding on their motorbikes was a unique experience and we felt super comfortable and safe during the whole tour.

With the girls driving us around there were guys as supporters, waiting for us at each stop.

The tour is well organized as you eat at one location then stop at another without eating so you can digest a bit.

At the last stop they asked us if we wanted to get some more so we would feel well fed which was really appreciated.

Highly recommended as a unique way of discovering Vietnamese food and local places that you would not discover if you would be living in the city center!

Cam on Em Nga and Em Anh!

Xuan Thanh and Daniel

Fun Trip through Saigon/HoChi Minh - The trip was great. We stopped enough to make the trip so enjoyable and relaxing. Good drivers,good guide, good sights, and wondergul pictures sent to us at the end.

Amazing Experience & Awesome Guides! - My partner James and I did the XO foodie tour on the vespas through Ho Chi Minh city at night. This tour was by far our best experience in HCM! Our guides Ann & Lynne were amazing and so funny. They were so knowledgeable and taught us so much about the Vietnamese culture and way of life. They also made us feel super safe on the back of their scooters.
Would highly recommend this tour to everyone that visits Saigon!

Incredible Food Tour - What an amazing tour! The food was amazing, the guides were brilliant and the experience incredible!

Our guides Tien and Anh were so friendly, with amazing english, and told us so much about both the food we were eating, and the sights and culture of Vietnam as we were on the bikes.

Highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to try some of the more local Vietnamese foods, and see some of the less touristy districts of Vietnam - just make sure you turn up hungry!!

"Saigon Through the Lens", highlight of our Vietnam vacation - My wife and me did the "Saigon through the Lens" photography tour and it was awesome.

Our drivers, Nga and Nhung, safely drove us through Saigon chaotic traffic to places we never would have seen, like Saigon oldest bridge where we met Son, the photographer.
Son is highly skilled and taught me useful things about my camera I didn't even know.

If you are in Saigon, don't hesitate and book this tour or any tour that XO Tours offers. It will be your highlight as well.
You will learn about photography and take great pictures and as a bonus, you will fall in love with your driver.

Frans Pfaff, The Netherlands

Top notch - I did the XO foodie tour and loved it. Background: I’m a Southern California native, so much standard for Vietnamese food is quite high. This was my first time visiting Vietnam, with my first stop being HCMC. Everything from booking, modifying, and the tour itself was run very professionally and was top notch.

When I booked the tour online, I immediately got an email asking me to confirm my submitted details, including dietary restrictions. When my travel plans got derailed and I was delayed going to HCMC by one day, they responded immediately to my frantic email requesting a date change. When I got into HCMC, the visa process took even longer than I had anticipated (I had accounted for this, based on advice of many, but even so...). I messaged their WhatsApp and I got a very quick reply, and they told me not to worry since their first stop was near my hotel, and to let them know if I didn’t make it out of the airport by a certain time. Thankfully, I made it with time to spare!

The tour itself was excellent. My driver, Mai, was very funny and nice. She came right on time as stated in the email, and she again confirmed any dietary restrictions. She was so friendly and gave me so many random local tidbits, which I love learning about during my travels. She navigated very easily and smoothly; I always felt very safe, despite it being my first time.

The food was excellent, and I don’t have anything negative to say. Not only was the food good, but we also got to try some things we may not have tried on our own (frog, fetal duck egg). There were more standard dishes such as bun bo hue, beef, crab, etc. The ladies on the tour were also so nice and grilled/prepared the food for us (if it needed any preparation).

We would also go to different areas between food stops so we could digest a bit and learn about some of the different districts. Sang was our tour guide and he did an excellent job in giving us the historical/local background stories.

I also enjoyed that this was very much a “family” type event - while I didn’t talk to everyone on the tour because of the size of the group, it was quite enjoyable to meet people and sharing delicious food with them. I think XO tours also helps foster this by playing games, etc in between and during meals.

An excellent experience! I know that it’s much more cost effective to seek out food as individuals, but it’s definitely a time saver, which is primarily why I did it (I wasn’t in HCMC for very long). It also gave me the opportunity to briefly check out districts I may not have gone to otherwise. They also take a bunch of photos for you and send it to each individual person after the tour. Highly recommend.

So much more than a food tour - Wonderful tour of HCMC. I’d heard friends rave about the tour, and it’s well worth the money. It’s a quick way to take in many different districts, and sample saigon’s varied food scene at the same time - this isn’t just a cursory visit to a few food stalls, far from it. Our guides were excellent: great English, safe drivers, and happy to answer all our questions to gain insight into today’s Vietnam (they also helped cook our food and saved us the effort of cracking open many crab claws- bonus!). Highly recommended

Amazing experience! - We did the XO Foodie tour and it was absolutely amazing!! They catered for our pescatarian and vegetarian dietary requirements and the dishes we got were absolutely fantastic. We would definitely not have had the chance to enjoy the same food had we not done the tour. It was also great to see the other districts of HCMC and all the scooter drivers were so lovely! Couldn’t recommend it more!! Worth every penny!

XO Saigon by night. Best way to see the town - I had a great time. My scooter pilot Nhi was quite the host and comedian. Navigating the city on a scooter gets you right in the thick of things. You will feel like you lived it and did not just observe.
Do the food tour! - Super fun! Girls were great. Good was yummy. And the back of a motorbike is the only way to see Saigon. Highly recommend!
Great fun - Had a great tour. 8 of us with eight wonderful young ladies as guides. Food wonderful and the guides were extremely informative. A must do in Saigon.

MUST DO EXPERIENCE - I cannot rave enough about how much this tour made my trip to Saigon. Anne and Nee were our drivers, and they were welcoming guides for the evening. It was very cool to see Saigon from the perspective from the roads. This tour is EXTREMELY ORGANIZED! I've been to many food tours in the world, but this TOPS them all. Lots of great food, entertainment, and siteseeing! A MUST DO! Book your tour now!

Amazing Saigon Food Tour - a MUST DO!!! - We did the XO Foodie Tour.. it was a little more expensive than most others, but there is no way you can go to Saigon and not do it. We were a family of 4 (19 and 15 yr old boys) and it was brilliant. Amazing food, we were so full at the end.. the girls were amazing tour guides and the fun of riding thru HCMC on the back of a bike is something that has to be experienced to be believed. If you love your food, then do this!! Also, because the tour is 4.5 hours long, there is time between each stop to let the food go down as well as learn more about the city... oh, and all drinks are included.. it is well worth it!!!

Brilliant Company - We took a half day scooter tour of HCM with XO - They're amaxing, loved my rider, Miss S, she was funny, intelligent, and she could really drive the bike around the city. 100% confidence all the way. Go XO!

Fun Food Tour in Saigon - Well this was one way to see Saigon in all its noisy, crazy glory. Our first night in Saigon in our 'watermelon couple outfit 🍉😂' we were picked up by Thu2 and Nhi from XO Tours who would be our personal motorbike drivers and guides for an evening of Vietnamese food. A little anxious to say the least (I've never been on a bike in my life!) these girls put you at easy and although the streets were crazy busy (over 10 million motorbikes) it felt very safe. We met up with the rest of our 8 man group and our first stop was iced tea and a delicious beef noodle broth. Then back on the bike to a large open air restaurant where our drivers cooked for us on little bbq's in the middle of our table. We ate beef strips, goat, okra, prawns all with delicious salt and pepper dips. That was a hot and sweaty experience and not one for a health and safety manager 🙈 Back on the bikes to the next stop which was for superb seafood, clams, crab shots of rice wine before their (speciality) 19 day fertilised duck egg!! Not for me but my husband gave it a go. Not sure he'd repeat it though. This was a great tour and one I'd recommend if you're ever in Saigon 🇻🇳 So friendly and very safe.

best "moveable " dinner party EVER! - we rode on the back of scooters driven by young ladies in ao dais to restaurants we never would have found let alone visited in Ho Chi Minh. The girls were great drivers, very funny and able to explain the food we were being served in great detail.

Fantastic tour - highlight of the trip! - XO Tours was every bit as good as expected. I had been referred by a friend who recommended XO as a safe, diverse and interesting tour of Saigon's excellent food scene. My guide Anne provided lots of interesting historical and cultural information, and the stops at different parts of the city gave a really great overview. We visited 7 districts in total, so it was a great way to get outside district 1. The food was great, the games were fun and the service was top notch!

Just do it! - Had an amazing night on the XO tour, girls were exceptionally friendly and helpful. Food was also amazing and more than you could eat.
Always feel safe and there are tag alone support staff that ensures no Issues and nothing is too much trouble
Would definitely do it again

Amazing - This is deadset the best thing I did in HCMC. Was a bit nervous as I'm vegan and therefore wasn't sure I could have a *full* food tour experience. But I was wrong. Everything was perfectly catered for and so much fun. Absolutely recommend this. Especially if you're daunted about the prospect of discovering HCMC street food solo (which I was). 10/10

Super way to explore Ho Chi Minh! - I booked the morning sights tour and it was the highlight of my short time in Ho Chi Minh. Definitely the best way to see the city. Couldn't really drive myself in this hectic city so in the back of a really sweet and experienced driver it was amazing. Saw many places I wouldn't have seen otherwise and it was just great to drive around. My driver also gave great tips of what else to do and see in Vietnam and told about the culture and history. We were a small group with three bikes + the guide. :) Highly recommend!

Unforgettable experience - Thank you Chau and Anna for the most amazing tour we had with you! We did enjoy driving at the back of your motobikes in such a busy traffic feeling completely safe!.Knowing how massive Ho Chi Minh is I was blown away of how many different Districts we were able to visit!And deferent foods we tried was too exceptional! That was enjoyable true Vietnamise experience. Will highly recommend this tour to people visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Saigon Visitors Tour - Excellent tour. We were a group of 6, our family of 4 and another couple. Easy getting around on the scooters with the girls. Ming was a great guide, excellent English. Yen was a great driver and guide as well. Interesting sights and a great way to see the city. The market stop was a highlight for a breakfast snack. Really good and informative Vietnamese guides run the tour. Highly recommend.

Fun Vespa Foodie Tour in HCMC!! - Our family traveled in Vietnam for two weeks this past December: 2 parents and 2 teen daughters. We loved the country overall, but would rate the XO Vespa tour as our favorite outing! Recommended by friends, this tour began as four wonderful Vietnamese women, looking radiant in their aqua and white ao dai clothing, pulled up on Vespas to our hotel.Their English, humor, kindness and driving skills were impeccable and they took us to markets and restaurants that we would have never found or been brave enough to enjoy. Led by our leader Chau Nguyen, we ventured for four hours on a busy Saturday night through various districts of HCMC, stopping for history and delectable dining on the familiar and exotic--all led with great humor and care by these charming, attractive and intelligent women. HCMC after hours, without tourists, in phenomenal markets and bustling neighborhoods, cannot be beat as an authentic and memorable experience. Thank you Chau, Zan, Linh and Anna!

Great food and fun way to discover hcmc - I highly recommend this tour:
- food is really good with some unexpected surprises ;)
- tour operator will also explain a bit about the different city districts
- the drivers are really good drivers and they really take care about you

Best would be to do this tour at the beginning of your holidays as they explain also about the culture, names of the dishes, basic words, etc

Choosing the correct tour for you - With literally hundreds of options on the table, choosing the correct tour for you is the hard part. After doing our homework we settled for XO Tours and there is nothing to regret, on the contrary if I have 2 nights in Saigon, I would choose 2 different tours with them. Hands down it provides the best of all the worlds, from china town to low and high class districts with an explanation in every corner that lets you better understand the city. You get a good taste of the real Saigon. Special mention goes to Hong and Mia, the sweetest absolute best guides possible, they cater to our every need and made sure at all times we were comfortable and happy!

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh - This food tour was fantastic! It is a really well run tour and the girls are absolutely amazing drivers in this crazy city. They make you feel really safe and looked after. The food is great, the best seafood we have ever eaten and the extra stops to learn a bit more about HCMC were great (also to digest some more food!) We will be recommending this tour to all our friends who come to visit this vibrant city!

XO food tour - This is one of the best tours you could ever go on. The girls driving the scooters were exceptional, the men in black were organized and helpful and the guide was outstanding and very informative. The other participants were also great. Not to mention the food. What a fantastic way to experience Ho Chi Minh City. I would recommend this to everyone as a very safe and enjoyable way to tour the city.

Fast-paced tour of Saigon by night with delicious food! - This is a fantastic tour if you want to see some areas of Saigon you might not visit, learn about its history from an entertaining tour guide, and stop off at local eateries to taste some regional specialties. My fifteen-year-old son and I had an absolute blast. The wonderful women who picked us up from our hotel and drove us around the city on the back of their scooters were a total delight. They spoke great English and we had fascinating conversations while being ferried from one destination to another. All the food we tried was delicious and we enjoyed the company of the other participants. XO Tours really have captured the market for this kind of foodie tour and I can't imagine any way they could have made it better. It's an unbelievable thrill to whizz about by night in the crazy traffic and feel part of the buzz as you watch the city spin past you. This was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon so if you're a foodie and love the idea of ​​getting out and about on the back of a scooter, don't hesitate — book now!

Best introduction to Vietnam - We booked the tour so that we will arrive at our lodging in Vietnam just before they came to pick us up. Instead of the excessive planning to make our first evening perfect, we left it in the hands of our tour guides. The evening food tour was perfect. The ladies picked us up, taught us how to stay safe on the motorbikes and off we went! Riding through Ho Chi Minh during golden hour sunset on a scooter was the most magical experience. I never felt unsafe, but instead fully exhilarated. I had the time of my life and met some other great couples on the tour. Having the different food on the tour introduced us to how to order what during our stay, pushed our boundaries with new options, and found new favorites. One of the ladies in our group was Vegetarian and it seemed that they took very good care of her. I wouldn't go with anyone else. They were simply the best ❤️

Fabulous and fun way to see Ho Chi Minh - This is an excellent way to see the city. Expert drivers whizz you through the traffic, telling you all about the city and its history. A great fun experience and an opportunity to see parts of Ho Chi Minh you perhaps wouldn't otherwise visit. I only managed to do the morning tour but had I been there longer I would definitely have done others. Hopefully I will be back to try the others out. Highly recommend adding this to your route.

Ho Chi Minh Highlight - We did the evening food tour of HCMC with XO tours. It was a highlight of our visit. We got to enjoy some great local dishes and got to see a lot of the city from the back of a motorbike. The tour guides were wonderful and the tour gave us some knowledge of HCMC that we would not have picked up on our own. I highly recommend it if you're visiting.

A highlight of Ho Chi Minh City! - We did a night tour riding through Saigon that went for 3 hours.

The lady riders were excellent and really explained Saigon and made a huge effort in involving the kids.

My family of 3 boys under 15 noted that they didn't feel uncomfortable at all, felt safe and loved the experience.

Food places were local and very yummy with us all trying some different foods we hadn't done before.

We had an excellent time. Highly recommend!!

Wonderful foodie/motorbike tour! - My adult daughter and I LOVED this night of exploring the lesser known districts on motorbike and eating AMAZING food. Just do it - twas indeed a highlight in Saigon.

AH-MA-ZING - I was excited about doing this tour (the XO foodie tour) after hearing from a friend about it but the reality was so much better! There were four of us and our guides/drivers, all women(!), picked us up at our hotel and off we went. The tour starts with some Pho Bo at a local place, it was warm, it was flavorful and a perfect way to start. From there we took off through the city covering about 30 km by the time we were done. I never felt unsafe just exhilarated. I don't want to give too much away but it exceeded our expectations and was an amazing way to start our vacation. Should out to Mia, you were wonderful.

Must Do - Loved this tour in HCM. Definitely do this if you're interested in food, culture, and the city itself. I enjoyed interacting with the hosts and they had great insights as they were HCM natives themselves. It's a great way to see different districts of the city that most tourists might not see -- the food tour takes you through MANY different districts. While I didn't enjoy everything we ate, the seafood at the end was amazing! But it was still nice to sample all the different things that locals enjoy. It was my bf's bday the day of the tour & the hosts were very sweet & had a cake for us at the end <3 so sweet! Highly recommend!!

The best thing to do in Vietnam! - As a family of four (traveling with a 13 & 11 year old) this was hands down the best thing we have done in Vietnam - the HCMC evening street food tour. The drivers were amazing and soooo good with our daughters. We loved zipping around HCMC on the back of a scooter getting a great experience of what it's really like to be in the organized caos! We felt safe and secure the whole time. Everyone who hosted the tour spoke excellent English and we got to see parts of HCMC that we would never have gotten too if we didn't do the tour. The drivers were witty, knowledgeable and an absolute delight and chatted with us the whole time while we rode on the motorbikes around HCMC pointing out key places. The food was amazing! - I was so full by the last stop I could barely fit anything else in! They kept us asking what our favorite dishes were and I honestly couldn't choose everything was delicious and they were all dishes we wouldn't normally have ordered ourselves. Our children were a tad on the plain eating/fussy side but they tried mostly everything and they were catered for with alternative dishes. I can't recommend highly enough this was the best thing we have done - make sure your family doesn't miss out.

Wow, wow, wow - don't miss this tour!! - My only regret with this tour is that I didn't book it in the beginning of our trip to HCMC! My husband and I had the best time. XO Tours is extremely organized - our two guides/drivers picked us up at our hotel, drove us all around the city, ordered & even helped prepare food for us, and were so much fun to talk to! We booked this for our last evening in HCMC and it was an amazing way to cap off our trip - but we were able to see so much of the city we wouldn't get to see otherwise that I wish we had done it earlier so we could go back and visit some of the different Districts (and restaurants!). I felt so safe riding on the motorbikes (even safer than walking around the city!) and my guide, Yim, kept me laughing the entire time. Do not miss this tour on your trip to HCMC!

Saigon by Night - We booked the tour after it was recommended by other travelers we met on a boat in Halong Bay. We weren't disappointed :)
The girls drove us safely through Saigon at night and showed us various places we wouldn't have visited without them. Communications were super easy via WhatsApp. After the tour we even received some photos taken while the tour.
We can highly recommend the tour to enjoy a different view of Saigon besides district 1. Special thanks to our personal guides Lucy & Tran!

Best Food Tour Total - I wasn't expecting much when I signed up for this tour. But I was wrong. This is the best tour ever in Saigon.

The guide (Her name is Dung) was very helpful and funny. Foods are good and I got to see another side of Saigon. Highly recommended tour if you want to get out of the tourist spots and experience the city.

'Must Do' Xo Food Tour - The Xo Food Tour was a highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh. The drivers were safe, knowledgeable, professional and a lot of fun. We would highly recommend a must do when you visit this city!

Fantastic tour with XO! - We had a great morning with the XO Tour. The company were very professional and we felt very safe with our drivers. Our guides explain the history about each sight we visited and answered any questions we had. Fully recommend this way of seeing the main sights of Ho Chi Minh - can fit so much in in so little time! Thank you for a great trip.

Great way to see lots quickly - I had a great time. I love that this company is a women's company, they were fabulous to deal with by email before and I thought my scooter driver Ha and tour leader Russia Team were exceptional. I ended up having to cancel 2/3 of my party and go solo last minute, they refunded the 2 spots despite it not being their policy and gave me a warm welcome to Vietnam. This was my first tour in and I got very lucky. The ladies spoke excellent English, were quick with jokes and historical gems alike. Nga shows us black and white pics of old Saigon and war era scenes to help us put things in context. I only discovered afterwards that there are loads of tours here where guides don't speak good English, show up late or are otherwise not professional. XO Tours is a class act - go with them if you want a seamless experience!

Street Food Tour - Family holiday from 8-70 years old! each on their own bike - we got to experience Saigon in a very special way - great food at all stops, the all women team of drivers were amazing, with great tips and knowledge - the food and restaurants are all clean and well selected - cold beers along the way are just perfect ! Keep it up XO!

Best city and food tour ever - Without a doubt the best city tours we've been on, anywhere, ever!
We did the half day city and the foodie tour in one day. There's plenty of down time between the two, so it's easy to do both.
The drivers were really knowledgeable, with perfect English and most of all great fun. We laughed from start to finish.
The food was amazing, a little challenging here and there, but nothing too wild & easy to dodge anything you're not willing to try. Some of the best noodle soup, prawns and scallops we have ever tasted.
Go hungry!
Night tour with family - Fantastic fun night seeing the sights of Ho Chi Minh on the back of scooters. The girls were great, informative and created a great experience for the whole family.
Excellent Foodie Tour - Very well organized and professional tour on backs of moped. Not to mention the food, which was all excellent. Highly recommended.

Fun & informative! - Loved this evening sights trip - it was better than we had expected, and we really were taken to places tourists don't usually go. The girls were very chatty, full of interesting stories, and went out of their way to answer questions and give us a good time (not least catering to my awkward allergy issues). They were fun to be with and as a team, XO are clearly a fantastic female force to be reckoned with in HoChiMinh - an impressive outfit (and not just the blue&white silk costumes!). They deserve to be recognized further afield - an excellent model for other motorbike-friendly cities. Thanks especially to Hong, Cham and Chau (and apologies for any mis-spellings). Keep up the good work! Rachel & Zoltán - Budapest (chuffed to be their first Hungarian co-riders!)

A tour for everyone - We are retirees and have never been on motor scooters before. The skilled and careful drivers made us feel very safe even in chaotic HCM traffic. Tour covers interesting sights and is timed well keeping us moving but also relaxed. Recommend XO tours.

Fun way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We are a family of 4 with two children ages 10 and 13 and we did the day tour because our sons are not adventure eaters. We were a little nervous for our boys to be on the back of scooters in a busy city, but it was very safe. Because there are so many scooters, the traffic doesn't move fast. Our tour guides also drive very safely.
XO Tours is a fun and convenient way to see all the sites of HCM City. Our tour guides spoke excellent English and were very knowledgeable and friendly. They happily answered my numerous questions.They were flexible in taking us to see some things that weren't on the planned agenda.
The tour included quite a few drinks and tropical fruits. I highly recommend zipping around HCM City on scooters with XO Tours rather than in a car or bus.

Best food tour ever - Bottom line - This is an amazing tour and I can't recommend it enough. It was my first time in Vietnam and the first day was pretty overwhelming (before the tour) and I was nervous to eat a lot of the food. I usually get some kind of stomach bug everywhere and anywhere I go so I'm extremely careful. This food tour made the entire trip that much more amazing.

The food was delicious. The combination of the restaurants they brought us to were very well thought out and planned. If anything is too weird for you, no pressure to eat it. We got to see and eat from various districts within Saigon. It was all a very seemless experience - as soon as we got to the restaurants, we had our tables and seats all set up for us.

The girls on the motorbikes were absolutely incredible. They are the best part of the tour!! Jimmy was my motorbike BFF and she made the tour so much fun. It would have been a different experience without her! She was truly very thoughtful and made sure I had a good time. She also took extra steps to make sure I was completely comfortable and not afraid while on the motorbike.

Motorbikes in Saigon are all over the place and can seem a little terrifying from the outside, especially when you're not on one and trying to cross the street through hundreds of them!! However, when you're on the back of a bike with an expert driver (like Jimmy and the other girls of XO), it's truly an amazing experience and arguably the best way to see all the districts of Saigon. I am so grateful for jimmy making sure I was comfortable and unafraid. She really went the extra mile and it worked.

Highly recommend xo food tour for anyone curious about local Saigon foods. And for anyone thats open to seeing a new city from a completely different perspective.

Can't wait to come back to Saigon to do it again!

XO!

A must-have in Ho Chi Minh City! - This tour is the best way to see the city at night. Our drivers were professional and so much fun. They had so much to teach us about the city and all of the food we ate. At no point did it ever feel unsafe and the food was sooooo good. We loved the tour so much, we actually would have done it again the following night, if we weren't leaving. I couldn't recommend this company and this tour more. They are the best.

Great tour, even for those of us who think we know enough already! - I'd spent enough time in Vietnam to think I didn't need to go on any sort of organized tour, but I'd been away for a while, and my friend in HCMC assured me that I NEEDED to do the XO Foodie Tour. He was right! That was a few years ago, and it is easily one of my favorite memories.

When my mother-in-law asked me to play tour guide on a family trip to Vietnam over Christmas, I knew exactly what I wanted to do on our first night. I knew Saigon traffic would freak her and the rest of our traveling companions out, but I also knew that the drivers were so smooth and so skilled that all their fears would soon melt away. I was right! I'd hazard to guess that it will end up being their favorite part of the trip.

The tour covers a lot of ground, taking you to parts of town you might not have otherwise ventured, and offers dishes that you might not otherwise have tried on your own. Nothing too scary, but adventurous enough to feel you deserve a pat on the back.

It's a long leisurely evening, and A LOT of food. Three of our group were up for all of it, but one ran out of steam. Not a problem! Her driver brought her back to our hotel earlier than the rest of us without hesitation. Everybody was happy at the end of the night!

Having gone on the Foodie Tour twice already, I can honestly say I would gladly do it again and again with future guests.

Fab organization and guides - EXO tours, who we'd booked through Trailfinders, were amazing during our 15 days in Vietnam.
6 airport transfers, numerous day trips or short tours, plus a 4hr car drive bewteen cities.
Everything was perfect; on time, oh-so- friendly guides and drivers, good cars, water provided, valuable advice provided, superb information provided, warm welcomes, smiles and companionship.
Absolutely faultless, totally to be recommended.
Big thanks to all the EXO teams in Saigon, Hué, Hoi-An and Hanoi. Happy 2020!

Incredible low - Our first night in HCMC could not have been spent in a better way. Seeing the city from the back of a bike is the only way to experience the real HCMC. This tour is about much more than just the food (which is amazing) but instead an up close tour of the city's heartbeat, down side streets and districts you are less likely to visit on your own - all guided by wonderful ladies with super friendly personalities, interesting conversations and insights about the city. Both of our teenagers were made to feel completely at ease on the back of the bikes, and the driving quality was first class - we always felt very safe. Do not miss this off your HCMC itinerary.

A great way to see Saigon! - This tour was a great way to get a local's perspective of Saigon. Everyone was very professional and accommodating to dietary preferences. Our guides were extremely friendly and knowledgeable. We had the opportunity to try some of local dishes. I highly recommend this tour for anyone who will be traveling through Vietnam!

Best Tour in Saigon - Did the street tour on the back of the bikes , this was a fun filled evening that I never though would be so much fun , I will highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon .
You pay for what you get, it's money well spent, you will thoroughly enjoy every minute.
The young ladies riding the bikes take exceptional care of you , I never feel unsafe at any time .
The food is delicious 😋and awesome that you will never experience in your own , in addition to the food tour your be taken on a tour away from tourist areas .
This tour is a memory I'll never forget ..,
Awesome 👏

A brilliant evening - What a fantastic food tour. The four young ladies were exceptional and our teens loved the opportunity to experience Saigon at night by motorbike. Such a well organized tour, blending excellent food with culture and we loved going further afield to see six districts. Exceeded our already high expectations.
Great Foodie Tour - This was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam: great food, wonderful guides - a really fun adventure.

Awesome way to see Saigon & taste some great food - This tour was a highlight of our two week vacation. Felt extremely safe on the back of the bikes, the whole experience was so well organized, we got off the beaten track & went to places that you normally wouldn't experience. A MUST do... Tour Guides are Legends!!

You'll regret not doing this tour! - We booked this tour based on the great reviews and it did not disappoint! Traveling in Thailand and Vietnam for 3 weeks, this is the best tour we've ever done. We don't speak Vietnamese and don't ride motorbikes so this tour is so fun and unique for us! The food was excellent, the tour guides were so friendly, knowledgeable, spoke English extremely well and most importantly we're really good drivers!! We did the night tour and were glad we did, Saigon is too hot for us during the day. The food ranges from “normal” food (beef, noodles, shrimp, clams, dessert) to more adventurous (frog, quail, duck embryo!) but they also accommodate for people who don't like or can't eat certain foods. Our tour guides were Ngoc and Mae- they were the best!!

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! BEST FOOD TOUR AND FUN TRANSPORTATION! - We absolutely loved this food tour! We were a little nervous about the scooter transportation; however, the girls made me feel very safe and did an incredible job! Not only was the food stellar, but we visited several other districts outside of District 1. Ming was very funny and entertaining as well! I would highly recommend this to anyone and will send any future friends here as well! If I could give it 5 million stars, I would!

Great tour - best in Saigon - We did the private XO foodie tour and had a great time. Better than the other private tours we did with another company. XO's tour leader Chau really knows how to give you the true insider view into Saigon. She and our other guide Tu both spoke English fluently, so we could have real conversations and not just hear a guide's memorized script. They also took great photos and shared them with us. Highly recommended!

A must do - Loved every minute of this tour.
The girls where friendly and looked after me from start to finish.
The food was awesome and abundant.
If your in Ho Chi Minh City do yourself a favor and check these guys and gals out.

Awesome way to experience Saigon in a half-day! - Me and group of friends were only in Saigon for a couple of nights but still wanted to be able to experience the key sights of the city and the rich history. This tour was perfect for us, as we were somewhat time-poor. The tour never felt rushed, and the girls driving the bikes were absolute professionals. Sang, our tour leader, gave us heaps of historical background and context behind each of the landarks we visited. Overall, the girls and Sang provided a fun experience and I would highly recommend it for anyone looking for an activity to do for a half-day.

Making new friends - We are so happy that we got a chance to go on the XO Foodie Tour. Ming and his team made all the difference for our visit to Saigon. We can't thank them enough. Our kids loved the scooter rides and the food was delicious. Never would we have had the chance to meet such a variety of people and incredible taste local dishes. Thanks again XO tours!!

Well, it's worth it! - We took this tour right at the end of our 3 week holiday in Vietnam and it was a perfect way to end the trip! Our guides were great, the food was amazing and the time really flew by!

A lot of other people on our tour were doing it at the start of their holiday and that seemed like a great way to start as they provided you with a handy Vietnamese phrase book.

Would strongly reccomend this and it's well worth the price.

Morning city tour - This was a great tour to do with our 4 teenagers. The girls driving the bikes were so friendly and funny, enjoying a good joke with us. They were all very competent drivers in the crazy Ho Chi Minh City traffic. We were accompanying to each stop by Sang as our guide. He was great, well prepared and very good English. We all really enjoyed the tour, it was just the right mix of history, culture and fun. Perfect for our teenagers who all really loved it. They also enjoyed talking to the girls about life in Saigon and Vietnam, and the differences and similarities with their own lives. Although a big expense for 6 of us it was well worth it.

Great night out - This was my second time. 1st time was in 2017 and this time was with my kids 11 & 16 and parents (70). Had a great foodie tour. Amazing food and fantastic drivers. It's a must do if you are in Ho Chi Minh.
Vietnam Trip - It was the most exciting experience we had in Vietnam. We tried different food in different stations with kind bikers who were professional and kept us at ease throughout the trip.

Forbes is right. And my belly and heart are so full. - My wife and I had already had an amazing intimate food tour through district 1 of Ho Chi Minh City the night before, but through the magic of Instagram we realized we were in the city at the same time as another friend and we decided to join her for another food tour - XO Tours.

She said it was a bit more pricier than most but with the Forbes' endorsement and that we as a couple could eat forever and ever and ever, we said why not!

THIS IS A MUST.

Our two XO motorbike lady drivers (the company is owned and operated by women, all drivers are badass ladies who know their food, culture, and way around town on motorbike) arrived at our district 1 airbnb and gave us our crash course on bike safety. Since we had ridden through a motorbike tour the night before, we were both quite comfortable but one lovely, professional note from one of our drivers - she told my wife that she could hold on to her driver if she felt scared or nervous but let me know that the back handle bars were going to be my best friend if I felt scared or nervous. This was such a fun, subtle and friendly way to remind me as a male to keep it appropriate and respectable without making anyone feel awkward or uncomfortable. Kudos XO!

What really makes the foodie tours in HCMC so uniquely Vietnamese is experiencing the city on the back of a motorbike. Most of the city gets around on motorbike and it is an exhilarating and intimate way to see the city as a local. It also allows time between each dish for digestion (maybe? lol) and growing an appetite (definitely!) for the next dish.

Fortunately for us, 9 out of the 10 dishes were different from the ones we had the night before and this is mainly because XO travels to different districts (which really makes for some epic motorbike rides!). We started with Bun Bo Huy - if you're in Vietnam and don't know Bun Bo Huy, please walk outside of your hostel, hotel, airbnb and get a grab and go get some RIGHT NOW. From there, we had grilled proteins over charcoal - frog legs being the fun one! We learned some Vietnamese drinking games, cheered very loudly with endless cold Singha beers, made quick friends with the rest of the tour participants and zoomed off into the night!

We went through the Chinatown and Korean populated parts of Vietnam as every other stop of the tour was a mini history lesson of each district we were visiting - food and history made a great pairing.

All the food was great but the most memorable stop was our last one in District Four. The mafia history surrounding the smallest district of Saigon added just the right amount of danger to the incredible seafood dishes we had. Our group really tried to push the quote on their site "full flow of food as long as you keep eating!"

I swear, between the five of us (two couples and our friend Jeni) we ate 50+ scallops (so diep) with peanuts and onions, 40+ spicy crab legs peeled by our multitalented motorbike ladies dipped in a chili/CUMQUAT/pepper/salt, and 4-5 escargo each. The beers and drinks kept coming and it was one of my favorite stomach/heart/soul moments of my life. I love food.

We had eaten so much there that I just had to ask if we were being too much (that's the overly polite Korean in me) but apparently there had been others who had eaten more and it almost made me want to keep going (that's the competitive and obnoxious American in me).

Just writing this review, I am craving Vietnamese food. I'm gonna go find some Bun Bo Huy right after this. Also, I apologize for not including the names of our talented and charming motorbike ladies - it's been a couple weeks and I'm already terrible at names. YOU LADIES ARE SO COOL.

Best way to discover Vietnamese food - The food tour was really well-planned! I got the chance to see districts outside the touristic center and visit 3 restaurants where locals go. The guides take care of you throughout the tour and explain everything you need to know about the food you're trying. Throughout the tour, my guide was also telling me facts about Ho Chi Minh City. Overall, it was an amazing experience and I strongly recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

Saigon at night - Enjoyed the tour guides and experience in the city! The dinner and desserts were both wonderful and we had the added bonus of watching a women's soccer match at the restaurant which was very fun.

Absolute Blast! The best of Saigon and Saigon food! - I did a total of 5 food tours in Vietnam, and this was by far the best and most memorable!

My driver, a third-year university student, picked me up on her scooter at my hotel, and we spent the next 4.5 hours zooming around Saigon, seeing the sights, and stopping in 4 different districts for very memorable food. We had everything from a truly amazing lemongrass beef soup (similar to pho, but from Hue) to Vietnamese barbeque to a knockout selecting of Vietnamese seafood. In total, we stopped at 5 different restaurants in 4 different districts.

The highlight of the tour was learning to ride (and enjoy riding!) on the back of a scooter in Vietnamese rush hour traffic. To be clear, I am not a moto novice — I once drove from Boston to the Bay Area by myself on a motorcycle, so I love the freedom of two wheels. However, I have never driven with others a few inches from me on all sides. Starting out, I held on to the back of the bike for dear life, but then realized that there were small children on all sides of me just going with the flow and enjoying life. Pretty soon, my driver and I were deep in conversation about Vietnam and a comparison of the Vietnamese and American educational systems, and I forgot my worries about falling off. I am told that the others in the group enjoyed watching me gesticulate wildly as we went from district to district. I am not exaggerating when I say I had a fantastic time.

This is NOT a tour that could have been completed on foot. The different restaurants were quite separated, and the districts ranged from reasonably wealthy to a bit sketchy. We saw a side of Saigon that could not be experienced in any other way. (I should pause to note that our retinue included a discreet security team, who were not needed.)

The food, of course, was superb. The company was even better! All of the drivers are young, university-age women, and there were 6 other travellers + me in our group (2 Australian, 4 American, + me).

There was one dish that pushed some out of their comfort zone (balut — delicious!), but everything else was very approachable. The guides were outstanding.

This was by far my most memorable tour. Now that I have learned to cross the streets in Vietnam all by myself, I am looking forward to coming back and learning to ride a scooter like a true Vietnamese!

TL;DR: Stop reading and book it!

Highly recommended.

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh - This group is quite organized. The girls arrived early enough to be prepared for a great start. Their scooters were of good condition and comfortable. Their knowledge of the city and English was excellent. The stop for dinner was of good location and timing. This was the highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh. Thanks to both girls for their excellent tour and pictures. Cheers.

Amazing Day Tour! - It was a memorable experience riding a bike and touring around Saigon. Our friendly tour leader shares the rich history and culture of Saigon as we visited various iconic buildings and sites. Such an enriching and pleasant tour!

Phenomenal Way to Try Street Food Without the Worry - If you travel to Ho Chi Minh City, chances are you'll spend most of your time in District 1. This absolutely phenomenal tour will take you to at least five other districts so you get a varied look at (and taste of) Saigon.

You'll be picked up at your hotel by traditionally dressed members of the all-female motorbike team (one driver per person) and taken to meet the larger group for food that goes way beyond the usual banh mi sandwiches and spring rolls.

On the way, they chat with you to find out more about you, and they're very willing to answer any questions you have about the way of life in Vietnam. It's a great way to get a one-on-one local perspective on everything from family and social norms and holidays to food, clothing styles and religion.

The three food stops we made lasted about an hour each, and each one included several dishes like grilled goat, frog (skin on and off), duck embryo eggs, quail, rice pancakes with mung bean and lots of other, less adventurous ones that featured fresh veggies, chicken, beef, pork and seafood. (They ask about dietary preferences and restrictions when they pick you up.) Sweet chili sauce, spicy salt and kumquat juice are common accompaniments for dipping.

Between each food stop, an informative stop is made, and the tour leader gathers the group to talk about things like how Chinatown developed, which district is known for its mafia connections and why you won't see many motorbikes in District 7.

Round it all out with a fun game of “put the peanut in the water bottle with your chopsticks,” and you've got a tour that's easily one of the best I've ever done. (And it's a perfect way to try street food from places that are reputable, so you're far less likely to fall ill.)

Huge shout out to Houng and Mia (our drivers) and Sang, our tour leader, for making it a tasty night to remember. Highly recommend!

Amazing food tour! - I would like to thank An and Lin for giving us the best experience when visiting Saigon. They were super friendly and made us feel very comfortable. They were both very professional and safe drivers. We really had so much fun and it was one of the best tours we have been on. The food was super delicious. Sang did an amazing job giving us the overview of the tour and information about the different districts in Saigon. Thanks again.

Best Food Tour — Hands Down - Hands down one of the best food tours that I have ever been on. They pick you up at your hotel and give you a briefing of the night. You have your own personal scooter driver navigating you through the busy Ho Chi Minh City traffic and throughout the districts. You have three food stops with local cuisine and beverages (beer included). If you're not adventurous or don't like a certain dish, they will provide you with an alternative selection. They even take your photos during the evening. It's about 4.5 hours including stops. Fantastic and highly recommended.

Best experience in Saigon - I was worried about safety of taking my 8 and 9 year old daughters on motorbikes but the last drivers were very safe and super welcoming. Highly recommend. This was the highlight of our Vietnam trip!

Best Foodie tour - What an amazing experience, from start to finish. Lee and Anne picked us up on time and they were thoroughly entertained and knowledgeable. We joined the rest of our group and started off what was a highlight of our Ho Chi Minh trip. Thank you so much, we can't recommend more highly!

Fun Night touring the town on a motorbike! - We did the Saigon by Night tour, and loved it! The scooter traffic was insane in HCMC, but our gals knew how to safely navigate the madness. If was fun, safe, and informative. My guide was 'Chao,' another was 'Queen', and we cannot remember the other gal's name. All good. Great job, ladies!

Why not give it a try! - I know this company since 2012 or 2013 when they just opened.
They are really a great service with good business idea
The only problem if you are not interresting in bike travel "^"
