The best food tour we've ever done - Honestly, I could not recommend this tour any more. It was absolutely fantastic! The girls were so so lovely and we just chatted the whole night! The tour group was also so much fun! The food was delicious and helped us immerse ourselves into the Vietnamese food on one of our first times here. You just have to go on this tour! Thank you to everyone at XO tours for such a memorable experience!

Highlights of our trip! - We did the foodie night tour and it was such an amazing night!

Our drivers Nhi, Na & Anh were the best! So friendly and fun! I always feel safe on the bike.

Ming our tour leader and the men in black were very nice and very funny! Which made each stop enjoyable!

The food was delicious! (Note: there was a lot of it so don't eat before)

The whole team was great! I highly recommend this tour when in Ho Chi Minh City! It is a must!

Thank you XO tours for making such a memorable night for us!

Better than Ever - This was my second trip with the XO girls and exceeded my previous one in that a few years have passed and a lot has changed. Chau and Li were terrific at showing us all the food and market places and offering us remarkable amounts of sometimes unusual and always of excellent quality food. Again highly recommended.

Ah and Na were amazing guides - We had a great time touring around the city checking out some districts we might not normally see. The girls we were paired with, Ah an Na (forgive me if I missed their names) were sweethearts. Very knowledgable and fun to hangout with, and pretty too. The other guides from other groups seemed very friendly and accommodating as well. Would highly recommend this tour! If we were ever back in HCMC we would do it again!

Fun morning filled out and about in Saigon with XO - We were met on time at the Opera house by our two very professional and friendly drivers Nga and Thao. My friend and I were a little concerned about the motorbike riding aspect of the tour not having been on a bike before. The girls quickly put us at ease. At no time during the morning did we feel unsafe as both drivers proved to be very capable in amongst the crazy Saigon traffic. We got to see some of the landmarks and local life and the girls plus the tour guide Mr Ming were very knowledgeable on the history of the city. I would definitely recommend this tour to any visitor to the city.

Morning Scooter Tour - Fabulous morning, I had never been on a motorcycle (and in the 50 age group) but our guides Nga and Thao gave some simple instructions and we were off. Trusted our drivers completely. We where then met along the way by Ming the tour leader. All 3 were very informative and passionate were about the history of their country and their work. Would recommend this tour.

Night Food Tour - Such a fantastic experience for the first time tourist to Ho Chi Minh. It is an absolute highlight to whiz around the city on a scooter with these young professional ladies expertly weaving through the crazy traffic of HCM. The food is varied and fab as well. We would highly recommend this tour.

A must-do tour! - We did the food tour on the second night in HCMC - what a fantastic experience! So glad we did this as it was the highlight of our 12 day Vietnam trip :-) Very well organized and felt completely safe on the scooters. It was raining at the start of our tour but they kept in touch with our hotel to let us know when we will begin. Sure enough nothing stops these guys from providing a wonderful time. The girls were so nice and we gained so much knowledge about the wonderful food and Vietnam in general that we would have otherwise not had. Worth every cent and would highly recommend!!!

Ho Chi Minh City Tour By Scooter - I had a wonderful experience with my driver Nhu and my guide, Sang. We had so much fun together. Seeing Ho Chi Minh by Scooter was the absolute best way to see the sites. Nhu and Sang were very welcoming, knowledgeable and the perfect hosts. I would absolutely recommend XO Tours if you are visiting the city and want to learn more about the history and have fun at the same time!

This is one of the best things to do in Vietnam - Just an amazing experience. Going around in a scooter in Ho Chi Minh City and eating very tasty food in local restaurants. It is a "must-do" tour in HCMC. I loved it.
Wow! - This tour was my favorite part of HCMC! Amazing staff, well organized, wonderful food! So much fun.

Fun foodie tour - This was a fabulous way to see Saigon by night and enjoy lovely local foods. The ladies were professional, fun and were happy to provide lots of local information. We were a family group with teenagers and we all thoroughly enjoyed this experience. Thank you XO Tours.

I can't think of a better way to get to know Saigon! - This tour really is a must for anyone visiting for the first time, or...enjoying it so much you want to do it again. Zipping around many of Saigon's districts on a xe om, at night, with a very careful driver-soooo much fun! Seeing the sights and lights, traveling with the locals, hearing from the locals about Saigon and enjoying so many tasty foods. The guides are extremely attentive and go out of their way to make sure you enjoy yourself.

Excellent Food Tour - The Food Tour was phenomenal! We had a blast on the back of the motorbikes and getting to know our local guides. The food was delicious and we learned a lot about Ho Chi Minh along the way. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting the city!

Best foodie tour yet! - Amazing fun!!! This tour is just spectacular. We have been on many food tours all over the world and also in Vietnam and this was one of the best. The food is great and you most probably won't get to taste it on your own. The drivers and the tour guide are fun and speak perfect English. A must for any foodie and a great way to experience the city in a short time!

Crazy fun! - This was my 5th time doing the night food tour as it's a must for every new person I bring to Saigon. If you want great food and a great time then this is it. The lady drivers are always super fun and speak great English plus they make you feel like long time friends from the start. This trip our drivers Nhung and Nhung 3 were just a ton of fun!

Exciting adventure - Friendly ladies and guides.
Certainly a sample of driving in Ho Chi Minh, not for the faint hearted.
Food experience great and takes you to restaurants off the tourist circuit.
Quite pricey but very professional.

A great way to experience Saigon as a solo traveler - I highly recommend this tour.

I was recommended to go on XO Tours by a friend that had previously done a solo trip to Saigon, and I chose to do the same thing.

This was by far one of my favorite activities during my travels to Vietnam. I signed up to both the morning and night tour. The guides and drivers are so friendly and it is a great way to see many parts of the city. The tour was perfectly organized and the food was local, unique and delicious. Thanks XO Tours!

Awesome experience in Ho Chi Mihn! - I highly recommend this tour! The drivers were all wonderful, especially Lee! I got a nice background of all the districts we went through and the driving felt so safe, despite traffic being as crazy as it is in the city. Ming was a wonderful tour lead and all the food stops were awesome! This is such a great way to explore the city and see parts of it you'd never be able to on your own. Highly recommend!

Don't think, book! - After hearing about XO, we chose for the XO foodie tour and we're not disappointed! Loved everything about the tour. Everything runs like clockwork. The drivers were friendly and funny, and make you feel very relaxed whilst driving around the impossibly crowded roads of HCMC! There is plenty of food and drink provided at some cool locals spots. They were very accommodating, like I don't eat shellfish, they brought other delicious dishes out for me. Don't be put off by the manic traffic, it just seems to work, you'll soon relax and really enjoy it. Highly recommended!!

The XO Foodie Tour - Our guides were amazing - speaking with them was the highlight of the tour for us, and quite possibly the best way for us to learn about Vietnam and its culture. Of course, they always made sure we were feeling safe, comfortable, and well-fed. Wonderful way of spending an evening in the city!

XO tour - Solo traveler from Aus. Tour was amazing - I did it as it was recommended to me. The drivers were awesome and made you feel immediately comfortable. Quickly everyone gets to know each other over a drink and some food. The places they take you are incredible and the food is amazing...you'll get full I promise you!

Highlight for this family of four - We had a blast on this tour. Initially my two boys were a little nervous but as soon as they got on the bike and started chatting with the lovely guides they relaxed and didn't stop smiling. Ming provided lots of local knowledge and we loved the non touristy aspect of this tour. Little personal touches were appreciated and we would recommend this tour to young and old. What a great way to spend a birthday

Highlights of our Saigon trip - We had a blast on our night tour with our amazing guides Jenn and Mai. They picked us up from our hotel on mopeds and made us feel safe and comfortable. Our guides were knowledgeable and friendly. In addition to eating delicious food and venturing out of the tourist area (District 1), we learned a lot about the history and culture of the city. The tour itself is very organized and well thought out. XO Tours was one of the best things we did during our 9 days in Vietnam

Best thing I've done on any trip to date - We had the most incredible time ever on the XO foodie tour. Felt incredibly safe on the back of the bikes with the expert XO girls driving us around. We covered so much of Saigon and most places all outside of the main district one getting to eat where the locals do and wow the food was out of this world. It was a group tour which was even better getting to meet and mingle with people from all over the world and all the drivers and guides. Best night and would recommend this to everyone coming to Ho Chi Minh as not only one of the greatest ways to see so much more of the city but to eat incredible food! Thanks XO

Nyree - The XO Tour was amazing!! Very organized right from picking us up from the Hotel to dropping us back. She made me feel very safe and secure as I was a bit anxious. The food was so good as well. Would highly recommend this tour in Ho chi Minh city.

Two nights and a day with XO - I had only one and a half days to see the sights of Ho Chi Minh City. I elected to go on three tours with XO tours (Saigon by Night”, "Sights of Saigon and “XO Foodie” tour ).
The drivers were incredible, safe, polite, and knowledgable, and most important were patient. The tour guides were very knowledgable, open to many questions, very understanding, and caring. Example: one dish of food I couldn't eat (allegory) so they made me a special dish to replace the one I couldn't eat. The Foodie tour is great, different kinds of food including ( in their words ) jumping chicken. ( Frog ).
Sights of Saigon was very informative and touched on many new things to me.
I highly recommend these tours, especially the Foodie tour to anyone wanting to have a great exciting evening in the city.

Lots of fun and very informative! - The guides were wonderful, very skilled riders and full of great information. You learn a lot about different parts of the city. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon!

Fabulous - XO food tour - What an adventure! A really immersive evening out in Ho Chi Minh City with my 'eat anything' daughter and strictly vegetarian partner. The food was delicious and quite surprising as we ate like a local for the evening and we all thoroughly enjoyed it despite our different dietary approaches. The girls, our drivers, were great fun and really shared their love of their city and their country - we all felt we had made a friend in Vietnam. Khoi, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable, with a quirky sense of humour. Surprisingly I felt very safe on the back of the scooter - the girls are very very good drivers. I liked this tour so much I booked their photography tour later in our holiday.

XO Foodie Tour - Had a great time eating good food and seeing the city.
The XO Foodie Tour allows you to travel from one district to another learn the history of that area while sampling authentic Vietnamese dishes. My rider An, was exceptionally sweet and helpful. Her driving skills were amazing; I always feel safe. I highly recommend this tour.

Lots of fun with great guides - We made the food tour on evening. The guides spoke fluently English and were really nice. We laughed a lot and had a lot of fun. And of course the girls are saving drivers through chaotic traffic.

Best Food Tour Ever! - How do we give a tour more than 5 stars?! Our food tour with XO Tours on motorbike was THE best food tour we've ever done and definitely among the most fun tours we've ever done in general! I was a bit worried going in about being on the back of a motorbike (it was my first time!) but it was a total breeze and such a fun way to tour the city. Our tour guide, Ming, was great about sharing insight into history, food and culture at each stop, and our personal driver/guides were AMAZING. All of the girls were bubbly, fun, so engaging and spoke incredible English. My guide, Hong, was wonderful and it was so much fun getting to know her throughout the night. Food was great and the spots they chose were perfect -- off-the-beaten-path and so much fun. I don't eat meat and they had great substitutes at all of the stops when needed. All around 5* experience and worth every penny. I'd recommend this to everyone visiting Saigon!

I highly recommend this tour. - We were recommended this tour by two lots of friends and we weren't disappointed. Lovely young ladies who drive us and entertain us. We also met some other travelers which were great to share stories with. The food was amazing and we certainly wouldn't have gone to these places on our own. One of the highlights of our trip so far.

View from a scooter - I wanted to experience a little bit of what it is like to be among the people of Ho Chi Minh city and jumping on the back of a scooter for three hours to visit some of the sites is definitely a great way to achieve this. Trang was my fearless scooter rider and she expertly weaved us through the buzzing streets of this colorful, incredible city. Visiting the sites and having tour leader Ming to add the background was great but getting between the sites on the scooter was the best fun.
The XO team are very professional and extremely kind. Two thumbs up.

Best Foodie Tour Ever - The lovely ladies from XO are the best. We booked a group of 21 as a last minute thought and they were able to accomodate all of us on the same day we inquired. Food was unbelievable, our drivers were so friendly and knowledgeable. I have done two different companies foodie tours and even though the other one was great theses guys are the best.

Exhilarating morning - We did the morning city tour. Our drivers Nhung and Huyen picked us up at our hotel and went through some bike safety. Helmets on and we were off!! The girls were excellent drivers and we felt very safe with them. We arrived at the Notre Dame cathedral and met our guide Ming Lai. What a lovely man he was. He was very knowledgeable and pointed out many interesting places. We stopped for some desserts which were lovely. The girls were very chatty and charming on our trip. Would highly recommend this company. The girls and Ming were a pleasure to be with.

A Great Night Out! - The end of our holiday in Vietnam and we chose to do the Street Food Tour with XO Tours - and had so much fun! A little daunting to be part of the crazy HCMC traffic instead of nervous pedestrians, but these girls had it under control. We could relax on the back and take in the sights. We saw much more of the city than could ever have done ourselves (35km), and had some fabulous food in places we would not have found. We were very well looked after, the girls even cracked the messy crab claws for us! It was good to know there was a back-up crew keeping an eye on us all too. We swapped stories about life in both Vietnam and NZ and had a lot of laughs along the way. A great night out - thanks to Khuong, Diep & Koi - we highly recommend this tour!
Gillian & Brendan NZ

Best foodie tour - A friend of mine highly recommended this tour and we decided to give it a try.
We booked XO foodie tour online and our guides collected us in our hotel at 5:30pm.
It was a truly local foodie experience - everything was included (drinks + food) and you get to go to different districts. For us, it was great because we had only seen district 1 and 5.
Just be ready to start the tour with an empty stomach because there are lots of delicious foods to be eaten.
XO Tours were great and we totally recommend them.

Best tour ever - I really have to say that this tour is really worth your time when in Saigon, being on a back of a moped is so freeing, traveling with the locals in the traffic, stopping at some restaurants to try some food and drink. Being with a lovely group and feeling so welcoming. Good tour leader and guide. Thank you XO tours and keep up the good tours.

A Must Do!!!! - This tour was a highlight of our trip. It was very well organized, friendly and fun. The food was fabulous, delicious and a large variety at several stops. We saw lots of different areas of the city that we would not have seen without the tour and stopped to learn about the history of the different districts. The girls were friendly and were outstanding in their jobs (they had no problems maneuvering through the traffic with much larger passengers).They rode safely and chatted (in very good English) about things we passed and how to eat the different dishes. We felt safe and in good hands at all times. Highly recommend this company.

XO Food Tour - lots of exes and ohs!! - Fun night on the back of bikes, chatting with our friendly and knowledgeable drivers, and eating plenty. Nhung and Trang (2) collected us from our Airbnb and we were off on our 4-hour adventure. Ming provided lots of information at various destinations and the girls were delightful in helping us navigate the food. We had a beautiful soup at our first destination (where we met the 11 others on the tour), then a variety of meats as well as prawns at the massive grill house and finally a seafood extravaganza at our last stop. A bit of rain didn't dampen our spirits - Nhung and Trang were well-prepared and very confident. Great night with some hilarious photos.
Jennifer and Colin

XO street food tour at night - This was a great tour, But our tour leader was lovely along with all the other tour guides. We got to experience a wide range of dishes and there were lots and lots of food. It was a great way to travel around the city while feeling very safe on the back of a moped. We were traveling with a 5 year old and they accommodated very well, bringing the tour forward in time so that it finished slightly earlier.
Got to see areas of Saigon that I would never have visited normally including a number of the districts. Was great!

XO Saigon by Night & XO Through the Lens - XO Tours were excellent in the two trips we did with them, XO Saigon by Night and XO Through the Lens. The girls were excellent drivers, guides and hosts for my daughter and I, and we always felt safe on the back of the bike, even with the peak hour Saigon traffic. We enjoyed quite a bit of time on the bike exploring many districts we would on our own most likely never seen. It was good fun. With Khai and me as our guides, we had a good time exploring the markets before our meals. XO Through the Lens was really pleasing for the photographer in me. I learned much from Kwai to improve my photography skills, and we went to several locations which were very photogenic and provided many opportunities for the Photo Eye to kick in. I Thoroughly recommend XO Tours, and my daughter and I enjoyed both tours very much. Look forward to catching up, next time we are back in HCMC (aka. Saigon) Jaala and Owen.

Highlight of our trip - We recently returned from our 2 week holiday in Vietnam. Our last stop was HCMC. I read so many good reviews about XO Tours and really wanted to ride on the back of a motorbike and see HCMC from a different perspective. However I was a little apprehensive from a safety perspective. We did the City Tour and had the most wonderful and fun experience. We met them at the front of our hotel and they went through the safety of riding a bike and made us feel really comfortable. We then headed off to the Post Office to meet the tour guide and another couple who were on our tour. We visited the Post Office, Notre Dame Cathedral, had Vietnamese coffee in an old apartment building and visited a Chinatown area. I can honestly say it was so much fun and the highlight of our trip. I would like to say thanks to the girls Nhung3 and Anh2 who were our drivers for the duration of the tour and Khou who were our tour guide. When we come back we will definitely do the scooter ride with XO, but this time do the foodie tour.

Best Food Tour we have had - What an adventure rain included at no extra cost, it added to the fun.
Only the second time on the back of a motor bike and peak hour in Saigon I was a bit apprehensive, our drivers Hong and Huong made us feel very safe, after leaving District One and riding through District Five we felt like we had been riding for years.
The girls were delightful, providing us with stories of their life and culture and asking many questions about us.
First stop we met up with others, 14 in total and also met Tai our guide for the night, one funny guy.
Five stops in total three for food and two informational.
The food was outstanding, XO are true to their advertising, every dish was something we had not tried before.
Worth every cent, go with an empty stomach and a sense of culinary adventure and you will not be disappointed.

Fantastic Tour and Fun Guides - Had an absolutely awesome time on this tour! The guides picked us up right on time and were very safe driving us around on the scooters. They provided you with advice and would allow you to take photos/videos after asking them if it was okay to do so. The food was also amazing and very local. Not touristy type food but authentic and unique dishes from Vietnam. I was also very surprised at how far they took you as the tour extended to about 5 different districts! 5/5....Great time.. .will go again!

BC

XO Saigon Food & City Tours - I went on the “Sight” and the “Foodie” tour with XO, and the tour was wonderful! I got to see and learn Vietnam's history and landmarks, as well as try food I would have never discovered to try, and got to see hidden alleyways I would have never seen if I went on my own. It was a great way to explore Saigon on the back of a scooter!

A truly good experience! - I'd like to appreciate Thu for guiding through city with so much energy and knowledge. I'm already staying in HCMC for 2 months, but this tour gives me very different view to this city. I certainly recommend this tour to those who seek real depth of this city!

Feeling hungry and brave! - I have been traveling in Asia for 40 years and I've taken numerous tours of many different natures; this was without a doubt the m inost fun and interactive that I have ever experienced! My Moto bike driver, a little spitfire named Lin, was a cool and confident and humorous driver (when I told her my helmet was a little tight she informed me that our first stop would be the hospital to get my head fixed) even though we traveled for about 5 hours throughout the chaotic City in the rain.. at all times I felt safe and secure on the back of the scooter! It was exhilaration at its finest!...At each stop the guides took turns explaining about the foods and how to prepare them with different condiments..if you are capable of sitting on a scooter and letting someone else feed you for 5 hours then it's sort of a no brainer!
We went to neighborhoods I never would have experienced and since the trip have gone back to them... Ming, the tour leader was a man of great humor and information!

Great tour - We did the XO foodie tour on Friday night, we had only 3 days in Ho Chi Minh this was on our first night it was fantastic to get around and see a few of the different districts. The young ladies were safe riders and very informative and able to answer all our questions. They were great in sharing their culture with us, the food was great, I would thoroughly recommend this tour.

Awesome tour - This was one of the best food tours I have ever been on. You get to see so much of Ho Chi Minh city as your personal scooter driver takes you around 5 different areas (3 food stops and 2 sight seeing stops in between). There is so much food and a great variety available at each stop, and unlimited beers! Every driver was so friendly and Tai was an excellent tour guide as he was so enthusiastic and made a personal effort with everyone on the tour. I can't recommend this tour enough - book now for an unforgettable experience!

XO Foodie Tour - Saigon - The XO foodie tour was highly recommended by an FB group I'm in - and I'm glad I experienced it.

My host Hang (motorbike driver) picked me up from my hotel and briefed me on motorbike 'rules' - a much appreciated safety talk & meet and greet that set a relaxed and fun tone for the night.

Zooming around the busy streets of Saigon on a motorbike expertly handled by Hang (half my size) was exhilarating. Weaving through the traffic at night during peak hour is a must try - so patient and calming amid what appears to be chaos.

The food: I applaud XO for their detail to a guest's dietary requirements - I don't eat pork, molluscs or crustaceans. Each meal served was introduced to the group (five guests) before hence consumption everyone knew what they were about to taste and ... Yummy!!

The conversations around each meal flowed between the hosts and guests (five). The girls were very attentive, engaging with their passengers. Our guide Koi was knowledgeable and in between rides answered queries broadening our appreciation of Saigon and her people.

The group was also accompanied by male members of XO who rode alongside, sometimes behind us - motorbikes in busy Saigon mean other road users are within conversation and hand distance. Once again I applaud XO for their detail to safety.

Great way to see Saigon - We were a group of six girlfriends who did the XO Foodie tour at night with Chau and her team of drivers who were good fun, friendly and very informative. I felt very safe on the back of the scooter through the crazy traffic and streets of Saigon.

There are 5 stops, three for food (noodle soup, bbq and seafood) and two sightseeing stops (markets and new upmarket area). Enjoyed all the delicious food and beer (even tried balut).

Great way to see Saigon at night and explore the different districts.

Highly recommend the tour.

Highlight of our trip - Incredible experience. You and your scooter driver through the crazy streets of Ho Chi Minh, weaving in and out of the traffic. Frightening at first but actually exhilarating and exciting. After the initial shock, it was actually quite safe. The drivers are experienced and they all drive slowly in Vietnam. Didn't see any accident while there. The 3 restaurants they took us to were all very different. One was a delicious noodle soup place with the most stock. Followed by Korean BBQ of unusual cuts of meat followed by seafood and for those brave enough egg embryo. In between the meals we visited the local markets and a well to do area. The girls were full of tips and stories. Would do it again.

Amazing experience - Absolutely amazing experience, seeing the city on a bike was something else. LOVE it. The girls were fabulous. I did however feel it was a little pricey for the sort of food we were offered. Food I didn't particularly like and found a little tasteless.

Exceptional service & great night in the city - The service was exceptional & we had a really fun night. Recommend that you do this at the beginning of your visit, so you can see the city. The food was varied & high quality, with plenty of drinks & beer. Always feel safe on the bikes, even in the busy Friday night traffic. You get what you pay for IMO, would highly recommend

Best of Saigon - We took the XO Foodie tour on one of our final evenings in Vietnam and it truly completed our trip. Seeing the city by bike was one of the best experiences - one you should certainly have in Saigon! Our drivers (Hong, Mai, and Hieu) made each of us feel incredibly safe while driving and spend the entirety explaining to you where you are and what you are looking at along the way. We would never have been able to see as much of the city had we not done the tour - nor would we have learned as much about the culture. It was highly worthwhile. Sang, the tour guide explaining each stop, was fantastic as well. Thank you to XO!!

Busy Saigon- thumbs up - Khoi and his team gave us a great insight into a bustling busy city. Khoi and his team are a great crew and provide an excellent service. This tour gives you flavours and memories of busy Saigon/ Ho Chi Minh City that you will remember. Highly recommended tour. D & V

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City - We recently took the XO Foodie Tour and it was easily the highlight of our time in Saigon, possibly even the whole trip in Vietnam. The drivers (Hong, Mai, Hieu) and guide (Sang) were so friendly and informative and sincere about showcasing their country. The tour was thoughtfully curated with 5 stops spaced out over the course of the evening divided between food stops and sights. There was plenty of food and drink available, but the tour was so much more about culture as well and getting the pulse of this city which could be overwhelming otherwise. I would highly recommend the tour especially on one of your first nights there because it will open your eyes to so much. They also provide recommendations and ideas for the rest of your stay there. Thank you XO!

A great fun way to see Saigon - We decided to spend our last night in Vietnam taking a scooter ride through Saigon. This was a great idea. We chose the private tour on Saigon by night. We got to see parts of the city we never would have discovered on our own. Riding through the streets of Saigon at night in the back end if the motorbike was exhilarating. The women were friendly, fun and very adroit at maneuvering through busy intersections. I highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a good time. Thank you to Thuy (sp?) and My.

Great way to learn more about the city - I did the HCMS XO Night Tour and it was excellent. My driver, Yen, was really knowledgeable and made me feel very safe in the traffic. I was a little confused as to why there's a 'tour leader' at each stop when the drivers seemed more than capable to providing us with the relevant information. He seemed a little unnecessary, but was very friendly and knowledgeable.

Highly recommend these tours as a way to experience driving in HCMC and see a lot.

Sam & Marina Zaidan - We had a site seeing and foodies tours with Xo Tours in Ho Chi Minh, which we have enjoyed greatly.
The tour guides and scooter drivers were extremely helpful, polite and knowledgeable.

We had great conversations and gained a lot of knowledge about the history and Vietnamese culture.

Great tour, food, and sights. - We booked this tour as the reviews were great and thought it was a good way to see some of the city. We weren't disappointed was a great trip we chose for the evening tour starting at 530 there is plenty of food to eat some of the strangest food I have ever come across. The tour guides are informative and talk throughout the trip thanks to our guides khanh hang, Thu huong and Anh Diem great job!
You visit places you would not normally see, the guides have very good English and the tour is very safe, traveling in a larger group of about 16
Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Ho Chi Min City !

A bitural - I must admit that putting a rating on this activity was very difficult as the staff were all terrific and extremely friendly and professional. The reality is that whilst seeing the sites and being given a run down on the history of Saigon was good the actual experience was only average. The traffic and comfort level was significant due to the fact that there was such a long journey which was not something that was expected given the reviews. The food was diverse but average and lacking in substance and flavor for what is described as a foody tour. I think that the concept works but the actual tour could be greatly improved by working on the route and the way they space the stops and impart the history of Saigon. I am not suggesting that you avoid this activity however I think that one should prepare themselves for something less than the high % of 5 star reviews.

Highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh City! - My husband and I traveled to Ho Chi Minh City for a few days on our honeymoon. We did both the Foodie tour and the Site Seeing tour with XO Tours. We would highly recommend both. Our tour guides were friendly and outgoing and also very informative! Both tours were a highlight of our trip. It was super fun to ride on the back of the mopeds (we felt very safe at all times) as well! It was a great way to learn a lot about the city, see many different markets, hear about the culture, and try many tasty foods!

Best thing I did on the trip - Solo traveling, with just a weekend in MCMC - so keen to do the max. Booked the night-time foodie tour. Initially I was a little nervous the trip might be canceled as the heavens opened 30 minutes before pick-up (which is by the Opera House, so you can wait in Happy Hour in the bar at the top of CaraVelle Hotel).

Anyway - a coupel of whatsapp messages late from my driver - and we're sorted. A 30 minute delay to the start- then good to go. About 12 people in the group - from real youngsters to some older business types like myself.

Good vibe - lots of food... so I can remember the beef soup, goat, chicken, jumping chicken, loads of seafood, partridge, the famous duck egg, deserts. Some stops have free booze too. There's no skimping - happy to order more food (we double-up the crab and scallops at least, maybe the prawns too).

Anyway - my guide was called Tuyen - she's just finished her English Degree. All the guides seemed really pleasant and the tour manager was good to his word and had drop-boxed all of the night's photos within a couple of days.

Highly recommended - wish I'd booked something with them the next day too.

Fun time! - The driving guides and food guides were all well-informed and answered all of our questions about daily life and food in Vietnam. The tour was also well planned with lots of break time between different dishes. Would recommend

Highlight of Our Ho Chi Minh Trip - My husband and I took a tour with XO last night and it was by far one of the most special travel experiences we have ever had! Hong and Sophie were our drivers and we had a blast with them! By the end of the night, it felt like we were spending time with old friends.

All of the food stops are delicious and you get some information about the city as well.

If you have come across this tour, book it right away!

Best Street Food Tour Ever - Easily the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh. The guides were incredible and a pleasure to chat with while riding the bikes (which would be worth the price of admission alone!). The food was amazing; I would've never discovered these places without the tour. If you're coming here, you must do this tour!

Fun bike tour - When we arrived the idea of ​​a bike tour in this city was scary but I felt at ease immediately with these girls. They were great fun and as a family of four we all enjoyed the experience. The tour was interesting and informative. I would highly recommend XO Tours.

Do not book elsewhere! - My husband and I did a Night Foodie Tour with XO and it was a wonderful evening with great company, fantastic food and our two girl drivers were brilliant and made the evening complete. We visited some great restaurants (places you would probably not venture yourself) and sampled food in true authentic Vietnamese style. It was such fun being pillion with the girls and we did not feel unsafe at any point. This tour was one of our highlights. Highly recommend this company and tour!

A brilliant way to see Ho Chi Minh City and taste it's foods with XO! - A great & fun tour on the back of scooters carefully driven by some charming women. The tour leader Sang helpfully explained the different areas we visited & An and Ni were wonderful drivers and companions for the whole tour. Highly recommended!!

XO Saigon by Night and the Sights of Saigon - Our family took our first trip to Southeast Asia this summer. Our first stop was Ho Chi Minh city. We were doing an Adventures by Disney trip and arrived a few days early so I arranged the Saigon by Night tour our first day. We have two girls 12 and 14 and we all LOVED this trip - I was a little nervous about booking a moped tour with the girls but we all loved it - even the hubby! We felt strangely safe and loved our guides. They travel with two body guards in case one of the guides has a moped issue or if tourists get handsy (you hold on to the back of the bike - not the guide). This was a fantastic introduction to Vietnam - we loved it so much we booked the Sights of Saigon the next morning rather than trying to walk around the city (funny we felt safer on a moped than walking)...

an extraordinary food tour - This food tour was organized by our Tour Operator. During 4:30, we turned around Saigon city with 6 scooter drivers. the drivers were very safe, the food was extraordinary. A very good souvenir!!!

Fab night city tour of the city - Had a brilliant night tour on the back of XO tours female bikers. What an experience! Seeing the city by night on the back of a bike was really special and gave you a much better feel for the city than being in a car stuck in traffic. We also went to areas of the city you will never see which we thoroughly enjoyed. Our tour guide Kevin spoke excellent English and told us lots of interesting facts and stories of the areas we went to. All the girls who drove us around also spoke great English and chatted to us about the city throughout the evening. If you feel brave enough to face the roads of Ho Chi Minh on a motorbike then this tour is for you. Highly recommended.

Wonderful tour - We went for a great tour of Saigon, with family (4 children between 11 and 17 years) We went to areas that we probably could not visit for lack of time, we ate very well, wherever we were staying. I recommend at least 3 hours minimum (I think we did 4 hours and it's perfect), the girls drive very well and have good benevolence towards everyone. Absolutely charmed by this experience, which seemed to us at first glance too touristy and not at all!

Moped madness and food galour - Sang and the girls were fabulous - Saigon may look like mayhem but have never felt so safe! The food was fabulous and so much! I would recommend anyone traveling to Vietnam to do this tour 10/10.

Just WOW! - We really can't recommend this tour highly enough. We're coming to the end of our wonderful trip to Vietnam and Ho Chi Minh is our last stop - and tonight has been Amazing! Our two drivers, Tuyen and Trang, are both delightful girls who really looked after us, drove competently and safely, talked about everything and everything with us, explained all the delicious food and were just a real pleasure to spend time with.
There were 16 bikes altogether in our group and it was great mixed with such a range of people, under the careful care of the group leader, Tai, and all the other XO riders. The opportunity to tour the various districts of Ho Chi Minh in such a fun and informative way, is one we feel grateful to have experienced. It really was such a blast! And the food really was fabulous - and we've tried a lot in Vietnam!
Thanks again Tuyen and Trang - you girls are awesome.

Thank you Li and Ming Xo-best tours/Andi from Sweden - Xo tours/Xo fun/Xo Wow!
Thanks so much to Li who took me around the beautiful city of Saigon. She has a so big and good heart and so service minded.
She is perfect for working with Public Relations! So so kind.
Thanks to Ming the nice and humble guide with the passion for his city Saigon/Ho Chi Minh city. A real good history teller that provides you with everything you need to know.
Thank you Xo tours for the nice experience you give me☺️ 50 ⭐️ and 1000 ❤️.

Awesome way to see the sights and sounds of HCM city! - It was the first time me, my wife and 3 boys (5, 6, 10) had ever been on bikes... and to top it off .. in the crazy traffic of HCM city! But the friendly guides made the experience an awesome one with their good riding skills and warm hospitality. They were also very knowledgeable . We covered 5 districts in 1 night and learned interesting tit-bits and socio-economic nuances of the various districts. My boys can't stop reminiscing about their motorbike ride experience. Highly Recommended!

Absolutely fantastic way to see Saigon! - This tour was fabulous and one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. We went to five different districts, which showed us the bustling, teeming variety of life in Saigon. The food was delicious, the tour really interesting (and taught us a lot about life in modern day Saigon) but the highlight of the trip was the wonderful girls. Educated, charming, funny, knowledgable, an absolute pleasure to be with. We and our teenage children loved getting to know them and spending the evening with them. Not only that, they were very safe drivers.
Thank you so much to Sang and the whole team - we cannot recommend you all highly enough!

Half day motorbike tour of Ho Chi Minh City(Saigon) - This tour was exactly what we wanted. We knew we were staying close to some of the attractions but this tour puts it in perspective and helped determine where we revisited. The tour doesn't go into all the places you visited but the explanation by the guide the places we did enter were perfect for us. We felt completely safe the whole time despite being in traffic on motorbikes. My ten year old loved it and was completely at ease on the bike. I wholeheartedly recommend this tour at the beginning of your visit to HCMC as a thorough introduction to the city.

What a wonderful way to see HCMC. - On the recommendation of Tien at our hotel (Pullman Saigon), we chose a night tour that allowed us to witness the authentic Saigon. Our riders (Ngung and Anh) were quite the conversationalists and guaranteed our excursion was a memorable one.

Top Quality Care - My partner and I joined XO tours for a night time foodie tour in Saigon. It was our second night in Saigon and our bellies were still acclimatizing to the Vietnamese food and traffic when we ventured on the tour. Our guides were caring, enthusiastic and knowledgeable throughout the journey. They made sure we were comfortable with the motorbikes and as I had never been on a bike before I found this very comforting. My driver had been riding bikes for 20 years and grew up in the area.
Unfortunately I became unwell at the second food stop (which was nothing to do with the tour or food, it was an unrelated illness) and our driver and the main guide Khoi were so accommodating in taking us back to our hotel. We were sad to miss the rest of the tour but thoroughly enjoyed the time we had!
We also loved that Khoi sent an email the next day checking in on our health and sending photos through. Will definitely recommend this tour to others.

Must do in Ho Chi Minh - We approached this tour with great trepidation and wondered if we had made a mistake. However, it has proved to be the highlight of our Vietnam holiday. It was such good fun and we felt very safe as the female drivers are really competent in the mad traffic. Give it a go.

Flawless - I can't speak highly enough of this food tour. It was without a doubt my favorite thing I did in Saigon.

The tour is perfectly organized; all of the tour guides were very friendly, knowledgeable, great drivers and spoke fantastic English; never at any point did anybody on the tour feel unsafe; and best of all the diversity and quality of the food was amazing.

I've recommended the food tour to every traveler I've met since who's going to Saigon. Without doing this tour I wouldn't have seen half as much of the city, or realize the diversity of people, cultures and food that exists here.

I would happily do this tour again next time I return to Saigon :)

MUST DO in Ho Chi Minh - This is an absolute MUST DO when in Ho Chi Minh. You get a unique experience riding through the city on the back of a scooter driven by the very safe XO girls and eat all kinds of wonderful foods that you wouldn't normally try. This was the second time I have done the tour and it was just as good as the first time.

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh - This is the second time I have done this tour and loved it just as much as the first time. The girls are wonderful and make the evening so much fun. We had all kinds of food that you wouldn't normally try and it is fun experiencing the streets of Ho Chi Minh on the back of a scooter. This is a MUST DO.

A must-do in Saigon - This tour is the best way to taste authentic Vietnamese food and see the city! Not only do you get a wonderful personal guide but you get to ride around on the motor scooters that are so popular in Saigon. We absolutely loved it!

Great Food Tour - An excellent food tour in Ho Chi Minh. 100% recommended. Lots of choice for food tours but really felt we made a great one. Picked up from hotel and you get to visit 3 great food spots whilst having a tour of the city. Food spots are great really get that local feeling and also get to try some out of the ordinary dishes (obviously you don’t have too). All the ladies are lovely and safe drivers didn’t feel unsafe at all on the tour.

The best part about my trip! - I really enjoyed the company of the people at XO tours! Truly amazed by their hospitality and friendliness. The places Sang and his team took us to were really delicious and we never would’ve gone there if it were not for them. I discovered a lot of food I’ve never had before and ended up loving! So much that I’m going to try to recreate them at home. What I loved most about the tour is they took us to other districts and educated us about what’s going on in Vietnam with relation to their culture and economy, so it was educational and interesting! Thank you guys so much. I’ll definitely book this tour again next time I’m in Vietnam and would recommend it to all my friends and family! Thank you so much, Sang and XO tours!!! ♥️☺️

Fabulous night in HCMC with XO - I had so much fun, food and laughter on this tour. I was a bit nervous before jumping on the back of a scooter into HCMC traffic. But Chau, my excellent driver, instantly made me feel at ease and I had full confidence in her driving skills. The tour group is also accompanied on the road by guys on support bikes just in case. I really enjoyed seeing all over the city whilst having a chat with my driver about a wide range of topics. The food experience was fun - visiting places where the locals eat. The food was delicious with some very interesting dishes - I won't spoil the fun of discovery. The organisation and timing of the tour was excellent and getting amongst the HCMC traffic was exhilarating. I would definitely say this tour is a 'must do' in Vietnam.

Fantastic Experience - I'm 52 and have never been on the back of a motorbike so when my husband surprised me with this trip I was, to say the least, somewhat daunted by the prospect! There's nothing like breaking me in gently in a nice quiet and calm environment and this was truly nothing like it!! Hoi Chi Minh is literally swarming with motorbikes but our drivers were amazing and completely put us at ease. The 3 hour evening tour took us to local places to eat as well as several of the different districts of the city. Our drivers were fun, informative and spoke excellent English. There is an alternative 'foodie' tour but we chose for the evening tour which also included 3 different food stops. I would thoroughly recommend this tour which was the highlight of our visit to Vietnam!!

Nice and friendly tour guides - Very attentive & friendly tour guides. They took us to historical sites & signature places in HCM and shared us stories behind every location. The food was awesome too. Worth money spending money on.

Amazing tour! - Went in the Foodie Tour with XO and was one of our highlights from Saigon!

XO is timely, professional, safe, and FUN. We had such a great time trying things off the beaten path (which would have been almost impossible to do on our own never have been to Saigon and only there for 3 days). We didn't eat Pho, Bahn Me, or any of the typical foods you see in all the touristy parts of town. Instead we tried authentic, local, and DELICIOUS food from different parts of the city. Plus seeing the city by bike was an experience in itself.

A MUST do for any traveler. Good for families, couples, and solo travelers!

Great food tour and nice guides - I'm not too happy about motorbikes but the driver made me feel safe. All the drivers and guides were really good English speaking and we had fun during the rides and dinners. The food was a good selection representing Vietnam. I especially loved the seafood.
Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We had such a great time on XO tours. We felt completely safe the whole time and it was the best way to see a lot of Ho Chi Minh in a short time.

Amazing - What a great night from start to finish. Although did not want it to finish. Had the best night with the XO Gang. Amazing service and great food places. How Ming remembers all the group names is excellent. Loved it and would recommend to anyone

Best tour on offer - XO scooter foodie tour. This was the best tour!! The scooters are driven by women in traditional costume. They are very honorable and fun hosts. To become an XO driver you have to sit an English Test, Driving Test and then undertake a 1 month course in customer service and safety. They are highly trained and gorgeous young women with some spark and were terrific company on the evening.
The tour takes you to 5 different stops - 3 food stops and 2 sights. It's 11 courses of great food, laughter and an insight into Ho Chi Minh City.
Totally loved it and it is a MUST DO TOUR when in Vietnam. Highly recommend XO tour.

Exhilarating and Amazing - My husband and I have just arrived back from the Saigon Sights tour with XO Tours. Absolutely fantastic. The two drivers we had were excellent, very good drivers, friendly and knowledgeable. The tour leader Khoi was very knowledgeable and friendly too. We sampled dessert in a traditional market, traditional fruits, sugar cane juice and many sights in Saigon. I would highly recommend this tour and this tour company.

An awesome evening tour with Nhi - I found out about this tour from my guidebook and liked that all the tour guides are female since I'm traveling on my own. Nhi picked me up from my hostel (she was there early) and we spent three hours riding (safely) around the city. I chose for the main evening tour (rather than he foodie one) since I wanted to spend more time on the bike. Being up close and personal with the crazy Vietnam / Ho Chi Minh traffic was so much fun. Always felt safe. There was also another 'guide' wearing a branded 'XO' T-shirt who met us at each stop off point. Nhi explained this was partly for her safety and also for him to prepare some food at our food stops. We enjoyed some lovely fruit from the market and a rice-based meal, finally stopping off for a couple of deserts from a street stall. Nhi was very informative, friendly, smart and professional - thank you Nhi. I paid around £35 / $50, which is quite a lot of money by the standard of what most things cost locally. However, it was well worth it for the fun and for the fact that I felt safe and in good hands.

I would highly recommend this tour.

City Tour by Night - Fantastic way to see Ho Chi Minh, the whole experience was something to remember. The girls were all great riders and able to speak great English. Seng was the Gentleman followed us around to our various destinations and his insights into the City were amazing. Once on a scooter you soon realize that it's the most efficient mode of transport. Just do it.

XO-lent tour - This tour was my four-year-old dream come true. A scooter in HCMC.

It also turned out to be the rest of the family's dream come true too.

We took a private Sights of Saigon tour on the morning of the 19th and it was just awesome. The women on the scooters were absolutely lovely and incredibly professional.

Our guide for the sights had such a great demeanour and way about him and was incredibly knowledgeable. All together they were such a polished and professional operation.

Excellent way to see Saigon - We absolutely loved the sightseeing tour. We were shown in a few hours things and places that would have taken otherwise us way longer to do it on our own using a taxi. The girls and the tour guide, Mr. Ming, has a great knowledge of the city places and its history. Highly recommend!

XO Foodie Tour - So glad we decided to do this tour, it was a highlight of our time in Saigon. The girls were fantastic and made us feel comfortable, not to mention very capable scooter drivers in a place that can only be described as organized chaos. Not only did we sample some delicious Vietnamese cuisine, but we also visited various districts around Saigon and heard about the history of each one. My favorite dish was the jumping chicken!

Great food and fun tour guides - I was traveling by myself in Vietnam, and this tour was great for a number of reasons. They safely took me through parts of Ho Chi Minh that I was unfamiliar with and might not have gone to alone. They also described the history of the different districts and pointed out both famous landmarks and local hotspots. We also tried a nice variety of Vietnamese food, including noodle soup, Vietnamese BBQ, and various seafoods plus dessert. They even arranged special meals for me since I am vegetarian/pescatarian, and all of the veggie options were delicious so I didn't feel like I was missing out!
My tour guide was Nhung, who told me she is also a student at a local university. She was very friendly and spoke great English, and even tried to teach me some Vietnamese! She also gave me additional recommendations for restaurants and bars to check out. This tour was also a great way to get used to riding on the back of a motorcycle/scooter, and afterwards I felt completely comfortable calling my own Grab Bike (the Vietnamese version of Uber) and riding on scooters to get around in general. Overall the tour was great and the people were phenomenal! The tour manager, Ming, was also very funny and knowledgeable!
Xo night tours - Absolutely the highlight of our time in HCMC. Amazing girls, awesome local knowledge. Just brilliant... if you do nothing else, do this!!!

Best part of Ho Chi Minh! - I can't say enough good things about XO Tours.

2 friends and I did the sightseeing tour with Bao, Nga, Tracy, and Boi two weeks ago when we were in Vietnam. I booked with them because a friend recommended them after having a great time with them last year. Not only was it a good way to see the city quickly, the motorbikes were SO SO fun. Not to mention the girls and Bao were SO sweet, knowledgable, and friendly - we all became friends by the end of the trip.

I've already recommended them to many friends who are planning trips to Vietnam this year, and will continue to recommend!

The Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City - Ming as our tourguide and the fabulous women scooter drivers were so much fun. Not only was the food fantastic but information the drivers gave each of us on their city was priceless. My family had a memorable time.

XO tour! - Thankyou XO tours! The foodie tour we went on in Ho Chi Minh City was the highlight of our Vietnam trip. The girls were fantastic tour guides, very safe drivers and made the entire night so much fun. The restaurants we visited were incredible and gave us an excellent taste of Vietnam. A must for anyone who visits!

Brilliant tour! - We did the sights of Saigon tour and it was a real highlight of our stay in Vietnam. Our kids are 9 and 7 and we all felt completely safe throughout while loving weaving through the traffic! Our guides were brilliant fun and hugely knowledgeable with truly excellent English. We all learned a great deal and the kids were really engaged; they haven’t stopped talking about it since! There were lovely touches as well, where we saw less obviously touristy places and had the chance to taste local food as well. I can’t recommend this tour highly enough.

Brialliant Brilliant Brialliant - The best foodie tours we have done by far. It failed to disappoint from the first minute right until we got dropped off at our hotel front door. The food was the best we have eaten and it just kept coming as did the drinks. What made it even better was the fact the two male XO riders were with the group and they endured my wife was safe when went and took a look outside one of the restaurants and went with her (all part of the price)
To our lovely moped riders Huyen and Loan 2. Thank you both so much for making this a tour one we wont forget and have already told so many people back in Australia about
Please book an XO tour you wont be dis-appointed and the foodie tour is something else.

Ivan & Vee

Two great tours with XO Tours! XO Foodie Tour and Sights of Saigon Tour - These tours are absolutely wonderful! Each person who tours has their own scooter driver guide as well as a tour guide leader who chats to you at each stop. The result is wonderful conversations as you proceed through the Saigon traffic! The scooter ladies are lovely and it gives you a chance to chat to them about their lives and their history as young ladies growing up in Vietnam.

I did the XO foodie tour first. They whizz you all over Saigon painting a picture of the city as they go. This tour gives you an insight into eateries and dishes that you are unlikely to find on your own. The selected dishes were all absolutely delicious. The guiding was wonderful. I really enjoyed the fact that the selected places were off the beaten track. There were no other westerners around and it was wonderful for people watching! A marvelous job by my guides Han and Sang!

For the Sights of Saigon Tour I was lucky as I was alone on the group tour - as such I had my wonderful scooter lady guide - Nga and Khoi - the tour leader guide. I was spoiled having both of them. This tour scoots you around for a wonderful intro into the history and the main sights of the city. It is perfect to do on your first morning - and then they can drop you back at any of the museums you would like to visit to do an in-depth exploration at the end of the tour.
I would highly recommend both tours. Thank you XO team for a great intro!

Saigon highlight! - What a way to see the city, especially if you only have a few nights here. The food experience is unique and you’d never find such variety and freshness on your own, and the sightseeing stops give you a super insight into the city. Best of all though are the staff who understood how to make it fun for the kids as well as adults. Five star plus! Thanks Mai, Sang, Jan and the rest of the girls.

Delightful female guides on scooters - We booked two tours through XO; the first was the Foodie tour and the second Sights of Saigon. Both were excellent. The girls were delightful. So friendly, helpful, knowledgeable and kind...plus excellent and safe scooter drivers. If we had to pick one tour it would be the foodie tour...it is a great way to discover different parts of Ho Chi Minh as well as many different types of food. Food the locals eat.
I would highly recommend using XO for any of their tours.

Great experience, so much fun. - We took the “Saïgon by Night” tour, two young at heart ladies and our two teenage daughters. The ladies were extremely capable riders so we felt very secure and comfortable, even in the busy traffic. We enjoyed the opportunity to see many of the other districts. Tour leader Chau was very knowledgeable so we learned a lot about the Saïgon culture and lifestyle. The ladies were a lot of fun and we loved talking and laughing with them. This tour suited us as one of our group was not too adventurous with Vietnamese cuisine, we did get to try a few dishes, but not as full on as the foodie tour. Very professional tour, thank you XO

Highlight of our Vietnam trip - My wife and I recently took the XO Food Tour and we both had a fantastic time. There was a huge selection of street food on offer and it was all excellent. Our hosts & scooter drivers were excellent - offering lots of tidbits of information about life in Saigon and Vietnam. The traffic may be absolutely mad in Saigon, but the crazy system kind of works; at no point did either my wife or I feel uncomfortable or in danger whilst on the back of the scooter :-)
Beside the food, its a fantastic way to see the city - you cover way more of Saigon in the 4/5 hours than you could in a taxi, and the hosts are always willing to point out areas of interest and answer questions.
If you're visiting Saigon, I would thoroughly recommend taking the tour.

Great day out - This was the best day out on our month long trip to Vietnam.
Highly recommend. We done the tour of sites around HCMC, the ladies were great on the bikes, felt really safe. We learnt so much about HCMC and the people.
When we go back we want to do the food tour.

Great introduction to Saigon - Friendly and knowledgeable guide and drivers, comfortably paced tour, great fun being in all that chaotic traffic on the back of a bike - somehow it all feels more controlled when you’re in it! We all loved it, and we are booking on their food tour tomorrow night.

Must do at least one of the tours - night tour is best - It was recommended by a couple of different friends and a must do in Saigon We did the city tour in the morning and then the foodies tour at night. If you only do one then do the night tour it’s a great way to try the variety of foods on offer in Vietnam. You go on the back of a motor bike with your driver - it’s the best way to get around Saigon and can get quite scary but a lot of fun. A great experience and the both teams who ran the tours were great.

AMAZING Foodie tour on Motorbikes - We had the most amazing time on the food tour of Ho Chi Minh seeing the city behind the beautiful and friendly ladies of XO tours.
I went with a group of 4 friends and they picked us up at our hotel and brought us to the best spots to eat. It was the biggest highlight of our trip! We can’t wait to recommend this to everyone who visits HCM. It’s a MUST DO!!

XO Foodie Tour - The highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City! This group was highly professional, well organized, and knew how to have fun. We were able to see different districts of the city, ride the infamous scooters, and try amazing food. They were also very considerate of my husband's shellfish allergy and had substitute foods for him to try. I would definitely do this tour again.

Foodie Tour - First tour I did when I just landed in Saigon, as it was highly recommended by a friend. It was really a foodie + sightseeing tour as the group introduced Saigon through a scooter (part of everyday life of Saigoners) + history of the various districts + local cuisine! I would however like to suggest to XO Tours to include a dessert or coffee stop at the end of the tour, just as a nice ending to the tour for guests who like desserts. The guides rode well, spoke English and kept introducing Saigon to us. Overall, an enjoyable experience.

Must-do tour! - With a 9 hour layover in HCM I had been googling the best things to do for the four of us, including 12 year old & 10 year old kids. A few motorbike food tours popped up but I kept seeing XO Tours’ great reviews and so I booked it in. Our expectations were absolutely topped by the brilliant, fun & exciting tour where we learned so much about Saigon & ate some really great food. All the staff are fabulous & super-friendly and made everyone feel very safe & looked-after.
The ladies on the bikes are wonderful - negotiating the crazy traffic (!) with ease & chatting to us about life at home while explaining the districts & answering any questions we asked. The food we tried was delicious - so much we couldn’t eat it all - and whilst veering slightly from the usual pho/ banh mi we see at home, was not too spicy or out there for my kids!
Right from our initial email exchanges to sending prompt receipts, waiting for us - we took quite a bit of time to clear passport control - to the tour itself and the wonderful food, everything was brilliant, professional & worth every penny.
A must-do tour that was perfect for the limited amount of time we had, and certainly kept us all awake until the next leg of our journey!
Thank you Bao, Nhi and all the team at XO Tours :-)

Fun Food Tour - We did the night food tour with two lovely guides, Duyen and Tram. They were both very professional and friendly and we felt totally safe and well looked after all night.
Communication prior to the tour was excellent and hotel pick up was exactly as arranged.
It was great fun to be on the back of the bikes navigating the streets of Saigon. We visited several districts and tried a range of popular street food.
Well worth doing!

Amazing way to see Saigon - My partner and I did this on our second night in Vietnam and it was such a wonderful way to learn about the culture and layout of Saigon. We would never have known to go to all these awesome spots to try the local food and everything was delicious. Initially nervous about the motorbikes, we ended up having so much fun zooming around at night, it's super safe. Can't recommend this enough. Special thank you to Phuong and Ha our tour guides for such an amazing experience we won't forget.

Sights of Saigon - A great way (the only way!) to see Saigon! The XO Tour team is sensational from opening extra spots on the day we wanted to do the tour to their knowledge and sensitivity about the diverse history and culture. The riders are so friendly and fun and despite my initial concern and slight fear not once did I feel worried riding around the bustling streets of Saigon. Kids aged 11 & 14 also loved it - to date the best part of the trip for them! XO was recommended by a friend and I would highly recommend them to anyone. We are about to book again for a Hoi An tour. Thanks!!!

Fun and educational! - At the recommendation of friends, we jumped at the chance to see Saigon by motorbike - a first for us both! The foodie tour seemed a bit long and perhaps too filling for us so we opted for the Saigon by Night tour. It was a lot of fun and still included delicious dinner and dessert across a few different districts. We learned a lot from our guides and the tour leader, which was perfect for us as first time visitors. Big shout out to Linh, Nan and Khoi. They picked us up and dropped us off right at our hotel. They also prepped our food and gave us ponchos during a little rain on the way home. They were wonderful hosts who made us feel at home in Saigon. We were also very happy to support a company that makes it part of its mission to provide opportunities to women in the city's growing tourism industry.

Best thing to do in Saigon - What a fantastic experience. Got to go all over the place that would never have seen otherwise. The drivers are lovely and very friendly. Also ate food I probably would never have ordered. Highly recommended.

excellent - The ladies are knowledgable and vibrant. It was an amazing experience sitting on the back of the bike and we felt totally immersed into the hustle and bustle of daily life. The ladies were confident at navigating through the chaos and we felt safe in their hands. We were taken through various districts and given a lot of information regarding each district. We highly recommend this tour as you will see and learn so much.

A lovely evening trying some amazing food! - My partner & I joined for the evening foodie tour & had a fantastic evening. Our drivers were really friendly & both excellent drivers, dealing with chaos of Ho Chi Minh traffic while also maintaining a conversation, teaching all about the city. On the tour you covered several districts and saw so much more than if you’d have been on foot. The food was all excellent & varied, with loads of seafood & plenty of beer. You won’t leave hungry!

Super fun tour - We did the Saigon City tour - it was super super fun! The drivers picked us up on time, was very friendly and we enjoyed the tour a lot! Boa was a great tour guide with lots of interesting facts! Thanks Ann and Thu - for better drivers and guides we couldn’t ask!!

Amazing - XO tours came recommended by a friend and it did not disappoint.
Apart from the lovely food our guides were amazing. Yim was the poor girl lumbered with me and she was an absolute angel. So informative and helpful.
When we were sat having food the other guides interacted with us all so it was one big happy party.
Loved it and recommend anyone visiting HCMC to go on this tour.

Fun tour - I had a great time on the foodie tour with XO. The guides were great fun and introduced us to some meals that we would have been unlikely to pick from the menu ourselves. I'm vegetarian, so just watched on as the others sampled meals like balut and frogs, but there was no shortage of food (and beer) for me to sample as well.

Good tour, great food, wonderful people, high price - I think we did the Foodie Night Tour (in HCMC). This was a great tour experience, but quite pricey. Our food tours in Hanoi / Hue were 50% - 75% less. XO is a real tour company, not just students with scooters, so I understand their costs are different. I'm just not sure all of the "extras" (many extra staff, pins, phrasebooks, etc.) made any noticeable impact on our experience. Again, great tour, great food, great people, just expensive.

Great tour guides Hong & Trang - We had an amazing night at the back of the scooter of Hong and Trang of XO tours. They took us to local restaurants in districts 5, 8, China Town etc. Best night in Ho Chi Minh, not only because of the food being amazing but even more so because of the genuine talks with the girls about how their life is in HCM.

Wow!! - Unbelievable tour!! We are a family of four with two university students. We didn’t know what to expect but were immediately impressed when we hoped on the scooters. Our drivers were University students, or recently graduated, and very friendly and professional. We did the sights of Saigon tour in the morning and the foodie tour in the evening. We couldn’t be more happy with the tour. I highly recommend it for anyone. The only way around Saigon is by scooter and you will feel like a local.

Bike tour 👍🏻 - Great morning riding around the city on mopeds Ming our guide and the 4 girls who drove us were great. We felt very safe riding with them even though the city was very busy. My driver was Cathy her English was excellent as she pointed out things of interest and chatted between sites.
Best way to see Saigon! - This was the highlight of my stay in Saigon! Even if you ate nothing, I would still recommend the tour as I seen parts of the city that tourists never mention!

Amazing motorbike foodie adventure - My family and I were pleasantly amazed with XO Tours in Saigon. The lady drivers were fun, sweet, and informative. We ate, and chatted, and laughed, and were able to see places and try things that we would have never been able to figure out on our own. The food places they took us to were wonderful! All three of us thoroughly enjoyed the tour from beginning to end. Ww wouldn't hesitate doing more tours with XO Tours.

Best Afternoon Tour Ever - I was looking for an afternoon activity for a hastily scheduled stopover in Saigon when I stumbled on this in TripAdvisor. Glad I followed the recommendations, the trip was great. Well planned and fun without feeling too confining or structured. The tour just flowed, with the right amount of time being spent at each stop and was perfectly planned. We didn't have to wait for anything, as soon as we arrived at a restaurant the food and drinks arrived. Everyone was really friendly and my guide Nga spoke english very well and was an excellent driver. I will definitely schedule one of their other tours next time I'm in Saigon. Highly recommended!

MUST DO WHEN IN HCMC - The tour may be a little more expensive than others, but once I saw their website and the fun they have I just had to book this adventure. One reason is they have insurance to cover you should an unfortunate event occur - but unlikely as the girls are "excellent drivers" to quote Rainman. We were lucky to have Phoung 2 and Phuong 4 as our drivers and both young ladies were very informative and great to converse with. They are very smart ladies studying whilst being XO drivers. You don't just go around the block. You venture into Saigon peak hour which is a bit scary, but OK after a while and what a great insight to their daily life. Many stops on the tour which are all great and includes 11 dishes and some beers if you want. You are escorted with some guys that act as security in the background but are unobtrusive also. I reckon we covered 20km over the four hour tour, so I felt really well worth the money. You meet up with other like minded tourists and the girls make for such a fun for four hours and would do this tour again with hesitation. It was awesome. Thanks Phoung 2 & 4, we loved our night! Love Graeme and Catherine from Melbourne Australia.

Cycle fun with XO Tours - I just came across pictures of the day we enjoyed with the XO tour team. They were so professional and so insightful. Our group included adults and 2 boys of 10 and 8 and everyone’s needs were met along the way. It’s a great way to spend your first day or so in Saigon and get immersed right into the craziness of the traffic and start to identify and taste some of the unusual foods. Also a good idea if you’re thinking of hiring a scooter and have never driven on this type of traffic before. And of course you get to see all the main sights in one go and then you can return if you want to explore any of them in more detail. Highly recommended!

Fabulous adventure! - My partner and I went with the XO Tours crew for night time Foodie Tour on 3 June. We both absolutely loved it. A highlight of our visit

We felt totally safe on the back of the bikes. The people we met and the foods we tried will forever remain with us.

Highly recommended for anyone travelling to Saigon.

Highlight of Our Stay in Vietnam - What a great experience.The tour was great from start to finish.Very well organised and the staff were great.Thanks to Ming and our girls Ha and Phuong who were both lovely, friendly hosts who patiently answered a barrage of questions and even taught us some Vietnamese along the way.Such a memorable night,would recommend highly to anyone visiting HoChiMin city
XO Foodie tour - What an awesome and exciting way to explore Ho Chi Minh city on scooters and the food at the same time.

Wow, What a Memorable Evening!!! - My husband and I did the Night Foodie Tour of Saigon and what an experience it was. We were collected from our Hotel by our two girls and they took us to a meeting place to join the rest of the Tour Guides and Guests for the evening. What a great bunch of people!!! The Districts that we were taken through were amazing - definitely saw some sights that we would not have if we had been doing our own thing. The food markets were a bit smelly to some but overall, we were on the bike so didn't stop for it to affect anyone. The places that we did stop to enjoy the local foods, were great. Busy with the locals and we just blended in (as best we could!!). Ate a variety of foods that we normally wouldn't - some we like, some we didn't but at least we gave it a go. I do draw the line, however, at fermented duck eggs :-)
Do the tour - you won't regret it!

Scooter Food Tour - I planned this activity for my husband's birthday. We had a great and memorable time! (They even got my husband an entire cake at the end of the night for us all to share!) From start to finish it was professional and well organized. They answered all my questions quickly and thoroughly over email. The ride itself was not only fun but I really enjoyed chatting with my driver and learning more about everyday Vietnamese life. Her talent at talking and driving at the same time was impressive given how crazy HCMC traffic is. I think my only room-for-improvevement feedback is that we did not go to more places to eat and instead seemed to spend lot of time on the scooter. I would suggest trying 5 or 6 restaurants instead of just 3. Other than that we loved it and will recommend it to others. Thanks XO!

XO foodie tour saigon - This was a surreal experience. Riding on the back of a motorbike through the streets of Saigon at night. Being part of the maelstrom felt like being part of the city. The staff and food was amazing. We laughed all night and after four hours were sad to see our hotel rising in the distance. An unforgettable, and unmissable, experience in Saigon.

Highly recommend! - Great! So friendly! Great food great company. very informative. Very safe drivers. Know what they are doing. Food was great and unique. Not too unique to where it’s too frightening. Had frog, quail, clams, scallops, crab, goat, beef, okra, eclairs, green beans, bread, tropical fruits. Missing some I’m sure but it wa great. I didn’t try the duck embryo egg, but it was an option.

Saigon by Night: A stunning experience with a lot of fun - We had only a short layover in the city on our way to a much quieter place in Vietnam, and I am glad I discovered XO tours to get a first impression via their Saigon by Night tour. We were greeted by the very friendly and communicative girls in front of our hotel, and soon dived into the traffic madness. We got a tasting of different city districts, and the tour leader provided very interesting socio-cultural background information. We found the three hours duration to be perfect for a first evening, and dinner was tasty and filling, completed by a dessert at the last stop. I cannot recommend enough booking this adventure.

Coolest thing I did in Ho Chi Minh - I was in SE Asia for two weeks and this was one of the highlights. great perspective of the city that you can’t get from just walking around. This is really a lot of fun. You’ll see a lot of the city at night, eat some great food, meet new interesting people, and make great memories. The pictures they take are great too. It’s awesome. Would recommend to anyone.
