Wonderful start to my trip - I joined the Saigon by Night tour a few hours after I landed in HCM. It was a very insightful and colorful experience. The tour leaders and guides were all friendly and accommodating. A great start to a memorable trip here in Vietnam.

Amazing food tour! - I just went on this tour with a few friends and had the absolute BEST time. All the guides were amazing, and Khoi was a wonderful group leader. The food was delicious and the logistics were flawless. We were staying in District 1 so this was a great way for us to see a lot more of the city. Be prepared to eat a LOT!

AWESOME Food Tour - The entire tour was such a great experience. The guides are well organized, kind, fun, knowledgeable, and informative. You'll learn about the city, it's people, and their delicious food. I heartily recommend this tour, it was the highlight of my trip to Vietnam.

Foodie Tour of Saigon - Cannot recommend enough - I really cannot recommend this tour enough. It was so well organized, the drivers and guides were so friendly and open, and I learned so much about Ho Chi Minh City, its history, people, and food. A truly unique, delicious, and amazing experience. Thank you, thank you, thank you XO tours for an incredible view to your city!!

BEST foodie tour in town - My classmates and I were going to be in Vietnam for a school trip and we were looking for a fun group activity for us to learn about Vietnam. XO tours was the best way to accomplish just that and more.

I helped coordinate and book the tour for 19 of us. After careful research and comparison to other services, I decided to choose XO tours due to the ease of communication, professionalism, and their knowledgeable staffs.

I was even more impressed on the day of the tour to see that we had 10 addition security staffs with us to ensure our safety. The team was experienced, friendly, and most importantly, they know how to have FUN. The tour was worth every single penny and would recommend it over and over again to others. These guys are AMAZING!!!

Night Foodie Tour - Lots of Food, Lots of Fun - This is a great way to see many areas of Saigon. We covered a lot of distance with our very safe and proficient “drivers” Jen and Nhung who were great to chat with. We had three food stops with a variety of delicious dishes, some cooked by our drivers. A couple of info stops when our tour guide Sang provided relevant and interesting info regarding the particular area. There is plenty of food with the option to have more if you want. The same for drinks. We ventured into places we probably wouldn’t on our own.

Will do it again and again! - Second time tour for my fiancé and I - we loved every minute of the Foodie Tour. Visited a number of awesome food spots, and were not left hungry. Plenty of meat and seafood were offered - as well as beer! We also tried frog, goat and duck egg embryo. Highly recommend XO Tours. Drivers and leaders are some of the friendliest people you will meet in HCMC. We’ll most definitely be returning for a third tour. Thanks for your kick ass hospitality!

Fantastic experience - I had before a while a fantastic experience of tour with motorbike. It was Ho Chi Minh tour by night with XO Tours and it was really super. We also tasted Vietnamese cuisine and became part of the city for more than 4 hours. My driver-guide Tou and Mingh the supervisor solved everything for us so we enjoyed our time.
I strongly recommend this experience to people who love to be part of the city.
Driving by girls are very safe’

Brilliant food tour and excellent guides - First thing worth mentioning is the price, at $75 USD per person it may seem expensive at first glance however it is worth every penny.

The wonderful drivers meet you at your hotel, give a quick and informative safety brief on the bikes before you are whisked off through the busy streets of Saigon to your first destination.

The second thing worth noting is that the portions at each food stop are massive. The first stop was a beef noodle soup (similar to pho) and despite it being described as an appetizer it could easily have been a meal on its own. The tour leader reassured the whole group that no one would be offended if the food wasn't finished - which was good to know as there was 12 dishes in total on the tour!

At each stop the guides made sure to recommend which accompaniments went best with each dish and not only explained in detail how each dish was prepared but at the BBQ stop they cooked the food right in front of us. They were so friendly and knowledgeable and on each drive provided us with lots of information about the areas we were driving through.

We took this tour at the end of our time in Saigon and it really was unlike any other experience already encountered and the highlight of our South East Asia tour so far!

Best food tour in Saigon!! - We had such an amazing experience on this tour. They are such good drivers, very professional and so friendly.
The variety of food and places we visited was amazing!
Can’t recommend this food tour enough!

Awesome Food tour of Saigon - We were 4 Americans traveling together and XO was our first activity in Vietnam. Best way to see Saigon and try lots of different foods. Motorbikes were incredibly fun, guides were well-informed and spoke great english. Food was outstanding. Worth every penny.

Amazing food tour with great hosts - My wife and I had the most fabulous night seeing different Ho Chi Minh City districts on the back of a scooter driven by two wonderful ladies who put us at ease with their safe driving and took us to great food spots throughout the city. This tour was very well organised and the hosts provided a wonderful insight into the city and Vietnamese culture in general. Highly recommend for those visiting Ho Chi MInh City to do this tour.

The best tour in Hochiminh. - This is the best tour I've ever been in my life.
5/31 のnight tour に一人で参加しました。当日、滞在した1区のホテルに迎えに来ていただきました。ホスピタリティも素晴らしく、楽しく夜のホーチミンを案内してくれます。英語での案内ですが、わかりやすい英語で話しを盛り上げてくれます！ホーチミンに旅行に来たら是非おすすめのツアーなので、参加してみてください。スリリングですが安全で、楽しく、ホーチミンの夜を満喫できるはずです！

In one word... Awesome! - In one word...Awesome! 

Thank you so much for your five star service, variety of dishes and neighborhoods to experience and a special shout out to Thao! 

She had me smiling the moment she picked me up at the hotel.  I couldn't have hoped for a better guide.  

She may be one of the 40% of Vietnamese named Nguyen, but make no mistake she is one of a kind!  Smart, sweet and a cute sense of humor. 

Thank you so much for the highlight of my few days in Saigon.

Night Tour - This trip was fantastic. The girls were friendly, engaging, fluent in English and very confident and careful on the bikes. Never felt unsafe at all even with bigger kiwi guys on the back. Cathy was a great guide. Sang who met us at the stops had excellent english and was really informative. This is a must do in Saigon and was alot of fun.

Night Tour - We did the 3 hour Night Tour from 6-9pm and saw the city outskirts stopping at 4 places the second being a food stop which was fabulous. We were a group of 4 kiwis and we all loved thos tour. Our girls were all super friendly, excellent drivers and had very good English. A very well organized group with Tour Leader Sang at every stop to explain the city in detail. We had a great time and would highly recommend XO Tours.

Foodie and City Tours - We went on 2 tours during our recent trip to HCM. The foodie tour is in the evening with the city tour in the morning. When you get over the initial fear of the traffic which is crazy, the tours feel very safe and the drivers are confident and friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed both tours and we saw some sights that were off the main tourist routes. It was just the 2 of us on the city tour and only 5 on the foodie tour. Whilst there is local cuisine on the foodie tour there isn’t anything too bizarre to eat. A really interesting way to see the city

Tour around Saigon - We absolutely loved this tour. Zipping around the city on the back of the scooter was so exhilarating. The guides were incredibly competent and friendly drivers and shared really interesting stories about Saigon. We totally recommend exploring with XO.

Nightlife tour in Rain - I did the Saigon by night tour. It rained heavily 1 hour before the tour was due to go start. The tour went ahead despite the rain and I was pleased it did.
The traffic in Saigon is crazy, but at no point did I feel unsafe during the tour despite the weather conditions or other road users. The thunder and lightning added to the experience and my driver was very experienced, good rider.

I saw part of Saigon I would never have experienced had I not taken this tour.

My driver Lin, and tour manager Khoi were very friendly, spoke very very good English, and shared lots of interesting information about their city.

I would highly recommend this tour.

AMAZING food tour!!! - Hands down one of the best tours I have ever done! As we are backpacking around South East Asia, this was a bit of a splurge for us and we were so glad that we did it. We got to sample so many different Vietnamese dishes and explore Ho Chi Minh from the back of the motorbikes. The girls were so lovely and I learnt a lot about the city and culture just by chatting to them throughout the night. If this is the one thing you spend your money on when visiting Ho Chi Minh, then do it! Highly recommend!!

Great Tour - XO Saigon through the lens tour - I went on one of the XO tours that is focused on taking pictures around Saigon. It was certainly a great experience riding on the bike and touring the city. I had some great tips from the tour leader Khoi on street photography, they had brought me to some of the iconic places to take pictures and told me stories and the history of Saigon. Not to forget the delicious local breakfast and iced coffee ! Definitely recommended !

Fantastic tour with amazing scooter girls - This was probably the highlight of our Vietnam tour, although it was all excellent. We were a bit apprehensive about riding on a scooter in the crazy Ho Chi Min traffic but we felt totally safe riding with the fabulous girls on the scooters. The tour of the many areas of the city was fun and informative and the food stops were equally fun and we learned so much about the local food which was helpful on the rest of our stay. Can't recommend this trip and Company enough! Thanks for a great night!

Fantastic tour - My husband and I did the foodies tour around Ho Chi Minh city and absolutely loved it. We got to see all the districts you wouldnt typically go to and learn more about the city. And of course the food is amazing! Definitely a highlight of our trip and would recommend to everyone

Highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh - My husband and I had a fab night with the ladies from XO tours on a foodie tour. Great experience to sit on the back of the motorcycles and travel around the various districts of HCM and enjoy food in places we would never have eaten in. Food was great as was the company. I would highly recommend this tour.

Must do in Saigon! - One of the best tours I've ever done. Fantastic guides, super friendly and informative. Heaps of fun riding around town on the back of a scooter. Gets you out of the centre and into areas of the city you would never normally visit and most importantly, great food!
XO food Tour - Great night with a great company very professional. Would highly recommend. The food was amazing and it was a great introduction to the city

The best way to taste Saigon - We chose this company because we liked their ethos and because they had great reviews. We were not disappointed! Our lady drivers turned up to the hotel we were staying at with the warmest of welcomes to their country. Anh 3 and Nghi 2 were the most beautiful, polite and professional pair. They explained everything brilliantly. We drove first to China Town where we met the tour guide Sang. From China Town we continued through the different districts with our MOTO GP RIDERS Anh and Nghi stopping of to get all the great history and current information regarding each area from Sang. Being on the back of a moped in Saigon is amazing... We would never have seen the different districts by ourselves. My sincere thanks to tour leader Sang for all of his great info, photos and his lovely personality and genuine interest in insuring we had a good time. To both ladies, we will never forget putting our lives safely in your hands and for your great answers to all our questions. We will hopefully return to see you some day. Nearly forgot to mention the food was amazing. Next time we will do the food tour! Regards and thanks D & K

Most Awesome Saigon Night Tour - This was one of the best tours our family has ever done. We surprised the kids with a motorbike tour. Once we landed in Saigon and saw the traffic madness we were second guessing our decision until the amazing XO team showed up. They immediately made connections with each of our kids and safety was top priority. Within 10 minutes the kids were trying to tell them to go faster. The food, local areas explored, knowledge of the city was top notch. They made it so fun and engaging. We cannot wait to do the Danang tour next time. Thank you!!!

Awesome!! - This is a must do while you are in Saigon. Great adventures all around Saigon, excellent guides and the food is amazing- and never ending! The guides are incredibly safe, experienced riding the bikes and are knowledgeable about the city and food that is being served. XO took our booking at short notice and nothing was a problem. Thanks Nguyen, Trang and Bao - so friendly and great sense of humour too.
Fantastic tour - The Saigon Night Foodie Tour. Fabulous food, great drivers, fun times with the guides and others on the tour. Being on the motorbike thru the busy streets was so fun. Just book it!

Best Experience in Vietnam (Motorbike Food Tour) - I'm an American expat who has been living in Asia for about 9 months. I took a trip with a friend to Vietnam this past month. We only had two days in Saigon and one of her friends suggested the motorbike food tour. I was super scared but thought it would be a good way to explore the city and try local eats.

This tour has been my favorite experience in all my time in Asia (that includes things like The Great Wall). The people working on the tour were so friendly and accomodating. They made sure that even someone like me felt very comfortable on the scooters. Everyone was super knowledgible on the city of Saigon. I liked how the tour takes you to some locations that are not food related as well, giving you a look at the history of the city as well as how different areas are made up.

If you are in Saigon I highly recommend the Motorbike food tour. It's the best.

Holiday - Was not sure about getting on a scooter and heading off into the traffic with someone younger than my daughter driving into the chaos of Saigon traffic. The girls soon put us at ease explained what we had to do and we headed off. After the first block and the peak time traffic they were great. Did not have any hesitation and felt safe and confident with them. Then we get to the food, so much to eat and try and the tour guide and girls assisted all the way. Cannot reccomend this tour more highly the experience alone was well worth it
I encourage everyone to have at least one tour with them, we did the night food tour and was not disappointed but pleasantly surprised with organisation and professionalism of the whole night

Foodie tour - My wife and myself did the foodie tour last night.
We were a bit aprehensive about this tour.
From the miniute we met the drivers Tam and Nhi we were put at ease.
There skill in the Saigon traffic was amazing. The tour is very well organised with great food stops and infomation stops. Kohi was our tour leader and was a wealth of knolage.
But the tour itself was much more than expected.

Like parachuting but, - For some, including yours truly, the thought of jumping out of perfectly good airplane is terrifying. When we arrived in Ho Chi Minh City and I discovered that motorcycles were like a constant river of ants swarming through the city with seemingly no rules, I shuddered at the thought of my getting on the back of a scooter driven by a young lady young enough to be my granddaughter and weighing about as much as one of my legs. But this is the XO Tours experience I was "encouraged" to do. I think I would have preferred a proctology exam during church. I tool one for the team and went. I. HAD. THE. TIME. OF. MY. LIFE. It took me about 5 minutes to realize I was probably safer on that scooter than trying to cross a street. We saw more of HCM City in one evening than we ever would have and explored great sections of town and authentic Vietnamese food. I tried almost everything. While being chauffeured around town, I had a wonderfully engaging conversation with my guide. She wanted to know about the USA and I wanted to know about Vietnam. We talked candidly about Trump and communism the way we should talk about those subjects. It was great. At one point during our drive when we were nestled in the peloton of scooters, I raised both arms "Rocky style", and yelled WHOO-HOO. Glad my kids didn't see me do that. If you are going, please consider this a way to see the city and eat like the locals. Don't try with the excuses. One in our party is 82 and I weighed 266 lbs and others never rode on a bike before. Go ahead. LIVE!

What a fabulous experience! - Booked this tour as a surprise for my husband's 50th birthday - it was fantastic from start to finish.
Brilliant hosts who really engaged and cared about us having a good time.
They even organised a surprise cake for my husband - thank you XO tours it's a night we will never forget!

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We took this tour as last minute thing and really enjoyed it! Our young women drivers were terrific in the crazy traffic and it was certainly a cooler way than walking or being stuck in a bus. The places we visited were very interesting and the dessert provided was great, as was the coffee on the go and the fruit. The only slight criticism is that we thought there would have been enough time to see one more attraction. Highly recommended

Great tour - Enjoyed seeing the sights of HCMC with locals
Super safe with the girls on the scooter
The knowledge they shared of the areas and lifestyle is also important to understand the culture
Enjoyed the food and getting in amongst it all 🙂🤙🏾😎

Very interesting - Very interesting look at Saigon by night. Pleasant and well informed guides took us to places we could not have seen on our own. Safe drivers in heavy traffic.

Recommended. Good value. Prompt start and finished. Well organized. They even sent us photos afterwards by e-mail.

Saigon By Night - Top notch tour taking you to parts of the city one might not otherwise get two. My guides, Khoi and Mai were first rate, knowledgable and informative. I would highly recommend XO tours -- ask for Khoi and Mai.

Highly recommended XO Foodie Tour Ho Chi Minh City - Picked up promptly from our hotel at 525pm and met our amazing tour guides and drivers for the night Hong and Na, both were super friendly, helpful, spoke excellent English, and we learned so much talking with them about their lives in Vietnam and living in HCMC (definitely a highlight). Also to note that they were extremely good and safe drivers of the scooters and navigated the busy streets expertly and it was no problem having a big 6'2'' guy on the back of the scooter either.

There were about 10 or so other people on the tour you get to meet and go on the tour with. There were 5 stops, 3 for food (15 courses) and 2 for sights. At each food stop your guides hang with you,talk about the food, help prepare and show you the best way to enjoy it, they also play some fun games. Beer/water or drink of your choice provided throughout at each food stop. They take great photos of you during the tour and send to you after.

Great way to see the city, and extending to parts of the city you wouldn't normally, great food, great company, Highly recommend!

Amazing tour! - Last night my partner and I did the ‘Saigon by Night’ tour with XO. Our tour guides were Chau 1 and Phuong - they were amazing! So informative and very funny. We couldn’t have had a better night. The value for money is fabulous and I felt very safe being on the bike. The tour is planned very well and they even give you a gift and also a notebook with how to say things in Vietnamese! It was hilarious trying to speak Vietnamese with our tour guides. I would highly recommend XO tours! Chau and Phuong thank you for a great night!

XO Foodie Tour - I had the best time on this tour, knowledge of the area and the cuisine was excellent.

This was the best thing I did in Ho Chi Minh City!

Highly highly recommended.

An amazing experience - Don't worry about the traffic, that's half the fun and these young ladies are excellent and safe riders.
The food was amazing. You are stuffed full of food! They catered for a variety of people's food allergies and preferences.
Our 'drivers' were funny and knowledgeable as was the main tour guide.
A fantastic way to see and experience so many districts.

Not just about the food - Five of us went on the food tour with XO. Not only was it interesting to try various types of street/casual food in HCMC, the guides took us to five different districts. It was refreshing to see the city on a motorcycle. The guides and the tour leader are super friendly and fun. Felt like it was just the 11 of us hanging out as friends. Also learned a lot about the culture and the city through the eyes of our guides. Was definitely a highlight of our whole trip. Thanks for a memorable evening.

Great way to see the city of HCMC - Had an absolute blast on the sightseeing tour. The girls were so friendly and lovely to hand out with. Our tour guide was friendly and knowledgable. Being on a bike with such a good rider was gold aswell in that crazy HCMC traffic! Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend XO Tours or to book with them once again

XO NightTours - What an awesome experience!!!!! Our girls and leader were the most wonderful tour guides and we were able to experience, first hand, the madness of the roads behind our experienced riders....like threading a needle!!!!!! We did the night tour and visited the local market, ate at a local restaurant and visited various sights around the city. This was one of our favourite experiences and I thoroughly recommend it.

Highly recommend this foodie tour in HCMC - The foodie tour was one of the best things to do in HCMC.
You get to try a number of interesting and delicious Vietnamese foods, see lots of new areas in HCMC, and the guide and drivers make it a really fun time.
The young women who are the bike drivers are friendly, helpful, speak great English and really make the experience.
We had heavy rain on our trip and although there are poncho’s provided expect to still get wet if it rains - however this took nothing off the fun of the tour.
Great for solo travelers or a small group.

Amazing food tour in Ho Chi Minh! - We had an amazing time last night on the XO food tour in HCMC. The guides were excellent. Food was great. We had terrible weather but even that couldn’t dampen it for us. Thanks Ming, Thao and team for an awesome time. Would absolutely recommend.

Do it. Seriously - The wife and I did the Saigon by Night tour with XO. I simply cannot recommend it enough. The drivers were funny, friendly and had a deep knowledge of the city. We saw lots, ate lots and laughed lots while zooming around Saigon on very cool bikes. They are so good we immediately booked the day tour a few days later

Such Fun - Highly recommend. Laughed and smiled our way through the evening. Started from Opera House in District 1 at 6pm and ended at 9pm. Traffic everywhere, so much fun, food stops were great, market was great, and Drivers were the best. Thank you XO Trours

XO “Foodie” and “The Sights” - Thanks very much to our drivers and guides at XO, both tours were at the top of our highlights from our holiday in Vietnam.
The drivers are friendly, fun and very safe.
And the guides are also friendly and fun with plenty of knowledge of the history and culture of Vietnam and HCM city.
I highly recommend going on at least one of these tours during your stay in ho chi min

Four Fun - Wow, we had a great evening on this Tour. The 2 women who took us on bikes were informative, friendly, and entertaining. I felt comfortable and safe riding on the back of the motorbike. Was such fun, I'd do it again.

Best food tour ever!! - Wow!! If you do one thing, do this!! Such an incredible experience and simply exhilarating way to see HCMC. Our hosts were delightful, fun and so informative. Great bike riders who made us all feel safe. The amount of food was huge and we really got to try so many things we may not have had the chance to otherwise. One of my Vietnam highlights!

Foodie Tour - Excellent tour, well organized. We visited several districts in Saigon. The tour leader was very knowledgeable and the young ladies that ride you around on the motorbikes are so lovely, friendly and so easy to talk to. Not to mention the food is Amazing. Highly recommend this tour.

Best food tour and definitely a must do in HCMC!!! - Booked the private food tour with XO tour and it was definitely the highlight of my trip.
It was an amazing experience zipping through the busy HCMC on a bike and visiting different places for some very good local good.
My guide, Ms Loan Nguyen was such a good rider and guide, Although ive not been on a bike for around 20 years but she made me feel safe and i really enjoyed the ride.
She was also a very good companion and took good care of me during meal times. Never had i felt so pampered by someone over a meal whereby she did all the preparation and serving including peeling of the crab shell. Definitely made me feel like a king for a day!
Also had the chance to visit a few different districts (ie district 5, 7 etc) which i will never have done so on my own.
I would strongly recommend everyone to do this good tour at least once when you visit HCMC. And if possible, go for the private tour. It allows you to travel at our own pace and visit more places.
Thanks Ms Loan and XO tour for giving me such a memorable experience in HCMC.
I am looking forward to my next trip back and I will definitely want to try the custom tour.
Amazing guide - The tour was incredible, motorbike was the best way to see the city and the guides were very nice and knowledgeable. Even for not the most adventurous eaters this your is a must!

Seriously fun! - Chau 1 was a fantastic guide, her humor and professionalism extended way beyond and made me feel very welcome. Had so much fun thanks to her and the rest of the crew. Food selection was awesome! Will recommend to my entire company who travels here often!

Foodie Scooter tour - Fabulous night out. - 5 districts, 11 courses, night street life in HCM city and the opportunity to be part of the civilized mayhem as a scooter rider in this crazy town. My driver Hong was the lovelies lady and I felt very safe at all times. This experience is a MUST for anyone wanting to experience the real Saigon.

Foodie Tour was Amazing - My dad (65 years old) came to Ho Chi Minh last year and did this tour, and raved so much about how amazing it was to us that we decided to give it a go for ourselves. It did not disappoint! I was a little apprehensive having never been on a motorbike before, and seeing the carnage that is the streets of HCMC at rush hour, but that was put to one side after about 5 minutes. Firstly, the tour guides (Lao and Chao) were amazing. They were funny, knowledgable and patient, and gave a wonderful tour. The security guards were also very nice. Secondly, the food was brilliant. The restaurants were different to what we would normally do, and served an array of local dishes that were paired with a dipping sauce/marinade, which really gave a taste of Vietnam. Thirdly, the price was fab. We went as a private tour as we like to eat and didn't want to hold a group up, and it was very reasonable. The 5 hours flew by and I will remember it for the rest of my life. My personal highlight was sitting on the back of a moped, at 5:30pm at a red light, where there were perhaps 10 mopeds abreast, and 30 deep, all revving I waiting for the green light. What an awesome and exhilarating experience :-)

Great fun - We did the street food tour with our three kids (7, 9, 11) and it was fantastic. We felt so safe, the guides were wonderful and fun, and the backup network support made everything run smoothly on the night was amazing. Food was tasty, and we got to see lots of the city. Our kids are still talking about it. Highly recommended.
Top class - Excellent guides, incredible food, really fun to ride around Saigon at night on the back of a motorbike!!

Great fun, great good! - Friendly staff who speaks good English, great riders who made us all feel safe, and most importantly, it was great food in places we wouldn't have gone ourselves, and we all had a great time! Highly recommended!

Great Tour - Wow have to admit that this is the best way to both see Ho Chi Minh city and taste some amazing local food! Tam and Ann our drivers were amazing and great in providing their local knowledge in both these areas. They made the night a fantastic experience as did Sang our tour guide. We would suggest that if in Ho Chi Minh this is an experience not to be missed!

Xo Foody Tour! Amazing - Brilliant!! A must do tour to do while in Ho Chi Minh! Great way to see the city and try the different cuisine!! The tour guides were excellent! Had loads of fun and met some really cool people! 😊

The best tour we have ever taken. - Can't stress enough that if you only do one tour in Vietnam...this is the tour. Amazing from start to finish. The staff took care of every detail. The selection of restaurants and food choices was perfect. The bikes were safe and the drivers were very talkative and safety conscious, at the same time. Our 12 year old son absolutely adored his driver and my wife and I felt he was in great hands, even when HCMC traffic meant he was out of sight for extended periods of city riding.

Just do it! - This trip really is as good as everyone says, do yourself a favor and get on it! Food is unreal, service is amazing and the girls are so funny, kind and intelligent! Big up to Vy on her second day! Seemed like she had been doing it for years, extremely interesting and knowledgable conversations with a cracking sense of humour!

The Foodie Tour is so good I've done it twice - I have fond memories of doing this tour in October 2014. It was the highlight of our tour then and now on my 13th holiday in Vietnam I decided to do it again. It hasn’t changed much and doesn’t need to as this is an exceptionally well organized and designed tour for both food and sightseeing.

It is also the most fun you’ll ever have as the lady riders, the tour guide and his helpers are all exceptionally good. They take you to parts of Saigon we never saw on our first 8 trips to Vietnam, the ladies are all safe, skilled drivers and I’m told they have never had an accident on one of their tours (quite amazing when you see the chaos of Saigon traffic).

Our guide, Ming, was happy, knowledgeable, speaks perfect English and made the tour so much fun. My own bike driver was Tuyen, a gorgeous, happy, friendly lady from whom I learnt a lot more about Vietnam and who looked after me at each of the food stops, as did all the other drivers with their guests.

The food was delicious, a great variety served and there was always more than enough to eat. They were also generous with the drinks, ordering as much as you could drink at each of the venues.

This tour is a little more expensive than some of the others but is exceptional value and I believe it is the best. I would highly recommend it to anyone, especially soon after arrival in your first visit to Saigon.

so much fun - The food was great, and my motorcycle guide was so nice and informative on the different districts we were passing through. It's a little intimidating at first but you get comfortable on the scooter fast. I didn't want it to end!
Awesome Tour! - My friends and I highly recommend this tour! Everything was amazing! I would definitely do this tour again whenever I visit Ho Chi Minh City.

I was in food heaven.... - If there is one thing you should put on your food bucket list, it’s to do the XO Food Tour in Ho Chi Minh City.
We travelled with some friends who had done this once before and loved it so much they did it again when we booked for our first time.
From start to finish, I don’t think I stopped smiling as we were lost in a sea of scooters. Little horns rooting around us everywhere to let others know you were coming. Never once did I feel unsafe despite the controlled chaos. Our guides were very professional and extremely hospitable throughout our entire evening. There is nothing they couldn’t do for us. Beers are refilled before you know it, amazing food placed in front of us and each dish as good as the one previous.
A truly unique experience that I will never forget and for as long as I live, I will recommend this company to anyone visiting Vietnam.

Best possible introduction to Ho Chi Minh city - XO tours are a delight from beginning to end. The booking process is simple, personal and welcoming. Our 3 smiling, supportive and knowledgable drivers Li, Vi and Vi5 collected us on time and drove use safely through the exciting and crowded city streets. Stop offs were frequent and interesting. Snacks and drinks were provided. We were met at various locations and shown around by an experienced XO guide. Photographs were taken and sent on to us at no extra charge. There was nothing missing. This is good value for money and a must do for visitors to HMC.

Education fun - I would highly recommend the Foodie Tour by XO. It's an evening of fun, excitement, good food and excellent company. Our scooter drivers were skillful and safe in the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Minh City - a truly authentic way to see the city and become a part of it. We toured numerous districts and tried many Vietnamese dishes in a group of eight - our tour guide met us at each location and gave us information on the area and the food we were about to try. Thoroughly enjoyable.

Remarkable experience - The Saigon by Night tour is fantastic! I would highly recommend anyone visiting this grand city for the first time to take this tour. The ladies were super friendly, professional and very experienced, confident drivers. My friend and I had the best time exploring Saigon on the back of the vespas. This tour was a perfect way to see the city and enjoy a local dinner dish followed by a delicious dessert. You'll regret not taking this tour.

Simply Amazing - We are a family of 4. We were looking for a safe and realizable company because our kids are small. XO lived beyond our expectations. From booking to the end of the tour everything was very professional. Guides/riders were very knowledgeable and loads of fun. Food experience was very authentic and ample. Sight seeing stops makes it more interesting. We had done a food tour in Cairo where we hardly got any food. This was nothing like that. Ample food and drinks. Loads of fun. Highly recommended. Keep up the good work ladies.

Best thing we did - We booked this on our first night in Ho Chi Minh and that was one of the best decisions we made. Really great way to get your bearings in a new place, see some of the different districts in the city, and eat awesome food at the same time.

The food was brilliant start to finish, can't overstate that enough. The drivers were awesome too, really engaging and funny, also very knowledgeable about their city. They sit with you at many of the courses and help prepare some of the dishes, so you really have the chance to get to know them a bit over the course of the tour.

We didn't leave hungry!! Highly recommend this tour.

Moped food tour - What a great fun night we had. Friday night on the back of a moped around hcmc......crazy but such a laugh. The riders were amazingly safe and the tour guide fantastic. We have some beautiful food and learn so much about the culture and way of life.
If you're not sure just book it. Don't miss out on a great night!
Highly recommended

Amazing team full of fun, very informative and buzzing - We booked this on a hunch , but it was the best thing we did , cannot go wrong , dont be scared of the bikes , the staff are very safe in traffic and feel the buzz of the city while tiu zoom around . Food and drink stop was amazing as well. Book it before it gets fully booked .

Awesome Saigon by Night Tour - Phung was an excellent tour guide and such a lovely person! The tour was so interesting and really gave you an idea of the scope of the city and Vietnam in general. Being on the back of the scooter in the city can be scary but I felt at home in no time.

I really felt looked after, from booking over the phone last minute (perfect english so no worries there) to being accommodated as a solo traveller who doesn't drink so wanted an experience unlike some of the other foodie tours that can get a bit boozy!

Phung was great company and had me laughing all night! I think this is such a great initiative and am happy that I supported other women. Massive respect to all the girls at XO tours. Thank you!

So much fun on foodie tour! - We had a great time on the foodie tour. The food was excellent and it's a great way to see different parts on the city you might not visit otherwise. Guides give a lot of info about life in Ho Chi Minh and all the different neighborhoods. And just the whole experience of riding around in the chaotic city traffic is absolutely awesome!! Definitely recommend!

The BEST way to explore the city! - We were thoroughly entertained from start to finish on the Sights tour - hosted by very sweet, fun, & knowledgeable guides! We were very much looked after in terms of food & drink, and safety was certainly a priority if you’re at all worried. Highly recommend this tour! If we’d had more time, we would have done another tour with XO for sure!

Great experience with awesome guides - Our family of 4. 2 adults and 2 teenagers loved this tour. It was our first experience on the back of a scooter and we were all a bit nervous but the girls were awesome and made us feel at ease. The tour was great and we ate at places we otherwise wouldn’t have. Highly recommend

Great Way to See HCMC - We arrived in Ho Chi Minh City late on February 26, 2019 and had booked th XO Foodie Tour in advance for the next evening. What a great decision! HCMC can be a bit intimidating for first timers and this was absolutely the best way to get our feet on the ground in this sprawling city. We are two couples in our early sixties and we all feel so safe on the back of the scooters with our four knowledgeable and fun hostesses. The food was an adventure (included frog, goat, and duck embryo) but it was the trip itself that left the most lasting impression. We drove through many of the 19 urban districts and saw and learned so much about the city that we would have otherwise missed. We didn't want the evening to end!!

Perfect evening!! - Ni and An picked us up at our hotel right on time. They were personable, hilarious, and clearly loved their jobs. They were by our side the entire night, answering questions, and making sure we were having a great time. We had an absolute blast with the two of them and the rest of the staff. Everything about the evening felt safe and was tons of fun. We were worried about the traffic in the city, but the girls did a great job making us feel safe. The food, games, and interactions with everyone involved made this one of our trip highlights. We highly recommend booking this tour with this awesome group. Thanks again!!!

So much fun! - Great way to see HCMC and try some delicious (and interesting...) foods. Great tour guides, fun mode of transportation, wonderful opportunity to ask questions about every day life. Was a little nervous about the bikes before, but felt safe the entire time!

Great loss - We were met by four lovely, educated young women in traditional dress who briefed us about riding as pillion passengers. We headed off into peak hour traffic and not once did we feel frightened. It was wonderful to be part of the crowd.
We were taken to a variety of locations around the city and our guides explained Vietnamese culture and something about what it is like to live in such a large city. Two stops included food in local eateries and at each stop a senior guide will appear to give background information and answer any questions.
Our drivers were excellent. They were skilled, careful and considerate of our needs.
We participated in this trip as soon as we arrived in Saigon and felt it was a great introduction to the city. Would very much recommend it.

XO Sights and XO Foodie tours - These two tours were one of the high lights of our Vietnam round trip. Everything was so well organized - there is a full team around the drivers to make sure everything is ready when we arrive at the different locations. The guides and drivers are very knowledgeable about the sights and food. We took the tours with two kids aged 9 and 10 and they loved every second of it. It’s an amazing feeling being driven through the crazy traffic in Ho Chi Minh on the back of a scooter. The sights tour is during the day and the foodie is after dark - different sights on both tours so we recommend doing both. We can highly recommend XO - they are extremely professional from the initial booking and the tour itself.

The best way to start your visit to Saigon! - I can’t recommend this tour highly enough. It was an incredible way to orient ourselves to the city. The drivers were so kind and knowledgeable (not to mention deft motorbike drivers), and the food choices were spectacular and varied! We went beyond District 1 and got to learn about other parts of the city. And again, the food. Thank you, XO Tours, for an amazing time!

YES, Amazing, Adventurous, Highlight - Every step with this organisation is meticulous .
Our 3 guides turn up on time, lovely introductions and information and we are off. Environmental scooters n speed was roughly 30 ??? 4.5 hours yeahhhhh.
Stop 1 is meet our other travellers in the group. They have 8-12 in a group and there were 2 groups out last night
It is broken down into 3 food and 2 rest information stops.
Learnt about districts, prices of living, history and their lives.
Ate a stack.
Loved the variety, having female drivers, security, food, our guides being part of our team and preparing the food.
Definitely do it again. Everything brilliant
Thank you XO

Xo food tour- must do - An absolutely brilliant experience. This is a must do. A great way to see the city and places you wouldn’t normally go. The girls were great drivers. I was nervous about going on the bike with the busy roads but was soon put at ease and loving the experience. The girls played local Vietnamese fun games which were great. The food was great and drinks included. The only bit of feedback would be to replace the information stops with one or two more food stops.

Thanks again!

The Foodie Tour - One of my favorite experiences in Vietnam! Our riders, Ni and Anh, were excellent guides. We felt so safe with their expert driving skills in this frantic city. They have great English and taught us a lot about the city and their lives. We were taken to many different districts and learned about the city. There was so much incredible food at every stop and drinks to accompany. An amazing evening out in Ho Chi Minh City. Thank you!

Amazing Experience! - What an amazing experience! We were able to visit parts of the city we would have never known about and try local cuisine at some restaurants only the locals knew about. The staff was professional and accommodating to every need. We would recommend to anyone who is visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

Not to be missed. Fantastic Tour! - The Foodie Tour was recommended to us by a friend and we were not disappointed. When you walk around Saigon, you would hardly consider hiring a motorbike or driving - it's crazy BUT XO Tours has nailed it for Tourists and it's really good value for money. The female only riders met us at our hotel and my group of 3 were matched to the size of motorbike (scooters). The three girls gave us a really warm welcome, explained the tour, what to expect and some safety info. Then we set off on the back of the scooters to meet the rest of the tour at the first restaurant and then made our way in convoy to the next stop.
Time spent on the bikes and in the restaurants is about 50/50. You get to see most of the Saigon Districts and 100% of the time you are really well looked after. I felt that our guides also really enjoyed themselves. The conversation is great, the restaurants are where the locals eat and all the food (some cooked in front of us by the guides) is superb and varied.
XO Tours is innovative, safety conscious (insured) and very progressive as it only employs female riders, who go through a strict selection process. We loved every minute of it!

Amazing experience - We did the “Siagon by night” tour with XO tours and had a fantastic and truly memorable time. From my initial inquiry to the conclusion of the tour my experience with this company was first class. We were greeted warmly by Phung Le and her team outside our hotel at the time stated and for the next 3 hours we experienced 6 of Saigon's 24 districts. The mopeds are modern and immaculately clean. Our female drivers were impeccably attired, super friendly and spoke exceptional English. They are most important first class moped riders and despite the frenetic nature of Ho Chi Minh City and its roads you always feel safe. This view was echoed by my wife and kids (aged 11). This is a brilliant tour which takes you to other areas of the city outside of tourist district 1. Each district has its own culture and energy and there is no better way to visit and experience than on the back of a moped. I can't recommend this trip and this company highly enough.

A highlight of our trip! - We took the Night Foodie Tour on or first day in Vietnam and loved it. Our drivers Nuy and Thien (? spelling) were lovely but all the staff were great. It was a buzz being on the bikes, trying so many different foods and seeing parts of HCM we wouldn't otherwise have reached. Very informative and great fun - highly recommended!

Best evening entertainment in Saigon - We had a group of 8/9 couples and organized a 'street food' tour of HCMC with XO. Without exception the staff were fantastic. The riders were fabulous hosts - very friendly, informative and interesting - despite the hectic city traffic, they got us around safely and confidently - being on the back of the scooters was a lot of fun. The tour took us to see parts of HCMC that we would otherwise not have traveled to and the food stops were authentic local haunts with good quality dishes. Definitely a highlight!

Just WOW! - Booked a foodie tour with XO and have to say, it was the best tour I've ever been on! Two fab guides, Tuyet and Nuy arrived at our hotel to collect us and give the “pre tour instructions” which were informative and funny at the same time - I knew then it was going to be a good trip! Tuyet was absolutely brilliant. She was a confident and competent rider, and despite the “organized chaos” (aka seriously scary traffic), I felt completely safe riding pillion. The food stops offered some of the best Vietnamese food I've tasted and the atmosphere at each stop was buzzing. Throughout the tour, Tuyet was an excellent tour guide, pointing out numerous points of interest and interesting facts about the city, and Vietnam in general. If you do nothing else in Ho Chi Minh City, do this tour!

As good as expected! - I asked on TripAdvisor forum , which 'foodie' tour to do in HCMC.... this came up in 8 out of 9 answers. Total no brainier to book it. It's more expensive than others I've seen, but well worth it. My rider, Nhi was simply lovely.
The food was fabulous ranging from Beef noodle soup (note .. not Pho!) to goat cooked on a BBQ. There were scallops and crabs and various other surprises. Not a Banh Mi or a pancake in sight (compare to other tours!) There is a fair bit of traveling to get to outlying districts, but the girls are full of information and are great fun.
Probably the best tour I've done anywhere !

This tour is a MUST DO! - LOVED this tour! It was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. It's the most perfect way to tour Saigon and see several districts without having to do any work yourself. The food served on the tour was really delicious and adventurous. The customer service of XO is second to none - they are fast at responding to emails, they have the entire tour dialed in so well, and they are very accommodating to all needs. Don't pass up on this! I wish I could do it over and over again.

Food and Sights in Saigon - My husband and I did both the Food and Sights tours with the wonderful lady drivers at XO. An experience not to be missed.
We took the Foodie Tour on our first evening in Saigon with Khoi our guide and our lady drivers Hahn and Duen. I expressed I was nervous and Duen took great care made me feel safe and offered a smooth ride. We ate some great food (I chose out of the goat, frog and duck embryo still had sooo much food) and experienced the wonderful night lights of the city.
The next morning we took the Sights tour with our guide Bao and lady drivers Vy 5 and Thien 2. I absolutely loved this tour we visited all the sights I was interested to see and more. Thien was a gem at taking some creative photos for us at the post office and cathedral. I was more relaxed on the bike for this tour.
On both tours we were kept really well fed and hydrated. I feel like a real local sipping my sugarcane drink while riding pillion.
Following the tours we were sent some great pics taken by the guide.
All in all lots of fun and highly recommended when visiting Saigon.

Xo tours - Foodie Tour with kids - Our expectations were completely exceeded with this this tour. We had concerns about our girls aged 9 and 13 cruising on bikes around Ho Chi Min city at night but the ladies were experienced drivers and kept us together in peak traffic.

We cruised through different districts of the busy city with the tour ladies giving us a history on each district. Food was very tasty, packed with flavours.

The experience is not for the feint hearted but you knew you were in safe hands with this tour.

Would do it again and to this point it is my highlight of Vietnam

Night Riders - Great experience to see Saigon at night on machines that had been so annoying to us during the day. The tour was well organized, and all of the staff were friendly, informative and professional. We hadn't ridden on motorbikes before, so really appreciated the initial instruction and attention to safety. It was rush hour when the tour started, so traffic was hectic, but the girls handled it with ease. Our two food stops we're good - maybe even too much to eat. Saw parts of the city that we'd never have gotten to otherwise. So glad we did this.

Over-the-top-Wonderful: A Must DO!! - Where to begin?!?!
Our night time Foodie Tour was way beyond any expectations I could have dreamed up.
The scooter drivers were daring & darling women. They were right in time, gave us a thorough briefing on scooter riding- we each hop on the back of a scooter with our driver/tour guides an off we go on our grand adventure!

our drivers:
Van le
Bich Thuy Tiert
Boi Lam
Truc Vy
Leader: Nguyen Khoi

I do have to say
Traffic in Saigon is unbelievable- something nightmares are made of-as a westerner it has no rhyme or reason but to these drivers-both auto &scooter- they move like water, flowing without effort & gliding along in harmony.

First stop, we meet our Head Guide Nguyen Khoi- he sat us down in A local restaurant for delicious soup- he explained the ingredients- history & small talk as we enjoyed our first tasty stop. We did some sight seeing along the way to our other dining spots- each stop was amazing - our Head Guide & our personal driver/guides were attentive to our every need, question & desire (more beer please😜) Each & every person in our group made us feel extremely safe both on & off the scooters. Their English was perfect, Attitude: cheerful & caring
Driving skills: 5stars!!!!!
Our itinerary far exceeded my wildest dreams!
This is a MUST DO while in Saigon!!!!
I want to thank each & every employee at XO for bringing the Authentic Saigon alive for me- And tasty too!!!

Foodie night tour - We had a great night touring Saigon with the girls! Taking off at the traffic lights in the middle of a sea of hundreds of bikes is amazing! What a great way to see the city by night. It was good to get out of the main tourist hot spots and get to the places the locals frequent. We tried food that we never thought we would, like frogs (jumping chicken) and balut eggs! Our guides were wonderful...always felt safe and confident on the scooters and the girls were very knowledgeable about their city and the districts. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone travelling to Saigon!

XO Foodie Night Tour - a wonderful Saigon experience! - Overall, an amazing experience for our all-Pinoy group of seven that was quite entertaining, very casual and really the type of activity which gives you all the ingredients of a memorable trip - a sample of local culture (motorbike adventure), great food and drinks! (all the food I tasted were delicious! quite reasonable servings), and chatty conversations with lots of laughter (tour guides/drivers were very hospitable and warm similar to Filipinos so we felt very much at home and it really helps that they are quite proficient in English)

I thought the tour would be long but I guess 4 hours is nothing when you're enjoying every minute of it, I definitely would recommend this for anyone who would like a great experience in Ho Chi Minh city.

Things to remember:
- be friendly, ask questions and follow the tour instructions
- the female drivers are quite professional and will ensure you have a smooth motorcycle ride but you must also be a responsible passenger. safety first and always
- be adventurous with the food, you might be pleasantly surprised
- try to upgrade to a private tour if you have a big group. for me it was also pretty relaxed because you know everyone and you don't have to be mindful of strangers
Must do scooter tour! - Ride through Saigon’s famous chaotic streets safely with your female driver. Fun, informative, and I had only five in my group. Can’t recommend more highly!

Saigon by Bike - Great tour and would recommend, the girls were really safe drivers and Ming was informative and took us to some great places. Thanks for a great day
Glen

Excellent service - This was set up through Trailfinders. It was an overnight trip on the Mekong Delta on a Bassac.
From the moment our guide came into the hotel to collect us, to the time we were delivered back, the trip was wonderful.
Guide and driver were very polite and informative with a running commentary on the long drive there.
Cold water bottles were available in the car both there and back.
We were escorted down to the dock with our luggage and the guide did not leave until we were safely on board.
The same happened when we finished the trip, our guide and driver were there waiting for us in the village we ended up in.
The overnight trip on the Bassac was one of the great highlights of the holiday and life on the river passing by was a memory that will stay with us.
Everything was seamless. 5 star.

XO Foodie Night Tour-what an experience! - On recommendation from a work colleague we booked the XO Night Foodie Tour and we had a fabulous time from the moment we hopped on the back of the motor bikes until we arrived safely back at our hotel 4 hours later. Other than tasting our way around HCMC, along with a group of eight other people on the tour, we also developed an understanding of the different districts from our lead guide who also accompanied us as we travelled around the city. Even though the traffic was crazy(and exhilarating) we felt completely safe with our very competent young female drivers who also made sure we were well catered for and explained each of the dishes we ate at the various stops. A big thank you to XO staff for making our time in HCMC a fun and memorable experience.

XO tours of Saigon - XO tours was recommended by friends at home as a great way to get a glimpse of Ho Chi Min City that a tourist wouldn’t be able to see on their own. Right from the minute we were met by the 4 lovely gals at our hotel to when we were dropped off several hours later this tour was the highlight of our trip for all of our family members which included a teenager and 10 year old. Truly an unforgettable experience of the incredible scooter capital of the world, negotiating through throngs of traffic with confidence, ease and safety. Seeing the contrast of the very differing districts of Saigon was informative and left a lasting impression. And the sampling of delicious foods was fantastic! Thank you so much for the professional and extraordinary experience of Saigon at night. We adored all 4 of our hosts and will talk about this adventure for a long time to come!

XO Tours HCM The Sights - What a great way to see the sights of Ho Chi Minh City!
Our guide Ming gave us lots of good information at each spot we stopped and we had plenty of time.
All credit goes to the wonderful women driving us. They were so competent, calm, friendly and fun ... all while weaving in and out of very hectic city traffic.
Lee was my fabulous driver.
Thank you for a really special birthday treat in HCM, everyone should ask for you to drive them, couldn’t get a more skilled motorbike driver!

XO Foodie Tour Saigon 2019 - I am terrified of Motorcycles!!! Especially on the busy streets of Saigon! My fears were alleviated with my amazing tour guide/motorcycle driver Fong. She knew I was super nervous and she handled me like a pro.
The experience was "once in a lifetime"!!!! Take this tour...not only for the food, which is great, but also for the cultural experience of navigating the streets of Saigon and for getting to visit other Districts outside of D1. Such an great city!

Really really excellent - We were picked up right on time at our hotel by two charming and cheerful young women on scooters. They gave us some safety tips and off we went to start our amazing tour. They skillfully navigated the traffic while maintaining a conversation with us as we moved from place to place. The first stop was the Post Office where we met Ming who gave us the history of the Post Office and Notre Dame which is right across the street. He was to appear at every stop and provide us with interesting historical background. He also showed us some photographs which added more detail and insights about each stop. Our drivers were also able to share interesting bits of information along the route. The team of three really provided us with a magical experience and a wonderful overview of Saigon. Every moment was fun, enriching and historical.

A good time in HCM City - This food tour was exactly as they had advertised. We walked out of our hotel and there they were. Nothing to fear while the young ladies drive you around.
The mixture of culture and food selections were excellent.
We did a motorbike food tour on our first day in Hanoi and highly recommend using this type of introduction to these most interesting cities.
XO tours is reliable and good value for your investment. You won't be disappointed!
FYI, I would not have tried the duck embryo otherwise!
Russ

Foodie Tour - Awesome experience and highly recommended to highlight your Vietnam trip. Foodie tour has 5 stops. 3 food stops and 2 sight seeing stops. 4 hours of riding around Ho Chi Minh and enjoying street food with beer. Really worth the money.

More fun than I expected - We took the evening foodie tour. It was fun zipping around many parts of HCM city on the back of a scooter. Our drivers were skillful and I always felt safe. The drivers were fun and informative. We went to several restaurants and everything was delicious. It was one of the most entertaining tours I ever went on.

Best fun ever - This tour was the highlight of my Vietnam trip. Vi and the ladies were amazing drivers and made sure our night was memorable. Vi was not only knowledgable and skillful, she became like a dear friend. Vi is a beautiful soul and I will always remember how special she made my night. Thank you beautiful Vi. ❤

What an Experience - An evening on the back of a scooter, riding through 5 different districts of HCMC with the most brilliant female drivers. We would never have seen these areas if we had not taken part in this tour. Our drivers were superb and at no point did we feel anxious, even although we started at rush hour in the city amongst literally hundreds of other scooters/bikes at our side at any one time. The female drivers we met and the team leader were so friendly, chatty and interesting people who made this such a great trip. We stopped off at various places en route, the market, Chinatown, for dinner at a street food restaurant and dessert in a different district. The food was delicious as was the nice cool beer. Having never been on a scooter before and both in our 60s we did wonder if we were wise! However it was great and is a must do tour for everyone with the best drivers so would thoroughly recommend.

A MUST DO IN HCMC - My partner and I couldn't possibly rate XO tours highly enough! Firstly our XO foodie tour was our highlight in vietnam, such an amazing experience. The entire team instantly felt like lifelong friends making us feel at ease about getting on the bikes and having all dietry needs and requirements sorted right from the beginning. We laughed the entire evening and created some awesome memories.
The food was SENSATIONAL! We tried so many different varieties of local food in different districts of Saigon, wow! These local places they took us to eat were the best dishes we had in Saigon and places/food we would never have discovered without this tour - please don't hesitate if you have food allergies or requirements this tour company have no hesitation in going above and beyond to make sure your requirements are met and no body goes home hungry, so many delicious dishes to indulge in. We haven't stopped talking about this tour since we left Vietnam, Enjoy!

Absolutely Brilliant! - A wonderful introduction to HCMC.

The girls are excellent drivers and hosts.
The food is delicious and the bike ride exhilarating.

So many different dishes to try, and the best scallops ever.
A must do trip.

Morning trip around hi chi min city. Well worth it - Another fantastic city tour by xo tours. Ha and le were our vesper guides for the morning . Well driven , good English and very well looked after . It’s a great way to see the city, seeing , notre dam cathedral, a food market where you have an opportunity to sample some Vietnamese deserts, on to the old Chinese quarter and a visit to some of the oldest temples and churches in Hanoi. Couldn’t have asked for a better trip . Thank you ladies

No better way to explore the City - Among the delicious food is the added bonus of exploring various Districts within the City. There is no better way to experience the culture by navigating the heart of traffic on a scooter ride and covering so much ground within one evening.

Oh yeah. Did I mention the food is delicious? Get your inner Anthony Bourdain on.
Amazing food tour - Best experience in Saigon. We had a good time with my husband and the girls are so friendly and nice. Recommend it
Xo food tour in Ho Chi Minh - Fantastic way to see the city and taste test some great food with good company. A must do for the adventurous.

If you have a spare night in HCM then you must do this foodie tour! - It’s a fun way to see more of the city (than just district one). You also get to eat some amazing and sometimes exotic street food in the company of like minded tourists and some very capable scooter chauffeurs. It was the highlight of my stay in the city and I can’t recommend them highly enough...thanks XO 👍

Xo streetfood tour - Great night with xotours in Saigon big thanks to the beautiful Ming and Mi (sorry if the spelling is wrong) for their fearless driving skills, and tour leader Bao. Great gang looked after us and fed us all night. Yo yo yo.

Best experience a must do in Hoi chi min - Accommodating and helpful lots of fun
Safe and fast way to city the whole city amazing food options and accommodating to all tastes.

AMAZING.This tour will blow you away. - What an evening we had! We had the most enjoyable time and were looked after extremely well. The attention the girls gave to us in discussing the sites of the city as we rode on the back of the bikes and helping explain the food we ate at the stops we made was exceptional. XO Tours have two wonderful guides in the two girls we had. Having seen the way bikers ride in Vietnam made us a little wary, but no need the girls were amazing and we both felt completely safe as pillion riders, what an experience.
The information you gave us at the stops, both site seeing and the food.Your happy outlook to the evening made it go so smoothly. Well done for organising such a great evening for us.

Wow Wow Wow - HCM on 2 wheels - As a group of four elderly adults (?) we chose to ride HCM withy XO Tours. Some of us were first timers on scooters but what the heck because within minutes we were comfortable and feeling safe. This is one experience you must try when visiting HCM and XO Tours are the place to do it. Great value for your $ and the Tour Leaders and the Lady Riders are highly competent and professional. Full of local knowledge and as friendly as you can get this team made our experience unforgetable.

Best Part Of Vietnam! - If you are visiting Vietnam, you MUST experience XO Tours. My husband and I were visiting Ho Chi Minh and being a HUGE foodie, I was thrilled when I found the XO Foodie Tour. Obviously when visiting a foreign country, you're never quite sure, but the reviews were all more than stellar so I went ahead and booked it.

I think my husband was still a little skeptical and not expecting much, but after the tour he simply said: This was the best part of our trip.

Firstly, it was just SO wonderful to receive such a high level of customer service and hospitality. Our Tour Manager/Leader, Ming was just BEYOND. He was SO nice and genuine, paying attention to our needs and our experience throughout every moment of the experience. My husband and I were paired up with our amazing motorbike drivers, Nhi4 and Nhu2, and they made us feel so safe and comfortable on the bikes (we were both a bit apprehensive after seeing all the crazy traffic). Within a few minutes, I was saying, "I want to drive one of these."

On top of enjoying a variety of incredibly delicious foods, the tour brought us through some of the different districts in HCMC and we ended up learning a lot more than we had expected to.

We were well attended to the ENTIRE time and had a blast with Ming, Nhi4, Nhu2, and all of the other guests on our tour.

You 100% receive the FULL value and MORE for the price of this tour.

We tried to book an XO Tour in Hoi An for the next day but they were unfortunately full.

I would fully trust any tour with them and really appreciate the hard work they put into delivering such an awesome and pleasant experience.

Lastly, I'll add that all of the booking and e-mail communication with the XO Team was superb. Not sure who exactly is running the show, but they are doing a phenomenal job.

Thank you SO much XO Tours!!!

PS. Included a pic of this scallop dish that was out of this world good (we ordered seconds). Oh and they are VERY generous with portions and beverages. You will not leave hungry!

BEST TOUR SERVICE in Ho Chi Minh City !! - from enquiry until the LADIES (sadly) greeted us upon departure was a hugely positive experience. I have been traveling to Vietnam since 2009 and service mostly from alternative providers have been below par however XO TOURS put all to shame.
We watched from hotel reception as the Ladies arrived ahead of schedule which pleased us greatly and made a lasting impression.
after greeting & short but informative lesson on how to be a great pillion we were off.
Vietnam traffic is not for the feint hearted however the Ladies weaved their way through traffic without a negative incident.
As a physically challenged (above the knee amputee) who lost my leg due to a motor-bike incident I was initially hesitant to mount a motorbike but my Lady drove like a PRO and had me at ease after 2 minutes I could determine she knew how to handle her steel horse.
I mentioned to KHOI that he could certainly put any physically challenged potential tourist in touch with me personally should they require confirmation.
Our group around 10 tourist were well taken care of and throughout our journey to various eateries support staff were visible and in attendance.
I'm uncertain if the FOOD or STAFF were better however both food & staff had my wife and I impressed and we spoke about this constantly. In fact throughout our stay in HCMC did we "use" XO TOURS as a guideline when receiving service in HCMC we would say "not as good as XO or as good as XO".
KHOI was the Master Story Teller and the only bad news I have for KHOI is that I found him so good at this particular job that I suggest he does not move or start his own service ha! ha! He was knowledgable and listened as well as commented. He KNOWS his City & Country very well.
I found all the food very interesting and tasty and some were new to me but I enjoyed all offered.
The FOODIE TOUR after about 5 hours were over quickly however at this time we could not eat any longer and returned to our hotel.
Alternative services or any company providing service in HCMC should learn from XO TOURS who only asked for payment once we were safely back at our hotel and NOT before as many service providers in HCMC demand payment upfront.
We asked for a recommendation for some COCKTAILS & the venue recommended we frequented for 3 nights after regularly.
We will return to HCMC & most certainly use XO TOURS again and as we have family who travel regularly we would definitely recommend XO TOURS.

All Girl Bike Food Tour - We loved this tour .It was recommended by friends and although pricey we thought it was a great experience .The girls were really personable .They all had very good English and were informative .Plus they were very good riders and negotiated the traffic really well .My girl is called Nhung and she was so bright and funny !
The food was really interesting .We tried frogs and goat BBQ .My husband tried the duck embryo ..I didn’t ! .We had the tastiest Bun Cha soup ever .
The tour included a ride to several districts in the city including Chinatown and district 4 which was vibrant and lively .I recommend this tour and really enjoyed our night out .Thanks XO

Amazing not to be missed evening adventure - What a way to get to know a place!
I didn't have much time in Ho Chi Minh, and decided to join the XO team on an evening of fun and adventure, besides getting a visual awareness of the city, we had so much fun trying different foods, meeting new people, and cruising the streets of Ho Chi Minh. Each guide passed on so much information, and Ming provided a wealth of info at every stop. We felt safe and well looked after. Thanks so much team, highly recommended. Will definitely go again!
Aaron

Best night - Did the 3 hour Saigon by night tour was the best night of my 3 weeks in Vietnam. My guide was called noon (not sure if that’s spelt right) she made me feel so
Safe and comfortable on the bike even in the crazy Saigon traffic . I loved every minute of it . If your ever in Saigon you’ve gotta do an xo tour you won’t regret it

What an amazing time! - I can't say enough about our 2 XO tours. We liked the first one so much, we decided to book a second, different tour, on our last night.

The ladies are amazing scooter drivers and very engaging. They are friendly and knowledgeable, and so helpful! They know exactly where they are going and everything about what you are seeing or eating. We learned about their lives as well.

There is only one way to see saigon, and that's out on the streets with the locals on a scooter! Thank you ladies! We'll see you again next time!

Heart and Soul of Saigon - I like to attribute a region to its food and its people. This incredible journey I have embarked on started and ended with a pickup and dropoff at the ground floor of my hotel on a motorized scooter. Tian (I hope I am spelling your name right) drove me all around Ho Chi Min City with me lazily sitting in the back of her scooter while she conversed with me about life, navigated with manual transmission, and served me food in our multiple destinations.

The women of XO Tours are nothing short of super heroes. They are fun, kind, and professional. If you had to do only one tour, please do yourself a favor and pick this one. XO tours displayed the best of Saigon's food and her people.

Excellent Tour for all ages - Our extended family of 14 ranging from 2 - 70 year olds had a fabulous morning on "The Sights' tour in Saigon recently. I highly recommend it no matter what your age or experience with motorbikes.

I arranged this via email before departure from Australia and the process was easy and responsive, payment via a paypal link. The girls were outside our hotel with their bikes on our first morning and it was a fabulous way to get about HCMC and see the sights even with very young children. (Children under 7 ride with adult). I actually think easier than trying to cross the road on foot with young kids!

It was extremely well organised and the guide was informative. The kids absolutely loved it and I think even listened to a bit of history! There was plenty of treats, water, fresh fruit but the highlight for them was definitely just cruising about on the back of the bikes. The drivers were so friendly and within moments everyone felt comfortable and safe.

We all loved it so much that we did another XO motorbike tour when we were in Hoi An. Both have been the highlight of our family holiday. Thank you for looking after us so well.
Highly recommend - We have done other tours on our trip but this was the best! A must when visiting Saigon. Great food and professional staff. Will not disappoint.

Lives up to the great reviews - Yesterday we did two tours with XO Tours. In the morning we did the City Sights and in the evening the Night Food Tour. We are 3 adults in our 60s and had a blast on the tours.

We loved riding on the back of the motor bikes- it was our first time but we quickly got use to riding them. The drivers were very good on explain8ng how to ride on the back and made us feel very safe.

The City Sights tour is a perfect way to see a number of different sights including a lot out side of District 1. They make several stops and the tour manager gives you a good explanations n of the history of what you are seeing. When riding the bikes the drivers are very engaged with you in conversation. It is a wonderful way for you to also learn more about everyday life in Saigon.

The night food tour was probably one of the best food tours I have ever done. It is a completely different experience riding on the back of the bikes at night. There are some longer rides as you travel out into farther districts. The food we tasted was varied and good. There was more food than any of us could have eaten. The drivers sat with us at the different venues and cooked when we did barbecue, explained what we were eating, showed us how to eat the foods. We were with 10 people from a variety of countries and had a fantastic times.

I recommend that you do at least one of their tours and if time permits do both the day and night tours, we had limited time 8n HCMC and this was a great use of our time.

Best tour ever! - Do yourself a favour and do this tour! If there is one thing to do in HCMC then this is it.. My mum and I did the night tour and we were so impressed with the girl drivers and tour in general. Saw a side of HCMC I never would have if we didn’t do it. So professional and we both felt safe on the bikes. Guides are so friendly and knowledgeable. Thank you team XO for a fantastic tour

A must in Ho Chi Minh City - My husband and his friend took the XO Food Tour and cannot stop raving about it - from the professionality of the 2 ladies to the quality and variety of the food! Communication is excellent and very informative, we did the same tour a couple of years ago, and it is great to hear they are still fantastic!

Fun, reputable company, easy to understand - Very organized; I did the Saigon city tour; Incorporated some local food too. If you have a short stay, more reason to book with them. Guy's, ever scoot behind a woman? Even the drivers speak English. I've been to their corporate office & everything looks proper.

A Foodie’s Dream! - What an amazing tour! Our guides were awesome, funny and knowledgeable. Their English is excellent which made communication very easy, and they taught us so much about the culture and districts. The food was absolutely incredible! Great value and the variety was fantastic - noodle soup, BBQ, seafood... all delicious! The scooter ride itself felt safe and comfortable. Really enjoyed this tour and would highly recommend to all food lovers!

Fun excursion - The young lady drivers were informative and handled themselves well in the incredible city traffic. We took the foodie night tour. Okay size group of about 15. The organizer always explained about the culture, the different areas and the food. A great evening. A chance to see the city first hand travelling not just in tourist areas but on side streets, lanes and trying different foods you probably would not order on your own. A very enjoyable experience.

A Brilliant experience - We did the XO city sites tour which was fantastic, from the time we were picked up from our Hotel to the end I felt so safe with my driver. We were taken to some great sites, our tour guide was fantasic. We cannot wait to return to do the foodie tour with XO

XO Tours - If you do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City this should be it! Bao and his staff did an excellent job leading us around the city and entertaining us as we went. The drivers couldn't have been nicer and thankfully they were very skilled. The food was the best we had in Vietnam with an excellent selection of many types. We scootered around to areas of HCMC that we would never have seen. Absolutely a highlight of our Vietnam trip.

Excellent HCMC food tour - Our tour with XO was really fantastic. We were taken to places we would have never eaten, off the beaten path, and totally delicious. The added tour of HCMC from the back of a scooter was a fun bonus. XO were fully accommodating to our allergies and dietary needs, which made the experience feel comfortable and safe.
