Xo tours a must - Sang and his crew are fantastic. Not only do you get to try so many different kinds of local cuisine but you get a scenic and informative tour of the various districts in HCMC. If you’re looking for a great evening out look no further that XO tours.

Ps. They also email you photos taken throughout the trip after you’re done.

Thanks again Sang!

A Must Do! - I was hesitant at first about riding behind a scooter through the busy streets, but just after a little while was having an amazing time! Highly recommend this tour. Great drivers, great food, and just a great evening! Thank you XO Tours

Fantastic Foodie Tour - We had a great time on the foodie tour. All of the guides were super friendly and I really enjoyed chatting to them as they drove us around the city. Getting to experience the roads on the back of a motorbike is great and such a different perspective to the time you spend trying to run across the road on foot trying not to get in their way. the girls are really experienced and I felt totally safe in their hands. The food was really tasty and even though this is a tour which joins together with others who have booked it doesn't feel like the usual guided group tours. Something I also enjoyed was getting to see the other districts in HCMC which I probably never would have got to see had I not taken part in this tour. Highly recommended!
Fun exciting fantastic - Thank you for tour guide. Thank you very much for the tour. Very fun. Next time I will use the service again. Thank you very much.

FANTASTIC!!!!! - What a blast! We had Sang as our tour leader and Ahm and Tweet? (Sorry if thats not right) as our drivers and we’re the best! We felt so safe on the bikes and they have a,axing skills when navigating the traffic. The food was great and got to try the balut eggs. So good I had 3!
The knowledge of the whole team was superb and we learnt much more than just about the food.

Thanks guys, we WILL be back next time we come to your wonderful country

Wow! Terrific Foodie Tour - Four of us recently did the foodie cycle tour with XO. Turns out the tour only included the four of us which worked out great. The 4 ladies arrived promptly at our hotel and we proceeded to see so much of Hanoi for the 4 hour tour beginning during rush hour. Although we were riding through a bee hive of activity, none of us felt any concern for safety. They were incredibly skilled in weaving through traffic. We had three food stops. a walk through the 24 hour Chinatown market and another stop to view a new part of town. At each stop, the tour guide would meet us to talk about the area or the food. All the drivers and the guide spoke English very well. The food was varied, healthy, safe, and we ate at spots where the locals ate outdoors. This tour was definitely a highlight of Saigon and exhilarating.

Fun Tour in HCMC! - I did the sights tour recently, and can highly recommend! I felt very safe on the motorbike. We learned a lot about the history of HCMC. We took enough breaks with drinks/snacks in between so I never felt like the heat was an issue. If you're looking for a good introduction to HCMC, I would highly recommend XO Tours.

Culinary Delight - This was one of the highlights of our trip to Saigon. You get to see so many of the other 24 districts in the city, not just District 1 where the tourists stay. Our guides were great to talk to, so informative of their country, and great drivers! The food was outstanding. It is not humanly possible to eat so much. If you are a seafood lover, this is the tour for you!

Exhilarating bike food tour! - Brilliant idea! Exhilarating bike ride through and around Hanoi! Delicious food tastings in local canteens I would never have discovered on my own. Thank you XO Tours for making me feel like a Saigon insider for the evening.

Great foodie tour ! - Our 2 guides Hong and Tuey2 were brilliant from beginning to the end of our tour. They drove perfectly in the madness of Ho Chi Minh City and put us at ease at all times. They gave us information about the city and culture as we drove around and we were taken to restaurants we would never have found on our own. The food was delicious and we had such fun with them and the other people in our group. I would highly recommend this tour and if we are ever back in HCMC we will definitely go again.

Best tour! - I did the foodie tour last night with a large group of friends and it was the highlight of our trip to HCMC! The ladies driving the bikes were great and the food was delicious. I really enjoyed getting to talk with a local for a few hours and also getting to see some of the districts that aren't as touristy. The foodie tour is a must while you're here!

Best Night Tour in Saigon - They may be a little more expensive than the others but it is well worth the money. Nee picked me up from my hotel right on time and brought me to meet up with the rest of the tour group. There were eight of us total. They indeed take you to places an ordinary tourist would not see. All while zipping around on the back of a motorbike. These young ladies could win any motocross race back home with their expert driving. We made several stops to eat “interesting” street food. This included - Bun Hue, clams, quail, goat, frog, Balut (duck embryo) in tamarind sauce, and a few other dishes. These were served to us by our drivers at the various restaurants. Nice touch. Their support person Bao, took group pictures and gave history lessons at various stops. He was quite honest and knowledgeable. All n all, this was a highlight of my Saigon visit.
Fun food adventure - An amazing food tour that combines sightseeing and food. An excellent variety of Saigon street food and a kind and knowledgeable group of female guides!

A fantastic tour! - I couldn't recommend this tour highly enough! Not only did we eat many tasty things on this tour, we also had a wonderful time chatting with our very friendly and accommodating guides (especially Ting!) who were very generous with their kindness, local insight and tips and tricks. Thank you for taking care of us!

Amazing scooter tour - I came with a group of 3 for the XO Foodie tour. They pick you up from your hotel on scooter and then you meet with the rest of the group going on the tour. You get to meet amazing people from all over the world. The best part are the girls who guide you around the beautiful city at night. All of the tour guides were awesome! The tour gives you a taste of various districts and local flavors. The best part of the trip was the interaction with our tour guides. They are so helpful when eating and their personalities are great! We were skeptical on how good of a tour this would be. We were recommended by friends and took the shot. I really hope this tour stays as good forever because if I am ever back in Vietnam, I would do it again! Thank you XO Tours!

Amazing experience! - Our family of 6 enjoyed two fantastic XO tours. The first, 'foodie night tour' and the second a daytime sightseeing tour.

Both tours were such a fantastic way to see the city and experience the culture and history of Ho Chi Minh City especially if you are strapped for time. They take a couple hours to finish but you are surrounded by the friendliest drivers and tour guides who are professionals in navigating the city. You'll see all the attractions in efficient time and not miss anything.

The experience of being amongst the traffic and bustle of the city was the highlight of our trip and our whole family found this the highlight of our stay. Private tours are available (up to groups of 6 and would recommend for the 'foodie' tour as you'll be eating with family) which make the experience really personal and comfortable. There's also a video option that has a camera guy follow you around and give you a video of the experience for you to reflect on.

I would highly recommend this experience and the XO team were an absolute delight to work with. Can't wait to join in again.

Highly recommend! - This XO foodie tour was the highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh. I was a little apprehensive about being on a motorbike in the crazy traffic but there was no need. I felt absolutely safe at all times. The guides were so friendly and informative and made everyone feel relaxed. The food was wonderful but the experience itself was the best! I would recommend anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh to make sure they book this tour...fabulous!

4 of us on scooter around the city. Perfect - I could not imagine a better way to experience Saigon than on the back of a scooter riding through the Chinese market. The sights, sounds and smells will be remembered by my two teenage girls. Loved the tour and the cultural experience of the guide telling about the local areas and food. It felt like we were in the middle of a scooter gang at rush hour.
Worth Visit to Vietnam - I have opted for XO tours during my visit to Vietnam. Their service was awesome and I was very happy on taking their service. Highly recommended.

Exhilarating and entertaining - I was dubious about this after seeing the traffic in Ho Chi Minh but I'm so glad I did it! The girls were excellent drivers and the sight seeing tour in itself was worth the money, let alone all the fabulous food stops. Great for our first night there as we could get our bearings and get some insight into the local area, culture and food options. The food and fun were amazing, a real night to remember and a highlight of our trip. they easily accommodated a large party and made it really special for us.

Great way to see Saigon and enjoy local delicacies - We had an amazing tour and got to try a lot of great food with our tour guide Khoi! It was also a lot of fun riding the mopeds with the talented drivers across the city and seeing all the local spots up close. Highly recommended :)

XO Saigon Street Food Tour by Motor Scooter - My wife and I cannot recommend this tour highly enough! It was brilliant! We were met promptly at our Q1 hotel by our two charming young drivers Nghi and Duyen. Wonderful girls, worldly, well educated and fluent in English. We had three food stops and two sight seeing stops. At the first food stop we were met by our pleasant tour manager Sang. The tour took us to districts 1, 5, 8, 7, & 4. The food was amazing! Drinks (including water, tea, beer & “happy tea”) were provided and we went home well nourished. The girls took us back to our hotel when the tour was done. The tour took roughly five hours. Thank you Sang, Nghe and Duyen! We will tell our friends to visit you!

City sights tour - I did a city sights tour with Then who was fabulous. Very knowledgeable and made me feel very comfortable and safe on the bike. This tour is a fantastic way to see the city highlights and help get your bearings. Tien was very attentive, making sure I had enough water and answered any of my questions. The guide also takes photos for you and emails you copies after the tour. Definitely recommend! Thank you!

Saigon by night - The best night I had in Ho Chi Minh city. The girls were fantastic, lots of fun and happy. They were also full of knowledge about each of the districts we visited. Had more food than I could eat. Would recommend to anyone.

Much more than a “Foodie” tour - We enjoyed a private foodie tour with three highly knowledgeable young women who happily shared their views and experiences with us. The motor cycle tour was a great way to get us around the city and visit districts that we as tourists would otherwise not have gotten acquainted with. On top of that came the visits to local restaurants and an exciting and tasty introduction to the Vietnamese cuisine. We feel that we got an authentic insight to the life in various parts of the city and go not hesitate to recommend this tour to all visitors to Ho Chi Minh City - in fact, it’s a must.

Great experience - We booked onto the xo food tour as a way to see the city and to try local food. What an experience! We were picked up at our hotel by our guides exactly as advertised and were taken on the back of their motorbikes to meet the rest of the party. Just getting around the city on a bike is a must do activity, but that was just the start of a fab night. We whizzed about, ate a number of local dishes, were entertained and informed both by our riders and the provided guide at each stop. There was as much food as you could eat of excellent standard along with a friendly group. I can’t praise this activity highly enough

Amazing tour !!! Highlight of our visit to Vietnam - I am delighted that we booked this tour ! The girls were amazing and looked after us so well. We laughed all night and tasted some amazing dishes ! They brought us to different parts of the city that we would never have seen and to do it on the back of the moped , was incredible ! What a way to experience Saigon as a city ! This is a must do tour and can not recommend highly enough!

Best night of a 3 week trip - We went out for an amazing food tour by motor bike last night. We researched quite a bit and XO got the best reviews. The reviews did not do the night justice
It was Amazing. Tons of amazing interesting cuisine with wonderful guides who were willing to answer our questions and also take us all over Saigon

Thanks for an amazing experience

If you must do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City this is it - I have done several trips over the years with XO Tours. They are the innovator and have the highest standards for sure. This trip we did 2 tours the 1st was the night foodie tour. There was 4 in our group and I had booked the Video option as well. A few minutes early XO Tours was at our hotel waiting for us. The night was a thrilling experience. having done this before I knew what to expect but the others did not. They were all very excited once they realized the surprise I had in one for them. The XO Tour staff were all exceptional, each rider had their own driver. the girls we had were .... Hang, Hoa, Han, and Mai. The support staff included the following: Hoa was the Videographer and Boa his driver. Tuan and Phat were the other 2 support staff that were there for what I call security reasons. They were there to monitor the girls and guests safety and security and to make sure there was space behind or bikes and to watch over the bikes while we ate at the various places. This is a night of eating and drinking that will last a lifetime for sure. You get ti try some very traditional and questionable delicacies I tried and I honestly admit there was nothing that I did not like. This is for sure a top notch company to deal with. the nest day we did a morning sights tour and it was just as memorable. I have misplaced the list of the staff for the morning tour. But they were also very professional and courteous. All of the guides and tour leader spoke very good English. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

XO Tours is one thing I will also try and book when I return to HCMC again. Booking in advance is highly suggested.

Xo foodie tour - 4 of us did this tour 2 from Ireland and 2 from USA. We were picked up promptly at 520 from the hotel and met by the brightest articulate young women I have met in a long time . You go as far out as district 9 u stop first for meet and greet with other members and noodle soup on then for 2 more food stops bar b que fish and oh yes those eggs - not compulsory thankfully 😂 u go through Chinatown Korean and mafia and stop and get a history on each place so informative our guide was superb it really is the best way to see the city . The best tour I have ever done in any city a must do thank u xo we will be back loved it 😍😍😍

Best tour ever! - From the moment our tour guides picked us up, we had the best night so far in Ho Chi Minh.
I cannot recommend the tour enough. Amazing English speaking guidwa

Best tour ever! - We loved this tour so much that we can’t wait to return to HCM city to do it again! We’ve travelled lots and encountered many tours but this by far was the best! Awesome drivers, confident, friendly, safe and funny.
Heaps of delicious and some adventurous food to eat.
Covered so much ground in HCM on bikes and wasn’t even scary after the first few minutes.
Thank you for the best time!

One of the best! - By far, one of my favorite trips! Went on the Saigon by night tour with my mom and we both agreed that this was one of the best tours from all the ones we went on. The girls really do make this trip. Both girls we met had great personalities and were really easy to talk to. We really liked all the places they took us to and we’re impressed by their riding skills. It really is a great way to experience this busy city. Loved everything about this trip, from the girls to the riding experience, the other people we met on this trip, the tour leader, the food and drinks, etc. Would highly recommend!!

Fun food ride - We had such a good night with XO tours.
We are both 68 years old and thoroughly enjoyed or night, the girls, the bikes and the food.

Best way to experience the city! - This was so much more than a street food tour. While the foods we tried were wonderful and the variety of venues impressive, the best part was seeing so much of the city at night and meeting the lovely tour guides. We took this tour on our first night in Saigon and would highly recommend doing so. Exhilarating and exciting — wonderful experience!
Perfect way to get to know Saigon! - Loved this food tour! Awesome food, awesome guide and all together a great experience! Would definitely recommend this trip to anyone visiting Saigon.

Foodie Tour - Great! It was one of the best tours we did in Vietnam.
I can recommend the Foodie Tour in HCM to anyone who wants to experience a different tour in great company.
The tour is super professionally organized and it just fits everything ;).

Awesome Saigon by Night tour - I had the best of times with this tour. Thuy was a great driver and company, and Sang told me a lot of interesting things about the city that I would otherwise wouldn't have known..

Also the food was amazing and they the tour is very well organized!
5 stars!

Hope I come back to Vietnam soon and do another tour with them again.

Fantastic evening, even for golden oldies. Not to be missed. - The whole evening is a joy. The girls were delightful, the food excellent ( don’t be afraid of the frogs ) and riding round Saigon was an experience not to be missed. In and out of the traffic all night long. We are in our 70’s and absolutely loved every minute.

Ho Chi Minh whistle stop tour - Really fun tour of Ho Chi Minh! I loved it so much I insisted my parents went the following week, and they loved it too! The girls were amazing, especially Nhung who coincidentally drove me and my Dad. Excellent level of English and fun and informative tour as we were driving.

Food was great, and just as the advert says not like you would eat otherwise. We went on the tour on our last night of a two week trip and I can definitely say it’s true! We originally looked at a cheaper food tour, but the 6000 excellent reviews persuaded us I’m really glad we chose this one!

Ho Chi Minh City Food Tour - My wife and I had an amazing time seeing the city on the back of a scooter trying delicious local food. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to see a large part of HCM and try real local food.
Loved it - Best thing ever!! Loved this tour, such a fun experienced time flew by, felt super safe on the moped and loved each dish I was served!

Must Do Saigon Experience - Recommended to Xo tours by friends & so glad we did it - one of the highlights of our trip. The Foodie tour by night is a wonderfully exciting experience. We paid the extra charge & had a private tour. Felt totally safe the ladies hands in all the craziness of HCNC and saw & learnt so much about the city that I do not think you could do with any other tour. Ate great local food at places we simply would never have found or tried elsewhere, talked, listened, learnt, drank local beer, laughed & had such a fun 4 hours. Thanks heaps ladies!

Foodie tour - awesome experience - A really fantastic experience. I'm usually not a fan of group tours but this was totally different. Our guides were really funny and bubbly, picked us up from our hotel, and whizzed us all around the city through the different districts, chatting and giving us interesting facts all along the way. The food experience was really great, we sampled things we'd never have ordered ourselves, and everything was delicious. This really is a must do in Saigon and if I return, I would most certainly do it again.

Amazing!!! - We did the foodie tour at night and it was one of the best tours I've done in all my travels. The guides were incredibly knowledgeable and offered insights that only locals can. You go outside district one and see places that other tourists don't know about.

Foodie tour and city tour - Fantastic great we did the city tour in the morning the 2 girls are were very helpful funny a joy to be with the guide was also great
At night we did the foodie tour 2 different girls again great
Motorbikes great
Also sent us a photo book of both tours email
Highly recommend

Fantastic! - We did the foodie tour in the evening. We got picked up at our hotel by our drivers. All lovely and bubbly personalities, they drove us to several locations where a guide explained food and history of the location. Although we thought the scooter part may be a concern because of the traffic, it was so much fun and all the food was delicious. They catered to vegetarian diets too which was great! I highly recommend this tour to anyone!

Exhilarating tour! - This tour was the single most fun thing I have done in a long time - such a sense of adventure in the safe hands of competent, experienced drivers and tour guides. My daughter and I (age 50s and 20s) thoroughly enjoyed the entire evening. Zipping through the streets of Saigon on the back of a motorbike and eating where the locals eat - it doesn't get much better than that!
XO - Great time to explore the city with great ladies ride . good adventure and try new local food . highly recommended it

Fabulous night tour - We did the Saigon by night tour and can highly recommend this company. Or female drivers , Lee and Trang were so friendly with excellent English and driving skills.
Ming was the guide and very informative and helpful. The stops we made were really interesting and off the normal tourist track which made it even more attractive to us. Good food and company. We were in a small group of 6 with Ming and another group had a separate guide and drivers.

I like the ethos of this company to empower young women. We look forward to doing some more tours with XO when in Hoi An later this week.

Highly recommended!

Great foody adventure - This is a fantastic 5 hour tour, zipping around to less visited districts of HCMC to see interesting part of the city while trying out some very unique foods. Transport is by the ubiquitous scooter driven by well spoken, friendly, professional and proficient young women. l

Amazing way to see Saigon and get a glimpse into the life & history of the city - My wife and I took part on the "Sights" tour on our second day in Saigon/Ho Chi Minh. It was a lot of fun and a brilliant way to see the city. The girls were great and my wife made a new best friend in her driver. Ironically, we actually felt safer as passengers on the mopeds than we did as pedestrians on the street (pavements are just an extension of the road for mopeds). Our tour guide was good and provided context and historical info of each of the locations we visited. Would highly recommend this tour for anyone who only has a short amount of time in the city, and wants to absorb as much as they can.

Great food tour - Had a great time and experience with the food tour. It took us through many districts of HCMC seeing the differences and diversity which I didnt expect from the tour.

We of course also got a lot of great local food.

Our tour leader was good in explaining about Vietnam and HCMC and our drivers were very social and safely drove us around the city

Highly recommended experience

Best experience ever - This was one of the best things my sister and I have ever experienced. Riding on the back of the bikes through the chaotic streets was exhilarating and the food was absolutely amazing. Our guides were friendly and just genuinely beautiful and helpful people! Can not recommend this highly enough!

Awesome way to experience Saigon by night - This Saigon by Night tour was a way to finish our family holiday in Vietnam. The whole family had great fun, we saw an interesting range of areas in Saigon, the food was fantastic, and our friendly hosts/drivers were just awesome. We were recommended to do this, and we would recommend it to anyone else.

Most unique way to see a city - My daughters and I took 2 tours with XO--the Saigon Foodie Tour and the day time City Tour. Of all the tours we've taken over the years, these 2 were the most unique being on the back of individual motorbikes. XO also has a different way of delivering the tour information--each group tour is lead by one "tour leader" but the transportation is by individual motorbike drivers who also provide city information during the rides. Our drivers were so energetic and fearless, weaving in and out of that crazy Saigon traffic. Saigon is a city that is quite spread out, so Foodie Tour was a bit long as we drove around quite a bit and the smell of the car and motorbike exhaust toward the end of the evening was a bit nauseating.

XO really pays attention to the details. During our walks at local markets, one driver was always the last person in the group, presumably to make sure no one gets lost or left behind. The drivers also doubled as the hosts at our tables, making sure that each guest is served properly and offered sufficient food and drinks. At the bbq restaurant stop, they also prepared the raw food for grilling. Our favorite was the last stop--the seafood was excellent. Thanks, Bao and Khoi for being our tour leaders! Pls give our best to our respective drivers.

Fantastic Saigon City Tour By Scooter! - We didn’t have much time to see Saigon/HCMC and we wanted to have an experience of areas that we couldn’t easily get to on our own. We did the Saigon by Night Tour with XO Tours which was simply perfect! We saw districts we would never have seen and we did it on the back of a scooter which is a genuine experience of how the locals live life everyday. A real adrenaline rush! Even more special is that the drivers are all ladies. My husband and I rode with Phung and Anh. These ladies were amazing with their knowledge, driving skills and their perspectives on life in Saigon/HCMC. They were fun to spend an evening with. If we were here longer we would definitely do another tour with XO Tours.

Fabulous Foodie tour - We booked an XO Foodie tour prior to travelling to HCM as a friend had recommended them to us. We are so glad we booked at went on the tour!!

Two of the girls came to our hotel (in District 1) and collected us on motorbikes. They provided a helmet for each of us. Whilst traffic is fairly chaotic in HCM I felt extremely safe on the back of the motor bike at all times. They took us to the first restaurant where we met the other people doing the Foodie tour that night. (All tourists from countries including UK, US, Romania, Canada and Taiwan).

Not only do they take you to a few restaurants but you also do some sightseeing.

The food was very good and we thoroughly enjoyed the tour. The girls riding the motorbikes were excellent and spoke good English. The main tour guide, Bao, was also lovely and very informative at each stop.

This tour company only employs female motorbike riders as a way of increasing employment opportunities for women.

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCM!

Well planned, good food, delightful hostess/drivers - We really enjoyed this food tour. We were introduced to some interesting and less common Vietnamese dishes, plus given a night-time tour of the city. The drivers that we had were university students with perfect English - and most interesting. Gave us a good insight of the intelligence and aspirations of young Vietnamese.

Foodie tour was totally worth it - You are a passenger on a scooter eating and drinking your way around 5 districts in Ho Chi Minh City. The drivers are your guide for the night giving you a real insight into Vietnam. The food and drink is all included. This trip was an absolute pleasure and great fun. My driver navigated through the madness of the HCM rush hour traffic - it all adds to the fun.

Amazing way to see the city... - We absolutely loved this tour. The ladies were amazing, professional, fun, informative and just generally lovely. Our kids age 6, 9 & 12 loved seeing the city this way and were even willing to give the food a try. This turned a food tour with bored kids into a fun and memorable experience for the whole family. We would absolutely do this tour again here or in another city. Only suggestion, consider wearing a mask if you're not used to the pollution....Amazing tour with great memories!

Love XO tours! - XO tours was recommended by a friend and described to us as a female lead, girl scooter tour company. So i loved the idea of girl gang scooter tour group so I knew I wanted to do one of the options. Everything from picking a tour and registering to pick up and tour was so easy and so fun. My friend and I loved our tour group and fearless scooter tour guides! For the morning sights tour, they pick you up from where you're staying and you head to the first location. You go around to several locations and learn the history and meaning of all the places. You stop for dessert at a local market and then drive by and pick up coffee on your way to the next location. I absolutely loved zipping around on the scooters and again, the girls and the guide make this experience amazing. My only regret is not having more time to do the food and night tour! highly recommend this company to anyone wanting to zip around Ho Chi Minh!

Half day Ho Chi Minh sights tour - I highly recommend this tour! The drivers were great, friendly, fun and safe. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. In just a few hours we saw so so much, Reunificarion Building, Post Office, Norte Dame, markets, burning monk monument, tasted sweets, fruits and sugar cane juice and experienced HCM city by scooter!

An awesome tour!!

Great way to start a HCMC holiday - This is a great way to start your time in HCMC. The tour was fantastic fun and we were given lots of local tips for our stay. Ming and the girls were a friendly and interesting bunch to hang out with. It was the highlight of our time there.

Best experience in Saigon! It had it all! - We had the BEST time. The tour was amazing. The food taught us authentic culture. We felt safe on the motorbikes, our instructors spoke great English and were relatable. It was nice having a conversation with them and learning about life in Vietnam, all while driving a motorbike right through the crowds. Honestly, something we will never forget! Highly recommend. This isn't a "want to" this is a "must do"!

The food tour to end all food tours - There will be sightseeing, games, random factoids, inconsiderate drivers, mildly dangerous riding, questionable helmets and shots. Who doesn’t like shots?

I confess, I doubted my rider’s ability to take on my 6ft1 frame and bring me home safely in this crazy Saigon traffic. The uni student could barely reach my elbows let alone the motorbike seat. But she did. And she did it better than I’d ever could hauling someone twice their weight whilst navigating jammed streets and sharing an anecdote. I believe she was also doing her homework with her left hand but I couldn’t be sure. I guess only women – multitasking magicians no matter where they’re from – can do this.

You will see beautiful old towns, learn about different cuisines, and taste so much food I can’t say you won’t explode from both joy and over-eating. The rider helps you at the table too. She shows you how to grill meats or add condiments to a shellfish and you can have local drinking games. I don’t recommend your rider participating though (she wouldn’t of course).

If you’re worried about safety, do note that they have a convoy of male riders who discreetly escort you to every stop point and during the ride. It’s assuring when they look after you so well. I would recommend this not only for the food but for how special the town feels on two wheels compared to how it looks being in a car.

//

TIPS:
- Ask the rider if she prefers you to sit closer or near the back.
- Your name is now Tip. Tip Well. So you won’t forget to Tip Very Well.
- If you have dietary restrictions, please inform early. They can assist.
- Make friends

Totally fun, well organized and safe - This motorbike food tour was totally fun, well organized and safe! Riding on a scooter in HCMC is an experience like no other and is super cool. The places chosen for food were great with delicious examples of the thriving food scene of the city. And the guides were so much fun, yet informative. This tour was the highlight of our week in Vietnam!

Unique and fun way to experience Saigon & its food - We did the evening foodie tour and it was exceptional. The food stops were all interesting and delicious, and the tour itself was incredibly well organized. Saigon is a city that runs on scooters, and so it was great to experience the city this way. The women who were our guides were all so friendly and willing to answer just about any question about Vietnam and life in Saigon. This tour was definitely one of the two or three best things we did during our 10-day trip in Vietnam.

Eat where the locals do! - I signed up for this adventure solo, and loved the way this experience was run -- the tour guides were all so welcoming and friendly, it felt like I was out for the night with a group of my friends! It was also a great way to meet other travelers. I would have preferred a couple more food stops, as opposed to 3 stops with multiple courses at each. It was great to see the real "local" food scene but I also wish we still got to experience what the tour guides would consider the BEST of the typical food that all tourists know about like banh mi, banh xeo, spring rolls, etc. Overall, great fun riding around town as a motorbike gang, eating our way through the city!

Night Foodie Tour - As a group of 8 we had a wonderful time zooming through the streets of Ho Chi Min City. We visited 5 districts within Ho Chi Min city, having 11 dishes, 3 food stops and 2 sightseeing stops. Although the tour took 4-5 hours time flew by very quickly. The tour guides were amazing and kept the children entertained at all the stops while the adults were also throughly informed about Ho Chi Min food and life. The food was delicious and it was a great taste of Vietnamese culture. I highly recommend this experience.

Must do tour! - Cannot recommend this tour highly enough. It was absolutely sensational from start to finish.

The guides experience at handling the scooters is brilliant, their English is flawless and are able to provide such a fascinating commentary of Saigon as you zip around.

And then there is the food.... OMG the food. Brilliant.

If you come to Saigon you MUST do this tour.

A must tour in Saigon - This was an awesome tour, riding around Saigon on a motorcycle was an amazing experience, the food locations were absolutely great, tasting all of what Vietnam has to offer. Guides were amazing, nice, great English speaking and lots of fun. If I could give it more than 5 stars I would.

Came back for more, need i say more. - I had done the foodie tour about 8-9 years ago. And yet I decided to do it again. Being a returning customer, I was welcomed with a discount which was a nice touch.

Reservation was done online and promptly confirmed. Once I reached the city, shared the room number and local contact details of the hotel I was staying in.

The pickup was punctual and after brief introduction on dos and don't as a pillion rider, we we're on the way. I was riding behind Tuyet, who was half my height and possibly one third my weight.... but did a great job in driving me around through the interesting traffic.

We convened at the first stop where we joined the rest of the group, a total of 12 tourists. We were served a variant of pho... Thereafter to barbecue at second stop and seafood at the third stop. There were two tourist stops in addition to the three food stop.

Other than the food, the experience of being driven around with a group was something which brought me back. But the smart riders, made the riding time informative and interesting... and with a great sense of humour Tuyet made it really memorable.

Best wishes to the entire team. Look forward to doing it again in a future trip.

A great way to explore HCMC and the local cuisine! - My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our foodie tour with XO tours. The professionalism and staff interaction with the guests was exceptional. If you’re nervous about riding as a passenger on a bike, don’t be. The drivers are very skilled and can easily hold a conversation at the same time as navigating the streets. The food was very well appointed. My favourite was the beef noodles and the bbq. Thanks to our drivers Ms Foo and Ms Thao for a great night out, and to our tour guide Mr Khoi for explaining to us a bit about the courses and the vibrant city of Ho Chi Minh city! Regards, Will and Sophy :)

Amazing way to taste and see Ho Chi Minh - If you want a lovely way to see HCM City by night while tasting some of the not-so-common treats it has to offer, then do the evening Foodie Tour with these guys! They were awesome. I am a bit nervous of Vietnamese traffic as a rule but on the back of a scooter, being ridden by the lovely Lee, I was quickly at ease and had such a fun night. I felt completely safe, the food was marvelous and the chatting with Lee as she expertly doubled me through the traffic was lovely. I highly recommend XO for this tour!

Fantastic night with lovely people! - We are a family of 5 visiting Vietnam for 2.5 weeks and this was our final night! It was a fantastic way to celebrate a lovely holiday.
The staff were friendly and chatty - made us feel really relaxed. We also felt very safe the whole time, despite being in the crazy Saigon traffic at night!
The experience was well organised, ran on time, the food was delicious and we would thoroughly recommend this experience.
They also take fantastic photos of you to remember the experience.

Amazing experience - We took a night tour as a family of four, two adults and two children aged 9 & 11. Initially I was sceptical about putting my two children on the back of mopeds in the crazy traffic of this city however the girls who picked us up were simply adorable and put us at our easy straight away. They made sure we were all happy before we took to the city streets and always made sure that we had full view of the children no matter how busy the traffic was. In fact I can safely say that the driving feels a lot less chaotic when you are part of it and drivers are calm and very aware of other drivers around them. We all felt completely safe the whole time we were on this trip.

What is lovely about this tour is that the girls talk to you all the time and make sure you get lots of interesting facts everywhere you go. Our two children came away with so much knowledge about the city, about life in Vietnam and loved every minute of the evening. We ate with the girls in a typical Vietnamese outdoor eatery with the locals partaking in Karaoke at their tables as they ate. We visited the local Chinese food market, selling everything from live chickens to fruit and vegetables, we visited the older parts and newer parts of the city. We had a great guide Ming who met us at each location and gave us some great insights to the city and local life and could confidently answer all our questions.

This is a fun and exciting way to see the city and gain a good overview and understanding of life living here. I would highly recommend this to everyone visiting the city

An extra big thank you to Hong, V2, V5 and Cheng (hope I spelt your names correctly), you really are fantastic and made this an extra special night for us.

Highlight of Saigon! - This was our favourite experience in Saigon. We had a fantastic time with Tam and Tian; they were extremely friendly, answered all of our questions, and made us feel very comfortable on the motor bikes. We did the Foodie tour and couldn't decide if we enjoyed the riding on motorbikes or the food and drink more. 10/10 would strongly recommend if you only have 1 night in Saigon.

Great fun and great staff - Went on this night tour with our two young children 9 and 11.
The girls are very welcoming and safe drivers. We had a great tour of many areas in the city and a fantastic dinner too, the guide Ming was also organised and informative.
They also take photos of your group during the night.
Highly recommend

Night tour of Saigon! - Brilliant trip with the XO girls. This is a must do in Saigon. Not to be missed. They brought us to different districts and we stopped for a few food stops along the way. Had a brilliant evening would recommend to a friend!

One of the highlight of Saigon trip! - Did the XO foodie tour on a Sunday evening. The tour guides (Binh and Huong) showed up at the scheduled time, and were absolutely wonderful. They spoke almost perfect English, had a great intro to the mopeds, and provided the best company for the 5 hour tour. Both of them (I did this tour with one other person) were so personable and interesting, and knowledgeable of the city. They were also fantastic drivers!!!!! It was so cool to be able to experience the city (and traffic) on the scooters, and I never felt unsafe even though Saigon traffic is crazy. The food was also great. I had been warned that there would be a lot of food on this tour, so I did my best to NOT finish the bun bo hue at the first stop to keep space in my stomach for the next tops! At the second stop, the girls had some games for us to play to get to know the others on the tour, which was awesome. The last stop was my favorite, and I LOVED the balut in tamarind sauce. Getting to experience spots where true locals go (every place was PACKED with locals), with these fantastic and interesting guides made for such a wonderful evening!
I would highly recommend this, whether you are in a group or traveling alone. The tour guides make sure you are always talking and learning and it is a fantastic way to experience the city!!

Thrills, eats, and good times all around! - We only had 3 days in HCMC and just did the foodie tour at night - it was amazing! The girls are so friendly and easy to talk to. It was like a two in one deal where you get to try some real local food (and not the usual packaged food tour fare of pho and banh mi) that you probably wouldn’t think to order yourself and see a TON of the city beyond District 1! Between the unlimited food and drinks and circuit around Saigon it was the best way to get out of the tourist box. You get some thrills and talk to locals about their country and food. We saw so much more than we would have on our own or doing another tour by foot or car. Hands down the highlight of our time in Saigon.

PS. The scooter is actually a really fun way to get around and felt surprisingly safe - such a fun night!

Amazing Tours - Other reviewers say it all, this really is a 5 Star exciting way to see Ho Chi Minh. the ladies drivers were skilful and informative with wonderful personality. Annie(Anh) our guide was well informed about the city, wish we had more time to do other tours with XO but were on a cruise with only one overnight stop.

Best tour in Vietnam! - Like everyone else, can not recommend the XO foodie tour more.

A great way to see more of the city than you would otherwise, trying so many different dishes, and learning about the city and it’s people with your student driver.

We were in a group with around 12 others from all around the world and had the best time, but it’s the guides who really make the night wonderful.

Do it.

Great “local” tour with fab food - Great way to see more of the city than my husband and I would have seen one our own. Also a great way to chat with our Vietnamese guides while clutching on for dear life ;-) The gals are good drivers, very good hosts and we had a lovely evening with them and the rest of the group. The food was really good and they were very accommodating to a non-meat eater. Thanks XO!
Night tour is awesom - The food is great and the information is interesting, but the guides are the best part. Great way to get introduced to the geography and character of Ho Chi Minh City.

2 great tours! - We did the Food tour on the Friday night and then the Sights Tour on Saturday morning. All 4 girls were wonderful - so personable, great drivers, interactive. We felt we were in great hands, safe and well taken care of. Great way to start your time off in Saigon and just loved touring around on the back of the bikes. Food was great. I had done the Food tour in 2012 and still loved it again!

A must do with XO Tours - We went on the Foodie Tour with the XO ladies and it was one of the highlights of our trip. We were also lucky enough to be able to book it without too much notice (although I wouldn't recommend leaving it to the last minute). We had 3 young kids with us and one of our kids was really nervous and frightened to go on the scooter (we thought for a second there we may not be able to) but the guides talked her through it and was totally fine within 3 minutes in (and didn't want the tour to end)! The best part was the hustle and bustle of being on the scooter in all that traffic which we would never have attempted on our own. We felt safe the whole time, the ladies were informative, professional and friendly. The food choices were great there as more than enough food for us. We were even a little more adventurous with what we ate. I cannot recommend this tour enough! If we ever go back to Ho Chi Min city we wouldn't hesitate to book another tour. The kids loved it, we loved it and the 4.5 hours flew by. We saw so much we wouldn't have done on our own or have even known to go. We had a wonderful and memorable time.
Highly highly recommended.

Adrenaline Filled Food Tour - If simultaneous real life and dining adventures are your thing, then look no further than XO’s Foodie Tour (by scooter). While our family of four are International food tour veterans, we’d never ridden on scooters before. But that’s the best way to get around Saigon (there seem to be thousands on the road at any given moment), so we took a chance on XO and their energetic staff of all-female drivers. Ngan, Queen, Yuong, and Nihg safely guided us around town, engaged us in lively conversations, and helped to put us at ease. It was a bit nerve racking at first, but once we relaxed, it was a lot of fun. Over the course of four hours, we scooted through six districts, got a brief history lesson, and enjoyed many tasty Vietnamese dishes. Highlights were the barbecue stop in the 4th district (prawns, frog, goat) and the seafood joint in the 8th District. That last stop included more prawns, scallops, hot vin lon (duck eggs) and a delicate ginger soup, to help settle our tummies for the evening. They also shot video of our tour ($40 extra), which we can’t wait to share with family and friends. If you’re looking for adventure in Saigon, look no further than XO!

Extremely fun, delicious and insightful experience - We booked a private foodie tour on our first day in HCMC and couldn't have kicked off our trip in a better way. Phong and Tien were total experts on the city, food and of course on their scooters. They took us to some very local spots and opened our eyes to the local life and culture in HCMC. The tour was well mapped out, organized and efficient. We loved our experience so much that we tried to find similar experiences in the other cities we visited but nothing compared to XO Tours! Thank you for an incredible time, ladies!
fantastic experience, great staff, and great food - the staff was awesome and really great with our kids. We did the Foodie tour and the food was awesome, a simply wonderful experience.

Most memorable tour of HCMC! - I am so glad we decided to disregard any fear of the crazy Saigon traffic and go with XO Tours on a motorbike roundtrip of Saigon! These guys made us see Saigon in a totally different perspective - one that the other 9 million motorbike-owners see every day :). Four professional drivers showed me and my family how to get on the bikes and enjoy the ride. We were accompanied by Bao, the most professional guide who told us about the fascinating history of each site. Added as a bonus into the program were various tasting of typical Vietnamese food - very enjoyable. This was an unforgettable experience - highly recommended!

A Really fun and delicious few hours - We travelled on a private tour with my wife and 2 daughters. We were picked up at the hotel by our drivers and went to about seven different locations to eat. The guides were really friendly and informative. The tour included both eating and seeing local markets and locations. All of the food was amazing, from the noodles to barbecue to frog meat! The team also included some fun games along the way and nice touches like a present of a phrase book. Some of us were a little apprehensive about riding on a moped in the craziness of Saigon traffic but the girls were very good drivers and my daughters ended up absolutely loving it! The tour is more expensive than other tours but we thought it was worth it and was one of the highlights of our holiday.

You have to do it! - XO tours delivered well above our expectations - which were quite high since we had read the number of positive reviews and word of mouth by a friend of ours -
My wife and I were picked up from the hotel by our drivers/guides, which they were both friendly, packed of knowledge about Ho Chi Minh City and super skilled drivers to navigate the city's crazy traffic - which in itself it is quite an adventure worth experiencing.
We completed 3 food stops for a total of 14 courses; interestingly enough I hadn't tried any of these dishes before after 10 days in Vietnam so the sense of discovery and adventure was heightened; and 2 sightseeing stops - mostly to get a rest from eating and seeing a different side of Saigon away from the hotels where most tourists roam around. The tour in total took the better part of 4 hours and if I had the time to redo it the following day I would have done it!
Shoutout to Khoi the tour leader as well for sending the pictures of our adventure so soon.
Thanks XO Tours for a great evening

AWESOME Foodie Tour!! - We had an awesome time on the Foodie tour! Getting on a motorbike in Ho Chi Minh City was an experience within itself, while going through several different districts tourists don't go to was also so fun / adventurous! The food was delicious and plentiful. We learned heaps about Ho Chi Minh City as well. We had a great time and had no issues.

Amazing way to see the city & get a taste of local cuisine - My sister, cousin & I cannot speak highly enough about this tour group. All of our tour guides/drivers were very welcoming and kind. The tour guide leader Bao was also very welcoming, kind and knowledgeable. We all had an excellent time getting to know our guides and the other people on the tour. We loved being able to see and get around the city this way, as well as getting the opportunity to learn more about the city we couldn't find in a book. Definitely recommend!

Thrill and Fill of a night ! - We booked the XO Food Tour on recommendations from a friend. So glad that we did!

Booking and reservation was all done online. The process was seamless. All the communication from XO was via email and excellent.

We were picked up outside our hotel by three lovely ladies on mopeds/scooters. For those of you visiting HCMC for the first time, the sheer number of scooters zipping down the streets is mind boggling. Overwhelming. daunting.

But, if there was a way to be a part of that buzz and get a safe, thrill, enjoyable ride.... this is it.

The tour takes you through 5 different eating places. You drive through pretty much all the distrcits of HCMC, so you do get to see the city and its different faces (affluent, busy, old, new .....)

The food locations and local... and the food choices .. local. For food lovers, this is a definite treat.

The conversations you have with your rider, local snippets... is memorable.

We couldnt wait to get back on the scooters after each meal. There is a LOT of food to eat.

Picked up around 5.30 PM.. we finished around 10.30 PM.... but didnt miss a minute of it. Loved it !!!

Saigon by night - We had the Saigon by night tour with two beautiful, wonderful ladies!

It was so fun just to go on a motorbike. They drove us around safely and we had Great conversations both on and off the bikes.

These Girls had a lot of knowledge about whatever we asked about, and also about everything that they shared with us in all the different districts we visited.

The best thing was that it felt like we hung out with friends and The tour was perfectly organized from start to end.

Very interesting tour that showed us a whole new Ho Chi Minh.

We Really recommend it!

XO = WOW! - Came to Saigon and took directly the tour “Saigon by night”. I don’t want to spoil too much. It was interesting, informative and for me ... marvelous. The to guides took care of me and answered even my strange questions. I got delicious vegetarian meals during the trip. Best hosts during my travel through Vietnam!

Best tour in Saigon!! - Myself and my husband are just back from the “Foodie” tour. It was definitely the highlight of our time in Saigon and even Vietnam.

Huang was my guide and Ann was my husbands. They made us feel at ease from the moment we met them. They were very knowledgable and great fun to be around.

There were 5 stops in total, 3 of them being food. The food was exceptional and we tried lots of new Vietnamese food. We were offered as much food and drink as we wanted.

If you are visiting HCM this tour is not to be missed and if you get Huang as a guide that is a massive added bonus :-)

Great overview of key locations around the city. - Fantastic tour. The ladies driving the scooters were informative, entertaining and great drivers! We felt safe at all times, and really enjoyed ourselves. We heard from other tourists that their "foodie" tour is also amazing. Maybe next time :)

Great introduction to the city - We started our week in Saigon with a motorbike tour of the city. The guides were friendly, knowledgeable and very talkative. The enlightened us on the history of different places around Saigon and we ate some delicious classic Vietnamese food. The ladies made everyone, including the teenagers feel safe and comfortable riding on the back of the motorcycles. I would recommend children over the age of 10 as you must hold on to either the guides or the handles as you ride.

Very nice and fun food toue - We enjoy evening night out on motorcycle with XO!. On the positive side this was very fun trip with real understanding of Vietnam especially HCMC and the culture. Our group leader had very good English as well as the motorcycle driver.
All stop where carefully chosen and they did above and beyond to adjust to our dietary requirement and needs which was highly recommended.
One very small minor remarks and again this was not effect our experience was the fact that the food station they choose was too authentic and very limited ( again we had enough food) but for the price of 75$ which is a lot in terms of Vietnam we were expecting to get something more upscale combine with Authentic.
We had very good foodie tour in Hanoi which was half the price and was perfectly organize to combine all scales.
But regardless we had fun night and the tea is superb!

Fantastic tour worth every penny! - We loved our foodie tour and count it as one of the highlights of our three week trip in SEA. Not only is the tour incredible for the fact that you get to see so much more of the city than you would have otherwise, but you get to try some delicious and still very authentic street food surrounded by locals who are enjoying the same. The drivers/guides were so much fun to sit with and chat while we ate, and we loved getting to know so much more about their lives as we drove around. Even though this was definitely one of our bigger expenses, we would do it again in a heartbeat!!
Best part of my Saigon trip - A very enjoyable evening cruising around spots outside of the main tourist area. It felt like a night out with friends rather than a tour. I highly recommend.

Definitely a highlight of our trip! - Our kids 9 and 11 ranked this as one of the highlights of our Vietnam tour. Phung and her team were fantastic! They were friendly and knowledgeable and very safe drivers. It was really nice knowing the security team were with us, without being too visible. Its a great tour with delicious and fun, adventurous food. Our son had a bit of a headache so we were able to pull over quickly at a pharmacy along the tour to get some ibuprofen. He was better by the next stop! Highly recommend this and recommend it at the front end of your visit to HCM to get a good idea of the city. Thank you Phung and team!!
Highlight of our trip - We had a great time on the foodie tour with our hosts Hong and Jan. It was definitely a highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

Friendly and fun tour - I had an awesome time on the Saigon by Night tour! I got to try baby banh xeo pancakes and my wonderful driver taught me how to eat them like a local. Loved visiting a variety of districts and learning heaps from our tour leader, Ming. Definitely recommended. Would love to try the foodie tour which followed close to our tour and looked amazing!

Unbelievable! - When my wife and I read the reviews for this trip we figured it had to be a setup. There is no way it could have that many 5str ratings...then we went on it. OMG! It was even BETTER than we hoped! This tour exhilarates a multidue of senses. It’s not just about taste...you travel through multiple districts learning about the cultures, markets and the people that make up each. You even play a game! (Don’t worry Tien...maybe next time you’ll beat us;). Which leads me to the best part of the tour, our guides Haug(sp) and Tien. Special shout out to Tien what had an abundance of knowledge and a delightful personality to go along with it. (Haug just started but has a bright future ahead as well). They did a tremendous job making us feel right at home. Thank you both for making this tour one of our highlights in an already fabulous journey in Southeast Asia!
Great evening - Thank you for a great evening. Saw and tasted dishes that we wouldn’t otherwise have done so and got to experience how locals eat out. Highly recommend.

Fun night in HCMC - We booked a motorbike food tour with XO Tours after recommendations from other friends. We had a fantastic night with the XO girls seeing parts of HCMC we wouldn’t have otherwise seen and tasting new foods. I am not an adventurous eater, but with gentle coaxing from the girls tried some frog. I always felt safe with the girls in the crazy traffic - made even crazier by Vietnam winning a soccer match. A fantastic night and I’ll be booking another tour when I return to HCMC.

Most enjoyable thing we did in Saigon! - Highly recommended! I thought it was going to be a food experience, but the thing I liked even more was the experience of seeing the city on a scooter, and hanging out at local places and talking (while eating).

The tour/bike drivers were personable with excellent English and even with the chaotic city traffic, they drove safely and still managed to carry on conversations so you could talk about what you were seeing. It's wonderful that they take you to several districts beyond what the typical tourist would see, and intentionally serve you food you would see or try or your own. An XO rep also met us at each stop to explain further where we were, which was nice context for the evening.

Meanwhile, we hung out with the other tourists and guides, and it just felt like a fun evening out with friends.

Generous portions of whatever food was offered. **Favorite dish - the grilled scallops !!!

Thank you for the memories - Travelling solo and armed with enthusiasm and energy but inadequate time, XO Tours proved to be a late but very fortunate discovery.

I did the ‘foodie tour’ the night I arrived in Saigon, with Bao as the tour leader and Ha as my companion. The tour started right after a thunderstorm and was almost cancelled. However, fate would have it that the night would be truly memorable. Ha is an extraordinary person. The first impressions of the city on the back of a scooter riding through puddles and the adrenaline accompanying it will be savoured for years to come, as well as the food that I never thought I would try.

Two days later, I rejoined XO and did the ‘sights tour’ in the morning. Even though I stayed in district one and could walk to all the landmarks, I was admittedly lazy (it’s a holiday!) and wanted the convenience of a scooter. This time, I had Nhung as my companion and Khoi as tour leader. Nhung was hilarious; from all the laughs, I’m glad we didn’t fall off the scooter!

Thank you so much. Looking back, I just enjoyed travelling around Saigon in the company of like-minded tourists who can share experiences and the conversations had with our guides. The off the script conversations with the guides were the best source of local insight of this beautiful city and hope our paths may cross again in the future.

Fun day out! - Just went out on the AM sights tour with the lovely ladies of XO tours. We didn't know what to expect with our little guys riding around on the bikes (ages 5 and 7) but the girls were great, safe, made us all comfortable and we all had a blast! Their English was great and Ming our tour guide was perfect for our needs. The sights were perfect and just enough to entertain all of us without tiring us out!

XO foodie tours - It was an excellent experience!
Great hosts who were knowledgeable and attentive.
Wonderful food too which we would not have discovered on our own.

Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City - The XO Motorbike food tour was fabulous! We were picked up at our hotel by 5 adorable and smart motorbike drivers/tour guides and a lovely young man “security” driver. The leader was Nhung. She, along with the 4 other girls spoke perfect English and they made us feel very comfortable on the motorbikes. Our dinner tour took about 5 hours and took us to 5 places in Ho Chi Minh City. It was quite an authentic experience and the food was good too! Just riding on the motor bikes and eating at local places made this food tour amazing. Nhung and the other guides taught us so much about the city and we each developed a wonderful repoir with each of our drivers. It was a highlight for our family of 5 (our kids are young adults). I highly recommend it!!
XO foodies Tour - It was wonderful experience go around Saigon on the scooters . The XO girls are friendly and beautiful in their aó dài . Well organized. !!!
Fun fun fun - A good fun nice tour. Great English speaking riders & guide, good support team. Good local food; didn't expect high end food, it's street food right. Result was good value for money.

Great city tour! - We booked the tour quite spontaneously and were still the only guests this morning. We got a lot of information at the city stops and were spoiled with desserts, fruits and drinks. We had a lot of fun and always felt safe in the back seats of the scooters. We would definitely recommend the tour!

Best food tour ever! - Decided to do a food tour on my last night in Saigon and loved every minute/mouthful of it. Travelling by scooter at night and visiting the districts you’d never see as a tourist was so much fun.

My guide was extremely informative and funny. All the food stops were very tasty and I definitely got fed well!

I try and do food tours when I travel and can that this is easily the best one I’ve ever done. Don’t miss it!

Would do again if I'm in Ho Chi Minh City - Very well organized! The drivers are all wonderful women and so knowdgeable as well. We had a great time and they provided us with free incredible photos! Would do again if I'm in Ho Chi Minh City :)

Wonderful scooter tour and food adventure - My wife and I are big foodies and thought this tour would be perfect. And it was! Our drivers were very personable, knowledgeable, and demonstrated some serious skills navigating the densely populated streets of HMC. The tour was about 5 stops in all 3 for food, 2 for guided breaks. While the food was unique the highlight IMO is the scooter adventure around the city. I won’t ruin any of the surprises but the food is unique. I recommend going in with open mind and an empty stomach.

Wish I would have done this the first night of the trip and not the last. So much to see and do here.

If you could only do one thing in HCMC, make it this! - Oh my goodness, what an amazing idea. I travel alone fairly often, and my trip to Vietnam was no different. My XO tour was hands down my favourite thing though. Riding shotgun through Vietnam on a motorbike is definitely something to tick off the bucket list! The food is amazing (be prepared for the weird and wonderful, but everything is edible!). There’s something so special about visiting another country, being ferried around their hometown, having the culture explained, and heaps of food and drinks being brought to you - especially surrounded by people undergoing the same experience. I’m definitely headed back to Vietnam at some stage - and definitely taking this tour again!

What great fun ! - A wonderful evening being taken to various sites around Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a motorcycle ridden by a woman.These women are very skilled and very safe so I was happy to hop on the back and enjoy the ride.The food was great and it was so interesting to see the different districts of Saigon.Thanks to Trang and Tien4 who were our drivers for the evening.They were delightful company and conversed in fluent english.We came away with a much better idea of what it is like to live in HCMCITY.The survival guide and phrase book is sure to come in handy too.

Foodie tour by vespa - A truly great tour to get to see more of HCMC while experiencing a lot of local food like goat, frog and even balot! They will take you to 4 different districts outside of district 1 and not only let you try different local food, but also tell you a bit about each district. The guides were great and extremely friendly and helpful and truly wanted to give you a great experience. I really recommend the tour to anyone who visits HCMC and wanna see more of what it has to offer outside of district 1.

Amazing time - highly recommended - We recently went on the “Foodie” tour with XO in HCMC, and it was so much fun. At first I was very nervous about being on the back of a motorbike in HCMC traffic but our guides were extremely reassuring and helped calm me down. Our guides were so friendly and helpful - they really were one of the best parts of the experience. The food is obviously very tasty, and the tour takes you to parts of the city you probably wouldn't venture to yourselves. They do all of the little things right - reminds your name, where you're from, seating people together that seems to be hitting it off - it all really helps to build an enjoyable experience. At the end of the night, I was sad that the experience was over. I would highly recommend booking with XO Tours - it was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon.

Fun & safe scooter tour - I booked our city tour before we arrived in Ho Chi Minh and was so nervous before the tour started as I had no idea how crazy the roads are here! But Ann & Nee were great and really put us at ease they were great fun and really good riders. Minh was a great tour guide and we really enjoyed the morning all 3 spoke really good English and we learned a lot about this lovely city.
Would definitely recommend thanks guys x

Worth every dong! - Have done this tour twice, excellent way to cover turf & visit the best eats on 2 wheels.
Drivers are safe & chatty.. traveling in convoy through the bustling streets. Try a bite of everything, great times!

Exciting and fun foodie night out !! - So much fun! Great way to see and experience Saigon. The food was delicious . Our cyclist guides Phuong and Lam were delightful and entertaining as well as being very safe drivers in the hectic and chaotic traffic! The 5 hours flew by as we were ferried to great locations outside of the touristy parts of the city to enjoy the flavors and diversity that Saigon has to offer. I was a little sad at the end of the night and would have loved to give one of the other tours on offer a go but our time was short this trip - maybe next time! Thanks for the great memories XO Tours.

Scooting and eating all around Ho Chi Minh - Had a fantastic experience with XO Tours. Scooting all around the city and checking out the different districts was a great (and safe) experience. The food stops and history lessons were also a fantastic. The highlight however are the friendly and knowledgeable tour guides who really helped make the experience everything it was.

Eat your way through Saigon - This experience is much more than a food tour - we got to see multiple districts in Saigon and experience tons of different foods and cultures. Our drivers were amazing as was our tour leader (Sang) - we spent the night trying new things, making new friends, and making great memories.

We definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon, especially if you have limited time as it packs in a lot within a few hours. And, it's the only way you'll get to ride a scooter safely in this crazy city!
Saigon by night tour - What a fantastic tour! Very well planned and girls were friendly and knowledgeable. Certainly a highlight of our time in Saigon. Highly recommend

Excellent tour. Recommended - A family of 5 we took a 1/2 day tour on the motorbikes around Ho Chi Minh.
The girls and our tour guide were prompt, proficient, skilled motor bike riders, excellent tour guides and FUN.
Our family had a brilliant introduction to the city.
Our tour guide was informative and engaging and thankfully we were not once taken somewhere on the pretext to show us something and then try to sell us products unlike other companies .
We all thoroughly enjoyed our morning and can happily recommend this quality tour experience to potential customers.

Amazing tour! - We absolutely loved this tour, the girls and our tour leader all spoke great English and would answer any questions that you had about Saigon or general Vietnamese life. I'm not great at eating spicy food but they did their absolute best to accomodate me.
Such a highlight in Saigon and I highly recommend it!

Perfect evening with Foodie tour!! - It was just great! Highly recommended if you are in Saigon. The tour was amazing, the lady drivers were awesome, spoke very well English. They are a perfect guides, knowledgeable about the city and about the food. You will learn a lot about the Vietnamese food and for sure you will not finish this tour hungry 😊
It is kind of expensive, but definitely worth the money.

Recommended not only as food but sightseeing tour - We did the tour this Sunday and I have to admit that I thought in the beginning the tour was quite expensive but I thought it was absolutely worth it. Great guide Ming Lai, funny ride with scooters where I was able to chat a lot about Vietnamese culture and I liked the food a lot.
It was the first thing we did when we arrived from Germany after a short nap and would recommend it

Saigon Nights Tour - Perfect way to spend 3hrs - Started off with a prompt pickup and a 20min cruise from hotel to Chinatown. Got to try the famous "Batul" duck egg, a 2 week old fertilized embryo! Had a fantastic local meal of various styles of pork over broken rice and pickled vegetables, washed down with a beer. Ended by cruising through the newer more modern area of ​​town, and finally to the older less expensive local area where we sat for dessert. My motorbike driver Quynh was the consummate professional and very knowledgable about the city - she made the entire ride both fun and safe! Would highly recommend as a unique way to see parts of the city you normally wouldn't get a chance to visit.

The Foodie - DO THIS TOUR! If you are questioning whether you should do this tour, stop. Book the tour and have a complete blast. Wizzing around Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) on the back of a motorcycle was one of the highlights of my entire trip. It was a wonderful, unique way to experience the city. The food on the tour was wonderful and you went to places that were authentically Vietnamese and not touristy. The people I was with (5 of us) and I LOVED this tour. My driver/tour guide Trang was an absolute gem. I can't recommend this tour enough!

Great tour, but overpriced - Yes, the ladies drove safe. yes they speak English very well. Yes, the food was very good. Yes, it was fun. But you're not going to fancy restaurants, but to local restaurants where local people eat. Considering the fact that a monthly income in Vietnam is about $300, the price of $77 for 1 night is just too much. I hope the girls get paid well as they make the tour well worth!!!

Ho Chi Minh City here - I'd never temp ride a scooter in Ho Chi Minh City, but the women who drove us around were amazingly talented at the 'dance' of scooters in the city. We wore helmets while on the scooters. I never felt nervous riding shotgun on their scooters. Every guide is college educated or going to university. They all speak pretty good English and are a lot of fun, knowledgeable about their city. The tour was coordinated with a tour guide that met us at various spots around the city and gave us more information, insight and great food. It was a wonderful way to introduce us to the city.

Great way to see the city - My husband and I loved the tour in Ho Chi Minh City- we loved the concept, loved our guides, loved seeing the city that way. The food choices could have been better for our taste, but there is plenty of it.

Morning Ride Around Ho Chi Minh - We booked a private morning tour for our family of five and had the most wonderful experience with Xo tours. We saw amazing places and drove around by very experienced beautiful ladies and then met our tour guide Ming who was most friendly, courteous host of his city.
We will definitely book Xo yours again, our teenagers said it was a highlight for them.

The best thing I did on my trip - I was so tired. I almost bailed. After an incredibly fun 5 hours, I am extremely glad I did not. This was such a fun and interesting night and I would not hesitate to book another tour the next time I am in Ho Chi Minh City.

Thanks to XO and all our tour leaders.

Cheers,
Scott

Foodie Tour - An exhilarating experience zooming along on the back of a scooter around Ho Chi Minh City combined with delicious food stops ensures that this was one of our favorite activities on our trip.

We were picked up from our hotel by the scooters and off we went. At no point did we feel unsafe during the trip. The girls are excellent drivers and make you feel very comfortable. They all speak excellent English and it's great to learn snippets of information as they weave their way through the city roads.

The food stops consist of noodle soups, barbecue and seafood. There are a variety of foods that can be tried (and no limit to how much you want to eat, they'll just order some more!) and soft drinks and alcohol are also included.

Ponchos are also provided so the heavens open (which they did for us).

Overall the tour was an excellent way to learn a bit about the city, visit districts you may otherwise not have, and eat food you probably won't have (balut)!

What a fun and unique tour! - We've just come back from the 3hr Saigon by night tour and have to say it was fantastic and such a way to see so many of Saigon's districts.

The girls arrived at our hotel about 5 mins early, they spoke good English, drove well and looked after our safety and advised regarding belongings.

The staff were all good and there was no additional selling / extras.

The group size was just 4, us and another couple, which worked well.

Recommend this to anyone

Glad we did it. Totally worth it. - My wife and I did the night foodie on our 1 and only night in Ho Chi Minh City. We were picked up at our hotel exactly on time. My guide was Tu and my wife's guide was Anh.

The first food spot we went to was to get Bun Bo Hue. At the restaurant we met up with 4 other people so in total, our group had 6 people. The dynamics of our group has been good since we were all in our late twenties/thirties. Ming was our tour leader and he was very personable and had his jokes. After the noodle place, we drove to different Districts and got to experience scooter life in Ho Chi Minh City. My wife was nervous at first being on the back of the scooter, but after 10 minutes she was having so much fun. Being on the scooter, you get to experience the city in such a unique way that you can't get while walking around or being in a car.

Shout out to our scooter drivers. While driving we got to chat about life in Vietnam, day to day stuff, pretty much stuff that isn't scripted or covered in tours. It's not many times I met someone that had a pet pig living in the city. I think that was the most fun part of the trip.

Sign up for the night foodie tour, ask for Ming, Tu and Anh.

Great Evening Ride and Food in Ho Chi Minh City - I highly recommend this tour. It was so well organized and thought out. First, Diem my driver was right on time and was very engaged and explained things as we went to the first stop. The food along the way was all good (even if there are some exotic choices, even for me!). We went through many districts and there was a variety of locations for food and sites. I got a better idea of ​​the city and how it developed over time. Thank you for a wonderful time.

This was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam - Booked XO tours prior to our first trip to Vietnam. Everything went smoothly. We were picked up by 4 very friendly and cute young ladies on their scooters. Toured about half of Ho Chi Minh city with them on the evening food tour. It was spectacular. Can't recommend this enough. 10 stars.

Great Food Tour!! - I highly recommend the XO Food Tour! We had a group of 8 people, and all of us thought it was a great tour! Traveling through Saigon on the back of motorbikes was incredible, and we ate food that the locals ate. The ladies and our tour leader were professional and fun. Don't miss this!

Amazing Tours with Great Drivers and Guides! 10 Stars! - Definitely take a tour with this professional and fun company of all female motorbike drivers! I took two: the morning city tour and the evening food tour. The morning was just me so it ended up being a private tour. The evening tour was a group of 11. Both times the drivers: Tiene and Nhung were on time, went over safety rules, were polite, knowledgeable, fun, smart, and safe drivers.
