They were both lovely women and top-notch drivers in the busy streets of Saigon. The guide for both tours was a man named Sang, and he was also professional, polite, knowledgeable, smart, and friendly. I learned a lot about the history and food of Saigon and Vietnam. Sang was also top-notch. This company must only hire the best. Booking the tour was easy through the website, and communication was prompt. Hotel pick up and drop off are super. I loved seeing the city during the morning and evening on a motorbike. All the stops were interesting, and we covered a lot of a huge city. The food tour filled you with a ton of food. Bring your appetite! We ate delicious soup, BBQ, seafood, and dessert. You will certainly be full, and enjoy all the tour has to offer. I enthusiastically recommend both tours and using this company! If I ever get back to Saigon, I will take another tour with XO!

Highlight of our trip - Over the past two days in Ho Chi Minh we took two of the most amazing motorbike tours with XO. Friday night we did Saigon by Night with Khoi, Tuyet and Anh. This was my first experience on the back of a motorbike and I have to admit I was terrified going in but the girls were absolutely fantastic and I felt so safe despite the busy roads and the weaving in and out of cars, buses, trucks and motorbikes. Not only did we venture into five different districts, we tried some street food and learnt more of the Vietnamese culture.
Saturday morning was the Sites of Saigon. We were so lucky again to have such an awesome team looking after us. Today we had Ming, Loan and Linh. The history we learnt today was incredible and the ride was just a lot of fun with singing and laughing.
If you are ever in Ho Chi Minh please look up XO Tours, this company goes beyond what you would expect and we cannot recommend them highly enough. Thanks so much guys, we appreciate all the effort and care put into each of our tours.

Night Food Tour on Scooters - I HIGHLY recommend this tour. Was by far one of the coolest things I have done on a trip. Taking the scooters out in Saigon is so much fun (though a little crazy). Got to see 5 different districts and walk through the market. Drivers were great - really friendly and engaging. And most important the food was amazing!

Best way to see the city at night.

Incredible Street Food Tour - The experience of joining the millions of motor bikes cruising around was enough, but the restaurants and food that we were able to try on this tour was just incredible! The guides were incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. I would break my cardinal rule of repeating a tour for this one!

One of the best and fun tours I've done! - The tour was great and the girls that drove us around were very funny, smart, and knowledgeable about Saigon.

The food was very good and it was fun to try foods I normally wouldn't.

I couldn't recommend this tour more and I would say it's a "must" for anyone visiting Saigon.

Great food and even better sights! - The drivers were incredible. Not only could they handle 2 people on a scooter, they talked to us the entire drive. Very informative about history, culture and relevant aspects of Saigon that we visited. By far the most fun thing we did in Saigon. An absolute must!
Really good - Tien and Mai were amazing. We had a great time and it was worth it extra for the private tour. We were afraid of the bikes at the start but they turned out to be the highlight!

Best way to spend the first night in Saigon - I don't normally write TripAdvisor reviews for anything, but I feel compelled to take note of the AMAZING experience with XO Tours in Saigon! We decided to do the Foodie tour on our first night to introduce us to the plethora of street food. Our hosts took us on a tour of many of the districts in Saigon on the back of a moped and introduced us to a lot of great local fare (with some strange menu items in the mix too, if you're adventurous!).

What a Night!!! - We did private food tour with Ming Lai, Tien, and Duyen. Started in rain but quickly cleared up. Got to see all of those motorcycles from different perspectives. Entire Company was super communicative and sensitive to our needs. We enjoyed going to some unusual food stops and the girls were super nice in sharing their insights into the city. Could not ask for better tour guides. It was an experience we will not forget.

First night in HCMC - After some friends recommended a bike tour in Ho Chi Minh, we came across the XO Foodie Tour and booked in advance based on the amazing reviews. It completely exceeded our high expectations and was the absolute perfect start to our time in the city. The tour guides were so friendly and put us completely at ease on the mopeds, pointing out the sights as we toured the various areas of the city (during rush hour), which was such a great experience. The food was incredible and beer unlimited - some of the best seafood my partner and I have had anywhere! The girls got to know what else we would be interested in the city and gave us some tips for the rest of our stay, meaning we tried some amazing bars and restaurants that we wouldn't have otherwise. The tour was hands down the best thing we did in HCMC and one of my favorite tours full stop! Cannot recommend enough :)

Brilliant food tour to die for - This food tour was excellent....I and my companion were taken to the Cholom night market, to two different places for delicious local food and laughed a lot with our guides, who had much of interest to tell and made the four hours pass as quickly as anything! It was so good I booked another tour for the following morning:) I can highly recommend these tours, they are the best way of moving around the city and getting a feel of life there!!!

XO Tours Saigon Foodie Tour AMAZING!!! - XO Tours Saigon Foodie Tour was AMAZING!!! Bao kept us informed and on schedule while the ladies (including the wonderful Rosie) kept us engaged and safe. We were in Saigon for two full days. This tour allows us to engage with locals while seeing more districts than we would have gotten to and eat fantastic local and regional food. I do not eat chicken, beef or pork and they accommodated me with no problem. Sooo much food!!! Pace yourself :) They will never leave you hungry. Beyond grateful we found this group!!! Do it!!!

Best thing we did in Saigon! Don't miss this tour! - We did the nighttime food tour with XO and it was HANDS DOWN the best thing we did in Saigon. We weren't sure what to expect and our expectations were exceeded! The woman picked you up right on time at your hotel and they are so nice! Duyen, my driver, was incredible. She was so knowledgeable and talkative and just fun. The food is fresh and delicious, riding on the motorbikes in the insane traffic was exhilarating and you really see a part of the city that you will never see on your own. Our tour guide, Bao, was also amazing. He answered our questions and told us stories and we all laughed until we couldn't laugh anymore. Please book this tour. We would have booked a day tour the next day with XO but we had to fly home. Such an amazing tour!!!

XO 'Foodie' Tour - This tour was recommended to us and we had the best time!! The girls were just lovely and so friendly. It was a great way to see the city of Saigon and also eat some of the best food in Vietnam. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone traveling to Vietnam!!

A must-do! - This was hands down the highlight of our trip!! It was an amazing and exciting way to see the city and try foods that the locals eat (not just pho!). Riding the scooters and being part of the crazy traffic was nerve-wreaking yet exhilarating at the same time! The girls spoke great English and were so friendly and fun. There's just no better way to experience HCM. Highly recommended!

XO Foodie Tour Saigon - Without a doubt, the best thing my wife and I did in Vietnam! Being passengers on motorcycles driven by the XO girls put us right among the mad traffic but we always felt safe as we winded our way through Saigon to the great eating places. These girls were fabulous and careful drivers, very intelligent and spoke the best English of nearly any other Vietnamese person we met.

Best food tour in Vietnam - I went on this trip with my boyfriend to experience the real Vietnam and I have to say it was one of the best things I've done. The food was superb and the company was even better!! We were made to feel so welcome by everyone and some of the facts we learned were so interesting. Definitely 5 star experience!

Amazing way to see HCMC and taste some great food! - This is a must if you want to see the city and the places you will never go. Atmosphere at everything place we stopped was buzzing. The drivers were so fun, knowledgeable and really looked after you from start to finish.
I would certainly do it again.
Thank you again for the surprise birthday cake treat.
Everyone book this trip it won't let you down at all.

Great way to explore the city! - We did the night time foodie tour of Saigon, it was really awesome!! The ladies who drive the scooters are absolutely delightful, friendly and bubbly! This tour was probably one of the best things I have ever experienced in all of my overseas travels, would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Saigon!

XO Tour of Saigon - We did two tours with XO - one in Hoi Ann and one in Saigon. Both were excellent. We learned so much about Saigon especially the war between North and South Vietnam. We got to sample great food in the market and saw many sites. The guide was excellent and clearly understood his history. The bikes were great fun and I never felt unsafe. In Hoi An we traveled outside the city to a really cool pig market. We also learned to make rice paper food and pottery. The drive through the countryside was lovely. I really like that this company is owned and run by women. We will return and I will be sure to do any other tours they are offering.

Exciting way to see Saigon - They say when in Rome, do as the Romans do. So what better way is there to see this hectic and wonderful city than to hop on a scooter. The tour was very well organized and the girls are all wonderful, funny and knowledgeable. Not to mention they are all extremely safe riders. This is a must do in Saigon!

Great Food Adventure on Scooters - We picked the "foodie" tour and had a great evening visiting 3 restaurants and several sightseeing locations. We got to eat a wide variety of different foods and see parts of the City we otherwise would have seen on foot. The tour guide and security staff were great and were very accommodating. The scooter/motorcycle drivers were friendly and fun. In addition to learning about foods and food culture in Vietnam, the tour also covered interesting information about Ho Chi Minh City and its people.

As we had a last minute allergy concern, our scooter drivers (I'm not sure how to spell their names - but pronounced like noon, and tuen) and the tour guide(Sang) went well out their way to accommodate us - far beyond our expectations. This tour was a highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh.
Must try foodie tour in Ho Chi Minh! - Great company: from the safe & accomodating lady drivers, to the alert security team, & interesting team leader...well worth the price of their foodie tour 🙂

Must do in HCMC - Of all the things I did in HCMC, this may have been my favorite. Very well organized and worth every penny! The drivers are all bad*ss, wonderful women and so knowdgeable as well. We had a great time and they provided us with free incredible photos! Would do again if I'm in Ho Chi Minh City :)

In the Saigon slipstream - If you want to slip right into Ho Chi Minh (Saigon to the locals) speed and local ways, then jump on an XO Tours ride.
I recently did a “Saigon by Night” motorbike tour with my wife. Nhung and Ngoc bounced into our world on time meeting meeting at our hotel and on the bike and into the traffic we go. The two girls were brilliant and engaging, showcasing an energy that was vibrant, lively and as cheeky as cutting across oncoming traffic in Ho Chi Minh.
We visited districts outside the normal tourist trail and discovered more about this dynamic city. Transport, food, dessert, photo opportunities (the girls take the photos for you) and just a lot of fun made this a memorable night. It’s a must do experience!

Great ride through Saigon - I did this trip after my colleague recommended it to me. It's a 5h tour, 3h spent on moped and 2h eating.

The moped part was crazy fun, it was an awesome experience to ride through Saigon in areas I would never have gone on my own, and to also experience the local way of commuting. The drivers are very good and safe.

The food was decent, but not mind blowing. I guess it's important to remember this is not restaurant quality or sophisticated food, but street food. One suggestion I would have would be to give the opportunity to cook/prepare the food ourselves, rather than have the drivers do everything for you. It would be more fun.

Overall I found it a bit pricey, but reading similar reviews it seems most of the fee goes to providing a better salary for the drivers which is fair enough.

Best night out ever 😍 - Thank you for such a fab night ..
From the moment we were picked up from our hotel, the lady drivers Hannah and Anna were so polite, funny and welcoming.
Both were amazing drivers which made me feel so safe as I'm a little scared on the back of a bike especially in Ho Ch Minh..
There knowledge was amazing as we drove around the districts ..
The food
Definitely amazing one of the best trips my husband and I have ever done . Would definitely recommend , loved having lady drivers 😍😍😍😍😍

Fun, Fast & Fabulous - The best experience in HCMC!!! I had the most fantastic time getting to know our tour guide and wonderful XO Angels. While scooting around the city and experiencing the wonders it has to offer you get to see the bustling market and learn the heart renching history of a magnificent culturally robust country. All staff were friendly, funny and abundantly kind and when the tour inevitably ends, you're sad to see them go. I could not recommend this tour enough, an absolute MUST when experiencing Vietnam!

Awesome foodie tour - Was one of the most enjoyable food tours I've ever had, worth every dime.
The girls were very knowledgeable and got to see the city from the locals perspective and eat at all the hidden gem spots

So much fun! - What an awesome evening! The female guides are very knowledgeable, funny and sweet. I loved riding on the back of the motorbike seeing parts of the city that were unfamiliar to me (and I have been living in Saigon for over a year). We did the tour with friends who were visiting. It was really fun, the food was tasty and the beer abundant. It was such an enjoyable evening that I would do this tour again when different companies come to visit.
It also feels good to support a company that honors and employees young, vibrant, smart Vietnamese women!

Great food and even better guides - We took the foodie tour the first night we were in HCMC and it was a great way to start our trip. Our guides could not have done a better job. They picked us promptly at our hotel and explained how the tour would work and how to safely ride the scooters. We enjoyed all of the places we stopped for food and our favorite was the first stop for soup. Seeing the city at night on the back of the scooter is a highlight of the trip. Thank you to everyone at XO tours for a memorable evening.

Fabulous tour! - The XO Food Tour was such a blast! My parents and I were picked up from our hotel to meet the rest of the group (total of 8 ppl) at the first restaurant. Our motorbikes were driven by the most beautiful and kind girls who greeted us with a smile. Riding the bikes in the chaotic traffic was quite the experience, but we felt completely safe.
The food was incredible... after traveling through the country for 10 days from north to south, I thought we had tried it all, but these locations were “locals only”, and we were very impressed. We had traditional soup, bbq, seafood, and even dessert.
I would absolutely recommend this tour during your time in Ho Chi Minh. Highlight of the trip!

Good fun on night foodie and day sightseeing - I strongly recommend both trips. Not only you knew more about different regions of HCM, riding on a scooter gives you a different perspective of the city. The tours are well organized that gave customers various food tasting menus. The ladies drivers are caring and funny.

Love, love, love this tour! - My husband and I only had 1.5 days in HCMC, so we booked the "Saigon by Night" tour for our first night. And WOW. What a well organized company/tour. This was a great way to see Saigon beyond the touristy District 1, and really learn about this modern city. Our two motorbike ladies -- Ngoc and Nhung -- were essentially our Saigon wikipedias. It was such a pleasure talking to them on our rides, learning about Vietnamese culture and their daily lives. I really feel like I left this tour having gained a new friend. Each stop on the tour also provides something new and interesting. We went to five distinct districts and really gained an understanding for the different areas. Linh, our tour leader, was very knowledgeable and friendly. (personally, I also really appreciate that this tour is essentially run by only women!)

If you're looking for any sort of tour to learn and see all that Saigon has to offer, I'd highly recommend XO Tours!

Brilliant tour! - This was my second XO tour and I will easily come back again. The food was amazing and the experience of meeting our drives (young female university students) and exploring Saigon on the back of the bikes was such a fun thing to do. We also appreciate that we got to visit all the different districts and learn more about how people live in various parts of the city. Well worth the money and I still rate it as one of the best things to do in Vietnam.

Highlight of our trip - We went on our first night in HCMC to get to know some local food and we were surprised how good the foodie tour was! Lovely hosts and the food was interesting and very tasty! It's all you can eat and drink but don't go all out on your first stop as there are many more.... highly recommended.

Foodie Night Tour is fabulous! - This tour is phenomenal! You will see parts of HCMC that you would otherwise seriously never get to. The food is amazing and authentic, but the ladies are really the highlight! Along the way, they pointed out interesting and unexpected things. Shout out to Hong and Tsu (sp?) - you made this so memorable for us! This was the highlight of our trip to Saigon!

Excellent - Best tour. Long our tour guide gave us an in-depth look into the city, mentality of people as well as his personal experiences. Strongly recommended for all curious people who are visiting Saigon for the first time.

Wonderful drivers and great food! - Absolutely loved this tour. Riding around on the motorbikes was just as awesome as the food! Knowledgeable and friendly drivers.
Thanks for showing us local food and letting us experience the traffic like a local!

Foody tour - This tour is an absolute must!

We took a private tour ($30 extra but well worth it!) starting at 6pm to about 10:30pm. It is cooler at this time of the day which makes it even better. Also, a smaller private tour makes it easier to get space in the street eating establishments.

Our guides Hoa and Mai(?) are very intelligent and attractive young ladies. English is very good and can converse on many topics on and off the motor scooter!

I will repeat this tour on a subsequent visit!

One of the best travel experiences ever - Ok - now I am a complete foodie and I did not think any tour could satisfy my penchant for fine delicious foods - well this week I was proved wrong! XO tours were absolutely brilliant down to EVERY detail. Value for the dollar was staggering as we had a private tour for 2 - That included two lovely tour guides How and Mai, an excellent tour manager and a security driver - we certainly felt like VIPS as raced all over Saigon tasting every imaginable delicious delicacy. Best of all we booked that afternoon and by 6PM the entire crew as standing at attention in the hotel lobby waiting for us. These ladies were smart and conversant as we talked all about food, politics and the history of Saigon. I really can't complement them enough as the 5 hours (yes 5 hours) flew by and boy did we eat well. Thank you XO!!!

Our Favorite Saigon Experience - Highly Recommended! - My partner and I did the Foodie Tour and it was by far our favorite experience from our 3 days in Saigon - not only was it a great chance to try some delicious and occasionally quite adventurous dishes from restaurants in a variety of districts, it was a great way to see and learn about parts of the city we wouldn't otherwise have visited on our own, and to embrace the joyful chaos of moped travel with our brilliant guides. We would highly recommend this to anyone wanting the real tastes of this amazing city, many thanks to Loc and the team!

So much fun!! - I did the Foodie tour and it was one of the best things I did in Vietnam. The guides were super friendly and fun. There was plenty of food and beer and it all tasted amazing. Cruising around on the scooters at night was excellent. 100% recommend this tour.

An Experience Not To Be Missed (for all ages)! - With some trepidation we (two 60 year old females) booked to go on this tour on the recommendation of friends. My goodness, what an amazing adventure it turned out to be! Our female drivers were delightful, considerate and went to great lengths to ensure we were enjoying ourselves. Riding through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City at night was amazing. We were part of the craziness of this city for nearly five hours. We saw the sights from the back of the bike and visited three local restaurants. If in doubt - do it! It was SO much fun!

Great introduction to HCM - We did the tour on our first day in HCM. It was the best thing we decided to do. Got to see the different districts, try the best of each food and learn about the city along the way. Our guides were lovely, welcoming and accommodating. The food was yummy and each stop had a replacement meal for my partner who doesn't eat seafood. Great tour.
Amazing Experience - I and my girlfriend did the tour. The girls are very carefull drivers funny and the food is amazing.

An amazing way see Saigon - travel and eat like a local - We are not much for tours as they are typically a watered-down touristy waste of time. This tour is different. Scooting around Saigon eating like a local is an authentic experience. Food is great, scooter transport is sooooo Saigon, and the tour guides are genuine and knowledgeable..

A Must Do in Ho Chi Minh City! - We traveled to Vietnam for 10 days and this was one of the highlights of our trip.
We were collected from our hotel and taken on an adventure across HCM city, experiencing a number of different districts from the back of a scooter. The female drivers all spoke very good English and gave a great insight into life and culture in modern Vietnam.
The food was incredible and varied from the 'typical' street food we had experienced across Vietnam.
We would definitely recommend you try this!

Highlight of our trip - We did the city tour and it was Fabulous! The women who drove the scooters were fun and full of knowledge. The guide helps us understand the culture and history of a complex society.

Can't wait to do the foodie tour.

Highlight! Go Girls! - We had a 2 couple foodie motorbike tour in Saigon. Very professional, well organized and the drivers were not only competent and safe but also informative and attentive. It's a great way to see the city at night but also join the locals in their dinner without taking pot luck to find the right spot. Highly recommend it for a fun and real local experience.

WOW!! - From the moment I booked online, until we said our final farewells, the experience was professional, fun and eye opening.

I had never even been on a motorbike in my life (at age 53). Vy was caring and calming a let me know exactly what I need to do. Thank you - words cannot express how comfortable you made me feel. You made my night a truly memorable experience.

We met up at the first eating point and were introduced to our co travllers and enjoyed our first course - a noodle soup. It was then off on the bikes through the crazy Saigon traffic to Chinatown, where you did a brief drive through the local food market, then it was back across the river to a BBQ venue, where you get to try delights such as goat and frogs legs (all good). Another ride and stop at a fashionable new development, that back into local eating with your final courses of the night, including soups, sallops (YUMO) and the only thing I couldnt try - th Balut!

Then its a final farewell and a drop off back to your hotel. We also met some lovely travelers during the night. To top it off XO send you photos the very next day, so you dont need to worry about having a camera in your hand all night.

Thanks for a fabulous experience guys.

A best way to enjoy HCM evening life - It is wonderful trip for everyone who would like to enjoy sighseeing as well as eating streetfood in Ho Chi Minh city.
The tour is very good will beatiful ladies ( driver) and speaking English very good too. They will willing to introduce what you never find it in all over thet world just in Viet nam specially in streetfood.
Highly recommend you to enjoy this tour when have a change to visit HCM.

A great evening negotiating the crazy traffic in the city with our fabulous guides Trang and Ngow. - This is great fun from start to finish. The girls were brilliant, interesting, well informed and get around company. Myself and my wife had a blast and would recommend it to anyone, it's a great intro to the city and its huge scale.

You will se parts you normally wouldn't as a tourist, and riding through the chaotic traffic is a blast. Great fun.

XO, the best of the best. - Brilliant experience to be had in HCM. Riding a scooter/bike and eating and drinking is an memory for a lifetime.
From pick up to drop off, a great night had drinking and eating Vietnamese cuisine. And it's not all the usual stuff either. No banh mi or pho here. All local delicacies.
Warning! Do not eat anything beforehand. You will not finish this tour on an empty stomach! Food and drink will keep coming until you are full.
Would recommend to anyone visiting for the first time or even to repeat visitors to HCM.

A phenomenal motorbike tour led by amazing local women - an absolute must-do (Saigon by Night) - My partner and I went on the Saigon by Night tour and consider this an absolute must do!

From the moment of pick up by our amazingly friendly, funny, informative and simply wonderful drivers Loan 3 and Chau, we could tell we were in for an absolute treat of a tour.

This tour takes you on a whirlwind trip by motorbike through the streets of Saigon and to neighbourhoods you would not normally be able to reach easily.

We felt so safe throughout the trip as our drivers handled the streets and traffic with ease.

While on the streets, our fantastic drivers pointed out sights and shops of interest, chatted to us about all sorts of things, and engaged us in some super fun bike karaoke!

Along the way there is one food and one dessert stop where you eat like locals - these were absolutely fantastic.

Overall, we loved this tour so much and felt sad when it ended and we had to pass our helmets back, and say farewell to Loan and Chau.
We felt like in this short space of time we really connected with Saigon and two amazing locals.
We would really love to be able to relive this adventure for the first time again.

Incredibly highly recommended - just book it!!!

Cannot justify the price but the tour is good - My review of XO tours comes from the perspective of someone who has lived in Vietnam for a year. Two years ago I moved from Vietnam and this month I decided to take a holiday there. My boyfriend and I heard great reviews about XO Tours so we signed up. Our our guides, One and Phuong were great and honestly they are the reason my rating is as high as it is.
I will list the Pros and Cons of the tour according to my personal perspective:

PROS:
The two tour guides that we ended up with were fantastic. We could tell that they were two of the very special ones whose English was so good that their personalities could shine through (especially One).
One did a great job of explaining the food to us, chatting with us, and also leaving us to chat amongst ourselves when appropriate.
Also, One made sure that we had enough to eat and drink.

Food: Shrimp, Scallops, Beef, Bun Xeo, and aioli chili salt!

CONS:
The portion of the trip that was supposed to be a tour was lacking. The tour was supposed to give perspective on the different districts of Saigon. However, each time we stopped to learn something about the district, it was short, superficial and not meaningful. I thought that I would learn something significant about a district that I had never been to or did not spend much time in before, but I was mistaking.

I would suggest that the tour guide who delivers the information to the whole group give something more meaningful besides the price to live in a district or how many luxury cars there are. District 7 fell completely flat for me because of this. Also, Chinatown was a big disappointment as I knew there is so much culture there and how different D5 is from the other districts.

The food- the first stop for Bun Bo Hue was simply, not interesting. The food was bland and just not tasty. I would suggest they reconsider this as Saigon has so many spots with a delicious soup dish.
The second stop at the grill restaurant was a little better. The saving grace there was that we were able to try two dishes that some people may have never tried before. Still, why goat is on the menu is beyond me. the shrimp, beef, and even the frog were good.
The last stop for food in District 4 was a hit. We enjoyed this the most because of the life and the food was actually really nice. We were also able to try Duck embryo which is something that is as interesting as it is terrifying. I was grateful for the last stop to fill my belly. There we had crab, scallops, quail and desert.

Overall, the food portion of the tour seemed to strategically go from bad to good. The tour part of the tour, I guess will depend on your individual motorbike tour guide and what you actually want to get out of it.

I believe for an expat or someone familiar with Vietnam and its food, this tour is a bit overrated. For someone unfamiliar with it, I would definitely (highly) recommend it. The reason for this is simply the price point. Knowing the value of what we received, I cannot even come close to justifying the price even if the night did turn out well. It's simply not worth it. However, if money is no object, then the tour is for you!

Fantastic foodie tour - What a fun night and a fabulous way to experience the traffic of Ho Chi Minh first hand! The drivers were excellent, food delicious and the tour leader Sang the host with the most! Highly recommended!

perfect beginning of last day - Me and my friend got a personal tour of HCM in the morning that was just amazing. Driving from place to place through crazy traffic and getting interesting information about the city or a nice snack on the way. The drivers where fun and the guide great, I can really recommend it.

Highlight of my trip! - What an amazing time! I was a bit nervous at first, as I had no experience with scooters before, and the traffic in Saigon is crazy! But my guide picked me up from my accommodations and was an extremely safe driver, which put me at ease immediately -- I ended up loving the ride! The food stops were also great choices - you get to see a variety of districts in Saigon that you probably wouldn't have if you stuck to just District 1, where most of the tourist sites are. Absolutely loved the seafood, so fresh and interesting flavors. You also get the chance to try some more exotic flavors if you choose the foodie tour -- eg frog and balut. Very well-run tour, and loved my time with the group!

Highlight of the trip! - What an excellent way to spend my last night of my trip. If you don't have much time in HCM, or even if you do, this is an excellent way to be introduced to all that HCM has to offer. The food is excellent and the guides are lovely and knowledgeable about the city and how best to experience it. Our group wasn't ready to say goodbye at the end, so our guides were happy to drop us off at a good karaoke spot for us to continue our night from there! Highly recommend you include this as part of your itinerary.

A Must-Do Tour - A few of my colleagues and I were advised to take this trip. I was very nervous about trusting another driver with me on the back since I am a motorcycle rider in the states. Seeing the scooter traffic in Saigon made me ask myself was this a good idea. My colleague booked the Foody tour for the 3 of us. To add insult to injury I am alluding to shellfish and do not eat fish as a general rule.

The 3 girls picked us up from our hotel and introduced themselves and quickly went over a few simple rules. Keep in mind I am 6' (240lbs.) and my driver (Jane) was all of 4' 8” (maybe) 100lbs. She helped me don my helmet which fits my head like a teacup. After seeing this Jane assured me that she would fix this at our first stop.

As we took off I had the death grip on the rear grab bars with eyes the size of tea cup saucers.

When we arrived at the general meeting place where other riders (10 including us) all met to started with the first course of our food tour. Koi (sp?) introduced himself as our tour leader and politely asked if anyone had food allergies, which I let him know about. Out came a beef based soup with noodles and slices of beef. This was similar to Pho but 10 times better.

As we prepared to depart, I noticed we picked up 3 additional men that rode with us through the tour now known as the general for the rest of the tour. lol

My driver Jane was piloting our scooter all the while explaining fun facts and details about the architecture and other really cool stuff. As we continued to ride to our next stop, each explained before our departure by Koi, I began to understand that Jane knew what she was doing and my death grip slowly subsided and before I knew it I was riding with my hands on my knees and really soaking in the chance to move about the city like a native scooter driver. Jane consistently asked if I was doing ok to make sure I was not still petrified.

At each stop we all gathered to listen to Koi tell us about the district we were in, taking questions and showing his infectious smile. In the background security repositioned our scooters so they will be ready for our departure. If the stop included a course that involved any seafood Jane immediately ordered a special dish for me that I could eat so that I did not feel left out. When my beer got anywhere close to empty Jane anticipated it and promptly ordered me another..

I could go on and on writing this review, but I will close in saying the entire XO Tours team was beyond professional and accommodating. Each and every girl deserves a shout out as they all made our trip a social one. Koi (sorry for the spelling) was just amazing and always had a smile on his face. This is a must do tour and everyone in our group said what a great time they had.

Awesome job Jane, Koi and all the rest of the drivers and security team. You guys ROCK and I will recommend this tour to anyone that will listen. Thanks for making this trip to Vietnam the highlight of all my activities!!!

Mike
Houston, TX USA

Great Family Fun - We loved the tour of HCM with XO Tours.This is a 'must' for first-timers in Ho Chi Min, it gives you a sense of the city that you wouldn't get on foot. We wish we'd done the same thing in Hoi An. Our guides were fabulous: kind and informative and really good drivers! Our kids (7 & 11) are still talking about it months later! (The kids were safe on the bikes which meant I enjoyed it too!) Thanks for a great experience.

Serves more than 5 stars - The XO foodie tour was easily the highlight of our two week stay in Vietnam. From the moment we were collected at our hotel it was a professional, well organized and most of all FUN tour! We went to restaurants and tried food that without this tour we would never have discovered. Every meal was so unique and most of all delicious!! Being taken around a few different districts on the back of a bike was a unique experience. We were a little apprehensive at first but once we got going it was a blast. The girls are fantastic drivers and make us feel completely safe. Their knowledge of the area was so interesting and great to hear some local knowledge. An overall 10/10 experience!!

Great night out - Thanks for a fantastic tour. Food was amazing. Girls were knowledgable, thoughtful and great drivers. The rain did not deter them.
Would recommend OX to anyone.

Xo Food Tour Saigon - This was our first tour in Vietnam and it was a beauty. I was recovering from a stomach illness and this tour was still impressive. This tour not only shows you the best places to eat in saigon but shows you many districts around saigon and the tour guide speaks very good English. All the drivers are very safe and speak very clear English. They have a lot of information to tell you when you are driving from place to place. Highly rate this one for couples!

Exhilarating ride, excellent guides, delicious food - There's really no new information I have to share given the already excellent rating reviews here. Book and go. It's as simple as that! Huge thanks to Tien and Duyen for an amazing evening. Your steady, confident driving makes the ride feel like the thousands of other drivers were yielding to us. We appreciate all the stories you shared with us and for caring so much that we were having a good time. Thank you!

Best way to experience Saigon! - We had a great evening with XO tours. We went with family; our 6y old and her grandparents. We all loved it!
You feel a but worried at first as it is so busy in the city and looks chaotic, but seriously this was great fun, amazing food and a great way to see the city.
The girls are lovely and make you feel comfortable and looked after.

Thank you so much for such a memorable evening!

XO Tour - Saigon at night - What can I say? What an amazing and incredible experience I’ll never forget! Ive travelled a lot across the world and this has got to be one of the most thrilling tours ever!

I took the Saigon by night tour with my wife, daughter aged 6, and my wife’s parents (early 70s). Communication with the team to book the tour was extremely efficient & courteous.

Both my in laws were a bit nervous having already seen the crazy traffic in Saigon. But the moment the ladies arrived we all were relaxed!

We had such a brilliant time! From the moment we got onto the bikes, and the various stops and sights we saw, it was unforgettable! China town, luxury districts, districts where the Mafia used to operate, were just some of the stops. Wonderful short stop for dinner and then later for dessert, whilst all along seeing the city in a completely unique way!

The guides (led by Loc) were so friendly, incredibly knowledgeable and a lot of fun! Great sense of humour too, Loc!

We all fell in love with Saigon! The people, the sights, the smells, the sounds. And most definitely we will be back.

PS: If you can, also book the video option! A fantastic way to remember such an experience.

Foodie Tour - Probably the best tour my wife and I have ever done. Riding theough the traffic is an experience on its own. Felt safe the entire time. Our guide and riders were fantastic and fun. The food is not the standard Pho or spring rolls, every meal was delicious and there was more than enough. They are more than happy ro cater for any tastes or allergies. This is a must do tour if visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

Best family fun in ho chi minh - We had the most amazing time on the motorcycles with our 3, 5 and 7yo children. It was the best thing we did in our 5 week holiday. Thank you to Loc, Han and the other ladies who were so knowledgeable, warm and reassuring with us. We learnt so much and felt safe the entire time. The bikes stay very upright and move slowly in the thick traffic. There is zero road rage despite the traffic appearing quite chaotic. We did the tour day one and it vastly increased our confidence in venturing out and crossing roads in Vietnam. The staff are so kind and friendly, wonderful with our kids. I cannot rate this tour highly enough. It’s a MUST DO! We paid the extra US$40 to have an edited video of our trip which we love!

Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh! - A must do on your trip to Vietnam. Best way to see and experience the city from the back of a motorbike! The tour guides and drivers were so friendly and knowledgable, showing us parts of the city we would of missed otherwise. Food was delicious and the whole experience was so enjoyable! Would definitely book a tour with XO tours again if we ever come back to Vietnam!!

Foodie tour - not great food - The service, the scooter girls, the fun games & just overall warm hospitality and knowledge was excellent.

Visiting the different areas via the scooters was also a big highlight.

The food just didn’t do it for me. I didn’t eat all of my Bun Ho Hue & I wished I had as that was delicious. It was all down hill from there - the food was mediocre, and for what we paid I was surprised.

The dessert at the last stop was delicious.

I tried/requested a duck foetus, this came in tamarind and peanut sauce. This was the most adventurous part of the night and it kept on delivering the next day - serves me right!! Hahahaha

This tour is ok, I think maybe a but overpriced, but they emailed us some great pictures and we had a good laugh!

Best experience in HCM!! - This is one of the best experiences you can have in Ho Chi Minh. Seriously great fun, amazing food and a great way to see the city. The girls are very nice and make you feel very comfortable and looked after. The guide is also great, he shares some local insights which would be difficult to get elsewhere. The food they make you try is delicious - you would never find those places alone! Overall great experience, I have done it twice and would do it again without any hesitation!

Loved the experience - I really enjoyed this tour. We did a private Foodie Tour in the evening. I wouldn't say it's a typical foodie tour. I have done food tours all over the world and this one had the least amount of food stops. Instead of multiple bites, there are three stops with a good amount of food.

What I loved was the overall experience. Tien, Quan, and Duyen (probably messed up the spelling, sorry) were professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. I learned a lot just talking to my guide Duyen while riding the motorbike. Learning about how locals live and work was so eye-opening.

There were 2 sight-seeing stops. The district 7 stop was a quick stop to talk and I wish we could have walked around a little bit. The first sight-seeing stop we walked more.

I was nervous about riding a motorbike, but as others have said, the girls were great drivers and I felt safe. I don't recommend bringing a purse as it was a pain to deal with. A backpack or just things in your pockets are best.

Helmets and ponchos if it rains are provided. It was great to have pictures and video taken for us. It was all very well organized and a great experience.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - Had a great evening with xo tours and enjoyed the variety of Vietnamese food brought to us.
Everything was well organized and prepared ahead, my driver was the sweetest young lady and we had lots of laughs during the drive.
👍 5*

XO Experience - Unbelievable. we were met on time and immediately put at ease (those who have seen the driving in Saigon will understand). The staff were exceptional as was the food and the ambiance and educational experience.
Do not miss this once in a lifetime experience.

Too much fun and so much food - We enjoyed our XO Tour immensely. A few of the ladies in our group were nervous about the mopeds but the tour girls certainly put them at ease in a very short while.

Taken to the most amazing local food places, we enjoyed different types of meals. The guides were lovely and very knowledgeable, as well as plenty of fun. The video is a great reflection of the night.

Thankyou to all at XO Tours. We have already recommended you to friends.

XO Tours Saigon by Night - My father and I traveled with XO Tour Saigon by Night and we greatly enjoyed the experience. Our two drivers and Ming Lai were friendly, professional and informative about the Vietnamese culture of Saigon. I would greatly recommend them to travelers. Traveling the city by night on scooter, visiting the markets, dining on local cruisine and being able to ask any questions was an unforgettable time I will never forget. THANK YOU XO Tours.

Two tours with XO - They live up to their Lofty Rating - I took the Sights tour and the Foodie tour. Enjoyed both tremendously. This company lives up to the ratings they get. Guides and drivers are friendly and fun. Sent pictures promptly.

Can't imagine why anyone would pick another company for this type tour.

Great foody tour - This tour is a must in Saigon! My guide, Phong, is a lovely university student, an expert scooter driver, very fluent in English and just a hell of a lot of fun! Sang, the group leader was very proficient and interesting. We toured through 5 precincts, ate tremendous food and had a lot of fun! Thanks, XO, for a great time!

This is a must do foodie tour - The girls were amazing, really exciting to ride through the city at night, we felt very safe by the girls driving. They were really engaging and knowledgeable of the area. Great way to experience Saigon the food was amazing the places we visited tourists would never know about.

Best fun ever! - My family were told the foodie tour was a 'must do'. We were hesitant because it seemed quite expensive but we are so glad we went. It was the best fun ever. The girls were very attentive and full of interesting information. It really was as much of a sight seeing tour of all areas of the city that the tour bus doesn't go as much as a foodie tour. Food was delicious, riders were safe and all staff were very professional. It was up there with the highlights of our holiday for us. Do it!

Fast and Unique way to know Saigon - This is one of a kind tour that I have not experience elsewhere. A very good combination of history, sightseeing, food, drinks, and most importantly, local transportation: scooter. Highly recommended for people who want to experience Saigon in a fast and local way.

Absolute Highlight of our trip! - If there were 10 Stars we would give this an 11! This was undoubtedly the highlight of our trip. We decided at 12pm that we wanted to do the City Food tour and there was no problem at all to accommodate the 5 of us. We were really unsure with our 12yo daughter being on the back of the bike - but with the uniqueness of it being an all female driving tour was the best. They were so friendly, funny and interacted with each of us personally telling us all about HCMC. The food was great with different choices. Cannot rate this trip highly enough. Got to see at least 5 different Districts.

Amazing, One of a Kind Tour - Tour was absolutely fantastic! Both the guide and drivers are excellent, knowledgeable, and spend time getting to know everyone. We took the foodie tour and were delighted that they take you off the beaten track and away from the tourist scene. When it rained, they provided poncho's which added to the charm. Amazing food, awesome guides, and an incredibly well run tour. This was absolutely one of the highlights of our stay in Saigon! Highly recommended.

Just Brilliant!!! - My sons and I did the evening foodie tour. Being a little apprehensive about going on the back of a scooter our three young guides put us at ease and drove very safely around Ho Chi Minh city. It was an incredible way of seeing the city at night and tasting local food. I can not recommend this tour highly enough as it’s very well organised and very safe. Was a highlight of our trip.

Amazing experience - recommend - We book the foodie tour and it was absolutely fantastic. The guides pick you up with their mopeds at your hotel/Airbnb and drive you straight to the group where you’ll have 3 food pit stops and then in between some sightseeing of the different districts. We were staying in district 1 and so that allowed us to see way more of the city being on mopeds. We had bun bo hue as the first dish at a local restaurant on a tiny street, then bbq and finally finished with some seafood. The guides were very careful driving and it was such a nice experience driving around the town amongst the other moped drivers! The guides were friendly and made sure we were having the best time. We learnt about the culture through the discovery of new dishes. Highly recommend.

One of a kind experience! - If there were 10 stars rating, I would rated 10. I was recommended the Foodie tour by my dear local friends and it was an unforgettable experience. This activity is a must do while you're in Saigon, a tour that brings you to places non-touristy, giving you chances to try outs Saigon's specialty yet exotic. A night ride with the girls were exciting all through-out the tour, exploring the cities on motorbike, going through Ho Chi Minh's insane traffics was one hell of fun and excitement. My tour leader was "Mr. Khoi", I was in luck to have him as our tour leader, a very kind gentleman, very wise, very engaging and very helpful. Thank you so much for giving us the best time ever!

Night Food Tour To Beat All Tours - I had been recommended to take this food tour with XO and I was not sorry. I travel quite a bit through Asia for work and leisure and this tour was so well organized and executed. The food was amazing, I learned so much about the city and it was so much FUN! The guides are so knowledgable and the whole night was incredible from beginning to end. This is going to be a tough night to beat! Well done Xo!!

The best! - My first ever time on a bike.
We did the night foodie tour and it did not disappoint. I highly recommend this tour. We had the greatest time ate some interesting things and saw more of the city than I would have seen alone. It was safe and it was fun and it’s a fantastic way to see Ho Chi Minh

Day tour - Xo tours are great, a must do while in saigon, what stands out is the service each tour guide was kind, engaging, and our family felt welcomed by these great people. Riding on a scooter is alot of fun, the history lessons were informative and interesting even my teenage son put down his phone, what a plus. I strongly recommend this company!!!👍😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😁😗

Great city sights tour - My husband and I had a great city tour with XO tour service. They brought us to places with great stories of the city Saigon. Our tour leader Sang was a good story teller and help us to understand more about the city. Our bike drivers Ting and Fu were driving carefully the entire trip, it was very comfortable and safe riding the scooter in the city. We had a really good time with them :) Would be definitely book another tour with them next time visiting Ho Chi Minh City! ❤️👍

The Most Awesome Night Tour of Saigon - We did the foodie 3 hour night tour of Saigon & we absolutely all loved this tour!!!
Everything about this tour was amazing. The ladies were awesome, we all felt very safe riding the streets on the back of their bikes. We had 10 of us in our group and all of the ladies were fantastic with everyone in our group. Would have no problems recommending this tour for anyone of any age.

See the parts of Saigon you'd otherwise miss! - The Foodie Tour by XO Tours was a great way to learn about parts of the city from a local's perspective. My driver Hong joked and taught me about each district as she drove our motorbike through the sea of others in Ho Chi Minh City.

Our host and tour leader Loc was friendly and set an a fun, upbeat atmosphere at each stop that we made along the way. We enjoyed countless local dishes and beers, and had each food described prior to eating.

We took this tour our first night in the city, and it was the perfect way to be shown a bit of what is in Ho Chi Minh City for the remainder of our stay. I would book this tour again in a heartbeat! Can't say enough good things about it.

Don’t leave HCMC without doing this tour! - Such a fun filled evening on the XO foodie tour. Our guides Mai and Nhung we’re such awesome girls, felt like we had made new friends for life, they were great scooter drivers too we felt very safe at all times. The food was all super interesting and delicious - we got to try lots of weird and wonderful things and we got to see different walks of life in HCMC. Highly recommend this tour, Don’t leave the City without doing it - you’ll miss out on an A-Class experience. Wish we had more time to do more with XO.

No 1 on so many levels - XO food tour was recommended by a work colleague and it is an excellent choice because it is a professional company with great communication and very personal service, catering to our individual needs such as providing vegetarian food as well as the meat and seafood barbecue. The intelligent, confident female drivers were prompt and great tour guides adding extra insights to the history of the city. Sang the tour leader, is an amazing host, remembering everyone’s name and introducing us to each other, explaining the courses, taking photos and sending them to us on our return. In particular, they made a very special effort to cook alternatives for me as a vegetarian which I appreciated. The beauty of this tour especially on the first night is being immersed in the culture of the city immediately and while riding through the streets on the scooter was out of my comfort zone it was exhilarating and the whole experience was a night to remember thanks to Sang and his excellent team. An exciting way to meet people and see the city with safe drivers and delicious cuisine. Thank you Sang.

Do it! - What an awesome tour! Picked up from our hotel right on time by two wonderful & friendly young ladies. A quick safety brief and off we went 😊 Food was delicious and the girls explained what to eat it with and I really enjoyed the 2 non food stops where we were told about the different districts of the city, places you’d probably never venture to. All done with great humour and smiles, and a few little surprises! Highly recommend 👍

Great night out! - We were collected by our girls, shown how to get on and off the bikes and the rules Fr the night. We had five stops in five districts, three to eat and two to sightsee. What a great array of food we had from soup to bbq goat, prawns, beef, scallops, crab and a couple of surprise dishes! The girls were so fun and interesting and the other guides full of knowledge. This was a great way to learn about the fabulous destination of HCMC.

OMG COULD NOT WIPE THE SMILE FROM OUR FACES!!! - Wow - just WOW - this was definitely one of the highlights of our families trip to Vietnam! The ladies were just awesome - we all felt completely safe - what an amazing way to see Saigon! The food we had was just YUMMY!! The ladies were so much fun and really looked after us! The kids had the BEST time! Definitely a MUST DO if you visit Saigon!!!

Fabulous way to see the real Saigon! - We found out about this tour by word of mouth and were at first a little apprehensive riding bikes through the chaos of the streets and traffic. But what an experience it was. The girls were wonderful drivers and never once were we nervous in the traffic. It just flows. Lots of personal experiences were exchanged and we were able to get a picture of the rich diversity this city has. Would have to say that if you do only one thing in HCMC, do this! You won't be disappointed!

Awesome tour - Loved scooting through the traffic on the back of a scooter with an excellent guide getting a feel for HCMC. The good is excellent and all at places most tourists wouldn’t go to. Highly recommend.

WOW!!! Fantastic tour!!! - Well, I read some of the reviews here and must agree with all of them. This was the highlight of our ten days in Vietnam. My wife and I (50 +) made the reservation 24 hr in advance. Hoa and Hang, our drivers, were at time in the hotel and they drove us along the caotic Saigon which such a confidence that we couldn't feel more comfortable. They spoke a perfect English and were very very nice! Sang, the team leader was waiting for us in each station with explanations and pictures on his tablet. The street food was superb. This is A MUST do tour in Saigon!!

Best thing to do in Ho Chi Minh city - My husband and I went on the night food tour, it was the highlight of our 3 week trip in Vietnam 🇻🇳 absolutely professional trustworthy and lots of fun! The team really take care of you and know their city and it’s food.

Awesome Saigon tour - Couldn’t recommend this tour highly enough . Everything from start to finish was handled professionally. The xo girls were so sweet and explained all the major sights and were really great drivers . Bao was also an excellent tour guide. The Saigon night tour took us to places we definitely wouldn’t have gone ourselves . Would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to explore Saigon

Best food tour by far - What an amazing experience. Driven around the city by young girls. Felt safe all the time. Stopped at 3 locations that were local restaurants and there was time to eat and enjoy the meals and even ask for more if we were hungry. The food was amazing so tasty and fresh. The girls explained the food and what to mix it with they were all polite and friendly. It was recommend to us and we will recommend to our friends. They drive around many districts explaining the difference

Unforgettable experience for all the right reasons - I cannot recommend the XO night foodie tour enough. We went last night and it was absolutely fantastic. Our food drivers (Trang, Ann, Duden, Ngoc - please excuse my spelling) were simply wonderful. My husband and I are travelling around Vietnam with our 15 year and 12 year old sons. They arrived at our hotel on time, gave a safety talk and then we were off to the first stop where we met the other 4 people who were coming with us. I won’t spoil the surprise by saying what we ate except to say that at every stop the food was delicious. All four of us tried every course and devoured most of them. One or two local delicacies were interesting but given there were 11 courses we were absolutely full by the end of it. They take you to places that there was no way we would have found or seen on our own. There are 3 food stops and two additional sight seeing stops. Ming the tour guide is informative, funny and helpful. The four girls who drove the bikes are confident safe drivers who all had a great sense of humour. They were wonderful with our boys and made the night so memorable. I have been travelling for many years and without a doubt this is one of my all time favourite tours. I would highly recommend it to anyone coming to Ho Chi Minh. Go early in your stay as they also give you many recommendations for your time in Ho Chi Minh.

Super city tour - We had a wonderful tour of beautiful Saigon today with the amazing girls and leader from XO.
Everyone in the family was a little nervous to insert ourselves into the manic traffic of Ho Chi Minh City but after the first few sights we were loving it. This is the only way to feel like you are part of the city. It felt safe, it was so much fun and the girls were all, BRILLIANT!! Can’t recommend it enough.

Fantastic Siagon by Night Tour! Fun, excting, loved every minite - I was a very nervous passenger to begin with, but my driver put me at ease straight away, I felt safe even on the very busy highways and the tour was fun from beginning to end. I loved seeing so many different areas of Saigon, listening to our tour guide explain the history of each district we visited and eating/trying lots of different food. The girls were all very safe drivers, friendly and fun and together the XO team made this the best night of our holiday. A huge thank you to all the XO team, and especially to my driver for making my night perfect x

Exceeded my expectations by FAR!! - This tour and the team were so very incredible. I could not imagine a better way to spend my time in Vietnam. Their professional, friendly, funny, and warm demeanor made this a lasting memory. Meticulous care was taken to maximize deliciousness and safety. I even made friends!!! I’m so grateful there was room on the trip for me. I will recommend this tour to EVERY friend without hesitation. Thank you again!

Loved it! - We did the Saigon by night tour and it was one of my favourite things in Saigon. The girls are all excellent and safe drivers. The customer service is exceptional. The food was great. Overall an amazing experience! It’s a must do if visiting Saigon.
Great tour - was excellent, great food good tour guides, great experience for sure if in the area, would book before hand

XO Foodie Tour - Oh wow loved this tour....highly recommend. Felt very safe and our riders all stayed with us during the eating part and explained the food and chatted. The service felt very personal. While on the back of bikes getting around we were very safe both with the driver as well as the areas. At all times there were 3 security men on bikes around our riders. Some of the food we didn’t try but we did try most of the food (and the beers kept coming). Highly recommend this tour.

Fantastic! - We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and loved the food that was served and introduced. The scooters were very stable and the drivers were excellent. Never once felt unsafe or uncomfortable. The girls are lovely and their English is fantastic!

Great foodie tour in HCMC - Had a very good tour with my bike mate Julia in Saigon on the scooter during rush hour! Never felt unsafe altough the traffic is crazy. We had 12 very delicious dishes and enough to drink. Pearl, my lady driver, had a lot of knowledge about the food, people and the city. The tour leader Loc Truong did also a very good job. It is not cheap, but it is real value for money! I would recommend this tour to everybody.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - This experience was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The girls and Tein were gracious hosts and provided invaluable insights into living in HCMC/Vietnam. We felt completely safe on the scooters and loved the opportunity to experience the sights and smells at night of the city. The food was divine with too much to eat, beers cold and the girls were great fun. A most enjoyable night and highly recommended tour.

Amazing! - If there's only one thing you do in HCMC - it has to be the XO Foodie Tour. My partner and I were advised to do this by friends from Australia who had also done it. So glad we took the advice. Great fun, wonderful chaperones and amazing food.

The most AMAZING FOODIE Tour - Thank u so much Tein you were the most special guide and looked after us so very well. The experience was a high light of our trip to Vietnam!!!!!
Highly recommend......

Brilliant! - Cannot fault the 'Foodie' tour! Girls were fabulous with so much knowledge and just great fun to be around. The food was delicious and so much of it! The drinks were flowing, we certainly didn't leave the tour feeling hungry or thirsty. Loved touring around on the back of the bike and at all times felt super safe. Will certainly recommend XO Tour to all of our family and friends.
The best - Awesome way to get around HCMC. The tour guide was very knowledgeable. The food was amazing. The motorbike ride was like out of this world. You must do this if in Vietnam.

Great way to see Saigon - Although we were initially a little apprehensive to go on the foodie night tour it was a fantastic night that few by. The ladies and crew are very professional and fun. We loved everything about this tour, well worth doing.

City Sites Private Tour - What an Experience! Fantastic! Definitely recommend, best way to see the city sites on the back of a scooter. Took us to places we would never go on our own - Tour Guide was so knowledgeable and told us so many facts about Saigon that we didn't know - our drivers Loan and Nhi were fantastic and very capable drivers and put us at ease to enjoy this fantastic experience.

This is a ‘must do’ experience! - My family and I just got back from a morning ‘Sights’ tour with the XO girls! It was some of the best money we’ve ever spent!

The drivers are so warm and friendly and they take you to so many fascinating places. When you arrive at each location, a tour leader is waiting to show you around and give you valuable information. Our tour leader was Loc and he was funny and friendly.

Driving through the streets of Saigon on the back of a motorbike is an experience we will never forget. The traffic is crazy, but our amazing drivers made it look so easy!

The entire experience was magic and one that I cannot recommended highly enough. It was hard to say goodbye to Loc and the girls because in under 4 hours we had all become fast friends.

Moped magic - We were just in Saigon for one day, and our morning tour was perfect for seeing this crazy, bustling city. The girls were excellent drivers, ferrying us from location to location and chatting in perfect English as they negotiated the manic traffic. A guide met us at each stop to fill us in on the history, etc. Highly recommended

Fantastic! - What a fantastic night riding the streets of Saigon with the girls from XO Tours. We booked a private tour for five of us and Tour Leader Tien and the other lovely ladies made it their personal mission to ensure we had a fabulous evening. Starting off in District 1, through to China Town to walk the wet market then a super stop for bbq goat, prawns and beef cooked at our table by the girls who couldn’t be more attentive and informative. Moving on to District 2 we had a glimpse of how the other (richer) half lived (yes, cleaner, quieter) then back to reality to District 4 where we had seafood galore......scallops, crab, clams and delicious options for the non-seafood lovers. What a great night - the girls were just wonderful and their skill at negotiating those crazy Saigon streets amazing. Highly recommend taking this night tour and would definitely take other tours with them when next in Vietnam. Thanks ladies!

Best tour in Saigon - My father and I went on the Foodies Night Tour and it was an absolute blast! The girls are great drivers have excellent English and are an absolute riot. We were sad to have the tour end it really was that much fun. My Dad is 70 I just wanted to throw that out there as there may be people thinking they are too old for this type of tour. IMO that is complete nonsense and Dad hasn't stopped talking about it. Definately one of the highlights of our tour. Thanks XO

Highly Recommend Personal night tour of Saigon - This was recommended to us and we are so glad we did the tour. It was a bit wet but it just made it a bit more fun. The girls were absolute fabulous hosts and knowledgeable giving us a great memory of our trip to Vietnam. Thanks! 10 out of 10

"Sights" Tour--Exceptional - We only had one day in HCMC so we thought a motor bike tour would be a great way to make the most of it. My friend and I were completely blown away by the experience we had on our "Sights Tour." Two of the XO drivers--Vy and Nhung--came to our hostel to pick us up, and then took us to the Post Office to meet with the larger group. We had a main tour guide, Khoi, in addition to the personal drivers for each person in the tour group. I've never seen a set-up like this before, and it was absolutely phenomenal. At each stop, we had a small discussion with Khoi about the site and then we walked around with our drivers, chatting and sharing like we've been friends forever. The staff is so fun and so well-informed. We as a group had really meaningful discussions about life in HCMC and how it's complicated history informs life today. This was a 20/10 experience and I really hope you have the opportunity to take advantage. I cannot recommend XO Tours enough. Thank you again, Nhung, Vy, and Khoi!

Foodie Tour at Night - I did the Foodie Tour in Saigon and it was great! The drivers and the tour leader spoke very good english and they were very kind and liked to explain everything. I travelled a lot through asia and this was the best tour I ever had. Cannot recommend this enough! Thank you so much :)

Foodie Tour - Must do in HCMC! - The Foodie tour from XO tours was the best one we’ve ever done. The ladies who drive you around are so friendly and knowledgeable, not to mention experts on their motorbikes. It’s an incredible way to see the city, especially areas you likely wouldn’t go.

The food we tried was also fantastic (and so much of it). You can try as much as you’d like, and your beers/drinks are never empty.

You also get a couple sightseeing stops along the way, and ponchos in case if rains. It rained on us but that made the experience even more memorable.

Great trip for families, Tour guides are Great! Well worth the money! - We were a family of 4 traveling with our 4 year old daughter and 8 year old son. I read a review about XO tours and how this was a good option as a tour with kids. I wasn't sure how my daughter would ride with me or how my son would ride on his own (if he would be nervous). The guides Loc, Linh, Linh and Nhu were extremely attentive, really friendly and their English was great, my kids absolutely loved the ladies and they kept them occupied with their own experience while Loc talked to us about the sites we were visiting. The information Loc provided us about the history and the sites was probably the best on our whole trip. Very informational, historical and not just the highlighted basics. He knew his stuff. It was an action packed few hours and we saw and experienced a lot. The guides were great safe drivers and it was my kids favorite memory of HCMC. What a great way to see what HCMC has to offer. Between fruit tastings, dessert tastings, sugarcane juice and local market tours in addition to city highlights, if we had had more time I would have probably given them a go on a different tour or seen about extending a tour for longer if that was an option. If I am ever in HCMC again I would most definitely book another tour with them and I have already recommended them to others. This tour really is great for ALL ages. I cannot recommend them enough. You will not be disappointed.

Best way to spend an evening - This is a tour you just have to do. We were met at our hotel by 3 lovely guides. Each spoke excellent English and were very friendly treating us as long lost friends. We had decided to go with the video option so once the cameraman arrived we were off. Anyone who has travelled through Asia know how chaotic the traffic can be , well our experienced guides had full control of their scooters and were totally in control as we made our way zipping through the traffic. After a stop at the night markets we headed trough a few more districts and stopped to have dinner. We learnt a bit about our guides before heading off to a couple of other districts. After visiting some more sights we headed back to our hotel where we said farewell to our guides as they rode off into the night. Had heaps of fun. Very comfortable. We felt we were in safe hands the entire time. Totally recommend it to anyone

XO foody tour 7/9/18 - Our travel agent recommended this tour and it lived up to every expectation. The girls are great fun and the food was completely different to the usual tourist meals. It’s not for the faint-hearted whizzing through HCMC on the back of a motorbike, but the girls are exceptional riders so never in danger. The owner was with us and he provided interesting insights to the food and the city. This was of the best tourist tours I have ever been on.

Simply fantastic evening, experiencing the local side of Ho Chi Min and enjoying great food. - Our guides for the evening were, Phuong, Phoung2, Nhu and Trang. They could not have been more attentive, considerate and fun to be with if they had tried. From the start our evening was a full on experience. Leaving out hotel and heading into the crazy traffic, we quickly became comfortable and we all felt very safe with our drivers. We made many stops throughout the evening, on a couple of occasions to meet up with the group leader Khoi, who provide information on the various districts we were visiting and background to what the next food stop would involve. Each time we stopped for food the girls joined us and provide information on how it should be eaten, which spice, which herb etc. The tour was also very attentive to special eating needs taking care if people had allergies or were not open to trying certain foods. Without doubt this tour is worth doing and we for sure would not hesitate to do this again. It was a super fun experience. Already the next day we received a link to download photo’s taken by th XO team throughout the evening. If you are worried about riding on the back of a bike - don’t. Two of the four of us had never done this before. It was not an issue and the girls made us feel very comfortable and safe.

Everyone should do the Foodie Tour - Brilliant tour. Covers a huge area of Saigon over 5 hours, delicious food, interesting stops, very informative, knowledgeable and skilled drivers. This business supports young women to work in tourism. Support them. Worth every penny

Best tour ever! - This tour was awesome. The ladies are super confident riding us around in the incredible traffic. The food was fantastic and the whole experience was just great. This is a Must Do tour when in Ho Chi Minh.

Must do whilst in HCM, highlight of our trip - We attended the foodie evening tour. From start to end it was excellent. The ladies who drove us around were chatty and knowledgable with excellent English and the food was tasty and varied. We were so full at the end!! We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend, a real highlight.

Amazing views of the city with these guys !! - Hey this was an amazing tour with some awesome girls !! they really made the night special and showed off their incredible knowledge and skill when getting us around the city at night !! we did the Saigon by night as we don't eat to much and it was amazing !! the places you see and what you learn are unforgettable !!
Fully recommend this company and all they do !!

Really worth it - My boyfriend and I booked the foodie tour for the first day of our trip through Vietnam. We generally don’t love tours and prefer DIY-style travel, but this is totally worth it and we absolutely wouldn’t have seen as much of HCMC or tried the variety of food if we tried to do it alone. The drivers were great, the food was great and plentiful, and we just overall had a really good time. Booked the private tour and we’re glad to have done so.

X0 foodie and sightseeing tours - We recently visited Vietnam and did both the foodie tour and sightseeing tour with xo tours. Can’t recommend them highly enough, it is a must do on your Ho Chi Minh itinerary.

Absolutely Fabulous - This was the best tour and had been recommended to us by a friend - sooooo glad we decided to follow their lead - would totally suggest you have a go - this company had all the necessary insurances and they were fabulous hosts - Nhung Le was spot on with her driving and very attentive - they took us to some great little haunts and gave us a running commentary all along the way - local information - history etc as Molly says - do yourself a favour..don't miss it.....

Ho Chi Minh by Night tour - A Must Do - This was one of the highlights of our trip. We were in Ho Chi Minh for ten days and my only regret is not doing this sooner as we done it towards the end of our trip.
Our drivers were so lovely and very safe, I was wary of the bikes as the traffic is mental here but they make you feel so safe. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting.

Great Tour - We are friends in the age group 55-65 and absolutely loved this tour. The girls driving the motor bikes are so friendly and nice. They put us all at ease as we haven’t been on motor bikes before and the traffic in Ho Chi Minh is crazy. It was one of the highlights of our trip and would highly recommend it for all ages.

A pleasant surprise! - Let me be honest, I only went on this tour because of my husband.
Being a foodie that he is, he never fails to try the food tour of every city we go to and Saigon was no exception.
On the day, we were picked up by 2 tiny ladies on motorbike. I had my doubts but boy, they were really skillful handling the chaotic traffic.
They were also extremely fluent in English, very knowledgeable and chatty! The night turned out to be more than what I expected. In fact, it was the highlight of my trip in Saigon. Very fun and they were serving yummy food. I would recommend this tour to anyone looking for a bit of excitement during their trip in Saigon. I absolutely love the bike ride!

What a fabulous start to our Vietnam holiday!! - I’d read the excellent reviews before we booked but the trip far exceeded our expectations. We spent an exciting 4 hours weaving our way through the Saigon traffic with some wonderful girls and a great guide. Our 2 kids (8 & 9) absolutely loved it and felt completely safe on the back of the bikes. If there is one thing you do whilst in Vietnam, it MUST be this!

Awesome heaps of such a great way to see Siagon - Really well organised, girls really chatty and knowledgeable.
Traffic was insane and they handled this with no issues with a 100 plus Kg guy sitting on the back.

Do it every time you visit Saigon - I do an XO tour within in the first 24 hours every time I visit Saigon. It is an awesome way to immerse yourself in the city and experience the sights and sounds all while sitting on the back of a scooter piloted by an experienced and safe rider. I have taken several groups of friends, family and work colleagues on the tour and all of them have loved the experience. My favourite tour is the Saigon by Night. You see heaps of different districts, you sample food, you get a great narrative from your guides and, it is a really affordable price. Loved it as much this time as I have every time before!

So Much Fun - Our tour with the girls was so much fun!To be on a bike,in the crazy Ho Chi Minh traffic was not something we'd imagined doing but the girls were wonderful,and we felt confident and safe. We saw so much and learnt about districts outside our District 1 bubble. As we rode along, the girls were interesting, funny and entertaining. The market visit, dinner and dessert stops were fabulous. We consider this a 'must do'!

This was amazing, best way to start our time in Saigon. - I’m about 100 kg so getting on the back of a scooter with a little lady driving is not something I was sure about, but all the riders were amazing, so confident, so informative, and just a great fun trip for three hours.
