It included local food, the richest and the poorest areas plus local markets with all sorts of live and dead things.
We all reckoned we had the best lady riders, so thanks Anh1, New, V, Linh, Lamb you all rocked.

Amazing foodie tour! - My partner and I had the most amazing time on the “Foodie Tour”. The girls driving us were amazing. They made us feel safe from the get go. Everyone involved in the tour made us feel very welcome and their English was really good. Was great to see Ho Chi Minh like a local and eat like a local. Doesn’t matter if you are a fussy eater (as my partner is) they will go out of their way to accommodate you and swap dishes for something else. Would highly recommend to anyone travelling to Ho Chi Minh!

Best foodie tour ever! - This night was sooo much fun and full of laughs, the girls are fantastic drivers and you feel so safe, you get to see so much of the city and it’s night life, cannot thank (forgive my spelling) nhum and lam enough for making our night so great! Food was amazing and really got to taste things we normally wouldn’t have tried and I’m not usually adventurous with food but there was plenty to eat and great flavours. The tour leader had great energy and really friendly and full of information.

XO Tour - What a brilliant night, this had to be one of the highlights of my Vietnam adventure. My rider was absolutely fantastic. She was an expert around the crazy traffic and I didn't feel at all unsafe with her. Our tour leader Bao was great making sure everything was ready for us when we got there. Can't speak highly enough of this tour, a must do, well done XO tours

Best fun and so glad we did it - We were nervous before our XO Foodie tour despite reading all the reviews. The traffic in HCMC is crazy and the scooters and bikes look perilous. But our wonderful drivers had our confidence in minutes - and we are two women in our 60s so it’s been a long time since we have been on the back of a bike.
The experience of eating like a local does was great. So was the included beer. And the girls and our guide Loc were such good hosts. We would love to have done the daytime city tour as well. Next time.....
If you are contemplating a tour - don’t hesitate. Just do it.

Had a fun night out - We enjoyed the tour. Did the 3 hour night tour which was plenty for us. Food was sufficient- went home full. Enjoyed the interaction with the drivers. All were friendly, funny and very caring. The markets were crazy busy and we went to places we wouldn’t have otherwise ventured to. Would recommend.

Great introduction to vietnam - We jumped abord this tour at the end of our first day in Vietnam. A great way to get introduced to the city and be able to have all the questions one has in a new city, answered by a local. Trying all the food broke down some barriers and left us in good stead for the rest of our journey.
The girls were fantastic, fun, and being on the back of a little 110cc scooter was not a problem at all

Great Final Night - This was a fantastic tour to do on our final night in Vietnam. The highlight for me was spending time with my driver (Loan) and talking about Saigon and her life. She was so gorgeous, and enthusiastic to chat as we wove our way through the crazy Saigon traffic. I felt completely safe with her excellent driving skills. Our tour guide Loc was also a fantastic wealth of in formation, as well as a great sense of humour. So interesting to see so many different 'districts' of the city, and all the pulsing night time activity.

Absolutely brilliant - We did 2 xo tours on the day, a sights tour and a foodie tour. Being on the back of the bikes is a great way to experience the hectic traffic in Saigon. The girls are awesome. Very friendly, very good drivers. The guides met us at varying locations and were very informative. Great to also see security is provided for the girls. The foodie tour was awesome. We ate things we never thought we'd eat, but all was safe and tasted great. I had a taste of the foetus egg, and it was prepared quite nicely. Ate the lot and could've gone another. A wonderful experience, if you're thinking about it, don't hesitate.

Highlight of our travels - The foodie tour was just incredible - we had an absolute blast with so much laughter. The team from XO are so much fun and exceptional at what they do. The adventures around Saigon were enlightening and the food was another level of deliciousness. A special shout out to Mai and Luang who were our drivers/guides, you ladies are just awesome! Can’t recommend the foodie tour with XO highly enough, it certainly was THE highlight of our travels through Vietnam.

Foodie Tour - Absolutely fantastic, we cannot recommend this tour highly enough. We got to see so many sights of Saigon on the back of bikes by night along with enjoying amazing local food specialties. The 4 girls, Linh, Ann, Née and Hung who accompanied us on the tour were so knowledgable and so entertaining. They gave us many laughs throughout the evening and we all felt like we had been friends for years. A must do for any visit to Saigon.

Thanks for a fantastic evening - We went as a couple for the evening food tour and both said this was the highlight of our visit to Saigon. Loc was a great enthusiastic host and our guides Chau and Nguyen looked after us so well and made it great fun and interesting.

We really enjoyed seeing different parts of the city, trying many delicious dishes and being driven around by the girls. Thanks for a great evening!
Great way to see Ho Chi Minh city at night - Thank you so much to xo team for your Good hosting. I recommend this trip for who come to Ho Chi Minh city first time

FOODIE TOUR - It was such a good experience. I could see and eat all I wanted to in Ho Chi Minh City. Riding on bike feels so cool. Literally cool. Thank you for everything. Specially to Mui and Trang. You guys are the best!! 푸디투어 추천해요^^ 1군지역은 관광으로 쉽게 갈수 있지만 4,5,6,7 등 구역 곳곳을 함께 돌면서 실제 현지인이 아니면 접하기 힘든 로컬푸드와 문화를 경험!

Excellent food accompanied by excellent guide - I booked the “Foodie” tour with them because riding on back of motorcycles being driven by someone wearing an ao dai seemed exciting. And indeed it was. It was by far the best thing I did in Ho Chi Minh. The guides were very friendly, very knowledgable and we had some lovely conversations. We got to see a lot of the city by night and experience it’s crazy traffic. The food we tasted was great and you will get to try things you’ve probably never eaten before (no spoilers). All in all, the experience was worth the money (although it is a bit expensive).

Foodie Tour Ho Chi Minh - Outstanding!!! What an amazing group of people giving us an amazing experience. The food was to die for. The company was some of the best around. Thanks girls, and Loc. There will be a next time. Conrad

Must Do Sightseeing Tour - This is a must do first day in Ho Chi Minh. Guides are fantastic with amazing city and history knowledge. Very good English and very friendly. The girls are fantastic and I felt very safe in the kaotic traffic. Can not fault this tour as it gave us a great feel for the city. We saw everything this amazing city has to offer including sites captured in photos of the last hours of the war.
Would do the XO city tour again and cannot recommend it highly enough.

We also did the night foodie tour with XO and again cannot fault it in any way. Girls are again amazing and very knowledgeable. A chance to try some unusual local cuisine if you would like but certainly no pressure if you choose not to like me.
Do both definitely as both are highlights of a trip to Ho Chi Minh.

Food tour not to be missed - Despite the tropical storm delaying us by thirty minutes and the rain continuing we were provided with ponchos and set off to our first stop to eat pho. Our drivers Vee and Phong made us feel at ease and gave us confidence in their driving amongst the chaos. Sang, the owner met us at different sites along the route and gave us interesting background information about the city. The different foods we tasted were excellent. Overall the tour was a wonderful experience and lots of fun.

We will be back for more! - This was the highlight of our holiday .
Sang was awesome with his explanation of the history of the parts of town we visited .
The girls were amazing with the scooter skills and making us feel part of the crazy city of Saigon .

A+++

Not the usual tour - See Saigon from the back of a motorcycle, with stops for food that's local, and different, than what you'll usually find. We chose a private tour - a guide, 3 drivers (one for each of us), 5 stops including the Chinatown market and three different styles of cooking. The guides were all fun, informative and made sure we were well-fed and comfortable. Rush-hour traffic in Saigon is as crazy as you can imagine, but drivers aren't aggressive and it flows, safely, at a good pace.

Insightful - After a city tour with another company the day before was a disaster (where the guide was anti-American taking three of us around for a private tour), XO was recommended by my niece and turned our thoughts around about HCMC. We are a 50+ couple and felt safe on the scooters -- the drivers were careful, tour leads informative and together they really turned our time in Saigon around.

Great night out on XO Food Tour! - Myself and my friend booked on last minute to this tour - wow! It was everything I hoped for and more.

The girls who ride bikes are much more than chaperones. They constantly talk to you in fluent English whilst riding pointing out the different hot spots along the way. This really helped me get a feel for the city.

Also I want to point out - for those who are apprehensive or worried about riding on the back of a scooter, you really have little need for worry. The girls are excellent drivers and go very steady and sensibly. I felt 100% safe at all times. They also provide a helmet etc before setting off.

I can’t forget to add how amazing the food was also ! In addition our host Loc did an excellent job of integrating our group so we were all friendly and chatting to each other from the off.

Whilst the trip is a little pricier than others in Saigon - it’s definitely worth the premium. Would definitely recommend!

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh - I did the Saigon by Night tour a few nights ago. It was a great way to see parts of the city that a tourist might not think to go to. My driver (Hang) was excellent: her English was perfect and she did a great job of explaining the different areas of the city that we visited. She also handled the scooter like a pro: despite the hectic traffic in Ho Chi Minh, I felt safe the entire time. Our guide Bao was also excellent, explaining what everyday life is like for the Vietnamese and the various ways life is changing over time. Finally we also visited some street food markets and the food was delicious! Highly recommend doing at least one of their tours if you visit Ho Chi Minh.

Sights of Saigon tour - Had high expectations after seeing all the excellent reviews and ratings.
THIS TOUR DEFINITELY LIVED UP TO MY EXPECTATIONS!
We travelled with a toddler and friends who also had 2 toddlers, and not only was the sights of Saigon tour extremely well presented by the very knowledgeable and friendly Tai (our tour manager), but the XO girls were excellent with the children and made all of us feel safe and confident on their scooters. The kids absolutely loved zooming around on the scooters, and we all thoroughly enjoyed learning about interesting landmarks and historical points in Saigon.
We unfortunately had 3 friends cancel on the day of the tour due to illness, and the service and management in handling this issue was so professional. Excellent company - from customer service, to the drivers, and tour guide! So 5/5 highly recommend when visiting Vietnam!

Stunning - Saigon by Night..... what a brilliant experience.l for the four of us- 2 adults and a 13 and an 11 year old.
The girls, led by Nhung, took us to parts of Saigon that we wouldn’t have seen. From start to finish it was exciting and the sites memorable. They were very friendly, knowledgeable, and great company. Anyone going to Saigon should do this trip.

Great night out in Saigon - XO tours was about a lot more than food, it was a step into the real Ho Chi Minh City. Our tour guides were all fantastic, especially Sang who had an encyclopedic knowledge of the city. Highly recommended tour!

A great evening out in Saigon - My friends booked this tour for me, and being a rider of many years I was initially a bit dubious. However it turned out to be a pleasant, well rounded experience. Great food in many styles, great conversation and information while experiencing relaxed views from different parts of the city from the back of the bike. I am a big guy and was a bit worried my rider wouldn't be able to control the scooter, but she handled it superbly. My rider could also answer any questions I put to her, about how people live and their culture, religion, perceptions of others and the 'war', ..anything. Well worth it.

Highlight of our time in Vietnam - I would highly recommend this tour. It's a great way to see Ho Chi Minh and try authentic Vietnamese food (the scallops were my favourite). The drivers were safe, they provided us with lots of interesting facts along the way but mostly they were great craic. We had so much fun and didn't want it to end. Sang, our tour guide met us at various spots along the way and gave us a brief history of each area. He also made sure to take loads of photos which were emailed to us the next day. Don't miss out!

A great fun way to experience the city! - Riding on the back of scooters is a great way to see wider Ho Chi Minh City! The guides are hilarious and we felt very safe. The food was plentiful and delicious. Would recommend this for sure!

A great way to see the city. - A fabulous evening with attentive drivers and hosts. I would recommend the tour by night as you see parts of the City that tourists would not normally go to. Despite the traffic being crazy the drivers were very safe.

Amazing experience - Had a great time on this tour - possibly our favorite activity when we were in Vietnam. Guides were friendly and good fun. Food was excellent and it was nice that they had some stops where you learned about the various areas of Saigon. Highly recommend.

Fun experience! Delicious food! - Did this with my mom. Was so fun! They picked us up at our hotel & we met up with the group at location 1. Great variety of food you probably wouldn't think to order yourself off a menu. Girls were super nice, great English, and because of the way the route works, you will probably see a lot more of HCMC than you would if you just explored on foot! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! We did it in the rain & it was still great--they provided ponchos & none of my clothes got wet!

An awesome way to see Saigon. - So much fun, can't say a bad word about it.

My girlfriend and I did the private sites tour and felt very safe on the back of the bikes driven by Tien and Nhung.

Each stop of the tour was very educational and we learned about all the major attractions of Ho Chi Min through the eyes of true locals.

The guides were fantastic. Very entertaining and knowledgeable.

If anyone is visiting Saigon and wants to see the city like the locals do, this is an absolute must.

Our food tour - We had a brilliant time with Ting and her team. We are a family of 2 adults and 2 boys ages 10 and 7 and we all had an excellent time. The time flew by and we got to eat in restaurants with the locals and see areas outside District 1. We got to try food we wouldn't have tried on our own. Weirdly we felt completely safe with her and it was an exhilarating experience to see HCM from the back of the bike and experience it with all 5 senses. My son has a sesame allergy and we don't eat pork but this was not an issue. The biggest asset of the tour are the ladies themselves who make a big effort to make it entertaining and educational.

Nice Girls - Wow Very beautiful and friendly Girls for you riding with moto bike to city riding. If you have enough money with time= you get nice friendship and companion.Enjoy the different experience.

Highly Recommended - My husband, 2 y/o son and myself all had such a blast on this fun-filled tour of HCMC! We brought along a harness for my son to wear for the tour, but found we were so comfortable on the scooters, that it we only used it for the first bit of the tour..
Our drivers were always reassuring and checking that we felt at ease, which was so lovely.
I can’t speak more highly of this tour.
We would highly recommend this tour to any who are looking for a great way to explore HCMC!

Best food tour in HCMC - We looked around for alot of different food tours and came across this one! Best tour we could have asked for. We went to five districts and tried about 13 different foods like bbq, soups, frog, goat and lots of seafood!! The motorbike ride around the districts is amazing on it's own and the drivers were very good and knowledgeable! Highly recommend if you want to get as much in as possible! They also took photos throughout the night which was nice cause you get very caught up in the food and fun activities.

Best scooter ride ever!!! - Omg! Mind was blown!! I did a lot of tours while I was in Vietnam with my partner but going on the scooter ride around Ho Chi Minh City was just best thing we did the whole time! I would highly recommend a scooter ride and definitely with the XO your girls. The girls, Ling and Han, arrived right on time. They were just brilliant. I was so nervous but they calmed me down. They were really funny. It was like we were catching up with friends. They really made me feel at ease. They then gave us a safety briefing and what would we be doing for the night. We started off and the girls went really slow for us. Once they knew we were confident they started going at the normal speed. We were taken to China town first. It was great being able to go there because we normally wouldn’t go there. The girls were quite happy to explain everything and show us around the markets. They arranged dinner, including making sure it was gluten free for me. We continued on riding until we got to our next destination to eat dinner. It was again in a local eatery. The food was amazing. The girls sat down with us and ate dinner with us. It honestly was like hanging out with our mates. The girls were really funny. They were ever teaching us the language. We continued on to a few more places, finally stopping for dessert in another location we would never have gone to. It was great feeling the vibe of the city and eating the local food. Again the girls sat with us and explained everything. We were then returned to our hotel...we were really disappointed that ride had ended. We wanted to keep going. The girls made us feel so welcomed and safe. At no stage did I feel scared on the back of the scooter. I would def recommend this company to everyone. If you’re considering scooter ride, go with this comany.

So much fun! - I was in HCM on business and had very little free time. This was the best thing I could've done! It was so fun riding around the city on the scooters, I felt safer on the scooters than I did walking around. It was amazing to see the controlled chaos and be in the middle of it. My driver was so lovely & I enjoyed talking to her about her culture. The food was amazing also. I did try the duck embyo just to say I did it, but I cant say I would eat it again. Highly recommended - dont miss this tour!!

Don't Miss This - When you first arrive in Saigon you think, 'How do the motor cyclists survive?' When you do the XO Foodies Tour, you become one, right in the thick of it. It's brilliant; the girls are great hosts, great motor cyclists, look after their piles and augment the food experience with knowledgeable commentary. An outstanding experience, Do it before political correctness catches up with Saigon and we're banned from motor bikes and the girls become boys.

Best tour of Ho Chi Minh - We stayed in Ho Chi Minh for one week. XO Tour was the best tour of the week, the drivers are excellent and very careful, the tour is interesting and took to many interesting places outside the traditional touristic ones. You can't miss this tour!!

My favorite evening in Vietnam! - This is an amazing way to see the city, taste unique foods that you may not try in your own and get into neighborhoods like you would likely not end up in otherwise. You have your guide with you through out and they are so fun to talk to and ask any questions you may have. This is a giant operation with servers, spotters and your drivers. So worth the money!

Best thing we did in Saigon - The girls and tour manager were excellent, they made the 4 hrs fly by, traveling by scooters into the markets and different districts was awesome, you get to try the local food and beer, you also get to go to where must tourist do'nt go. They also have a security person who travels with you and the girls are very good riders

A fantastic way to experience the diversity and hospitality of Ho Chi Minh - I had a wonderful evening with the team from XO. We had a very small group, and the range of locations to visit and the knowledge of the tour party was second to none. This was a highlight of my visit to the city. The contrast between the different districts was fascinating, and the experience, sights sounds and smells of rocketing around the city on the back of a vespa was brilliant.
A must do if you want to experience a non-touristy dash around the night-time of HCM

Best tour in Saigon! - Had the best time last night doing the 'Foodie Tour' around Saigon. So much good food, beers, good company and laughter. If you're traveling solo also, these guys will make you feel right at home.
Best food tour I've ever done - hands down.
Cheers guys for an excellent night!

HCMC Night Foodie Tour - Soooo much fun & there is some amazing food! Got to see a side of HCMC we would never have seen or experienced if we had tried to do this ourselves. A great insight and taste into local HCMC life and eats. The XO girls are all super professional and a lot of fun. Definitely a must do in HCMC and one of the best things we did

Amazing experience, highly recommend - Polite, courteous, smart lady young drivers take you to 5 districts on motorbikes. Excellent way to see the city areas where tourists wouldn't venture. So much fun!

A must-do tour when in HCMC - Had friends recommend this food tour, so glad we did it because we had a great time and we were so full by the end of it.
Would definitely do this again when next in HCMC

Must do family fun! - We did the tour as a family of 4, with kids aged 10 & 8. Our 8yr old daughter was nervous before we started. Within a minute of commencing the tour, she was completely at ease. All 4 of our drivers were incredibly professional and very accommodating. Our guide, Tai was very knowledgeable and had exceptional English. Touring the city on the back of a bike gave us a genuine insight into the everyday exciting but hectic (for tourists) way of life. We loved it and would absolutely recommend XO tours for those with families or individuals. Can't wait to go back and do the foodies tour!
See you again

Excellent city tour. We didn't want it to end! - We had just a day and a half IN Saigon so thought this tour would be the perfect way to see the city in a fun and relatively short time frame. We would highly recommend the tour to anyone. We traveled with two children aged 7 and 9 and we're extremely well looked after from start to finish. The girls were friendly and knowledgeable, excellent safe drivers and the guides who showed us the sights at each stop went the extra mile to provide an informative and enjoyable experience. Despite the traffic being crazy we had complete confidence in the abilities our our drivers, who expertly negotiated the busy roads. We would highly recommend this tour to others.

Saigon by night on the back of a scooter - What a great way to round off our time in Saigon! Having traveled round Vietnam we were a little apprehensive of casting ourselves out in the traffic but the xo tours concept was exactly what we needed and both of our teens thought this was the highlight of the trip. 4 drivers in their Ao Dai costumers and 4 slightly apprehensive Europeans ... we needn't have worried. We were at ease from the first intersection and the only regrets were that we couldn't have continued for an extra couple of hours. We had a couple of food stops and saw 3 or 4 districts we would never otherwise have visited. Our drivers were knowledgeable and we were chatting away non stop so that 3 hours flew by...
Highly recommend this tour and next time we will do the food one. They are also in Hoi An.

Great fun - We traveled as a family with 2 teenage daughters, so it seemed like a good idea to do the Sights tour which took in a lot of the major tourist sights of the city, but did so in a short (ish) time-frame. The other consideration was the all-female riders, as we have 2 daughters.
The young ladies were very good as guides and excellent drivers at negotiating the crazy streets of HCMC. At each venue, we met with a young male guide who spoke excellent English and who explained the significance of each venue extremely well, being very happy to engage in conversation rather than simply roll out pre-rehearsed information. The 3 and a half hours exceeded our expectations and we were also treated to various snacks and drinks as we went along. It is amazing fun zipping around the streets on the back of a scooter, driven by a local! Highly recommended.

A fun way to see Saigon!! - We took this tour on our last night in Vietnam. We had been traveling in Vietnam and Cambodia for 3 1/2 weeks and we wanted to end the trip right. And, we did! This tour was so much fun. Our family of 5 (2 adults and 3 children ages 15, 14 and 12) had a blast. The food was so good and we actually mostly ate things we hadn't tried yet - even with all of our eating. The best part was all of the time on the scooters getting to see so much of the city. I would call this a city AND food tour! The guides are wonderful and sweet and knowledgeable. We just loved it and would highly recommend this tour!

Best way to spend my last night in Vietnam! - My partner and I did the foodie tour and, whilst I'm not the most adventurous eater, I surprised and enjoyed myself (with a little cheeky encouragement from our tour manager Tai!) by trying almost everything. It was a great group with lots of laughs throughout the evening and being on the back of a motorbike is a really fun way to see the city. My driver Anh was awesome and I really enjoyed chatting along the way, there was good banter and she was very knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend an XO Tour to anyone and everyone visiting HCMC/Saigon!

Incredible Food Tour!!! - Do not miss this! This food tour of Saigon takes place on scooters and your driver will be a pretty young Vietnamese woman. A tour guide and security also comes along to each stop. The service was incredibly professional. The restaurants that we visited were awesome and crowded, and we were usually the only foreigners present. There is simply no way we could have found such delicious and local food on our own. Our drivers and guide spoke fluent English. Riding around on scooters throughout Saigon was thrilling but our drivers were very skilled. Conversation with them was super fun.

Amazing experience - highly recommended! - I was reminiscing over our fantastic photos of our Foodie Tour by Night with XO and realised I had forgotten to write my review! This tour was the highlight of our visit to Saigon earlier this year. The ladies are incredible drivers and highly competent - my family (including two teenagers), felt completely safe and looked after. We were able to see so many parts of the city which we would never have ventured into ourselves and the food choices were amazing! The ladies were always courteous, friendly and very informative. They made us laugh and relax. They were so flexible and helpful with my husband who had difficulty sitting on the bike, yet he was able to get through the entire night comfortably with their help. I also paid extra to have a video taken of our tour - it was superb! And they threw in lots of still photos as well. It was a memorable night. Give it a go. You will not regret it.

Night tour - My family and I (husband and 3 kids aged 15, 13 and 9 years) only had one night in Ho Chi Minh and were recommended this tour as a fast way of seeing the sights, and it did not disappoint!
We had a fabulous time, our drivers were all so competent, friendly and knowledgeable, and even though the streets could feel quite hair-raising, we felt completely safe in their hands at all times.
Such a unique experience, and one that none of us will forget, I would strongly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon.

Amazing shopping tour - My aunty and I had a fabulous time on the shopping XO tour. The tour manager Tai and the girls Nhung and Tu made sure we had a great time. They guaranteed our safety at all times and not once did we feel unsafe.I would recommend this tour to anyone who loves shopping and wants a little bit of a thrill.

the great way to understand HCMC traffic and Vietnamese food habits - We did the Foodie Tour by night in Ho Chi Minh City and it was a great beginning of our stay in town! Very professional service, including vegetarian food options, very nice Team. somehow they make it "safe", in HCMC way :-) we recommend this company and Tour

What a blast! - r holidays in Vietnam. It was an absolute blast to get on the back of the scooters and experience Saigon traffic at its finest. It actually works better than it looks when you're trying to cross the street. Amazing food in authentic local eateries with great company from our lovely Vietnamese hosts.

What a Night! - We did the foodie tour by night in Ho Chi Minh City and it was a highlight of our holiday.
From the time we were picked up from our hotel till we were dropped off, Tien and the girls made us feel really comfortable, as we were all a bit nervous about driving around the city on the motorbikes. Food was great and the experience of driving around the city, being part of the millions of motorbikes on the streets was exhilarating.
Great way to see the different districts of the city as well. You will not be disappointed by this tour!

Street food tour - Hoa, Nihn & Tai were so friendly, professional and great fun😁. My wife was disenchanted as she had never been on a motorbike before but the girls were so professional and drove so carefully and Hoa even allowed her to cling on tightly all night 😁 thanks Hoa! It was a great experience and the girls shared so much information about their and lifestyle. Food & drink very abundant and a great variety. Book this tour - Liam & Tina Ireland

Special Night - We had a special night (group of 7) ridding around the city with the amazing girls and tour leader at XO last night. Couldn't think of a better way to experience Siagon and the food was amazing. The service and knowledge of the guides/leader was first class. This tour is a must do for those wanting to see the real Siagon and those that want to eat where the locals eat. Amazing night and I'd do it all again if I get the chance. Thank you so much XO

Great night activity - We did the Saigon by night tour and it was excellent. Thien was our guide and she was awesome! This is a great way to see parts of the city we wouldn't have on our own and really experience local non-tourist districts. Highly recommend if you like exploring alternative parts of town and want to meet locals.

An exhilarating experience - I haven't experienced a more exhilarating tour than this. Shooting around the streets of Saigon tasting some amazing food. The tour across 5 districts gives you an amazing insight into the city and the people. As well, you enjoy some of the most exciting dishes and eat with the locals. One not to miss. Thanks Ming and team!

What a Blast - “best part of my holiday”. - I booked the XO Foodie Tour in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh) by myself, after my wife and neice chose the daytime shopping tour.

I was picked up at the nominated time from the front of my hotel by Nhu - my driver for the night.

I thought the standard supplied helmet may be a little small, so I asked in advance about a large sized helmet - no issues, - provided and it fit perfectly.

I was taken to a local eatery to meet the other participants for the nights tour, along with tour leader Khoi. I easily fitted in with other group members so don’t hesitate to do this tour if you are on your own.

Food was great, experience was great, but best thing was being in the middle of the city traffic on the back of a motorbike with thousands of other locals. The sights, the sounds, and the sensation of riding through the streets of Saigon on a warm night.

Nhu was awesome - a safe rider, very sociable, excellent English, very knowledgeable, very attentive and always with a smile on her face. We constantly talked throughout the night at the stops and whilst riding - we learnt a lot about each other’s culture.

This experience would have to be the best of my holiday, and at all times I felt safe and in awe to experience Saigon on a motorbike.

The food type, quality and amount was just right, along with cleansing local beers - all part of the tour. Soup, beef, goat, shrimp, crab, clams were on the menu along with some exciting delicacies and deserts. The tour was well organised and timed.

Food, sightseeing and an education about Saigon combined in one event - win, win, win.

If you are looking for an awesome memorable experience, definitely give this a go. You will not be disappointed.

Thanks again Nhu.
Thanks XO Tours.

Don’t miss this tour - I was adamant that I was not getting on a bike in Ho Chi Minh city. But then I crossed the rd a few times and it wasn’t nearly as scary as I thought it would be. So we did the morning sights tour with XO.

Don’t miss this! The girls are great riders and the guides so friendly and knowledgeable. Next time we are in HCMC we will do the night food tour with these guys. They send you photos and provide a coffee and water. And a dessert stop at a local market. We rode through flower markets and went to a beautiful temple. And the stories about the war and some o d the history surrounding key events and media is worth it alone. It’s great to hear it from the local perspective.

I’m 50 and had a bandaged hand and am a bit overweight. No problem. Had zero safety concerns. Thanks guys. We will be back !!!!

Amazing night, must do - Highly recommend this tour. Great night out from start to finish, drives and tours guides were amazing. All very friendly, informative and made us feel very safe. Our drivers were very fun and made it a really good night. Must do!

Great way to taste the foods the real locals eat - I was recommended the XO foodie tour by a work colleague before I came to Ho Chi Minh for business and I'm glad I made the time to fit it into my short route. The drivers were excellent tour guides and accomplished scooter drivers and I was at ease breezing along through Ho Chi Minh on the back of the scooter even in rush hour.

The foods were all delicious - meats, veggies, seafoods and a few deserts. With a few nice local beers and even a shot of banana rice wine to wash things down it was a great evening. The menus were tailored to individual preferences for those in the group who didn't like specific items, and all the tour guides ensured we all had a fantastic trip.

I can't recommend this tour enough!

Street food - I did this tour as part of a group and enjoyed the experience of being on a bike weaving through the traffic that appeared to have few rules... but strangley works! The staff were knowledgeable and gave a great insight to the district's we were in or heading to, a little long though in my opinion as after the first dish of a lemongrass broth with noodles and beef which is to die for, I was hankering for more but found myself listening to a repetitive speel only to be outdone by my groaning stomach. In saying that once we were off again my excitement grew, salivating in anticipation of the next dish..... but was let down by the bbq goat & grilled okra, flavor was saved by the accompanying sauce which I must say became my go to sauce for the remaining dishes served there. The whole frog was absolutely delicious and the highlight of the night for me, I just wish there was more of it. The crispy skin reminded me of grilled salmon skin which the group were politely watching to see who would eat the last bit. I wasnt so forgiving and devoured the last bit! Our tour to the expat district was interesting and showed the investment into the area...very much like walking around home but again my mind kept wandering on where's the next dish. We ventured into the gangster district and are very happy to have a couple of bodyguards keeping watch over the group. I love how they organized this...felt much more at ease. The seafood was divine! Scallops,crab...fresh,beautifully cooked and with amazing sauces!!
I wish I could give this 5 stars as our guides were so cool!!especially my one, her personality was so hospitable and made this tour for me!! But found some of the stops to explain where we are and going to was a wee bit long and I was still hungry at the end...could be my samoan appetite.
Look in saying this I still think there guys are great, the rest of the group were very impressive, our tour guides of girls were so good!!plus we got a little momento to remind us of the XO tour... I may have been just looking for a different street food experience
Fantastic authentic tour - Had an absolute blast and tried some amazing foods. Was a truly authentic tour and we got to see an amazing side of Ho Chi Minh City!

Fantastic Experience - We did the "Saigon by night" tour and it was a great way to get around and see the different districts of Saigon. My driver was Lin and she was great. 5 minutes into the trip it poured with rain, they had ponchos for us to wear and the rain just added to the evenings experience. The food stops were good too. We would highly recommend this tour - thank you!

Perfect Introduction to Ho Chi Minh City - Just returned from a two week trip throughout Thailand & Vietnam and can honestly say the Foodie Tour with XO Tours was a highlight of my trip. The guides & leaders were amazing, the food was awesome, and it was much more than just a food tour - they zoomed us around Ho Chi Minh giving us a tour of the city filled with incredible insight that you won't get anywhere else. It was a perfect introduction to the city & Vietnam as a whole!!!

This is a MUST - We were recommended this tour by a few people. The common thread was you won't be disappointed & boy everyone was so right. This is a well organized guided food / beer tour of Saigon by night. The girls are amazing so knowledgeable & beyond skilful on the bikes - we were so lucky to have Trang & Mai to guide us. Morning our tour guide was fab as well. We were taken to places that we would never had visited. Thank you Trang & Mai for your company

Great food & a great night on a Scooter in Saigon - I spent the night in Saigon on a scooter with XO Tours. My Scooter companion was Nghi and she made me feel so at ease on the scooter with her excellent riding skills that I forgot how many scooters there are on Saigon streets. The food was genuine local Vietnamese cuisine which I greatly enjoyed and from which I had no ill affects. I also enjoyed several local beers as part of the tour. All in all it was a fantastic night so if you are a little unsure take the plunge and just do it. Go with XO tours as the girl riders are great.

Really Fun Way to See Saigon - I did the Saigon by night tour. Zooming round Saigon on the back of a bike at night was so much fun. I still don't know how people drive in that madness, but felt perfectly safe on the bike. Really interesting to see parts of the city that tourists wouldn't normally see and nice stop for dinner. Everyone involved was really nice, the ladies driving the bikes and the tour manager. One of my favourite parts of my trip to Vietnam, thoroughly recommended.

Super Fun Foodie Tour - We had a blast on this tour. The ladies are so friendly and happy to chat to you.

Weaving through HCMC traffic is exciting but we always felt completely safe.

We stopped at three different food places and the food was amazing at each of them. Make sure you come hungry.

They had no trouble catering for my vegan daughter.

GREAT! - The best thing we did in HCM City. The tour was perfect. Friendly drivers and staff, great sights and good food. You must do this! Do not be afraid of the traffic, it is much safer than it looks

Simply wonderful! - We did both the sights and foodie tour with XO Tours. I can't recommend this company highly enough. My two boys 8 and 11 loved the experience of zipping through the HCMC traffic on the back of the scooters. We all felt 100% safe at all times. Loc was our tour guide for both tours and we were truly wonderful. He managed to make the history informative and interesting keeping both us the adults and the kids entertained - not an easy feat!!
The girls really were incredible - friendly, warm and funny - we all fell in love with them especially our two boys who I'm sure will remember this experience for a lifetime.

Foodie tour for 3 adults - The XO Foodie tour is fantastic!! Not only is it well planned, the drivers are lovely and the food is scrumptious. Great way to get a different view of the city and authentic food! Would do for the scooter tour alone!! MUST by in Ho Chi Minh

Foodie tour - Must do in Ho Chi Minh. Lots of fun riding through the streets of many districts on the back of scooters with amazing food throughout. Drivers were just delightful and amazing at navigating the traffic

Excellent Experience - My daughter and I had an extremely excellent experience with the XO tour group. The girls were fun, friendly and informative and we felt safe throughout the entire experience. We had a great time and gained new knowledge. They even surprised us with a birthday cake for my daughter. We highly recommend the Saigon by Night experience to anyone.

Foodie Tour - Before I flew to Vietnam, a work colleague highly recommended going on XO's Foodie Tour. I am so grateful that I listened to her and had this an amazing experience. Booking online is very quick and easy, with terrific communication. The girls really know their way around the districts of Saigon and take extremely good care of you. The amount and variety of foods was hugely. I even ordered the video as a memento of all the foods I tried, and my bravery riding on the back of a motorbike! Thank you XO Tours.

Young Family Foodie Trip.... awesome - We were in Saigon with the evening free so I asked about this tour for my young family during lunch and within minutes the tour was organized. My wife initially was quite reticent to go on this tour. Our children are 5 and 9 and she was worried about the safety of the motorbikes for our children. By the end of the tour, our family had had an incredibly enjoyable night and we and the children were so glad we had come.

Tai, Tam and the rest of the lovely drivers and the security (yes they have a couple of their people driving around the group to ensure safety) were all amazing and went out of their way to ensure we had a safe and enjoyable tour. For families looking at booking this trip but who are worried about their kids....

Food: Tai asked as to our food preferences and we mentioned that our children don't like seafood or spicy foods. The first stop was at a Bun Bo Hue restaurant and I must admit this was some of the best Bun Bo Hue I've ever had, and I've had a LOT. During this stop Tai (the GM of the group who came on our tour) had a friendly chat to our children as to what their favorite dishes. During the course of the trip, most of these dishes amazingly appeared for the children and by the end of the tour they were absolutely stuffed.

Motorbikes: Obviously their is alwasy a degree of danger using any motor vehicle. However, we all felt absolutely safe during the entirity of trip. Our drivers were wonderful and patient...... and within 5 minutes of riding out my 5 year old son was asking me to buy motorbike once we got home so I could drive him around!! The children absolutely loved the ride.

If you're thinking about doing the tour, do it, you won't regret it. The team is utterly professional and goes beyond the call of duty to look after your safety and comfort. We also chose for the video option which I think is a brilliant idea.

Thank you very much Tai and Ladies, see you next time we're in Saigon :)

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh City! - We absolutely loved our tour. I did it with my daughters age 9 and 6 and felt completely safe and secure. The guides and drivers were all great and the food exotic and delicious. Would recommend to all

CO Food Tour - This is an absolute must when visiting Ho Chi Minh city. The girls guide you around on the food tour on scooters. They are incredibly skilled at negotiating their way through the manic traffic. I can understand if you havent been on the back of a scooter the thought of it could be quite daunting especially in the city. Just trust the girls because believe me they know what they are doing.

Exciting, Informative and Tasty - What a wonderful night we had. This is an absolute must if you visit HCMC. I was petrified to get on a motorbike in this busy city with its crazy drivers, however my guide Huong was a master rider and I was not scared at all.

Each rider is female and they speak perfect English. We joined a group of 10 others tourists and visited 3 food stops and two information/tourist stops.

The main guide Tai was very knowledgeable about Vietnam and the different districts.

We tried some delicious food and and saw some wonderful sights.

Thank you girls for a memorable night.

Highlight of my trip - My friend and I went on the foodie tour and it exceeded my already high expectations. The food of course was absolutely delicious, but what really made this tour great was our drivers/guides. Such a fun group of young women who really took time to get to know us while safely driving us around the city. This was the highlight of my time in HCMC and honestly one of the best experiences I've had while traveling! Thank you!

Saigon by Night - Brilliant! - My daughter (12) and I had an amazing time zipping around the streets of Saigon. Early nerves were quickly forgotten by the awesome fun the girls provided. Saw many parts of Saigon we never would have got to. Had a fabulous BBQ dinner and interesting dessert. Just one of the best tours ever. Will probably do another in Hoi An , when we get there. Thank you Nhung and Ngan!
5 Stars !!! 😁

Great for kids. - We had two very nervous kids (10 & 13) going on this tour but the ladies were excellent at encouraging them and within minutes they loved it. Was a fantastic way to see parts of Saigon you would never get to otherwise. Absolutely loved it- went on to do Hoi An tour as well.

Great fun! - We had a fantastic time with the ladies touring HCMC. It was our first look at the city as we flew in late the night before and what a way to start the trip then on the back of a scooter zipping around. It's crazy the traffic but it all seams to just work and not scary at all. Guide was very knowledgeable and the ladies were really lovely and fun! Would highly recommend. Thank you

Absolutely exciting, very well organized. Highly recommend - Fabulous experience! A female in my mid 60's, having never been on the back of a motor scooter before, I felt completely safe in the hands of my lovely rider. The food tour was amazing. A great experience that I can highly recommend.

World's best - Visiting Saigon and not experiencing this tour by XO would be a disservice to yourself. Beautiful, energetic, knowledgeable, and fun best describe the tour hosts. We saw parts of Saigon we defiantly wouldn't have otherwise, we ate food we wouldn't have tried otherwise. I can't overstate the pure joy of the Food and Drink Tour. XO Tour: my hats' off to you for taking the customer service experience to a new level. Thank you.

A fantastic tour!!! - The tour was awesome!! Extremely well organized and the service was the best I have ever experienced !!! Mum can't speak English, she was paired with the Rider that can speak Mandarin as well as Cantonese. Mum has such a great time!! For my little girl, special treats along the way. She wanted to do it again the very next day. Highly recommended for those who want a taste of the real Vietnam!!

Charming, cheerful, cultural and fantastic! - My wife and I were referred to XO tours as one fo the safest and most pleasant moped tour operators in the city. The trip allowed us to see the city, meet the locals and enjoy the culture while being very well fed and entertained throughout the process. I highly recommend the trip to anyone who is willing to move beyond the high street and sample the untarnished delights of Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Our group included groups, couples and parents with young children. We all had an excellent time.

Brilliant - Amazing, fun, interesting tour. Agree with everyone else's comments. Guides beautiful, food great and as i don't eat seafood the food available to me was excellent. Informative and definitely worth doing. It rained and this was part of the fun. The amount of food is considerable and no way you can get through everything so pace yourself.

Great Fun with these knowledgeable and very safe drivers! - We did two of XO Tours and would recommend to all when in HCMC. They were also great fun to be around and made the tours interesting as well as a great memorable experience!

Best way to see Saigon - We booked a tour with another family with young children. Absolutely the best way to see Saigon, and the food was brilliant. Our guides were personable, friendly and full of information, and we never felt uncomfortable in the crazy Saigon traffic. Would do again in a heartbeat. If you do anything in Saigon, you must do this.

Great loss - I was traveling alone and this was a great way to engage with others and experience other parts of Saigon that I would not have seen otherwise. Also good introduction to traveling on a motorcycle! I wasn't (so) scared of it anymore afterwards:)

Holiday Highlight! - Our family of five, aged 11 to 53, took a foodie tour and absolutely loved it.

I booked a personal group tour, because I thought my 11yo may be a little worried about being on the back of the bike - and I was right! But her tour guide was kind and convincing, helping her get on the bike on the basis that she tried one short ride to the first food stop and then if she didn't want to do it we would stop the tour. After realizing that she was in safe hands, she took the rest of the tour and never looked back.

We flew across Ho Chi Minh amid the traffic and all felt very comfortable and like we were part of the city. After the trip, my 11yo lost a lot of her fear of the traffic - it was a great way to get to know the flow of the city.

We loved the food, the tour guides were so informative, spoke beautiful English, made great conversation with us and taught us a lot about life in Vietnam for young people and families.

I cannot recommend this highly enough - we all agreed it was a highlight of our two weeks in Vietnam, noted there was hardly a lowlight in the entire trip!

Best experience in Ho Chi Minh! - We were told about this tour through a friend who highly recommended, we had the best time! We were a group of 4 adults and 2 teenage girls, we felt completely safe the whole time, the girls driving are so experienced and very safe and friendly. We all absolutely loved it! The food was amazing, we saw things we would never have seen if we didn't do it and experienced the real Saigon! Thank you so much XO tours!!

Simply a MUST DO , amazing tour for all ages! - We are a family of 5. I was worried about our children (12, 11 & 9) on the scooters. But i didn't need to be. The ladies were cautious and considerate & our children loved it & I felt relaxed. We were all in great hands!!! The tour itself, was incredible. We were not only stuff full of food (and challenging....) but also we learned so much about Vietnam. We went places we, as tourists, would find by ourselves. I 100% recommend this tour, it's simply a MUST DO!

Local areas, away from the busy touristy places - This is real good. I saw this tour from a Taiwan variety show, SuperTaste, that was filmed in 2015.

Anthony Bourdain would be proud! - I'm a travel videographer by trade and so I wind up on a fair amount of tours, and I can safely say that this is one of the best I've done. There's a wide variety of traditional foods that are not so well-known in Western culture (like a lemongrass noodle soup that ohmigod shutup it's so good and so much better than pho) plus a bunch of more eye-popping ones -- frog legs, balut, barbecued goat breast simmered in Coca-Cola -- and you should go and you should eat them ALL because it's all so good.

Excellent 'The Foodie' tour, but not really a food tour, ways to improve - My review of The Foodie tour will be in 2 parts.
First, why I think it's an excellent tour that deserves its reputation.
Then, why I give only 4* and what I think could be improved.

As a hospitality business owner myself, with my partner, we have oriented (and still do) many of our customers to XO's food tour, and to a couple of "rival" food tours, so that they can make their own final choice. We've heard only good things about The Foodie tour until now, really. Asians, Americans, Europeans, they all liked it.
We're well placed to know that whatever you do to satisfy customers, up to perfection (and ~95% of excellent reviews out of almost 5,000 is an accomplishment), they're always eternal (nasty) grumpies who will complain and find that it didn't cater to their own needs, it was too expensive, etc.
When they represent only a tiny minority, they don't deserve much attention. And I found the way XO's owner replied to them (the 1-2-3* reviews) very well structured and argued.
It's a guarantee of seriousness, in my opinion.
When you'll embark on this tour, you'll do an evening oval circuit on scooter - Districts 1-5-6-8-7-4-1.
It's sound and gives exposure to different districts that, indeed, tourists will never get on their own, even less if they stay for 2-3 days.
Although I still find the tour a bit pricey for what it really is, people should be aware that it takes a lot of upstream work and coordination to deliver a smooth flawless 4.5h experience combining driving and eating. Significantly more work than low quality tours with poor English spoken, unpleasant surprises at any time, and generating some stress.
It has a price to feel completely safe and be able to fully enjoy your experience. It's not to be taken for granted.
If, as the owner claims, most of the 75$ goes to the salaries of the young ladies, carefully driving you through the city and preparing your food, good, and you should be happy to help make their lives better. They more than want to learn and develop themselves in contact with other cultures.
Where else in the world will you be driven by young charming, well-educated ladies to explore a city and discover culinary specialties? In very few places, actually.

So, if you want to SAFELY experience "real" local life of Vietnamese people in HCMC, which often entails driving motorbike for extended time and occasionally entails eating BBQ meat and/or seafood in extremely lively environments, plus if you want to try some bizarre food (the famous duck embryo), you should definitely enroll in this tour.
As a tourist, you could hardly do it on your own, honestly. That would demand homework and still, you won't be able to order in Vietnamese.
But if you don't like the idea of ​​being gently "assisted" to eat, or if you want to share a meal with locals who'll eat with you, or if you're too independent to follow a tour, or if you prefer more "mature" tours, basically if you don't want to be treated like a tourist (without being pejorative), don't take this tour. I think that the owner will agree on this.
Also, if you expect an experience fully focused on food, this isn't for you either.

That brings me to the 2nd part of my review. Why I give only 4*.
Because I want the owner to read it!
I find that this tour wears its name (The Foodie) quite badly, indeed.
You'll start with a bowl of Bun Bo Hue, an iconic specialty of Center Vietnam, before venturing into other districts.
It's definitely a good idea to include a famous dish from Hue. Besides, I understand that you need a place where to gather the participants before leaving in convoy.
However, I tried this place called Dong Ba, and I found the soup only so so.
Then you'll drive through Districts 5 & 6 (Chinatown) without food stop, and continue to District 8 where you'll stop at a BBQ restaurant in Ta Quang Buu St.
It's understands that tourists feel excited about trying grilled goat meat to dip in different sauces, for example. It's unusual to them. I just hope that they eat the best items on the menus, and not some rotten meat that these 5k (20 us cents) skewer joints are capable to serve (soaked in special detergent). The cheapest choices are usually the unhealthiest ...
After BBQ, you'll explore a part of Phu My Hung, a nice area where to live in District 7 (we live there!), without food stop, where you'll be told that there's a large expat population, that rich Vietnamese invest in apartments, etc.
Finally, you'll enjoy the best part of the tour (in my opinion), a seafood fiesta in Vinh Khanh St. (District 4), with also the possibility to try the duck embryo and some desserts.
I carefully checked the tour description before writing this review, and found some overstatements ("the most amazing dishes" - ok, it's marketing, and it seems to work :) and questionable terms.
The tour name, first. I suppose that most of the participants are aware that the tour will consist more or less in 1/3 eating, 1/3 driving and 1/3 explaining.
But even the eating part isn't really a food tour. Besides the initial bowl of Bun Bo Hue, it's rather "Have a typical beer & food feast like locals in local districts" (which is nevertheless a very interesting immersion into local culture).
It's commendable to differentiate from competitors, but BBQ meat or seafood isn't street food. It's "party" food.
And tourists can have it in District 1.For instance, the famous 3T restaurant is filled with tourists eating pork, goat, venison, shrimp, etc. every evening.
Not really "street food dishes that most people outside of Vietnam have never had a chance to experience".
Not really "street stalls" either.
The exotic part can not be summed up to the only duck embryo, can it?
Otherwise, I don't see any dish from North Vietnam in the tour, as advertised.

If the owner doesn't mind, I'd like to suggest 2 ideas.
Why not include 2 more food stops?
- 1 in Chinatown, to quickly sample some dim sum like dumplings from a street stall (that's also part of local culture)
- 1 in Phu My Hung where, instead of parking for a while in dead Ha Huy Tap St. in front of Circle K, to brief customers about the area (we often see this scene at night), you can stop at the other side of Nguyen Van Linh Av., where there is village life; I'm sure that the few little quiet restaurants at the end of Street 6, near Dang Dai Do St., would be more than happy to prepare some typical northern dishes for XO's customers (ex: banh cuon) every evening. They're of comparable quality to the rest of places visited.
That would probably require reducing the time spent eating BBQ, but people would have the satisfaction to sample something from each district explored.
That would make it closer to a foodie tour.

I'd be happy to exchange with the owner, if he's interested in this review :)
Good luck XO Tours!

Despite a couple of nervous people (being on the back of a bike in HCMC traffic and trying some interesting' cuisine), everyone was soon very comfortable and having a great time.

This tour never disappoints and that is down to the lovely drivers (thanks especially to Tam (3rd time now) and Nhi (2nd time now)), our tour guide Tai (always a crack up) and all of the support crew (security, cameraman etc) who all made this an incredible experience for our whole group.

We are still talking about this tour as one of the absolute highlights of the trip and cannot wait to see the video.

Thanks again all and I am sure we will see you again-great tour.

Safe and fun - The girls are very friendly and tell you a lot about the city throughout the tour. My partner and i did this for the second time, last time was 6 years ago and it was an excellent experience and the food was amazing. This time it was still fantastic however the food this time is not nearly as good as the last. Would still definitely recommend to those who love food and looking to see a bit of the city.

Foodie Tour - We went on the nighttime Foodie tour and would highly recommend it! The girls were so cute and friendly (I was with Hoa, she was brilliant!) and such excellent drivers, I couldn't stop smiling the whole ride. Food was delish, especially the Bún bò Huế at the first stop (beef noodle soup). There was a great range of food (come with an empty stomach) and several interesting stops, our guide Loc was very informative. Thanks for the great experience, XO!

Food tour - Our guide Tai was wonderful and very knowledgeable about the surrounding districts. He was charming and managed to engage our 12 year old and persuade him to try many cuisines he normally wouldn’t dream of eating including frog. The girls were a lot of fun too, bright and bubbly. We really enjoyed the insight into the food and could eat anymore if we tried. Tai is always on hand to bring you cold drinks. The girls are skilled drivers and I felt very safe.

All about the $$ - - We did an XO Tour in another city which was fantastic.
Our flight was delayed into Saigon & I phoned from the airport (because I couldn’t ring any earlier from the Air) as soon as we landed to say our flight was late & in turn we would be late. (Which was 15-20 mins at hotel pick up point)
There was no offer to accomodate the lateness, but she did rebook for the following night and then charged a percentage of the cancellation fee anyway.
I had prepaid the entire tour price before leaving Australia & explained we weren’t cancelling & was told we had to pay for the 2 drivers and tour guide & support staff for the first night because we didn’t go on the tour. In the end we did not do the tour, because of the attitude of the office staff & if $20USD is going to send their business broke, rather than have a 5 star feed back, driver tips
and recommendations to others then they need to re-assess their business priorities in a city where tourism is competitive & the tourist $ is paramount.
Sadly disappointed!

BEST TOUR OF TRIP! Totally safe and so much fun - 9 of us had the best morning with the Xo tours girls. The motor bikes were completely safe and it was the best possible way to see the city. We got to try different Vietnamese desserts, fruits, and juice. We learned a lot about the history of Vietnam and got better insight into the culture of Saigon through the girls. They also provided us with great recommendations for the remainder of our trip. We would highly recommend this tour- best thing we did in Vietnam!

Great night out with great people! - Fantastic night out eating and zooming around the city! The girls were very friendly and very confident on the bikes. Great opportunity to talk to people who live and work in the city.

The food was interesting and tasty. I am a vegetarian and they made sure there was plenty of food for me to eat.

This is a must when traveling to Vietnam!

Great night out in Saigon! - We did the evening food tour with XO Tours on our first night in Saigon, and were really happy we did! We had never been to Saigon before, and the tour was a great introduction to the city, its food, and included many other districts other than District 1. The food was delicious, the gals were great drivers, as well as talkative, informative and super nice! We had a blast from beginning to end! Love it!

Awesome adventure - Hi guys...

There are a number of these type of tours operating in Saigon. We did the XO foodie tour and had a blast. All of the girls were just lovely, fun and knowledgeable.

5 hours of fun, food and yep! Traffic!!

Thanks for amazing memories.

David & Arina
Sydney

This could be THE thing to do in Vietnam - If you have a conversation with a friend about visiting Vietnam, the first thing naturally brought up is the chaotic mayhem on the roads. Just crossing the road is not for the faint hearted, let alone actively participating in the craziness. With over 8 million motor scooters in HCM City alone, considering getting on the back of one of them for a tour around the city seems like more than just a step out of the comfort zone but the very definition of insanity. There was certainly at the very least some level of trepidation, but when in Rome...
We were a large group of 14 people in town for a wedding. We booked the Foodie tour from XO Tours. Booking process and pre-arrangements were without fault. Due to the size of our group we were offered a private tour.
We were met out the front of our hotel by 14 lovely young Vietnamese ladies and their scooters. Our drivers were all delightful intelligent young ladies who all spoke excellent English. My driver started by gauging my level of anxiety but assured me her job was to keep me safe and I would be fine. After fitting our helmets we were away. No time to re-consider or back out now!. We all navigated our way through evening peak hour traffic somehow avoiding the literally thousands of other road users coming at us from all directions. It really is organised chaos- or maybe just chaos- I still don't know, but after a short while, it really did become a lot of fun. All in all we had about 5 stops at various street food stops throughout the city and must have covered at least 40 kms on the bike. I would have to say this tour is mostly about the thrill of the ride and the tour around the city- the food stops were more than acceptable, but not outstanding. It should also be noted, that XO tours makes sure all the restaurants they go to use clean water when preparing their food. Important!
Would I recommend to all? No. This is maybe not for everyone- but if you're between 10 and 70, and have even the tiniest part of you that, for a short time, is prepared to live a (little) bit on the edge, then it does not get much better than this tour.
And yes, we all arrived home safely back to our hotel- and have raved about it ever since.
PS- If you're in a group- get the video. For US$40 its a no-brainer.

Great way to be introduced to Saigon's food culture - I was initially worried to book this tour because my friend had no experience riding a motorbike. But the friendly ladies driving the motorbikes made sure to give us a few tips before letting us ride. The food selected were well-thought out to give us a view of the different types of food that the people in Saigon enjoy. Even the seating arrangements were set-up to make sure the conversation was flowing and there was no dull moment. They went above and beyond with our food requests (mine was no veggies and my friend's is non-spicy), and made sure the food was customized to our requests. We also had a few stops along the way where our guide/bodyguard Sang gave some information about Saigon's past and present. Overall, would highly recommend this tour. The price may be steep but the experience was well worth it.

Absolutely Brilliant - Totally loved this tour. I recommend it as a MUST DO!! Not only was the food wonderful but we also got a guided tour of the city and a history lesson at the same time. The girls were extremely friendly and riding through the streets of Saigon is an experience not to be missed. Worth every cent.

BOOK THE FOOD TOUR! - We did a total of 2 tours with XO, the food tour in the evening and the city tour the day after. The food tour was excellent! The food was amazing, they organised what every drinks you want very quickly and gave you lots of information about the city, local people, and themselves.
The ladies that ride the bikes are extremely competent and you feel very safe the entire time. The food comes out extremely quickly at each stop and they have very good vegetarian options (one in our group was vegetarian and was very impressed with the food they got)
Thy are very friendly and hold an all-women team which I think would be good for any solo female travellers or all female groups.

The city tour was also very good and they serve you some local sweets during the day. Although it can get extremely hot an uncomfortable due to the weather in Vietnam so if you book it make sure you cover up in long sleeves and pants and wear some sunblock.
If I was going to choose only one it would be the food tour.

If you go to Saigon PLEASE BOOK THIS FOOD TOUR! You won’t regret it.

Exhilarating experience weaving through the busy streets of Saigon - Myself and two friends booked the Saigon by night tour. We were picked up by three ladies and shepherded through multiple different districts in Saigon, from the poorer local areas to the rich, completely out-of-place foreigner areas.

The ladies were extremely safe and I did not at all feel nervous, which is very surprising considering how crazy the traffic is.

They took us to a local street food BBQ vendor and recommended eats for us, which were *very* tasty and I definitely would not have had to courage to eat if it weren't for them. Towards the end of the tour we also got to try vietnamese pudding and a coffee flan cake, both which were extremely delicious!

This is truly something that I would recommend people to experience as it really captivates Saigon in a nutshell.

The ladies were also extremely friendly, welcoming, and spoke fluent english! They were a pleasure to talk to and were genuinely curious about our stories and backgrounds.

Highlight of my Ho Chi Min stay - What an incredible way to get to know HCM on my first ever visit. This (Saigon by night) was an excellent tour - my guide Nhumg (sp?) was extremely friendly, funny, and made me feel at ease from the first second I met her. The tour leader Khoi was also really nice, knowledgeable and accommodating. Both of them spoke excellent English - I would not have guessed either had spent their whole lives in Vietnam. Definitely the highlight of my Vietnam holiday (I had booked a few other tours in Hanoi and Halong Bay but this one left the biggest impression) - highly recommended and worth every cent.

Excellent experience - great with kids older or younger - We had a tour with XO tours late April and really enjoyed it. We can recommend this for also parents with teenagers it is a great and well balanced activity combining culture , history, food and fun !
The guides were very nice to us and our kids ! Also as we had one kid getting sick the day early we got a reimbursement for a large part ... processed on the same day

Great thing to do !

Great Value - XO Tours packs a lot of sights and good eats in its day tour of Saigon. The lady motorbike tour guide speaks fluent English and drives very safely throughout the tour. The tour itinerary is explained at the beginning of the tour by the tour manager. The tour manager and motorbike tour guide were very helpful and knowledgeable.

Amazing way to see Saigon and eat AMAZING food - Highly recommend doing this tour, especially on your first night in HCMC. We stopped at three restaurants and every dish is incredible. Save room at the last stop because the mussels and clams are some of the best I’ve ever had.

The drivers are so friendly and easy to talk to and it’s fun to zip around the city on motorbikes. We were given helmets and felt safe the entire time.

Absolutely fantastic!! - My friend and I did the ‘Sights’ morning tour, which had been recommended by a friend.
We’d been looking forward to this tour all holiday & it did not disappoint!!
The drivers Tam & Loinh (hopefully spelt correctly) were amazing, friendly, chatty, lovely, knowledgable and extremely good drivers!!
Our guide Tai was fab, funny, friendly, extremely knowledgeable and really looked after us.
The tour gave us a great insight to the history and gave us chance to visit places & districts which we wouldn’t have seen otherwise. I could’ve done a full day!!!
Would thoroughly recommend everyone to do this tour, you cannot visit HCMC without doing it. This made our holiday.
FYI: we wore vests & shirts and pumps. Wore suntan lotion on arms & especially thighs. Your handbags are stored away in the bikes whilst travelling. We took photos at stops and Tai took some photos of us on the bikes and emailed them to us later. Refreshing drinks and fruits & yoghurt are provided at a couple of the stops..yummy!!

A must in Ho Chi Minh - The Foodie tour was so great. We got to try 12 different dishes and 2 desserts, all local foods. We travelled to different districts outside the touristy areas. The guides and driver are really nice and entertaining. It is also an experience in itself to visit Ho Chi Minh by scooter. The price was well worth it, a great activity to do.

A must do... - This was the highlight for our group. Great fun and informative. Really well organised and the whole XO team were lovely. Felt safe on the bike, we covered many districts and ate many things we would not have tried on our own. Our groups ages ranged from 8 up to late 40’s - we all loved it. A must do adventure...

One of our trip highlights - We did this tour on the recommendation of a friend and it was well worth it. We booked for the evening of our first day in Vietnam and it was a great way to see a bit of the city at night. Felt safe from the time we stepped onto the back of the scooter, even through Saturday night crazy traffic. Highly recommended. Thanks so much for an enjoyable and memorable evening. Appreciated being sent the photos. Have you thought about providing a map overview of where we went. That would really help with understanding where we went 😃

Absolutely amazing! - We did this tour with a group of 14 and it exceeded our expectations. To start off, the motorbikes were so stable, it was very obvious that the riders were very experienced drivers and knew how to ride with a passenger on the back. The drivers were also very friendly, they were talkative and helpful. The tour guide was also very informative, not only did we eat great food but we also learnt a lot about the history of Vietnam. Then the food, it was amazing. I have to say the places we went weren’t exactly places I would normally go on a night out, but it turned out that the food was exceptional and of quite a high quality. It was very interesting trying and goat and frog, and some of the dinners were cooked right in front of us so we were assured about the quality.
Amazing!

Street food moped tour - We were picked up at our hotel and jumped on the back of their mopeds to be taken on a fantastic tour of Hanoi, eating great street food and drinking beer. The girls were great fun and we tried some amazing food. Thoroughly recommended.
Ho Chi Minh on Wheels - We took the XO Tours City Sights & loved it. Great guides & we visited areas which you could not possibly do on your own...highly recommend!

Our favorite experience !!! - The XO girls are the BEST !!!!! You want to see the city. You want to taste the tastes They are the friendliest most incredible excursion we’ve ever done and we travel a lot !!

Best Foodie tour ever - If you want awesome communication, great pick-up service; safe passage through crazy Ho Chi Minh and a great selection and variety of quality foods... this tour is definitely for you....

Great experience - best way to navigate the traffic - We took the XO scooter foodie tour on our second night in this vibrant city and saw parts of the city we would never have found or learnt about on our own. Two of our group of four were very nervous but had a great time for the duration of our three hour night tour. Food was delicious, girls (Thao, Hoa were the only two names we can spell,) were fun, interested and knowledgeable. Khoi shared lots of interesting information on our stops. We highly recommend this tour - the bikes go at only 30km/hr so you feel safe and comfortable.

Excellent tour, delicious food, safe and fun! - I did the foodie tour and was really amazed at how well they'e put this together. It was incredibly fun, well-run, professional, and safe. Everything, including my pick up, was right on time. My guide's English was perfect. She was really knowledgeable about food, the city, and any other question I asked. Very safe driver too. And the food....was amazing! The first stop for bun bo hue was probably the least interesting, but it continued to get better throughout the night. Great mix of really adventurous (bolut upon request, frog, sheep udder, etc) and mundane--perfectly grilled shrimp. They were really accommodating for a guest who didn't like seafood, for example--probably 12 unique dishes just for him. I went to Saigon just for the food and there's no way I would have been able to sample such a variety--in so many different places--without doing the tour. Really amazing overall!

XO FOODIE FANTASTIC HCMC TOUR - We had a fantastic time In the foodie tour. It really is so well organised and the young team that look after your needs are so polite and funny! My driver Win (AKA WIN BANANA) was great fun to be with. As was my friends driver. Both being Thai they had a great time too. Ao's birthday was 19/05 and her driver was 20/05. Sisters TOGETHER!

Best way to see the city! Fun and informative tour - Following a recommendation we received to look into the XO foodie tour, we read many of the excellent reviews and swiftly made our booking. I can now echo the words of many of the other reviewers.. the foodie tour was one of the best things we did during our stay in HCMC!

Tuan (our main guide) and his team were all charming, funny, and very knowledgable. Having never been on a bike before (in any country) I was quite nervous to get on one. However the girls were very reassuring, safety conscious, and experts at navigating the crazy traffic in Saigon! Within just a couple of rides I was loving it, feeling super confident, and couldn’t believe I had been so nervous! After each stop to try some of the local delicacies, we were excited to get back on the bikes and soak up some more of the city!

I also have a serious nut allergy, which makes me very anxious about eating overseas. I informed XO tours about my allergy during the booking process. They duly acknowledged my requirements and let me know that most of the dishes do not contain nuts, and those that do would be prepared for me without nuts. On the night, the team were very efficient at keeping me informed about which bits I could/couldn’t eat by ensuring I knew which portions had been prepared especially for me.
