They were excellent at catering to my needs, took great care of all of us, and even despite my allergy I still got to try everything.

There was a great variety of food prepared for us, and very generous amounts of it too! We got to enjoy lots of seafood, and a BBQ cooked expertly for us by our drivers. We also tried different herbs, frogs, clams, scallops, and one of our party even had the duck embryo! Although we had been in Vietnam for a week and sampled a lot of different dishes already, I still felt we learnt a lot more about their cuisine from this tour than we had done previously. The pancake roll-ups and variety of different dipping sauces at the BBQ were my personal favourites!

It must be said that this is definitely much more than a simple food tour though. We learnt SO much about Vietnamese culture, city life and lots of the different districts around the city. It was great to venture outside of district 1 and see different areas. Tuan also took lots of photos of us/for us during the evening, which he sent to us only a few days later. We love looking back at them and are really grateful that Tuan took these for us, as we didn’t take that many of our own (clearly having too much fun!)

Thank you XO tours for such a memorable night! Loved every minute. This really is a must do!

Drowned in hospitality - We did this food tour with our four year old daughter. Started with hot soup in hot weather.. then down came the torrential rain and lightning, up went the experience. Our food guides and experienced scooter chauffeurs took us ponchos and all through the flooding and through the heart of Vietnamese cuisines. Duck embryos, peanut scallops, frog, goat, clams, and even some Vietnamese (French) fries for the little one. A great way to see, taste and experience Ho Chi Minh city it's people, cuisine and culture. All on the comfort of a scooter and very waterproof poncho (provided). Really great tour, the weather just made it more memorable!! Thanks to the girls that looked after us, especially Ella.

Best part of our trip - My aunt and I had a fantastic time. The Foodie Tour was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam! The guides were amazing (Thuy!) so friendly and knowledgeable. Getting to HCMC you are overwhelmed by the traffic and even just crossing the streets but once you get on the back of a motorbike you realize why everyone is on them. The women are such safe drivers and totally in control. The food was excellent and we tried a lot of things in areas of the city we would not have been able to get to without XO. Also talking to the guides we learned more about day to day life in Vietnam. We had a group of 8 (plus 8 guides) and it was a blast. We did the evening tour and maybe it was a bit cooler? Maybe not...Also I would wear pants or shorts not a skirt or dress.

Must do in Ho Chi Min City - Had heard about this tour from friends and it lived up to everything we had been told. The ladies were very competent riders and at no time did we feel unsafe. The information provided during the tour was interesting and the places we were taken too worth experiencing. Then there was the food. Loved it all. Won't spoil the surprise of what they cook up for us but recommend you try everything and I mean everything!!!!! Thanks to Miss Whin and Miss Tu our chauffeurs. Just do it.

Bike, food tor Saigon - Excellent. I have participated in many different tours around Asia, and this one is by far the best. Professionally run polite and exceptional food made for a great experience. If you take any tour in Saigon make sure it is this one.

Full belly & a happy heart!! - At first I thought we were going to be driving scooters throughout Saigon- thank goodness that wasn’t the case. We had the most amazing tour guides, Loan & Vi, drive us around and show us the ropes when it came down to enjoying authentic Vietnamese food. We had a blast, drinking, eating and enjoying everyone’s company- as it was a group of 16(8 guest & 8 tour guides). My husband & I truly enjoy foodie tours throughout our travels & I have to say this was my favorite. The combination of really getting a feel for the city on the back of a motorbike & eating w/the locals was a blast! I absolutely recommend this tour for everyone that isn’t afraid to jump on a motorbike, have some different food & enjoy meeting new people! You’ll leave this tour with a full belly & happy heart!!

Recommendations: wear pants or shorts, no skirts or dresses- you’re jumping on & off a motorbike. Come hungry because the food is soooo good you’ll want to eat everything. Don’t be shy about getting your drink on- you’re not driving 😄!!
Good service - I had great fun with them in a food tour. The girls are pretty and can speak really good english. Best way to explore the local food.

Best tour of my life - My girlfriend and I had the best time on this tour and will rave about it to anyone who asks! We took the morning tour which started with hotel pickup around 8.15am and dropped you back about 11.45am. Having just arrived in Saigon the previous night, we wanted to quickly get our bearings, see multiple places without having to deal with the heat and/or rip off taxis and of course, have a ride on a motorbike. This was ideal for it.

We saw many sights during the tour - post office, cathedral, reunification palace, the memorial for the monk who set himself on fire as a protest during the war, a temple in Chinatown, and lots more along the way as we rode through the city. We visited the market and tasted yummy yoghurts, monkey brain (not actually monkey brain!) and kumquat tea.

I felt perfectly safe on the bike. Driving was excellent, helmet felt sturdy, and I was certainly safer on the bike than as a pedestrian!! The tour guides were fantastic, extremely knowledgeable about the history of Vietnam and its traditions, but also witty, friendly and genuine. Flawless English speakers.

Tip: Wear sunscreen - including on your thighs - and cover up your arms if you can bear the heat!

I can't say a single bad thing about this tour.

Best tour!! - Honestly one of the best tours we have done in Vietnam, or in fact Asia in general.
We did the Foodie Tour and we have recommended to pretty much everyone we have met whilst in Vietnam. We really enjoyed how friendly, professional and knowledgeable the drivers were, but also our tour guide. The Foodie Tour was also more than just food. We visited so many districts within HCM and was explained the history around each district, which had we never of done this tour it's unlikely we would have done that! The tour took us to places off the beaten track and clear places where all the locals know and love as everywhere was so lively and charactistic. We tried food which we loved and probably would never had ordered or even seen. We absolutely love our Lonely Planet Guide book but even with its most authentic recommendations, it's still catered to the western traveler. The XO Tour; the Foodie Tour really allows you to experience true authentic Vietnamese food and it was truly wonderful!
If/when I come back to HCM I'll still definitely book this again!
Thanks so much guys your doing a wonderful service!!

yummy + fun motoring city tour - We booked this because a friend recommended. BEST TIME in Saigon/HCMC! I have a disability & the tour leader & motorina were so accommodating & helpful. The food (we're both vegetarian) was DELICIOUS! Great way to see the different districts of HCMC & enjoy yummy local food. MUST DO!

Step Out Of Your Comfort Zone! - We were arriving by cruise ship to a port over an hour away and were taking a ship shuttle into the center of Saigon with no way of knowing exactly where we would be dropped off by the shuttle. Ms Nguyen didn't see that as a problem at all! We made our booking, she waited months until we actually got on the ship and could find out where we would be dropped off in Saigon, and then arranged everything so we were picked up perfectly!

We did a private 3-hour tour and it was fantastic. Since my husband is six foot tall and 230 pounds, I was a little concerned that the girls would be able to handle him on their bikes but it was no problem at all. They were absolutely charming (and fearless in traffic) and Tuan Nguyen was there at every stop to explain things, and there was also a man who watched over the parked bikes while we were stopped at sites (and he even purchased some fresh juice for us and was standing by the side of the road as we whizzed past--he held out the juice and my driver grabbed it from his hand, passed it back to me, and we never even slowed down!) It was amazing to get so far away from the tourist District 1, to taste some different snacks, and just to experience Saigon in such a crazy, local way. I loved every minute of it.

We had a lot of fun! - My friend and I booked this tour because it was recommended by a travel buddy, and we were not disappointed. Our tour guides were lovely and they drove safely (especially considering the traffic in Saigon). We had a lot of fun and got to try many different and tasty dishes. I am vegetarian and my friend is not, and we were both very satisfied with the options, we were so full at the end! It's a great opportunity to visit different districts, and get to know Saigon and its cuisine better. Highly recommendable!

Must Do - My wife and I booked the foodie tour with XO and it was hands down the best thing we did in Saigon! After spending two weeks in Vietnam, this was our first and only time riding a motorcycle and it is something I think everyone should experience at least once! We felt completely safe with our tour guides (Tam and Ha) who were both professional, friendly and a ton of fun! The food was amazing and we got to try many new dishes all over the city. I am vegetarian and my wife is not and we can confidently say there is great food for everyone! We also really enjoyed driving around the different districts and seeing areas of Saigon that we would never have ventured to if it hadn't been for this tour. Highly recommend this tour, even if you're short on time, it should be at the top of your list.

What a ride!!!!! - Something everyone should experience when visiting HCMC Vietnam.
The girls were great showing us all the districts and hearing all the history from Loc. Eating the local food among all the locals was so much fun. Thankyou XO Tours for a memorable adventure!!
PS: even with a bit of rain was awesome
David & Penny (Melb, Australia)

Best way to see Saigon - Thoroughly enjoyed our Foodie Tour. Three men, one each to a scooter, driven by three young, petite women, on a wet night that dried out halfway thru. Tried all manner of foods at different locations, and survived to tell the tale! Awesome evening zipping thru districts old and new. Just do it!

Great Tour and with kids - Did the sights tour and the foodie tour.
Both with our 2 kids and both great.

Sights Tour
- Very interesting and the Guide Sang did a very good job
- You don't spend a lot of time at each place. So don't expect a full tour of each location.
- Girls were great with our kids. And of course the kids loved the motorbike ride.

Foodie Tour
- One of the best tours I have been on.
- Have plenty of room, as you will eat at three different places.
- Once again, the girls and guide were great.
- Enjoy the motorbike ride all through Saigon at night.

Just can't recommend this tour enough.

Memorable! - My husband and I did the Saigon by night tour. We enjoyed immensely. We lived in developing Asia before so traffic did not scare us, but our drivers were very skilled and cheerfully chatty. We enjoyed viewing different sides of the city while enjoying authentic local food. The girls and the guides spoke impeccable English and were very willing to answer even not easy questions.
Also, the city comes alive in the evenings. Markets are buzzing and restaurants/street stalls are full. Definitely do not miss the opportunity to enjoy this "version" of Ho Chi Minh.

Couldn't recommend this tour more highly! Exciting AND delicious - Zipping around Saigon on the back of a vespa, driven by a friendly, knowledgeable, funny young woman - who is also an expert driver - going from one off-the-beaten-track restaurant to another, we saw neighborhoods otherwise hidden to tourists.
Dress casually and arrive hungry... way more food than we could eat - all fresh and deliciously prepared. Some food that we just couldn't eat - things you will never see on a tourist friendly menu. Superbly organized and well-planned. Lots of inside info from the tour guides. A memorable experience!!!

Super well-organized, great experience! - The tour was really well organized. Thumbs up! The tour leader was hilarious and warm-hearted and shared with us nuggets of information on life in HCM City.
It was our first time on a scooter and the ladies/our guides gave a safety briefing to inform us of what to look out for.
The foodie places they brought us to were kind of like a friend brought us to the best local eats in town.
Although the tour is pricey (for Asian standards), I would still highly recommend this to friends and family.

Will be the most memorable thing you do in Vietnam! - We are still raving over this incredible tour! We didn't want it to end. Our driver hosts Huong (sp?) and Mai were impeccable XO drivers and very conversational speaking excellent English. Don't feel worried at all on the back of their motorbikes driving thru traffic, and lots of it, like a symphony crisscrossing in and out. We were also accompanied by our "Men in Black" who followed us to ensure we get from place to place. Never did we feel unsafe. We visited numerous districts stopping for historical and current information from our master host Hieu who also was very warm and friendly and most knowledgeable. You see and experience so much on this 4 hour tour.

Then there's the food! Wow! Truly authentic Vietnamese dishes and many stops equating to over 10 entrees and they want you to eat and drink as much as you want. You can be adventurous and try goat and frog, in addition to enjoying the amazing scallops, (we ordered two platters), clams and prawns. All of the reviews are spot on and we can appreciate why they were chosen as 1 of 9 best foodie tours in the WORLD. Well deserved!

We ❤️ XO tours, and tipped our drivers generously,

This is up there in our top 10 tours of all time and certainly a bargain for what you experience. If you love adventures, you'll love this!!!

Fun way to see Saigon - We went on the Foodie Tour & had a great night. The drivers are knowledgeable, funny & really look after you. XO Tours is so well organized, they even send you photos afterwards. You get to see the city & have fantastic food. Best ever tour!

Fun way to get an overview of Ho Chi Minh City - I really enjoyed the motorbike tour. The whole city rides motorbikes, so you get a feel for how locals get around the city, and the driver was very careful. I didn't feel unsafe. You don't stop at any one place for very long, so you get a good overview of the sights of the city. I loved going into the market and trying local yogurt and flan. We also had sugarcane juice and some tropical fruit later on. Hu (sp?) was the tourguide (separate from the driver) and he was knowledgable and made it fun.

Second time as good as the first - We did this tour last year on our first trip to HCMC, this year we have friends travelling with us and the first tour we did was the XO foodie tour. The tour was excellent and the guides changed things up slightly so we experienced
different things. Absolutely fantastic evening and a great first experience of local
Vietnamese food for our friends.

Best tour ever - Don’t worry about the price, it’s a wonderful experience. Enjoying Saigon this way is unique. Even if it’s rainy season it’s worth it. Our guides and drivers were amazing, they were constantly trying to satisfy your time there.

Food is amazing through all the night. That’s real local food, the place they take you will be difficult to go by yourself.

Adrenaline tour! - A perfect way to see the city and find out so much. You travel around about 7 districts and see so much you wouldn't normally see. The girls are excellent guides and very capable on the bikes. The traffic and chaos on the roads is ofcourse mental to a westerner, but it all works in Asia and the girls navigate it very well!

The food- I think our main problem was we had already been to restaurants in phu quoc and ho chi minh like 5ku which are excellent so most of the dishes were average to us. Comparatively, the soup and bbq were average. The crab scallops and clams were tasty.

Overall, it's a must do experience to see the area. Maybe on your first night in Vietnam as you will be wow'd by the food too (unlike us)

If you do one thing in HCMC, do this - This back-of-the-moped foodie tour of HCMC is a brilliant experience on many levels. The food is amazing. The drivers are friendly and knowledgeable educated young Vietnamese women who skillfully navigate the mad Saigon traffic, and then wrap you a spring roll and barbecue the meat on hot coals on one of the many delicious food stops while casually updating you on Vietnamese history and culture along the way. We did this tour with our family, which included a range of ages from an 8-month old baby, to a grandad with a hip problem, and included a clutch of toddlers, tweens and adults in-between. There were fun chopstick games and coloring competitions for the kids when their energy levels were starting to wane late at night, and among our group of 17 it was a unanimously amazing experience with which to cap off our Vietnamese journey. Perhaps even better, the purpose of this venture is to provide a career path for Vietnamese women outside of the kitchen in a very old-fashioned society. Most highly recommended, Tip well :)

Sights of Saigon tour - Great morning with lovely hosts. Good way to see the city if you have limited time or just want to experience riding on a motorbike with an expert driver.
Lynne & Wayne

sights of Saigon tour - Such a lovely tour if you have limited time in Saigon to see the main attractins but also to see the less touristy Chinatown. Lots of yummy snacks provided and the girls riding the bikes were so friendly. tour guide was very knowledgable and answered all of our questions!

Absolutely worth it - I can only add to all the positive reviews here. We did last night's foodie tour and had a blast. Thanks to our amazing driver/hosts Quyen & Tuin and Soong and all the back up crew who really made this special. I've been to Vietnam twice before but definitely learned so much more on this tour than other trips combined, especially about the city districts and their particular flavor. Happy to recommend & always feel safe on the back of the bike.

Still the absolute best... - We just completed the Foodie tour in Saigon. This is our second time with OX tours, having done a site seeing tour a couple of years ago. We took our friends along, who we had bragged how amazing XO tours were and again they lived upto and beyond expectations. Again XO tours staff are exceptional. Our tour Leader Tien was so warm, welcoming and funny. Not to be mentioned very informatively on the type of food and culture. All the lady riders are so easy going, friendly and very safe bike riders.Go hungry because there is a mountain of food to taste and eat. They cater to all tastes and food neads. My friends wife is vegetarian and this was no trouble for Tien to make sure they had the same food experience as everyone else. If you are arriving in Saigon for the first time you should put this on the top of the list of things to do to set you up for the rest of your adventures in Vietnam. A very big THANK YOU to Tien and XO for another outstanding tour that I will certainly tell all my friends about as a must do in Saigon.

Fantastic tour! - Thank you to Khoi, Ni and Tu in( sorry for bad name spelling !) . If you want a fully fun night with delicious authentic Vietnamese dishes, visiting areas not usually accessed by tourists, and safely navigating the streets of Ho Chi Minh city on a scooter with your very own capable and informative guide, then this is the tour for you !!!
So much fun, and a chance to safely see and taste some of the “real” Vietnam. Thankyou XOtours!

Best Night - This is a must do while in Ho Chi Min. We had a fantastic time and the guides are all well spoken and knowledgeable with terrific English. I will do this tour again on our next visit.
My guide Tam was such a lovely friendly person. If you thinking of this tour DO IT you won't be disappointed.

Definitely do this tour!! - Friends recommended XO Tours to us for their “Foodie” tour of HCMC, and we are so grateful they did - we did the tour last night and it was AMAZING! We had a private tour for 17 of us (a family group) including 9 kids aged 8 months to 11, and 8 adults including my parents in their early '70s. The XO Tour is so well organized and executed - highly professional! I love the fact that the company only employs female drivers, to create jobs for women in Vietnam that “aren't in the kitchen.” The women who drove us were all very smart, friendly, confident women with impeccable English. The tour manager (a guy) was also fantastic and then there were a few guys in support including a photographer/videographer. I had my 8 month old baby strapped to me in a front pack on the back of a scooter (driven by the amazing Hong) and I felt very safe with her despite the insane traffic! It's not something I'd ever do in NZ, but as they say, “when in Vietnam…”. The Foodie stops are also fantastic - you eat like a local and try the real Vietnamese food that locals eat. The girls everything prepare for you and they took such good care of us and our kids. I honestly cannot rate this tour highly enough - the best way to see Saigon!!

JE - Fantastic tour the girls and guide where fantastic. Very informative, safe drivers in this crazy city. We learned so much information kept us hydrated. Snacks along the way, can't talk this tour up enough I highly recommend. Good job girls and guys.

A must-do in Saigon - If you are visiting Ho Chi Minh City I would absolutely recommend you do the XO foodie tour. This was by far the highlight for us in Saigon. We feel secure and safe on the back of the scooters with our trusted drivers weaving in and out of the traffic. We visited places that we never would have found nor eaten from if we were by ourselves, and stopped at Districts that we would not have ventured into. Not only did we get to eat amazing food, we were also given the history of the areas we visited.
A must for all ages.

Family Fun on Foodie Beyond Expectations - Our family of five highly recommend the XO Foodie Tour. Children aged 7 and 9 “loved it” and were kept safe by our excellent driving team and security escort.

For adults, the tour was very well organized and entertaining. Food was great.

The best part of the tour was the wonderful, friendly group of young Vietnamese women that drove us.

We travel a lot, and this experience stands out in the minds of every family member!

Best tour for people that hate tours! - Had an amazing time on the foodie tour of Saigon courtesy of xotours and my awesome guide and hella great driver Nhung. Attached are some shots from the tour captured by moi and our tour cameraman. Some food highlights include Bun Bo Hue (like pho but beef broth and hence more flavor), BBQ goat breast, tasty clams and prawns, three layers coconut flan dessert, frogs with the skin on, oh, and duck embryo. 😳🤩 Tour highlights include eating local grub, meeting fellow solo travelers, venturing outside the touristy neighborhoods with the requisite trivia, and fun conversation with the guides. Highly recommend this tour if you're in HCMC. It's just a great way to experience the city and local fare. It's incredibly well organized and safe. 🛵💯

Don't hesitate to book with this company - After much reading and worrying I decided to book the night tour for our family of four based on the strength of the reviews. I am pleased to say we were not disappointed, and our two teenage boys declared it the highlight of our week-long holiday, and that they would happily do more tours on future trips if they were all like this! The food was delicious, the company fun, and the ride during Ho Chi Minh's evening traffic was interesting. We can now confidently say that frog does indeed taste like chicken, but I am afraid I was not brave enough to try the duck embryo egg.

Best tour ever! - Wow, what can I say, what an awesome tour. From the organization, contact and then the tour. Tuan and his team were excellent, not only were they extremely knowledgeable it was fun, the food was excellent and I even felt relaxed on the vespas! The best way to see the city, cannot recommend them enough, thank you for a great way to end my trip to Vietnam.

A must do tour when in Saigon - amazing time with wonderful and professional guides! - If you are visiting Saigon than you should do yourself a favor and take this tour. We did both the Sight-seeing tour and the Saigon by night tour and we had an amazing time.

There are a few things that set this tour apart from the other tours we've been on. They are:

1) Professional, kind and friendly tour guides who are truly interested in you seeing their beautiful city and enjoying the great food and sights.
2) Informative and great pace in which the tour operates
3) Great organization with time to enjoy, chat, eat and see with no rushing of the sorts
4) Super safe and a phenomenal way to see the city ie by scooter

Can't recommend this enough, like the others here, it's a must try when you're in Saigon.

A massive shout out to our tour guides who were amazing - Tuyet, Mai, Duyen and Linh! You ladies were professional, informative, and so sweet! Thank you for looking after us - especially because we were three clumsy idiots from Australia lol :)

If you're visiting, do yourself a favor and book the tour to see this beautiful city in the best way possible, with a local and on a scooter :)
Night tour - A great tour and strongly recommend using this company. My wife and I used this company for 3 years for a day tour and the girls are a great

Best tour ever! Highlight of our Saigon stay! - We had a great time with the girls touring through Saigon. We felt completely save on the little scooters, the girls are excellent drivers. Our group included two 73 year old participants, and they had a fantastic time as well. Whenever we had a stop to do sightseeing we met Sang, our tour guide and his knowledge about the Vietnam history is amazing. He was very patient with us as well as we had many questions to ask. The stop at the market, the fruit and drinks we got served ... it was all excellent. I highly recommend this tour.

Best night in Vietnam - Thank you so much for getting us in at late notice, we had the most amazing time ever. The food was lovely, sightseeing beautiful, relaxing motorbike ride and the girls were absolutely the loviest, sweetest, kindest and friendliest soles. We loved our night and the experience so much. Our host was informative, hilarious and fun loving. Thank you, thank you, we will never forget it

The highlight of my vacation - This was by far one of the best tours I have experienced in my lifetime! I am a well-seasoned traveler and have been on tons of tours, however, this foodie tour was over the top! First and foremost the staff was on time, professional and well organized! They were very knowledgeable about Vietnam as a whole including the culture and food. The drivers were very safe and made the entire tour so much fun! I highly recommend this XO Tour you will have the time of your life!

Foodie tour - This was by far one of the best highlights of our 3 nights in Ho Chi Minh. We had quite a large group of us, including a 9 year old, but from the moment we were picked up, everything was perfect. Zia and Tam our moped drivers were fantastic. Tian explained the different districts with humour but also with great knowledge. Would highly recommend XO tours.

Amazing tour for solo travelers - I lucked out and was the only one on my tour which allowed me to really get close to the guides and ask all the questions I wanted. This was the first thing I did when getting to CHMC which ended up being a great idea to get an outline of the city to explore more later. Their attention to detail in what makes a tour great was all there and beyond. All the small things your don’t think of - providing a water bottle, stopping for small snacks, drinks and fruit already paid for, taking candid photos of you and sending them to you later. Things like this really exceeded my expectations.

One of the best tours we've ever done - From the moment we were picked up from our hotel, to the drop off, this was a next level tour. I'd never been on a motorbike before so was straight out of my comfort zone but once you get used to it, it really is the best way to see HCM city.

The tour consists of 3 food stops and 2 city/explanatory stops. Each food stop had been carefully vetted for suitability (and hygiene) and included a selection of local and regional specialties. Food and alcohol are included in the price.

The guides were knowledgeable and very friendly, and the supporting XO crew were slick and unobtrusive - they accompanied you the whole way, arriving just before you do at each stop, set everything up and take pics throughout the evening (and email them to you) which is great if, like me, you're gripping the scooter rear seat handles firmly with both hands.

We visited most of the key districts/zone in the city including Chinatown, the upmarket ex-pat district on reclaimed land (aka New Singapore) and the 'mafia' district 4.

Pics of some of the dishes we tried, are below.

XO Foodie Tour - We had the greatest time. We were only two and were joined up with two Korean Australians and 3 South Koreans. The tour guide was exceptionally knowledgeable and spoke great English, giving us a wonderful insight into every area we traveled to and the scooter drivers Duyen and Muy(unsure of spelling sorry) were very polite, chatty, friendly and warm. We tried some foods we normally wouldn't have tried (frogs and duck embryo) and they were very accommodating for my preference of avoiding seafood wherever possible, organizing alternate meals for me at all locations. Beers were kept coming at no additional charge and the food was all delicious. We would do this tour again even if they went to the same locations each time, but upon asking I was told them do mix it up a bit and go to different places.
Top evening with fine Food and A great tour trough HCMC - Yesterday evening we were On the Food tour of XO. IT is top. Best drivers, fine Food, A grand tour and Good explanations.

XO Foody tour awesome experience! - Excellent and very confident female drivers. They speak excellent English and tell us a lot about the city, the culture and the food. It is quite an experience to ride like the locals in various districts. We make a few stops along the way and the tour leader tells us about every district we go through. The food is great and the drivers teach us about everything we eat. Very entertaining evening. However I think the tour is somewhat pricy.

A MUST-DO in Ho Chi Minh City - This tour was highly recommended by friends who visited HCMC. It's an amazing way to eat a variety of authentic Vietnamese food. The tour guide takes control of ordering everything at each restaurant we visit. Nothing gross like dog either! However, the variety is quite traditional and delish! It's an all-you-eat type of event. However, they do warn you to "pace yourself" as there will be TONS of food! Also and all-you-can-drink event. They'll offer both non-alcoholic beveages as well as Vietnamese beer! The women who drive us around are exceptional with their motor bikes! No way I'd have ever considered riding on those in Ho Chi Ming City as it looks like complete CHAOS! However, it's the MOST organized chaos I've ever been a part of. So much fun and we felt VERY safe. We also visited places outside of District 1 which many people don't get to see as District 1 is the most popular place for tourists. Next time I'm in Vietnam I will do the tour they offer in Hoi An! I also definitely recommend XO Tours-Saigon City. Again, amazing and very organized!
Misleading - Some of these tours at great prices are misleading! Low prices but you can book the cheap tours and show no availability! A bait and switch game

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - I've been to Ho Chi Minh City several times and have found the very best way to get to know this incredible city. A scooter tour with XO tours. I've done the foodie tour twice and can't recommend it highly enough. Perfectly organized and executed. A great sampling of the food and of the different areas of the city. My skittish wife loved it and felt totally safe throughout.
XO Tours is Outstanding - We took both the City tour and the Foodie tour last week - both were outstanding! The company and it's employees are first rate. Highly recommend it.

FANTASTIC, Adventurous, wonderful and exciting way to see Saigon - XO SCOOTER TOUR....FANTASTIC
Absolutely loved this tour. Excellent, friendly and professional drivers, wonderful delicious food, lots of history very knowledgable Guide. Simply the best way to experience food culture and sites of Saigon by night.
I will do this tour every time I go to Saigon! cant wait to take my daughter and go again.

Fantastic tour! The highlight of Ho Chi Minh and the whole of Vietnam so far! - What a wonderful tour. The guides were all so friendly. They made us feel so safe on the motorbikes, we began to see some chaos in the madness of Saigon traffic. We felt safe at all times. Our group consisted of 2 families with teenage children 15, 16 and 18. We learnt so much, our guides so informative. We saw parts of Ho Chi Minh that tourists would not usually see. Our kids are fussy eaters, but they found lots to eat and loved every minute. All the food stops were delicious, with some traditional cuisine such as frogs (or jumping KFC as the guides called it) and duck embryo, but plenty of delicious beef, pork, chicken, seafood if that is not for you. We had a private tour of 7 people, and a videographer followed us the whole way, weaving in and out of the traffic to video us so our hands were always free from cameras or phones to hold onto the motorbike. Our leader Khoi met us at each stop and was very informative and friendly. He also took lots of photos and sent them to me the very next day. Thoroughly recommend XO foodie tours, do not leave Ho Chi Minh City without doing it!

XO Tours = Seeing the REAL Vietnam! - I am a US citizen and first-time visitor to Vietnam. In the past few days I was honored to take the XO Saigon Nighttime Foodie and Daytime Sights tours. The expert driving of, and incredibly interesting and fun conversations with, the XO female drivers, as well as the incredibly articulate and informative male tour leaders, will leave you feeling like you were just given a special, personal gift of local residents' views of Vietnam.

I was completely blown away...carried away...transported...by XO's tours. I can't thank the XO ladies and guys enough. - Phil M

Highlight in Saigon, feel the vibe and taste the food! - After 17 nights in Vietnam, the XO , Vespa , foodie tour for 4 plus hours was a definite highlight.
Our drivers Vy and Diem were good riders, caring, knowledgeable, beautiful personalities, who made us feel welcome to their city. From China Town, fresh food markets, different districts , poor to upper middle class, district 7, Goat BBQ , Best scallops and clams, Beef Noodle soup, and so much more, what's wonderful final night in Saigon.
Well worth the $75 US dollars.Also paid $40 for the video , looking forward to receiving soon.
Hieu Nguyen you are a true professional and great leader of your team.
XO , we read about you on Tripadvisor, you exceeded our expectations!
We recommend you with confidence.

Oh, what a night!!!!!! - I have to say this is a fantastic experience, in this part of the world where things are sometimes disappointing I can assure you that this is not so.
Very professional from booking through to getting you back to the Hotel and even then sending you the photos on the web site.
The team are so friendly and they really make you feel welcome.
Exceptional evening.

The highlight of Ho Chi Minh - We did the foodie night tour of Ho Chi Minh. It went for about 3 hours and visited 4 or 5 restaurants and took us into several districts.
The food was great but the real highlights were the riders. All girls in their early 20s with excellent English and a good sense of humour. They were clearly all trained in keeping their passengers entertained and informed. Being able to converse with someone with strong English meant we could get a good idea of ​​what life is like in Vietnam.
You can spot them around Ho Chi Minh easily as they come immaculately dressed in long white gowns.
Doing a motorboke ytour also means you get to experience the real organized chaos of the Ho Chi Minh roads.
It's not cheap - $75USD - and its clearly aimed at the top end of the tourist market (not so much for backpackers who are trying to survive on $50USD a day). There is a cheaper day tour.
They even have a rap on youtube. But it is worth it. The girls seem to truly enjoy the interaction.
If you've got the money I'd say do it.

Second time we did the night tour of Saigon with XO Tours - On our return to Ho Chi Minh city after 3 years, we repeated the XO night tour. It was thoroughly enjoyable again, with great friendly professional guides and support staff.
Would highly recommend as a great way to experience Ho Chi Minh and street food. Our 10 year old daughter had a great time on the back of a bike.

Superb night tour of Saigon - Huge fun on night tour of Saigon

Loan and her 2 pals took our party of 3. The 3 guides were great. Fun, funny and informative.

Saw a different side to the city not just because you're on a scooter.

An absolute highlight of this trip and really any trip. Fabulous

100% recommended.

What a night - Ho Chi Minh - Went on the food tour tonight, Food choices were fun, group explanations were insightful. My wife and I were happy to meet and be with people who enjoy food as much as we do. Highlight of our trip so far! Can't wait for Hanoi tour

Amazing Experience - To try the different food in Saigon (HCMC) is something unique, but to ride in the back of a scooter to different food markets is truly amazing!

Not only were the drivers very helpful and kept us safe, they were informative and letting us know the different stories behind the areas we were riding through.

I recommend the foodie tour for anyone who is in HCMC! Beer and Food - what else do you need?!?!

Highlight of our visit to Saigon, Ming & the ladies rocked! - XO Tours was undoubtedly the highlight of our trip to Saigon, we went for the "Saigon by night" tour and it was just perfect.
Initially I was bit concerned as I was doing this trip with my 65 year old mother who had never sat on a moped for such a long time but the ladies tour guides assured that we faced no issues & my mother had a blast.
Tour started promptly and all the ladies drivers were fluent in English, they drove the mopeds very safely, we were also followed by 2 security boys to ensure that everything was going smoothly.
We visited many great areas, they focus on non-touristy places which were good as we got a glimpse of real life, we got to try great Vietnamese cuisine, desserts and sugar cane juice.
We got a lot of insights by talking to all the ladies and the tour guide.
They always went above and beyond in ensuring that we were safe and we were having fun.
Ming also helped us after the tour, so in the next few days whenever we faced any language problems or whenever we needed any help we used to call Ming and he used to always try and help us which was great.
I would highly recommend this tour and I would recommend doing this tour as soon as you land in Saigon.

2nd Tour with XO Tours. - Booking a tour with XO Tours is a breeze. Ms. Nguyen (booking manager of XO Tours) answered all my questions and made the process very easy for me. She honored a promotion that didn't work on the website and was very efficient all around.
The tour went off without a hitch, the XO guide promptly arrived at my hotel on-time (without getting lost like most GRAB motorbike drivers do). My guide was very sweet and pleasant throughout the tour. Mr. Tai Dang was familiar with me and I was with him as he was the leader of my last tour with XO Tours and this tour as well. He has a great sense of humor and after 2 years+ he still brings a lot of energy and charm to the tours. I enjoyed seeing Saigon at night and I'm thinking if I return I'll probably redo the foodie tour as it fills your boots with food. The saigon by night is more sightseeing with an option of a drink, entree, and dessert. I had a Banh Mi, Milky Pear and other exotic fruits, and Iced Coffee Flan. Always a great time with XO Tours. I wish they start new ventures into different kinds of tours. Time for a change!

For pictures of the tour follow me on IG: TravelingSoon

Highly recommended :) - The XO Foodie Tour was a fantastic experience. It was a great way to see the sights and visit many of the districts. Guides were super friendly and chatted throughout the entire trip. It provides us with an opportunity to visit places we would otherwise not have gone to. Tried a variety of foods, some delicious, some interesting! The highlight of the tour was the time spent on the bikes. Super fun. I went with my husband and two children aged 10 and 15. We were all on our own bike with our own guide. Was the best part of our trip to Ho Chi Minh. Highly recommend.

Fantastic way to see the city! - Booked the night foodie tour and had a wonderful experience. The scooter portion was so fun! I have to admit I was a little apprehensive about getting on one but it was an excellent way to travel around. At times I just closed my eyes as I was afraid we were going to run into someone but my driver Ting was fabulous. It was such a smooth ride and I see now why they are so popular as a mode of travel. The food portion was also great! There was so much food that by the end I couldn't put another bite of anything in my mouth. The girls spoke great English and were very engaging and seemed to really enjoy their time with the tourists. I would highly recommend XO tours. They also took a lot of photos during the tour and sent them a few days later.

Best bike tour! - We chose for the “foodie” tour and did not disappoint! At first we were really nervous to ride on the back of the scooters given how crazy Ho Chi Minh traffic is but after a few minutes we felt completely safe in the hands of our very capable drivers!
We were taken to several food stops to sample a variety of local dishes from noodle soups to frog legs and duck embryo. The best stop was the final one which had lots of yummy seafood and dessert !
The tour also included some sight seeing stops which was a great way to see the city! Our tour tour leader, Tuan, gave a great explanation at each stop and was also very funny and entertaining.
Overall this tour was a great experience :)

A highlight of Vietnam - We went on the Saigon by night tour and enjoyed every minute of it. Our 4 ladies that drove us talked to us the whole time and were so funny and friendly. Loc was our tour guide and he was very informative. The food was delicious (not yum that means something else in Vietnamese). The mains we each chose a different dish do we could try them all and then dessert was really good. Highly recommend doing this tour when arriving as you will see a lot of Ho Chi Minh.

Fantastic tours! - My husband and I did two tours with XO and they were fantastic! We did the sights and also the foodie tour. I had witnessed a really nasty accident in Halong Bay Involving a scooter and I was really worried about getting on these scooters for the tour - I needn't have been! The girls are fantastic and you feel in safe hands! The sights tour gave us so much information on the history of HCMC and took us to places we would never have seen and plenty of stops to take photos. We also loved the foodie tour! 5 stops - 2 for information on the city and 3 food stops with a total of 14 different foods to try! Lots of fun and again we got to see HCMC and districts we will have never been able to see any other way! You must do at least one tour with XO when in HCMC

Saigon Foodie Tour - Excellent final evening to our Vietnam visit - a real highlight of the trip. Great way to see around the city by night, tasted some excellent food and had a lot of fun. The Girls looked after our daughter and us perfectly - they are great company, have bags of energy and chat, and make you feel very safe on their scooters. Thank you XO Tours.

Absolute Must Do! - We can't stop raving about this. Seriously, everyone we talked to in Vietnam and pretty much everyone at home has heard about what a great time we had on the XO Saigon Foodie tour.

We booked this tour on the recommendation of a Vietnamese friend in the States and I'm so glad we did. We got to see a side of Vietnam you don't get on the usual bus tour. It's not all food - the tour took us through some of the smaller districts and the XO team shared a real local's perspective of what it's like to live in Saigon. I truly feel like we got to see what it's like and that was informative.

Now for the fun! Our drivers Nhi and Mui were like best new girlfriends. Who joke and laugh and tease while expertly navigating the crazy roads. And our guide, Loc was hilarious. We didn't know what to expect food wise, but we figured it would be the usual players like banh mi or noodles. Nope! We got to try food we'd never tried. As in frog, goat and shellfish and not a spring roll in sight. There was plenty of deliciousness and plenty of craziness.

Some highlights

• Zipping on the bike through food markets, live fish, clothing stalls and streets loaded with decorations and flowers
• A huge locals only restaurant with do it yourself grilling
• Succulent fish, scallops and crab - with your driver doing all the cracking
• And a couple of cold beers and banana flower liquor shots as well!

It was fun, informative and the experience of a lifetime. I don't know why anyone would go to Saigon without going on an XO tour.

Great evening food tour via motor bike - There are lots of food tours via motor bike, but XO tours stands out. They have wonderful English speaking students who pick you up at you hotel and whisk you easily thru crazy rush hour traffic to many of the districts of the city. Not only is the food delicious, the guides provide interesting information about the city (eg real estate taxes and the influx of expats as well as education requirements of children).

If you're adventurous, like good food, and want to see parts of Ho Chi Minh city you wouldn't ordinarily, then XO tours is for you.

Evening Street Food Tour - I was booked in for this on my first evening in Ho Chi Minh and made it to my hotel with only minutes to spare before I was due to be picked up for my tour. Despite the rush to get ready I was soon feeling happy and relaxed having been whisked on the back of my guide's scooter to join with the group. Never having ridden a scooter either as a driver or passenger was a little daunting but it was remarkable easy just to sit on the back ;-) The tour was great - I paid extra to get a video momento of the experience and having received it a few days ago I'm very glad I did. My tour group was 8 in total which was a great size and we ate a great variety of food whilst seeing many of the hidden sights of Saigon.

I would thoroughly recommend a tour with XO tours, just try not to eat at all during the day ;-)

Night Tour - we highly recommend XO - Our top tip: do a tour with XO as early as you can in your stay in Saigon. We did ours late in our stay and wished we had done it earlier because XO gave us a perfect overview of this bustling city.

We went as a party of 5, some of us were first timers in Vietnam and first timers on Scooters.
Our XO Night Tour hosts were fantastic. They gave us the local perspective that enhanced our understanding and appreciation of life in Saigon. And they are great riders too - we felt completely safe the entire tour.
We really enjoyed getting out of District 1 and seeing the different sides of Saigon.
It was really worthwhile - do it!

Half-day tour around Ho Chi Minh City - On the back of scooters is the best way to experience HCM.
The team at XO tours were lots of fun and gave great insight to the many sights we visited, we went through a few districts and went where locals go.
Our guide Tai Dang was funny and has great communication skills.
Highly recommend this half day tour.

Best tour of our trip, made us fall in love with Saigon - We had a fabulous night with XO tours on our “foodie” tour. We were in a group of 8 and it was the perfect size. My husband and I had both ridden motorbikes before but never as passengers & were a bit worried about how it would be not being in control in the traffic of Saigon. We didn’t need to worry, our drivers were amazing and we felt so comfortable on the bikes after just a few minutes. They both told us lots of things about Saigon & answered all our questions about the city and about their lives.

This tour was one of the highlights of our trip & we are not usually “tour people”. We got to try some great food & it got us out of the main tourist areas & we got to see a few different sides of Saigon. Definitely worth the money, would highly recommend to anyone who is interested in seeing the city at night & wants to try some delicious street food!

Best tour in Vietnam - My wife , myself and 4 friends did this tour on second last night of a 15 day trip in Vietnam . To quote my friend peter at the end of fhe tour “ well I guess we all now know what our trip hightlight is” . What a way to see Ho Chi Minh city being taken around many of the districts on a motor bike driven by the most adorable , informative and professional young ladies you will ever meet . Our tour lasted well over 4 hrs , we visited what seemed like every district in this amazing city and consumed approx 14 courses of food , we tried food we would never normally try ( frog , goat and duck embryo ) and joined the locals along the way . The foodie tour is hands down a must do trip if you are in Vietnam to truly experience the culture , food and madness of the Ho Chi Minh traffic up close and personal . To Quang Le our tour leader a big thank you your one of the greats mate , to our lady drivers you were so knowledgeable and so much fun .
Can’t wait to do tour again one day and for our many friends to one day experience this tour also .
Well done XO Tours

Awesome your around HCMC - The Foodie tour is a great way to get to know Ho Chi Minh City. The excellent drivers take you right out of District 1, and into the districts you would never think of visiting yourself. Our guide was very entertaining and enlightening, and the girls driving and feeding us were great.

You won't get all the traditional Vietnamese food you get everywhere else, but rather some more interesting dishes. We finished our 18 day trip around Vietnam with this tour, and most of the dishes were a first for us.

I can easily recommend this tour. Even though it's a bit on the pricey side, it delivers on both quality and quantity. Make sure you're hungry at start of the trip!

The best night so far - We did the foodie night tour last night we had an awesome time i laughed and smiled so much Tuan was our tour leader he was so funny and so much fun i would suggest that no one should miss this tour it was such a great experience i felt so safe on the back of the bike and my driver was such a sweety i loved this tour so much

Great Introduction to Vietnamese Food - My wife and I booked the foodie tour on a recommendation from a friend. This was our honeymoon and this experience was one of the highlights. It was well organized with delicious food that you wouldn't be able to find yourself.

However, the highlight was the girls/drivers who were very welcoming and had a great personality. They were both personable and made a lot of jokes while doing a great job driving. My tour leader, Sang, was also friendly and playful throughout. It was a pleasure to meet some of the other tourists on the trip as well. Highly recommended

Best day in HCMC!! - What a brilliant introduction to HCMC! My family and I had the most amazing day with the girls and Loc from XO tours. I had done lots of research prior to booking in the sights tour, as initially I thought it was too crazy to take my 3 boys (aged 6, 8 and 9) on a motorbike through one of the busiest cities in the world. However all the reviews I read were so positive and I am so glad I listened to them!! All the girls were just so lovely and my boys adored them and we all felt incredibly safe. It was such a brilliant way to see all sights that we wanted to see and Loc gave such a wonderful tour and spoke so passionately about Vietnam’s history-it was interesting and we learnt so much. We got to taste some Vietnamese desserts and some sugar cane juice-all delicious. And they were so helpful with allergies to gluten and nuts.
I had to pinch myself a few times to think my kids and I were riding on motorbikes through HCMC!! Thank you for a fabulous day, we will never forget it! Don’t hesitate with this tour-you won’t regret it!

Our Saigon highlight! - Absolute highlight of our three night stay in Ho Chi Minh was our XO Foodie Night Tour. Our right gorgeous riders were Trang and Vanessa who quickly earned our confidence in the crazy traffic and were thoroughly enjoyable company with their happy chatting and local knowledge. The tour guide, Khoi was so upbeat, entertaining and made us laugh all night. The food at each stop was AMAZING and we got to see various districts of Hoi An that we would not have otherwise seen. Highly recommend XO and the foodie night tour!

Food tour of Saigon - At first I thought $75 per person was a bit steep but after the trip it was worth every dollar.

Our team leader Tai had a great smile and energetic personality, great English and did a very good job introducing the guests to each other to break the ice.

Food was fantastic and also the scooter ride through Saigon was rather exciting. If it wasn't for XO Tours I would not have seen as much of Saigon as I did. Driver was also very friendly with a warm smile and made sure to chat with us during a the ride so didn't feel like we were just in a taxi. Pictures and videos got taken and provided back is great so we weren't stuck on our phones all night.

Wonderful job and I'd definitely go on it again next time I'm in Saigon :)

A must while on Saigon - One of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam!! We booked online on the XO tours website. The foodie night tour is USD75 per person and it is well worth it! It is about 4 hour long, the service includes pick up and drop off at your hotel or Airbnb location and each guest gets to have their own driver (a lovely female wearing a tradional vietnamess dress). There are 5 stops, including 2 sightseeing stops and a little cultural explanation provided by a very well spoken guide and 3 food stops, including a local street food stop where Bun Bo Hue soup is served, a second stop where you experience those small bbq placed on table (beef, goat, shrimp, frog) and a third stop where lot of seafood and desserts are served (crab, clams, tradiotional egg with embry, coconut desserts) The clams in broth were the highlight for me! All you can drink pop and beer is also included. The girls take care of you like royalty, providing you with beverages, wet napkins, cooking food on the bbq, and deshelling all seafood. They are very intuitive and pay attention to your well being. There are more staff then tourists, including the drivers, the guide and the photographers. At the end of the tour, they take the time to send you personalized photos which were taken during the tour via email for no extra charge! Fantastic experience, visitng 5 districts, seeing the city by night and experiencing a very safe local and culture adventure! I would recommend to anyone visiting Saigon. It may seem expensive but it is worth every penny!!!
Must do in ho chi minh - This food tour was exciting. We enjoyed the motobike ride with some charming girls, seeing the city like locals. The foods were well selected and delicious.

A great way to see Saigon at night and eat with the locals - XO tours have nailed this experience. From the moment you get on the back of the bike you are thrown into the chaos of Saigon traffic and safely negotiated from place to place to experience the most amazing food. The drivers and tour guide provide entertaining knowledge of the various districts and take photos along the way. The food is plentiful and the only wired and wonderful delicacy was a duck embryo which was optional. Thank you XO for a really great evening

XO Tours never disappoint...Great fun for everyone! - Four years ago my foodie Aunt and I joined the XO Foodie Tour and had an amazing time. It was an adventure from the moment we hopped on the back of the bikes. Back again in HCMC and this time my children and I are travelling together. The first thing I did was book 2 tours and we weren't disappointed - We had a hoot.
My 12 and 9-year-old kids had never been on motorbikes before, so they were excited but nervous. As soon as they had their helmets on and were on the back of the bikes the excitement took over. The tour guides were well informed and kind. They engaged with the kids beautifully and we learnt a lot about the reunification of Vietnam from the sights tour. I highly recommend XO tours and will do it all again, next time we visit!
XO Tours Rock!

A fantastic family experience - Such a well organised and well managed experience. Our children (age 7 and 11) loved the experience and I was impressed by how well they were catered for ( not too spicey food options) etc. The ladies were so engaging with the children and it was certainly a highlight of their trip. We learned so much about Saigon and it was fascinating to see the vast differences between each district. Would recommend to those who want to try something a little different.

Private foodie tour - not to be missed - We booked this for our very last night in Ho Chi Minh and indeed Vietnam. What a fab evening it was! We set off a little earlier as we had a private tour which meant we got to see the sun set as we headed across to China town. The food stops were great and our guides, Loan and Nhu were amazing! They were great fun and had brilliant English so were able to have a real laugh as well as telling us all the important stuff too! We felt totally safe on the back of the bikes and would recommend this to anyone - it’s the best way to really ‘feel’ the City and of course have the locals tell you all about their wonderful food and share the best tips on how to eat it!
Thank you for a great night - loved the pics you sent today and can’t wait to see the video!

Exceptional - My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the night tour. Our guides were very welcoming and highly informative about modern HCMC, and skilled drivers through the busy streets. My wife wanted to make a special mention and thank you to Ting, as they had a thoroughly enjoyable conversation all night.

Professional,friendly and fun, A must do in HCMC. - What a fabulous experience, highlight of our holiday to Vietnam. Absolutely loved it. The XO girls speak excellent English and are amazing hosts. From the moment I sat behind Fu on her scooter I felt completely safe. We were picked up at our hotel at 5.25 pm and returned at 10.00 pm after a fun evening of riding around large parts of HCMC, eating lots of delicious (and different) foods and learning more about the city, it’s people and culture. There were 8 bikes in our group and a tour leader Loc who was informative in a fun way. A special thanks to Fu and Bing for being our drivers and hosts, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.

The Sights Tour! - Thanks ladies for a great tour! We were picked up in the morning at our hotel and the fun started from there, “scootering” around the crazy streets, exploring the sites and tasting the food. Very fun and educational! Would recommend the sights tour to anyone who has limited time in Ho Chi Minh

One of the best tours I have had in a very long time! Must Go! - First time in HCM and wanted to experience their food and XO Tours' Foodie Tour was the best experience ever on 30 March 2018. Tu, Moon and Anh were our riders and they were so professional. Meet up was at 5.15pm but at 5.10pm they were already waiting by our hotel. Before the trip started they gave us a safety briefing prior to moving off. All of them had very good command of English, Tu and Moon could even speak some Mandarin.

Total of 3 food stops evenly spaced by 2 local sightseeing stops in between so you do not feel bloated. These 5 stops took us through to most of the South districts in HCM including Chinatown and District 7. These 2 stops were the sightseeing stops without food. The riders would give us information about HCM too.

Overall, this is a definite MUST go if you are first time to HCM or if your previous trips only took you to District 1 to 3. No regrets and we had so much fun!

Great for kids! - We took the "sights" tour with our two kids, ages 5 and 2. We were nervous about safety in the crazy traffic, of course, but our two drivers were amazing. They drove slowly and carefully and made sure to give us small directions like "sit back, please." They also spent a lot of time talking to the kids and playing games with them. They taught them some Vietnamese words and really made an impression! (Vi and Ting, whereever you are, our kids love you and miss you!)

For us two adults, the tour guide, Loc, was awesome. His "behind the scenes" style tour was really great. Instead of going inside the Reunification Palace with him, we stood outside the gates and he told us some of the stories we didn't learn on our tour of the palace. It was a really nice supplement. He was a great tour guide!

I also just think the structure of the tour is great. We did some touristy stuff, some local stuff (markets in district 3), sample some desserts, and got to see the city by motorbike. It was easily the most expensive thing we did, but it was worth it!!!

Quite expensive for what you get - We were picked up by two lovely ladies and taken to the first part of the tour. Our first stop served us our first course and then we visited an area on the side of the road for some history and information of the area. We then had more food at a BBQ place and then another stop for history and information. The final stop was seafood and dessert. Overall it was a nice tour but very expensive for what you get. I did not eat very much and feel I would have enjoyed it more if it was just a moped tour of the city but with no food involved.

Really great fun and definitely worth the money - Went on the evening foodie tour - really great night, wonderful hosts and guides - plus a range of different vietnamese foods to snack on throughout the night.

The hosts were superb, and accommodated any foods that we were allergic to or just fussy about (e.g. I don't eat prawns).

When I booked I did think the cost was a bit on the steep side, but having been on the tour and seeing the effort and service that goes into it - it's definitely worth it for the nightime scooter alone, with the food as an added bonus!

Thanks again Khoi and the team!

Awesome experience!!! - Highly recommend this tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh.
I was petrified about being on a back of a scooter but felt extremely safe the whole time- the ladies are awesome drivers.
We laughed the whole time and was an overall great night.
I was a little fussy with the food so left hungry but the 9 others in the group were super full!
Good way to see the crazy city.

Food Tour - This tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. We were picked up outside our hotel by our two drivers, Lin & Tinh (not sure of the spelling) who put us completely at ease before driving us to our first stop through the rush hour traffic. There we enjoyed the first of our delicious nine courses of traditional Vietnamese food. All of it was delicious and included dishes that we would never have had the opportunity to try. My favourite part was being driven on the back of a scooter around HCM City and learning so much from our fantastic drivers and our very entertaining and well informed tour leader Khoi. I only wish we'd done it sooner as we were leaving the next day. Although I had been apprehensive about being driven through the crazy traffic, at no point did I ever feel unsafe. It was a truly invigorating experience.

Great way to taste and see Saigon - We did the "Private Foodie" tour that started at 4:30 and lasted for 4 hours. While we signed up for the tour primarily for the food(which was great), we really enjoyed seeing so much of Saigon on a motorcycle. You can see so much more of the city by motorcycle than you can in a car or tour bus. We have been to Saigon once before, but this is the first time that we felt that we really experienced the city in all of its various dimensions, both by day and night.

Now for the food-- wow, what a fun experience stopping at various locations and enjoying totally different themes of food from soup, to seafood, to a tasty barbeque with all of the meet cooked at your table. Go hungry, because you will have plenty of tasty food.

Lastly, we have to say that our guides/drivers/photographers were incredibly fun, attentive, and extremely informative. The tour would not have been the same without them and the energy that they brought to the whole experience.

Initiation to Saigon !! - Arrived Ho Chi Minh 5 am. XO collected us at 5 pm and then the fun began. First rate foodie tour, plus sight seeing, and a great initiation to the city madness driving on a scooter. Food was amazing, and stops very informative, off the beaten tourist routes, meeting the real Vietnamese of Saigon. This trip was so much fun, really chilled, and is the one to do if you want a great time. Our drivers were brilliant and we never felt unsafe driving in heavy traffic. Thanks to XO we had a brilliant initiation to Saigon !!

A highlight in Vietnam - We heard about the XO 'foodie' tour through a friend and it was well worth doing. Definitely the highlight of HCM. My boyfriend and I had such a great time on the motos with the girls. It was wonderful to explore the non-tourist districts of HCM and eat the local food. Was great to talk to the girls and ask as many questions as possible about Vietnamese life. They went above and beyond to make our night fun. Our tour guide was also very knowledgeable and gave us great insights into local life in HCM.

A Must do for first time Vietnam visitors!! - It is the first time for us to visit Vietnam. We have decided to do this tour to experience the traffic and a few of the best landmarks in Saigon. The tour leader was very informative and friendly. The girls who are the drivers are amazing, friendly and we had a few good laughs. I will recommend this tour to any body, does not matter what age you are, you have to do it!!! The drinks and food we were offered on the tour was amazing.
Keep u the good work and all the best.

Let your hair down! - This is the second foodie tour I have been on in Vietnam. I liked this tour as we got to meet other travellers on the tour. The food was delicious and far more adventurous than I would normally try, but I was feeling up for it... (with a little help from some happy juice). We went to about four different eating venues, the last was by far the best in the 'mafia district' where we ate some fabulous seafood and were entertained on the street by a fire breather dancer. This tour also takes you through the streets with stops along the way to also talk about the culture and different areas of Ho Chi Minh city. A great evening... thank you!

A really fun experience! - We booked the XO food tour in mid March as we were keen to see what it was actually like on the roads and to get a chance to travel around Ho Chi Minh and sample some of the street food. The girls that we travelled with were professional and fun and were able to tell us more about the city as we travelled with them on the back of their scooters. The food places were great -I’ve tried things I never thought I would and eaten in really authentic Vietnamese places. The tour took us to districts outside the main tourist zones too- everything from the old Chinese district to the newer modern ones. Our group was really fun too and in between the meals there’s a chance to chat and get to know the others on the tour. Would definitely recommend this I had the best time!

A Must Do Experience! - We did "The Foodie" motorbike tour with XO Tours on our last night in Vietnam, and it was the highlight of our 2 week trip! I highly recommend this tour group if you want to experience the real Ho Chi Minh City - on a motorbike amongst the throngs of people, eating amazing local cuisine, and being very well taken care of. Our drivers Trang and Halle were very safe drivers, excellent cooks and along with Sang, our tour guide, provided great info about this wonderful place. Truly a unique evening not to be missed!

Highlight of HCM - Really really fun night tour, tour guides were excellent drivers through the Saigon chaos and were v funny and informative. Got to experience districts of HCM not many tourists go to, not to mention the fun of being on bikes. Dinner provided was also really nice.

Big shoutout to Chau (1) & Loc xxx

Sights tour HCMC - We had a great tour of all the main sites in HCMC. The girls were all lovely and had brilliant English, we both received inside info from the guides during our drive around the city and lots of history of each of the places we visited. They even recommended us some restaurants which have all been great.

This is a great way to see the main attractions plus a few lesser known parts of the city.

We felt very safe throughout and would recommend the sights tour to anyone

XO Evening Foodie Tour - My wife and I ate some amazing food and had a great time touring the city on the back of a scooter. The Girls were experts at navigating traffic with some rather large Americans on the back. Thank you for making this a fun experience.

A night we'll never forget - We were advised before leaving Australia that one of the best things we could do was to book an XO Girls food tour, I'm so glad we did. We ended up having an extraordinary experience that we'll never forget. The care and attention to detail made it possible to feel the true heartbeat of Ho Chi Minh city. The food was great, the XO Girls, Ngan and Ting were fantastic in the crazy traffic and our tour leader, Vu Luu, was full of enthusiasm and information that really added to the experience. We couldn't recommend it highly enough if you want a taste, in every sense of the word, of the real Ho Chi Minh city

Indescribably Good! - Probably one of the best sightseeing tours I have ever experienced! Not for the feint hearted as it all happens on the back of motor scooters, however it was brilliantly organised and superbly operated. We saw sights and tastes that the Vietnamese experience daily. Numerous districts visited all with there own highlight. As I said words can’t describe it, this is truly an experience I believe most people would just love! Thanks to Quynh Anh my superb scooter driver!

Great night out - This tour was a fantastic evening. Great guides super informative. 10 different dishes and ones you would never find on your own. The bike ride around the city was a great way to explore too. A must do

Do this tour - Highly recommend the “foodie” tour. Felt really safe & well protected by all the XO crew. The tour starts in HCMC & takes you to it’s outskirts where you can try the most beautiful Vietnamese dishes - they’re “yummy.”

The tour guide Khoi was knowledgeable & provides a great photo service so you can really enjoy the food. The girls we rode with - To & Anh - could not have been better. They were lots of fun & always ensured we had enough food & drink.

Recommend doing this tour at the start of your time in HCMC.

Great tour and drivers, do at the beginning of your stay in Saigon - Me and my girlfriend took the Saigon by night -tour on the last night of our four day stay in Saigon. I wish that we would have taken the tour at the beginning of our stay as the tour revealed to us many new sides and areas of Saigon. Many of them we would not have discovered on our own.

Our tour guide Sang told very interesting facts about Saigon on each stop of the tour and with good humor. Our drivers, Nee and Flaa (I am probably misspelling the names, sorry about that) deserve a special mention: They were really skilled scooter drivers but also really interesting persons and they kept the mood light and discussion going on.

We can definitely recommend participating on a scooter tour from XO Tours. We consider the tour was well worth its price.

You'll get more out of this tour than any guidebook - 5* - If like us you treasure food, good company and adventure, you shouldn't look further than this tour. We're a young couple and had arrived in Ho Chi Minh City Airport an hour before the tour. We rushed to the hotel where our drivers, Thao and Nhat were waiting. Incidentally, all the drivers are women, as the founder of the company had great respect for women and wanted to give jobs and careers to women. We chucked our bags in the hotel and we were off! Throughout the tour we visited three restaurants, two cultural spots and went through 14 dishes, all of which were local delicacies - not the tandard banh mi or pho that you can find everywhere.

The thing that really made the tour was the history, stories and banter you'd receive from your driver as you dashed across the chaotic streets and highways of Saigon. Thao was so sweet, with perfect English and a great sense of humour.

I'm sure i'm saying what countless others have said before me but this tour is a fantastic introduction to Saigon and one I won't forget.

Amazing Experience - This had to be the most amazing experience we have ever had. Exploring Vietnam on a scooter is a must. We felt safe the entire time and the ladies were very friendly. The food was amazing and very delicious.
We highly recommend this tour

Best tours! - My friend and I did both the Saigon by Night and the Sights tours and both were incredible! We were a bit apprehensive before the tour about being on motorbikes in all the traffic, but felt comfortable right away. We both enjoyed being able to see a lot of the city by bike. All of the girls were so sweet and fun and both Sang and Hieu (our tour leaders) were friendly and very knowledgeable about the areas and sights we went to. Everyone with XO was wonderful and we couldn’t have asked for more enjoyable tours. They were definitely the highlight of our time in Saigon!

Just do it! - After watching all of the motorbikes from our hotel window, we were very excited to be a part of the action. Our eight-year-old had a blast zipping through the streets, and the two adults had a great time as well. The drivers were friendly and fun. The tour guide did a good job of answering our questions and sharing some of the cultural aspects of Vietnam with us. Come thirsty and ready with a sweet tooth because you drink and eat some sweet treats along the way. What a fun day!

Best tour we did in Saigon - This was the best tour we did during our visit to Saigon and Nha Trang in Vietnam. If there is one tour you should do while in Saigon to get a feel of the city, this should be it and you will not be disappointed.

We did the Night tour which lasts about 3 hours because we did not feel very adventurous enough to do the Foodie tour. But that did not mean that you did not get to taste some street food. We were treated to some Banh Mi and Com Tam (pork) to savor at one of the stops and this was followed by dessert at the last stop. So you do get a taste of the street food, just nothing too exotic or if you don't like fish. In any case, you get a choice to suit your taste.

We could not rave more about this tour. Tai (our tour manager), and Linh and Nga who were our drivers/tour guide on this trip were excellent and kept us engaged every minute while we were on the bikes.They answered all the questions we had about Saigon, the places, people and culture while driving around and this was done without any of the hype. Their English was excellent.

XO only uses female drivers and we felt really safe on the back of the bikes in their hands (including my wife who was initially apprehensive about getting on the bikes during evening rush hour in Saigon !) but that is a big part of the experience. The reason why chaotic traffic works in Saigon is because there is a lot of give and take. Everyone yields to each other and honking is not done in anger but just to let others be aware of your presence.

There were only four of us on the tour (including two other girls visiting from the US) so it felt like a private tour. When we were picked up at the hotel, there was another company waiting to pick up their guests on a similar bike tour and there must have been at least 20 bikes.

After a very brief intro (none of the "sign this waiver" stuff you get in the US) we were off into the 5PM rush hour traffic. We first went to China town to get a feel of the night market selling poultry, fish, fruit etc and then went on to tour several over districts including one where most of the expats lived. So we saw a a good mix of the poor and rich side of Saigon (good to get out of District 1 where all the tourist hotels are located).

The whole tour was a lot of fun and finished around 9PM as traffic calmed down a bit (relatively for Saigon!) and after our stop for dessert of flan and coconut dessert. This tour provided a great mix of adrenaline, culture, food and good company.

Thanks Tai, Linh and Nga for a great evening! We would do it again when we are next back in Saigon !

Absolutely the best - Ho Chi Mihn is not one of the great Asia cities to visit, although it does have some highlights, principally street life, tea shops, the coffee and of course food whether in fancy restaurants or in the street food, so when you get to combine some of these together you have the makings of something truly great. The XO foodie tour is one of these, yes the food is good if not great but don't expect gourmet this is a collection of street food 14 plates in all, in restaurants around the city which would be difficult to visit if being not taken. My driver spoke great English as I believe they all did, and were highly educated young ladies. She truly excellent in her knowledge of all manner of questions which I asked and her excellent skill in driving her scooter, making me feel absolutley safe and at ease.
