The tour leader was also very knowledgeable on the areas which we visited and adding to all of this a ride on a scooter around Ho Chi Minh for 4 hours and the excellent manner in which we were able to get to know other people on the tour made it "Absolutely the best part of my trip to Ho Chi Minh.

Brilliant morning - I was a bit worried about booking this tour with my 3 year old but what a brilliant morning we had! The lady drivers were lovely and great riders. We got to see loads of the city. The tour guide was great, the stops were just long enough .... brilliant. Could not fault anything.

What fun! A highlight of our trip! - Two of us weren't interested in doing a scheduled tour off our cruise ship, so a friend recommended XO Tours. We did a shopping tour. Shopping was so-so, but the experience of riding around on the back of a scooter through Ho Chi Minh City was priceless. We had two ladies driving and one gentleman as a tour guide. All I can say, I will never forget it. What a blast!

The greatest way to start your trip in Vietnam. - We organised the tour over the phone with XO and we set off the following evening at 4:30pm. Not only was the food amazing (1x Vegetarian) but we had 11 courses of it! The ladies were fantastic at their job and fit plenty of information in around culture, history and sights. 1st time in a scooter/bike and felt more safe than we imagined we would. The guides were kind enough to jot down a few further dishes to try based on our tastes. They were taking photos throughout the night and we’ve just been emailed a copy, they’ve turned out great. Would highly recommend as a starting tour for your Vietnam trip.

Wonderful foodie tour - This was one of the highlights of my 10 day trip to Vietnam ... the girls driving are all amazing and great English, I learnt a lot about the different districts in this amazing city as well as sampling lots of different food, very good value for money and felt so safe on the bikes and looked after as male drivers accompany the girls.
Thank you to my lovely driver Linn, she was just lovely and learnt a lot about life as a young lady in this part of Vietnam, I highly recommend this trip and well done to the owner of the company who also came along with us, a great idea to have lady drivers, it was 10 stars out of 5.
Amazing ride - XO TOURS offers amazing scooty rides to enjoy the beauty of the city and relax , Xo tours offers an remarkable tour.

XO City Tour via motorbike - Enjoyed the city tour with our drivers Tien and One (? spelling). We were also accompanied by our guide, Sang. We were 2 adults and a 7 year old child. My husband rode with one driver, and my daughter and I rode with the other driver. We were a little apprehensive about getting on a motorbike in Saigon but at no time during the tour did we feel unsafe. As we had limited time in Saigon, this was an efficient way for us to see several sites and learn a bit about the history of Saigon. Would recommend this tour.

Come early in your trip and get to know this amazing city! - My wife and I are both vegetarians and wanted to find some good local “ăn chay” (vegetarian food), so we booked the Foodie tour and specified that we were vegetarians. Not only did we have amazing vegetarian food at every stop, they brought out so much that our fellow tour mates were able to try a greater variety of food!

The guides (Onah and Thao) were excellent English speakers and us having different guides ended up being really fun–we compared notes and shared our different conversations for days afterwards. Zipping around the city on a motorbike sounds scary at first, and I am not at all a thrill-seeker, but I ride a bicycle back in NYC, so was comfortable and never felt in danger. Streets are mostly smooth (so few cars that the pavement is in good shape) and the motorbikes are comfortable and clean. The food was outstanding, but riding around the city at night with the breeze was by far my favorite part of the tour.

Khoi, our lead tour guide, has a masterful command of the English language and a real knack for being a guide. He was able to pivot his sightseeing “script” easily and his sense of humor is appropriate and fun. He took pictures all night which helped us stay in the moment and enjoy our guides and the other tourists more than if we were constantly on our phones editing Instagram posts. Taking pictures from the back of the bikes is not allowed, for good reason, so I think next time I plan on bringing a helmet mounted action camera, as the best sights were definitely along the route instead of at the stops.

We definitely recommend making this one of your first things to do in the city to get a sense of the layout of the city and find some spots you are sure to return to. We are both so excited about coming back to HCMC and taking another XO Tour! We hope to see our wonderful guides again soon and see more of this amazing city and her wonderful people. Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều Khoi, Onah, and Thao!

A fun evening with great food, great memories - I did the Foodie Tour with my husband and my two children, aged 12 and 10. What a great way to discover different areas of the city and to eat great food!! We have had some of the same dishes in different places in and around HCMC after the tour, and none was nearly as tasty. The ladies are very careful drivers and very kind and attentionate, and provide you with loads of information. My 12 year old was really scared of going in the crazy Saigon traffic on a scooter, and almost refused to do the tour. After 5 minutes on the scooter, he had a huge smile on his face, which he kept all evening.

Best night in Ho Chi Minh City - My fiancée and I loved this tour. We did the food tour at night by scooters and it was amazing. Would highly recommend. Girls looked after us and Sang and the security guys, felt very safe. Thanks for an amazing experience Sang and team.

Absolute hightlght... !!! - My husband and I attended the foodie tour with my 14yr old. It was the most fabulous tour and highlight of our trip. All the girls girls guiding us were personable and so easy to talk to. They looked after each of us the whole night and the food experience was great! We loved getting a chance to experience a peek of life on the roads and Sang the tour leader was so pleasant and full of interesting knowledge. My husband is a little on the plus side and was worried going...but the tour accommodated with a bigger bike and I think he certainly would have regretted not going in hind sight as he love every minute. We had been recommended by friend and I too now can't recommend it enough. Keep it up XO Tours

Saigon sight tour - Absolutely amazing. We took the morning sight seeing tour and it's magical. It was only myself and my husband as the other people cancelled last minute. Our guide Tuan was extremely knowledgeable and very interesting to listen to as he presented lots of facts in fun way. Our drivers Tien and Nhung were simply superb. We loved every single minute spent on this tour. Felt safe at all times as both are excellent drivers. Also, extremely informative. Could not recommend more. Thank you for making our time in Saigon so memorable.

Ps. Thank you for taking the pics :)

A perfect way to get to know Ho Chi Minh City, its food and its people - My wife and I took 'The Foodie' tour last week, and were absolutely delighted with our experience. Travel by scooter was fun and we felt very safe throughout our journey, not least because of the wonderful ladies who chaperoned us over the evening. We found the conversation insightful and fun, and the food was diverse, exciting and brought out our more adventurous sides. This is the quintessential 'off the beaten path' tour, covering parts of the city I never would have visited on my own. We left with great memories, and I would strongly recommend XO Tours to any visitor to the city.

Amazing - We took both the Sights tour and the Foodie tour in the same day.

Both tours were excellent and exactly as described.

The ladies driving us were professional and safe. The tour guides on both tours were excellent and informative.

We felt safe and well cared for the entire time on both tours. XO Tours has it down to a science. Everything was well coordinated.

We would recommend XO to anyone wanting a fun time in Ho Chi Minh.

Fantastic - This was really worth doing as a good look into Saigon life outside of the tourist areas. Really well organised, very informative drivers & tour leaders. The food was great & the explanations with it. Well worth the dollars

Highlight of our trip! - I was considering a scooter tour from a couple of companies, and this one was recommended by a local. It was by far the highlight of our week in Vietnam. The food, the guides, the atmosphere, and the other members of our group were all top notch. I highly recommend this experience to anyone who is looking for a fun way to spend an evening exploring - you'll get to experience parts of the city and amazing food that you would never find on your own. Do it!

A great evening out! - As a Westerner, the Saigon Foodie Tour was nearly overwhelming with the introduction of the many new foods, smells, and HCM traffic but it was well worth the price for a wonderful new experience while abroad! My driver, Binh, expertly navigated the streets and highways of the various Districts while generously answering my trillions of questions and making me feel comfortable and safe. I was surprised that our tour leader, Sang, although lovely, was a male. It's a big operation with "bodyguards" paired for most drivers so only the drivers are female but sitting with them to eat and driving around with them was really fun! I highly encourage all people, even budget travellers, to go outside of your comfort zone and to try the delicious foods and motorbike experience that XO Tours has to offer! I'm so glad that I did :)

Excellent food, excellent company/drivers, and great tour leader! - We have done many food tours as we've traveled around the world, and the XO Tours in HCMC is one of the top of the list. First off, the scooter/moped drivers are all females so here's to female power and feminism! SEA countries should provide more opportunities for females so this was great to see. They all spoke English fluently, and our tour leader, Tuan Nguyen, was very knowledgeable about HCMC and Vietnam in general and he was very friendly and kind. We ate SO MUCH food! The food is excellent, and gives great overview of the types of great cuisines available in HCMC. I would recommend this for any and all!

Way too much fun! What a way to see the city. - I have to say that this was the highlight of my first trip to Ho Chi Minh City. We had a group of nine and were all amazed. The nine drivers roared up to our hotel a few minutes early and took us on a five-stop tour that lasted about 4 hours. The ride through traffic on a motorbike is an experience in and of itself. Great food at three of the stops that made for a total assault on the senses. This is a WOW excursion that should be mandatory! Don't forget to tip your driver!

A one of a kind foodie experience! - While planning my trip to HCM months back, I found XO on TA & the great reviews sparked my interest in trying this one of a kind gastronomic experience, another reason also was the insurance coverage. Our guides Dang & Ngi (hope I spelt it right) was superb! They were fun, caring but professional at the same time & I salute you girls for your expertise in weaving through traffic with inexperienced pillion riders! The tour leader Luc was also amazing, he had great humour & took time to explain about the districts we were visiting & the food we were going to taste throughout the night. So, well done XO team for a wonderful night & keep doing what you're doing! The food was yummy!!!
Siagon Foodie Tour - Excellent tour - drivers are friendly, fun and safe. Food was excellent. Really great way to see the city and experience the hectic streets!
City tour - Very professionally run tour. Very safety conscious and a lot of fun. Felt very safe on the bikes and toured areas that only locals go to.

Girl driver motorcycle tour - We booked XO tours as it had great write-ups on safety. My wife is 67 and I am 69 and we were both a bit apprehensive about touring Hi Chi Minh city on back of motorcycles. It was brilliant and we loved it. It was very well organised with safety stressed. A great sightseeing tour in groups of 8. We would thoroughly recommend it.

Gastronomic Adevnture - The foodie tour of Saigon (provided by XO tours) was everything and more!

My first impression about Saigon was the crazy traffic but my apprehension was quashed by my wonderful foodie tour guide Ne, who calmly navigated the thousands of motorcycles and scooters on this aptly named tour.

The many stops for wonderfully authentic street food (believe me, you will not leave hungry) were interspersed with sightseeing in this beautiful vibrant city.

The all female drivers, spoke perfect English and were a delight to share the evening with. Ne was the epitome of elegance and good taste, whilst Vu the tour leader (and security) was engaging and informative.

I learnt about Vietnamese culture,
Vietnamese food and Vietnamese dreams on a gastronmic adventure around the city.

If visiting Saigon, this tour is a must!
Foodie Tour on motorbikes - Wow! This was alot of fun. The drivers were amazing and safe. I would recommend this to anyone that wans to experince Vietnamese food!

Amazing experience! - We had been to Ho Chi Minh City 2 years during the Tet and were unable to do this tour however the wait was worth it. As a "foodie" this was an amazing experience, even for my wife who was concerned about eating street food. The entire evening was wondefful and made all the better by our two "drivers" Quynh 2 and Ning. It was very fun and safe and a great way to see many areas of Saigon that you wouldn't normally see and taste real Vietnamese food that the locals eat.

Un Reliable Vendor - We booked and paid for this tour, and it was to take place during the Lunear New Year. We did get a confirmation and infact were told it would cost more since it was during the holiday. The day before the tour, we called to confirm, and were told that they decided to cancel the tour.. I guess not enough people. I then had to call the company I booked it through( in the USA) and get them to try and get a full refund.. which they did. I would not use this vendor again. We booked something very similar using another company

City Sights and Foodie tours are AWESOME!! - We took the Foodie tour on Saturday, March 10 with Ning and Tu and then the City Sights tour on Sunday, March 11 with Dong and Thuy. Both we outstanding. Our drivers and guides were great on both tours. We had some trepidation about being on motorbikes in the heavy Saigon traffic insanity, but our drivers and their professionalism quickly made us feel at ease. The food was interesting and diverse as we made three food stops and two cultural stops. We thought that it was going to be a long tour, but the time flew by so fast that we weren't ready for it to end. Our guide told the group that no one should leave the trip without feeling totally full, and that promise was met as they continued to provide as much of the food that we wanted. The city tour was very interesting and also had some food and drink stops, all of which were provided by XO. These tours are both fun, interesting, and well worth the cost. I would like to do them again tomorrow!

Food tour and more - unforgettable night! - This is an amazing experience! It's not just about the food as you will get to see different parts of the city as well. Our tour manager Tai was very knowledgeable and the girls Nhu and Nga were excellent drivers - they kept us entertained all the time!

I highly recommend this tour!
Thank you XO Tours for a great night!

FABULOUS WAY TO SEE THE CITY!!!!! - Driving in Ho Chi Minh city could be a frightening experience but today, being on an XO tour around the city was a fantastic!! Our drivers picked us up at our hotel and after a short briefing on riding on the back of a motorbike, we were on our way to see several sites. The women who drove us were wonderful - competent drivers, calm and VERY knowledgeable tour guides! We were also accompanied by Tai, who gave us the information about each of the stops we made. We stopped at the main post office, local market, where we got to taste some local treats, through the shopping districts, a Buddhist temple, and saw some Vietnam War era landmarks before returning to our hotel. This company is topnotch. We have another tour planned with them (THE FOODIE TOUR) tomorrow and I am very much looking forward to it, if it is anything like today's.
XO Tours is a great company with exceptional tour experiences. Happy to have been with them!!!

Great experience - Loved seeing all the different parts of Saigon I'd never have seen otherwise. Got to go to restaurants where the locals eat. Would never have gone there without the tour. Food was yummy (mostly!) and varied and the girls are terrific. The scooter travel was quite exciting and the info from the guides about the city and economy etc was interesting.

Amazing Tour and Value! - If you're going to book a tour, you want one that your truly couldn't do by yourself. Nevermind low-priced walking tours that don't show you much, XO Tour "The Foodie" is the best tour in Ho Chi Minh. Knowledgable guides, great drivers, and as much eating and drinking as you can handle. Get beyond the Pho and the Banh Mi in District 1 and take this tour next time you visit. We enjoyed it very much.

Fantastic Saigon by Night Tour not just for the young - This was the best way to experience HCMC and the drivers and guides could not have been better. We covered 5 districts and saw areas we would never have found on our own. They answered questions and explained things all along the way including questions about food, traffic, language and culture. My husband and I are over 60 and were wondering if this was just for the kids, but we had a great time and highly recommend it for everyone. This was also my first time ever on a motorcycle and that was not a problem.

Best night in Ho Chi Minh City! - Booked XO tours because of a friends recommendation and I'm glad I did. Hands down the best night I had in Vietnam. The entire XO tour group took such good care of our group from meet up to drop off. The scooter was ride exhilarating and the food was astounding. The girls were great throughout the trip and taught me a lot about Vietnam. Will definitely book again!

Amazing food and so much fun - We have done food tours all over the world and this ranks as one of the very best ever. The food was delicious and plentiful. Our scooter drivers, Dang2 and Thao4 were amazing drivers and gracious hostesses during our tastings. Tuan, our tour leader, was informative and fun. Seeing HCMC from the back of the scooter gave us the feel of really experiencing the city. We traveled through many of the districts to see what life is like outside of district one. All in all, a most memorable evening.

I would give XO ten stars if I could. - Second time around with these girls and guys (Trang (3), Nhung,Linh (1)
Lo An and Quang) on both group and private tours.

The time, thought, care and attention put into the tour is amazing. Honestly it’s one of the best things I’ve done - whizzing around HCMC and eating (and we had different dietary requirements which were well catered for) delicious food with the nicest, most charming, chatty ladies imaginable. They are beyond delightful.

I am not going to eat for a week and I would come back to HCMC just to go on XO tours again.

Truly, I can not recommend them enough.

The Peole Mkae This Foodie Tour So Much Fun - Some of thenfood was really good and some of it was just ok. That being said we had an awesome time. The young ladies that drove us around were so much fun and their manager/leader was also awesome. The group of tourists were also so mich fun. We learned a lot about the vietnamese culture and daily life and they made sure that we were always having a great time. I highly recommend that anyone that goes to ho chi minh goes on the foodie tour with XO.

Amazing foodie tour!! - I have never been on food tours before but after this tour, I have very high expectations! A great way to see ho chi minh outside of the touristy District 1. All the staff were professional, organized, friendly, spoke English very well and funny! My husband and I had a great time.

Great time! - I booked the "Saigon by Night" and "The Sights" tour. Everyone was so nice and personable. They are really good at what they do. We went through different districts within the city. They were very knowledgeable and also offered good places to go on my leisure time. I also enjoyed riding around the city on a motor bike and not once did I feel unsafe. I would recommend this to anyone coming here. I was able to meet really nice people on the tours from all over as well. One of my favorite parts was when we stopped for dinner and deserts. Sugar cane juice is sooo good.

The best way to explore HCMC and taste the local food favorites! - We did the "Foodie" tour and had the most amazing time! In addition to hitting up many local food hotspots, the tour provides a unique way to visit the different districts of HCMC and to truly experience what it is like to get around like a local--on the back of a motorbike! The drivers are pros at what they do and never once did we feel unsafe or scared amidst the chaos and insanity that is HCMC traffic. We highly recommend this tour for all food lovers!

A must-do in Saigon! - We (I am 30 and my 60 year old parents) did the XO foodie tour. I can't say enough good things about this tour. The food is great and at times adventurous but that's really just one part of why this tour is great. The drivers are so friendly, informative, and fun, willing to answer any questions and really allow you to get to know what the lives of local Vietnamese people are like. As well as 3 food stops you also make some site-seeing stops which allow you to see districts around HCM that you wouldn't otherwise see as a tourist. We are already planning to do the Hoi An tour when we go there. I definitely recommend this tour!

The best way to experience HCMC - An absolute must. We had a fabulous time tonight. My driver Twee was gorgeous and the most hospitable guide you could wish for. It was a fantastic opportunity to try some new 'taste sensations' in a fun environment with great people. Thank you Twee and Minh for a memorable night.

Don't hesitate! - A great introduction to Ho Chi Minh City in the company of our obliging and knowledgeable guide, Loc and our two very professional drivers, Lin and Tan. Not only did we visit so many of the city's memorable sights and learn of their history but 'in transit' conversations with the girls gave a fascinating insight into Vietnamese life. At 60 and 70 plus, friends and family thought we were crazy booking this trip but it really was a fantastic experience and despite the traffic chaos around us, we never once felt our safety compromised. Thank you XO for such a memorable tour.

Great fun - Fantastic very professional on time very slick operation from the time you book till the minute you finish the tour
Highly recommended

Amazing experience on the Food Tour of Ho Chih Minh City - I went on the food tour a few days ago and could not be more pleased with the overall experience. All of the guides on the trip were incredibly friendly and engaging throughout the tour. I do want to give an extra praise to Tai, our group lead, and my driver Quyen. Tai was awesome, he was highly energetic and spoke English really well, which surprisingly I found to be an issue on many other tours that I booked while visiting SE Asia. Quyen was also great, she definitely wanted to make sure I was having a good time and comfortable on the bike as we road around the city. I never felt nervous on the back of Quyens bike, which when I initially booked I thought might be the case since I had never been on a scooter before. At the same time, it is clear she enjoys her work as we ended up doing scooter karaoke and took turns singing our favorite songs as we cruised around the city haha.

The tour itself was also fun and delicious. I was pretty much stuffed after our first food stop but they broke up the food with other informational non-food stops so that you can get your appetite back before having to eat again, very smart. I'd highly recommend it for anyone visiting Ho Chih Minh for the first time.

Don't think - just book it! - Don't bother reading the reviews, you won't regret booking this tour - it was awesome!!!
Great staff, great service, amazing food.

Absolutely fantastic! - What an amazing experience! Not only did we get to see Ho Chi Minh City from the back of a moped, but we also got to try so many different dishes. Great food and completely new taste experiences! The girls were super nice and helpful, and the tour guide Tai was excellent. An absolute must for everyone who visits Ho Chi Minh City and wants to see more than just District 1! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

XO Tour of Saigon - I cannot praise this tour enough.

I chose the day tour and booked online prior to arrival in Saigon. The tour runs from 8.30am to midday and I was picked up promptly at 8.30am at my hotel by scooter. I met with my fellow tour team members and the main tour guide who at every stop will provide us with details of the historical significance and separate facts from fiction.

The scooter drivers also provided interesting facts whilst we zipped through the City from location to location and were very friendly and attentive.

The stops at the food market to try some deserts were a nice touch too

Stop what you are doing and book this tour NOW - My partner and I did food tour by night 2 days ago and it was absolutely amazing. The guides are very knowledgeable and speak very good English. Dieu and Tuong made us feel welcome and a part of their family and they were very funny. It was great to see the other districts and try authentic Vietnamese food and to see how the locals live. I didn't want the tour to end as I had such an amazing experience with this tour. I can't recommend this tour enough as I want to go it again. XO

Sightseeing Tour was awesome! - I am so thankful we booked this tour! The tour guide, Sang, was great, knowledgeable and friendly. He provided Information and insight that i never would have known or found on my own. The ladies driving us on scooters were so sweet! It was neat to drive around the city on a motor scooter like the locals. I never would have been able to do it on my own. The other drivers on the road are so crazy! I highly recommend this tour. It gave us good insight into what we wanted to come back and see in more detail.

We loved this tour! - This is definitely worth your money if you are in Ho Chi Minh for the first time. You'll get a wide variety of things to eat. They are also very accommodating to dietary needs (I am vegan and my sister is vegetarian). The women on the tour driving you around and all very kind, educated and super helpful. This was a wonderful experience.

XO foodie tour. Just hopped off the bike. - “Tie” our leader for the night, and the XO ladies were brilliant! What a truly awesome night. Fantastic experience. All the usual as expected I am sure as there are lots of these companies out here....Our hotel said these are the best. 1) sage as woman drivers take fewer risks and 2) they turn up on time! Simply...but we had the history of where we visited. Eat quail and frog! You choose! Lots to eat and drink. The all ladies drivers in uniform spoke perfect English. We drove all over the place. Back streets and way out of town. 5 districts we visited. This was more than we expected. 6 stars. 75 dollars per person. For 4 1/2 hours. At least half of it driving. Just do it.

Tuyet (Tweet) is the best!! Two thumbs up for my great tour guide! - Loved this XO tour! Tuyet and Vu were fantastic!

Answered my million questions about their lives in Ho Chi Minh and ate some delicious food throughout the evening. Best part was the motorbike ride through several districts in Ho Chi Minh city. Fun, scary and worth the experience! Really got a great sample of all the different districts and see the culture outside of the typical tourist district 1 & 2.

As you are on the motor bike a lot of the tour ask all the questions you want, they are happy to answer! Its what you make of it. Would highly recommend to everyone that visits the city to ride with XO tours, especially to choose my fabulous tour guides! Wish I had done the Foodie Tour after all said and done but I think my tour was more intimate and got to see more of the city!

A must do! - Highlight of the trip! Was a very fun and informative day. Girls are very friendly and helpful.
Felt safe on the scooter even though the traffic is insane!

Best Experience in Saigon - Can't say enough good things about XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City. This was an exciting and adventurous food tour to experience the city on a scooter. The food was excellent with a large selection of 14 tasty treats to include seafood meats vegetables and some exotic dishes such as Balute. There were 5 couples on our tour from all over the world which was exciting to hear their stories and world travels. The scooter ride was out of this world exciting.

I could give more stars I would! - We completed the foodies evening tour. From start to finish our hosts, Dieu and Tuong, make us feel like we had known each other our whole lives. Very informative, fun and friendly. The sightseeing and food experience was amazing! It was great to experience the local culture and the lesser known places. The scallops in district 4 changed my life! We were torn between the top 3 here on tripadvisor but are extremely happy we chose this tour, the girls are amazing, kind and fun! And full accident insurance and private security for anyone with concerns. From the months abroad in SE Asia this has been the highlight, my partner and I didn't want the night to end! Thanks XO!

It's a must when you're in Ho Chi Minh! - This tour is super awesome! Me and my gf enjoyed it so much. The gurls are so nice and very good in English, so language is not a problem at all. The FOODIE TOUR is so worth it! Good foods, good bike rides and good people! The easiest way to get a taste of all the local foods in saigon is by doing this tour!!!! Love it and we'll definitely gonna do it again!
Great tour - Great English speaking drivers and guide, took us on an eye opening tour of the cities districts and food halls.
Perfect Tour! - The tour was perfect. Our drivers spoke very good English and were extremely friendly. They showed us the city and we ate a lot of good food! I can only recommend!!!

You have to do this tour!!! - my husband and I spent three weeks traveling through Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand and this was the highlight of our whole trip! we each had a tour guide who both spoke brilliant English and were so down to earth and knowledgable about the food/area/culture. the food was out of this world!! we got to try so many different things that we might not have tried otherwise. our favorite was the scallops with peanuts and the crab claws (see pictures) which our guides kindly prepared for us!!
traveling on the scooters was such an experience and we felt so safe with our drivers! This tour is a must do when in Saigon!

Excellent - Was lucky enough to find place on the Foodie tour, as I booked a day ago. Driver/guide was fantastic, punctual, very educated and spoke perfect English. Although I told her that I do drive motorbikes, she still put me through the safety procedures. We visited 5 or six different districts. In total, we ate 12 different dishes...all very nice. Was planning to book the city tour with XO, but unfortunately I don't have the time. Will definitely be going on another tour with XO on my next visit to HCMC. Highly recommended

Best tour in Saigon ever, food or otherwise! - Easily the best tour experience in Saigon, food or otherwise. The girls on scooters showed up on time at our hotel, and took us on a very informative and eye-opening ride through the different districts of Saigon, each with its own feel and history.

The girls are fantastic (ie safe) drivers, very fluent in English, and very knowledgeable about all aspects of Saigon. Not to add witty and fun!

The restaurants/food themselves are decent but I wasn't mind blown. But if you factor in the extensive knowledge and guide from the girls, as well as the length of the tour, it's very much worth the price if not more.

Lives up to the hype! - We had a fantastic time on the Saigon by Night tour. Our drivers, Tam and Hang, were super friendly and professional and the ride around the city at night was a real thrill. This is a tour that really lives up the hype and is well worth the money.

Amazing, amazing, amazing!! - If you want to see Ho Chi Minh at night and enjoy amazing local food whilst on a bike this is the tour for you!!
I cannot praise this tour enough!! Picked up from our hotel by our individual drivers, we were taken to our first stop where our tour leader introduced us to our amazing team of guys who would look after us all night and informed us about the tour. From there through out the night we enjoyed local food, amazing sights and expert transport on the back of bikes.
The food is incredible and limitless with unlimited drinks too.
The ladies on the bikes are amazing drivers and make sure you feel safe at all times, even sharing interesting facts through out the city as you drive and amazing conversation!!
We were also really pleased to learn that the tour leader takes pictures all evening and will send them to us via email!
Well worth it and a once in a life time experience!! Cannot recommend this tour or combing enough!!

Yo! - Booked the private Foodie Tour for four. Best money I have spent in a long time. Lady drivers were superb. Skillfully and safely weaving through the insane traffic, they were adept at entertaining and educating, explaining the various food items and keeping the tour moving along at a good pace. They even happily catered for my vegetarian and gluten-free friend. This tour is an absolute must-do! They even took photos and sent them to us free if charge to remember our tour by. A classy operation from start to stop. Book ahead - I can see why they are #1 on Trip Advisor.

fun morning touring around Saigon - We joined XO tours for the sightseeing tour of Saigon with our 4 yr old...not feeling brave enough to rent a moped for the 3 of us, we thought this would be an experience for our son - and it was! we all had such a fun morning and covered a lot of ground and places we would never have found on our own. One of our favourite activities on our 8 week trip for sure. Highly recommend for a few fun hours if travelling with kids. Our riders were great. Thank you!

Phenomenal food tour! Must do. What an experience! - XO Tours Food Tour was an absolute seamless and fantastic experience. From correspondence with Ms. Nguyen in booking and her accommodating for allergies etc to the actual tour leader Mr. Tuan to my personal driver Tam everything was 5-star and above and beyond!

I've been to over 20 countries and done my fair share of tours and I'd have to say the overall experience this ranks in my top 2 tours ever. The food was obviously clean, yet authentic and mouthgasmic street food, but it was beyond the food. Mr. Tuan was informative with a great sense of humor and Tam was beyond witty with her humor as well and answered every question I had about Saigon while riding on the back of her bike. Her engagement in conversation as well as her English skills were impeccable!

Everyone else in our group of 8 also had similar praise and thoughts about the tour. If you are in Saigon and want a fantastic evening experience this food tour is a must!

Food tour - Well what can I say , I rarely write a review but having just returned from this tour I feel compelled to , the young lady drivers were fantastic, friendly knowlegable and enthusiastic , the ingredients for a great evening which we definitely had. Just want to start all over and go again, thank you so much xo tours and twee for the great evening of food and beer

Experiencing Saigon traffic on scooters at night. Feb 24. - This night foodie tour was so much fun. Hang and Ann, I'm sure I'm spelling their names wrong(excuse me ladies), picked us up at our apartment. These two ladies were amazing, the knowledge they passed along both on the bikes and also at the restaurants was so informative. Their handling of the scooters in traffic was great.

I think driving throughout the city might have been more fun for me than the food which was so tasty.Sang met us at all the stops and was very informative, passing along tidbits of the local areas we were in.

I would not hesitate to do this tour, they are very professional in their driving but also love joking while sitting around eating.

Thank you XO tours

Fantastic Food Tour - This well organized, enjoyable and informative tour was one of the best things we did whilst traveling around Vietnam. Competent and caring female motorbike drivers took us to places most visitors don't get to see. The combination of food & history stops was perfect, giving us lots of local knowledge. The mini guide books were really helpful too. This tour is worth the higher price that you pay.

Magnificent tour - Sometimes reviews can be a little long and there is so much I could say about this tour. So what I will do in this instance is keep things very simple. This tour is fantastic. We had were in our early 50's and had a wonderful night riding on the back of vespa's driven by fascinating, intelligent, lovely young ladies. You will see the sights of the city at night, meet friendly people and enjoy great food you may not normally eat in Vietnam. You will eat where the locals eat. We highly recommend you include the video in the package. This is a must when in Ho Hi Minh city. You won't be disappointed.

Highly recommend this tour!!! - I have never enjoyed a tour as much as I enjoyed this one. The scooter drivers and tour guide were not only very knowledgeable and patiently answered all our questions, they had all had a delightful sense of humour which only added to the fun of the tour. The scooter drivers and tour guide are what makes this tour so interesting and fun.
If you are thinking about doing this tour but are hesitating because it is on the back of a scooter - don't!! Our friend that did it with us is at least 70 years old and he loved it and had no problems at all. We got to see a different side and learnt so much but the country we were visiting. Traffic was no problem with the scooters and all the girls were very careful drivers and at no time did I feel unsafe. Helmets were provided. The time just flew and before I knew it, the tour had finished.
If you do this tour during the day - make sure you put on sunscreen face/arms/legs as the sun can get a bit burning as you ride around the place. There is secure storage on scooter for your handbag whilst you are zipping around and bottled water was provided.
Can't recommend this tour enough !!!

Highlight of our trip - We did two of XO Tours tours in one day - the sights tour and the foodie tour - and it was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

The traffic in Ho Chi Minh City may look a little chaotic, but everyone knows what they are doing, are courteous of others on the road and realise that everyone just needs to get where they are going. When you are actually in it, even on the back of a scooter, you realise how safe it is and how well it all works.

The drivers, all girls, were excellent. They were knowledgeable about the city, great riders, and strong too -able to balance the scooters even with passengers much bigger and heavier than themselves. Both tours had plenty of stops where we joined back with our group and our guide.

The highlights of the sights tour for us were the monument to Thich Quang Duc (the Buddhist monk who set himself on fire in protest of the imprisonment of his fellow Buddhist monks), the Vietnamese yoghurt at the Binh Tay market and the ice cold sugar cane juice drunk on the back of the scooter on the way to Chinatown.

The highlights of the foodie tour were seeing this beautiful city at night, the barbecue and shots of banana rice wine and the seeing the contrast of the newer Korean district as compared with the city’s older districts.

Booking the tours online was a breeze. Would definitely recommend it.
Excellent - Wife and I found this to be one of the best tours. Excellent guides and evening full of experiencing the outer skirts of Saigon

Enough said! - I've reviewed XO over the last five years; apart from changes of staff, nothing has changed. They still provide a great product; try it, you'll like it! (I don't usually go for organized tours, but I have done their food tour five times). They are good, simple as that.

Best night out on scooters! - We did the exploration at night tour. Hanh and Lin are super fun guides and drivers. Luc met us at each stop for more information. The food was delicious and abundant for us.
Would do this tour again and highly recommend!

One of the best tours we've had - My husband is enjoying many great tours as we travel through Thailand and Vietnam, and this is one of the best. Our drivers and guides made the evening stand out. Great way to learn about the city, and you can have a good conversation with your driver while on the scooter. Our drivers were terrific - capable, fun and informative. It was exhilirating to experience riding a scooter in the hectic traffic of HCMC. The dishes were abundant and delicious at each stop, so pace yourself if you're not a big eater. My husband is allegorical to shellfish and they gave him superb alternatives when necessary. This is the ultimate way to experience HCMC! I would recommend it to anyone

Great Evening on Saigon by Night Tour - 3 of us took the Saigon by night tour we were lucky as no one else booked for that evening so was effectively a private tour. We stopped at a number of places and got given of interesting facts and info. All 3 ladies were great drivers (Yung was my driver and Loan my wife) and went out their way to make a good evening.

Their was good options for food (3 choices) and they even bought extra fruit to try after seeing it in the market section of the tour.
Really fun foodie tour - Don't miss this ! A great way to see a few of the districts and talk to locals as well as eat a bunch of different food. My wife and I loved talking to our drivers.

Best Tour you can do In Ho Chi Minh - This tour was absolutely fantastic. We would do it again in a heart beat. Our two girls Hong and Traci were just amazing. Not only did they navigate their way through the chaos of bikes on the roads but did so whilst talking to us and giving us an overview of the areas we visited. The food was absolutely amazing and we did not have to do a thing. The girls even peeled the crabs for us. At first being on the back of a bike is a bit disconcerting but the girls are so great we quickly forgot about it and enjoyed the whole experience. You also feel very safe as XO have security guys who also ride along with you to protect you on the roads and in the street markets you attend. We ate the best food during the night...so much so nothing else for the rest of our visit really compared. Definitely worth doing if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Amazing tour! - I cannot recommend XO tours enough!! My husband and our friends took the “Foodie” tour in Saigon. Not only did we get to eat so much delicious local food, the motorbike tour of the city was incredible. It was exhilarating being on the back of the bike, flowing through traffic. Even in some crazy holiday traffic, I always felt safe being driven by the expert XO drivers. All of their staff were safe, professional, and so much fun!

Night Foodie Tour Saigon - Such a fantastic tour, a must do in Saigon. Picked up on time, and before getting on bikes we were given clear instructions as to what to do, not to do etc. All felt extremely safe in the hectic traffic, all the girls great drivers and full of information along the way. Food delicious, and taken to places you may not try by yourself. Lots of laughs. Thx to Thuy, Dang 2, Duyen 2 & Ngoc 3, Quang Le and the boys for making it such a wonderful night.

Really cool Bike tour!! - Me and my friends took a night foodie tour. We could try a lot of Vietnam street food and restaurant cuisine. And we enjoyed sightseeing Vietnam TP. Ho chi min by using Motorbike.-It really cool!!- We could listen local news and histories from my partner guide wearing Ao dai. I think , XO tours is amazing , useful and reasonable price.
친구들과 함께 투어를 함께 했습니다. 밤 먹거리 투어 신청했습니다. 영어만 되신다면 정말 친절하고 영어 원어민 같은 수준의 영어 가이드와 오토바이를 타고 호치민 도시 전체를 구경할 수 있습니다. 오토바이를 타고 고속도로를 시원하게 달려보았습니다. 볼거리도 많고 먹거리도 많습니다. 지역 소식이나 역사에 대해서도 들을 수 있어서 좋았습니다. 추천해요!!

Super fun tour - We really enjoyed the nighttime foodie tour - a great opportunity to try local foods, seeing lots of tdifferent parts of he city by motorbike (latter part not for the faint of heart) and the drivers/ staff were very good. Thanks Nhung for your expert driving and humor.

Just Do It! - Agree with all the great things written already but just to add that as an over 50, overweight, sole traveller who has never been on a motorbike before I was slightly nervous. There was no need - the women who drive the bikes are very competent and make you feel completely at ease.

I did the Foodie tour and the Sights tour - both very different and I learnt a lot and really enjoyed myself.

Great fun, great food, great company!

Fun and informative way to see Hoi Chi Minh - My husband and I went on the foodies tour during our stay in HCM city.
Such an awesome tour! The girls that drove us around ( Phu and Quin) were very professional, fun, knowledgeable and most of all safe driving around in the cities crazy traffic!
We stopped at numerous ( 4 or 5) restaurants in different districts of HCM. Visiting different districts in itself was an eye opening experience and great way to see HCM. We tried different Vietnamese cuisine at each restaurant, if you are brave ( unlike me) there is a lot of food to try! I'm not keen on seafood and they catered very well for me, go hungry to make the most of the food as it is plentiful!
The other tour guide ( Tuan) was fun and very knowledgeable.

Would definitely recommend this tour especially if you only have a short time in HCM.

Great hostesses! - I felt completely safe with my lovely driver, who told me wonderful stories about her life. It was a great thing to do the day we arrived and introduced us to the city while we got over jet lag!

SAFE experienced riders - NEW bikes - MORNING SCOOTER TOUR. 2 smartly dressed Vietnamese women arrived at our hotel to take us on the tour. They were very EXPERIENCED riders and their bikes were new and in excellent condition (safe).
We covered a lot of ground and went to many places where there were no other tourists. Everywhere we went there was a professional tour leader (Tuan) and a couple of other guides who were in the background GUARDING us from touts and pickpockets.
Great tour with door-to-door service.
Foodie Tour Saigon - My husband and I had a wonderful time on this tour our first night out in Saigon! The drivers were friendly and knowledgeable and the food was delicious! would highly recommend!

A must do - We did the sights tour and the foodie tour. Both are excellent value for money. Great fun being driven around the madness of HCMC traffic, but felt very safe with the girl drivers. We visited places and tried foods we would never have found without taking these tours. Very professionally run from the booking process to the pick up and drop off at our hotel and a nice touch was they emailed us photos of the tours afterwards. Thanks XO.

Magical and cinematic "Foodie" Saigon night tour - This was such an incredibly unique, special, and truly mind-blowing experience. We went in not knowing too much what to expect, and it truly exceeded any expectations we had. We had limited time in Saigon (only 2 days), and we felt like we got a very good feel for Saigon after this tour.

My husband and I we were picked up by Ngoc and Lam, two kind and bright young Vietnamese ladies who spoke fantastic English, and we hopped on the back of their motorbikes and off we went! The ease and skill with with they navigated the bustling and seemingly lawless Saigon streets was breathtaking. My husband works in international travel, and he said this was "probably the number one travel experience ever." You really feel as though you're in a movie as you weave down alleys you otherwise would have never explored. You pass small families washing their vegetables and preparing their dinner meal in a small alleyway, then pop out into a huge bustling street with incredible shopping and high risers, then cross the river into a new district...really just magical.

We stopped a number of times at different 'street food' restaurants, all of which were incredible and served bizarre, unique, and local food. We tried some strange and delicious things, and had no stomach problems whatsoever.

The entire experience was guided and narrated by the one and only Tai Dang, a kind, enthusiastic, well-spoken, and knowledgeable young man. At every stop he was either explaining the importance of certain dishes, discussing the historical significance of certain areas we stopped at along the way to the next restaurant, describing the lifestyle of the typical Vietnamese youth or family, or just joking around and having fun with us if that was our mood.

DEFINITELY one of the top experience of my husband and my lives, I couldn't recommend this experience more.

You have to take the foodie tour - The foodie tour at XO was the highlight if our 2 week tour of Southeast Asia. The guides are wonderful young women....bright, fun-living and delightful hosts. Riding in the back of scooter at night through all the districts in the city really makes you experience Ho Chi Minh City in a way ni other tour could,
The food and the venues are great and exoand your food experience to a new boundary (especially if you're from the west.....this ain't Mickey D's Toto!)
My daughter did this tour 3 years ago, told us it's a mustand she was right,

It's not just a tour but a totally fun evening and unique experience.

It’s the experience.. - Sure you can eat just as well at lower cost, but you get to see (emphasis) Saigon / HCMC and to eat in authentic places. And best of all you get to experience the travel by bike through this insane city.

Six of us and most had never been on a motor bike. But you realise that this apparent chaos is relatively relaxed with no great machismo or aggression. The ladies who escort us through the mayhem are simply fabulous.

If life is about experiences then this is one not to miss if you’re in Saigon. Stunning!

Fun, food and facts - We booked a half-day private tour to explore Saigon and it turned out to be a really memorable experience with a perfect mixture of fun, food and facts. We enjoyed the company of our drivers Thao and Hang and our guide Hieu very much - they all did an excellent job, being very kind, knowledgeable and having a very good command of English. Our three guides gave us an excellent insight and an understanding of Saigon within a rather short period of time. We started at the famous post office and the cathedral, had a look at the independence palace, visited a local market, learned about the story of the Buddha monk and marvelled at a wonderful pagoda in Chinatown. Inbetween we tried some delicious fruit and sugarcane juice, Yummy!

5-Star night foodie tour - I will try not to duplicate what has already been said many times before about this tour but can not recommend tour this highly enough. Planned and booked before we arrived and communication and interface with the company went very easy and professional. Our young, friendly, professional scooter drivers picked us up at our hotel right on time, explained the plan for the night and gave us the standard safety briefing on the scooters and put us at ease about riding on the back of the scooters in the organized chaos of HCMC traffic. We met up with the rest of the group (8 total guests in our small group), and our overall tour guide (Quang Le) at our first stop for an excellent Pho. The overall guide did a great job the entire evening briefing us and giving us more details and history on the places we visited, he was very professional, entertaining and had a good sense of humor.... and excellent english! Overall the food part of the tour was a very good introduction to the HCMC street food scene and if we had to rate on food alone I wood give it 4-stars. BUT the real gem of this tour is the driver/guides, the 2 young ladies (Binh & Trang) we had where just fantastic, young, vibrant, educated ladies that did everything they could to ensure we had a good time. Their willingness to share their knowledge and passion for both the present day and the history of their country helped us both to learn a bit more about Vietnam. At the end of the tour we felt more like new friends then customers who had been guided on a tour around the city! hats off to XO Tours for a first class operation, and if you get the chance "JUST DO IT"!

Traveled with a baby and had a great time - I will preface this review and note that we are a couple who have ridden on motorbikes on multiple occasions, and one of us even owned a bike for many years. The difference here is that we now are parents to an infant.

So we booked the foodie by night tour several months before our arrival in Saigon and were very unsure about doing it once we got to the city. In fact, we were still debating whether to opt out minutes after the tour started.

I must say that the entire crew at XO Tours couldn’t have been more professional, reassuring and understanding.

From the tour leader Sang — who patiently listened to our concerns and never pushed us to go one way or the other (i.e., to stay or to go), his leadership guiding his team who clearly enjoyed working with him, and his love and knowledge of the city — to the broader crew including the security lead who trailed the motorbike with our baby ever so closely to be on standby to provide an additional set of eyes and hands should we ever need them (no concerns there at all), this team is what made the difference and turned an evening that started with near dread to one in which we could finally relax (at least a little!) and truly enjoy the food and the hospitality so generously granted by our local guides.

Most of all, we genuinely appreciate the two ladies we rode with: Phuong and Tuyet. They knew our concerns and did everything they could to make us feel at ease. And of course, most importantly, they were amazing, amazing, amazing on the bikes and made us feel so good about the whole situation that we were soon smiling and laughing as we noshed at the stops and chatted with them while on the bikes.

There are now so many bike tour companies in Saigon. Since they don’t actually supply the food per se, the real barometer is really the people and the service they provide.

So go tonight with these guys.

Brilliant fun - Yes, it's expensive but the XO street food was the highlight of our 3-week trip. The tour is very professionally run & the girls are excellent drivers & great company- they really go out of their way to chat & look after you. The food is very tasty too. Definitely worth the money.

Simply awesome!! - We decided to do this tour given the positive reviews on TA, best excursion in HMC. I called the morning of the tour and was able to do the evening foodie tour on the same day, no issues. We were met by our motorcycle drivers at our hotel who both were young, friendly and very assuring about the tour. If you've seen the organized chaos HMC traffic can be like, after this tour you will feel confident that the traffic is nothing but a symphony missing a conductor! We never felt uncomfortable in the traffic and the girls drove in a calm manner, always asking if we were ok.
The tour included three food stops in various parts of the city and accommodated our "no pork" request. The food was plentiful, freshly made, and all dishes well explained. We even tried frogs legs, goat, and were offered a chance to taste boiled egg containing duck embryo (I opted out!) The dishes we had were delicious and good, we were full by the end!! Beer is included as well as water and soft drinks so no worries there.
The tour manager Koi, spoke great english and explained a great deal about VN and the city--good job!
We received an email a few days later with a bunch of pics that were professionally done at no charge. We didn't opt for the video and now regret not doing it :(.
For $75USD, it was well worth the price!

Fun - Embrace the traffic maelstrom that is hcmc and dive right in on the back of a scooter. My wife and I did the Saigon by Night tour and really enjoyed it. Our guides were 22 and 24 year old wonderful women who were careful, superb drivers and spoke great English. While this was not the foodie tour, we did tour a night food market and then stopped to eat local street food, which was plentiful and very good. I’m sure we could have saved a few dollars on a similar tour elsewhere, but we liked the idea of supporting this business that employs women. Memorable evening.

Night Tour - Last night we went on the night food tours. After looking at reviews for XO I said to myself how is it possible to be rated so high (the skeptic in me) I’m not going to get into the food part but the hospitality part. We are staying at a five star hotel and every member of XO knew more then our concierge.
The best mingling and interacting with locals.... it was spectacular!!!!!
By far the best thing to do in this city....... Too bad we can’t give more ⭐️

What a blast! - When I told my husband I had booked the scooter foodie tour in Saigon he thought I had a death wish. With some convincing I got him to go and let me say it was one of our highlights of our visit. From the pickup to the drop off everything was top notch. Our lovely young female drivers took very good care of us as we maneuvered through the traffic. They were both knowledgeable and enjoyable to be with throughout the evening. The tour leader was professional and made sure we were well fed. We sampled many delicious dishes in various Districts of the city. All I can say is don’t hesitate to book. It is an adventure you won’t soon forget.

Sights and Food tour - both awesome! - We did both of these tours on our first days in Ho Chi Minh City. It was a great way to see the city and be a part of the hustle and bustle! The guides were awesome and we felt perfectly safe on the scooters. Both tours were informative and fun. Essentially no overlap, which was nice. The food tour introduced us to food we never would have tried on our own - at places we never could have found. Overall, my family would definitely recommend XO tours!

Awesome Foodie Tour - We went on the Foodie Tour a few weeks ago whilst in Ho Chi Minh. Booking was very easy and emails we replied to quickly. Everything was explained in the emails with the added bonus that payment could be made at the end of the tour.
Not the cheapest tour on the market but I would expect this is the best tour available and the best reviewed tour.
We were met by the girls exactly on time and given the relevent safety information.
My wife was aprehensive about being on the back of a motorbike but her driver soon put her at ease and we were all driven around in a very safe manner.
The gilrs were lovely,very polite and knowledgable about the food.In addtion to stopping at food stalls we stopped at various districts and given a talk about the history of the region which was very informative.
The food was amazing and avoided the normal tourist dishes.The girls provided us with beer to drink and as much food as you could eat.
We ate amongst other dishes ,pho, goat, beef, crab claws,quail,clams,scallops,frogs,prawn & beef skewers,greens,vermicelli rice and various deserts.
Also to the delight of everybody I ate a duck egg foetus which was delicious.
The eating stalls were in different districts and filled with locals and we just blended in.
The atmosphere was very good and friendly.
We booked a video and at $40 is a steal.This arrived by email a week later and is of very good quality and backed by music.We have a permanent reminder of a great evening in Vietnam spent with lovely people.
Again thanks to the girls and if we are back in Ho Chi Minh in the future I would not hesitate to book again.

Best tour ever - We were pushed for time and had booked a three hour tour that needed to be condensed into two and a half. The girls and the guide did a brilliant job, we squeezed everything in and loved every minute. We felt safe and so well looked after, thanks XO

I am so glad we did this! - We followed the positive reviews and it was brilliant. There were 13 of us together friends and they managed us brilliantly. Each one of us were passengers and we all argued as to had the best guide in terms of their skilful driving, wonderful personalities and fantastic knowledge and language skills. What a great way to enjoy the chaos and life of the city and be introduced to the food.

A must do in Saigon - Riding a motor scooter through the nightmare traffic in Saigon with a very experienced and skilful driver. What a sensational way to see this beautiful city. Scary at first as you sit on the back of the bike and dodge and weave through the city. Simply the best and most exhilarating way to see this city and all of the major sites. Would do this again in a heart beat. The drivers are wonderful people.

Must do! - We last did this tour 3 years ago. It was so good that as we were travelling through Ho Chi Minh again we decided to do it again! We were not disappointed! The girls are all delightful & make the evening sooo much fun. The food is good too. I tell anyone going to Ho Chi Minh to do this tour!
You Have to do This Tour!! - This was the best tour my husband and I did in Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City..Both drivers were professional, friendly, knowledgeable of the city and excellent driver's!!!

Morning tour of Saigon - Had an awesome morning touring with the XO group. They packed so much into the 4 hours I had with them. There was only one other person in my tour so we lucked out and were able to ask a lot questions and learn a lot.

We went to a local market, tried some local fresh food, went to a temple, many sights around the city and learned a lot about the history. Of course all of this while exploring the city on scooter which was so much fun!!

Best tour in HCMC! - I did the foodie tour with XO and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. I was initially a bit hesitant about getting on a a back of a moped and scooting around town, but actually it was really fun and I felt very safe.

You get to visit districts which are off the beaten track and eat where the locals eat. They always give you the option to try something a bit different, but not necessarily too challenging - for example - I discovered just how good kumquat juice tastes when squeezed on scallops and why chilli salt should always be eaten with papaya. Things I will take home with me and try!

The whole XO crew led by Loc were a pleasure to hang out with. This might be a bit more expensive then other tours in town - but I think you get what you pay for.

Thanks guys for an awesome time :-)

Great tour, ok food - Very well organized food tour. There are drivers that take you to the stops, men in Black who get to the restaurant early to organize the tables, a tour lead who explains the food and the cultural sights. The drivers go out of their way to ensure you enjoy your time, they grill the food at bbq stop, de shell your seafood and are very hospitable. The food however was not much to write home about. The tour does include different types of food (bbq, noodle soup, and unique foods like duck embryos and frogs). However we’ve enjoyed tastier foods in HCM. If you’re interested I. Trying different types of foods and getting a tour of the city, this is the right tour for you. If you’re looking for memorable foodie experience, suggest venturing out on your own or exploring other options

Saigon by Night tour - The Saigon by Night tour offered by XO Tours is an outstanding experience in rain or dry! The enthusiastic girls drive their motorcycles to many different districts of Saigon during the tour and share their knowledge and culture of the city. You experience street food at its best and the tour leader explains in detail key information about each district. A fun way to see the city and a must do tour!
Loved! - Loved everything about this food tour. We did the night motorbike tour and the guides were wonderful and the food even better.

#1 thing to do in Vietnam - If you visit Vietnam and don’t go on a motorbike with XO tours, you are missing out on a the time of your life! Our family, ranging from 4 - 66 yrs old had an AMAZING time riding on the back of motorbikes and eating our way through Saigon. It was the best memory of our vacation. The tour was very well coordinated by Sang and his team AND he even emailed pictures he had taken of our family during our tour! We can’t wait to visit Vietnam again and take another XO tour!

Fabulous Foodie Tour on Motorcycle - Terrific in every way - the food, the sights, the guides/drivers. Great way to really see Saigon and taste the real,not tourist food and places. Can not recommend highly enough. It would be a mistake to visit Saigon and not do this tour withXO.
Also did their Dinner with Nuygens in Hoi An , a terrific walking tour in the countryside.

So much FUN--and GREAT food! - We booked the evening food tour and really had a fantastic time. Initially we weren't so sure we would enjoy the bikes--but they really made the tour so much more enjoyable. I felt like I was part of the energy of the city as I zipped along holding on to the bike. Totally different experience than being isolated in a car or van. Even our 4 year old had a blast! As for the tour itself--the ladies picked my family up at our hotel on time and we were given a couple quick safety tips to ride on the bikes. Then we took off and were taken to a central meeting point where the other people on the tour met us for our first meal. We chatted and got to know everyone, then headed off to our next location--really got to see a lot of different neighborhoods in Ho Chi Minh City and heard about the differences in each area. All the food stops were great and also included beer and water. I tried some things I probably would not have normally tried, but everything was so good. I highly recommend this tour--a highlight of our trip!

Best foodie tour in HCMC !! Go on !! - Great experience ! Ours drivers were pleasant and smiling ! We had discover restaurants without tourist and local dishes ! And ours « bodyguards » were very peaceful ! We get somes history of the city and people whose live here ! I recommend this tour! It was perfect !!! Thx so much !

Foodie tour - I've been in the airline industry for over 30 years and traveled the globe...this by far the most fun I've ever had! Eat and see the city like a true local.
None of your typical Vietnamese fare on this tour...its fresh and served with unlimited beer.
Tai our tour guide was funny and full of little known facts about Saigon and Vietnam in general.
This tour is incredible and would be different each time you took it. And don't forget about your drivers !....very witty and safe as they navigate the wild traffic of Saigon...
We will be back!!

Just do it! - I was admittedly a little nervous, but our drivers Lyn and Moon took such good care of us. The whole experience was run like a well-oiled machine, and at no point did I feel unsafe, even as we made our way back in the most absurd grand final football traffic! Thanks to them, and Tuan for a great experience, especially for ensuring The Vegetarian was so well fed!

Awesome tour of the city - We went on the Saigon by night tour on the back of scooters and it was fantastic.
U are right in the middle of the crazy traffic but the drivers just take it in their stride.
Great dinner and dessert on the way.
Get to see different districts and learn a lot more about the city on the way.
Well worth doing and good price.

Foodie Tour in HCM - incredible fun, but know what you're getting! - We did the tour as six friends with only 2 nights in HCMC and it was well worth it! Hugely impressed with all the staff and food.

Reasons to do the tour:
- Want to see lots of the city in a small amount of time; you get taken through different districts and told about each one, often places you'd never think of visiting/have time to see
- you want to see the city from a scooter but don't want to ride yourself; although you don't get to walk around the districts, riding through the streets and alleys on motorbike feels almost the same. Most of the time is spent on the back of a bike and talking with your driver (all of whom are lovely and interesting!)
- you want to try different dishes in safe places; you only stop at a handful of places for dishes (not really stall by stall for one dish), but the variety is great and it is delicious. Most of the dishes we'd never heard of before and we liked them all a lot.

Reasons not to do the tour:
- you want an 'off the beaten track' experience; by virtue of being so popular, you'll likely see a few tours following behind you. At our last stop, there were still locals around but a lot of tables reserved for the XO tours, compared with some of the other shops we passed packed with locals. But that's part of the trade off with the company choosing safe and reliable places.
- you want a traditional food tour; it's not a walk through the market, shop by shop, affair. It's as much a city tour as a culinary one.
- you want to do things on the cheap; the tour is 'expensive' (esp for Vietnam) at $75USD but does include insurance, lots of staffing (all of whom are excellent), a fun way to travel and all you can eat/drink. One could achieve the same fullness for cheaper with a large enough group, a private driver, and a lot of research into what to eat, where to eat it, when to get there (and an order in which to do all the above), if you weren't interested in the scooter experience and the cultural/personal aspect of the interaction with your rider and guide who live in the city. For us, the scales tilted greatly towards the tour being a worthwhile and memorable experience. We'd even call it a 'must-do' for those with a similar mentality to us!

Don't Miss This Tour - Traveling on the back of a motor scooter through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City on this food tour should be at the top of your to do list in Ho Chi Minh City. The ladies and tour guide speak excellent English. You visit 5 the Districts of HCMC where the tour guide gives you a little history about each one. The restaurants visited are where you'll be eating with locals and eating what they eat. The ladies on the tour are attentive and make sure you have an enjoyable time. Best tour I've been on in a long time.

Great Experience - Traveling on the back of a scooter is the only way to experience the craziness of HCMC streets. We were somewhat apprehensive about safety before the start of the tour, but we quickly became comfortable in the traffic. Drivers were excellent and your safety is their priority. Food was very good and our conversations with the drivers were enlightening for all.

Superb - This tour was brilliant. We’re a family of five and we all had an awesome time learning about life and food in Ho Chi Minh City as we whizzed round town on the backs of motor scooters.

We booked a private tour and all of our guides were excellent. They were all amazingly generous in sharing their stories and perspectives on life and culture in Vietnam.

This is a world class tour and a real highlight of our family visit to Vietnam. Don’t mess around ... book it!!

Such a fun night! - We only had one night in town and this was the perfect way to see the city. The girls are fantastic and amazing drivers. It was so fun racing through the city on motorbikes. We got to try all sorts of interesting foods and learned a lot about the different districts which we couldn’t have done on our own. We’d definitely recommend XO Tours.

An unbelievable and genuine way to tour Saigon - We did the day and night tours on the same day - and WOW what an experience. We saw so much - both the touristy stuff and the things only locals see. We all LOVED our tour guides - we did not want to say goodbye at the end of the night. We only had one full day to see Saigon - and after these tours we felt we had seen the city and, more importantly, really gotten a feel for this fantastic place. And to tour amongst the hundreds of motor bikes made it that much more enjoyable. We have taken many tours in cities around the world - and none have been better than this one!

'Saigon at night' tour was an amazing experience - We had Hieu as a tour leader, and Linh and Phuong were our divers.
It is an incredible experience, we had so much fun. We learned a lot about Saigon and also about the country. They are very knowledgable.
On this tour you get to see the real Saigon outside of all the touristic places...how do they live, where do they shop or what do they eat...for instance. We also tried very good Vietnamese food that after two weeks in Vietnam we didn't even heard of.
Also the traffic in Saigon as everywhere in Vietnam is crazy and the experience of been on a scooter was really fun. Our drivers where very prudent so we never felt scared, in fact we felt very secured all the time.

I recommend this tour to everyone that come to Vietnam, you won't regret.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - I booked with my wife and while we were hesitant based on the price, after experiencing the evening foodie tour we thought it was worth every cent!
The ladies are sweet and kind and excellent riders. They are engaging and enthusiastic, as was Tai the host and guide. We were fed some incredible food (noodle soup, goat, beef, frog, ochra, crab, clams, scallops, coconut jelly, etc), as well as given information on it's background and the areas that we visited. Unlike a lot of tours, drinks were included and there was no shortage of these either.
We had an excellent time and would recommend it to anyone of any age or background.

Hands down is the best - There is a reason this is number one and definitely a reason to pay a little bit more. I'm so glad I got to get on a motorbike. I will say I'm a smaller person and I think if you are a little above average size wise you might feel squished. I was happy to see so many districts. I enjoyed the breaks between meals and learned more about each district. It was a lot of food so save room! I also liked that the girls cut up the food and helped us with what to eat and what everything was. Highly highly recommend!

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh! - I highly recommend XO Tours! What a fantastic experience! Only female drivers, studying at the university and they speak very good English. They drive calm and professionally and I, who was quite nervous about the traffic, felt safe. We (my driver and I) talked along the ride and I got to know a lot about the country and her everyday life as a young woman in Vietnam. We had so much fun! Sharing the same humour. And all the food we ate and different areas of the town we drove through! Really recommend! A must!

Amazing Food Tour - Thanks so much to Hang and Ha who were our lovely drivers tonight. Hubby and I had a great time, the food was delicious, we learned about and visited different districts and were kept safe and looked after amazingly. Vietnam have just qualified for their football final tonight so the streets were absolutely heaving with bikes and people- I cannot say just how busy it was!! It was a fab atmosphere so exciting being amongst all the traffic and the girls drove so expertly and safely that I never felt nervous. I cannot recommend this trip highly enough - it really was a special way to end our 3 days in Saigon.

Awesome way to see Ho Chi Min City - My teenage daughter took the Saigon by Night tour on our second night in Ho Chi Min! It was absolutely a highlight of our whole Vietnam trip! The girls on the bikes and the tour guides took us to see a cross section of Saigon, to districts we would never have seen by foot! We had a terrific meal and it was just so exhilarating, safe and the most fun!

Absolutely Fantastic - I, my husband and 13 year old son did this tour on our first night in Saigon. It was one of the best experiences we have ever had in our travels. The girls were amazingly friendly, making us feel comfortable from the moment they met us. Quang our tour leader was entertaining and full of information. We learnt so much about the city. Riding through the streets of Saigon and on highways to the different districts was totally exhilarating and the food was delicious. I don't eat meat and they provided heaps of vegetarian options. I couldn't eat it all. Drinks (inc beer) was also included. This is the best way to experience Saigon. Would recommend to anyone. Thanks XO...the tour will be something we will always remember!!

A must do with these charming ladies. - Last night we did the Night sights tour with our 11 and 15y old kids. My daughter was rather anxious however the ladies were very caring which put her at ease straight away. Our guide, Vu was very friendly and informative and was and able to answer any questions about HCMC that we had. It's a good idea to take a scarf, for the fumes. Very safe, food was delicious, brilliant guide & drivers, can't fault it in any way!

Motor Cycle City Tour Of HCM City - First class tour of the City sights with stops at Central Post Office , Norte Dame Cathedral , Presidential palace, markets, etc...

NB: The War Remnants Museum was not included in the tour. This was not an issue for us as we planned to do it by ourselves the next day. Make sure you have plenty of time reserved - as we spent over 4 hours there.

Tam & Linh were our motorcycle drivers and Hieu was the Tour Leader. All were very professional , knowledgeable, very friendly and probably most importantly good motorcycle drivers.

What an exciting way to see the city...

We were told about the history of the various sights and shown things I will never forget.
For example , a view of the CIA building which featured in the iconic Vietnam war photo showing the last US helicopter on the roof of the Pullman building evacuating people from the city. There were too many people in the queue and most never made it to safety.

Great day out . These guys know their city.

Fun tour! - My husband and I did this tour last we and had a blast! The drivers are very safe and all involved (drivers, tour guide) spoke excellent English. You'll not leave hungry! They promptly picked us up from our hotel and off we were to meet the rest of the group (10 guest) at our first stop.
