We saw several very different districts of Saigon including the vastly different newer "Korea town" district where we stopped for commentary and photos.

Best Food trip of my many food trips around the world! - Highlight of our trip! A must do, very professional, amazing guide. Saw places in Saigon we would never have seen, and the food ...... oh the food was fantastic, lots of it, interesting and definatley non touristy.

Amazing trip! - Did 'the sights' tour with this company today. It was the best trip I've ever done! Easy pick up and drop off from the hotel (this may only apply if you are staying in district one however!) The stops were all great, including a market, a temple, and other historic sights- across various districts of the city. Our tour guide was very friendly and knowledgeable too. Oh and it was great fun hopping on the back of a moped to get between each place. Amazing tour and very friendly staff! This was a great way to see Ho Chi Minh.

Must do - Yes, this is a must do. “Must Do” again. In a safe yet very exciting way (on motor bikes) you get to see the city in a quick and efficient way. The guide was excellent, friendly and well versed in international cultural norms. A refined knowledgeable friendly person. Great guy. To top it off, I had a wonderful motorbike ride. The driver was an expert with her bike and calmly and easily navigated the shoulder to shoulder traffic. Very impressed indeed. Aside from a few historical sights one gets to experience some local markets, food (drinks, deserts etc) during the daytime tour. Save yourself time (especially those on short visits) and take the XO tour. If on longer visits, my suggestion would be to take the bike tour first and get quickly familiar with Ho Chi Minh city first.

Night Tour - Being over 55
we were a little apprehensive. We were picked up at Hotel Equatorial by two lovely young ladies who made us feel at ease and WOW it was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh city - the sights, back streets and food tasting were fantastic! Within the first couple of minutes we felt part of Saigon weaving in and out of traffic - 5 Stars loved it!

Saigon by Night - It was an excellent tour. My guide was a careful driver. She speaks an excellent English. We visited many interesting places, we got delicious food and learn a lot about the country, the people and the city. I would always do it again!

Best city experience of all international travels - My husband and I just did the foodie tour with XO and this was by far the most incredible way to experience Vietnamese culture. Riding on the back of a motorbike like the locals while tasting unique foods you won’t find in everyday restaurants and learning the culture and history of Saigon is truly one-of-a-kind! Wish tours like this existed in every major city!

Glad I chose XO tours as my introduction to Ho Chi Minh as soon as I arrived - Lynn and Lynh3 as our “captain drivers” on our motorbikes and Tuan as our tour leaders were all three more than awesome!
My friend and I were really happy we did this 3 hours after arriving in Ho Chi Minh for the first time. The girls and Tuan introduced us to this vibrant city through their eyes which was not the “touristy copy paste” which you easily find. It was as if we were their friends visiting for the first time, and what really helped in this was the fact that we were not in a group but did the whole thing privately.
The food was more than enough for us and really well thought out. Tuan used his humor very effectively explaining in the very little time he had, the areas, the Vietnamese and the way of life these wonderful people lead. I can go on and on......... We both thank you for everything and you are in our hearts.

Geo and Dio

A must for Ho Chi Minh City!! - One of the best experiences - not just because of the delicious food (worth it just for it alone), but because of the great people involved (who are so nice and professional), the fun time joining the waves of scooter traffic, getting to see parts of the city you wouldn't see otherwise and learning a lot of things about them. I absolutely loved it, would recommend in a heartbeat!

Best foodie tour - Ladies are amazing and were great with the kids. We felt so safe and looked after us so well. Really worth doing. Previously we had done the day time tour but this one was much more fun. Great staff!

Top top top tour! - What an experience....
Picked up at the hotel and introduced to the most engaging and informative pair of young ladies that rode the streets with care and compassion for their pillion passengers whom had to put their full trust and lives in their hands(Wheels!)
Without giving too much away it was a laugh and experience from start to end
Fantastic manoeuvring through the scary streets and traffic lights that I only saw through blinkered eyes - I did get brave enough to watch more at the end of the tour, but with multiple undefined lanes at junctions showing total disregard for any kind of road sense.
The food was simply amazing and most edible but drew a no -no line at the egg embryo!
Already recommended to fellow travellers going to Saigon from Phu Quoc where we are now.

So glad I did this! - I was in Ho Chi Minh City for 3 days and this tour was one of our picks on the to-do list. Vietnam is all about food so why not take a food tour, eh?

The girls are very sweet & friendly, they make sure you eat the kind of food you prefer and but also encourage you to try something you otherwise wouldn't. This tour also becomes a nice ride around the city on a bike, if that piques your interest.

Wonderful informative experience - This was such a wonderful experience! We were able to try many street foods and see many different districts that tourist do not seem to visit often. Not only was the food wonderful, but the knowledge and attentiveness that Manager Anh Tai gave all of us was off the charts! Shout out to my tour guide, she was just the very best.

Great fun - A way to see all districts in Ho Chi Minh, and see real life and eat good street food. Tien and Vy took very good care of us. It’s a must, but don’t do groups if you can afford to do private, you learn a lot more

This tour is a must do, great for teenagers - We had a fantastic evening with XO tours with our teenage children (age 14 & 17). It was a great opportunity to get out of the tourist areas, eat with the locals and sightsee in the different districts. So much fun to be out on the motor scooters, taking in the city and eating dinner at carefully selected spots. The ladies are very skillful, safe drivers and are well aquatinted with Ho Chi Minh. It is worth treating yourself to this tour. Kids were very impressed!

A Must Do in Saigon - We had booked the Foodie tour for our first full day in Saigon and in Vietnam, after experiencing the chaotic traffic we were quite nervous, however there was no need at all, our 2 drivers arrived early and chatted to us about Saigon and gave us a brief explanation on how to sit on the back and basic safety information. Then we were off to our first stop, the drivers were so friendly and we felt at ease within minutes. Driving through the traffic was exhilarating and seeing districts outside of district 1 was fantastic. The tour is really well run and definitely worth the money, as well as all the drivers there was our guide Tai who made sure we were always eating and laughing and a team of security always nearby. The food was amazing, my partner does not eat seafood and he was catered for so well receiving 3 huge and delicious meat dishes and snacks while on the seafood stop. Overall it was a fantastic evening, we were entertained from start to finish and would recommend this tour to everyone.

A brilliant way to experience the many facets of Saigon! - The team at XO is what makes this experience exceptional. Tai, our tour leader, was highly knowledgable, very sensitive to individual needs and entirely charming. He even took brilliant photos of us and sent them to us immediately. Our scooter drivers, Nhung & Tam, inspired confidence on the nerve-racking streets, were warm and friendly and made learning about Saigon, with them, a real pleasure. We can not recommend more highly!! Ramani and Neil

Must do! - Our night out with XO Tours was fantastic. We were delayed by 15 mins getting to the hotel to be collected which was no problem as the girls waited for us.
We zipped through Ho Chi Minh on the back of the scooters feeling safe amongst the craziness of the traffic.
We stopped three times in diff districts for food and twice for local area info.
The food was amazing and unique, I won’t spoil the surprise!
Definitely worth the price - could not fault.

"I can see why they are rated so highly" - My husband and i organised this tour the first night we arrived. Great first night experience. We did "Saigon by night" which also included a delicious meal and desert in different locations. Highly recommend this tour. Felt extremely safe with the girls! They were delightful.

Great tour, we really recommended - We were picked up by our two driver on time at our hotel. The selected restaurants and the food was delicious and authentic. The tour guides gave some really interesting background information on Saigon during the stops and our drivers explained a lot during the rides and answered every question we had in perfect English. Driving on a motorbike through Saigon was so much fun.

We really recommend this tour. Do it at the Beginning of your stay, we got back to some places afterwards

Exhilarating, excellent food, lots of laughs, time of our lives! - A friend insisted we book this on one of our two nights in Saigon and we were so glad we did. I had been a little concerned after listening to people's experiences of this city that we might find it overwhelming but I feel that doing the Foodie Tour with 14 other intrepid travellers set the tone for the remainder of our visit and we found the city to be easy, fun and exciting. I must admit to feeling a fraction nervous about getting on a motorbike but reading the other tripadvisor reviews just before the start of the tour gave me confidence and really from the moment of setting off to the end of the tour I had a massive grin on my face. The girls taking us around the city were just delightful - chatty and treated us like old friends. Tai, the Tour Manager was loads of fun and we learned so much more about the different districts than if we had tried to explore ourselves. The food was amazing too - seriously the best crab/clams/scallops/everything I ever tasted. I would do this tour again if I returned and highly recommend it for anyone visiting HCMC/Saigon.

Saigon Night Tour - The night tour was incredible, the highlight of our time in the city. We were a school group of 15 and at first I was concerned about the safety of the students but XO tours was so professional. A great way to get an introduction to the city. Go on this tours!!

Don’t Leave Saigon without doing the XO Tour - We did the Night Foodie Tour with our 17year old son. We all had the best evening. Being amongst the evening Saigon traffic on a scooter is nothing less than exhilarating. I was slightly nervous to begin, however was quickly put at ease with my expert rider. The three food destinations were amazing experiences in themselves, and the food all fabulous! Seeing parts of Saigon, plus the local knowledge isn’t something you’d find on a regular tourist guide and contributed greatly to our overall city experience. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon.

Best tour ever! - My wife, 10 year-old daughter and I took the foodie tour at the end of December. Without a doubt it was the highlight of our time in the country! Our three guides were phenomenally kind, attentive and informative. And the experience they provided - with insight into life in Vietnam’s biggest city as well as some delicious foods - was truly unforgettable. We are not typically tour people and tend to like self-directed experiences, but the small, personal tour structure made for a very special way of enjoying the delicious food and better understanding this fascinating country.

Amazing tour! - This tour was delightful! It is a mixture of a city tour and and a food tour. The guide/driver (I can't remember her name :( ) was awesome, super nice, was able to answer all the questions, I only eat seafood and she had that present all the time. I can't recommended this tour more! The food was delicious and very different. It has been one of the highlights of this trip, I loved it.

A must do! - We did this tour with our 13 and 15 year old sons. It was just brilliant and the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The girls drive you expertly through the busy streets of Saigon while talking to you about various interesting things. The food was great and varied and you certainly didn’t finish the tour hungry. If you’re in Saigon you have to do this tour.

A highlight of our 21 days in Vietnam - This tour was fantastic. Our first time on scooters in Vietnam. We booked this for our last night and so glad we did. An absolute blast .Everything about the trip was amazing. We are a couple in our 60's and would recommend it to everyone.

Super fun! - Great tour! Careened all over Saigon on motorbike eating delicious food. Our driver/guides were awesome and fun. 4 food stops and 2 sightseeing stops, all delicious and interesting.

We had noodles, bbq goat, beef, frog and shrimp, rice pancake. seafood including crab, clams, scallops. Dessert was crème caramel and coconut jelly. Plenty of beer, and a rice wine shot. My husband doesn't eat seafood and they brought him awesome fried chicken and stirred fried morning glory. The motorbike ride is a bit white knuckle because of the insane traffic, but if you're adventurous, this is a must do!

Best trip In Vietnam - Did the foodie tour this evening and have to say it’s been the best 4hours of any tour we’ve ever done.
the girls are all very engaging and informative of culture and each of the districts in Vietnam.
The food was awesome, taking you to places you wouldn’t necessarily go into just traveling on your own.
Felt very safe on the back of the scooter and it was an awesome experience being amongst the traffic and not walking amongst it.
Would highly recommend xo tours on any visit to the city

What a great night! - This was one of our favorite tours in Vietnam!! We weren’t sure what to expect and we were a little nervous to ride on the scooters around HCMC but boy was it fun!! Riding around the city at night is amazing and we felt totally safe with our awesome drivers. The food was delicious, too, and they will give you as much as you want so you’ll be sure to leave full. Would 100% recommend this tour!!

Great fun - This trip was a lot of fun. Tai was a very good guide. The drivers were good. I felt safe all the time at the back of the bike. There was a positive energy throughout the whole trip. I enjoyed tasting the local food in the markets. The guide sent us photos after the tour. I recommend this tour.

Fabulous Foodie Tour! - My entire family loved our foodie tour! The exhilarating ride through Saigon at night was a blast - so fun not having to worry about dying or directions! On top of that, the food experience was awesome. Khoi (our tour leader) did an amazing job introducing us to new-to-us Vietnamese food and arranging delicious vegan and vegetarian options. Throughout it all, our guides were fun, professional, and skilled drivers. My family is so happy we had this experience.

Fun and different way to see Saigon - We took a private evening tour. The ride was fun and as exciting as expected in the Saigon traffic. Felt safe the whole time. The girls were great - thanks Tam and Nok!
We were looked after for dinner especially as I have loads of dietary requirements.
At each stop Saigon life was explained by our guide Sang. It was informative and not the usual guide book spiel.
We had a great time - the tour was completely secondary to the pure experience of being in the traffic on a bike.

Great morning tour of the city. - Riding on the back of a XO guide’s bike is a wonderful way to experience the city. The night tour we took last year and the day tour we took this year were both memorable: well-organized and lots of fun. The young women drivers are polished, skilled, and offer a lot of insight into life in Saigon.

best tour ever! - This food tour is simply amazing! It combines food- and cityexploring in the night at the same time and it’s great! You sit on the roller while one of the professional girls is driving and telling you a lot of interesting and funny things about the life in HCMC. Then you taste up to 14 different dishes on one night- they even have vegetarian options if you order it in advance! Highly recommendable for everyone that will see the city from another point of view and taste some dishes that aren’t so popular yet! Thanks for this great night!

So much fun - I booked this not sure what to expect, but it turned out to be a really great evening, we got introduced to everyone in the group and our individual scooter driver which we got paired with, went to a number of different eating places, food was really good, I tried frog for the very first time, tasted just like chicken, we played a game of with chop sticks this was fun, was a great tour organised by XO, I would recommend them to anyone, thanks guys for such a great night
City Tour Saigon - great tour and nice people - It was a really nice and professional tour. Friendly and competent staff! Highly recommended! Safe lady driver and nice places visited.

So much fun! Loved it! - we were recommended this tour by some friends and it exceeded our expectations. best way to see Saigon at night. the guides, group, food and drinks were all amazing!. exactly what we were looking for, local food with local knowledge.

Best Tour in Vietnam! - Wow, what an experience! We loved this unique tour through various districts in Ho Chi Minh. Riding a motorbike through the city with the safety of a driver was very cool. We would not have tried this by ourselves. We explored parts of the city we would not otherwise have seen. We tried so many new foods along the way. Our team of guides led by Tien Nguyen was outstanding - they were so kind to the kids. They catered well with vegetarian options when needed. They gave a great explanation of where we were and the local history. Definitely recommend these tours.
The best thing we did! - I had such a great time on this tour, my guide Nhi was amazing, so friendly and informative, I loved the entire tour!!

So much fun!!! Amazing food! - You NEED to do this tour. They take you to all these crazy food places, nothing too basic or touristy. They also show you a lot of parts of the city you wouldn’t see on your own. Beware, they will serve you a TON of food (and of course it all tastes amazing). Best to fast the day before! The drivers were extremely safe and friendly so don’t worry about the road conditions
Amazing tour - Well organised, fun, safe, friendly people. Make sure you don't miss out on this - expensive but well worth the cost.

Highlight of our trip - We did the Saigon By Night motorbike tour, and it was awesome. It was a great way to see the different neighborhoods in HCM and experience some delicious Vietnamese cuisine. The ladies who drove us were very friendly and very competent drivers - we felt completely safe with them. Being on the motorbikes was an adrenaline rush, and also the best way to experience Saigon! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Vietnam.

Completely lived up to the TripAdvisor hype - There are a lot of five star reviews for this company, and as any other traveler trying to plan a trip, you ask, "Is this really as good as everyone says?" Yes. Yes, it is.

Like many others have said, seeing Saigon from [the back of] a motorbike is not to be missed -- when you do, you feel like you're a part of the city, as if it's a single living organism.

I am a first-generation Vietnamese American. My mother was born in Northern Vietnam and my father is from Central Vietnam (and both moved to Saigon later before immigrating to the US) -- therefore, I have been exposed to the more "common" Vietnamese dishes available in the US. In addition to seeing Saigon from a motorbike, I was interested to see what foods would be introduced on the tour, so my husband and I opted to do the foodie tour.

To my delight, I was exposed to a couple new dishes on this tour, tamarind balut and fried breadfruit. For those who want more exposure to Vietnamese cuisine beyond pho and banh mi, this is a wonderful tour. I was also enthralled to learn more about modern Vietnam, as I feel that first-generation Vietnamese Americans have a very stunted view based on our parents' outdated perspectives.

PRO TIP: We were lucky and only booked the tour 2 weeks before the tour date, but was told that our particular tour had a very long waitlist, so I recommend booking early. I would also recommend doing this for your second night or further along when you're not jet-lagged. It's a great opportunity to socialize with others on the tour as well as your guides.

Adrenaline Rush on a food tour?! - Well, where do I begin?! Who could have thought that this would have been such an adrenaline fuelled food tour.

To begin, for the more experienced travellers you would understand the chaotic nature of traffic of most SE Asian cities, so you would need to be very bold or extremely experienced to even consider riding a motorcycle here in the heart of HCMC. So what is the next best thing? Outsource it to an experienced tour guide, that's what XO Tours is about!

XO Tour seems to show you where the great food places are while also showing you the more charming aspects of the city. The tour manager and the drivers on our was top notch. We all had such great fun and got a taste of what HCMC has to offer. For those that are looking for some fun on the streets do not leave the city without doing this tour. There is a reason why over 90% of people highly recommend this tour (they start fearing for their lives but end up wanting more).

The drivers also seem to have a unique talent of pointing out (while still having both hands on the bike) the best places to eat! If you see Tai (a tour manager) make sure you pick his brains about life in HCMC.

What are you waiting for?! BOOK NOW!

Vietnam Holiday Highlight - Our family from Australia included 13/16 year old girls and we took the XO city tour. It was easily the best tour and experience that we had during our two week trip to Vietnam and Cambodia.

It might seem scary to be on the back of a motorbike amongst the streams of other bikes and cars mingling all together through the packed roads of a crowded city like Ho Chi Minh but there is actually incredible politeness and curtesy to the way they all interact with each other.

The ladies who drove us were all extremely competent riders and our whole family always felt completely safe zooming around this amazing city. It is fun, exciting but definitely not scary. My daughters also loved every minute.

All the guides were super friendly, always smiling, happy, enthusiastic and spoke very good English and they were all extremely proud to be sharing their incredible history.

Had the other tours not been booked out, we would have taken other one on another day.

Take our word for it, don’t see Ho Chi Minh stuck in traffic through the window of a bus or van, get in amongst the action on the back of an XO bike.

Highlight of our trip - If you're thinking about doing this tour, don't hesitate for a second! It was by far the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. My partner & I don't eat meat but the seafood & vegetarian options were absolutely amazing. We didn't feel that we missed out in the slightest - if anything we thought our food looked even better than the meat eaters!

The tour combines stops at local eateries with an insight into Vietnamese culture. We learnt more about local life in a few hours than we did on the rest of our trip. Quang was a great host and made us all laugh.

Having spent a few days observing what looked like total chaos on the roads I was very apprehensive about getting on the back of a bike but the girls who drove us around were brilliant and put us at ease. There does seem to be some method in the madness! There is a lot of time spent on bikes so bear that in mind if you're really nervous.

Overall this was a brilliant tour and I'll be recommending it to all my friends who have trips planned to Saigon.

What a great experience. - I have been more than once on their night city tour and I loved it each time. It's just such a different way to see the city but more than that, the girls (tour operators) have such an enthusiastic attitude. They genuinely love showing you their city and that is what makes it such a great experience.

Food and fun - This was an amazing and fun tour around the city.We were a group of ten and everyones guide was friendly, the food was excellent and abundant, we were all stuffed after the tour .This allowed us to see the city from another angle alltogether. I sincerely recommend this as a must do in HCMC.

Foodies Tour - We decided to do the Foodies tour on Xmas night as something special. The girls were waiting at the designated meeting spot and greeted us with big smiles. We absolutely loved every minute of this tour, went to places and ate things we would never have tried by ourselves. The girls spoke great English and made us feel special until the end. Heaps and heaps of food on offer as well

Food tour was amazing, highlight of HCMC! - So happy we choose this food tour, it was amazing. This was the highlight of our stay in HCMC. I cannot recommend this enough. I would have done the same food tour another night if we had time, it was that good.Such sweet guides and informative tour leaders. We learned so much, met great people and had so much fun. The ability to eat, tour and see all of what HCMC has to offer for such a reasonable price is incredible. i cannot imagine topping this tour. This is a must do while in HCMC!

Thanks greatly,
Elijah & Leslie Roberts

Amazing trip - Not only the tour permitted us to see districts of Saigon we wouldn’t have seen otherwise, the tour also abled us to have the tastiest foods! The girls and the tour guide speak great English and are very nice and a lot of fun! Definitely recommending this tour to anyone who comes to HCMC.

Food tour was a highlight of our trip - We can’t say enough about this tour and our guides. It was so much fun. It was the perfect mix of sightseeing and eating. Our guides were all delightful and knowledgeable. As a woman I loved that all of the guides were smart engaging young women. The food was great and we felt like we ate like locals.

Foodie tour - Exceptional experience, a must, must do when visiting Saigon. Stop what you are doing & pick up the phone/computer & schedule a tour. The variety of tastes, the zoom-zoom scooter ride & the tour through the different districts is an educational experience and most importantly FUN!! Thank you, XO!! 😀

Food tour - The best thing we did in HCMC! - We were picked up at our hotel by our riders. Who were friendly, and immediately made us feel safe on the moped. They gave us helmets and let us know how best to get on and off the moped and also how to hold on to them/the bike to stay safe.

We then rode a short way to our first stop where we met the main tour guide, Loc. We were given drinks while we waited for the other people on the tour to arrive. There were 8 of us on the tour in total, this was a good size, it was fun to get to chat to other travellers, but small enough to be intimate.

Both Loc and our drivers were friendly, knowledgable and great fun! We rode all over the city and it was a great way to experience HCMC, so though predominantly a food tour, it was so much more than that. We saw so many parts of the city that we otherwise wouldn't done, for example the very different district 7.

The food was excellent, and we had such a great range of dishes to try. You certainly wouldn't go hungry! They check about food allergies and likes and dislikes, and catered for any needs really well. They encourage you to try new things, but aren't pushy if you don't want to. I do recommend trying the frog!

Highly recommend, if you're in HCMC then do this tour!

A great way to dust away the jet lag!! - Our first full day in Vietnam after a long flight from London my wife and I jumped on the back of two mopeds and were led into HCMC rush hour by our FANTASTIC guides Chau and Nam.

This is an extremely professional company who offer a fantastic product. Yes it is a little pricey by Vietnamese standards but if you can afford it, do it!!

We met the tour leader, Khoi, and a further six customers at the first food stop. Our girls made sure we were comfortable on the back of the bikes - for us both it was the first time in over 35 years. By the time we met with the rest of the group we were not gripping the back of the bikes quite so hard.

As vegetarians our dietary requirements were met perfectly. They even made sure that we had our own dipping sauces.

The food was great and we ate in three different restaurants that were well off the tourist trail. Time is allowed between stops so that you are not too full when arriving at the next place.

This tour is fully immersive and is equally about the places and areas you visit along with the thrill of being thrown into the middle of HCMS's road system.

The girls who are driving are what really make this experience special. They are very engaging, great fun to be with, and provide a wonderful insight into the city and the culture of the country.

We have just returned home from almost three weeks in Vietnam. We have had some wonderful experiences and this is definitely in the top five.

The most fun on a motorbike! - After days of being pedestrians on the crowded sidewalks and streets of HCMC, it was so much fun to be on the back of a motorbike! I had full confidence in my driver and she and we shared stories and information on the U.S. and Vietnamese cultures. The food was good - dessert was better than the main course - and the rides through the alleyways of District 4 were exhilarating, I regretted not doing this tour on the first night because it would have shown us other cool districts within HCMC to visit!

Awesome & delicious way to explore the various areas of Saigon! A+++ - The XO Tours Foodie Adventures came HIGHLY recommended from one of my friends and I'm glad I took his advice.

Two beautiful and sweet lady tour guides, Huong & Nha, arrived our hotel to pick us up on time, gave us proper intros and instructions on being a passenger on a scooter, and off we went. During the scooter rides between the various stops, the tour guides were always conversing with us. We always felt very safe riding with them and never felt a single moment was dull. Sang was also an amazing tour leader. All three Huong, Nha, and Sang were all very knowledgeable and nice. We got to see parts of Saigon we never even though about visiting and are very happy we got to see them (no spoilers :) )

Highly recommend!! A must do for anyone visiting Saigon!

Amazing! - Dont miss this if you are heading to HCMC. The food was great and the company (both other guests and the staff) was amazing! If we had time, we would do it again! Schallops are abseloutly amazing!

Great food tour - Do this tour! Great combination of fantastic food, sightseeing and understanding the context of modern Saigon.

The food was varied and sometimes pushed our boundaries (frogs, goat and duck egg embryo!) but plenty of safer options too including bbq beef and delicious seafood (the crab was superb!).

Extremely well organised from the booking and payment process through to pick up at accommodation and through the 5 hour tour.

Our guides, Loan and Hoa, were charming, excellent hosts at each of the food stops, safe drivers, and spoke excellent English. Tai the tour leader was amazing also with a great sense of humour and memory - remembering everyone’s’ names (15 people) and giving interesting insight into the food, history and people.

Riding on a scooter is the quintessential way to see Saigon and the only way to really feel a part of this city. Can’t recommend this enough - thank you Hoa, Loan and Tai!

Fabulous Evening - My husband and I and our three children, ages 20, 18 and 15, thoroughly enjoyed the food tour by motorbike. While this tour may be more expensive than the competitors, it really is worth it. The women drivers were kind, interesting, attentive and safe. Their English was great and they were able to give us an overview of Saigon as we toured the city. The food was delicious and different than the standard Vietnamese fare. It was also abundant. We all loved everything about this tour. Highly recommend this activity.

Worth the nerves (+ Dress Code Tips)!! - My husband and I visited Ho Chi Minh for Christmas, and took the foodie tour on Christmas evening, which was a fun way to have a little bit of a family-style dining experience. Our moto drivers were so safe and cute and spoke wonderful English. In addition to our drivers, who helped us through each food "adventure" the group had a guide, who would give us some background about the food or neighborhood we were in. If I remember correctly, the stops were as follows: pickup at your hotel; meet the group and guide for Pho; drive through China Town to see night life; Vietnamese barbecue (goat, shrimp, beef, veggies grilled by our guides and dipped in delicious chili sauce); drive to district 8 to see the snazzy new part of town; seafood stop (scallops, crab, fetal duck if you dare!, coconut dessert). We were a little nervous about riding motorcycles, but our drivers were cautious, and you just feel like part of the larger crowd in Ho Chi Minh. We never got sick from the food, and we loved the little guide booklets they gave us on the tour. Overall a great experience! Highly recommended!

Some pointers:
1. Wear pants (not white)
2. If you're going to carry a purse, make it a small one, because they will store it under the motorcycle seat.
3. Bring a light jacket - it's breezy and you might get cold.
4. If it's raining, they will have really good ponchos for you.

Awesome tour - My partner and I did this tour on the 28th Dec 17 and it was fantastic the ladies we had as our riders were Thuy and Hoa and they were brilliant as was the tour leader Khoi. They could not do enough for you and the food was outstanding. They certainly made sure you had plenty to eat and drink and insisted you were not to leave hungry and we certainly did not. The seafood was so yum and by far the highlight, it was also great to see the city on the back of the bike, hairy at times but lots of fun and we felt very safe with the ladies. I would highly recommend this tour if you have the time when in Ho Chi Minh city. Thanks so much ladies your both awesome.
Deb

Unique and delicious experience! - We just did the Foodie tour last week with our 3 teenagers and it was simply amazing. The team of all female drivers were great, entertaining and took us "off the beaten track" where we ate the most delicious foods. We felt completely safe, in great hands and simply a very unique way of visiting the city. Highly recommended and very well organized. Thank you all for these memories!

great experience - We picked this tour because of tripadvisor and it didn't disappoint. the guid you spoke very fluent english, they meet you at your hotel, and the information and food was interesting and not typical. we liked their sense fo fun and humor and they accommodated our young kids with grace

Ripper foodie/scooter tour! - Found this tour on TripAdvisor. Luckily we had spent a few days wandering around so we were comfortable that the scooter/car traffic actually worked. It looks scary and having been a motorcyclist for 40 years I was a little nervous to say the least.
Our diminutive young female guides picked us up at our hotel and after a very quick safety briefing we set off into the slightly pre peak hour traffic to our first restaurant.
What an absolute blast!
As I said, 40 years riding and racing dirt and road bikes and this has to rate right up there with the very best riding I had done!
Fong who was my rider spoke excellent English and we chatted the whole time on the bike about the districts we were driving through and other high lights.
As for the food three stops, noodle at the first bbq at the second and seafood at the last. Beer was included at each stop which was great!
The food was great, I won’t bother describing each dish but needless to say enjoyable and fun!
Wang who is the tour leader is a great friendly guy full of excellent information and the couple of info stops very informative indeed.
This tour is a must do!
We were picked up at 430 and dropped back to our hotel at 9pm.
Our tour consisted of 8 in total.
Thanks Wang and Fong and the rest of the team for a fantastic night out!

Trip highlight for our family - Sensational tour. Each of the girls was adorably attentive and well spoken. Their English was excellent! As was their riding skills. Totally competent riders and charming hosts. Food was great and plentiful. Loved that we stopped at authentic joints!!! Thanks so much XO. Our family will be talking about this for a long time to come!

Fantastic Tour !!! - Myself and my 15 yr son did the night tour on 2nd jan, was everything we expected and more !!! The girls were waiting for us before time, spoke great English, they were informative as we weaved in and out of the traffic and made sure we felt happy and safe. When you stop at the different districts it’s good to see the differences and the guides meet you and tell you about the history or anything else you ask.
We took the tour on our last night, the day tour was fully booked but got on this because of a cancellation, my advice would be to book early and do the tours when you first get to the city to get your bearings and also you can visit the different districts if you want another day with more time.
Best trip if our holiday xx
Thank you

Fabulous and delicious food tour in Ho Chi Minh City - Three of us enjoyed the evening food tour with XO Tours. We can't say enough great stuff about the food, the drivers, and the tour! We had a blast on the back of the motorbikes of three expert lady drivers who spoke excellent English. We got to tour at least 5 different districts, and their knowledge of hcmc really impressed. The food stops were delicious and very local--unusual and delightful for my tourist friends, as well as for me. I can hardly wait to host more visitors so that I have an excuse to do this tour again!

Outstanding tour! - Never in a million years did I think I would be on a motorcycle, touring Saigon. Well hell froze over.I did it and its all thanks to XO Tours. I am the most nervous person on the planet, and if I can do it, so can you! The tour was fantastic from start to finish You must do this tour if you visit Saigon!

Too much fun - We visited Saigon in late November as part of our two week cruise in the South China Sea. We had 4 couples on the trip, but only two couples opted for the XO Tours day time tour of Saigon, the other two couples decided just to walk around. Of the four of us that did the XO tour, two of us are bikers so we thought we knew what to expect despite it being weird to be a passenger and not be in control like we were used to. We met our guide and the drivers downtown, and from the start it was AWESOME. The traffic is crazy in Saigon, with 8 million scooters, but it was amazing how smoothly the girls navigated the traffic on the streets, through intersections where the massive traffic hordes seemed to simply flow through each other, and through the side streets and markets. It’s a different experience on the back of a scooter but you get all the sensations, the sounds, smells, and of course the crazy traffic. We visited many of the cities major sites and made a few stops where they had us try different kinds of fruit juices, and fruits themselves, many of which we could not identify. The guide and the girls were great, very knowledgable, of course very capable on the bikes, and great sense of humour. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to experience Saigon from the same vantage point as 8 million locals.

Foodie tour - Fantastic from when the young ladies picked us on their scooters from our hotel. It was an informative tour and exciting weaving through the chaotic traffic. I did this tour with my daughter and was a little anxious about getting on the back of the bike being in my mid fifties. My girl put me at ease and said to hang onto her and talked to me throughout the tour. There were toilets along the way and they made sure we would enjoy the food be asking us about our preferences, allergies and levels of spice. The tour included travel insurance (covering the bike) and as much food and drink as we could eat and drink. Great way to experience the street food and we were given a phrase book and eating recommendations.
Saigon by night - This was a highlight of our holiday. The guides were excellent, full of knowledge and very safe drivers. I highly recommend this company

Fantastic! - The six in our family loved this experience. The guides were friendly and competent and lots of fun. The food we had was amazing and unexpected.

One of the best things we ever did.
Amazing - My wife & I completed the Sights Tour & thought it was absolutely amazing, Lin, Lung & Thi were very knowledgeable, professional and a good laugh.. must do while in HCMC 👍🇻🇳

Well organised, and heaps of fun scooting round HCMC! - I don't generally book onto tours like this, but had limited time in HCMC, and had heard glowing reviews from many expat friends in Singapore, so decided to give it a try... I was not disappointed!

My boyfriend and I went on the morning sight-seeing tour (3.5hrs) and found XO Tours to a very slick, professional operation, and I was seriously impressed with everyone I came into contact with; from the fast and helpful email responses, to the enthusiastic and interesting guide (Khoi Nguyen - thanks!) and the awesome ladies who drove our scooters safely whilst chatting away in great English - very impressed!!

Definitely recommend booking with XO Tours if you want a great experience with a well-organised company (I love how they had cool sugar-cane juice waiting for us at a cafe before the scoot to China Town... such great organising with timings we didn't even have to get off the scooters as the guy was waiting outside for us!) Also nice touches sending you photos of the tour, plus a stop in a local market with some yummy snacks included.

I would definitely book other tours with them, and don't hesitate to recommend them. Can't wait to see the photos now!

Delicious & Delightful! - My friend had recommended this tour and had told me that it was the best meal of her life, so I went in with very high expectations. And luckily they were all met! Starting off with the super kind Vietnamese girls who drive you around in scooters in their beautiful outfits, you feel the incredible energy of riding around the awesome city of Ho Chi Minh; I am not exaggerating when I say that going on the scooters was the way I fell in love with the city. Not only do you get to say many sides of Saigon, but the FOOD IS INCREDIBLE. I recommended this tour to everyone I ran into during the rest of my trip in Vietnam, it was one of the best parts of my vacation!

The BEST of HCMC! - Thank you XO Tours for making our trip!

We did the Sights of Saigon morning tour as a private tour with Lin, Jin and Sang. What an amazing experience. Having spent a few days in HCMC already it was fantastic to see a few of the Sights we had already seen, and to hear the stories behind them. Vietnam is such a vibrant and interesting city with such history. But in addition to the main sights, heading out to the city centre to other districts allowed us to experience a bit of the life of HCMC residents.

HCMC is constantly buzzing 24/7, with activity and motorbikes, and to be on these bikes being whizzed around the city made for a great experience. And don't worry if you are a little apprehensive about being on the bikes - the expertise of Lin and Jin made it really comfortable, safe and enjoyable. It was great to be able to talk to them about their own families, lives and knowledge of Vietnam - we felt very privileged to have this personal touch that made our trip feel more personalised.

We were kept refreshed with drinks throughout the tour, and got to try yoghurt, flan and fruits. The yoghurt was seriously the best I have ever tasted!

I would not hesitate to recommend the Sights tour - it was the highlight of our time in HCMC. We also did the XO Tours Hoi An evening tour whilst up in Hoi An, which was also the highlight of our time in Hoi An.

Thanks to everyone at XO Tours for creating such awesome experiences for visitors.

Sights tour and foodie tour - Epic experience. We had so much fun with these lovely people. Incredible experience riding around the streets of Ho Chi Minh on the back of a scooter. The girls are very friendly and informative. The tour leaders are also great. Highly recommend for people visiting the city.

Must do - We did both the Foodie tour and Sighs tour and both were fantastic.
Driving in from the airport is the crazy traffic I was more than a little worried about getting on the back of a bike the next day but I felt completely safe during both tours. Our drivers were lovely and the guide very friendly and professional.
The foodie tour is a real local food experience and driving around the streets at night was a fantastic experience.

The 5 star local experience!!!!! - Coming from a country where majority of the women are bad riders/drivers, I was quite skeptical that I would have a good time (or rather be alive after the tour) being a pillion to a woman. The lady rider was a skilled rider and very informative without being prompt. She would explain to me the different districts and how the locals lead their life. Being a person who has deep interest in culture, this tour gives you the opportunity to visit the less touristy places in HCM and give you an unbiased perspective of life in the city. Secondly, I'm a fussy eater. If the place isn't clean, I wouldn't bother eating. Xo tours brought us to places where the food is clean and you wouldn't have seconds thoughts about the food. Lastly, the tour leader Tai. He adds some personal touch to the tour by remembering the names/country of his group in a short space of time. He was also very informative and witty in his comebacks. Xo tours will be the first company I'll introduce to anyone who wants to visit HCM. 🤙

So much fun! - Ok, this might look cheesy before you get to Vietnam but once here and you see the sea of motorbikes and traffic in general then you will understand this is more than just a food tour. Riding on the back of a bike in that chaos was so much fun. The food was really good, caution pace yourself there is lots. A really fun evening and great way to start your time in Ho Chi Minh City.

Fun and informative! - Booked this based on its great reviews and it certaintly lived up to the hype. The drivers were all very professional and I felt very safe on the motorbike even going through busy intersections. My driver, Xiao (maybe I misspelled it as I forgot to ask for the spelling) was fantastic, making conversation on the rides, even jokes. Tai, our tour guide was also great. He has a great mix of historical spots and local spots off the beaten path and they even take photos for you during the tour.I will definitely recommend XO tours to future visitors of HCM!

Loved it! One of the highlights of my trip. - Loved how XO organized this tour. Overall, excellent tour and staff, worth the price.

I signed up for a Foodie tour by myself. I joined 14 other guests, which made it a lot of fun! My guide Nhung was a young woman, full of sass and humor! Nhung was pretty proficient in English, too, which was a plus. We were able to have in-depth conversations about life, culture, boys, food, etc. She was also a motorbike ninja, navigating the roads with ease (and traffic and driving in Ho Chi Minh are pretty horrendous). She picked me up from my hotel and brought me to the first restaurant, where I met the other guests. At the first restaurant we met our tour leader and his entourage (who were kind of like bodyguards). He was great and a lot of fun!

We went to a total of 3 restaurants: one for a noodle soup bowl, one of "bbq", and the other for seafood. We stopped in other districts to discuss some of the history, current status, culture, etc. The tour itself was not only about food but the culture and way of life in the different districts in HCMC.

I thoroughly enjoyed the tour and was pleasantly surprised with the overall experience! What a great way to see HCMC. I got to see the areas tourists wouldn't normally see.

Best way to experience Saigon! - We went on the nighttime Foodie Tour and had a brilliant time! Our drivers & guide were extremely friendly & it felt more like hanging out with friends than a paid tour. Food was fresh & enjoyable, & we got to try so many Vietnamese dishes... they really do keep the food coming till you almost burst! Highly recommend as a fun adventure, the best way to experience HMC is definitely on the back of a scooter. Thanks XO Tours!

Great night tour of the city - We had planned to do the foodie tour but my wife didn't feel up to eating so much, so we tried the night tour of the city. From start to finish it was fantastic, just as I expected it based on what I had read. Girls were such good fun having a giggle all the way round, my wife and 18 year old son both loved it. Markets in Chinatown were amazing, and we made stops at various other (very different) parts of town, finishing in District 4 and eating some street food along the way. Our overall guide, Sang, was excellent and kept us informed and entertained, and the girls chatted away on the bikes as we went along, pointing things out. Super fun evening.

Real local experience - It's a real local experience, our leader Tai, a very knowledgeable leader, we particularly enjoyed his sharing about the social, economic and cultural matters. The ride, the food and the places are excellent. The motorbike gals are very accommodating, thanks for the safe and fun ride! The evening was full of fun, interaction and friendship, not even one second of dead air! Highly recommended.

City Tour - Family of 3 (two adults + 13 year old son) did the morning city tour of Saigon. Absolutely fantastic way to see parts of the city probably not frequented by tourists. The women driving each of our vespas were caring, inquisitive & knowledgeable. A team of male XO staff followed the group, keeping an eye on us and helping out at each stop. Our guide, Tai Dang, was brilliant. Great sense of humour and text book knowledge of every place we visited. If you only have time to do one thing in Saigon, I could not recommend an XO tour highly enough. We all loved it! Only wish I'd had time to go the night time foodie tour, too!

Fantastic foodie bike tour of Ho Chi Minh - If you are looking for a great way to get your bearings around Ho Chi Minh City including seeing districts you would not normally visit jump on the back of a motorcycle with the wonderful team at XO tours. They will treat you to a series of culinary delights including local soup, seafood, beef, chicken, quail, frogs and some other local delicacies. Guides are friendly, knowledgeable and you always feel safe despite the hustle and bustle of the local traffic. We would highly recommend this fantastic tour.

So much fun - I had two days in Saigon, so I booked the Sights Tour as well as the Foodie tour. I LOVED both.
The guides are light hearted and fun and the girls/drivers are awesome... are fluent in English so can chat to them as you drive along!! The food was delicious (leave enough space in the tummy for the last stop)!! The food is not the best of the “regular” food but the best of the food at places you would never go as a tourist!! Do yourself a favor and don’t miss touring with these guys!! The pic was my favorite dish!! ❤️❤️

Highlight of our time in HCMC! - My wife, two daughters (ages 10 and 12), and I did the XO foodie tour, and it was spectacular! Though we were a bit nervous about being on the back of motorbikes in Saigon, it turned out to be safe, fun, and fantastic! We saw parts of the city we would not have seen otherwise, and we ate fantastic food at a bunch of places we probably would not have known to try otherwise. And the dishes were just the right level of adventurous for us--things we might not have known to try, but not so out there that we could not bring ourselves to eat it. All in all, a terrific, well organized, and very fun tour. Thank you to all of the great people at XO!

Private Foodie tour - Ridiculously impressive private foodie tour with the 2 coolest prettiest and funniest girls in Saigion! Ngan and Tu were amazing hostesses, great scooter riders, BBQ chefs and super fun company. Awesome interesting food and definitely our best experience in Saigon! Cheers again Ngan and Tu from your kiwi friends....YOOOO!!!!!

Saigon is a must-go city - We took two Buffalo tours in Saigon: Ho Chi Ming City Tour and Half Day Chu Chi Tunnels. Both a must go tours. The Chu Chi tunnels are well preserved and has great historical significance. The City Tour is also very well planned and arranged. Highly
recommend both.

Amazing Sights tour. If you book one tour, make sure it is this one - XO Tours were even better than the glittering online reviews had suggested with a superb Sights tour that proved as entertaining as it was educational. It was easily the highlight of our trip and offered insights into contemporary life and history.
My wife and I will treasure the memories of the team's warm hospitality from the time the two ladies met us outside our hotel, and the protective way they took care of us while navigating the noisy streets throughout a memorable December 24 morning. I had watched several slick XO videos the day before we arrived in Ho Chi Minh City - and wondered how the tour would stack up in real life. I needn't have worried. Participating in the Sights tour surpassed all expectations.

Must do experience in Ho Chi Minh - We did a Xmas day Foodie tour with this company and had a fantastic night. Through the craziness of the traffic we always felt safe and in good hands. It was an amazing experience to move from district to district and see some of the many faces of this city. The food was great and something we would never have done on our own. I had Mai as my driver, my husband had Dang. Both ladies spoke English well and had lots of information about the city and its people. Thank you for a night we will never forget. I would highly recommend this tour.

Highlight of Saigon visit - We did the XO foodie tour two days ago at the end of three days in Saigon. We had a schedule packed with tours and the foodie one was last. It was definitely a case of saving the best to last. Girls showed up at hotel bang on time and I was a bit convpcerned being 130kg on back of bike with small driver. I needn’t have been and touring Saigon by bike was fantastic to blend in with the seven million other bike owners. The whole experience was brilliant, met some really nice people, ate some weird and wonderful and above all had great fun. This is highly professionally run with out riders keeping an eye on us whilst the girls were highly skilled riders but also great fun and informative. Do not leave Saigon without doing this!

Fantastic Foodie tour! - Booked this famous foodietour before we arrived Vietnam. The ladies were waiting for us at our hotel ready with instructions and a beautiful smile. After some ground rules (don't dance when on the motorcycle..) we went ahead to the first place to meet our other companions. Food, drinks and history of Ho Chi Minh was explained in these 5h foodietour across the districts! Must see and do when visiting the city!

Must do - My wife and I went with XO Tours for the Saigon Night tour during our visit to the city.

Our guides (Mai and Anh) were excellent. Very attentive and shared some great information during the trip. They were really the highlight.

The tour is fabulously organized with everything taken care of. The tour team leader, Sang, knew all of our names before even meeting which we were really impressed by.

The tour takes in some great sites and allows you to see a totally different side of Saigon. We felt totally safe during the tour and would definitely have done the food tour if we had the time.

And excellent tour run by some great people. Highly recommended!

A one of kind and exhilirating ride! - Female scooter drivers will drive you around the city to try their different and exciting local cuisines!!

Im a scooter virgin so to be able to ride around Ho Chi Minh was quite exciting! It was also safe as you will be required to wear helmets and the female drivers were more trustworthy in their motor riding skills.

Dont fret though, male riders are at your back following you guys to make sure everyone is safe from any harm or danger.

Food selections are basically grilled/bbq/noodles....more of street food style.

If you are expecting fine dining, this is not for u.

They also explain the food you are about to eat...(what is it and how is it prepared)... so that was really informative. Oh and unlimited orders! :D Eat all you can!!!

Highlight of our honeymoon! - Everything about this tour was perfect. Ladies made us feel safe riding on the back of their mopeds in this mad traffic. Food was delicious and LOTS OF IT! Incredibly fun evening, definitely a must do!

Foodie Tour - My 15 year old daughter and I decided what better way to explore HCMC on our first night in Vietnam than an XO Foodie Tour. We had never ridden on a scooter or motorbike before, so that was scary enough...add the traffic in Saigon, riding on the opposite side of the road and an entire different food culture (than Australia) and I did question our mental state with our planning. Nhat and Vi (Trucy) our XO Guides were just amazing - I knew we were in extremely safe hands the minute we met them at the lobby of our hotel. The food during the night was delicious and plentiful, and even the balut wasn't too bad. My daughter generally won't eat seafood but ate every morsel on the tour and has become quite a convert. Our host, Tai, was an absolute gentleman and ensured that everyone was happy, had enough food and was eating food they were able to. We would definitely do another XO Foodie Tour or try a different tour next time we visit HCMC. I cant recommend XO Tours more highly.

Do Not Miss - Everything about this night food tour of HCMC was superb--the organization, the tour guide, the drivers, THE FOOD! I could not recommend it more highly. Got to see so much more of HCMC than I did on my main tour, which only hit a couple of touristy highlights. This gives you an overview of the city and it's neighborhoods with just enough background and information to really appreciate what you're seeing. The drivers are excellent: knowledgeable, safe, informative, helpful, and entertaining. Truly one of the best tours I've ever taken. Thank you, XO. You guys are great!

A must do!!! - First night and was a little wary as the traffic is chaotic, however the girls soon reassured and I felt so safe on the back, it was a real fun experience as they get you to try a few delicacies that I wouldn’t normally do. All the staff were fantastic!

Awesome - Must admit my daughter and I were a little nervous about doing this tour but we are so glad we plucked up the courage and went for it. We had such a awesome and fun time and felt completely safe and secure with our girl's. It was a great way to see the different districts of Ho Chi Minh City and get a great insight into daily lives of Vietnamese people. We stopped for some street food and cold beer which was also really good. Ashley & I couldn't wipe the smiles from our faces after our trip, we highly recommend this tour.

Attentive guides expose you to diverse cuisine - Highly enjoyable ride through HCMC with XO tours. I did the night foodie tour which included three food stops: the first was to enjoy traditional soup from Hue; the second, was to sample a variety of grilled meats; and the final, to sample a variety of seafood. A group the joined us were offered veg options at every stop.

Be prepared to spend a good bit of time in between each food stop riding - the tour is not set up in such a way that you go from food stop to food stop. Enjoy the scene and be a part of the hustle and bustle of rush hour traffic in HCMC. This works because of the amount of food you’re given. BTW, my understanding is that there’s no limit with the amount of food you can have. Not sure how you can do more than sample because I felt absolutely stuffed.

Highly recommended as an intro to HCMC.

An absolute MUST - We were really interested in the culinary scene in Vietnam but high end restaurants didn’t do it for us. So we booked this street food “foodies Tour” and were completely satisfied. Great concept (two beautiful Vietnamese girls - great English- giving us a crazy scooter ride all over town for sightseeing and eating delicious super authentic local food)! Wouldn’t have found the places they took us if it wasn’t for the Tour. Very entertaining and great attitude! Happy clients :)

The highlight of our short trip to Ho Chi Minh - I was a little unsure about booking a bike tour. My family thought I was mad and my 8 year old was determined that he was NOT going to get on a scooter with a stranger! It turned out to be the highlight of our trip and I would highly recommend it to anyone. We did the morning sightseeing tour, which took us to various landmarks and we also got to taste a local drink and dessert. The girls were wonderful, pointing out interesting sights as we rode and happily answering questions about their city. Our guide, Hieu gave us more detail about the sights and the history and took photos to document our trip. If you are hesitant to try an XO tour, don't be. It was fantastic!

Amazing tour and great guides city half day tour - We had a fab time on this tour. Ting, Lin and Tai were so knowledgable and really made us feel safe and well looked after. We saw so many things we wouldn’t have had chance to do otherwise as our trip to Ho Chi Minh was only 3 days.

Experienced some of the more local sights and tried some real local dishes.

Thank you so much XO - we highly recommend this to anyone!

It’s 5 stars from me!!! - Can’t recommend these guys highly enough! Professional and fun from start to finish. I did the foodie tour at night which was delicious, interesting and a real adventure. The sites tour in the morning was so interesting and moved at a good pace with a lot of variety. As a travel industry person and ex- guide myself, I can really appreciate when a tour is put together thoughtfully and delivered with enthusiasm. XO tours are both. Book it, you will be in good hands. Special thanks to my guides; Ms Hung, Mr Ton, Ms Nhut and Robert Sung.

Highlight of our trip to Vietnam - We did the Foodie Tour and had such an amazing time. Riding a scooter was so much fun and you feel extremely safe. Our tour guides were so sweet. The tour leader, Tai, was funny and extremely knowledgeable-- he'll shine a light on life in Vietnam and Saigon that you wouldn't be able to find anywhere else. The food was incredible and you'll be going to many different districts to sample local foods and learn about Vietnamese culture. Simply amazing, couldn't recommend it enough. Thanks again Tai and the XO team!
Best tour ever - The best tour ever!! It was fun and informative!! I really recommend everyone who has short time in Ho Chi Minh.

100 per cent must do - My daughter and I did the night food tour and what an experience -highly recommend-the best tour ever as my daughter of 44 said-So much food showing a large variety that at the end of the evening you are filled up and loving your driver/guide/cook who you just want to adopt and take home.The girls are all from what we could see fabulous and very safe driving habits-The best tour ever-make sure you do it.

This rocks! - Cannot recommend this trip enough - did the night food tour - brilliant way to see HCMC. The real highlight for me was the ride on the back of the mopeds. We covered a lot of ground - districts 1, 3, 5, 8, 7 & 5. Around two of the four hours were on the mopeds. Both my driver/guide, Vy, and my girl friend's, Loan, were excellent. Chatty, enthusiastic and knowledgeable, and we felt totally safe when we settled in after the first 5 minutes! Neither of us ride motorbikes. You feel like you're seeing the city from the inside, sights, sounds and smells. The tour leader, Tuan, gives a very honest & amusing description at each stop. We loved all the food too & we were eating in places we'd never have found. Cannot really think of a better way to spend an evening!

Best experience in Ho Chi Minh City - Me and my mom did the morning tour (stopping in the most important attractions of the city) and the foodie tour. We were scared of the motorcycles but the drivers were very careful and made us feel comfortable. All of them have really good english and are so nice and fun. Our guide for both of the tours was Tay and Linh was my driver for the foodie tour. They made my experience ever better. The drivers were on time to pick us up for both tours, too. I would recommend both tours for everyone. Compliments won’t be enough, you really need to go and do it!

Night Scooter Food Tour - Had an absolute ball on the night food tour. It was great fun on the scooters and the range of food and sites we saw were everything we could ask for.

Felt very safe with our scooter drivers, whilst enjoying the hustle and bustle of the Saigon streets.

If you want to experience some local eating spots and the crazy traffic, I’d highly recommend using XO Tours.

Unbelievable - Had an amazing night food tour with an amazing guide Quynh! The food was incredible with the bike ride through the different areas of town one of the best travel experiences I have had in any of the +30 countries I’ve visited. A must when going to Saigon.

Excellent Tour, Great Fun! - A really excellent street food tour and great way to see the City. Hieu was a great tour guide and the girls (Duyen 1 and Duyen 2) were very friendly, informative and good drivers. A variety of local cuisine, hugely plentiful! Would definitely recommend.

2017-12-01T00:00:00 - What a wonderful experience. Our family of 6 (4 teens & Mum & Dad) did the XO food tour last night and it was simply amazing. The scooter drivers were charming & friendly. They were very good drivers and we all felt very safe as they navigated the night traffic. We made 3 food stops and 2 sight seeing stops. The food was mostly delicious (didn't enjoy the duck embryo) but there was no pressure to eat things we found a bit too challenging. No better way to explore HCM and to see places that you wouldn't otherwise visit as a tourist. Highly recommend this tour!

Saturday night in HCMC - Wow😃 no better way to spend a Saturday night. My wife and I were met at our hotel by the two Beautiful women Tu and Linh from XO Tours and a video crew. They gave instructions on the do’s and don’ts. Their skills on the motor bikes are second to none. We then meet the rest of the group at the first restaurants and Khoi (team leader) gave us the details of the tour. The food was good and they did have items for vegetarians and non shellfish eaters. Tu and Linh were so helpful in explaining things about the different districts we were riding through. The traffic was so chaotic and seem like a free for all. It was something we will most likely not see again. Tu and Linh were always smiling and laughing. They were great ambassadors for XO Tours👍👍👍. I would definitely do again if the opportunity arises. This was the highlight of our trip in Vietnam. We would like to thank Khoi,Tu, and Linh. We did this tour on December 9th
Fun morning tour! - What a great way to see the city! The girls are terrific! All the little stops were well thought out and provided lots of info on the city.

Best way to see HCM. - We travel to HCM first time with 2 kids (15 and 10 years old) and a elderly. Prior to the travel, we noted most of the great reviews on tripadvisor. Due to short stay of 1 nite in HCM, and we wanted to get the most out of this city, we booked the night tour despite protest from the elderly due to safety reason. When we landed in HCM, we almost freak out from the traffic condition. Can`t imagine going around on a bikes with kids. We were so glad that we push ahead with the plan. We were received by 4 lovely, cheerful and bubbly girls. They went through the basic of a pillion riders and then off we went. My initial fear for my little ones safety were totally gone when I saw how experience they move around that crazy traffic ( although I was a bit fearful that my little toes on a slippers will be cut off by the close proximity of another vehicles but it didn`t happen). Wow, it was a great experience. I will not go into the trip details as already mentioned by others but to all the parents with kids, don`t be afraid, if your kids can follow instructions, these ladies will give them a experience of a lifetime. My kids enjoyed so much that they asked for more. It is a great way to see the city in such a short stay in HCM as mine.

Delightful way to see Saigon! - I took the morning “Sights” tour and it was one of the highlights of my week in Saigon! Our tour guide Tai was excellent at informing, entertaining, and making the whole morning fun and it was great having a personal motorbike driver to give me additional commentary as we zipped around the city. The itinerary was good with several key sights and a couple stops for refreshments at the local foodie locations. I only wish I had saved enough time to do their evening Saigon at Night and Foodie tours!

Foodie Tour - One of the best tours I’ve been on. Incredible experience on the scooters weaving through the traffic. All the girls were lovely and super fun! (especially Vi 5). Food was outstanding and was full prior to or last food stop. Overall an amazing tour that we are looking to do again in Han Oi.

Expensive... - Don’t get me wrong, we had a good time...but for $75/pp this is just not worth it. There just is not that much food or booze. Online it seems like all you can eat- all you can drink! Not really at all..we only kept getting beer because we asked and at that it was 333 (the cheapest beer in Asia) it was all fun and our tour guide was so sweet but I would never pay to do it again. To those of you who don’t eat meat- I don’t eat meat either and they were extremely receptive to that but besides that we only were able to drink about six beers each and eat what they gave us... I barely ate anything. I would have paid MAX $100 for this instead of $150. Ugh.

Great way to see Saigon and sample Vietnamese food. Highly recommended. - Although a little pricier than other tours, worth every dong. The girls drive the scooters through the chaos of Saigon very safely, you have one to one attention as they describe your travels through the city and then sit with you to help you understand what the food is you are eating and encourage you to be more adventurous with your food. Great evening, very professionally run and very informative.

Probably the best choice we made while in Vietnam - TL;DR: 10/10 would recommend. Do it.

Three friends and I did the Foodies tour. It was fantastic. They were on time, professional, friendly, and incredibly knowledgeable. The drivers were amazing and safe, comfortable drivers. The tour takes you around many of the districts in Saigon outside of the touristy one. They bring you to genuinely local places. The food on the tour was fantastic but not dishes that are always associated with Vietnamese food (pho, spring rolls, banh mi) which was exactly what we wanted.

There was also a side of the tour where they talk more about Saigon and the changes that are happening. It was insight that we would not have gotten otherwise.

Foodies tour - Absolutely brilliant the young women drivers were extremely safe drivers were very engaging , knowledgeable bright bubbly and fun to be around. They challenged you to try all manner of food stuff outside of your comfort zone. Dhu my driver managed to cart my 6ft 4in 115 kg frame around with elegant skill. I highly recommend this tour.

My favorite activity in Saigon - When I got to Saigon, I never imagined I would be someone who would ride on a scooter considering the amount of crazy traffic there. I happened upon an article by someone that mentioned one of the best ways to see the city was actually with a scooter tour. I was intrigued and we started looking for a company to go with. We liked the idea that XO tours was an all female company (though we came to learn that the guides were male) and we wanted to support that. That also had great reviews so we figured we couldn't go wrong.

We booked only a few hours before our Saigon By Night tour, but they were super friendly and able to accommodate us. Our drivers Nhat and Tuyen met us at our hotel, gave us a safety briefing and we were off to meet up with the rest of the group. As many people have said, the women are very safe drivers and you immediately feel comfortable.

I really enjoyed the combination of the riding time and the places we would stop to get explanations of the areas. The guide also did a great job of using photos to help explain things. As an added bonus, the guide took photos for us and emailed them to us the next day. What a great way to capture the experience. This really is a wonderful way to get out of the tourist area and see some other areas of the city. You will find the drivers and guides to all be very personable, knowledgeable and safe. Definitely check this out, you won't regret it!

Friendly staff and good tour - The staff was very helpful. They came to pick us up in our hotel. Everyone spoke good English. During the tour they gave us ample snacks and drinks. The tour is covered completely on two wheelers with women drivers. Although the tour was a bit expensive priced at $48. We took the morning tour from 8:30 to 12:30. We covered very few locations.

Good experience - I went for the foodie tour. It was a very enjoyable night. It wasn't the food that impressived. It was the experience of riding a bike in the city, seeing and hearing about the different districts of HCMC and talking to the ladies and learning about the local lives in this colorful city. The tour staff were very professional, friendly and attentive to details. Things could be chaotic in the city but I felt we were well taken care of. I truly enjoyed this experience and time passed so fast for this tour.

Fun, Fun Ride...... - My husband and I had such a good time with this XO night tour. After 3 weeks of touring the ancient civilization of Europe, this tour is surreal. Such a non stop moving, vibrant, young, hip atmosphere..
These young girls were so sweet and they managed the tough streets of Saigon with their motorbikes professionally. At each stop, Quang, the tour leader gave us the briefing of the next stop, the history of the area and the people. Very enriched tour in wonderful, lively setting.
You have the feeling of being on a ride in an Adult Disneyland. Being on the bike were and experience, adding the stops for meal, desert and town... This is unreal.

Riding on the bikes in the rough traffic with these competent girls gave you the feel of and insider. Beside, with the bikes you could go to smaller streets. We had desert in one of the small streets where most of the customer are locals.

The tour is well organized. We'll come back and join this tour again!

Kids had a blast - Our kids - 4 and 6 - couldnt get enough of the ride. They were impatient to get back on the bike at every stop.

We did the half day city tour which included about 4- 5 stops - at the post office, local market and 2 temples.

The Foodie - Best Night Ever! - The best food tour, we’ve done anywhere around the world. Highly recommend the night. The girls are excellent riders. Both myself and my wife have ever felt safer on the back of a scooter. Not only that, they’re great fun to talk to and have a laugh with. They’re full of knowledge and can answer all of your questions.
The tour leader is great also. Makes you feel very welcomed and will take great care of you with the rest of the tour ‘body guards’.
Unlimited food and drinks. You won’t leave feeling hungry at all. Complete pick up and drop off service from your hotel.
If you only do one tour in Ho Chi Minh City, make sure it’s a tour with the girls from XO Tours.

Thanks An and Tu - Best night we had in Ho Chi Minh. The food was definitely an experience, not necessarily all to my tasting, but street food at its best. An and Tu were our drivers, very safe, very friendly and good fun. Best part was scootering around the city at night. I could do this every night. As others have said, this was definitely a highlight of our trip. Do it early on because you will probably book another scooter experience. We did.

Best fun on two wheels - We couldn't leave Vietnam for the first time and not have a scooter experience. We'd read the reviews on TripAdvisor and witnessed the traffic so there was some trepidation however any concerns were quickly dashed by the first contact with XO.
We were picked up at the hotel by two young ladies who walked us through the safety steps very thoroughly and then on we got and straight into the traffic. It's organized chaos they say and you know what, it actually is! We felt very safe and confident that our drivers were in full control. 
For 3.5 hours we scooted around the city going from district to district that we wouldn't have been able to see on foot. We had several stops like visiting a true local market, the secret CIA building, flower market, Reunification Palace and more.
Our tour guide Tai was fantastic, the best tour guide we've had in any tourist experience.
Our drivers were great, very capable and friendly.
We would highly recommend XO tours, it is a must do in Saigon. We will be back and will do the food tour at night. 
Don't hesitate, it's the best experience you'll have on two wheels!

One Of The Best Things I Did In Vietnam! - The service was fantastic! My driver/guide Diem was great! I felt safe riding with her and she was able to provide me with a lot of useful information about the city. All the food was great! I had already been in Vietnam for over a week and wasn't sure if I should do this tour or not because I had already tried so much street food. Boy am I glad I did! I got to see parts of the city that I would not have discovered on my own. All of the food was fantastic and it was all food that I had NOT had anywhere else in Vietnam!

Truly Great Experience!

Private foodie tour = great night out - Right from the beginning, service was spot on. Our tour guides Tien2 and Phuong3, were on time and very friendly and outgoing.
