After a short bike safety introduction, our tour began at 4:30pm. Special shout out to Phat, who we didn’t get to say goodbye to but who was quietly in the background being our “bodyguard/supporter”. We had 3 food stops and 2 sight seeing stops - Chinatown and to a more affluent area so we could see the difference. The food was delicious and there was plenty of it. We were taken across a number of districts and ate at local restaurants that we never would of gone to due to the language barrier and distance travelled. Photos were taken care of thru the night and we received over 20 great shots via email 2 days later at no extra cost. Very well organised and timed. Never a long wait for food and tour guides were very informative. Our tour finished at 9pm and our kind tour guides dropped us off near Walking Street so we could enjoy the rest of our night. Highly recommended the food tour.

Excellent tour. Experience Saigon almost like locals, from the perspective of a motorcycle rider - XO Tours is undoubtedly the way to go.

If you are looking at things to do in Saigon (much easier and quicker to say and write than "Ho Chi Minh City") then you know that the majority of locals get around on their motorcycles or scooters as opposed to private cars or even public transportation.  The reality is even more impressive and intimidating than anything you might read or even see. Rules of the Road as we understand them in the US do not seem to exist or are merely suggestions, and pedestrians most definitely do not have right-of-way.

Bottom line is that I recommend you  experience Saigon from the back of a motorcycle and XO Tours are the way to go. They are very well-reviewed and the service does live up to the hype. Online booking was a smooth process and our women drivers/guides were at the hotel in a timely manner as was the lead tour guide (a man in both tours, even though all drivers were young women). We took the City Tour in the morning and the Foodie Tour later that evening.  The conditions were clear but hot and humid in the morning so we were able to get accustomed to riding the back of a motorcycle. It was raining hard for the early part of the evening Foodie Tour but that did not stop XO Tours. We were all given waterproof (but not breathable) ponchos and off we went. Fortunately the rain stopped half-way through the night and we were able to dump the ponchos.

The City Tour was both fun and informative, a very good introduction to Saigon and Vietnamese history. Our lead guide, Sang Nguyen, spoke very good English and the young women motorcycle drivers quite well too. They were as curious about us as we were about Saigon and their lives. My driver was very cheerful and a bit of a jokester. The places we visited included the Independence/Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, the main Post Office, a local market for Vietnamese snacks and drinks. We were shown the intersection where, in the early 1960s, a monk set himself on fire to protest the policies of the South Vietnamese government that discriminated against Buddhism. His self-sacrifice has made him much revered. Our guide discussed the circumstances surrounding theWe stayed in the central District 1, as far as I could tell. We did not go to the War Remnants Museum but the American War (our Vietnam War) was never far from any discussion about the history of Saigon. 

We enjoyed the Foodie Tour more, but this is not meant as a knock against our guides for the City Tour.  It is just that we really enjoy eating and the Foodie Tour was quite the gustatory experience. We also visited different districts of Saigon, including District 4, the "gangster" district. One non-Foodie stop was in the expat District 7 where our lead guide, Hieu Nguyen, explained the ongoing real estate boom which was based on cash transactions and not leverage or loans; given then relatively high inflation meant that real estate was actually a more secure place to invest. We enjoyed the grilled food restaurant where our guides grilled a variety of veggies and meats on small charcoal braziers at our tables. The seafood restaurant was in District 4 but we never felt any danger; our guides joked they and the drivers all knew Kung-fu and would protect us. On a more serious note, there were a couple of guys in black T-shirts riding with us that were our bodyguards.

It was definitely worth combining the daytime City Tour with the nocturnal Foodie trip.

We thoroughly enjoyed our time with XO Tours for both the places we visited and the the people who took us there.  I regret not remembering the names of the young women who not only drove us safely through the craziness that is Saigon traffic but also shared a bit of their lives and hopes with us and, in doing so, gave us yet another perspective on life in Vietnam.

There is a reason everyone gives 5 stars - You can't ask for a better food tour. This was tons of fun and incredibly well done. Everyone spoke English well, tour guides very funny and personable. The food was amazing. Highly recommended

Must do in HCMC! - We were on a food tour with they ladies and it was amazing! They really did a great job and drove us savely through the city. Food is very local and they bring you to places where you would most likely never go to on your own! Great experience!

Amazing Experience! - The foodie tour was undoubtedly a stand out event of our trip. From the moment Nhi and Trinh picked us up from our hotel we knew this was going to be an amazing experience. The girls were so friendly and knowledgeable and their driving skills were exceptional. We then met, Tuan our team leader who was extremely entertaining, especially with his gold microphone! The food we tasted was incredible as were some of the stops we made and this was the best way to discover the city. We loved every minute of it and cannot recommend this highly enough. The whole XO team were so professional but also a lot of fun!!

Best thing I did in Ho Chi Minh! - Went by Tripadvisor ratings, and did not know what to expect, having never been on a food tour before. I am from India though, so I am used to eating great food at the nooks and crannies and small little best-kept secret places that no one knows. I totally felt that way with this tour, like I was going through a little food adventure through several of the city's very diverse districts and learning about those. For a foodie, for a culture geek, this is the ultimate bike tour. Great service, nice personal touches, awesome keepsake photos - if there is one thing alone to do in Ho Chi Minh, make it this one!

Best activity in Ho Chi Minh City! - My husband and I booked the XO foodie tour from the recommendation of friends who went the past few years. This was by far the coolest experience we had in Ho Chi Minh! It felt so local and personalized. You get the real experience riding motorbikes and trying the best food! Our group was fun and our drivers very friendly! Overall we learned a lot about the city and ate lots of good food! A “must do”!

Outstandingly great! - We booked the foodie tour for our first day in Saigon and it did not disappoint. Loved it. Loved it so much we booked it again for our last night on our 3 week trip, a final cheerio to the city. The tour guides are brilliant, we had a lot of fun and interesting food (duck embryo, anyone?). We loved zipping about Saigon the back of the moped visiting districts we'd not have otherwise seen. You'll learn a lot about Vietnamese life and culture, the changing city and lifestyles. Cannot recommend this tour enough to bring you closer to the real Vietnam and of course, the food. Troi oi!

Unique experience - My girlfriend and I recently visited Ho Chi Minh City and were looking for something different to do there. Thanks to TripAdvisor reviews we checked out XO and were glad we did! We took the scooter food tour and it was a fantastic experience, one of the highlights of our trip. I was sceptical at first upon witnessing the traffic there but I'm glad we did it. Great food and sightseeing and our guide Tai did a fantastic job. Would highly recommend!!

Great Night tour! - We did the night tour of Saigon and enjoyed every minute of it. It was such a great experience of zipping through Saigon on a motorbike. On our night tour we visited 5 different districts including walking through a night market, eating Com Tam, and enjoying fresh fruits and dessert. Our 2 guides were excellent drivers and provided us with a good overview of each district. The 2 guides also spoke excellent English.

Great way to explore the city - The entire tour was thoughtful and immaculately planned. We were picked up by our wonderful lady guides right on time and shuttled to the post office where we met up with the other members of the tour - just 5 of us in total. They would drop us off to park while the tour leader (Hieu Ngyuen) gave us information and shared stories about the point of interest, returning right back to join us on a one-on-one basis. We were shown some interesting sites and Hieu’s commentary was detailed and engaging.There were local snacks and drinks provided along the way, as well as local fruits for us to try. Learned a lot about the local way of life while on the scooter chatting with my guide! Aside from the main guide we also had 2 male staff who were around to assist and flank the girls amidst the chaotic local traffic, which i thought was a very nice arrangement. Thumbs up to a great tour!

Food, scooter, history, neighborhoods - This tour combined food, scooter ride through the city, stops in different neighborhood districts with social and historical information provided. You’re paired up with a scooter driver who also stays by your side during the evening to act as hostess during the meals and provide information. Yuen (spelling?) was welcoming, engaging, and spoke excellent English. She was also a skilled scooter driver and zig zagged around the various neighborhoods adeptly. It started raining at the beginning of the tour and they had ponchos readily available. The food was plentiful and excellent. Noodle soup, baked scallops, duck embryo, grilled goat and okra skewers, sticky/crunchy rice thingy, shrimp, crab legs, frog legs, on and on...

Great food, Fun people - This tour exceeded all of our expectations. The food was amazing as well as the company. Our guides were fun and interesting to talk to, had a great time. Would highly recommend this tour!

Exhilarating and memorable! - The Saigon traffic snarl is infamous, so imagine being right in the midst of it! My family and I had a wonderful time on the foodie tour with our guides and riders Tuan, Tam, Yen, Tuong, Minh and Hanh. They spoke English fluently and made us feel cared for and safe. The food was delicious and everything was taken care of from start to finish. Thank you for a brilliant and unforgettable tour!

Fun and informative and lots of food! - Did the Foodie night tour on the back of a scooter with great guides who were expert drivers in the chaos that is Saigon traffic. Had lots of fun, games, food and experienced life in the busy motorcycle mad city Saigon. Certainly a highlight of our time in Vietnam

Awesome food tour - Did a night motor bike food tour. This is a must do in Saigon. The tour is well organized, the food was fantastic, and in a few hours got to see a variety of districts. The drivers, guides, staff all were fantastic. Probably one of the best tours I took in my time in Vietnam.

What great memories of Saigon - We have just returned from a trip around Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand and I have to say our evening out with the girls was one of the highlights. From the meal out down a back alleyway where the students go to the the drink and chat acros the other side of the river admiring the views of the city, we had great fun. Riding a bike in this city takes some nerve but doing it with an ageing British tourist on the back asking questions and videoing the ride is probably even tougher. This is a must do evening out in the city. Thanks for the memories team and thanks to Henry for the photos! Loved it

Incredible incredible incredible - This food tour..where should I start, it was absolutely amazing from start to finish. I cannot believe how much food I ate. And if you asked what my favorite dish was I would name 4. They start you off with what is now a dish I will forever wish I could find in the U.S. a noodle soup like pho but 10 times better. This is not just a food tour we also made a couple stops where a guide explained a little history and some interesting facts. Then on to more food. We ate everything from crab legs to scallops goat soup noodles fruit delicious desserts. SO MUCH FOOD and if you want more you just ask! Also unlimited beer and soda. The girls were excellent drivers and provided entertainment the entire night. We played games, talked about our lives and enjoyed amazing food. I would recommend this tour to everyone and I would do it again just to have all the delicious food. It's more than worth the price. I loved it so much the next day I googled where I could find some more soup and did so as my last meal in Vietnam. Thank you xo food tours for a wonderful night we loved it.

Do yourself a favor and book this tour - Don't have much time to write extensively, but wanted to endorse this wholeheartedly. Everything is great about this tour: drivers, tour guides, food. Their English is great and they are super friendly. Will show you interesting hoods that you would never visit by yourself, and take you to food places where you would never go by yourself. Just do it, you will not regret it! We loved it!

Foodie tour - Absolute must on your visit to Saigon! Not only was it informative, being on the back of a scooter in Ho Chi Minh is an experience in itself. The tour is incredibly fun and you taste amazing food all over the city! We loved it and highly recommend it to anyone visiting! Thank you xo tours!
Fantastic - Had an absolutely amazing time with this group, the site seeing was first class and the guides were excellent.

Fantastic fun - Experienced the XO Foodie tour when last in Ho Chi Minh City a few years ago, which we absolutely loved, so decided to use them again for a morning tour to see the sites. We were only in the city for a short time and wanted to see as much as we could for the little time available.
We were every bit as impressed with this tour as the last. The company are so efficient from our initial contact by email, which was responded to almost immediately, to collection from our hotel. Faultless.
The young women who drove us were, without exception, friendly, funny and charming and also very adept drivers. We felt safe at all times, despite the crazy traffic in the city. The guide who met us at each site was knowledgeable and lovely too.
We were with our son and daughter in law and they enjoyed themselves as much as we did, which shows it appeals to all age groups.
What a great company they are and certainly deserve all the praise they receive in the many TripAdvisor reviews posted. Highly recommended.

Amazing time, so worth it! - This was an amazing time, I highly suggest doing it at the beginning of your stay in ho chi minh city. It's not only a food tour but a tour of the whole city, a history lesson and the girls on the bikes are so hilarious. Be prepared though - it'll be the best thing you do there and possibly the best thing you do in your entire stay in Vietnam!

Highlight of our trip! - My mum, my 6 year old son and I did "The Sights" tour with Lyn, Quynh and Quang.

From the initial booking of the tour to getting dropped back at our hotel is was the most professional service we've had in HCMC.

The girls riding our bikes and Quang at each tourist site explaining the importance to the fresh juice and desserts at the local market it was all fantastic.

An experience we will never forget and will be forever thankful for.

Perfect Nighttour through Saigon! - We had an awesome tour with our tour leader Tien. All three girls drove us safe around the city and showed us parts of Saigon we wouldn't have seen. The best thing about the tour without a doubt are the beautiful girls who speak perfect English and can answer you any question about Saigon, Viet culture and the People. We highly recommend it but the price seems a little bit too high for young travellers.

Excellent tour.. Just go ahead and book it already.. - For anyone just a little adventurous I would highly recommend this tour.. Was not quite sure what to expect, but experiencing Ho Chi Minh City from the back of a scooter spiced with local food and interesting stories about the different part of the city turned out to be very interesting indeed.

Loved this foodie tour around Saigon! - We had a great time on this tour! You get to visit different districts in Saigon and enjoy several of the local cuisines all from the main mode of transportation the locals use, a motorbike. The ladies that drive the bikes are so nice, knowledgeable, fun and their english is great - they engaged in convo throughout the tour and answered any questions we had. The main guide snaps photos of you along the way. They also have "bodyguards" accompanying the tour. I felt completely safe the whole time. You get as much food as you want and an eclectic variety and you also learn about the city. I highly recommend this tour!

Do it! - This was so much fun, like an 18-30's trip but for grown ups (allegedly).
They picked us up from the hotel promptly, took us on the back of mopeds to meet up with the rest of the tour, ate some kind of delicious stew and then got on our way.
Tai the boss man speaks perfect English as do all the ladies that ride the mopeds.
Went all over Ho chi Minh City, places you would never get to on foot.
I ate frog for the first time in my life, delicious, just waiting for Tesco to start stocking it!
The girls cooked at the tables for us at one of the stops, at another it was brought to the tables. All delicious food and non of it made me sick the next day which is always s bonus.
If you are planning a moped your of the City I can recommend these guys, will definitely go again.

This Tour is Amazing! - Take a motorbike tour with these ladies.They really know how to get around the city. The traffic in the city is crazy and this was the best way to see the sites. Along with the post office and Reunification Palace there are stops at the market for some snacks and you get to grab a drink on the go, which means while you're still on the back of the bike!

Great way to start a visit to Ho Chi Minh; absolutely delicious food and great guides - This was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh. A friend recommended the tour and it went above and beyond our expectations. Riding on the back of a motorbike was a great way to see the city (and get more comfortable with the craziness of traffic in Ho Chi Minh). Our guides were incredibly sweet and did a really nice job explaining the layout of the city and many of the local customs.

The food on the tour was also excellent. XO Tours did a great job taking us to places that felt very genuinely local and also told us that they avoided feeding us easily accessible Vietnamese food (e.g., Pho) in favor of some other more local flavors. The food turned out to be incredible.

Food on a bike - Such a great experience. Immersed in the crazy traffic of Saigon with Anh who navigated the way to all corners of the city. The whole XO team was friendly and enthusiastic, making the night a memorable one. The food was excellent and not your typical Vietnamese fare. A must do when visiting Saigon.

Fantastic Motorbike Food Tour - A fantastic first night in Saigon with this food tour. Don't have lunch the food is plentiful and varied with some sightseeing thrown in. For me the seafood at the end was a real highlight.

I never knew whizzing around the city on the back of a motorbike in crazy traffic would be such fun. I can now toast in Vietnamese and am a champion, do the tour to find out whether you can be one too!

My lovely driver Lee (apologies if this spelt wrong) was great fun and we chatted all the way. We even sang Christmas songs. What a great memory as we sailed over one of the many rivers singing George Michael's Last Christmas.

Absolutely all of the drivers were polite, fun and engaging. The tour leader Khoi was extremely nice, very informative and ran everything with precision.

My husband and I were really impressed. It's been a highlight of our two week trip to Cambodia and Vietnam. Don't miss doing this and do use this excellent company.

Absolute BEST way to see the city! - I was told about this tour by a friend who had recently visited Ho Chi Minh city and I am forever thankful that she did. I can’t imagine a better way to see so much of the city and to experience different types of food than this! Simply put: I don’t think you have truly toured HCMH unless you have taken this tour. The staff are wonderful and the food - let’s just say if you do not walk away feeling guilty for your gluttony than that is on you- is great! I can not over recommend this tour - book NOW!!

Highlight of my Holiday - I did the Saigon By Night tour and it was one of the best things I did during my two-week tour of Vietnam. I'll admit I was a bit nervous because the traffic in Saigon is chaotic to say the least and I've never been on a moped before, but there was absolutely no reason to be worried, I felt safe the entire time.

My guide (Tuong 2) was absolutely fantastic, chatting to me the entire way about life in Vietnam and her experiences, and answering the questions I had. She was lovely and I felt totally safe with her, and we had some laughs on the way. Also our tour manager Sang was great, he told us so much about the city during our various stopping points.

Honestly, I learned more about the country on this tour than any other part of my trip, and it was excellent to see the city from another perspective. We covered so much ground, with local food, and good company, but mostly it felt pretty cool to be whizzing along the streets with all the other commuters.

It was professionally run, they looked after us really well, and I totally recommend it to anyone.

Night Saigon Ride - Even with the pouring rain, the guide was cheerful and informative and told me information about and took me to places in Saigon I would never have considered visiting otherwise. The food was tasty, can’t recommend enough. What a great way to see the city without having to navigate the roads, felt very safe at all times! They also email you photos so you have memories to look back on :)
Fantastic - What a great experience this was. It was raining the whole time but the drivers were awesome and very safe so didn't need to worry. I would highly recommend this

Took two tours - night food tour & private sightseeing - Food tour
Went all over city on motorbike. Young woman were very nice and fluent in English. At each stop there was a guide who gave an overview of what we are eating ladies also added commentary

Different than other food tours as it was more focused on experience rather than food quality But a great experience overall. Three food stops. beef Pho, BBQ and fish/ sweet
Be prepared to try some unusual dishes
Have to comment. There was moonsoon type rain falling and we waited in one place for it to let up a bit. Was very impressed that they refunded part of the ticket price bc they cancelled one of the siteseeing stops
They also gave us rain gear which kept us try

The highlight of both tours was the scooter ride. I had not risen in 30+ years and was very nervous especially considering the Saigon traffic. I really enjoyed seeing the city by bike. Felt very safe and secure. The young woman were really a delight to be with

private site seeing tour. Well worth the extra money to do. 3 hours and we saw the highlights. Post office cathedral reunification palace spot where last us helicopter took off , local markets Buddhist monument China town and Chinese temple
Guide was excellent and gave us enough information and answered all questions. Had some snacks and drinks along the way again the young woman were great drivers and helped fill in extra information

So much fun!!! - Had a fantastic night doing this tour - not only is the food great, but the atmosphere they create is amazing. Being a solo traveler, I was very impressed with how the tour guides went out of their way to be social and ensure that guests have a good time and interact with each other. I also LOVED getting to see other parts of the city that I would never see on my own, especially by scooter!! While she may be the shortest, my scooter guide Le Nhung was the best - great driver and great fun. Tour leader Tai Dang was awesome, informative and interesting and took some great photos! Thanks guys for a fantastic night :)

Fun night out! - I have had my doubts with doing a food tour as I've had the assumption you eat the generic local food which we have all tried. However this tour squashed those assumptions and I was surprised by the diversity in the dishes included. All the dished eaten where ones I have never tried before during my 1 month trip through Vietnam. I also got to try some adventurous dishes such as BBQ frog and duck egg fetus. Highly recommend this tour!!

Foodie Tour - Ho Cho Minh City - If there’s one thing you must do in HCMC it’s this tour.
Tour organiser Sang is one of the nicest people you’ll meet and shares some very interesting insight and knowledge about Vietnam and the culture. The tour whilst not super cheap is worth every cent. The range of food is amazing and you’ll be sure to go home full.
The tour girls are fantastic and a heap of fun as well, you won’t regret booking a foodie tour with XO.

An absolute must if you’re visiting Saigon - My husband and I did this tour a few days ago and it was pretty much the best fun ever! Our drivers, Min and Lin (excuse me if I’ve spelt that wrong) were great company and we felt very confident with them both driving. The traffic in Saigon is really something else so it’s a pretty exhilarating experience weaving through it. Great opportunity to see parts of the city you might not do otherwise.

Khoi’s talks in between food stops were interesting and informative, this is about much more than the food. The food is ‘interesting’ to say the least, a chance to experience foods you wouldn’t normally try, but you don’t need to be a foodie to enjoy the whole experience anyway.

Fantastic fun, thanks XO tours!

The Sights tour is amazing!!! - I had so much fun on The Sights tour!! We spent the day cruising around the city, weaving thru traffic and truly experiencing the magic of Saigon. The drivers and guide were so helpful. We learned so many cool facts about the city that you don't get on large group tours. This felt so much more personal. Tasting Vietnamese desserts in the markets, sitting with families in the villages, and learning about the history of the city. I'd have done all of their tours of I had more time!! You get a chance to meet the people you are on tour with so it feels much more comfortable. You really should experience this yourselves!

Great night out - Not sure to start with but the girls from XO Food Tours are very good at making you feel safe and relaxed on their motorcycles,all the stops were good food and great company,i am 67 and had a great time.

Incredibly exciting --yet safe in a sea of other motorbikes - This tour stood out from just about any tour I have ever taken. It had the right combination of excitement (on the back of a motorbike with an experienced driver), cultural and culinary landmarks (including at the market!), and history (from the tour leader, Hieu Nguyen, who gave us some key historical facts about each of the major landmarks, such as the unification palace and the Notre Dame church). In four hours, this ended up being the best essence of Saigon, truly the best educational adventure that can be had on two wheels!

XO Tours - Foodie Night Street Food - Awesome! - We did the foodie tour by motorbike our second night is HCMC. Great food. Really fun crew of drivers/leader. I highly recommend this tour if you go to Saigon and want to eat the best street food.

XO Food Tour - Excellent Fun - My husband and I joined the XO Food Tour last weekend and had loads of fun. The ladies on the bikes were professionals and it was very safe. The evening was well planned and Tai and his team were great. Food was very good and it was a great opportunity to see other districts in HCM. Highly recommend this activity for everyone.

Great Introduction to Ho Chi Minh City - We did the morning sightseeing tour. This takes you around the major attractions and is an excellent introduction to the city. It doesn't take you to the War Remnants Museum because that is a sight worth visiting on its own. You go to local markets, not the touristy ones, the post office, reunification palace (outside only), Notre Dame cathedral and China town. The guides are brilliant and make it a lot of fun. Refreshing snacks are provided as well. We often do local guided tours when visiting new cities and this tour is up there with the best of them.

Brilliant tours - DO NOT MISS! - We used XO for both 'the sights' and 'the foodie' tour around HCMC. Myself and my husband absolutely had an amazing time and left the tours buzzing! The girls were so friendly and great safe drivers through the busy streets and the tour guide was so informative. The girls offered additional information whilst you were traveling along on the scooter and could easily answer your questions about HCMC and Vietnam as you travelled around. We were sent photos of us on the tours within a few days and the whole thing was incredibly well organised! The food tour was my highlight, as a veggie I was completely catered for and given so many huge dishes that I shared out with the rest of the group, all so tasty. Even the sights tour included snacks and drinks, fresh fruit and some yogurt and caramel flan at a local market. Everyone should check out at least one of the tours from XO, you will not be disappointed!

Easily a highlight of our trip so far - My guide Han (I hope I've spelled that right) was incredible, she had fantastic English and was really insightful on such a broad range of topics. We did the evening tour that brought us to loads of districts we would otherwise never have seen and gave us a much better overall idea of the city. Never once felt nervous, I'd highly recommend to anyone

HCM Foodie Tour on a Moto - Excellent !! - I booked the “Foodie Tour” online on their website well in advance and the communication was great.

As promised we got picked up by two really nice young ladies on Motos at our hotel, and we were taken to a meeting place and the first restaurant where we met the tour guide Tai, a very knowledgable tour guide and leader of the group.

The tour lasted about 4 hrs, we were taken to some restaurants and other places of interest, visiting several of the Ho Chi Minh districts, not just the Expat area, getting some history lessons and other information each time. We ate some great food and had a few beers as well.

Our Moto girls were excellent and gave us commentary along the way, also good safe riders. Special thanks to Tien & Anh !!!!!

I highly recommend the XO Foodie Tour.

A must do! - Me and ny boyfriend decided to try this food tour in Saigon based on the ratings on tripadvisor. We did not regret it afterwards!
We got picked up at our hotel by our drivers around 5:20 pm and brought to the first restaurant stop where we met the rest of the group. We were about 10 people on this tour.

The tour takes about 4,5 hours and has 5 stops - where you eat/drink at stop 1, 3 and 5. At stop 2 and 4 our guide Tai talked about the different districts of Saigon - really interesting - and necessary with a break from the good food - so you have more room on the next food stop! It’s all you can eat/drink, and we tried a total of around 12 dishes - my favorite beeing frog (dare to try it if you haven’t already) and clams (last stop).

Definitely would recommend doing this, because of the good food, a really good guide and a perfect driver! I really felt safe in the hectic trafic on the back of your scooter Sky! Thanks for a lovely evening!

do it do it do it!!! - We had an excellent evening with XO tours. The drivers are all brilliant so not need to be nervous (I had never been on a motorbike before!)
There were 3 food stops and they were all brilliant, especially the last seafood one. Our guides could not do enough to help us enjoy our evening; the drinks were free flowing and we even played a quick game. It was more of a city tour than i had realised, we saw lots of sites as well as eating (and we learned lots)
A particular thank you to Tien, my driver/guide who was amazing. Probably the best bit about the tour was getting a bit of an insight into real life in Vietnam and Tien was the reason for this. one of the highlights of our trip, thank yoU!!!!!!

Excellent food, company and sightseeing! - We were only in Saigon for one night and were looking to maximize our experience. We saw XO Tours highly recommended several places and decided to give them a whirl (quite literally, as you are on the back of a motor bike for the tour!). We did the food tour and it was amazing. The guides seemed like friends.... we went to local places/neighborhoods we probably would not have ventured to on our own.... the food was delicious... and we learned about the city along the way. Overall, it was one of the best tours I've ever been on and was the highlight of my 10 day trip. Many thanks to Hong (my guide) and the rest of the team for such a memorable, enjoyable and warm experience.
Awesome sauce - This was the best tour ever. Friendly and safe. Nicely organized. Will definitely do this again. Blah blah blah blah blah blah

An amazing food and cultural experience - Absolutely awesome experience. Our drivers (Ve and Thu) were courteous, polite and punctual, and full of interesting and fun facts about Vietnam.

Our tour leader, Tai introduced himself and it was clear that his English was excellent. He quickly established a rapport with all group members and briefly outlined where we were going to go, and what to expect. Tai was passionate about his country, and was very keen to share his experiences living in Vietnam as well as his comprehensive knowledge of the very different Districts we would be riding through.

The food we tried at various locations was authentic Vietnamese and ranged from soup to BBQ and seafood delicacies as well as sweets - all complemented with local beer and a taste of a locally produced spirit.

We recommend this to be one of the first things to do as soon as you get to Vietnam. It gives you a great basis to understand the breadth of the city, the traditional food the country offers and different aspects of the various districts (ie shopping in Chinatown). A fantastic experience not to be missed – we would definitely repeat on a second visit to this amazing country!

David and Michelle

Excellent way to eat real Vietnamese and see HCMC! - We booked the “Foodie Tour” online on their website the night before, and got an informative email back right away.

We got picked up by two really nice ladies on scooters at our hotel, and they drove us to the first restaurant where we met 8 others and the tour guide Tai, a really nice guy who is good at his job! Also being the main guide, he also photographed the tour and emails you the pictures.

The tour lasted around 4.5 hrs, all the places we ate at where awesome. Eat and drink as much as you want/can. The tour combines food and sightseeing with some historic insight, and you get to see many districts of HCMC at night.

Also a chance to eat at really good local restaurants with zero other tourist.

Safe and good drivers, thanks Sky and Bang!

A must when in HCMC, highly recommended!

Amazing tour - This tour is very informative, with wonderful guides and the food is fantastic.
A must do in Ho Chi Minh, it gives you a new perspective of the city.

Well worth doing. - I had the best time on this tour. Sooooo much fun. My driver was Skye and she was the loveliest most informative guide I could have hoped for.
The food......well prepared to be right out of your comfort zone, but also be prepared to give it all a try, even the jumping chicken.
Honestly, if you get the opportunity to do this, then do it.
Not only are the drivers great, but the food experience is great and the local information you get along the way is great. A fun, informative and enjoyable tour.
Thanks Skye. You're the best.

Brilliant experience - What a great opportunity to join the other millions of scooters on the streets of HCM. The girls are brilliant. I felt completely safe and confident with the driving and loved whizzing round the city. At each stop we got off and our guide met up with us and spent time telling us about parts of HCM we would never have come across on most tours. Definitely recommend the half day tour. Great fun and informative.

Great tour! - Such a great tour overall! The ladies that picked us up were so sweet and helpful. They visited lots and gave us lots of helpful hints and tips. The bikes were a blast to drive around on and we felt very safe on them. The food was also so good. We tried some very interesting food items that we never would have tried ok our own.

Would 100% recommend this tour.

Sightseeing Tour - We don't normally do tours like this but due to a project taking up most of our time in HCM city, we realized we needed to see everything quickly otherwise we wouldn't have time.
The price is quite high but it was worth it! The riders were soooo friendly! They were full of knowledge, recommendations and laughter. You could tell they loved their jobs!
The tour guide was funny and great at explaining everything. Great knowing you are famous and in the hands of experienced riders. Definitely recommend the tour even if you aren't on a tight schedule.

Fun Food Tour - I was debating on this trip. Especially since it was 75 USD. Pretty pricy when compared to the food tours we did in Hanoi. But I have to say the team really worked hard to make this a great trip. We had a lot of fun, there was a lot of food. Heaps of sight seeing. Khoi the team lead was really funny and the team was well organized.
The gals were all really nice, sweet and funny. it turned out to be a group of friends zooming through the city. Would recommend doing this.

Great fun and great people - Was a bit nervous - how do the very small girls cope with a bit fat guy on the back of their bikes in Saigon's rush hour? Answer - Perfectly. The guides are fun, knowledgeable and safe. They speak perfect English and many are graduates of translation school. The drive through the traffic was exciting and I felt myself relax after the first ten minutes when it became obvious they knew what they were doing. The food stops were great fun, and they kept up an interesting commentary during the trip. Really cannot recommend these guys highly enough.

The foody tour - an absolute must - The foody tour is something you have to try whilst staying in Saigon.you get picked up at hotel and for 4 hours you travel on the back of a motorcycle with the best knowledgeable ladies, traveling through Vietnam like you've never seen before, eating the best food. The men in black follow behind to ensure your safety. For $100 au each, it is worth every minute.

Fabulous "The Sights" Tour!! - We chose to do "The Sights" tour with XO tours on our very first morning in Vietnam. This was such a fun day! Riding on the back of the motor bike can be a little bit overwhelming at first due to the crazy traffic in Saigon, but these ladies know what they are doing! This is a spectacular way to see the city. The guides take you on a tour of many different districts and take you to see some sights that are off the typical tourist trail. My favorite part was visiting the local market and trying some of the food! Yum! Thank you for a fantastic day :)

Street Food Vespa Tour - Wow. We went on the XO tours street food tour and had such an amazing time. The trip around the city was a fantastic way to see the less frequented districts, and the food was incredible. All of the riders and guides were incredibly welcoming, friendly and funny and we will do this again in a heartbeat. Can't recommend enough.

Tour of the city, penty of food and your own guide/driver - The tour goes through many districts in Saigon and you get a sense of the size of the city and the different aspects of the city. The food is well chosen giving the tourists offerings that are a little more difficult to find on their own. The last stop showcases the excellent seafood that can be found in Saigon. The best part of the tour is actually the guides. You have your own personal guide who is also your drive. It is like being introduced to a new friend

Foodie tour + sightseeing - Worth it!!:) Must do in HCMC!! Very well organized. 3 food-trips and 2 sight seeing. First class service—the ladies will even help you with your food. They will cook, cut and open the crabs for you. :) They even include bodyguards for you to feel safe. We even have photos sent to us through email!:) Our head tour guide provided iPad pictures for us to appreciate the history of the districts that we visited.:) food includes: grilled meat, wrapped meat, shrimp, crabs, clams, fruits, pho noodle, coconut jelly. The areas you will go are not fancy, dress simple.:) 👍🏻 for Sang our Tour guide!:)

Fabulous Food Tour - This tour was definitely a highlight of our trip to Vietnam. As a family of four we were given a private tour led by Tuan. We sampled some amazing food in venues that we would have never seen by ourselves. The girls were fantastic guides as well as being a lot of fun, we loved their company and constant chat, which they managed to keep up while weaving through the traffic clogged streets (Hong, you are a serious multi-tasker!) Whizzing through Saigon on the back of a motorbike is definitely an experience not to be missed.

Absolutely the best thing to do in HCMC!! - Tonight we did the "Saigon by Night" with XO Tours. It was by far the best thing we did during our time in HCMC. Our tour leader, Tuan, was fantastic!! He had such a great personality and told so many funny stories about life as a young Vietnamese man. Our drivers, Phuong & Huynh, we are so cute. We talked about so many things as we drove from one district to another. We stopped for delicious food at two different places and truly enjoyed the camaraderie. This tour may seem a bit pricey compared to the others offered throughout the city, but it is well worth the extra $. The owner is a Vietnamese American, and really understands what is important to Westerners. They also took lots of pics during the tour that they emailed you about 5 days later. This is an activity that cannot be missed.

Sight tour and foodie tour - Both were amazing! The girls made me feel very safe on the back of the bike. Enjoyed meeting new people, enjoying local food and seeing main attractions.

Overall super fun experience from start to finish! Highly recommend.
Great motorbike tour! - Very well organized tour, with extremely nice and knowledgeable guides. Felt safe the entire time despite being driven in the crazy HCM traffic.

Guide was really friendly, great insight into city life! - Did the nightlife tour, was a bit worried about riding on the back of a moped but the guide really put me at ease, and as soon as we got going all worries went away. Was solo (obviously) for the driving parts, but met with a group for the food/strolling portions. Guide was super friendly and easy to chat to, and this was a great way to see parts of the city that as a solo traveler I probably wouldn't venture to otherwise.

Best tour ever! - It is the most incredible experience for feeling like being in a part of Vietnamese ppl and more into their life closer. Perfec english speaking tour guide and best driver guide, friendly n nice! Thank u guys

Simply Superb - We did the city tour this morning and I can quite honestly say that this is the greatest way to immerse yourself into Ho Chi Minh. Sitting on the back of a scooter traveling from one site to another. We stopped to taste fresh yoghurt and a dessert at a local market and then on the way to our last stop we picked up an iced coffee and drank it sitting on the back of the scooter.

I thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to experience what it's like riding around the streets of HCMC.

Foodie tour - We cannot recommend XO tours enough! All of the guides and drivers were super professional and friendly. They were full on helpful hints and information. And the food, amazing!
Must do tour

absolutely uninteresting - We did this tour on our first night and it was the highlight of our entire 2 week holiday, the tour on the back of vespa,s took us all around Saigon experiencing the different styles of food in each district, the female drivers constantly talked about the history of Saigon and there own lives making you feel like a family member, i would recommend this tour to any one.

Great experience! Must do!! - We had chosen The foodie Tour, that was an absolutely wonderfull experience! Girls came to pick us up, Made Fun and are very Safe drivers. The combination of meeting New people, Also other tourists, food and driving through different zones of The city is perfect. The food is delicious and The planning is really Well organized. A must do! Thank you So much! Gr Sjoerd & Tessa

The Foodies Tour - Another great XO tour - I have already been on two XO tours but have been looking forward to doing the Foodies one. It didn't disappoint! Sang was an informative and personable tour leader. He took the time to learn everyone's name and also to chat with each of us personally during the tour. He took photos overyone on the tour and emailed them to us later. They are a lovely memory of a great evening.

My motor scooter driver was Ngoc. She arrived 10 minutes early when she came to pick me up, so we were able to have a chat before we left. She was a very good driver andf I was soon completely relaxed, even though I had fallen off a motor scooter on the island of Lembongan a year ago and was therefore, initially, a little nervous. Ngoc was also a great hostess, explaining which sauce went with which tidbit of food, cracking open the crab and extracting the flesh and so on.
Last, but not least, I should add that the food was delicious. We tried lots of dishes: everything from Bun Bo Hue noodle soup to crab and, my favorite, scallops in their shells with a very tasty sauce.

Brilliant! - This tour is amazing! Sang and the drivers were so friendly, made us feel very welcome and most of all very safe on the back of a bike for the first time! The food was great and abundant and the beer and soft drinks flowed freely. "The best thing iv ever done on holiday, anywhere" were the exact words of my girlfriend! Very highly recommended!

Great way to explore Saigon with passionate guides! - We traveled in a group of six, this was the highlight of our trip to Saigon!

1. Best way to see and understand Saigon's history in a few hours
2. Very knowledgeable and informative tour leader, and the scooter angles are just great (even for someone who is scooter-phobia like me, her skills and patience make me feel comfortable)
3. It is amazing to see how scooters / motorbikes crisscrossing at cross-roads, it is definitely a life experience to be part of that!
4. it is a trip with passion and kind heart, the team took effort for us to try local specialties (popular drinks, seasonal fruits), and have professionally taken photos through dropbox to capture the great memory!

Foodie tour - This is one of the highly recommended trips. Riding on motorcycle in Saigon is one of a kind experience for ppl who never ride on motorcycle before. The guides are well trained. We had lots of fun. Highly recommended.

Excellent food and company! Highlight of HCMC! - We went on the foodie scooter tour and had a fantastic evening!

The company are extremely professional and well organized. As a vegetarian couple, we were so grateful that they arranged a huge variety of meat-free, fish-free food for us to sample throughout the evening without any trouble at all.

The girls collected us from our hostel and took us to meet the rest of the group. We felt safe and comfortable with the girls, but also had a male scooter driver with us at all times, just in case there were any problems.

We spent the evening driving through districts of Ho Chi Minh city that we otherwise had no intention to see as they are not tourist attractions. We stopped along the way to learn about these districts and sample their specialty food and drink. The host ensures an unlimited supply was available at each stop - and they really do fill you to the brim!

This tour gave us a fantastic opportunity to socialize with other travelers, eat with the locals, and compete with each other during the fun and games!

We would like to extend special thanks to our host Sang Nguyen who took care of our dietary requirements. Also, the awesome girls who drove us around the city, did karaoke with us, taught us how to eat their food, kept us energized throughout the evening and brought us back to our hostel in one piece - Nhung Le and Yen Nguyen.

Sites and Food Tour - We did both the sites and food tour in one day. A great way to see Ho Chi Minh. Tai was our guide who was funny and insightful. The drivers made us feel welcome, were very happy to talk about their much loved city. We felt very safe and the food was amazing. Very well organized and would highly recommend.

Fab Foodie Tour - The idea of ​​doing a city food tour on the back of a scooter in the crazy traffic of HCMC was a bit daunting. But we took the advice of friends who had previously done it and were thrilled. The four young women who came to our hotel to collect us immediately set us at our ease with their simple instructions on safety and their professionalism. They were experts at navigating the traffic. Over the course of about 4 hours, we covered 5 different districts of the city, sampling an amazing array of Vietnamese specialties beyond the common items (such as pho and spring rolls) available back in Toronto. Two of the stops were sightseeing stops where the tour leader gave a fascinating talk on the history of those districts (the Chinese and Korean areas respectively). The evening spent in the company of our engaging XO drivers and hosts was a resounding culinary, cultural and educational success!

Great way to see the city - Did the food tour with these guys and glad l did it. Went through districts 1,2,7 and 4 and Coy (?) was very informative and Tree (?) was a great rider. Experienced some amazing flavors and got a taste of real Vietnamese food although I had to pass on the duck embryos!
Thank you XO.

Great street food tour! - This is an incredibly well organized and well run street food tour. Takes you all around different parts of Saigon and you get to try 10-15 different local specialties. They took great care of us given a few food allergies in our group. Yen and Vi were great guides, offering great insight into local life and food in Saigon. Sang was a great tour leader. Would highly recommend!

Great night out in the city! - It's a bit too crazy to try to ride yourself through the city, so being the passenger was a really good option. Guide speaks fluent English and learn quite a lot about the city in the few hours. Food was amazing and we got to try all sorts of different foods in different districts. Would definitely recommend.

XO foodie tour is a blast! - On the back of a motorbike is the BEST way to tour HCM City. Nerve wracking? No doubt, but this is the true HCM experience. And the food is delicious! It includes a wide variety of authentic Vietnamese cuisines, artfully prepared and abundant. The main tour guide shares broad knowledge of the city. Door to door service by your friendly, English-speaking driver makes this a perfect evening. Go for it!

Highlight of my Trip to Vietnam (Caters to tall people as well!) - As i stated in the title i am 197cm so the thought of being on the back of a motorcycle in Saigon can be a little daunting at first but once you hop on and start driving for a bit you learn to just relax and just embrace the organized chaos that is Saigon traffic knowing full well that your driver will look after you and get you where you need to go safely. The drivers are excellent, they speak extremely good English, are very friendly and outgoing, are well dressed and are very eager to listen to you talking about your home country. You will definitely form a bond with your driver throughout the tour. I will not spoil the trip but rest assured that you are in good safe hands surrounded by great company enjoying wonderful food and drink together and just embracing what the city has to offer.

Great day out - We had a fantastic time on the sights tour, at great way to see Ho Chi Minh city! The guides were so knowledgeable and the girls went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. We would definitely recommend!

Best tour in the city! - We had read glowing reviews so booked the foodie tour before we even arrived. It was even better than we expected! The ladies are excellent drivers and tour guides, we felt safe the whole trip. It was so good to get out of district one and to see the different districts and taste the local flavours. The food was delicious and did include some unusual foods (goat and frog were really tasty) but there was no pressure to eat anything you didn't want. The scallops we had were the best thing I've eaten in Vietnam so far!

Highly recommended!

What a great night! - Second time I've done this same foodie tour but this time a couple deal (last year I was solo). Had perhaps an even better experience and time sharing this with my partner and of course the wonderful tour leader Tai and his wonderful team of female drivers who took each of the 10 people in our group to each destination on the route.

Each stop was fantastic, informative and delectable.

Just love XO Tours and what they deliver.

Highly recommend and I consider it a must do thing for everyone visiting Saigon.

I really enjoyed it! - We went on The Sights tour last week with myself, hubby and our 2 kids. Picked this company as they had insurance which others didn't seem to have that, which gave us piece of mind. Our 2.5yo went on the bike between dad and the driver, and I wore our 6m old son in a carrier, so we had 2 bikes/drivers between us. We all really enjoyed it! We only were in HCMC for 3 days (arriving and departing on days 1 and 3), so this tour was a perfect way to see the city in an "express" way. Our drivers (ladies) were both really lovely and polite. We thought they would do the "tour guide talking" at each stop, but actually we had another person meet us at each stop and tell us about where we were. He had a tablet as well which showed old historical pictures to give more context about where we were and the history behind it. The day was hot (pack sunscreen!) and while lunch wasn't included, the team provided us with lots of refreshments throughout in the form of sweets, drinks and snacks. They took heaps of family photos of us which we really appreciated, and emailed us the photos a few days afterwards. Everyone was so lovely to our kids as well and even held and played with our youngest while we looked through the Chinese temple. Price was worth it given the experience and how zippy it was as a sightseeing tour, rather than a bus tour.

Great fun experience - Had a great time on the night tour, definitely one of the highlights of our stay in HCMC. Felt like a local whizzing around on the scooter. All the girls were friendly, spoke excellent English and made us feel very welcome. Good way to see areas of the city you wouldn't normally get to. The food and drink included was really nice. Highly recommended.

Could not have been better! - We did both the sight seeing tour and the food tour. Not only were the tours highly informative, the sights interesting, and the food outstanding, the guides could not have been more personable. In particular, I highly recommend the food tour. Not only did we get to know our guides, we also got to meet and enjoy the company of the other visitors. The guides all have excellent social skills and really promoted a very positive experience for all.
Foodie Tour - No point in repeating all the other reviews on TA - it's all been said already, this tour is well worth doing and I thoroughly recommend it. Great fun with Foo and the others!

OMG amazing - we did the foodie tour, all the reviews rave about this, well so do i.
a bit apprehensive at the start but after a short time it was fine. the hosts are excellent and full of fun and adventure, at no time did we feel unsafe or at risk, there was also support staff and completely professional. The tour even has you announced.

The thing is, in the traffic in the car you in the traffic in a bubble, on the back of a moped you are part of the traffic, the life blood flows through the arteries of the road and this is an experience we westerners cannot duplicate. You will visit areas you will never get to as a typical tourist.

all i can say is go for it

Just book it! - Booked this tour with my wife, I think this tour is the highlight of our stay in saigon. Our drivers / tour guide Chau and Thuy (Teow) and their tour manager Tai are all very professional and entertaining. All the food they served is really good and authentic Vietnamese dishes that you won't easily find just strolling around the streets. Tai and the girls have explained very well the food they have served us and gave us a little history of every district that we passed through and stopped over. We will definitely book this tour again when we get back to HCMC.

Just do it, you will be pleased with your decision - We did the Saigon city night tour with XO tours for our family of four and paid the extra for the video filming to go along with it. We already had booked a food tour in Hue and we thought our two teenage boys wouldn't really be up for the dedicated foodie tour. So we decided to save the $30USD each and go with the night tour. So it turned out there was plenty of food offered up on that tour as well so we didn't have to worry about being fed.

This tour was excellent. They looked after us very well and we felt safe at all times. Because the speed limit in Saigon is only 30mph there was never any time when we felt that we were going too fast or the traffic was an issue. Sure we spent quite a bit of time on the scooters but the girls kept us engaged at all times telling us about the city and the history of Vietnam and their service was fantastic.

We went to 4 or 5 different areas of the city including China Town, the markets, the newer upmarket part of town and all points in between.

Our two teenage boys thoroughly enjoyed themselves and we felt the tour, despite adding up to quite a few dollars, was well worth the investment. This was our second time to Saigon and this was probably the best thing we experienced in either visit there.

We were fortunate to order the photo and video package, which made it so much more special. This was only modest in price but the guys did an excellent job with it. They even faithfully included the songs in the video that we requested. I would highly recommend it.

Thank you XO tours. Please keep doing what you do so well.

Scooter adventure - A fabulous night out with the boys and girls of XO
We went on the night food tour and had so much fun
The girls were charming and funny and our guide informative and friendly

This was just a great experience and we learned and laughed so much
Thank you!

Wonderful tour - will do it again! - The highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Min City and, probably, the highlight of our whole trip to Vietnam. I do not know which part of the evening I enjoyed the most - riding on the motorcycle in the very busy traffic, the wonderful food at the various restaurants or simply the company of the guides and the others on the tour. It was all marvellous and totally unforgettable. Very highly recommended - including for pensioners like myself. Not to be missed.

5 is not a high enough score - This was one of the best tours I have ever been on. The driver Trang3 picked me up from my hotel and straight away she was so friendly and welcoming I felt as if I had known her for years. Through out the tour Trang3 was telling me all about the areas we were in and the district we were going to next.
The tour leader Tuan was fabulous and kept us entertained and filled us full of knowledge about each district and about Vietnam itself.

The food was fabulous and there was lots of it. Had to pace myself at the start so I wasn’t full for the next stop but that wasn’t a problem. Exciting being the passenger on the back of the scooter but the girls are very good drivers and I never felt in any danger at all.

I can not recommend this tour any higher for anybody visiting Ho Chi Minh and there is no excuse as you can do a day or night tour. The night tour would be best to escape the heat and the traffic.

Foodie Tour 16/10/2017 - This was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam! Our lovely drivers collected us from the hotel and zoomed around HCMC to our relevant stops in the different districts and dropped back to our hotel door. We felt very safe and we enjoyed chats with our drivers and tour guide. The food was outstanding! We tried things we have never eaten (or even thought to try!) and we were not disappointed. My husband and I both had some dietary restrictions, which the team managed very well and provided alternative dishes. Our tour guide Khoi also took photos throughout the night so we could relax and just enjoy the evening. Photos were emailed to us very promptly, which we appreciated.

All the best XO Tours, thank you again for a wonderful experience!

Kind Regards,
Sonya and Kalon

Highly Recommended Bike Tour - MUST Do in Saigon! - When i first saw the Excellent rating for XO Tour, I decided to book the air tickets to HCMC. The bike tour looked fun and safe. And true enough, it was exceptional!

The foodie tour was quite pricey USD 75pp for abt a 5hr tour, but it was worth every cent. We traveled with their full time drivers Phuong and Dung, as well as the Tour Manager Tai Dang who were all very good. Tai was enthusiastic, caring and sincere.

My driver/rider was Phuong who was excellent with her service. She speaks immaculate English having graduated from uni majoring in English.

The tour covers 3 food stops and 2 "intro of HCM" stops in the Chinatown and Korean town of the city. The bikes (which are v safe) zipped us through different districts of the city and allowed us to see the different faces of the city. The traffic was interesting, busy, messy yet orderly at times.... and we got to see how/where some of the locals ply their trade and stay.

There was plenty of food and unlimited drinks including beer. The drivers/host will help to barbecue the food, peel the crab off the claw etc. Very good service. They had an entourage to follow to take photos and for security purposes. I thought it was rather impressive when we went over a hump whilst taking off to the next stop and one of the staff helped to cushion the uneven ground/fall.

All in all, the tour with XO Tour was truly the highlight of our holiday. Keep up the exceptional service standards and smiles!

XO motorcycle foodie tour - great girls, great food & an excellent nights entertainment. very smooth & confident riders negotiating the usual traffic. good english speaking skills. told us all about the different districts on our visits & cooked some excellent meals for us

The tour of HCM, great, funny and tasty. - Excellent tour. Tu and Vy picked us up in front of the hotel, really friendly, professional and funny girls who were our drivers for the night. First they drove us to our first destination, where we met our guide Tai, who was great, always in a good mood, constantly making jokes, making the tour even more fun. The food they serve you is to die for, you even get to taste some of their local "weird" stuff ;-) (If you want of course). The tour is really well organized, they are well prepared even for rainy weather, which caught us by surprise. I think the rain made the tour even more spectacular. It didn't rain for long, but HCM traffic and rainy weather made it even more fun. There were a few more stops, but I am not going to spoil the adventure so If you are in HCM city I really recommend you book this tour, I think you won't regret it.

Best Food Tour - The XO Tours "Foodie" Tour was the perfect way to experience the food and nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City! Not only was the food great, but the staff and tour guides added to a wonderful experience as well. Our drivers, Thuy1 and Han, and our tour guide, Koi, made sure we had an amazing night!

Highly Recommended! - If you're in Ho Chi Minh you NEED to do a tour with XO.
We were short on time in Ho Chi and wanted to do a tour that would teach and show us a lot in a short amount of time. We chose the “Saigon by Night” tour and loved it. Whizzing through the busy city on the back of a scooter was such a thrill, and our drivers were safely conscious and confident. It rained heavily during our first stop at the China Town markets but the staff provided us with good quality ponchos so it was no trouble.
Food was delicious and the whole tour was very interesting. The staff were extremely knowledgeable, spoke excellent English and super friendly. By the end I felt like we were old friends.

Tips: don't wear a skirt or dress. Wear comfy, enclosed shoes. Only take a small bag as it will be safely stored under the scooter seat. Wear your hair in a style that you can put a helmet over (buns and high ponytails might not be a good idea).

highlight of our trip! a Must-Do - We grinned ear-to-ear throughout the entire evening with the XO team. The drivers are all absolutely delightful: fun, witty, professional, and safe of course! We did a food tour in every city of our trip and this one shines above the rest (which were also awesome). It's actually not as food-centric as others -- only 3 stops for food -- but what it lacks in food it makes up for in exposure to different parts of the city that we would NEVER have found on our own. (Also, the food really was incredible too!) Riding on the motorbike was so fun and not nearly as scary as I thought it would be. My husband and I rode with Phu and Hung (sp?) and they kept us close together on every ride: impressive! Loved every minute.

Highlight of my visit to Saigon - A fabulous adventure for someone who was rather nervous at the thought of travelling on a motor scooter in the traffic. The girls are so attentive to every need and are excellent drivers making you feel comfortable and relaxed very quickly, especially for someone who has never been on the back of a bike before. What a wonderful way to experience the sights and tastes of this vibrant city. Our tour leader, Tuan was very informative and entertaining when chatting about the Vietnamese culture.
Thank you to XO tours for a wonderful, memorable experience!

Dont think about the what if's, just do it. - We booked a tour of Saigon at night. Our group consisted of 9, 4 adults and 5 children! children were 13, 11, 7, 6 & 3.

Where do I start?! I never thought to do a tour with the family. Being an Australian and all, the traffic situation in HCMC is out of control. But after reading family blogs and reviewing their recommendations, thought it would be a wonderful experience and it was.

We had 6 drivers 13 & 11 year old had to have their own drivers/ scooters and the younger kids could go with adults. We paid extra to get a video of our adventure (still waiting to receive, was only a week ago)

What I loved about the tour.

1) They took control: we were extremely apprehensive to say they least. The girls came in professional and, knew their job, explained safety instructions, where we were going, do's and don'ts and led the charge.

2) Safety: before we went anywhere near the scooter, they explained to us which side to approach from, not to wiggle about too much, how to properly hold on and other general knowledge that Aussies who have never ridden a scooter just wouldn't know.

3) Security: it wasn't mentioned when I made the booking, but not only did we have 6 drivers, we also had a main tour guide - Sang,( two videographers as requested extra $$$) but surprisingly 2 security escorts, because we were seeing seedier districts. They gave us precautions like take off necklaces and shoulder bags.

4) First hand experience. If we didn't book the tour, we wouldn't have been game and seen so much outside of the tourist strip. We experienced an authentic night out in Saigon. Unfortunately half way through the night it started raining, however it was a highlight having to pull over (ON A BRIDGE!) and put on raincoats -- Along with all the other scooters in Saigon. Literally every scooter in the area you could see was pulled over putting on raincoats.

Don't think about it, just do it. It really was special. Little expensive, however part of your ticket purchases extra insurance to cover the tour. Also includes dinner and a beer.

*kids with remember it forever

Best tour in HCMC - We did the Foodies night tour. We were pretty nervous about hopping on the back of a bike in Saigon traffic but two minutes in you knew you were safe and relaxed and enjoyed it.
The girls are fantastic and they take you to great little places to eat you would never experience otherwise. Favourite activity in Saigon by a mile. A must do!

Sales Manager - Excellent tour, Lovely tour guides thanx to Hieu and Ngoc and the whole team.
Great job!
Team very knowledgeable and interesting authentic food and great rides.

Best Tour in a long time! - Honestly folks, if you are in Saigon and you miss this tour, might as well have not visited! XO tour takes this already amazing city to the next level! Thank you Thao (my awesome and professional guide) and Hieu Nguyen (our informative and enthusiastic tour leader) for a spectacular time. It was totally worth every penny! Thanks again All. XOXOXO!!!

Outstanding, best foodie tour ever! - We had an amazing experience that we won't forget in a hurry. Khoi, our team leader provided excellent information, was professional and very engaging throughout the tour taking the time to answer our questions about the various Districts of Ho Chi Minh City. My husband and I had two amazing, lovely girls who were our drivers for the evening, Vy and Quynh who looked after us so well and they too shared many insights into what life is like in Vietnam. Then there is food...SUPERB!!! We had such a great time tasting all on offer, washed down with local beer, water and soft drinks. We were smiling and reliving the adventure long after the tour was over. We have done tours all over the world and recommend this is a 'must do' if you visit Ho Chi Minh. Thanks XO Tour team, great job.

One of the highlights of my trip - This is my third trip to HCMC. This time alone. So I signed up for this tour. Worth every penny. We went to several districts that are off the tourist grid. The food was adventurous and delicious. The ladies were safe and delightful. I highly recommend this tour. I liked it so much that I signed up with xo for a tour in Hoi An in a few days.

Night Tour of the districts in HCMC - It was my partners first time in Vietnam and I wanted him to experience riding on a scooter for the first time. It was a fantastic experience for him and myself, with lots to see and fantastic guides who could speak English well and answer all my questions. The only thing I would say could be better was the food choices, however just a minor complaint on an otherwise great Vietnam experience.

Great way to see the real HCM City - We wanted to see the real HCM and experience those crazy bikes. I have three children aged 12, 11 and 9 and I wasn't keen on taking them on a motor scooter. Well after 1 min of being on the XO Tour I felt completely safe, the female drivers were great and we had an absolute ball traveling throughout HCM. It's the best way to see the city and we stopped off at many places. This is a 'must do' tour to tick off your HCM City visit.
perfect - Hop on your bike guides and live the best experience you can possibly get from Saigon. Ride, eat, discover, drink, meet people, laugh, eat again, drink again and ride again. Perfect night.

Best way to explore HCMC - I highly recommend the food tour conducted by XO Tour. The staff and the tour leader, Tai was exceptionally friendly and professional. They pay attention to every detail and ensure every member's need is well taken care of. The tour was also very informative and provided a glimpse of life in HCMC in 4-5 hours.
Great job and do keep up the good works XO Tour!!!!

Excellent, friendly and safe tour - Fantastic way of taking the city in. I took the 'Sights' tour this morning. My driver, Linh, was extremely safe and knowledgeable about the roads. It might be a little intimidating at first, but the drivers are super safe and I was put at ease right away. While driving, I talked a lot to my driver and she was a wealth of knowledge and answered every question I had. The tour manager, Tai, gives a wonderful tour with a mix of historical facts, modern and humorous talks. Like other reviewers have said, if you have time to do one thing while in HCMC, do this one. You won't regret it.

Food experience tour - We had a splendid evening; with friends we had a pick-up with four friendly and enthousiastic ladies. Sitting on the backseat of their scooters, crossing through Ho Chi Minh during rushhours , visiting market, beautiful sightseeing stops and most of all eating delicious at the several stops!
With compliments, Ad&Emmy. Ruud&Carine

Highlight of our trip! Very veggie friendly. Little touches were the icing on the (very yummy) cake. - We took the foodie tour this evening. We were a little nervous to start with but our drivers (Mai & Linh) soon had us at ease - they were laughing & joking with us in excellent English as we zipped around the city, pointing out points of interest and telling us stories about their city. I felt totally safe at all times; Mai & Linh were great drivers and we were also escorted by some extra guys (“bodyguards”) who were there to make sure we were safe. We met our host Tuong at the first stop - he was great and taught us lots about the city. We passed through lots of different districts, it was a great way to see the huge diversity in HCM. A couple of highlights were walking through a market and a stop in “K-town” (district 7).

It was worth the money just for the tour and the experience of zipping through the traffic, but then there was the food....oh the food. It was delicious & we got to try a huge variety of dishes. We enjoyed some local delicacies that are much less known than things like pho or banh mi which you can get everywhere. I’m a vegetarian and was extremely well catered for. My husband enjoyed everything he ate, including some of the “stranger” dishes...!

The team gave us many little surprises throughout the evening which I won’t mention as I don’t want to ruin it for others but they were the icing on the cake.

I would highly highly recommend this tour. Brilliant from start to finish. Thank you Mai, Linh, Tuong and everyone else for giving us such a special evening.

Saigon by night - We had an amazing time doing the Saigon by night tour with our guides Lu Anh and Vi as well as Tai!

Lu Anh and Vi were great drivers, very safe and skilled. They were great company and very informative. As was Tai who came along and took photos and sat with us to eat. We felt like we got to see a lot of the city we wouldnt have visited otherwise. Food was amazing also, very gernerous portions, so tasty!

The extra touches like tips on the language and places to.visit were a welcome surprise and lovely to have.

All in all a great evening and highly recommended!

A must do. - Cannot rate highly enough. If you only do one tour in HCMC make it this one.
The girls are amazing and keep you well informed of the nights events and current issues of the city. My guide Ang was hilarious and spoke as well as I.
So much food and beer on the "Foodie Tour" had to force down desert!!
Thanks girls it was my best night here.

Best of the best! - Charming, intelligent, funny, congenial young women drive you all over HCMC on their motorbikes, guiding you through all kinds of amazing, incomparable, delicious food experiences (most of which you will never discover on your own). This is much more than a foodie tour. This was my fourth time on the tour (it's an annual tradition) and I have always had a fabulous time! There really is no comparison. And yes, it is absolutely worth the price. Do it!

Fantastic! - The XO tour is a must do in HCMC! Our drivers were great hosts, safe riders, spoke excellent English and were heaps of fun throughout the evening. They took us to a variety of districts and told us a lot about the city. The food was amazing, with some opportunities to get adventurous! My partner is vegetarian and was extremely well catered for. Would highly recommend this tour...and maybe don't eat too much lunch before you go!

Great way to learn about Vietnamese culture - We did the foodie tour and had Nhung and Binh. It was really fun biking around Ho Chi Minh city and talking with the girls the whole time. They spoke wonderful English and we learned a lot about regular Daily Vietnamese life. I don't remember our guides name (I apologize) but he was also great. We enjoyed that they gave you the chance to try real Vietnamese foods and see different districts and didn't just give you the common food like pho and banh mi that you can get absolutely anywhere. Overall, great tour!

Highly Rated - My husband and I had a great time with XO. We did the foodie tour in the evening and cannot fault anything.
With only one day to spend in HCMC, XO gave us a tour of the city and a flavor for the food and the people. The ladies were very safe amongst the crazy traffic and our tour guide accommodated dietary requirements with no problem.
XO thought of everything from providing hand sanitiser after using restaurant bathrooms with no soap, to a handy Vietnamese phrase book to help us with the rest of our trip.
If you love food like we do, this is a must do in HCMC!

Absolutely fantastic! A must do!! - I loved every minute of this experience. The tour guides were amazing— informative, friendly, fun and navigated traffic well! I saw so much of the city that I never would have seen without the tour! I couldn't believe the number of 5 star reviews before I took the tour— now I know why. I wish I could rate this tour 10 stars.

Must Do Tour - This tour was a fantastic experience into what life is like in Ho Chi Minh City. You get to see more than District 1 which was the experience I was after. Guide and driver were fantastic!! Such a capable driver in the crazy traffic that is HCMC, I felt safe the whole time. More than just a food tour. Such an enjoyable experience. Thank you XO Tours!
