A real adventure! - After reading reviews of other companies we decided to go with XO. It was fantastic and a real adventure. I was a little nervous going on the back of the bike but the girls were wonderful and my guide Ngoc (I hope I got that right!) was delightful. My nerves calmed and I and my husband had a great time. We got to visit different areas that we wouldn't have gone to on our own, let alone on a motorbike. At all times we felt very safe. Sang gave us loads of interesting information at each stop. It was great to try different food that we would not have normally ordered on our own. I would without hesitation recommend this tour.

XO Foodie tour was the highlight of our Ho Chi Minh City trip. - My wife and I took the foodie tour on Oct. 1st 2017. It took some convincing to get my wife to go on the back of a scooter after seeing the wild traffic in Ho Chi Minh City. Once we got on the scooters with our two female drivers it became obvious that they were experienced drivers and very safety minded. The drivers spoke good English and were quick to engage us in conversation. They were humorous and lots of fun. The food was unique and delicious and the restaurants gave us a glimpse into Vietnamese culture. The tour personnel encouraged us to eat and drink as much as we wanted at every stop. We experienced some rain during our tour but ponchos were provided and the scattered rain did not diminish the experience. We learned a lot about Vietnamese culture and history from both our drivers and the tour leader Tuan. I would definitely encourage anyone traveling to Ho Chi Minh City to put this tour high on your list of things to do.

Great way to see HCM, experience the traffic and eat local dishes - Great riders make us feel safe. Great local experiences foodwise and I liked guide-Sangs stories about his city. You find many of the touristy stuff in District 1. If you want to get out, experience HCM and eat local dishes then do this tour.

DO NOT MISS! - We did the foodie tour with Tuan as our group leader. A special shout out to our wonderful drivers Dung and Ngoc. The night was perfect from beginning to end. We had very limited time in Saigon and learned so much more about the city's culture from doing this tour. The food is abundant and delicious and my dietary restrictions were handled beautifully. A truly memorable night in Saigon. A must do!

City tour on a motorbike - The girls from XO Tours were exceptional. I would definitely recommend sightseeing with this tour company. Riding a motorbike around Saigon is a scary and exhilarating experience but so much fun. We took this tour with our 6 year old and she loved it.

Motorbike tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Awesome. Do it. - Fantastic. Highly recommended. Fun, professional, informative. Had 2 scooters with a parent and kid on each. Kids loved it. So organized - they have scouts that separately go ahead to get things ready at next stop. Our guide was awesome and felt super safe behind the girls driving. Do it!

The best way to see the city! - These guys are really amazing at what they do. The foodie tour was fantastic. The staff create a really fun atmosphere while they drive you safely from one place to another to experience yummy local food. They are punctual, friendly and very very well organized. They even take a lot of photos so you get to enjoy the ride and all the eating without a worry in the world. Shout out to our lady drivers and especially to Tai for being a fantastic host!

Best nighttime tour in HCMC! - I have been on this tour twice and have enjoyed it enormously. The girls handled the hectic saigon traffic really well and made sure we were all comfortable on the bikes.
They provide a great insight into life in this busy city, taking us to back streets and alleys to try local, street food . They all had great English so we're able to enter into individual conversations with us

I highly recommend this tour

Excellent experience!! - Got on their Foodie Tour on Sept 29, and oh was I impressed and very happy with the entire tour! (1) the riders were of very good quality and spoke good English. (2) the food was good particularly the scallops, which were to die for! We ordered 2 plates of that! (3) area of ​​coverage was superb. Went out of District 1 and into Districts 4,6,7,etc. (5) there were the 'silent' heroes that traveled with us. They were our bodyguards for the evening ensuring the journey is safe. (6) the tour was very professional. (7) bonus was that the riders were all ladies dressed in the traditional Vietnamese clothes.

Highly recommended tour!

Best Tour Total - My husband and I did the foodie tour of Saigon with XO Tours and had the best night out. The girls were fabulous guides and a lot of laughs. Big shout out to Linh and Tiht for making our evening very memorable. The food was fabulous and touring through the city of Saigon on the back of a scooter was exhilarating. Would recommend this tour highly.

XO night tour in Saigon - Great experience touring around the different districts of Saigon on the night bike tour on 21-Sep. Most of the places we visited were not on the standard tourist trail but it was very insightful and fun. The tour group was small (only three of us), the local food we tried was amazing and everyone was friendly and the tour was fun and informative.

Would like to mention the professionalism of Sang on the tour and he was very informative and knowledgeable.

I would also like to specially thank Loan for an amazing experience and chat on the bike. She was the best rider, fun to chat to and made the whole experience fun and enjoyable.

Fantastic! - First time to Vietnam and my husband and I did this tour having read the reviews and following a friends recommendation. We did the food tour on our first full evening in Saigon as we felt it would help us on our travels with all the different things we wanted to try.
We were not disappointed!
Having seen the traffic I was initially quite anxious getting on the back of the scooter and heading off into the night, however my fears were totally allayed by Hang who was my driver. She navigated the crazy traffic fantastically well and I felt at ease very early on. My husbands driver was exactly the same- calm & confident. Both girls were also a lot of fun and good company.
The tour itself takes you to places you are unlikely to find yourself and all food and drinks are included in the tour price.
I can only reiterate what others have written, if you are unsure about taking this tour for fear of traffic / scooters etc, put those aside and go for it! You won't regret it. Thank you XO Tours for a great night!

A must do in Ho Chi Minh City! - Seriously, if you only do one thing in Saigon, do an XO tour. We had 8 fabulous days in Saigon and did some really cool tours and activities but to get an appreciation of the city the XO tours were the best. We did the foodie and the sights tours both with the very witty and knowledgeable guide, Tuan. The girls were also fantastic, not only in getting us around the city safely but they were great to talk to and gave us an insight into life in Vietnam. The tours gave us an appreciation of the food, history and culture of the city, covered off multiply districts, gave us feel for getting around in the crazy traffic, but most of all were just so much fun.

Seriously legit - I'm not a big fan of tours but since it was my first trip to HCM, and since there were great reviews about XO Tours, I decided to give it a try. I have completely no regrets. The girls were really fun to be around, and Sang was so great and informative. You can actually see how passionate they are about their history and culture. They were also really thoughtful and made sure we were hydrated during the ride, buying us water and juice throughout the tour.
We spent 48usd for the day tour and were greeted by the girls who took us to the first site where we met Sang and a couple other guys who were tasked to keep a lookout for us the whole tour. The girls also gave us a short safety briefing about being on the bikes at the beginning of the tour.
We heard the foodie tour is a good one to take as well, but we didn't get a chance to. I highly recommend XO Tours. No tourist traps. Completely legit. Thank you Sang and XO team!

Excellent 2nd Time. - This is my 2nd time on this tour & my husband's 1st. Enjoyed it so much last year that I had to have my hubby do it. The girls that ride the bikes are just awesome (thank you Tre). We were taken out of the tourist area and into other areas of HCMC that we would never otherwise see. The food is very good, from district to district. The girl's speaks very good English & is happy to chat & answer questions. Our tour guide Khoi speaks very good English & more than happy to answer questions & give advice if asked. Khoi had a dish brought to my husband & me because I had been on the tour before, and my husband & I had paid for this tour for some friends as a wedding gift just recently. I highly recommend this tour even if you are a little afraid to hop on the back of a motor bike in HCMC, seize the moment as you may never have the chance again.

Foodie Tour - Thank you to XO tours for making our last night in Saigon so memorable. We were well looked after and our daughter who only ate chicken was very well catered for and fed lots of variety as well. The girls were brilliant and chatty and are a huge asset to your company and a pleasure to meet. The 6 of us loved experiencing driving round Saigon and feeling part of the real life of the city on the back of the scooter. We felt completely safe and the girls are excellent drivers and they checked at every stage that we were all ok.Sang our tour guide gave us useful information along the way which you wouldn't know yourself and took us to areas we might not visit ourselves. We got to see a lot of Saigon as well as tasting some delicious food. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone. Thank you once again for such a brilliant night - Tracey and family.

Absolutely Most Amazing Experience - I did the Foodies tour on my last night in Saigon. Originally booked with a friend but she fell ill and couldn't come. Based on a very high recommendation from another friend I decided to do solo and have no regrets of. My guide , Tam, was simply delightful and I felt completely safe on the back of her scooter. We chatted about Saigon, family and life. Tam took me in to districts I would never have seen otherwise, and I ate food I would probably never have thought of trying. I highly recommend this tour, my highlight of visiting Vietnam. Do it as a group, or on your own, you will be made very welcome and looked after superbly. All you need to bring is your sense of adventure. XO Tours take care of the rest. Sandy (Shepparton, Australia)

Simply The Best - The Foodie tour lived up to its No 1 rating, probably the most enjoyable tour we have ever taken anywhere !
We had the wonderful Anh & Hang piloting our bikes through the wet & busy streets of Ho Chi Minh city,our small group of 4 couples from London,Brisbane,Taiwan & Tel Aviv got on famous thanks to the XO team.
Riding through the various districts on the expertly driven mopeds was so exhilarating, the food choices from Noodle soup to BBQ to seafood were all delicious and in abundant supply.
Truly the highlight of our Vietnam holiday, don't miss booking this tour as it is worth every penny!
Final thank you to Khoi who orchestrated the tour perfectly.

Like a night out with friends - My sister and I chose this tour based on reviews and we were not disappointed. Great fun, really friendly guides. Even though we had some rain on the night of our tour we had rain ponchos and were well looked after. You will eat where the locals eat and see parts of the City that you would otherwise not see. I visited without my teenage children but they would have loved this tour. Highly recommended.

Great fun - We did the Sights with our 2 girls (6 & 9 yrs old). 6 yr old went on the scooter with her dad and a driver whilst the 9 yr old went with just a driver. The tour was definitely the highlight of our brief stop in HCMC. Our guide, Sang, was great - very knowledgable. Information provided was a good balance of historical facts along with current day. The girls who drove the scooters were amazing and not just their driving skills. Our girls did get a little bored with some of the historical stuff however our drivers sensed this and entertained them whilst we went with Sang to look at things. Highly recommend the tour - it's a completely different perspective of seeing the sights.

Fantastic Evening - My brother and I did the XO foodie tour and loved it. The girls were just lovely, chatty and so skilled manouvering us through the chaotic traffic safely. The whole evening was a lot of fun with great food and plenty of it.

Best Food Tour in Ho Chi Minh City! - I booked this Foodie tour through a recommendation from a friend and I can't recommend it highly enough. I loved riding on the back of the motorbike and felt completely safe the entire time. The female drivers and tour guide were absolutely wonderful!! They drove us around to various districts in the city and we tried many of the authentic street foods which were delicious. It was a fantastic way to spend our first night in Vietnam and check out the amazing city. Thank you to all the staff at XO tours for making this a truly wonderful experience. What a fun night we had, filled with great laughs and delicious food.

Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh - My friends and I decided to do the 'XO Foodie Tour' our first night in Ho Chi Minh, and what an exhilarating & delicious way to experience the different districts of the city. This tour came as a recommendation from a work colleague, and we are so glad we took this advice.
Tour Leader Tuong and the girls were fantastic, and we felt safe the whole time while scootering through the hectic city traffic.
We got to taste a large variety of Vietnamese dishes, all of which were extremely tasty, even the ones we wouldn't normally opt to order, so it was great to be able to be adventurous with this.
Worth every cent, and our bellies were extremely full upon our return to the hotel.
Thanks XO Tours for the amazing memories, was the highlight of our trip!

Attractive - I did the 'Saigon by Night' tour. I was the only person who booked it. The 'foodie' tour is the most popular. However my guides made me feel so welcome and comfortable. I highly recommend you give these guys a go in Ho Chi Min City.

Foodie Tour was amazing - Such a great night ! The girls were so fun and professional. Felt saved at all times whilst still so exhilarating riding through many districts of Ho Chi Minh. Food was delicious.. worth every cent.

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh - What an awesone way to spend your first day in Ho Chi Minh.. My 10 year old Daughter and Myself chose this shopping tour instead of going to the Chi Chi tunnels with My Husband, to say we were nervous was an understatement as this was our first time in Vietnam and wasn't sure what to expect, just the drive from the airport had us nervous enough... Well we had nothing to worry about, Tai and his team could not have been more lovely and welcoming if they tried. The nerves that I had (mainly putting a 10 year old on the back of a scooter in a foreign country with someone i didn't know) was completely forgotten the moment we took off. Tai did not leave our sides whilst shopping and made sure we didn't get overcharged for anything
We had an absolute ball, it well worth paying the additional fee for the video, it makes the experience all the better when you have a camera man following you around for a day...

City greetings on scooters - An amazing experience. Great drivers with good English and knowledge of area. The sights visited were relevant and historical. But the best is just being in the hectic traffic. I wish I had a Go Pro or the like to record what I saw as we rode all over the city.

A great time all around!! - The girls are extremely knowledgeable about the city and tons of fun! Their sense of humor and friendliness made for a great first day in Vietnam for us and set expectations for the rest of our trip at a high level.

Thank you XO Tours, will recommend this to anyone wanting to know about the city and foods of Ho Chi Minh city!

Mad if you don't do it - We did the foodie tour the day after arriving in HCMC, it was a perfect way to see a lot of the city, enjoy some fantastic food and enjoy the company of the XO team. We had Vy & Quyan as our drivers and they were awesome, bloody cheeky and great to hang out with.
We felt safe and very well looked after the whole time.
Only thing that was wrong is that I forgot to take the GoPro!

10/10 A must do - If there is only one tour you do in HCM make sure it is this one.
Fantastic guides, delicious food, very informative 4 hour tour that can't be missed.
Our guides for the night were Sang, Fu, and 3 other lovely ladies. There was also a security driver riding with us the whole night.
We had 3 adults and 2 children, 6 & 7 and XO tours accommodated each and everyone of us in particular making the children feel safe, secure and really spoiling them
Thanks again XO for the best night

Lived up to the reviews! - Reviews and a consistent 5 stars don't lie, the Foodie Tour was incredible.

We were taken to multiple districts, tasted lots of food outside of the usual pho, banh mi, etc. and we could keep ordering until our group was full! I especially appreciate the girls providing insights into Vietnamese culture and life.

Highly recommended.

Sammy.

Most amazing first impression - We took the foodie tour as a family of 6 with two younger children 6 & 7. There were a few nerves from the little ones but as soon as we started moving the grin from ear to ear was priceless. The food was amazing and the staff were so professional and so attentive and made this tour such a wonderful experience for our family. We did this tour at the beginning of our stay and it was well worth it as we had a better understanding of our surroundings. Thank you xo

Best Food Tour Total - I have been on food tours in many countries and many cities in the US and this was the best food tour I have ever been on. We were a group of ten adults and my 7-year old daughter and booked a private tour. We had three major food stops where we sampled a soup from the Hue region (similar to pho), a BBQ place with goat, beef, okra, shrimp and frog, and lastly a seafood stop with the most amazing scallops and clams as well as crab legs, quail and dessert. The food quantity was enormous and we all left very happy. In addition to the food portion of the tour, we were driven around Four separate districts of Saigon and were educated on the differences and history of these distinct areas.

The tour was phenomenal and I would recommend it to anyone from age 5 to 80.

Tour de Force - Amazing night had on Foodie Tour. Great to see parts of city will never have visited on our own.
Driven expertly around by our lovely lady drivers Nhi and Chau. Sang led tour and his information on all the districts was very interesting to say the least.
Thanks to Nhi and Chau for making us feel both exhilarated and safe at the same time, as well as all the laughing on the way.
Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh City and recommend to everyone.

Don't hesitate...just do it! - Traveling to HCMC for work, I thought I'd do something a bit different with my evening - I love food and have always wanted to zip around on a motorbike, so a tour that combines the two? Perfection! Sure, I as a bit nervous having reminded horror stories of tourists in Asia having motorbike accident. But my nerves disappeared in seconds after a friendly pickup from my funny and charming driver/guide Anh at my hotel. The tour is part food tour, part cultural tour. The food is amazing, free flowing beer, water and soft drinks and I felt well looked after and 100% safe all night.

Would highly recommend this tour! It may seem a bit more pricey than the competition, but here's why: they include insurance (whereas many standard travel insurance policies do not include cover if you are injured on a motorcycle), the guides are professional and speak immaculate English, all food/drinks included (though there was not too much food - the exact amount to leave you full!).

Basically, you've come all this way to experience the REAL Ho Chi Minh City - do the tour to experience it!

Highlight of my time in Saigon - What can I say that has not already been said, besides this was an amazing time! I booked the foodie tour the evening that I arrived in Saigon and so glad that I did. I learned a ton about the city and felt like I got a great glimpse into the "real" Vietnamese life. The food was amazing and I ate until I couldn't eat, but then I found room to shove more crab meat into my mouth because it was so good! The guides are wonderful - I felt safe on the motorbike and learned a lot about my driving and guidance in the process. You meet wonderful, fun people on this tour and it is worth every dollar. The only word of caution I want to mention is that you are on the motorbike a lot over the 4.5 hours and the chairs at the restaurants are very low to the ground, so it may be harder/more challenging for those with muscle or joint problems with their backs, hips and knees.

Great food and experience both for the soul and belly - IT WAS GREAT!!!
We are a family of 4 with 2 teens, spending our last night in Vietnam with XO tours, and what a grand finale.
The girls/guides/drivers were amazing, they were so cute and friendly and it was a pleasure to talk with them. They were very knowledgable and had great English.
Experiencing the city from the viewpoint of riding a scooter is the true way so get how amazing Saigon is.
We got to see places which are truly different.
And last but not least, the food. It was amazing, so unique and so tasty.
Even our kids were excited with the experience.
A must do in Saigon, worth every cent.

The BEST Way to Experience Saigon - Easily the best and most fun way to experience another side of Vietnam. The excitement of cruising through traffic in the back of a scoffer, driven by some super cool ladies who are very passionate about their city.

Combine this with amazing food results in a highlight of our trip and great value for money.

Great - Me and my partner went on the sights tour recently and really enjoyed it. Definitely a great introduction to the city. The drivers and tour guide were really friendly, spoke great English, and were informative. Fun to experience the craziness of Ho Chi Minh traffic on a bike!

Highlight of Vietnam - This was such a great way to experience Saigon. The girls were lovely and such great drivers, not to mention our tour leader was very informative and caring. I would highly recommend this to anyone traveling to Vietnam!

A must-do tour! - This was a real highlight of our two days in Ho Chi Minh City. Experience the craziness of the traffic in good, safe hands. The girls were so charming and friendly - we did the day tour and it was a great way to get an overview of the city, visiting the main sights as well as enjoying snacks at a market and chatting about life in Vietnam. And our tour leader took photos at every stop and emailed them to us the next day. What more could you ask for?

Fantastic city overall - From start to finish, the XO foodie tour was fantastic, from the thrill of the scooter ride through the crowded traffic, the delicious and abundant food, and the lovely and knowledgable guides. Thank you to Chang and Sun(sorry about the spelling) and the test of the crew for a great evening overall. Well worth it, just book it!

Deep Experience - Xo tours super ! The girls were great and so good drivers. We did the night tour and it was perfect to get an idea of ​​Ho Chi Minh and see the real city. Fantastic I recommend it 100 %

Happy in Ho Chi Minh City - The best tour … a must-do tour when in Saigon. Don't miss it!
A wonderful experience and a great way to see the city at night.
XO tour crew was super, safe and fun. Thank you all.
I enjoyed the whole tour including the food and places we visited.
On the night tour you feel the real beat of this incredible city while enjoying the ride with these professional personnel.
I definitely recommend this tour to anyone planning on visiting beautiful Saigon!
Thanx.
Dr. Bill
Too good - Easily the best way to see what Ho Chi Minh City has to offer. A great blend of cultural experiences and fun.

Must do in Saigon! Foodie Tour: wonderful experience - Even after some time in Vietnam mainly driving around in company shuttle buses the traffic is a completely different experience if you're on a scooter! But the female drivers superbly handle the chaos – so no unsafe feelings at all. The different food stops are absolutely delicious – and sometimes a small challenge (frogs or duck embryos) but you will always get the choice and will be rewarded (with good taste) if you go for it.

Foodie Tour; amazing! - Unfortunately, I was pretty sick with a headache and stomachache during the tour, but it was still great. Tam was my guide, and she was absolutely wonderful; we had great conversation throughout and she was so incredibly sweet, even going as far to check if I was feeling better the next day. I really enjoyed seeing the different districts at night, especially by motorbike.

Being sick, I didn't have a large appetite, but I was able to try at least a bite of everything. I'm also pescetarian, so I was provided some delicious vegetarian dishes as substitutes for some meat dishes. My favorites were the shrimp skewers (so fresh and perfectly cooked!), vegetarian rice cakes wrapped in lettuce leaves, and of course, the seafood feast at the end with crab, scallops, and clams.

Our start to Vietnam - I pre booked this trip with XO tours before we left the UK, we were only in Vietnam for a few days, so I thought we could have a taster of HCMC. The girls arrived prompty and we set off on our tour, i have never been on a bike before and was a bit worried at first, but after about 2 minutes on the bike i realized id was missing something i should have tried years ago. The girls made us feel very relaxed and were very informative along the morning. They took us to all the normal attractions. Along the way we were given fruits to try and also drinks. there is a guide who also travels around with you and also a guy who acts like security. They take some photos of you which they send you a few days later, and they also give you a key ring as a parting gift.
We did the morning tour of HCMC.

Unique experience in Saigon!!! - If you are in Saigon, you cannot miss the XO Tours foodie experience! It's something unique! It's a perfect combination of foodie, adventure and culture tour.
1) Foodie: I just can't remember how many different and delicious dishes we tasted that night! I will not make an spoiler of the dishes, but I just want to warn that it can be a good idea to skip the lunch if you plan to book an evening tour, because the tour includes many stops with tons of mouthwatering food that you can not miss and you'll need all the available space in your stomach!
2) Adventure: Riding a bike in the terrific Saigon traffic it's really a challenge, and the XO riders make you feel really comfortable and safe at any time of the trip. Our charming riders were Binh and Huyen, who I want to congratulate once again for their riding experience, for being enchanting and talkative with us during the whole night, for cooking for us during the BBQ, and for trying to sing "Despacito" the best they could! They treat you as if you were a part of the XO Tours family from the very first moment! Well done girls!
3) Culture: The tour escapes from the city center and allows you to visit several quarters of the city. Sang, the tour leader, gave us some interesting information from each quarter that we were visiting, which added a cultural component to the foodie tour that we did not expected before the tour.
After all these explanations, there is no need to say that XO Tours was one of our best experiences all around Vietnam and we absolutely recommend it!

An amazing Foodie Tour - Awesome experience with XO Tours. The food was amazing and the girls are awesome as well. Explaining the details from all the district and attractions at night. Love their working attitude.

Great Tour - Had a great time on my evening tour! My XO tour driver was very kind, and a great driver. We saw several interesting neighborhoods, and our tour leader was excellent - very knowledgeable and gave us the information while keeping it fun. They were also well prepared with ponchos for everyone when it started to rain. Opted for the video option and the videographer was fantastic - cant wait to see my video. They also emailed me pics after the tour. Had a great time and would recommend to anyone!

Hands down best tour we've ever done! - Our tour was one of the most fantastic we've ever taken. The drivers were our hosts and were engaging, knowledgable, funny, friendly and a lot of fun. We thought the information about the history of the neighborhoods we visited increased our understanding of the place. And, of course, the food was unbelievable. Every stop includes a fantastic meal, an incredible experience and a super fun ride through Ho Chi Minh City. We took the tour on a recommendation from a friend and have never been happier to have done so. This tour is not to be missed. When we return, we will take this tour again!

Best tour we did in Vietnam - We've just finished the foodie tour and it was honestly the best tour my 18 year old and I did while I Vietnam. The girls are articulate, fun and very good scooter riders. The food is amazing and will most likely challenge you at times. There aren't enough stars to this tour. Not only is there plenty of food but also an insight to Vietnamese life and a good look around the city. Bravo to my guide V and the whole team ☺

Foodie Tour - Amazing food and amazing way to see Saigon - Such a great night experiencing the food and sights of Saigon! The girls were friendly and chatty, spoke very good English and were able to answer all of our questions about the city and Vietnam in general and were great drivers. The food was really diverse and a great way to experience some Vietnamese food at places we wouldn't have chosen on our own. You do need to have an open mind to try new foods as there is some unique choices such as frog, goat and duck fetus (we skipped that one) however there is still plenty of other options and you will definitely not leave hungry! While it is expensive I believe it is worth it as you get to see so much of Saigon that you otherwise wouldn't see as a tourist and experience some great food at places you wouldn't think to stop and eat at!

Amazing Experience - My boyfriend and I ended our vacation with this tour. It was spur-of-the-moment and they easily accommodated us. They explained all of the safety procedures for being on the bikes (which was a lot of fund and easily one of the highlights of the trip). On top of that the entire crew were extremely friendly and funny! Unlimited amounts of beer and food - there was way more than we could eat/drink. If you go to this city you MUST do this tour.

Night of skilled scooter driving, great food & fun! - I would thoroughly recommend the night foodie tour. We were picked up from our hotel on time by two local women and whisked to our first street food venue.

Great sights, amazing street food and wonderful conversation with the local guides.

Despite raining, we still had loads of fun. Driving was excellent and I felt very safe.

This tour is a great one to do at the start of your Vietnam holiday as it shows you the sights but also introduces you to new dishes that you can throughout try your stay.

Enjoy!

Fantastic fun and so delicious. - My husband and I had such an amazing time buzzing around Ho Chi Minh in the craziness of their organized chaos, on the backs of the bikes.The girls were expert drivers, fun and knowledgable and not only did they drive us and educate us, they entertained, cooked and served to us!
The tour was highly organized with drivers a guide and 3 security / camera people although we were in a group of only 8 guests.
Food was terrific, as much as we wanted and drank too (all inclusive) My personal favorite being the delicious scallops.Im not one to try the street food as I suffer with a delicate constitution but I felt they (with their very high ratings) were to be trusted with their choices and I was proved completely correct.
It was such a fun , informative , delicious evening an absolute highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh.Thankyou XO tours Foo ( my lovely driver ) and sorry cant remember her name ..Gregs gorgeous driver.You wete the icing on the cake girls .

Foodie Vespa Tour 2 Thumbs Up!! - By far the best experience I had in Ho Chi Minh. The girls were awesome and entertaining and so professional. Not once did I fear for my life in the Vietnam motorcycle crowd. Mr Khoi was amazing and my group had the time of our lives. Food was awesome and you can't go wrong with Saigon Beer. Will definitely recommend to everyone I know who is heading to Ho Chi Minh!!

Outstanding foodie tour! - we did the foodie tour last friday, 25th sept led by Mr Khoi. the wonderful two ladies (Yen and Yun, i hope the spelling is correct!) took us around on the bike and were wonderful hosts who cooked for us and gave us little snippets of what life is in Saigon.

mr Khoi and the girls are really fluent, clever and my motorbike tour guide, Ms Yen, is so witty and made the tour so hilarious and fun. we made fast friends and the 4 hours seemed to move to quickly for my liking.

Ms Yen should be a stand up comedian, as her good humour is so unique and unexpected. when i commented on the number of cartoon character mascots on the streets, she pointed out a winnie the pooh bear mascot smoking by the side of the road, and how our childhood memories have now been crushed by such an image!

the food was amazing - i think we got a good taste of Saigon in places i wouldn't have otherwise visited. the place where we had seafood was the best! i wish i ordered more scallops but was truly too full.

thank you Mr Khoi for your insights about Saigon and its people, history and culture. and thank you Yun and Yen for being such caring, humorous and entertaining bike guides! i wish you all the best for the future!

Girls with attitude - One of the highlights of our trip without a doubt. We were recommended this tour by friends and the Saigon by night tour did not disappoint. We were driven around all districts of the city by some delightful girls who not only dominated the roads on their bikes, but also provided great knowledge of their city. We had a great time chatting to the girls while they owned the roads - there were a lot of laughs.
Food was great and we enjoyed it so much that time seemed to fly by.
In my opinion it's the only way to see the city.
Special thanks to my driver Minh - an absolute legend

Amazing night out - We had a wonderful night out for the Foodie Tour (August 2017). The girls were simply brilliant and it was unbelievable how they navigated us around the streets in the craziness of the HCMC traffic. The food was excellent, with the scallops my favourite. My wife and I had a great night. Whilst we got a bit wet (evening thunderstorm) it did not alter the tempo of the night....all we needed was a poncho and some of the local beer. The guides were so helpful and full of info. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the city.

The absolute best experience in Saigon - I would highly recommend the Foodie Tour as a great way to see different parts of the city and to have a fabulous food experience as well. This was my second time with XO Tours after having such a great time last May with my family I took a group of 15 friends in August and they all agreed it was the best night out!!! No shortage of food or beer and well worth the cost! The tour leader Hieu, on this tour, and Sang on my last trip, were both very knowledgeable and friendly, as were all the drivers. 3 of our group enjoyed it so much they booked a second tour sightseeing the next day with XO tours. Definitely my pick for a must-do in HCMC.

Great night - food tour - What an awesome fun way to explore hcmc. Food was good and the guides (very ably led by Sang Nguyen) were fun and influential. Good English. Interesting stops and information. Would definitely recommend this tour.

A fantastic experience! - What a fantastic night we had on the foodie tour! We were picked up by the loveliest girls who were to be our drivers for the evening. Driving through Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a bike at night was amazing. We saw so many sights and learned lots from the girls and the wonderful tour guide, Sang. It was so exciting weaving through the traffic!

The food was delicious and we enjoyed tasting foods we hadn't eaten before. It really was a pleasure being in the company of all the tour group.

We were surprised with a lovely cake for our wedding anniversary which was so lovely. It made the evening even more special. Thank you so much to Sang, all the girls and the guys who made the video for us. It was a night we will never forget!

Go right ahead and book this tour; it's one of the best things you'll ever do.

Night tour of Saigon - I can't thank Sang, my driver Thao and the rest of the crew enough for a wonderful evening.
My sister had already been on two tours on two previous visits to Saigon. Her praise of XO tours is why I ended up booking a tour with them.
Sang's knowledge gives an interesting insight to the city which one can't simply get on there own.
My driver Thao did a wonderful job weaving in and out of the traffic, and her local knowledge and bubbly personality added to the experience.
I throughly recommend XO tours Saigon by Night tour. The tour takes you to places a tourist will just never discover.
You guys have a winning formular. Keep it up.
All the best.

Greg Winter
New Zealand

Saigon by motorbike - A very nice experience to do in Saigon. An opportunity to speak with local young people (they speak good English). Very nice, varied stops. Nice for teenagers too. It was one of the highlights in Saigon for us.

See the real HCMC - This is a great experience & wonderful opportunity to see the real Ho Chi Minh City & experience the local street food.

The girls are friendly & informative as they weave you through the crazy traffic on the back of their motorbikes from one district to another.

Would highly recommend this tour to everyone who wants to get off the normal tourist trail in HCMC.

Foodie Tour: Don't Miss It! - I ended a 2 week trip in Vietnam in Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon, joining XO's Foodie tour for my second to last day, and I couldn't have asked for a better way to close out my trip. A friend recommended this tour to me, sharing that it had been her favorite part of visiting Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon. I thought that sounded like an exaggeration, but decided to try it out for myself. I called from my hotel in the afternoon and was able to join a group tour for that evening. I was picked up at my hotel by Ting, my motorbike driver, who was incredibly friendly and walked me through riding in the city and the general details of the tour. We rode to the first restaurant to meet up with the group, where our tour guide Sang introduced everyone to each other and gave a more detailed outline of the evening. We alternated between eating and sightseeing stops, allowing time for digestion, Vietnamese culinary adventures, and local insight into the city's culture and history. Our drivers sat with the group at each food stop, explaining our dishes. We were also supported by male staff members who were both security and technical support (in case something happened to the bikes, reserving tables, etc). It was an honor to be in the company of the XO staff-- both the women drivers and the male support team, all of whom were dynamic, fun and very engaging. Over the course of five hours, you eat delicious food that is unlike the average street food you normally encounter and eat while traveling in Vietnam, and you are brought to districts of the city that you otherwise would most likely not visit on your own. I was traveling solo that day and joining in with the group felt effortless with XO's energy and activities. Afterwards, they send you photos from the trip, so you don't have to worry about losing your phone while riding on the back of the bike :) While the price may seem high, every penny is worth it-- going towards a vibrant organization and team. Had such an amazing time, couldn't recommend it enough!

A must-do in Saigon! - I cannot recommend this tour enough. It was the best thing we did in Saigon. I wish we did it the first night so we could have gotten a better idea of ​​the city right from the start. The food is delicious, the guides are so lovely and knowledgable. The tour also isn't just limited to information about local food, you get to learn about the culture and people of Saigon. It is also a really cool opportunity to venture out of district 1 and get a real feel for the true Saigon.

A must when you visit - Did this tour with my 13 year old daughter and both really enjoyed it despite the rain we had that night we didn't let it dampen our mood.
I have only 1 regret about this tour and that was that we didn't do it as soon as we arrived as we saw so many places that we would of liked to of visited after.
Foodie Tour - I joined the Foodie Tour with a friend and felt like we could have missed a lot if we wouldn't take this tour so do not miss it simply.

Last Night in Saigon! - We recently did the Saigon by Night Tour with XO Tours and absolutely loved it! It was easy to book online and we received tour confirmation quickly.

On the day of the tour, our guides met us at our hotel at the agreed time (they'll come to your hotel if staying in District 1). Ngan, the tour leader gave us some pre-tour regarding safety on the motorbikes.

What I loved about the tour is that all the guides were very personable, friendly and funny. Each of my daughters, including us had great conversations with each of our guide on the way to the next stop. Although it started raining partway through our tour, ponchos were provided and we continued to have a great time.

We traveled to various districts of the city on motorbike with some short periods of walking to see the local market etc. The tour guides took great photos of our family and then sent them to us via email as promised. I just wish we had time to take this tour on arrival to the city because it gives a great intro to Saigon with some great food sampling! They even provide you with mini booklet of helpful phrases in Vietnamese.

Thanks to Ngan and her tour team for a memorable last night in Saigon! Don't miss this tour!

absolutely perfect - My mom and I did the Foodie tour and had an absolutely wonderful time. It was the highlight of our stay and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

My mom is a little bit on the larger side, but they were able to accommodate her on the bike with no issues and took us all over the city. We ate some great food and got along very well with everyone else on the tour. Our guide Tai took pictures all through out the evening and sent them to us via email a few days later.

Great Tour - Had a great tour of Saigon, visiting the highlights of the city. We adjusted to the chaos of the city traffic fairly quickly and our drivers were great. Our tour guides were very knowledgable & helpful. Great induction toHo Chi Minh City.

A must! - Booked the night tour which is 3 hours but stopping includes for food but not the 'foodie' tour - only a few hours before we went and it was brilliant - best way to get and see the city and districts as we would not have a clue where to go and what lovely friendly young ladies they are - would recommend to anyone it is worth the money

A must do! - A group of 5 of us did the tour in early August and it was one of my favorite things we did. It was an authentic experience as it rained hard for quite a lot of it - but it just made it more fun! A great way to see the city and the girls are careful drivers while giving you lots of information while driving around. A must do!

Loads of fun - We went on a night sights tour. What can I say.....what a fantastic way to see the city. Whizzing through the traffic like a local, chatting to the friendly and informative ladies driving us safely through the chaos! Our 11 and 13yr old kids really enjoyed it and rated it as one of the best things we did during our 5 week holiday! I wasn't expecting quite so much food though, so don't eat before you go! A choice of local bbq dishes which we shared and another stop for dessert. The kids were also thoughtfully sent to buy an icecream while our guide explained some of the less child friendly facts about the city. Great tour. Would highly recommend.

Vietnam highlight! - Wow. What a night ! Such a professional organization from the moment I booked online. They accommodated easily a last minute addition to our tour when my son and his partner got to HCM city earlier than originally planned. Great choice of food, and included is a tour around the evening China town markets and around many of HCM city Districts all in one night and great authentic food stops. We tried food we had never tried before and it was soo tasty! Some we were not brave enough to try and while we were encouraged to try, there was no pressure. ! The guide manager and female tour guides are so knowledgeable and speak English really well. You always feel safe as about 4 minders from XO tours follow a group of 8 to ensure the ladies and guests safety as well!
Thanks Tuong, Dang, My, Nghi, and Lam. You made an awesome team on the night. !
Dang , thanks for helping me become an XO champion!!

Believe the hype! - I did the Saigon by Night Tour with XO Tours after reading all the positive reviews on trip advisor and all I can say is... believe the hype! Every single positive thing everyone has ever said about this company is absolutely true! This was one of the best tours I've ever done, and I've done plenty. Booking was so easy to do through the website and I only arranged it the day before. I was a little apprehensive about riding on the back of a motorbike through the crazy streets of Saigon but I promise you have absolutely nothing to worry about. The girls are all fantastic drivers and I felt safe the entire time. I was picked up from my hotel by the lovely Thao (4) and she was super friendly, excellent English and very easy to talk to. She had a lot of tips about where to go in the city, and pointed out interesting sights along the journey. Tuong was the tour leader and he had a great sense of humor and was very informative about life in Saigon in all the different districts. We had a few stops for dinner/dessert- not touristy stops, but places where the locals eat and drink. The food was great. So wishing I had done the foodie tour as I couldn't get enough of it! I'm hoping to make a return trip next year and will definitely be booking another tour with XO. Thank you for the fantastic evening!

A convivial night to remember - A fabulous tour with great food and great company. The girls and guys were amusingly funny and friendly. The tour felt itself more like friends gathering which makes my girlfriend and I feel more at ease. You're not only able to experience local food on this tour, but also able to experience how local get around in a bike/motorcycle as well as seeing different districts of Ho Chi Minh city. Tuong, the group leader did a congenial job of explaining the history of each district of the city that makes us understand Ho Chi Minh a little bit more. Overall, this is well put together tour that one should not miss if they're in Ho Chi Minh city.

Foodie tour! - My and friend and I being first time visitors to Ho Chi Minh City wanted a food tour and this tour came highly recommended by a friend that did this tour as well. I see why now it is! We had a fantastic time with all our tour guides. We had amazing food at various stops, we rode on motorbikes and got to see different districts of Vietnam like a local should. Most of all, we learned about Vietnam history and societal ideals that allowed me to really understand what is Vietnam and why things are the way they are. The tour guides are super nice, sociable and flexible. Had a terrific time! Don't be afraid to go on that bike! Haha

Cool experience - We have just had a fantastic night with the Vespa team of Tuong, Dang, My, Nghi, and Lam. What a fabulous way of seeing Saigon and tasting authentic Vietnamese food. Negotiating the hustle and bustle of the city is challenging at the best of times at rush hour on a Friday night.. the thought of being on the back of a motor scooter with these slight young women at the helm seemed initially somewhat perilous. Our initial doubts were quickly erased as they skillfully negotiated the chaos with ease. We had a ball.. their humour, skill and easy company combined with the organization of Tuong and his minder team backing up silently behind (a little bit like a diplomat squad) meant we saw the sights of this enchanting city safely and in a way the average tourist would not. The beers flowed and the food was abundant.. well worth the $US75 per person and definitely a highlight for the four of us on this wonderful trip to Vietnam.. well done XO.. we will be back!! Thanks ladies for a wonderful time.

Fabulous fun on night motorcycle foodie tour - The guides were beautifully dressed and well spoken. The different food stops provided excellent food and the tour manager was on hand at all times. Great fun for the full four hours or so and we felt safe on the roads, even though a little exciting at times.

Off the beaten track adventure - We did the Foodie night tour and it was well worth the price we paid. Scooter ride was loads of fun and felt very safe. Tour itself was away from all the main tourist areas and standard tourist food. District 4 was a highlight. More expensive than other foodie tours but it's by far not another cookie cutter tour and something more unique and interesting.

The night foodie tour - The foodie tour was better than I expected. The food stops were good. Professional and safe tour. Tai (manager)and Moon (my guide) were excellent. All the ladies were very well educated. I would highly recommend. Thanks.
Foodie night tour - Can highly recommend this tour! A lot of fun, great staff, interesting food & amazing diversity of sights to see!! 🤙🏻

Fantastic, Must Do! - So pleased I did this tour... I did the morning tour - for me I had limited free time so this seemed a great idea to let some experts show you the main sights. But it's much more of an experience than that! The scooter thing in HCMC is a must - and the drivers are very competent, it was still fun but felt safe. Sang gave us excellent facts n info and clearly knows his stuff. The stops and extra treats are really well placed. They even took and emailed several free pics. And the drivers are all delightful, so positive, fun and great company. So even if you bags of time and have seen every part of HCMC by foot or bus or whatever, you should still do this!

Fun way to tour the city - Friendly locals taking tourists around the city on their scooters was such a fun and intimate way to learn about local life and landmarks. They were truly interested in hosting us in the best way possible and very knowledgable.

Deep Experience - We did the night foodie tour as a group of 5. The staff are very professional and take you to the best places to try Vietnamese food. If you do anything in Ho Chi Min do this tour, it was the best fun ever! PS - Get the video to show your friends back home.

Fantastic - I was picked up in my hotel and bought on a most interesting tour.
I would recommend anyone to do this. They were professional and so friendly.
I felt safe at all times and got to meet lots of new people.
Fab tour - This was great! We did the personal tour (just the two of us) on our first night in HCMC and it was such an eye opener! Great team and well worth the money - even if it's raining!

Great tour and experience! - This unique bike tour offers splendid experience of Ho Chi Minh City. We took the morning Sights tour which started at 830am and ended around lunchtime 12pm.

The drivers of this bike tour are exclusively ladies. So my wife feels very safe. They are skilful and rode the bike in a safe way, so we felt safe amid the famous crazy Saigon traffic.

They're also very experienced and speak good English so the guidance and narrative were very clear.

In addition to the drivers (2 bikes with one lady driver each for me and my wife), there was a 3rd tour guide who's young and experienced as well.

Throughout the tour we had free mineral water, refreshing sugar cane juice, and dessert. We were never left thirsty or hungry even though this was a Sights tour, not a foodie tour. The ladies were attentive with great attitude.

I can't think of any negatives, which makes this a great tour if you and family just want a quick tour of Ho Chi Minh City! Highly recommended!

Great experience! - Had a great time on this tour with special thanks to our tour guides, Sing, Muy and Binh! Food was great, especially the seafood & enjoyed the fun facts about the city. Overall a fun and very worthwhile experience!

Best thing we did in HCMC! - A group of four of us took the XO tour yesterday evening and without a doubt it was the best activity we have done all week in HCMC.

The ladies were fantastic and the food was absolutely delicious. We all really appreciated the whole experience of eating real Vietnamese street food and discovering the real Vietnam through this tour.

We felt so safe the entire time. Nobody in my group had ever been on the back of a bike before so we were a bit nervous at first. We were immediately brought to ease with their excellent driving across such a hectic city.

This tour really opened our eyes and taste buds. If we had the opportunity to rate this over the 5 we would - it's a must do if you have time in city. XO are very organized and have thought out every last detail to make the experience personable and so much fun.

Great Tour - So much fun, great tour.
Food excellent, the scooter drivers are so good at riding and really charming.
Lots of information, lots of great food, lots of fun.
Yes, the traffic is crazy but I feel secure and in good hands.
Highly recommend this tour.

Great time on the Foodie Tour with kids - From the initial contact via email, the company was helpful and very responsive.

We were slightly apprehensive about doing the tour with our kids (aged 10 and 12) but we were reassured sufficiently and we went ahead and booked it.

Unfortunately, on the day of the tour my son was sick, so I did the tour just with my 10 year old daughter. The company didn't impose their usual cancellation fee which was very much appreciated.

We were picked up on time from our hotel by the amazing Hang and Dang. They soon made my daughter comfortable on the back of the motorbike and we were off into the manic Saigon traffic.

We met up with the rest of our group at our first stop - where we also met the Tour Leader, England. He spoke to everyone individually to make sure they were happy and got to know everyone.

We had our first dish and then we set off on the bikes again. The girls spoke to us as we weaved through the traffic and were great with my daughter - she was slightly nervous at first but was soon riding pillion like a local (not holding on!).

I couldn't praise the girls more highly - they were confident, friendly, kind and safe drivers. They really spoiled my daughter, even taking her off to buy an ice cream while Anh told the grown-ups about life in Vietnam.

I'd notified the company previously that my daughter might not especially like the food, so they said they would prepare some kid friendly food as well. However, this wasn't touched as we all wolfed down frogs legs, goat and other local delicacies.

Out of our three week holiday in Vietnam and Cambodia, this was my daughter's highlight and I'd recommend the tour to anyone, young or old.

Thanks to everyone involved!

OMG these girls rock!!! - Did the Foodie Tour with my husband and loved every minute. The food was amazing as was zipping through the streets on the back of the XO girls bikes. Super quick at returning my email inquiry for a last minute tour booked on the day. Worth every penny and more. The support crew of boys was equally awesome and made everyone feel 100% safe and organized. Very comfortable bikes and not at all scary for a wimp like me. Keep up the fabulous work XO, you do Vietnam proud 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

Number one for a reason - Super professional and safe tour these ladies know their stuff.

All the ladies were well educated and up for conversation.

The food stops were awesome we had the best bun bo hue on this tour.

Highly recommend. Do this tour on your first day in Saigon you will not regret it.

Amazing tour, amazing food, amazing girls!!! - The foodie tour 100% recommended, very fine and friendly staff. The girls always explain everything. Very good food, undoubtedly the best tour of my life. Thanks for the unforgettable experience.

Best thing you can do in HCMC - This foodie tour is a very well-run unit managed by professionals. The mrs and I were picked up by 2 girls on motorbikes and after a safety briefing we rode to the first restaurant (ban bo hue dong ba) where we met the rest of the participants - 10 in total. Tai (the manager) was the tour leader and he was supported by another 8 or 9 members. Together with the girls we were a pretty big contingency! We sampled the dishes there and moved on to 'Oc Oanh' for some barbequed 'goat' prawns, beef and so on. We then proceeded to Chinatown for a briefing followed by a couple of other places.
Lau De 3q was the final restaurant for seafood and dessert.
This was easily one of the best activities you can do while in HCMC. I read somewhere the Forbes has rated the one of the 10 best foodie tours in the world. It's easy to see why as they are good at what they do and most of all they enjoy it.

Best of Saigon - This tour is amazing and a must when you are visiting Saigon. My husband and I only had 1 full day to see the best of Saigon and XO tour did just that. We booked the sight tour and foodie tour. Our tour guide brought us to the hidden gems of Saigon, got to see the best part of some district and experienced foods that we thought we would never eat but we did. They accommodated to the foods that we cant eat which is pork.

I never had an experience riding a motorbike before but my girl made sure that i was comfortable, she might be young but she was experienced and good driver and i never felt unsafe riding. It rained a bit at night but of course the girls were prepared, they brought ponchos for us.

The girls are so outgoing and friendly, and they ensure that we are having a fantastic and memorable time.

Sights Tour - This is an absolute must if you are in Ho Chi Minh. We did it the first day we arrived and it gave us a real feel for the city. The ladies who drive you make you feel so at ease, believe me, I was nervous. I didn't even feel the need to hold on, I just held the back of the bike and felt so safe. It's the best way to see the city and gives you a feel for the crazy traffic in the city. As well as the ladies who drive you, you also get a personal tour guide who tells who everything you need to know about the city's History and culture. The team were so attentive throughout the tour, making sure you never went thirsty or wanting for anything. You get to try traditional Vietnamese delicacies and visit a traditional market, which was my favorite part. We were sad to say goodbye! Best tour I've done in South East Asia and I have traveled here extensively. The only point to improve because hey everyone needs constructive criticism, would be a little bit more time by yourself to take pictures at certain points.

Best way of experiencing Ho Chi Minh - The tour completely surpassed my expectations. The driver's English was great and they were very friendly and knowledgeable about the city. The food places were very authentic and immersed you in the local 'non tourist oriented' Vietnam food and culture. Would recommend to anyone!

PERFECT! - This tour was amazing! So much fun with the girls on the motorbikes, getting to know HCMC, a small sightseeing tour, and really cool, local eating places. For sure one of the best experiences in our 1 month in Vietnam! :-)

Fantastic tour - What a terrific tour. Loved riding on the bike through the crazy Ho Chi Minh traffic. Drivers were great and always felt safe. The food was awesome and a great variety. Also got to see a variety a districts. Only problem was no beer at the first food stop. I thought for the price that was a bit disappointing.

The best way to see the city! - We did this tour as a family of 4 - it was really informative and great fun! Our guide Han and the ladies who drove us round were the perfect hosts, they made us feel welcome and also safe on the bikes. The city tour helped us get a real feel for our surroundings in a short space of time and what better way to do this than from the same perspective of the majority of locals who use motorbikes to get around. The sites we visited were well selected and each stop well informed. In between stops we talked to our drivers and found out about life in the city more generally, which was just as interesting. Refreshments were well timed and took the opportunity to introduce us to some local pit tops. Thouroughly recommend this - one of the highlights of our travels round south east Asia.

Awesome tour - This was so fun. Felt extremely safe with these girls, well organized and super friendly staff!
Thanks again!

You simply have to do this...... - We did the Saigon by Night tour as we didn't think the investment for the Foodie Tour would be worth it for the kids. We had a blast. TheXO guides were great and made us feel really welcome from the first introduction.

Being part of the lunacy that is Saigon traffic was awesome and our kids (14 and 12) loved it. It was great to get around to number of different districts and get a guide talk to you about the area and be exposed to elements that books, internet and simply walking around don't give you.

You will find cheaper tours available but i wouldn't hesitate to recommend XO and our kids loved the girls and felt really safe with them

Great food tour!!! - We chose for the xo your after reading the excellent reviews and we were not disappointed! The girls were so friendly and fun to be with! They were excellent drivers and we felt safe at all times!! The tour was a great combination of experiencing new food as well as learning about the city and culture! Couldnt recommend these girls any higher!

Twoet cigarettes - Being a solo female traveler with limited time in HCM, I decided to do the Sites Tour and Foodie Tour all in one day.

These tours were both superb. I loved being on the back of the bikes with my guides.

The girls were such great fun and so friendly.

I felt completely safe at all times in the manic traffic.

Not only for you get to see so much visiting the different districts but learn a lot in the process.

The foodie tour provided so much food and was all delicious but definitely went on an empty stomach.

Would definitely recommend this to anyone

BEST TOUR EVER!!!! - Far out, if you want to experience some awesome food and see some local parts of the city, def do this tour. Helen and Moon were the best drivers, very knowledgeable and sweet. Sitting on the back of a bike having a chat with the girls like they have been your friend for years, was just amazing. We will be back in the future for sure. Have been to 39 countries, endless cities and tours, this has to be #1 by a long shot. Thanks so much Helen and Moon oxox

A good way to visit Saigon - We did it last April and it was super. Nice drivers, nice guide, we went to many small places we would never visited alone. Really great, I definitely advise you to do it!

the best night of our leisure trip, no doubt; and trip has just begun... - wonderful, sensational, awesome, you name it; no matter how you say, the XO FOOD TOUR is something you will never, ever forget; in no other way a mere tourist could know vietnamese real life, out of district 1; and as a person who loves to eat, this deep dive - although for a few hours- in intimate Ho Chi Minh City should obviously be thru food! and not only the meals and he restaurants deserve A grade; being IN the messy traffic, on a scooter, missed and missing the other scooters and cars and buses for a centimeter, always driven by careful girls is an experience that will keep stuck in your mind, for days to come; to make it short: if you are going to Ho Chi Minh (or Saigon, if you like), the first thing to do is booking them, no regrets at all... ah, almost forgot: if the ladies drive the scooters, Thai, the general manager, is in charge of the whole thing, showing us real precious places!!!

Highlight of Saigon/Ho Chi Minh - After seeing the traffic in the city, it was with some trepidation that we climbed aboard our scooters for the evening food tour of Saigon with XO Tours. Our fears were soon unfounded once we met our superb drivers Hong and Mai as we joined the rest of the group for an almost 5 hour mix of entertainment, excellent food, drink, local knowledge and sightseeing of Saigon at night. It was such a wonderful experience, An unmissable must do event for anyone who wants a real non-tourist visit of a great city. Hong talked non-stop about all the sights and culture of Vietnam, that we were always the last to make it to the next meal stop, but she gave me a fantastic insight into Saigon.

Thanks also to Tour Leader Hieu and his team of Men in Black who watched out for us. The photos emailed through a few days later were fantastic.

Food was great - real authentic and Hieu's attention to detail over everyone's dietary requirements was just brilliant.

I cannot recommend XO Tours enough, this Foodie tour by night will leave you buzzing, and give "jumping chicken" a go, you won't be disappointed!

Do it!!! - Went on the 'Foodie' tour on my first night. Had the best time with the group. My personal tour guide, Yen, was brilliant and had heaps and heaps of information as we rode around the city. I felt completely safe on the back of the scooter and you can tell these girls are professionals.
We went to five places overall. Three for food and two for a quick tourist stop.
There is soooooo much food there is no chance of leaving there hungry. It just kept coming!
I would definitely recommend this trip as not only is it fun, but informative and helps you get so much more out of your stay.

Amazing XO tours - We did the Saigon city am tour and foodie night tour on our first day in HCMC as family (mum, dad and 8yr old daughter).
It was brilliant. All the xo girls were really friendly - chatting away through the tour, making sure we were all entertained, and safe, on the scooters. Tour guides were equally friendly and knowledgeable taking us round some of the sights.
They treated our daughter like a princess throughout and she loved it!
I can't think of a better way to explore this city and you "get" their crazy traffic system really quickly from the back of a scooter. The wife was concerned about our daughter (and her) on the back of scooters but this was soon forgotten and both tours have been a stand out highlight of our travels to Vietnam.
On the day tour, you'll see a lot of districts and temples but you will need to return to larger sites like reunification palace / war remnants museum yourself but this is as advertised and means you see more of the city anyway.
Foodie tour not only takes you to lots of different food places but also lots of other districts at night too so you get best of both, with more food and drinks than you'll ever finish!
This may be more expensive than some other scooter tours but it's worth every dollar. XO tours fully deserve their top ranking on trip advisor and I cannot recommend these tours more highly. Well done XO. Thank you!

Must do XO city tour - We did this tour on our second day in Ho Chi Minh city. It gives you a great feel and understanding of the city. We felt very safe on the mopeds. The girls really look after you and they are sooo polite and sweet. The guide was great and took us round to some great sites. The best tour we have done.

Amazing way to spend an evening - We had a great evening with Ngan and Vi. Such professional tour guides and company overall. We did the evening tour and saw many parts of the city we would have not had the chance to on our own!

A must-do in Saigon - Ok I'm a person who is disenchanted of everything!!!! BUT, this tour on a scooter is ACE!!! It is so much fun and I highly recommend it.. 😃
A few points to encourage you to go on this fun adventure:
-Excellent drivers
-Female drivers only
-Excellent English
-Interesting insights into Saigon history
-The city is massive and this is a quick, super fun and easy way to see this awesome city and sights ..
I loved every minute 😃...
Special thanks to my scooter buddy BANG TAM LE !! She's the best driver, great English, friendly and intelligent 😄😄😄😄
GO ON DO IT !!!

Kids will love it - Best way to go around Saigon city within a short time span.
We did the 'sights' tour.
XO tours are well planned & you will find the guides at the rights spots.
The girls are good drivers and they kept us informed and entertained throughout the entire time. If there are kids in your group, they are going to love it!

XO tours - two thumbs up - I tried this tour on my first day in Ho Chi Minh City to get an idea of ​​the food in Vietnam. Riding on the back of a scooter, with a confident driver, through the peak hour traffic of HCMC was a blast. Vee was a confident and engaging host who made this tour great. She entertained me and made me laugh and was so informative about the food we were eating too. I had so much fun and would not hesitate to recommend this tour to anyone thinking about seeing a different side to the standard tourist tour of HCMC. Thanks Tuan and Vee for making this tour a memorable one for me!!!

Unforgettable culinary and sightseeing experience. - A really well thought-out service run by friendly, polite, knowledgeable and extremely helpful people. The tour covered a range of exciting and lively areas well outside the usual tourist haunts of District 1.The mode of transport was a lot of fun and exposed us fully to the sounds and smells, as well as the sights, of Friday night HCMC. All this with the added benefit of an expert guide on each bike, and a remarkable selection of local street food. The culinary experience was quite challenging in our case (a challenge we welcomed) but it was clear they could adjust the level according to guests' preferences and restrictions. All in all an great evening and an absolute must for visitors to HCMC.

Foodies night tour - Amazing!!! Can't speak highly enough of this tour and company. Very professional, the female riders were awesome,so lovely and polite, my lovely girl Phoenix was funny and delightful. Felt very safe both on the bike and with the male tour guide Tai, and the male security detail that accompanies you wherever you go. Five districts gives you a most insightful experience into Ho Chi Min at nite. Coupled with way to much delicious food and beers, Laughs and smiles there is nothing to fault. My tour consists of fifteen people and they managed us all with grace and charm.... highly recommend this tour, the company and staff.

Very nice and authentic foodie tour - At first, I chose to book both city and foodie tours.
However, I canceled the city tour due to sudden important occasion and really I regret that I canceled that tour.
My experience with the XO foodie tour was amazing.
I met my partner who drove the motorbike all time.
We went to the first stop while seeing the beauty of Saigon river.
At the first stop, I met several friends from Korea and Netherlands (Nice to meet you guys).
We tried the first meal, which was the beef noodle.
I believe that we might not taste this local food if we don't know any Vietnamese.
In the second stop, we tried the Vietnam BBQ and enjoyed the local beer.
XO girls will cook for you so that you can focus on your food and talk with other friends.
Finally, we tried various kinds of seafood with additional special food that you must try.
Between the food session, we went to two stops where our guide Hieu explained many things about Vietnam and Saigon.
During the tour, we can not only taste the food but also know the daily activities about local people.
In addition, I really talked a lot with my partner while we ride the motorbike.
I really recommend for travelers who come to Saigon / Ho Chi Minh City to take the XO tour.
I believe that XO tours always give 200% to meet the expectations of their customers.
I wish I could take the city tour when I come to Saigon next time.
Thank you for the best memory while I am in Saigon.
See you later.

An absolute must do - Fantastic experience. We did this with our two children aged 8 and 11. It was a totally professional service. We felt so safe and it was a fantastic way to see and learn about different parts of HCMC. Tai as our Tour Manager was brilliant. The tour was really informative with a great balance of information. This was an absolute highlight of our time in Saigon. Totally recommend it for all age groups.

Highlight of our holiday - An absolute must do activity in HCMC. All female bike foodie tour, over a 4 hour period throughout many of the districts that make up Ho Chi Minh City. Very well organized, professional group of lovely young ladies (and men) that have an absolute love of what they do. Even if you have never been on the back of a motor scooter, you don't ever feel unsafe. It was an absolute blast and so much fun. The food that we tasted on the night time tour was a 10/10 and you got to see parts of the city and taste things that you may not normally have looked for whilst on your holiday. Very informative and a great night out. Highly recommended regardless of the cost, worth every cent.

Professional, well designed and great experience! - I went on an XO foodie tour and it was an awesome experience. It was fun, safe and unforgettable!

You taste a large variety of food, see areas of Ho Chi Minh that many tourists don't see and learn more about the backgrounds of the different areas and the food.

The Linh and Dung were excellent drivers and companions, making the tour itself fun and safe.

Authentic food and experience - We went on xo tours on our first day in Saigon. We were picked up delicious from our hotel and taken to multiple restaurants and street stalls around Saigon by scooter.

The food catered well to different tastes and you get to try some interesting foods for the more adventurous.

Compared to other scooter tours we took around Vietnam, XO had by far the best service. Hieu our guide provides lots of interesting information about all the districts in Saigon and our drivers Linh and Dung were wonderful company. They provided excellent hospitality and helped us get to know more about the people and culture in Saigon. It was one of the highlights of our trip.

What an experience - One of the best things we have done whilst on holiday, what a great way to spend an evening. Everyone associated with our evening should take a bow, extremely professional, well organized and such great fun. One of the best ways for experiencing and getting to know this wonderful city. Thanks to all

Top-notch - Xo foodie tour is THE highlight of my trip to Vietnam! Very organized and fun filled. Iy literally had me on the edge of my seat as my tour guide drove me around different districts of saigon. What i loved about this tour was that it offers insight in to the different parts of saigon and the unique street foods. The interactions each tour guide had with their clients were amazing. Been recommending thus trip to my friends and random strangers i met on my way aroundthis beautiful country called vietnam ~~

The best evening out! - This is a must do in Ho Chi Minh City! It is an all female bike tour, so if you are a little nervous about going on the back of a bike then look no further. They take you all around the city showing you different parts and explaining everything in detail for you. They take you somewhere and pay for your dinner, drinks and let you try as much as you like! You get to walk around a night food market and also stop a couple of places to look at all the buildings. You feel very safe with them and even though it's not very cheap it is worth it. They gave us a recommendation for what to do after we got dropped off which was exactly what we were looking for!

Excellent Tour - My husband and I and teens (18 and 13) booked a motorcycle sightseeing tour with XO- they were brilliant. Our guide Quang and the 4 girls were amazing. I had researched tours before leaving the UK as my daughter was slightly nervous and had never been on a bike- all the reviews are true. A safe and informative fun half day. Highly recommended- August 2017

The 1st thing you should do in Saigon! - Wow! What an experience. We did the "Foodie tour" on our 1st night in Saigon and absolutely loved it... you can easily see how Forbes rated it in the top 10 tours on earth. The Xo girls were incredible (my xo girl Mia was exceptional) our food host amazing and behind the scenes there is a team making the night run seamlessly. If you only do one thing in Saigon, DO THIS!

Superb Saigon experience - We did the XO Saigon by night tour on our last day there. It was one of the highlights of our Saigon stay.
I'm glad I did my research well and chose XO. 3 Lovely ladies Tin2, Anh and Two were our guides for the night. They met us at the hotel lobby and after a brief intro we jumped right into the safety features. My only concern was if my kids would be safe on the bikes and they went over and above to ensure our safety.
Big thanks to them, showing us a side of Saigon we will never have seen on our own and making it a fun, enriching evening for the entire family. Some delicious street food was included as well.
The group manager Thinh ensured everything went smooth and I highly recommend this tour company if your looking for a unique, fun and unforgettable experience.

An unforgettable experience! - My friend and I did a night around Ho Chi Minh city with Loan and Ngan Ly. It was a fantastic experience as we they were young women. They made us feel very welcome and safe. Our guides provided information about 5 different districts and took us around the city to try local foods. This tour is a great way to try the bikes and see the city in a different way than in a taxi.

Best Tour going - First time to Vietnam and the XO foodie tour was recommended to me by several friends.So glade i booked it. Which i have to say was the easiest tour to book hands down.
I really have to thank my guide Thanh and the tour manager Tai. so much fun all night.
They both made the night fun, interesting and one , never to forget.
