We got to see districs, i would not have seen and the information Tai passed on was amazing .
A define tour to do :-)
Fantastic experience!! - The night/foodie tour was amazing - a definite highlight of our holiday! Super friendly girls, great food & an unforgettable way to see Saigon!!

One of the best tours I have ever done - I have had a travel business for over 15 years..

I was traveling with a group of 16 friends and we booked this tour because it seemed like fun but it turned out to be one of the best tours I have ever done..

The staff were unbelievably helpful and really made an effort to make our experience special !

This is a must do!!

Food Tour excellent - We recently experienced the XO Food Tour and had a fabulous evening. Our guides were very competent riders, had a great sense of humor and proudly introduced us to their local cuisine, some history and culture. We recommend this Tour for all visitors to Ho Chi Minh City. It was a definite highlight for us. Thank you to XO Tours!😃

Local Street Food - XO Food Tour is a great way to see how the locals live and eat fresh local produce. Its a fantastic way of getting around the area on Scooters. The roundabouts are a little scary but they the girls keep you safe. Well worth it.

Must-do activity in Saigon (HCMC) ! - As a visitor, you feel Saigon's unique vibes the moment you step out of the airport and dive in the ever going flow of scooters. It may seem overwhelming at first but once you ride one of these vehicles across the city you commune with the city's heart beat!

Wanting to experience it safely with my 2 teenagers boys (16 and 15), I chose XO Tours (sights visits). Tai Dang was our tour manager, what an outstanding crew, the service was impeccable from start to finish. No wonder they are on top of the Trip Advisors list for things to do in Saigon.

We also took the video option (around 40US$ extra). A filming crew on a scooter followed us during the tour and filmed all our activities, from the hotel pick-up till the end of the tour. Can't wait to see the edited movie of our memorable tour!

Saigon by night tour - just brilliant! - This tour was easily the highlight of our time in ho chi minh. Everything was organised to perfection and i genuinely could not recommend it more! In addition to amazing food, lovely drinks and great sights, the guides gave us a real insight into their lives in Vietnam, whilst being genuinely interested in our lives in england! This tour is an absolute must do!!!!!! Thanks, laura and tom

What a FANTASTIC experience - Well what can I say about the XO Tours. It was just absolutely amazing from start to finish. From the booking on the website right up to receiving photographs from them of the evening's excursion.

It's very good to be taken round a vast city like Ho Chi Minh with very well informed guides.

We did the Foodie Tour and I could not recommend it any more highly. Tasting various Vietnamese street food in lots of different city locations and definitely not sticking to any tourist areas at all. This was the real Ho Chi Minh where the locals and their families all eat together and we got the chance to be involved in that.

All different types of food was cooked, consumed and even just stared at depending on your likes and dislikes. They cater for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike.

A 10/10 experience and one my son won't ever forget. The smile on his face when we returned to the hotel was a delight to see.

A huge thanks to our guides Phoung3 , Vy4 and Hieu who were excellent.

Highly recommend this to anyone.

Saigon by Night scooter tour - We did this last night & had a great time, I thought the traffic in Saigon was CRAZY and that was from the safety of a car so to zip about in it on a scooter - wow. Our lady drivers picked us up at our hotel & off we went. Felt very comfortable and safe with the driver and she was very friendly and spoke excellent English so I got non stop commentary along the way. Stopped at a local food hall and had the choice of a few food options & a drink, walked around Chinatown foodmarkets & then deserted in a tiny local cafe. All in all an excellent evening, I would not hesitate to reccomend this tour.

A worthwhile experience - We did a private tour, being slightly older this suited us. The girls are lovely and very competent on the bikes, after a short time I was comfortable on the bikes and they have a security person riding with you to make sure all is well. This is more than a food tour it was an experience in all that HCMC has to offer, we ate at some real Vietnam food spots and had an explanation of the city and sights as well. Well worth its top rating.

Great tours! - My daughter and I did the sightseeing tour and the foodie tour with them, and they were both fantastic. It really was the best way to see and experience the city, its culture and food. Highly recommended!

Amazing - We went on the Foodie night tour and it was an awesome way to taste authentic Vietnamese food, talk to genuine people and see Ho Chi Minh at night from the back of the bike. We went when it was slightly wet yet our drivers were funny, helpful and lovely. The drivers are dressed in traditional clothing and at two of the stops help us to cook our food while playing chopstick games and talk to us about where we are from and tell us about the reality of living in Vietnam. We were able to visit all areas of Ho Chi Minh and had an amazing time doing it. We also received a large selection of photos and a video of our trip after being well organized and extremely professional. Was sad to leave our drivers at the end of the night, our highlight of Ho Chi Minh.

Food tour is a MUST in HCM City! - My girlfriend and I did the evening food tour and can't recommend it enough. From pickup to drop off, XO tours exceed our expectations. They bring you to restaurants and street vendors where you are truly the only tourists, and when they say 'all you can eat and drink' - they mean it! Our guides and trip leader were fantastic, spoke English well, and helped prepare food and explain sites and culture all evening. Make sure you make time for this when in HCM City.

MOST FUN TOUR EVER - We are 76 and wanted a fun tour of Ho Chi Minh. We found XOXO TOURS on trip advisor and cannot be happier with our decision to book a private tour showing us so many districts with different personalities in each part of town. The ladies were so professional and elegant in their Vietnamese dress--and what great drivers! Pictures were taken all along the way and sent to us in a text. We did a private tour because Princess Cruise did not get to Ho Chi Minh in time for the regular tour. It was worth every penny for the private tour. Next time I want to do the Foodie Tour! We were in 7 countries and this was the most fun tour of all.

Fantastic tour! - Going on the Foodie Tour, zooming around the city on the back of motorbikes, and trying a wide variety of Vietnamese food with guides to help with what everything is and how to eat it properly is really fantastic. We had the opportunity to try Bun Bo Hue, a bunch of different seafood, quail, frog, balut, goat, okra, coconut jelly, steamed rice balls, tea, beer, and a shot of hard liquor. We were encouraged to ask for more of anything we wanted: all you can eat and drink. Our guides also told us a lot about the city and the different districts as we drove around. To top it all off, the night we went was my husband's birthday, and they helped me arrange a surprise for him: a beautifully decorated birthday cake at the end of our last stop and everyone sang him Happy Birthday. It was awesome (and delicious)! I really appreciated their extra effort.

Foodie tour - Definitely the highlight of our trip to ho chi min city. XO tours are an extremely well organised and professional company. This became apparent from the minute I booked online. They responded quickly and provided all the necessary information in a timely manner.
The actual foodie tour was amazing! We had a ball! Thank you to Thanh, Lam and Koi for being incredible guides, riders and hosts! We would highly recommend this tour to all!

Best way to see HCMC and spend our last day - The tour is one of our top highlights of our trip so far. You learn a lot about the city and get to see parts we probably would never have gone to or knew about. The mopeds we so much fun and safe, my wife was scared before the tour but quickly fell in love with getting around the city that way! The girls are super friendly and speak English very well, our tour leader Tuan Nguyen was very energetic and really made the tour! Would recommend 100 times over!
Until next time XO Tours!

Gets you out of District 1 - Trust your beautiful driver and relax into the thrill of being on a scooter discovering Ho Chi Minh. The five hours went so fast as we weaved our way through the Saigon traffic from District 1 to District 4 (Chinatown), then a wonderful BBQ joint, then onto District 7 and finally Cholon. The added surprise was the great photos our tour leader took of us enjoying the night which promptly arrived in our email the following day. Throw away your inhibitions and try all the local delicacies. The highlights were the imperial Bun Bo Hue, delicious grilled scallops with spring onion and peanuts and a dipping sauce, chilli crab.... and watching my husband eating balut (Google it !!)

Fun way to see HMC! - Had an amazing time on the foodie tour! The girls were very professional & friendly. They were happy to chat, tell you about their lives & living as a local in Vietnam. Excellent motorbike drivers & always felt very safe (even in the torrential rain!!) It was really interesting to compare and see the different areas of Ho Chi Minh City from the back of a bike. Food was delicious especially the seafood at the last stop! A must do while visiting HCM City!

Fantastic tour - We had such a good time on this tour of food spots in Ho Chi Minh. The drivers are all girls, and took really good care of us, both on the road and in the eateries. We were taken to spots we wouldn't have been to otherwise, and tried some unusual foods (if we wanted). Would definitely recommend.

The best ends up being a great time in Vietnam - We were recommended this tour by a couple the day before we wanted to go. There was no trouble booking for the next day
The girls met us at our hotel and immediately put our 13 and 15 girls at ease. It just went from good to amazing. Even on one of the wettest nights. The drivers were amazing and completely competent driving in horrid conditions
We had the best time and would recommend this to anyone without any reservation. Absolutely loved it from start to end.
Thank you

Fantastic Fun! - Riding around the teeming streets of Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a scooter, driven by a really nice Vietnamese girl, eating great food, what a great experience. Our group of 9 had the time of our lives, thanks so much XO !!

A must! - I thoroughly enjoyed our foodie tour with XO tours on the 8 July. Khoi our group leader was a wonderful guide and the drivers were great fun and I felt very safe on the back of the bike! The food was fantastic at each and every stop and they were very accommodating with alternatives.

XO Food Tour - A must if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh. Traveling from restaurant to restaurant on a scooter was thrilling. Trying all the local foods delicious. The drivers are well experienced. My daughter who is 12 had the time of her life. Highly recommended.

Excellent .... A must do for everyone. - We had an absolutely wonderful time doing this food tour. The girls are so friendly and very knowledgeable. What a fantastic way to see the city and eat your way as you go. Well done to all concerned.

Shopping Tour In Ho Chi Minh - Highly Recommended - We did a shopping tour as a family of 4. It was great to get out of District 1 (paying premium prices) and go shopping in District 3 on a bike ! We hardly saw any tourists at the shops/markets we went to.
Tai and the team were great, discuss with us when we met at the start of the tour what we wanted to buy on the tour and negotiated the prices for us to make the shopping experience a great memorable and successful - All our purchases were transported by the team and given to us at the end of the tour - Highly recommend!

As amazing as advertised - I did the sights tour (led by Anh) in the morning and foodie tour (led by Tuan) that evening. I would highly recommend both. When it comes to food I am certainly not very adventurous, but this tour was a fantastic way to see the city and eat where the locals eat. The lady drivers are amazing and I always feel safe on the busy streets. Believe the reviews, this company gives great tours!

Saigon Must do! - We took an XO bike food tour on our very last night of a month long holiday in Vietnam. We had wanted to do it when we arrived in Ho Chi Minh a month ago but it was booked out at the time. It would be a great thing to do at the beginning of your trip to teach you about food and the Saigon but was really fabulous at the end too! Our lovely drivers, Linh 1 and Minh 3 were amazing girls. We really enjoy their company (they are the same age as our daughters). We enjoyed the many taste testings as well as the tour through the districts. We learned and laughed a lot! Really worth booking this tour!!!

Excellent tour, friendly tour guide! - Decided to go on the Foodie tour last minute, and I am glad I did! It seemed a little pricey for me at first, but it was worth it.
I got picked up right in front of my hotel, and since it was my first time on a motorbike, my driver explained carefully what I needed to know.
Our tourguide, Khoi, was really friendly, explained sites and foods very well. He also made sure to introduce everyone to each other and that you are having a good time.
The food was amazing too, the girls helped with the bbq-ing and peeling the seafood everytime.
We got to eat amazing seafood like crab, prawns, scallops, bbq beef, chicken etc. But just be prepared for some exotic dishes like frog and duck eggs :)
Also it's a good idea to bring a facemask to wear during the bike ride. They're available in convenience stores like Circle-K or Family Mart, which are located practically in every corner.
One thing is that I did not realize that the tour did not go to the popular tourist sites. It was great seeing the more local areas too, but I wish I realized this before hand. I was hoping I'd see some main attractions since I only had one night in HCMC. Despite that, I still had an awesome time at this tour and would definitely go for it again.

Night food tour - Great night out on this tour. Thoroughly enjoyed every minute. We saw areas of Ho Chi Minh that we would never have seen on the back of the bike. The girls who rode were very experienced and made us feel very safe through the mad traffic. The food was excellent. A must do!!

Great way to get to know the city - I had just two days in Ho Chi Ming and decided to do this tour. Yes it's pricey and at first I thought it wouldn't be worth it but decided to follow the Trip Advisor and Lonely Planet reviews. Great decision: in a few hours I could not only taste quite unusual tastes (be ready and open minded!) but also, and more importantly for me, get to know Ho Chi Ming besides the touristic and rich District 1. Great experience, excellent drivers - important in the chaotic traffic - and nice staff. Definitely would recommend, it's worth every penny.

Great food, exciting city!!! - We were a party of 10 and all thoroughly enjoyed this tour.
All the girls were very informative and fun. There was plenty of great food and drinks throughout the night.
I initially felt a little uneasy on the back of bike in Saigon, but this feeling soon disappeared, scooter drivers very competent.
It was a great tour and would recommend to all.
Thanks XO !!!

Must-do tour! - This is a must-do in HCMC. We were provided the opportunity to see five different districts on motorbikes. What a great way to really see the city!

The food was fabulous (food and beer were free flowing until you say stop!). Try all the food it's what makes the experience!

Tai, our guide was so friendly, attentive and knowledgable about the city and its food! We felt very safe on the bikes with our girls the whole time. Ting and Lena were wonderful! So nice to have chats while we rode and while we sat and ate our meals :). There is always something to keep everyone engaged along the way (games, history, etc.)

They take photos throughout the night and send them to you so you can relive your motorbike experience without dropping your phone! A great little extra we appreciate :)

If you love food, and even if you just want a personal tour of the entire city, but are too afraid to ride your own bike and navigate, try this! HCMC is a delight, and XO tours made our experience that much better :).

Brilliant Tour, Incredible Fun - Brilliant, brilliant, brilliant way to experience Saigon districts in Ho Chi Minh city. We did the foodie tour in July and the weather was great. The female riders were fantastic and were extremely safe to ride with on their motorbikes in the very busy traffic. We traveled all over the place eating and drinking and there were 14 courses in total, we couldn't have fitted anything else in. All drinks were supplied and of course we were given helmets and wet weather gear if needed. The drivers even cooked the food for us at one of the locations. The food was great and was very safe to eat. This is an excellent company and we think they are brilliant. Thanks so much to Choi the tour leader who was exceptional. Our riders were Mee, Yeung and That and we fully recommend them to you!!!

The best way to tour Saigon! - This was recommended to us by other travelers who we met just prior to our visit to Saigon. We didn't know what to expect however it was such a great experience. We came away thinking it was the best decision one could make. We saw everything we wanted to see and felt very safe despite the crazy traffic ! Jump on the back and enjoy!

XO Foodie Tour - what a finale to our holiday! - We booked an XO foodie tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh City for our family of 4 with two teenage boys and it was an amazing finale to our holiday. We were a bit anxious about getting on the back of a scooter, but with the experienced riders it didn't take long before we were at ease, and feeling liberated! It was informative, we toured around many districts of Ho Chi Minh City to see the diversity of the city and places that not many tourists ventured to. Our drivers pointed out different landmarks as we toured around. We ate in places that the locals eat and tried a great range of local foods. We enjoyed the grilled foods that were cooked up over hot coals on a mini BBQ on our table. The goat, beef and prawns were very tasty and also the vegetable Okra. The last stop had lovely seafood, which we could order as many serves as we liked. We had a second serve of the crab, which was so tender and delicious. During the tour we stopped at interesting locations and our guide kept us entertained and we learned more about the local culture. A big thank you to our lovely drivers and guide Understanding for great entertainment.

A great experience and way to see the city! - My husband and I recently did this tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh City, and we loved it. The staff are so lovely and they showed us so much of the City that we wouldn't have seen otherwise. The food was great. This tour is a must when visiting.

Thrilling experiences - So much fun and a great way to see the city. Traffic was scary, but the drivers are amazing and very informative about the food, the country and the culture. The food is great and if you want some weird tastings, you can do that to.

All about the experience! - This was our 3rd food tour in Vietnam. The girls picked us up at our hotel at 5.30pm before meeting Hieu and the rest of the group for our first fish, similar but nicer than Pho although the name escapes me now! Traveling by scooter in HCMC is such an experience, from terrifying at the start to exhilarating at the end when more at ease. We made 2 other food stops and traveled around 5 districts around HCMC and we stopped a couple of times along the way to hear about the districts. We enjoyed the food and had enough although it was definitely less than what we had eaten on other food tours although you could order more if you wanted. This tour was equally about talking to the locals and seeing the different areas and we had fun with different games and talking to the rest of the travelers. The price was twice what we paid for any of the other food tours ($65 USD each) but we spent almost 5 hours in great company and saw and tasted so much we felt it was worth it for this one off experience. The pictures that were sent on in the coming days were high quality and really captured the fun we had. If you can afford this unique experience then do it!

The company was super friendly. - After being scammed earlier that day from a Cyclo tour, my sister and I weren't in the best spirits and were feeling a bit down.

However we are so glad we booked this tour because the tourguides and girls were fantastic, making our trip to ho chi min wonderful again.

They were so knowledgeable about all the different areas of Ho Chi Minh, and went out of your way to ensure you felt comfortable and safe. Highly recommend loved this tour!! Thankyou so much we had the best time.

Safe and Fun - The host is funny. The food was great. At first I was afraid, I was petrified to be on the back of the scooters but between my driver, the host and other members of the staff, I relaxed and enjoyed the ride. It was the best way to see the city. I will do this again

You must do this in Ho Chi Min City! - We had a super morning with our fabulous drivers Vy & Nhung and tourist guide Ty. I was a bit apprehensive about getting on the back of a bike with all the busy traffic, and even had trouble getting on the bike. However, the girls were careful & safe drivers, and they worked out a way for me to get on more easily. It was a really great way to see the sights and learn a little more about Vietnam and the city. We thoroughly enjoyed the morning, don't worry........just do it!

Top of the "Must Do" list - What a great way to see HCMC by night ... Scooter thru the manic traffic driven by expert ladies. They take you to 3 fabulous eating places and visit a number of areas around the city. The whole experience was brilliant. Don't leave town without doing this.

Great - Very good tour. We took our ten year old boys and one was a bit freaked out at first with the craziness of traffic etc but by the end of tour he was smiling. The ladies were great with the kids and excellent drivers with lots of information on food and HCM in general. They try and keep away from the more popular Vietnamese dishes and let you try different stuff. The frog or "jumping chicken" was good, but I couldn't do the duck embryo. All other food was delicious- especially the seafood!!! They even made me a birthday cake which was appreciated. Excellent way to see a lot of HCM!

Not to be missed!! - Absolutely excellent from start to finish. Food, sights, guide, and driver were all excellent.

Never feel unsafe on the bike even though traffic in Saigon is crazy.

It was great to see other parts of the city and get some history as well as hear current politics, etc..

I think we had about 14 different courses (all delicious) and there were two on our tour of ten who have specific requirements (a non fish-eater and a non-chicken-eater), both were accommodated with smiles.

Great value. I wish there was a '6 Star' option....

Brilliant way to see the city. - Fantastic night tour of the city includes lots of stops for great food. The lady drivers are extremely safe. All guides are helpful and give insightful information about different areas we traveled to. Our guide gave great explanations on the food we were eating. The atmosphere of the tour was brilliant - very friendly, good humour. Very professional ran tour.

Lot of Fun - We did two tours with XO. The first one was the shopping spree for our daughter's 14th birthday. She showed Tai (leader) where she wanted to go and what she wanted to buy (we would never have found the place on our own) and it was so easy, he also helped with purchasing and making sure everything was correct. The girls were wonderful with our daughter and fussed over her and helped her shop. The added bonus was zipping through the traffic with our lovely riders. You get to see so much more on the back of a scooter than in a car.

In the evening with did the Saigon Night tour. It was fantastic, had different girls who were just as lovely as the girls from the morning tour. We got to go to some interesting places, eat some great food and learn plenty about Saigon. At the end of the night they had organized a birthday cake for our daughter. It is those special touches that make this company 5 stars.

Would definitely recommend this company, both of the tours and all of the staff were fantastic.
Fun and good food - They do a great job with this tour. Great food and a lot of fun. The guides are fun to spend the evening with and the restaurant choices are authentic and delicious.

Night food tour - Brilliant food tour, would highly recommend. Super organized, great team, great female drivers, amazing food and a different way to see a few districts in Saigon and eat at local restaurants that you'd never find yourself! Also learned a lot about the city from my driver and the rest of the team. Really enjoyed our evening!

This is an absolute must.....so much fun!!! - There is a reason this is the #1 TripAdvisor tour in Ho Chi Minh City.... It's fun, it's informative and you'll be served delicious food in areas where the locals eat, not in the tourist district..... A special thanks to our amazing riders Thanh and Lam and our fantastic host Khoi... Congratulations XO Tours, what an awesome experience!!!!

Shouldn't miss!!! - My husband and I along with our 4 children experienced this tour on our last night in Vietnam. We traveled throughout the country for 3 weeks and by far this was the BEST way to end our travels. The drivers were friendly and energetic. They were incredibly informative and fun to be around all night. The tour guide (Ahn) was funny and had a lot of insight to Saigon. My kids really enjoyed talking to him. The food was amazing and pretty daring. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone going to Saigon!

The best way to see Saigon - The hustle and bustle of the traffic in Saigon can be very intimidating to a first time visitor. Initially I was hesitant to cross the rd let alone sit on a motorbike... but XO sight seeing tour was the highlight of my stay. Anyone visiting should arrange a tour on their first day. The ladies working for XO were very kind and caring and the tour guide knowledgeable. Great company! Great experience! Very nice to learn about the history of the city.

An awesome morning out and about! - What a great way to see some sights, get a feel for the city and plan what else you might want to check out. The drivers and guides were super friendly, really engaging and well informed, making sure the kids and we had a superb time. Highly recommended!!!

Memorable Moments - Friday 7th July

Experiencing the culinary delights deliver an amazing fun filled trip, throughout all the off beat districts. Experienced young ladies, safe & informative revealing the life of a Vietnamese. Definitely one of the most memorable evenings. Fulfilling our taste buds with an assortment of delicious flavors, every taste danced on my tongue wanting more. Safely escorted to each district with such grace & professionals, I can't stop singing the praises of all that participated. Would certainly state the amount of variety on offer would suit even the fussiest. What better way of stepping out your comfort zone is to give everything ago as it was beautifully presented and the company of guides talking us through and explaining was definitely a plus. Well done, team XO you all very extremely friendly and nothing was too much trouble.

Kind Regards Kim & Craig (Australia-Adelaide)

Amazing Food!! - We went on this tour with high expectations and they were blown away. Not only does the types of food you eat cover a vast amount of all of the best street and traditional Vietnamese food but it is also an incredibly informative tour. Our tour guide Hue will tell stories and the history of each stop along the way and really give you a real sense of what the Vietnamese culture is like. Overall a brilliant your and I would 100% advise anyone to do it.

Fantastic Tour - Me and my friend did this tour and we couldn't recommend this more! The food was fantastic, the information from Hieu was fascinating but the highlights of the tour were the guides (Vi and Vi)! Very charismatic, energetic and brought a lot to the overall experience! A must do in Ho Chi Minh!

Xo Foodie Tour - Excellent. So much fun and a great way of experiencing the madness on the streets. Traveling through different districts is really cool and allows you to see a lot in a short period of time. A very well organized tour with amazing female drivers. You wont leave feeling hungry after this tour!!!

Best Thing I've Done in Southeast Asia - Wow... the nighttime motorbike food tour was AMAZING!!! Our guides were super knowledgeable and spoke great English- they took us to a bunch of different districts in Ho Chi Min you wouldn't normally see, and gave us the chance to eat like locals. Zooming around on the motor bikes was another world experience, but super safe!! I love that the bike riders are all women - they were so fun and engaging the whole night. Plus they have a photographer and security team following you the whole night- and send you all the pictures free of charge! Of all the things I've done abroad, this is definitely a top choice and if you do anything in Vietnam, DO THIS TOUR!!! I can't recommend it enough.

"Foodie" Tour - a must-do! - Thanks so much to all the team, especially Anh our tour leader and my driver Ngoc. Riding on the back of a motorbike is a great way to see Saigon and to have time to hear personal insights from your driver about life in Vietnam. We crossed all over the city and tried some great food in out of the way places. The guides were so friendly and kind. Highly recommended.

Tour was fun - the food was very average - We went for 2 tours with XO. The guides were friendly and informative, the drivers were excellent and going on the back of a bike was a great way to discover Saigon. The delicious homemade yogurt during the day tour was the highlight of the food we tasted, however the night food experience was not what I would call a Foodie Tour. The food was very 1 dimensional- nearly all meat, no real actual dishes except for a noodle soup which was not particularly pleasant. For the money I was expecting very good food.

WOW what a great way to see Ho Chi Minh - Was booked with know idea of ​​the traffic of Ho Chi Minh city yet here we are jumping on the back of two scooters driven by delicate woman I am 6'4 and 115 kgs. What a fantastic tour well organized and controlled, we did the HCMC tour at night and it was outstanding,meals were great the riders friendly and knowledgeable company was great would recommend for anyone to do this and feel safe.
Brilliant

A must sign-on tour in Saigon! - We had a lot of fun interacting with our individual tour guides who took us around on their bikes and also tried different foods around different districts. Not to mention, the breeze at night while riding on a bike was refreshing and exciting, especially for first timers! The free-flow foods and drinks were scrumptious, and there's also some "exotic" flavors for the adventure! Our main tour guide leader, Tuan, was superb! He speaks good English, is friendly, amusing and warm hearted as he showed and explained to us about the uniqueness of various districts. This allows us to gain more insight about the culture and lifestyle of Vietnamese people. Tuan also took an extra step to take photos for us and later send the photos to us via our personal emails. This is one of the most awesome and a must sign-on tour in Saigon! Will definitely recommend to our friends and families!
XO night tour - Was fantastic, enjoyed it very much. The girls were lovely, friendly and helpful. The food was great. Highly recommend.

Brilliant trips - Definitely the best trips in Saigon. The riders are friendly, helpful and make the trips fun and entertaining. We did both the foodie and shopping trips. They find out about you and tailor the trip to what you want. The scooters were fun and felt safe. We had some amazing food and managed to get some good gifts as well as see parts of the city that we wouldn't otherwise have seen. The guide was knowledgeable too.
Can't fault either trip and if returned would definitely take another XO tour....if you only have time for limited things make sure this is included!

Great way to see, taste and feel Saigon - We did an XO foodie tour, it was fantastic. What a way to experience Saigon. The guides are lovely and speak great English and make the trip fun. We went with 2 10 year old children, and felt confident that the kids were in good hands, plus the guides entertained and interacted with the kids, ensuring they enjoyed it and tried most of the food. It rained on the tour, they have great raincoats and to be honest it made us feel like a local and did not bother us at all. You stay dry, except your shoes, and it is warm enough that you are never uncomfortable- so don't be put off by doing it in the rainy season. This is a real highlight!

Great way to see Saigon and experience a bit of city life - We did both the evening food tour and the day time sights tour. I think the food tour was our favorite, but both were excellent. Our tour guides where knowledgeable, friendly, and fun. The scooter drivers were very safe, even for me at 6'4" and over 200lbs and our teenage daughter. I highly recommend this as a great way to see the major sights and experience a bit of city life in Saigon.

Foodie excitement for two Aussies - The XO Foodie Tour was our highlight on our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. The organisation was easy, the tour guide (Hieu) and drivers amazing!! We would not have been game enough to venture out like this on our own, we felt safe and well looked after. Oh and the food was SO GOOD!
Night market ride - What a fun trip around town on Saturday night. Although it rained a bit we were well taken care of. Great sense of humour and lots of laughs .

BRILLIANT - We visited in September 2014.
These Girls are brilliant. University Students in traditional dress drive you around Saigon stop at many places for a snack (costs included) and sites of interest for 3-4 hours at night.
They are all gorgeous with wonderful personalities and smiles. At one point you stop for a banquet with them and they explain the food to you.
They drive you on the back of Motor Scooters and they are very careful with your safety.

BOYS PLEASE NOTE: When your on the back of the scooter please do not touch the Girls to hang on. Girls okay.

Great tour! - Was a bit nervous about going on a scooter in Ho Chi Minh but so glad I did. We really enjoyed the tour and the food, was interesting to see the different districts which is something we wouldn't have done ourselves. Would really recommend doing this tour!

The best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh City! - We had a wonderful time on the Foodie tour. Our sons had expressed that they would like to experience Saigon outside of District 1. We were a little apprehensive about traveling on the back of a scooter in the apparent chaos of Saigon traffic but in fact it was incredibly safe and so much fun! The XO girls and the guides are amazing and eager to impart information about Saigon and Vietnamese culture. We also experienced wonderful food. I would recommend this trip to anybody and would do it again in a heartbeat.

Absolute must in Ho Chi Minh City! - We did both the sites and the food tours-the guides were incredibly knowledgable and you really get the sense you are seeing more of Ho Chi Minh than the normal tourist sites (especially on the food tour). The food on the tour was delicious and you certainly don't leave wanting more! This was the perfect introduction to the city. You MUST do this tour if you are in Ho Chi Minh.

Perfect! - Did half day city foodie tour. What's an experience. We enjoy the ride on motobike and Saigon street food. Many delicious choices. Huong was our guide. She's very friendly and fun. WE had great time and highly recommend XO travel!

Fun night in Saigon - Took the foodie tour with them. Booking was easy and they communicate well in the emails. The pick up was on time and my driver explained the safe way to get on and off the bike. Everyone was very friendly! My driver was very nice, helpfull and talkative! Really enjoyed the tour, ate so much food that i wouldn't have tried if i didn't go with them. They also took me to other districts within Saigon and show how real Vietnamese people live. Very informative!

The best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh. Safe, fun and informative. - I was very nervous to take my teenagers on a motorbike in Saigon. I had been told by friends to try the tour and wasn't disappointed. The female tour guides made us feel so safe and they were extremely friendly and great fun to be with. We laughed, sang and ate the most amazing food with them. We felt so safe (I can't believe I am saying that) but somehow the chaotic traffic made sense when we were part of it. The food was delicious and we ate things we wouldn't have tried if left to our own devices. There was such a variety of delicious food. I would not hesitate to use XO again next time we are in Saigon. Thank you to Phu, Yun, Yu and I am sorry but cannot remember the other guides name. Lovely drivers with great English and full of information.

XO-tour with Diêm and Thao - We had an awesome tour with these two :) we had the daily sights tour. we were picked up from where we lived and they explained where we were going and that it was a male guide Who would give us info about the sights. We had so much fun on the bikes, they were really Good drivers. They also spoke english really well and answered all of our questions with a smile! Would definitely do this again :) the sights guide (tour leader) Anh Pham was okay in english and told us a lot of interesting stories. He also took photoes which he sent by email later on:)

Very Fun City Tour on Back of a Scooter. - extremely well run tour. fun and professional. well polished. our drivers spoke English well enough, were very good drivers and lots of fun.

This was a great tour. Each guest had their own driver (all women), and we sat on the back as our drivers navigated the crazy traffic in Saigon. It was very fun and a bit hectic. we saw many areas that we wouldn't have gone to had we not joined this tour. We had five stops. Three stops at restaurants that all had interesting food.

We had two stops where our head tour guide spoke with us about the local people and how many Koreans are driving up property values. It was interesting, but a bit preachy.

We drove our bikes through a night market in china town, where vendors had tarps on the ground with their food/wares/hunks of meat all sitting on tarps. their was barely enough room to get our bikes between the tarps, but it was great.

we also drove down one of the popular shopping streets where all the locals shop. there was some crazy shops there. A Santa shop (all things Santa), a Hello Kitty shop and lot of bright flashing lights everywhere. It would have been fun to stop and check out some shops, but driving through was great too.

Must do when you visit Saigon - I would recommend doing at least one XO Tour during your time in Saigon. There's tour options for everyone including a foodie tour and a shopping tour.

We did the foodie tour and were blown away at how involved it was. We were definitely the oldest ones there with the tour mostly appealing to younger persons. This didn't stop us from enjoying the Bun Bo Hue or any other dishes. On our night we tasted around 15 dishes including deserts. The dishes include goat, beef, frog, duck embryo, crab, clams and more. The desserts were lacking but the constant flow of beer made up for that!

Your experience may be improved by your tour guide however. I had an excellent fluent English speaking guide who was engaging and informativewhile driving through the local areas. My travel partners guide not so much but we still both had a great time.

I'll definitely be doing another XO tour when I return.

The Highlight of Our HCM Visit - We did the nighttime scooter tour and saw parts of HCM we would not have otherwise. Really fun time with several stops along the way, where the main tour guide will give us a history of the area. Stopped a couple of times for food and dessert. The girls on the scooters were very nice and great at handling the motorbikes.

See and taste Saigon on the back of a motorbike! - We had the best time on the motorbike food tour. As we were only in Saigon for 24 hours at the end of a 10 day visit to Vietnam, this was the PERFECT way to see the city and taste local food. Our tour guides Ngoc and Trang were amazing as well, super friendly and very knowledgeable. The food was delicious and all at local places we probably would have gone to ourselves. This is a must-do when visiting Saigon!

Great way to see Saigon/Ho Chi Minh - We went on the Sights tour with Xo tours. The women drive excellently, and their knowledge of the city is great. It is also a guide following the group informing us on speciall places we stop. All of the team speaks very well English. Can highly recommend this!

An exhilarating ride and incredible food all in one! - Absolute highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh City. Our riders were a delight and provided really interesting historical and cultural context as we made our way through one amazing dish after another. The rides in between stops were great fun and all of a sudden the traffic made sense once you were a part of it.
Cannot recommend highly enough!

Best thing I've done while traveling - xo tours was the best experience I have had traveling over the last month. If you go to saigon you must do this tour - it was extremely organized, professional and fun! Our host, Mr. Sang was very knowledgeable about the different parts of Saigon, including its history, and each distinct areas food specialty. Also, our drivers, Ms. Yueng and Ms. Notch were very safe and experienced. This allows us to sit back and enjoy the events.

I would highly recommend this to anyone interested in traveling to saigon.

Immerse yourself in all that is Saigon - One of the best tours I have ever been on!

Even though marketed as a Foodies' Tour, it was so much more than that! The food itself was good but nothing much to shout about.

What truly won me and my family over, was the experience of navigating through the chaotic traffic the true Vietnamese way - on bikes, eating at places where the locals hang out, and interacting with our guide and drivers. The whole experience lets you learn about the local culture, way of life and really get into the heart of Saigon.

Would definitely recommend this tour!

Awesome Foodie Tour on the back of a scooter :) - The XO Foodie tour was amazing. After the first few minutes on the scooter we started to relax and really enjoy the city. Far easier on the back of the scooter than walking. We visited area's that we would never have gone to on our own and really enjoyed the experience. Tai, Quin & Tim Tam did a awesome job, very informative and felt very safe. Tried different foods, some we will defiantly eat in the future :) Would highly recommend any of the XO tours and we will definitely be booking again when we go back to Vietnam - we might even bring the kids next time :)

Excellent guides, felt very safe and saw lots of Saigon - Had a great time on this tour on our first night in Ho Chi Minh (24th of June). We went on the foodie tour (3 different places to eat, with alternatives offered for our party members who didn't eat seafood) and enjoyed it immensely. Our tour leader Tuong and each of the ladies were fantastic. They were very informative and friendly, and spoke perfect English.

The food was delicious, if a bit adventurous for us - including duck embryos, frog legs and lots of clams and scallops. But if you're not keen, just say no and they aren't too pushy. Beef, chicken and crab options is also on offer if you're not keen on frog.

We also felt surprisingly safe on the mopeds (considering the overwhelming difference between Western and Vietnamese road rules). It poured rain for about an hour on our tour, but we were given rain ponchos and the ladies stopped for a bit when it got too heavy. The rain didn't really detract from the experience - it was lots of fun.

Brilliant Guides! - We made 5 stops in total, three of which were for food, and by golly there was a lot of food involved! Some very weird things such a duck embryo and other more usual like pho. The food itself wasn’t anything to write home about, maybe just the variety and weirdness, but the best thing about the tour were the other people on it, together with all the effort our tour guides made. Our bike companions (you do not ride the bike yourselves) were brilliant, chatty and full of entertaining stories. We got to learn a lot about local life in Saigon from renting houses to dating life, all of which made this tour memorable and so very different to others we had experienced.

Best. Foodie. (And City). Tour. Ever. - As a family, we are not much into organized tours, but this one (the Foodie Tour) sounded intriguing. And we were not disappointed.
Our drivers Tam1, Tam2, Dieu and Vy4, picked us up from the hotel. I'd not told the fam what the tour was about so the surprised delight on their faces was great as we hopped onto the back of the bikes and took off into the organized mayhem that is HCMC traffic.
Our tour leader, Tuan popped up at each stop with fun facts about each district and the food we were about to eat.
The next few hours were enormous fun. Traveled to 5 local districts, ate fabulous local food, drank beer and had a hilarious time with the girls.
Can't rave enough about them, tbh. They were warm, funny and informative - even my shy 15 yo chattered away all night.
I had total confidence in the girls' ability to negotiate the traffic and to be in the thickness of it was amazing fun.
If you do one tour in HCMC - this is the one.

The drive of your life on a moped - Well we set off on a Saturday night in the middle of rush hour. Well it's rush hour all the time in Saigon. Grip the bars tightly and away you go.nit rain and poured but that added to the fun. The food amazing, the girls who drive the moped are great craic even if they speed through the traffic. Forget the fear and just do it

So much fun! - Our party of 7 decided to do the Saigon Tour with XO Tours. They range in age from 7 years to 50 years. We were so pleased we chose XO to do our tour with. What a professional organization! Everything was done efficiently right from initial contact. The team that took us on our tour were just brilliant with leads, scouts etc all in place ensuring our safety. The whole team took the time to explain things to us, chat and ensure that all ages were catered for. The Saigon tour took us through quite a few districts and from the back of a scooter, you really get the vibe of the area. We could not recommend this tour company more highly. Well done to the team at XO!

A Foodie's Delight! - If you only do one thing in HCMC, do this tour. Fantastic fun from beginning to end. Great food, amazing to be on a bike and see things that would take days to cover - all while getting local wisdom from the guides as you scoot around. The drivers are so terrific - funny, knowledgable and most important, very in control of the motor bikes. We knew friends who had done this tour so knew it would be good based on their recommendations but it was even better than we hoped though so do yourselves a favor and sign up. Absolutely amazing.

Overall city tour - This group of people were so professional and accommodating. The driver was very knowledgeable as well as the tour guide. They had a great sense of humor and made the tour very relaxing and comfortable. Anyone wanting to find something to do for your first visit MUST book st least one of these tours. I did the overall tour and loved all of the historic and current spots of the city. Thank you all so much for making my trip memorable! ❤️

Motorbike tour with kids - I really wanted to take this tour after reading the reviews online but was discouraged to do it with kids. What if they fell off? After all, in the US, a kid on a motorbike would be unacceptable. We took the chance and I am so glad we did!! This was one of my favorite tours in a month-long trip to SE Asia. Being on the motorbike in Saigon traffic was exhilarating! The drivers were delightful and our tour guide was excellent! Perfect english and I loved that he used photos on his ipad to explain the history of what we were seeing. They also provided local snacks and beverages, which was a learning experience too. Highly recommend this tour!

Night food tour - We did this and was amazing. You get picked up from your hotel by girls in traditional dress then spend the night going around in a group of the back of the scooters. Was amazing to taste and try different things that you wouldn't do without the help of locals. They all spoke great English and explained things along the way

The best experience for your first night in HCMC - This tour (foodie) is the best way of an introduction to the caos of HCMC. I wish we did it the first night of the first time we traveled to this beautiful country.
Not only are the bike guides fantastic (thanks Linh and Quusing - my apologies if I've spelled your name wrong) funny and informative, their bike skills are amazing (I've never felt safer on the back of a bike in such intense traffic).
The tour leader Sang and the girls give you all the tips you will need to navigate the food, markets and roads of Vietnam.
A must do for any newby before doing anything else in Vietnam and an experience for seasoned VN travelers that will make you wonder why you haven't done it before.
An awesome experience.

Loved it! - Went on the night tour and loved it! Was mighty nervous about riding on the scooter at first, but got used to it after a while. And it was great fun to experience actually riding on the roads among all the scooters. The only thing that got in the way was the weather - it was raining throughout the whole night so we couldn't really enjoy the tour fully.

How can you beat perfection? - Did we love it? YES! Did we have momentary thoughts of "what the hell are we doing? YES! Would we do it again?? ABSOLUTELY!!!!

After reading all of the reviews here, our expectations were quite high and it's safe to say they exceeded those expectations without a doubt!

So attentive, safe, and absolutely fantastic with the kids! (6&8) It was pouring rain, and the feeling of driving along their highways with the rain splashing on your face and the city lights was an insane but a memorable experience!

The food took us out of our comfort zones with the staff! My son even tried frog!

Our daughter came down with a high temp nearing the end of our tour and the concern and care they had for her was phenomenal.

Amazing

!

Fun Day Zipping Around Ho Chi Minh - This group is very well organized and full of energy. Very flexible to meet your tour desires and schedule. We touched and tasted many things on the back streets of the city that we would not have experienced otherwise.

Not to be missed! - What an exceptional tour. The girls were so lovely and great drivers. My 10 & 8 year old boys loved the motorbike experience and there was plenty of food for them to eat. The food was the best I've tasted.

Best way to see, experience and enjoy the city! - We requested a Custom Tour so we could get a little market time, a sampling of local fare, a snapshot of city history, and a real HCM City experience. XO Tours delivered beyond our expectations. We are two couples in our late forties and early fifties and three days later we are still all raving about the fun memories we created together on this adventure. I cannot say enough good things about the experience--from the booking, to the pre-communication, to the tour itself.

Tai, the tour master, showed perfect hospitality, concerned for our comfort/safety and knowledge of his city--all with a charming sense of humor. Our four drivers wowed us with their skill and charm.

On behalf of all four of us in the group, we highly recommend this experience and this company. We will be scheduling the other tours next time we are in Saigon.

A Must do tour for a HCM city trip - My daughter and i did this tour with Tai and the girls. We had a fantastic 3.5 hours on a shopping spree (basically just happy to see the sights) We both felt so safe on the bikes and were so well looked after.

Thanks XO for a fabulous tour.

Another great XO Tour - My second XO Tour in HCM, a couple of new locations in this tour compare to the first tour two years ago.
Great ladies on the bike and great tour leader guide. Thanks for another great experience.

The best food tour I have ever done! - We did the night food tour by motorbike and it is the best food tour we have ever done! Riding the bike was so much fun and the girls and tour guides made it such an enjoyable experience. I was a little nervous about the bikes but felt so safe all the time. Everything about the tour was really professional, booking the tour was easy and they showed up right on time. The absolute best part about the tour though was the food! The food was nothing short of phenomenal and there was so much of it! I don't eat red meat and they accommodated me easily. There were only a small number of things I couldn't eat and they had substitutions for me for every one of them. I'm not sure if I would spend much time in HCMC on a return trip to Vietnam but I would at the very least spend half a day so I could do a food tour with XO Tours again. It's well worth the price.

Great fun - We did the half day morning scooter tour and boy was it a fun thing to do! Interesting and informative stop offs along the way to teach you some of Vietnams history. It was brilliant fun to be whizzing around through the chaos of Vietnams traffic but even if you are nervous don't worry the girls will take great care of you. Very friendly staff and a relatively inexpensive thing to do. Groups are kept small, it is safe and highly recommended.

Motorbike Tour - Great choice of tours. Very safe, delightful young women drivers and the tour guide spoke excellent English and knew the city well.
Highly recommend.

Fun night city tour - We had an amazingly fun time on the back of a motorbike with these guys. Did the Saigon by night tour which took us all over the city to places we never would have seen otherwise. We feel like we got a really good feel for the whole city from this, not just the tourist areas. Our guides were lovely and helpful. This is one of the more expensive tours you can do but we felt really safe with their experienced guides, insurance etc. Dinner was tasty and the riding was exhilarating!

XO Tours are the BEST! - I can't speak highly enough of just how amazing this tour was. All the drivers were super friendly, organised and accommodating. They were on time, always around to help answer questions and we got some good and beverages included which was nice. They took us to many local places that we wouldn't otherwise have gone to see which was very enjoyable and made this an even more memorable experience. We had a tour lead and a gentleman assigned as security guard who joined us for the day. I'd highly recommend any of their tours, they made sure we were all together and safe, smiling and enjoying the tour!

Full day Mekon River Tour - We had a wonderful Private day touring the Mekon and Delta rivers. Started out with a hotel pick up in a late model SUV for a comfortable 2 hour drive to the Mekon. We then boarded the Mekon Queen a very large boat which was set up just for two. It had fllor beds if we want to use and a large seat out the back. The hostess cut up fruit and gave us tea as we motored out down the river. She was wonderfull alway gave us a hand to get on anf off the boat, had cool towels for us and coldwater. We boarded a small boat called a sanpan. Then we were paddled down th he small canals. We then msde a stop where they made coconut candy and rice cakes before going to have a very nice Vietnamese lunch. All yhis for just two people. Thank you for such a memorable day.

Fabulous Tour - This is the second time we took a guided food tour on a bike. The first tour we had was with a different company and it was during our first time in Vietnam. That tour shows us the list of food that is famous in Vietnam. So it is good for an info start up.

XO Tour is a different ball game altogether. They did bring us for food too ... but it is something that is more local. For example, instead of bringing us to a place for a bowl of pho, they introduced us to a bowl of bun bo hue (it is mt family's favorite now!). Instead of bringing us to a hip and trendy bar, they showed us "mini Singapore" and a walk around Chinatown. Instead of just giving us "regular touristy" food, they gave us an opportunity to eat Vietnamese version of "balut".

At the end of the tour they also give you a small booklet of "survival guide in Vietnam" and it also contains the list of suggested foods to try and where to have them. The icing of the cake was, the tour guide actually gave us his name card and encouraged us to text or call him if we need anything even after the tour has ended.

The next day we decided to give another place for Bun Bo Hue as suggested by him. Since we did not understand the menu we actually took a picture of it and sent it to him through whatsapp for explanation. He was being helpful to guide us to order even when he was not with us in the restaurant! Talk about first class service!!!

Great tour, highly recommended - I booked the Saigon Day Tour with XO Tours 2 days prior to the tour date and received a prompt response via email.

Transportation arrived at the hotel right on time - after a brief bike safety review, we were on our way. Smooth, safe and fun ride around the city. The stops in my route were:

Notre Dame Cathedral, Post Office, Reunification Palace, Monk statue, a local market, the flower market, Chinatown and ended the tour at a temple within Chinatown. Also had cool dessert (very good!) and drinks/fruits from the local market.

I think the real highlights of this tour for me were my fun driver and the informative guide. My driver Tam was very funny and clever. Made the ride extremely fun and enjoyable. Thun (spelling?) was a very informative and entertaining guide as well. I usually don't pay too much attention to this kind of stuff but I was captivated by the interesting history and culture at each location.

Highly recommend this service. I know they also have a night and foodie tour - I'm bad at planning in advance so next time I'm in Vietnam I intend to use their service again.

Saigon is really great city to be seen on motorbike .. go for it you won't regret it :). Thank you XO Tours for a wonderful experience!

Great foodie trip, very knowledgeable staff on food and History of HCMC - Very enjoyable tour. Value. Huge range of local foods - food I would not of found myself. Also a side bonus the tour had lots of information on HCMC & Vietnam in general. Very happy.

Best of Ho Chi Minh - WOW! This tour was incredible. The food was delicious, the drivers were hilarious, and the bikes were exhilarating! You might be thinking that it is a little awkward to sit on the back of a motor bike with some stranger. Think again! These women are so fun and quirky. They loved answering our questions and going around with us. I felt like I had a great new crew of friends after the tour. They take you all around the city, so food aside, it is a great way to explore and learn about Ho Chi Minh. Absolutely loved the tour. Thinks XO tours for showing us the best time!

An absolute must in Saigon! The BEST introduction to Vietnam! - I booked this tour for myself, my sister and our parents for our first night in Vietnam. We were all a little hesitant of hopping on the backs of motorbikes in Saigon given the crazy traffic and also as it had been raining, but the XO Tours team quickly put our minds at ease as we took off to our first destination. All of the girls were so incredibly friendly, as was our tour guide Khoi who met us at each stop. We actually spent a lot more time on the bikes than we were expecting but this was great as we got to explore so many different districts of Saigon and really get a feel for the city. We enjoyed a wide range of food - soup, grilled meats, seafood and there were a couple more interesting choices made available for us to try. I highly recommend that anyone traveling to Saigon participates in this tour, I promise you'll love it!

You only live once - We weren't sure about doing this foodie tour. My wife was very nervous about being on a moped in HCMC and it was a little more expensive than we would normally pay. At the end after reading the reviews we decided "You only live once, let's do it!" Thankfully we made the right decision, it was amazing, a real lifetime experience and it's worth every penny. The XO ladies were great fun, knowledgeable and a pleasure to spend time with. My wife's nerves were soon forgotten as we weaved through the organized chaos of the Saigon streets. These memories will last forever. Thanks guys! Highly recommended.

What an experience!! Must do in Ho Chi Minh. - Must do if in Ho Chi Minh! This was great! The Foodie tour at night was worth every penny. The tour includes a food tour of three local restaurants (fantastic food at places we will never go too) and also a sight seeing tour of 5 different districts.
My driver, Thuy and my wife's driver Na, were fantastic. Our friends had Thanh and Xuyen. They were so pleasant and nice to us, great driving skills, spoke perfect English, good cooks and great fun.
Always felt safe in the mad traffic of the city.
We booked the day before, which I was worried about but had no trouble.

The most amazing tour I've been on - Having never been on a motorcycle I had concerns about going on a foodie motorbike tour by night. Especially after witnessing the crazy traffic during the day . Th organisation by this company was second to none. The drivers were bang on time, reassuring & careful. It poured with rain but ponchos were provided & care was taken to make sure my helmet fitted every time I got back on the bike.The head guide was funny intelligent & clear in his observations on the issues Ho Chi Minh's rapid urbanisation is causing.The girls riding the bikes also prepared the food for us in locations one would never go as a tourist.spoke excellent English & conversed easily about the food to expect at our next stop. Charming minders also kept a watchful eye on the party to make sure nobody came to harm. A fantastic way to spend an evening. An absolute must.

Highlight of our Vietnam holiday - This the third time we've holidayed in HCMC so we were looking for something different to do. It was suggested by one of our group to do the Night Foodie XO Tour but the females being scaredy cats said no! But after looking at the excellent Trip Advisor reviews it was obvious we had to give it a go! And lucky we did. It is the only way to really experience HCMC and see places in districts we would never think of going to! The girls in traditional attire on scooters picked us up at our hotel and after a quick run down on being on a bike we were off through the crazy traffic but they are very careful drivers so we never felt unsafe. Their English is great and they are very attentive to your every need. There are culture stops in between food stops but pace yourself there is more than enough food! This tour is definitely a must don't think about it book now!

Best tour ever!! - By far the best tour we have ever done!

Not only was it an amazing food experience, we were able to see amazing areas of Saigon while our beautiful guides narrated for us!

Such great food off the beaten track, we ate local cuisine in local spots with the locals.

I highly recommend this tour to experience the best food and cultural experience Saigon has to offer!! A+

THE way to seee HCMC - HCMC is a lot to take in. It's hectic, crowded, huge and FILLED to the brim with motorbikes and amazing food. Why not combine the best of all these things into an incredible tour??! When traveling, I do not typically pay a lot of money for tours or guides and do not typically pre-plan much of anything, preferring to explore and see what I find. With XO Tour's "Foodie" tour, I went completely off-script and pre-planned a tour that was pricier than things I usually do on vacation. What a FANTASTIC decision. My entire family (3 in our 20s and 2 in our 60s) LOVED this tour - both for what we learned about HCMC and Vietnam from our guides, the thrill of traveling through HCMC at night on bikes and the ridiculous and amazing cuisine that we sampled throughout. If your travels take you through HCMC, this tour is a MUST!

Foodie Tour - A must do in Saigon! - We heard about XO Tours while on a Ha Long Bay cruise from some Ozzies. We were able to book a Foodie Tour only one day in advance. This audible ended up being one of the trip highlights - wish they had it in all the cities we visited. The girls all spoke English well and really made sure you had a great time. The food was amazing and the experience of driving a motorbike through crowded Saigon streets is unforgettable. There's no other way to experience real Saigon and be completely catered to. You'll have security guys in the background to ensure you're completely safe (more so to help in traffic). XO also takes photos throughout the tour and emails them to you a couple of days later. Highly recommend!

Excellent tour guides - Booking our 1st trip to Vietnam my wife and I wanted to get a flavor of the country so booked tours before departure through Trail Finders in Richmond upon Thames. Their local agents were XO tours. Efficiency seemed to be their watchword from airport meet & greet to transfers and private tours in a modern 4x4. When arriving at tour sites it felt very special not being part of a 'herd' off a tour bus. We also accessed the attractions quicker and seemed to bypass the big groups. Having a private, knowledgeable guide and safe efficient driver made the enjoyment of the trip days all the more rewarding. This ensures that we could also inject a modicum of flexibility in the day and some venues visited. If the tour was running ahead of time the guide would always suggest another venue not included in the standard package, at no extra cost and without prompting. Couldn't fault this company and highly recommend them.

Foodie Tour and Sights Tour - Together with our 3 teenagers, we enjoyed the 2 tours very much. XO tour head guides and scooter driver/guides were very informative and fun. They showed us the real Vietnam- not only the tourist spots. There were 2 support bodyguards who made us feel safe throughout the tours.

The best tour agency we have encountered in Ho Chi Minh!

Highly recommended tours around HCMC - All staff were helpful and knowledgeable, attentive and experienced. They all speak English well and wanted to make sure you have a good time. Also a good experience to get driving around in the chaotically organized HCMC. I would suggest an empty and VERY hungry appetite for the foodie tour.

Unforgettable experience - This food tour with a difference was an unforgettable experience. I was a bit apprehensive about going onto the streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter but the ladies are experienced and i was soon relaxed and enjoying the experience. We experienced a wide range of Local food that was washed down with cold beer in what could be described as a progressive dinner . Our group of 5 had a lot of fun and we would never have tried some of food by ourselves. The photos that were emailed to me are a great memory of my XO Tours food tour of Saigon

Eat your way around the city - This is an amazing way to see different parts of HCMC. The drivers on the motorbikes were very informative, and made the experience fun for everyone. We took the foodie tour, which brought us through districts 1,54,5,6,7,8 (not in that order). Even with the crazy traffic, we were perfectly safe.

I have lived in HCMC for 3 years and I was introduced to foods I have never had before. It was great to go to different local places. The girls explained what we were eating and which sauce to use. They also accommodated my food allergies, bringing me specially prepared dishes. At the final stop, they arranged for a taxi to take us back to my residence, instead of returning to District 1 first, since we were in a neighboring district to where I live.

AMAZING and worth the price!

A MUST DO when in Saigon - This was definitely an experience that will stay with our group for years to come, the highlight of our whole Vietnam trip.

The tour was well organised, staff were so much fun, and food was amazing.

This tour wasn't only about the food, it showed us corners of the city that we would never have found ourselves, taught us about it's history and current climate and best of all we got to experience it all off the back of scooters.

Well done girls (and guys), you deserve all the perfect ratings you get. Shout-out to Ngoc and Sang xo
Chicks on bikes - Excellent tour would highly recommend , I felt very safe and the girls are informative and fun . We used the company twice and both times we not disappointed .

Vietnam highlight! - This tour was the absolute highlight of our stay in HCMC! A fun, bubbling, degustation of a trip through the many districts of this amazing city on the back of an expertly driven scooter. With the warm evening breeze brushing your face and the exotic aromas of the passing road-side kitchens greeting you as you ride by, this is truly a delight for the senses and that's even before you start sampling the tasty array of food that is presented at the many stops along the journey. The food ranged from BBQ'd goat to duck embryo (yes!) with plenty in between and all were a taste sensation. Our scooter drivers were a delight and never let us feel in any danger on the back of their scooters despite the insane traffic that winds its way around you disregarding each and every road rule known to man. Our host who magically appeared ahead of us from one location to the next was funny, polite and extremely informative taking many pictures that were later emailed to us as a reminder of this extremely fun night! Don't go to HCMC and miss this tour!

Awesome foodie tour - I was a bit nervous to be doing this but a friend had heard good things about it, it turned out to be amazing I loved being on the back of the bike in the middle of the chaos the girls made us feel at ease from the minute we met them my driver yen was funny and caring and the food experience was great we were so full by the end it was lovely to see the city at night and we definitely got to see parts of Ho Chi Minh that we wouldn't have seen on our own thanks tours xo

Xo Foodie Tour - If you are in Ho Chi Minh you must do a foodie tour. We have done several of them and it is a great way to discover ho chi at night. The food is great and the girls and tour guide fantastic. Just don't eat too much during the day as you will be so full by the end of it. It's an experience you will truly enjoy and won't forget. A must

a delectable night with xo foodie tour, good food, best drivers, safe with all the men in black and more fun games in - I would recommend this tour on your first day in Saigon, one of the best. Xo will show you the bird's eye view of the whole city. I assure you, the tour is fun, the food is worth trying, beers are great, you'll meet other people and have a chance to exchange words with them and the drivers are all experts therefore those who are afraid to ride a motorbike, worry not because the girls can handle everything. To Tai and the girls and to all the men in black who made us feel secured the entire tour, thank you. You made our saigon tour a memorable one. A must try tour in Saigon whether you are a solo traveler, couple, with friends, or a big group.

John

Best thing we did...nights of Saigon - What fun! I had high expectations and they were met. Our drivers were there early and ready to go. They were more than amazing, their confidence and expertise had us at ease from the moment we left the sidewalk! A great tour of a huge city, with so many different districts (areas) to see. A great supper and desserts...really good. The drivers spoke excellent English and chatted with us the whole time.
What a great night, thanks XO tours!

My favorite experience in Vietnam! - This tour was an amazing experience and the best part of my Vietnam trip. Along with all of the food provided, we were given history of different parts of the city along with exploration of several districts. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who is looking to be immersed in the Vietnamese culture as this was an amazing experience!

Fantastic introduction to the city! - What an amazing tour! My travel partner and I did the Saigon by Night tour on our first night in Vietnam. What an intro! It was so exhilarating to ride around on the back of the scooter first during rush hour and then in the night hours. The food was good, the information about the city was great. We managed to feel both a thrill and completely safe at the same time. Definitely a must do in HCMC.

Just what we needed! - Yen was brilliant and as I walk around I am using her little pieces of advice. Just loved the opportunity to see more of Saigon than just the hotel area......and bike was the way. Great fun.

Best food tour in Ho Chi Minh - My husband and I had a great time on this tour in Ho Chi Minh. We were driving around the city to various food spots on the back of a scooter (it was very safe). A fantastic way to see to get out of district 1 and see other parts of the city. The food was excellent, particularly the last stop in district 4 where we had some delicious seafood. We had great fun with the tour guides and the rest of the people on the tour. Suitable for all ages!

Still buzzing!! - Saigon is a buzz anyway with all the traffic, food, strange currency for most of us and 10 million people. If you want to take it a notch higher you MUST do this. If you are a little older (in my 50s) you aren't going to ride a scooter round the place. So why not get an articulate, smart female in her 20s, beautifully dressed in an Ao Dai to drive the thing for you, negotiating the crazy traffic. Of course, you must do it at night to catch rush hour, the lights and sample the food as part of the foodie tour. If you think HCMC starts and finishes in District 1, this tour takes you everywhere - it is a serious 4.5hour trip through HCMC stopping off for a bit of history, culture and most of all food outlets you will never find. Absolutely one of the best urban tourist experiences ever anywhere. Its so Saigon.

Saigon by night - Awesome! I've been to HCM City a few times - this motorcycle tour took me to districts I had never seen, contrasting the various areas, such as Chinatown with the modern District 7. All the cycle drivers are women - great drivers, good English and fun. Tour leader -terrific!

XO Foodie Bike Tour- best thing ever! - I booked my son and I on the XO Foodie Bike Tour at the end of our 15-day Vietnam Trip based on a friend's recommendation. We were impressed with XO's professionalism from the booking time to the actual bike ride around HCM. Never having ridden a motorbike before, on top of navigating the crazy traffic of HCM, I was absolutely petrified!! but the capable XO girl drivers, the funny briefings of Tour Manager Tai, the presence of the XO men-in-black bodyguards and the friendly bantering of the 20-other International Foodies in my group soon had me laughing away my fright. We made several stops and learned about Districts history, cultural insights and the Vietnamese daily life. The eat-all-you can food was simply divine! The groupall agreed it was a fantastic night- some did not want the night to end! Lucky I took up the offer of the XO video- it reminds me that I happily survived the bike ride and it was simply the best thing ever!

Go XO! - Did the City Sights tour with Sang as our tour leader. Although I have visited HCMC before, Sang supplied information that I had never heard before. The ladies are excellent drivers and provide a fun element to the tour. Everything you read about XO tours is spot-on. Highly recommended- even for older, seasoned travelers!

XO Tours - The foodie tour - The best food tour I've experienced yet! Great tour guides, amazing food and the best moped experience ever. This is a must try if you are ever in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. A visit to there and not having experienced the foodie is a crime. Keep up the amazing working people, I will be back for more

Stop thinking about it and book this now! - You've read the other reviews - just here to say it lives up the hype and anyone even thinking about this tour should just go ahead and book. And do it at the beginning of your visit to Ho Chi Minh!

Bike tour Saigon - Having visited HCMC a number of times already we were looking for something a bit different and 'off the usual tourist track' and we found it with XO tours.
We loved the 'Saigon By Night' tour a lot.
I am not confident on a scooter but my lovely driver soon made me feel comfortable and confident. She had excellent English and was great to talk to. Our tour took in 4 contrasting districts of HCMC not normally visited by tour groups. We also got to try some delicious street food and drinks.
A very professional outfit which I highly recommend.

A must-do tour! - I highly recommend this company. We did only the sight seeing tour but I'm sure the others are great as well. It was absolutely thrilling for our kids (and us!) to experience, first hand, the traffic movement in the city. The sightseeing tour was informative as well. They hit a lot of highlights. I had wished we could have walked through the flower market a bit but we got a lot in. They also provide some extra touches like cold drinks midway through and fresh fruit at the end. Our guides were delightful and the staff was very accommodating to a change in schedule that we had. We had a fantastic experience. Don't miss this tour!

If you have kids with you they will love this!! - This was the first of our tours in HCM and it was just amazing!!! The ladies that drove us around were great, very friendly and spoke English really well. We were with our two children ages 6 and 3 and they were just fantastic with them. The kids loved the bikes and didn't want the night to end.
