We went to so many great places we would never have gone to on our own, covered a fair few districts with interesting stops to chat and eat along the way! I'm pretty squeamish but tried the jumping chicken, goat and the duck embryo..it was all delicious. The kids tried most things but even had chicken nuggets and fries and ice cream brought out to them, they loved it. Such kind thoughtful people. Great night. Great company. Great food. Thank you XO tours

Friendly, well organized, adventurous, highly recommend - I visited Ho Chi Minh for 4 weeks. A street food tour was a must. Googled street food tours and found XO. Like the back story of the founder. The XO team was super friendly and fun. I went solo and met others from around the globe on the tour. The food was varied and included the option of trying a duck embryo. Very well organized. One of my favorite Vietnam experiences.

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh - 100% recommend to anybody visiting Ho Chi Minh. For $75 each you see the real Ho Chi Minh and not just the touristy bits all of the guide books talk about. I have Coeliac and found it extremely hard to eat here in Vietnam. The XO tour took care of any dietary requests I had and made sure none of my food was contaminated. The girls were amazing and spoke perfect English and the group we were with were great fun. The group consisted of all different types of people from all over the world, children, couples, old and young travellers and the tour catered to all. The food was also incredible. It may be a little more expensive that some other activities here in Ho Chi Minh but this is 100% worth every penny. The tour guide Hieu the tour guide leader gave some interesting talks about Ho Chi Minh life and history, that we didn't know before and was lovely.

A most do whilst in HCMC - We had limited time in HCMC, so it was important that we used that time productively. I chose XO Tours due to the positive reviews on TA. The experience was truly amazing. They covered a few districts, gave some background information on local history and allowed us to sample local cuisine. The guides were great with both my girls (8 & 10) and made me feel at ease with them riding solo. HCM traffic is crazy to navigate and the team made me feel safe and I wouldn't hesitate in recommending them; particularly if travelling with young children.

An amazing cultural foodie tour! - If you want a fun night which allows you the best with regards to Vietnamese food, an insider`s view of the various districts of Saigon with great guides who are excellent motorbike drivers, don`t miss out!!!

2nd tour - This was our second tour and delivered another amazing time. This one was the night tour and we took our 5 year old son who loved it. The food is interesting and the girls who take you are excellent bike riders. Must do tour. Thanks again for a great night out.

Great day - I had a late reservation and called in so no issues there. I did it have to pay for anything until after the entire tour was over. My driver was very engaging and informative. She maintains an intriguing conversation the entire tour even telling me things as we passed. In short this is a great tour to start your trip off seeing the city. We stopped by some great places and told the history of each one. Great tour

So much fun, a real highlight XO Foodie Tour - Do not miss this experience. From the tour guide, security/photographer boys to the lovely little lady riders this is a quality evening out. As you zip in and out of the traffic on the back of your bike, you feel like a true local. My husband described his lady rider as a female Evil Knieval (much to her delight once he explained what that meant). This tour takes you to many different Saigon districts, each slightly different from the other. I am still amazed at how these ladies know their way around. And the food.....so much.....so delicious. The trouble is trying to pace yourself. Try everything on offer - it is all really good, and I ate foods that I would not normally have tried. The barbecue was good and something different to a normal restaurant. Great photos were emailed to us a couple of days later. I would recommend doing this trip early in your Vietnam holiday as you will find that your dining experience will be greatly expanded during your stay. Thank you for such a great time.

Best of HCMC! - Wow, what an amazing experience! My partner and I did The Foodie tour and it was without doubt one of the highlights of our visit to Vietnam.

The tour guides are heaps of fun and very knowledgable. We not only got a great snapshot of some delicious Southern cuisine, but also discovered a lot about life in Ho Chi Minh which I thought was a really thoughtful and important addition to the tour.

This tour is a must-do! Make sure you order the Balut!

Extraordinary wonderful and brilliant - If I could give XO Tours 10 Stars+ I would do so in a heartbeat. This tour should be mandatory for ALL visitors to Saigon! We arrived in Saigon from Hong Kong and on our way to our hotel we were literally blown away by the number of motor bikes, scooters, mopeds on the roads; talk about a culture shock! Total organised and utter chaos, yet everything just seemed to flow so very well!
NOTHING would have got us into that mayhem. (Even more so in a tropical downpour!) The very next evening at 17.30 sharp, two very beautiful girls in traditional dress arrived in a downpour; Tranh3 was Helen's driver and mine was the lovely Thanh (please excuse me if I have spelt your names wrong...not easy for an old Western Capetonian) On with the ponchos and helmets and into that glorious downtown Saigon chaos! No words...simply awesome...felt perfectly safe and suddenly we had blended into Saigon, we became one with the city. We met up at the first restaurant with the other gorgeous Australian members of this travelling partaaay! Like minded lovely people. Suffice to say..it all took off from there.It was a different course in three different wonderful wonderful wonderful eateries plus two stops for some cultural knowledge with Khoi an amazing articulate tour leader...all the girls spoke beautiful English and were far more educated than I'll ever be...these are VERY special people.
Magnificent authentic food in every place we had among everything else...blue crab, prawns (shrimp over here) goat, frog, the scallops were to die for (and it just kept coming in lashings! ) beef, chicken...oh so very lekker!
Could go on and on but won't....we've been travelling around the world for many years....honestly this experience will never be forgotten....thank you so very much XO Tours ☺

Wonderful way to explore the city and eat....and drink. - Highly recommended. The people are extremely professional and speak excellent english. food is also great. Queyn was my guide and was brilliant.

What An Experience - By far the best tour we had in Vietnam. Might be my best tour ever in any country.
I was not excited about going on a scooter tour after seeing the traffic in Saigon, however after being on the back of the scooter with My for 5 minutes, I relaxed. It was quite clear she knew the art of riding a scooter in Saigon (and there is an art!).
At our first stop, we were met by Tai, the tour manager. He is very professional, speaks great English, is humorous, personalble, and a class-act. He follows along with his "henchmen" to make sure all are safe and sound. We made a total of 5 stops. Not only is the food great, but Tai and his drivers are all very knowledgeable. We saw parts of Saigon we would not have seen on another tour. I highly recommend this tour. XO Tours is definitely a cut above the rest! Thanks for a great night!

Taste of the real Vietnam - Wonderful nightime foodie tour of Saigon. Scooting through many districts of the city it was great to see beyond District 1 tourist area and explore some different food options I would not normally have been aware of.

The ladies who drove us around were wonderful, knowledgeable and friendly.

Our guide Hieu explains the history of the city and different areas we visited on two of the stops that didn't involve eating.

Lots of fun, highly recommend to anyone.

unworthy - The MOST SENSATIONAL TRIP, enjoyed myself so much. Am a completely scathed cat, never been on a bike in my life, I CANNOT RECOMMEND this highly enough. The girls, the food, the sense of humour, BRILLIANT, This will stand out as a highlight!!!

Saigon highlights by motorbike - We had a fabulous time doing the Saigon highlights tour on our first day in the city! The girls are cool, and very confident and safe bike riders. While the traffic seems crazy, it also seems to work, and it was great to be part of the throng! Tai and the girls were full of information and history which gave us good insight into this amazing place and the resilient and happy people who live here. Highly recommend doing one of XO's tours.... you'll love it!

Worth every $$ - Our family of 6 adults decided this would be a good way to see the city and explore all the wonderful smells and flavors of Vietnam. We did the Foodie Tour back in March 2017 and it was INCREDIBLE. The guides and girls were both super professional but loads of fun. We each got a scooter with a female driver and we got to sit on the back. They took us to many of the Districts and we were blown away by the stark differences across the city. We got to try some delicious foods and also some food that was a little bit different, but all part of the experience.
It was my birthday also so they had organized an amazing cake at our last stop which is as truly special. Definitely recommend XO tours. 10/10 THANK YOU

Such a fun way to explore HCMC - We loved the night tour with XO Tours! It was great to see the city on motorbike - like the locals do. We enjoyed the food and the opportunity to learn about more about HCMC and Vietnamese culture. The guides are very friendly, and even when we happened to run into them two nights later, they were so nice and helped us to find great food.

The best part of our holiday! - Our enails prior to our holiday were answered quickly but when we arrived in Saigon and saw the way scooters whizzed around the streets and how crowded the roads were we were really quite nervous about going on the tour. We needn't have worried, the drivers were very proficient and so friendly. The guy who met us at each stop spoke excellent English and was really informative. I have no hesitation in recommending booking this tour

The highlight of our trip to HCMC - We did the night foodie tour and we had such a great night.

Initially I was a bit worried about joining the bike traffic in the city but the girls are so great I never felt unsafe.

The tour is well set out allowing us to see different areas of HCMC that we wouldn't have seen otherwise.

The food is also something else, so many different things to try and all of it delicious. There is so much food that there is no chance you go home hungry.

Thanks to everyone involved in this tour, we had a blast.

Best thing ever! - Without a doubt this was the best tour we've ever taken, anywhere. We booked the Saigon by Night tour for our first evening in Vietnam. I must admit coming in the taxi from the airport through the apparent chaos of Saigon traffic we wondered if we were mad!

Anyway the time came and our two lovely drivers Vee and Mie arrived (sorry for the spelling girls). They explained what we could expect and how to ride pillion and that was it, off into the Saigon rush hour.
What an adrenaline rush but felt completely safe, these girls are amazing riders and manage to chat throughout.

You're taken through parts of Saigon you'd never find on your own and get fascinating insights into ordinary life there. But it's your drivers who make it special. If you do nothing else in Saigon make sure you do this.

Big thanks! - I had a fantastic night time food tour on my birthday last Sunday with thuy1 and tuong. It was the perfect start to my Vietnam trip and the phrase book has been fantastic in starting a connection/conversation in my travels since on the train and on the street. Thank you so much xx

Lots of fun! - We did the city highlights tour on our recent trip and loved it! The girls all spoke excellent English and our guide was great. Our 2 children (8 and 6) were well looked after, even being taken for an ice cream when they started to look a little bored at one of the sights. At no stage did we feel unsafe while on the bikes - the traffic is manic but somehow it all works!
Our guide took lots of photos on the day which were emailed to us within a couple of days.
A great experience and one I definitely recommend to others! Thanks

Great evening food tour in HCMC! - We done the evening food tour on scooters in HCMC and had a great time! Everyone gelled really well and being on the scooters is great fun. Additionally, you cover a whole range of the city that you otherwise wouldn't see.

You get to try a variety of dishes from the classic to more unusual dishes, and the food is very tasty! Plus there is plenty of it!

All in all, a fabulous experience in HCMC and we would highly recommend it! :)
Great morning ride - A must do got to see some places that you would not find on your own the girls were fantastic and spoke good English really enjoyed it

DO NOT MISS THIS!!!! - I think this tour was one of the best things I've ever done in my traveling life. Me and my partner were blown away with this experience. There is no better way to see HCM in my opinion. We were taken all over the city and visited 5 (I think?) different districts in one night. But what makes this so unique and so special is the dedication to keeping this experience authentic and honest. We weren't told boring novelty facts about the city - we were told about the problems with wealth distribution, we were told how people live, eat, work in Vietnam and we got to taste some of their most frequently enjoyed foods in the locals favorite spots. The girls on this tour are hilarious, charming and well informed and I absolutely loved hanging out with them! Thanks XO!!

Absolutely amazing tour!!! - We took Saigon night tour 4.5hrs duration including a meal and a dessert. Exploring different Districts out of D1. Those girl drivers spoke well English and everyone were so nice. I truly like those uniforms because it's traditional and also bright color so it's easy to recognize them.

It's my best moment I had in Saigon. They make us feel safe even it's crowded with vehicles around because this girls drivers were escorted by male bike rider too, "security escort"..am not sure about front but I was riding last and I saw a male rider wearing XO Tour uniform following behind us making sure we are safe to the next destination. That's a good and caring service.

I want to thank my lovely driver Vi, my friend's driver Quynh and team leader Heiu for the excellent hospitality.

Pushed my boundaries and I had a fab time - I usually book walking tours when I travel but decided to do an evening tour to kick off Easter weekend. From booking through to the end of the night the service was fantastic.

It was my first time on a bike and I did not feel unsafe or scared at all. My scooter driver gave me some guidelines when we started and from there I just held on an enjoying the atmosphere.

Its a progressive dinner, stopping at different places for each course which was great. Service was great throughout and I was never without a drink.

Highly recommend this tour.

Exceeding expectations! - Riding on the motor bike to tour HCM is the way to go. Drivers are knowledgeable, fun, and good motorists. The Tour guide shares up to date information and history about the City, and get to taste local foods. Seeing the true local life-style on the bike was an unexpected experience. I will do this again!

DO THIS TOUR NOW. I'M NOT KIDDING! ALL CAPS MEANS BUSINESS - This tour was awesome! If you're on the fence, get over it and book it. Although it's pricier than most things in Vietnam, spoil yourself for the occasion. My husband and I booked this tour on our last night in HCMC, and that's our only regret; do this your very first night. We realized just how little of HCMC we'd seen (and we had seen a lot). Our drivers, Thanh and My, arrived promptly at 5:20 and explained how to ride passenger on the motorbikes. From that point on, things just got more awesome. Seeing the city on bike was enthralling and every food stop was delicious. Tai, the tour guide, was entertaining, inclusive, and kind, and he has a great sense of humor! The city was beautiful, the driving safe, and the experience was not one to miss. It's so much more than a typical touristy thing to do. We've been on tours before, and this one sets itself apart. They go out of their way to avoid typical foods and sites, and give you an authentic experience (and, again, AWESOME food). Seriously, book this and you'll be the one writing the next raving review. Thanks, XO!

Best part of the trip - The tour was great had some apprehensions about riding on the moped but neednt have worried, its such a good experience and felt so safe the girls were great really informative and so friendly we wernt so much about this great city in 3 hours do not hesitate and book now!!

Saigon by night - Super amazing tour! Quang was our guide he was super helpful and friendly and really made us feel welcomed! Linh (sorry if I spell that wrong 😂) was my driver she was great and had tons of local knowledge it's been one of the highlights of my short trip! You see so much of the city in a short amount of time! I couldn't recommend this trip high enough! They even accommodated us on super short notice!
Thank you xo you guys rock!!!

We had a great time! - So pleased we booked this tour! The girls were outstanding and really made our experience terrific. I'm a fussy eater but I really enjoyed the food! Very well organised. Thanks for the great night XO

Wow! A fantastic tour (again) - The XO Tours foodie tour we did with our sons 3 years ago was one of the key highlights of our 2013 trip. Now returning as a couple, we just had to do this again.

I am very happy to report that the tour still remains every bit as good as our past experience and I highly recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC.

Tai the tour leader is just as funny and knowledgeable as ever and it was great that Tam2 hosted us again. Thanks also to our other hosts Nhi and the whole XO team who made the tour so enjoyable.

My other recommendation is that you pay the extra to have the tour video recorded as it is a great momento (and we will now have 2).

Fantastic tour, so much fun to be on a scooter in Saigon - Absolutely loved our food tour with XO tours; our guide Anh was charismatic, with perfect English and a wealth of local knowledge and our scooter girls Tien and Truc were capable riders in amongst the 7 million scooters around the city, that you never felt unsafe in traffic or for my personal safety. The girls too were very charismatic and helped cook and serve us some amazing dishes, as well as shared plenty of laughs.
I feel that the tour is comprised of many elements and I really enjoyed experiencing the different districts to give you a better feel for Saigon.
The food was great, I couldn't fault it, I really loved the "jumping chicken" much to my surprise...."when in Rome" and although some pics in the local market would have been good, we experienced this on our own later in our stay so it did not deter from such a great night! Thanks. 🙏

Probably the best tour in the world - Having traveled around the world and taking various free/paid tours. This has to be one of the very best tours I have been on. Motorbikes are the best way to explore Ho Chi Minh! My friend and I chose for "The Foodie" tour and we definitely enjoyed ourselves! You will be brought out of the tourist district to where "locals" actually live and sample "exotic" food. It is nice to learn a little history from the main tour guide at various stops. Your drivers are all ladies and they speak fluent English! They made the trip very personalized and I'm sure you won't regret one bit! If you are still considering whether that $75usd is worth it, running the tours cost a lot of money as they have to cover the drivers, the bouncers, the tour leader, the company and more importantly the ultimate supply of food (seafood isn't that cheap, go crazy for the scallops). They aren't advertised at hotels because they don't give commission.

We had Thao and Nhung as our drivers and they were really nice ladies! They did a great job sharing with us their side of Vietnam. Consider requesting for them and hopefully they won't be on their off days when you visit! 😊

Tip: They offer free pick up from selected districts and if you want to pay for the tour with a credit card, please do so 2 days in advance before the tour. Otherwise, it's cash payment only.

Amanda Portland Victoria Australia - A must ... absolutely brillant experience . The girls on the bikes were so friendly. The goat and scallops were delicious. The guide was informative and the bike ride through Saigon was amazing

Half Day City Tour - We rode on motorbikes through the city. They take you to the big sites, some that you go into (Central Post Office, Notre Dame Cathedral), and others that you just take pictures from outside (Reunification Palace, Ho Chi Minh City Museum). There's a separate tour guide (male) from the drivers (female), as well as a "security team" who watches the bikes.

We got sugarcane juice and some fresh yogurt, which was great. Felt pretty safe, although definitely glad we weren't driving ourselves.

They took photos, but most weren't great quality as there was something on the camera lens.

Highlights of our trip! - We had such a brilliant time on the Saigon Food Tour! We were only in Ho Chi Minh for 2 days, but felt like we covered more ground and tasted more of the local flavor than most tourists. These guys take you beyond the usual Banh Mi & Pho favorites and expose you to real local favorites across the city whilst stopping off for some unusual sightseeing along the way. We tried everything from goat bbq, delicious grilled okra, frog and some of the best scallops and crab meat I have had to date! All washed down with delicious Saigon Beer! Not only is the food great, but the girls are incredibly friendly and always up for a laugh. It was great fun weaving through the city during rush hour with them. Thank you XO Tours!

Saigon by Night with Young Family was awesome! - Our family (8 year old, 6 year old and 3 year old) all went on the Saigon by night tour. The elder two were on a bike with the guides and the youngest rode pillion between driver and myself on the bike. We actually had tour booked for the night before, but it had started to rain and sensibly the XO recommended we move the tour to the next day so that we could go more safely in dry weather. All of the drivers were excellent and the tour was our highlight of HCM, especially for the kids. Would highly recommend, XO are extremely professional and made the night very enjoyable.

A Saigon must do! - Best advice I received pre trip was to do a city tour by scooter. Looking at reviews I picked XO & booked a private city tour with them. Booking online was easy and they were helpful & communicative (fluent English) & when I missed my connecting flight into HCMC, XO rescheduled my tour without hassle. On the day my tour guide was Khoi and our drivers Nam & Wei (apologies for any misspelling). We had a BLAST - this was our first day in SE Asia and turned out to be the highlight of the trip. If you have any misgivings about jumping on the back of a bike - just do it. It was exciting but it is an excellent way to see the city in a relatively short space of time & the guide & drivers are super knowledgable. Everyone in HCMC is friendly and our drivers were hilarious. Definitely recommend this tour Co and will certainly use them again. Thank you XO!

Outstanding way to see Saigon--Highly Recommended! - I did both The Sights (morning) Saigon tour and the evening Foodie Tour on the same day. They were fantastic and I highly recommend both of them. XO Tours is clearly a world-class tour operator and you can see more of Saigon with them than you could ever do on your own.

Traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is insane. Scooters outnumber cars by a large majority and traffic rules are highly questionable. Watching scooters fly through the traffic is pretty amazing. Everything just seems to work. One of the best parts of XO Tours is that you are getting from stop to stop on the tour on the back of a scooter driven by an engaging, English-speaking, female guide who is proud to show you her city. It was awesome getting to talk with my guides about their backgrounds, life in HCMC, and whatever other questions came to my mind.

As others have described, while you have your own driver/guide, there is a lead tour guide who does most of the talking when you are at a stop. For my tours, Khoi was the tour leader and he was great. He clearly takes a lot of pride in his work. He took several pictures of me on the scooter with my driver/guide that they sent to you for free afterwards--a really nice touch! Additionally, there are a couple of other guys on the tour who blended in, but are safe for the group. I felt completely safe during my entire time in Saigon, however, I think it is smart that they have additional people with the tour group just in case.

This set up means there are more people with XO Tours on a given tour than guests, which makes for an incredible guide to guest ratio. The people from XO Tours are awesome and are willing to take pictures of you and answer any questions as the tour moves along.

As for the tours, I really enjoyed both of them. The Sights tour was a great way to get oriented in Saigon and also see several districts of the city that you probably wouldn't get to see otherwise. There is a stop at a market for a mid-morning snack and they also drive-by a sugarcane juice stand for a refreshing drink in the hot and humid HCMC weather.

The Foodie Tour in the evening is a great way to both see the city at night and get to try a lot of different Vietnamese food. Across three different food stops, you take many courses and they will not let you leave hungry. You also get to see different districts of the city than you get to see during the morning tour.

I was extremely impressed with XO Tours. If you are going to HCMC, I cannot recommend them enough.

One of THE BEST things we did in Vietnam... - I read all of the fabulous reviews left by all of the travelers who enjoyed this tour and still, I was skeptical. Knowing how inexpensive food was in Vietnam, $75 a person seemed steep... or so I thought.. I WAS SO WRONG... and I'm happy I was.

There were 4 of us in our group, 2 moms, 2 twentysomething daughters, traveling to Vietnam for the first time. We are all adventurous eaters (1 daughter is a food writer for a US newspaper) so we were looking forward to eating some new things.. 3 young Vietnamese women, all dressed in traditional outfits, met us in the lobby of our hotel. We walked down to the street level from our hotel and there, 1 more young woman joined us. The Group Leader (I was assigned to her) assigned riders to guests - gave us all helmets and stowed our belongings under their motorbike seat. They instructed us how to ride on the back of the motorbike, we put on our helmets and hopped on.

Slightly terrified because we were now part of the motorbike mayhem that is Saigon. What an amazing feeling to be out there finally catching a breeze in the 100% humidity days that we had endured.

We rode to an alleyway restaurant where we met 4 more people from the other tour group. We met our tour leader, Sang, a very nice young man who was very thoughtful, courteous, knowledgable and funny with some of his goofy jokes... So in the entire tour group there were:

8 guests
8 motorbike drivers (all female, young, nice, helpful, english-speaking and excellent motorbike drivers)
1 Tour Leader (Sang)
2 Tour Muscle Guys - they watched the bikes when we stopped and made sure everything was safe for guests

We made 3 stops for food and 2 stops for a history and info lesson about the various areas we were in from our Tour Leader, Sang. Absolutely fascinating to learn so many details about the various Districts of Saigon that I didn't know before. We visited 5 different Districts (most visitors only get to Districts 1 and 3) so it was nice to see the other areas that we normally would not have had a chance to see and to understand the history behind them.

Food Stop 1 was for a delish bowl of Bun Bo Hue (beef noodle soup)

Food Stop 2 was for a Vietnamese BBQ where we had BBQ'a goat, beef, shrimp, okra and frog and bahn Khot, and ice cold BEER!! It tasted so good.. The motorbike drivers turn into our food preparers and literally made the food in such a way that all we had to do was open up, bite and chew! We played a few fun games and just had great conversation and fun.

Food Stop 3 was for grilled seafood and other delicacies where we had grilled scallops, clam soup, crab claws, quail, balut and a couple of nice light desserts.

I think the best part of the entire experience was getting to know our drivers and sharing awesome conversations with them. 2 of us are mothers so of course, we spoke to the girls about life, being a strong woman and working hard to get ahead.
It's what mothers do... :D

Second best part was riding thru the entire city on the back of a speeding motorbike and seeing Saigon whiz by...

Now, ask me again, is $75 too much for this experience? NOT AT ALL!! I would pay twice what I paid for the same experience. 4 hours of sightseeing, food, transportation and getting to know some locals and have local experiences.. Can't put a pricetag on that experience.

Thank you to XO Tours, Sang, Tien 2 and the rest of the girls for a memorable experience that we will never forget!!

Our first experience in Vietnam - After arriving to HCM City in the evening, XO tours "The Sights" was our first programme in Vietnam - you can imagine the thrill we had on the motorbike. Altogether this was one of our best programmes during our 2 weeks trip in Vietnam. I don't want to repeat all the nice things in previous reviews, try it yourself!

Just Awesome - We decided to book both the sights (day) tour and the foodie tour (night) before we arrived in Saigon based on the excellent trip-advisor reviews of this company. After arriving at the airport and being transferred to our hotel in peek (rush) hour we honestly wondered what we had gotten ourselves into. The Saigon traffic is unbelievable! So it was with some trepidation that we jumped on the back of the motorbikes the next morning. In the end there was nothing to worry about. Our girls made us feel safe and secure and we had a fantastic morning seeing the sites of Saigon. Our guide, Tai, was fun and informative and we got to see so much more of the city than we would have on foot or by bus. The foodie tour was equally enjoyable and the food served was tasty and not too confronting. We were extremely well looked after and no-one went hungry. Truely, there was sooo much food : ). It was really nice to talk to the girls and learn a bit about what life is like in Vietnam. Generally there english was very good (far better than my Vietnamese - lol) and I had some very interesting discussions whilst cruising along the streets of Saigon. I would definately recommend either of the tours that we did and consider it a must-do activity for anyone visiting Saigon.

Priceless - I did the sights and foodie tour with Ting (#1) and Trang (#4). Both were led by Huin. The attention to detail, willingness to go at whatever pace the group desires and attitude are all unparalleled in my experience.

I enjoyed every moment and would recommend this to any one who is comfortable not sitting in an air conditioned bus being driven to only tourist hubs. They truly do their best to show you a more authentic Saigon.

Trang has a brilliant sense of humor if you are lucky enough to tour with her.

Thank you XO,
Adam

Amazing experience - Nothing lets you see the city quite like riding on the back of a bike. The tour guides were amazing and friendly. They were very knowledgeable as well. We did the day tour which was great and the night food tour which was amazing. We got to try some really good food at local establishments. My recommendation is that if you do the day tour be prepared for the heat. Also, if you're taller the back of the bike can feel cramped after awhile. If you have a GoPro strap it on your helmet. I got some great videos of the city at night. Highly recommended!

Such Fun! Do It! - We did the Street Food Dinner tour early during our stay in Ho Chi Minh. What a wonderful way to enjoy the different areas of the city and the traffic from the traffic point of view. Between the 4 of us we had those who were unsure of the food and those who were unsure of riding the back of the motorbike. After about 20 minutes on the bikes the afraid just disappeared as it was evident that all the ladies were excellent drivers and took very good care of their passengers. The food was enjoyed by all although only two of us tried the fertilized egg. It was just a lot of fun and the ladies were full of information and seemed to really enjoy what they were doing. All I can say is DO IT!

Shopping Tour and Foodie Tour - Really professional services. They pick you up at your hotel and drop off at your hotel at the end as well. Every tour has a group leader and security as well as your individual biker. I really enjoyed talking with the girls. They are friendly and very willing to share details about life in Ho Chi Minh. Overall, I would say that it was a very authentic experience, especially in the Foodie Tour where I got to experience real Vietnamese cuisine.

Must-do tour in Saigon - I had experienced the night see tour on April 28, 2017. I met Nice female drivers and friendly tour manager! Thank you guys for great time! I'll never forget those memories😆!
영어 잘 못하는데도 계속 말걸어주고 친절하게 이것저것 알려줘서 고마웠어요. 베트남 음식 잘 못드시면 푸디말고 나이트투어도 좋으실듯 해요~ 반미랑 사탕수수 음료 그리고 푸딩 두개 먹었는데 다 맛있고 좋았어요. 오토바이 전혀 무섭지 않았어요^^ 꼭 해보세요~

Excellent! - Very nice, professional, friendly guides and female drivers. The traffic in HCMC can create a bit of panic at times, but we feel very safe behind them. They were taking pics of us (and sent them by email not even 2 days later) and giving water at any time. We saw many places, went to a local market to enjoy homemade yoghurt and another dessert. They offered sugarcane juice as well. MUST DO! We had such a good time with them.

Highlight of our trip in Saigon. - Saigon by the night tour was truly a fun & informative way to experience Saigon's night. Our tour guide Tu and Thag were very friendly, fun loving and entertaining! How they corrected our way of pronouncing Phuc Long was hilarious! The tour lead Tuong was very informative and funny too. Such a wonderful night with some quick food too. A true highlight of our trip to Saigon. We would love to do it again when we return.

Excellent tour, when we come back we'll be doing another! - My partner and I did the Sights tour and it was fabulous! We just loved being on the back of the bike, zipping around and seeing parts of Vietnam that we weren't able to reach by foot.
Our tour guide Sang was fantastic, friendly, enthusiastic and so knowledgeable! The girls were fabulous and safe drivers and will always engage you with conversation and make you feel comfortable.
What made the tour even better was that another couple dropped out of the tour in the morning, so we basically had a private tour! We plan to go back to Vietnam and even though we didn't intend to do Ho Chi Minh City again, we will just to do the foodie tour as the food provided in the Sights tour was delicious!

What a great time we had! - Our family of 2 adults and 11yr old and 13 yr old loved the food tour! We did the tour on our first night in Ho Chi Minh which really opened our eyes to the wonderful food and the busyness of the city. I admit it was a little scary at first...getting on the back of a bike BUT the girls were lovely and after the first stop we all felt very comfortable riding the streets of Saigon. We learned all about the foods too and met some great people. Our guide was fantastic and informative. Well worth it!

Such a fun way to see Saigon - You are never too old to do this tour!! My husband and I (both over 70) were just booked by the family to do the tour with XO Tours.I never thought that I would be "scooting around" busy Saigon on the back of a motor bike!!
The girls are dressed in traditional dress and are all so charming and speak excellent English. I did the Cultural Tour . We stopped at various places of significance and were met at each stop by our chief tour guide Thien. He was such a great story teller giving us the facts in a most entertaining way..We went to some places that had a real "Local flavor" and they adapted the tour so that we could visit The Jade Pavilion although it was not on our original route. Well done and thank you for that.
You feel completely safe sitting on the back of the motor bike with your helmet on as they weave in and out of the traffic.
My husband did the Night Street Food Tour the previous evening and he is not very mobile. The girls managed him so well getting on and off the bike...he loved the tour, food, sights and looking at the night life of Saigon from a different perspective. It is great value for the money you pay.
Thank you all for a really fun, exciting and interesting tour

Excellent from start to finish - Did the Saigon by night tour that included a couple of food stops. Excellent service and attention to detail by the riders and tour leader. Loved the dessert. The beautiful lady riders endeavor to build good rapport with guests, so you almost feel you are out with a pal giving you a tour of their local city. Highly recommend

Excellent tour, excellent food, excellent drivers - We just returned from our first evening in Vietnam and it could not have been more perfect.

We received a great overview of HCMC accompanied by fabulous food and most charming and professional scooter drivers.

We could not be more pleased, highly recommended.

FANTASTIC EXPERIENCE!!!! - Our friends recommended this tour and we were not disappointed!

Our tour guides were absolutely lovely, and accomodating to our needs. The food offered on the tour is not what you'd expect, which took me by surprise (in a good way). It lets us walk in the shoes of a local and experience local street food. Heads up though! It's not just a food tour, but it allows you to understand and appreciate what Saigon is truly about.
I found the tour thrilling and I really enjoyed riding through different districts on the back of a scooter.

Saigon by night is something that needs to be experienced!

10/10

Don't be wary - it's fun not scary! - On arrival in HCMC I did wonder what on earth we were thinking booking a motorbike tour but within minutes I felt in safe hands and the rest of the night flew by. The food was incredible (I don't eat meat and everything was adapted for me seamlessly) and we visited places we probably wouldn't have thought to go to ourselves. The drivers were spot on and great fun as the night went on. It's expensive but well-worth it - this was a real trip highlight for us! Thanks to Ti and Hoa (hope I got this right?) for a fantastic evening!

Best part of our trip! - The Foodie Tour was one of the most memorable activities on our trip, would highly recommend all see this side of Vietnam. They truly care about our happiness and enjoyment during this tour.

The Foodie Tour - Spent a huge amount of the tour on a moped, which is not the most comfortable mode of transportation, which is fine as you know that going in, but if you have any kind of back issue the amount of time you spend traveling is gonna hurt.

Basically the food tour consists of this, 1/3 travel time (prob about 90 mins total not the moped, ouch) 1/3 listening to a tour guide talk about things not related to food in anyway at all, 1/3 actually eating food.

Food was OK, but nothing you wouldn't experience on your own, without even trying that hard.

This was in no way a tour fit for a foodie, was really disappointed, bored and physically hurt from all the travel time after this tour.

Was nice to see different areas of Saigon that you probably wouldn't see otherwise, but if you think that this tour is really for the "Foodie" than you will be sorely mistaken.

Our tour guide (they guy that travels with the tour, not the girls, they were great) was also rude and insulting at times. I don't think this was intentional, more of lack of communication and understanding in English, but it's enough to really annoy you.

A poor experience...

Best way to see the city - Cannot recommend this tour enough! It is such a fun way to get around the city and get a chance to see places that guide books don't point out. We did the sights tour and you certainly see a lot over the 3.5 hour period. I was a bit nervous about the tour as crossing the roads the day before had been a heart pumping experience! However as soon as we met the girls they put my fears at ease and by the end of it I didn't even need to hold on to the bike. They are all excellent drivers and you certainly feel at ease. Our tour leader, Tuong, was also great and had lots of interesting information to give us. For me, the highlights included the post office building, the food market in Chinatown where we had some exceptional food (much better than the main market in town) and the pagoda at the end of the tour. They make sure you have lots of water as it is boiling and I really enjoyed the drive by where we picked up some sugar cane juice. If you have a spare half a day this tour is by far the best way to get around the city and have some fun whilst doing so!

A must do at the beginning of your trip.....AMAZING!! - This was an amazing experience! I myself own a walking food tour in Canada and this to me was so professional, safe, well organized. The food was great, historical insights and awesome entertainment!!

The very friendly staff will dazzle you with their charm, knowledge and very great driving skills...

One of our highlights.. to say the least!!

Tammy
Owner
Taste This! Gout Ca! Food Tours Canada

The original and probably the best! - We did the Saigon by Night Tour and it's probably one of the best ways of seeing the districts of Saigon that most tourists wouldn't usually get to. The ladies on the bikes are brilliant drivers and of course the ride is thrilling at times! As with our entire trip to Vietnam the food was superb, I would highly recommend this tour!

Most amazing night of the whole trip - We were very scared to get on the bike and were going to cancel. After meeting the girls all our fears faded and it was the most fun night. We are 2 60+ ladies and the girls made sure they looked after us. At no time did we feel unsafe and I cannot believe the food we ate and the fun we had.
Thankyou XO tours you guys rock. :-) Val and Monika

Fabulous and efficent way to see Saigon with very high quality guide and drivers al of whom spoke excellent english - Riding on the back of motor bikes around Saigon was terrific fun. We took our teenage daughters and our 80 year old mother and we all loved it. We had an excellent mix of tourist attractions and local experiences. We ate some fabulous deserts at a local market and sipped the local lime lassie.
Our guide Tuan was incredibly knowledgeable and entertaining. He added color to the history of the city. The girls who drove us were kind and helpful and very safe riders.

No sooner had we got back to Australia than we received photos of our excursion from our guide.

Simply brilliant!

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh - We had so much fun on both the City Sights and Street Food tours. We always felt completely safe on the back of the scooter and our drivers Tam, Num, Yen and Phu were very knowledgeable, fun and friendly. The guides, Anh and Hieuw, were also very knowledgeable and told us so much about the history and food of this lovely place.

Awesome, unique, family experience - Foodie tour - Great way to see beyond District 1 and see some of the real city. Authentic local food, fabulous information from the professional and funny tour guide Tao, and such a great connection with some young local women who were our drivers. They were professional, friendly, intelligent, knowledgeable young women and it was a delight to spend the evening with them. They looked after our 2 kids, aged 7 and 3, beautifully, and even took them for an ice-cream while Tao was explaining the sights. We felt completely safe on the bikes despite the crazy traffic, and we would highly recommend it as a family experience.

Fantastic & fun way to explore HCMC - Fantastic tour of HCMC. Very well run by tour leader, Tai.

My guide, Tam, was an enthusiastic & knowledgeable girl. Well deserved #1 Spot on TA!

Great night, good guides and felt very safe. Awesome way to see the other sides of Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City)! - I did the Saigon By Night tour with my boyfriend. Our tour guide was Tuan, he was very knowledgeable and full of energy. We rode around with Nga and Chang (not sure of the spelling on this) and they were both great, felt super safe and their English was really good. We talked the whole way through the ride! The food was good, the sticky rice was my favorite, definitely try the mini pancakes too. Great way to see all of the different districts in one night.

Great Food, Great Sites and Great People - FOODIE TOUR! Fantastic way to get around and see a lot and eat a lot. You see most from the back of the scooter vs. walking around, but that is not bad considering the touring is mostly to ensure there is enough space in your stomach for the next stop! Great local places in many districts, it was all just so simple and good :)

Don't miss this! - A highlight of our trip. Good company, a unique experience that brought Saigon to life. Unforgettable memories of our ride and the tastes on offer. Everyone was so welcoming and we really felt that we really got under the skin of Saigon. A must do! Thank you everyone. The photos were a bonus!

Best experience I had in Vietnam - And that's saying a lot cos I've been conned and cheated so many times here.

The owner Tung is an awesome guy who I had the privilege to meet.

My rider, her name is Vi, was very well trained and professional. I wish her all the best in her future.

The ride itself will give u one of the defining experiences of Vietnam. Weaving thru traffic on a motorcycle. And yet, so safe. They've never had a major incident before which you'd never guess seeing how the motorcycles weave about.

There's supreme order to this chaos!

Foodie Tour and Sights Tour - Saigon - Did both the Foodie Tour and Sights Tour in Saigon in March 2017 and absolutely loved both. Our tour guides were so friendly and very informative and we saw sights we never would have seen on our own. It was so fun to run on the back of the scooter and I would never have done that solo in such a busy city. We always felt very safe and learned so much while having a wonderful time. I would not hesitate to recommend XO Tours... fantastic!
Maureen, North Vancouver, BC, Canada

Don't miss this! - The highlight of our trip in Saigon! A group of young guides (mostly female) took on a scooter trip of the city at night. We started with a trip through the different districts in the city, and then stopped for dinner at a local restaurant that served street food. The food was delicious. The guides all spoke great English, ate dinner with us and told us all about the city and their customs. After dinner they took us to a great rooftop bar with an amazing view of the city. A must!

Sights of Saigon and Foodie tour... absolutely brilliant! - This was our first time in Ho Chi Minh city and after our first night I was very apprehensive about our tours for the following day as the traffic can be very intimidating. We did the sights of Saigon tour in the morning followed by the foodie tour that same night and I can honestly say after the first 15 minutes of our morning tour I felt in safe hands and was having an absolute blast! The girls are so lovely, their English is perfect and their driving ability is even better. I must also mention that despite thinking that the foodie tour would be completely unsuitable for a vegetarian, our guide and the girls made sure that all my meals were meatless and also dairy-free. And all were delicious!

I think the combination of two tours was perfect, completely worth the money and I would most certainly recommend it to anyone and everyone.

Great experience! - Awesome time riding around on scooters in Ho Chi Minh traffic! Very experienced drivers know how to keep you safe! Very fun touring around different locations including the post office, markets, temples and the burning monk shrine, definitely a fun experience!

Worth more than every penny - A wonderful way to see Ho Chi Minh and experience the roads on the back of a scooter. The food was incredible and the tour also included some stops to learn about the city (and give us a break from food). Felt very safe on the scooter, we recommend you do this tour, but book ahead as it books out! Thanks XO!

Brilliant street food menu - This tour is an absolute must for travelers who want to experience the real Vietnam. The tour manager Tai was brilliant, very informative and very funny. The girls on the scooters were fantastic and rode with great skill and safety. Do yourself a favor and book this tour, you will not be disappointed. Thank you XO Tours.

Best Adventure! - What a great adventure/foodie tour in Saigon! If it were possible to give a super excellent, six star rating I would!

We booked the night time motorbike/foodie tour about two months before traveling to Vietnam. I read many of the glowing reviews on TA and thought, it can't be that good...

Well, we were blown away with the whole event! Our motorbike drivers (all cute smart young ladies) arrived at our hotel as scheduled and proceeded to give us the safety procedure and explained what we we're going to do for the evening.

And, then it was off through the streets of Saigon! With all the crazy drivers (except ours who were very professional) zipping in and out of traffic like a school of fish trying to avoid being eaten. There were moments that I had to close my eyes and just have confidence my driver (Thanh) would navigate through the storm of spinning wheels, exhaust and constant sounds of beeping motorbike and car horns.

Our first stop was an outdoor restaurant sandwiched between two buildings just off a main street, specializing in Pho. Having survived the first 30 minutes of our 5 hour tour, we were all great-full to have the opportunity to enjoy a quick delicious meal...

And then it was off again to the roar of the motorbikes and my expert driver at the reins...Thanh glided her motorbike through the bustling streets of Saigon as if we were floating on air. I was in-awe of her skillful abilities slip in and out of traffic and carry on a conversation without missing a beat.

This repeat the entire evening as we enjoyed the sights and sounds of nightlife in Saigon and, sampled many of the delicious street food delicacies this amazing city offered. Our tour ended with being smoothly delivered back at our hotel with our memories and our tummies full...

Anyone looking for a different and exciting adventure would not be disappointed with an XO tour!

Wonderful experience!!! - A friend and I recently did XO's Foodie Tour and loved it! The food was great and varied as promised. I always felt safe on the bike as we traveled through 5 districts at night. The girls drive but they also have a few men traveling with you in case there are any problems. At each restaurant the food was quite different and the XO team make sure everyone is enjoying themselves. It is a really fun night so don't hesitate to do it!!

Highlight of Saigon! - ​We booked this tour upon the recommendation of a colleague and it turned out to be the highlight of our time in Saigon! Our tour guides were so fun. We made many stops, visiting several districts in the city. We had plenty to eat, including: Bo Bun Hue, grilled; okra, goat, beef, prawns, frog, lettuce wrap, quail, crab claws, scallops, clams, spring roll,
Balut (duck egg embryo) and coconut jello. If you're even slightly adventurous, I'd give this a try. Also, pay the extra $35 and get the video! It was very well done and quite entertaining!!!

Foodie tour - This tour and company were great. I am a big guy, 6'2, 300 pounds and was a little worried about riding but Ngoc (pronounced Neow) did a great job no problem. To me the ride was best part...at one point there were 10,000 scooters in my vision, a symphony of traffic. I have taken scoot/moto taxis in Tanzania, Kenya, Vietnam and Cambodia before and it is always fun but also your always worried, with xo I can relax.

Food was good to great and abundant. Last stop had best food but all were good. Beer is all you can drink you just have to keep ordering.

The price is expensive, example I ate breakfast most days for 50,000 vnd or about $2.33 usd while in Vietnam but the xo tour is still worth 75 usd because it is nice to be able to relax and let someone else take care of things and xo does it and it was a blast!

Staff are great fun to chat with and good English speakers. Charming time.

Food Tour - This is an absolute MUST for anyone wanting to experience a food tour in Ho Chi Minh. Our drivers Ngoc and Trang were absolutely amazing - as were our tour leader, Khoi. They made us feel safe and comfortable - especially when they found out I was a little disenchanted of bikes. Trust me - the safest place you can be on the road here is on the back of one of their scooters!

The food was incredible. I'm a vegetarian and the meals served were easily the best veggie meals I've ever had. My partner is a meat eater and feels the same about his dishes.

Not just a food tour - the XO team also takes you sightseeing and explaining the districts, offering some fascinating background info on the food & life in each.

We couldn't recommend the XO team anymore highly - we had an absolute blast. Thanks for having us guys!

Dani & Ned x

Food tour Saigon - It was an amazing evening with lots of different typical Vietnamese dishes. The girls were very friendly and we had lots of fun. They are perfect drivers - we feel safe all the time. Thanks a lot.
Riding a motorcycle!!! - We went with XO tours around the district it was amazing. We went on motorcycles for the first time ever.

Saigon by night - great fun - I had the pleasure of moons company and experience on this great tour. There was only a couple of us but it didn't matter as it's a very social experience hanging on the back of a scooter. While sitting in traffic jams it was quite fun chatting with other locals all of whom had big smiles and welcome to Vietnam comments. We visited Chinatown And a variety of other districts to see the various ways of life. We also had dinner at one of the stops used by the foodie tour, I couldn't eat another thing so it was the perfect experience for me.
The only downside is that the tour did not collect or drop off from my hotel in district 10 so I had to spend several more dollars getting to and from. This is in no way a criticism of the tour but more and acknowledgment that I should have stayed closer to town .

Such a great way to see and experience the city... especially if you're short on time. - If you prefer listening to music in your car with the windows down over the energized sound of the music coming from your computer speakers, this is the tour for you. Rather than merely enjoy Saigon's culinary delights from a stuffy indoor venue, this tour gives you the opportunity to explore several different districts on the back of a motorcycle with a generous tasting at each stop. If you are indecisive or conservative with ordering at restaurants, this tour is great because you are supplied with tons of options (all included), some of which are much less "conventional." And, the staff is incredibly professional and courteous. You won't regret it.

Tour of Saigon - Excellent. Go and enjoy a few hours around Ho Chi min
Loved the tour and the informative guides
It was great
😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀 😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀😀

Exhilarating - I like to read lots of reviews before booking things and I often dismiss reviews from people not likeminded (you know those ones "I can't believe the bed only had 4 pillows!"). So it was pretty easy to see that XO tours was the best from the 1000s of 5* reviews. So booked it months ago. Then yesterday while relaxing in the air con, my anxiety ridden teenager asked about the negative reviews just so she knew what to expect, so I started to look at the "terrible" and "poor" reviews for XO. There are only 4 out of 3966 reviews so that didn't tell me much!! (or maybe it told me a lot!). So I started to read the "average" reviews. Complaints of the tour not being authentic, too touristy (no locals), the girls sitting and serving you, not having the opportunity to talk to other people on the tour, the girls not eating with you, the food being boring, the tour guide being too corny and the two non-eating stops. Then I read the replies from Tung Do, owner of XO which others have described as defensive. So I'm not going to give you yet another description of the tour, you can read that in the other 3900+ rave reviews. But I will tell you, the XO tour was one of the most exhilarating and yet terrifying things I have ever done. Driving around the city (don't think you just drive around little streets), on the highway and across the bridge was something I have never experienced and will probably never get to experience again.

Now to all of those "average" comments. I didn't see one westerner in any of the restaurants. The places were all packed with locals eating food similar to ours, wait until you see a table after the locals have eaten at the last stop! Yes the girls sit next to you, they cook the food (cutting heads off prawns, snipping legs off and de-shelling with a pair of scissors) and then "serve" you, that is, they take the food off the BBQ and put it in a bowl! But they talk you through the food, the sauces and how to eat it (which leaves go with which food). Yes, you don't get an opportunity (except for the first stop) to chat to the others on the tour, but why would you want to. You get to talk to locals about Vietnam and their life!! I can talk to other tourists anywhere. And no, the girls don't eat with you, but then I've never had the person cooking for me eat the food either! At our last stop two of the girls had the duck fetus egg (none of us tried it) so that was great as we got to see it without eating it (and the 15 year old got to take photos). For us, the highlight wasn't the food, yes the food was great and it was good to try different things that we would never order normally (goat, frogs, quail etc). The highlight was the "tour"!! Riding around the city, seeing different districts and hearing about those districts (and food stops) before we got there. Yes, the guide is a little corny, but then you have to be, to be a guide! We will never get to see China town, Mafia town or the strangely different District 7 with its wide streets, high rise apartments and American chain restaurants. This is a great tour to really experience HCMC. My kids are raving about it and best of all we all had a different perspective and saw slightly different things on the back of a bike zipping through Ho Chi Min city!

See Saigon like a native - I took the city tour in the morning, and had so much fun I did the night tour that evening!

These young women are extremely articulate, not to mention super drivers! Swirling along in the chaotic traffic, I never felt anxious or uneasy - they knew how to navigate Saigon's never stopping traffic with ease. Seeing the city from the back of a motorbike, while daily life literally swarms around you, is incredible. Hieu, the manager, is extremely knowledgeable, well spoken, and professional. Both of my drivers were friendly, engaging, and great companions.

The night ride was held during a rainstorm, but instead of dampening spirits, it only made it more fun, as we plowed through deep puddles as we navigated the city. The food was great, authentic, and it was fun to be part of the crowd of Vietnamese diners.

This was one of the highlights of my three weeks in Vietnam - I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

Amazing time - We booked the foodie tour for our first night in HCMC and after the taxi ride to our hotel from the airport, I have to admit I was rather worried about being on board a scooter! I needn't have worried, we were collected on time by two lovely girls (Anh and Lyn I think? sorry girls! ) who were with us all evening as our guides and in some stops, our cooks! We had the most amazing time ever on this tour, probably one of the most fun tours I've ever done! We saw all parts of the city, ate all sorts of food that we would never have been brave enough to order ourselves and enjoyed everything we ate. (though i stopped at the duck egg! ) I'm glad we did it at the start as it helped us find foods we liked at restaurants after. It was nice to meet and share the experience with folks from other countries too. I always felt very safe with the girls driving and our male outriders. (I only had to shut my eyes once!) If my kids could have seen me whizzing through the city they would have been amazed! The photo's at the end were a nice surprise too. Don't debate whether to pay a bit more and do this tour, just do it, its worth it.

One of the best Foodie tours. - We went on the foodie tour in Ho Chi Minh City. The people were very accommodating and were great host. The driver were very safe and ensured that we were all comfortable. They have bodyguards to ensured everyone's safety. The food places were clean and the food was delicious. This tour gave us the full experience of the different types of foods that the local Vietnamese people eat. It was incredible.

Best way to explore HCMC! - I took the "Saigon by Night" tour and I felt that it was the best way to explore HCMC after dark. it was a wonderful experience to be driven around the streets of HCMC. What better way to get to know the city than by exploring it around like a local! I felt completely safe on the passenger seat of the scooter as I was driven around different the different districts. Not only that, I also learned a lot of information as my driver shared a lot of things with me. Their English was good so there was no trouble in communication. The food was SUPERB. This was the authentic Vietnamese experience I was looking for!

Awesome Experience - We did the Saigon by night tour. It is a great way to see the city and probably visit areas of the city that you wouldn't go to. It also helps being out of the blistering heat of the sun.

Our tour guides (lady bikers) were very polite and friendly. Their driving skills will no doubt leave you more than impressed. If you know what Saigon's traffic is like... hats off to them. They were also very knowledgeable and constantly engaging.

As vegetarians they catered very well for us. The meat lovers will most definitely enjoy the food as it was apparent from the other guests that joined us on the tour.

Apart from their food, the experience they provide you with is phenomenal. Would definitely recommend to every visitor to Saigon who would like to see a different perspective of the city and not all the common tourist places.

Two thumbs up!!!

Must Do In HCMC - We pre-booked well in advance of our trip to HCMC the Sights Tour (first full day) and also the Foodie Tour (evening of day we arrived).
Due to flight issues we then had to email at late notice to change the date of our Foodie Tour - this was quickly replied to, no charges passed on and our requested new date confirmed. It was all dealt with professionally and easily.
Both tours were fantastic and we cant express how much they provided us in terms of feeling more comfortable in a new city.
Our drivers for both trips were amazing and to be honest are a special memory of our overall holiday.
These tours really are a must do - they are worth every cent and then more.
What a wow! - Very professional riders/tour guides who answer all our questions and provide very interesting commentary all the way. Excellent food also.

Amazing tour - recommend to anyone! - If you want to see the real HCM, hop on the back of a motorcycle with these crew. Do it like the locals do. The female drivers were amazing and the male tour leaders/bodyguards were funny as! It was definitely the highlight of my trip here! I cannot praise this tour enough!

The Foodie Tour-Highlight of my trip in HCMC! - Of all the things I had planned on my trip to HCMC, this tour was the one I was most looking forward to. I was afraid that I was too excited that my expectations would not be met. They were easily exceeded!

I was a total blast riding on a scooter through traffic. There were times I was a little scared, but I had a great deal of confidence in my driver, Quynh. She had the perfect personality for me. We traded sarcastic jabs to each other the whole time.

They were able to space out the meals with stops in different districts so that we were not too stuffed. It was the perfect amount of spacing. I wanted to do either the night tour or the shopping tour, but unfortunately I didn't have enough time to do it all. It would have been ideal, if they incorporated a stop to do some shopping in between meals.

I highly recommend this tour and the tour company. I can't wait to see my video they are making!

Ming

Fantastic motorbike experience - Saigon by night - We pre-booked a Saigon by night tour for our first evening and it was a great experience all round. The guides were helpful and friendly, the food we were served was tasty and we ended up having a private tour even though we booked a group tour at no extra cost. Although we were on a tour we felt like we were in the middle of things and got to see the city from a different view point. Would recommend!

Great way to get an overview of the city - Wonderful morning on the Sights tour! You get an overview of the main sights as well as stops at a market and temple. They fed us delicious snacks at the market as well as a sugercane juice on the go. The drivers and guide are all very sweet and eager to share their history and culture with you. If you're nervous about the motorbike, don't be! I had never been on one before, and I felt completely safe and relaxed by the end of the tour. My only regret is that the foodie tour didn't also fit into my schedule.

Great fun tour on the back of a scooter! - Both our tour guides were very knowledgeable and the girls did a great job of keeping all the patrons safe while riding us around the city from sight to sight. Would definitely recommend XO tours to friends and family visiting HCMC.

Nice tour of the city - Did this on the last day of our stay in Saigon. Our tour guide Sang was very knowledgeable and friendly. The lady drivers were also very friendly. They do know how to drive and course through Ho Chi Minh traffic! Would recommend this if this is your first visit to Saigon. If I had time, I would have tried the night or foodie tours as well!

Simply an Awesome Experience! - My friend and I took the Foodie Tour and we were sure glad we did. It was definitely one of the highlights of our trip. From start to finish, we had a blast. The four and a half hour tour went by so fast. The XO Tour company is very organized and easy to work with. Booking was very easy and the support leading up to the tour was excellent. The person that I corresponded with prior to the tour was very professional and responsive. Our guides picked us up at the hotel as scheduled and greeted us with a smile. We chatted a bit, got on our motorbikes and withdrew to join the rest of our tour group at our first stop. All the food at the three stops was delicious. I like the fact that we went to local restaurants off the beaten path and were offered unique dishes that we would not have normally ordered. It was nice to try different dishes. But the best part of the trip was our guides. My guide Linh was amazing and made the evening so much fun. She has such a wonderful personality; so friendly and talkative; very fluent in English. And Linh's motorbike driving skills were superb. I felt very safe and thoroughly enjoyed the exhilarating ride through Saigon. Linh and our other guides also did a wonderful job with some of the tableside cooking and food preparation. Our main guide. Anh, also did a great job that evening. He made all the stops with us and provided informative discussions along the way about the food, and the city. I selected for the video option and recently received the finished video. It was well done and I'm glad I got it. I normally like to take photos and video clips during my trip to make my own videos. It was nice to not have to worry about doing that during our tour and just focus on enjoying the experience and conversation with our guides. Watching the video brought back great memories of our Foodie Tour in Saigon!

Just do it - We did a couple of tours - the night Foodie tour, and the morning Sights of Saigon tour. Both were excellent. My guides (Quyen and Ting) were great fun, and I felt completely safe on the back of the scooter behind them. Just relax, trust them, and the traffic just all seems to work.

The Foodie tour had some great food (and a couple of beers!), as well as some HCMC delicacies - I just couldn't do the duck eggs!

The Sights tour took us to some of the less visited areas - so while we saw the Palace and Museum, we didn't go in (it's easy enough to do this solo). So we saw some areas that are a little off the beaten track - China town, the markets, .. Similar on the Foodie tour, where we went to different areas of the city to experience the differences.

We had understanding as our tour leader on both trips - he was great. Knowledgable, personable, interesting, and fun.

A great time - thoroughly recommend it.

Best tour ever! - This was by far the best thing my partner and I have done on this trip. Skip the tunnels and do this instead.

We were warmly welcomed by our two friendly drivers who came to pick us up - Mai and Linh (spelling?) Immediately they started bonding with us - and they didn't stop chatting and laughing for the entire 5 hours. Not only were they lovely, they also guided you through almost every meal, played games with (and on) you, and made you feel extremely safe when on the back of their scooters. It was sad to say goodbye at the end.

The food was interesting, delicious and diverse. It's perfect if you want to try an array of Vietnamese food that other tourists will never try (because most of it is outside of district one). If you're a fussy eater, try it anyway - we had one on our group and he managed to enjoy many of the dishes.

Darting around on the scooters was slightly scary at first, but you quickly get used to it - believe it or not you feel safer being on the scooter than a pedestrian on the side of the road. Relax and you'll be fine.

You also feel safe in every restaurant due to the small army of men from XO that stood guard. It was a nice touch.

While the group leader was helpful, nice and efficient at being the business dealer for the evening. However, his talks were over-rehearsed and felt very 'showy' - especially when compared to the genuine nature of the girls.

I feel safe to say this made our trip here in Ho Chi Minh.

These guys are pros - a fantastic tour and a highlight of my Vietnam holiday - XO Tours are pros - western-standard service provided with local charm. I can't offer much other than confirmation of what the other reviewers have said. I did the Foodie Tour, 5 locations and 3 eateries, on scooters. My driver, Mei, was delightful and very funny. We also had a guy on another Vespa filming the whole tour and he didn't speak English but was also a very pleasant chapter.

The tour was informative, and I got to see far more of the City than I would have otherwise. After the tour I felt I had a much better grasp of Ho Chi Minh City, and had been seduced by its vibrancy, which really can be best appreciated from atop a scooter.

The food was interesting, varied and delicious. The first stop offered the best Bun Ho Hue I've had so far, including in Hue. The second stop, the grill place, where you can cook your own meats, was also great, and I got to learn much about the different herbs and leaves the Vietnamese included in so many of their dishes. The third stop was the highlight, with its grilled scallops served in abundance, and the weird balot (duck foetus) I ate. Certainly an unique experience.

The tour leader (Hue? Hugh? Hew?) was fantastic - very charming and knowledgeable.

In any event, this was definitely a 5 out of 5 for XO Tour and I recommend it to anyone who wants to get a feel for the "real" Ho Chi Minh City. These guys are pros. They know what they're doing.

The best in Vietnam!!!! - We would like to highly recommend the "Saigon by night" tour for the following reasons:
All the sights are outside of district 1 (the center), were tourists usually don't get, like China town.
All guides speak very well English.
The tour includes local tasty food.
A safe comfortable ride includes other riders keeping up the ride.
The stuff is very friendly and communicative.
DON'T MISS!

Awesome foodie tour - This was a highlight of our trip and loved it. 5 destinations, 3 food ones, incredible food, wonderful and attentive staff. Everything was perfect and they even took pictures and sent them a few days later. This is great value and a fantastic way to experience HCMC on the back of a Vespas, see many districts and eat where the locals do. Food is excellent too. Highly recommended!

Amazing and unforgettable family tour of HCMC - My family of 4 (2 kids aged 3 and 6) did the half day "The Sights" tour with XO Tours. We booked the night before and we're so glad we made the last minute decision to do this tour. We had 2 bikes between us, kids under 8 ride on the same bike as their parent. The girls driving us around, Nga and Trang, made us feel comfortable immediately. We never once felt unsafe and all the staff were amazing with our kids. Tai was a wonderful guide and let our eldest son ride up front with him for a couple of the rides, which he loved. The support staff were equally amazing and entertained the kids while we listened to the interesting information Tai shared with us about HCMC. Tai and the girls' English was fantastic which made things easy too. I cannot recommend them highly enough especially for families. It may not seem like the most conventional tour for families but you will not regret doing an XO Tour.

The foodie-fantastic tour of both food and the city - We had such a great time on this tour and would really recommend it even though it blitzed our backpacker budget! You get to drive through lots of different districts many of which you might not end up visiting otherwise with occasional stops for some background and history of the city. The girls who drove us were so fun and friendly and were really excellent drivers, you never felt at all unsafe even in HCMC's crazy traffic! They were keen to chat and tell you about life in HCMC and gave us lots of recommendations on places to eat and go during our stay.
As for the food.....it was fantastic! As much as you can eat and ranging from a special type of noodle soup to barbecued meat to seafood (plus a few more weird and wonderful optional extras). One of our group was vegetarian and the veggie options were plentiful and also really tasty. It was all absolutely delicious with plenty to drink to wash it down. It was a great night all round, we would highly recommend it.

Best Fun !! - A must do in HCMC ! I was hoping it would be a great tour as it was quite pricey but once you do the tour you can see why it costs a little more than others . It is very professionally run , and all the details are taken care of . The girls that ride the bikes are very engaging and a lot of fun ! The photos they email to you after the tour are great !! Thank you XO !!

Great Foodie Tour in Saigon! - This was our last stop on our trip around asia and we were looking foward to it the whole time. It absolutely lived up to our expectations! The tour was wonderful with 5 stops (3 for food) in 5 different districts that we wouldnt have gotten to see. The food at each place was bomb and I skipped lunch and was still packed full at the end. My wife is a vegetarian and she had more than enough options at each stop to fill up as well as share at the table! Everything is all inclusive too from the food to the beer which makes this a fantastic way to see the city and eat the food. The girls are amazing on the bikes, navigating the Friday traffic with ease. They keep you engaged with good conversation all while maintain a watchful eye on the road. You won't be disappointed with this tour!

One negative that we did have is that we felt we were secluded at tables a little too much at the second two food stops. We were kinda broken up into couples and non-couples, so outside of the first stop we didnt have much interaction with the other people on the tour.

Saigon by day - First time in Saigon and never been on a motorcycle before. This tour was sounded too good to miss!
Our drivers were so confident after 5min I forgot all my nervousness:)
Absolutely the best way to experience this city
Our guide Sang gave us a pretty good background and history of this city mixed with local feeling going to markets
If you are a tourist you will most likely experience only district 1 but with these guys we managed to see a whole lot more

See THE SIGHTS with the family! - Before we arrived in Saigon for the first time and when we arrived in Saigon we were unsure about taking our kids (7yrs and 10yrs) in the crazy traffic on a motorbike. My husband thought I was crazy to consider it but after lots of TripAdvisor research I decided to book an XO Sights Tour and aren't we glad we did.
Three lovely ladies showed up at our hotel on motorbikes at exactly 8.30am to take us on a morning of sightseeing around the city which we all loved. My 10 year old rode with his own driver and 7 year old rode with Daddy. I also had my own driver. The bikes all rode fairly close together and I could see my oldest at all times.
We felt very safe among the traffic which moves slowly quite and all drivers on the road seem careful too. My oldest couldn't wipe the smile off his face as we toured from one sight to the next. At each stop we were met by our own personal tour guide Mr Khoi who was excellent with his knowledge and also lots of fun. He really made our day interesting and enjoyable.
Highlights for the kids were visiting the local food market where one of our guides walked around with us and we bought some Vietnamese candies from a local lady, getting the "drive by" Sugarcane juice, feeling like a local.
