My husband and I enjoyed it all too and found we got around the city very fast compared to trying to do it ourselves and we got to see lots of Districts and their differences as well as the main attractions in District 1.
We will book an XO tour again and next time we will try the night time Foodie tour for sure.

Favorite of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City! - Riding on the back of a Vespa motorbike through the busy streets of HCMC was a blast! Our family of 4 loved it! We hit several points of interest during the tour, a few touristy spots like the post office and cathedral, then a few markets and areas that felt unique. We will do the night tour with food next time. Completely safe and fun day! Our drivers were fun, quick and great to interact with. Tuan was our chief tour guide and he was knowledgeable, funny and excited to show us HCMC.

Friendly, fun and fantastic way to see the city - This was the highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh. My husband and I don't often go on tours but decided this would be a good way to get a feel for the city. The tour exceeded our expectations. We did the night tour and enjoyed the whole experience. I would recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC.

Superb Foodie Tour of HCMC - My wife and I took this tour a few days ago and it was a brilliant evening! Joining the throngs of motorbike drivers alone is a buzz but this tour takes you to 4 or 5 different districts to sample local cuisine and get a taste for the real life in the city. Our drivers were so friendly and the tour guide Sang was also exceptional! It's expensive by Vietnam standards but a must for any tourist!

Just the way to see Saigon by night - Excellent scooter night city and foodie tour! We were a party of four, two adults and two teenagers. We felt completely safe and comfortable being driven around in the bikes, and the food and cultural city experience was brilliant! Highly recommended tour.

Great sites tour! - My girlfriend and I took the morning sites tour right after arriving in HCMC to get oriented to the city. We had never ridden on the back of a scooter before and were a bit apprehensive - especially after we saw what traffic was like. However after just a few minutes we felt completely comfortable. The girls navigated traffic with ease and we never had to stop hard or sweat a near miss.

Once you get used to the bikes we absolutely love them. It's a much more efficient way to navigate than by car, and the breeze felt great. The girls were very knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. We got the orientation to the city we were looking for and learned a lot about its history, culture, hot spots, and the food scene. I strongly recommend taking time for this tour - it has been the highlight of our time in HCMC!

The BEST Experience in Ho Chi Minh! - If you're traveling to Ho Chi Minh City, there is only 1 tour you MUST take! XO Tours is it! This back-of-the-bike experience is by far the BEST experience we had when we were touring through Vietnam.

The company is owned by a Vietnamese American who moved back to Vietnam to open a company that provides opportunities for women in Vietnam! Each motorbike is driven by a woman and their knowledge of the culture and customs only adds to your experience!

They have several different tours, but I highly recommend the "Foodie" tour! It is 4.5 hours of fun, excitement and laughter! You'll try about 12 different dishes and really get to see the city from a unique perspective (the back of the bike)!

The only wish they had an XO tour in Hanoi & Hoi An! I would tour with them all over Vietnam!

The best way to see Saigon - We recently booked the Sights of Saigon morning tour, and this is easily the best way to see the popular sights. The traffic in HCMC can sometimes be intimidating but being on a motorbike is actually really good - much easier than being in a bus or car.

Our tour leader was really knowledgable and we learned a lot about the history of the city, as well as some interesting local stories.

If you're visiting HCMC I'd highly recommend XO Tours as the best way to initially explore the city.

Saigon by Night - This nighttime motorbike tour was fantastic. My driver, Dieu (pronounced like "you"), was so friendly, and I also felt very safe with her. There were five people on the tour (myself included), then a driver for each person, and then a few guys serving as guides/bodyguards/photographers.

Everyone was so personable.

We saw several neighborhoods that I otherwise would not have visited, including Chinatown, the "BBQ area" (where we had a delicious dinner), a wealthy area, a typical neighborhood (where we had dessert), and everything in between.

Definitely recommended, this company is fantastic.

Fun food tour - We had an amazing time
Just fun
Meeting people and visiting all different types of places in Saigon!!
My driver was a lovely smart and fun girl! I love her!!!!

Amazing Food Tour - Had a brilliant time on this foot tour. Saw parts of HCMC that we wouldn't have gone to otherwise and tasted all sorts of delicious foods! Also made gluten free eating very easy - thank you!

Excellent! - What an exciting way to see Ho Chi Minh at night and also get the opportunity to get off the beaten track. My driver collected me promptly at the arranged time and immediately I felt safe and comfortable riding with her. I was traveling solo so joined up with a couple of other groups at our first stop in central Ho chi Minh. There we were introduced to our guide who was so knowledgeable and most impressively he remembered everyone's name and where they came from! We spent the next 3 to 4 hours zipping through the different districts of Ho Chi Minh where we not only ate delicious food but also were given a brief history and background of the district. You really feel part of a group of people that you hardly know and also quickly bound with your driver. My driver was fantastic and loads of fun. I would definitely recommend this tour to foodies and those who also like a little excitement.

Best thing we did in Vietnam - I will start off by saying I'm not the smallest of guys (6'2) and when the 5'2 Vietnamese girls came to our hotel to pick us up on their motorbikes I was a little nervous to say the least....

My fears were unfounded as the girls riding skills were exceptional. Myself and my girlfriend had absolutely no idea what to expect but we were soon greeted by our tour guide In a cafe close to our hotel along with the rest of our group for the evening. Within 20 mins of the meet and greet were we're all on the back of different bikes and headed out for the evening.

We visited many different places and tried some amazing dishes that I would never of been brave enough to try without it being ordered for me. We were dropped safely back to our hotel at the end of the evening stuffed with food and massive
Smiles on our faces. XO tours were professional from start to finish, the girls were amazing and the tour was worth every penny. If you are reading this and wondering if you should book it, please please do as you seriously won't regret it!!!

Great tour guides. Super to be on the Scooters - First, the tour guides were fantastic and participated in our every need. Very, very personal. Second, so much fun to drive around HCM on the scooters. Could have done that all night. Third, food was good and loved trying new meats. Fourth, very well organized. Could have done without the lecture on the evils of capitalism (rich get richer, there is no middle class, Koreans and Chinese are buying up the country). Fifth, got to experience other districts other than district 1. Overall, would highly recommend this tour as a way to experience the HCM people and culture.

Fantastic way to see HCMC! - My husband and I booked two tours with XO Tours, the Sights Tour and the Foodie Tour. We both loved tours and can't say enough great things about XO! We chose to do both tours because they really captured two fundamental pieces of HCMC - its rich history and its delicious food. What I didn't expect was how different the city felt at night, compared to the daytime. Being on the back of a scooter was the best way to zip around town. During the same trip, I had a few friends go on a foodie tour with another scooter company. After comparing notes, I was very pleased we went with XO Tours. Unlike my friends, we were introduced us to delicious Vietnamese dishes that we hadn't tried before (no pho or banh mi on this tour!) and also got a lot of insight into the specific districts and how HCMC has changed/evolved over time. Overall, I highly recommend XO Tours! We also paid the extra money for the personalized video - it is such a great way to memorialize the fun times!

What an extreme adventure - I was scared to death and did slot of praying for the first half an hour! I had complete trust in my driver it was the other millions of bikes on the ride that worried me. I loved visiting all the different districts as much as the food. The food is not your normal everyday food, although they can still accommodate fussy eaters. A must do while in Saigon.

Outstanding Tour - My girlfriend and I took this tour the other day. We did the sights tour and a Foodie tour. All four girls were excellent. Very knowledgeable and they make you very comfortable. I ride a scooter so it may have been a little easier for me but I believe you will have no problem with them. They are very good drivers ad conversationalist. Very interesting tours. I have done plenty of tours through out Asia and this was by far two of the best. Don't even think about it just do it. You will not regret it.

Don't hesitate - go! - It's just brilliant. On arrival in Saigon we were totally daunted by the idea of ​​being on the back of a Scooter in this crazy city but within 10 mins we felt totally safe with our fantastically experienced riders Chang and Yen. Along with the tour leader Hiew and the assistants that are with you it's fantastically well organized. This gives you total confidence to venture down some really authentically Vietnamese streets and alleys in the various districts that give you a real overview of the city. I found myself sampling some fantastic seafood , barbecue meets as then venturing off piste into some wilder choices but totally your decision to do these 'bonus' dishes. The ladies are brilliant company - superb English, funny and sassy it was like hanging out with new friends. Book it now online you'll absolutely love it!

Book Now So You Won't Miss Out! - Experienced this tour last night with my 12 year old son. We both thoroughly enjoyed it. The food was great, make sure you don't eat before, and the all the staff were a delight to enjoy the many meals with. Felt very safe and extremely satisfied with this tour. Book now if you are headed to Ho Chi Minh.

Amazing people, great tour. - I booked two tours with XO Tours, the Sights Tour and the Saigon by Night Tour. I thoroughly enjoyed them both, even though it was raining for the first half of the night it didn't seem to bother anyone. The sights tour was very interesting and informative, our guide leader was displaying great general knowledge about Ho Chi Minh and the history of the sights we visited, you can feel he was proud to share it with us. Our drivers were simply awesome, they made the tour so much fun and were super friendly. I would definitely recommend these tours to anyone, it was the highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Minh.

Best way to experience the city! - We were visiting Saigon on our honeymoon and this tour had come highly recommended from several of our friends who had recently done it. The total experience of this venture was absolutely five stars from beginning to end! I honestly cannot recommend this tour highly enough!

Our guides were so friendly, knowledgeable, professional, and their English was fantastic! I am a vegetarian though my partner is not, and they were extremely accommodating to my dietary needs despite the fact that all 3 food stops were not explicitly geared towards vegetarian diet. I also eat seafood so this made it much easier, but I don't think that would have been a deal breaker. I had plenty to eat during our tour. The food was incredible and they take you to local places, not tourist spots. It felt very authentic and the guides said they hung out at the BBQ place in their free time with friends!

Most people likely stay in District 1 while in Saigon and never really get to see the rest of the city, this was the best way to see more of the city and learn a little about the life and culture of its citizens. Our guides were happy to discuss just about any topic of conversation I brought to the table. And Saigon by scooter at night was beautiful with the open air against your face and the city life bustling around you!

We were initially hesitant about being on the back of scooters and when you visit Saigon you will see why! The traffic is CRAZY! Our drivers were safe, professional and for two larger build Americans, they had no problem balancing the scooters.

Again we recommend cannot this trip highly enough!!! Definitely one of the top 3 things we did on our honeymoon in SE Asia!

Awesome tour - I went on the three hour Saigon by Night tour with my wife and it was just spectacular. The main tour guide, Tuan was fantastic and the female drivers were super. Despite the organized chaos of Saigon, there was never a moment that either my wife or I felt like there was any safety issue. We visited a number of different districts to get a feeling for the city and my only comment would be that I would have enjoyed a tour that lasted even longer. Next time that I am in Saigon, I will definitely do another tour with this company. What a great experience.

Don't miss this fabulous tour! - You won't find this tour at your hotel Tours desk but a quick search on Google (XO Tours) will have you booked and ready to go with a minimum of effort. This tour has been one of the highlights of our 4 weeks in Vietnam. A fabulous five hour adventure to restaurants in a number of different districts in Ho Chi Minh City, that you will never find as a tourist. Young women wearing traditional Ao Dai costume, pick up from your hotel on a vesper bike, give you a helmet, and you set off riding pillion. These women have been driving motor bikes for years, and they are excellent! Never once was I worried, and I am in my 50's and my partner in his 60's. Food was amazing and the tour was informative as well as delicious, ably led by our English guide. Male staff also on bikes accompany the group ensuring traffic stops to let our bikie group take off and arrive with ease from each restaurant. Our riders, Hong and Tuong2 were wonderful - funny, great anecdotes, always checking we felt safe (and this was while we were on the bikes!). At the restaurants, they explained the various foods we were eating, and were masters at grilling goat and cracking crab claws. Within a couple of days you are also sent some photos from the trip. There are many copycat tours of this experience, but XO tours are the original. Book! You won't be disappointed.

Fabulous experience even for families with young children. - It gives me great pleasure to recommend xo tours. This tour delivers all that it promises & more.

Highlights:
1. Interactive, fun & well informed staff.

I was riding with my 6 year old son & the driver was courteous safe & guaranteed that all safety precautions were adhered too by making it a game for my son.
She had good knowledge of the city & pointed out interesting anecdotes about the places we visited.

Apart from the driver, we also had Tuong who was our guide & will meet us at various points to give us information on why that area it's importance etc.

I must point out that our driver with my permission took my son who was getting bored with the information like any child would for an ice cream & I was not charged for this. I feel that this shows the dedication the staff has to ensure that the patrons have a good time.

2. The food itself:

If you are looking for a box standard Vietnamese meal then this is not for you. However if you are a foodie like me then this is the best tour for you.

I was taken to those districts where tourists generally don't venture. But the food was fresh authentic & had a local charm to it. It was unapologetically Vietnamese & hence brilliant.

My son enjoyed the dishes though Tuong organized some chips for him at one of the places. Again this was over & beyond the call of duty.

The choice of drinks was good & unlimited.

It has been a great experience & a highlight of our trip.

Best thing we did! - After seeing the wild traffic in Ho Chi Minh we were a little apprehensive about braving it on the back of a bike, but we four 50 somethings took it on anyway and can I say were so glad we did. The XO tours foodie tour was the highlight of our trip. The girls were great and spoke excellent English. The food was varied and local and they even catered without a hitch for the non seafood eater. We stopped in 5 places all up, eating in three, and visited 5 districts with a guide to discuss and inform at each stop. We all highly recommend this tour for all ages (traffic made much more sense from the back of a bike).
Amazing! Highlight of our trip to Saigon - XO Even sent through professional pics taken throughout the tour, amazing well organized service! Did city sights, great highly recommended tour.

yahoooo! - XO's Back of The Bike night food tour was exactly as fun as everyone says! My brother and I were only in Saigon for a few days, but we knew we had to fit this in. We are so glad we did! The young women who drove our motor bikes and guided us from location to location were amazing ( I ​​mean YOU Phi Anh,Tinh and Anh!) They were smart, funny and spoke excellent English. The food was authentic and delicious (the green papaya salad was amazing). We laughed , we ate , we learned ...what more could anyone ask. I highly recommend this little adventure in Saigon.

What a ride - We went as a family of 3 on the foodie tour not confident but excited to jump on the scooters. We felt quickly safe and thrilled at the ride through the districts. All though my husband became suddenly ill and was taken home - not because of anything to do with the tour. So my 14 year old and I were well taken care of and given quite a lot of wonderful and different foods, some of which we have never tried before. They catered for all dietary requirements and never forced us to eat anything we didn't want to. My daughter is a very fussy eater however she did try some new and different foods. The beautiful girls who drove us around entertained and cared for us and made us feel like family. It was great to see the different districts and zipping through the streets like a local. We loved the food and highly recommended taking this tour if you are up for adventure, wonderful food and of course fun. Thank you to the wonderful team at xo tours, keep up the great work we will fondly remember this trip.

HIGHLIGHT OF MY TRIP - I pumped myself up for a month in advance of arriving into HCMC because I wanted to do this tour but I'm an absolute chicken !

When I arrived and saw the ridiculous traffic and the "frogger" game trying to cross the streets I almost canceled.

But it was amazing, the food was abundant and I loved seeing other districts. Ang was a terrific host and my driver, Nuoc was steady and confident in her driving and a total sweetheart. I highly recommend!

Enjoyable - We couldn't leave HCM without experiencing it from the seat of a motorbike. We did the Saigon at night tour, booking on the same day (afternoon). The booking process was easy and straightforward.

Our drivers were very good and informative. They speak very good English. The tour manager, Tai, is a fun person to talk to and you warm up to him instantly. He remembers everyone's names!

There are two stops for street food on the night tour. Being Muslim, we requested no meat. And they gave us more than 1 vegetarian option. We ended up loving the one we chose and even another non-vegetarian person ended up choosing it too. We also love the fruit that they introduced us to called milky apple (we tried looking for it the next day on our own, but failed). The sugarcane juice they served us was also amazing. I know it's only sugarcane but maybe because we were enjoying the company so much that even sugarcane tasted amazing.

I highly recommend this tour because they brought us to districts that tourists don't normally go to and it gave us ideas on other places to visit in the future.

Thank you Tai and the other guides. I wish you all the best!

Behind the scenes, authentic experience of Saigon! - XO Tours Night Foodie Tour of Saigon was one of the major highlights of a 6 week trip through Asia. Tai, the main tour leader, did an incredible job utilizing the food and the sites to share insights into the social and economic aspects of living in Saigon and Vietnam as a whole. Chanh, my driver, was an absolute gem! On the back of her bike, in between stops, she was open and generously answering all my questions about life in this new season for Vietnam. Both Tai and Chanh had superb English skills and it was refreshing to be able to joke and have conceptual questions answered. The food stops were excellent (didn't feel like the typical tourist loop) and the non-food stops were interesting and educational. They made me fall in love with their city!

One of the best highlights of my trip - This was an absolute highlight of our trip. We did food tours in three different places in Vietnam, another of which was on scooter, and this was the best by far. It was so well organized and executed that it made the others look amateurish. The food was great, the restaurant selection was outstanding, and our drivers were excellent. It was a blast, and it is worth every penny more than they charge over the competition.

Excellent guides. Food just ok - We did the night food tour. Five stars for the guides & service. Three stars for the food.

The guides and ladies were excellent. Motor bike was a great way to see all the different parts of HCMC. They took a lot of pictures for us and sent them via Dropbox within 4 days.

The food was a bit disappointing. Not bad, but not much different from nor better than Vietnamese food I've had elsewhere. But I guess it's more about the experience.

Tips:
- don't bring large bags or items. They can store small/medium sized purses in their seats, but that's all.
- they ask you not to take pictures while riding. luckily the male guide rides along side and takes pictures along the way.

And evening we will remember - This was a must do for us we are both in her upper 50s and had a great time the bike ride was something you will not forget very professional just have to relax and enjoy it I plan on doing this again in my late 60s thank you XO from the girls to the guide to the security professionally done Rayand vicky

Unique Food and Tour all in one - What a way to take in so much of HCM culture in just under 5 hours. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed this very professional tour. Tried some interesting food and it kept coming. Never too old to ride on the back of a scotter!

Insightful and educational city tour - I went for a morning "Sights" Tour to the post office, Notre Dame cathedral, chinatown, etc, and tried some local desserts, drinks and fruits. The guide was knowledgeable and friendly. The rider was also very cheerful and shared a lot of the local culture. It is relatively safe on the bike so don't worry!

Tips: Bring a shawl or something to cover up if you are wearing a spaghetti strap top, or you're not allowed in the cathedral

Fantastic night in HCMC - We had a fantastic night on XO food tour. The ladies were great fun and we felt very safe with them.
It was wonderful to be brought to places that we would not have found ourselves and to get to try traditional foods. This was our first night in Vietnam and it was an amazing start to our holiday!

We went back for dinner to one of the fish restaurants they had taken us to...very much a local place.. .(not a tourist in sight)....a great experience!! We would never have found this place on our own.

We would highly recommend!!

XO Tours in Vietnam - We had a fantastic night with Trang and Tien from XO Tours, we would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to do something different in Ho Chi Minh, thankyou girls for a great night.

Moped night foodie tour. The best thing we did on our holiday! - This was an absolutely amazing experience.
From start to finish it was well organized. The experience was superb, and the balance between trying great local food, driving around and seeing so much of the city, and the fantastic commentary of the tour guide all made it an A+ choice of activity. Add to this the lovely girls that drove us around with elegance in the chaos of the city, and their great English and knowledge, it was a trip not to be missed.
It is quite expensive but worth every penny.

Daren and Steve
London

XO Foodies motorbike tour HCM - Excellent. Well managed tour. Well worth the experience. My partner and I were lucky enough to take part in this fantastic tour. Our 2 riders.Teeng & Nagi picked us up promptly at our hotel. Their English was excellent, they had a great sense of humor & they explained everything very clearly. The tour starts off meeting Sang.our tour guide & another couple on the tour as well at a lovely restaurant with a traditional Vietnamese soup. We then went to a number of food markets & cafes & tried lots of Vietnamese dishes. . Lots of Fantastic food & wonderful information from Sang about HCM districts. We felt safe riding with the girls at all times & would definitely recommend Samg & the girls XO foodie tour
Foodie tour - So much fun. Had a great time with great food. The XO girls are very funny and knowledgeable. Very good drivers also.

The Best Tour Ever! Foodie or not! - If you want an experience that gives you the opportunity to see parts of Ho Chi Min that you wouldn't normally see, accompanied by superb local dishes and delightful guides, then make sure you're on this tour! Our tour leader and his lovely ladies are an absolute pleasure for company and I can't recommend them highly enough! Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!

Super fun night with XO Tours - My sweet driver Moon was so nice and fun to talk to. She made it extra special. The street food tour was organized so well - lots of delicious food (and not the usual Pho and banh mi) and I really enjoyed seeing the other districts from the perspective of a motorbike. The tour leader Thai, did everything to make sure we had a good time and could not have been nicer. I highly recommend this special experience.

Foodie Tour - These guys are really professional if you are ok with the price it worth it as you experience something absolutely different and I think it is not possible to get these information and experiences even by lots of readings in the web. They do not offer popular foods like pho! You can experience these foods anywhere in Vietnam or your homeland. To sum up do it and get useful information about Vietnam by asking from these professional drivers and guides.

Fun for all ages - This was a fun, informative and yummy tour. Everyone in our family with 2 boys (11 & 13) found something they liked and even tried new foods. The team was tireless in trying to bring up the interest of our moody, picky kid; but even he enjoyed some the delicious food and enjoyed cruising around town.

Loved the bikes, food was okay. - We absolutely loved the bike tour at night, an experience to remember, even if it was a little hairy at times!
I think we'd have preferred to have done just the bike tour, and not the food.
I was expecting more of an experience from a 'foodie' tour.
The first stop was at a busy little cafe, for a dish similar to pho. It was ok, but nothing extravagant - and I thought I was put off by a rat I saw climbing the ridge on one of the foundations!
We enjoyed the second stop, which was BBQ meat and fish. Although they said you could ask for more, the portions did seem a little measly. We played a fun game with chopsticks here too.
The final stop they announced as usually being a favourite. Maybe it just wasn't for us. In one of the more urban districts, it was busy, not particularly clean, which put us off trying most of the fish which was on offer.
However, we're happy overall as we got to see many districts of HCM at night, the girls on the bikes were charming and wonderful, and it was a memorable experience. Perhaps we'd been a little spoiled with such amazing food during our time in Vietnam. This was our second last night here after an exceptional two weeks of culinary delights. I think we'd have appreciated it more if it had been one of the first things we'd experienced in Vietnam.

Feel safe at all times - Well worth doing, money well spent.
From the start with online booking, reminder email, girls early to pick us up at our accommodation.
Very well organized company, had two lovely safe driving ,good English speaking young ladies.meals and drinks were abundant ,and more than happy to highly recommend to fellow travelers

A great evening for your first or last night in Saigon - After 2+months travelling around Vietnam (our second long-term stay) we booked the XO tours Foodie Evening for our last night in Saigon and Vietnam. It was a brilliant way to end our trip. We would highly recommend this tour for an introduction to the delicious foods of Vietnam to be had in the most unlikely places. It will convince you to skip the "tourist" restaurants and experience food as a local. We have travelled by motorbike on our own but were delighted to be driven about by the charming, knowledgeable, and most capable women guides/drivers, Nguyen and Nga, that evening. Nguyen and Nga were very open sharing information about their day-to-day life. This is the kind of connection and immersion that we seek when we travel. At the various stops Anh shared more general information which was interesting. And of course the food - delicious, well selected, and nicely presented by our most helpful guides/drivers. As promised it was not the usual food that is easily understood and obtainable for the average traveller. We must comment on the support staff that accompanied us. The security men and the photographers were always there as backup and we did not fully appreciate their efforts until we received the wonderful collection of photos - how did we not see them taking those shots?! As travellers in our late 60s we can recommend this trip to the young at heart!

Great way to experience the city, locals, and food - The drivers spoke excellent English, answered our questions about their lives in the city, and seemed truly interested in showing us their culture. I felt totally safe on the bike, loved the places we went to and enjoyed talking with the other travelers. A fun evening and a great way to experience the city.

Awesome Sights and Food on XO Tours - Thank you XO team so much for the 2 tours, hleu ( our knowledgeable tour leader) and his team ( especially Ngoc - my bubbly day-sight tour guide, and Nhat - my warm and enthusiastic evening foodie tour guide are simply awesome...

There's simply no regrets in taking up both the morning sights tour, and evening foodie tour with the team and they really made up the highlights of my HCMC trip.
Just simply the experience of 1st time riding on a xe om :) striding and wheezing through the busiest streets i have ever seen, is waaaaahhhh amazing, hahaha... felt really good, and that alone is worth a big deal to me.

Both of my awesome guides were very punctual ( were at my hotel lobby even before actual meetup time), and explained the DO and DON'TS on the xe om motorbike in a fun way for 1st timer like me. i was impressed by how both the petite girls are able to reassure big size guys like me to pillion the ride ;) simply do not underestimate their petite build, they are totally in control and the entire ride is rock solid and stable ;D

Both Nhat and Ngoc are wonderful tourguides, communicates really well and never fail to bring out little secrets, tips and sightings of the city while enroute on the bike, and offering to take photos at major attraction sightings; they also gave little sharings into their world during small talks ;)

i really enjoyed the tour and companionship very much. i have to mention that during the foodie tour they even helped removed the shells of the prawns and crabs... so touched :) and explained the different type of sauces that goes with the food. we even learnt a Vietnamese cheer on toasting our drinks... " MOT HAI BA, YO!" i think it's like 1 2 3 Cheers...

This is definitely a awesome tour team to go with if you are looking out for great company, sights and foods... however i must warn that if you are not keen to venturing into the open weather, scenery, environment and road traffic conditions and simply looking for in room, under shelter tours, then this fun loving, lots of cheers and outdoor fun tour is not for you. For me, i'm loving simply every part of it... and i will not hesitate to recommend this tour to my friends and would want to have a go at it again my next trip to HCMC. Thank you Hleu, Nhat, Ngoc... XO teams, way to go ;)

Brilliant evening! - We booked onto the foodie tour for our first evening in Saigon, and what a fantastic introduction to the city!
Firstly, the drivers are brilliant. We felt so safe and comfortable on the back of the scooters. They were lovely ladies, chatting to us about the city.
Then of course the food....a great variety and excellent quality (the scallops were our favourite). There was plenty of it, we all had seconds of our favorites. You certainly won't end the evening hungry! Also plenty of beer and water.
Finally we got to see and learn a bit about districts of the city we would not have otherwise seen.
A very well organized and fun tour. I would thoroughly recommend. Well done XO!

XO tours is the best way to see Saigon - I did the XO Saigon by night tour with colleagues I met at a work event. It was such an amazing tour and the tour guides & drivers were great. They make you feel very safe and are great drivers.

Once you've done this scooter tour you'll understand the method to the madness of how they drive on the roads in HCMC.

I will definitely be doing this tour when I bring my family back to HCMC, Vietnam.

Best part of the trip! - I cannot recommend this highly enough. I generally do food tours every destination I go to and I have to say that this was one of the best by far! For a start, it's on the back of a motorbike which is awesome! Second, the women are so so friendly! My guide, Moon, and was literally the best guide I could have asked for it made the whole night all the more enjoyable. The food was also great, and different from what you'd normally eat in Vietnam. You also get to see areas of the city you'd never visit as a tourist. Absolutely brilliant!! If I could give it more than 5 stars I would.

XO foodie tour fabulous - Me and my partner were recommended this tour and it didn't let us down. What a fantastic experience, a great mix of exhilaration from being on the mopeds and seeing parts of the city we wouldn't have seen combined with excellent local food. Added to this we had two great drivers and a very informative and comical tour guide.
Highly recommend for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh
Fun morning around HCM - The Sights tour took us to a good variety of places. Really friendly guides (a little hard to understand at times). Nice that there's food stops along the way.

Night food tour - My wife and I did the motorbike food tour for one of our nights in Ho Chi Minh City. The tour was a highlight of our visit. We were picked up at our hotel right on time and whisked on the back of two scooters to a central meeting point to join the rest of the tour. We started with a delicious soup dish and got an introduction to our evening. The best part, the tour is all you can eat and drink (including beer). XO and our tour leader Huie did a great job at mixing in food and culture so we were never bored or overwhelmed. The experience with XO was much better than what we could have done exploring the street food scene on our own.

Enjoy the sights of the city on the back of a scooter!! - The best part about this tour is that we sat on the back of the scooters and we were able to enjoy and see everything. If we were driving ourselves, we would have missed so much. We would have been so stressed, trying to drive in traffic and keep our group together. We had a group of 8 adults. Our cute female drivers were great! They were very anxious to speak English with us. They picked us up right at our hotel. We did the foodie tour which was very authentic. The vegetarian in the group ended up with the best meals, only because the meats offered were too exotic for me. Everyone else enjoyed all the food. We did the tour in the evening and the weather was perfect.

The only negative was that our tour guide(I can't remember his name) had a somewhat arrogant attitude. There were two breaks that we had to take and he made us stand in a semi circle around him, and forced us to listen to his opinions on life. We had little interaction with him, so it didn't effect how great the tour was.

I highly recommend!! (We tipped the girls about $15 each)

Amazing and a must-do! - We did the sights and foodie tour with XO and had an awesome time. Our lovely lady drivers were fantastic, friendly and super knowledgeable. Our guide Hieu was a legend. We felt super safe on the scooters despite the crazy traffic and its one of the best ways to see Ho Chi Minh City!

XO Food Tour - We went with XO on the recommendation of our tour guide WATERBUFFALO TOURS !
It was a fantastic experience trying different foods in many districts, many we would never have found while in Saigon. He was great at all the local information facts and figures. The VERY skilful girls who rode their scooters in the peak hour traffic with us as pillion were amazing extremely knowledgable very friendly and beautiful girls. Treat yourself next time you are in Saigon we LOVED it. Evening breeze in your face on a scooter nothing better than Kerry and Glenn Perth Australia😂

A great way to experience the food of Saigon! - We booked onto the Foodie Tour and had an amazing experience.

The tour was a great way to see 'real' Saigon and taste some authentic cuisine all under the watchful eyes of the fantastic XO tour guides.

Thanks to Tai, Hung and Han for a great night!
Did the food tour and had a blast!! - It was a lot of fun to go and see all of the different parts of the city and try all of the new types of food. I would highly recommend

Thrilling ride... great fun - At the age of 50 we jumped onto the back of a moped with a 21 year old young lady. Phang was my driver and boy was she confident . She told me to hold onto the back of the moped as this would be my friend for the night.
My wife was on another moped and we rode through the streets like we were kids once again. It was great fun and was completely safe. The whole experience was amazing including the tour guide and the food. Great value for money . A must do whilst in Ho Chi Minh ... whatever your age .

What a blast! - This was a highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. The restaurants we visited were impressive and diverse, and in neighborhoods that aren't populated with other tourists. But maybe even better than the food was whipping around the city on the back of a scooter get a history lesson and commentary from your guide the whole way.

A day full of fun! - We had a city tour with visits to tourist sites and then foodie by OX team. Drivers, as well as our guides, were perfect. They were so experienced, knowledgable and funny. The food was great. Saigon was nice at night!

Great introduction to HCM - We did this tour the day we landed and I'm glad we did. A great way to quickly get into the culture and the food which is amazing.
I'm not too keen on motorbikes but the girls are amazing, so friendly and usually once I relax on the bike after the first stop it was really enjoyable.
We got to see so many areas of HCM that we wouldn't have had time to make it to or hat we even realized were there. The guides are very accommodating and sit with you at meals to talk to you about what you are eating etc.
I'd highly recommend this tour to any Vietnam first timer.

If you only do one thing in Saigon do this! - Did the evening food tour with a friend and loved every minute of it. Not only do you get to sample some amazing food in places you wouldn't find on your own but you get to ride through the crazy streets on the back of a motorbike.
Our drivers Nguyet and Diem were superb and both spoke excellent English and chatted about Saigon and they're life in Vietnam.
The food was yummy and abundant and each course was fully explained by the Tour Leader, Tai.
11 out of 10 Superb

So much fun!! - We did the evening street food tour and the morning sightseeing tour and loved both of them. It was my first time on a scooter but my guide was super nice and went slowly and I felt very safe. The food tour was our favorite, loved all the different places we visited that we would never have tried on our own. It's also great being able to talk to your guide between stops and learn more about life in Vietnam. Highly highly recommend it!

Great fun and a good experience. - This is our first experience traveling around HCM city on bikes with a female rider/driver. It was fun and good experience for us. The female riders are good and experience in riding around especially going through crazy traffics at junctions - wow they are great. They are sweet, friendly and nice. Keep up girls.

One of the best tour experiences in HCMC - I did the Foodie tour with XO as one of my first experiences exploring HCMC and it was a blast. From my motorbike driver to the tour guide, it was such a fun, personal, and unique experience. I also love doing these types of tours (whether they're walking, biking, or motorbiking) because they give you a good feel for the layout of a new city when you first arrive. And as if I didn't already love Vietnamese food enough, this tour shed light on some new finds I'd never even thought of trying before (BBQ'd frog legs anyone?). I especially enjoyed the fact that all of the motorbike driver guides were female, such a cool spin and one that makes XO stand out in the amount of motorbike tours there are in the city - well, that and their incredibly friendly service. For anyone who is looking to get a good local experience in HCMC and try some tasty food, this tour is a must.

Unforgettable experience! Brilliant :D - I would like to thank my driver is particular. So knowledgable and smart :) These girls are all fantastic drivers - it actually feels like you are a ball in hungry hungry hippos. The food was amazing, but the atmosphere was superb. It did cost us 1.7 mil dong each, however it was worth it. I would highly recommend this as it was a great night. You may be asked to try some strange foods - give it a go!

Let me add to the din of successful praise for the XO team - Hard to say what was the best part of this trip. Hanging with the expert and enthusiastic drivers for a lovely evening. Trying some of the most delicious and story-worthy things I've ever eaten (I'm still getting people asking me at work about the Balut we ate). Or super exhilarating drive through the incredible experience that is Saigon traffic. Or going into neighborhoods all over the city (from high to low) that literally there would be no way in hell we'd ever see without this kind of tour. And the best part is the guide, women drivers (another feel good part of this trip is all the drivers are women) or the awesome support staff of camera men and security fellas make you feel confident you are in great hands and they know what they are doing. So you relax, let go and enjoy the experience!

Easy dressing - Compared with discovering the city by cyclo Xich Lo driving this is way much better. I don't feel guilty to the driver especially when going up the bridge. Also, the motorbike is the best way to get you among busy streets and can take you further. The good thing is the food shops for visit is real local and authentic taste, not a touristic and fancy one. Real Vietnam experience you should try once coming to Ho Chi Minh.

Fantastic tour - faultless! - Three lovely Vietnamese girls collected us at our hotel and spent 3 hours showing us a various range of sights in Ho Chi Min City. We had the most wonderful time, they were fantastic guides full of enthusiasm and knowledge about each place we visited. Their English was flawless and they went out of their way to be helpful in any way they could. Riding on scooters with them was so much fun, even for my 67 year old disabled Auntie!

I would highly recommend this tour company, the best one I've used in Vietnam.

Has made our visit very special - We have made a foody tour with XO. The tour was extremely enjoyable. The girla is very nice and explained us a lot about the city. The food was good and the group was very interesting. We don't think that the price was too high. You're touring for more than 4 hours, get a lot of food and see a lot of the city. Besides, XO gives the opportunity for the young girls to earn some money, which is not as usual in Vietnam. For us absolutely the tour, when in Ho Chi Minh.

Great Fun! - My three girlfriends and I went on a night food and sightseeing tour last night with this company. We were very impressed by the professional service by the guides and especially the Tour Mgr, Tai Dang. We were very well taken care of and they made sure food and drinks were enough. This tour is a little different to another which I did last year with another company, Back of the Bike, which offered more interesting food choices but this one offered more fun and bonding with some insight into different districts, explained clearly by the Tour Mgr. Both are good so if you have an evening free do try either one or like me, go on both!

Better than all other tours - With this company you do different tours on motorbikes with lady drivers who know what they are doing very well indeed ! I did the sights tour with my family. Very cute , ladies are sweet and we feel safe . The tour is well thought out - loved the use of IPAD at different venues to show us historical photos. Being on a motorbike was just such a good way to get about . I loved the photos they took of during the tour and we also paid for extra video and that was great as well . Recommend trying one of their tours they are a bit different !

Food and Fun - One of the best tours I have ever done. I joined a group on Friday night. My pick up was excellent. Very safe, competent drivers and interesting tasty and plentiful food. Fantastic way to see all of the city - great to do this tour early in your time in HCMC.
The absolute best thing is the staff. Warm friendly drivers who are informative and caring. The tour leader Khoi was charming and well organised but it is the female drivers who are the real diamonds here. They have excellent road skills, are smart and funny, give lots of individual attention and they peel your prawns and crack your crab! You honestly feel like a VIP. Worth every cent!

A must for any foodie. - I'm rather selective when it comes to tours, and I can assure you this is a fantastic tour. The mix of adventure riding through Saigon traffic mayhem and really exceptional local food stops is a big winner. Having a master guide tell about stops combined with chatting away with your own personal local expert/moto driver makes just that much difference.
If you're not sure or think it's a bit expensive, take this as a sign and take this tour. It's worth every penny.

Great food, great tour - awesome way to see HCMC! - We booked a last minute tour with the ladies of XO for our first night in Saigon. Our two personal drivers/tour guides picked us up at our hotel and instantly I felt excited - they were very warm and friendly and fun and I knew we were in for a good night! The tour itself consisted of a group of 13 tourists, each with their own motorbike drivers. Now it may seem insane to hop on the back of a motorbike in Saigon but you HAVE TO DO IT. There's a method to their madness and flying through the streets at night on the back is the only way to really experience it all! We made 3 stops for food and 2 additional stops where our main guide provided us with additional information about the district we were in. It was really informational and I also held several great conversations with Hong, my driver, to better understand her life in the city and the culture there. We tried several different kinds of food - even a duck embryo which I must admit wasn't as bad as I thought it would be! Highly recommend this tour - the girls are fantastic and there's no better way to see the city.

Discover Ho Chi Minh City! - I went on this tour originally in November 2015, and when I returned with my family in March 2017, this was the first tour on my list. Because there simply isn't a better way to experience the size of Ho Chi Minh City and to discover some of its incredible food. Through 5 hours and 5 separate stops, you are whisked across the districts on the back of a motorbike, driven by the XO Angels. You are taken through markets, backstreets, and highways not seen by most tourists, seeing, hearing, and smelling the massive city along the way. And the best part is being able to stop and eat the incredibly delicious food, all you can eat and drink while learning about the culture behind each district. I never felt unsafe, never felt pressured, and the girls were friendly and helpful. If you want to discover Saigon, the true Saigon, start your search here.

Fantastic Night!!! - After reading all the great reviews we had to do the 'foodie' night tour and it was fantastic from start to finish.

My girlfriend and I had Thuy and Loan as our drivers who took us through the hectic Saigon traffic like it was nothing. Their English is fantastic and we talked the entire bike ride about Saigon and parts of the city as we drove by.

We stopped through many of the districts to see the differences and tasted all of the different foods at each. Our tour guides helped cook the food and prepare it for us to eat which we didn't expect but it was a really nice touch to each spot we went.

We had many photos taken throughout the night which the Sang (tour leader) sent us through via email a couple of days later. Was great!

Sang was extremely knowledgeable and explained all the different districts along with the current goings on in Vietnam to give us a better understanding.

Overall I would highly recommend to everyone to try the foodie night tour!

Awesome Experience - I contacted XO Tours and set up a 'Custom Tour' due to time constraints (we were on a cruise). XO Tours gave us a ground level experience of Saigon riding on the back of motorbikes. I wanted to eat local food and my wife wanted to shop at 'Non Tourist' shops. We also wanted to see areas and sights the cruise tourist don't usually go. XO completely compiled. Tai Dang was our Tour Manager and he did a marvelous job. Hong and Hai were our lady drivers. These ladies took us through the massive motorbike and vehicle traffic like pros. We never felt uneasy weaving in and out through cars, buses, trucks and motorbikes. You want excitement, IT DOESN'T GET ANY BETTER! I can't say enough about XO tour staff. Tai Dang, Houng and Hai are very fluent in English. They are very knowledgeable of their country's history and proud of their City.They took us through some of the best and we saw some of the less fortunate areas. We walked through market stalls were only locals shopped, where a tourist or an ex-pats is rarely seen. It was a Saigon tour busses don't take their tourists. We ate local and shopped local and had the most exciting experience at this stop on our cruise. If you're on a tour and Saigon is a stop, set up a tour of the city on the back of a motorbike with XO Tours. You will never regret it or forget the experience.

Great evening of food, fun and entertainment - Four beautiful young ladies picked up our group at the hotel. During the evening, we must have covered 10-15 miles throughout 5-7 city districts. When it rained briefly, we stayed dry with panchos. Stopped at a variety of locations for food, beer and wine. Tried some new foods that were interesting and delicious. The only thing I couldn't eat was the duck embryo which is apparently a delicacy in Vietnam. It was tasty but I just couldn't deal with it mentally. Our hosts were delightful and engaging. I highly recommend this tour.

Great fun and great food - I thought this would be scary once I'd seen the traffic in Saigon but the women drivers are really good. We were picked up from the hotel by our drivers and taken to join the group of 6 other guests. We were taken to three different eating establishments plus a couple of sight seeing stops. The drivers even shelled our crab claws and prawns for us, as well as teaching us a bit about our food. There was also a tour guide and a discreet photographer so that we received photos of the evening afterwards by email. Brilliant fun!

Amazing! Highlight of HCMC! - Do this! The tour was recommended to us by another couple we met in HCMC, and we have since recommended to several others on this trip. Absolutely the best way to experience the traffic and street food. Our drivers were very experienced and so personable. The wife was hesitant at first, with the traffic and general chaos of it all. They quickly put her completely at ease. Really can't give them a high enough rating.

Tour - Wow!!!
Great way to explore Saigon.
Well organized, friendly staff, very professional, and they on every detail. Highly recommended!!!
Thank you guys for a wonderful adventure.
Oded Levi

Best experience - As other reviewers have stated on here, after seeing the chaos known as Saigon traffic we weren't sure about our booked trip but we were so glad to have done it. I would recommend the Foodie Tour to everyone. We went in a group of eight and were so well looked after from being picked up from the hotel to every meal and part of the trip. Our drivers Ngoc and Thao were lovely and friendly and gave great advice as we zoomed around the streets and made us feel extremely safe. Great night!

The reviews are true - Am gonna keep this short as I agree with all of the excellent reviews and recaps here. This is an absolute must do when in Ho Chi Minh. And even though you may want to say no, if you don't try the Balut at the end of the night, you have failed. Ask for them to drop you off at the Caravalle or Rex for a nightcap on the rooftop bars.

Excellent way to explore Ho Chi Minh City - Everything about this tour was excellent, and I would highly recommend the Foodie tour to anyone who wants to immerse themselves in Ho Chi Minh City. We were taken to places that we would never have found ourselves, and having a local guide gave us an opportunity to learn lots about the City. There was so much food, and it was all so delicious that I really wished I had a second stomach!

Exciting bike ride!!!!! - after looking at the madness on the streets of HCMC I was unsure we had done the right thing by booking a scooter tour, but after just one minute we all said we felt completely relaxed and had full confidence in the girls. The information given to us throughout the morning was both interesting and fun, if you're in HCMC go and do this tour you won't regret it.

Exciting tour of Saigon by scooter - We have just experienced the highlight of our trip so far. We took the evening street food tour on the back of the scooters and what a way to experience the real side of Saigon. We were slightly apprehensive to say the least after seeing the sheer number of bikes on the roads, however we need not have worried. We were immediately put at ease by our lovely drivers Chaing and Hang. We learned a lot about Saigon from both the drivers and the team leader Huia. We were taken to many districts not usually visited by tourists and ate some really delicious food en route. The highlight was however simply driving through the highways roads and back streets of this fascinating city. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone!

Absolute must do tour in Saigon - This tour is amazing. The people running it are sensational, all super friendly and give you so much knowledge about Saigon. The girls driving the bikes are fantastic and give you information about the city along the way

The food is incredible and it gives you a taste of what the locals eat. The tour also takes you to places in the city you might not go unless you're on this tour.

Excellent value for money and a super fun tour

The Only Way to Experience Ho Chi Minh City - Having never been on the back of a bike before I was a little wary but excited. I needn't have worried, right from the moment we met the girls and our guide we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Khoi, our guide, told us so many interesting facts and stories about the history of the city and even took us to taste desserts and drinks in the local market. The drivers were brilliant and although I was a little nervous at the start, they were confident competent drivers and we both enjoyed the ride. This is the only way to really appreciate the city as the bikes can go through markets and side streets where coach tours cannot. I cannot fault this tour - it was excellent

First Class! - I spent a delightful evening with XO Tours. These are basic scooter tours and the driver is also our guide. The tour was well organized and if not for this tour I would have gone back with a different impression of Saigon. My guide and driver Tina was excellent and drove me for about 4 hours safely and confidently. On the way she shared interesting facts about life and culture in Saigon. I chose for a food tour and it had five stops. Two stops were for sightseeing and three food stops. We got to sample local delicacies and let me warn you, no matter how much you like the food just taste it and leave the rest because there's more coming ! Tai the manager was superb in his presentation and made us feel special. For us it was a tour like no other. There were several surprises through out and I don't want to kill the fun by revealing it. They clicked plenty of pictures of us and mailed it back to us. Definitely a great way to see and taste Saigon. No need to check for a better tour company, pick this one and you will thank me.

Best way to see Ho chi Min city and you'll have fun! - I booked myself on 2 tours of Ho chi with Xo tours - a day time city tour, and a night time tour. Both of these were fantastic and I had so much fun. You'll get to experience the hustle and bustling city life on the back of a motorbike driven by a female representative. The whole team at Xo tours were really good fun and I'd recommend this tour company to anyone if you are going to Ho chi for a small amount of time and want to see the main parts. Plus you'll have fun, fun and lots of fun!

Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City - Such a lot of fun, great food and an EXTREMELY PROFESSIONAL company!! Very interesting and a little scary in the beginning! Being ridden through the traffic by very experienced young lady motorbike riders. I fully understand why they are Number 1 on TripAdvisor! I would do the tour again in a heartbeat! Thanks to Triang and An for taking my wife and I safely from one excellent food place to another!! Book it - it's so much fun!

Amazing Foodie Tour! Just Do It! - This tour is rated #1 for a reason and they are the best - from the fantastic guides/drivers to the delicious food. Touring Saigon by scooter is an adventure not to be missed and we loved it! Our guides, Twee and Moon, were expert drivers, super friendly and so much fun. We ventured into districts outside the typical tourist areas and were given insight into the daily life of residents. We were met at each stop by the tour leader, Khoi, who gave an overview of the area and also took pics during the entire evening and emailed them all to us a couple of days later. We took the Night Foodie Tour so each stop included interesting, delicious Vietnamese specialties. Outstanding tour! Thank you Twee and Moon for an unforgettable evening!

Foodie tour and Sights tour - I did the foodie tour and Sights tour with XO tours. Personally the foodie tour was my favourite. I have been travelling around Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia for 6 weeks and these tours, especially the foodie tour was one of the highlights of my entire trip. The girls are an asset to the company. They make you feel safe, and are clever, whitty and so caring. Initially I was a little worried about being on a scooter but within minutes of being in rush hour traffic my guide, Quine No.3 (I hope I have this correct!), made me feel at ease, she knew what she was doing!
The tour leaders are equally as brilliant and everyone seems to enjoy their work. The entire thing is such a smoothly run operation. Whizzing through the streets is a great experience no matter which one you do. Keep up the good work XO!

Only way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - Everything about this tour is fabulous! We had so much fun exploring Saigon on scooters with the best ever tour guides. The trip was fun from the word go! I can not recommend this guided tour enough to fellow travelers. Please do it!!
The girls (and the guys) are friendly, professional and extremely knowledgeable. We covered the entire city in the day and did another food tour the same evening. The foods we tasted, the sights we saw, the history we learned, we could have not done a quarter of the stuff on our own in three days.
Loved and enjoyed every minute of our tour. Wishing the xo gals and the guys very best!

Spectacular Foodie tour - We joined the night foodie tour, and it was one of the highlights of our HCMC trip. My husband and I had a wonderful time with our entertaining driver/hosts Loan and Hoa, our tour leader Tai made the trip fun and memorable as well. We really liked the hospitality they showed, I felt at ease right away considering I hate riding on motorcycles. We were given a beautiful tour of the different districts with accompanying insights and inside info for each particular district which was really interesting. The food was good too! I am a picky eater and I would say that it is not the usual vietnamese food that we get in the Philippines they showed us what the locals eat and it was really delicious!! Crabs, scallops were fresh and tasty!! The tour was worth it! Would love to do it again :)

An awesome way to get a local feel of Saigon - This is an extremely professionally run company. I anticipated The nightFoodie tour would be the highlight of our SE Asia trip and it didn't disappoint. It was educational, fun and the food was interesting. Tai, our tour leader, was fantastic - passionate, personable, and fun. Our drivers were also amazing - fun and interesting.

Highly recommend this company and its Foodie Tour. I imagine their other tours are also very good.

"An Amazing Night Out" - After witnessing the crazy traffic in Vietnam, we were a bit skeptical about our booking for XO foodie tours. A bit nervous on our drive to the first destination we were soon comfortably sitting behind our drivers. My driver Lin and my mums driver were very friendly, telling us about the city and lifestyle of Vietnam as we drove around and we felt extremely safe with their top notch driving skills. Tai, who was running the foodie tour that night was a wonderful, light-hearted and funny guide who made the whole trip great.

The food was amazing! Even though we already felt full midway, we just couldn't stop eating. We tasted foods that we would have never thought of trying in Vietnam and throughout the food stops we drove to other districts for a bit of sightseeing. I learned a lot about Vietnam's culture and lifestyle in those few hours. It was a fun, tasty, cultural experience and I would recommend this to anyone.

Bec

XO Food Tours - had a blast! - I wanted to rate the food tour 4 stars because it is a lot of money but I just couldn't do it. I had so much fun on this tour. I loved riding on the back of the motorbike through the crazy Saigon traffic. My guide was wonderful. The stops were all unique and interesting. I got lots of good pictures and XO sent me some too. And I got to try some food I never would have tried otherwise. I highly recommend this tour.,

The Best Way To Experience Saigon! - This was everything we expected and more. Riding on the back of scooters driven expertly by smart, professional Vietnamese girls, we were taken to several districts of this wonderful city so we could taste some incredible food carefully selected for it's authenticity and flavor. We joined up with other travelers so our group totaled around a dozen people from around the world. The team leader, Tai, explained about the food and location at each stop providing us with great background information. Meanwhile, my driver, Diem, safely ferried me between stops chatting in excellent English and telling me more about Saigon and Vietnam itself. The drivers really are the stars of this show and I can't speak highly enough of Diem who was great company all the way through. All the other travelers said the same thing about their drivers too. The food was wonderful and varied. We started off with a classic Bun Bo Hue a very tasty beef and pork noodle soup. Then at the next stop we were treated to grilled ochra, goat breast, succulent beef, large tasty prawns and finally some delicious frog! Washed down with a bottle of Saigon beer of course. Next food stop once again contained multiple dishes, a kind of Vietnamese tapas almost, consisting of beautiful scallops, crab, clams, quail and finally a delicacy of duck egg embryo which tasted much better than it sounds. The sugar-cane drink at this stop was very refreshing also. I may have missed a dish or two as there was so much food on offer! I had a great trip to Vietnam but this tour with Xe-Om scooters was by far the best thing we did and if you don't do it, in my opinion, you are missing out greatly. Ten out of ten.

Best scooter tour in Saigon - We booked the Sights tour (morning) and the Foodie tour in 1 day and it turned out to be the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We went with another family, so 6 of us in total, and were a bit apprehensive at first especially after experiencing the traffic in Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) on the ride from our airport. But they were really experienced and safe drivers on both our tours. We felt comfortable after only a few minutes.

The drivers were very courteous and more important, very good in English -not easy to find in Vietnam. The morning tour had us zipping along to various historical places in Saigon. This is just a highlight tour so apart from the Post Office, you don't really get to go inside the landmarks (ie Reunification Palace - you just see the outside). We had a snack in one of their markets where the yogurt was amazing. In fact, all the food we sampled were great especially during the Foodie tour. Not your typical restaurant type of food, it's more street food. They were tasty, different and safe - no one had stomach issues after our tour which was a relief as we took the tour just after we arrived in Vietnam.

If you don't have a lot of time to spend in Saigon, go for one of their tours. It may be on the expensive side compared to others but it is well worth it. If you are on a small group, you'll be mixed in with other people. In our case as we had 6, we ended up being the only ones on our tour. So it turned out to a private tour by 'accident'.

A shout out to Anh, our tour leader and the girls for an unforgettable time in Saigon. We hope to come back again in the future.The pictures they provided were really good as well as the video (optional on the tour).

Best comprehensive food tour - The girls were there right on time for pick up and felt so at ease with their expert riding skills despite weaving through the crazy traffic of HCMC. Started off in the following order and the tour manager Tai was there to take us through the whole tour from stop 1.
1. Bun bo hue soup. Traditional and light flavorful soup was our first stop. Had the vegetarian option with tofu, noodles ,mushrooms..raw banana shavings ..morning glory flower bean sprouts etc.
2. Stop in district 5 to explain the origin of business and how life goes on in the Chinese market.
3. District 8 for a food stop after a drive through the local market. The girls literally taught us how to pair and eat the dishes and played a game with chop sticks. Had amazing local beer and I was served special veggie options. The jumping chicken was a good try for the adventure.
4. District 7 was the next stop and we got to see a different side of Vietnam. Here is where the expats live and everything seems like out of Singapore or Melbourne.
5. Last stop was Dist 4. The food was again local delicious and sumptuous with a great variety and the girls to guide us.
Tai the tour manager needs special mention for his witty and crisp summation during the stops.
The girls rode safely and securely.
One of the most exhilarating food tours I have ever done.
Good way to get a comprehensive grip of the city, its districts and flavorful food in the most local way possible.
Must do when in HCMC.

Very good service recovery - Our booked tour was mistakenly placed on a different date resulting us missing our tour but XO tours attempted to schedule us on the next available tour which we declined as it clashes with our route. The next day, we received a letter from the hotel Recep; it was an apology letter from XO tours and they offered complimentary tour the next time we visit HCMC. The letter was personal and we believe they will be a very good guide so we join their tour next time.
A good way to explore Vietnam - We tried the foodie and it was fun. It was quite expensive at uad 75 each but it was worth it. Had fun

Fabulous! - This night was so much fun, We had great food, visited 5 districts in Saigon- each unique and interesting- experienced night traffic on a scooter winning in and out of alleys, highways and TRAFFIC - an absolute blast - with great drivers and 6 other travelers. Our driver/guides were wonderful- fun, hospitable and great to spend the evening with. This tour is a must! A real highlight of our trip.

Private Foodie Tour and Custom Tour - We had an excellent night and day tour with XO Tours. We were mostly interested in eating good, local cuisine and visiting outdoor markets in Saigon. Our guides combine outdoor markets with delicious, local restaurants our first night, and historical or interesting sights in between stopping for delicious food or drinks, the next day. We visited almost every district in Saigon and felt we saw more of the city, than the average tourist. Our guides were friendly, funny and very good drivers, we had fun seeing Saigon from the back of their bikes!

Fantastic Night Out - Fun, informative, GREAT food - This is an excellent way to experience HCMC. You'll get the thrill of riding on a scooter in the busy traffic, lots of interesting information from the delightful hosts, a look at a range of neighborhoods (which most tourists will never see), and of course THE FOOD.
We had an amazing evening with Bing and Tao (spelling ?) who participated to our every need throughout the night. We ate at several restaurants, and also stopped along the way for a bit of insight into the various neighborhoods.
We also felt very safe - competent drivers, a tour guide in addition to our own guide, two additional staff on scooters who took care of parking the scooters/security/safety, as well as a photographer. We received a delightful selection of photos from XO about two days after our tour - a very nice touch!
If I had to do this again, I'd put this tour at the beginning of the trip - as the information about local culture, various foods etc will be helpful throughout a visit to Vietnam.
As far as cost is concerned, I think it was worth every penny. You can probably find cheaper options, but I think XO offers an unparalleled experience in HCMC.

Thanks Bing & Tao for an incredible experience from your Canadian friends!

Amazing!!!! Worth every penny - This tour was absolutely incredible - we went on our last night in Ho Chi Minh and we definitely hadn't experienced the real Vietnam before this! Our guides Lynne and Nhi were fantastic - fluent English, super friendly and made us feel at ease. The food wasn't particular to my taste but regardless the trip was worth every penny as we learned so much about local culture (2 of the 5 stops for sightseeing but not your typical) and learned so much from our tour guides from
Chatting when on the bikes

Highlights of Vietnam Trip - We took the Foodie Tour one night while staying in Saigon and couldn't believe how much fun it was. Enjoying safe street food at many places was a treat. However, the real fun was riding on the back of a scooter through the crazy streets of Saigon. The trips are well organized and safe. The price seems a little high but well worth the cost.

Foodie tour - Did the foodie tour in a group of 6 and it was a great experience. The drivers speak fluent English and are very friendly and are very experienced in driving around the city. The tour was very well planned and everything ran so smoothly. Definitely not one to miss!

Aurora enjoyed - We really enjoyed our foodie tour. Great fun zooming round Ho Chi Min City on the back of a scooter. We traveled to a number of districts. The girl drivers spoke good English & we felt safe on the back. Tried a number of different foods at 3 venues.
If I was being picky, a bit more vegetarian type food would help (there was a lot of meat / seafood) and maybe get away from setting seating positions within the group to allow more socializing with everyone in the group.
That being said, I still think it an excellent tour.

Awesome Food Tour, but Consider the Value - Our group of four had a fantastic evening with XO Food Tours, but we left questioning the value/cost of the experience.

First, the lady tour guides are truly wonderful and the whole experience runs so smoothly. The guides all speak excellent English and seem sincerely interested in speaking about Vietnam and their experiences in HCMC, as well as learning about our own travels. Each stop along the way provides a different eating experience, from cooking on a tabletop stove to slurping scallops while seated at tiny, plastic sidewalk chairs. All in all, the food was great and the guides made us feel at home.

Cons: you are literally spoon-fed the entire evening, making the tour seem much less interactive and adventurous. Of course, some travelers appreciated that level of service, but it took some of the fun out of it for us. Second, in hindsight, I find it difficult to justify the cost. After taking many tours throughout Vietnam, we received more bang for our buck most everywhere else. You could do a self-guided food tour of HCMC for a WEEK for the cost of this tour.

If you appreciate a very attentive guide and want absolutely every aspect of a food tour taken care of for you, this tour fits the bill. But if you're like us and want something that feels more grass roots and adventurous, save your money and create your own tour, you'll have just as much fun.

Such a fun and interesting tour - highly recommend! - I joined the evening Foodie Tour as part of my solo trip around Asia based on a recommendation from family, and it was truly excellent. The lady driving the scooter I was on was really interesting and welcoming, whilst the tour manager Tai was fun, entertaining and knowledgeable (as were the other ladies driving scooters). The atmosphere was great from the start, the choices of food stops really good, the sightseeing locations fascinating, and the whole experience just so worth the money. I felt safe and comfortable on the bike, and riding around the city at night was thrilling. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough - a must-do if you're in Saigon.

Motor scooter tour - This was one of the highlights of our trip. I was nervous about traveling on the back of the scooter, but the guides were so careful and attentive it was a breeze. The guides were so kind and caring. THE ONLY WAY TO SEE THE CITY AND MEET THE MOST WONDERFUL PEOPLE.
A must do and I am not the adventurous type.
Don't miss out!!!
❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤

Foodie Tour - What a fantastic tour. You really do experience HCMC as a local with brilliant guides! Our guides were Trang and Huyen who really looked after us. My wife was extremely nervous but was put at ease very quickly by Huyen.

We had so much fun - The personal is great, the service is great. We have a family of 5, kids are aged 7,14 and 17. We all enjoyed the tour and ate a lot of strange and not so strange things. The guides where funny and nice. We recommend this tour!

Foodie tour - It was nice experience and took about 5 hrs. Food was very good. Service was great. We rode in motor bikes driven by ladies dressed in their traditional costumes. Anh, the tour group leader was very accommodating host. He had important bits of trivia and information about Vietnam, its customs, culture and the people. The tour is very entertaining and exciting.

Best night in Saigon - Really good food, drivers, and tour leader. I felt lucky to have Quin as my driver and Tai as our tour group leader. Their English was very good and they made the night informative, while still joking around and making sure everyone had a good time. I don't think a food tour could be much better, the bun bo hue and bbq were my favorites.

Outstanding food and city tour - This tour gets a huge rating on trip advisor - for good reason ! It is such a good way to get the total Saigon experience in 4 hours - to experience what it like on the bikes around the city , get given some wonderful insights into the city and its workings plus the added bonus of eating all types (l mean all types) of Vietnamese dishes . If you are all concerned about being on the back of a bike in a crowded city don't - the girls are all experienced riders (been traveling that way all their lives) and they really only go about 30 kms at max. The group of supporters to our trip made everything extremely simple and easy and the choices of venues were fantastic in its variance. Everyone has rated this tour extremely highly - am here to tell you they are all correct - don't miss this !

Two tours in a day - We decided that the best way to get our bearings in Saigon was to take a scooter tour. Since we couldn't decide on which tour to take, we elected to go on one tour in the morning and then the foodie tour at night. We had a blast. The morning tour gave us the highlights of the important and historic sites in the city and the evening gave us a balance of good food and more history - all while securely balanced on the back of a scooter. The girls driving the scooters may be small, but they are highly accomplished drivers - never feel nervous. What a fun day. Highly recommend!

Great food, excellent drivers - There were eight in our group for the night foody tour on scooters, not counting our guide Sang and the 'body guards' that followed us the entire evening.
