We tasted a variety of dishes from, goat, frogs legs, and beef to shrimp, scallops and duck egg embryo. All the dishes were a great taste experience. Each course was explained so we knew what to expect before taking a bite.
The divers, all ladies, were very experienced and we felt safe at all times even when driving through the most congested areas.
I would highly recommend this tour for the food, for the great drivers and get a different perspective of saigon city at night on the back of a scooter
Saigon by scooter! - My wife and I had a back of the bike tour with XO. It's my best experience ever. Saigon is so busy and having a good driver to take you around exploring the city is so amazing!

Best tour ever! - How much did we love our tours with XO tours?? So much, that when I am in Saigon again, I will use them to see more of the city! We had a sights tour as well as a foodie tour with them during our visit. Our two tour leaders Sang and Tai were extremely knowledgeable and we came away with a better understanding of Saigon's history. I also suggest getting the video that they offer, not only was it great fun, but we had photos from them as well after three days. All of our drivers were fun, safe and professional. There was lots of laughter, conversation and we all felt like friends in the end! The food tour had five stops, three of them with food, and all at small local restaurants where often we were the only "white" people eating there with the locals. They cater for food allergies and vegetarians, even having extra options for the one person in our party that did not like seafood. Make your reservations early, as they are a very popular tour company! We saw the sights and also lesser known sights and markets, we really got a great taste of the city in our two days there. We also traveled here from our cruise, and they worked within our schedule there!

Nice bike ride around the city - The tour was well organized and touched a number of districts in HCMC. Driver was very friendly and kept the whole group engaged throughout the tour. Team leader was very knowledgeable and there was an interesting conversation on the differences between Communism and Capitalism during one of the stops. I would definitely recommend this to anyone

Fun introduction to Saigon - My mum and I signed up for their half day Sights Tour, highly recommend as your first stop to Saigon. It's an excellent introduction to Saigon and get your bearings of the vibrantly hectic city.

Our tour leader and bikers are safe and friendly. They worked hard to make sure our trip was a good one. The girls even helped us find the right place (and price) for cushion covers.

My mum is 67 years old and she really enjoys herself with no worries. We felt safe throughout the journey (considering Saigon's chaotic traffic!).

Don't hesitate and sign up!

Excellent way to quickly get around the city - Our two lady riders were very professional and had a great sense of humour! The trip was great fun and very informative. They expertly weave through the busy streets stopping at markets and places of interest. Highly recommended.

Must do - our Vietnam highlight. - We loved this tour!! Can only echo the sentiments of the other positive reviews and thank our tour leader Khoi and our guides Anh and Linh.

Absolutely phenomenal experience whizzing around Saigon on motos and finding out more about the city and the different districts. So exhilarating and intriguing.

There is so much food and we loved how varied it was and different to what we had tried in our previous 2 weeks in Vietnam. We were apprehensive about the food as we'd had a bad experience in Hanoi. Our guides were so understanding and supportive that we didn't feel any pressure to try any dishes or to eat more than we were comfortable eating. Everything was so delicious, clean and safe!

The tours are exceptionally well organized and thoughtfully curated to connect like-minded people so that the evening is fun and sociable as well as full of food and wonder.

We were extremely impressed by the logistics and attention to detail - it would put some Australian tours to shame and in our experience there just isn't that level of service standard in the rest of Vietnam and therefore well worth the price.

Not often you come away from a 4 hour experience with friends but that is how it felt saying goodbye to Linh and Anh. Very grateful we got to experience the XO Foodie Tour.

Great tour with XO tour - I had a great and awesome time touring with XO Tours. They really take good care of you from the start to the end. Booked the Saigon by night tour and they were prompted in replying to my booking.

Friendly and truly nice girls. They will introduce you to their culture. Ask them anything about Vietnam because they know everything.

Time allocated for the tour was appropriate, not too long and not too short. They really put a smile on each and everyone's face.

No complaints at all. Tours not to be missed!

The perfect way to see HCMC! - I did the nighttime food tour and the city sights tour - both of which were great introductions to a city with a lot to see.

The guides and drivers were absolute joys to be around and I would highly recommend these tours to anyone once they get into HCMC.

Great fun!!!! - A group of us went on an XO Food Tour. It was fabulous! We saw parts of the city we would never have seen. We ate at places we never would have known about. The drivers were fantastic!!!!! Highly recommend doing this!!!!

I had to do it, so I did it again! - Last year I did the night food tour and had such a great experience, that I had to do it again when visiting with my wife this year. And once again it did not disappoint but exceeded expectations. What makes this tour great? Well while it is a ton of fun riding around the city on motorbikes, and experiencing some fantastic food beyond the pho and spring roll, what makes it great is the entire staff of XO. All are exceptional. For this trip a special shout out to our drivers Binh Nguyen and Trang Nam. They are what made it such a neat time for my wife and I. So much that I am sure we will do the trip again! So quit reading reviews and just book a tour with XO now!

Food tour on motorbike - Best experience in Saigon so far. What an incredible way to see the city, and more importantly, try the food! About a 5 hour tour, and required of 14 courses. Each more delicious than the next. And the food isn't watered down for tourists, either. You will eat some interesting dishes, so come to it with an open mind. You won't be disappointed! Now for the motorbikes. You won't be the one riding. Just holding on tightly in the back. The experience is surreal, to say the least. There are 10 million people in the metro area, and 7 million motor bikes. You will quickly understand what I mean by surreal! The tour guides are absolute professionals though. At no point did I feel insecure. In fact, we (party of 8) all felt exhilarated by it. I can't recommend this tour enough. It was recommended by a friend and his wife, and am ever grateful for it. You will be too.

Saigon Foodie Tour - What a fantastic trip we had getting driven around ho chi min city on back of mopeds by two lovely Vietnamese girls . They drove us around many different districts of Ho chi min where we tried many different types of food which all tasted fantastic. Me and my wife really enjoyed the trip and highly recommend this tour and we also met some lovely people.

Must do!! - Traveling through Vietnam I and 2 friends wanted to learn more about Ho Chi Minh and Vietnamese food and somehow came to XO tours. We could not have made a better choice!! The food tour we did was planned great, we felt comfortable with the girls (they are all awesome!) immediately and well taken care of. We saw places of the city we would have never seen and experienced otherwise, learned a great deal of Vietnam (there's not only war stories being told here) and indulged in the food culture. If you can get a spot on any of XO's tours - grab it, it is FABULOUS!!!!

Amazing tour - I would just like to Thank XO tours for a fantastic day in Ho Chi Minh, my husband and I did two tours as we were only in the city for one full day. The staff on both tours were very professional, friendly and welcoming, I was very nervous as I had never been on a scooter before and to have my first ride in Ho Chi Minh but both girls were fantastic and I felt perfectly safe. The foodie tour was a lot of fun and all the places we were taken too were clean and the food was excellent. The same couldn't be said for my use of chopsticks!! It was my birthday the day we did the tours and at our last eating destination they had arranged a birthday cake for me. I was so touched. I know people complained that it wasn't all eating, I enjoyed being driven around the city at night, seeing all the different districts allowing time for my food to settle. This tour gave us a chance to meet some lovely Vietnamese girls who all spoke very good English and were very informative. I would particularly like to mention Quynh 2 and Loan 3 our evening guides. So much fun. I wish all your staff and your company all the best for the future and providing the service you offer I am sure you will continue to thrive. If you are considering this tour just book it and have an amazing experience.

HO Chi Minh on wheels - Just back from a fabulous weekend in Ho Chi Minh where we booked the attractions XO tour on the Saturday morning. What a wonderful adventure and great way to get around and get a feel for how the locals do it. Our tour guide Koi was extremely knowledgeable and very informative explaining the history of all our stops, and the Drivers were so kind and caring of us. Will definitely be back to try their foodie tour next time. Highly recommended.

Foodie Tour with XO tours - We did the Foodie tour and overall enjoyed the experience, however, living in HCMC and knowing what the prices are, especially in the local areas, the tour is pretty overpriced. We did three stops for the food and I wish the stops were a bit differently organized. Our guide told us to pace ourselves since there will be a lot of food and they will be ordering until everyone was full. That was definitely true, however, the last stop consisted of duck embryos and other pretty brave food. Even though everyone tried all the different options, it wasn't really the type of food you can keep ordering and eating and so no one really ordered any extra. We loved that they introduce that type of food but that should be the first stop where everyone tries a bit and is then able to keep eating and ordering more at the next two stops where they served shrimp, beef and other barbeque that people would be able to keep ordering and enjoying. We left so much room for the last stop and didn't leave the tour hungry but we definitely regretted not ordering more at the earlier stops.

Exciting Experience and a lot of fun! The Foodie Tour was the best! - We took the Foody Tour and it surpassed our expectations! We took this tour in the last day in Saigon. Three nice ladies picked us up outside of our hotel and gave us safety instructions and a big smile in their face. I was with my husband and my mother. I was a little worried about my mother, because she was 66 and I was not sure if riding in a motorbike was going to be safe for her. Just riding in the back of the scooter among dozens of other motors and cars in just AMAZING!! The air in your face, looking around and seeing other local riders holding their new births, toddlers, or their spouses is just amazing. We stopped in 4 street restaurants, where the food was DELICIOUS!! You end up being part of a larger group of people, which is great because of the more merrier! It is all about your attitude and openness of embracing new culture and people. Our 3 tour guides were knowledgeable, careful to drive, and just very nice with us. If we go to Saigon again, we will do it again! GO FOR IT and have the best attitude and enjoy your trip!
A don't miss! - Join in the mayem and go for the ride. Incredible fun and quite informative. A true highlight of the visit to the city.

Very Overpriced - Not a 100% food tour (like Istanbul Eats). Combination of food tour and life in HCMC tour. Three of the stops are restaurants. Four hours overall. You ride on the back of scooter..a little challenging at first, but easy to adjust. Great way to see the different districts in the city.. but $75 US per person is ridiculous. Went on a great walking food tour in Can Tho, granted smaller city and we walked, but same number of food stops and with tip it was $7!! Yes this tour is fun, but it just not worth $150 US for a couple.

Don't be scared - Just Do It! The highlights - This is my second time in Ho Chi Min and I was too daunted the 1st time to risk being on a scooter in that traffic! Walking across the road was enough (although I got used to it quite quickly) and the thought of being on a scooter was a bridge to far. I have my motorbike license and ride most days in my big city...but Saigon?!

BUT - with my 22 year old female guide (less than half my weight at a guess) at the helm - we ventured out into peak hour traffic.

She was fantastic, I felt quite safe early on and then very comfortable after about 20 mins. All the girls were great, they knew the sites, knew the road and were fantastic hosts and representatives of their growing country....and the food was fantastic. Again on my 1st list I was too scared to add ice into my water even at the 5 star hotel... don't wait like I did for the Next time...do it this time.

Good luck and have fun.

Fantastic Immersion in City Life - i booked the half day morning sightseeing tour by motorbike
collection from the hotel was timely and my motorbike drivers Ms Chang was skilful, safe friendly and professional
we met with other members of the tour and were transported around the city to many different sites and attractions
at each place our guide met us and gave a knowledgeable, informative and humourous talk
the best bit was traveling around the city as a passenger on a bike - along with the local commuters

Helmet on, hold tight and enjoy the ride - Having booked the tour in the calm of my home, arriving in Vietnam and seeing the mad traffic, made me question my decision but needn't have worried! Felt perfectly safe in the extremely competent driving of our guides who were delightful.
As I had some dietary restrictions, alternative dishes were provided so I ended up with more food than everyone else (and there was a lot of food!).
It was great fun and one of the highlights of our fantastic holiday. Would definitely recommend to anyone who is visiting HCMC.

Great experience! - We had a wonderful morning with XO Tours doing the market tour. Our drivers were such lovely ladies who were extremely friendly and informative. The drive through the Ho Chi Minh City streets is not for the faint hearted! The only way to drive around this city is on a scooter as its so much quicker - I've never experienced traffic like this before! We went to a local market where we were the only tourists. Unfortunately it was "Black Friday" on our day of shopping, so as u can imagine the market was chaotic! Once we finished there, were were scootered off to a street where locals bought shoes, as this is what we were wanting to buy. Our guides did the talking and price negotiations which was a huge help as the English was non-existent! We bought trainers and sandals for half the price of the tourist market! Thank you to the XO team for a wonderful experience and for helping us negotiate great prices.

X-Tremely Fabulous Foody Tour Experience - We were promptly picked up at our hotel (after a late booking the night before) by our two very friendly tour guides. Off we went into all the crazy wild Saigon streets which was a great experience in itself. We drove to many different districts of Ho Chi Minh City, including very interesting Chinatown, and stopped at three different places to eat various foods we would have never known about otherwise.
Highly recommend and would do another tour with them again.

Amazing Experience - The XO team provided a thrilling experience, riding on the back of scooters we visited a number of different neighbors with contrasting foods and surroundings. Our riders and guides were very knowledgeable, kind and friendly and it was an unforgettable experience.

Foodie tour - Flying visit to ho chi minh city so wanted to see as much as possible whilst experiencing some local food. Picked up by four lovely girls, excuse the spelling queen, anh, ting and quan. We also had two young men filming the trip. Quite nervous being on the back of a moped in such a busy place but the girls were very safe drivers. Saw a lot of the city with commentary enroute and extra info during stops from our guide koi. Food not really to my taste however when in ho chi minh and all that. Great night out and enjoyed by all our party. Thank you xo tours.

Great Way to Experience Saigon - Recommended by a friend, and was worth every penny. Great way to really get a feel for Saigon. The ladies are excellent guides and spend the entire time joking and chatting with you and making sure you have a great time. We were very well looked after and really enjoyed the whole experience.

Fantastic entrance out! - We did the foodie tour last night and it was certainly the highlight of our time in HCMC. This tour is the best way to see parts of Saigon that you wouldn't ordinarily get chance to see and the food was absolutely fantastic. Thank you all so much!

Amazing & fun motorbike tour - one of the highlights of our vacation - XO Tours is professional, responsive, fun and friendly, experienced and safe and I cannot recommend them enough. This was one of the highlights of our three week trip to Vietnam.

I requested a custom tour for my family and me to see some of the key locations from the American / Vietnam war. We had a tight schedule so I needed a quick turnaround and was very impressed with their fast response time.

The girls were so friendly and personable and were very experienced drivers. It was important to me that my mom felt safe and secure on the motorbike and she had a great time - she was grinning the whole time.

Our tour guide, Sang, was incredible. My request, I learned during the tour, was unusual and Sang shared that the day before our tour, he did a bunch of research and went to visit each location on our tour first to make sure he had accurate information and historical pictures to share with us. I was so impressed with this and pleased that we didn't have a cookie cutter tour and deeply appreciated the educational and historical aspect. Sang also took some awesome photos of us and shared the historical ones he found as well.

I would absolutely do another tour with XO when I return to Vietnam and recommend everyone do a tour with them, whether it's one of their standard tours or a custom tour. They are FABULOUS.

A Remarkable Experience - This "foodie" tour was recommended to us by friends and is absolutely a must do Experience. The friends have children and took them on this tour so I would say it's something the whole family can do. The young women who drive the motorbikes and the young men who help out at each place are wonderful. Our head guide who provided information at each stop was very knowledgeable. You will experience not only the food eaten by the people of Vietnam as opposed to tourist fare but you will gain insight into the country. There may be one or two foods that you don't care to try and that's not a problem. The food is delicious though there was one item I chose not to sample.The areas of the city that we visited were not typical tourist places. The tour gives you many ideas of other places to go and things to do in Ho Chi Minh City. All I can say is go!!

Highly recommend the street food tour! - We stayed in HCMC night on our way to Nha Trang and would definitely recommend the XO tours street food tour. We even had a little bit of rain but it didn't take away from the experience at all. My wife and I felt safe the entire time and enjoyed our conversations with the young ladies hosting the tour. The food and drink was great and we felt like we got a relatively authentic experience for a tourist.

One of the Highlights of our trip - Fun fun night.

Shoutout to our tour leader Tai and guides Trinh and Quynh -- provided us with a good intro into Saigon.

They're upfront about not giving us the usual banh mi and pho food -- and it's ok!

Toured so many other districts as well, and gave us a big insight into Saigon life and culture.

Must do.

Amazing tour with amazing staff! - We had such a great time on the Saigon by night tour! The guides were outstanding, extremely knowledgeable and friendly. You definitely get to see a different side of Saigon you dont see on a typical tour. I would definitely recommend this tour!

Scooter is the best way to see and experience Ho Chi Minh City - This tour has so many excellent reviews already and it deserves them. This will expand your geographic and gastronomic horizons in the most fun way possible. Special thanks to my guide Thanh who was absolutely fantastic!

Tour by Vespa! - I can hardly imagine a more fun or more effective means to see highlights of HCMC in a limited amount of time! Transported by our "chauffeurs", Thuy (1) and Thao (1), my wife and I were taken around key landmarks of the city for 3 ½ hours, including a stop for a dessert snack in a local market plus a refreshing sugar cane drink while in transit. We had a ball! Their commentary was lively and fun, and we had an outstanding guide in Hieu Nguyen who met us at each destination. Our tour was on a Sunday morning, so traffic was a little less Ray than normal. At any other time how could one choose any other means of travel? Bravo and thanks we were delighted!

Great experience to see HCMC authentically - Loved everything about it. Very professional and friendly service. The extras made a nice touch, fruit, photos etc. All spoke perfect English and each guide gives very personal attention. I'm repeating with the night tour

Saigon City Morning Tour - Ezceptional. Our tour leader was very well educated and deep in the history of South Vietnam. We enjoyed the education, the tour, the very professional drivers and the team.

Great Fun...Yummy Food - Did the Foodie And Sights Tour with this mob and had a blast.

The Foodie Tour was our favorite and if you only do one tour in Ho Chi Minh this one is not to be missed. The guide and girls are awesome showing great hospitality. The food too being diverse and tasty.....and the beer flowed!

Highly recommend this Tour to anyone that can sit on the back of a bike....and for those who can't there's always gaffs tape! (Which they also provide to strap on the drunks)

A 7* experience!!! - For everyone visiting Saigon the XO tour is a must !! I do not have enough words for the crew .. The girls were excellent and competent . We did 2 tours -- sights & the foodie tour & I am vegetarian and still came back stuffed and happy from the foodie tour . The efficiency of the guide & the girls on both the tours that we did: Tuan , Thu, Phoung2& Khoi , Phuong3 , Linh & Tam with our videographer and helpers were too good .. The places we saw were never possible to see & experience without this team !! Loved the unique experience !!
Brilliant. - Foodie tour - can't think of any aspect that wasn't excellent. All I can do is add this to the thousands of other 5 star reviews. Just do it.

A real highlight of our HCMC experience - Day Sights & Foodie Nights Tours - My wife and I did both the day sights tour and the night food tour with XO Tours on Monday 6th February.

**Day Sights Tour**
Our guides collected us from our hotel and after introductions we were fitted for helmets before jumping on the back of the bikes and being whisked over to the meeting place outside the Post Office where we met our tour leader.

Don't be put off about going around on the back of a bike! Having seen the traffic in HCMC from taxis the previous day, we were nervous about being in that traffic on the back of a bike. We needn't have been - the ladies made sure we had a smooth and safe ride throughout. You'll get around quicker on a bike and see a lot more too.

This tour has everything - architecture, historic sites (and stories), local food and drink - it gave us a real sense of what HCMC is about. The ladies spoke great English and were happy to answer all of our questions as we went around. Our tour leader was interesting, organized and fun. We were buzzing when we got back from this tour - if I could give it 6 out of 5 I would!

**Foodies Night Tour**
The night tour has a number of stops in different districts around the city, so again is a great way to see a lot of HCMC in not much time! There were 3 food stops and 2 sight stops. The first food stop was at the meeting point where we had a delicious noodle soup. After that we went to a brilliant BBQ place, full of local people and cuisine. Our guides cook a variety of food on top of small table-top BBQs. The last of the food places was in the 'Mafia' district, which was good but probably didn't top the BBQ place. At each food place the tables, food and drink (free all night) were ready as soon as we arrived - great organization.

In between the food stops we drove through loads of different districts - which was a great way to see the city at night. We did one 'sights' stop on the edge of Chinatown and one in the newer development of District 7. This would be the only thing to consider in the future - I understand that we were trying to see lots of different places, but going from the electric atmosphere at the BBQ place to standing outside a closed shop in Chinatown dampened the atmosphere a bit. Similarly, a ride through district 7 rather than a 15 min stop there would possibly have kept the energy in the group a bit higher.

Food-wise, the team were very careful to check whether we had any allergies or things we wouldn't eat (so should cater to everyone). Because we didn't raise anything we were able to try some VERY different foods to what we typically have in the UK - thanks for helping us push our boundaries!!

**Overall**
Both tours were great - the team really made it a fun time and it was a real experience that we'll both look back on fondly. We also had photos taken of us by the tour guides during the trips sent over to us a couple of days later. We had a brilliant time and would highly recommend!
So lovely! - Girls are awesome, but the whole crew as well deserved nothing but the good words! Easy and fun to talk about everything. Very good english. So happy to pick this one :)
XO Tour - Fantastic, friendly and knowledgeable! Absolutely brilliant evening, with prompt collection. So well organized a must do if visiting HCMC.

A 5* Fantastic and Interesting Evening with Amazing Food. Do It! - It was a fantastic evening. Seeing Saigon from the back of a scooter is a unique way of seeing an extremely diverse and interesting city. While the traffic looks un-navigable to a foreigner, the lovely guides glide through it calmly and efficiently.
The food stops are authentic, and any dietary requirements are carefully catered for by your guide. I loved the food, the atmosphere, and the information provided by the knowledgeable guides. I would do this every night if I could. One of the best evenings I have had.

The best thing we did in HCMC!! - SO MUCH FUN!

Strap on a helmet, grasp the back of the scooter and say a Hail Mary as your driver dives into oncoming traffic! Welcome to Saigon!

Our drivers, Thao and Phoung, were delightful: entertaining, charming and fearless!
My husband is a vegetarian, and I don't eat mammals, which always earns us some side-eye on food tours, but our hosts were accomodating and honorable. We gorged on delicious broth Pho, the most clams, chili crab, sauteed veg, grilled frog (yep, you heard right), prawns, squid, and balut. I now dream about coconut jelly.

We covered 5 very different districts in the city. For that reason alone, I'd recommend this tour. You're right at street level, amidst the traffic, the pedestrians, the tiny alleyways and sidewalks. You see how the districts vary in culture, architecture, and way of life.
There is no way we'd have this kind of exposure to a city on foot or in a bus, or even a tuk tuk in one night. Our drivers share their knowledge and love of the city and the food.

Get out of your comfort zone, eat the best food you'll have in Vietnam, and book this tour now!

Foodie tour- A must do for foodies! - Absolute amazing time on this tour. Staff were extremely organized, safe, informative, and funny. We were picked up on time, given detailed itinerary, and lots of great information about the city as we drove around.

Excellent tour - My partner and I originally booked the city sights tour but we enjoyed it so much that we also booked the foodie tour the following night.

We learn so much about living in Vietnam. We definitely recommend this tour company

Click ride - My husband and I just finished our tour with XO and it was fantastic! Our drivers, Tom and Twin, were wonderful. They drove us in areas I would never imagine going and I loved it. Along the way we saw sites and they will have treats for us along the way. I won't spoil it by telling you what they were. I highly recommend the tour if you want to see Ho Chi Minh City.

THE BEST COMPANY - I would strongly recommend to each foreigner who visits Saigon to book a tour with XO. All the women are amazing and very friendly! The company is well organized and it's very easy to book with them and to have information from them. Just go and try the xo experience

Best experience - Great trip well worth it. Our drivers Ngoc and Trang were fantastic. They were really friendly, informative and above all made us feel really safe as passengers. We got to see quite a few of the different areas of HCMC which we otherwise wouldn't have seen. The quality of the street food was excellent. Souvenir photographs were emailed to us as promised. Overall this was one of our favorite trips within Vietnam and we will definitely do it again. If you are thinking of doing a scooter trip get it booked you will love it !

Easily the highlight of HCMC! - While in HCMC in December I went on an XO Tour. I booked at the last minute, but that wasn't a problem! What can I say, it was a truly wonderful evening. I was highly impressed by the drivers: all intelligent young women with business minds and strong English skills. But Quynh was the best! Finally this was my best night in HCMC, I got to experience so much of the city, and at the same time try lots of traditional Vietnamese cuisine. Definitely worth the price!

A MUST During Your Vietnam Visit - My friend and I did the "Saigon by Night" tour and were SO glad to have chosen this as the first thing to do upon our Ho Chi Minh arrival. By experiencing how it was to drive around on motorbikes just like the locals did, we could immediately get a better sense of Vietnam that we could take for the rest of our travel time there. The staff was incredible - my driver made the ride very comfortable by keeping me constantly engaged with interesting conversation about cultural differences and info about the city (she had GREAT English!). Our tour guide was so helpful, entertaining, funny, and informative as well. The rest of the staff was warm, friendly, and experienced, and this had to be the best tour we went on in Vietnam. It was highly organized, fun, and the food was SO good and enough for our dinner that night. Thank you, XO tours!

Highlight of Vietnam - My fiance and I did the night tour in January 2017. Xo was very prompt picking us up from our hotel and our drivers had excellent English skills. I had great conversation with my driver the whole night. We stopped at 5 different places all over the city, away from the tourist districts. My favorite were the scallops and BBQ, but all the food was interesting and delicious. Would highly recommend to anyone with a free day or night in Ho Chi Minh.

A lot of food on this tour - First of all I must thank the fact that the XO foodie tour was suitable for my vegetarian boyfriend. They were very attentive in arranging food that was appropriate for him. But it was too much food. I myself eat a lot and still, it was just too much. And we don't like to leave food to waste so it was hard to say no. The girls are great, very informative and helpful, but I'm a cook and very interested in understanding the food, techniques and felt they lacked a bit if this information, it's more of an eating tour, with many stops through the various districts of HCM. Nice that they sent the photos later. The tour lasts around 5 hours. Go VERY hungry!

Excellent Night! - This was such a fun and excellent way to learn about Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon). I wish we had done this on our first night there.

Everything was very timely, and thought through - food allergies, what to wear, what's next, etc. My husband and I had such a blast talking to the other travelers and the drivers. Everyone spoke English very clearly, some had spent some time in the US All the food and restaurants they chose were very local.

It is definitely on the pricier side for HCM, but it's well worth the money. We were so stuffed at the end and received so much knowledge on the current and past history and geography of the city.

One confusing thing is that they advertise that they hire all female tour guides... all our drivers were female, but our lead tour guide was a male!!!

The only way to see Saigon! - Although the thought of riding on the scooters was scary at first, it was a thrill and my driver Chang was very good. Anh was our guide and since he spent 10 years in California, his English was perfect. The variety of food was great and it was as much as you can eat. Beers were also included. The last place with the seafood, crab, clams and scallops was the best. The staff enjoyed their jobs and it showed. Great way to spend an evening.

Fantastic, delicious, and fun. - The Foodie tour was among the best we went on in SE Asia. XO is professionally run, safe, and a fantastic way to see a variety of districts and taste the food in Saigon. When you first get to Saigon you might be intimidated by the scooters. It seems like chaos, but honestly riding on a scooter was incredibly fun. The girls are high energy and very knowledgeable about their city. This is a must do if you are into culture, food and meeting interesting people.

Nice Way To See The Sights - Myself and a friend did the 3 hour city sightseeing tour in the morning. Was a great way to see the sights and experience the hectic city on the back of a scooter. Always feel safe riding through the crazy traffic of HCMC. All the guides were very friendly, knowledgeable and spoke excellent English.

Highly Recommended - We did the sights tour 9 January 2017 and couldnt speak more highly of the guides, organization and the wonderful insight to HCM. A must do to orient yourself to the city, sights & sounds. Photo's and memento of tour makes this one to remember.
Worth it for the ride - Good way to see a few sights in a short time. Best bit is the experience of scootering through HCMC traffic, sights themselves are less exciting

Fun night in Ho Chi Minh City! - Very fun last night in Ho Chi Minh City! As a solo traveler, it was really fun to do this and connect with other travelers and see a bit of the nightlife in the city. It would have been great to do this on my first night into the city as it provided a great overview to how it is laid out. Excellent guide and service throughout. Super fun!

The sights tour will give a new meaning to the historical Vietnam war pictures. - I took the sights tour on 22 January 2017 and it is about 4 hours. My flight was at night so I had a lot of time to spare. If you are looking for an overview of the city, I highly recommend the sights tour. The guide leader is very knowledgeable and fun and the XO girls are also just as fun too.

What I like most about this tour is that before to coming to Saigon I have seen alot of historical pictures taken during the Vietnam war. For example the CIA building evacuation, and the burning monk etc so visiting these sights where the event took place and hearing the stories from the guide gives a new dimension and perspective to the pictures.

One tip, don't carry heavy bags because you will be going around the city on the back of a motorcycle.

I'll do all the tours on my next visit - XO is a tour that had apprehensions mainly because of the motorbike riding. Glad I changed my mind. If you'll be riding a motorbike in Ho Chi Minh, better do it with them. And the day tour was excellent. I especially love the trip to the market and eating everything they offered. If given a chance, I would book all the tours they offer.

Most Authentic way to see Ho Chi Minh City - My husband and I toured HCMC last month with Won and Quin. They were fabulous! I couldn't believe how they moved through the chaotic traffic. They took us to some of the must-see sites as well as some local spots we would never have found on our own. We loved this tour!!

Highlight of a Ho Chi Minh Visit - This is the second time I've taken Foodie Tour. I came with eleven of my golfing buddies and wanted to share with them this fantastic experience.

The girls arrived on time and they showed the group the dos and don'ts of riding a motorbike safely. You will experience the thrill of weaving through the crazy Saigon traffic with thousands of motorbikes around you. Some of the bikes will literally be inches from you as your experienced drivers take you around the city. You will visit Districts that are not normally visited by tourists.

On the first stop, you will be introduced to your Tour Manager who will explain the food and the routes the tour will take. Tai, our manager was extremely friendly and knowledgeable and immediately remembered all the names of our party of twelve. We were with a vegetarian and arrangements were made for a special menu for him. The guides also asked if anyone has food allergies.

The food stops were great, with delicious, unlimited food and drinks served. You will notice three men in black XO Tours shirts drive beside you and stand around your group while you are eating. They are bodyguards who will ensure the safety of your tour group.

I highly recommend getting the services of XO Tours when you visit Saigon. I have also tried their Sights Tour which was great but not as much fun as the Foodie Tour.

The Foodie tour is a must-do! - My boyfriend and I did the evening "Foodie" tour. Our drivers picked us up on time and were so nice. They had great attitude and even though Saigon is hectic with motorbikes I never felt afraid with my guide. She was very capable and knowledgeable about the area. We got to try many different dishes, which was why we picked this tour, it gave us the chance to eat foods we might not know to order on our own. I have a minor peanut allergy so I told them and they made sure to have alternative preparations of dishes for me. The groups are small so you get to know other people. It was probably my favorite activity that we did in Vietnam. I would highly suggest any of the XO Tours!!

Amazing Tour and Night Out - Our guides were amazing and made the night tour so much fun! The guide, Khoi made sure we had everything we needed and always made sure to ask about any allergies or preferences. He gave tons of information. Everyone was really great and showed the group a wonderful time.

A Pleasant Surprise, Indeed - Our first tour in Saigon so not sure what to expect but the girl guides turned up on time and after a brief safety instruction including that the male passenger didn't get to hold onto the guides we off into the sea of ​​motor cycles and the traffic, first turn was across 3 lanes of traffic, but bit by bit, miss by miss, we made it into the ocean of scooters, buses and cars heading to the first attraction the Post Office.

Being among the locals and seeing first hand the gear that's taken on the scooters/bikes is amazing. You can be next to a bike carrying a large gas cylinder, 3 meters of pipe, the family of 4 or just a solo rider doing a text between traffic decisions. If you want to have a snack going along that's ok too!
Amazingly no one seems to get angry with a rider cutting another off, of doing a U turn in the middle of the road, you just ride around and keep going.
The girls were very good and at no stage was there any indication that they were not at home among the traffic.
We met up with the tour guide Tai at the Post Office and Cathedral who then provided all the commentary and took lots of photos which the cynic in me thought I wonder when the sales pitch will come .
The tour covered all the items mentioned on the web site with the girls dropping us back to our hotel. They wore gloves and long sleeve garments when we were outside , when asked why, they don't want the sun to make their skin go brown and are happy to be hot to ensure that !
Re the photos Tai took, well they were emailed to our home email addresses !

There are not a lot of "landmarks" to see in Saigon but these guys show you the major attractions in a way that provides a real local experience.
Find half a day and do it, you will have no regrets on this one.

Thanks Tai and girls or thank you.
Trevor

Must do fantastic HCMC experience - We are an active couple in our early 50s with little experience on motorbikes. We were impressed by all the positive reviews we had read and decided to give it a go. Our expectations were high and were absolutely exceeded. We paid extra for a video which was a brilliant memento to share with friends and family. Well organized, safe and highly informative tour. Great food and great fun!!
Amazing!!!! - It was an amazing and unforgettable experience!!!! The greatest Way to know the Vietnamese cuisine !! Very professional and friendly staff!!! Outstanding!!!!!!!

A great experience - Being on the back of a scooter is a fantastic way to see Saigon. It may look scary at first, but the XO drivers are terrific. Not only does XO do a great food tour, but they make an effort to show you parts of the city tourists wouldn't typically see. They made it feel like it was a real party with friends. A great evening and highly recommended.

Night Sightseeing Tour - We had a great evening with our two teenagers. Drivers were extremely courteous and made us feel very at ease riding around the city. Enjoyed the views, the information, the dinner and desserts. Great activity with teenagers.
Amazing food tour! - Great foodtour, lots of fun and a defenite must-do! Enjoy the non-standard Vietnamese cuisine and the rides through town

Excellent way to start a trip to Vietnam - My daughter and I did the Foodie / Saigon by Night tour our first night in country in January of 2017. In short, it was an incredible way to start the trip! This is an extremely professional group, the girls speak excellent English....some had college degrees in commercial English....I am a big guy (approaching their upper weight limit) and they handled me on the scooter with ease. Additionally, they take care to provide "security" for their guests....In addition to the Girls, there were men dressed in black who shielded the girls in heavy traffic and provided guests an extra bit of security from locals and peddlers. The food was excellent, the tour was awesome and overall, it was a GREAT experience!

Foodie Tour! - Used XO Tours fore their Foodie Tour on our recent visit to HCMC. Pick-up at the hotel was perfect and just the beginning of a wonderful night. In addition to sampling many Vietnamese street foods, you get a great tour of the city on the back of the bike. Our drivers were fun, courteous and super-safe! Highly recommended!

10/10 Outstanding! - What can I say?! Absolutely brilliant trip, from start to finish. We went on the Saigon night tour, and delighted we did. We had 2 food stops, one where we ate a main course, and the other for dessert. Delicious! Thoroughly enjoyed the tour from start to finish, as did my husband. Felt very safe throughout the tour, despite the crazy HCMC traffic! After 2.5 weeks in Vietnam we learned even more about this fabulous city and was one of the highlights of our entire holiday. The girls are fab, informative and very friendly. Our tour leader, Hieu Nguyen, was equally enthusiastic and a wealth of knowledge. 10/10 without hesitation. Don't visit HCMC without a trip with XO tours!

Food tour with XO Tours - We went on a food tour with XO Tours and were not disappointed. It's pricy, especially when considering local currency, but I thought it was worth it. We had five different stops in the tours, with the first, third, and fifth being food stops and the second and fourth being cultural stops to hear about local culture and trends in HCMC. The food was all superb, the young women drivers charming, and the cultural insights were interesting. This is a good tour if you want great local food that isn't the usual fare (rice, bread, etc).

Wow! What a blast! - With limited time in HCMC, booking the Foodie Tour was our most brilliant idea. The young women who took us around were so much fun, so smart and helpful and all around wonderful. It truly is a city exploration and food tasting tour. We met friends from all over the world, ate, drank, and sang into the night. Thank you, XO Tours, for creating such a special experience!

Best Decision! - So I traveled to Vietnam in October 2016, as part of a bigger trip to Southeast Asia. Of all the food tours I did, this was the best one, and the most fun. I can't say enough good things about XO Tours. The girls are so nice, eager, helpful, and their English is excellent. Since everyone is assigned their own personal tour guide, it makes it an intimate and fun experience. I feel that XO Tour really went above and beyond to make it a unique and enjoyable experience for all. And, they make sure you are full by the end of the tour. In fact, they even tell you that if you're not full, to let them know and they will order more food. I went on two tours with XO: The Sights and Foodie Tour. Highly recommend both!

One of the best tours I have taken. - I took both the recommended Sights tour and Foodie tour. Both were great tours but my favorite was the foodie tour. I chose for the company to record the tour and it honestly turned out very good. It is a unique tour due to jumping on the back of a scooter and traveling throughout the very busy city. Both tour guides were amazing and were very knowledgeable of their city. The sights tour did not waste time visiting the main attractions. The food tour was special because it rained throughout the tour. The guides were prepared and it was really fun riding in the rain throughout the city. The food was great and so were the drinks. A special thank you to Thanh Tam Nguyen. She is a veteran employee who is an asset to XO tours. Don't miss out on this experience if visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

This is a must do experience in HCMC - So pleased we went on the XO foodie tour. Not only for the wonderful, delish and sometimes unusual food but also for the knowledge, care and consideration of the girls and Khoi.

No need to feel anxious about being on the back of a scooter in the crazy HCMC traffic, the XO girls are more than capable and very safe drivers.

Thanks again to the girls and Khoi for such a wonderful Vietnam experience!

All the best, Paula, Drew and Lisa

Best thing I did in Vietnam - The drivers were incredible. They really personalized the experience for me, were fun to hang out with, were very friendly, and extremely accommodating. The tour guide was great, too. Plus the food was really delicious. I couldn't recommend this more highly.

This is a must do in Ho Chi Minh City - I'm so glad that a friend told me about this tour, first I did the Sights Tour with BingBing, "Binh 3", she was really funny, nice and really professional, the Tour was so amazing that I book the Foodie Tour, and that was my best decision, this time I got Tinkerbell, so nice, she almost speaks Portuguese, she is learning Spanish and she showed me the best food that I had so far, Thanks Bing Bing, Tinkerbell you made my stayed in Saigon really special

XO foodie tour - No need to deliberate, please do this and support this great group. This was a last minute find and I'm super happy that they accepted my very late registration (ask your hotel for help). The foodie tour brings you to different HCMC districts, which you will learn about, and you are presented with lots of delicious foods. The driver's and staff were all great and professional.

Free! - Nothing like riding on the back of motorbike in Saigon to see the real city. Our drivers and guide were very knowledgeable and considerate. We loved our meal and especially the Chinatown visit. This an activity cannot be missed!

Best thing we've done this trip - We were picked up right on time by 3 enthusiastic and cheerful scooter pilots at our hotel to take my husband and I and our 9 year old boy on this scooter tour. The girls were amazing pilots and super safe. Weaving thru peak hour traffic like a tie fighter in a star war scene , that itself is an experience I'll remember forever ! We made 3 food stops and 2 site stops. The team was very knowledgeable and spoke perfect English. Gluten free requirements was no problem! The menu was interesting and varied, we enjoyed the bbq goat, frog legs, quail, crabs , prawns , scallops to name a few. The pilots even cooked for us and de shelled for us! We were so spoiled! They looked after our boy so well, he was jetlagged and falling asleep during dinner (not good when you are pillioning!). They bought him ice cream and that perked him right up! We got a drop box link to the links 3 days later as promised too. Best thing we have done all trip! Oh.. Vegans need not apply! Well done team!

XO Foodie Tour = a must do in Saigon - Hands down my highlight in Saigon!

If you are visiting Ho Chi Minh city, you must do the foodie tour!

What makes it so great?
- the tour guide girls are so cool, personable, fun and have great English

- you get to experience scootering amongst the hustle and bustle of the city

- you get to go too different districts, something that I wouldn't of been able to do otherwise

- you get an informational tour of the city at the same time

- you get the true local Vietnamese food experience

I'm going back to Vietnam in August with my university class and this tour was so good I'm going to insist we all do this same tour again!

Great fun and interesting sightseeing :) - Tour leader Khoi and the drivers were all very nice and took good care of us on a morning trip.
When back in HCMC we will do the night trip.
Highly recommended:-)

Best experience in Saigon - Our family of 4 did the night time foodie tour. Our guides picked us up from our hotel and gave a quick summary of how to be safe on the back of their Vespas. What an experience, making our way through the madness of Saigon traffic, we felt very safe and couldn't wipe the smiles of our face! We drove through many districts and stopped at 5. The explanation of each district was very informative and the food was amazing. The highlight of our evening were our lovely drivers, Nhi, Loan3(Phoenix), Trang and Ngan6, they were so funny, informative and spoke great English. Thanks also to our tour guide UK. Would definitely recommend this tour for all ages.

Best foodie tour ever! - I was a bit unsure about traveling on a scooter in Ho Chi Min City, the traffic is madness but after a few minutes on the back of the bike I felt perfectly at ease. It is also a fantastic was of seeing the city by night.
We traveled to the lesser known parts of the city, no tourist spots, so felt like we had an authentic experience. All the drivers are female, I was told that this is because they have a better track record for safety on the road. It also gives these young women an opportunity to work in an otherwise male dominated field.
The food was amazing but not for the faint hearted or vegetarian. The food included beef soup, goat, frog, and loads of sea food. The scallops were amazing. They catered to our tastes, I can't eat dairy so they prepared a different dessert for me and the chilli sauce was a bit too spicy so they gave me sauces with a bit less fire in them. Our guides educate us on how to eat each dish. They also did all the hard work cracking the crab legs and cooking the meat in a little grazier. I tried the duck egg with duck embryo but could only manage a mouthful, mostly because I couldn't get my head around what I was eating.
Our guides were friendly, informative and the tour leader was most entertaining.
Wear comfortable clothing, not skirts or dresses, a bit tricky to negotiate on a scooter.
The tour is not cheap by Vietnamese standards but totally worth it. For a little extra they will make a video of your night however throughout the night the tour leader takes photos and has promised to send them to us via email.

Fun motorbike tour for the adventure eater! - What's better than a city food tour at night? One on the backs of a parade of motorbikes helmed by a dozen lovely Vietnamese ladies in traditional dresses, of course! Our respective lady hosts picked us up at our District 1 hotel and we met up with the rest of the group at the first of many, many food stops - being on a motorbike in a city filled with 8 million of them was such a fun experience! I was disappointed to rent my own but being on the back of one with an incredibly experienced local made it a carefree and incredibly fun ride through the city. We stopped in five different districts, most of which we would never have seen on our own, and the food was incredible - we tried everything from frog legs to the infamous balut egg and everything was delicious, though maybe a bit too adventurous for some! Our hosts were incredibly sweet and entertaining and totally made our night - I would recommend everyone do this in Ho Chi Minh!

So much fun! - Our XO The Sights tour was the best tour we did while in Vietnam! It was incredible riding around Ho Chi Minh on a motor bike seeing some of the major places in the city. XO values ​​safety and despite the craziness of Saigon's streets, I never felt unsafe on the bike. Our guide was very knowledgable on the city and friendly. We learned a lot about the city on this tour! Loved going to the market and trying local yogurt and flan. We also had a sugar cane drink while driving to Chinatown, which was delicious! A wonderful experience!

SIMPLY AMAZING - This was such an amazing experience! My husband and I love eating and wanted to ride on some vespas on our trip to Vietnam so the Foodie Tour was just what we were hoping for and more! Thank you to Tai and all the XO Tour staff for making this such a special evening for us!

Fun experience for all - LONG AND DETAILED REVIEW BELOW:

Since I was planning a trip back home to the Motherland with my boyfriend, I was looking around for a city tour plus food. I came across a few other companies that does almost the same thing but this was a bit cheaper than the rest. After reading reviews I have set on XO.

They gave us a location to meet up which was in front of the Opera House. You couldn't miss them with the white and blue ao dai. They greeted us and welcomed us. Went over safety instructions. Mind that my boyfriend Is almost 300lbs and he was scared/nervous. His driver was very professional and kept him calm and made sure he was comfortable. Being big means he also has a big head. The helmet they gave him was on the smaller size so they called the HQ to bring him a bigger size helmet and they did! They didn't bring it until after 2 stops but it was very cool they tried to accommodate for him.

I was feeling under the weather due to all day of flying the day before so I wasn't enjoying it as much but he had a blast! The food was delicious and he tried new food which he ended up loving! Since we had to sit in plastic chairs, he couldn't fit so they brought out a bigger chair for him every time which is an extra plus. NOTE: We both ended up being on the toilet the next morning but it was so worth it.

We went through some of them districts to see different sides of Saigon which was very nice and something I wouldn't be able to do for my boyfriend Since I have no business in any of the districts.

The tour manager and a few other guys were on the tour with us including the girl drivers. Their work relationship is very friendly and fun which makes it fun during their working shift. The guys are like the guards for the girls and the clients. They make sure we are having fun and comfortable throughout the tour. Our drivers were Trang and Loan I believe and the tour manager was Tai. I would highly recommend this to anyone.

Best. Tour. Ever. - XO Tours has, by far, been one of my favorite tours of all time. I've been on many tours with family and friends around Asia but none have been this engaging and entertaining. We started the ride at our hotel with our private scooter drivers/tour guides. Our first stop was for Bun Bo Hue (spicy beef noodles). At this stop, we meet up with the other tour scenes. There were folks from Australia, US, and Korea. This is where we also meet up with our host, Tai, and the "bodyguards".

We then ventured through Ho Chi Minh City and made our way to Chinatown. We stopped on the side for a brief history lesson from Tai and got some insight as to where we'd be going for the rest of the tour. Our next food stop was an outdoor BBQ restaurant where we tried some more unique meats (ie goat and "jumping chicken", aka frog). As we went from location to location, our drivers were super friendly and told us about the city, their life in Vietnam and asked us various questions about our life and hometowns as well. I learned a lot about the culture and social aspects of Vietnam from my driver Hua!

We scooted around to visit various other districts to check out the sights before arriving at our final food stop for seafood. This was in the poorest district (I think 4?). We could definitely feel that as we felt more people watching us but I never actually felt unsafe during the tour. This probably because there were plenty of locals leading us around and my friends later told me that the "bodyguards" were on higher alert. Anyhow, the seafood was delicious! Especially the scallop and crab :). There was an opportunity to try balut (boiled bird embryo) but I passed on that.

Then it was time to say our goodbyes to the other tour arriving and our drivers took us back to our hotel. We did a final group selfie before saying goodbye to our wonderful drivers.
Great food, brilliant guides - Amazing experience driving around the busy streets. Great variety of local food, all delicious. Felt very safe driving around with Chang. She ruled the streets!

Hands down the best thing we did! - I'm not ashamed to say I was quite nervous about this for a group with ages ranging from 7 to 70 - but it was FANTASTIC. The lady drivers are wonderful - friendly, excellent English speakers and safe (including being necessarily firm with my son to ensure he sat properly on his bike). We got over our nerves quickly and loved everything about the experience. We did the Sights tour which was perfect for us - the tour leader met you at each stop to tell you about the landmark/an important time in HMC history. They also incorporate opportunities to try very local food and drink as you go around. Can't rate it highly enough.

What a great experience! - Having only a limited time to spend in HCMC before returning to Australia, we decided to book the XO Night Foodie Tour after reading all the rave reviews on Tripadvisor. This was the best decision we made on our whole Vietnam trip!
Having never ridden on a motorbike or scooter before, I was anxious and reluctant at first. And who could blame me, have you seen the traffic in HCMC? However, upon meeting and talking to our drivers, I felt assured that we were in safe and capable hands. The girls (Tuyet, Nguyet & Huong) were all very well spoken, fun and friendly. Tai (the XO tour manager) and his staff are all very knowledgeable and we were well informed about every District, market and food stop we visited. The customer service was well beyond what we had expected. It felt like we were reconnecting with long time friends over great conversation, delicious Vietnamese street food and a nice cold drink/beer.
My most unforgettable experience on the XO Night Foodie Tour has to be weaving through the night traffic on the back of a moped. This gave me a sense of freedom and exhilaration I don't get to experience when driving a car. In addition, my 6 year old daughter really enjoyed this tour. She took to the moped ride very well and always felt safe with aunty Snow as her driver. She was well accommodated for when it came to food and drinks and gave two thumbs up for the fun atmosphere.
We came away from the XO Night Foodie Tour feeling very happy and satisfied.
Don't miss out. We highly recommend the XO Tours to anyone wanting to see and experience HCMC like a true Vietnamese local.
Thank you Tai for sending us all the beautiful photos of our tour via dropbox. These will be well cherished memories.

Saigon at its best! - There is no better way to see this incredible city. The young lady drivers are smart and funny and great with kids. We felt completely safe at all times. My kids (11 & 9) were looked after very well. Our tour leader Ahn Pham is a great guy and explains the significance of each sight in a conversational manner. This is the best way to learn about this magic city

Awesome family fun - We are a family of four including a 9 and 11 year old. We booked a private "Sights" and "Saigon by night" tours for our first day in Ho Chi Ming City. What an amazing experience we had. The kids loved their time on the bikes and the attention their riders gave them. With kids occupied, my wife and I were able to listen, uninterrupted, to the great commentary provided by the tour leaders, who popped up at stops with seasonal fruit and water.

“Sights” tour included a market stop where we enjoyed a desert. At our request, riders dropped us off at a restaurant close to our hotel for lunch. We then had some R & R back at our hotel before going out again on the private “Saigon by night” tour, with different riders and tour leader. All were very friendly and great conversationalists. Saigon by night's tour included separate delicious dinner and desert stops.

XO tours is very well organized operation with good systems in place. We booked/paid via their webpage before leaving Sydney. Confirmation, further instruction and other correspondence were via email.

Highly recommended as an introduction to HCMC.
Just perfect! - It was one of our best experiences in Vietnam. Great drivers, great guide, great informations about Saigon culture, even better food! If you have the chance, book it!

What a fantastic opportunity. - On our second visit a year later to HCMC we had to go out and see more of the districts. Well I wouldn't recommend anyone else but this fantastic company! Me and my partner had a fabulous time with the two girls (sorry I couldn't remember there names) they took us to the districts we would have never seen, we saw and tasted some phenomenal foods and we had a laugh. You feel like you've known these girls forever they are so accommodating and friendly I could have taken them all home. We rode for 4 hours on the back of there pedders and it was a trip of a lifetime. Do not hesitate in booking with XO tours they are worth every penny and more.

Friendly and Outgoing Staff - As an introvert traveling solo, I'm so relieved that the tour guides are friendly and outgoing. They were very informative and funny too! I did the tour on my first day in Ho Chi Minh and I got lots of good recommendation from them while we're on the tour itself. I especially enjoyed the bike rides! Will recommend XO Tour to my family and friends!

XO Tours - Fantastic in every way - My friend and I did the evening tour - which was amazing.

The girls couldn't be friendlier, their English superb and at every stage we were well looked after.

Biking through HCMC is exhilarating, intense and an experience not to be missed. The girls are not only great company, but experts on the bustling streets.

We got to see parts of HCMC off the beaten track and had a fantastic meal too.

One of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam and cannot recommend them highly enough.

Indescribably delicious! - Prepare yourself for an experience. After picking us up at our hotel, we were immediately introduced to our individual scooter drivers. Can't say enough about their friendliness and skills driving through the city. Even with helmets, we were able to converse with them throughout the ride.
We were taken to three different restaurants for a combined 10 courses. Started with banh canh, a Vietnamese noodle soup. From there, we rode through neighborhoods not listed in tourist guidebooks to the other venues. Had great local cuisine, including some interesting surprises.
If you have the time, this tour will be the highlight of any trip. Make sure to ask for the video option, which is limited to only two people per night using a GoPro mounted to their helmet. is not possible to take pictures while holding onto scooter through traffic. We were too late to take this option. So if I had one complaint, it was that they have availability for more people to take advantage of this feature.

Foodie Tour - What an amazing night. XO was a brilliant tour group who are organized and very professional. My tour guide some English very well and took me around Saigon very safely. The food was great and abundant and highly recommended. Tai was excellent running the night. Thank you XO.

Fantastic tour with wonderful XO girls - We did the evening tour and we were lucky enough for it to be a private tour for our family. The girls are fabulous with smooth driving skills among the crazy traffic, speak very good English and give their local experience of living in a busy city like HCMC. It was really good to see the various districts which gives a very different impression of the city beyond the central area. We had never been on motorbikes before and we were a little apprehensive but it was very easy and most enjoyable. The highlight of our trip. Thanks so much to XO Tours.

Saigon at Night - The XO scooter tour was a highlight of our 3 weeks in Vietnam...a must do experience for all visitors to the city. Great drivers....this is how the city should be seen, from the back of a scooter :)

XO means love riding on a scooter in Saigon traffic - XO tours had been recommended by a Canadian friend and what a great recommendation it was! Not only do you get a friendly, experienced motor bike driver but you also get to experience Saigon traffic at its best, as you tour an learn about the city, the market and other significant sites. Our guide, Tai Dang did a wonderful job connecting historical photographs of important city sites with clear and excellent explanations in English. Everyone on the XO team really makes sure you have a safe and enjoyable tour. To my surprise, Tai sent our group photos after our tour which I will cherish. Wish I would have had time for the evening tour! Great job XO!

Foodie Tour was great!!! - This tour was recommended to me by friends who did it last year and I'm so glad I did it.
Tai was a fantastic guide and my driver was knowledgeable and chatty which was great. At all the stops, we had great food, the other drivers were all friendly and we had a great time chatting. The food was yum, I saw places I wouldn't have seen just on my own and I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon. I'm traveling solo and it was a great way to start my visit in this city.

XO Night Food Tour - EXHILARATING!!! - Must do!!! Professional, safe, enlightening are all factors that I consider as musts for 10/10 tours! This had so much fun factor as well!! Our drivers/guides Ngom and Thao were polite, friendly and helpful in abundance! My husband is experienced on a motorbike - I had none! This brought "some" reservation - although that was soon blown out the window whilst on the back of the bike with my driver. Especially when you get to the first stop to meet up with our fellow thrill seekers and one is an 11 year old (in tow with family). "When in Vietnam... !" became my mantra! At the first stop we met Anh our Chief Tour Guide / overseer for the night. He was also fantastic, a professional and friendly manner with informed dialogue. The Tour took us to many districts as Anh suggested many visitors may not get to! Oh and the food was excellent as well! Another item off my bucket list !! Thank you XO !! 10/10!!

Highlight - The best way of experiencing HCMC. The girls are absolutely delightful and fantastic drivers. Their English is perfect, they drive the scooter whilst giving you a personal guided tour. Being on the back of the scooter whilst seeing the sights at the night plus the markets and then the food stops was one of our holiday highlights. I can't imagine a tour experience that would be more fun.

Highlight of Saigon! - The best decision we made in 3 weeks in Vietnam was to take a 'main sights' tour with the girls from XO. Not being intrepid enough to drive a motorbike ourselves in the crazy Saigon traffic, it was nice to 'feel the fear' and have the experience of being on the road with someone else far more competent to drive for us. The whole experience was great fun, informative, and gave us an excellent overview of the main sights of Saigon that we would never otherwise have achieved by ourselves. I was super impressed with the entire XO Tours experience, not just the tour itself. Communication at the booking stage was outstanding. Tuen and Queen, our wonderful drivers, picked us up out the front of our hotel on the morning of the tour. They were two of the nicest, loveliest people you would ever meet, both with a good sense of humour. The motorbike experience was memorable (in a good way!). The tour was superbly organised, with stops at key sights with Hieu, our tour leader, explaining the significance of each in very good English. The stops were well coordinated and included markets, temples, snack stops and a sugar cane drink. We had six people in our group overall, so it was nice to talk to other travellers from Switzerland, Denmark and Russia as well.

A lovely final touch was being sent 20 or so photos a couple of days later via Dropbox that were taken by their photographer. He took some fantastic photos of the morning.

We did the 4 hour sights tour from 8.30am - 12.30pm. It was one of the best experiences that we had in Vietnam and was well worth the $48USD per person.

I'd like to send a huge 'thank you' to Queen, Tuen and Hieu - and to anyone coming to Saigon in the foreseeable future, I can't recommend XO Tours highly enough. Our tour was sensational.

Great time on the Foodie Tour! - We did the Foodie tour and it gave us great insight into both the food and culture of the area. Not only do you travel to the popular tourist districts (1 and 3), but you also see 5 or 6 other districts that you may not otherwise see. All of the drivers are very friendly and we felt safe the entire time. Would highly recommend!

Tour of Ho Chi Minh City by talented staff on motorbikes! - Made a reservation for the Sights and Saigon by Nights tour a week or so prior to arrival into HCM due to all the fantastic reviews on TripAdvisor.

Logistics were well organized with an e-mail confirming my reservation and some very talented staff as motorbike drivers for the small group tour. XO Tours did a phenomenal job with their talented drivers as that was truly the highlight of the experience!

English was surprisingly decent from all of the staff members although it was still apparent that English was their second language. One minor caveat was that the demeanor of one of my motorbike drivers was less than a 5 star experience...

Both tours brought me to a few touristy spots along with some local venues where no tourists were seen.

From a costs perspective, it is extremely affordable as a foreigner. Surprisingly, they also take USD as an option for payment. After staying in HCM for a few days, an Uber ride from the airport to District 1 is merely $3 USD (Uber Motorbike is much cheaper) and a full service meal at a luxury mall is ~$5 USD (Street food is much cheaper).

From a safety perspective, although a motorbike is a fun way to see the city, it's also good to keep in mind that the risks are significantly magnified when riding a motorbike, even when the city is 90% full of motorbikes...

...it appears that XO Tours does carry some type of insurance for the impending, $5000 USD may be on the low side for foreigners...

Lovely drivers, a real highlight of our trip! - We are a family of four with 8 and 9 year old kids and we loved our tour today of Ho Chi Minh City sights. The kids had no problem riding on the back of the motorbikes and they got on so well with their drivers, afterward they were just buzzing sharing all the things they had learned and wishing they could see the girls again! It was awesome seeing the sights and some famous historical spots and the photos associated with that piece of history. Loved trying a few local specialties like the sugar cane juice and just loved being part of the city on the back of a motorbike, the only way to really see the city. Thank you that was a real highlight of our trip!

Tinkerbell - There is a reason this is one of the top rated trip advisor activities…. wow, they are fantastic. Pretty standard sort of trip but the customer service is fantastic. I had Tinkerbell and you couldn't ask for more. She was brilliant, kind and gave a very insightful view of Saigon at night. I am not sure if you can request a specific tour guide (they all seem great) but Tink was just next level… brilliant! Thanks!!

Great Way to Immerse Yourself in Ho Chi Minh City - We took the night food tour and had an amazing time! All of our guides were engaging and funny, and it was cool to have a casual conversation to learn more about Vietnam and the city.

The food was well-paced between stops. There were definitely some unusual and challenging items (I won't ruin the surprise), and not every dish hit the mark, but that was part of the fun of the tour. One of the best aspects of the experience is that they bring you to several different neighborhoods so you can get out of the tourist center and get a nice overview of lesser-seen parts of the city.

Even my mother, who was very reticent about the scooters, had a great time. Would definitely recommend!

Our best way to finish our trip in this amazing Country - Great experience, we definitely got in touch with the local culture (not only the amazing food), the staff is really experienced, smiling, kind and helpful, they really make their best so that you can enjoy the tour.. We definitely recommend this tour!

WOW! What a great experience! - We did the Foodie tour and it was fantastic.
The girls were very good riders and we felt safe weaving through the crazy Saigon traffic exploring the various regions in the city - it was eye opening.
The food was good and a great experience.
This operation is Slick, the riders and support staff were all very professional and extremely fun loving and friendly.
I was initially nervous but having experienced this all I can say is do it!

Super fun! - We really enjoyed the night out with these fun and smart girls on their motorbikes. It's fun to be in the middle of the chaos in a very safe way. (even with kids, aged 7 and 10!)
We tried a lot's of interesting food and had a very informative and pleasant night.
This was the best tour!
Thank you so much!

One of our highlights of Ho Chi Minh City! - We went on the foodie tour with Chang and Loan after a recommendation from a friend, and truly had one of our best travel experiences to date. Chang and Loan both took excellent care of us, shared many insights into Vietnam, and made our experience all the better by showing us their city. Hieu was a great guide too - he was able to share facts about the city weaved among some interesting stories. Do not miss the chance to see this wonderful city - like a local among the traffic - crossing bridges at night to see the cityscape and eat some fantastic local cuisine (beyond the pho and spring rolls that everyone will insist you try)!

Excellent - a must-do in HCMC - This tour was amazing going around to all the different districts and the food we got it was lovely. The interaction and information we got was unbelievable. Highlight of HCMC for sure. Book in advance for the date you want

Best tour in Vietnam - Did the foodie tour and it was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. A big shout out to our tour guide Tai Dang for making it a wonderful experience. He was very entertaining, informative and friendly. The girl tour guides were excellent and spoke great English. The XO tours are a must do in HCMC as you get to taste food and visit sights which you might miss otherwise.

Amazing Food Tour - We did the XO Foodie tour and it was definitely worth it. The drivers were great and I felt safe the entire way through the chaotic traffic of Ho Chi Minh city. The food was great and featured things you wouldn't likely get as a regular tourist (eg BBQ goat, frog, and even balut with tamarind sauce). You can order more if you like and we were stuffed at the end of the tour. Drinks are included also. Highly recommended for everyone visiting HCMC.

Unforgettable! - You'd be crazy not to do this tour through several districts of HCM city on the back of a motorbike to eat wonderful food. Intelligent and fun drivers (thank you Lyn) instantly made me fun safe driving through the craziness of the traffic.
Delicious food (pork, beef, scallops) and once in a lifetime experiences! Particular care was taken to substitute some menu items due to allergies - you can trust the staff.
The immersion experience, the 1:1 attention and the wonderful staff made this trip.

Excellent scooter sights of Saigon tour - This is a must do! 12 of us 6 adults and 6 kids ages ranging from 9-13
Everyone thought this was the highlight of Saigon.
We went to all districts inc 7 that not many folk no about and is so different from Dis 1 you will never see this on your own
Great food, entertaining tour guides all women excellent English and so accomodating! A true must do!

Family custom tour - We had a fantastic day with the XO team. They were friendly and knowledgeable. We visited all the major points of interest for us and even allowed us to add a few stops like getting a fun drink at the market and taking us to a great souvenir shop and even showing my kids a unique little coffee shop. They take photos along the way which is really nice. We purchased the video and have enjoyed having that as a memento.
I have never been on a motor bike of any kind! After the first stop I was already comfortable. I really trust the drivers. My kids were very well cared for. They kept us all together so I could always see them. The kids couldn't wait to get back on the bikes, they loved it! So glad we were able to do sometime so fun!
