We came off a cruise ship. We took the "on your own" cruise tour which brought you into the city by bus and got you back to the ship. The XO team was happy to pick us up and drop us off from where the busses dropped us.
We had a great day with XO. I have no regrets on my experience of Ho Chi Minh City. Even only having not even a full day, XO made sure our experience was fulfilled.

Favorite Tour of Vacation! - The drivers were safe and knowledgable, and it is a great way to see parts of the city that otherwise would be missed. This was our teens' favorite tour of a 3 week vacation - lots of fun!

Fantastic Tour - The food was fantastic and riding on the motorbike was a great way to see many different parts of the city. We drove through at least 4 or 5 of the different districts, which I never would have seen on my own. The food was fantastic, and the motorbike driver/guides were extremely friendly and funny. They were all also very good drivers and I felt 100% safe the entire time. Highly recommend.

The food stops are interrupted with driving and sightseeing so you have a little time to digest. We ate a ton of food, but because it was a lot of meat and seafood as opposed to just noodles and bread you didn't feel completely overstuffed at the end.

The most fun you'll ever have!!! - Our family of 4 decided to do this foodie tour. We have 2 teenage daughters, aged 12 & 16. We were picked up at our hotel by 4 friendly tour guides on their Vespas and off we went. As we drove through the streets of Ho Chi Minh, they gave us so much information about their lifestyles and culture. Then we met Tai at our first food stop. What a friendly and hospitable guy. I have never met a person who can remember each and every person's name and where we were from who were on this tour (And were a group of about 15 people!) We drove through areas where we would never have known about if we were to do this city on our own. This is exactly what we wanted to see and experience. Real life in Vietnam. The food we tried were delicious and some of if quite adventurous! The guides were highly entertaining and engaging. This was one of our highlights of our Vietnam vacation!! You must experience this amazing Vespa food tour!!!

Best fun ever! - This tour was recommended by friends who had already been to Vietnam!

It was the best fun ever, great was to see different parts of HCMC - especially districts other than 1 and 2. Also very informative, food and beer will flow as much as you allow.

The guides (girls) are all personality plus and make the night fun!

Food was awesome, very safe! Highly recommend this tour.

Grand Fun - The reviews are true: a fantastic, safe, and fun way to see Saigon whilst sampling an assortment of local cuisine. Not to be missed, especially if only in the city for a couple of days as I was. Thank you XO, I will tell all my friends.

Foodie tour and sightseeing tours great for Teens - We did both the sight seeing tour in the morning, and the same night we did the foodie tour. Both tours were brilliant for my two teenage daughters. Perfectly safe (mum freaking out a little bit!!) but they took to it like ducks to water (mopeds).

The food was awesome, but the guides and the atmosphere of Saigon were the winners! Totally deserves to be
top of the pops.

Thank you Tai, Twin, Quin, Lyn, Twee and Mei. We had a ball.

Brilliant adventure! - Just a brilliant way to see Ho Chi Minh; this well organized group gave us an excellent 3 hour tour of the city on the back of motorbikes. All drivers were female and we felt safe all the time. Our drivers were interested in us and our lives and were chatting all the time and telling us about the city.
We saw loads of different districts of the city as well as experiencing a night market, tasting local foods and chatting with our drivers and the tour guide who told us all about the city and it's quirks!
We would highly recommend XO to anyone who has time in Saigon; we did a night tour and it was a real experience. Our family group had 6 people, 4 adults and 2 youngsters under 10 who both loved it too.

Awesome - highly recommend - Was a bit hair raising at first as not used to all the crazy traffic. Tam my rider was awesome and safe. Got a lot of good local commentary as we went along. Went to many off the track places you wouldn't normally see as a tourist. Dinner was also fantastic. Highly recommend you do this tour to see a lot more of Ho Chi Minh than a regular tour plus it's fun.

Best Tour Anywhere!! - The most fun we have ever had on a tour! Took the nighttime foodie tour, Hong and Huyen were the best guides ever! We felt like we learned a lot about the city and ate very well. The evening was coordinated super well and even though the scooters seemed like a crazy idea to suburban Americans, we had a ball and felt very safe with our drivers. Can't say enough good things.

Your only option to take a tour - I just regret we had to cancel the foodie tour because our flight was delayed.
What a service! Mr. Thao and his team made sure all day, that we had a good&secure time.
We were the seconds one to arrive to the meeting point,and starting chatting with Thao about the city,then 4 more tourists arrived and the tour started there.
We went to the major sights in little time considering traffic. We also had refreshments and desserts!
We loved the experience and can't say enough good things about the tour.
The photos were a super plus for us, due to the precautions we were given to not take pics during the moto ride.
Advice: wear sunscreen!

Best tour we did in Vietnam - The 7 of us (4 adults and 3 teens) did the Foodie Scooter Tour on our last night in Vietnam. After 4 weeks of traveling through this fantastic country, the Foodie Tour was the best thing we did. The girls that drive the scooters are charming, funny, intelligent and safe drivers. I was completely comfortable allowing my 13 year old daughter to head off into the madness of Saigon traffic riding on the back of an XO scooter. The route they take is well thought out and interesting while the food is exceptional. I would suggest fasting all day before going on the tour. If you only of one thing while in Saigon, do this tour! You will have a fantastic time. Thanks for the memories, XO Tours.

Highlight of our Vietnam adventure - Crossing the road in Saigon is challenging enough, but the experience of riding on the back of a scooter in the middle of the madness will stay with me forever. Add on top of that the fabulous food (best scallops I've ever tasted) and you've got a night that will overload your senses. Sang Nguyen and his team of drivers (Hi to Bing Bing) provided our two families with a sensational experience that the kids haven't stopped talking about. Better than any day at a theme park, educational and delicious. The perfect way to top off an already brilliant three weeks in this beautiful country.

So good I did two! - I was solo in Ho Chi Minh City, so decided to try this tour based on reviews. It did not disappoint. I did the daytime sight seeing tour during the morning, then the food experience tour in the evening. The company is very professional, and very kind. The trip was organized so well, and the lovely woman driving the scooter picked me up and dropped me off right at the front door of my accommodation. It is a great way to get a feel for the city, and a glimpse of its history. I felt very safe even though the traffic was busy. The foodie tour catered well for my vegetarian requirements - amazing food and great conversations with the tour guides and other guests. I would do it again! Highly recommended.

BEST TOUR EVER!! - We did The Sights motorbike tour of Saigon with XO Tours and it was AMAZING!!! I cannot even express how fun and unique this tour was! It is worth every penny and more! We actually signed up for our tour only 2 days beforehand and we had issues getting into our emails to confirm our tour, but a quick call to XO tours and everything was sorted. We originally wanted to do both The Sights Tour and The Foodie Tour, but The Foodie Tour was actually booked a month out!!! On the morning of our tour, the girls met us outside the hotel lobby right on time! They are very easy to find wearing the beautiful white and blue Ao Dais. They kindly introduced themselves and gave us a quick motorbike safety lesson. Then we hopped on the back of the motorbikes and drove to meet the rest of the tour group. There were 4 other people in our group (so 6 people total) which is the perfect size to be able to hear and interact with the tour guide. Our tour guide was a very kind young gentleman named Heu Nguyen who was very knowledgeable and easy to speak with. There was also a “bodyguard” with the group who kept an eye on our entire group to ensure that nothing was stolen and no issues. The girls took us to each destination on the motorbikes through the busy and chaotic streets of Saigon. That in and of itself was a fun adventure!! There really are no rules on the road. At each destination, Heu would speak about its history and significance and then he would give us some time to explore and take pictures. It was just enough time that you didn’t feel rushed and you didn’t get bored. At the Tan Dinh Market, we even got to try yummy homemade yogurt, flan and sugarcane juice, which was a really nice surprise as we weren’t even expecting to get fed on this tour! I also liked that they took us to the less-touristy Market to see the real side of Vietnam!! They also kept things interesting because we got to take jumping and riding on the motorbike pictures with the girls! Also, the girls themselves were SUPER sweet and would talk and interact with you while riding on the bikes. When the tour finally ended, we really didn’t want it to end. The girls took us back to our hotels. Afterwards, we received an email from XO Tours with a free download of all the professional pictures that they had taken of us during the tour! My husband and I travel internationally a lot and we do many tours, but this is without a doubt THE BEST TOUR that we have ever been on!!
When we come back to visit Saigon in the near future, we are definitely going to use XO Tours again!! We want to do both The Foodie Tour and the Saigon by Night Tour!!!
Thank you again XO Tours for an amazing experience!!!! We will definitely be using you again!!

Best tour I've done - All other reviewers are not lying. It's the best tour around for many reasons. You get good food and an amazing taste of culture. You learn about the history of Vietnam! It's really interesting and delicious. Do it. Do it now.

Best way to sample Saigon living. - My partner and I had a great time on the foodie night tour. Picked up by two lovely ladies on scooters. Being a 100kg guy I was a bit apprehensive about the scooter ride with a lady half my size but they were great. The buzz you have being a part of the carnage that is Ho Chi Minh traffic is a great experience. The tour guide huew was very informative and provided a great deal of knowledge about Saigon. Was easy to see that the Vietnamese really don't waste anything when it comes to eating food. It was the push needed to try some of the more stranger dishes in some areas you wouldn't go by yourself (and not a bowl of Pho in site). Would recommend to anyone.

Foodie night tour - incredible evening! - We were determined to do a foodie tour whilst in South East Asia, and we picked XO pretty much exclusively due to the wall to wall exceptional reviews from this site! And I'm delighted to say it more than delivered on its promise.
Loan was my Vespa girl and she was fantastic. Really knowledgable about the city, the areas we were going through and the foods we could expect to eat. Her driving was superb - don't get me wrong, there were some hairy moments on the road riding pillion, HCMC traffic at rush hour is total insanity. But I always felt safe. Her English was superb too and she was great to talk to.
Another big shout for the team leader on the night, Khoi. He was funny, charming, intelligent and the kind of guy who's presence just lifts a group!
We met up with our group of 8 at the first restaurant, Hoang Tam, and had some bun bo hue, a clear beef soup, similar to pho to my untrained eye but quite different according to those in the know!
We then drove quite a way, via Chinatown, and a crazy, very narrow Chinese street market with fish, meat, veg and spices spilling out into the street! It was an awesome place to drive through, very eye opening and an assault on the senses...
The second stop was a superb BBQ place, I think called Bo To Cu Chi, which is so off the beaten track, I can't find it on TA but it served phenomenal BBQ - goat, beef, prawns (which were next level tasty, although the heads - not so much) and what turned out to be pretty decent skin-on frog! Very cool and full of locals, tiny chairs and a very authentic experience which we loved.
Then from there through more non-touristy districts (including an interesting Q5 with a very busy shopping street) and a stop in Q7, which is new, full of foreign investment and very expensive. Khoi gave us an insight into this area and how out of reach it is for most Vietnamese, which then turned into an economics discussion which was unexpected but interesting!
Then onto our last place Toan Phuong Quan, which had even smaller seats, out on the street and serving mainly seafood. We had quail, crab claws, clams in a delicious broth, a weird egg dish (definitely a local delicacy which I won't spoil anyone's appetite with by describing here), and 2 plates of the most delicious scallops I've ever eaten. All finished with coconut water jelly (a bit bland) and a sort of creme caramel dish.
Overall this was a top class experience, seeing amazing authentic parts of the city, visiting off the beaten track restaurants, having laughs and lots of fun with the group, leaders and drivers and of course eating delicious food everywhere we went! I can't recommend this tour highly enough, a must do if you go to Saigon.

A MUST-DO in Saigon for foodies - My husband and I did the night time tour and it was AMAZING. Riding on the back of the scooters was so fun and really helped us experience and see so much the city. Chang was my driver and she was so friendly and warm, we got along great all night and she really helped make the tour so fun! The places that we went and the food that we ate were all so good and different. I would recommend this to anyone that likes to meet people, have a good time (a little bit of adventure) and EAT!

So much fun!!! - We went on the Saigon by Night tour towards the end of our trip. It's best to go on this tour in the beginning of the trip since they did such a great job giving us the best places to check out on your own based on your preferred experiences. The motorbike drivers are all women and they were all amazing. Our tour leader Hieu did an excellent job giving us interesting facts and history of each district. His English was great. They got us some delicious tropical fruits at the
Street market. We non discovered touristy areas and had meals like the locals. The whole experience was superb. They were really organized too.

Wish we did the tour sooner - We went on XO Saigon Night tour on our last night in Vietnam. We learned more about the city and the culture of Ho Chi Min City in a few hours than the rest of our 2 weeks here. The tour guides were awesome - friendly, knowledgeable and informative. The street food was great! The unique fruits from the Chinese market were a nice touch. Glad to have seen some out of the way and quirky parts of the city. Would definitely book XO again.

5* Tour - Exceptional Value for Money - An excellent, fun and interesting evening on the back of a moped. The tour was well executed and thorough. It visits half a dozen of Ho Chi Minh's neighborhoods along with three or four restaurant stops. Free, unlimited drinks (inc. alcohol) and fresh, delicious food including - scallops, crab, frogs, pho, goat, BBQ. The guides (all female, mostly university students) are friendly and well informed. A brilliant trip, you will not regret it.

The ratings speak for themselves - Me and my wife went on the Saigon food tour with XO Tours. Cannot give enough praise. Throughly enjoyed it. The local foods we were given to sample were excellent, the bike ride was thrilling, the tour guide, Tai, was informative, attentive, humorous, and spoke perfect English. Our bike drivers were friendly and easy going. Highly recommended. Thank you XO Tours!

Great food and nightlife of Saigon - A great way to experience amazing Vietnamese food, Saigon and the beautiful people of XO Tours. The girls we are very friendly and we met some really nice people on the tour.

Easily the best thing to do in HCMC - We did the tour on our second day in HCMC with out two children (8and 5 years), the 8 year old rode on her own scooter and the five year old with one of us as well. While at first a little worried they very rapidly gained confidence and were often riding just balanced behind the driver in complete comfort and ease. The drivers are extremely safe and careful, it gives a new appreciation of Saigon traffic to be on a scooter through it but also to see that people are actually fairly considerate of other drivers. No sign of road rage.
Picked up at our hotel at the agreed time by three drivers and taken to the first restaurant to meet the others in the group, 12 of us, 4 Australians, 2 English, 4 Canadians and two Americans of varying ages. Bun bo Hue to start. Driven through Chinatown and into various other parts of Saigon, districts 4,5,7 and 8 from memory. Fascinating to see how much this city has developed since we were last here 10 years ago and even more since our first visit 15 years ago. Went to some of the newer parts with expats and I presume the new Vietnamese middle class and also some of the poorer parts which are reminiscent of the last visits.
Huge amount of food, I'd suggest not eating much during the day, some were probably a bit edgier than others but never any pressure to eat anything. Food ranges from goat, beef, crabs, prawns, scallops, pipis to frog and fertilized duck eggs. The egg is for some reason a challenge for westerners, taste is actually not too bad, quite eggy surprising. Give. It's a try. The frog was also interesting- guess what! It tastes like chicken although the parts with skin are harder to block out what it is. Beer and soft drinks are also provided.
This is a great tour, could not recommend it more highly. Very safe, even in some of the. Ore dodgy areas there are additional male riders who probably act to make sure nothing happens to the guests. The children loved it, not so much the food but the bike tour. I loved it all. Do yourself a favor and book this tour.

Fun foodie tour - All female scooter riders with male "escorts". Very well trained, friendly and professional. A great way to see Saigon traffic, different districts and sample some different food and beer!

Foodie Tour via scooter with Tai and Phuong - Can't think of a more fun way to experience Saigon and be introduced many different types of local food. The tour was well organized and professionally managed. Tai, our tour coordinator/guide was very knowledgeable and engaging. My driver Phuong was awesome maneuvering her scooter through traffic and a truly fun and pleasant person to get to know. The entire XO team was just fun to be around and made for a very enjoyable group experience. Overall a very fun evening and highly recommended!

Really fun! - These scooter tours had really good reviews, so I tried it, although it was expensive. It was totally worth it. I went on the Saigon by Night tour, and the next morning, my 68 year old father and I went on The Sights tour. They were both amazing. You'll never see the craziness of the traffic like you will here. We zipped around and saw different districts of the city. The guides were amazing. The food was excellent on the Night tour. My father and I enjoyed it immensely. We ordered the video, which I also recommend. I just received the video tonight, and it was great. I have traveled all over the world and this was probably my favorite sightseeing tour. The scooter is a must in Vietnam!

A Must For Foodies!!!! - An absolutely amazing experience, from the second we were picked up until the moment it ended. This is a combination of experiences all wrapped together and it was just what we wanted. You try some really interesting and delicious foods, you sightsee parts of Saigon (HCMC) that you might not normally see during both day and night - by scooter which is an amazing way to see this city - you visit with the guides who are all locals and you meet some fellow travelers. What's not to love about that experience. Our family is two adults in our late 50's and our teenage son, 16. Trying to find activities we would all like is always a challenge. We all loved the tour, I think my son had more fun than we did. He had his own guide that he rode with and we parents had our own too. Riding around the city with a private tour guide on a scooter was educational and fun at the same time. The entire team of workers (and I'm not kidding when I say team) makes sure you are totally taken care of the entire time. Hong Tong, Yung and all our guides were amazing and fun. Highly recommend.

Fun way to see the sights - I was very hesitant about braving the traffic, but really enjoyed this tour. Our 3 teens loved this. It was a fun way to see the sights and to be submerged in the atmosphere of the city. Felt safe at all times. We traveled as a family of 5 so had 5 lovely ladies as drivers who took great care of us. Definitely a highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh.

Terrific! Loads of fun and delicious food! - We booked a private foodie tour and it exceeded our expectations in every way. We were met at our hotel by two lovely young ladies on motorbikes. They explained how to ride on the back and off we went. Although we were a bit scared at first, we discovered riding on the motorbikes was fun! During the course of the tour we drove through most of the districts of Saigon, enabling us to see far more of the city, and at closer range, than would be otherwise possible. The food stops were prepared for us in advance and the food was delicious, consisting of dishes we would never have found on our own. The food selections were tailored to our special requests and our tour guides really made an effort to please us, explain the food, and order special dishes we would like. We also walked through a wet market in Chinatown where we could ask questions about what we saw and buy fruits we wanted to try. The cultural and historical information provided was informative and highly interesting. This tour was a highlight of our stay in Saigon and was money very well spent!

Best night in Saigon! - My girlfriend and I participated in a private night tour. My driver Phuong, was able to maneuver through the chaotic streets of HCMC with such ease and finesse, whilst i sat comfortably on the rear. She was very well spoken for a person whose first language isn't English and provided great conversation throughout the night. Our tour guide Khoi was very informative and also had a great sense of humour. Its very interesting to see the contrast between the different districts, which was displayed over the course of the night. It was great to see the city from a locals perspective. Food and drinks were also amazing!

Foodie bike tour - Chances are if you're coming to Vietnam you're coming for the food. There's no better way than exploring this city by motorbike. We signed up for this tour based on a recommendation from our friend and we couldn't have been happier. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable, spoke impeccable English and were so engaging. They took us around to all the local spots and gave us history behind all the districts. I tried food that I never would have and also went to places I never would have discovered on our own. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone coming to Ho Chi Minh City. Thank you for one of our best memories!

Great First to Saigon - The Lowdown:
- Prompt pickup from your hotel. Do yourself a favor and just remove all jewelry b/c they'll make you up before riding on scooter.
- The ladies are merely drivers who will fill you in on random cultural things if you ask. You will be met on location by a guide (assuming all male) and a bodyguard ("the muscle").
- Guides are super friendly and informative. Tai & Sang were my guides for the The Sights & Foodie tours.
- Plenty of beer provided on Foodie tour. They take really good care of you.
- They take tons of pictures while you're on tour, so you don't have to worry much about that.

Suggested Improvements:
- Helmet on my Foodie tour smelled a bit. Maybe there should be a smell check performed before giving to a guest.

private scooter tour - Can't praise the young guys and gals more who took us on our private tour of 5 historical landmarks within HCM.
We were met at our hotel by two lovely girls who were our scooter drivers for the day (Thuy1 and Trinh). They drove us very safely onto our first place to visit, which was the post office and we were met there by our main tour guide for the day (Tuan). The historical information he gave was very informative and interesting and his knowledge for such a young guy was incredible! He also has a wicked sense of humor so it made our trip very fun!!
Both girls were excellent drivers and we're very informative along the way giving extra information and knowledge of their city.
I can't recommend this tour enough.

Hugely entertaining - Absolutely nothing to fault about the excellent foodie tour! Super well organized - the girls arrived to pick us up at the hotel right on time - we joined another 3 couples at the first stop and then it was 5 solid hours of cruising around several districts, getting to sample a wide range of food as well as a hefty dose of history and other information about the Vietnamese local way of life. The girls were great drivers - even my 6ft tall husband who was a first time pillion passenger felt pretty relaxed after a short while on the bike. Thoroughly recommend it to anyone looking to experience some great food and another side of Saigon away from the tourist hub.

A 'must' if you want local experience - Epic experience around Ho Chi Minh from especially Loan, Quynh (2), Vy, Ngoc and tour manager Tai. Very professional, yet very laid back tour.
We did 2 tours, foodie & sights. Both tours are a must! Had so much fun. Highly recommended. Very accommodating if you have any dietary issue. Wish they had a 'whole day' foodie tour, so much yummy food to eat. We would have been lost without them.

Saigon by Night - This is a must do, it was an amazing tour & the staff were absolutely fantastic, they are so friendly & have a great sense of humour. It was an awesome way to see other parts of Ho Chi Minh that you normally wouldn't see. It was also a great way to see the different districts by night. We would definitely recommend this to everyone. Loved being on the bikes and we felt safe at all times. THANKS XO TOURS 👍

Fantastic - Loved the Saigon night tour! Lot of fun riding on a motorbike visiting a number of the districts you probably wouldn't have seen otherwise. The female drivers speak solid English and are a lot of fun. Highly recommend doing this tour.

Super fun time! - We had a very delicious and very memorable time with XO tours. The real experience is riding on the back of the moped and being part of the South Vietnamese traffic experience. But of course the food and the cultural background are great too. If I have any friends visiting HCM, I would tell them the food tour is a necessity!

Definitely the highlight of my trip! - We spent three days in Saigon and booked the tour on the last night before we left for home. The tour was excellent! My rider Linh was simply amazing. We talked a lot about the city, the country, the younger generation and their aspirations. You get to understand the city and people well by talking to riders. The food was nice too! And the tour manager Tai was funny, helpful and informative too! The route of the tour was deliberate and well designed. You get to see the areas of the city normal tourists will never go to. All in all, this is the tour not to be missed if you are visiting Saigon! Highly recommended.

整个行程中主要使用英文，如果对英文水平不够自Contact Us

Great food tour - Yes, their evening food tour isn't the cheapest one around. But that's immediately the most negative thing I can say about XO food tour. We had a great time and I will recommend this to all my friends. The girls that drive around are very friendly, speak good English, are save drivers and are truly fun! The food is really good and there is more than plenty. They actually drive you around quiet far in the suburbs so you'll spend time on the bike which is good to digest the food and look around you. If you're not comfortable on a bike I suggest you take a motorcycle taxi a few times before the tour so you get used to it. Again really recommended: just experienced it!

More than just food - We booked foodie tour based on our friends' recommendation and it was definitely a great experience. We had a group of eight cruising around the city and we had a lot of fun eating great food with the locals.

During the tour our tour guide gave us great introduction to the city. Drivers were extremely friendly and I felt perfectly safe among the chaotic traffic.

Oh what fun it is to ride on the back of an XO ! - We did the XO food tour last night and had a really great time! We've read the reviews and chose to do this to feel what it's like to be part of the Saigon traffic, to see more of the city and other districts and to taste a variety of dishes eaten by the local people. And this is exactly what we got and we had a great time! The girls are friendly, good and safe drivers and speak English really well. They gave us lots of information while riding and also about the food which they sometimes helped to prepare, explained about the ingredients and showed us how it is usually eaten. We stopped at 3 different local restaurants in different districts and had a huge variety of dishes to try, including BBQ frog legs (with or without skin) and boiled duck egg with yoke and embrio inside! But there is lots more if you, like me, cannot really stomach these weird snacks! BBQ goats meet, beef, beef noodle soup, corn and vegetable pancakes, seafood, deepfried tofu, fresh springrolls, coconut jelly and cream caramel, all served with a variety of delicious sauces.

Thanks to our wonderful guides, Phuong and Ngoc 2, we had a really great evening!

Foodie Tour - We booked the evening foodie tour, it was excellent, the girls did a wonderful job driving us around on the mopeds, we never felt unsafe, the food was superb and we would recommend this trip to anyone.

If you haven't met Truong don't leave Asia - The best hands down tour guide I ve ever had
Smart sensitive to your needs and interests and so knowledgable about his country
I understand he does other country tours but if you are going to Ho Chi Min City
Do contact him. He's the best

Great scooter tour of Ho Chi Minh City - Getting on the back of a scooter was unnerving at first but it proved to be a great way to really feel like we were part of the scooter madness and to get a feeling for the city. We had so much fun with our drivers and felt very safe with them...we also felt enriched with the information that our tour guide gave us at every stop. It was a highlight of our time in the city. Not to be missed!!!

Fun Foodie Tour - We had great fun zipping around Saigon and visiting districts we would not otherwise have come across. Food was great and Tai, Lyn and team made us feel very welcome.

Very well organized and professional and you pay for that so if you would rather a bit more rough and ready, the cheaper options that may suit better. Thanks again to all at XO tours for a really great evening.

Best Tour we've every taken anywhere! - All the good reviews about this tour prove to be true. I cannot speak enough about how friendly and informative the tour guides are. From Chang (2) and Chuy to Tai and his staff, we were made to feel as though they were friends that we'd known for years and that they were showing us around their town. We went on the foodie tour and ventured to places that as a tourist, you might drive by and catch the waft of meats or seafood grilling, but be too intimidated to enter because you didn't speak the language. The food was fit for both locals and tourists alike, and we enjoyed it. We happened to join a group tour, and we had a blast with people that we had met at the start of the tour.

There are many bike tours, and I'm certain that many of them are friendly and professional, but XO deserves its ranking as the #1 Tour in HCM.

XO Foodie Tours - This was one of my favorite parts of the trip. You have the opportunity to try many foods that locals eat while getting to see parts of the other districts. Everyone on the tour was very nice and helpful. Don't be scared about riding on a motorbike with these girls, they really know what they're doing. I will definitely do this again some day.

XO tours voted BEST for a reason! - I'm so thankful that my research paid off again on TripAdvisor and I found XO Tours! We booked a city tour which lasted from 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Our drivers were both lovely and shared so much of the country, their personal life etc. My guide, Chang- thanks for a great experience! We drove around Saigon and visited historic places, interesting local market, post office etc with the tour leader An being so entertaining and informative.

The evening foodie tour is a MUST if you into your food like us and willing to try some new things. Saigon by night is amazing and you will see and experience different districts you won't see if you do the city on your own.

You will visit 5/6 different districts and try different foods- on the day we had beef pho, grilled goat, grilled beef, grilled okra, scallops, clams, delicious crab claws, grilled frog legs.

Never thought I'd say it but after the Foodie Tour, grilled frog is delicious!

My guide for the evening tour was Tam. She was yet again amazing and it was such a humbling experience to be allowed into her life for a few hours in that evening.

I can't praise XO Tours enough. There are quite a few other Tours available but not at the personal standard and expertise these guys do it.

Enjoy your trip in Saigon with XO TOURS. They are the Best for a reason.

Ian and Jason

Great night in Ho Chi Minh - We joined an XO foodie tour on our first night in Ho Chi Minh. It was a fabulous way to see the city and lots of fun on the back of the scooters. The tour is very professional run with excellent guides . The tour had been recommended by several friends back in Australia and we were really glad to have followed their suggestion.

Highly Rated - This was recommended to us as a 'must do' in HCMC
We did this on our first evening in Vietnam and what a fantastic experience
Great scooter drivers, very well run, very high service ethic by the team, great views of many HCMC districts after dark, great eating venues, great food
I would highly recommend to others

Morning tour in Saigon - This is definitely the way to see the very busy Ho Chi Minh City. Lots of information, humor, visuals, tasty samples and traffic! I felt very safe and relaxed with my driver taking me all over the city and will definitely recommend and plan to do this again!

Great way to take in the city - This tour is great for groups (no more than 19) to take in the city from a local's perspective. we enjoyed learning about the city on a motor bike and trying some of the local foods (ie frog and quail egg). definitely recommend!

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh - Wife and I had a great time with our guides. Female guides arrived promptly and did quick safety briefing and off we went. Did Saigon by night tour and went to a few districts most tourists wouldn't travel too. Felt safe from the second we took off on the scooters. Guides spoke English, provided explanations on all locations and were also great drivers. Would recommend this tour for anyone who wants to be on a scooter in the chaos of Saigon but doesn't want to drive :)

Excellent - Friend of mine recommended the foodie-tour, and really glad I took the advice!!
The 4-hour tour was excellent scooter-ride through Saigon. We got to see the cities many faces and taste many delicious dishes right where the locals enjoy them too.
Guides were excellent, girls drove us really skillfully through the caotic traffic, really worth to ecperience this tour. We warmly recommend this experience!

City Bike Tour - Don't miss this tour while in HCMC! It's super fun and great way to immerse yourself in the city.

Drivers- My driver (all drivers are females dressed in traditional Vietnamese clothing) was very safe and I never felt scared (though I'm quite adventurous). They tell you all the do vs don't before you ride. She was also quite conversational (as was my husbands driver) and shared a lot along the way.

Tour Leader- Tuan. He took some good pictures on the tour and emailed them to us later. He meets you at each stop along the way and tells you about the locations you are visiting. He was funny, cracked some jokes along the way and provided a healthy concise dose of history.

They were quite responsive to my needs. When I asked for a gauze mask they did their best to get me one right away. The only thing I would suggest is that they always have gauze mask on hand for anyone who might require one. I do not recommend this tour for anyone who has issues with asthma- but I strongly recommend it for everyone else!!!!
Amazing Way to Learn about Vietnam - Excellent service, tour guides spoke fluent English and were great guides. We were very well taken care of. Would recommend this tour to anyone

Moped delight in Ho Chi Minh - My husband and two teenagers booked this tour on a friend's recommendation. It was one of our highlights since visiting Vietnam. We spent 3 hrs seeing Saigon by night. Our drivers (female university students) were fantastic. Never once did I feel unsafe. The women were very friendly, informative and incredibly skilled drivers. The tour was well organized and we saw different areas of the city which most tourists didn't get to see. A must when in Ho Chi Minh.

Awesome Night Food Tour!!!! - I was brave and decided to partake of the scooter/ motorbike madness of this city....albeit as a passenger. Huong 2 was my personal scooter guide and food assistant throughout the evening. She was lovely, friendly and a very safe driver. I felt relaxed after a few minutes on the scooter. The tour was very well-organized and the driver picked me up and dropped me off at my hotel. The leader, Thai, was energetic, friendly, knowledgeable and truly loves his job. We traveled to five different districts in the city and had very unique foods (not pho, banh mi etc. like other tours offer). Throughout the tour we will stop and have history lessons in the different districts. Our group was loud and rowdy and lots of fun. A few days after the tour, Thai emailed all of the clients digital photographs of the evening. Highly recommend this tour company. They are reputable and extremely professional. Definitely a highlight of my time in Ho Chi Minh City.

Fantastic, friendly and full of information - This morning I was picked up right on time. My guide Ngoc drove down a small alley to pick me up. We drove about 10 minutes to the cathedral where we met 4 more people. So our tour had 5 in all. A head guide and an assistant also traveled with us. His name was understood he gave us very detailed information on each place we visited. We dropped in to a market for a taste of local desert s and were later given a sugar cane drink and fruit.
Great tour. You pay more and you get more.

Excellent - We did the Saigon By Night tour with XO yesterday and it was the highlight of our stay in HCMC. The food and dessert choices offer a tantalizing glimpse of XO's Foodie Tour - and the candid advice about market shopping and haggling was most welcome.

Nguyen was a knowledgable and engaging host who ensured all parties in our (very small) group got a proper introduction to the city at every stop.

And we can't say enough good things about our motorcycle pilots and guides, Tam and Thuy. Both were excellent drivers, attentive tour guides, and fluent English conversationalists. We truly enjoyed their company and camaraderie through our 3-hour tour.

Thanks, XO!

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City! - This was the highlight of the time I had in Ho Chi Minh City. The drivers are super fun and you really go to restaurants and districts you'd never go to as a tourist ... And driving was through the city was crazy, but that's why I booked it!

What a treat! - Booked the Saigon by Night tour with XO and the service the team provided was beyond exceptional. We were a company of 6 with one senior who was at first nervous to get on a scooter - however with the reassurance of the girls, the evening went very smoothly. It is a whole new way to experience Saigon on a scooter, and our team lead, Khoi & the girls were very knowledgable about the city.
The safety of all the passengers were their first most priority - there were additional 2 riders to ensure that we got to places safely, even when walking on the streets in the other districts. The route was light, fun, and the entire team was coordinated, patient, sensitive, very professional and always engaging and as a result, everyone enjoyed themselves hugely.
This tour is a must for everyone who wants to experience Saigon like a local.

There's a reason they're number 1!! - We booked XO thanks to their supreme rating on Tripadvisor. There is a reason they are so highly rated! The tour guides are incredible, all the women who work for XO have a voracious sense of humour, are kind, knowledgable and know how to make your tour unforgettable! We chose the night food tour and they take you all over Saigon, through the majority of the districts and you see everything you wouldn't normally see. Being on the back of the motorbike is so unique and such a great way to see Saigon and experience it like a local. Our guides Chang and Que(?) were so friendly, constantly making us laugh and looked after us like we were family.
I was unfortunately unable to enjoy any of the food due to a prior stomach bug but both the ladies were constantly checking to see if I was feeling ok and offering cool drinks, towels and if I needed to return to the hotel. Despite not being able to eat anything, all the food looked fantastic, my husband thoroughly enjoyed trying all the local Viet delights which were different to the standard Banh Mi, Pho & Bao. Even though I couldn't eat and felt uncomfortable due to my illness, it was still the best tour we have done! Just having our tour guides personally escort us through the hustle of Ho Chi Minh was an amazing enough experience.
They make you feel extremely safe and well looked after, they ensure they have an entourage of "security" who keeps an eye on our for us whilst we were eating and stopped to listen to information.
Best of all, XO somehow figured out we were on our honeymoon and brought out a huge celebration cake at the end for us and shared it around! This was on top of all the other food that had been stuffed into the group!
If you want to truly see Saigon, choose XO. You will be met with the kindest, friendliest, humorous and knowledgeable group of guides and you will have a unique and unforgettable tour!

Excellent way to do food and sigh see - My son and I did the foodie tour and it heavily rained but that didn't stop the tour going ahead (we were given the option of not continuing). Drivers are very safe. It was a thrill to be among the traffic for a change and not having to navigate through the traffic to get to the other side of the road when crossing the street. The drivers/riders are very good and communicate very well. My rider Tuyet was extremely knowledgeable and could talk about anything. The food was all good, but you do need some adventure in you. We ate goat, frog many different seafood and finally, the fertilized duck eggs. I'll say no more. This is not a spring roll tour! the places you go are real Vietnamese places. Very well run. Thoroughly recommend!

Good fun and food! - We booked the Sights tour and Foodie tour and were not disappointed! Saigon traffic is crazy and being in the middle of it makes the experience amazing.

Our tour guides, Tai and Hieu were amazing, and so were all the girls!! They are all friendly, knowledgeable and great fun. They made our Saigon experience a memorable one.

If you want a 'quick' 3 hour tour around the city I recommend the Sights tour. If you want to eat like a local (ALL kinds of meat), you have to book the Foodie tour.

It was great fun and would do it all over again.

Exceptional tour - My 19 yo daughter and I went on both the Sights tour during the day and the Foodie tour at night. We only had a day and a half in Saigon and it was the best way to see a lot and eat like a local in a short period of time. I highly recommend them and didn't think it was overpriced given the amount of things we were able to see and do.

Best thing you can do on two wheels - This was outstanding fun. The guides were excellent and rode the chaotic streets with ease. The choice of locations gave an excellent variety of food and beverage. It was amazing traveling among the thousands of scooters and experiencing Ho Chi Min as the locals experience it

Can't recommend this enough!!! Must do!!!

Foodie Fun - What a blast! XO's Foodie tour should be a must for anyone with an interest in Vietnamese cuisine or even if you're just a big guts! For a start, zipping around Saigon on the back of a scooter ridden by our lovely guides Quyen and Mai was a real thrill and we got to see areas we would never have seen on our own. And the food was delicious, even if occasionally challenging. Our daughter and her partner did the tour a couple of years ago and raved - now we're raving too.
It was the perfect way to celebrate our 35th wedding anniversary and XO Tours certainly came to the party.

Excellent tour of Saigon - I took my family to Saigon and decided to try something different. I have two kids- ages 9 and 13. Also, grandpa came along on this trip - age 75. All five of us were on the scooters and away we went. Both my kids said it was there favorite activity for the entire two week trip. A ton of fun was had by all!

Excellent XO Tours - We booked a food tour on recommendation by a friend and we were not disappointed. Ho Chi Minh has so much food on offer and we were taken to places that we could never have tried. We felt safe everywhere; especially on the bikes. The women were also really, truly funny. One of the best things you can do in this City.

Excellent tour - Our tour with Tien and Trinh was nothing short of exceptional, they knew Saigon inside out and made the tour very entertaining. They also ride very safely. They answered our questions as well as gave insight at each stop we had. I highly recommend the tour. It's certainly a must do in Ho Chi Minh City or as locals call it the city.

The best way to see Saigon! - What a great way to see this amazing city! We did the "Sights" tour and absolutely loved it. Our tour guides Tien and Trinh were so amazing and knowledgeable, we learned a ton about the city and about Vietnamese culture in general. Riding the motorbikes is definitely the best way to see the city, we were able to visit a number of sights comfortably in a couple of hours. The tour leaders were friendly as well and the whole experience was so well-coordinated. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone coming to Ho Chi Minh City!

A real must do! - I booked the Sights tour in the morning and the Foodie tour later that night, which I would say is the highlight of my whole Saigon trip!
What I like about the Sights tour is that it's very informative and you get to know more of the Saigon history. (The story of the Burning Monk broke my heart. 💔) My guide is very friendly and I felt safe all through out the tour.
Then there's the Foodie tour later that night! My friend felt sick so he wasn't able to do this, but I'm very happy that I still pushed through this tour! This is the best thing I did in my entire Saigon trip! All the food that we had were AMAZING -- the scallops at the last stop is to die for -- plus the city is a beauty at night! I would never get to eat those awesome and authentic food and would never get to those places if it weren't for XO. Our tour manager that night is nice and funny, and my tour driver Chang is awesome!

Exceptional experience - We did the city and the food tour with XO-Tours. We got picked up at the hotel from two ladies with scooters. Traffic in Ho-Chi-Minh is very chaotic, but the drivers were sovereign and I felt very safe. In both tours they brought us to exciting places & restaurants we would never have visited without them. The tours allow me a very interesting insight in a vibrant, developing city and its inhabitants. The best was that whilst driving to the next place I could share my impression with the driver. I can highly recommend these tours. Its a very good opportunity to get in touch with Vietnamese young people and share experiences as well with other travelers from all over the world.

AWESOMENESS! - When my wife and I decided to go to Vietnam for our honeymoon, some of our well-traveled friends recommended that we take the Foodie Tour with XO Tours as they had previously done. We couldn't be happier that we decided to do so! Our trip to Saigon would not have been the same without this experience. A few things that are worth highlighting:

-First, our tour guide, Thu Duong, as well the rest of the crew did an incredible job. We felt perfectly safe as they navigated us through Saigon's crowded streets on the back of their motorbikes. This was a really cool experience to see the city like this, as you actually felt like you were participating in the hustle of Saigon.

-The food was excellent. We went to 3 different spots that we definitely would never have known about or visited otherwise. Each place was clean and we had no apprehensions about eating there. Of the three places we went, it's hard to pick our favorite since they were all very good in their own way.

-Also, it's worth pointing out that everything operates seamlessly. Each time we arrived to a restaurant, a table was waiting for us, the food was served shortly thereafter, and every detail seemed to have been accounted for. It was very impressive how smooth everything seemed to go.

-We loved that the tour allowed us to see so many different parts of the city. We visited 5 different districts and Thu did a great job of explaining their history, culture, etc. It was great to break out of the heavily traveled, tourist-populated areas. If planning a trip I may recommend doing an XO tour on the first day of the trip just so you know what areas are out there.

-We chose for the video/photo crew to follow us around and take footage of our tour and we're thankful that we decided to do so. We just received our video and we're amazed at how well it turned out. We'll certainly be watching it for years and years to come.

Our XO Foodie Tour was an experience that we'll never forget and it should be at the very top of the list for anyone visiting Saigon. You'll be thankful that you decided to take the tour.
Great way to experience HCMC by night!! - My wife and I did the food tour at night with Canh and Phuong (Tai was the leader) All around amazing!

Best foodie tour! - What an amazing day! Best foodie tour in Vietnam. I got an authentic and cultural tour of the city. We visited 5 districts that I probably would not have gone to unless I was with a local. We tasted true authentic Vietnamese dishes and they were all delicious. Did I mention it's all you can eat and drink?!! Yum! These women are professional, informative, sweet, and fun to be around. They made my trip amazing! Thank you!

So Much Fun - We booked the Sights Tour for our first day in Saigon - which was an excellent way to see the city for the first time, from the back of a bike! Initially i was quite nervous about being on the back of a scooter in the busy traffic of HCMC, but the girls were excellent drivers and very considerate to check that we were not scared. Within a few minutes of being on the back of the bike, i was relaxed and loving the experience.

The tour took us past some of the key sights of the city, and provided us with an overview of the history. We were also able to sample some food/drink from markets along the way. It was very well organized, safety conscious, and such a fun way to spend a half day seeing the city.

Highly recommend this tour group - we had people of all ages on our tour and everyone left with huge smiles on their faces. We certainly will be booking another tour with XO Tours next time we are back in HCMC!!!

Great Tour, Worth the Extra Money - I booked a tour with four coworkers who had not been on a city tour before. I have been on several through the years, mostly cheap tours that involve more gift shops than sites. Our tour guide, Sang, and our five drivers were extremely professional. Their English was very good. They all had a good sense of humor and seemed to enjoy their jobs. The tour was concise and well organized. No time was wasted at any stop, though we never felt rushed. Sang's overview of each stop was very well executed, I learned a few new things and saw a few new sites during our tour. I highly recommend any of the XO tours to anyone considering a motorbike tour (or any other tour, for that matter) of HCM. A motorbike is by far the best way to experience the sites (and smells) of HCM. The drivers are excellent and the whole tour feels very safe.

This is a must-do! - This is a must. We wanted to see as much of Ho Chi Minh as possible. So we booked a custom five hour tour. We were not disappointed. Our guide, Tai, did a great job. He was very informative and we learned a lot of Vietnam's history and its culture. Our drivers were Huong, Thanh and Tam. My driver was Huong who was intelligent, fun and always smiling. She speaks perfect English. Better than me! She was a great ambassador for Ho Chi Minh and all of Vietnam. She can zip in and out of the hectic traffic and still make you feel very safe on the back of her scooter. All in all it was a fantastic day. Couldn't be happier and would highly recommend this tour. This is a must.

Amazing!!! Highly recommend!!! - Did the sightseeing tour and LOVED it!! I had an incredible time with Cahn ^-^. I traveled for a month and she was my absolute favorite person I met on my trip. Laughed so much and had such a great time! Not to mention she's a top notch motorbike driver and super sweet to boot. The smoothest driving!! She also gave us a list for all the things we wanted to find in the city :). Thanks for being so awesome Cahn!!!
Tai was also exceptional. He was informative, cheery and made sure we were having the best experience possible. He also went above and beyond for us going out of his way to find Vietnamese balloons for my balloon artist partner. Thank you Tai!!

We also went on the private Foodie tour and the food was absolutely delicious. I'll never forget the mouthwatering coconut jelly made with agar from seaweed. One of my favorite dishes in the entire trip.

Thanks so much XO!! We were extremely pleased!!

Safe and amazing tour in HCMC! Most enjoyable tour ever! - I was hesitant about doing this tour because of safety on the motorbike and as well as eating food from restaurants that may not appear to have the highest sanitary standards coming from Canada. However, I am so happy that we did it and both me and my wife agree that this was the most enjoyable experience any couple could ask for.
We were picked up promptly at our hotel by our two guides (Hoang and Vi) and after some safety tips, we were quickly on our way to the first stop to meet the other people on the tour. The streets of HCMC are chaotic at the best of times but our two ladies navigated the streets skillfully and safely at all times. I cannot stress how calm and professional they were the whole time. This is despite having a brief downpour that requires us to wear rain ponchos (provided by XO tours). Do not hesitate to let them know if you are nervous!
while on the road and on the streets, there were also several guys who accompanied us as "bodyguards" and also made sure we could cross the streets safely. They also helped us with food and took photos and videos. We never felt our safety threatened on the roads but knowing that these guys were there was certainly nice.
Next, for the food, we stopped at 3 different places for food and I won't spoil what we ate but they were very accommodating if you have any food allergies or restrictions. They certainly do not cheap out on portions or drinks. You will definitely need to pace yourself and you will not finish the tour hungry, guaranteed!!
We were also provided with education at each stop and our guides gave us a lot of commentary as we drove through the city. Each tour (I believe) has a tour manager and ours was Tai and he gave us an introduction to everything we ate. He provided a lot of comic relief as well and made the tour even more enjoyable.

All in all, if you are thinking about doing a food tour, this is definitely the one you should do. Safety is not an issue and the food is probably as safe as you can get. They also allow you to try foods that most of us probably wouldn't be able to do on our own...trust me... Luckily we never get sick from the food as they do choose carefully which restaurants to take us to!

XO Tours simply the best tour I have ever been on! Hoang, Vi and Tai were amazing and I'm sure the rest of the crew is as well.

M&S

Tour Leader is aces. Hard working staff and security. - I booked the foodie night tour.
The price is quite high compared to other tours I booked which would make me hesitant to rebook.
The tour is by motorbike with a female guide.
My guide was on time as I wasn't due to rush hour traffic.
The tour leader was on point throughout the tour, always checking in and being a very smooth comedian.
The security detail always made me feel safe at night as there's petty crimes that could happen on motorbike.
The tour guide I was assigned was nice but we had some miscommunication due to language barrier, at the end we addressed my concerns and continued on.
The other guides and my guide work tirelessly to make the tour a great one, I appreciate their hospitality during the tour as a Westerner I'm not accustomed to having my seafood shelled and prepped.
The tour itself shows you different districts of HCMC.

Must do in Ho Chi Minh City! - We had a great time on the foodie tour. Everything is well organized and it's a nice mix of learning about the different districts and enjoying great local food. The girls who drove my husband and I were absolutely great and riding around the city on scooters was a lot of fun. All of the guides were friendly and knowledgeable, and made sure our group was having a good time - plenty beer and games added in between meals! The food was delicious and included several items we would not have ordered on our own, but that we enjoyed a lot. After the tour, we received an email with photos from the night which was also appreciated. This is a highlight of our time in Vietnam and highly recommend for others visiting.

Coolest tour we took in Vietnam!! Not to miss!! - We took the night tour around HCMC and this was without doubt the best experience we had so far in Vietnam. The stops were very interesting (and show you a complete different picture of the city than any "standard" tours), the food was really good, but most of all, the guides (we had Tam1, Thao1 on the bikes and Tuan Nguyen as tour leader) were really amazing, they made the tour very memorable! Thank you all 3 for that and the best to you all ...

A Can't Miss Experience! - I took the Saigon by Night tour and was very pleased. The staff was friendly and professional. The stops were vibrant. The food was tasty. Everything was absolutely wonderful. I HIGHLY recommend taking a tour with this company!

Ho Chi Minh by night tour - Me and my girlfriend took a night tour around Ho Chi Minh. It was definitely one of the best experiences during our trip to Vietnam. The guides are really friendly and welcoming, they are fluent in English and have a lot to tell and show around the city. The best thing about this tour is that you get to visit some districts, sights and places to eat that you probably won't visit on your own. And riding on a motorcycle around the city is actually a lot of fun)

Best tour ever - highly recommend - If there is one thing you do in HCMC, do the XO foodie tour. It's a little expensive but well worth it. You get a unique and local tour of the city and get to see the real and raw parts of Vietnam. The food is amazing and the drivers are awesome on the road. An incredible experience.

MUST DO in Ho Chi Minh City - The "Saigon By Night" tour we did with XO was absolutely one of the highlights of our 10 day trip to Vietnam. This was a fantastic way to get out of District 1 and see some places we would have definitely not seen otherwise. The tour was professional, well-run and an all around blast. Our drivers were incredible and were so personable/easy to talk to that it felt like we were just hanging out with our friends for the evening. The meal provided was delicious as well. I really recommend cannot this tour company enough. Thank you, XO Tours!

NOTE: We also paid extra $$ for the video option. Having recently received the video I think this was definitely worth it and such a fun keepsake of our trip to Vietnam. Get the video!

Amazing tour! One of the best in South East Asia. - My friends and I all had an amazing time with XO tours. We did the Saigon tour by night and the girls and tour guide were great. We cruised around the districts, ate great food, and got a taste of the local life. This was one of my favorite tours while traveling around SE Asia. Highly recommend!

Just wonderful! - We had a relatively short time to enjoy Saigon but decided that we really wanted to the XO "Foodie Tour" and booked this for our first evening. Well, what an introduction to the city!

The tour started at 5.30pm when myself and my husband were collected outside our hotel by two adorable Vietnamese girls on scooters called Tien and Ann (forgive any spelling mistakes!) The girls took time to explain how the tour was organized, told us how to ride safely on the back and reassured us that we were in good hands! The we donned our helmets and set off for our first stop where we met up with Tai, the group leader.

At this first restaurant we met the other participants on the tour (there were 11 in total, 10 adults and a four month old baby!) and we all got to know each other while we enjoyed a lovely bowl of Bun Bo Hue.

We left here and drove through the Chinatown district and we stopped a second time for Tai to fill us in some more on life in Saigon. One of the lovely things about the tour was that all the way along when we were on the back of the bikes the girls told us lots of interesting things about their lives and it was really so special to meet people who wanted to share their culture with us.

Next stop was a restaurant where we had a selection of food which the girls prepared for us at the table on small individual BBQ's! We had a selection of goat breast, marinated beef, large shrimp and ocra. And a surprise addition on frog for anyone who wanted to try it. I wasn't too sure about it but decided to have a taste and it was really very good! There was water, soft drinks and beer on offer, and everyone was encouraged to eat and drink as they wished.

Then we had another stop on the very new district where Tai told us more about how modern Saigon is.

Final stop was in a seafood restaurant where we had the most beautiful crab claws and scallops you could ever wish for! All the time the girls served the food to us and made sure we had everything we wanted.

I have to say that this is an experience that should not be missed if you have an evening to spend in Saigon.

Definitely 10 out of 10 from both hubby and I.

Wonderful evening with XO tours - Just did an XO tour with Luan and Anh as our drivers. It was amazing. I am just turning 70 and want you to know it's a wonderful way to see Saigon and eat with the locals. Our excellent drivers picked us up at the Sofitel and off we went. Well prepared with helmets of course. Anh was the tour leader and filled us in as we stopped on both cultural and Vietnamese customs. We were with three other couples and it was just the right size. We had lots of fun with all the drivers as they prepared our food we ate. Thank you XO for a memorable evening. I highly recommend this tour.

Great way to experience Ho Ch Minh City - We participated in the evening foodie tour. We absolutely loved the tour. Everyone was wonderful. Our lady drivers were very knowledgeable and they made us feel very safe on their motorbikes. The tour guide was wonderful and had a great sense of humor. The food we got to enjoy was exceptional. We highly recommend this company and tour!

No question...this is a MUST DO - My family of 7 (2 adults and our 5 kids aged 18, 17, 15, 13 and 11) did this tour on our very first night in Vietnam and can not recommend it enough. It is a brilliant introduction to not only the food but to Vietnam (and its crazy traffic). We were upgraded to a private tour as we were such a large family, and the 7 girls picked us up at the hotel right on time. Introductions were done, and off we went holding on for dear life. We stopped firstly at restaurant to try Bo Bun Hue and the guy in charge of our tour came and introduced himself and explained the dish. He gave us a run down of our itinerary for the night, lots of food and a couple of tourist/information stops. We covered 5 districts and ate a variety of food including bbq goat, bbq frog, scallops, crabs, prawns and even balut (duck embryo) which the kids all tried..and finished with coconut jelly and sticky rice - beer and soft drinks included as well! We were accompanied by a photographer, video filmer and security staff .. we received the photos which were awesome by email 2 days later and the video will arrive in 2 weeks. By the end of the night we were all very full and were so accustomed to the traffic we were no longer holding on! If you only do one thing in HCMC make it this!

Saigon on back of scooter with excellent guides - What a fantastic experience! Really excellent drivers and guides,. They took us to many interesting parts of the city we would never have seen on our own. Excellent historical information from guides as well It was exhilarating on the scooters and we always felt safe. Drivers and guides all spoke impeccable English and were extremely friendly. We took a private tour which is nice, but probably not necessary, as a group of 6 or so would probably give a similar experience.

Awesome Experience! - This was such a fun tour! My boyfriend and I took this tour in November 2016, and had an amazing time. We take food tours often in new cities that we visit and this was one of the best we've done. The girls (Nahn & Phuong2), picked us up at our hotel exactly at the time they said and were both so nice! They were so much fun throughout the whole tour, always asking us questions, as well as telling us about themselves and the places/things we were seeing throughout the ride. Riding on the back of the motorbike really gives you the experience of the crazy traffic of HCMC, although you feel completely safe with these girls at the wheel! They take you to multiple districts (1,3,4,5,7,8 - i believe), so you really get to see all aspects of HCMC, and not just the touristy parts (Districts 1 and 3). The food is also amazing! You really do eat a lot, so I would recommend not eating at all before you take the tour. Unlimited beers and drinks are also included which is a big plus. They will also let you be as adventurous as you want. We tried frog, goat, duck embryo, among other things, but they dont pressure you to eat anything you dont want to! Overall the experience was awesome, and the girls and tour guide (Hieu) made it great! They also take pictures of you throughout the tour and send them to you after which makes it fun to just experience the tour and not worry about taking a bunch of pictures. Highly recommend!!

One of the highlights of my trip - This tour was sooo much fun! Highly recommend. Most definitely one of the highlights of my trip. The girls who drove, and the tour guide were fun, informative, and personable. Really tried to make sure everyone had a good time. Loved the stop at the market to try deserts, and sugar cane drink!

Saigon By Night - We did the saigon by night tour with XO tours. We had a great time! The women who gave the tour were awesome and we always felts safe on the bikes :) You get plenty of food and the tour guide who met you at the stops was lovely. Definitely recommend!.

The Gold Standard - I went on the foodie tour. It's a very polished and well organized tour composed of touring different districts around the city and plenty of incredible local food.

I can't fault a single thing about this tour. My guide Nguyet was so funny and charming and matched my personality perfectly. She was an absolute pleasure to spend the night with, providing an insight into how the locals live and her own life. The leader of the tour, Hieu, is just as charismatic and has an impressive memory for names!

You'll eat heaps of sublime food at popular local haunts and for the adventurous get to try a few things that might be new to you.

I wish I'd done this tour last on my route as it sets such a high standard it'll be difficult to top the experience.

Enjoyed the night time foodie tour - Probably geared to people younger than we are but we thoroughly enjoyed it too. The girls were very informative as we rode through the city. Really got a glimpse into the entire city...at night. Stopped at 3 different restaurants in 4-1/2 hours so we weren't stuffed full the whole time which was good. We didn't eat anything super weird but enough local flavors to realize you are in Vietnam. Definitely a winner. The only suggestion for XO is to break up who you sit by at the different stops. I felt like I was seated next to the same people each stop. Might have enjoyed getting to know more of the group.

Foodie Tour . . . Highlight of Our Trip - Although one of the more expensive tours we did in Vietnam ($70 per person), the cost was definitely worth it. We stopped at three restaurants. At the first restaurant, we had a traditional soup based dish street side (not Pho) and we were introduced to the tour agenda. Our second stop was a Vietnamese bbq where fresh meat is cooked on the table. Fortunately, our drivers did all of the hard work for us and showed us some fun games to play and shared other interesting bits of information, as well as answered our multitude of questions. Our third stop was a little street side shop were the food focused on seafood and we got to try some more unusual dishes (duck eggs). If you have certain foods you don't like, they will happily get you a dish of something else. The beer was also freely flowing. Between each stop, we will check out some sights around town and get some valuable information about life in Saigon. Each food stop was truly all you could eat and drink (we definitely took advantage), the drivers were knowledgeable, safe, spoke great English and were just generally fun to hang out with. I cannot recommend this tour enough.

XO Foodie Tour Through Saigon - An incredible experience and a perfect way to taste your way through Saigon - highly recommend! The drivers picked us up from our hotel and had ponchos on hand for us due to some light rain. Not only were our drivers fluent in English and great on their scooters (the traffic is nuts!), but they were also incredibly fun and made our first night in Vietnam one we won't forget. We had five stops through the tour, three of which were to try different types of food and the remaining two were to other notable places in various districts in Saigon. A truly authentic experience.

Amazing way to discover Saigon on a motorbike! - Wow what can I say, I was blown away by the tour. I was always nervous about seeing the traffic here in Saigon but to be in the middle of it all on the back of a motorbike was very thrilling. I felt safe the entire time and zipping through traffic was very exciting!

Our guides picked us up on time and after a quick briefing, we were zipped away to various districts outside district one to try different local restaurants. Never felt pressured to try anything I was uncomfortable with. Your driver will even serve you and help you peel shrimp shells and crack crab claws - amazing!

I also liked how the tour leader made brief stops along the way to tell us a bit more about lifestyle in Saigon so it was educational not just on food but also the city.

Highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Amazing Tour - - Must do! I am highly recommending this tour. It's like getting a free history class from our guide. Our guide Hieu Nguyen is really good in English and really knows what he is talking about.

I went for the Sights tour with my girlfriend. She was a little hesitant initially but eventually enjoyed herself.The girls are fun loving and professional.The Best!!

Received the photos after 3 days as promised.

Fun Evening and well looked after! - We did the Foodie tour a few weeks ago and would throughly recommend. Our drivers Thuy 2 and Tuyet were brilliant, telling us all about the city as we went around on the bikes and making the evening very fun. I didn't feel well going on the trip that evening, but Thuy 2 looked after us very well to make sure all was fine. The tour leader Anh helped give an insight into each of the districts and ensure the whole night went smoothly. Great trip!!!

Great Night Food Tour in Saigon - I was excited to try riding a bike in the crazy streets of Saigon and it was realized by joining the XO Foodie Tour. The experience enabled me to try the best bun bo hue on my 3-day stay in Vietnam. Lots of food were served grilled goat meat, beef, okra, even frog! Food and beer were overflowing and the guides were so accommodating. The tour wasn't only a way of discovering the night food scene in Ho Chi Minh City but also taking a peek on the history and culture of Southern Vietnam. Definitely a must try activity when in Saigon.

Absolutely loved this - Thank you XO Tours for a wonderful experience!

We had a great time during their Sights Tour. Kudos to our guides Anh, Nee and our other bike driver (so sorry I forgot her name :( )

We got picked up on time and first headed over to the Central Post Office and Notre Dame Cathedral. We then stopped at the Reunification Palace. We also visited Chinatown, the local market, the Burning Monk statue, and the second oldest Chinese temple.

We snacked on fruits that Anh bought at the local market (really good stuff especially the Custard fruit). They also provided us with water and sugar cane juice.

Our tour guides were super juice . friendly and shared a lot of information about Vietnam. My husband and I truly enjoyed the tour.

Bike tour of Saigon sights - WOW - what a unique + superlative way to see the sites of Saigon! A seamless service - fun, informative + the girls Mun + Tam were amazing weaving their way through the traffic safely. Thoroughly exhilarating - try it -- well worth the experience!

Foodie dinner tour on Vespa's - My wife and I took this 4.5 hr tour starting at 4:30 PM. Two girls on scooters picked us up and we went to five districts in Saigon trying the various street foods. I wound highly recommend this tour to get you off the tourist areas and experience the challenge of navigating the streets of Saigon on a scooter. The cost of 210 US includes all the food and drinks and the tour. My wife had a great time and she is the cautious type. She even wanted to take another of the tours they offered.

Way to Go! - We are "seniors" who are first timers in HCM, loving sitting on the back of our safely driven scooters by charming, fun and very pleasant ladies. We had two different tours with XO through HCM's multiple districts, one during the morning and another that same evening. And we enjoyed having the same guide, Mr. Tuan (by coincidence), for both the morning and evening tours.

We enjoyed seeing many parts of HCM and quickly observed the vibrancy of the city and quicker convenience in the traffic traveling via the motor scooters. The evening rides can be even more exciting with somewhat less traffic. We also quickly learned the inherent motor scooter etiquette that each HCM rider carries in being able to avoid each other. Foremost our riders were safe 'drivers' and even carried on discussions with us throughout our time with them ... and whether on the road or walking around, always looking out for our safety from other vehicles and pedestrians. We also loved the youth, excitement, energy, and future growth they all have for Vietnam.

A definite recommendation for many to see HCM first hand. The stops for the culinary local treats were great. And Mr Tuan was always a gentleman throughout. We've included photos, like many others, to give you a taste of our two bike tours. Hopefully all the photos get uploaded.

Enjoy!

Fun & Unique Experience- Even For 78 Year Old Couple - We took the Private Sights tour on Sunday, June 11, 2016 with Anh. We had two couples, including two 78 year olds. We do not ride motorcycles, however, everyone thoroughly enjoyed the experience and thought it was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The ladies are fun and delightful, (as well as quite skillful drivers). They drove us to 5 stops, where we were met by our guide and his assistant. (We later learned that the assistant was actually providing security for us. What a nice extra!) The guide did an excellent job explaining the various sights and showing us around. The strawberry fruit drink and the peeled fruits were a very nice touch in making the experience even better for us. But the ride itself, with the lovely ladies, was the best part of the experience! They were playful and fun, which made for a unique and memorable experience.

Fantastic tour with adorable drivers - We were 35 friends , so 35 motobikes and drivers in November for a saigon by Night Tour.We enjoyed a lot, we had great fun and a typical and good dinner.Each girl was great and able to answer your question.The organization was Top..Don't miss if you are a small group.I really recommend.

Must do tour not to be missed! - What a fantastic way to taste the traditional Vietnamese food at night on scooters! Female riders pick you up, take you to your first venue where you meet the tour guide. You then are take to some amazing places in different districts of Saigon to get the full experience of Vietnam.
