The tour is very well organized and all staff are most professional and have good English which can sometimes be hard to find in Vietnam.The food and experience are amazing not to be missed, a must do if in Saigon.

Loved every minute! - We did the Sights tour fresh off the overnight train from Danang, and it was the perfect way to start our time in Saigon!

The XO team were fantastic, and made us feel so welcome! Very special thanks to Khoi, Thui and Gam who took such great care of us. (I'm really sorry for the spelling - I should have asked how to spell your names!)

Every stop was informative and fun, with little refreshments. I only wish we had time for some of the other XO tours too!

If anyone is thinking of doing this tour and is nervous about the scooter travel, don't worry. The guys took really good care of us, and even our tired bones were more than up to the scooter trip. In fact, it ended up being our favorite part of the tour.

Thanks XO!

Brilliant Experience - We went on the Foodie tour with Tour Leader Sang Nguyen and scooter drivers Tam and Phuong2 and then on the City Tour with tour leader Tuan Nguyen and scooter drivers Ngoc and Ngan6. Awesome experience buzzing through the crazy traffic on the back of a little scooter. Our hosts couldn't do enough for us. The food, the sites and the local knowledge of the XO team were awesome. A truly memorable experience.

Absolutely amazing way to see HCM in a day! - We were picked up from our hotel by Chang 2 & Chang 3. They greeted us & outlined what we were going to be doing & the rules for riding on the scooters. Their driving was impecable & they were really friendly & knowledgeable - happy to answer our million questions about the city.
We went to 4 or 5 different districts - majority of them we ate at. What I loved most was their positivity & organization, organizing vegetarian food at each food destination.
Portion sizes were great - we couldn't eat the last meal. You really do get value for money. The whole trip went for 4.5-5 hours. Picked up at 5pm, dropped back off around 10pm.
Cannot recommend this enough! Request the two Chang girls! :)

The best way to see Saigon - We did the sights tour on our first morning in Saigon. Seeing the city from the back of a motorbike gives you a great perspective and really helps us to get our bearings. Tuan was a brilliant guide and Ngoc and Vy fantastic drivers. We couldn't have felt more welcome.

The tour includes some of the city center sights, including Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, as well as some further afield such as Tan Dinh Market and the Thich Quang Duc monument, which we may not have otherwise seen. In 3 hours we got a great sense of the history and culture of Saigon.

Definitely a highlight of our trip to Vietnam and highly recommended.

What an amazing night. - Saw this tour on trip advisor and the reviews were spot on. We did a number of tours on our trip but this was definitely the best. Right from the kick off where the girls picked me and my wife up from our hotel. My driver for the night Nxung was brilliant, funny and very chatty and made my night . The tour is as explained on their website. We visited parts of the City which we wouldn't have seen ate some great food and some different dishes. There was nothing I didn't try and there was a variety for those who don't like to try something different. But it was the girls and the male guide who gave us all the information on our stop that made it a great night. And they email you the photos later. Would recommend this trip to anyone.
Great tour - Great way to see the city. I did the foodie tour which is a mixture of food and sites. Felt safe at all times, got to see Ho Chi Minh and try dishes I would never have on my own.

Highlight of Saigon! - After being recommended this tour from a friend, I booked the foodie tour before traveling to Saigon. It was very simple to book and pay for via email.

The tour itself was fantastic.
All the food stops were great, they told us all about the food we would be eating and were happily ordering more if we wanted it.

The tour not only took in food stops but also a few tourist stops. We saw parts of Saigon that we never even knew existed.

All the girls and our tour leader Khoi were fantastic and we had so much fun spending the evening with them.

I've seen a few comments about it being expensive, but for unlimited food and drink, great company and all on the back of a moped in Saigon, I think it was definately worth the money.

Khoi sent us photos of our tour a couple of days later so now we have something to remember such a great experience!

The highlight of our trip - This tour was easily the highlight of our trip in Vietnam. We did the 'Saigon by Night' tour. The girls were very enthusiastic and informative, and the tour leader 'Sang' was great.

We'd heard a lot about scooter traffic in Saigon and experienced it ourselves crossing the road at rush hour - so it was great to be able to become part of it ourselves and see the city from that perspective.

All of the stops were very interesting, and places we never would have gone without this tour. I can't recommend it enough!

Wonderful tour....wonderful staff...Huong, Tam and Thanh WOW WOW - Booked a 5 hour custom tour for three to see the many districts of Ho Chi Minh. We were not disappointed. Our male guide for the day, Tai was very good and informative.
And our male guide responsible for watching traffic and the bikes, Hai, did an awesome job. But the real highlight was our female drivers....so pretty,,,,so intelligent and so careful with us. Smiles all day long. The oldest of the group referred to as grandma was only 25 but had worked at XO for five years and they are blessed to have this girl named
Huong on their staff. The other two girls, working with XO for three years, Tam and Thanh, were also superb. A great day with a great group of people who were easy to talk to and made us smile all day as we learned more and more about Ho Chi Minh. Couldn't be happier and would highly recommend. You might ask for Huong, Tam or Thanh......but be prepared to give them a nice tip because you will have a great time.

Not to miss while in Saigon - Got a tip from a mate back home that if you visit Saigon, that you are best not to leave until you have done an XO bike tour. And he was right! The women that took the 7 of us were so amazing. They were safe, professional, and most of all super chatty and funny. They made the 3 hour night trip so much fun and memorable. Enough cannot be told about them. There is no better way to see the city of Saigon but at night on the back of a bike, zipping through all the various districts, being escorted by a fun group of women. Like I was told, don't leave until you go on a tour with these guys, totally worth it!

Chanyeol - Had the best of time. We were a group of 3 couples, some of us quite wary of what was to come. The scooter drivers were professional, friendly and proficient in both driving skills and English.
We all thoroughly enjoyed our selves Thank you Tai and the girls

Fast Furious FUN! - Our hyper-skilled guides took us right into the middle of Saigon traffic on a busy Saturday night and it was unreal! We sped into and through many districts, all the while chatting with our guides who pointed out different sites on the way. We stopped off at various points to try an eclectic mix of popular food at grill bars, and with street vendors, as well as chatting to others and hearing about modern day Vietnam. In all, we were thoroughly entertained for the whole time and it flew by in a riot of colored lights, scooters, fun and laughter. Excellent!

Worth it! Great fun! - I would thoroughly recommend this tour. The staff made the tour great! We went on the foodie tour, which was great fun. The driving was skillful ad careful. The street food didn't cause us any problems(in fact none of the street in Vietnam caused us any problems! And we tried lots, just need to be sensible)
Some of the explanations about Vietnam and Saigon felt like a lecture, I think they can be made a bit more fun.
If you are considering it, you should definitely do it! Especially if you are going to be in Saigon for just a short while.
Also I'd had never ridden a bike and felt safe the entire time!

Good drivers, and great food locations - We booked a food tour and loved the food locations they took us to. They really took us to hidden local places that I'm sure you wouldn't find else where. We had great drivers, they were safe and also tried to keep us together which was appreciated.

The one thing I think was slightly bothering was their exaggeration of the Vietnamese life. In fact, the information probably wasn't exaggerated however the delivery came across almost condescending. Also, a few of these places were just them telling us thing - nothing to do with food - even though we were on a food tour. Totally understand that they were trying to teach people about culture but I think they could do it differently.

Wow!! - 5 hr evening foodie tour which whizzed by!! Double meaning definitely intended! Chatting away on the back of a scooter bang in the middle of saigon life, eating with locals. A wonderful experience I will never forget. My driver, Vi, was superb. She is an exceptional driver and great to talk with. And I will not forget the crazy food we ate. Wonderful organization, Tai.
This tour must not be missed.

Loved it! - We were a group of 6 friends and had an amazing evening doing the foodie street tour. From the moment we were picked up at our hotel to being dropped off again 5 hours later we had the best fun. We were looked after so well, by our lovely girl drivers and by the tour manager -all of whom had a high level of English. We were not an easy group to cater for as non of us are "spring chickens" and our food needs aren't normal either! But nothing was too much trouble and I would recommend this tour to anyone looking for a memorable, fun and exciting evening
So good - We loved it. Best thing we did in Saigon. Loved my guide. So exciting. All lovely, friendly girls. Great food. Do yourself a favor and book!

Shouldn't be missed! - Our group of 4 did the day time tour with XO. All four of our drivers were personable, knowledgeable and easy to understand. It was absolutely a blast to experience the city from the back of a scooter! We visited several different areas of the city where we were met by our tour guide, Khoi, who shared with us the history of each site.We all agreed it was one of our favorite experiences of our 2 1/2 week trip.

The best thing we did in Saigon! - Without going into too much detail, this was the most fun experience we had in Saigon. Our group of four did the night time foodie tour and it was an incredibly memorable and fun experience. From booking to drop off, the service was excellent, but our guides and manager (Tai) were truly phenomenal! From their friendliness, humor, safe riding, and warmth, we can't speak highly enough of them.

There is so much more to HCMC than District 1 and this tour is a way to really appreciate how diverse and large the city is as well as get a taste of what riding a scooter in the madness would be like. The different stops for food are a great way to get introduced to Vietnamese food since traditional Vietnamese restaurants tend to specialize in a single dish.

Even if you don't think you have the time to take one of the tours, take the tour, it's worth every penny!

Authentic food at its best! - You've heard all the stories of great food in Ho Chi Minh and now your finally here but don't know where to start? These guys are the way to go!

Their awesome scooter riders will meet and greet you right outside your hotel. They're super friendly and fun to talk to as they drive you to the first food stop.

Once there, we were greeted by
our tour guide, Tai. He introduced us to the rest of the group and made the whole experience easy and social.

In fact, the whole team takes care of everything for you. Its organized perfectly so it's totally stress free.

By the end of the night I was completely satisfied and I considered it the best thing I did during my time there.

BEST. NIGHT. EVER! - My best friend and I did the 'Foodie' Tour with XO Tours.
I can only speak highly of this tour It was the highlight of my time in Saigon. Our Tour guide for the night was amazing, full of knowlege and cracked some great jokes. Our Drivers for the night were spectacular and always up for a chat. The food was out of this world and is a fantastic way to introduce you to the different cuisines and areas. There was not one dull moment of the evening and worth every cent. Don't miss out and book the Foodie tour now! 10/10!

Best tour by far - We went on the foodie tour and it was absolutely fantastic. The girls and Tai our leader were so friendly and very informative. We felt very safe on the back of the bikes and it was a great way to see the city. The food was delicious something totally different. Would definitely recommend.

The only proper way to see HCMC! - We did "the sights" and "Saigon by night" tours and had a blast. This is the best way to experience the city. All of the tour guides spoke fluent English and were very knowledgeable. We felt really safe even though the traffic seemed chaotic. The motorbikes in saigon move like fish in the ocean. So don't hesitate to book this tour!

Saigon By Night Tour - Book.It.Now. - Want to explore the city like one of the locals? Jump on a motorbike! There's definitely something to be said about driving side-by-side to a motorbike with an entire family and their dog! This tour was a perfect blend of city education + excitement. All the motorbike drivers are women and Hieu (the tour leader) joins, takes pictures and educates you, as you visit all the different districts in the city. We visited 5 different spots in the span of 4.5 hours, so you literally ride across the entire city. Everyone was very friendly!

I rode with Jhang, who was just wonderful! We had great conversation while riding through the streets and she suggested a variety of spots I should visit in the city, based on my interests, as well as where else in Vietnam I may like to visit. I never would have gone to Da Nang w/o her suggestion, which I really appreciate, as it was my favorite city in Vietnam!

Overall, great staff & content and a must-do at night, as the city does not sleep!

Don't delay, book now! - Having seen the mental traffic in Saigon (locals prefer that to HCMC apparently and who can blame them) was in two minds about doing this
How wrong I was
An absolute delight from start to finish
Informative, lovely drivers, safe (as possible😄) great selection of food at places you would never visit if not on tour
Thank you so much a perfect end to a perfect holiday
I love Vietnam❤️

Pretty damn good way to eat and see the city - Certainly enjoyed the tour. And I do believe they are the best at what they do, but I question value for money. In comparison to what you can do and eat in Vietnam, $70 USD per person (1.6m dong) is right up there with expensive restaurants. They nail the introduction, are very insightful and the food is good. But you can only eat so much, so please stop asking me whether Im full just so I cant complain about how much food I got for the money. The girls are amazing, very personable. Safe and smart riders. We visited 5 places in 5 hours, so there is a fair bit of riding. This is good if you want to see a variety of districts. I wouldnt have minded a few more beers, but spending only 20 min at each place meant there wasnt much opportunity to drink. All in all it was a great tour, with fantastic people and fantastic food, it is just slightly overpriced for Vietnam.

Must do when in Ho Chi Minh - We had a great time with XO tours. The girls were great drivers and very informative. I hadn't been on a motorbike for 35 years but felt very safe despite the mad traffic. We visited 3 food locations and 2 sight seeing locations and visited places we would have never got to. Our favorite was the seafood cafe. All the food was delicious and it's great to do the tour as soon as you can to get some great information about the local food and an overview of the city. Many thanks to Nhad and Huonge (apologies if I spell the names wrong!). You were great company

Night Time Saigon Scooter Good Times - We booked this fantastic tour with our most skilled and excellent lady scooter drivers. We were submerged into a sea of ​​scooters when we left our District 1 hotel around 6pm for a "saigon by night" tour of the many different districts of Saigon. We sampled different foods, fruits , drinks and meat dishes during our 4 hour scooter ride around Saigon. It was fantastic and a great and novel way to get around Saigon. Visiting places that the tour takes you to are authentic and a real Saigon experience. If you want to feel like a "local".... A SCOOTER TOUR IS THE ONLY WAY!!!!
HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!

Fun and informative tours! - I went for 2 tours (The Sights and Saigon by Night) in October and thoroughly enjoyed myself. The young ladies (motorbike riders) and the tour managers were very professional.

It was my first time sitting behind a motorbike and going around a city so it was all the more interesting. Since a lot of locals get around using motorbikes, you can be sure to experience Vietnam in an authentic way.

In addition, I wanted to get a SIM card and received help efficiently as well even though it was not part of the package plan. Truly appreciated!

Special shoutout to "Tinkerbell" for being so entertaining and lively on my first night tour! Keep up with your singing.

To those I've met during the tours, thank you :)

Exhilerating - November 11th., our first morning in Ho Chi Minh City and we embarked on the most exciting tour that we have ever undertaken. Neither myself, my wife or our two friends have ever ridden or been a passenger on a motor bike previously. We were greeted outside our hotel by four of the most delightful young ladies, Thu, Thuy, Canh and Ngan that we have ever met on any tour. Charming, happy, excellent English and at 9.00 am the fun began on our selected tour, The Sights. Imagine; she 44 kgs., me 126 kgs of passenger and after 30 seconds I felt as one with driver and bike. Great conversation and relay of information as we braved the HCM traffic. I made one mistake when booking, I should have ordered the video of our tour so that we had a live memento of our 4 XO angels and the motor bikes as we darted through traffic, sped through back streets, visited areas were there are few tourists and in years to come, we could look at the video as proof that we actually did the tour. Tour leader, Sang, met us at the the various stops throughout the City and gave pertinent and excellent information on the various buildings and monuments. Refreshments supplied during the tour. We would love to have taken another tour with XO, but as we were part of a larger tour group, we were unable to do so. Easy to see why XO get such glowing reports on Trip Advisor. If you want an exciting difference in HCM, THIS IS IT!! On our next trip to HCM, XO Tours will be booked for a repeat. Wonderful!
Excellent Tour - Really enjoyed the foodie tour and tried new food that I would never ordinarily order! Special thanks to Moon who was a fantastic driver and guide!

XO Tour - What a brilliant and charming outfit. Smart lovely young ladies with perfect English take you on a ride around HCM sharing info and laughs on the way. It exceeded expectations in every way. I would highly recommend it. Also no trying to up sell you anything during the tour. They take you places to try the tasty street food and explain all the different areas of the city. Great fun. We took the evening tour but would also take the day tour as well if we go back. They leave you with little souvenirs and email pictures of your tour. Fab 😄

Awesome - My wife and I completed the Sights Tour and the Foodie Tour. Both tours are great to do.

The sights tour was great to do as it gave some insight of the city of Saigon and of the people and some history. On this tour these wonderful girls will drive around where the tour leader will humorously inform of the locations history.

The foodie tour was great also. This is a more personable tour as you interact with the drivers more. This was great fun as not only you get to eat a lot of good local food with a great tour guide you get to sit down and talk one on one with the girls who you are riding around with.

I would recommend for anyone coming to Vietnam for the first time to do these tours.

XO Foodie Tour - Put this on the must do list. Great food, great fun, all round great night. Our guide Hieu was very informative. Our drivers Chang and Chang were wonderful and looked after us all night. Highly recommended. Loved it.

Exciting night on motorbikes!! - Very professional organization!!!

Prompt email communication with bookings etc; drivers turned up on time; received a follow up email after our tour with photographs of our night; staff very friendly and easy to talk to.

Felt is very safe on the back of the scooters. Had numerous support staff (men in black) accompanying us also.

Good group size (8 of us in total).

Tried some interesting dishes (frog; goat; duck embryo)..

I thought the tour would be a great opportunity to identify some local spots to eat - over the course of our 3 days in HCMC. Unfortunately, the places we visited were not your normal eateries - very off the beaten track!! (My husband loved this aspect of the tour).

Great way to see the city. Awesome night out!! Definitely recommend!

Highlight of our trip - We did the food tour, which started about 530. My driver, Chang spoke flawless English and her spontaneous wit had me giggling all night.
We ate our way around HCM and at the end dropped us off at a craft beer hall which was very much appreciated!
A must do.

Hangies - One of the best experiences as you get a taste of Saigon or HCM and where locals go to eat, shop and what they eat. My Russian driver, spoke very well, helpful and gave insights into the city. I've never been on a motorbike before this, but always felt safe with her. If only a short time, I'd recommend this tour
Great fun - We had an amazing tour on the back of the bike. Safe, fun and interesting. Highly recommend our tour guides. Very knowledgeable and experienced. A must do experience

Good way to see the city - The xo tour on Saigon at night was interesting especially if you are keen like us to see the local city and way of life.

The tour operator was friendly and had a great sense of humor that kept it interesting. Even phoung and tui, our motorbike riders, were helpful and gladly shared saigon related information with us. They also quite willingly helped us with many other recommendations which were great.

The food served on the trip is decent
No regrets - Although pricy, the foodie tour was worth every $. Basic things done extremely well. The girls are charming and told us so much about Vietnam, that we wouldn't have known otherwise.

The best thing we did in Vietnam - During or recent trip to Ho Chi Minh city we had the time to enjoy XO tours. We are senior citizens from the US and we did have some worries about or safety. After about five minutes of fear we were fine. Or guides two local Vietnamese women were terrific drivers and lots of fun. They took us to many different stops and even though it was sprinkling we really did not mind. The food was ok but the trip is really about the variety and fun. I am a fussy eater but still found some things to eat the Bar Be Que was good and they would give me all I wanted. Our driver and guide made sure we were happy and we were. I want to go again.

delicious food tour on motorcycle - We were picked up at our hotel by 2 girls on motorcycle. Excellent drivers, very nice and talkative. We met up with the rest of the group and went on driving through different districts making 5 stops in total. 3 for food, 2 for some extra explanations on the city. The food was plenty, the drinks, all included. We tried many different dishes and went to local places we would have never found ourselves. Excellent experience, we tried goat meet, frogs but my favorite were the scallops, shrimps and crabs that the girls prepared for us!! Excellent experience.

AMAZING!!! - We did the Sights tour today and absolutely loved it. Our scooter girls were so lovely and spoke great English, took a lot of photos for us and our tour guide Sang explained the history of our stops. We went to parts of Ho Chi Minh City you would never go to without a tour guide. It was extremely hot, we were offered water and a sweet/sour drink along the way. This should be put on your "must to-do list". Thank you XO Tours you did an amazing job! :) from Nicole & Matt

Foodie Tour - so much fun! - My husband and I were picked up outside our hotel by two young Vietnamese women on scooters. We were in a group of eight tourists altogether. The English guides were excellent and they were all really relaxed and professional. The food on the tour was varied, authentic and delicious!! We were never made to feel like we had to eat something we didn't like and someone on the tour that didn't eat seafood was given plenty of alternative foods to have instead (which we got to try too!). Being on the back of the scooter around HCM was great and we felt very comfortable, even in the very busy rush hour in torrential rain (effective ponchos were provided!). XO Tours even got me a surprise birthday cake and everyone sang happy birthday for my 30th! Would really highly recommend this tour if you want a relaxing evening, full of fun, sharing the experience with fantastic people. Top tip - pace yourself, there's a lot of different food to eat!

Loved this Tour - Great Into the City - We did the night tour to some less touristy locations around the city & a yummy dinner. They are incredibly well organized - I was so impressed! At every stop our tour leader was there in advance ready with a table & food. A "bodyguard" follows with a spare bike if any issues - which there weren't. They have great options for vegetarians too. The drivers were so lovely & it was great chatting to them while zipping around town & getting some real insight into how the locals live, best places to go, best foods to try etc. thanks guys, loved it!

The Sights - We were very well looked after from start to finish. As bikers in the UK I wasn't overly looking forward to being pillion but my worries were for nothing. Yes the traffic is crazy and yes there are scooters everywhere but both my guide (Binh) and my husbands guide were brilliant. Khoi was a brilliant tour leader and told us loads of interesting things at every place we stopped. Very well organized and we are looking forward to doing the Foodie Tour later in the week!

Fun, Safe, and Informative - We took the morning tour of Saigon with the ladies of XO and they made sure we saw a lot, learned about their city and country's history and were pampered just the right amount, despite being on the back of a scooter.

Just Way Too Much Fun a Way to See Ho Chi Minh City - XO Tours offers wonderfully hospitable, fun, English-fluent Vietnamese university student women who take you to five different districts on the back of their motorcycles, three for great street food dishes and two for cultural sites. There may be other copycat groups, but stick with XO Tours - by far the best and most fun. At our last destination, the heavens opened a deluge, and we all donated panchos and headed back to our hotel through the pouring rain. My driver friend, Nhung from Vinh Long, one of my favorite Mekong Delta places, launched us into the old Cascades song, Listen to the Rhythm of the Pouring Rain," so of course we dueted all the way back, rain pounding off our motorcycle helmets - don't know how she could even see in that downpour - just way too much fun. And they are all lovely, articulate, good hearted and considerate young women who help make the experience memorable. Would go back for more in a minute. Do the night-time tour. Cooler and more fun.

Tasty and Exhilarating and Enlightening! - Oh my gosh, where do I begin!??? The beautiful young women dressed in traditional garb picked us up at our hotel and spirited us away on a grand adventure. If we had only driven around on the back of their scooters all evening, THAT would have been well worth the price. Zooming into Saigon traffic was more terrifying-fun than any downhill ski run I've ever done! But then there was the food! Oh so tasty, and strange and fun and tasty! And then the different communities of Saigon, very interesting. And finally, the women themselves were professional, informative and engaging. I will do this again every time I'm in Vietnam.

Simply Brilliant - 3 of us went on the XO night time foodie tour and had a whale of a time.
It is very definitely a tour where you get out what you put in and you do need to be ready to meet “the unusual” head on.
For us, the tour was quite simply loads of fun from beginning to end.
The scooter riders and XO hosts were charming, knowledgeable and with a fantastic sense of humour they kept the evening running along nicely.
The food, local sights, games and entertainment were all superb.
We ate a lot, drank a lot and learned a lot. The tour occurred at the beginning of our 21-day trip to Vietnam and gave us a grounding in local food which stood us in good stead later on in our trip.
All-in-all a truly excellent way for us to spend our last night in HCM.

Cool fun evening with great food - The guys and gals from XO really know how to have fun. My 11 year old loved being on the back of her own scooter and the girls really looked after her and made her love every second including trying new foods ! Highlight of our 2 weeks in Vietnam. XO also took some really great photos - Thank you all xxx

So much fun - Myself and 2 friends did the foodie tour in HCMC a couple of weeks ago. It was great from start to finish, the girls were good at calming nerves as 1 of us had not been on a moped before and they were very friendly and helpful throughout the tour. We felt safe during the whole tour and it was a great way to experience different districts of HCMC and riding amongst the traffic! We sampled various foodie delights and went to places we would never have gone to without going on this tour. It was a highlight of our trip to HCMC and I would definitely recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting the city.

Something really unique ! - The XO food tour was a real fun experience. Being driven around on the backseat of a scooter was a great way to get some of the sights and sounds, not to mention the tastes of the Ho Chi Minh city. The girls driving were very friendly and took the time to converse and provide some insights about the city. We sampled the local fare at several locations around the city and by the end of the tour, everyone was happily stuffed. The food we tried was delicious and included a wide range for everyone's palates, including some optional items that are perhaps more suited for the adventurous ones. Also a special shout out to the tour leader Tai for making the tour really fun and lively !

Loved every minute of this tour - The XO night time foodie tour we went on a couple of nights ago was the highlight of our stay in the amazing city of Saigon. Our personal guides and drivers, Trang and An, were so friendly with a great sense of humor and knowledgable on everything about Saigon including of course the incredible food we had the privilege of sampling, as was Tai who hosted the evening. I really didn't want the tour to end and can't recommend it highly enough.

Lots of fun - We went on the evening "Foodie" tour yesterdy. Very professional and felt very safe, Given excellent guidance on how to be safe pillion passengers. After the first few minutes, both my wife and I, really got into the fun of whizzing around town amid the previously intimidating traffic. Introduced to numerous local foods. Nice people from around the world join these tours. But what really made it so special for us were the guides. Khoi in charge and our two amazing young-lady drivers/guides, Tien2 and Phon.. Charming, fluent and well-informed. But mostly just great fun.

Sightseeing scooter style. - After doing the XO foodie tour two years ago we decided on the sightseeing tour this time around. So much fun!!! Being in the thick of the hustle bustle peak hour traffic is an absolute buzz, we learn heaps about HCM city as well. Our tour guide was very informative and the girls driving were amazing. We felt safe the whole time, laughed heaps and had a ball. XO tours are a must do when visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Amazing foodie tour - The foodie tour was the best thing we could have done to change our mind about HCM city. We saw the different sides of the city, tasted delicious food, learned more about the city from our guides than we ever expected. The traffic may seem to be a chaos but we never feel unsafe or threatened at any time as the girls always maintain a steady pace. Although riding on a scooter in Vietnam may seem scary, it's a ton of fun once you're actually on it. We honestly cannot recommend this tour enough

Fantastic food experience by Scooter - A friend and I booked this tour based on trip advisor reviews and it didn't disappoint. We got to travel throughout multiple districts of Ho Chi Minh City and sample some of the best food on our 2 week trip in Vietnam. We felt very safe with our scooters drivers and it was a fantastic way to experience the traffic and local life both on the scooter and the local food we sampled. This tour is worth every $

Educational - I am highly recommending this tour. They say that for you to be able to understand a new place / or country is to do what the locals do. So we visit Saigon riding a motor bike just like any locals do. We visited 5 districts which includes the major tourist spots in each district.

It's like getting a free history class from our guide. Our guide Khoi Nguyen is really good in English and really knows what he is talking about.

Fun and Delicious! - My husband and I are honeymooning in Saigon and we were really excited to embark on this food tour. From the very beginning the staff were professional and sweet. We had Chang and Nhi 4 as our motorbike gals. They were both awesome. Chang rode my husband around and answered his multitude of questions. And Nhi 4 rode me around and also answered so many of my random questions. She also made sure I felt safe on the motorbike.

The tour was guided by our motorbike girls and then a lead guy, Tai. He was really funny and made sure to check up on everyone to make sure they were doing OK. I really appreciate that.

The food was all very delicious. I won't ruin the tour by outlining everything since the element of surprise certainly makes the tour interesting!! Note that this tour was very meat heavy so you should ask about veggie options before booking.

We stopped in 5 different districts and got a mini briefing on each district. I liked the diversity of districts we saw and also enjoyed getting to know the other guests.

Highly recommend!

MUST-DO tour - This is a MUST DO tour. I can only sing praises of the staff that picked us up and took us around - perfect English, great conversationalist, entertaining, funny and insightful!
My friend and I did the night tour where we had 4 stops (2 x food stops and 2 x information/wander stops)
Such a fun experience, seeing the sights in a true local way, I felt 100% safe, the drivers are confident but cautious.
You HAVE to do this tour, the company I rate 10/10!

Holiday highlight! - Did the Saigon by night tour - it was brilliant! We were taken to all the districts to show the contrasts and it was an experience such that we wouldn't otherwise have had.
The girls are absolutely lovely and smart and they took really good care of us too - as did the tour guide :)
It's such a great idea to have an all female tour - keep up the good work!

Fabulous Foodie Tour - Despite our initial hesitation to embark on this tour due to the initial very wet weather, we absolutely loved the entire experience. Both the girls and Khoi were so enthusiastic and energetic that we forgot the rain and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The food was varied and delicious and our knowledge about both the food and Vietnam increased a great deal but it was the guides that enhanced this whole tour. Thanks for such a memorable night!!

Great Foodie Tour on the back of a bike! - Very professional local foodie tour. So much fun riding on the back of the motorbike with a local who expertly weaves through the chaos of the traffic. Visited a number of different districts on the tour and tried a good range of local foods. Highly recommended tour!

Two Terrific Tours -- great guides! - We were in Ho Chi Minh for 3 nights before our Mekong River Cruise. We took "The Sights" day tour and the night time "Foodie" tour on the same day. Both were outstanding! Great way to see the city as a local experiences it. Great food options at our three stops.

Best tour on our trip - We had a great experience with these guys. This should be a must for everyone visiting HCMC. We went to 5 districts, three of the were food stops and 2 were just stops in that district. They took the time to explain the areas and answered any questions.

A highlight of our stay! Book this tour!! - We chose the Saigon by Night tour, which lasts three hours and includes three meals: a delicious local dinner dish (one of three choices, including veggie) and two local deserts.

I can't recommend this company strong enough: the girls (all drivers are female) are very friendly, safe and good drivers, speak excellent English and above all are totally hilarious!

They negotiated the very busy Saigon rush hour traffic with a sure hand and drove us to 5 very different quarters which we would never have seen on our own, as all are outside the typical tourist spots and include China town and district 7 which basically feels more like Singapore than Saigon.

The tour guide was very knowledgeable about his city and arranged for food and drinks but also made pictures of us which appeared in our inbox a few days later.

I understand that there are a few other tours to choose from and I can only encourage everyone to book one! After the war remnants museum and the Cu Chi Tunnels, this company should become a staple for everyone visiting the city of Saigon!

Motorbike tour! - We booked a full day back of the bike tour with XO and had amazing experience. We were so scared with traffic in VN. But the guides (drivers also) did great job. We felt safe to enjoy the crowd, noise and chaos of traffic. We liked also the street food here. Great tour!

Night sights on Two Wheels - Great experience on two wheels to explore Ho Chi Minh city at night. Our tour guide / rider are all young ladies and some are part time university students. They are very professional and took us on a guided scooter tour to all the local spots and eateries.
We chose for the night tour as we felt that it would be more interesting and colorful.

We were even given a little gift pack / souvenir of a key chain, 2 postcards and a small booklet of survival guide and phrase book. We even received photos sent to our email.
contact to book tour is 09 3308 3727.
or info@xotours.vn - ph 0939 307 341 enquiry

Good but could have been great - This tour was good but easily could have been great. Being escorted by multi-lingual and engaging young female guides on the back of bikes was amazing - with the accompanying sights, smells and sounds of cruising throughout areas of Saigon we would not have otherwise gone was amazing. The area where this tour could have gone great would have been eliminating the unnecessary stop in a developed area of town to show the plight of development and prosperity not experienced by others in the area that frankly felt like a play on sympathy for tips (sorry maybe the skeptical nature of me took over). The other complaint is the lack of diversity of food offerings - on a similar, albeit walking tour of Hanoi, stopped at 2x as many places and sampled a much more diverse menu,

Still - scooters through the city with beer/food = happy traveler!

Awesome Food Experience! - My husband and I had a wonderful experience with our guides Chang and Moon who were awesome! They did everything possible to make our tour special! We felt extremely safe riding on the back of the motorcycles. This tour felt like we were truly experiencing local life. I love to try different cuisine so the whole evening was perfect and Tai the tour manager was excellent. I would highly recommend the tour to anyone wanting to experience local cuisine in different districts in Ho Chin Ming.

Excellent Customer Service - I was booked to go on this tour today but unfortunately I became unwell just before I was due to be picked up. I called and cancelled and apologised, they very kindly refunded me 80%, even though I was not expecting that. Such a nice gesture and I really hope I can re-book again soon.

Saigon Sights - Our family of 5 arrived in Saigon (Ho Chi Mihn City), and decided that we needed to do a formal tour in order to see the sights.
We're not really "tour" people, but a friend from Australia had mentioned XO Tours, so we called them and organised a "The Sights" tour for the next morning.

A lovely young lady with excellent English arrived at our Hotel lobby precisely on time, and took us out to meet the drivers. XO Tours has all female drivers, and in their distinctive blue Ao dai, the drivers really stand out.

Depending on where you're staying in Saigon, the first stop on the tour may be really close! We were staying in District 1, so our first stop was all of 6 minutes from our Hotel. At the first stop you hop off of the bikes and meet your tour guide/leader. Our guide was a very entertaining man called Anh. His unique insights into Saigon and the Vietnamese people were great.

The Sights tour takes 3 hours, and gives you a great summary of Saigon, plus takes you too some very cool markets and other places the average tourist wouldn't go to.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed all aspects of the tour and went away looking for more information on the history of the wars and unification. Our children are 11, 9 and 6, and while the 11 year old was a bit interested in the history, the younger two were more interested in zipping about on the bikes.

All in all an excellent trip to take. If I could go again without the kids, I'd definitely do either the Foodie tour, or the Saigon by night tour. But with kids, The Sights was fab fun. Thanks so much guys! We loved it.

Must do in HCMC - Having decided to do a food tour while in Ho Chi Minh City, I quickly came across XO Tours on Tripadvisor as being the most highly recommended operator. Booking was easy and we made all arrangements, including advance payment, via email.
We were picked up promptly at 5:20pm at our hotel by our drivers. Since it was raining a little, they outfitted us with rain ponchos, as well as helmets and haunted us on what to do while on the backs of their scooters. I admit I was petrified for the first few minutes (traffic there is quite crazy), but by the end of the evening had started to relax and enjoy the ride.
XO Tours makes 5 stops along the tour, three of which are food stops, and the other two are sightseeing related. All five of them are outside of District 1, which is great since as a tourist that's usually all you see.
There were three main reasons why my husband and I thought this was an excellent experience we'd recommend to anyone visiting Saigon:
1. The food was great, and we tried a lot of things we wouldn't even have known to try by ourselves. No pho on this tour.
2. Being able to talk to locals about a variety of subjects. Our drivers, as well as our guide, speak excellent English and we cover topics way beyond food - everything from living standards to divorce.
3. Experiencing the city on the back of a scooter is thrilling and puts you right among the locals. As nerve-wracking as it is at first, the girls are actually very safe drivers, and I never felt like I was in any danger. To top it all off, they actually have "body guards" riding with you just in case (again, I never felt threatened, but it just shows how important your safety is to them).
The cost of this tour may seem a little high for Ho Chi Minh City, but it's totally worth it.
GREAT - Must do! Would recommend doing it on your second day there to gain an insight in the city. Super safe, well planned out activity! Would rebook with no hesitation

Number one for a reason :) - This was one of the first things I did once I arrived in Ho Chi Minh and it was the perfect thing to do! It was great to take a tour of Ho Chi Minh and learn about the districts before setting out on my own. The girls were expectational, friendly, knowledgeable and pleasure to be with. As was Mr. Hieu!

Foodie tour - So good!!! Have never been on a motorbike before and what a city to have that experience in. Was petrified at first but my guide, Bimh (apologies for spelling this wrong) was so lovely - by the end of the five hours I was not holding onto her at all. The most fun part for me was riding on the motorbikes. The food was spectacular - especially the last seafood course. Stuff I'll never try normally was brought to the table. Our group guide, Tai, was so fun - engaging, attentive and full of information. Loved the stop at District 7 to hear about life in Vietnam and it's economic circumstances. Totally recommend this!

Get a taste of the local food and life. - Great to ride on the scooters and visit the different Districts. We learned about various districts and got to eat local food from several places. The food was only okay, but the experience was so worth it. The scooter drivers and the tour guide were great and very helpful. A definite must if you are in Ho Chi Minh!!

City Scooter Tour - Wow, what a great way to see Ho Chi Mien City. My wife and I found XO Tours to be very professional, organized and friendly. I would have no hesitation to recommend them to anyone.

Fantastic way to see all of Ho Chi Minh City - Our group of 7 had an amazing time on the Evening Foodie Tour which takes you to all the different districts you would not normally see and lasts about 3 hours. I have never ridden on the back of a scooter before and felt very safe with my girl driver. All the girls were very friendly and joined us at our dinner stop which was a choice of 3 different Vietnamese dishes. Even if it rains it is still fantastic and they provide heavy duty raincoats. Its an experience not to be missed!

Food tour was a ripper! - My friends and I went on a Ho Chi Minh food tour and really enjoyed the experience. We were picked up at our hotel and rode from destination to destination on the back of scooters driven safely by our guides.
We were able to try a variety of foods (including some unusual ones!) and see a variety of areas around the city.
Our guides were very friendly and great hosts, and were able to provide useful insights and information about the city.
I was also impressed by the extra information on their website/blog, such as tips for travelers to varying areas in Vietnam.
Would definitely recommend and return for future tours

Good Fun - After recently doing a bike tour with another company, decided to venture out on the XO service. Not disappointed. The drivers - girls - food stops, and general tour of the city was great. The knowledge of certain areas and the significance to the city could not have been faulted. Thank you.

Scooters in the rain, such fun! - We had a fantastic time on our foodie tour a must do in Saigon the ladies were lovely and it was all very safe even in torrential rain. Thank you soooo much for a great evening. Photos are brilliant thanks again.

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - My husband and I decided to spend his birthday in Ho Chi Minh and one of the highly recommended to do is going on a Foodie Tour with XO tours! This tour was the best decision we've ever made!

Their foodie tour is a mixture of sight seeing and food tasting! We went to districts beyond District 1 and got to learn a lot about the people and their daily lives. The food they served were the best!!They will definitely keep on ordering if you can still eat! I wish I had a bigger stomach that time just so I can eat more :) The

team leader Tai was amazing! He was enthusiastic and communicated very well! Our drivers Tinkerbell and Ngaoc were awesome! Tinkerbell was like the sister I never had. Tinkerbell and I had long chats during the whole drive and we're even singing with Ngaoc when they were driving side by side! It was incredible how they maneuvered their motorcycles all through out the tour while chatting with us. They kept us safe and dry (since the rain was on and off that time).

What's so nice about the XO team is that they actually care about you. They even bought a birthday cake for my hubby as a surprise. They also had a lot of bodyguards (that's what they call them) while we were out on the tour so you'd really feel safe and carefree!

Another thing that I noticed about the XO team was they were all good looking and presentable-- the drivers and the "guards" both. This is a major plus plus!!

All in all the Foodie tour was the highlight of our Ho Chi Minh visit!! :) I would definitely do it again and again!

Beyond excellent!!! - Our family of 3 did the evening foodie tour with XO and LOVED every minute! Even our teenaged son had a blast and tried foods he never would have under other circumstances. The all-female driving staff are so personable & friendly, and the transport by scooter is exhilarating while still feeling safe at all times. Our tour guide, Tai, was fantastic and explained a lot about the real life of HCMC which is so refreshing after so many tours are just the usual tourist sights. Best of all, they take loads of photos while you are enjoying yourself and share them with you later so you have the memories to keep! We will definitely do XO tours again!

The best tour we have done - We LOVED the XO Foodie Tour.
The girls were very friendly and we had such a great time with them. Riding on the back of a scooter through Ho Chi Minh City is a fantastic experience on its own.
We were the only tourists at every spot we went to so it was nice to eat where the real locals eat. We also stopped and did a little bit of sight seeing, at places we would never have known about. We did the tour on our last night in HCMC and we wished we did it on our first night so we got our bearings around the city earlier.
I do not eat pork and I am quite fussy with what I eat - they were very hospitable with this. They made sure there was an appropriate alternative where ever we went. One lady on our tour did not eat seafood and she was also very well looked after. There is so much food so I would recommend not eating lunch so you can fit it all in. Food was delicious and it really was so much fun. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Tons of fun! - This is a must! I did this with my adult daughter. Having never been on a motorbike I was a little apprehensive but the feeling was very short lived compared to the purely fabulous experience. Saw so much of Saigon, learned a lot, had lots of laughs with the very capable drivers in their lovely blue and white traditional garments. It was a blast...due to this!

Wow! If you want to see the real Saigon then you have to take this tour! - Rather than taking an organized tour from our cruise ship, our family of three booked a private tour with XO. We were slightly tense about riding on the back of a scooter especially after seeing the amount of traffic and the way the locals drive but after a few minutes riding behind our amazing English speaking three lady drivers, Nhung, Binh & Nguyet, we were completely confident in their ability to get us safely around the sights. They weaved effortlessly through the traffic and never took any risks and were completely confident.
They delivered us to all the important sights as well as taking us to markets and other places that a normal coach tour would not include and where we could see and experience the real Saigon. Our tour guide Khoi was always there meet us at each of the stops but we still cannot work out how he managed to get to each place before us on his scooter? Khoi, spoke excellent English and was very knowledgeable about all the different places we saw en route and gave us a real insight into the way of life in Vietnam plus he also provided us with various refreshments along the way.
Our lady drivers were great personalities and chatted away happily whilst we weaved through the throat of other scooters and cars. Certainly it was the fastest way of getting around as most of the coaches we saw were stuck in traffic queues! XO also take pictures of you along the way and send these to you electronically a few days after the tour. Overall it was simply one of the best tours we did during our two weeks in the Far East. Highly recommended

Safe and fun! - This is a must. I had never been on a scooter and felt safe. The drivers not only take you from a town but also spend time with you as you walk around at each of the sites. I wish I had taken the foodie tour when I could so don't be nervous if you are thinking about it.

Soooooo much fun! - What a great way to experience HCMC! Booked two tours w/ XO and we just got back from the first. These women are fantastic! So friendly and happy to answer any questions you have. We visited notable sites and had time for pictures and treats. We're set to take The Foodie tour tonight and can hardly wait! Book a tour, its worth every penny!

Saigon on 2 wheels!! - What an amazing tour group!! XO Tours is a great way to try local Vietnamese street food and see some different districts of Ho Chi Minh city. Zipping through the crowded streets on the back of a scooter with our skillful guides was so much fun! Even got to try a local delicacies like "jumping KFC" (frogs legs)! I highly recommend this tour to anyone!

Fantastic Tours - Had the most amazing night and experience doing the foodie tour. Seeing Ho Chi Minh City from a scooter and going to parts of the city that I would have never known to go. Amazing food and amazing tour guide! Highly recommend doing any of their tours when visiting

Awesome adventure - don't miss - After the 1st couple of minutes I was no longer worried about being on a Vespa in the middle of Saigon traffic. The girls are great & took wonderful care of us during the night. The time flew by & there was so much great food. Vegetarians are also well catered for. We visited most of the districts and was given background on each by our guide. Only take what you absolutely need on the tour. My small bag spent most of the time locked in the Vespa seat 😄

Best way to see the city - We had such an amazing tour.
We did the Saigon by night tour and it was a great way to see all the different parts of the city and how everyone lives.
The food was amazing and the guides and tour leaders knew so much and could tell us everything about the city!
This is a must do if you are in Ho Chi Minh city without a doubt.

A night to remember! - My friend and I went on the night city tour with XO this week. It was absolutely amazing from start to finish!

I was a little nervous about the vespas, but my guide made me feel comfortable from the get go. We both had fantastic guides (bing and food excuse the spelling) and our group guide, Han, was also fantastic. Han told us so much information about each district, which made it so unique and insightful. Also, the food was great.

I'd highly recommend to anyone! Our best night in the city!

What can I say but 'JUST DO IT!!!!' - You will not regret this food tour in any way. I've been on a few food tours in different countries and for sure this is the best tour I've been on by far. Over three hours of freedom, food and entertainment. Being on the back of a motorbike is Saigon is a real blast. I felt safe all the way.

If you are lucky enough to get 'Tinkerbell' as your motorcycle guide, lucky you! She is a real cracker, full of enthusiasm, fun and energy for what she does. Her English is excellent. Thank you again Tink for making my tour so special.

As for the rest of the XO team I have to say well done for being so professional. The tour was managed by 'Thai' (sp) and he led the tour convoy for guided stops in the Saigon Districts we visited and he entertained the group with history of Saigon relevant to the XO food tour.

Don't expect to get the standard old fresh spring rolls on this tour. All the food is fresh, tasty and most definitely NOT what you will find in the 'Tourist' restaurants. You will eat with local people in 'their' restaurants. The foods we tried were most certainly a taste of the real Vietnam!

Again, well done Thai, Tinkerbell and all the team at XO Food Tour. You guys exceeded my expectations in every way!

Cheers,

Milan

What a great way to see Ho Chi Minh! - The booking process for our custom tour was very easy, Ms. Nguyen was very accommodating in adjusting to any changes or requests we made prior to our arrival. Our drivers were on time and we were pleasantly surprised to understand with us as well as our guide. He was very informative and loved to take pictures for us so we could simply enjoy the tour. Riding on the back of the motorcycles was comfortable and the traffic congestion was not an issue for the ladies, they were a pleasure to ride with! Without hesitation I would recommend XO Tours to anyone spending time in Ho Chi Minh!

Haven't been so full after a tour! - Amazing tour of the city. The girls who ride the bikes are great and are great to talk with throughout the journey. Our main guide, Khoi, is very friendly and knowledgeable about the city and the food.
Which brings me onto the food. It's fantastic! It's unlikely to be what you would put on your plate back home but it's well worth trying as much as you can! Everything is worth a taste! As well as the food being a good quality, the quantity is also excellent and the XO staff are happy to top you up with food and drinks at the food stops.
A must-do in Saigon.

Highlights of our Vietnam trip - The evening foodie/scooter trip was one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday -- saying a lot as I've never been on a motorbike before (let alone in such bonkers traffic) and as such was rather nervous, and I'm vegetarian, so food tours are normally a bit dull for me.

The scooter ride thru the city was gloriously good fun, even with the rain. It gives a great view of the city, helped by the witty, insightful commentary from my lovely driver.

Despite being vegetarian, there were plenty of alternative dishes on offer for me. We let them know about my eating choices ahead of time, and it was clear a lot of effort was put in to ensure I was well fed. I nearly exploded from over eating.

This tour is perfect for anyone with a sense of adventure who wants to get a bit of insight on Saigon, try some local food, and have a go in the insane traffic.

Loved every minute of this tour. Would do it again next time we're in HCMC.

You'd be crazy to get on two wheels in HCMC - but crazy not to! - A sensational sight seeing tour on the back of a scooter- a "must do" in my book to get your bearings around this wonderful city. The team were fantastic to deal with when booking, keeping me informed of any weather challenges. On the road, We felt safe all the way with Thuy, Tab and Ngoc riding us around, tour leader Hieu did a great job explaining the history any showed great knowledge in the sights we visited. The whole team speaks exceptional English. The"Foodie Tour" was also great value, I'd highly recommend this Tour company.

Best Tour Total - Holy carp how to describe the feeling of zipping through Saigon traffic after spending 3 days watching it from the outside? Just amazing.

7 of us chose for the foodie tour and were not disappointed. We saw districts and restaurants that few westerners ever get a chance to see. Of all the tours I have done around the world, this is by far the best.

It seems a little expensive for a local food tour, but honestly this is a city tour by night with some amazing food and experiences thrown in. Go do it! Book now!

Just a side note, the 3 men on the tour are American football build guys, myself weighing around 275 lbs. The girls who drove us on the scooters had no troubles and really handled everything like true professionals!

Great experience! - Awesome time navigating the crazy streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter with great tour guides! My favorite tours are those that get you out of the tourist areas and this one didn't let me down on that front in any way. Highly recommended!

Money Well Spend - The food tour was amazing. Traveling on the back of a scooter through Saigon is one of those bucket list type things. What made this a unique experience was traveling through the many "non-tourist" districts. I ate veg and seafood only and the options were amazing. The tour director made an effort to replace the standard items on the menu with veg and seafood. Most times the veg and seafood options looked more delicious than the standard option because everyone else wanted a taste of my food.

So much fun with the sweetest girls ever! - Wonderful time with the XO girls! We had a group of 4 girls and a short amount of time to see Ho Chi Minh. We booked the city sights tour for a Sunday in the morning. We stopped at the must see sights and got some good history of the city. We also loved the short market stop with a sweet snack. The drivers were great, fun and talkative! We felt safe and happy the entire time. Highly recommend this tour!!

Amazeballs!!! - I'll be honest that at first glance I didn't think to spend $70 on a food tour because Vietnam is not that expensive. After seeing all the reviews and not wanting to sit around in my hostel I booked it.

I love it.... the food tour on scooters is designed by some awesome young ladies taking you around about 5 different locations to eat. We had an array of different dishes and even though we drove through a significant storm (rained and provided poncho) everyone loved the outing.

The staff is what really makes this experience worth while Hieu Nguyen the tour leader has an amazing staff of young ladies on his team and I would love to take another tour with this again in the future.

Great fun - Did this tour with my wife.

Great fun from start to finish.

They collected us from the hotel, took us to various street food vendors. Explained all the dishes we were eating and how they came about

Between the food vendors then included a tour of various districts of the city, again exposing the history and any interesting facts.

The tour is done on the back of young girls riding mopeds through the insane Vietnamese traffic system (which in itself is pretty scary/exciting)

A well organized tour which is Well worth the cost.

I highly recommend!!!

Brilliant tour of the city at night - The girls picked us up at our hotel and went through how to be a passenger on a bike. I was a little apprehensive about getting on the back of a bike in HCM. My driver understood that I was nervous and was very friendly and eased my fears. My apprehension soon disappeared within a few minutes and I was enjoying the sights as we whizzed around the city with stops in several districts. It is an excellent tour which is run by very professional and friendly female drivers, a must do for anyone going to HCM. Thanks Vi and Ni (hopefully that is the correct spelling!)

Foodie Tour provides a rare taste of Saigon - I just finished the Foodie night tour on the back of scooter. My driver Quynh and the group leader Tai were both excellent. I am Viet Kieu (returning Vietnamese from US where I've lived most of my life). I have been to Vietnam four times and I do speak a little Vietnamese. Most importantly I am no stranger to Vietnamese food. I was worried about the tour being too basic or not 'foodie' enough. I am happy to report that the food we ate was quintessentially Vietnamese and yet I was exposed a number of new dishes I was not familiar with. The company is owned an Vietnamese-American like me and it really is a well run operation.The guides speak excellent English and are able to engage wonderful depth of conversation about the food and the city. You also get to see parts of Saigon that would not easily be accessible by the average non-local. I felt like one of my cousins was driving me around and showing me the sites. For what it's worth I'm from the Bay Area and NYC and my foodie expectations were met! I would like to say I was very inspired to talk to a young Vietnamese woman like Quynh who truly has a passion for hospitality and food. Vietnam's future is very bright with young people like Quynh and Tai leading the way. This tour is more expensive than others and it is worth every penny. Especially if you have a limited time in Saigon, sign up for the night foodie tour!

Do the tour first - Anyone adventurous enough should do this your first to get an idea of HCMC and its culture. The bike ride was very safe and the foods were not typical touristy (and clean, safe to eat). The tour guides were great. Would definitely recommend this tour.

XO Food Tours - a must do! - We had seen many posts on TripAdvisor about how good the XO Tours were so decided to do the food tour on our first night in HCMC. Without doubt the best of the three food Tours we have now done in Vietnam. We were picked up from our hotel by Chang (2) and Anh (3) and they expertly navigated us through Saigon's crazy streets to meet up with our group. All of the food places they took us to were amazing and I have never eaten such amazing scallops!!

They were so friendly as were the other girls on the tour and the tour guide was very funny. Overall it was a fantastic tour and a great way to experience Saigon traffic from the back of a scooter!! Thank you Chang (2) and Anh (3) for looking after us so well!

- Elizabeth and James

Back of Bike is the only way. - I have been wanting to do the XO Tour for a few years now, so this time in HCMC I booked the Foodie & The Half Day City Tour. The Foodie Tour was excellent, the girls are just lovely & like to chat, the food was good and I did'nt have a worry about the traffic as the girls are very careful. After this tour I ended up doing back of the bike tours all through Vietnam, the only way to see more than one normally would be.

A highlight of our trip! - I was extremely nervous about getting on the back of a moped, but 45 seconds after we started driving, I felt completely safe. Driving around the city at night was exhilarating and not once did I ever feel scared. The tour was so interesting (thanks Anh) and our drivers were amazing. Extremely personable and fun, they made this tour what it was - fantastic! The food was so good and we saw parts of Saigon that we never would have seen if we hadn't done this tour. We also ate food we never would have eaten and we loved every bite! Would recommend this to anyone!

Awesome night out! - What a great introduction to Ho Chi Minh! Our girls picked us up from our hotel and it was full on fun from here! Great safe riding. A combination of food to delight every appetite and a great insight to the different cultures that surround the city! Can't recommend this tour enough! Definitely one of the highlights to our trip!

Highlight of our trip to Vietnam - An amazing tour and a must-do tour when going to HCMC/Saigon. First a call out to our great drivers, Chiang and Anh (not sure of spelling) and tour leader Khoi. Great people. All the XO personnel had the perfect balance of being professional yet friendly. You really get to know your driver and the interaction is enlightening because you can ask them about the culture, the city, the food, etc. First you have the tour of the ring road around the city, which was worth the price by itself. My favorite was snaking through the "wet market" (fish market). What a memorable experience to see the huge variety of fish and seafood, up close and personal! The food was really something as well. We're adventurous eaters, but always a bit skeptical when overseas. It was reassuring to know these places were sketched out, even though, by our San Francisco standards, some of them appear a bit sketchy. Our concerns were unwarranted, as all was fine/good. Delicious food and good SE Asia beer and no stomach problems. A must-do if you have the time/interest!

Definitely the highlight of a trip to Saigon - The girls are the ultimate hosts; lots of knowledge on the city and its history, they help you with cooking your food, and ensure you are engaged with conversation, their English is perfect, the beer kept flowing. And the food was awesome!

Motorbike street food tour - Those ladies rock! This is The perfect venue after a long flight and a humid afternoon. The breeze, the streets, the sceneries, and the street food are like a movie! We really enjoyed the whole experience and felt like a part of the locals. You gotta relax and enjoy the ride. It's an adventure in a foreign city.

The only way to experience this city - And what an experience. On the back of a motorcycle during rush hour traffic through an intersection where the traffic lights were not working!! These girls are magical. They managed to navigate thru this melee cooly and calmly. I kept thinking this would have been chaos in NZ. Road rage and accidents in abundance, but Vietnamese people are extremely calm and polite and all together wonderful. Loved our tour of the city and the guides assistance thru the throngs of tourists to see wonderful sights and have them explain so that they expanded our knowledge and love of this wonderful country.

Night tour - Absolutely fabulous! Lady drivers were extremely confident and provided us with an experience we will never forget. Great manoeuvring in HoChiMinh traffic, good food and great company with fellow travelers. Thoroughly enjoyed and highly recommend this tour to everyone who wants a unique experience and a break from museums to have some fun.

Must Do in Ho Chi Minh City! - The XO Foodie Tour is highly recommended. My husband and I got to experience the city by motorbike driven by very experienced tour guides. We stopped at various districts in Ho Chi Minh City to taste many dishes that we wouldn't have known to order. As we ride on the motorbike from one district to another in the evening, we got to see places and people that we wouldn't otherwise be exposed to.

If there's any one thing that you have to do while you're in Ho Chi Mihn City, it's by far the XO Foodie Tour! It's worth the time.

Be sure to get well rested and save your stomach before the tour because it's a long tour with lots of eating. And be open to trying different dishes and have fun!!

MAGICAL MYSTERY TOUR - Wow!!!!!!!!!! what a fantastic tour. The best tour we have done throughout Asia. Anh and the team were superb hosts and provided us with an unforgettable experience. The ride through Saigon, the food and the sharing of the life in Saigon was truly amazing. JUST DO IT!!!!

The only way to see Ho Chi Minh! - We had limited time in the city, and decided to book with XO Tours to see as much as possible in a short time.

Best choice we could have made. The girls were a lot of fun, very chatty made us laugh and the guides kept us entertained as we toured the sights. They were happy to take pics for us and also had a camera of their own that they captured some snaps on and emailed over a few days later.

The only way to see Ho Chi Minh is on the back of a moped. You get to see the city from the locals perspective, the traffic by western standards is crazy and that's part of the fun - only in Ho Chi Minh does a shortcut mean mounting the sidewalk!

Our only regret was that we were not available to experience the food tour in the evening.

Great service. Great food and location. - Very well executed tour. No safety concerns. Great experience viewing the city from the ground level. Would recommend a day or two of prior street food consumption to get a comparison.

Must do in HCMC - We only had a limited time in Ho Chi Minh so I decided to book the sights and foodie tour with XO. This is the best way to explore the city if you only have a short time. The female tour guide/drivers (Linh) were fantastic. The tour leaders were very informative. Really truly you will have a great time! Especially the foodie option. Both will take you to areas where tourists dont usually frequent. I cannot say it enough how my boyfriend and i enjoyed our time with xo :) highly recommended!

Highlights of a Vietnam trip - What a sensational experience. We (Dad, son & myself) were picked up at our hotel by three lovely young ladies on scooters. What made it a standout was the friendly and expert drivers, the food, places visited and people we met on the tour. Has been highlighted of our Vietnam trip.

Fantastic Scooter Food Tour - The girls picked us up and toured us around on scooters to great little eating places scattered around Ho Chi Minh. We had a traditional Beef Noodle Soup, BBQ frogs, prawns, squid, beef and goat, ate at a little seafood place with clams, prawns and I even tried Duck Egg Embryo. An incredible food tour and well worth doing. You get to visit areas of Ho Chi Minh that tourists don't visit.

Best tour yet - This is the best tour I've experienced yet. I've been to the US, Europe, different Asian countries and nothing comes close to the excitement of riding the back of a scooter and experiencing the city. They are very professional and they even have video coverage service. The tour guides are very entertaining and friendly. Highly recommended

Best way to experience street food and culture of HCMC - We did the foodie tour and had a blast! It's definitely more of a culture tour than a historical one. We started to feel like locals going from place to place on moto scooter. We had the best food of our trip to Asia on this tour. It's a must do while in Saigon.

We felt really safe the whole time. The drivers were excellent and XO provides a couple extra guides that act as guards at each destination. So glad we didn't miss this!

One of the highlights - Just returned from the foodie tour and couldn't recommend it more. Thanks Tai and all of the riders and staff. Absolutely great trip thanks
Craig. Needle. Brad. Harry and Anola

Foodie Tour - An excellent tour and the best of our trip to Vietnam!
The guys are fantastic and professional! And the food yummy! :)
A must do while in HCMC!

Brilliant fun! - The night sights ride with XO tours was absolutely great. The lady drivers were charming and always laughing and the ride was thrilling but not scary. In particular Ting and Wan were great - joking around the whole time. The evening was well planned and it was great to see parts of Saigon you would never normally see. The street meal with sugar cane juice was yummy and the phrase book was fun to try out as we ate. I'll be back to do another tour soon! The foody one sounds good. A tip - the night trips are more comfortable than hot day ones.

No better way for a tour - I have been on many tours in USA, Europe, Japan, Korea, Cambodia, China, Taiwan, etc. A motorbike tour is one of the best ways to fully experience the wonders Ho Chi Minh has to offer. You will feel the freedom, excitement and great sense of adventure all in a safe environment. The choice of food, experienced tour guide, fun, youthful and sporting guides is a perfect well put together package. Excellent service and worth every cent!

The 'Sights' tour was awesome! - Great way to see the key sights in the city as well as some local culture! Guides are heaps of fun and speak great English! Was a super engaging half day and one we would totally recommend!

Foodies Tour - Words cannot express how delighted we were to have taken this tour. Our drivers took excellent care of us. Not only were they extremely competent in their driving skills they had delightful personalities as well. The tour is very well organized. The food is delicious. In addition to all of this you cover an amazing amount of the city.

The company was very responsive to my inquires and a pleasure to do business with.

Thank you XO for a great tour.

Perfect way to end our holiday in Vietnam - A week later and we are still thinking about our tour it was absolutely the best way to see Saigon and the perfect way to end our holiday. I was initially a little nervous about riding around the busy streets on a motorbike but by the end of our Foodie tour I felt like a local. Our drivers were Tuyet and Phuong, they were excellent drivers, calm, quietly confident, experienced and so knowledgable about their city and country. It was lovely to hear about their lives and culture and to share some with them about our life in NZ.
We loved the food and tried all sorts of things that we would never have tried if we were on our own. We also got to see so much of Saigon, in fact just about every district and got to experience all the very different faces of the city.
The group leader Tai was so interesting and really brought Saigon to life for us.
He has since emailed through some wonderful photos that they took of us on the tour.
If you are visiting Saigon you MUST take a tour with XO you won't regret it.
The memories of our tour will last a lifetime. We are eagerly awaiting the copy of our video, to show our kids that we aren't as old as they think!

Foodie Tour - Fantastic, fantastic, fantastic
Everything about this tour was excellent beginning with the very smooth organization even though the tour start had to be delayed by 30 minutes due to heavy rain. Our female riders were extremely competent and I felt 100% safe for the whole tour. Both were lovely girls who made us feel special. The tour leader provided excellent information on the history and culture of each district we visited, all delivered in his very warm humorous style. All food was delicious and well explained. The tour was an absolute highlight of our trip.
I am excited about receiving the photos in about 5 days time.

A great way to see Saigon! - I rode with Nhut and my friend rode with Ngoc. They were both great motorbike drivers, very good at navigating the insane traffic of Saigon and I never felt unsafe. XO tours was a GREAT way to see Saigon. We did The Sights tour....it lasted 3 hours which was the perfect amount of time for me. We got around quickly on the motorbikes vs walking from sight to sight, and way more fun than taking taxis everywhere. We feel like locals on the back of the bikes without having to drive them ourselves (too scary!). At each stop, Sang was waiting for us to give a detailed history of the location and he was great at answering all our questions! We even got some delicious treats along the way :) I HIGHLY recommend XO tours (esp. The Sights tour) as a fun/different way to experience the city and culture of Saigon!

Great way to see the city - We've done a couple of bike tours in the past and had an idea what it was like.
To be honest in this city its so busy and we were a little worried about having a crash with someone as there is a lot of traffic mainly other bikes.
But, we met our girls who came to our hotel we climbed on board and had a fantastic time.Every one just melts in and gives way.
