A few times front wheels came close to my legs but you get used to that.
This is not our first visit to Ho Chi Min City but we were taken to a lot of places that you would normally miss as a tourist.
Like district 8, and China town.
We visited 8 districts.
All different but similar in ways.The riders are very passionate about their city and more than happy to tell you about their culture.
I highly recommend this tour to anyone.
The only thing I found if I were to have a minimal complaint is I had a sore shoulder for hanging on the bar for 3 hours behind my seat.
As a male you can't hang onto the riders for safety.
Don't let this discourage you though.
Thanks XO tours we loved it!

The best tour ever! - This tour was fantastic. Our group of 4 did a private foodie tour with XO tours and we all loved it!!
What a way to experience the hustle and bustle of Saigon than to be weaving in and out of traffic on the back of a motorbike. We loved trying all the local foods and eating them where the locals eat. This did not feel like a tour at all, more like a Vietnamese culture experience with the locals.
The girls were so funny and instantly made you feel relaxed before you even hopped on the bike. It was my first time on a motorbike and I wasn't scared at all, in fact I can't wait to go back to Saigon in the future to do another bike tour with XO tours.
It was my 3rd time to Saigon and this would be one of the most memorable experiences. AMAZING!
Scooter Tour - It was sooo cool! A must do! The woman drivers were brilliant and chatted to us the whole way, pointing out sights etc. tour guides at each destination were brilliant too.

Well organized and fun - To me this tour was very well organized and really showcased the local culture (motorbike, ao dai dressed driver, etc). Don't be afraid since the lady drive like a pro. Special credit to the lady for her driving skill and engaging conversation. Overall it was an enjoyable tour.

Must do! - We booked the "Saigon by Night" tour and had the best time. The girls are so funny and quickly put you at ease as they expertly weave in and out of the Saigon traffic. The tour leader was informative and funny too. We were hesitant at first as our youngest child is 5 years old but she enjoyed it so much and did not want the night to end. Thoroughly enjoyed by both adults and children.

Stop thinking about and just do it! You won't regret it. The nicest bunch of young people you'll ever meet :)

Amazing experience - As a group of 15 we had a wonderful bike tour of Saigon. I have never been on a bike before - but felt safe and secure the whole time. Guides were very knowledgable and helpful. Food was lovely and I would recommend this tour to everyone!

Fantastic! - My girlfriend and I booked the Sights tour and the Foodie tour, and they were both excellent! We did the Sights tour on our first morning in HCMC and it was a great introduction to the city. The girls are so friendly and informative and it's a lot of fun being on the back of the scooter. We had an amazing time on the tours and can't speak highly enough about the experiences we had. Thank you!!

The VERY best way to enjoy Ho Chi Minh City - I was very nervous at the outset but the wonderful young lady driver quickly put me at my ease and assured me she had had much heavier passengers than me on the back of her bike before. Her English was excellent and she quickly established a rappore which she kept up throughout the trip.
Only four of us on the morning sightseeing tour and our tour guide 'Sang'? gave us loads of excellent information on Saigon, the buildings we visited, the markets and the very beautiful monument to the Buddhist monk whose self-sacrifice was so instrumental in changing the attitude to buddhism.

The evening 'Foodie Tour' was also excellent and very good value for money, again with just four of us with another great guide. My driver was so funny, she had me in stitches with her tales and her driving skills were fantastic. At no time did I ever feel I was in danger - not even when she so skillfully negotiated the crazy roundabouts and places where four roads converged and no-one was prepared to give way!
The selection of food was amazing and it just kept on coming. By the end of the evening I was totally stuffed and couldn't have eaten another thing.

Later on in the week I did another scooter tour (different company) with a young male driver. It was nowhere near as good as the XO Tours and I didn't feel anywhere near as safe as when I was with the girls.

Just take one of their tours - you won't regret it and you will learn so much about Saigon,

Best first night in Saigon - So happy I came across XO Tours and that I decided to book the Saigon By Night tour on myfirst day there. My guide Gwen was very friendly and we instantly clicked. She and Khoi, the Tour Leader, were most knowledgeable about the city. I was initially afraid of getting on a motorcycle in crazy Saigon traffic but they guaranteed our safety and were very safe riders. Easily one of the best guided tours I've been on. Highly recommended!

Great Great Experience - Not much else to say that hasn't already been covered by all the other reviewers. That being said, if you are still on the fence stop that and go sign up for one of their tours ASAP. I can't speak for all of their other offerings but if the food tour in Ho Chi Minh is any indicator they are all a high quality experience.

The kids loved it as much as the adults - Wow, what can I say - you have to do this tour. XO Tours are professionally run and heaps of fun. The kids felt at ease on the back of the scooters with the lovely ladies from XO Tours. Our children are 17 and 15 years old and at first were a bit nervous, however the ladies put them at ease very quickly. We visited many Districts on the Food Tour and tried lots of different food that we would not normally eat (Goat, Frogs Legs etc). We did get caught out in the rain, but we were quickly given raincoats to stop us from getting completely soaked. We went home very full and very happy. If we visit HCMC again, we will definitely be back for another tour. Well done XO Tours :)

across shopping - We thoroughly enjoyed our third XO tour during a short stay in Saigon. This time we chose the shopping tour and it was a personalized adventure around various shopping streets and markets away from the main shopping areas. We met our two drivers and guide at the front of our hotel and discussed the arrangements of things we were looking for. He was then on hand to negotiate prices of the items we were wanted to purchase. We were able to make a couple of detours for extra purchases including finding a local Chinese Herbalist. Even though we have been to the city some of the times we saw a different side. Our drivers were excellent, with very good English and we had lots of fun along the way. I would highly recommend any of the XO tours.

Amazing gastronomic adventure! - Three words: BEST. TOUR. EVER. We've been to several organized tours in most of our out-of-country trips but nothing beats the Foodie Tour from XO. Amazing team! We didn't want it to end actually - however our bloated stomachs were already an indication for us to go. HAHA. It was worth it! Despite the sudden rain :) Highly recommended.

So much fun! - I did two tours with XO: the Sights and Saigon by Night. They were so much fun! There were only three of us on the first tour and four on the second, and they should always be full as they are such great tours. I had two different motorbike drivers, both of whom were excellent. The tour leader on both tours was Anh. The women give a running commentary as you ride, and Anh gives details at each stop. The women all have great English skills (one of mine has an English degree from university), are very personable and very sweet. Anh is knowledgeable, entertaining, and has excellent English skills. I had been to some of the sights with a private guide, and I learned much more from Anh. I highly recommend this tour to everyone visiting Saigon. You zip around the city and feel like you belong, not just as a tourist, and the locations they take you to are all very interesting, and not all are mainstream. I recommend doing a day tour and a night tour as they are different, and give you a different feel for the city. I can't say enough good things about them. Don't hesitate; do it!

Fabulous! - We did two of their tours - The Foodie and the Sightseeing which were both fantastic. The Foodie Tour at night was the highlight and highly recommended. The girls were just gorgeous and lots of fun. The food was great and we all felt safe (including our 11 year old) riding on the back of the bikes in the busy traffic. Definitely a great way to see Ho Chi Minh City!!

Xo Foodie Tour - Was recommended we go on this tour by friends that had done it last year. So I had high expectations but it was even better than expected . Yes it is a pricey tour but it is a must do and I think it is great value. It goes for 5 hours and you get to see 5 districts of the city at night, from the back of a scooter in buzzing traffic. You may think it may be a bit dangerous because of the traffic but we feel very safe as the girls were good drivers . The girls we had were fantastic.My driver Nung was very quirky and funny. My wife's driver Tinkerbell was too. In fact everyone was fantastic so thanks to all the girls and to Khoi our tour leader. I will be telling everyone I know that goes to HCMC to do this tour. Make sure not to eat lunch as there is so much food and lots of beer too. Lou and Paula

Amazing!!!! - I chose this tour to discover both vietnamese food and Ho Chi Minh city. I hesitated a lot to reserve it because the price is quite high, but it is totally desserved and I highly recommend it. They come to pick you up at your hotel and bring you in many areas of Saigon. All the tour guide are really careful about you, the security is highly controlled and of course... Last but not least: the food is ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS! I had a great night. I also suggest to do this tour on your arrival so you can have a global overview of the city!

Fun Regards - Our party of 6 thoroughly enjoyed the sightseeing tour of Siagon. The bikes were a fantastic way to see the City. Our guides were friendly and helpful and we finished the tour just buzzing.

The True Saigonese Experience! - A MUST-DO in Ho Chi Minh City! Me and my wife had 2 different tours: The Sights and The Foodie. Both are awesome but if you have to choose, pick the Foodie! We had a great time with Chang (Page #2) and Tam #1 riding the bikes. Actually the first tours were so good with them that we asked to have them riding again with us. Foodie is an amazing off-topic HCM side of what you can see by night in the city! Worth every single penny and make you see a side of HCM you wouldn't find by yourself! Strongly recommended! Thanks XO Tours!

Highlight of our trip to Vietnam - Do yourself a favor and book an XO Foodie Tour. My husband and I had the best time. The girls are so wonderfully friendly and make you feel very comfortable at all times with their driving ability. I was very scared at first being on the back of a motorbike in the middle of Saigon knowing how busy and dangerous it could be. The girls talk to you the whole time and put you at ease and by the second stop I was just craving to get back on the bike. The food was amazing and very abundant. Everything about this tour was well organized and very professional. Congratulations and best wishes to you all at XO Tours, what you offer is an absolutely amazing time for all of your guests and nothing is too much trouble for you. We were looking after the whole time and just had the best night out with you all. Thank you so much we will be telling anyone and everyone about XO Tours.

Just do it! - Fantastic tour, not only because you enjoy great traditional food. Tai (main host) was so accommodating to anyone's food allergies or preferences. A great way to see a lot of Saigon in a limited amount of time. Not only because you taste great food, but you learn so much about Vietnamese culture. Whether your in the city for 1 day, 1 week or 1 month - JUST DO IT!!

Best food tour we did in Asia - and we did a lot! - We were picked up from outside our hotel promptly at 5.50pm by our two drivers. I'd never been on a scooter before, even riding pillion, so I was a little nervous to be out in the midst of rush hour HCMC traffic! Our girls were brilliant though, I felt safe the whole time and just started to relax and enjoy myself. Our first stop was a market in Chinatown, where we waited for the others in our group for the night. We were only a small group of four in the end which was great! This is just as much a tour of the city at night as a food tour - you get taken to a few different districts well away from District 1, so you get to see a bit of 'real' HCMC. The food choices were delicious, and the drivers were all very friendly with excellent English and a good sense of humour. We did the Saigon by Night tour and it was just the right amount of food and length of time - word of warning - if you're thinking of doing the full Foodie Night Tour - go with an empty belly, the amount of food sounds ridiculous! Brilliant first night in Saigon, would recommend to anyone - five stars girls!

The very best - I did two tours with XO - the morning city tour and the evening foodie tour. They were both fantastic! XO were extremely professional from responding to my online booking, picking me up at the hotel and during the tour, as well as sending photos afterwards! A bike is the best way to see Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City and XO were very safe and friendly. My two bike drivers were each charming and knowledgeable chatting about the sights as we drove through different areas even though there was another guide with us to provide information when we stopped. I felt very safe on the bike (the opposite to the experience I had using Uber Moto!!) and everything was very well organized. When it rained they had a smart branded XO poncho ready to keep you dry. The food in the evening was varied and extremely tasty and there was as much as you could eat they would order more if you were washed hungry down with local beer or soft drinks. Your driver sat with you and talked you through the different foods, accompanying leaves and sauces and it was a great fun evening.

Amazing time - This is a must do tour in Saigon. Two nice ladies pic us up in our hotel and ride us around Saigon in two motorcycles. You will experience saigon as a local, trying all the best dishes meanwhile they show you around the districts in Ho Chi Minh. You will experience the best way to understand Vietnamese culture. The ladies where so nice as well as the tour man.

An absolute must! - This is a superbly well organised tour that will delight your palate with amazing Vietnamese cuisine. These girls will take you to food spots that you wouldn't likely go to unless you can converse in Vietnamese and the variety of food will bow your mind.
If you live seafood, prepare to be amazed!
Apart from the food is the whole idea of riding on a scooter rain or shine. They've got raincoat ponchos to keep you dry and ride safely.
I also appreciated that the tour guide Tai also introduce bits of Vietnamese culture and lifestyle.
We had the best time riding on the scooter in the rain giggling like kids and our riders Ngoc & Anh kept up a running commentary of sights as we rode past.
If you only have a few days and you can't decide what to do and you love eating, this Foodie tour is your fix.

If there is rain beware - We were picked up by two great ladies. We did the Saigon by night tour. Then dropped off by a wet market which wasn't that impressive. Our next stop was street food and on way there started lightning and thundering. Soaked and flooded roads we still were on a bike. Soaked even with a poncho the night went on. At that point we didn't feel safe out in the weather and asked to leave. Side note personal accident before in the rain on a scooter it does happen, They said we would have to pay WHOLE amount!! What? The guide said he was shocked with that decision but that was what manager said. We were pretty upset but continued on to get street desert at last stop. This tour is not worth your money. Looks like foodie your would have been better but second guess that as they don't care about safety!

Foodie and more... - Fabulous! Well organized and informative with a great support team. Visit areas outside touristy district 1 and get a feel for HCMC old and new. A tasty menu thats not your average Vietnamese food in your home town, no spring rolls here. Special thanks to team leader Hieu and my driver Huong. If there is ONE must do while in HCMC this is it!

Awesome!!! - If u hesitate to join in, i highly recommend this tour - night foodie tour.
U can meet various international friends and nice private tour guides as well.
All guides can speak English very well and soooo kind.
U can also try many Vietnamese local foods. 👍🏼
Very exciting tour and safe even uaa woman and alone !
완전 강추 합니다~~~여성분 혼자라도 전혀 위험하지 않고, 베트남 로컬 음식 많이 접할 수 있어서 매우 만족합니다.
또한 가이드 모두 영어를 잘해서 베트남어 못해도
괜찮습니다.

Safe hands! - We were apprehensive about going on a bike for the first time, in Saigon no less! But 30 seconds in, you know you're in a pair of very safe hands. An excellent way to see Saigon, especially on your first day. We took the morning tour around the main sights ie cathedral, GPO, palace. Little tasty treats along the way too which we thoroughly enjoyed. Very insightful and educational trip

Best thing on my Vietnam trip - We did the XO Tours' Foodie Tour and at first it seemed a bit pricey, but it turned out to be the best thing we paid for in Vietnam and definitely worth the price. The ladies who take us on the bike are extremely friendly and speak great English. They don't hesitate to try and break the ice and by the end of the tour you really get to know not only your driver, but the other drivers and the other guests.

The food is excellent and abundant, the bike rides are scary at first but an absolute blast by the end and the people are so friendly. Not only is this a foodie tour but we also stopped at a few sight seeing spots along the way to learn about other places than just District 1.

All in all, the Foodie Tour is highly recommended and worth every penny. Thank you XO Tours.

Superb sightseeing tour. Ideal for brief visits to HCM - We did the morning sightseeing tour and it was excellent. Great way of cramming a great deal into a fleeting visit of Saigon.

The girls were great motorbike riders, and so helpful, we felt safe at all times. They even dropped us off at a great recommended little vegetarian cafe so I could satisfy my mock meat craving :)

Our main guide Hieu was a super tour leader. Very knowledgable.

Highlights were meeting the 87 year old letter writer in central post office who has been translating letters in the same place since his teens, certainly seeing a great deal of change in the city in that time. A real honor!

Great to visit a little market that hasn't fallen foul to tourist trap habits too!

Highly recommended all round.

Best Tour in Vietnam! Worth the penny! - The night before our tour, I wanted to cancel our schedule after reading a review that he canceled his, and there was no problem. But my husband said we try even if it's expensive.. and its the best decision we have done. I will be very detailed about our trip and our experience..
We did the Foodie tour for $72 per person.
They picked us up at 530pm in our hotel, 2 very neat and nice ladies (Nhat and Tien2) gave us intoduction on riding at the back of motorbike. They are very careful in driving and gave us helmets. My only downside is that the helmet smells bad, reason is that this was used by the earlier people who took the tour. But safety first and I manage to ignore the smell. Bring an alcohol spray with you if ur sensitive to this kind of smell, good i brought one. It was helpful.
They took us to the first restaurant and introduced a beef noodle soup (not pho) it was very very good! On that restaurant the nice tour manager Tai introduced us to the rest of the group and explained the food we are about to eat. He is very kind and looks to all customers' concerns. I was rumored to shrimp and crab and they asked everyone for any allergy on food. Nhat and Tien2 have been with us all the way, we were really comfortable and they speak very good English and treat us very well.
Next is they took us to chinatown and then explained the history of chinatown, its a bit ling for the intro but thats okay then we head out to the BBQ. They served us a lot of food (beef,okra,tofu, shrimp crabs,pancake wrapped in lettuce,and a whole lot more), highlight is frog bbq which is so good. I found it way better to eat the frog with the skin! Tai knows i dont eat shrimp so he gave me pork it was caring of them. Next is we went to the singapore like town which is nice and explain to us that place. We also drove to district 5 which is the shopping district with the cheap prices.. next stop is where we ate the balut, clams, frogs, too many to mention and then desserts! We were sooo full!!! :)
Thank u XO for giving us 2 very nice ladies we were so satisfied by the service and most especially the experience. The money we shelled out is worth it.
I would recommend this to everyone who goes to Saigon.
And note that the ladies/escorts dont starve themselves. They ate the beef noodle as well, and from time to time they munch/eat food with us. Its just that theyve done this so many times that the food is already normal to them. Their main concern is YOU! To serve you best and give you a great experience, if ur happy then they are happy.. Note that they also open the water for you but i dont allow them to do coz i can open it myself, thats how nice they are.. Thank you Tai, Nhat and Tien2! Thank you XO..

Wonderful - Foodie tour of Saigon is a wonderful experience . I can't praise it too highly. It gives you a view of the city that is unique. My driver was Chang and she guided me through parts of the city that otherwise I would not have seen. The opportunity then to eat delicious foods as we stopped off in local restaurants was excellent. The staff of XO tours looked after our group very well. I would recommend this tour as an essential way to see Saigon and really experience the life of the city.

Fun! - What a great way to see the different districts of the city. The tour guide was helpful and informative and the girls were fun to talk to! You get to experience the chaos of riding a scooter without having to maneuver and find your way around the city.

Great fun! - We did the night tour which was great fun. It's an excellent way to see the diversity of Saigon and the tour guide Tai was awesome along with the girls that drove us.would highly recommend, was definitely the most fun thing we did in Saigon. The traffic seems really hectic from the roadside but when you are in it, it feels way less chaotic.

Best thing we did in HCMC - Amazing tour! We were collected by two lovely girls at our hotel and at first I was a bit nervous riding on the back of a scooter around such a busy city but the girls driving was amazing! I felt safe the entire time and it's such a great way to see the city. The tour was very well organized and all the food we had was amazing. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCMC.

Amazing experience in Ho Chi Minh - From the moment the great drivers arrived at our hotel to pick us up for the foodie tour, we felt completely relaxed. Both ladies were friendly and fun, made the whole tour fantastic.
Tai, our tour guide was great, making sure the whole group had an enjoyable night.
Not sure what was the best part, the experience of seeing the city at night on the back of a scooter, or the delish food that we had on our 3 food stops.
Overall a highlight of our trip!

Helpful and professional - I booked a tour with xo the day before I wanted to do the night tour. They got back to me straight away and confirmed the tour. The next day there was strong monsoon rains with thunder and lightning so I didn't feel safe to go on the bikes. When I canceled they were so friendly and polite and understanding. If I was staying in ho chi Minh again I would definitely book a tour with them!

Your motorbike - Fantastic introduction to HCMC!
Was made comfortable immediately and secure riding behind Ni. She was wonderfully sweet, an accomplished rider and we chatted about life in hcmc and their respective families. Sang accompanying on separate bike, took pictures and provided great historical perspective at each site we stopped to explore. Special fruit drink provided at local stand was divine. Both became good friends in the hours we spent together and got big hugs from me at the end. All in all I highly recommend this trip to folks of any age!

Amazing tour, sensational food, and super nice tour guides/drivers - All I can say about this tour is WOW. The staff are so lovely and welcoming, and you kind of get your own personal tour guide who looks after you at each of the places where you eat and arranges for more food (if you could possibly eat any more) and beers or water/coke.

They were very prompt in picking us up at the hotel and we were whisked away to the first stop which was a pretty big bowl of Bo Bun Hue. One thing it is important to say is that you should absolutely not eat anything for about 4 hours before you come on this tour. There is so much food that you will regret being full before you get there!

Given how warm the evening was it was refreshing getting back on the bikes just for the breeze. The drivers were super professional and I felt completely safe at all times. The break up of the time between food and sightseeing stops was perfect. Our out and out favorite (all four of us) was the last stop with the seafood. Probably the best and sweetest crab I've ever eaten! The scallops with peanuts was incredible here too, as were the clams in lemongrass broth - just WOW!

One of our group did try the frog but it wasn't for the rest of us. The BBQ beef at one of the stops (BBQ'd at our table) was incredible too - marinated in lemongrass, chilli and soy I think - it was out of this world! The desserts at the last stop were also very refreshing and not too rich (flan and a coconut jelly made from the coconut water with a layer of coconut cream jelly on top).

The ladies are so welcoming and really make you feel at home, helping with every aspect and working hard to make sure you have a great time. The tour guide (overall) Koi was also super nice and remembered everyone's names, taking photos and being an amazing leader to the other drivers.

Cannot speak highly enough - just make sure you come with an appetite!! The price is very reasonable given the amount of time you spend with the team and how many miles you will actually do - seeing every aspect of Saigon, high class areas, slums, Chinatown, and everything in between.

Thanks to all of the team for our evening tour on Friday 9 September 2016!! We got the photos you guys sent to us yesterday - loved them!! We will definitely tell our friends about you!!

The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - My compliments to this tour organization! Very well organized with a high level of customer service. The ladies are very knowledgeable and confident on the crazy streets, and check in with you often to make sure you are comfortable. They take pictures along the way which was a very nice touch, as most of my photos food usually only myself or my partner (not both of us).
We had a very limited time and chose for the morning "sites" tour and the Saigon by night tour - both on a private basis. I believe we get a very good feeling for the city from a local's point of view. Highly recommend it!
Fantastic Tour! - We had a great time zooming around Ho Chi Minh city with our lovely guides. We booked the morning city tour and we were very happy with the overall experience.

Foodie Tour a Must Do - What else can I say. These ladies are true professionals with a passion for what they do. They will guide you throughout HCMC and show you two different world's in the same city. The ladies along with their male counter parts (tour leader and security team) will guide you through various places to where you can get a look at the HCMC from a locals view instead of just the usual touristic places.

Best way to see Ho Chi Ming life - We are 3 couples that take this tour in 6 motocicle, driven by young people that work or study in the day, and have extra income due to the tour at nigth. Very kind people that took us around the city. Local restaurant at the street, around the city near the river and to the disko in the roof of high building, there you can see all the city around with the ligths' and drink a beer. Every thigh like the local young people do. I want to tell that we are senior people every one more than 60.
Nice talk and learn about the real life in Saigon

Really fun tours, don't be scared. - These tours are great, and I feel that riding around on the backs of the bikes is the best way to see the city & snapshots of street life. Really well organized & running. We did The Sights tour in the morning, and The Foodie tour in the evening. A tip for those doing tours during the day - make sure you cover up and wear sunscreen, even if it is a cloudy and overcast day. I thought I would be fine as the sun wasn't out, and was severely burnt on the face and shoulders.
Highly Rated - Great way to see the city. Staff were super helpful and informed. Booked the foodie tour after this one went so well

best ever - My wife and I (both 50+) have just experienced the best tour we have ever been on. The xo food tour of Saigon is fantastic. 3+1/2 hrs of fun and food with a little education thrown in. You are picked up at your hotel (on scooters) by two very lovely,friendly, charming young ladies, who make you feel like long lost friends.They chat while driving you from location to location , where the more daring of you can eat all kinds of 'delicacies'. Tia the tour manager was always on hand to help and was great fun. But for us the girls made the tour. Thanks Tim and Hung. Sorry if we spelled it wrong.
This trip is a must do..
Thank you XO.

Best way to explore Saigon - The Foodie Tour by XO was an A+ for fun, learning, dining, and seeing Saigon like a local. Typically I'm averse to tours and tour groups, but the staff at XO were incredible. Tai the manager and Tahn my motorbike tour guide are excellent. Driving through the streets of Saigon on a motor bike with someone who has skills and deep knowledge of the city were priceless. These folks knew everything about the food, the neighborhoods and their environment. Due to the 5:30pm to 10:30pm night Foodie Tour. Its a great time, very safe, and an incredibly unique experience.

Not just fun and delicious, but informative, too! - Really lovely people, from our personal guides to the overall team. Well-organized, incredibly easy. Everything went very smoothly and professionally.

Great food, and the guides even made sure everything was easy to eat. Literally, zero work for us.

But most impressively, they made sure we saw a cross-section of the life and style and geography of Saigon, going out of their way to show us special destinations, even if there wasn't any special food there. Then, they augmented that with interesting commentary about life and culture and economics. An excellent way to learn more about the city as a whole, not just the street food. Thanks, guys!

(Oh! And they even sent you a folder of pictures, so you don't even need to worry about taking your own. As I said: *zero* work for you. Just enjoy.)

Saigon by Night Tour - This tour offers an amazing insight into HCMC - I totally recommend it to everyone. My driver Chang was at my hotel ahead of schedule - answered all my questions amicably, knowledgeably and offered great insights into the city's (and county's) history...all while aptly managing her scooter through HCMC peak hour traffic!!!
We saw the oldest and newest areas of the city - from the bustling Chinatown markets selling live foods to the brand new and relatively soulless modern highrises.
Totally recommend this tour to everyone - 10 out of 10.

Amazing - We took this tour on our last night in Vietnam (Saigon).Great experience and professionally done , took us to all the places where normally tourists won't get to go. The girl drivers were on time and had great knowledge of the city , took us to great places and had a great local dinner and even better deserts , total value for money , the only glitch was that they promised us the photographs via e mail but we still haven't received them so if they could , would be much appreciated .

Should be Number 1 on your list! - We booked the “Sights” tour which runs from 9am – 12pm. We had the 4 girls who drove us around, Sang, our guide and 2 video crew. Pretty great, for just the 4 of us! It also included the food tastings and sugar cane juice.

The girls, Thao3, Quynh, Tam and Nhung2 were absolutely wonderful! Their English was fantastic, and they were just so happy and sociable for the entire ride. All four of us are still chatting about what each of us talked about with our drivers and just how much we loved them! There was never a time when either I felt unsafe or worried about either of my kids (age 13 and 10). The entire team were so great with making the children part of everything and including them in the entire trip.

Sang, who talked us through every location was so knowledgeable and able to speak on a level to engage the kids which is not an easy feat! He was so friendly and engaging, definitely went with the flow on conversation and taught us so much more than just about the sites, but about Vietnamese life, history and culture. He was brilliant!

I think you can see I can't recommend this tour enough! It was fun, knowledgeable and entertaining all in one.

Not To Be Missed - This would have to be one of the highlights of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnam
This was an exciting and fun night traveling on the back of a scooter driven by a delightful well spoken lady. You get to see the sights of Saigon, as the locals call it, sample food cooked at various street restaurants around the city. The scooter drivers speak great English and chat to you as you weave your way through the busy streets of the city. The food is great. The restaurants gave us a great experience of Vietnamese food that you would not experience elsewhere. All made so much more wonderful with the lovely team of motor scooter driver and the support staff. This is a great night. Starts at approx 5pm and finishes at approx 10 pm. Not to be missed

Amazing Night tour the day I landed - Like it says, a couple of hours after I landed, I went on a night tour of Saigon with these guys. The format is great; you ride behind one of the drivers and a tour guide follows you along to run you through information about the stops.

My tour guide was Tuan, who was probably the friendliest bloke in Saigon and my rider was an amazing girl whose name unfortunately escaped me. They made it an amazing experience with some food, riding through Saigon streets and pics they mailed back to me. Would highly recommend to anyone.

Highlights of HCMC - Had the most interesting evening with a lovely young lady as my guide. Best way to see the city and try local foods. Your own little private tour guide on a scooter! Got to try local delicacy among the locals. I also learned a lot about life in HCMC through the eyes of local people. Must do in HCMC.

Awesome foodie tour! - I can't say enough good things about XO tours. Everything from the professionalism and responsiveness of making reservations via email, to the places we visited and the amazing staff, all was perfect.

The XO team was so friendly and helpful and caring, like going on a tour with good friends. We went to some amazing restaurants and tried some local foods that I NEVER would have experienced otherwise. And riding around town on the motorbikes was exhilarating and fun. They took such good care of us, several staff there to watch out for us, in addition to the charming ladies that drove us on the bikes.

If you want to experience Vietnamese food, you must do this tour. You won't regret it!!

Thanks XO team, WELL DONE!

Best night in Ho Chi Minh City - Friends recommended the XO Food Tour after a recent visit to Ho Chi Minh City. What a great recommendation - we had an amazing night. The food was just great however the wonderful guides and beautiful female drivers made this a truly memorable experience for our family. This was a definite highlight of our trip!
Amazing foodie tour - Very fun night. Worth the money. Everything ran smoothly and the guides were friendly. Good was delicious. One of the best memories of our trip.

An unforgettable 2.5 hours - I used XO Tours in December 2014 upon my sister recommendation. I had a friend from school with me. The girls turned up on time at my hotel in District 1. Ms Phuoc was my rider for the night & she was brilliant throughout. Conversant in English & well versed in all things HCMC. We had a food stop about halfway through & that was excellent too - both in terms of the local food served and company, which by this time included other riders & their guests. Highlights for me at least, were a local couples hangout & a shiny new neighborhood filled with expats in District 7 . The night in 2 words - highly recommended.

Awesome food night! - I went on the evening Vespa food tour and what a fun night!!! The drivers, which are all female, are sweet, welcoming, make you feel safe and great at involving others on the tour. I was definitely concerned riding on the back of the Vespa at first but by the end of the evening was very comfortable.

The food: SOOOO yummy!!! You get to taste different kinds of food all of which were fantastic! It's spread out as you travel to a few different districts so I never felt over stuffed.

The people: As I stated above, the girls were beyond nice! There's one driver per patron and they are very good at talking with other patrons/starting conversations. The girls were also kind as far as making sure we had everything we needed when we ate. There are guys there as well that follow us from place to place to make sure everyone gets there ok. Along the way they take photos of you on the Vespa which is fun to see later.

What you see: They take you around a few different districts which I'm sure I would've never had seen on my own. They are also informative along the way explaining each stop.

I'm so glad I did this tour and would recommend this company to everyone-already told a few friends about it that are heading to HCMC. If it's a rainy day, they do have ponchos on stand by for you which is a nice touch!

One of the best experiences of our trip - My wife and I went on a trip throughout Asia, and stopped in many places and did many tours. The Food tour at night with XO tours was probably the best tour that we did all trip. For anyone that has not been in Ho Chi Minh, it is a cool city, but the experience with seeing 7 million scooters, in a city with only 10 million people, was the craziest thing we've ever seen. We live in NYC, and this traffic was way crazier. That being said, we felt VERY safe on the scooters when we were driving around.

Our tour guides, Dieu and Nhung, were both very sweet, and very informative. They did a great job on explaining to us the different sites and areas throughout Ho Chi Minh as we drove around. It was a great experience to see 5 different districts, rather than staying in district 1, like most tourist's. All three restaurants were delicious, and it was great to try the actual local cuisine, rather than just Pho. Also, all the beer you want is included.

Highly recommend this!

PERFECT FOOD TOUR - I just everything loved about our food tour. Normally, I'm dubious about tour companies as I hate to experience highly commercialized and sanitized tours of developing cities, but this one is truly different. The tour guides are genuine and fun, and nothing feels contrived, fake, or sketchy.

My fiancé and I were picked up by two of the sweetest tour guides right in front of our hotel in D1. They whisked us away to our first stop where we waited a short few minutes for others who were also in tour group. We met people from all over and our tour manager, Tai, did a great job introducing all of us to each other. It began to rain (heavily) as we headed to Chinatown, so we put on ponchos and soldiered on. I'm actually grateful for the rain, as it added to the experience overall (rain doesn't stop anyone in Saigon!) Of course, the high quality ponchos made it so much easier.

I'm a VERY picky eater and mostly eat only chicken, but I ate goat, beef, clams, and FROG on this tour, and I had a great time! If you absolutely can't have something though, the tour manager does a great job of providing an alternative. Tai asked me a few times, having observed that I didn't touch the meat in our first dish, if there was anything I didn't want to eat and took the initiative to obtain a different dish for me at one of our stops - without prompting! I appreciate that a lot!

Tai took our photos throughout the evening and promptly emailed them to us the day after our tour. Talk about fast!! In terms of safety and efficiency, our tour guides were excellent. They communicated instructions and safety guidelines very clearly, were funny and quick-witted, and did a great job sharing their knowledge and perspectives of this wonderful city. I cannot sing their praises enough, and I hope you get to experience this tour for yourself! This is top-notch.
Night tour - A fantastic night tour with the lady drivers. An exciting way to experience Saigon at night. Dinner at the street market was superb. I strongly recommend it.

This tour is SO awesome, do it! - This review is long overdue but I have to say this is one of the best food tours I have ever been on in my life! My best friend lives in HCM and she takes all her visitors on this tour. We did the evening food tour and the night was filled with endless (absolutely DELICIOUS) food, stopping all over the best spots HCM has to offer. Was so much fun riding on the back of the bikes at night with the city whizzing by! The XO girls are fun and fabulous. You need to do this tour!!!

Saigon at a fast pace - Sounds risky....on the back of a motorcycle in the middle of such a crowded city with so many cars and motorbikes.....but it was so fun.....so fun, that the risk was worth......they know what the do....they offer a great view of Saigon in a relatively short time

Fantastic! - I participated in the evening food tour with my girlfriend and we had a blast. Loads of exciting local foods from a range of restaurants as well as taking in a variety of other areas to hear about the city and life locally.

Our guides were brilliant with excellent English, good humor and guaranteed at all times we both felt safe. Highly recommended, and worth every penny!

Most Amazing Tour You Will Ever Go On - This is a fun exciting and professionally organized tour. Don't be afraid to jump on the bikes with these girls, they have more experience on those scooters and a pack of bikkies! Someone else said don't let the rain put you off, don't even let a thunderstorm put you off! We are a group of 4 in our mid to late 50's and we LOVED it and felt so safe!
The food is fabulous and stuff you won't be able to find it even wish to try as a general tourist. Information on the city and the culture was great to hear. Enjoy your stop at the gas station and make sure someone in your group eats the "duck egg".
Book this tour for when you first land in Saigon as you will benefit greatly from the information you get.
Well done XO Tours, you are the greatest!
We will be back!
Lynn & Keith

Wow... Spectacular night was had - We went on the foodies tour last night and I have never been on such a fun activity on a holiday before.
To start with it was raining an hour before the tour commenced at 5:20 & we revived a detailed email letting us know the procedure for delay if needed, so the communication is excellent.
I am not experienced on bikes but Linh, my excellent rider was very encouraging and skilled, I felt totally at ease in the torrential rain that we experienced for the beginning big the tour.
The food was very local and very good.
I would highly recommend this trip.
Well done XO tours😎

Excellent Customer Service - We took two tours with XO Tours this week. The foodie tour and the city sights tour. Both were excellent with safe drivers and a great tour leader. This is a great way to get acquainted with the city.
Additionally, I accidentally booked two city sights tours for two different days. XO caught it right away, asked me to confirm if we wanted both tours and when I indicated my mistake they immediately sent my refund. Exceeded my expectations!

Very fun, informative tour - This was a great tour - both informative and fun! We were picked up at our hotel by our motorbike guides for the evening and made 5 stops (three with food, 2 for sightseeing/information). It was great to see so many different parts of HCMC, and I appreciate that the guides gave background on the different neighborhoods and on life in Vietnam. The food tastings were great too and went beyond the usual offerings - would satisfy conservative and adventurous eaters alike. They went out of their way to provide personalized attention and information at each stop. Since the tour company advertises all female drivers, my only critique would be for them to employ women as the lead tour guides/speakers as well.

Excellent & Best Choice for our First Time in HCMC - We were hesitating to join the pricy Foodie Tour, but decided to join due to Tripadvisor #1 Food & Drink in HCMC.
Our Group was all first timers to HCMC. On our way from Airport to Hotel, we were disenchanted by the messy massive traffic. Going to regret to ride on bike...
However, it was the best decision. When onto the road, we just blend into the traffic.. At first, it was scary with oncoming vehicles very close to us. Later on, I felt it was okay and safe with my guide's skillful driving.
The tour is as good as what most reviews stated.
A Big Thank You to our 4 Pretty and Young Hosts ~ Thu, Ngan, Ngoc, Dieu !
Don't hesitate to take this tour! - Exhilarating and so much fun! Excellent guides, amazing way to get an overview of the city and how it works. Kids had an absolute ball - treated like rockstars!!

Great tour! - This tour was great. Got picked up at hostel. Taken round different districts. Had food and dessert. Organized well and really well run your. Such a good job! Thanks to the girl who took me. And the tour leader Tuan was great. Would recommend this tour. Was a great way to finish off a week in Ho Chi Minh 👍All the girls were great and fun!😎

Amazing & fun - I booked XO Tour for "The Sight" and "Saigon by night" tour. It was really amazing experience to explore Ho Chi Minh via motorbike! Our team leader Khoi and Anh were good in explaining about the Ho Chi Minh! Very informative! Not to forget about the beautiful lady riders Tam and Quinh! I really enjoy and have fun during the bike. Definitely will do again when I come to Ho Chi Minh next time!

perfect - Yesterday we went to the foody-tour, and we really enjoyed it! The food was excellent and something we haven't had before in Vietnam. We went to restaurants in which also the locals went. Khoi, the tour leader and especially Ngan and Yen were super friendly, smart and they always took care of us. It couldn't have been better and it was a lot of fun to spend our time with them.

Second time around and just as good! 😁 - We visited Ho Chi Minh for the second time and chose to do the XO City Night Tour and as predicted it was just as good as the City Food Tour we did two years ago. The girls are great they like to have a laugh there knowledge is fantastic. On our tour we got to see the back streets of all the Districts try some local food.
Doing this tour is a way to get out of the Hotel and the area you staying in and get involved and onto the fast paced roads in the best way possible. It's really exhilarating to be zipping around all the different districts and don't let the rain stop you it adds to the fun of it.
I think if we went back again we would do this tour just to get among it.
Highly recommend this without hesitation. Take the leap !!

Foodie fun on two wheels - Everything you've read or heard about XO Tours is true.

If there's a better, funner and more exhilarating way of experiencing the different types of food on offer in this city, tell me about it. Because this was simply great. Zipping around the craziness of HCM in the capable hands of your female drivers, straying way outside the relative comfort of District 1, enjoying the jokes of affable tour manager Tai Dang and savoring some of the more esoteric dishes on offer. (I'm rubbish at trying out new food, but after a few cans of the local beer even I managed a few mouthfuls of frog.)

The main emphasis is on fun. The staff are dead keen on everyone having a good time, and although there's no forced jollity, you'll inevitably have a great laugh and get some great memories. Do it!

Great way to explore Saigon - I tried both the day tour and food might tour. Both were well organized, fun and great way to see saigon. I was offered a lot of recommendations of places to visit in saigon and where to eat. Thank you!

XO Food Tour is a Saigon must do!! - What a great way to see and taste Saigon. Tai and the team delivered an entertaining, informative tour from the back of a bike. Tasty food, the young ladies who were our bike chauffeurs were knowledgeable, friendly and amazing drivers. If you want a great Saigon experience then the XO Food Tour is a must ... loved it all including the "jumping chicken" 10/10 Thank you

"Saigon by Night tour" was great! Take this tour if you want to explore different parts of Saigon in a unique way. - The 'Saigon by night tour' of XO tours was a great experience. The whole team was very friendly, continuously making sure we where doing fine. They way the girls where interacting with our children was so nice. Even for younger children this tour is fun and safe. Driving in the Saigon traffic is so different to what we are used to, but the driving skills of these girls are very good and we feel safe all the time.

The sequence in which you go from district to district is well thought of. It shows you very different sides of the city and gives a good understanding of what living in the city must be like for different groups of people.

The food was very good and the location to eat was perfect. Being among local people, makes the experience great.

Thanks again to the whole team for making this a very enjoyable evening!!

Well Worth the Price - Pricey for HCM but well worth it... Girls were very good and welcoming! Rained for the entire journey and they provided ponchos... We got to see areas of HCM we would have never experienced otherwise.... Highly recommended

Saigon in four hours - The XO tour has been one of the best experiences that I have had in Vietnam.

Firstly, the staff are very friendly and make a genuine effort to get to know you as you drive around Saigon. The ice is broken quite quickly as the tour group is introduced to each other early on and participate in competitive games/food experiences throughout the tour. Tai, the tour manager makes you feel included in every conversation and encourages you to get the best experience that you can get by ensuring that you are well fed and trying new things. He even goes above and beyond to make sure that you feel safe on the bikes (he provided security personnel for me as I was holding a camera whilst on the bike).

The food is not what you would normally experience (ie it is not Pho or Banh Mi) but it is the food that the locals eat. This took me by surprise as we went to different districts around Saigon and experienced true street food. There was an array of dishes to suit different palettes which the tour guides assist in introducing you to and even help prepare the meal (ie cooking raw food/ cracking shells etc). There will also be food for the people who think that they have tried all that Vietnam has to offer (be warned, this is not for the squirmish but it is a great experience nevertheless).

The scooter rides are extremely fun and an exhilarating experience. You would think that you have experienced Saigon traffic just by walking through it, but you see it from a different perspective once you are in it.

The tour does cost $72 USD and relatively to other tours it might not seem that cheap, however it is worth every dollar for the experience. I would recommend it to anyone who visits Saigon.

Don't miss this tour. Unbelievable experience. - My husband and I have just got back from our night tour of Saigon and can't believe what I have just experienced. My husband is a very good motorbike rider however I have not been on the back of a bike since I was little as I was to scared but I wanted to give it a go. I can't explain in words how at ease Canh and Trinh made me feel and after a few moments I was at ease.
During the 3 hours we visited many districts in Saigon with all of them being different from the affluent areas to the poorer districts.
The whole way the girl explained each area in detail.
The tour includes an authentic meal including dessert and a must to try the sugar cane juice.
I can't go past saying how awesome our tour leader Tuan was with his explanation of the districts and his wonderful sense of humour.
This tour is by far the best I have ever been on and I have traveled a lot in Asia. If you want to see the real Saigon you can't miss this tour.

Saigon Special - The guys that dreamed this up are pure genius!

How to connect well to do tourists with the real Vietnam and tell the story behind it?

We did the foodies version bright English speaking young women with a support crew of blokes to anchor them and the tourists riding shotgun - great fun and a terrific experience!

Do it!
Foodie tour - This was the best tour I have ever been on! One of a kind, amazing guides with great English! I highly recommend. Food was great!

Must do! - I did the Saigon by night tour and Canh was my driver. Excellent driving Darling ☺...Sadly I did the tour on my last night and I really regret not doing it the first night. The tour gives you a great feel for the general layout of Saigon. I most definitely would have spent more time out of district 1 if I had known more about all of the districts. District 4 was by far my favorite , if you would like a genuine feel of Saigon and what looked like amazing street food this is the district. I have read previous reviews about a body guard accompanying the tour but I do not feel that this is accurate. The other young man that was with the tour organized the girls bikes while we were being filled in on information on the specific district we stopped in by Anh (well done Anh) Also I think he was just a spare bike if there may have been any sort of mechanical difficulty at no point in time for my entire week stay did I feel that I was not safe in Saigon. I just wanted to point that out.

Highly recommend, everything that is in previous reviews is very accurate.

Cheers Bob

Best experience of Vietnam! - What can I say about the XO Food bike tour that hasn't already been said? My 7 year old daughter and I LOVED it! We shared a motorbike with Nee (not sure of the spelling!) and she was lovely. She knew our names and never forgot them and she was so happy and proud to have our daughter on her bike, all the other girls wanted her too! She pointed out all the cute and interesting things for my daughter to see and made up little games while we were riding.
The tour was SO organised. They had body guards to mind the group and there was sightseeing as well as food. The food was lovely - I had tried so many new things!
I would love to do this tour again :)

Best fun. Very professional team - Absolutely wonderful. Best value for money. Cannot fault this tour. Great immersion in daily Vietnamese life in the streets. Also visits great attractions. Trang was my rider and Thai the leader. I will do this tour again next visit. The Best experience after seeing 14 countries!

The sights tour - We've just completed the 1/2 day sights tour with our wonderful guide Tien. We had 2 female guides who drove us on their motorcycles and 2 male guides that would meet us at the various sights to give us the tour of the sights. The only way to really experience Saigon is on the back of a motorcycle. Our 6 year old daughter rode with myself and Tien and absolutely loved it! The girls are very good and safe riders. A very memorable day - Thankyou XO tours.

Best Tour I have been on in Vietnam - I had the most amazing time on this tour. It was my last night in Ho Chi Minh and I wanted to see as much of the city as possible. We visited so many districts giving us a real insight to the diversity of HCMC. The drivers were safe, informative and great fun to hang out with. The tour guide was hilarious, warm and so relatable. We also had security guards follow us around all night so we were in good hands. I did the foodie tour which was incredible seeing all the sights and eating the real local dishes! All you can eat and drink makes it well worth the money. So much seafood, so many laughs I will definitely do this tour again!

Hang on to your hats! - My husband and I did a half day tour with Sang as our tour guide and Trang and Ngoc as our fearless motorcyclists navigating the city!! They were bang on time to pick us up and we had an interesting and enjoyable day with lots of laughter. I really can't recommend them highly enough. We also did the XO 'foodie tour' the next day and had lots of lovely food interspersed with seeing a few different areas in the city. Khoi was our guide and we had Trang and Quynh to drive us safely through all of HCMC's motorcycle madness! They try to give you a slightly different experience to what you get with other tours and it was a pleasure.

Girls on Bikes! - What a great experience. We booked XO Tours before we arrived in Saigon. We were picked up at our hotel by two great Vietnamese ladies on bikes. We enjoyed lots of sights in this busy city, and felt completely safe at all times. A must do on your trip and very informative. Thanks for a great 3 + hours on bikes!

Motorbike tours - On arrival Saigon was both exhilarating & intimidating with the volume of motorbikes and we wandered how best to get a whistle stop tour as we were only there for 3 nights. My friend found XO tours before we left the UK. They responded immediately to our email query and we had a day tour set up for the next day. The female drivers are excellent we felt safe and saw everything from local markets to the old post office's amazing building. They pretty much do what you want especially if you are the only ones in the party at that time. We loved it so much we did the night tour the same evening. The night tour included food stops where we sample local foods. Both tours were excellent value for money. Apart from the riders there was a guide giving us local history as well as taking photographs which were emailed later. A truly fantastic experience. Wear comfortable clothes and sunscreen as you're pretty much exposed for long periods. They pick you up from and drop you off at your hotel.

Excellent Tour! - Was the best tour ever we were on the food tour last night (13/8/16) if your heading to Ho Chi Minh book in a tour. The girls were so lovely you felt safe the whole tour, Tinh (pronounced Ten) was great so were the other four girls. There were x5 in our group including our 13 and 17yr old girls and they loved it now they're asking for a moped! We went to 3 different food places if your into seafood crab claws prawns clams this is the tour for you, there was also a bit of sight seeing in between good way of getting around Saigon and learning about the different districts. Would highly recommend you won't be disappointed! Thank you ladies next time we return to Vietnam,we will bring the rest of our family with us :)

Brilliant tour - Loved this tour. Felt completely safe on the back of the moped & loved seeing the sites. Got to try some Vietnamese desserts and drinks along the way which was a nice surprise. Highly recommend.

Amazing tour - I booked the night foodie tour & the sight seeing tour, they were the best, the food one was excellent tried so many different dishes & all types of food the different locations, the sight seeing one was just as good, they have a lot of information to tell you about Ho Chi Minh & its history, the ladies of XO were so friendly & they couldn't do enough for you, you are very well taken care of, I felt very safe & its a great way to see Ho Chi Minh, if you are looking for a bike tour this is the one to book, thank you XO tours for a wonderful experience, it did rain but they supplied ponchos so you kept dry, 10/10 from me

Foodie Tour - We went on the Foodie Tour last night with XO Tours. It was so much fun! Such a well organized tour with wonderful guides/drivers who made you feel so safe driving through the crazy HCM traffic. It was exhilarating!

Our lovely drivers Thao and Tam were so funny and helpful and amazing drivers. The food was delicious (including the frog) and so much of it! The tour guide Hiew was extremely knowledgable of the whole area. You get to see parts of HCM you would never normally visit as a tourist. You visit 5 districts outside of 1 and eat food with the locals so get a real taste of Vietnam!

I would highly recommend this tour and company to anyone and would definitely do it again! Thank you XO.

Great tour! You cannot see Saigon without it - Amazing experience and amazing informative guide and rider. Thu was the best guide I had on this trip, and really got me into understanding this city and its people. Good local food

Amazing Experience. Amazing Ladies. You have to do this tour! - It rained… a lot… but you know what I would do this trip again with the ladies of XO in an instant, even in torrential rain.

We took the night tour as a Lonely Planet inspired choice and they were not wrong. It might seem a little on the pricey side compared to some other tours you see, but it's worth every Dong, Cent, minute of your time. The experience you get from this trip is truly wonderful and is something I will remember as a highlight of my time in Vietnam.

Booking is quick and simple via their website and the communication from the admin team is first class. Rain delayed departure but they let us know by phone and email. However it didn't matter because these ladies came prepared for the rain with wet weather gear for us. We were greeted by Vi and Linh at our hotel, giving our safety briefing before they whisked us through rush hour traffic to meet the rest of the group and the tour leader.

Nervous about riding pillion, the thought of rush hour traffic coming from every direction terrify you? Don't let it go; These skillful ladies have it covered and made quick work of getting us from District 1 to District 5 to meet the rest of our party (all two of them!) and Sang the tour leader.

The night tour is completely off the beaten track, not a tourist attraction in sight. We were given a knowledge downloaded by Sang at each stop along the way. Also the girls are constantly talking to you about the areas you're traveling through pointing out the local sites.

You get several stops along the way including one for dinner where you can eat some great local food, beer, sugar cane juice and chat away your companions for evening, oh and even get a Vietnamese lesson (there was a lot of laughing at my pronunciation and I'm not sure what I was really saying). Not only are the team great guides but their English skills are superb, these are well educated young women who have a real desire to share their knowledge and experience of life in Vietnam and learn about you.

Vietnam is a real enigma at the moment and Ho Chi Minh is a real microcosm of this, on the trip you see the ultra-modern, clean district 7 which is reminiscent of Singapore or Seoul, with hardly a bike in sight and then reality of life on the streets in district 4, with some great desert.

The entire evening was amazing, not at all rushed and the team went out of their way to make sure we had fun and learned about real Vietnam. We felt completely safe at all times, both on and off the bikes and they even have their own security team to keep an eye on things when you're stopped.

I had a blast, I'd love to do it again, next time let's try the foodie :) Vi, Linh, Sang many thanks for an amazing experience to end our trip in Vietnam. Hope to see you again….

Mark & ​​Alex

Brilliant way to see the city! - We had a great time visiting the sights of Ho Chi Minh city on bikes with XO Tours. Our children, ages 14 and 9 thoroughly enjoyed the experience too. The girls were safe drivers and were lovely to talk to. We were also met with their guide who briefed us about the sights. Highly recommended!

Awesome way to explore HCMC - The best way to explore the city. Smart young women will drive you around on their bikes and show you some parts of the city which will allow you to get the real feel of the bustling city that HCMC is. Absolutely recommended.

Faultless! A must-do!! - My friend and I (25 and 30 yr old) did the Foodie Tour on Aug 7th and it was absolutely excellent! Our drivers were so warm, friendly and fun, plus they were v.skilled drivers. Sang and Anh, the tour leader guys, were really charming/funny and so knowledgeable about Saigon. Food was just wonderful/authentic (eat as little or as much as you want!) and there's a few cool surprises along the way. Our guide took pictures on their camera for us, and sent us the Dropbox link 2 days later with a lovely personal email. No complaints here. Have fun, and remember to tip your driver!

Unique and delicious experience - My boyfriend and I decided to do this tour due to a recommendation from my best friend. On our first day in Ho Chi Minh and observing how crazy the traffic is, I began to become apprehensive about being on a scooter myself. However, the girls are so professional and explain how to manoeuvre on and off the scooter. Whizzing around the streets was amazing and is a super way of seeing various districts that we wouldn't have seen otherwise! The whole team are fab, good fun and the food/drink is amazing. Also a great bonus....as much food/drink as you like. Fantastic quantity and quality. Thanks so much to the whole team for their hard work and I would 100% recommend this trip!!

Wow, So Much Food - No need to eat lunch before doing this tour with so much amazing food. The guide is great and you get to cover some good spots around town (5 districts in total). The driver girls speak reasonable English and are very bubbly and make for good conversation when riding around town. Always feel safe on the back of the scooter. The girls also do a good job of keeping you full of food and topped up with beer at each food stop. Highly recommended tour and worth every penny.

XO food tour - My girlfriend and I did the XO food tour tour around the districts of HCMC. It was a great experience. The tour guides were excellent. They were extremely friendly and fun. The food was great, and there was plenty of it. Definitely worth checking out.

Great Experience - We went on XO Foodie Tour. Pretty Guides (Tien 2 & Trang) picked us (me & my hubby) up from our hotel located at District 1. The ladies speak English pretty well. They have all ladies bikers picking guests from hotels to the first dining location. There our main male tour guide (Tai) for the night starts to intro everyone, including himself. He has great memory! Remembering each & everyone of our name & which country we are from. Thru out the night, he will share with us on the little story/history of the places we visit. We get to sample (unlimited) local noodle, BBQ meat, seafood inclusive of beer & drinks too. All the female guides even BBQ meat & deshell seafood for us. We just need to focus on feeding our stomach :D Highly recommend this tour!
Saigon by night - Informative and very fun. Seeing the contrasts between different districts gave us real insight into Vietnamese culture and the food and information was excellent!

So little food - I did the Foodie tour during a short stay in Saigon when I was feeling particularly hungry. They take you around the city on bikes and you get to see some parts of the city you wouldn't have necessarily ventured out to otherwise. All the food was amazing, especially the seafood - scallops and crabs were the highlight of the tour. The girls are very fun and provide helpful commentary about the dishes as well as the city. That said, I did a walking food tour in Hanoi for a quarter of the price of this tour, and I can't say that it was that much better, but you are going to realize that most things in Saigon are a lot more expensive. The tour leader took some pictures for us and shared them a few days later - a nice touch. Overall, I had a great time, and even though I though it was a little pricey I would definitely recommend it.

BOOK THIS TOUR - Holy smokes what a fantastic tour. The girls were so nice, punctual and a blast to hangout with. We had a large group of 17 and all the girls were awesome as well as Tai our tour manager. I could go on and on and on about the fantastic tour we had with them. Fun energetic youthful group that shows you things you wouldn't see if you were touring the city on your own or even with another tour group. I do a ton of tours each year and this is in my favorite one. Book now do not hesitate. We did the night food tour but if I go back to Saigon I will do it all over again and book all the rest of the tours too. Keep up the fantastic work XO!

A must-do!! - We did the XO Foodie tour and got a lot more than expected! Had lots of fun with the girls and the group we were with. The guides made it very unique and the effort that was put into the tour definitely showed! An experience that takes you ALL around Saigon and makes you try ALL types of local dishes just like a local. We can't recommend this tour enough! Thank you to Tam and Chan, our scooter guides, and Thao our tour manager!

Awesome experience! - Just did a tour last night and am so glad I did! Would not have seen nearly as much of the city as I did! Great food and great company too :)

Ngoc was my guide and she was so lovely and personable. I feel so safe with her driving too (despite my nervousness about going on the bike). She (and the rest of the staff) really made sure I was having a great time :)

Thanks again!

What a great way to see Ho Chi Minh City, enjoy it's cuisine, and meet local people - This tour came highly recommended from a few sets of friends that had done the tour previously. We signed up for it on our first night in Vietnam and it was a great introduction to the cuisine and to the people. Ho Chi Minh City is so full of cars, motor bikes, and people that it's hard to get around the city on your own, it was great to have the assistance of XO Tours. I felt completely safe zipping around the city with my guide on her motor bike. She was an excellent driver and taught me so much throughout our drives. I am vegetarian and the XO staff were unbelievably accommodating. I was served so many of my own delicious dishes. This night was probably the best I ate the entire three weeks I was in Vietnam. We played fun games, ate lots of yummy food, the company was great and we learned so much about Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam and the cuisine. This tour is worth every penny!
Foodie bike tour - I can't recommend this tour highly enough. It was a unique and fun experience that was also informative. They even emailed us specific photos of our evening a few days later!

The sights tour - Wife and I did the tour. Basically the setup is you sit on the back of the scooter, and a guide drives. You are not allowed to drive the scooter. All the guides are female. At each stop there is a seperate main guide who does the talking. The girl who drove my scooter was very friendly and we chatted as she drove between sights. It was like having your own personal guide between stops. She also gave me tips for her favourite coffee spots, restaurants and it was a good insight into the life of a local.

Somethings you stop and walk around and others you drive through and they will tell you where you are, whats going on etc.

I thought it was a good way to get off the tourist track and see the city. We went to alot of other districts as well ticking off a bunch of the main tourist sights.

The tour includes some desert style snacks at a market, water and a drink. They were all tasty. You are picked up and dropped off on the scooter at the end of the day.

I thought it seemed a little pricey prior to the tour, but I couldnt really fault it and it was a pretty good experience.

XO Tours - A Must Do in HCMC - We had a fantastic time on the "Saigon By Night" tour. It is the perfect opportunity to see some lovely parts of the city and to experience the best mode of transport. The tour guides/drivers are very kind and informative and they are pros at navigating the bustling Saigon streetscape. See where the locals spend their free time and get some great street food. We can't say enough good things about this tour and look forward to trying one of the others that XO has on offer when we are in HCMC again.

Brilliant food and city tour - Had a great time doing this tour, guides picked us up and dropped us off at our hotel, food was excellent- got to try loads of different things, guides were very nice, friendly, and good fun. Visited a number of different districts and was given interesting info at each location. Highly recommended.

Best tour ever - Don't look past this tour. The tour guides are knowledgeable, very friendly and a whole lot of fun. The experience was brilliant. Touring through Saigon at night, we visited 5 different districts. There was time to stop and hear about life in Saigon and each district. We got to try a variety of tasty new foods, which were cooked to perfection. This was the best tour I've experienced overseas. I've travelled extensively. Thanks team for a very memorable night. Special thanks to Lein.

The highlight of our holiday - Totally un-expected this fantastic night out.
So well thought out and organized. The staff were all amazing, spoke fluent English and are all university educated. Apart from that, truly lovely people.
The locations we visited and explanations of the background and history of the area were incredible.
Not to mention the local food - we were treated like royalty and were very safe.
Thanks guys, well done.

Best trip ever - What can I say...just super fun. We went on the Saigon by night tour.

My wife and I were picked up by Linh and Ngan (6) and greeted warmly. Their English was brilliant too which was great. We drove through some districts and then met Tuan who helped us buy items from a locks street vendor and also ordered us some amazing Vietnamese food from a local BBQ type of place that the locals use.

My wife and I were a little nervous being on the back of a scooter especially in the madness of Ho Chi Ming but I can honestly say we felt completely at ease and relaxed. I asked permission to take my phone out for a video and she didn't mind although she did advise at the start that it wouldn't be the best idea (I wanted a little souvenir video).

We saw lots of different places that normally tourists don't see and also told us some very interesting facts about the place. The two girls were really friendly and talkative, even on the bikes we discussed Justin Bieber and Adele and various other things.

The food were ate was lovely and the desserts too were delicious. This might be one of the best type of tours I have ever been on and I've been all over the world on various tours here and there. For only $45 each or 1,000,000 dong you can't go wrong especially with all dinner etc being included.

Thank you all for such an amazing tour and thank you to all on trip advisor for recommending it.

Good food and great way to see the city - The foodie tour was great - sampling loads of traditional Vietnamese dishes and you also get to see lots of different Districts of HCMC. The girls driving you round are lovely and very chatty - and being on the back of the bike is a really fun way to experience the city.

The tours are very well run, there are loads of 'tour guides' available to answer questions on food, history and culture. It's a 5 hour tour which we thought would be long, but it flies by and you feel like you've seen a different side to the city from just the tourist areas of District 1, and you're so full from all the delicious food! We would definitely recommend this!

WOW! An extraordinary adventure! - We took the "foodie tour" on motorbikes and it was one of the most exhilarating and fun experiences I've ever had. The food was varied and great, too....but it was hard to top for sheer excitement darting about on the back of our Honda scooters in what I can best describe as a moving, chaotic swarm of similar commuters, all of whom have instinctively learned to avoid collisions. Nothing short of miraculous! My driver/guide was a beautiful, charming, highly-educated Vietnamese lady who kept up a running conversation with me as we darted about, pointing out everything of interest and answering all of my questions in great English. She sat next to me at our various eating venues, pointing out which sauce to dip which offering into, peeling my shrimp and opening the eggs with the eatable chicken embryos. I've never had service so fine! Traveling with us was a team of "men in black" who watched out for our safety and helped us get on and off our motorbikes. This was an exceedingly organized and well-managed effort in all respects! Our contingencies of fellow riders included South Koreans, Brits, Japanese and Kiwis. I was the only American. We quickly bonded and had an absolutely fabulous time together tasting all of the exotic fare that was so carefully prepared for us. We also got to see Districts in Saigon that most tourists rarely visit. My favorite was Chinatown where we rode down narrow aisles separating all of the various wholesale food vendors. Another plus with the "foodie" tour is that you take it at night when it's relatively cool. I understand there are quite a few "knock off" companies who are trying to imitate XO, but don't be conned into using them because they are cheaper. Go with the best and you will not be disappointed!

Amazing Tour! - If you're in Ho Chi Mingh at all, definitely book a tour with XO tours! My husband and I had a tour of some of the districts of the city, places we wouldn't have seen if we were touring on our own.

Our guides were amazing; the two women who drove us around on their scooters (Linh and Ngan 6) spoke brilliant English and made us feel so safe (if you know about the traffic here then you'll understand why we were a little apprehensive to begin with!). Each time we made a stop, we met with another guide, Tuan Nguyen, who again spoke fantastic English and was extremely helpful and funny!
