He took photos of us and will send these via email a few days later.

Included in the package was a dinner ... we stopped at a traditional Vietnamese diner and ate delicious local food.

The views we saw on the back of the scooters were amazing: some parts were eye openers (the poorer parts) and others were just unreal (some of the buildings in the newer district 7).

I couldn't recommend the company more. We were also given a phrase book and keyring as gifts! Cam on (thank you) XO tours! 😀

Just do it! - My wife was not keen on this Vespa tour of Saigon with food but we went ahead (2 adults and 16 year old son) and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. We felt very safe with our careful, experienced drivers. The tour is exciting and the drivers give a real insight into modern Saigon life. The food, as usual in Vietnam, is delicious. Highly recommended.

best night in Saigon! - YOU NEED TO DO THIS! This was an incredible 'foodie' tour! Brilliant for all ages - friends, families or couples - even people travelling solo as you'll meet some fantastic people. We booked this on our first night in Saigon and it was the best way to discover the delights of Vietnamese food and get an insight into the city too.
When you first arrive in Saigon you will see hundreds of motorbikes which might make you pretty nervous about doing this tour but don't worry - they are much safer than they look! The girls are brilliant drivers and navigators and will make you feel very safe at all times. It was great fun experiencing what most Vietnamese people experience on a daily basis in terms of riding the roads on bikes.
It's an amazing way to see the city too as you go to lots of different districts and as you're riding you will get a bit of a tour as they are explaining everything you can see while you're on the bikes. All the guides speak brilliant English and they all seem to LOVE doing their job. They are always smiling and you can have a great laugh with them.

They stop at loads of different locations which means you get to try all sorts of food. If you like something in particular too you can ask for more. We tried some incredibly tasty food and enjoyed a few beers too. It's great fun joining other people on the tour too - everyone has a great laugh and they might even create a couple of games to play. We had a very funny situation of trying to put peanuts into a bottle using chopsticks within a set time and the forfeit was hilarious! *no spoilers!* Let's just say, I'm glad the boys lost!

The whole experience was out of this world. Definitely one of the best things we did in Vietnam and I would do it again if ever we ventured that way in the future.

Don't think twice! Book it!

XO love and kisses - This is, hands down is the best night we have had so far in HCM city. From the very start with these gorgeous girls picking us up from our hotel and taking us to the first resturant where we met 4 other guests and the fabulous tour leader Tran Nguyen. Travelling through 5 districts to eating places where the 'locals' go on the back of motor bikes was the most amazing experience. We tasted many different foods, went through China town market place, travelled in pouring rain, had lots and lots of laughs and we delivered back to our hotel safe and sound. Thanks to XO tours...we will be recommending this experience highly

Dont' leave Saigon without doing a tour iwth XO - We did the street food tour - all I can say is AMAZING!. The staff were so professional and knowledgeable. We saw so much of city and experienced little off the beaten track places, that you would not normally get to in a car. The right mix of food and site seeing. Do yourself a favor and book a tour with XO!

If you only do one tour in Saigon, pick this one - This was the absolute highlight of HCMC for us. Our delightful guides all spoke English and really made the effort to share information. It was a little scary at first being on the back of a scooter, but our guides drove very carefully and the escorts who came along on the trip provided a little buffer.

The tour covered several districts, many of which we would not have ventured to otherwise, and Anh provided a great deal of interesting information at the stops.

The food choices provided were amazing! Grilled goat, quail, frog, scallops with peanuts, okra, prawns, etc, etc. And all of it was delicious and fresh.

The best tour ever!

Thank you to our special guides Ngoc, Trang, Quynh, and Nhat!

Tip: wear comfortable clothes both for the scooter ride and also as some of the chairs are low

great fun - This was the best activity I did for my whole holiday. We were greeted by three gorgeous and very experienced female motorbike rider. We rode in the hustle and bustle of HCM, what an experience. They also had other staff on hand to ensure our safety and make sure that all our requests were met. Along the tour we stopped at many Districts and gave and insight into the area, which was quite informative & interesting. The food, well what can I say. It was the best and if you wanted more you just asked as they are not shy to order more. The girls cooked , peeled and showed you how to eat it if not sure. Don't be afraid, there are no weird foods if you do not want to try. However if you are adventurous,go for it. Yes it may be pricey, but it was the best money I spent, Where can you get an informative, safe and very well run tour in places you wouldn't think of traveling too with unbelievable food & drink along the way. Go for it you will not be disappointed. This was the highlight of our trip. No matter how old you are

Awesome driving skills! - On our trip, HCMC was our first city and first time in Vietnam. One of the things I noticed was that there were motor bikes everywhere, it looked incredibly chaotic at first. It seemed unreasonable to just hop on a bike and go to see what's it's like to cruise around on one. Enter XO Tours. They picked you up from your hotel on a motor bike, speak English very well and answer any questions you may have. They also have a great sense of humor too. Touring the city on the back of a motor was definitely a thrill; zipping through alley ways, in packs of other motor bikes. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone going to HCMC. I wish they had this tour for all the major cities we visited in Vietnam.

Side note: there were plenty of people there that would taxi you to different spots on a motor bike but I don't think that was the experience I was going for. Taxi normally takes you to point A to point B; no humor, cold beverages, information about the place you're visiting, and so on.

You must do this tour! - We did the Foodie Tour back in June and it was outstanding! Can't rate it highly enough. The guys in our group were a bit worried about having lady scooter drivers (especially when one of them rode a bike for a living) but they were extremely impressed. The tour takes you on a journey through the back streets of Saigon and in amongst the crazy traffic. We feel like locals! The food was amazing, I recommend that you don't eat to much before the tour because you will be stuffed full by the end of it. Our guides were super friendly, funny and all spoke great English. This tour is one of the most memorable Asian experiences I have had. Will definitely do it again. Massive THANKS to our whole crew...Nhat, Thao 3, Phuong, Ngoc 2, Binh3, Quynh 3, Nghia, Deim, Khoi, Binh and Minh (Hope I got that right)

Surprisingly Great! - I came into the foodie tour with no expectations but was pleasantly blown away with how great it was! The drivers spoke perfect English with great conversation skills and were very witty. The food was great, but it was the overall experience that made it incredible.

A must! - Have no fear! These girls know what they are doing. They are bright, funny and above all else are skilled on their bikes. Having never before been on a bike I had a little trepidation but was put at ease immediately. This is so much fun! Hilarious pulling up at lights with the locals having a giggle and a chat. This is a very successful company. Tai went out of his way to accommodate my fussiness with certain foods, he made sure they were a substitute for me. It's a great way to see the city.
Thoroughly recommend it.

An Absolute Must!! - This was by far the coolest thing I did in HMC, a guided motorbike tour of several districts with food stops in each. The moto drivers are absolutely amazing and the tour guide Tai was also so good! Highly highly recommend!

Lovely night riding around Ho Chi Minh - We spent a lovely evening riding with XO tours around parts of Ho Chi Minh city. The guides were lovely. Funny, knowledgeable and very helpful. Would recommend to anyone wanting to see the less touristy parts.

Great way to start a trip - Arrived in Ho Chi Minh at 2.30pm and was picked up by XO at 5.30 pm. My lovely driver quickly got me on the back of the bike and hit the streets. Nothing really prepares you for traffic in Saigon but it was scary and exhilarating at the same time. My driver expertly weaved in and out off tight spots all the while pointing certain sights and information. We soon joined the rest of the group for an intro of what was to come and had our fist course of the evening. The rest of the night saw us 4 eateries all differing in taste. The food was fantastic and our hosts looked after us all extremely well.
The tour finished around 10.30pm and I was dropped off back at my hotel.
What a way to start my first trip to Vietnam. XO certainly lived up to their reputation and I will definitely go on another one of their tours.
Thanks for a great night.

Great fun - We did the Saigon by night tour. It's expensive at $45 a person but we had a lot of fun and saw parts of the city that would otherwise not be accessible. The girls were lovely, very informative and very funny. They were particularly good with my teenage son. We were taken to the Chinese district and walked around the market and encouraged to buy something to test out our Vietnamese. That part felt a bit like we were being treated like children We ate street food -
There wasn't a great deal of it and it felt a bit rushed but it was all very tasty and there was quite a good choice. We then went and had two portions of creme caramel type of desert. When it rained they had ponchos for us and if we needed anything they were happy to provide it or stop.
A really good thing to do and thoroughly recommended.

Attractive - My name is Alfie and my mum booked this tour for me my mum and brother.

We met the hosts/bike drivers at the opera house. They came and gave us a warm welcome and taught us how to get on the bike and how to sit on it properly.

The staff were very kind and helpful they were great with my younger 3year old brother, Rex.

When we were on the bikes and seeing the sights there were camera men behind us videoing it all, they were very kind as well.they are going to Email the video to my mum once it has been edited and improved.

They showed us around at an array of different attractions and locations such as:
China town,
A local food market (were we tried some home made yogurt and caramel creme)
The cathedral,
The post office(designed by Gustave Eiffel)
The re-unification palace
A religious temple
And a few religious/famous/historical statues.

To sum it up, it was an amazing tour/experience.i defiantly recommend it worth the money. If you take your children on this tour i can guarantee you that they will enjoy it. i had sooooo much fun.

Really fun foodie tour - We took the foodie tour and had a really great time. The food was delicious and the drivers were all very fun and personable.

It is a pricey tour, but in my opinion good value for money. The humour was also a little bit dry/awkward, but all in all a very interesting tour which I would recommend.

Family fun well went after - A great evening on the Saigon by night tour, with super guides.

Apprehensive teens made to feel relaxed immediately on the mopeds as we saw a multitude of different districts, ate some fine food in fabulous environment and were treated to a tour to remember.

The female guides we excellent, great English and non stop information. Even the rain at the end didn't dampen enthusiasm.

TripAdvisor is right, great tour and tour company...do it !!

What a superb way to see the city - Thoroughly recommend this tour. A great way to see parts of the city that you wouldn't ordinarily venture to. Great stops for street food and desert ( would suggest a decent toilet stop. The drivers and tour guide were excellent. One of our bikes broke down but they sent a replacement very quickly. They also stopped and walked us back to the market that we drove to as I wanted to take photographs. They took some photos of the tour and emailed them to us later.

It was good to learn the history of the spots you visited - I went on this tour after I spent the day on the back of a locals motorbike with him taking me around to the sights. The loal was much cheaper and quite chilled out as he will go wherever you want to go. The XO tour was well run, you go to the main sights and learn about each spot. 3 hours is a good amount of time as it doesn't take your full day. I had a good time, but if you are happy grabbing a local motorbike taxi you will see the same things and save the $$

Had a very good time. Guides speak English well. - I booked an XO tour after finding them on Tripadvisor. The guides were great and safe. I took my 78 year old mother on the tour and they took care of her well. It was a good experience to see the city and travel like locals on a motor bike.

Amazing! A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - Best Tour ever. Lady's and guide speak excellent English. We did learn more about Vietnamese culture in 3 hours then the 3 weeks ago. You feel completely safe on the bike with these skilled drivers!

Fantastic day! - Did the City Sights tour with my 70 yr old mother, her best friend and my 2 children aged 14 and 10. We all absolutely loved it! Felt very safe, our guide, Khoi, was great and the ladies were all so friendly. Having each driver turn in to our personal guides for each stop was especially appreciated. One of the highlights of our trip!

Food Tour Was Special - We compared several tours throughout Ho Chi Minh, and we agreed this looked the best and the reviews looked outstanding. We were not disappointed! The tour was sensational; we tried the most interesting yet delicious food that we would have not sampled on our trip if it wasn't for XO tours. The girls were very safe drivers and they also had a great sense of humour. I feel very safe. On our first day we completed a tour to the Chi Chi tunnels which was great, however this tour allowed us to see all the city including a variety of districts from china town to district 7. We couldn't of asked for better tour guides. We had so much fun! It was the best part of our trip!!

XO Foodie Tour - Awesome!

I highly recommend it!
We visited about 5 different restaurants, Great food, beautiful girls!
Lots of Beer!
Make sure you take the video option!

A great local experience you can't miss! - I was on a business trip in Saigon and only had a couple of hours to spend one evening...I am so glad I chose xo tours' Night Tour. It was a unique and fun experience, taking the motorbikes and having my personal tour guide (I was asking questions throughout the tour). Instead of just staying in the more high-end district 1 and 3, I could go to the districts where common Vietnamese live, play, shop and eat. The food options provided were very tasty, the people are the most hospitable and friendly. Special mentions to Khoi Nguyen, the tour leader as well as my female companion (I forgot her name, but she's the 'racer' with a mother whose a Japanese cuisine chef)

Street Food Tour - We stayed in Vietnam for two weeks, one week in Hoi An and one week in Ho Chi Minh City and I have to say, we all agreed that this tour was the highlight!! The staff first and foremost were nothing short of AMAZING, they were so friendly, funny and just a pleasure to spend time with. They loved their jobs and it showed in their attitude. The places we went to, the food, the feeling we had from start to finish was simply amazing. Well done to the staff who really took an interest in our welfare and ensure we had fun! For someone who doesn't eat a lot of seafood they made sure that I had an alternative dish that I just loved each and every time. A must do when in Vietnam!!!!!!!!

Amazing foodie tour!! - Wow this has to be one of the best organized tours around with the most amazing staff! My guide for this fun filled adventure was Ahn and she was such a beautiful lady... I felt safe at all times and the sights we got to see along the way were awesome but the food we got to eat was outstanding and our guides had a way of encouraging us to try all the food on offer!! I even got game enough to try jumping kfc (frog) which does actually taste like chicken.
Thank you to all the XO staff you certainly are the best at your job!! We have great memories to take with us!!!!

Excellent tour - XO tours are very slick and professional while still giving a fun experience. The communication and booking by email was prompt and easy. We had done the tour 4 years ago and were interested to see what it was like repeating it. It maintains the quality visited and many the same locations. The drivers were very good, skillful and communicative.

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City - Bottom line just book this tour. We had a blast and enjoyed getting an overview of the city. The drivers were safe and courteous.

Also the video crew is a good addition and we love showing the video to our friends and family.

Just book this tour.

Saigon by Night - incredible! - I have literally just got back from the Saigon by Night tour and couldn't speak more highly of it. My driver, Tam, was lovely and spoke to me for the whole of the journey, pointing out particular places of interest; and the tour guide, Tuan, was equally as amazing - he was professional, informative and very nice. The content of the tour is also very good - they take you to a variety of districts, so you get to see a lot of different sights and get a feel for how people live in the city. You also eat along the way (which is always a plus!) They are very good at catering for dietary requirements - I don't eat egg or dairy and they catered for that with ease. I would really recommend this tour for other solo travelers, the staff are so friendly and whenever you stop to eat etc. you eat all together as a group so you don't feel alone at all! :) I was very lucky as there was only me and one other guy on my tour, so we had four members of staff all to ourselves. Couldn't recommend this tour more highly! All of these 5 star reviews aren't for nothing!

Success! - What a find this XO City Tour turned out to be. Perfect mix between bike time and tour information. Experienced, skillful female drivers wound their way through the streets of Saigon. Great way to get an overview of the city. Well organized and punctual. Interesting facts provided about some of the more historical sites. Great snack foods at market stalls. Cheerful and friendly. This tour came highly recommended and I was not disappointed. I loved every minute of it.

Om tour of Ho Chi Minh City bus with great women drivers - This tour came highly recommended by experienced visitors to Ho Chi Minh City. My friend and I did the day City tour. The drivers are all women, very professional and friendly and excellent drivers, and tour guide Tai Dang gives good information. The group is kept small so plenty of opportunities to ask questions. The sites are well-chosen, with entertaining refreshment stops, you get to see a lot of different parts of the city and hear some very interesting stories. Thanks very much to my excellent driver Trang.

Fantastic Experience - Took an evening tour on the back of a scooter. Fantastic experience; saw Saigon from a different perspective with a very friendly, knowledgable and good English speaking rider/host. Stopped at various places to eat (and drink) local delicacies which added to the experience. Information provided by an excellent tour guide at a number of prearranged rendevous. I must say when I first heard of the tour I was a little nervous, bur in reality it was one of the highlights of my trip.

Highly Recommended - We were recommended this tour of HCMC with XO tours and really want to pass on this recommendation.

We booked the tour ahead of our stay for 3 of the family (including our 15 year old daughter).

We chose the day sight seeing tour and booked it for the first morning after we arrived. This turned out to be a great idea as it provided a wonderful introduction to life in the City and an idea of ​​the layout of the City (as the tour covers several of the districts.)

The company was professional from the original booking (quick response) and to be ready promptly at our hotel on the morning of the tour to provide an introduction to the bikes. The girls were charming and very reassuring and our tour leader (Tuan) was very knowledgeable. We also booked the photographer/ video who took care of the photographs so that we could concentrate on the tour!

We highly recommend this tour which gave us a wonderful insight into the city. It is especially good if you have teenagers in your family/group.

Be prepared for the experience of riding through the morning chaotic traffic but the girls ability on the bikes makes you feel very confident.

I am only sorry that we didn't have time to go on the foodies night tour

Just Do It! - We were picked up from hotel, given instructions then on we hopped and were off. The girls were so friendly and made us feel safe and comfortable. All the time chatting to us on bikes or at food stops giving us information about HCMC. Anh the manager for the night was informative, funny and interesting to listen to. Thu, Tam 1 & 2 & Hung (apologies for spelling) helped make the night so fun. Crazy, cheeky, fun yet incredibly proud of their country to share with us. Enjoyed all of it. Felt safe at all times. Thank you.

A must! - We found all here with this tour around Saigon. Guide was so informative answering our many questions. We visited some famous sites before joining street food tour. Great overview of Saigon with delicious food. Amazing trip!

Our Highlight in HCM with 2 Kids 8 and 12 years old. - On the day before the scooter tour, we did a private day tour in a van and went to see some of the historical landmarks. It was interesting for the adults but not so much for the children. The kids weren't keen on another tour in case it was boring but after experiencing the Saigon By Night tour, they were keen to do another motorbike tour at our last destination in Hanoi.

My husband and daughters were quite nervous at first as they hadn't done it before, but after the first ride to our first stop, they were fully relaxed with their confident drivers. We went to different off the track tourist locations and also sampled different local foods which we all enjoyed.

We also took the filming option which took the hassle out of taking our own video footage. We are looking forward to receiving our video files.

Well done to our drivers Ngoc, Tam1, Huong 2, and Thuy and tour leader Hieu Nguyen who gave us some great insight into life in Ho Chi Minh City.

Super fun tour! - XO Tours is great if you'd prefer a small group tour instead of the regular bus tours. Staff were really friendly and the Saigon by Night tour brought you to places you wouldn't see on any other regular tours - it brought us outside District 1! Plus, riding on the motorbike in HCMC is an amazing experience. I would recommend this to EVERYONE.

Gotta Do!!! - We arrived at lunchtime and had pre booked our XO foodie tour...it was FANTASTIC! Not only did we get 4+ hours of touring and food stops, the girls who drove us around were fun and informative! They talked , laughed and fed us...while answering questions and giving us a great intro to HCMC!! Worth every penny!!! Gotta do it!!
Can I give 6 stars? - Loved, loved, loved it. Incredible way to see HCMC by night. We did the foodie tour and everything about it was fabulous. The food, the guides, the tour. Definitely a must do.

Another brilliant xo trip - We did the xo foodie tour without our children in 2014, and knew without a doubt that this would be great. This time we did the Saigon by Night tour and we all loved it. Our children (6 year old and an anxious 11year old) were thrilled and felt safe and valued by the xo tour girls. The food on this tour was also great, and plenty too! We particularly enjoyed walking through the night markets where the xo tour girls were very keen to procure our daughter guava, rice snacks and other things she was interested in. If you were worried about taking your children on scooters in Saigon, don't be! Do it!
Best experience! - Best thing to do in Ho Chi Minh! Went through many districts and tried food in two of them. The women drivers were so lovely! Felt completely safe. So much fun!

Brilliant street food tour on the back of mopeds! - I went on the evening street food tour with my mum and my husband. It was so much fun and I highly recommend it!

I was a bit worried about putting my 69 year old mum on the back of a moped as the traffic is very busy, but our female drivers were excellent and very competent, safe drivers. They also spoke perfect English, which was a bonus as our Vietnamese is pretty awful!

We got plenty of food during the evenings tour and visited places that we would never have found/ had the confidence to try on our own. The food was tasty (apart from the fermented duck egg - blughhhh!)

You should definitely try this when in Saigon!

Exhilarating motorbike ride in Ho Chi Minh! - If you happen to be in Ho Chi Minh, don't miss the opportunity to see the city from a different angle. XO Tours allows you to be immersed in the culture in a fun and safe way as you ride on a motorbike exploring the different districts of the city. You will make a couple of stops for yummy food and conversation. The lady drivers and guides are super friendly too. Excellent tour!

Awesome food tour! - Went on the Saigon food and city tour a few days ago on a recommendation. It was so much fun! The food they introduced was very local and were types of food you don't normally get to see or try if we had just stayed in district 1. Most were delicious but all were at least interesting to try.

My cousin and I had very positive experiences with our scooter driver ladies, who were both very fun to converse with and ask more questions of about the city.

Amazing - What a wonderful way to see the real Ho Chi Minh city we visit ed for a couple of days and did this tour on our last night it was wonderful being on the back of the bikes so exciting ,these girls know how to handle the roads with care.
We stopped at lots of different places had lots of different foods which were amazing played games had so much fun would definitely do it again thank you ladies you made our night 🤗

Excellent! - Fabulous fun!We have been in South East Asia for 3 weeks now and this is one of the best things we have done. We did the Saigon by Night tour and it was fabulous. The first half of the trip was in a thunderstorm with torrential rain but it was still great. The women are a lot of fun, the guide provides some really interesting facts, the food is delicious and you get to see some really interesting districts of HCMC. Plus just being on a scooter in the middle of all that crazy traffic is really good fun. Do it!

Now I know what all the hype is about - Everything about dealing with this company was a pleasure, from the moment we made initial email contact until the end of our tour.
My wife, 5 year old daughter and i booked the morning tour. We all instantly fell in love with our guides Thu and Quien. They were charming, professional, knowledgeable and reassuring, and went out of their way to make sure that we were comfortable, safe and had an enjoyable day.They gave us a wonderful insight into their riding city and the day to day lives of the Vietnamese people.It was exhilarating through the morning traffic and we total confidence in the girls ability on the bikes.
Out tour leader Khoi was wonderful also and very knowledgeable and passionate.
It was definitely a highlight of our 3 weeks in Vietnam and i would highly recommend this tour and the company to all travelers young and old (especially families).
I am only sorry that we didn't have time to go on the foodies night tour!

Saigon by night! - Nice tour with very friendly staff!
You can tell they really want to inform and please the customers!
Still wouldn't rate this tour 5 stars since the food wasn't quite what we expected. For a 45 dollar tour I hoped to get some more food and a little less rush while eating! Looked like we were tight on scedule..hoped that we were really gonna experience the chinatown food but instead we could choose from 3 dishes which we were gonna eat somewhere else.. The desserts were really nice a part from the crushed ice on top?? Maybe you think 45 dollar is still cheap.. But wages of the staff members are 200 a month so wonder where all this money goes, since it's not going to the food nor the staff..
Loved the ladies though they where really good drivers and provided with plenty of information about Saigon! Big up for you girls!
City Tour - We had wonderful tour around Saigon. Excellent guide, good itinerary, delicious food, well-organized itinerary. Strongly recommended this for Saigon!

Must do in Saigon! - My girlfriend and I did the morning bike tour and loved it. A great way to see the city, with very friendly staff and knowledgeable guides. Would highly recommend doing this early in your stay here.

Foodie Tour was amazing! - Went on the scooter food tour the other night. Our drivers were amazing. Not once did we feel uncomfortable during the tour and our drivers loved telling us about the districts. Their English was excellent and they always made us laugh with their humour. The tour took us to a range of different areas around Ho Chi Minh and the places where we ate were genuine Vietnamese food, no westernisation or tourists (besides us) there. Food was great and the girls were always making sure you had a drink in your hand. The main guide was very funny and provided a lot of information about the history and the future of Vietnam.
We would definitely recommend this tour to someone going to Ho Chi Minh, it's worth every cent and an amazing experience!

Though expensive... Unbeatable and best quality enjoyment will be on offer for sure - Actually XO tours not only made our day, we need to say they all made our whole Saigon trip…!! the Foodie tour that we had with them was fun filled, caring, amazing unforgettable experience in our life,

The Drivers Vi and Quien are excellent, they engaged us through out the tour with very good english and their team leader Khoi Nguyen was great, overall great team work...!!

If you dont have any restriction to your food, you will for sure love all the activities in the foodie tour.. with a ride to 5 districts and few important places in ho chi minh city...!!

Once again a heartfelt thanks to all wonderful, dedicated girls & boys of XO tours…

Sights tour - Wow, what a wonderful company to deal with. Communication was very quick and on a whole they were very professional, what a great way to get an overview of a very busy city. Nang my tour guide was fantastic, I felt extremely safe throughout the trip and she was continuously checking that I was ok. I had traveled on the back of a bike before but I knew if I hadn't I still would have felt very safe. The tour leader was very knowledgeable and professional. I highly recommend using this company, you won't regret it!

Go Book Their Tours - Believe all the great reviews here. We were three ladies and they took good care of us. Saigon is known for crazy motorbike traffic but all our lady drivers were amazing. After we've adjusted, it was just fun, fun, the rest of the night.

A different side to Saigon - Everything about this tour of 5 districts was fun and memorable......food selection, venues, walks, wet markets, charm of the ladies driving, overall hospitality, safety of driving and in particular, the friendliness and good levels of English spoken, made this tour of Saigon unforgettable..high;y recommended for all ages..from 3 to 93.....

A real must - This was booked for by the wife as something to do on our last night in Ho Chi Min City, also to celebrate my mothers 60th birthday by doing something slightly different.
We went on the foodie tour, there was 4 within our group but 11 in total on the overall night tour.
We were met at the hotel, by lovely young ladies dressed in the Vietnamese outfit. Everyone was introduced and some small talk swapped, then paired of with one of the ladies that would look after us for the night.
Got on the back and off we went, as a motorbike rider and never a pillion I was unsure how I'd be especially in a busy city like this, however very relaxed even after witnessing a small bump at the traffic lights.
Stopped for a quick intro to all the group, a bowl of noodle soup, a drink and off again, took in 5 districts, saw the new and the old of HCMC, guides always chatty asking questions and answering them too.
All the food and drink you could muster was on the table if you wanted, a few games, jokes and lots of laughter.
As it was my moms birthday, they even arranged a cake with it personalized, everyone sang happy birthday, mom in tears.
Best night of our trip, and according to my parents one of the best holiday nights ever.
Thank you to all that made our night special.
Please do book this tour as well worth it.
Great loss - Lovely and friendly drivers and guide , felt like u saw the real deal different types of food and educational about culture

Highlight of our trip - Can't recommend this highly enough. We took our 8 year old and 4 year old on this and they just loved it. The ladies and tour guide are fantastic. We got to eat amazing street food and had a wonderful tour of the city at the same time. Would recommend to anyone to give this a try and the kids loved being on the bikes

Highlight of our Ho Chi Minh visit - Absolutely loved the tour! Went with my husband and 12 year old daughter last week and had a ball with the ladies. Felt totally safe on the bikes and saw so many sights over the 5 districts that we would not have seen. Not to mention food that we would not have tasted otherwise!!

The best things to do in Ho Chi Minh City - I took my sister to Ho Chi Minh City for her birthday, with my girlfriend buying her this tour as a present on a recommendation from friends.

I can honestly say this was not only the best thing we did whilst in Saigon, but the best food tour I have ever been on.
The food was awesome, the experience of being a passenger on the scooter was great fun (and felt a lot more safe than I was initially expecting), the guides were brilliant, and the fact that we experienced things we never would have seen unless we'd gone on this tour was the icing on the cake.

Speaking of cake, I mentioned in passing that we'd come to Saigon to celebrate my sister's birthday - the team went out their way to get a birthday cake for her as part of the last stop on the tour. Such a lovely surprise for her.

Book it, you won't regret it. I'll likely be doing it all again with my girlfriend and I look forward to it!

Great night out - My wife and I did the night foodie tour. It rained for a good portion of the trip but XO provided heavy duty ponchos so the only thing that gets wet are your shoes. Tai the tour guide and the girls who rode us around were fantastic. The night was a lot of fun with interesting facts and history thrown into the mix. The food is excellent and there's plenty of it. Tai encourages you to eat as much as you can/want and he also takes photos of the group throughout the night and sends them out via email shortly after which is great. Would recommend!

Site seeing tour - Very informative and yet quite relaxing. Had a great time on this tour.
Thank you guys and girls on this tour. Highly recommend this in Vietnam.

Lovely Professional tour - Unbelievable trip to see the main sights in HCMC (Saigon) - see the city like a local with important facts and fun thrown in ...incredible tour - it's the only way to visit the city

The best thing we did in Vietnam!! - The night foodie tour on mopeds is amazing!!
+ You get to see all different areas of HCM
+ You try all sorts of good food, with a few beers
+ Tai is very funny and amazing to remember everyones name
+ My guide - Ngan, was so chatty and it was really good getting to know her
+ Such a good few hours and well worth the money, I have nothing bad to say at all! Thank you!

Foodie Tour - We had a great tour on the "Foodie Tour." We enjoyed trying local foods and seeing different neighborhoods that we wouldn't normally see. Our guides were so nice and spoke perfect English. Would definitely recommend!

Foodie Tour - We chose the XO Foodie Tour as the female drivers really appealed to us as a family with teenage daughters, but what we got was so much better than expected. Our drivers were very friendly and talkative during the whole tour, they stayed with us to eat and cook some of our food for us which was unexpected and really tasty. We played some games and had a great night of laughter, food and seeing the sights. Always feel safe being the passenger. Would definitely recommend this tour

You just can't miss it. - This was one of the highlights of my trip to Ho Chi Minh city. Extremely well organized. Extremely professional staff. Great experience that combines trying some of the local food in places you wouldn't probably go on your own, with riding a bike in Saigon and visiting some key places. Just amazing.

Fabulous food - Was very nervous about doing it but it was one of the best tourist experiences we have ever had.
Loved it.
Fantastic fun - This was an amazing experience and so much fun. An absolute must do! Girls are fantastic and really helpful. Every cent well worth it. Would highly recommend

The Highlight of My Trip to Ho Chi Minh City - Truly an interesting, tasty, delightful and FUN experience in Ho Chi Minh City. No doubt, the best way to experience HCM is on a motorbike. XO Tours are highly organized, well thought out, somewhat crazy...and a whole lot of fun. You'll see parts of the city, most tourists will not visit, and the staff are determined for guests to have an enjoyable time.

We chose the nighttime culinary tour. Private drivers (thank you, Trinh...you are THE BEST!) picked us up at our hotel. We met up with other members of the evening tour at the first restaurant stop. Here we meet the delightful and informative guide Tai. He introduces guests to one another and explains the first meal of the evening. There will be two more traditional, neighborhood-style restaurants and four more locations to see. We are introduced to many (non-western) Vietnamese dishes. And, if you are bold enough, you can try balut!

Each tour group is escorted by several bodyguards for an added level of security and organization.

It was an amazing time...and for me, the highlight of my visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

As an added-value, Tai takes pictures throughout the visit and sends them via email a few days later.

Thank You XO Tours Team!

100% MUST DO- best thing in HCMC!!!! - My wife and I went on both the morning moped tour and evening foodie tour, on the same day. We both loved!!

The morning tour was more informative, bringing you round various sights and giving us information on city. This is a super tour to do at the beginning of a trip, to give you an overview of HCMC. The mopeds are surprisingly safe and you feel much calmer on the moped- watching them as a pedestrian seems much more terrifying!!!! Our drivers were Chang & Tien and they were fantastic and so informative. Their English was brilliant.

The evening foodie tour is an absolute MUST!!! If you are like us and are slightly afraid of the street food; my wife is a vegetarian and is petrified of getting hidden meat in her 'veggie' dishes (happened before in Malaysia!)... So this tour enabled us to go and relax with the confidence that the XO girls could explain clearly to all of the foodie stalls we went to. The food was delicious!!!! We had a range of traditional Vietnamese street food and were not pressed into finishing anything if we didn't like it or more likely, too full. Note: do not eat lunch that day!!! You will be stuffed full of delicious food and beer and it's so annoying when you can't finish it!! We had Chang again as our driver & another Tien, who again were fantastic.

The two tour guides Tai & Huei had superb English & were a wealth of knowledge. They were very polite and kind.

We really did feel like locals in the end zooming around the streets, laughing with the XO team and soaking up the culture.

Depending on what you want, both tours are amazing separate and together.

So much fun! - We had two weeks in Vietnam with our two children aged eight and 10. We loved every day of our holiday in Vietnam and had some amazing experiences but all of us agree that this was without a doubt the standout of our entire trip. We did the night tour and our guides took us on one of the funnest evenings we can remember. You get to see a side of HCMC that you would ordinarily never see. Our guides were the most charming and fun girls you could spend an evening with. Our kids adored the ladies and the ladies adored them. The food we had on our tour was fantastic but that was not the highlight. The highlight is just being on the back of a bike riding through a thriving and teaming Metropolis in the company of delightful locals. This sounds over the top but it was exhilarating and soooo much fun. Do it and you will know what I mean! Can't rate this tour highly enough!!!! Thank you XO tours!!!!

The best thing we've done in years - From being worried about a motorbike tour of a city renowned for its mad traffic, I can honestly say now that this was the best thing my family and I have done in a long time. The young women who ride you around are professional, interesting, engaging, good humoured and interested in you too. Riding on the back soon becomes a wonderful way to see the city and you get to see so much of it in a short time. We did the foodie tour which was wonderful....if you are keen to experience some different and unusual tastes. Our two boys (10 and 12) loved the tour too. Our tour leader couldn't have been more responsive to our needs and even managed to arrange a birthday cake for our son whilst he zoomed around the city with us. Brilliant five hours, would live to do it all again.

Best thing to do in HCM - We were blown away by this tour. We booked it on the premise of being number 1 on trip advisor and having been in Vietnam for two weeks already, we wanted to end our holiday on a high, tasting the best Saigon had to offer. We weren't disappointed.

Our girls, Tam and Quynh who took us around the city were so personable, friendly, funny and yet professional. Thai, our guide for the evening was genuinely funny, professional but extremely organised and wanting to ensure everyone had the best time.

We visited 5 districts that we can remember, everywhere we were offered great food and drinks including alcohol. Without doubt my favourite was the last stop and the scallops! Most significantly though, the tour allowed you to see the real HCM, not just the high rises and nice shops in district 1 but the alternative and authentic districts where people are really living.

We enjoyed this tour immensely, my partner and I would like to thank Tam, Quynh and Thai for such a fantastic finish to our holiday to Vietnam! The organisation and professionalism of everyone involved in getting a group of 20 people around HCM was superb. A wonderful experience, one we both loved and will never forget! Thankyou x

We will remember it forever - HCMC city is the last stop (leaving today) on our honeymoon trip and we booked this tour a while back, on recommendations from friends.

Booking it was so easy and they emailed you really quickly to confirm.

We were picked up by 2 wonderful young ladies at our hotel at 17.25pm. We explained neither of us had ever been on a motorbike and asked a couple of questions. Then it was helmets on and we were off.

We sped off in rush hour, weaving in and out of the traffic. It was absolutely exhilarating.

First stop we met up with the Tour Leader Tai, an absolutely wonderful man. He's so insightful and funny.

We sat down and were introduced to a few others from our group and had the first taste of food, a beef noodle soup. Not Pho, it was different but absolutely delicious.

Then we were off on quite a long trip to Chinatown. The ride is just amazing, you even go on the highway!

Tai gave us all some facts about the area, it's very far out from the main tourist part, hence why it's more locals orientated. It feels like a huge place, 600 thousand Cantonese live there just to give an idea of ​​scale.

We then went on a ride through Chinatown and onto the most amazing food place, just off a busy road.

The girls all then BBQ different meats and the beer starts! Saigon beer is so nice, as it has 333 beers.

We had goat, beef and frog! Surprisingly nice. You get a really good chance to chat to the girls, they are all so incredibly lovely and you warm to them immediately.

We then drove on to a newer part of the city, which is nicknamed 'K Town' as many Koreans and other expats are taking up residence there. It's entirely different to other parts of HCMC, very new and quite characterless. It was very interesting to see the contrasts.

After this we went into District 4 (I think) which Tai explained was one of the poorer parts of the city. Here we had more food, more seafood focused. Clams, crabs, prawns and the most amazing scallops. All washed down with more beer.

It was then time to end the tour, so we said our goodbyes and the girls drove us back to our hotel.

I know it sounds cheesy but I cannot emphasize enough how amazing it feels to be sitting on a motorbike, with traffic and life whizzing past you.

Thanks XO Tours, you made this the absolute best part of our honeymoon trip. We will never ever forget it.

Big love to all of you.

Amazing adventure! - My wife and I did the foodies tour - which did not disappoint at all. We were quite lucky as we booked this quite late.

We were picked up on a rainy Saigon evening, where two young guides and a bodyguard picked us up. We were given a short but excellent safety briefing, and off we went.

While the food itself was to die for, the real experience came from chatting with our guides. I was driven by Tien (who's awesome), and got to hear about life in Vietnam.

Throughout the whole night - I did not feel unsafe at all, and I have to say, it was an exhilarating ride through HCMC. We ate ourselves silly, and most importantly - we ate food that most tourist otherwise would not have eaten.

Thank you Hieu, who was our overall guide, and Tien (for being an awesome rider)!

Great fun and great way to get the city vibe. - My wife and I planned this trip for our second morning in Ho Chi Minh to get the lay of the land. The girls Thao and Trang were adorable, friendly, courteous and a pleasure to spend a few hours with. The city is a hectic, frantic, and chaotic but they made it all seem safe and comfortable sitting on the back of their scooters. We stopped at the Post Office, Reunification Palace and a couple of other major spots as well as temples and a ride through Chinatown. Along the way they provided water (it's really hot) and some fruit. Afterwards the girls even gabe us great suggestions for restaurants and shopping. Great tour!
Mark and Mary

AWESOMENESSNESS. - Possibly the best time I've ever had whilst sitting down. Usually I'm not a fan of guided tours but this seems unique enough to offer some interest. All the girls are fun, professional and careful riders. Even in the insanity of Saigon's traffic I never felt unsafe once. Eating with locals is something you won't do with out local knowledge and this tour has all the right contacts. The guide is informative and breaks up the sight seeing with some welcome insights.
I have a shellfish allergy which can sometimes get in the way and I am happy to just avoid it where I can but XO provided substitute meals with out any fuss. Thanks guys for a great night out.

Brilliant way to see Saigon - Had a fantastic time with my 5 year old (charged at 50%) on the morning tour. What a great way to see the city in a few hours, see some of the important sights, taste some food and chat to some locals with excellent English. Our guide, Tam, was great - very open and easy to speak to. I would highly recommend for families - my wife took our 3 year old the previous day. The drivers were super friendly to the kids, buying them icecream and chatting to them.

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - We had a great day riding on the scooters behind our professional drivers. They were VERY experienced and we felt as close to being a local as you can in a one-day visit from a cruise ship! We felt entirely safe and cared for the entire time. The drivers were not only experts on the road, but they stayed close to their passengers to ensure we had a safe and positive experience, even helping us with local purchases. The tour hit the highlights and was very informative. I can't say enough positive things - what a FANTASTIC experience!

No. 1 for a reason - The XO foodie tour is a flat out, no holds barred winner. I'll try not to say all the same things that have been said many times before. It is a fantastic night out for everyone; young kids, teenagers, 20-somethings and older people who like a bit of adventure.

The food and drink is abundant and beyond delicious and not the sort of price you would find without local help. That said, it is the people who take you out and the experience of mixing it with the local traffic that really makes the night. It's hard to describe the thrill of going from district to district on the back of a motorbike with one of the fantastic guides and seeing just what the Saigonese get up to a daily (or nightly) basis.

It probably reflects how safe and homogenized life in large Australian cities now is, but the experience you get with the foodie tour is just what you need to remind you what a bit of chaotic fun actually looks like.

If you are coming to Ho Chi Minh, just book it. You won't regret it.

Saigon food tour by night....Vietnam Highlight! - We didn't really know what to expect on this tour however once complete we all agreed it was the highlight of our whole Vietnam trip! We went as a group of 5 and it couldn't have been better. We covered more ground in HMC in 5 hours than we would if we stayed there for a month. The XO girls are amazing, super friendly and knowledgeable and most of all you can tell they really enjoy what they do. Sang and his crew are great as well, very informative, there for anything you need and making sure everyone stays safe while maintaining a really casual feel to the whole thing. As everyone else is saying, don't hesitate, just to it! Be a local for a night in HMC. Thanks XO :-)

Must do!!! - Wow, wow, wow! After completing this tour that was all my wife and i could say.
We completed the Foodie tour and it was worth every penny. May seem expensive at first, but you will finish your 4.5 hour tour with a huge smile on your face! The food was amazing. The experience of seeing different parts of Ho Chi Minh was a treat. Finally, the service we received from Anh our guide for the day and our scooter drivers Trang and Idhi were simply out of this world! Be adventurous and do this!

Fun tour! - The tour was great it was a lot of fun and a fun way to see parts of Ho Chi Minh city which are not frequented by tourists. The food was so yummy and the staff were amazingly friendly and knowledgable. Excellent way of seeing the city. Also Thanks for emailing us the photos! Would highly recommend to anyone visiting HCMC.

Highlight of Saigon - We foodie tour around the streets of Saigon with the XO girls and it was one of our highlights of Saigon. The tour guides were excellent drivers and we felt very safe on the back of their scooters. Our guide's English was excellent sand they were able to give us a lot of information and travel tips throughout the tour. Each food dish was amazing and you are left feeling very full and satisfied after the tour (you are given as much to eat and drink as you like). The guides also took photos throughout the tour so that you are able to sit back and enjoy the tour, although we also took our go pro to put on our helmets and the footage is great! I would highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience local Vietnamese food and culture - you won't regret it!!

If you only do one thing in Saigon, you MUST do this! - XO Tours are top notch and a must do - I have only the best things to say about this highly professional, fun and delicious adventure. My husband and I are in Vietnam on our honeymoon and chose the foodie trip on the recommendation of a friend. I am so glad we did, this made our time in Saigon so extra special.

For the foodie tour, XO bikers pick you up at your hotel and take you on an exhilarating tour of eating spots in the city you would never find as a solo tourist. Our tour guide Tai was so funny and helpful, and we so enjoyed riding along and talking to our two bike drivers. I didn't want the tour to end! Added to that, the food was out of this world delicious

Thanks so much to everyone at XO for such a great time. Book with XO, you will not be disappointed.

Must do - This is THE way to tour HCMC and a culinary immersion into the tastes and smells of the real Vietnam.

Climb aboard and be whisked away with wonderful guides who are fluent in English.

Expand culinary horizons and even learn some "essential" Vietnamese phrases.

Our group of seven have been raving about this group ever since we have finished our tour. 5 hours just evaporated with good food and great conversation you cannot do better in all of Vietnam!

The absolute best way to see Saigon - There's no way to capture how awesome our tours with XO were. We did the Foodie tour and the Sights tour, and both were absolutely wonderful. Friendly, articulate, funny guides (Tai and Khoi) were just the beginning; Seeing and learning so much of HCMC was wonderful, and riding the motorbike was absolutely exhilarating. All the food was exceptional and the whole crew was very attentive to all of our needs and keeping us full and entertained. But above all the best thing about this company is the drivers, who are fun and make an active effort to keep you feeling comfortable and to get to know you. We left our tour feeling like great friends with all of them, and their enthusiasm is what made these tours the unquestionable highlight of our time in Vietnam. Thanks, Tai, Khoi, Nhi, Trang, and everyone else!

A must-do activity in Saigon - We did the sights tour on our last day and had a blast! We saw so much of the city that we otherwise would have missed. Our drivers were wonderful - fun, extremely safe, kind and eager to share details on each place we visited. Our tour guide, Hieu Nguyen, was great. His English is perfect and he did a wonderful job sharing details on each site we visited. We did not pay extra from the video (although they did take photos throughout the trip which they shared for free, which was awesome) but I really wish we would have. Another couple on our tour had the videographer following them around all morning and I really wish I had booked that as well!

This is a must! - I discovered this tour via Trip Advisor and decided to book it for our family of 4 (two teenage children) based on the amazing reviews. I am so glad we did. This tour is amazing and a must for any tourist coming to Ho Chi Minh City. Of the tours on offer, we chose to do the city night tour.
The girls who drove us around are just wonderful. They are friendly, funny, informative and so good at driving you around safely through the traffic. Their English is fantastic and they explained all of the different districts they took us to as well as some handy tips for shopping and eating. We booked for dinner and dessert and this is all included in the price. Our tour leader was also wonderful, making sure that everything was ready for our arrival at each point.
The tour is so well organized - they have thought of everything. Honestly, you can't fault this tour company. Thank you XO Tours for a very memorable experience.

Best Time in Saigon - This was our favorite thing we did in Saigon. The girls are great and really friendly. They made us feel safe on the bikes. This tour gives you an authentic look at the city seeing it the way the locals do: from the back of a moto in traffic in the wild streets of Saigon. We loved going to the market, the temple, and hearing the history of the city.

Don't miss it!

This is a must-do! - We booked this foodie tour before we left home and I am so glad. I would hate to miss out on this adventure! Our tour manager was Tai, he was great, very funny, spoke great English and took wonderful photos. Our girls Kim and Tuyet were pretty incredible! We had so much fun riding with them and when we would stop to eat, they would help prepare the food and teach us how to eat it!!! We were in a group of about 13, and from what I could tell everyone LOVED it. Oh, by the way I'm not really that adventurous and I felt completely safe on the scooter thanks to my wonderful driver!! We decided to spend the extra $$ and had them make a video of our tour so we could share it with our arm chair traveling relatives and friends. Who knows maybe they will see how much fun it was and it will get them out of their chairs!!! So what are you waiting for? Book it!

Awesome Foodie Tour - So glad we did this Foodie Tour. Booking it was exceptionally easy and communication from Ms Thao was super quick. They are very flexible with payment options too.

The ladies were very prompt (actually they were early!) Both had the best personalities and were very entertaining, informative and interesting. They were great riders and drove safely at all times.

All the food was prepared well and tasted great. The frogs were a nice tasty treat but the fertilized duck egg is only for the brave (hint: it tastes better than it sounds). No pressure to eat anything you don't want and they catered for vegetarians quite well too. Lots of seafood options as well as other red & white meats. Something for everyone.

This was the best thing we did during our short stay in HCMC - highly recommended.

Be careful with food poison - I don't understand why they offered me seafood while there has been a DISASTER of sea creatures' death in the middle of Vietnam???
Now I have a HARSH stomach ache and I can totally blame it on them, for I haven't had anything as disgusting as that of XO tour!!! The street food may look nice on the plate, but, well, it's just hard to digest....

Foodie Tour is a must-do. - These guys are awesome!!!! Did this on our first night in Saigon, very professional and friendly girls and support crew. Ride as a passenger on a scooter through the crazy traffic, eating at the best local street foods and including a tour of many districts mostly unseen by tourists. We had an absolute ball and would recommend this to everyone!

Saigon by Night - I had such an amazing experience and recommend this tour to anyone I know who is planning their trip to Saigon. They had different tours to choose from and this particular one allowed me to experience the entire city and all of its different districts. We had a delicious meal with the locals and continued to safely tour throughout the rest of the city. I am very pleased and would do go with this tour company again if I return.

Like food and have a sense of adventure? You need to do this tour!!! - While I was certainly nervous about getting on the back of a motorbike in the crazy HCMC traffic I needn't of worried, the drivers did everything they could to make sure I was comfortable and had a fabulous time. The tour has everything fun, great information, friendly and safe staff and of course wonderful food! I would recommend this to anyone with a love of food and sense of adventure.

A must-have for any food lover. - My girlfriend and I are massive Vietnamese food fans back in the UK and were keen to see another side of the cuisine. We couldn't have been happier with this tour!

Part food tour, part night city tour we were taken to 3 street food spots and 2 other points of interest. While we were a group of 9, being on the back of a moped it felt like a 1-on-1 personal tour, and this hospitality extended to each food stop where we were fed and watered with unlimited beer and food!

Highlights for me were the scallops (unreal!) tabletop BBQ, and just simply being part of the insane Saigon traffic! Thank you to Khoi and his team (especially our drivers Ni and Nung (infinite apologies for spelling!)) for making this a highlight of our Vietnam trip.

Amazing tour - We had a great time whizzing around HCM.
The tour is eat as much as you like so you definitely won't go hungry! A mix of sea food, noodles and BBQ food. It combined eating with seeing the city at night and escaping district 1.

The girls were great thanks so much Ngung and Ni (sorry about spelling!)

Saigon by Night - As a family of four we absolutely loved our tour. Was thrilling and a fantastic way to see Saigon. Great tour guides and the girls are so lovely. One of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. A must do if you want to see all of Ho Chi Minh!!

Don't miss this when in HCMC - A friend recommended the XO Foodie tour and after the experience we would soundly recommend this tour to anyone that visits HCMC and wants to try real street food how the locals do it.

Yes being on the back of a bike in this crazy place takes a bit of getting used to but the girls are great riders and as long as you follow their directions all is good.

You visit several districts and have the chance to try some local delicacies so you wish to. I couldn't bring myself to try some of them but there is no pressure and the food is great.

The Best way to see Ho Chi Minh! - We only had one day in Ho Chi Minh and wanted to make the most of it. XO Tours had great reviews so we decided to give them a try -- and we couldn't have been more delighted! Our drivers were the BEST: courteous, safe drivers that not only drove us around but were always taking care of us. Like making sure we got the appropriate amount of change when we were purchasing something, or that we didn't get separated from our group in crowded areas. And to top it off, they take great group photos all along the way and then send them to you! I can't say enough about our tour guide Anh and the 7 lady drivers that we had. They definitely were the highlight of our vacation!

One of my absolute Vietnam highlights - A friend of mine recommended XO Tours to me before I leave Melbourne. It's not a cheap tour, but my partner and I both felt that if it wasn't the best thing we did in Vietnam, it was certainly in the top couple of highlights. I would not hesitate to spend the money again.

While scooter-dodging seems to be a bit of a national pastime for pedestrians in Vietnam, being out in the traffic is exhilarating. And the Foodie tour which we did cover a lot of different districts across the city which we would never have visited.

From riding through the middle of a traditional market to stops in the barbecue precinct and the posh District 7, I loved this little window into Ho Chi Minh. My guide spoke fantastic English and answered all the questions I had about Vietnamese life and culture. I was such a chatterbox that many of the things we talked about I kept thinking about in the days ahead.

From the customer service to all the little details, this is about as perfect as a tour gets. Great food, great company and a chance to get right into the middle of life in this fast-paced city.

Don't miss the best food tour of HCM city - If you have the time book yourself on an XO tour of Ho Chi Minh city for a food tour. Driving around 5 Districts on the back of a motorbike was an awesome experience. Learn lots about the food and the areas you go to.
Highly recommend and the girls are great bike drivers! Enjoy

When in Saigon Just Ride It - As a rider myself I wanted so much to hop on a motorbike and explore the city. What better way than having a guide who takes you off on her bike and brings you to different districts tasting their awesome street food. My friends and I had so much fun and laughter with our tour riders. They are truly skilled in handling their bikes maneuvering through heavy traffic. If you are an adventure traveler, Just Ride it in Saigon. Our many Thanks to our rider guides Thu, Thong and Jenny for the awesome experience.
Rdgs
Tini.Y

Fantabulous Evening Tour. If you do only one tour in Saigon make it this motorbike tour. - Our family had completed an Intrepid tour of Vietnam and had a few extra days in Saigon. We chose the XO Saigon by night motorcycle tour to experience more of the city than is possible by walking. With XO tours we got a group of friendly, knowledgeable, passionate guides who made the experience fun and memorable for our whole family. The ladies who drove skilfully in chaotic Saigon traffic fawned over our daughter while my son had the most animated conversation of our trip with our official guide of the night, Tuan, about Japanese pop culture! My husband and I really enjoyed the insight into what it's like living in Vietnam today, from the point of view of these young people starting their careers. And it's such an experience to be IN the motorbike traffic instead of avoiding it as pedestrians! It's great value for money with two food stops and all drinks included, and despite booking at the last minute and being unable to use the website, the process was really easy, by phone and email. We got bonus door to door service despite being at a hotel in District 3. A great night!

Such a thrill! - We took a private night tour (just 2 of us), and it was remarkable thrilling, yet safe-feeling. I enjoyed the food and info part (well presented in perfect English by our guide, Khoi), but the highlight was definitely gliding along on a motorbike, behind our incredibly competent and personable drivers (Phuong (or Jenny) and Linh)

We'd been traveling in VN for 2 1/2 weeks by this point, and were fascinated by the chaotic road rules (or lack thereof!). I am normally extremely risky, however I feel very safe on the back of the motorbike. I was super impressed that our drivers were able to concentrate on the road while chatting casually with us.

It was also nice to receive photos (by email a few days later) so we didn't have to take photos as we went along.

We signed up for a private tour because I thought there would be a lot of waiting around, and awkward forced conversations with the others had we gone with the group tour (I think that was a maximum of 10). However we crossed paths with the larger group as we went, and they seemed to be having fun. The company is so well run that I'm sure they do a good job with that as well. So I think if we were to do it again, we'd save the additional $20/person and just join the group tour. Either way though—definitely a “must do” while in HCMC!

Fantastic - Amazing I think everyone should take this tour we had the best time running around on the motor scooters with the girls and going to all the different restaurants I highly recommend 1000-year-old chicken egg!

Saigon by Night - What a great idea- you hop on the back of a scooter with a young woman driving you around Saigon at night with the other 2 million scooters?? How about in the rain at night- that's what my whole family did last week and it was A BLAST!!
The tour guide / drivers are articulate and drive the scooters with skill- add the mystery of a foreign city at night with all the exotic new smells you can only appreciate on a motorbike and you have a fun filled unforgettable night!!

Day Tour and Night Tour - Pre booked the day tour and night tour about 2 weeks ago I was due to arrive into HCMC. Booking and confirmation was very quick and easy.

I arrived into HCMC around 5pm and am glad I chose to do the tours the very next day.

As arranged, I was greeted by my tour guides (Vy for the day tour and Canh for the night tour). Both girls were great. Very chatty and extremely smiley! Both were willing to give recommendations in terms of type of shopping and food! Both make the moped ride fun and they are both extremely confident and capable riders.

Anh was our tour leader for both tours and he's a funny guy! Mixing in jokes along with being informative and knowledgeable.

One of the great things about the tour is that they also take you outside of district 1 (where all the tourists congregate). You get to see the other side of HCMC with out the glitz and bright lights (less bright lights!).

Overall, I highly recommend XO Tours and will definitely be encouraging family and friends to use them if they ever visit Vietnam.

Thank you Anh, Vy and Camh for such a wonderful day!

Victor

Absolutely Fantastic - While not a big fan of organized tours, I am so glad that we did this one. Every single detail of this tour was flawless. This is due in large part to the lovely ladies who are the motorbike drivers and take care of you from pickup to drop off. The best way to see Saigon and sample the amazing food, I can't recommend more highly. The only bad part was having to say goodbye.

Excellent - Really excellent and fun tour. Would highly recommend to anyone. The girls were very friendly, outgoing and fun, and their English was excellent. We really felt welcome and well taken care of. Thank you so much!

Definitely not your usual foodie tour... - ...and I mean that in a good way. I had some friends in town, and although I am quite familiar with Saigon, I thought this would be a great experience to try XO based on the reviews I've read. Everyone enjoyed it and I'm glad that it was mostly centered out of the much visited District 1 and shows the city from a different light. The highlight for us was the personable experience in getting to ride with the locals across the city and hearing about their daily life. The food is delicious and I'm glad there was no pho or the usual banh mi offered on this tour.

I'd highly recommend this tour for first-timers to Saigon!
Absolutely loved it! - These wonderful women drivers and tour guide couldn't have given us a better intro to Saigon - the people, history and city.

Xo tours was incredible! - We did the night tour and of our week long stay in Vietnam, it was the HIGHLIGHT!! Our girls and the tour guide made the night so enjoyable, enlightening and FUN! We smiled for every second of it. This is an incredible company run by passionate and hard working people. If you're in Vietnam for even a short time, this is a must do!

Foodie Tour Simply the best - If you only do one tour in Saigon it should be this one. The food was great, the drivers and our tour manager Tai were absolutely wonderful. A fabulous time was had by all.
John Boy hasn't stopped talking about it.
Thank you Tai and a special thank you to Tam.
Alana

Zen and the art of motorcycle madness - So we went with this amazing tour company on the Saigon Night Tour, they took us to less familiar parts of the city and told us about them in a well balanced light hearted way, nothing too heavy but it gave us a more up to date take in the city and its people.
The all girl gang is amazing, they were so witty and we had great banter with them.

The girls are all great fun and speak good English! I was with Vi and she was fantastic at weaving us through the busy Saigon Roads!

I was a bit nervous previously having seen the madness of the traffic around the city but it was great fun and I felt totally safe throughout! We stopped and had some traditional food in a couple of places throughout the city too which was good.

Don't hesitate and book a trip with this company you will have an amazing night!
Wonderful Experience - An absolutely MUST DO Saigon experience! Tour guides were excellent, great insight into the city and wonderful food. Cannot recommend enough.

Foodie Tour - It is a trip that went beyond our expectations. Our drivers are great, never felt so safe before and we had so much fun. Nothing to worry about an upset stomach as all food is prepared.

In short, if you want to know what the locals eat, join this trip and you will have no regrets.

Ho Chi Minh Saigon By Night Tour - Amazing tour. The guides were so sweet and spoke great English. The tour guide was very insightful and taught us a lot about the city that tourists do not usually get to see. Highly HIGHLY recommend.

5 hours adventure of city, culture and food - We are very happy that we have taken the XO food trip, it was a little bit hard to book but worthied every penny.

Our beautiful drivers picked us from the hotel and dropped us at a really delicious rice noodle restaurant, in where we met our group mates and the trip manager. After a quick catch up, the group set out to the next stops, where we not only tasted the different food but also travelled the city in a different way. We have been taken to total local districts with almost no foreign tourists or known by tourists, caught the very different scenes of ho chi minh city, even that we had been in the city for more than half a week ourselves.
More important, the manager briefed us all the way about what we were going to see, made the trip not just sitting at the backseat of a motorbike.
Our drivers were also super cool. They wore quite elegant uniforms, explained all the way of the city culture as well as answered all my weird questions, and taught us useful Vietnamnese words. At the same time, they made sure that each little group mates would be together at most of the crossroads (really not an easy job on busy road of ho chi minh). When we sat at the table, each one got his/her driver beside, helping with the difficult food and orders. Really sweet!
All the times, there were a few young muscle guys following the group as our body guards, and kept our safety. The trip also included some funny picture time and games to ease the atmosphere.
There was no limit for the quantity of food and drinks, and I don't think the trip contained any food that out of the safety zone of normal modern citizen.

After all, it was really a trip went far beyond of my expectation. each detail has been considered carefully, and each staff does perfect job to function the trip. It was a really good way to dig into the city while enjoy the great food.

Must do thing in Ho Chi Minh city. - If you want to have real flavour of ho chi Minh city then XO Tours is the right choice of tour. They have good English speaking tour guides who explains you about all stuff in city will take you to farthest corners of city on motor bike.
It's a must have experience.

AMAZING - I loved this tour so much. The women who drive are so much fun, and I never thought I would be on a motorbike in HCMC and feel safe! Between the ride which was exhilarating and the food (I did the foodie tour), I was definitely out of my comfort zone and loving it.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - There are a few difference scooter tour companies to choose from, all with great reviews. We chose this one as it had great reviews and the foodie tour sounded just what we wanted.
Many reviewers describe this tour as the highlight of their holiday around Vietnam, I was thinking that this was probably an exaggeration given all the interesting sights and beautiful places there are to visit, but those reviewers are right! The foodie tour was definitely one of the highlights of our holiday.
The food was great and plenty of it, I always felt safe on the back of the scooter; it was great whizzing around HCMC.
I would highly recommend this tour while in HCMC, I’d do it again upon a return to the city.

Over-priced with uncomfortable moments. Not an authentic experience by any standards - This is the second time (out of at least 300 experiences) that I have tried something based on reviews on TA but have had a very disappointing experience. It is extremely surprising to me that my experience has been in sharp contrast with other 3025 reviewers who have tried the tour before me and have given it an excellent or very good rating. I am going to explain in detail why my wife and I had a very disappointing experience with XO tours. I always appreciate the information I get from online communities like TA and try to contribute to that as much as I can, especially in cases where I have a different experience so others with taste and preferences similar to mine can make more informed decisions and avoid disappointing experiences like ours with XO tours. Let me tell you right at the beginning that this review is for you if you are a curious tourist who tries to live the life of a local as much as possible when travelling, a traveler who looks for an authentic experience and therefore wants to minimize the touristy aspects of exploring a place. I should also mention that I am not one of those difficult snobbish perfectionist travelers who is looking for an experience that does not exist, I have had many nice experiences with tours in many places I have travelled to, including Vietnam (you can read my other reviews on TA).

I should talk about the good part of the tour first. The girls are extremely nice and professional. They are great drivers so you won’t feel unsafe even for a minute. They are very young, educated and have a great attitude and are the highlight of the tour. So I am not blaming them at all for my poor experience. The tour is also very organized, in fact over-organized and too westernized to the extent that it lacks originality, creativity, and locality (more on this will follow).

I should explain first what I expected from the tour. Having paid $US70/person (app. 1,540,000 VND) I expected to learn a bit more about Vietnamese cuisines, and try authentic Vietnamese street food in authentic places where locals eat, something along the lines of what can be easily found online by searching “Street Food in Saigon” (TA does not allow me to include links in my post). Keep in mind that with 1,540,000 VND you can eat your way through Saigon! If we estimate the average price of a Vietnamese street dish at 50,000 VND, you can then have 300 dishes with that amount of money. Therefore, one should get a bloody unique experience for trying 12 different items (cannot really call them dishes, will explain more later) for the price of 300 dishes.

The XO Tours website suggests that they “will take you to the most popular street stalls and hidden alleyways in the city and show you where the locals really love to eat.” Let me tell you that this claim is categorically false. Anyone who has walked the streets of Saigon outside Backpacker area and knows anything about the street food in Saigon, or even have read about the street food in Saigon, will recognize that the foodie tour XO offers does not even get close to what this sentence suggests.
