In fact, I will personally send a prize to anyone who can find anywhere online the name of any of the three eateries XO tour takes people to on the list of the “most popular street stalls” in Saigon!
Here are some statistics about our tour: we spent 4 hours and 30 minutes from the time we were picked up until we were dropped off (5:30pm to 10pm). My Geo Tracker app suggests that we drove about 25kms which is way too long for a tour that is focused on food. We spent around 100 minutes of the time eating (3 food stops), around 30 minutes listening to the main tour guide talking about Vietnam (2 stops, more on this will follow), and the rest driving around on a motorbike. We covered a lot of ground on the motorbike, and saw a couple of interesting neighborhoods (just passed through), and that is exactly one of the problems with the tour. First of all, I booked this tour for the food not for the street tour, if I wanted a street tour of Saigon I would have booked a different tour (Saigon at night or something like that). Of course it is nice to see different neighborhoods and learn about Saigon and Vietnamese culture while trying some authentic Vietnamese dishes, but unfortunately the first part was not done well, and there was too much time allocated to it.

Second, the tour fails even when it comes to food. Our first stop was a very average restaurant (not a local place where Vietnamese eat) where we tried a very average Bun Bo Hue (Beef Noodle). Our second stop was in China town close to the Chinese market (Binh Tay). On the way there we passed a very interesting local market which would have been nice to check out and walk around, but we instead made a stop at Binh Tay (when it was closed!) to listen to our tour guide making some corny jokes and giving us some random scripted information about Vietnam (again, this is not the tour guide’s fault, I am sure he was not brainstorming or coming up with the jokes off the cuff, he was clearly instructed to talk about those things). I kept waiting for us to walk somewhere and try some food, but to my disappointment and surprise we walked in front of the closed market, took the most stupid touristy photo while making heart shapes with our hands, and walked back to our bikes and left!

Next stop was a BBQ place where we tried 4 bbq items: goat breast (which was nice), frogs (not nearly as good as what I had tried in Malaysia since the frog was too small and had too many bones and not much meat), beef and shrimp. Perhaps except from the goat breast, nothing else we tried here reminded me of authentic Vietnamese street food. Moreover, when we were about to leave I realized that the BBQ place had a large selection of options in a buffet in a corner, locals would go and choose what they wanted to try, and then bbq it on their table. These guys didn’t let us choose anything although there was a large selection of options available, and despite the fact that we paid $US75 for the tour. As a quick aside, my wife and I were taken to a bbq place in Can Thu a day later as part of our Mekong Delta tour, and there we tried amazing Vietnamese bbq dishes much better than what we tried with XO tours, and this was part of a tour that had nothing to do with food!

Next stop was somewhere in district 7. We got off in this weird place and half-circled in front of our tour guide in front of a closed shop while he lectured us about the state of the economy in Vietnam (inflation, interest rest, investment, income inequality, rental prices, etc.). the funny thing is that I am a professor of economics and usually find these things interesting, but not when I am on a foodies’ tour, and not with such a shallow commentary! After wasting another 20 minutes and listening to a few more corny jokes memorized and recited, we were about to get on our bikes that we were told our drivers have a surprise for us. What was the surprise you might ask? To sit in front of the bike while they take another stupid photo from us, like a 10-year-old offered to take a photo with a bike pretending he has driven one! After the photo we took the back seat again and ride to our final stop. This was probably our most authentic food stop, a small restaurant on a lively street full of other small restaurants, with tables and seats on the sidewalks. Here we tried some seafood: bbq clams with green onion (Chem chep nuong mo hanh), small crabs, a developing bird embryo that is boiled (hột vịt lộn xào me) and two deserts. The bbq clams and the deserts were nice, but nothing especial about the rest. After this last stop we were dropped off at our hotels.

There was also another thing that made us very uncomfortable during the tour. Except from our first food stop, the girls accompanied us during the other food stops by sitting next to us and virtually feeding us while they would not eat anything themselves. They peeled the shrimps and crabs for us, bbqed the meats, and put them in our plates for us to eat! I don’t know about you, but that really makes me uncomfortable. First of all, I would like to prepare my own food because that is part of the fun. Second of all, I don’t like to feel like a bloody king with servants. I offered the girls a couple of times to share some of the food with us (in some cases we left the table with leftovers), but they refused. In one case one of them told me that “she is on a diet”! This is a tiny girl who probably hardly weighs 80 pounds. They were clearly instructed not to touch the food.
I think this description of the itinerary makes it clear that what is offered by XO tours is not really an authentic experience. Yes, people have different tastes and preferences, but I would not call this an authentic experience by any standards. The tour is also way over-priced. To give you an idea to compare, my wife and I did a private two-day one-night Mekong Delta tour for $155/person the day after which included: a great private tour guide, around 5 hours of driving in an air-conditioned car which included visiting a couple of villages on the way, two floating market tours on private boats with hammock (one during the first day and one during the second day, for a total of 5 hours at least, and we tried different things like noodle dishes, fruits, coffee, Banh Mai, etc. during the tour), great homemade lunch at the guide’s relatives during the first day, an amazing bbq dinner in Can Thu, A buffet breakfast on the second day, two amazing local market tours in Cai Bai and Can Thu and a night market tour in Can Thu. The food we tried on this two-day tour alone was much better than what we tried on the XO foodie tour! We also paid $40/person for a two-day trekking tour in Sapa which included four full meals, a night of homestay, and an amazing experience. These two examples should give you an idea about how over-priced XO foodie tour is. The price they charge is outrageous given prices in Vietnam, even if they were offering a great experience which they don’t.
As you can notice from the poor and average reviews left for this tour, they all have got a similar (defensive) reply from XO tours, basically blaming the reviewer for their poor experience. I am sure they will find something from this long review to say that it is not their fault I had a poor experience, and so many others had a nice time. Again risking to sound too arrogant and snobbish, I don’t think most of those people have any idea about authentic Vietnamese food. All people on our tour had not tried anything but pho before, and that is why something that was a bit different made them so excited. I am a professor of economics and know how smart marketing can successfully promote a below-average product or service to seem great (you can find many examples around you), and I believe marketing is also the key to the success of the XO tours. You can criticize the crappy food at McDonalds all you want, they will always refer to their sale numbers, like XO tours refers to its reviews, and tell you many others have had a great experience, so shut up!

If you really want to try authentic Vietnamese cuisines in an authentic ambient do yourself a favor and skip this tour. Use the tone of information available online to identify the most famous street foods in Saigon, hire a taxi or a motorbike for a few hours, and get them to take you to these different places. This will cost you much less, and you will have a much better experience. I did some exploring the day before the XO tour based on the information I found online, and I had a much better experience and much nicer food.

Foodie Tour - highly recommended! - I only had a long weekend in HCM, looking to sample as much delicious Vietnamese food as possible, whilst also exploring areas of the city outside of the main tourist district.

The foodie tour I went on with XO was brilliant. We were taken round a good selection of 7 or so different stops, sampled different food (with unlimited drinks!) and heard about the character of each area. However, the highlight for me was without doubt my guide, Hanh, who was lots of fun and lovely to chat to as she drove me (safely) round the city - it was great to hear about HCM from a local's perspective while stopping off to indulge in the delicious cuisine that the city has to offer.

XO Tours - This was one of the best experiences I had in Vietnam! I love trying new foods when I travel, and this was a great way to try a lot of different types. Most of them were dishes that I wouldn't have ordered on my own, which is great. The tour is definitely worth the price. The XO drivers and tour guides are very nice and informative, and I had a lot of fun that night! This is a great way to see the city from the back of a motorbike, eat some good food, and make some new friends. I cannot recommend this tour enough!

If you only do one tour when in Saigon... - Crossing the street on foot in Saigon is like an extreme sport, even the locals try to avoid it. But cutting through traffic on the back of a scooter driven by a local is surprisingly relaxing.

We did the foodie tour, 5 hours of seeing all the districts of HCMC and tasting street food the locals adore.

You'll be taken to places you could never find on your own, meet locals and tourists alike and try food that you have never tasted (probably).

Safe, fun, educational and a great way to experience this enormous city. 5 stars!

Wonderful screw - Great food, great service, wonderful sightseeing. One of the best value for money tours I have ever made. You get to see many of the spots a regular visitor will not get to see. You are also able to eat superb food in local spots that you will hardly believe by only seeing them but are incredibly delicious.

The attention and care by the staff is outstanding. And their experience in driving is very good.

Fun and safe way to see the city at night - This is a great and fun way to see Ho Chi Minh City at night. The female riders made you feel very safe with their skills in negotiating the traffic and narrow side streets.

We were picked up at our hotel and taken by moped to a meeting point where we were joined by another 5 guests. The tour then continued by moped through various districts of the City. The girls were informative and pointed out and explained many things about life in the City whilst we were riding between the three dinner spots.

As regards the food - don't expect that much; it was basic street food and the tour was more about finding out a bit more about the wider city and its way of life in a fun and informative way..

Others have commented about it being a large group. There is an element of that at the eating spots where there were other moped groups. However, it did not detract from the tour as there seemed to be different routes and timings, it did not feel like a big pack of tourists going around the city.
Saigon by night - friendly, charming guide and drivers and an intimate way to explore this friendly charming city. two thumbs up!

Backstreets of Saigon - My husband and I booked the Saigon by night tour whilst in Ho Chi Minh City and we can't get more glad we did. We were collected by two girls and taken to our meeting point to pick up the rest of the group. When we arrived we found that there were only the two of us that night due to another couple canceling, so we had a private tour :-)
We had the two girls as our drivers, Sang the tour leader and a photographer. The whole night was great! The girls were really informative and AMAZING at driving in what can only be described as pure chaos! We were taken around districts that you would never get to see when looking through a traditional tour book and got to try some local delicacies! All the highlights were captured by the photographer, including the chopstick game, where my winners badge has pride of place now home :-) The photos were then emailed to us free of charge within days of the tour! Absolutely fab night and so glad that we booked! Thanks to all the team that gave us these memories!!!

Explore Saigon through its food on the back of a scooter - This was the highlight of my time in Saigon. When I first arrived I was taken aback by the traffic. It just seemed chaotic and crossing a road by foot downright dangerous - even on the crosswalks but by the end of this tour on a scooter I can see how it flowed. Everyone is courteous and really, traveling on scooter is the BEST way to see the city.

So that was the first revelation.

You hop on a scooter driven by a Saigon local. My driver was very confident which gave me confidence. You are told you can hang on to the back bar if you are feeling nervous. Let me go soon!

First stop is to try soup from the Hue province. Delicious but be warned. This is just the first stop and there is SO MUCH FOOD on this tour. Eat lightly!

Tai the main guide is funny and informative - you will enjoy the insights he brings into the tour. He really makes you feel as if you are seeing Saigon like a local.

The other thing I loved about this tour is that you go to several districts. Most people stay in District 1 - a tourist trap. On this tour you visit districts 1, 5,6, 7, 8 and 4. Tai tells us that 4 is the poorest district with the best food. I can tell you the food is delicious - especially the scallops and clams so if you like seafood - eat lightly on the earlier stops because this is the last stop and you need to save room!

Tai's commentary is complemented by your driver's insights. She will point out various things and you can ask questions as you travel along. She will also prepare your food for you which is lovely - you don't have to shell your own prawns!

This is also your opportunity to try some local delicacies. No spoilers though.

I tried everything... #brave and I don't regret it. So be prepared to have a go and you might surprise yourself as to what you like.

One bit of advice - I took a daypack which was a pain. They warn you about bag-snatchers so take a small bag that you can put in the seat of the scooter. Tai will take photos as you go so you don't really need to take a big camera or anything. Taking a phone is fun if you have google maps tracking enabled so you can see at the end where you went.

Overall this is a terrific introduction to the city. You will feel like a local and meet new people. And you will see why everyone rides a scooter in Saigon!

Foodies night tour - Overall, a great experience; the tour guide (Tai) was simply great; he explained every face of Saigon, and brought us in the most hidden place of the city.
The food experience was amazing; one of the best asian cusine so far.

The price worth completely the tour.

A different opinion - We did the Saigon by night tour. Firstly I will say the tour did deliver exactly what it promised. We were taken to different districts in the city and had them explained to us. We were taken to a local spot for some food. The guides were very friendly, great drivers and very helpful. I just personally found the experience to be underwhelming. As interesting as Saigon is, it is just a city. If you are looking insight into the city it does accomplish this. You could also save yourself 45$ and just talk to some students at the park or something and take a tuk tuk around the city. Also the dinner we had got me sick for a few days. This is of course a risk you run eating any street food in Vietnam, was just a bummer.

Exhilarating evening! - Our Saigon by Night Tour was the absolute highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. What a great way to see the city and to visit areas that most tourists never set foot in. Our drivers were wonderful and we felt completely safe at all times. I would thoroughly recommend this tour!

Excellent way to see the city - highly recommend - We were only in HCM for one full day and thought this would be a good way to see in what short time we had. We thought perhaps we were a little crazy to get on the back of the bikes as it is HECTIC...my husband even more so was more than a little freaked out by this.

The girls were fantastic - not once did I ever question my safety or their driving skills. The guide was informative as were the girls themselves. I learned a lot about Vietnam that I would never have known had I tried to do DYI this...

It is worth it - highly recommend

Can't Ask for More -- XO Rocks - WORDLESS!!! If you are in ho chi minh city, go take this. It's WOWWWW. Special thanks to tour manager Anh Pham and his gang of girl riders. :)

I took both morning and night tour. Glad I did

Fantastic food and tour guides; a very different side of the city - We booked this tour at very late notice and I was grateful that they were able to accommodate our group.
The tour guides were simply excellent, with lots of interesting discussion about aspects of Vietnamese life and culture.
We did the night tour rather than the foodie tour, and found the 2 stops for dinner and dessert were more than enough to satisfy us. The food was brilliant!
My only comment would be that although the stops were interesting, and it was good to see different parts of the city I feel the main focus was on the enjoyment of the ride, chat with the tour guide and the food, rather than actually being very informative about the sights. I think this may depend which tour guide you get, and what questions you ask rather than information being volunteered.
Notwithstanding, it's good value and a bit different.

Amazing family experience "Foodie" - From start to finish XO tours took care of everything even booking changes were easy and no drama. The girls who drove myself and 2 sons around the city were friendly, fun and helpful. I felt very safe in their capable hands!! the food was also very tasty and local. My boys (8 & 4) are still talking about the night and wanted to the same in another city recently

Fantastic! Highly recommended! - An amazing foodie experience. The girls who take you around on motorbikes are all very lovely and friendly, and our lead tour guide Huw was great too. Taking us to non-touristy food spots to eat authentic, delicious Vietnamese food, and allowing us to see so much of the beautiful city on the bikes along the way.

The best way to experience the city - We took 2 tours with these delightful women drivers and it was the experience of a lifetime. The first was a sights tour with a great guide at each stop to explain the local history. The second was a night tour of different food outlets where we experienced the local fare in each district. As I am an elderly lady I was a little apprehensive but have to say I felt completely safe and would recommend it to anyone young at heart.

Great sights tour! - As a solo female traveler in Saigon, I did not want to explore the city alone and their "Sights" tour was a wonderful alternative. Motor bikes are an integral part of this city so to leave without experiencing this mode of transportation would be a mistake. The drivers are all female and extremely safe and cautious drivers. I never once felt scared in their capable hands on the crazy streets of Saigon. The tour was fast paced with fun stops along the way that were very informative. I also enjoyed how they provided local snacks and drinks to enjoy throughout. I was impressed at their professionalism and their command of the English language. Overall wonderful tour and would highly recommend!

Saigon in new light - This tour introduces Saigon from the viewpoint of its districts and also its food, It brings the visitors out of the much visited district 1 and shows the city in new light. Overall a very interesting experience.

Fun night and something different! - Overall a great night - very friendly service and the drivers and guides did their best to ensure we all had a good time. Had many changes to our schedule / line up and they were all accommodated with very professionally. Highly recommend.

Quick observations:

The motorbikes were very safe, even as there was slight rain. many in my group had never been on one before and they loved the novelty of it.

There isn't an over abundance of food, although u get full if you drink alot. that said, we did order extra food (this was partly to have more variety in dishes too).

One final note, this tour is absolutely designed for westerners. Not a bad thing but just something to be aware of. As my group were all Asian a few things that would be a surprising/impressive simply weren't for us. Or many of the food we had had before. I won't ruin the surprises however!

The tour goes for four hours but it feels a little rushed with the amount of places you go to. That said, being on a bike can get tiring and I can imagine older people having trouble.

Would give 10 Stars if we could - ** Exceptional experience, simply unmissable **

Group of four traveling to Ho Chi Minh for the first time, extremely tight on time, and keen to take in both main city attractions, as well as local food scene. Highly responsive and professional from the moment we sent the first email, the team helped us design a 5 hour custom private tour, split 50/50 between sightseeing & eating.

We had high expectations given the strength of reviews, but they were surpassed in every way.

Our group belongs to our dedicated tour captain Tai, four wonderful drivers Thanh, Canh, Trang 2 & Thao 2, our two cameramen Dat & Hoang, and support man Hai. Tai and the girls in particular were a cut above - each engaging, energetic, highly knowledgeable, and safe/experienced drivers (all spoke pretty much perfect English). True locals that are passionate about showing the world their fantastic city.

The way the team blended a historical education, fun and games, and personal touch were superb. As an example, one of our group briefly mentioned in passing he could do with a coffee but did not want to inconvenience the rest of the group, 10 minutes later at our next pit stop, our support man Hai delivered four local iced coffees right on cue.

In summary, would consider this is an unmissable experience for any trip to Ho Chi Minh trip. A sincere thank you to the entire team.

So much fun! - We had an amazing night on this tour. Our drivers Ngan 3 and Loan 2 were lovely and so much fun, we forgot to be nervous about being on the bikes. The tour covered a much larger area than I expected and was well worth the money. The food was great and the fun group dynamic encouraged us to try a few things we hadn't tried before and have a good laugh about it. Definitely one of the best things we did on our trip. I would travel to Ho Chi Minh City again just to do this tour.

A great "Foodie" tour of HCMC - The "Foodie" tour by the XO folks was really very good. It lasts 4.5 hours and there are good gaps between the eat-fests so one is not overwhelmed by food. There is definitely a lot of variety and for those inclined to eat heavily, the quantities are solid. The girls who drive the scooters/motorcycles are just fantastic and the main guide does a great job explaining every dish and its ingredients + local history and influences. They do claim they accommodate allergies, but I did not test that out. Some people did bring larger cameras, but it's more convenient to rely on cell phones if you need pics. All-in-all, it's worth setting aside an evening to do this in HCMC.

Best Saigon Tour - We did the Saigon by night tour and it was the second time with XO tours. Our riders Quynh and Ngoc Ngan were very experienced and we felt very safe negotiating the traffic. Our tour leader Tuan was wonderful, making sure we were happy and giving us some background to the places we visited. He also took photos while we were on the tour and emailed them through which was greatly appreciated. If you want to experience the real Saigon and Vietnamese culture go on any of the XO tours. The food was great and the pocket guide book was very helpful.

Sights and Foodie Tour - We went on the Sights tour in the morning and Foodie tour in the evening. Both were brilliant but if you only have time for one, due to the Foodie Tour. Felt 100% safe at all times and the girls were absolutely delightful and professional (Nye 1, Nye 3, Loan and Hoang). Without doubt one of the highlights of our month trip to SE Asia.

Fantastic evening entertainment - Booked this last minute but normally you need to book a day or two in advance at least. This was a fantastically organized and fun experience. Ladies were wonderful, especially Tuyet. They drove with confidence and care and my initial anxiety quickly dispersed. Food experiences were very interesting and tasty. A surprise at the end that I will not reveal..
As others have said, not the cheapest but for sheer entertainment and a unique experience, it is very good value.
Thoroughly recommended.

So - so - The areas around HCMC that were covered by this tour were fabulous, taking us to some lesser known spots. and the girls were great riders; no disputes about that. But
I found them a little too keen to please!

Food spots were as expected with a good variety on offer but I like to enjoy my meals without the feeling of being almost force fed! Alcohol was sparingly served - not to everyone's pleasing.

I understand that the staff were probably following instructions but I found them rather intrusive when trying to share the experience with friends. Too OTT for my liking.
Sadly, I have to say this was my least favorite Saigon experience to date.

The foodie tour is worth every penny! - Last May, my cousin and I went to Ho Chi Minh and we are just glad that we booked this tour! It's like hitting two birds in one stone, you get to visit the different districts and eat delicious food at the same time! The tour guides are so friendly. Everyone is friendly! And they speak English fluently so it was easier to communicate with them and they are so lovely and great drivers! Special mention to Tin for putting up with a boring person like me, hahaha! The scallops with green onions and peanuts is divine! And i have to say that it was the longest time I've been on the back of the scooter and yet it feels 100% safe. Tai was tour manager at that time and he is very humorous, entertaining and very knowledgable and thank you for not forgetting our names :D! Thank you for taking care of us!

This tour is highly recommended!

Simply the Best! - I can't say enough about this tour it was so good! Me and seven Aussie tourists chose the Foodie Tour as we all love our food. The tour was fantastic it was so professionally run and the girls were so lovely, special mention of my driver Tam she was so friendly and knowledgable. We all felt very safe in the heavy Saigon traffic and the food was really good too, plenty of it and Beer as well. We saw so much more of Saigon that we had never seen before, we all loved it !

Saigon by Night - One of the highlights of my trip in Vietnam - I had a wonderful time with XO Tours and specially with my driver who made me discover districts of Saigon I hadn't even heard about. We've had great conversations, ate really good food and just enjoyed the night out even if it was pouring rain. We had a nice group and got along pretty well. I wish I had done that earlier in my trip. I highly recommend this tour to everyone who wishes to travel a bit different and get out of the touristy areas.

Great company, delicious food. - My wife and I arrived in Ho Chi Min City on May 10th and decided to start our vacation off with the XO food tour and what a way to start. Although a little apprehensive about getting on the back of a scooter, especially given the traffic in Saigon, we had nothing to fear. Our drivers, Ngoc & Nhi, were absolutely fantastic. We had full confidence in their driving abilities and they were fun and informative. They made this a great adventure and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The locations they took us to and the food were outstanding. We would highly recommend this tour, it was such a great start to our trip. Thank you Ngoc and Nhi.

These guys rock - Was in Vietnam for a long weekend and did the foodie tour...where should I start?! These guys are simply excellent. Everything was very well organized down to the tiniest level of detail with professionalism and love for what they are doing (yes you can see that on their faces). My driver (Queen) was a fluent English speaker with driving skills to die for!...and you do need a local to drive in Vietnam!!! They took us to 5 different places for food, with stops in between. Drinks were part of the deal and at no point did I feel that I needed more. The Tour Leader had a fantastic sense of humor and we ended up with more knowledge around Vietnam, its people, customs, way of living, drinking, eating. I can recommend these guys for sure. Definitely the best tour I ever had in Asia (even better than some in EU too). Keep it up boys and gals...was a pleasure meeting you and thanks for all the fun! You made this an unforgettable memory ;-)

Saigon by Night - An Excellent Tour Not To Be Missed - Thank You Tuan, Quynh and Ngoc Ngan - We have traveled through 45 countries and the provided tours by XO are in our top two from hundreds of tours taken around the world! We loved the daytime "Sights" tour so much last year, we decided to come back this year and do the "Saigon By Night" tour. It is one of those amazingly joyous experiences, that makes world travel so worthwhile. After this tour I would say every trip to Saigon should include as many XO tours as you can fit in, as you will cover all the bases of life in Saigon in a way that will introduce you in a fun way, to the best parts of life in the city, then you can go back at your leisure and spend more time at your favorite locations.

The ladies that drive the scooters are simply wonderful. On this tour we had the amazing and talented Ngoc Ngan and Quynh, who were very knowledgable about the history of the city and generous in sharing their knowledge and experience of social structures, religion, economics, family life, politics, sport and education. My favorite part of taking a tour is sharing a laugh - and these two ladies were so funny, intelligent and vibrant - we sang some songs during the tour, including some traditional Vietnamese folk songs that were wonderful. It was an unforgettable experience and we were very grateful. The driving is first class, you should feel very safe on the back of a scooter with the XO ladies, as they are true experts, just sit back and enjoy as the traffic and amazing sites whizz by, you are in safe hands.

Our tour leader and guide was Mr Tuan Nguyen, he was fantastic and very knowledgable on all of the historic aspects of HCMC and discussed life in the five distinct districts of Saigon so well that we all gained a very good understanding of life in each district. We asked many questions about food, religion, real estate, social customs and the changing nature of life in Vietnam, which Tuan handled very well, he was very well presented, an excellent communicator and a true professional.

This tour was so much fun, it's so exciting and the real joy is being able to spend some time with the excellent and talented team that work for XO. A tour with these guys will exceed your expectations and leave you wanting to book another one, so make sure you book as soon as you arrive to leave time to a second or third tour with XO.

The pictures they took for you and emails after the tour at no extra charge are just brilliant. The pocket sized "Survival Guide & Phrase Book" we were given at no extra charge was a hoot, a real bonus and you will use it in your travels. Make sure you ask your driver and guide to sign it at the end of the tour, it's a great momento to keep.

Thanks so much to the wonderful Ngoc Ngan, Quynh and Tuan, you are a real asset to XO tours and we give you and your Saigon By Night tour on Thursday 5/26/16, a solid 10 out of 10! A perfect tour and wonderful introduction to life in Saigon, thank you for the laughs, the singing and sharing your knowledge of this wonderful city.

Awesome Way to See Saigon - I joined the evening foodie tour under the recommendation of my colleague who visited a year earlier. It was definitely a very unique and enjoyable experience to be driven in a motorbike in the evening around many areas of Ho Chi Minh city. We get to try different foods which we wouldn't have been otherwise wise to try.

Foodie tour by XO - What a fantastic way to spend our first night in Saigon, the rain didn't slow us down at all as the girls came equipped with wet weather gear. Visited three different food stops all and two more for the sights. Had a bit of a history lesson and meant some other travelers. Would highly recommend the girls are great and couldn't be more friendly.

Awesome Foodie tour...and a great way to get out of District 1 and see more of the real Saigon. - This was a truly memorable tour from start to finish. The staff are so friendly, professional and informative. We were taken to parts of Saigon that the average tourist does not visit...the food was varied and really, really good. It is exhilarating being on the back of a scooter making your way through the traffic, knowing that all the while you are completely safe. I would highly recommend that if you only do one tour in Saigon, that you take part in the XO Foodie Tour!

Amazing experience - best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh! - We decided to book this tour for the first evening of our trip having flown in from the UK to keep us awake. It's fair to say we were flagging a bit just before, but the XO tour was so much fun. We were picked up from our hotel by our two female drivers and taken to the first venue to meet with the other people on the tour.

The format was a guide who did all the talking and explaining throughout - excellent English and very funny as well. The girls were the drivers who handled the chaotic traffic with great skill and chatted to us throughout. Then there were some men who drove around us as some form of security which was nice and reassuring.

We stopped at 5 different venues throughout the city and you get out of the tourist distraction to other parts and learn a bit more about it all. The food is incredible and you can have a beer at each stop as well.

It is just such a fun experience and the XO team made it so easy and made you feel very safe. Some of the gaps between the stops can be 20 minutes or so, so you need to be prepared to wait on the back of the bike for this. I wouldn't drive in Ho Chi Minh, but this is the closest you can get to actually doing it safely! I can't recommend this highly enough, simply brilliant experience.

Loved this tour! - My daughter-in-Law and I went on the Foodie tour while in Ho Chi Mihn City. Was driven around on a motor scooter by a woman driver. It was so exciting! The traffic is crazy. It was good to be in the middle of all the craziness! They took us to 3 different restaurants and 2 different parts of Ho chi Mihn city. The drivers were very informative. It was so much fun! I recommend this tour.

Great night. Must do!!!!!! - My partner and I did both the sights tour and the foodie tour with XO. The foodie tour was without a doubt the best night we had on our Vietnam holiday. The tour leader was a great host and all the girls were hilarious. We covered a fair distance during the tour and always felt completely safe on the back of the scooters. Also, the food was incredible and was a true Vietnamese cuisine experience. There were some interesting menu options for the brave, not to mention the free beer! We've since recommended the tour to other people on our travels as it truly is an unforgettable night. 5 stars.
Amazing tours. - We had an amazing day and night with our sweet guides. We took the sights tour and the foodie tour and it was both perfect. Perfect tour and food.

An unforgettable experience - My friend and I both recently did the "Foodie Tour" with XO Tours and I must say it was one of the most exciting experiences of my life. Being in my late 60's & my friend late 70's we were initially a little apprehensive about a motorbike tour & all that chaotic traffic, but I have to say if I were in my 80's or even 90's I would do it all over again!
XO Tours has to be the most professional tour company I have ever dealt with. From the initial booking online where communication was excellent to the tour itself I would rate it 10 out of 10. The drivers themselves are delightful & very professional, not to mention extremely careful & safe drivers. They have a wonderful sense of humor and make the tour such a joy to be with them. It really is the "only" way to see this fascinating city & the bonus is all the wonderful food you get to eat along the way. An XO Tours guide meets you at every stop & gives a rundown on the area & also takes photos of every group member. These photos were waiting in my inbox on my return.
If visiting Saigon do yourself a favor & book an XO Tour, it will probably be the highlight of your entire holiday.

A must-do in Saigon - My wife and I booked the tour for our last night and Saigon and it sent us off well. She had told me about the tours several times before we had gotten to Saigon. XO tours are prompt in communications and pleasant to deal with. Heads up, book 2 days in advance if you plan to pay with something other than cash. Our guides met us on time and scooted us off to the first meal where our tour guide Tai told us about the plans for the evening and got everyone acquainted with each other. We were on the foodie tour which goes from 530-10 in the evening. The food was great, guides were great, the experience of getting out of district 1 and seeing different parts of the city by scooter was a lot of fun.

Highlight of HCMC - I'm so glad my friends and I decided to book with XO Tours. If you're planning on visiting HCMC, this tour is a must! Most will tourists only ever see one district within the city because things are so spread out. We were so happy to visit several other districts to get a better feel for the city outside of the main tourist area. The Chinatown market was definitely a highlight.

Despite the craziness of HCMC traffic, we always felt completely safe of the tour. All of the drivers were excellent, and being on the bike is somehow a lot less scary than trying to cross the street as a pedestrian. The girls were really great guides and pointed out lots of interesting sights along the way.

The food was very tasty and there is no way you can leave this tour hungry! They were also very accommodating with my dietary restrictions (no pork or beef), which can be a challenge in Vietnam. Make sure to pace yourself as you eat or you'll be too full by the end!

I can't recommend this tour enough. It's worth the money for a great evening out!

A great way to explore Saigon! - We didnt have much time in Saigon so booked the half day sight tour with XO tours. The booking process was smooth. We were met by our 2 young ladies Lin and Thao (sorry if I missed the names), and they drove us to the meeting point for the tour which entails of 6 people.

The tour was fun. We were quite nervous getting onto the motorbikes because the traffic in Saigon is chaotic but the girls were brilliant and safe drivers. We went to see some major sights as well as some local sights including the local market and sampled some nice local desserts.

Understand our tour guide was great, knowledgeable and enthusiastic. We learn a great deal about Vietnamese culture and the meaning of various sights.

Would highly recommend this tour company.

Amazing tour! - We honestly had such a great time on this tour! The novelty of being on the bikes coupled with the friendliness of the drivers made for an amazing day. We did the sightseeing tour and got to see a lot of sights but we were also treated to some very welcome refreshments at the market on the way. Our drivers were SO fun and did what they could to ensure we were having a good time, we laughed so much!

All the other ratings are correct--this is a must!!! - Spent a much too brief weekend in HCMC and had booked for the evening foodie tour. This was without a doubt the best tour I have been on. Anywhere. Previous reviews are right--the wonderful, humorous and engaging guides pick you up promptly at 5:20pm at your hotel. I had the fortune of having Lien as my guide, who was not only fun and engaging, but a great driver---although it is an adventure cruising through HCMC traffic, her superior driving skills made this a fun and safe adventure. Although you get picked up individually, you meet up with other tour members (we were 9 in total) at the first food stop (there are 3 food stops and 2 sightseeing stops). Khoi was the tour leader who rallied everyone together at these stops; and was personable, funny, and informative (and yes, he remembers everyone's name). In sum, the tour is fantastic because the city, the people who run the tour, and the food are all fantastic. Do not miss this!!!

Fantastic way to see the city - Saigon traffic is rightly famous for its chaotic nature so becoming part of it on a vintage Vespa is certainly a memorable experience. I am not a 'biker' in any sense of the word and having booked this activity in the UK, I was more than a little apprehensive before embarking on this adventure.
But I needn't have worried the expert drivers ensured that I, along with my wife and 14-year-old son, felt 100 per cent safe as we weaved in and out of the thousands of other bikes and cars. Our guide was knowledgeable and entertaining and we saw parts of the city we would never have found on our own.
All in all a first class experience everyone should try.

Perfect Activity for the first (or only) night in the city! - We loved it! Awesome motorbike rides, super friendly and fun staff, delicious and exotic food. Although everyone on the tour was westernized, the experience felt authentic. We got to see a lot of the city and the staff gave us great information. We based the rest of our stay on what we had discovered while on the tour. Definitely book!

An excellent Night Time exploration of the streets of Saigon - I joined the "Saigon by Night" tour which is slightly shorter tour than the "Foodie" tour that XO is more famous for. We saw the evening market in Cholon, had a lovely local dinner of "Com Tam" (grilled pork chops on broken rice) and drove through about 5 districts of Ho Chi Minh, finally ending up with a lovely local dessert. The guides / drivers were quite knowledgeable and went out of their way to be gracious hosts on the tour. I'd highly recommend the experience of an XO tour to get a feel of the manic night time energy of Saigon.

Saigon Street Food Tour with XO - My husband and our friends did the XO Foodie tour during our 3 night stay in Saigon, and it was an absolute highlight. The guides, riders, information and food we received was a great introduction to life and street food for locals. We visited 5 different districts. After being completely amazed & overwhelmed at the crazy traffic in Saigon it was really interesting to be on the back of a motorbike and see how seamlessly it all flows and keeps moving. That experience in itself was amazing let alone the delicious food, sensory overload of sights and the fabulous riders. My lovely lady was Loan, she answered all my many questions and gave me lots of local information, the team we were with were fun, informative and we had a great laugh and an enjoyable experience. Thank you Koi and Team, keep up the great work.

Foodie and sightseeing tours - Did the foodie tour and the sight seeding tour. Excellent and knowledgable drivers, felt very safe on the bikes with them especially with the traffic in HCMC. Excellent variety of food on the foodie tour with all the info about the food and locations and also with the sightseeing tour all the info and history was excellent. Also had trouble with my hip on the first tour, I thought bike may have been too small for me, but XO took us back to hotel in taxi and paid for and was always there to assist on the next tour, highly recommend

I'm still excited! - On the top 10 list of things I have done! and I've done a lot! As a single female traveler this was perfect! I can't fault one thing they did, I am so impressed! everyone every age should do this! Just go!

XO Tour "Saigon by night" - I had a wonderful time on a Saturday night visiting various districts of Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) on a motorcycle. My motorcycle driver, Binh, was really fun, kind and helpful. She took excellent care of me and showed me an interesting side of life in Vietnam. Tuan, the tour group leader, was well-versed in Vietnamese culture, cuisine and history, and shared some interesting photos and stories of Saigon. Overall, it was a fascinating and well-organized tour.
fun, safe, and memorable - Very well organized and a great experience. Highly recommend. The Girls are lovely and excellent Riders.

Great scooters around town. - Did dinner food tour. Pick up was easy. The girls are very professional and look fantastic in their uniforms. The guy that does the actual tour at the stops (Thi?) was amazing, reminding everyone's names. It's definitely on the more expensive side, but we'll worth it. We felt confident scooting around Saigon with XO!

A tour every foodie will love! - I just want to say I had a fantastic time going on the foodie tour. The food offered were extremely delicious...definitely some of the best I had during my stay in Saigon. The host Tai did an excellent job informing about the food we were eating as well as the parts of the city we visited. My driver Thao did a great job taking me safely from one spot to another. I would do it tour again and again.

Would give 10 *'s if they let me! - We did the evening food tour on May 18th and had so much fun. Our drivers, Ngan and Nhi, picked us up promptly at 5:20 so don't be late! The whole evening ran like clockwork though did not feel staged at all. I was a bit nervous about the scooter ride thru the crazy streets of Saigon, but was riding hands free by the end of the night. The girls were very professional and safe drivers. They also share a lot of information about Vietnam and the culture. Hieu was the orchestrator for the whole group which made up 16 people. He somehow keeps track of everyone by name. Impressive! They do a nice mix of touring the city, stopping for informative facts, and eating the different foods. We tasted everything from frog to quail to goat, and beers were abundant. Loved the scallops!! It is all you can eat and drink so a good value. I especially enjoyed seeing so much of the city (we rode close to 30 Kim's) that we never would have visited. They send pictures to you a few days later, so do not worry about bringing a camera. The photo quality was also excellent and at no added cost. Strongly recommend as this was one of the best tours I have done anywhere.

Saigon is more than District 1- The Foodie Tour - Had a fun time for our last night in Vietnam. Only regret is that we didn't do this tour sooner. The tour let us explore many places we wouldn't have otherwise seen in Saigon. Great, friendly guides and Tai our overall tour leader was phenomenal. Aside from the food, beer, and guides, this tour is also a great way to meet other travelers from around the world.

Foodie Tour - We truly enjoyed the tour! The girls and tour leader are really informative and friendly, gave first class service. They speak good English, so no worries about communication.

Tip: do the tour on the first day of your arrival if you are coming to HCM for the first time.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - On recommendation from several groups of friends we organized the Foodie Tour. We are a group of 4 adults in our early fifties, having not been on the back of a scooter for years, wondering how we would go. The girls are such safe drivers, and the whole evening is very professional but friendly.

We went to 3 different districts where we stopped and ate in the different style cafes. The hosts always make sure we were enjoying the food, were having enough food and drinks. Their English was excellent together with the host, who was taking photos of us and then several days after the tour we received an email with photos of the evening - this was a lovely touch. We were also given explanations at each stop.

An extremely enjoyable evening, and comes highly recommended as a must do!
Thank you for a really fun evening.

An amazing experience - We did 2 sight seeing tours with xo tour company, the city sights and the foodie tour. One was by day and the other mainly at night. Both were fabulous.

The girls who drove the motor cycles made the events unforgettable. They were talkative, spoke great English, attentive to our needs and going beyond expectations. We and they were sad to part company, especially as we'd been fortunate to have a couple of the same girls for both tours.

Tour guides who accompanied us were also personable and informative.

Photos from both events great keepsakes.

Tip for the foodie tour - starve yourself in preparation as the quality and quantity of food was unbelievable.

Foodie Tour - A Lot of Fun!!! - We took 'The Foodie' tour on a Saturday evening a few weeks back.

Ngan and Tam, our scooter drivers, were excellent hosts and we felt in safe hands on the back of their bikes. Being on the back of a scooter (our first time ever) in the midst of the traffic driven by our lovely drivers and seeing areas of Saigon further out than District 1 were the highlight of the tour.

The tour involved 3 food stops: the first in District 1 for soup (something other than Pho, nice touch). The second food stop was an huge outdoor BBQ spot that was teeming with locals. We had a long table for the tour group (12 guests in total) and tried a variety of BBQd meats and veggies along with some other Vietnamese delicacies. The final food stop was for delicious seafood, more Vietnamese delicacies (2 options for duck embryo! woohoo!) and dessert in District 4. This stop was actually our final stop and it was a short ride back across the river back to District 1. Tai, our very personable host, made sure everyone had enough food, drink and was comfortable. Our scooter drivers sat with us on the 2nd and 3rd stop, to help with the cooking and food preparation (cracking crab shells) and to keep things running smoothly.

The food stops were interspersed with stops in various areas along the way (chinatown, district 7...) for other views of Saigonese life. Tai, our host, gave us great insights and explanations at these stops.

There were opportunities for toilets at the food stops.

We thought that the email to us with a nice selection of photos taken during the evening by Tai was a very nice touch.

This is a very well thought out tour and we had a lovely evening.

FUN! FUN! FUN! - No need to add to the already said accolades about this tour - it is fun, the driving ladies ever so fun and friendly, food is great! Whipping through the streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter was WAY less scary than I thought it would be. So proud to have not fallen off! So happy to have taken this tour.

Yes, it is that good!! - Two of us non motorcyclists went for the food tour on first full night in Saigon. Really great fun, the traffic is bonkers, but never felt unsafe. The food and the experience was so enjoyable. Eat and drink all night, with each new district and restaurant a revelation.

Guests grouped together from around the world adding to the conversation.

Well organized, fun, friendly with great street food. So yes it is that good.

Wonderful food...amazing company! - These ladies are amazing. Thank you for taking us safely through the streets of Ho Chi Min City. You will not go hungry or thirsty on this trip...bring your appetite! Our organizer was also kind enough to celebrate my birthday with the tour group. We would recommend to anyone!

Very interesting tour, very friendly guides - I received the recommendation from
my seat neighbor in the plane and can absolutely recommend XO tours myself. I simply gave them a ring and my guide picked me up at the place and time agreed. The foodie tour not just gives you an insight into food, but the city and culture as well. Also, driving with the motorbike makes you feel almost like a local. No problem for them to organize veggie dishes for me, they offered hand sanitizer before food stops and photos were delivered to you after a couple of days. Not cheap, but worth every penny.

Saigon at night tour - I was pretty nervous prior to doing this tour as the streets of Saigon are manic, there was no need, the drivers are confident and above all more than competent at negotiating the streets.
We were picked up from outside our hotel and toured many districts stopping now and again to listen to the tour leader give an insight into each district.
We stopped for some street food which was really tasty, then stopped somewhere different for some desert.
An exhilarating tour with some bubbly female drivers, not to be missed.

Don't Miss This! - This is our 2nd time in VN and our 2nd time taking the XO Foodie Tour. The opportunity came up to partake of a private tour, and after the fantastic experience we had 18 months ago, we couldn't resist!

As were staying out of District 1, we met our team at the Opera House - host Tai and girls Thao and Thoo. They were all extremely friendly, chatty and just great fun. The girls delighted in joking around with my husband and I. We tried some delicious noodle soup dishes, walked around the night market in Chinatown, picked what we wanted to try at a BBQ smorgasbord, ate some exotic fruits we'd purchased at the market, gobbled street food of rice paper noodles with delicious bits added, and ate ice cream and smoothies for dessert. All the while, learning about this great city and our team's lives.

This is an experience not to be missed, especially for those new to Vietnam. It really is a great way to be introduced to this country.

DO IT!

One of the best tours I have ever done - FANTASTIC!!!!!
Im not a big"tour" fan really, but this was just fabulous in every way!!
I cannot rave about this tour enough.
The female drives are just WONDERFUL and biking through Saigon is just SO much fun.
Our guide, Ahn, was AWESOME and the food was GREAT!!!
Even my 80 year old mum (who was hesitant before we went) just LOVED it !! We will 100% do it again. SO MUCH FUN :)
Ten out of Ten X0 Tours !!!

An unforgettable night, unreal experience, Wanna go again!!! - We did the foodie tour, and so glad we did.

Our drivers Trang3 and Ngan3 had so much energy it was contagious, They really looked out for my lovely wife who was a little anxious to be in the Siagon traffic. The energy they bought made the night so exciting, and learning about them and their way of life was great.

Served food and beer up faster than you could keep up.

A safe environment with a few pretty much body guards (guys) that come along to ensure no trouble.

Food experience is unreal, your not going to get Pho or Spring Rolls, as you get that everywhere, eating at great places where the locals are.

Stop looking and just book it.

A must when visiting HCMC - The Xo foodie motorbike tour was without doubt the highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh City. Everything about the tour was great. We tasted a variety of great foods, visited districts we probably wouldn't have visited otherwise, and learned about local life and culture, all whilst having a laugh and lots of fun. The experience wouldn't have been as good if we didn't have the wonderful guides Ngan and Thuy, and tour manager Tai leading the way. My husband and I felt very safe in the hands of our lady bike drivers who provided commentary as we went between places. Then upon arriving at each place, Tai provided information on the food we were about to eat as well as any interesting facts about the area or customs. All of this with lots of laughs thrown in. Without knowing it, the girls and Tai gave me a birthday I will always remember.

Great tour! - Our tour of Saigon with trip leaders Sang and Thu Duong and the other girls were really wonderful! Amazed by their knowledge of the different parts of Saigon. They brought in really interesting facts about the socio-economic classes within Vietnam. Go for it if you're looking for something different!

Great way to see the city - Just got back from a great night on the foodie tour. Seeing the city from the back of a motorbike, with all the chaos of the traffic, lets you see things like the locals & the stops for food let us eat some fantastic food in places tourists wouldn't normally go. All of the ladies who were our "Pilots" for the night were so friendly, looked after us at every stop with showing us how best to enjoy the various dishes, as well as being safe drivers
Recommend doing this if you have an evening to spare in Saigon

Best tour I've ever had - When I first heard about the foodie tour, I was a little apathetic because of the high price tag. US$72 is the most I paid for anything in Vietnam. However, many people recommended it to me and once I looked up how great it does on tripadvisor, I decided to give it a shot. I am so glad that I did - yes, the price is high, but the quality of the tour is totally worth the money.

I was picked up by my guide, Canh, at 5:30 at my hotel and taken to our first stop. There, I got to try Bun Bo Hue, a beef and lemongrass soup. It was incredible! I'd never had that kind of Vietnamese soup before and I was really glad to try something other than pho. I liked that they explained what we were eating to us very well. I had the opportunity to sit with other people on the tour and get to know them, which was nice.

Our next stop was a sightseeing stop in Chinatown, which was interesting. However, we only stopped and left in the same place. I wish we had gotten to walk around a little bit - though we did get to see it on motorbike.

Next, we went to a barbecue place. WOW. This was amazing. We had selections of beef, goat, prawns, frog, okra, and fruit. It was fun to try more unusual foods such as goat and frog, but it was also nice to also have the prawn and okra (a bit more "normal" to me) as backup (I loved the goat but found that I'm not a frog kinda gal!). There was SO much food and they seriously didn't stop feeding us. I had to force myself to stop because we had one last stop!

Our next sightseeing stop is District 7, the richer area of ​​HCMC. This was definitely an interesting stop - I didn't know it even existed! I really enjoyed that they took us to so many districts (4,5,6,7,8!) because I really got to see so much of the city that I wouldn't have otherwise. The head guide, Tai (unsure on the spelling?) was very informed and gave us a lot of great information on every place we stopped.

Our final stop was a seafood place in District 4, the poorer area of ​​HCMC. I want to say this was my favorite place because I definitely loved it the most, but it's also hard for me to say that because I loved EVERY stop so much. Here, we had quail, crab (with chili and black pepper), scallops (with peanuts and vinegar), and clams (in a lemongrass broth). The quail was okay but the seafood was mind-blowingly excellent. Not gonna lie, I was a little scared to try street seafood but it was extremely delicious and tasted very fresh. In addition, we got the chance to try balut (duck embryo/ egg). It was definitely not something I would have eaten otherwise, and once I got past the mental block it was surprisingly quite good. We also had desserts - flan and coconut jelly. I don't really like dessert, but if you're a dessert fan, you'll love these! Our guide made it very clear that we could order more food if we wanted...I chose not to because I didn't want to get too full, but honestly I wish I had because I'm still craving those amazing scallops several days later.

My motorbike tour guide, Canh, was truly wonderful. She was talkative, friendly, and very attentive. I was traveling on my own, but she made sure that I was not alone for pretty much this whole tour, either seating me with other tourists or talking to me a bunch of myself. She was super well informed on the city and pointed out interesting historical /cultural spots to visit as well as places where she liked to eat and go out all throughout the city. Furthermore, she was a really excellent driver. I never once felt unsafe on the back of her bike, even in the hectic Saigon traffic. I feel super lucky to have had her as my guide because she did a GREAT job.

All in all, this is probably the best tour of any city I've ever had. I love that they combine history/culture/sightseeing with the most important thing about any city...food. The food was really excellent and varied. It was an experience I would not have gotten otherwise. Furthermore, they do a great job of making you feel safe and very valued on this trip - all of the tour guides will learn your name instantly and because it's a small group, they pay attention to you and make sure whatever you want or need is taken care of.

The only thing that gives me a little pause is that I am truly bothered by how XO tours seem to respond to negative reviews. I have nothing negative to say about my tour, but it seems that they do not respond well to criticism. I think that, as a business, it's important to take criticism well instead of getting defensive, which I don't see in their responses. However, like I said, I have nothing negative to say about my tour. In spite of this small thing, it was really the best tour of any city I have ever taken. I got back to my hotel that night full, overjoyed, and feeling well informed about HCMC and its culture. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a fun, intensive experience of the city and its food. I am a serious foodie myself and this was PERFECT for me. It was the best thing I did on my trip to Vietnam. I am a very, very satisfied customer. Thank you so much, XO Tours :).

Great Experience, Must Do in HCMC! - We had a great time seeing the sights of HCMC on the back of the scooters of our guides Ngap and Ngoc (sorry if we got your names wrong!). Their English was superb and they really took care to look after us and make sure we were enjoying ourselves. Our tour guide Anh and Sang were great too, informative and witty in humor which made 'history class' very interesting. Would highly recommend this tour for those looking to enjoy the sights of HCMC with A-class service and care!

excellent guides and food - This was one of the last things my wife and I did on our trip to Vietnam, and it was also one of the most memorable. We went on the Foodie Tour with a group of about 9 and had a great time. We loved chatting with our tour guides, especially our drivers Vy and Hu, who were fantastic. Everyone is friendly and the food was excellent. We felt like we learned a lot about the city and saw some things that we never would have had if we hadn't taken the tour and talked with the guides so much. It was also great riding around the city on the back of a motorbike (and a great way to cool down from the heat)! Would highly recommend.

Best activity I had in HCMC - We had a night tour of 3 people with 3 motorbikes, 3 lovely intelligent lady drivers that speak fluent English and a great guide called Sang Neguyen which was the group leader. My driver was a lady called Chup, that was very nice and has a lot of knowledge and my friends told me the same about their drivers.
the tour is highly recommended, and aspecially the night tour which is a little bit cooler in the heat of HCMC.

Fun ride around HCM - We took the Saigon by Night tour. Very well-organized, safe and well-run. Drivers and tour guides are friendly and professional. Some of the sights are perhaps more awe-inspiring for visitors from the first world (wet markets, busy streets etc), but nevertheless we got to see parts of the city that we would never have gotten to otherwise.

"Private Saigon by Night" tour - Absolutely great experience that we would highly recommend to anyone who would like to experience Saigon outside of typical tourist area and to get real feel of the city! Thu and Bing were great guides and drivers, made us feel very comfortable and shared with us a lot of great information. Although this is not food tour, we tried some very tasty local dishes. Great fun!

Best Tour i have ever been on EVER - Girlfriend and was in Ho Chi Minh City for 4 days, and the final day, we decided to go with a little tour callede Xo Tours. This was no mistake. The two lovely girls that came to pick us up where Tranh and Nhan. They where really good guides, and it made us feel welcome and like we knew them for like forever. Happy and really trying to make everything about "YOU" We went to all the districts and we ate all kinds of different foods. At the last stop where we had the final dinner, Tranh and Nhan where surprizing us with Duck in Embrio, also known as "Balot/balut" They had listened to us and made sure we got to try what we had wished for 😜 Thanks for making our last day in Ho Chi Minh City very memorable Thanks Xo Tours and thanks to the whole crew. Thanks for making us feel welcome and part of the family Live Jeanett and Thomas
Best food ever with coolest guides in HCMC! - More than 3 hours ride in HCMC with cool and lovely guides! Very good food and very nice atmosphere!

Fabulous fun and a great way to see HCM City - My wife and I had only 2 1/2 days in Ho Chi Minh City so wanted to see as much as we could without spending hours walking around.

What a fantastic experience we had with XO Tours.

We booked online via the XO Tours website and did the Sights tour on our 1st morning and the Foodie tour on our second night.

The girls are waiting at the front of your Hotel, and introduce themselves quickly and with great friendliness and humour. After a quick explanation, you're on the back of the bike and off into the chaotic traffic.

You are taken to a meeting spot to meet the Tour Leader and rendez-vous with the rest of the group. There's also the "security" team: another couple of guys who stay with the group, follow you if you wander off at any of the stops, and basically make sure that nothing goes wrong.

The Sights tour was really interesting and well organized. In 3 hours we made numerous stops where the relevance of the spot was clearly explained, along with famous pictures that we all knew being displayed on Tour Leader Anh's iPad. Very clever.

The Foodie tour was quite different, an exciting ride through the night streets (but with no less traffic), stopping at various food spots until you truly could not eat another mouthful. At each spot your girl will look after you and explain each of the treats. The food was varied and delicious, and our Tour Leader Sang was again excellent.

So, both tours were very interesting, lots of fun and well run, but the highlight is really these fantastic young girls. Their enthusiasm is infectious, their English is excellent, their riding skills are terrific and their sense of humor is wonderful. They talked to us the whole way, sharing stories about their country and their lives, and were also keen to hear about our family, where we were from, and what we were doing in Vietnam.

We were lucky to have Linh, Nhung, Ngan & Trang for our two tours, and we felt straight away both very safe in their hands in the madness of the HCM streets as well as completely engaged in their conversation. We love them!

Overall, XO Tours was one of the best things we did in Vietnam, and very very highly recommended,

See the city in a different way - Would thoroughly recommend this tour! The riders were really informative, friendly and made you feel safe throughout the trip. Our riders were Nhung and Tam. Their English was brilliant and they were full of interesting facts along the way. Our tour guide Any also spoke amazing English and had a good sense of humour. We saw parts of the city that we wouldn't have been able to see on foot. Don't worry about needing bike experience, this tour is appropriate for beginners. A must do while in Ho Chi Minh!

Best start to a Saigon holiday - This review is written 9 months after the tour, in the realization that we never reviewed them but really good given they were so fantastic.

Even sometime after the event, we often talk about our brilliant intro to Saigon, on the back of scooters with educated and intelligent guides, all women studying at university. The food was brilliant, the guiding was brilliant and you also got to see parts of the city you never would as a standard tourist in district 1. There can't be any better way to introduce yourself to Saigon or Vietnam.

Oh, what fun it is to ride... - With an XO Girl! My wife and I did the Foodie tour with XO Girls Vy and Ngoc. They had us smiling and laughing the whole trip! They were the most honorable hosts we could imagine! The food and drink were excellent and we never felt rushed or unsafe at any time. Great job girls!

Saigon City Night Tour - Wow! This is a definite MUST DO when visiting Saigon! The girls were brilliant, very informative and friendly. Both myself and friend Chris felt completely comfortable and safe in their care for the whole journey throught the districts of Saigon in the chaotic traffic. Our meal was fabulous and the tofu dessert delicious, who ever thought tofu could taste so good! Certainly a highlight of our trip. Thank you XO tours will be recommended to all our Australian friends.

Ecellent expirience. Great fun. - Its a great way to see and feel Ho chi min through what you see, how you feel and what you taste
The company is very organized . the drivers and the group leader are very professional. if you have time just do it you will enjoy a lot.

Amazing tour! - I would highly recommend this tour and do it again in a heartbeat. The guys who take you round are lovley and so kind.
You eat traditional food and they take you for sugarcane juice. We went to rubber trees and rice fields. They also took us to the tunnels.

Amazing fun day out would def do again.

Outstanding!! - This was a highlight of our holiday in Vietnam! We got to travel on the back of scooters driven by very entertaining, vibrant, enthusiastic ladies who knew the history & stories of Saigon. We got a tour around the city. We got to experience a bit of local life in this pumping city. We got to eat local food (yes that is an experience, but you have to try it!). We got to do all this with people we had never met before, but by the end of the night we were all laughing together like old friends!
If you visit Saigon & you don't take this tour, you haven't visited Saigon!
We will talk about this one for years!

A different way to see the city! - My friends and I traveled to Ho Chi Minh City for a brief 4 day catch up and wanted tours that were informative but covered off on most of the sights. We loved the Sights tour so much we decided to also do the Foodie tour a couple of days later. We had a blast on both - recommend it without hesitation to young and old. Despite the MAD traffic we felt completely safe and the scooter riders and tour guides were knowledgeable, professional and a lot of fun!

Best tour by a country mile. - The Girls were excellent defensive drivers ,making for a safe and still exciting trip round the city .Good stopping points with a great veriaty of things to see. Post office built by the same guy who built the Eiffle tower, Cathedral, flower market , fish market , Parliament building , Lots of interesting stories along the way. GREAT FUN & AN EXPERIENCE NOT TO BE MISSED
,

A must do! Really you gotta do it! - what an experience! These ladies are absolutely wonderful tour guides and were a delight to be with. we did the HMC tour followed by the foodie tour which everyone MUST do!

Private tour worth every VND - Wow! We only had 12 hours in HCMC before flying home after traveling north to south Vietnam. So we chose for a 3+ hour private tour as we couldn't make the standard start times. From the off XO staff made us feel welcome. For the two of us, we rode passenger on the back of the two girls' - Thao and Nhung - bikes. We also had our main guide, Tai on another bike and Hai who helped us negotiate the mad traffic safely. The girls in Ao Dai traditional dress talked to us the whole time and answered questions knowledgeably as we swerved through the rush hour streets. We stopped at various sites where Tai gave us the low down on culture and history. XO had planned what to do very carefully with western interests and our likely starting knowledge in mind. Yet Tai allowed some flexibility to cater to our requests on the day - we asked to taste the local sugar cane street drink. Welcome refreshment in the very hot end of April city. We ended up in one of the largest Chinese street markets I've ever seen. XO then made sure we were safely ensconced in a legit taxi back to the airport. A private tour is not cheap by Vietnam standards but it was very worthwhile for us and left a lasting impression on our last day in the country. XO even took photos en route and emailed them to us later. All in all a fantastic experience.

Why rate this company... Most say it is awesome... My rating is the same!!! Great job! - This is a great tour company. I basically live part time in HCMC and have done many tours with many different tour companies. This was a great evening out. Not only was my tour guide fantastic, I lucked out and was with a great bunch of people from all over the world. Don't hesitate... Book this tour...

Keep in mind that you are going to ride on a motor bike. It is completely safe, but I can see how it can scare some people. Don't worry... just enjoy.

As a note, I would not suggest for small kids... and you need to be able to get on the motor bike with no issues.

Fantastic way to see and feel a city - A night tour of the city as passengers on motor bikes driven by extrovert young females who felt like friends at the end of the night.
It was a very efficient, very organized and a marvelous tour. Gives a wonderful insight into this fascinating, vibrant city.
My wife and I with my daughter, husband and two granddaughters all thoroughly enjoyed the hair raising ride: the different districts, the foods and the social scenes will remain with us.
We were sent photos afterward which provided a lasting record of a truly memorable evening.

Excellent tour - a must when in Vietnam! - The tour was fantastic. Very well organized and it was great to be in a group with 5 other travelers. Some of the sights we saw were those we would not have seen without our guide; the guide books don't mention some of them. Each traveler had their own driver and moped and the group as a whole had a tour guide who told us about the sights we visited. There were added extras on our trip which were a wonderful surprise and made the experience even more memorable. This tour is absolutely worth the price and I have already recommended it to all my friends and family. Thank you XO Tours for such a brilliant, educational and exciting experience.

The best event in Saigon! - Thousands of people have reviewed this tour group, but my girlfriend, Lisa, and I loved it so much I feel obligated to throw my voice into the masses.

The best part about this tour was the individual guides that each tourist gets. Lisa and I got hosts, Tam and Nhung (not sure I'm spelling that correctly), who were absolutely wonderful. Had I realized how much fun we all would have had, I would have tried to book the same guides for another of XO's tours (we were on "Foodie"). I don't speak a bit of Vietnamese, but that didn't stop us from joking around the whole time, since their English is so good. I am genuinely unpleasant to be around, but you wouldn't know it from the warm conversation we had!

I also am not yet steady on the back of a motorbike, but this slim woman was able to manage perfectly fine with me on the back! Despite my general unease as a motorbike passenger, Tam had me comfortably appreciating the scenery as we toured several districts throughout Saigon. I was surprised to find I could talk with her easily, despite being amid the noise of Saigon traffic.

The tour focused around food, as you'd expect from the name. But we also stopped at a few key locations where our host, Hieu, taught us about the culture of Saigon. To my surprise, I learned quite a bit about what drives Vietnamese culture, from family structure to macroeconomics.

And the food was just amazing. We tried a huge variety of foods, designed to get you outside your comfort zone of Pho (the most popular Vietnamese soup). We had "normal" foods like grilled beef, to something more abnormal (bordering on gross to some). You're free to eat anything you'd like and as much as you'd like, so you're sure to find something to your tastes and get as much as you'd hope. What's more, your guide will be gracious enough to prepare the food for you - no more peeling your own prawns!

I did not particularly like Saigon and was much more comfortable outside the city. However, I loved this tour and consider it the best experience Saigon had to offer.

Night time - Street Food Scooter tour of Saigon! - Seeing Saigon from the back of a scooter as it slips in and out of traffic is a great way to see Saigon in its real street sense. The drivers are knowledgeable university educated who like to practise their english. They know the best street food stops and your guaranteed to have fun and see / eat a lot during this tour. We booked through our Hotel ( Finnegans ) and paid 35 usd each, the tour took three hours and we tipped each scooter driver an additional 50,000 dng. Its a great way to see the city that should not be missed.

Please take me out again. Simply the best time in town - Arriving at Hotel Majestic at 8am straight from the Reunification express we left our bags in the lobby to head out on our first day in this bustling city. Across the street we were greeted with the biggest smiles and the happiest of people form XO Tour in Linh and Oanh #2. After a quick safety brief we headed of in too the morning mayhem on our "Sights" Tour! What a great way to understand the city and it's history the guide meet us at each of the stops and went into great detail so it was wonderful learning experience and great opportunity for photos.
Both our rider in Linh and Oanh #2 were amazingly great fun and we had great conversations as we darted through the traffic.

The tour and the girls were so much fun that when we arrived back at our hotel and were able to booked on the we booked the "Foodie" tour for the following night and requested and were so lucky to have Linh and Oanh #2 as our riders.
