Again off out into the traffic this time it was evening peak hour, feeling very safe in the girls hands we were off to dinner. My wife has a serious allergy to Crustaceans, which was one of the reason we had not booked this tour in the first place, however Linh had mentioned that this was a great tour and that they could cater to this need. And they did the food was amazing the others on the tour were amazing, the locations we stopped at were amazing and the team went out of there way to ensure we were well feed, watered and safe.
I owe my sincere gratitude to Linh for suggesting this tour and for being such wonderful caring and fun host, guide and friend, we had not laughed that much in ages.

Deidre and I are so very glad we did this tour, both Linh, Oanh#2 and the guides were absolutely amazing, and the photos a great way to remember great times.

I highly recommend both tours if you are looking for a safe fun way to explore, with local people who love their work and visitors.

I look forward to one day return and no doubt will join another tour. #yum

Wonderful! - Don't think about it - just book it!
Everything about XO Tours was professional, efficient and fun. You may be a little apprehensive about riding a Scooter in Ho Chi Minh City - don't be. The Girls are amazing. They give you basic riding instructions, are very safe drivers and make you laugh! The Foodie Tour was great fun! Thanks for everything.

Exciting way to see the city - We took the night tour and saw the contrast of this large and vibrant city through several districts. It was exciting to ride among the locals in the rush hour. The girls were safe drivers and our guide He was very informative with a great sense of humour. We stopped at 2 places to eat. Anh was taking photos along the way to capture the moments.

COULD NOT BE BETTER! - We should have reviewed XO long ago, but the good news...is they have stayed so top of mind...I finally took the time THEY DESERVED! This type of thing was so NEW for a mom/young daughter couple from the US...we were a bit nervous about if it was for us! However, it was absolutely excellent in all ways. They really thought this tour out - such a behind the scenes opportunity, with the most kind people we could have ever asked for! Thank you for making this a highlight of our trip!

XO.....lent - This tour was professionally run from the moment we booked on line to the moment we were dropped off at our hotel by the friendliest, funniest and most knowledgable guides around. We had a ball zipping around the streets of Saigon, seeing, feeling, smelling and most importantly tasting our way around to places we just wouldn't have ventured to otherwise. Thanks XO. Brilliant.
Brilliant tour - This tour was brilliant - the girls so competent on their bikes, very friendly and informative about HCM city. Absolutely recommend this tour - it's a must do!

Foodie Tour - the best experience! - We did the foodie tour last night with high expectations after reading the reviews and friends' recommendations - and it was even better than we expected. The overall guide had such a great sense of humor and the girls were so easy to speak to - their English was flawless. Each dish was amazing and they took into account food allergies by providing delicious alternatives. We never felt unsafe on the bikes and their 'security team' were quick to move on a roadside seller who was headed over to us. From the beef noodle soup to the 'jumping chicken' to the most amazing cream custard dessert - everything was excellent. We can't recommend these guys and girls enough - completely professional - a fantastic team. Thank you XO Tours - you are the best!

Foodie tour of Ho Chi Minh City - This is a tour catered for all foodies, especially non vegetarians. Even though you feel its a bit highly priced, the experience and quality of service and food is awesome. Special mention to the tour manager and the lady guide who is always at your service and goes out of their way to make you feel comfortable. A must experience tour when in Vietnam

A must-have when in Ho Chi Minh City - This was by far the best thing we did in Vietnam. I must admit to being slightly nervous (never having been on the back of a bike before and taking along our 14 year old son) but within minutes of driving, those fears were gone and we all had the best time. The food was great, eating in places that probably tourists wouldn't have found and possibly wouldn't have eaten in. The whole evening was well organized and we felt completely safe. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone!

Great city tour around Saigon - Awesome trip with local guides in SaiGon. They're using motorbikes to tour around Ho Chi Minh City so that i can see as much as possible while getting the local Vietnam experience. Thanksls

Fantastic!! - Booked the Foodie tour after reading all the great reviews and was definitely not disappointed. This tour was fantastic. The female staff were excellent, the main guide was knowledgeable and very funny and the food was delicious. Everything was on time, you could have as much food and beer / drinks as you wanted and literally everything was done for you, including de shelling the prawns and getting the meat crab out of the claws. Got to try really interesting and delicious food, and visited many districts we wouldn't normally have ventured to. The girls were great drivers and my partner and I felt safe at all times, and the HCM traffic is hectic to say the least! A big thanks to our guide Anh, he was excellent, and especially our drivers Hong Tong and Chang, you guys were brilliant and really made the tour special, we had a fantastic time and would recommend this tour without hesitation. Well worth the money and definitely a highlight of our 3 week Vietnam holiday.

So much fun...... - Our tour to see the sights & it was amazing, zooming through the streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter was fantastic. Theses girls know how to get around & make the tour superb, Anh was the best tour leader.......cheeky & ever so knowledgable !!
You seriously need to book with XO if you want the best tour.

Foodie Tour was awesome - Although I was a little put off by the price — and worried what my mum would say when she found out I had been riding around Saigon on the back of a motorbike — I bit the bullet and booked on to XO Tours' The Foodie Tour. I have no regrets: it was one of the best experiences of my Vietnam trip so far.

I've never ridden on a motorbike before but before long, I was relaxing into the ride as my friendly, funny driver He took me to various food spots across the city — we visited a total of five districts, from Cholon (district 5) to district 4 for excellent seafood. My favorite dishes were probably the beef noodle soup Hué (a beef broth soup with rice noodles), grilled prawns and some delicious scallops.

Along the way, our charming guide Hieu provides the group with entertaining and interesting details about Saigon, its districts and its food scene. I tried so many different dishes, including many things I would have never known (or dared) to order. By the end of the night, I was completely stuffed and had learned a lot.

So much fun! - This came recommended by friends and in the Lonely Planet. My friend was nervous about riding on a scooter but the girls made us feel so safe and it was exhilarating riding around a city like Ho Chi Minh. The staff were friendly and approachable and spoke excellent English. The food itself really expanded our horizons - delicacies, BBQ frog and the local beers were a highlight. Do it!

Best ever! - Well, where to start...

The Host, the drivers, the food, the narrative and the destinations were all above expectations.

Tia came with us the whole time, and saw to our needs. He explained what we would eat, where we would eat it and how to eat it.

The menu was adjusted for those with allergies or sensitivities, although he did press me to eat some or the local delacies - which by the way - tasted like chicken.

The drivers were tops. Newbies, who had never been on motorbikes before, were taken care of. I felt total confidence in their ability to negotiate the traffic, as did all in our group of 15.

We saw sights, and had explanations that matched the diversity we experienced. A handy little booklet with travel tips was given as well.

If you want to see and experience some of the real Saigon, do this tour. 10/10.

Sights of Saigon morning tour - Fantastic tour. It was the only way to see Saigon. The tour guides lyn and Quinn were delightful with excellent English. I suggest you book at least a week in advance as the tours are very popular. We missed out on the foody tour as it was fully booked.

XO Foodie Tour - A fabulous tour to do if you're tourist or new in town. We visited several eating places including street food and BBQ - all food was great and are guides were super helpful and funny. They took their roles as entertainers seriously, prepared food for us (I didn't peel a prawn on the whole trip) and were much more than drivers.

Fantastic and authentic tour! A must do in HCMC! - Our family (2 adults and a teenager) decided last minute to do the motorbike sights tour. This was our second last day of our two-week Vietnam travels and after being fascinated by the traffic during our trip we finally decided to get right into it. It was the best decision that we made. The tour is guided by young and experienced lady drivers. There is no reason to be scared or feel unsafe. I don't remember the last time I had a grin on my face for three hours. The tour stopped at many sights and we couldn't wait to get on the back of those motorbikes again (none of us is a motorbike driver by the way). It was so much fun and the tour very professional organized and executed. At the different sights there is a tour guide waiting for the group to explain the sight. We were very much impressed with the overall organization. Great way to experience the real Vietnam! Don't hesitate and go with XO tours. If we had more time we would have done a second motorbike tour with them!
Food tour - Amazing tour!! Highly recommend. Great food and interactions with the guide. I was a little nervous riding on the back of the motor but the girl made me feel safe and comfortable.

Fun, Informative and Exciting Tour - We conducted our research in advance so booked XO Tours based on other reviews. We were not disappointed and would thoroughly recommend them to anyone else visiting HCMC.

Khoi, Linh and Quynh 3 were fun and informative guides, being very personable, showing us both well and lesser know sights to this vibrant city. A motorbike is most certainly the best way to travel and having an experienced guide makes it even better.

Thank you.

Best tour guides ever! - Pham my wonderful tour guide came and picked us up at our hostel. Just before you go on the tour- be warned, there is a lot of food so make sure you have enough room in your stomach to fit it all in with about 3-4 different pit stops that all involve food! We started with a bowl of noodles, followed by a bbq and finished with seafood as well as a balut.

Riding around the streets of Saigon is amazing and you constantly feel very safe, having previously had my wallet stolen in Saigon it was reassuring having a whole entourage of security driving alongside us.

The history that is also included in the tour is a highlight along with the photos, conversations with other guests and my tour guide and games that are played along the way. It is so well organized, don't baulk at the price it is completely worth it!

A great way to taste real Vietnam - This tour is a must!
We were given the opportunity to try all kinds of cuisine we normally wouldn't order ourselves and at local restaurants
Also an amazing tour of the city to parts we otherwise would have never seen
The girls were super fun and very knowledgable about the city offering fun facts while you road on the back of their bike
Very well organized and fun!

Highlight :Dodging shoppers and chickens on moped through night market - An excellent way to get a taste of Saigon at night time in very safe hands
Anh was informative , witty and an excellent moped driver.
The pick up and drop off went smoothly and on time. The chosen venues were well thought out and the food was great , with assistance on how to approach eating it ...
A good introduction to my first night in Saigon

Amazing way to see the city! - We had a group of six people and did both day and night tours. Great experience and all felt like we had our own personal guide throughout the city. The girls are friendly, knowledgeable and super fun. Loved seeing them navigate through a hundred other bikes like it was nothing. Food was great too and would highly recommend either tour.

Great to do with kids - We had a great evening with our kids aged 11.9 and 4. The hosts and riders were so kind and professional. We felt very safe and looked after. It really was great to see the city from the back of a bike. The kids were even taken for ice cream. A great tour I would recommend to families.

Foodie tour!! Amazon - I highly recommend the foodie tour for everyone! Our tour lead, Tai was super knowledgeable and just as much was my new buddy Thao. Who rides me around everywhere. She was awesome! Many different types of food were tasted, each as delicious as the others, but completely different in flavor. Loved it and great job XO tours!

Great way to see the city! - I did both the foodie and the sights tours. The service was impeccable, from pick up to drop off. The girls are amazing riders, and what helped me most was that from the back of the bike, I could better understand the way traffic works in this crazy city. It's easier to cross the road after you've seen it from the perspective of the rider. My only less positive feedback is that there's quite a few staged things like photo's where you're apparently riding the bike etc, that makes this tour feel a little fake. However, no big deal, I still highly recommend XO tours. They're #1 for a reason.

Foodie tour - This is our third time in Vietnam and this tour is easily the best and most fun thing we have experienced here.
The three fun patient and friendly XO ladies led by Thu Duong made this an unforgetable exciting night for both my wife myself and our 18 year old daughter Kim.
Forget any doubts or hesitations you may have, this is a professionally run business with a very warm personal touch which will leave you with nothing but good memories.
Thank you again to all three ladies.

Scooter Tour - Linh and Nung our lady scooter drivers were absolutely legendary. So friendly and full of questions and information. Anh our group leader was funny and a wealth of information. To be honest I am not fond of Hoh Chi Min City traffic but the lady's were amazingly skillfully drivers. That and taking a chill pill made things easier. A must do in Hoh Chi Min City.

Great fun & one-on-one tour - XO tours was a great surprise, all the girls were lovely & knowledgable, they were also safe drivers, I felt at ease from the start, even in the busiest traffic. Our tour leader Tuan was excellent, he was very impressive with his insights into the city. We saw 5 different districts, all different & our meal at the market was really good. Thanks for the fun time.
Kim & Bob, Elena & Franco

Best part of our trip to Saigon - We ended up taking two tours with XO, the foodie was first and the one we had booked from home. It's a shame to spoil individual elements of this tour, it needs to be experienced to be believed. The drivers were competent, communicative and so funny! Clearly the best way to see Saigon is on the back of a bike and we felt safe the entire time. There are a number of stops covering many districts that we could never possibly have seen on our own. Chinatown at night is a must see. The food was authentic and unbelievably delicious, experienced in restaurants that were full of locals. There was no tour, other than ours, at any restaurant at the same time.

Having enjoyed the foodie tour and been suitably impressed with XO, we decided to book The Sights tour on our return to Saigon, which was the last day of our trip. You can see the route on their website, it covers a few districts and includes the general post office, reunification palace, Chinatown and more. This tour was equally enjoyable and well organized.

I would recommend taking both of the tours if time and budget allow. If you have time for just one, I recommend the foodie. It's longer, there are a few beers involved if you like, the guides are knowledgable about their city as well as being fun and the food is great. We took the tour with friends who have lived in Saigon for about 8 months and all three agreed it was the best experience they've had in all that time.

Saigon by night - what a great start to our trip - We're a family of 4 (daughters 15 and 12) and kicked off SE Asia holiday in Saigon with XO Tours Saigon by Night. I thought it would be good but it exceeded expectations. Our (all girl) motorbike leaders were great, perfect tour guides, we saw loads of different parts of the city (as promised) and the street food stops in different places were perfect - especially the desserts in district 4 at the end. Also got a lot of information both in the structured bits of the tour but also just asking questions on the back of the bike. Saigon is high octane and a motorbike city so this is the perfect way to see it - from in the middle of the chaos. Not cheap at $45 per head but a great evening, totally memorable and more than enough to eat. Our girls were fairly gobsmacked. Totally recommend

Wonderful Evening in Ho Chi Minh City - Our group of 16 seniors decided to try the XO Foodie Tour ..... and are we glad that we did!

This tour gives you a whole new perspective on the City. First of all it is very professionally run to the benefit of both the motorbike drivers and the guests. Ahn Pham, the Tour Leader and his crew not only ensured everyones safety but did a wonderful job interacting with the group. The drivers themselves were simply great. Personable, fun loving and very good at moving their passengers thru the various districts of Ho Chi Minh City. A couple of our group were very apprehensive at the beginning but totally enjoyed the ride.

We saw parts of HCMC we will never have seen, really felt the traffic flow, and of course ate things we will never eat again. The pictures the crew took of us while on the trip are priceless.

I know all of our group was sad when the evening ended. A tour to truly remember.

Oh what a night. - Finally this is our third trip to Vietnam and HCM city and had tried on the previous trip to book the XO foodie tour. .
Met the girls, beautiful, friendly, smart and made you feel easy from the start. The night inluded fantastic ride through several districts of HCM and dined on , goat, frog, duck, quail, Pho and every type of seafood available.
The girls kept a running commentary while whizzing thru the streets and at no time did any of us feel unsafe.

5 hours later, the end of our tour, thankyou XO girls, a great time

So much fun - My sister and I did the evening food tour. It was fantastic. We were with a small group but felt so well looked after. The traffic in Ho Chi Minh is quite crazy but we both felt so incredibly safe on the back of the bikes. We visited a few street stalls and stopped for dinner. It was so much fun and I cannot recommend this group enough.

City Tour and Foodies Tour - I first went on the Siagon City Tour and my host Trang was fantastic. She was on time at the doorstep of my motel as promised and felt Trang was a true champion rider. The tour manager Tie was a champion himself and full of local knowledge with the ability of reminding everyones names which I found amazing, a true professional yet connected with everyone of us. I then went on the Street food tour and my host Linh was also amazing. She to was on time as promised and navigating the busy streets with the millions of other scooters was cool. The street food stalls we visited were great. The highlight for me was the visit to the BBQ market were our hosts cooked an array of meats with some veggies. Again the tour manager for that evening was Tie and again he was fun and informative throughout the evening. 2 amazing tours which I recommend for anyone.

Back of the Bike Night Tour - How fun! The tour guides were really professional and interesting. They brought us to lots of different places in HCMC. We got to try different food and experience how it feels to ride the famous bikes around Saigon!

So Much Fun!! - Hubby and I did the Saigon by Night Tour in early March. There were 5 of us all together. We had an amazing night, although it seemed to go by so quickly. Our riders/guides Anh and Ngan were an absolute delight! We got to see other districts we normally wouldn't know of visiting being our first time to Vietnam- with each one so much different from the other, from the traditional Chinese market area to the new and modern District 7 over the Saigon river.
The experience of riding through the crazy traffic was fantastic! You definitely get a feel for the way it all works by being on the back of a scooter. Not scary at all! I can appreciate why the locals wear masks as the fumes certainly get to you after awhile.
The girls were a wealth of information about everywhere we went. We had the best night! The food was yummy too.
We will definitely be back one day to do another tour with XO. Keep up the good work!

Brilliant!!!! - I have never been on a bike before but was determined to try something different while in Ho Chi Minh. Thank you XO tours for an exhilarating ride through the always packed streets of this wonderful city. The ride around itself the various districts would have been worth for money but the food stops from the Hue beef and lemongrass soup to the new experience of grilled goat, frog and quail topped off a great night.
The food was varied, tasty and abundant and was shared with a variety of travelers of different ages and from all over the world. Our guide, Huie made sure that if there was anything we could not eat that a suitable substitute dish was provided. He knew so much about his city and as we stopped in different districts he provided us with an entertaining and thoroughly informative insight into each one.
Our drivers Tien and Ngoc navigated us safely and confidently from place to place while providing us with interesting snippets of information about their city. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. If you take the opportunity to go to Ho Chi Minh make sure you do not miss this experience.
Short visit to Saigon - Great night out for all. Girls are fantastic, food excellent. If you want to feel welcome, safe and special, take the tour. Jerome

Truly amazing adventure to end our holiday - Thank you XO tours for our amazing scooter foodie tour. Words cannot express how excited, thrilled and happy we were taking this tour. If you want fun, food (lots of it) and to see the real Vietnam and what their culture is then this tour is for you. The girls on the scooters are amazing riders and their English is fantastic, you will get to be a local weaving in and out of Saigon's hectic traffic. Thank you especially to Truc and Linh for an awesome time. We visited many districts and tried all sorts of street foods which were so delicious. They even organized a surprise anniversary cake for our 10 year anniversary. celebration. Thank you for understanding our very professional and intelligent tour guide. I can listen to you talk about Vietnam all day. Also thank you to our video and camera guys i cant wait to see our video and photos that you captured of the whole tour.
We will recommend anyone coming to Vietnam to do this tour, you guys are amazing and beautiful people and we will never forget what you did for us. We hope to be back very soon.
Come on!
Alisia and Joseph from Sydney, Australia

Fabulous! Cant rate highly enough! - We wanted to get an authentic food tour. This tour definitely delivered and had the added bonus of being at night and on the back of mopeds. We had a really great night. And what really struck me was how well run, efficient and professional the tour was. We were collected from our hotel by our 2 guides, gave a safety briefing on the bikes and on to the XO head quarters to meet our group for the night where we had course 1. We then went around the city visiting authentic and different places for more courses. There was a huge selection of foods, given in small enough quantities so that you dont fill yourself up on just one type of food. Fear not, if you want more food (not that you will need it), XO is more than happy to provide it. They also brought us through the night market at the heart of Vietnamese Ho Chi Minh, well away from the tourist end of the city. They also bring you into lots of different areas of the city that you will never get to see. The girls who drive the bikes are just great, great fun, chatty and interesting. I was delighted to have Canh as my driver - really great girl who was delighted to teach me a few Vietnamese words/phrases (and who I hope can remember the Irish that I taught her!!). Anh, who runs the tours, is a really nice guy, very professional with interesting stories. All in all, this is a must do tour!!! Really really enjoyed it.

Night Foodie tour great and yum - This would have been one of the best experiences we have done.
The whole night was just a great time.
I plus 1 lady in our party were a bit worried about getting on a motor bike in HCMC but we had a great time, and the girls made us feel safe.
I traveled with Hong, and she was wonderful, told me a lot about HCMC and life in Vietnam.
Food was great, and if you want plenty of drinks
A truly great experience

Our best experience in Saigon - Our first trip exceeded expectations by miles, so we booked another - the ultimate award. Above all it was fun, made all the better by the four chatty English speaking drivers we met as well as the supremely professional tour guide Khoi who was charming and very knowledgeable. Ticked every box. Thank you XO!

Saigon By Night Was a Delight!! - Best tour ever! Our guides Thu and Han were excellent, thoughtful and funny! They were great drivers too! Tour is well organized and very professional, yet it was the most fun we've had on a tour. Would recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC. Thanks for the most memorable experience and the pics too!

Wow!! - Words can't describe how great our experience was with XO. This was one of our top three experiences during our two week trip in Vietnam. We chose to do the foodie tour. Our guides were experienced drivers, very outgoing and upbeat. The food was excellent as well. Seeing HCMC by motor bike is amazing and something we won't forget. Plus we were given a good overview on each district we stopped in. Another reviewer stated that they could have done without all of the interaction with the girls, but we couldn't agree less with their statements. The girls make the tour, they help with food preparation, explanation of things and the entertaining. We don't review a lot of things, but XO deserved a review. Can't wait to come back and go out with XO again! LOVED IT

Fantastic !!! The REAL Saigon, HCMC highlights - We traveled a LOT and this was the best tour we've done in a long time! After several days in HCMC we were less than enamoured of the city, we found it a bit bland, boring and lacking a soul (we'd only visited District 1). My 8 year old & I took the Saigon by night tour on our final evening and it completely changed our opinion of Saigon, it has an awesome soul, just NOT in District 1 ! Our drivers Thu & Nhung2 and our guide Tuan were fantastic, they all spoke great English and were very careful drivers. We zoomed all over the city checking out food and sights in different districts. I wish we had more time to do the daytime tour, next time for sure :)

Great fun - My daughter and I had the morning to fill in so we decided to go on an XO Tour and it was fantastic, our riders Thao & Anh were gorgeous, funny & safe riders, they spoke really good English as did our guide who was very informative. Loved the drink that they arranged along the ride & the fruit. So glad we decided to do it, great way to see Ho Chi Minh.

The foodie tour was excellent! - I had a great time doing the foodie tour. It involves three food stops, several sights on the motorbike along the way and two additional stops in different districts. They certainly show you a wide cross-section of the city, from the poorest to the most affluent neighborhoods.

The food was really excellent and they worked really hard at explaining everything and even peeling the seafood for you. And, I can honestly say that most of the food was new to me and that's saying a lot as I'm pretty well-versed on Vietnamese food.

Finally, but most importantly, the driver women were super friendly, funny and knowledgeable. They were great.

I only have one constructive criticism, and that relates more to the non-food aspect of the tour. It would have been nice to have 5-10 minutes per place to look around and take some quick pictures. Although I realize that would likely add another hour to the tour, but I wouldn't have minded that.

Highlight of our Vietnam vacation - Our group of 7 took the Foodie Tour with XO Tours and without a doubt, it turned out to be the highlight of our Vietnam vacation Almost 2 weeks later, we are still talking about how this was the most memorable and unique experience while we were in Vietnam. The drivers and the entire staff definitely added to the incredible experience and provide you a perspective of being on the scooter (instead of in front, around, or behind them). Tai, our tour manager, kept us thoroughly informed and entertained for the entire tour, pointing our interesting sites and providing us tidbits of our tour stops. As advertised on their site, the Foodie tour is a combination of eating and sightseeing throughout Saigon. You definitely get your money's worth between the variety of food you get to eat (go hungry!) and the various unique sites you get to visit. The drivers basically take care of everything from driving you around, to grilling your foods, and even de-shelling the seafood! You basically just need to get on/off their scooters, sit for each meal, and just enjoy yourself.

I would not hesitate to recommend this tour to anyone looking to get a unique, memorable, and most definitely fun tour of Saigon.

Great tour of the city - I really enjoyed the XO food tour. I absolutely loved going on the motor bikes as i hadn't been on one for ages! They're very safe drivers and they interact with you along the way. I wasn't sure what to expect of the food but quite a lot of it was really yummy and adventurous. The lady's were all very lovely and spoke good English and made it a really great experience!
Really good fun evening out - We went on the foodie evening tour. Really friendly, informative drivers. Felt safe even in the rush hour! Lots of different foods to try out. Would highly recommend.

Well, it's worth it... - My wife and I did the day tour and the Foodie tour on the same day. Easily do-able and both very interesting for different reasons. The riders are great being very proficient and safe in the chaotic traffic that is HCMC.

The day tour was extremely interesting from historical and cultural perspectives. Saw many areas which I recognized and a few myths were 'busted'.

Foodie tour was also good, again very safe and the ride on the bikes in the relatively cool of the evening was a nice change. Food was delicious and some interesting choices were available if you were game.

Tours like these are what makes travel such fun. Local knowledge is a must otherwise you will miss some important or significant sight. Is also a great opportunity to ask some questions about shopping, restaurants etc.

Many thanks to all those forms XO Tours, we enjoyed ourselves very much.

Excellent Foodie Tour - My husband and I did this tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh, we got to try many different types of Vietnamese foods, from Bun Bo Hue to barbeque to the fertile eggs (didn't try these). But it was really fun, the girls that we had were a hoot and very cheeky which was great, my husband and I were on our honeymoon and we were the punchline of many jokes which was good fun. But the girls definitely made it for us, we would highly recommend this to any traveler, however I would probably do this tour at the start of your time in Ho Chi Minh not the last night.

amazing food, experience out of this world. - my friend and myself went on this tour in late march and had the most awesome time. From the moment we were picked up we were welcomed into the group, all of the bike riders were so friendly and made sure that everyone ate plenty, drank plenty and enjoyed the evening. Would highly recommend this tour to all.

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh City ! - We did the XO food tour on our first night in the city. I've never been on a motorbike in my life so I was a little nervous! No need at all, the girls were amazing. Really safe drivers and very friendly . I felt at ease straight away. They are so professional in the way they look after you. I have done several other food tours in Vietnam but this was by far the best. So organized and the food is really good. I tried things I didn't think I would , mostly seafood like scallops a and clams , a first for me. I am now converted 😊
I had a wonderful and memorable evening. Thank you so much xx

Fantastic night tour - This is undoubtedly the best way to see Saigon at night. The traffic is mental but the girls are brilliant riders and you feel extremely safe with them. They also speak very good English and were chatty throughout the trip. You get a choice of food at a bbq place which is very tasty and authentic and it's a great way to see parts of the city you wouldn't normally visit and to hear about some of the local history.

Great foodie tour - We did an evening foodie tour that was lots of fun. You ride on the back of a motorbike (with a helmet and an excellent driver), but this is not for the faint of heart. You will stop and eat at 3 places and also get to see the whole city. We had lots of fun and recommend this tour for the adventurous traveler!

Awesome food motorbike tour - My wife and I did the foodie night motorbike tour. My wife had never been on a bike before and was slightly nervous, but very soon felt completely comfortable whizzing round the hectic streets of Ho Chi Minh City in the hands of her driver. The girls and our 'supreme leader' Anh were brilliant, very knowledgeable and you can tell they just love their jobs. The tour was very well organised, all the food was brilliant and a great chance to try the local food, we were glad we did the tour on our first night in Vietnam. My wife doesn't like seafood and had told them this at booking, they brought her lots of alternative dishes at each of the stops.

First time on scooter - After the raving reviews my wife insisted we took the foodie tour. Only then did I admit to her I've never been on a scooter. After her laughter subsided, we emailed the company and booked on for 2 days later easy as that. We were picked up from our hotel by two lovely young ladies....I felt sorry for who ever got me...They are so cute and small and were about to have a 6ft 15st lump that has no balance and no bike experience on the back of their ped. Well I can honestly say I've never felt so safe and loved every moment. They are great fun, so chatty and so friendly. These girls do amazing work and it really was a great and very filling night! All beer included in the price, you are not forced to try anything you do not want but I would say you should at least try, my wife eats only chicken and cannot do off the bone, yet she found she loved loads of these weird and wonderful dishes.

The best thing ever! - This a must do activity if visiting Saigon. Not only do you get to ride a scooter with a beautiful and safe female driver, but you visit 5 different districts with informative information, eat fantastic food and see a whole new side of the city. They even provided a cake for one of our couples on their honeymoon. Extremely friendly, fun and a great thing tondo at the start of your trip. Has been an absolute highlight!

You have to do this! - Absolute highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh. We took the morning tour and had an amazing experience traveling on the back of the bikes through the districts.
The girls were so much fun and took us to places we would never have done on our own in the short time we were there.
The traffic is mad but their driving skills were awesome.
Sooooo much FUN... A definite must do.
Loved it!

Great introduction to the city! - I took the morning tour with my 5-year old daughter. It was a great way to learn about the city and see some of the sights. Really friendly and knowledgeable tour guides. Definitely recommend!

A must-do XO bike tour! - What about HCM? Lots of good food, good shopping, good massage, rich history and the awesome Saigon River!

How about other than District 1? Those places XO buddies showed us are the best of the best.

First time on a bike, my experience is beyond description, pure joy!

Big thank you to big brother Tai, and our angels: Nhung, Canh, My2 & Truc2 for the unbelievable and beautiful experience.

Amos, Faith, Joshua & Tim
Singapore

Best time in HCMC! - Took both the morning and foodie tour and had the best time on both. Everything was perfectly organized, the girls were amazing and the tours were very interesting and authentic! I saw the sights as a local from the back of the most popular way of transportation in the country. The girls and the tour leaders were so knowledgeable and professional. They really enjoy doing their work and it shows in the way they interact with the guests. The food for the night tour was the best! Everything was so delicious and everything should be tried!! Definitely the best city tours I've had in SE Asia. You will not be disappointed.

Adrenaline rush! - The Saigon Night Tour was the most exhilarating part of our trip. Our guides were so friendly and funny and quite skilled in driving through Ho Chi Minh traffic. We got to see and learn things about Ho Chi Minh that we never would have without going on this tour. The ride itself was an adrenaline rush. Seeing the city at night all lit up on the back of a motorbike was something I will never forget. It's a wonderful and unique way to see the city.

A wild motorbike ride through buzzing Saigon - These motorbike tours are great! I took the sights tour and loved it. So I'm actually booking another tour - the foodie tour - for tomorrow. So much fun and so much to see while enjoying a sugarcane juice on the back of the motorbike - just like the locals. I felt very saved with my driver although the traffic is scary, but we always navigated safely through the streets of Saigon and the back of a motorbike is a great perspective from which to explore the city. During the stops our tour guide always had some interesting information for us, took some pictures of us and we also had some snacks and drinks on the way. I can definitely recommend the XO motorbike tours to everyone!

The highlight of our holiday - I had a fabulous experience with the beautiful Ngoc....she was an excellent driver and hostess...lots of information along the way.....the security boys were lovely and very attentive...the food was "different" but a great way to try unusual food I dont normally eat....some great information at stops along the way...so well worth the money...wish we had of known about the morning tour, we would have done that too...Lynda....PS Im over 65

Great way to end our holiday. - This is an amazing food tour-to be driven on a motorcycle all over HCMC weaving through the madness of the traffic at night is just fantastic. There is plenty of food & drink-up to you how much you eat & drink. The girls riding the bikes were great (I felt safer with them than driving in a car with my wife!!!)-the other staff were excellent. There were several guys who just made sure that we were safe when we were riding & also when we sat down to eat. My wife had injuries from a fall in Hoi An but they were so patient & assisted her at every occasion that was needed. One of the highlights of our 4 week holiday to Vietnam. We are in our late 50's so don't let age stop you although mobility could be a problem.

Vietnam Highlight - The Saigon Foodie Tour was off the hook for our last days in a beautiful country. The food was amazing and our scooter drives were so professional, safe and informative. We were amazed and delighted about how professional and organized the entire tour experience was for us. From the Tour Manager, the bodyguards and all the drivers, nothing was spared in the teams very deliberate quest to delight all their tour customers. Bravo and thank you for flavors and memories that will last us a lifetime.

Outstanding! - We did the Saigon at Night tour which was amazing! The women are brilliant guides who tell you all sorts of information as you tour around places you wouldn't normally go. The tour operators give you an outline of the different areas when you stop. Beautiful food and drinks plus an amazing dessert! So worth taking the time to do this tour. Thanks to the amazing staff who made this tour so wonderful!

A Big Hit With The Whole Family - We did the morning Sights trips with our 2 small children (3 and 5) and from the first contact this was one of the most professional outfits ever. Super safe drivers who were friendly, fun, informative and fantastic at playing with our children, taking them for ice cream etc while we did the cultural bits. Our guide was excellent, gave us just enough information for a taster and made this trip really varied and interesting. The children LOVED the scooters, we loved driving through the local markets, stopping for sugar beet juice and getting answers to all our questions. Would have loved to have done the food trip but it was just too late for the children. Maybe next time.... Definitely worth the money, highly recommend.

Family highlight on bikes - We went on the Saigon by night tour last Friday night. I was a little uneasy about my 8yr old on the bikes but quickly those worries were laid to rest as the girls were delightful, safe and we had the most amazing night. The tour as recommended to us and did not disappoint. Thu our guide was wonderful, informative, funny and great with the kids. I have 3 boys, 13,11,8 and they loved it. Was also a look at the city we would never have seen. The boys want to do it again!!
A must to do, I highly recommend it.
Thanks girls. 😊😊✌🏼

Very Fun!! - Had a blast on this Saigon by Night Scooter tour. 15 young women met our group at our hotel and after a safety briefing and donning helmets, off we went to see parts of Ho Chi Minh City not normally seen by tourists. Riding on the back of a scooter with hundreds of other scooters was daunting but oh what fun! All the drivers were young women in their 20's, college educated with good English skills. We drove for about 30 minutes through streets, freeways and a night market and then rendezvoused near a large wholesale market. We met the tour manager who explained what we were seeing and would be seeing, letting us know some things to look for. Our group of five each had a "bodyguard" who were young men - very polite, who made sure there were no problems such as a scooter breakdown or something. We stopped at a local BBQ place where our preselected dinner was waiting for us at long tables. Then off we went to ride through other districts of the city. The entire tour was about 3.5 hours and well done.

XO to XO - This is a very professional operation that will take you in parts of the city that you just won't see on your own. We went to areas that I didn't know existed, both old and new. You'll also experience the variation in local cuisine, from the sitdown restaurants to be side alley dining tables. Don't let the scooters scare you. They took great caution and care in maneuvering us around the various areas.

Easiest 5 Stars I've Ever Given - We did two of these tours, the morning one as well as Saigon by night. They were both so much fun, 3 hours never went by so fast!

Our beautiful drivers had fluent English and manoeuvred the crazy streets effortlessly. The guides were great also. Stops along the way for both tours were often outside the real touristy areas, and picking up little local snacks on the way is a great idea.

So if you want to see Saigon the way it's meant to be seen while singing Adele with your new best friend and driver whilst sipping on a sweet sugar cane drink then go for this one!

A must do - We did a half day tour & a Saigon by night tour too. We had 2 kids with us aged 8 & 17, they both loved it. The XO girls are great fun and very good at there jobs. When you get to each stop there's a tour guide to walk you around each site and another guy to turn the bikes around & get ready to move off. These tours are well organised, the stops are interesting and the food stops are fantastic. The girls give you a great insite into day to day life in Vietnam. I would highly recommend these tours. One of our holiday highlights.

A great Night out in Ho Chi Minh City - I have already recommended this tour to other people I met on the trip, as it was a great experience, and I felt safe on the bike at all times as Thao and Ngoc were very capable in the heavy traffic and got us in and out easily. The places of interest were well explained and and their knowledge of the city well informed. The food we tasted was great we experienced food we had not tasted before overall it was well worth doing and would recommend XO tours as they were so friendly and easy to enjoy a great night.

The wonderful thing about XO tours is........ it's fun fun fun fun fun fun - We were picked up from our hotel by Trang and Thao and spent the next 4 hours having one of the best experiences of our lives. These 2 girls were excellent guides to a city they truly love and their bubbling personalities were infectious. The whole tour is so well organised with a team of young male outriders making sure everything runs smoothly. Tai our tour leader was excellent making the whole evening fun and educational with his local knowledge. The food was very interesting and there is no way that we would have had the courage to eat this type of food had we not booked this tour. The BBQ was very good which included meat, fish and frog which tasted as you would expect...like chicken. On our last stop we had some excellent scallops which was our favourite dish of the evening. I would highly recommend that anyone visiting this fantastic city takes this tour, the way the team of young people work together to create a truly memorable evening is a joy to watch.

One of a kind Ho Chi Minh experience! - Before booking we watched all of their videos online. We could feel the authentic happiness in all the staff and loved the women in business environment! We booked the night time foodie tour and had the time of our lives. It was well balanced with stops for sight seeing in the midst of incredible food. We ate where the locals eat and experience the way food should taste, fresh and flavourful. Our guides were kind, warm and lovely and made our experiences unique as they chatted with us about their lives as we whisked our way through the streets of HCM.
Biggest gift was when we received our video emailed to us after. The quality of the video was professionally and superbly edited and the photographer had the perfect eye to capture the moments that were heart warming to us. Very much appreciate the honesty in which they tour us through their homeland and for the sweetness that they approach every minute with. Fun, laughter and that food!!! If you plan to visit HCM an XO tour will be your best experience :)

Half-day tour with XO Tours - Highly recommend this company! The tour was so much fun and very interesting. The guide was concise when explaining historical facts and he answered all questions. As for the drivers they were enthusiastic and very friendly when showing us around and taking pictures. It was a five star experience.
Friendly, informative and entertaining! - A great in depth look at Vietnamese cuisine coupled with great information about Saigon and the districts within the city. Can't recommend this enough!

Interesting way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We had a tour called Ho Chi Minh City by night and we were very happy with it. Staff was extremely friendly and easy going. They were also punctually on time and I never felt scared in the traffic even though some moments the streets were very packed and busy. The food was tasty and it was a joy to see so many districts and hear about the real life in Ho Chi Minh city. I would definitely recommend the tour for anyone who wants to see a lot in a short time.

Unique and Interesting! - A definite recommendation for someone who wants to tour the city a bit different. On bikes and at night, the 'Saigon by Night' tour was unique. The girls arrived on time to pick us up from the hotel lobby. We were only 4 people (2 couples) that day. Not only did the tour cover various districts, but also took us to several food restaurants and we could taste local cuisines and local desserts. Overall, a wonderful experience and a great time spent !

A fantastic way to see Saigon - My wife and I have just finished a night tour of Saigon - a really superb way to see parts of the city outside district 1 that are rarely seen by tourists. Our guides were incredibly knowledgable, kind and had a great sense of humour. They really went out of their way to ensure that we had a great time - even going to the trouble to organize a cake for us as we were on our honeymoon. The food we tried was outstanding. The best thing we've done in Ho Chi Minh City! Thank you so much XO!

Best food in Saigon! - The girls picked us up on time in front of our hotel. They welcomed us with enthusiasm and a lot of positive energy. The host explained the planning of the night and he also had a lot of positive energy. The girls were good drivers and we had lots of laughter. The food was very good and the most important, they knew about my allergies and they checked every thing. We had a wonderful time!

We would recommend this tour if you want to discover lesser know parts of Saigon and eat where you will've never eaten.

Foodie tour - Absolutely fantastic - recommended by a friend and sooooo glad we did this. Felt very safe on the scooters and the girls were great and really looked after us. Would definitely recommend to others - very fun experience !

Delightful, delicious, informative - We had never been to Ho Chi Minh City or Vietnam before, but we knew that we liked Vietnamese food, so why not book a foodie tour of the city? XO Tours provided more than we bargained for. Han and Ngon met my wife and me at the appointed time and immediately won our hearts with friendly inquiries. Soon we were off on their motorbikes for an amazing diversity of food interspersed with cultural and historical commentary by our overall guide, Hieu. Han and Ngon transported us to restaurants throughout the city where we sampled grilled meats, seafood, and vegetables. The contributions were generous and each setting offered something different. Along the way we stopped in culturally interesting spots for commentary from Hieu which added wonderful depth to the total experience. We came off the evening not only with full bellies but also enriching perspectives on the history and development of this very interesting city. The professionalism, clarity of English used, and thoughtful organization of the staff were exceptional.

An amazing introduction to Ho Chi Minh - Our first night in Ho Chi Minh was fantastic thanks to the XO girls and the food tour! Our guides, Loan and Anh (3!) were very informative; sharing heaps of local knowledge in very good English and keeping us entertained with games and jokes. The food was amazing (I'm vegetarian and they catered for me very well) all the hosts were fantastic and pictures of the night were taken and shared with us. Most importantly we never felt at risk on the scooters (even in all that crazy traffic!)
Highly recommended! :)

An exciting, informative tour. - Although this tour came highly recommended, we had some trepidation about riding around in Ho Chi Minh City's crazy traffic on the backs of motor scooters. We shouldn't have been concerned, and were extremely pleased with the tour.

The young women who drove us around were excellent drivers, extremely knowledgeable and fun to be with. Their English was flawless and their enthusiasm contagious.

Amazing, Brilliant, Exciting, Interesting - What a fantastic, well organized tour this was. I went on this tour with a girlfriend while our husband stayed and watched the kids, they participated the night after, and we all agreed this was the best activity we did while in Vietnam. The lovely ladies driving the scooters are so knowledgeable and explain different elements of HoChiMinh City from the history, to the districts, to politics and just general information that you want to know. The Tour guide, Tai, is marvelous and happy to answer any questions. He was fun, light hearted and a little bit of a jokester. He was happy to get us more beer and order more food and pushed us to our eating limits, Balut and frog.

The food was phenomenal and I have to say most of the menu items I had never tried before. Everything, except the Balut, was delicious and I would happily eat it all again. The venues look a little scary when you rock up but I promise you the food is sensational.

I couldn't believe how much I learned about Ho Chi Minh from this one experience. We ate so much food and had a great, fun filled night. Definitely a must when you are in HCMC.
Scooting Around - Found this tour via FaceBook. Booking was quick and easy. Communication was good. Visited a lot of the city and the tour guides were very informative.

This is definitely fun tours. - My wife and I were so looking forward to the two tours we set up with XO Tours.
It was the highlight of our time in Vietnam. We were like little kids, (we were NOT). The
girls are great drivers, very friendly, and well informed. We both felt very comfortable
on the Scooters, considering we spent 3 hours in the morning and three hours in the
evening on them. The XO Tours sets up the route, takes care of drinks and food and does a good job. If we return to HCMC, we will certainly use XO Tours again.

What a great way to see how the people live and travel in HO Chi Minh City (Saigon) - We are a group of 6 seniors 64-70 age range and have just had one of the best and exciting tours ever. We booked the XO Foodie Tour and were greeted at our hotel promptly by 6 of the most engaging, courteous young ladies we have ever come across. Considering these girls do these everyday tours, they were very enthusiastic and seemed to really want us to enjoy the night ahead and to have the best time on our tour. I was especially nervous of being on a motor bike in the teeming, endless sea of ​​traffic in Saigon, but my beautiful driver Huong1 was very confident and gave us all calm and sensible directions re the best way to travel. Apart from our motorbikes we also had a wide range and variety of different foods to taste and sample. Some very foreign to our usual diet but tasty and intriguing just the same. Each member of our group had a great time and all had great praise for the tour and it's well organized evening.
At various times during our 4 hour tour the leader of this group Hieu gave us excellent background commentaries and observations re the lifestyle and different districts of HCMC. We can't speak more highly of our wonderful drivers, Huong1, Ngan3,Anh2, Nhu1, Ngan6 & Thanh2. We would certainly recommend this tour for all age groups.
Lesley

Highlights of our HCMC visit! - This was a fun experience that we are so pleased to have had the opportunity to do. The XO team headed up by Anh Pham was well organized and managed and every need was taken care of.

Our three lady riders were so cute and full of fun, we spent the entire evening laughing! This is a wonderful way to do a whistle stop tour of the city, and to experience how the locals live.

We enjoyed some delicious food, and some rather unusual offerings too, which I did not partake of, however there is more than enough food on offer throughout the tour.

Thank you for a very special start to our holiday in Vietnam.

Must do! For first-timers and those often in Ho Chi Minh - This was my 4th time in Ho Chi Minh, but y 1st time to do the XO tour, and it was the best! I thought I knew most of what could be seen, done and eaten in HCM - I was wrong! We did the foodie tour on our first night there and it was a fantastic way to introduce the city to my friends. The tour guides were all very pleasant and knowledgeable, took time and effort to know each of us by names and our food preferences. We felt safe on the motorbikes, and the ride was a good way to see the city by night. Food was great, with a wide variety and was unlimited along with the drinks.

Superb and a must-do. - Family in this case was father and two teenage daughters (17 and 15). They had never been on a bike before let alone in the chaos that is Ho Chi Minh. We had three great guides led by Thu Duong, the English teams were superb and they knew their stuff on the city. The girls whizzed us around stopping for something to eat and drink whilst getting to see the real city and from a moped rather than just seeing them whizzing by. I cannot recommend it highly enough. Brilliant and a must do!! Well done on a great tour.

A brilliant way to get an overview of the city. - We had a wonderful morning sightseeing around the city on motorbikes ably driven by Hanh and Ngan. Traffic is crazy but the 'girls' are pros and we had a lot of laughs. We stopped off at all the main sights and guide Understanding was a font of knowledge with historical facts. Eating fresh yoghurt & banh mi at Tan Ding market was a definite highlight. I highly recommend seeing the city like this.

Awesome and well-run tour! - The Sites tour

Our guides for the day Ngan and Nhung picked as up from our hotel on time. After explaining the safety and riding on the backs of the scooters, we made our way to our first stop to meet up with the head tour guide Thi, and also rest of the tour group which was a family of 4. Thi was the one who did all the explanations at the different sites we visited! He was very knowledgable and gave us heaps of information about the history of each site, answered questions and had old pictures of the sites on his iPad. He was very interactive with our group!

Felt safe riding around to the sites with Nhung, she was lovely and friendly I enjoyed chatting to her along the way! Ngan and Nhung did walk around at a few of sites and helped take photos and look after us! At the end of the tour they also helped us change money before dropping us back to our hotel!

Very professional tour and everything flowed well! The guides English was perfect, their friendly and personable! The tour won't disappoint and you learn a lot about the sites in HCMC.

Good fun street food tour on the back of a vespa - We really enjoyed our street food tour with this company. As we were staying in district 2 we met our tour guides outside the opera house (they pick you up from your hotel if you are staying in district 1). The girls showed us how to ride on the backs of the Vespas then we were off to the meeting place restaurant. We met the rest of the group - some 8 or so other tourists then were given a very large and filling soup to start. There were two further restaurant stops - one a bbq place where we tried frog and goat and the other a seafood place locals use. All the food was very tasty and there was lots of it as well as free flowing beer. Our girl riders were very chatty and informative and drove us through several areas of Ho Chi Minh. The only criticisms I would have would be that when we got to the restaurants the girls sat with us and I think it would have been more fun if we could have sat with the other tourists as we would have had more in common with them. The girls are lovely and have a lot to say but they are still young girls and it was a bit of a struggle to chat to them all night - it would have been good if we only had to talk to them on the bikes. Also I think we spent too long driving around the city. I would have preferred to spend longer in the restaurants and less time on the bikes. A great fun thing to do though.

Very enjoyable :10/10 - I had read great reviews about this company, and the Sights tour I did on my first full day in HCMC definitely lived up to the high expectations I had built up from the reviews.

My lovely and very friendly guide arrived on time. There was not a single moment during the tour where I felt that I wasn't having a grear time.

This tour is very well organized. Everything flows very well and I love that.

Our guides had perfect English, threw in jokes whenever possible, illustrating the history of the places we went through pictures on an ipad.

The group I was part of only had 4 other people - perfect size for a perfect experience.

Definitely highly recommended. This company and its staff are rightly no. 1.

Excellent tour in every way! - My son found this tour, so we signed up for both their city tour during the day and the nighttime food tour. Both were fantastic. For the city tour, we were taken around to some of the major sites in the city, and of course updated on some of the more recent history. The great thing about this tour is that since you have a driver for each motorbike, it's a bit like having a personal tour guide, even when you are in a big group. The guides are all young Vietnamese ladies who speak good English, and are very personable. By riding the motorbikes, you are getting some of the local culture and even with thousands and thousands of bikes on the road everywhere, we always feel safe. The ride itself was half the fun actually. But we also got to see the local markets, and try some of the local food. The nighttime food tour was with a larger group, and that was also fun as we got to meet people from several other countries, and by the end of the night, and after a few beers (not for the drivers though!), we all became pretty well acquainted! I really believe that if you go to Saigon and don't go on at least one of these tours, you are really missing out on a great day/night in the city!

This is a must-do in Saigon. - We booked this on the basis of the number 1 rating in trip advisor. I was a bit worried that it was overrated and we would be disappointed. If possible it was underrated! A highlight of our trip. Whether you enjoy trying different foods, seriously consider this
It is a chance to better understand the culture. Riding safely on the back if a scooter, going to districts tourists don't go and the young ladies taking you plus the tour leader are very insightful. Apart from that it was a lot if fun.

FANTASTIC way to experience the food and fun of Saigon (HCMC) - Lots of great food..Fun tour guides. It's amazing experience driving around in the motorbikes. Lots of Laughs. Best way to see all of the city and learn about the different districts. Unforgettable night.

A highlight of our trip - I found XO tours on Trip Advisor and so many people had provided a great rating for their foodie tour. It didn't disappoint!! My husband and I had a great time. It's the perfect way to experience the busy streets of Saigon with your local guide. Also the food was really good - we went to places that we wouldn't usually go to. Highly recommend this tour. Plus the tour guides are really nice, talkative and knowledgable.

Highlight of Saigon - I can't recommend XO Tours enough. I did the night street food tour. From the easy pick up at my hotel to the drop off at the end of the night, everything exceeded my expectations. My guide (all guides are women) was super friendly and spoke extraordinarily good English. She provided commentary about the history and culture of Vietnam and information about Saigon as we drove around in the crazy crazy Saigon traffic. Talk about multitasking! There really is no other way to truly experience Saigon than getting among the traffic on a confidently (but safely) driven motorbike. The food at each stop was divine. And all places far out from District 1 that you wouldn't otherwise find - and all busy serving locals too, which is always a good sign. The tour takes you to a number of different districts that you probably wouldn't otherwise see, with a few stops to give the group some information about the different areas. This was also a great thing to do at night as a solo traveler - as you have dinner in the company of your guide and other members of the group. There were even security men who rode along with the group. This is an absolute must do in Saigon.

Best thing in saihon - Yep, the reviews are bang on. What an amazing tour, great food, terrific guides. This was brilliant.

We are a group of 24 - 31 year olds and we are still raving about how great it was. Fantastic food, lots of beer and brilliant sights.

This was the best tour I've done and will recommend it to anyone going to Saigon.

You can see why this tour is rated #1 - We did the Foodie tour on our first night and what an awesome experience it was. We were picked up by two charming young ladies who negotiated the HCM traffic like seasoned veterans. While the traffic is something that my wife and I had never experienced before we always felt safe in their hands. I think there were 12 in our group and it made for an enjoyable time. The tour leaders gave commentary at various points, not just about the food but also about life for the people of HCM. The young lady drivers were a fun lot and although they do these tours regularly you did feel special . The food was great too !
All I can say is you won't regret doing this tour!!!

Vietnam 2016 - Excellent way to see the sights of Saigon with Dinner thrown in..... Highly recommend the tour if you are in town!!!!
Dennis & Kaye

Start your visit with the Foodie Tour - The Foodie Tour is a great way to experience Ho Chi Min city. My wife and I started our holiday with the Foodie and it helped us plan the rest of our stay. Our guides were Ngan and Trang. They provided expert commentary including geography, history, culture and politics. The views of the city from the back of the bike at night were spectacular and of course the food was fantastic. Eating and learning about the local food was wonderful as well, but this tour is so much more. Thanks XO for a great start to our holiday.

One of the High Points of Vietnam - Our group of 15 took the Saigon by Night Tour. Lots of road time visiting 4+ districts with 3 stops. At each stop the tour manager, Tai, met us for commentary plus dinner. In between just you and the driver.

The Drivers - personable and articulate. Constant conversation along the way. Do you enjoy the conversation (helmet-to-helmet to hear), watch the scenery, or check for kamikaze traffic.

The Traffic - Saigon/Hanoi traffic is like nothing in the west, where signs and signals rarely exist and are rarely heeded. We felt comfortable with our drivers but the elbow-to-rear view mirror is quite the experience!

The Food - local, quite good, with commentary and perspective by the drivers.

Overall, a 'Must Do'.
Night Foodie -- Must do! - The most memorable experience in Ho Chi Minh! The guides were amazing and the food was fantastic. Totally worth it. Highly recommended.

A Guy Adventure - 8 young ladies arrived to pick us up and take us on a foodie tour. Peak hour traffic in Saigon on a motorbike, what an exciting time we had. The food was awesome too and we all thoroughly enjoyed our time with XO Tours. Would recommend this Motorbike tour to all travelers going to Ho Chi Minh City, excellent value for money......

Best thing in Saigon - We went on this tour on our first night in Vietnam! It was the absolute highlight. Could not recommend it highly enough. The tour guides were so lovely and very informative. We felt so safe the whole time. We ate delicious food that we otherwise wouldn't have tried. Worth every cent!

Fantastic tour! - My husband and I had a ball on this tour. In a nutshell - safe, fun, informative and a great way to get a local experience.

We chose the Foodie tour of Saigon at night. We were picked up at our hotel by two girls with scooters dressed very smartly. They gave us an introduction and quick run down, got us safely kitted up and away we went on the back of their scooters.
We met up with other people doing the same tour and from there kicked off 4 other stops. Three had food, two were stops to see the completely amazing differences between districts in Saigon. Our drivers gave us lots of information (and funny conversation) during the motor riding, and there was a guide to talk us through everything whenever we stopped.
The food was asolutely fantastic - fresh, local, abundant. The girls were fabulous and our main guide was great.
I only wish we had been able to do the tour sooner because we saw so much of HCMC would have been great to go back to some of the places we passed that our drivers pointed out.
If you are in HCMC you simply must do a tour with XO, and dont be worried about riding on the back of the scooter, it was perfectly fine!

Great time! - I was in Saigon for business a couple days and had a night free from factories taking me to dinner so decided to do this instead of eating dinner by myself and it ended up being the highlight of my trip. The guides were great and made it a lot of fun. Part of the allure is that you try different foods you will rarely ever get to try in neighborhoods you will rarely ever go to, but I have done both given that I visit factories in remote parts of Asia. That being said, while I was one of the few in our group who had already experienced a lot of this it was still fantastic. The girls made it a lot of fun and getting to know the other people in the group were great too. You have to eat anyway, so I would absolutely recommend this to anyone if you want to get a good feel for the culture. The crew is fantastic and they really do a great job to make sure it is a great time for all.

Amazing!!! - 4 of us had a private tour with four gorgeous ladies as our drivers and guides. Some male guides accompany us as well. It's absolutely worth the time and money spent ! We saw places and things, and ate food we would never have experienced on our own! Highly recommended !

Saigon by night tour - Just finished the tour with the lovely driver, this trip offered me everything I had hoped for, staying in Ho chi Minh for a week I have seen most of district 1, now I got a chance to also see the other districts and the contrast between them.

I got lot's of extra information and answers to my questions during the rides and stops, the trip is well organized and offers good food.
Besides the views, one of the best things with this tour is the friendly drivers that really "put the icing on the cake", love the idea with only female drivers, I felt safe and was entertained by both the city and my driver.

The tour has a higher price, but I think it's worth it, just hope that the drivers get a decent piece of the cake, because without them, this score would only have been a 3-4.

If I'm ever back in town, I will book another tour!

/Johan Andreas

Saigon by night - This trip was the best and funniest thing we did in Ho chi minh city.

We boked online and got fast, friendly and private answers right away.
The girls are really nice and fun, you surely will get a lot of laughter. I really was surprised that they remembered all of our names in the group.
The traffic are really intensed in Ho Chi Minh, but i feel as safe as it could probably be.
We took the "saigon by night" tour and i really enjoyed it. The girls made it 5/5

The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We had limited time at our disposal and XO came highly recommended. They did not disappoint. The drivers were exceptional and at no point did we feel our 3 and 5 year olds were at risk. Some lovely pitstops for refreshments along the way around the usual tourist sites but the trips to an atmospheric Taoist Temple and a market for locals made it special.

A fantastic experience!! - I've been lucky enough to see a few places on my travels, and do some cool things along the way, and I have to say that experience is at the top of the tree. It was so much fun! We were expertly looked after by Tien and Nhung, who were our guides. It was quite the thrill being on the back of the bikes as we discovered Ho Chi Minh. The food was fantastic but it was also a real treat getting to see so much of the city, including many different districts like Chinatown and Koreatown - places tourists wouldn't normally go. A great orientation, and additional bonus to the trip. The group was expertly run by Hieu, who was clearly very passionate about his city. Book it now!

Great night out - Just got back from a spin around the city on the night food tour, have to say the experience is top class. You have the fun of being driven around the city on the back of a bike, mixed with great food. The drives are brilliant in a traffic craze filled city they pick their way around safely, and calmly. Thank you Yen and the team for a wow night.

Brilliant - A wild safe informative evening with four fantastic ladies. If you want to see the districts eat great food and generally enjoy great company this is the your to do. No wonder they are number one on trip advisor. Don't miss doing this it's such fun.

A Must Do! - XO added so much fun to our vacation here in HCMC. As per our arrangement, we were picked up at our hotel and then driven through various districts. The divers safely navigated us through the traffic and provided us with interesting information. At various stops, we were met by another guide who provided us with more background information. Food was fantastic and the entire experience was one-of-a-kind. My 10 year old son would like to go again tonight!

Good Company, Good Food, Good Time. - We did the XO foodies tour on our last night in HCMC but doing it earlier in your trip can give you valuable bartering tips at the markets so you get a good deal. You also become aware of districts you may want to revisit during your stay.

Ensuring you have a good time is this group's number one priority and they do it so well. I tried food I would normally have never even considered. Some is challenging, only in Vietnam stuff but most is delicious, alcohol is also provided.

The girls are wonderful hosts who speak English fluently and who are attached to you individually throughout the tour. It is a nice personal touch. As we scootered through various districts enjoying the breeze it was fun chatting and learning about the areas we were traveling through. Each district has its own function. Some are high end areas while others look like organized chaos.

The tour leader, Tai hosts everyone very warmly and professionally as we travel from one spot to another. We gathered around him at various locations and learned that district area. There are also a couple of unobtrusive security fellows following along for everyone's safety.

I am so glad I had this experience in HCMC and would recommend it to everyone.

Foodie tour - Had always planned on booking an XO tour before i had even got here, and i wish i hadn't waited so long into my stay.
What can i say, everyone involved with the tour was awesome, and would definitely recommend to anyone interested in seeing a bit more of the city in a very fun and sociable way.

Great experience I won't forget! - I did the night tour which was amazing. You see a whole new side of Vietnam and all the drivers are lovely! My driver was Anne who was amazing and I also loved our tour leader Khoi who was very knowledgable. Would highly recommend this trip if you get a buzz from being on a bike, want to explore more than just the tourist areas and want to try some Vietnamese food. 5/5!

Do this, you won't regret it.... - We took both the city tour and the night food tour. Both were well worth it. Pick up and drop off at the hotel and a really enjoyable visit to the main attractions of the city. Our drivers were very competent and we felt safe on the busy roads at all times, a real experience. The night food tour was a blast, even more exciting and we tried all sorts of things you wouldn't think of trying on your own. Again our drivers were excellent and made the whole experience a fantastic part of our visit to Saigon. Do this the first day and then explore on your own.

Night food tour - Fantastic, great way to see the city. The girls are cute and fun and happy. Tai is even better.
Felt is very safe on the back of the bike.

Simply the best - I cannot rate XO tours high enough. We did both the day sight seeing tour and the Saigon by night tour - both in the same day. We were greeted at the hotel by our drivers both times and taken to meet our lead tour guide, Khoi. All guides and drivers had impeccable English. We were taken through many different districts in Saigon and got to learn about many different areas of life in Vietnam as well as learn some history. My two drivers, Lee (?) and Tian1 were both incredibly competent on the bike and I felt a million times safer on their motorbikes than walking on the road! The drivers took great care of our gear and took the time to warn us about removing any jewelry that could easily be snatched.
On the night tour we had some amazing street food too - just FYI it's more than a small snack but I won't ruin the surprise!
The experience was an adrenaline rush as well as informative and so much fun. We were so sad to say goodbye to our guides who I could easily become good friends with.

The only suggestion I could make to improve these tours is for the guides to wear name badges. This is likely to remain our favorite experience in Vietnam!

A great way to see the real city life - We used this great service on our friends recommendation and it was the best advice we got during our trip. As older travelers we felt quite safe and the guides were brilliant. These guys know all the great places to see, photograph and eat at and really made the trips a very personal experience and amazing value for money. As travelers to many different countries we have been ripped off a few times but this was a class act and a very refreshing experience which we have told all our friends about and would recommend to anyone. Great trips and many thanks to our guides.

Amazing! Made our trip. - This tour was brilliant from start to finish. We were picked up from the hotel at 9 by our guides who were really welcoming and friendly. We meet the others at the Central Post Office, including the guide Hieu. Hieu introduced himself and the tour and explained how the morning would go. His guide was very informative and his English is first rate. Between each stop the girls chatted to us about everything and everything, explaining the culture, food, shopping and even pointing out where they were born and the schools they participated.
