This was such a personal touch and made us feel really comfortable as we whizzed around the city.
For those maybe a little skeptical about taking a motorbike around the city I'd say give this a try. The girls are brilliant drivers and there wasn't one point when I felt nervous or unsafe. Be aware that men are not allowed to hold onto the women drivers and must hold the back/side of the bike.
Hieu also took pictures of the tour which was really nice as there are only two of us which means usually are pictures don't have both of us in!
We plan to go back to HCMC next year and so will definitely be doing the food tour next time.

I cannot stress enough how good this tour was. Going alone in HCMC is still a great experience but you get so much more out of the guide.

Thank you so much for making our time in HCMC brilliant :)

The highlight of Saigon - We recently enjoyed the foodie by scooter tour. What an absolutely fabulous tour. Not only did we get to eat fantastic food but we were shown the sites of Saigon at night visiting several districts.

The tour was informative and a lot of fun. It was a hoot riding through the busy streets. The girls are all fabulous and very friendly. They even peeled our crabs haha. I would do this tour again in a heartbeat. Maybe not the duck embryo ..... But everything else. 5 stars all around.

Best Vietnam Tour - Having toured from north to south, I can truthfully say that the xo foodie tour was our best and most informative tour in Vietnam. For value for money this tops the bill. An open insight into the real life of residences in HCMC was invaluable and was inparted in perfect perfect English by our tour manager Tai while our tour drivers Tian and Yhoum took the utmost care of us. The best way an Irish man can describe this tour is it was "mighty crack" from start to finish. If you have a spare evening in HCMC you must book this company tour.

Loved this!! - This tour was booked for me as a birthday present, on arriving here I was slightly worried about it due to the massive amount of traffic. However as soon as I got on the bike my tour guide was spot on and made me feel very safe at all times. The tour guides were able to speak good English and were able to point out places as we drove. Brilliant experience going around different districts and seeing how much it varied. We stopped in different places for information about that district which I found very interesting. The food they provided was lovely also.
Overall... I loved the whole experience!!

Amazing experience, a must-do! - My guide, V, picked me up at my hostel and we instantly hit it off. All the guides speak excellent English, which made for a super interesting ride! We talked the whole time which is a testament to her amazing multi-tasking skills, as driving in HCMC is no small feat! Seeing the sights, experiencing the organized chaos of motorbike riding, all the food, and of course, the company, made this experience worthwhile. It's a bit on the pricey side but definitely worth it. This was the best part of my trip to HCMC!

Best experience we have ever had!!! - Well what can I say, this tour was simply the most amazing thing we have done on our travels around the world. I had read previous reviews so guessed we were in for a good thing, but the actual tour itself just was so over and above any of our expectations. We chose the 'foodie tour' as we wanted to experience HCMC by night and experience the culture and food of the city that we knew as normal tourists we would not get ourselves.

I booked through the website and I have to say the pre trip arrangements were brilliant. Communication and contact was all clear and concise and we never felt like we didn't have the right information at all. You can also ask any questions and submit requests so the tour can assist you with your needs.

Now onto the tour! As per the instructions we were met outside our hotel by our two drivers for the night and well we struck gold! Ngan4 and Nhan were to be the perfect hosts for us on this tour. Being both 6ft and 6ft8 I'm sure we gave them a shock when we walked towards them, but from the off they were welcoming, informative and always caring about our needs and attentions. Now when you first arrive in HCMC the amount of bikes on the roads, pavements and well practically everywhere is a sight to be seen, so it can be very daunting for a first time rider, but Ngan4 and Nhan calmed our nerves from the start, eve making some jokes to lighten the mood! At this point we boarded our bikes and we were off!!!

What followed was a once I a lifetime experience that we will never forget. We joined a group of 11 other tourists from around the world each with their own guide. We also had our group lead for the night and our men in black to support the overall party! At this time let me say also a special thanks to Nhung1, Nhi2 and Hieu who were also amazing company on our tour (but a thank you to all of the ladies and men from XO on our tour as they were all friendly and amazing).

Throughout 4.5 hours we visited 3 amazing restaurants, that we would never have been to ourselves. We were driven to parts of the city we would never have seen and even given stops at different districts so we could so we could be told about each area.

The food was simply amazing, different sea food, vegetables, meats, fruits and desserts all items that we would never have considered ordering for ourselves but we are so thankful we got the chance. Every meal we sat down with our fellow tourists and drivers and everything was explained in detail and cooked for us in front of our eyes. There was no pressure to eat anything we didn't want, but to be honest we tried stuff we probably wouldn't have because of the girls explaining everything to us.

I have to say that we never expected to spend so much time on the bike, but we are so glad we got the chance. We were really taken to parts of the city and told things that would have been worth the price of the tour alone! The food, drinks, guides and hosts were added bonuses :)

If you come to HCMC make this tour a priority on your to do list! Don't be afraid of the bikes or what food it may be, just book! Places are limited and I can honestly say now we have done it, we know we would have missed out on a chance in a lifetime experience!

Thank you XO and in particular thanks Ngan4 and Nhan we will never forget this!

😄😄😄😄

XO Tours Vietnam Motorbike Tours - Excellent tour - fantastic experience riding through the streets on a motorbike, fabulous food and you get to see all sides of HCMC. There were 5 stops, 3 for food and 2 for explaining the area. The food included a wide range of local food including a few exotic items like goat and frog but there was no shortage of wonderful seafood and other things for the western palate. All the drivers were young women and they were very good drivers and spoke good English. The lead tour guide was very informative, personable and funny. Highly recommended tour.

My favorite experience in HCMC! - This tour was fantastic!! We did the Saigon by Night tour, and it was our favorite activity in HCMC. The drivers picked us up from the hotel (on time) and took us to three different districts that I wouldn't have visited otherwise. I was a bit nervous about getting on the back of the motorcycle after having seen the crazy traffic in Vietnam, but they were very safe drivers and made us feel very comfortable. Each of the districts they brought us to were unique and we got to see different sides to HCMC. The food we had during the tour was great, and it was nice to have options for dinner. Our tour guides were great; we chatted a lot about Vietnamese culture. They were so sweet! The lead tour guide even emailed us photos from the experience afterwards. Everyone was so kind and professional. We were so sad when the tour ended. Thank you XO for such a wonderful experience!

Amazing Experience! Must do in Saigon! - We absolutely loved both our tours with XO. We went out in the morning for the city tour & back out again in the evening for the foodie tour.
It was so much fun riding round Saigon on the back of a motorcycle! It gives you a completely different perspective of the city.
Our drivers Tam & Trang were lovely, we chatted the whole day & they were very knowledgeable about the city. We requested for them to come back for us in the evening.
You are a great tour host! All in all fab experiences that I would highly recommend to all. The foodie tour was my favorite we got to try goat & frog!

Fabulous way to see the city - Having arrived and seen the traffic and never been on a bike I felt slightly apprehensive. This didn't last long!
The ladies collected us, my driver was half my size and I did wonder how she would manage with me on the back but she was superb.
Confident and yet careful. She chatted all the way explaining many things. We made several stops to places of interest where we were met by another guide who then took us around and explained each area.
Along the way we sampled a drink that was literally waiting for us and as we drove by the simply passed them to us! Was a fun and informative way to spend the morning. We left at 9 and got back to our hotel at 1pm. Great value for money also.
Special mention to our drivers Ngan 3 & Nhung 2. They were both brilliant!
Can't wait to do the nighttime tour tomorrow.

Excellent in every way! - We did two tours with XO, the "sights" and the "foodie tour". Both were great. The girls were amazing drivers and we always felt safe. Mai Khoi was our group guide and he was super nice and knowledgeable as well. Nhu Quynh and Cam Tien were our drivers and we thank them for a great time! They showed us so much of the city and awesome food. Thanks!!

Foodie Tour - just do it! - What a great tour I had with XO on their Foodie tour.
Very well run and very safe.
I was picked up at my hotel by my driver for the evening, Tien.
She was great fun, very friendly and chatty, and a safe driver.

We went to the XO cafe where we met up with the rest of the tour group and had our first meals while being informed of the evening ahead.

Then it was off we went, navigating the Saigon traffic with ease.

We visited a number of eateries, tried various dishes (including Jumping Chicken), and even played a game with the winners getting a Chopstick Champion badge.

Everyone on the tour seemed to have a great time, all the girls were fun and we had some photos taken during the evening which were emailed me in the next couple of days. They even have a group of "bodyguards" behind the group to ensure safety.
The leader of the group was really good, reminded all our names straight away.

I would highly recommend an XO Tour (I only did the Foodie tour with them but I am sure any other tour would be just as good).
Fantastic experience - For me this was "once in a lifetime -experience". Super sightseeing, good food, extremely kind staff, excellent drivers. I couldn't wish more. I'm very happy :-)

Exceeded our very high expectations - My husband and I took the foodie tour in Saigon and we couldn't have been more happy with it. The girls picked us up on motorbikes and drove us from district to district. We ate incredible food and learned a lot about the city. I have to say, it's the staff, the drivers and the team leaders that make this tour worth it. The ladies driving the motorbikes are well educated and intelligent young women. Conversation was never dull. In fact, if I lived in Saigon, these are the kind of people that I would want to spend time with and become friends. They speak very good English as well. I was a little skeptical about the price but after having the experience I would pay double the price! We WILL take this tour again next time we are in Saigon.

Fun morning - We did the morning sightseeing tour and had a great time. Felt in very safe hands on the back of the bike. Lovely driver Nanh (?) was chatty and charming. Excellent English spoken. Able to see a lot more than you would on foot. Highly recommended.

Brilliant first day in Vietnam - Really enjoyed this tour from start
To finish!! It Was such a great way to spend our first evening in the city. We were met at out hotel by our two lovely guides, Nhi and Chang. They were so friendly and really made the experience so much fun. Nhi was my guide and a really great driver! We had a good laugh along the way and both enjoyed beating Chang and Merle at eh chopstick game! Haha.
The food was Good and the night flew by.
Would highly recommend this tour!

A great tour with terrific guides - First off, the tour itself is fantastic. Driving around HCM on the back of a motorbike is an experience among itself. The food is incredible and varied, and it will push you to try dishes you might otherwise miss out on. But the real highlight of the tour is the exceptional tour manager, Tai, and the incredible guides that do everything they can to make sure your experience is nothing short of perfect. (Ask for Vi and Chang as both are fantastic guides).

For a westerner, the traffic can be intimidating, but from the second I saddled up on the motorbike until the very end of the tour, I was entirely comfortable and never once felt worried. As our group had a number of allergies, we were all blown away by the way that Tai and company made sure that we were taken care of.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience and one I would recommend to anyone looking to try some new cuisine and experience Saigon from a more local perspective.

Great Food Tour & Excellent Guides - The food tour is awesome and totally worth the money. I had a great time talking to my driver, Chang. The tour manager, Tai, was entertaining and informative, along with being a great host. The other staff were also great, with my friend also having a great experience with his driver, Vi.

Additionally, XO tours were very accommodating of our group's allergies and making sure they had big helmets for the two of us who are rather large headed. I highly recommend them and the food tour to anyone in HCMC.
Foodie tour - Just brilliant! Enjoyed every minute, very informative and interesting. My driver was a really sweet girl with great local knowledge and good English. Highly recommend this tour

Simply the Best - What a fantastic way to spend an evening in Saigon on the back of a scooter with a delightful young Singaporean girl in elegant traditional attire. With a wonderful local knowledge and charming personality the evening has been one of the highlights of our trip. It's worth traveling back to Saigon just to do the trip again. I cannot rate this highly enough

Highly recommend! - So glad we booked this! The girls we had, Chang and Nee were absolutely delightful. So knowledgeable and friendly. Chang thank you for a great night and a good laugh along the way. Tan runs a great team. You won't be disappointed with this. Food was delicious.. And I have eaten a few Vietnamese delicacies tonight I'm not sure I would've picked off the menu myself. Highly recommend! We did the evening tour, picked up about 5.20pm and dropped off around 10pm. Full and ready for bed :)

Just book it. Don't waste time. - The highlight of my trip! I did the night time tour on Mar.6. As a Vietnamese person born in Canada, this tour really opened up my eyes as to how Vietnamese people REALLY live. This tour is a great way to explore beyond the tourist areas while feeling safe.

The guides spoke excellent English and Understanding the tour leader was very knowledgeable when asked about various topics varying from real estate to the economy.

The food was yummy as well.

My guide was Ngan and she did such an amazing job. The girls are very witty, fun and have a great sense of humor. They were also very safe on the scooters.

No need to contemplate when booking. I will be doing this tour again when I come back to see the rapid on going development. I will also be recommending this tour to friends/family.

Thank you XO for an awesome experience.

eXOlent - Don't get too carried away by the fear of being thrown into Ho Chi Minh traffic at peak hour on the back of a motor scooter ridden by a beautiful young girl dressed in traditional attire. It's not scary at all. This tour is the best way to get a feeling about how the locals transit and eat. The food choices on the tour are great and you are taken to some local establishments that as a tourist you would most likely avoid. The food is fresh and clean and is a good extension of the Vietnamese food that we are more accustomed to eating at our normal westernized Vietnamese eatery.
It is a thoroughly enjoyable experience with the most enjoyable hosts. Highly recommended.

The best thing I did in Saigon! - I came to Vietnam to eat, so I had done a lot of research in general in order to get the best experience. I decided to go with XO Tours because it was highly rated and I was curious to get more of a tour of the city. All of these great reviews are totally on point!!! I took the Foodie Tour, and it was nearly five hours of zipping around on a motorbike with a super fun group and an amazing driver (Ghanh!). I am pretty scared on a bike in general, but never ever felt unsafe while on this tour --- we even had to deftly maneuver a really intense traffic jam and that felt fine. I really enjoyed getting to see several different Districts, as well as hearing more about the stories of each spot we saw.

But what about the food? WELL, I realized afterward that we technically only ate at three places, but I was insanely full and so happy at the end of the night. Two of the spots were ones I never ever would have found nor probably figured out how to order at on my own, and they each had some of the best food I tried in the country. You may look at the price of this tour and think it's a little high, but I guarantee you it's worth it. You won't get this sort of experience on your own!!!! A fun plus was that Anh, our fabulous tour leader, took pictures throughout and emailed them to everyone afterwards. It's a small detail, but a really nice touch. Thanks XO!

Really special! - Really great experience on the back of a motorbike seeing the items of HCMC.
Guides are friendly, informative and fun. The pace of the tour was very well thought out. Tourist sites mixed with a little food sampling and drink.
Highly recommended!

Foodie Tour with XO Tours - a highlight of our trip and a must do! - You must do the Foodie Tour on the back of the Vespa with XO Tours. I decided to do this tour last minute and booked the day before. So glad I did. After 22 days in Vietnam from North to South, and doing many tours, this was definitely the best experience. It's for all ages, if you're not afraid of mixing it with the locals on the hairy roads of HCMC.
I was picked up at my hotel by my XO Angel 'Than' and she made me feel so comfortable and at ease about being on the back of the vespa with her, and then gave my own helmet, and off we went to meet the rest of the tour group.
I did this tour on my own and did not feel alone at all. Every other person on the tour was great and we were all made to feel very special by the friendly guides on this tour.
The tour is half Saigon City Tour and half Food Tour. You visit the Districts of Saigon that other tour groups don't go to and try foods that are all amazing! They even opened a Duck Embryo, however no-one ate it. Oh, and don't say the word 'yum', it means 'pervert' in Vietnamese. Extremely informative on so many levels - culture, food, the city etc etc.

Time of Our Life in Saigon - Can't say enough about the tour. The girls did a fantastic job navigating through the city with us in tow. Did the night Foodie tour our first night in Saigon, followed by the City tour the next morning. Both were fantastic in their own way, although I would have to give the edge to the Foodie tour just because of the variety of the tasting experience.
Don't hesitate to book this when in Saigon. It is a MUST do.

Great foodie tour - This is a great food and sights tour. Most tourists are stuck in district 1, but this tour takes you to 5 other districts and shows you the local food. Thao was my guide, she was a good driver and was very nice to talk to. The tour is for 4+ hrs and was super fun. We drank and ate till we were full. Very much recommended.

Night Tour - Good overall experience on our night tour, mainly due to the drivers, fun and easy-going Vietnamese girls. Road through 5-6 different districts, starting in Chinatown and ending in district 4 for a dessert. Made an odd stop in district 7 (the newly developed area) that seemed unnecessary and takes you away from the grit of HCM which you'd want to see on a tour like this. Second experience on a bike tour of HCM (first tour with Vespa Tours). Would recommend the food tour if you have some more time.

So much fun! - We had the best night with XO Tours - such an adventure on the back of the bike in the Saigon traffic, but we felt comfortable with our expert drivers. It was great to visit eating places away from the tourists and sample foods that the locals eat! Thanks to our tour leader Khoi and the delightful girls! We highly recommend this tour for people with a sense of adventure!! Trish and Pat
Must do - Most will have doubts, due to this. Its a wonderful perspective of HCMC. It is safer than it looks or may seem.

Tour on Two Wheels Really Great - I recently visited Saigon with my wife for just 2 nights. With so little time, we wanted to get a feel for the city as efficiently as possible. Saigon, like so much of Vietnam we learned, is a city of motorbikes. We took the plunge and hopped on the back of our young guides' (Thao & Hong...I may be missing their names) motorcycles. They were prompt, friendly and knowledgeable. And they were good drivers. We hit the major sites in District One and a few other areas. We visited a large market that tourists DON'T usually know about (where the locals buy stuff to sell at inflated prices in the other market). We also learned a great deal from them about life in Saigon & Vietnam...we are much more interested in learning about the people in places we visit than in buildings. I did not feel that I was being lectured or indoctrinated. It never felt scary or unsafe (though they cautioned my wife to remove her gold necklace before we started...petty theft is not uncommon and someone could have easily snatched it from her neck at a red light). So much better than being stuck in a bus with a big group. Highly highly recommend.

If you're going to do a tour, do it with XO! - What a wonderful experience! We did the foodie tour which is their most popular. The ladies who drive the motorbikes are so friendly and informative! I felt completely safe the whole time driving through traffic and actually found it to be so much fun to experience the roads the way they do! The tour guide spoke perfect English and was a lot of fun. All the food we tried was authentic and delicious, no banh mi or spring rolls here! Absolutely worth the price, unlimited food and drinks and a few nice little added touches. I would say a must while in Ho Chi Minh city!

Best tour - We were met at the hotel by two lovely young ladies along with their security escort. They took us to meet the 9 others who were on the tour. OMG. The tour was awesome the food delicious and overall well worth the money. Riding on the scooters was completely comfortable and safe. Thea girls are wonderful drivers. Get ready to try a variety ad different local foods. Some may make u squeamish but just skip those. I tried everything and was not disappointed. Well worth the money!!!!

great way to see Ho Chi Minh and food too - We had a great time with our guides, they were very knowledgeable and enthusiastic, i loved the way they combine food tour with sight seeing. The girls made us feel very safe in the frantic traffic of Ho Chi Minh. This was our second tour and as good as the first, make sure you have the BBQ frog to die for
Thank you XO Tours for a great night

XO Food Tour - great experience - I enjoyed the whole experience. It was fun from the beginning to the end. I could tell that all restaurants that we visited authentic places where locals go after work - I usually avoid touristy restaurants.
I tested many dishes and enjoyed quite much all of them, whether it was pho, barbeques, seafoods, embryon eggs, deserts, etc. And beer of course :-)
I also learned quite a few things about Vietnamese cuisine and a bit about HCMC.
Tour guides worked hard to keep us entertained, and it was lighthearted and funny.
All in all, highly recommended.

The BEST! Highlight of our trip to HCMC - Well planned, great staffs, simply amazing! It's my second visit to Ho Chi Minh City and I've always wanted to try the Vietnamese foods from a local perspective & not from what you get from the internet. Now i know what I missed during my first trip to HCMC. THIS!
A unique and great way of experiencing the culture and it's recommended for all ages. The members of our tour were really friendly and thoughtful. We laugh till it hurts & enjoyed the companion from the crowd & our knowledgeable tour guides. It's a bit pricey but I can 100% assure you that it is worth it! Thank you Hieu, Thao, Nhung, Loan & everyone!

Best Tour in Vietnam! - My boyfriend and I took the daytime scooter tour. Honestly, favorite tour of our entire trip! The girls are all lovely, incredible knowledgable and happy to answer any questions you have along the way. The tour shows you all the main sites you would've wanted to see in a short visit in Ho Chi Minh whilst giving you a super amazing insight into the history. Also, you feel very safe on the scooter despite the chaotic traffic. A must must do!

Perfect in every way - I did "The Sights" day tour on my first day in Saigon, and it was a great way to get acquainted with the city. The group is small, the riders all excellent, and we saw way more than I expected. I expected a driving tour, but we had quite a few stops where we walked around and actually learned some history about the places and the city.

It's really an incredible value, considering all the ground we covered, the education, the adventure, and the fun. Plus we had some fresh fruit and even some sugar cane juice (all included in the price.) They even emailed a whole batch of pictures a few days later.

My driver Nhung was outstanding. She was a safe and confident rider, and we had great conversations along the way. If she's indicative of the rest of their staff, you'll be in good hands. I should mention this was my first time on a motorcycle (scooter) in a big city, yet I never once felt nervous or uneasy. It was thrilling yet I felt completely safe from the moment we started riding.

I didn't have time to do one of the food or night tours, but if I'm back in HCMC, I'll definitely book with them again.

The whole experience was just perfect! There's a reason they're ranked #1.

Jeff

Great Perspective on the City - As we were pulling into the dense evening traffic on the scooter my driver leaned back to admit that tonight was her first night riding for XO Tours. Since I rode a big Harley back home, I found myself bemused to be a passenger on a 125 cc scooter, especially when piloted by an energetic young woman. I told her "no problem - all good - let's go". She laughed and said, "just kidding - I have been riding these tours for a year and a half". That sets the tone for the evening. It was the foodie tour. We rode in a pack of scooters up narrow alleys and across wide bridges, in the dark with thousands of other local scooters nipping at our fenders. Then suddenly we would roll into yet another food stop, to sit down to enjoy everything from grilled beef, to grilled goat, jumping chicken and more - all washed down with a favorite beverage or two. Mine was the local beer - and, I discovered I like embryo duck - I had two! The next day we set out again on the morning tour to see even more sights. Everyone was super friendly. The guides were knowledgable - and far from being aloof or jaded, they had genuine, infectious enthusiasm about what they were describing to us. I feel that I really learned a lot about such an amazing, lovely place by living even for just a few hours, like a local. I highly recommend XO Tours.

Great time and awesome HCM experience - I looked around at all the motorbike tours and this proved the best and most cost effective.

Had a great time and saw a lot of this beautiful city!

Great fun and worth the money - Really interesting, fun and exciting tour. It is half a site seeing and half an eating tour. So you don't really need to be a strict foodie type to go on this tour. Just keep an open mind. We were picked up (on time) by our two drivers and whisked away into the swarm of mopeds that meander thought the streets of Ho Chi Minh city. It was a really great night. Our drivers were friendly, educated, polite and genuinely funny. The whole set up is tightly run. Support staff are constantly monitoring the tour and the main speaker at each stop was very interesting. We ate everything and really liked every dish, save for the embryo duck. The traffic was constant but we felt safe and enjoyed seeing the various districts. If you want to see Ho Chi Minh at night this tour is perfect. Well done to all involved, especially our drivers.
Regards,

Fintan and Goda (Ireland)

Ho Chi Minh Food Fun - My husband and I booked the night food tour Feb 16th. Our guides were prompted in picking us up from our hotel. They provided the safety overview, secured valuables and provided helmets before we set off. During the evening they gave explanations of the destinations, food and any other questions we had. We were met at each stop by the support crew who provided an overview of the district, security and made sure that the seating and food were ready for us. The food was varied and abundant. Although traffic was a bit heavy due to the holidays, at no point did I not feel safe. Highly recommend this tour especially to those starting a trip to Vietnam in Saigon as it will help explain the foods you will be seeing throughout the country.

The best way to see HCMC - My boyfriend convinced me to go on this tour as i was a little apprehensive about being on the back of a moped. I'm so pleased I agreed to do it! The girls who ride the bikes are ever so friendly and confident drivers and really put me at ease. They collected us from the hotel, and took us to the first restaurant, where we joined the rest of the group, and ate the first course. The next 5 hours, we drove around HCMC, as far out as district 9, being shown and eating at places where everyday Vietnamese people eat, being told lots of interesting facts about the city. The food was also interesting and mostly delicious, and it was a fantastic way to see the city. I would very much recommend this :)

Highly recommended HCMC activity - I did the foodie tour. This is a great tour. The drivers are really friendly ladies who are interested to tell you about Vietnam and learn a bit about where you are a from. You do the tour with a small group so you meet some new people too. The food choices are really nice. They space at the meals at reasonable intervals so you can enjoy/digest. I enjoyed learning about other areas of HCMC I would have never known. The guide was funny/friendly. I recommend you do this tour in HCMC.

Favorite part of the trip - I had no idea Ho Chi Minh City had such an incredible food scene. This was a great way to try safe authentic food and our tour guides and drivers were very friendly knowledgeable and spoke great English. Worth every penny.

Super fun motorbike tour - I was growing oh so weary of the traffic in HCMC...until I got to ride on the back of a motorbike with the XO ladies! What a fun way to see distant parts of the city. We did the "Saigon by Night" tour (led by Khoi Nguyen) and had such a great experience - seeing parts of the city we wouldn't otherwise have made it to, plus eating delicious street food. Can't recommend this enough.

Do this tour! - We did the evening foodie tour and we are so glad we did. Our drivers Nhu and Tham made us feel safe while being friendly and lively. The food and conversation is great. The whole tour takes about 5 hours and every second is great fun. Highly recommend!

Fantastic night on the Foodie Tour - My wife and I signed up for the Foodie Tour for our second night in HCMC. Booking process was simple and come the night of the tour, the girls were out the front of our hotel on time and ready to go. The tour itself was amazing - well organized, friendly & informative guides (both Tung and the girls), great food at all of the stops and the opportunity to see various areas of the city from a different perspective. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone and would suggest doing it early in your holiday - the Vietnamese we were taught came in surprisingly helpful at times during our trip and picked up the Vietnamese names for certain dishes can make menus at restaurants and food stands easier to interpret.

Best things to do in Ho Chi Minh City! - We had more fun doing this than anything else. If you are a foreigner then the traffic in this city can see downright horrific. You have to just rust the drivers, all female and excellent. We did the major sites tour and it was wonderful. You sit behind the driver and hang on while they zoom in and out of traffic to the major sites. When you arrive at a site a guide is awaiting and discussing the place. I liked the tour because we saw a lot of amazing things but didn't have to endure a lot of long, boring inside tours. This was really a lot of fun!

Terrific motorcycle guided tour of Saigon - I had a great motorcycle driver/guide (Ngoc2) who picked me up at the hotel and showed me around Saigon for a half day. Our guide at each destination was Understanding who was interesting and personable. Refreshments and water made the tour more enjoyable. I had a great time and highly recommend it! Thanks Ngoc2 and Hiew.

Great evening food tour by motorbike - We had a fun evening doing the food tour. It was well organized and our all female motorbike drivers were very sweet, helpful, informative and safely conscious navigating the crazy traffic of the Saigon streets. The group was made up of about a dozen people and we were all picked up at our hotels by our motorbike drivers. Over the course of the evening, we traveled through a number of the different districts. Our drivers and the team leader provided lots of information about the districts and other aspects of Vietnamese life. It was great to learn a little bit about my driver and her family and culture. We made 3 stops for food; the first at a beef noodle place, the second at a BBQ place and the final at a seafood place in district 4. Our drivers demonstrate how each food is traditionally eaten and with which sauces. There were also opportunities to try things like frog (quite tasty) and duck embryo balut (didn't try though many did). Beer, soda and water were included along with the food. They made sure everyone was full and our drivers were so helpful, quickly cracking crab claws and doing the messy work for us! This was a fun eating, learning, and touring experience.

Friendly knowledgable staff - Fun day out! - At first I was a little nervous about getting on the back of a scooter but my driver was so professional and confidant, I soon relaxed.

This is a great way to get a taster of Ho Chi Minh City if you only have a limited time!

The best tour of my life!!!! - My wife, sister in law and myself took this tour in Feb of 2016. The drivers were great and you get to see parts of the city you usually won't see. We ordered the $30 video, we haven't received it yet, they said it would take 10 days. I'm sure it will be great. We did get our pictures and they were amazing. This is a must do in Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City.

So much fun! - Hands down one of the best tours we took while in Vietnam. The girls were extremely safe drivers in a crazy busy city, spoke excellent English, and the guide was very knowledgeable about the sites. I loved the historical aspects of the tour, driving through the flower markets, and seeing some of the nontraditional sites of the city. Highly recommended to anyone traveling to HMC.

Amazing Experience! - I've been living in Ho Chi Minh city as an expat for almost two years, and have booked this tour for my friend, who is visiting me from Korea. We had a fabulous time that we will never forget!
The tour was wonderful because they take you to places where most tourists, and even expats, would not normally visit. We were able to look closer to how the locals lived. I can't say that the food was amazingly delicious, but every dish was worth trying. I couldn't have eaten them if it wasn't for the tour. They give you the courage to try them all, and some were actually better than you could imagine.
The best part of the tour is that we get to see the city on the back seat of a motorcycle. It was exciting, yet safe. The girls who took care of us drove safely, spoke English very well, and were very entertaining.
I would recommend this tour to all the tourists and expats visiting this city!

A must do in Saigon - We only spent two nights in Saigon, and determined to make the most of it, decided to book both the daytime and 'Saigon by Night' XO tours.

Both were an outstanding experience. Our tour guide Anh was very knowledgeable and our very skilled and safe drivers spoke excellent English. This is a great way to get a feel for the different districts in Saigon and the daytime and night-time tours cover a lot of different ground

Crazy, Amazing Night - First of all, we are a "mature" couple (mid-60's). We got to be this old by not taking stupid chances with our health and safety. After reading all of the reviews of the XO Foodie Tour, we booked it - but I have to admit, I almost cancelled several times. The traffic in Saigon has to be seen to be believed. So happy we decided to forge ahead. After my jittery nerves were calmed, about 10 minutes into my motor scooter ride with Yuen, I really started to relax. The food is interesting - not your standard tourist fare. Goat, frog, quail...I tried it all. The neighborhoods we were taken to were definitely not in our guidebook. The guides took such impeccable care of us - no detail was too small to warrant their attention. By the end of the evening, I was really sorry it was over. Thank you XO Tours for giving this old girl a night she will always remember.

Highly Recommend - My husband and I did the Saigon by Night tour with XO Tours and highly recommend this experience. The tour went exactly as described by their website and our expectations were exceeded.
Our guides picked us up at our hotel and we were off! I have ridden a motorcycle before but it was a bit scary to make the first left turn with on-coming traffic. After a minute, I felt very comfortable and eased my hold on the back of the bike. The drivers spoke great English, and we got to know each other as we drove to our first stop to meet our guide and another couple in District 5. After introductions, we received an overview on where we would visit during the tour and we provided our meal selection. For us, the highlights of the tour were seeing the Cholon market and the experience of riding a motorbike around the streets of HCMC. The night went by quickly and we were not pressured to buy anything. The food was adequate but tasty. The XO staff were engaging and sincerely focused on providing an enjoyable experience for us. We had fun together. I highly recommend this tour for anyone wishing to see HCMC from a different perspective than the usual pedestrian view!

Amazing experience!!! - If you only have a few days to walk around Saigon, this is the tour you should take! With about 4 to 5 hours, those girls will not only take you to some of the most important tourist spots (and some corners that meant a lot in the history) but also tell you some stories that even the locals might not know. What's more, you will definitely be amazed by those girls' riding skills and get to know how it feels to ride a bike inside the city. In just a word, awesome!!!

The best experience in Vietnam - We decided to take Foodie Tour the day before we did it and it resulted to be one of the experiences of this trip to Vietnam. Having the opportunity to talk to them, to eat with them, and to be driven by them is something quite rewarding. There was lots of food in the tour, many that I would not have tried on my own, with a remarkable mixture of flavors, neighborhoods and explanations about the city. I recommend this company and this tour in particular.

Great experience! - Spent some 5 hours with XO the first evening in Saigon and it was a blast, especially our 12yo daughter says it was one of her highlights of our Asian tour.
Was amazing to experience Saigon on the vespas, both from a traffic perspective but also stopping at the various food places and eating all kinds of meals. The guides were really friendly, with good English skills so easy to communicate, they were funny with great humor, so they really made us love Vietnam from the very first day.
Greetings from a very happy family from Serbia! :)

exciting motorbike tour - Exciting evening tour- we had a pillion passenger's eye view of the busy traffic and appreciated the skill of our drivers in managing the congestion. A good overview of the city and a small snapshot of the many different people who live there. Our guides were knowledgeable and friendly, and there were breaks every so often which we as rather stiff OAPs, appreciated- one for a traditional noodle meal, one for a delicious dessert, and one just to rest our limbs and view the newest and most expensive district of the city.

An amazing way to see HCMC by night and enjoy some amazing food! - We did the XO 'foodie' tour which was absolutely incredible! Not only did we got to try some amazing Vietnamese food, we had an awesome time touring Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a scooter. Definitely one of the best ways to see the city. I thought the guides were excellent and felt extremely safe at all times. I would recommend this trip to anyone! Check out thedustyroad.com/ho-chi-minh-city/ for more!

An amazing highlight of our South Pacific tour - This was a really exceptional experience and one not to be missed at all costs. Four 60s/70s went on a fantastic motorcycle ride round Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon to most of us) on the backs of four individual motorcycles driven by four delightful and very skilful young, female, drivers. Once we had found our balance on these bikes, we were taken to food places that we would have neither found, still less considered, for out of this world gastronomic experiences. NOTE: go out on an empty stomach as there are mountains of food provided - meat cooked on table top bbqs - fish. - frog (yes) - duck foetus (no!!). Our four girls were very knowledgeable and kept a well informed and very witty running commentary at the table and on the move. The tour includes a drive round the sites of HCM City.
This was a stunning performance and we would not have missed this for anything. Unsurprisingly, there is a huge demand for this experience. Make sure you go with the right organization, this one, as there are paler reflections on offer. The time passed all too quickly.
Christopher and Jane from Buckinghamshire UK. There is a separate report from Bill and Jill from Berkshire UK with whom we are traveling.

Our Highlight in Saigon - XO's night Foodie tour was our highlight in Saigon. It was very exciting to get on the back of a motorcycle and get out in the traffic and experience it like the locals do. Our drivers were very polite, informative and very good drivers. The food was excellent and abundant, some of the best we had in Asia. Each food stop was in a different area of ​​HCMC allowing us to see parts of the city we would have not seen on our own. It was nice having breaks between food stops to allow our stomachs time to rest a little before the next meal. We highly recommend XO's Foodie Tour.

Perfect Indoctrination to HCMC ...see it like a native - My travel mate,Linda, and myself, both grandmothers with a spirited nature, hopped on board the back of our scooters driven by Chang and Thio respectively. We couldn't bieve that for 5 hours we wove through the streets of Saigon and lived to tell about it. What fun. We were a group of 12 and our guide, Hue, had us stop 5 times in different districts to explain the eccentricities and economy of the city. All along the way we sat and different respite and tasted the street foods of their culture... From soups with banana flowers and morning glory to crab and prawns... From quail to beef and so on. Our scooter guides were lovely, poised intelligent and the conversation was constant and fun. Don't miss the Foodie Tour. Well worth every penny.

Amazing and completely worth the money - My husband and I went on the evening foodie tour - lasts 4.5 hours and takes you across many of the districts trying different street foods. It also gives you some really useful insights and information into Ho Chi Minh and you see a lot more areas than if you were trying to do this by yourself or using a guide book

- the scooters I thought would be terrifying but actually the drivers are all amazing
- everyone is super friendly and chatty and informative
- the food is nice and varied with hidden surprises
- you get beer and drinks included in the price

This was my favorite part of our visit to Ho Chi Minh and we nearly canceled it because we thought we were spending too much money but I'm so glad we didn't. Well worth it!

Foodie Tour - I really enjoyed the Foodie Tour! It was very interesting to see so many different districts, including the Little Singapore. All the guides were very proffessional, food was amazing and you felt very safe! Very well organized.

Best way to experience Saigon! - This is my second time to Saigon and we were extremely happy that we picked XO tours to take us around on their city tour and foodie tour. Both tours were a MUST do and we were incredibly safe riding on the back of the mopeds. Nothing to worry about at all. The tour leader was very informative and the girls who drove us around were lovely. The tour was worth every dong and I'll be sure to recommend this to all my friends! @travelcaddie

Riding on the back of motorbike is unique way to explore Hanoi and XO Tours makes it fascinating and fun! - Our motorbike drivers, two lovely young women arrived at our hotel at 9am, gave my friend and me some brief instructions, a helmut, and off we went. It was exciting and a cool – in every way to explore the city.
Our first stop was a pretty plaza to see the iconic Central Post Office and the Notre-Dame Cathedral, where we met up with a few other “fellow bikers” and our tour leader Anh Pham. After introductions all 'round AP gave us just the right amount of historical background and interesting bits of information about the venues and the current Viet Nam lifestyle. We went in to see the buildings, each accompanied by our personal driver/guide. They were so helpful. We traveled through many of the neighborhoods, stopping at other sites and for snacks at a local (non-touristy) and at a “drive-through” for an ice cold refreshing sugar cane drink. Highlights included Chinatown and an ancient table. Loved it.

A fun way to see the city! - With only 2 days to see as much as we could in Ho Chi Minh City, we chose for the morning 'Sights' tour run by XO tours. We had a brilliant time and I would highly recommend XO tours to anyone! The drivers manoeuvred in and out of the traffic seamlessly and I felt very safe. The guides were knowledgable and very friendly. A great way to see the city, and way more fun than the usual coach or bus tours!

XO Motorbike Tours a big hit! - I really enjoyed my tour with Ngan and Hieu. They were both very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable people. Ngan is an awesome driver and I feel very safe with her driving me all around HCMC. Really enjoyed seeing the shrine to the Bodhisattva who set himself on fire in 1963 to protest. I was picked up outside my door... treated to drinks and fruit and they even followed up with sending me photos. Thank you!! Wayne from Canada.

Fantastic, not to be missed - My husband and myself visited Saigon in January and wanted to do the motor bike tour with XO tours. We chose the morning tour and also the evening foodie tour. We had the best time ever with the wonderful lady riders, who were most kind and considerate to all our needs. The tours were high fun and even though we are a mature couple, we are so very pleased we took the plunge and went ahead and booked. Do not hesitate, whatever your age, you will be well looked after and definitely will not regret it. Tours with XO is the best way to see Saigon.

A must-have in Ho Chi Minh City - They came and picked us up at the hotel, and from there it was just to hold on and enjoy. We felt very safe, the Girls were great riders, the Food was good, and we had a great time With a great group. We saw Places that we would never have seen if we hadn't gone on this tour. So just hold on, and go for it.

A must for any visitor! - S was just one of the most fun tours we've ever done! Our drivers were magnificent and fun to be with. We were treated to an array of street foods we would never have tried it was all delicious. At each stop we were given some local information and a
L our questions were answered by this intelligent group of staff.
Well done XO - this is an experience not to miss!
amazing stuff : Saigon Night Tour - Truly love the whole 3 hour tour that we had booked. The best way to see the city via scooters. Excellent experience! Definitely safe as well. a must do!

Fantastic experience, great guide - I got picked up (couple minutes early even) right at the hotel for this fantastic Scooter tour through the city. We stopped at a couple of places for Vietnamese food, which is all inclusive. These were all places you wouldnt normally visit as a tourist. Because I'm a picky eater my guide Thuy had to improvise and change one location, which was no problem at all. Nothing was a problem for Thuy: she explained everything i wanted to know in almost perfect english and I always felt 100% safe on the back of her bike. Totally recommended!

You can't miss this incredible tour. Definitely a highlight. - We did the Saigon by night tour last night with XO tours and couldn't rave about it enough. The girls who picked us up from our hotel were on time and very friendly. We rode with them to China Town for our first stop of the evening. They both made an effort to make conversation with us all night while on the bikes which we loved as we learned a lot about the city and were never bored! Each place we stopped at was fantastic with a lot of culture to experience and delicious food to try. We felt safe the whole night with our group and tour guide. We also loved that all the staff remembered our names and used them throughout the night. Wouldn't leave Ho Chi Minh without experiencing this tour; the staff, food and itinerary were all above standard and we couldn't recommend them enough. The best night we spent in the city, we wish we did it earlier in our trip but couldn't because of Tet. Loved every minute of the tour!

Must do if you never (or rarely) rode a scooter - I chose this experience based on other trip advisor reviews. Saigon can be daunting at night for the uninitiated.I have ridden scooters/bikes in a few countries before but not lately. Yet, I figured, since I had nothing better to do late evening and so figured why not see what the city feels like at night. After having taken this experience, I figured that it was not a good use of $45 for the 3-hour experience. I would still recommend this for travelers who never rode or rarely ride on a scooter. This, because the staff are professional yet friendly and informative yet balanced. The major drawback of this tour is that you cannot stop at specific places to take photos due to security issues - such as bag snatching. So it is an experience to be remembered than photographed. The scooter riders are all young college going or just graduated girls. In effect, you get a sense of their story during conversations in present day Vietnam. There are four pit stops. The first stop at Bin Thay chinese market is simply not worth it at night. Even the photo-op does not make sense. It is better visited during the day. The second stop is for dinner, the third at so called "mini-singapore" and the last stop at another foodie place. You need to ask yourself, is all this worth paying for and riding a scooter or you'd rather let someone else do all the planning and you simply tag along and meet nice, fun people. The tour guide Khoi was consistently enthusiastic and full of facts and figures. In the end, you receive the photos they promise you.

Motorbike tour in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam - Definitely, this is the most memorable experience ever in South East Asia. If I had enough time, I would have repeated this motorbike tour. I'll see again in my next trip to Saigon City, Vietnam. Love for you falks!!!

An investment! - I had an excellent experience with XO Tours in Saigon! I did the morning tour for about $40 and it was worth every penny. After spending a long time in SEA, I of course knew about the traffic and was a little scared about going on a motorcycle in HCMC. BUT, the driver was amazing. I feel more safe on her motorcycle than in a taxi. The guide was really nice and had a great bit of banter. All in all superb.

Highlights of our stay in HCMC - Must do if you are in Saigon/HCMC.

Being on the back of the motorcycle, delicious food, great companies and great hosts is a great way to know the city and escape the tourist areas of the cities. They made sure to accommodate my allergies just let them know in advance.

Although being on the back of the bike in Saigon traffic was terrifying, I never once felt unsafe, they took safety very seriously. If I make my way back to Vietnam, would definitely do this tour again - we just wished we had done this earlier in our travels so we could have done one of the daytime tours they offered.

"Simply the best." - " Simply the best "

An XO Tour is in my opinion the best tour anyone could do in Saigon / Ho Chi Minh City as it is now called.

They have several different tours that they offer during both and and in the evening. I was one of their 1st customers 5 years ago when XO tours first started. Tung the owner had only a couple of drivers then, now 5 years later more than 60 ladies are utilized as drivers (all of the drivers are ladies) There are quite a few more other employees in the company now and they have some men that do the Photos and Video (which is an option) and also act as guides.

A few weeks ago I made a booking for 8 pax for the night " Foodie Tour ". Everything went smoothly with the online booking which was very easy.

We met as scheduled at the Opera House at 5:00 pm. Upon my arrival about 30 minutes early there was someone already waiting there for our arrival. Yen, she turned out to be my driver. Soon all of the drivers, the guide, Hieu and his photo / video men were all there.

The 8 lady drivers were Yen, Tam, Nhu, Duong, Nhung, Quynh, Tuyet and My were stunningly dressed in their blue and white Ao Dai's. Each spoke fluent English and proceeded to give each of their respective passengers a detailed briefing with the " Do's and Don'ts " while on the bikes / motor scooters and then we were off. Traversing the roundabouts and negotiating intersections can be quite a task at anytime of the day there but at rush hour it is just pure crazy. Anyway, that is part of the thrilling experience and those that have done it before know what I am talking about. There is no such thing as yielding and stopping. Roads, lanes, alleyways in all directions just merge together and intertwine until they get through the particular intersection or roundabout seemingly effortlessly. There are literally tens of of thousands of bikes, cars and trucks always mingling amongst each other making left and right turns with NO ONE stopping just a slow continual motion on the busy streets. I wouldn't even consider attempting to try it. At the slowest time of day !!

We stopped at several places along the way for photo opportunities and brief sightseeing and at several local food establishments for some authentic local Vietnamese cuisine and local brews.
All of the staff enjoyed the food with us and answered any questions we had. There was plenty of food and beverages choices for all tastes. We did this for about 4 1/2 hours before we called it a night. It was a night to remember. We were talking about it the next day and everyone had a great time. We still talk about it and we are all still posting photos of our trip to Vietnam daily.

If you are ever in Saigon/Ho Chi Minh City and have the opportunity an XO Tours will be one you will remember for a lifetime. It is truly unique, exciting and tons of fun. The cost is minimal for what you get in memories and photos.

My thanks to Tung for creating this rare experience for tourists and a special thank you to my Driver, Yen. She was great. I am sure all my pax would agree each their drivers did an awesome job as well. All of the staff were extremely professional, courteous and I am sure they enjoyed us too. Hope to see you all again in a couple of years.

Fantastic tour - Hi guys, I just got back to Australia from my trip overseas, and now have time to write this review,
Whilst I was visiting Vietnam, I did the Saigon by night tour, and my tour guide was Ngan3, and she was absolutely fantastic, it was the best thing I did whilst in Vietnam.
She was so professional and so much fun. And the tour itself was fantastic, I will be telling my mates here in Melbourne it's a must do activity in Saigon. So Thankyou Ngan3 and Thankyou XO tours.

Kindest regards,
Brad from Melbourne.

Totally unmissable for foodies, 4 years later I still rave about it - I can't believe I didn't review XO tours before. I did the tour in 2012 and have recommended the night food tour to numerous friends who all came back raving about it. It's simple: if you like food, you cannot miss the foodie tour. It's a non stop 5hr intro to the very best the city has to offer, riding in style on the back of a motorbike, with some really interesting insights into the city as well. Tung Do who runs the company is incredibly sharp and personable, and has been helpful with recommendations even 4 years later! They are closed for Tet, so don't make the same mistake I made, and try to be in Saigon outside of Tet for their tour!

Foodie Night Tour - I can not say enough about the staff at HCMC XO. I booked a tour for visiting customers from the USA (total 9 people). The women the road us around are educated with great English skills - fantastic knowledge of the city ( they explain the different attractions, monuments, and areas of the city while navigating through the traffic). At each stop for the local food tasting - XO Tours has at group forge ahead of us so as we arrived all was prepared as we sat in our seats. During the meals the staff played games with us at the tables and entertained our group. Also note- they had 3 boys that followed our group to provide security - not that we traveled into any danger, they would support in case any of the motorcycles broke down or had any trouble.
All in all - I would recommend XO Tours to all the come to HCMC as you will see areas and eat fantastic foods that you would never find on your own. GREAT EXPERIENCE!!!

A big highlight of the trip, very well organized tour - What a great morning spent touring Saigon on the back of a motorbike! The high praise on TA drew me towards XO Tours and I was absolutely satisfied with my choice.

Our group of three did 'The Sights' tour and we had an awesome time. Everything was very well organized and professional from start to finish. What a rush this was! You can't experience the real Saigon until you've been on the back of a bike. Our excellent tour leader was Khoi Nguyen.

Perfect for adventurous food lovers! - This was one of the best things we did during our two-week stay in Vietnam. We did the foodie night tour where you get to eat delicious, and sometimes weird, Vietnamese food at the local spots, while seeing many districts in HCMC that we would have never gone to on our own.

Our lovely lady tour guides spoke great English, were so friendly, and we felt so safe with them! We love that they emailed us personal photos from the tour afterwards, definitely a nice touch.

Awesome - I had a great time on this tour. A group of 10 went together and were able to have a private tour. The girls were soooo lovely and made you feel safe and welcomed within minutes of arrival. Tour leader Anh was informed and cool. My driver Hong was the sweetest girl and you could tell she really loved her job. Couldnt recommend enough. Thank you XO

Put a smile on your face, have fun but also learn and experience - We booked 2x motor bike tours with XO, a morning HCMC tour, and an evening Foodie tour. Both these tours were well organized. Although you are told that all the drivers are ladies, there is also a number of guys in the background to look after the bikes when you stop at an attraction, get drinks ready and generally ensure your well being. The morning tour was just our party of 3x, and we saw a number of the main sites, and at each stop, one of the ladies would give us background information on the events or such. We requested at the end of the tour to be dropped off at Ben Thanh at this was not an issue and we were told how we could get back to our apartment. The Foodie tour was a great way to end our Vietnam trip. We joined up with a group of about 12x people and traveled to various parts of the city, each stop we were presented with different foods to try. The ladies joined us for the meals, and were able to give us guides on how to eat various foods, what sauces to use and such. Both tours had photos taken by the XO guys so one is able to get your whole group and drivers in the photos. Traffic in HCMC looks chaotic to most tourists, but we feel safe with our drivers, so relax and enjoy the sounds, smells and activities around you. May have paid a little more than other tours, but both tours were memories.

Food and Fun! - We did this at the end of our first full day in Vietnam and that was an excellent decision. I'd only ridden once on the back of a motorbike and was a little apprehensive about this, but the driver was great at explaining what I needed to do. That turned out to be important as I had to take a motorcycle taxi a few days later and I was comfortable doing so because of my night out on this tour.

The group was made of up 14 tourists and 14 drivers. They're all young women who speak incredibly good English. in fact, the woman who drove the bike that night was probably the best English-speaking guide I encountered in three weeks in Vietnam!

They were very accommodating of people who don't eat certain foods (my husband, for example) and give you a chance to try some of foods at restaurants that seem to have tasty offerings. The company also has a group of other people (a tour leader and 3 men who are watching out for us and the bikes while we're in the restaurants) who followed us from location to location.

The tour makes 5 stops in the course of the evening and three of them are eating stops: a restaurant that specializes in a beef soup from Hue, driving through Cholon (the city's Chinatown) past night markets and stopping opposite the wholesale market, a place that offers grilled meats, a district where wealthy ex-pats and Vietnamese live in high-rise buildings and finally to a seafood restaurant. All the stops were interesting and all the food was great.

It was a lot of fun and riding on the back of the back in the warm night air was a real blast. I'd go again.

BEST TOUR EVER!!! - My travel agent helped me book a 2 1/2 trip in Vietnam and Thailand. We were only in Ho Chi Minh City for 2 days so didn't want to book too many tours. I found this one on Trip Advisor and read the reviews and thought "this sounds like fun". So I booked it and ordered the video package (Note: Didn't know it at the time, but there is only 1 videographer per tour group, so we were lucky! Other people in our group said they tried to book it but we had already reserved. Just got my video today and have already watched it 3 times. ORDER THE VIDEO PACKAGE AS SOON AS YOU CAN AND TRY AND BE THE LUCKY PERSON IN YOUR GROUP.) My best friend and I were celebrating 50 years of friendship, so it was just the 2 of us. Our drivers (Tam and Tina) were beautiful and so much fun. Having watched the crazy scooter drivers in Vietnam that week, I didn't know what to expect, but these girls are such safe drivers. We tried some very different food; best of our vacation. Meeting people from other countries and dining together as a group was fun too. Saw parts of the city I would have never gone. I will go back to HCMC just to do this tour all over again! Do not hesitate to book this. I promise you won't regret it!

THE BEST TOUR. No questions about it. - The absolute only way to see Saigon. Soak in the atmosphere, the smells, sounds and sights riding with the coolest chicks in Vietnam. Honestly would do this tour over and over again.

No. 1 for a reason - XO tours are consistently no 1 on tripadviser - and for a good reason.
- Brilliant staff with way above average English levels for Vietnam
- A fun but safe attitude to riding around the streets on motorbikes
- Willing to stray from the tourist areas and show you the other side of Saigon
- Professional

Foodie tour delivered exactly as promised - off the beaten track places that tourists will never go without the help of a local guide. No spring rolls, no pancakes, no pho, just authentic Vietnamese experience in 3 different restaurants

Staff are so much fun and well done to XO tours for giving young Vietnamese men and women a good future. Mr Tai was our leader, great personable guy and amazing ability to remember all our names from the start.

Was very hesitant to hop on the motorbike, but by the end of the evening was thinking I should buy one :-)

Don't think about it - just book !!

I Would Fly half way across the world to do this again! - This was without doubt the best thing we did in the whole of Vietnam. Not only an incredible food tour, eating fantastic local food from restaurants, markets and street vendors off the beaten track, you also get a guided tour guide of the many districts in the city.

For those with only a few days in the city, this is the perfect way to indulge in the amazing local culture while seeing much more of the city then you would have otherwise had fitted in.

I can not wait to visit again (hopefully very very soon) and the first thing that will be booked will be the XO food tour.

Brilliant - Recommended by friends so we took the plunge, it was fabulous, never thought at my age I would be racing round Saigon on a moped. it couldn't have been more fun and they pre organized veggie food for us which was delicious. Hieu Nguyen was our tour guide and did an excellent job, the girls driving us around were so lovely. I enjoyed every moment and everyone should do this!!! Its a great way of seeing the city.

Really different way of seeing the city - I did the foodie tour - it was great! They bring you to several different places around town, which I would have never gone to otherwise (outside of District 1). The group was small (I think we were 12) and in any case we each went on one motorbike. We even have "bodyguards" that go on their own bike and escort us the whole way...

We ate a ton of different things, that again I would have never tried otherwise. The staff is really nice, and being a night tour is nice because you don't get too hot on the motorbike! You do spend quite some time on the bike, but still stop for long enough every time to have a nice chat with the rest of the group while you eat, but also to your driver :)

So i do really recommend it!
Fantastic food tour - This was a great way to experience Saigon at night on the back of a motorbike while also enjoying Vietnamese food. Great guides for a fun evening.

Awesome sites tour! - I was a little weary of motorbikes but decided it was probably the best way to see the city. And it was ! So fun! I saw a ton of sites, tried some new foods, and in the end I wasn't even holding on in riding the bike. This us one of the best tours I've been on I highly recommend. You see a lot of sites in 3 hours, and get a more authentic experience on a motorbike. By the end of the tour I was ready to rent one!

Tour guide also took some great photos which he emailed out afterwards, which is nice thing to do, especially since as a solo traveler I'm taking too many selfies!!

Best night out in Ho Chi Minh City ! - If you're lucky to get Thu and Quynh as your quides you will have a great and memorable experience. We chose for the foodie tour and were not disappointed, these two ladies had us trying everything and everything local you can imagine. If you are squirmish or have allergies towards any foods, they will avoid them but if you're ready to indulge they will feed your taste buds. Along with feeding till you are stuffed all over Ho Chi Minh, they will also entertain, amuse and inform you of their beautiful city. These two ladies made our night very memorable and surprised us with an anniversary cake to finish the night. You can do no better then XO Tours, the best in our opinion !

Foodie Tour - Great food and drivers were knowledgeable, safe and fun. I would recommend this tour for those wanting to sample delicious Vietnamese food as well as experience the lesser known and touristy areas of Ho Chi Minh.

Exciting, Fun, Scary - We did the night food tour. The traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is very dense. I couldn't understand the rules of the road. This made the tour a little scary and exciting. Definitely outside of my comfort zone, but the drivers were wonderful. The staff/management were thoughtful, considerate, and enthusiastic. The food was mostly good and always interesting. We tried everything, both food and drink (including iced tea) and did not have any negative consequences. While we were told we could have as much of everything we wanted, including beer, there was so much we couldn't enjoy more than a taste of everything. Also, they were great about accommodating my dietary restrictions and they sent us great photos. We highly recommend this tour for the adventurous.

Way beyond Excellent, Way beyond 5 stars. - From booking until the end of the tour, THEY NEVER DISSAPOINT YOU.
-Fast, efficient and very VERY considerate service from them.
-Friendly driver, supporting team and ofcuz the leader of the amazing team, tour leader.
-High Customer Satisfaction is never easy, everyone demands differently, but they did it. You can choose not to believe me, but hey! u saw the 2000++ people rated them Excellent, why not give a try?
-HAD SO MUCH FUN, NEVER THOUGHT MOTOR BIKE TOUR CAN BE THAT FUN! LOVE IT!!!

Super fun! Great way to check out all the districts! - We were a little reluctant to sign up because of the high price since we're budget traveling, but it was definitely a worthwhile experience and we're glad we joined in on the fun.

This isn't just a food tour, but you ride through about 5 districts. While I was expecting to be eating nonstop at back to back restaurants, I thoroughly enjoyed riding through the streets of Saigon and getting to tour the other districts I would not have gone to see on my own. I felt completely safe since there are other male workers who accompanies each group and act as crossing guards.

I loved the fact that they are all female drivers, and they are all fluent in English, super friendly, and provide the best dining experience. I loved chatting with my driver. We sat next to our assigned driver at the restaurants and they did all the food prep and cooking so all we needed to do was enjoy the food. The food was delicious, and we tried some foods that I normally would have tried on my own. It's all part of the adventure and experiencing more of the authentic cuisines since tourists mainly stick to the known phos, spring rolls, and banh mis. You are allowed unlimited portions of food and drinks at each stop, which was nice.

The leader of the tour takes pictures throughout the tour and emails them to you for no added charge, which is a bonus.

I learned a lot, tried good food, and had an all around great experience! I would recommend this tour if you want to explore Saigon, engage with and learn from the locals, and try good eats.
Foody tour - We did a foody tour, which was absolutely fantastic. The girls on the scooters are really choice and the food is yum. Would realy recommend it :)

Great way to eat Great Food - Went on the foodie tour on our second night in Ho Chi Minh, Great way to get around and see areas of the city you will not get to on your own. Went with XO because of the great reviews and because the riders were all girls which made my wife feel more secure, she did admit that after the first minute even she could settle down and enjoy the ride. The food stops were excellent with the girls always asking if you wanted more to eat or drink. At 5 hrs a great way to spend an evening.

Your Saigon itinerary’s priority number 1. - It's probably a bit dearer than some other scooter tours but it is so worth it. Excellent organization from start to finish. All staff members were super friendly. My wife and I (50-somethings) and my 2 boys 18 & 20 all had a great time. You get to see a great deal of the city and taste a great variety of absolutely authentic Vietnamese food. You get commentary the whole way so it is kind of a guided tour + food educational tour all in one. Don't be put off by the scooter thing - if we can do it anyone can do it.
One of the best organized tours I have EVER been on.
I would make this tour your Saigon route's priority number 1.

Perfect introduction! - Full of history told in a captivating way by genuine, kind, fun guides! Riding around the city by motorbike is also a unique experience. As someone who rides herself, I appreciate being in the back seat and getting the chance to just soak it all up. A great way to get a quick overview before diving deeper yourself. Loved it!

Do this! Best money we spent on our trip - We are on a 4 month trip and this tour was a bit out of our price range but it was worth every penny. Could not recommend this enough. I would say even if you are on a tight budget try as hard as you can to save to make this tour part of your travels. If you love food you will love this.

It was not only delicious delicious delicious but also informative. We felt like we learned more about Saigon in these few hours than our 4 days in the city.

Understanding who ran the tour was very knowledgable and approachable. I had Thanh had my guide and she was lovely and a very skilled driver- they all are!

It was a thrill to ride through the Saigon traffic too, an experience I'll remember forever.

The scallops were a highlight!

They take photos of your evening and email them through to you free of charge which is a lovey and thoughtful touch.

Book it now!! It gets booked up!!

A must-do!! - We went on the foodie tour around Ho Chi Mihn city, and it was one of the highlights of our month long trip in Vietnam. Never having been on a motorbike before I was abit nervous, but I felt safe the entire time and our two drivers were exceptional! Our guide Khoi was also outstanding. We saw a lot of sights we wouldn't have otherwise gone to, and the food was great. A must do when in Ho Chi Minh City!

Fantastic evening, great food & amazing guides - Picked up on time from our hotel by our two guides/drivers, Yen & Quynh. Straight into the whirlwind of rush hour traffic but felt completely safe & in good hands. From then on it was whistle stop tour of local food treats, markets, etc with our guides making sure we had an amazing time. All too quickly we were back at the hotel with great memories & full stomachs! We have already recommended them to friends heading that way. Thank you XO tours.

Perfect Introduction to Saigon and Its Cuisine - If you're looking for a way to kickstart your stay in Saigon, look no further than XO Tours! We booked a private foodie tour for the first night of our trip and thought it was a great way to get to know the city and its food.

The tour definitely lived up to its name - we tried a lot of interesting examples of Vietnamese cuisine that you would be hard pressed to find in a restaurant outside of the country. Expect to taste delicious soup (hue beef noodle soup), grilled meats (goat and frog, aka "jumping chicken" :-), seafood, and if you're feeling adventurous, maybe even balut (half-hatched egg) - believe it or not, it isn't half bad in tamarind sauce!

Our tour guides, Huong and Bao were super knowledgeable about the food, history, and layout of Saigon. They were both amazing motorbike drivers, and had no problem conversing in fluent English while cruising along the city's busy streets. I also really liked how they provided information about Saigon's different neighborhoods and lots of little tips along the way, like how to tell which district you're in and where to find the best coffee.

I'd highly recommend a tour with XO while visiting Saigon - if I have an opportunity to return I'd love to go on another one.

The most fun we had in Ho Chi Minh City! - I was initially a little apprehensive about this motor bike ride in Saigon but so glad we did it! The girls were great drivers and earned my trust. The sites were interesting but just being in the thick of that crazy traffic was a rush! I heartily recommend this to anyone. I am 70 and my husband is 73 and we really enjoyed it. The girls were very sweet and the guide was knowlegable and spoke good English. They even threw in some sugarcane juice with kumquat which was a treat.

If you only do one tour in HMC, DO THIS ONE! - My wife and I chose the Foodie tour with another couple. It was the best $72pp ever spent! First, they picked us up at our hotel. We were each assigned our own girl driver and rode on the back of their motorbike. Being 6'4" and weighing 230lbs, I was a little concerned at first but let me tell you, these girls know how to drive! They are charming, funny and FANTASTIC drivers...navigating the streets of Saigon with expertise. We met up with a larger tour group at the first restaurant where we sampled our first dish. Upon leaving the restaurant, the tour guide and several security escorts joined the group. We proceeded to several restaurants throughout the city and sampled some amazing food and drinks from several different districts. The food and drinks (including beer) are all-you-can-eat so we were fat and happy by the end of the night. I can't say enough about this tour, it has it all -- excitement, good food, beer, adventure, nice people, funny tour guides...This tour remains a highlight of our trip to Vietnam!

Fun Night, Yummy Food, Great Guides & Crazy Traffic!! - We booked the night Foodie Tour and met our guides at the Opera House. Two petite beautiful young ladies with cute motorbikes and a hell of riding skills that will put any racer to shame!! They weave in and out of the crazy traffic with ease and confidence.
