I never felt my life was endangered. It was super exciting to be caught in the traffic. U HAVE TO BE ON A BIKE TO EXPERIENCE THE FULL EXTENT OF THE CRAZY TRAFFIC!! hahahahaha it was very memorable. Lots of great food! Stuff that you will not find in your usual Vietnamese restaurant back home. No Pho! No Rice!! I wouldn't spoil the surprise for you but they ended the tour with a "special" dish. Only for the adventurous!! PLEASE SKIP THIS TOUR IF YOU JUST WANT A QUIET BORING NIGHT. FUN GUARANTEED for this tour.

Highlights of our time in HCMC - My husband and I were fortunate to get into the night time food tour due to a cancellation of another party. Although we attempted to make reservations about 4 weeks in advance, they were fully booked. We are so happy we made it in! It was a fabulous experience.

We were picked up from our hotel by two women dressed in traditional Vietnamese ao dai, the national costume worn by women. We were given instructions on what to do (or not do) on the back of the motorbike and off we went to our first stop, a restaurant offering soup with beef and noodles (delicious). It was here we met our group mates along with the host for the evening, Anh. Anh laid out the agenda for the evening, the number of stops and the type of food we would be tasting. He took pictures of everyone and then off we went through the crazy streets of HCMC. At first I was nervous on the back of the motor bike, but my guide for the evening was a careful driver and eventually I relaxed and thoroughly enjoyed the ride. Over the course of the evening we traveled through several districts sampling a wide variety of food including: frog, goat, shrimp, scallops and lots of other tasty treats. Food and beer was unlimited. The evening flew by and before we knew it, our foodie tour was over. I will never forget this experience and would highly recommend it to anyone who is looking for a glimpse into the real food culture of the Vietnamese people.

Also - during the course of the evening, Anh took many pictures of us and emailed them to us later. Much appreciated!

Excellent,adventuresand must do - It was the most interesting night with so many highlights.From the time you get on the bike till you say goodbye was the utmost adventures experince.They are excellent in speaking english,driving,and showing us four different districts,markets,you eat so much and have so much fun,and laughter.The food was outstanding and new flavours and new exotic food.One of the best experiences of my time in Vietnam not be missed

Adventurous ride! - We 4 ladies did the Sight Tour in a Sun morning, with 4 nice lady riders. They spoke good English and were friendly. Since there was nobody else joined the tour, they were kind to have asked us what we would like to see, as if it's a private or custom tour. The ride was fun and safe. Not a moment I felt unsafe and it was an adventure to be on a bike in this city with crazy traffic. They treated us to iced sugarcane drinks and some rambutan, and took some nice shots of us. It's not cheap but it's definitely worth it.

Terrific, cool and fantastic - The traffic in Ho Chi Minh may not be a heaven for the most European, American or Australian people, it's worse to have a look at the manner how they transport any too long products on the motobike. Sometimes it goes wrong and there happens an accident, but most of the time it goes well.

A TRUE HIGHLIGHT - If you only do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City, this should be it. The girls were gorgeous, friendly, helpful and very safe drivers. They allowed my husband and me to experience the city and its foodie scene from the back of motor scooters. We certainly dined at places we would have never gone to otherwise.
The three food stops we made were great. There was such an assortment of different foods. Be adventurous and try it all, and did I mention it was all you can eat. And even the beers were included in the price. While at dinner, your lovely ladies will even clean your shrimp and crab and even feed you if need be.
The only negative part of the evening was when we rode for 30 minutes to get to Chinatown, which sounded like a great idea, however, when we got there everything was closed. Why ride for half an hour just to see darkened buildings?
It was easy to make reservations on-line, so make sure you do that prior to your arrival and enjoy!

Fantastic - This was the highlight of our trip. We are 'in our 60's' and had a blast. The girl's are fantastic. The bike and their driving skills are very professional and safe. The entire operation is top class and extremely well put together. You see and learn so much. Each stop is full of history and information. The food is local, absolutely beautiful and the venues are outstanding. This is the only way you should ever see this wonderful city and its diverse Districts. We will do it again and again.....

The Food. The Scooters. The Guides. The One Thing You Must Do in Saigon! - If you haven't made plans yet for Saigon, then this post and the rest of the posts in this thread are the only thing you need to consider.

XO Tours. Is. That. Good.

For serious.

I took the 'Foodie Tour' on my first night in Saigon, and then the morning 'Sights' tour the next day.

First of, I consider myself quite knowledgeable guides in Vietnamese cuisine, but my tour really took me to school. The food was so legit, MC Hammer would quit.

Furthermore, the lady guides were professional, funny, informative and most of all - really good riders! I didn't feel unsafe for a second on their scooters (and I'm pretty worried about women drivers in my own country).

Big shout out to Thu, Thao, H'uong, Kho and Tam.

Thu is dead good at telling you everything you shouldn't know about Saigon City~!
Warning, she is born in the Year of the Horse, so if you are born in the Year of the Rooster...don't get on her bike. Haha.

Huong and Tam ran the Foodie Tour like it was a top rated culinary TV show. They knew all the ins and outs of how to prepare the food, how to eat the food and even the history of the food. Seriously, they should get their own spot on The Food Network - they would be heaps better than Jamie Oliver. And I like Jamie Oliver too.

Thao is really genuine. ^_^ Kho seems to know every nook and cranny of all the Districts in Saigon.

What you get with XO Tours is an experience with real cool Saigonese cats. This is the real beauty of XO Tours - to be able to roll with dope people in the backdrop of a phenomenal up and coming city taking in the food and history.

Thanks XO tours, I will definitely be back. But not on Thu's scooter because I am born in the Year of the Rooster.

Chris, Christmas Island.

Ho Chi Minh City by Night - Oh My God!!!
I had such an amazing evening riding through Ho Chi Minh!!!
Thu Duong and her colleagues are simply amazing, very knowledgable and so funny!!!
Ho Chi Minh by night is such different experience!
I was lucky to see different districts that most visitors don't get to see and the wide contrasts between the old and new modern city!
The local food and drinks were excellent!!
I DEFINITELY recommend this tour!!

Wonderful amazing food tour - I did the evening food tour. It couldn't have been better. My driver was informative and safe. They took us to many areas most tourists don't know about. I can't recommend it highly enough.

Absolute MUST for first-time AND seasoned visitors to Saigon! - A friend in Singapore recommended XO Tours (Foodie edition, in my case) and at first I was wary of spending one of my precious two nights in HCMC on a 4.5-hour scooter tour. Would it be safe? Worth my time? Too tourist-y?

The answers of course are yes, HELL yes, and no way. XO Tours is a legitimate "local" experience - we sampled all sorts of food from the traditional (beef noodle soup) to the surprisingly delicious (BBQ'd goat and frog) to the adventurous (balut), all while whipping through the vibrant and beautiful city on the back of a very professional driven scooter.

Our drivers Ngan and Luong were fantastic - we never felt unsafe, they answered all of our questions, and were very honorable throughout the ride. Being on the back of a bike is truly the way to experience this city - and experience we did, stopping all throughout Districts 4, 5, and 7, and seeing a mixture of the very local (a streetwide produce market) to the very well-known (seafood street in District 4).

Our tour guide, Tai, was absolutely wonderful - charming, funny, and informative, and made sure every single person on the tour was served and charged for (even when I asked for bathroom visits every other stop, haha). His English is fantastic and all of us Americans and Singaporeans (definitely making up the bulk of the group) could understand him and feel that he was professional and intelligent.

If you are a foodie, love adventure, want to see a different side of Saigon, or simply want a glamorous yet authentic taste of an amazing city, XO Tours are your people. We can't wait to come back and try another tour soon!

Night tour of Saigon. - This was our favorite trip in Ho Chi Minh. Thao and Thanh were excellent guides who made our night keeping us entertained with their local knowledge and good conversation.

The traffic looks terrifying but the girls negotiate it with ease making sure that their passengers are comfortable at all times. There are parts of the city that we visited on this tour that we would just have never seen without it.

The food that we ordered for was lovely, with a choice of dishes to pick from so something to suit everyone.
Booking was really easy through the website and the guides were on time.

I couldn't recommend this trip enough.

Informative and Entertaining Tour, Fantastic Hosts - The Saigon-By-Night Tour was a really fantastically formed tour, and my driver, Thao, along with her excellent team, made sure we were enjoying ourselves and personally engaged the whole time.

The tour itself includes a number of stops in locations and districts that most tourists don't get to see, including Districts 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8. Each district was unique and some felt a world away from Saigon (District 7, I'm looking at you). We stopped for dinner, and later dessert, and both were very delicious. The ride is fun, never feels dangerous, and the girls speak English very well - keeping up a conversation and joking all the time.

I would recommend taking this particular tour on one of your first nights in Saigon - I took it on my last night, and seeing all the enchanting, exciting places I had missed holed my heart. It provides a fantastic introduction to places that you could choose to revisit in the following days!

It's also worth mentioning how excellent my guide, Thao Nguyen, was. She was spunky, funny, and had loads of charisma. She was the leader of our group and gave us thorough information in very useful English. She was very personable on our ride, and willing to open up. Her passion and consideration shone through at every opportunity. To give an example: you have one of three options for dinner. Amongst our tour group, we had only covered two of the three options; nobody chose for the third. But while we were at the restaurant, Thao wanted us to have tried all three, so she and her team picked up the tab on the third dish, and enough of it for us all to walk away stuffed. It was a very sweet show of good-will.

All in all, the best tour I had on my whole trip. Well-organized, equal parts informative and entertaining, and all the while fun.

Enjoy!

Tour that exceeded our Expectations - Wasn't expecting much from the tour originally, thought it'd be a quick tour round the city then a drop off as my girlfriend and I picked 'The Sights' tour. But from the moment we first met them until we said goodbye they were friendly, professional and positive.

Riding a motorcycle through Saigon can be dangerous but they always took care to drive safely which was appreciated. Tour itself was also engaging and fun.

The team leader Khoi was also very friendly yet professional. Made us feel safe and welcome in a city that can be overwhelming at times. Definitely recommend to give them a shot but make sure to have bring sun protection if choosing the day tour as it can get hot. Otherwise have fun.

Gratifying yet humbling expericience - I signed up for the XO foodie trip tour and by far it has been the best tour throughout my stay.

This tour not only brings you all across the city to uncover some of the best eats of the city and it paints a touching picture of he day in the life of the local as we moved from one stop to another. If you're looking for a true image of the city that is distinct from the glitzy façade of what a typical tourist will experience in touristy areas like District 1, This is it!

The entire trip lasted through the night amidst the busy night traffic, but I was thoroughly entertained throughout by my chatty and friendly lady motorbike driver Tham. This trip completely erased one of my biggest concern which is language barrier but rest assured, all of them, especially my tour guide, Hieu converse fluently in English.

Lastly, the trip doesn't just got there, 3 days later you'll be sent photos of you taken during the trip and you'll be reminiscing of the good times that you had.

While it might be more expensive in comparison to other food tours, I implore you to hit the sign up button as it is definitely worth your money

Happy travels!

Great Tour for Tourists - I would have to recommend XO tours to any foreigner coming to Ho Chi Minh City. The food is great and they do a great job in selecting restaurants in order to get a more "local" experience. The foodie tour took us out of the familiarity of the backpackers district and gave us the chance to see more of the city and how the residents may eat. As a lover of all foods, they did a nice job of diversifying the restaurants and styles of food (bun bo hue, bbq, and seafood). That being said, I wouldn't have minded if they took us to one more restaurant.

Besides the food aspect, the tour gave me a better understanding of the city. The group leader, Tai will stop and explain certain places and ideas to the group. While riding along, the tour guides (in my case Tien) will explain their experiences in their city and point out places to see and things to do. Quite receptive in answering questions while maneuvering through traffic. Which brings me to something I really need to compliment them on is their ability to navigate through traffic. My guide, Tien, was an excellent driver and despite being swarmed in traffic at times, I always felt safe.

If the food and motorbikes weren't enough, Tai and the girls kept things light and fun. They do a great job with making sure their customers are happy and getting their money's worth. As a 23 year-old I had a great time, and if I ever made my way back to HCMC I would repeat this tour.

Fun way to see Saigon like a local - Not for the faint-hearted, driving on a scooter in crazy traffic to try some real Vietnamese food was a lot of fun. The girls were very safe, but I still couldn't open my eyes all the time. Some of the stops were for food, others for info (some of these could have been shorter). The food was good, and we were usually the only non-locals at the places. It is LONG (almost 5 hours), so be prepared.

The best way to see Saigon - We did a private daytime tour as a group of 5. XO are true professionals at every level. Everything is covered on their website and explained when you confirm your booking. Our head guide for the day was Huong, who was very friendly and spoke excellent English. All the other ladies were also very friendly and funny throughout the tour which made it even more enjoyable. They were all excellent bike riders and we always felt safe as we toured around town. This is the best way to see Saigon by far. Get the video as it a great way to remember the day. I cannot say enough about the high quality of this tour. Well worth every cent. Thanks XO tours.

Great Fun - My 18 year old son and I did the foodie tour and loved it. I felt very safe with the driver - who are all women and we saw parts of Saigon we wouldn't otherwise see. The food was delicious - a must do in my opinion. My driver was fun, informative and a lovely young woman

XO Night Food Vespa Tour - One of the best activities we have done during our month long stay in Vietnam. Felt very safe with our 11 year old daughter on the back of Vespa. Safety is a big priority. Food, service & interacting with individual guides was great. Visited 5 different districts from Wealthy to Poorer suburbs. Food was just amazing although held off on a few local delicacies- duck embryo etc. Our 3 lovely girl guides were very professional and just lovely. Best thing we did in Saigon. 👍

Super fun, great food, cool drivers - One of the highlights of our Vietnam trip was the scooter food tour through HCMC. Fantastic food and a lot of fun. We were picked up at our hotel by college age female scooter drivers. They introduced themselves and told us basic safety then we were off to meet the rest of our group. A soup kind of like Pho was our first stop. Next stopped in Chinatown to look around. Next stop we grilled meat at our tableside. Friggin delicious. We also did a toast with a traditional local alcohol, I can't remember what it was. Did I tell you that its all you can drink beer? They also gave us a phrasebook of common Vietnamese words. This tour would be a great idea for one of your first days in the city so you figured out the layout and the more distant parts. Our last stop was at a more unique restaurant serving foods like Bolutes (a la Survivor) and a lot of shellfish.

The scooter drivers were fun to chat with. We got to ask question about life in Vietnam and they answered, in somewhat reserved answers sometimes though. Super fun to just look around the twon while they buzz you around the streets. It feels super safe the whole time and they have a helmet for you. They also have a couple of big security guys on motorcycles riding with the pack.

Excellent Saigon Tour! - My girlfriend and I did both the daytime “Sights” tour and the evening “Foodie” tour! What an excellent way to tour Saigon! The girls / drivers / guides arrived at our hotel early and all spoke great English and knew the city and the sights well! They safely drove us through the chaotic city streets while pointing out sights of the city! Understanding, the head guide, gave us great information at our stops and had great reference pictures on his notebook as well and was able to clearly answer all of our questions.

If you just arrived in Saigon, the Sights Tour is an excellent way to understand the layout of the city!

The Foodie tour was great too! Many varieties of tasty Vietnamese cuisine were enjoyed! Hieu and the girls knew the food well and did great at entertaining us while we ate! If you decide to do the Foodie tour, be sure to come hungry! Skip your lunch the day because there is plenty of delicious food to eat!

I would highly recommend any of the XO tours for anyone new to the city!

My only gripe, and it is a small gripe, is the payment method. You can only pay in cash on the day of the tour or by PayPal a few days in advance. It would be great if they could take a credit card on the day of the tour!

Lovely way to experience the city - We went on the Foodie Tour after reading a lot of good reviews and didn't think that this could be so good that the review said. But we where very surprised, our tour-guides where wonderful, charming and so funny! The food was delicious and it was a real experience to see so much of HCMC that we wouldn't have seen otherwise. Than you XO Tours for a fun night, we really recommend everyone to go!

Moped tour of Ho Chin Minh City - We did the 4 1/2 hour food tour around the city on the back of a moped ridden by local girls. I ride motor bikes back home and was pleased to be on the back, the amount of traffic out there is mind blowing, how ever things flow is unbelievable. at no point did I feel un safe during this trip as the girls knowledge of the roads and were we where going was fantastic. The food was local so a few different flavors that you wouldn't normally try. I'm 16 stone and my guide must only have been about 7 1/2 stone but she never wobbled at all with a big lump like me on the back. This is the ultimate way to see all the different zones that the city is divided into from the new modern to the old and poorer areas. I have traveled the world and done many a trip, but this trip is a must do as for value and experience, this is the best trip me and my partner have done

The best tour I have ever done - From being picked up to being dropped off I felt completely safe on this tour, mix adrenalin with food and alcohol and you have a recipe for a great night, the tour guides were very knowledgable and attentive, The food was varied, we saw a great deal of Ho Chi Minh City through this tour.
Great foodie tour :-) - We had a fantastic foodie tour with XO tours, the staff, atmosphere and food was perfect. We loved it, what a tour on the "moped".

Absolutely loved this! - Took the night/foodie tour and collected by 2 scooters and met up with 10 more at first stop. Was a brilliant night and we both enjoyed it. Chat with the girls and the other tourist is great and the girls and the rest of the crew were so clued in and chatty.

The food was not spectacular but overall was a blast!

Fantastic friendly fun - Would recommend that all travelers to HCM sign up for a tour with this company. We joined them last night for the Saigon Light Up the Night Tour. 4 adults and 3 kids (16, 14 & 13 years). Within 5 minutes kids were relaxed and were chatting away to their driver (everyone spoke very good English). Traffic was crazy however felt safe at all times. Food was delicious. Great fun and an excellent way to see HCM. Worth paying for the best!

XO Sights Tour - We did this back-of-the-scooter tour around the principal sights of HCMC. By car/taxi it will take double the time and of course, a paid guide will also be needed. Plus, traveling on the back of these scooters is not as hairy as you might think. The riders are young HCMC students in the main and they are super confident. At each stop, a guide is on hand to provide historical information plus water and other soft drinks. You will quarter the city and learn much of its colorful history, all in a three-hour plus excursion. Highly recommended.

Fantastic! - Worth every dollar! Everything about the tour was fantastic..the food, the lady tour guides were very friendly and knowledgeable, and the tour leader spoke great English and gave us an incredibly, insightful look into Vietnam and its culture. The tour goes through many of the different districts not often visited by tourists, and they make it a point not to feed you "popular" Vietnamese meals that you will often see in your own country. Couldn't recommend this tour more!

The best!! - We did the night tour. The experience is exciting, amazing and informative. The guides and riders all spoke good English, are knowledgeable and happy to answer questions as well as taking an interest in us and where we are from. We were unable to book the tour for our first night in Ho Chi Minh due to them being fully booked already. I strongly recommend you book early and do this activity as your first in Ho Chi Minh as the information you receive from the tour will be of use for the rest of your stay. A special thanks to our riders, Nhi, Quynh, Wan (apologies if spelling is incorrect) who looked after my family so well, and our guide Anh for his informative and humerous talks.

Excellent sights tour - We did the morning sights tour with XO tours and we were extremely satisfied. The girls came to pick us up at our airbnb and brought us to the first stop where we met up with another couple. We traveled as a group through the various sites. Our drivers were very safe and incredibly sweet, always offering information and making us feel comfortable. In addition to our drivers we had a tour leader who gave us some history along the way and another staff who accompanied us throughout the day. It was a great combination of main tourist locations and an insight into some local hot spots where we got to samples some desserts and drinks. Overall this was a great intro to Saigon. Definitely worth your time and money!!

Amazing time with XO Tours - We had an amazing time with XO Tours! Our guides were fabulous (sweet, adventurous, spoke English really well, happy to answer questions, great drivers). We immediately felt super safe on the bikes. We enjoyed riding on the mopeds more than we did seeing the sights. We even thought about going on another XO Tour the following week since we had so much fun!

Fantastically fabulos - Did this tour on 15 January no one who knows methought I would do it
I felt very safe all of the time and couldn't wait to get back on the bikes
The food was great and the drivers and team leader couldn't have been more friendly helpful and attentive

It's a must whilst in Ho Chi Minh - I did the XO tour on the last night of my Vietnam trip, and it was by far the best experience of my holiday - an amazing/incredible/culturally enriching experience. I would even do the tour again if I was still over there. The unique array of Vietnamese food coupled with no shortage of beer made for a highly enjoyable night - great tour group and of course my amazing XO driver Thao! I even had the opportunity to shout một hai ba do with the locals as we knocked back a few beers! Sensational- thanks so much XO tours!

女性一人でも最高に楽しめました／Soooooo much fun even I was alone! - 女性一人で「The Foodie」に参加しましたが、期待をはるかに超える楽しさでした。
一人に一人ずつ、明るくてかわいらしい女性のツアーガイドさんがついてくれて、バイクの後ろにのって夜のホーチミンの街を周ります。ガイドブックを見ながらレストランを回っていたら絶対に食べられない、ホーチミンの地元民しか知らないようなグルメスポットを一夜で回って、シーフードや野菜、肉、果物など少しずついろんな種類の美味しい物を、彼らおすすめのお店で食べさせてくれます。

それぞれのスポットに行く前後には、市内の様々な区域に寄って、彼らの暮らし、楽しみ方、街の紹介をしてくれるので、その間にほどよくお腹がこなれて、「数が多くて食べきれないかも？」という心配もなく、最後までしっかり美味しく食べることができました。（逆に「足りなければ追加料金なしでもっと持ってきますよ」とも言ってくれるので、たくさん食べたい方にも安心だと思います。）ツアーに含まれる飲み物は、ビールもお茶もありますので、飲む人も飲まない人も、楽しめると思います。

ツアーガイドの女性は、みんな明るくて、賢く、元気でかわいらしかったです。わたしのガイドになってくれたホンさんは、独学で日本語を勉強中とのことで、一生懸命、知っている単語で話かけてくれました。英語と日本語を交えて、お互いのことや仕事のこと、やりたいことなどをバイクでおしゃべりしながら、カオス状態のホーチミンの車とバイクの中に混ざって夜の街を飛ばしていくのは、本当に楽しかった！偶然一緒に参加していた５０代の日本人のご夫婦も、最初は静かでしたが、すぐに打ち解けて、笑顔で「最高！」とおっしゃっていました。最後には、ツアーの方でわたしの誕生日までお祝いしてくれて、忘れられない思い出になりました。

参加した数日後には、彼らが撮ってくれた写真も届きます。今度ホーチミンにいったら、また参加したいです。

The Foodie I joined alone was much more than I expected ever. Of course it was great that I could try the great choice of delicious local meat, seafood, noodle dishes, vegetables and fruits which I would not be able to find alone. But not just I could satisfy my curiosity about food, it was also very exiting to see around the town on the bike, in the chaos of HMC crazy traffic. Especially the my guide Hong was excellent - very cute, kind, smart, friendly and person of the full of hospitality. Not just having great food experience, also riding keep chatting on her bike talking about each of us, fun games during dinner and the final surprise for my birthday is one of the BEST memory in my life.

I would like to keep this review to show my best appreciation for them - thank you so much Hong, and tour leader, Hieu!

Best thing to do in Saigon. - I did this tour with a friend last night for our first night in busy Saigon. It was so great to talk to the girls and have them tell us about the city/sights and local food. The girls and tour guide were amazing and such fun. Would definitely recommend, worth every cent. Thank you for a great night.

Emily and Chloe

A MUST DO experience in Saigon! - We did the night Foodie Tour and it is one of the best experiences we enjoyed in 1 month of travels!!! They are simply great: you will visit districts you won't see otherwise, you enjoy a great company, great food, sightseeing, historical notes etc... Extraordinary and well organized. A MUST DO!!!

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh at night - First night in Ho Chi Minh experienced motorbike ride at night sampling various local food markets. All completely safe and well organized. Very friendly English speaking guides. Food some of the tastiest we tried. Emailed photos a few days later for no extra charge. Highly recommend!
Really sad - This is interesting to visit the city by Motirbike. You can see crowded traffic. A lot of people and noise.
Best thing to do in Saigon - Wonderful way to see the real HCMC and get a taste for what life is like. Fantastic food and absolutely no regrets. Our tour-guide Hieu was awesome.

Highlight of my time in Ho Chi Minh! - My friend and I were looking for a fun way to explore the city and eat where the locals eat. This Foodie Tour hits the mark! We had such a fantastic time riding around the city with our fabulous drivers and learning about the culinary culture and customs of the local Vietnamese. Our drivers were excellent and it was a lot of fun to mix in with the swarm of scooters on the road and find great spots not generally frequented by tourists. Highly recommend!!!

Great experience with good food - Had a great night with the xo crew. All the staff was very good in English and the tourguy was funny ;)
Both mine and my gf driver were kind and talked alot about everything we drove by. When we ate the food they served us well so we didn't have to get dirty. Under the tour one of the staff was taking pictures and the day after he sent the pictures to us. U feel safe all the time cause they have ppl watching the group.
Try it, u wont regret it!

Awesome tour, lots of fun! - My brother and I just did the sight seeing tour. It was great fun and very safe. Guide & girls speak excellent English and provide lots of interesting information about the sights of Saigon. It was a great way to spend our last day in Vietnam. Thankyou!

A highlight of our trip - I can only mirror the comments of others when I say this is a must-do in HCMC. We did the foodie tour and it was excellent. Our ladies were brilliant and we felt safer with them than negotiating the roads as a pedestrian! They were lovely and chatty and answered all of our questions and took really good care of us. We loved the bun bo hue soup and I'm craving it back at home. We loved going where the locals ate and there was a variety of seafood, meat and vegetarian dishes. Our tour guide was funny and attentive. Sometimes you wondered why you were stopped at a place but it was nice to stretch the legs and hear more interesting facts about HCMC and Vietnam, including their cultural make up, housing prices and class systems. I couldn't fault this tour, it was interesting, fun, well-organised and overall delicious! They've chosen such good people to represent them on both the bikes and as guides and this is what sets them apart I believe. Highly recommended.

fun way to explore HCM and some interesting food - Thoroughly enjoyed the tour and I'm sure everything good to be said has been said - particularly since one of our party had already been on the tour about a year before and said it was exactly the same. The tour was fun, most of the girls were fun, the food was great although no beer included which allows me room for a little complaint, First is that the tour seems like it might be a little jaded, the girls say they do it twice a day, 6 days a week and it shows - the stops are quite regimented - sometimes I felt like a model for their tours with the insistence on group photos and sometimes I would have liked to have stopped to look around but not possible (particularly in the wet market). Second, the price - it happens that the day we arrived we did a large part of the tour on a motorbike taxi for about the same time for about 10% of the cost. Add food (but no beer) and maybe the real cost was 30% of the price. And of course you give the girls a good tip. In any case, good for them, and good that they employ girls to do the tours.

Riding with the Queens of the City - HCM was our first stop in Vietnam; I somewhat foolishly booked 2 tours with XO for the morning and evening after our late arrival from two very long flights. The morning city tour was kind of basic but gave a decent orientation of the center of the City. The nightime foodie tour was the thing, introducing us to the frantic yet graceful patterns of traffic, the heartbeat of city life, driving through markets , on highways and streets with stops for tasty food including noodle soup, grilled frog (bony) and goat breast (yummy), beef and okra (also yummy), along with decent local beer. We had to cut this tour short because my wife was exhausted but XO was gracious about returning us early and discounting the cost of the tour. The girls are excellent English speakers and motorcyclists. My only criticism was that they did not have a helmet to fit my apparently oversized head, but this tourned out to be the case in each city in Vietnam where we rode.

Great way to see HCMC - This tour is worth it. I thought we were only going to go around District 1, but this tour actually takes you to other areas, from Chinatown to the more modern District 7. The food selections were great and I appreciated that they didn't include the usual Vietnamese food. My driver, Jamie, was very friendly and spoke good English. Overall, I consider this one of the best and most unique experiences I've had in Vietnam and would recommend it to anyone.

A MUST-DO EXPERIENCE - If you love foods as much as we do, you must do the XO Foodie Tour. What an incredible time that was! Our group was four adults and 1 six years old. My son rode on the moped between the driver and me. It was safe and fine. I was worried at first but they knew what they were doing and it was fine. My son told me that the ride around the city on the moped was his favorite experience on our vacation!

The girls that drove us around and helped us prepare the foods were adorable! They are so sweet and full of energy. Loved them.

Forget the bus, forget the taxi, grab a scooter! - We had the foodie tour and the overall experience was amazing! We visited restaurants and Saigon districts that we wouldn't under normal circumstances! Safety first and then great fun with all XO crew! Definetely recommended! Riding on a scouter around the city and having traditional Vietnamese food feels a bit like being a local :)

Best thing I did in Vietnam - This was one of the last tours that I did during my two weeks in Vietnam, and without a doubt it was the best. I learned so much about modern-day Vietnam - the guide and the female drivers spoke fabulous English and spent much of their time explaining the various districts, discussing the current state of the economy, and feeding us! The best way to see HCMC is by motorbike. Highly recommend this tour!

Recommended! - My husband and I and our 2 teenage daughters (16 and 14) had an excellent night ride courtesy of XO Tours. We all loved seeing the city this way and we traveled a lot of miles. We were taken to different districts and stopped for some tasty typical Vietnamese dishes along the way (even though this wasn't the foodie tour). The women were professional and fun to chat with as was the tour leader who met us at each destination. We all rated the experience as one of the best things we have done in Saigon. Thank you XO Tours!

Not sitting on a bus - I took the foodie tour. Loved the women drivers and the story of the company. Felt really safe on the bike and it's a brilliant way to get out of district 1 and learn about other parts of Saigon. The food is great and the tour is really well designed. I have also been reading the XO blogs about other parts of Vietnam and they're great too.

Fantastic Fun way to see the city - Loved it. Never once was I concerned about my safety. At 72 I have to admit I had my reservations before. The girl drivers took such good care of all of us to be sure we were all having a great time. Would do it again. We did the morning ride, but wish we could have also done the evening one.

Do It - Not much more to add that has not already seen written about the "foodie" tour
Even when it started to rain and I mean rain, it was fun
Thanks girls, Daren still takes about it
Just do it and you will see Saigon from a different angle

Fabulous trip - My friend and I took the sights tour around HCMC, It was an exciting tour riding the motorbikes with the lovely skilled tour guides. We learned a lot about the city and culture. We enjoyed sampling the popular desserts and drinking sugar cane juice. The girls speak excellent English.We loved the fun pictures that were taken by the guides and emailed to us.

MUST DO!!! - After 4 weeks in Vietnam I can honestly say this would be my favorite tour. I had a migraine and contemplated not going, not even 100% and it was still amazing. Our drivers (Tina, ni) have to be two of the loveliest people we have met, they were so helpful at pointing out sights and telling us everything we wanted to know about saigon/Vietnam. There English was incredibly good.
We have always been hesitant to try street food, but this was just delicious, we tried things we nicer thought we would have.
My only negative is when you get off the bike and the tour guide gives you some history/run down of the district you're in is, he does so in front of a garage door... Would be nice in a more central/sight seeing position.
Thanks for an amazing night!!

Excellent Way To See The City - I did the foodie tour, it was a great tour of the city, the guides all spoke great English and were a lot of fun. Unlimited food and beer. Really couldn't ask for a better way to see the City, but running around Saigon on motorbike is not for the faint of heart.

Most excellent article - I booked the foodie tour a few weeks ago & was impressed with the professionalism of this operator. My driver, Yi, was incredible & the host, Tai, was informative & funny. It was my first time on the back of a motorcycle/moped in over 18 years & it was a thrill! I was in awe of the amount of motorcycles on the road & how much the traffic looked like organized chaos! The food was delicious & I tried everything & won a few challenges. Very entertaining evening & a fantastic way to start my three weeks touring Vietnam! A must do for all especially Foodies!!

Wonderful tour - We went on the Saigon night tour.
Lovely girls driving us, intelligent, thoughtful and wanting to share about life in Ho Chi Minh.
Great tour guide who followed us around and talked about the different districts.
Sampled some street food which was great.
Very professional business with safe competent drivers.
Very good - the best thing that we did in Vietnam. Very nice staff. Great fun and great food. A must do in Vietnam.

All These Great Reviews Are Real! - We had time of our lives! Felt completely safe with our tour guides/drivers. We learned a lot about the culture and this amazing city. And the food was out of this world! I recommend the group tour, we met some amazing people from all over the world. We did the evening foodie tour.

Amazing way to experience HCMC - After having read some of the reviews about XO tours, we were looking forward to the trip with many expectations. Little be said that we weren't disappointed and wished that the tour lasted longer. We were picked up on time by two lovely ladies who proved their skills on the roads of HCMC with their perfect driving skills. Even my lovely wife who was very nervous about sitting on the back of a scooter was giggling and enjoying her ride. The ladies spoke good English and gave us a good insight into the life of people in Vietnam. The tour guide also joined us during various key locations to provide us with insight about the places and answer the queries. We were also blessed with a tiny drizzle, which I really enjoyed.Overall it was an amazing night drifting in and out of traffic, enjoying some great street food, getting a first hand insight into Vietnamese life and having one of the best evenings in Vietnam. A shame that such tours don't exist in other cities as it would have been great to see other places within the world in a similar way, on the back of a two wheeler while whizzing in and out of traffic. Don't miss out on this amazing experience.

2 Excellent Tours - We did 2 tours on 26th December, The sights tour & the foodie tour. Both were excellent.

The girls spoke excellent English, were very informative & were very safe riders. Khoi was the tour leader for both tours & was very good.

The food was great as well!

Fun immediately - This is a great way to see the city and experience what it is like to ride on a motor scooter through the traffic of HCMC. The food is great but the experience is even better. A very professional group that takes care of all the details. We had two couples all in their 60's and everyone had a blast. Totally recommend this tour!

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - Great tour.

Was a great way to see the city especially areas you would not normally think of going to. My motorbike rider Quynh (pronounced like queen, sorry for my poor spelling) spoke great English and was very interactive while riding along which made the experience awesome.

Anh was a very good tour guide and introduced us to dishes I never thought I would try.

Thank you for the awesome time, will definitely be back next time I'm in HCMC

A fantastic evening, highly recommend! - We did this tour on our second night in HCMC, it is a little more expensive than some other foodie tours but we had a great time and don't regret paying the extra few dollars. The drivers were all fantastic and very friendly. The food was excellent at each stop, there was great variety and you'll certainly be full by the end of the night.
They took some pictures throughout the evening then emailed them to you free of charge which was such a nice touch.
This was one of our Vietnam highlights, and I will definitely do it again.
Just be mindful that there isn't bathrooms at each stop, so make sure you go early!

Good drivers and a good experience - I went with my partner and two kids aged one and two on a Saigon by night tour. We really enjoyed it, even the kids, it 'twas good to feel the wind blowing in our faces. It's something you have to do in the first days or week of being in Vietnam. They give good advice on where to eat where to go and where not to go. even ask questions, They speak fluent English and your covered by insurance. I recommend this tour. It is great!
Fun way to explore the city - Fun, entertaining and informative way to explore the city. Guides speak English very well and are great storytellers.

Evening foodie tour is fantastic! - Easily the best thing my wife and I did on our short visit to Ho Chi Minh, and we did the day we arrived. The food was excellent and we saw many parts of the city we would have completely missed otherwise. Our motorbike drivers were great, and very knowledgable about the city and country. Unlimited food and drinks (including beer) were included in the price.

Highly recommended!

Custom Tour the Way to Go when you're short on time! - We booked a custom tour when our cruise ship stopped near Ho Chi Minh City on Dec 23. We had limited time but got to see some fantastic sights, learn some interesting history, eat some fantastic food, and do some great shopping for bargains where the locals shop. All this in just 3 hours! We are a family of 4 and were a bit nervous of the traffic at first, but the awesome staff put us at ease with their great riding skills and fun filled commentary.

So fun and unique - We did this tour and loved it. Picked up at our hotel and we rode via motorbike to our stops. We had the same private tour person each stop which was nice. They really pay attention to your needs and answer questions about the food and the town. Great experience.

Great fun and very professional - 2 of us went on the sights tour around Saigon. It was easy to book online and the girls showed up promptly with their bikes at our hotels.

We had a lot of fund scooting around the city checking out various sights. Although I would definitely recommend doing a full day 2-in-1 tour, as our half day tour ended all too quickly.

Excellent Tour! - On Dec 17 we visited Ho Chi Minh City and booked a night "Foodies Tour" with XO Tours. Our two guides on motorbikes picked us up just as scheduled. These young women were wonderful (sorry, the names are difficult to remember). They drove us all over the city. We made several stops to try local dishes, and everything was really well organized, clean, and delicious. There was a lot of food to try! Whatever you may have wanted more of was available, and quite a variety of different foods as well. There was no pressure to eat anything you didn't want to try. We really enjoyed being driven around and feeling like we were in the heart of the action. We were out at least 4.5 hours, had an opportunity to see the sights at night, and thoroughly enjoyed driving through the Chinese market. So lively and interesting. I can highly recommend this tour for the excellent program, the staff, and the food. One of the highlights of our trip.

A little scary but a fantastic experience! - Went with my partner for the foodie Sea Food tour with Chang-2 and Ngam-4 (there are a few Changs and Ngams at the company) and we had a phenomenal experience! I was with Chang-2 and she was lively, entertaining and went out if her way to make the experience amazing! My wife was with Ngam-4 and she looked after her well, in spite of her holding on to her tight especially during the first part of the motorcycle ride. Hosts/drivers make us feel like kings, peeling the prawns for us, preparing the crabs and scallops. Probably slightly overpriced but one hopes the drivers get their well deserved fair share. Thoroughly recommended and a must To Do when in Saigon!
Great city tour for teens - My teen girls loved the experience. Drivers are young and vibrant girls. They made the ride exciting with free yogurt and refreshing drinks.

Feel like you are part of the action on a scooter in hcmc! - My family of 4 - 2 teenagers and parents booked the xo tour online after reading awesome reviews and we had a ball! Best way to experience the craziness of the scooter world in HCMC and to see different parts of the city. Our guides spoke perfect English, made my kids feel so involved, were fun and funny. Just the best experience we could have asked for. We did the night tour from 6-9 pm and had a street food snack that was fantastic and stopped for desserts later. Totally do this, you will love it!

Nice, but not for the adventurous traveler. Felt like a child on a school trip. - Sitting behind a moto in Saigons overwhelming traffic might seem adventurous enough, but actually you feel quite saved and the moto's drives a max of 40k. It feels nice to sit behind a skillful driver and just look around. The chatting with the driver while driving could be nice too, and their English is very good. However, the foodie tour did not turn out so rustic as we wanted too. It included three food stops and two sightseeing stops, and everything was a tad too organized, even the photos.. The drivers decided where you should sit, felt they had to entertain you all the time so you couldnt talk to fellow travelers nor other members on the tour, pealed your food and even sorted of fed you. This is not the way I prefer to travel, I feel like a child on a school trip.

The driver told me they have gone to the exact same places for years - not very boutique I'd say.... Food was good, but I expected to be taken into interesting food markets and to try the exciting street food from stalls. The trip is overpriced. My tip? Next time I would have gone on a private tour with a more enthuastic driver...

Foodie Tour - What a great way to see the city and taste a variety of Vietnamese foods. Ho Chi Minh city is massive and the traffic horrendous. Riding on the back of a motor scooter is the best way to see this city. The ladies were very personable, funny, entertaining and knowledgeable about the city and food we were served. We were told that the food was maybe not the most delicious food in all of Vietnam but was the food that local residents ate when they went out for dinner, no spring rolls or Pho. We visited 3 eating establishments and made two non food stops to learn more about the city. As part of the tour, the guide took pictures of us and they emailed them to us. Great evening on the town.

Foodie Tour - My partner and I cannot recommend "The Foodie" tour high enough - it is a must if you visit HCMC.

The girls are really friendly and speak excellent English and Understanding is a great tour guide.

I would rate this higher but I'm only limited to five stars 👌🏼

Foodie Tour - Food, fun and so much more - The tour was very professionally organized. The female tour guides and the male manager were all friendly, funny, knowledgeable and attentive. The food stops made sure we tried a large number of different types of foods, all delicious and fresh. The tour also stopped at non-food locations that helped us all understand what living in HCMC is like - very well done. An amazing experience.

Great tour with lovely ladies! - Whizzing thru 5 Districts in 3 hours in Vietnam's traffic with these really good drivers in their traditional Ao Dais was really a wonderful cap to a week-long holiday in Saigon.

Absolutely fun - We had high expectations due to the rave reviews XO Tours have had on tripadvisor. My 16 year old daughter couldn't wipe the grin from her face and my 14 year old son absolutely loved it. The tour leader and all of the guides were friendly, intelligent and 100% professional. I found the information given on the city and its layout personalized to the needs of our group. As an ex museum tour guider myself, I was most impressed.
Don't miss it!

Great time with XO Tours - Absolutely loved our night time foodie tour with XO Tours. Learn so much about the culture of Vietnam and definitely enjoy the food. Great way to see the city and feel like you are part of the scooter culture. Would definitely recommend it!

Oh my, they know their stuff! - We had marvelous time during this 3 hour "sights" tour. It was both fun and informative at the same time. The lady drivers rode the bikes safely and with confidence. They were so friendly and gave lots of information while moving between the sights. They were so super sweet that we would have wanted to take them home with us :) When arriving to each sight, there was a tour guide who gave further information on the importance of that sight. Truly interesting.

The duration was ok, you learned much in three hours. We got also sugar cane drinks and rambutans for refreshments.

We are so pleased to take this tour.

Do book any (or multiple) of their tours. They are so good in what they are doing!

Family fun in Saigon - Our family group of 7 considers the XO foodie tour to be one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The girls were professional and safe drivers (no small feat in the insane Saigon traffic), friendly and conversational (with excellent English), fun dinner companions, and informative guides into areas and restaurants not heavily visited by tourists. This was an unforgettable and delicious experience that is not to be missed.

Absolute best way to experience Saigon...unforgettable - This tour was far beyond what we could have expected. Riding around on scooters with incredible guides...though unnerving at first you feel very safe.

The guides are superb, informative, funny and very genuine. You will learn a lot on the back of the bike. You will see the city from a unique and exciting perspective.

Oh and the food!!! Outstanding, very local places. Some adventurous options if you're feeling up to it. I wasn't prior to the tour but it has a way of making you want to try everything! We are vegetarian and the accommodations never felt like an afterthought. Some of the most amazing dishes were specially prepared for us.

This was one of the most well organized tours I have ever been on. The thought and care that went it to it is unreal. The little touches like stopping for a brief explanation of the history of where you are, fun games and sending you pictures from the night really put it over the top.

They took us to the most interesting places you will never find on your own. It felt truly special. Worth every penny and to be honest, probably more.

To our very special guides Hong, Minerva and Hieu-Thank you for giving us one of the most memorable nights in Vietnam.

WOW! WOW! WOW! XO Foodie Tour is a must do! - This tour was fantastic. The drivers are welcoming and make us feel very safe. We all enjoy being a part of the crazy Ho Chi Minh traffic. It is an exciting way to learn about the city. The girls encouraged us to try the different foods and we were pleased that we did. We wouldn't have gone to any of the places visited without going on this tour.

Can't recommend highly enough! - I did a day time sights tour, it was my last day of the week I spent in HCMC. There was a group of about 6 people. We were taken to some of the main sights, the guide was worried I would be bored because I already went to these places on my own. Not the case! The guides were so interesting and informative and I learned a lot about the Saigon history/culture.

We were also taken to some other places I wouldn't have been to on my own, such as some local markets to sample some foods and also china town.

Riding around with my driver Tien was lots of fun. She as well as the main guide Tai spoke great English. She had a great sense of humor and offered to take lots of photos for me.

I am a young female solo traveler but also on my group were some older people and also a family with children, I really think this tour is great for anyone, any age etc. A must do in Saigon, would have loved to have time to try the night food tour!

Unforgettable tour - So glad that my girlfriend and I signed up for the Foodie Tour with XO. I was apprehensive about getting on a motorbike in Saigon, but the guides are great drivers and it felt completely safe. You spend a lot of time on the bike, and get to see many different districts (rich area, poor area, Chinatown, etc.). The guides are really what makes this tour great though. We had a lot of laughs with our guides Chang and Nio, and they convinced us to try some wild food we would otherwise probably not eat. The tour has plenty of food and beer and the 4 hours flies by. This group is really professional, they know how to keep you entertained, and how to make the experience unforgettable. They have other tours as well, and I'm sure that they are equally as good knowing how these guys/girls operate.

This is one of the best tours I've ever done in my travels and would highly recommend it.

Fantastic!!!! - This was an awesome experience. It was worth it every dollar!
The best way to see Saigon is on the back of a Motorbike, as it is a hard city to get around.

The girls tell so much information and everything is interesting. The food is really local, and I tasted some interesting stuff wat definitely enriched my try out list.

You should do this tour on your first day in saigon. Because after this tour you know exactly what to order and where to go.

We delayed our stay for this tour as they were fully booked. And I am so happy we did.

It really completed my stay in Saigon. unfortunately no local food for me anymore as it was our last night.

Good reason to come back :)

Book in advance and ENJOY THE RIDE

Friendly, Professional, Delicious foodie tour! - I cannot say enough about XO tours. What a wonderful evening! This was probably my best experience in Ho Chi Minh City, experiencing the delicious and flavorful foods of Vietnam while exploring the different districts on the back of a scooter. With the knowledgeable tour guides leading the way, you get a real sense of the energy of the city, as well as what makes it such an interesting location. Would highly recommend, as it might be one of my favorite memories in all of Vietnam. Definitely consider XO Tours next time you're in Ho Chi Minh!

XO Motorbike Food Tour - Was an awesome way to learn about Saigon and get authentic taste of the city! The girls are really friendly and knowledgeable and zipping around the city on scooters is one of a kind experience!

One of the highlights from our trip! - Loved everything about the tour - the friendly tour guides, amazing food and riding the moped around the city. I felt like we visited real local spots rather than tourist traps and appreciated all the attention to detail from our guides. A well-organized tour that I would definitely recommend!

Absolute highlight of our trip! - I really wanted to do the foodie tour, but with an 18month old and a 4 year old in our group I was nervous about how they would do on the scooters and of course their safety. XO were amazing! They had a helmet small enough for my 4 year old, we brought a bike helmet for the younger one and they had safety top of mind with a briefing and telling us how best to ride with them.

Now that is out of the way, it is time to enjoy the ride! What a time we had. 10 of us on a private tour flying through the districts of Saigon learning all about the different areas and trying local food. They skip the tourist traps and really show you the local experience.

I would do it again in a heartbeat and can't recommend this crew enough!

Excellent city tour! - We did XO city tour in HCMC in Dec 2015 and had a great experience. They were punctual and picked us up from the hotel. The drivers were friendly and made us feel comfortable as it was our first motorbike ride in a crowded city. After the first few minutes we really enjoyed the ride - it's a great way to tour the city. Our tour guide, Tai Dang, was very informative and friendly and made the tour very enjoyable for us!

Highly recommend this tour for everyone.

Brilliant! - We were recommended the XO tour by some friends and we absolutely would recommend it to others too!

We went on the night tour it was a lot of fun and very interesting, for us the best bit is it avoided the touristy areas and really showed us Ho Chi Minh City.

I'd never been on a moped before but the girls made me feel so comfortable and a really great experience.

Our guide Hieu was also great talking us through the different areas with real knowledge and passion!!

Great tour would definitely recommend!!

So much fun! - For anyone coming to HCMC this is a must do! We had the most amazing time, I couldn't speak more highly of the night.

The food, customer service and value for money were spot on.

do it - Great experience, gets you out of district 1 and let's you explore some foods that you might not otherwise be game to try by yourself. The rider and your leader will do everything they can to make sure you have a great time. Very well organized. No surprise this is #1 tour.
Awesome - This was one of the highlights of our trip. We would highly recommend this to everyone. We would have completely missed out on the real Ho Chi Minh otherwise

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh City - We had a few tours booked while in Ho Chi Minh city and the foodie tour was definitely the best one. Riding on the back of the bikes was fun and the food variety was great too. All the girls spoke excellent English and kept us laughing throughout the tour. Would definitely do it again!

Amazing way to see Ho Chi Minh - After reading about XO tours I booked with them as soon as we arrived in Ho Chi Minh. They got back to me immediately even though it was late at night. We did their sights tour and it was wonderful every step of the way. It was well organized, safe and fun! If your in Ho Chi Minh you must use this company!

Fun and interesting - Great company. The guides/drivers are wonderful. You'll see some of the typical sites, but also see some things you probably wouldn't see on your own. The drivers are very friendly and are happy to talk about their own lives, so it's a nice way to hear from some locals. We didn't do their night tour, but heard it was also great.

Food tour - Definitely a must DO! Felt safe and comfortable everywhere we went. There is an all you can eat a drink policy. So don't be afraid to ask for more, but with the amount of food that they will be sampling. You shouldn't be hungry by the end. If you were I would be Very Surprised.

Safe and the best way to see Saigon - The girls of XO are really warm and speak great English. My mum is afraid of motorbikes, and has never ridden even if my dad had one back in the day. She felt completely fine on this one! This is the best way to beat the traffic and see the main boulevards and some inner streets of this city.

Great Value for Culinary Professionals - I work as a chef and I wanted to experience as much of Vietnamese street food as possible in a short amount of time.

Going as a solo traveler I got to hang out with my awesome guide, Yeng (spelling uncertain, sorry!). The couples in my tour group naturally sat together while their guides hung back a bit but Yeng and me got along great. She speaks fluent English and not only understood me perfectly but we joked around and I had a lot of fun as well.

Living in Bangkok I haven't really felt comfortable with the motorcycle taxis but in Saigon I felt very safe. Yeng is a great driver and it was fun to experience different parts of the city with a personal guide sitting in front of me.

Food was exceptional. We didn't have Banh Mi or Pho but some very exotic and interesting dishes I've never tried before. Being an adventerous eater I got to fully appreciate everything they had to offer. I told them previously that I had no dietary restrictions and it really feels like I got an authentic experience for it.

The best thing is that I never would have been able to try this many different types of food if I had explored on my own. Maybe if I had weeks to do research and walk around, but for a very reasonable price I got to experience it all in one evening.

I did not have to take out my wallet once during the trip, everything was paid for by the guides. There was also no limit on how much you could eat or drink, as long as you said you were still hungry they would order more food. Nobody in my group did though as we had already been given more than plenty.

I went on another food tour the day after that was much cheaper. It was still nice but compared to XO Tours it is sadly underperformed in every area. My tour with XO was absolutely worth it and I had a great time. I hope I'll get the chance to go back and go on a tour with them again. I highly recommend them.

Foodie tour- great way to eat dinner - We did the food tour and it was my favorite activity in Ho Chi Minh. The tour guides picked us up on motorbikes at the hotel and took us to the first restaurant where we met up with the rest of the group. The tour took us all over the city and we tried a lot of different foods. There was plenty of food and drink but not so much that you couldn't move when it was over. The next day they emailed us photos they had taken of us along the way. They were well organized and really efficient. Only suggestion, is if you are carrying a purse (dont really need it) I would suggest a small one so it will fit inside the seat while you are riding around town.

Must-do Excursion in Saigon - I recently went on a Foodie Tour with XO for the second time -- and this time I brought my parents. It should say something alone that I'm willing to do the same tour twice, but honestly, the XO tour is great.

The XO girls are incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and the food is great. My parents (who are in their 60's and 70's) both had an absolute blast as well.

Make time to go on the tour when you're in HCMC.

Delicious and Professional - Can't recommend this tour highly enough! The ladies who escorted us were beautiful and full of local insights and the tour manager was personable and humorous at each stop. Great job all around!

Highly recommend!!! - This was a great experience -- you get to see parts of the city you'd otherwise not visit, you get to see the city at night and from the unique vantage point of a motor bike. You try foods that are memorably delicious and also popular locally, including some foods that you may otherwise never experience! We also learned quite a bit on this tour and there was a lot of attention to detail to make the experience enjoyable -- they took photos for us and emailed them right away. All in all, one of the best parts of our vacation!

Best way to tour Ho Chi Minh city! - My boyfriend signed us up for two tours with XO Tours - The Sights & The Foodie.

Our tour guides/ motorbike drivers are always very prompt. In fact on both tours, they arrived at our lobby before the designated time. They are very safe drivers who make the rules on riding on a bike very clear to us. Even after we told them we've been on an XO tour and rode on a bike before, they wanted to be certain we were clear of the safety dos and do-nots. Clearly, safety is vital to them.

Foodie Tour - This is a must tour for every foodie ESPECIALLY if you are an adventurous eater. I'm not an adventurous eater; I don't even eat beef! But I truly enjoyed the trip. There was exceptional seafood from fresh scallops with roasted garlic peanuts and chilli and fresh crabs. For the adventurous eaters, this is for you.. You can try the grilled breast of a goat (which tasted exceptionally good) and balut (developing duck embryo).

Sights Tour - We visited various places of interest and gained a lot of insight into Ho Chi Minh city.

On both tours, our tour leaders are very experienced and offered a lot of information regarding the places we visited as well as the customs/practices. Even our bike drivers were super friendly and shared plenty of information regarding Ho Chi Minh city and the places we scooted by.

I highly recommend joining the XO Tours if you are in Ho Chi Minh City. It gives you an excellent glimpse into the city on one of the most common mode of transport in HCM: Motorbike.

Excellent way to see Saigon! - We did the Sights tour and we all had a blast doing it. The tour is great even for those staying in the city for a short time. The drivers were very prepared as they did a short briefing for us before we rode the motorcycles and in the middle of the tour, we were caught in a sudden downpour and they had with them ponchos. It was our first time riding a motorcycle and what a way to be introduced to it - in a city where 6 million motorcycles prowl the city every day. A unique experience for everyone as we were also with teenagers.

Excellent! XO Tours is Amazing! Book with Confidence! - This is probably the best guided tour we've ever tried. Over-all, they've got it down to a science in terms of timing, the information given out, the travel times, the kinds of restaurants we went to, the different activities.

The Foodie tour was more than a foodie tour; it was the best way of seeing Ho Chi Minh City through the eyes of a local being on a motorcycle. In 4 1/2 hours, we got to see the different neighborhoods from the high-end to the plebeian, the old to the new. We were also able to try varied Vietnamese dishes way different from the usual tourist traps.

Tai was excellent as the over-all tour manager and our drivers/guides Yen and Thanh were nonpareil.

The XO Tours staff English-speaking skills were very impressive; Idiom and diction were close to native speaker proficiency levels.

Yen and Thanh were superbly competent in manoeuvring through the different roads of the city; there was never any moment we felt uncomfortable and unsafe being on their motorcycles.

Every stop had a different insight on Ho Chi Minh/Vietnamese society with some very entertaining activities courtesy of the staff (no spoiler alert here!).

There was also a lot of friendly interaction with the other tour participants adding more fun to the experience.

You owe it to yourselves to take this tour when you're in Ho Chi Minh City; you will definitely not regret it.

Amazin tour.. great girls and you will make friends.. - Will use this tour again.. maybe a different route..
Cannot wait to go on the foodie tour.. we went on the saigon by night and had a blast..

Food tour - We highly recommend this tour, and we don't usually like organized tours. We got to see a lot of the city and the tour guides were very knowledgable and friendly. It was such an experience seeing the different districts on the back of a bike. The food was tasty and plenty of it.

First class food tour - This was my first tour to do in Vietnam and what a great way to start. It gave me an overview of the culture and the food of Vietnamese people and how they eat the food. It was a real pleasure to experience this with great Vietnamese hospitality. Safe driver and experienced in the English language. 1 st class tour all round.
The Sights Tour - Excellent tour with friendly and experienced tour guide. Great experience traveling on a moped through Saigon. Very helpful and informative.

Highlight of our Trip - We did the tour a month back together with colleagues. It was on our first night in HCM, I never thought it would be that fun. I personally feel the culture of Vietnam thanks to the smart ladies who really exceeded our expectations, their service is impeccable, knowledge about HCM is splendid and they also have excellent communication skills. I want to commend Cindy Quynh for being at her best during the tour, If I will to take the tour again I will choose her every single time. The Concept of the tour is Pure Genius! Very Vietnamese, I felt like a Vietnamese for a few hours! Highly Recommended! Cheers!

Awesome experience! - I booked "The Sights" tour and would have even booked "The Foodie" tour if I had the time to. The entire booking process (via email with XO Tours) was very easy and friendly - pick-up and drop-off ran as expected and both the driver, Trang, and tour guide, understood, were extremely knowledgeable and professional. Riding on the back of the bike was great fun and it took very little time to get used to. I felt very safe all the time and there is no point to be scary. Strongly recommended!!!

Superb - We did this tour on our first day in Ho Chi Minh City.

The tour was exactly as promised... Punctual, informative and great fun.

None in my family had ever been on a motorbike, so to have our first ride in the bustling traffic of Ho Chi Minh City was a great first time experience.

The XO team were superb...from booking the tour, through to the end. Well Done team XO!

No better way to see the City.

Highly recommended.

Fantastic experience - sights of HCMC - From start to finish, this was a great way to interact with the extremely proficient, well-managed staff whose knowledge about HCMC was above expectations.

We decided to join a tour as we didn't have much time in the city, and what a good decisions it was. Our drivers were friendly and made us feel safe on the back of the bikes. Our tour tour was fantastic and was a great source of knowledge.

Book a tour, you can't go wrong!

Perfect way to explore the city - We throughly enjoyed the food night tour. The staff were extremely friendly and ensured everyone had a good time. It's a really good experience riding on a bike in Saigon, especially at night. They took us to several different places including places we wouldn't have known about as tourists. It was interesting to see the city outside district one. A good way to taste local food and to learn about the culture.

Fantastic tour of districts! - The ride and info was so much fun. Very safe, and just a great time! Great food! I would love to do this again. My driver was Khahn, and we road with another driver, Thao. Thao took several photos, which she emailed; what a great treat.

A must-do tour in HCMC - the best tour! - The XO foodie tour is absolutely great and delicious! Definitely recommend this to everyone. You will feel very safe on the back of the bike. The hosts are very nice and explain all kind of things about the delicious food, but also daily life in Vietnam. It's a great tour, a must do, and would recommend to do this at the start of your trip, since they will also share other recommendations of where to go to for markets, shopping, etc.

Thanks a lot XO for this great experience!!!!!

Worth every penny! - My husband and I loved our tour this morning. Ngan and Thao were our drivers and Anh was our guide. First, their English is great. Second, their customer service is impeccable. Finally, they can handle those motorbikes in this crazy traffic. We were completely relaxed riding behind them and they gave a lot of good information. Highly recommended even if just to experience the motorbike life in Saigon.

A great way to see and get to know HCM - We booked this tour on the recommendation of a fellow traveler, and what a great tip it was. It combines Vietnamese food with a motorbike tour around 5 or 6 different districts over a 3.5 hour period in the evening. We rode as passengers on the motorbikes of our hostesses to different locations and Tour Leader Anh gave us an introduction to the area and the food. There were 12 in our group and they were good company. Special mention to our hosts Daan and Quynh who were proficient motor bikers and gave us an insight into daily life in Vietnam that we wouldn't otherwise have had. Highly recommended.

Fabulous! - We did the Foodie tour and loved it! This is a must do in Ho Chi Min City. The girls are lovely and although I thought I'd be nervous on the back of the bike in the very busy traffic I very quickly eased into it. The food was good and the tour itself takes you through several districts enabling you to get s good feel for the city.

Fabulous way to see Ho Chi Minh City - The girls were fantastic riders, you felt safe every step of the way and they were an absolute delight. They rode together so you could still communicate with your partner and there was always an XO Security guy not very far away. The restaurants were well prepared and a variety of food was presented that you would probably not experience if you were on your own. They accommodated everyone's likes and dislikes as well as the myriad of allergies that people now seem to have. They sent us photos as well. I would highly recommend and will try the shopping trip next time.

An absolute blast! - This is the ideal way to see and learn about Saigon! Nine of us traveling together on a cruise ship booked this tour for our final morning in the city and it was a highlight for the entire trip. Nine young ladies on motor scooters met us at the dock and drove us to the sights. All were friendly, spoke English and knew how to navigate safely through Saigon traffic.

At the first stop we met up with our tour guide who provided more information on the history of what we were viewing. The tour steered clear of tourist traps and showed us authentic markets and important landmarks. If you can sit on the back of a bike, this is the best tour on offer!

Saigon by Night and Foodie Tour - Anyone who goes to Vietnam needs to go on one of their tours. These ladies have something very good going on with their business and are the heart of the whole experience of not only the tour, but of Vietnam! We honeymooned in Vietnam for 3 weeks and kicked off our first and last day of our trip with an XO tour because it was that much fun! I have to admit, we were a little nervous about getting on a motorbike in HCMC, especially being our first day in Vietnam; however, I advise everyone to experience a motorbike trip, as it gives you a whole new perspective of HCMC and Vietnam. We had a beautiful warm day for our foodie tour and a rainy day for the Saigon by Night Tour, but both were equally fun. You can't leave Vietnam without wearing a poncho at least once! They made the tour memorable and entertaining with their lively personalities, kindness, variety and knowledge about the food and districts, and safe driving. I liked how the foodie tour was with a group of people, so that we could exchange stories with others and experience trying foods for the first time with others. We also had a video made from our foodie tour, which is one of the highlights because we have been able to show people at home about our Vietnam experience. Photos don't always capture the true experience, so having a video of my husband and me will always be cherished. If you are feeling adventurous and want to experience A+++ hospitality and excitement, then take an XO Tour. It is worth every penny! I should also note that they picked us up and dropped us off at our hotel in District 1 for both tours, which was really helpful. This was one of our favorite activities in Vietnam!

Only review - We were family of 5 people doing the foodie tour. We really enjoyed, not all of us are eating sea food so they take care of us and served vegetation food.
It was very fun tour, we also purchased the video and it was beautiful!
the girls drive safely and speek very good english
really recommended!!

Fun tour, fun guides! - We had a great time touring HCMC with Anh and the ladies! Our guides took us through the wide boulevards and through narrow streets to get a sense of local life in the city. I enjoyed hearing the history of the city and how they tailored the tour to meet our needs.

Faultless. Well-paced, informative and fun - This must be the best way to get some of the flavor and taste of Ho Chi Minh City and handle a small group ranging in age from six to sixty-ish. I had expected a relatively short trip between restaurants geared up for western tourists. Not a bit of it.

The tour involved five very different City districts and maybe 30 kms of scootering. The route varied from dual carriageways down to weaving a small pathway between the caged birds and the eels in Chinatown. But throughout, my driver Ni was safe, informative and entertaining. Indeed, I cannot praise the professionalism shown by her, the other drivers and Ang the tour leader more highly.

I have been in a few situations where I have always not felt at all confident about a restaurant, how to handle the menu or indeed what is in fact edible (but I shun menus with pictures!). This way, all those concerns were removed and we were invited into as close to an authentic experience as it was possible to experience. Excellent - although there were a few dishes that will be a one-off taste experience.

As long as you can sit on a scooter pillion, this should be on the list for all first time visitors.

Fun, but maybe for a young crowd - What better way to see Saigon but on the back of a scooter! In this city, it's like riding a roller coaster. Thrills and chills galore. But, I always felt safe and had a blast seeing the city this way. I love street food, but sometimes it's hard to go where the locals go, if you can't speak the language or read the menu. So, take a foodie tour and they do al, the work for you.

The drivers are young, single girls who are sweet and fun. You get to see Vietnam from young, carefree eyes as they care for you and joke around.

Best Way to get the FLAVOR of Saigon! - My friend booked a private tour with XO Tours and we were so lucky to have Nguyen, Quynh and Dang for our drivers and hostesses! What a great way to see Saigon and get a taste for the city. We were offered all the food and beer we wanted and got a wonderful lesson in the culture of the city while scootering through all of the districts. This is a must do tour in Saigon!
