Fun amazing night!!! - Amazing tour experience. At first we thought that we would have so many typical Vietnamese food non stop. But, the tour already arranged so that we can enjoy unusual Vietnamese food + many saigon scenery. Thanks to our drivers (thao and nguyen) and our leader Tai for being super friendly n informative.

Ps
Shout out to Bart and Monica from Canggu Bali.

Quick fun way of seeing more than just Central Saigon - At a loose end with a few hours to spare, the evening tour was an excellent use of my time to see more than just District 1 of Saigon. Despite pouring rain, my guide (who called herself Tim Tam or Tam#2) was in good humour, spoke excellent English and did not just point out standard tourist sites as we whizzed along with the rest of the group.

For me, it was really interesting to see 4 of the other districts in town, including the modern, almost foreign district 7 which is nothing like Central Saigon. The food wasn't the highlight of this tour for me, but no matter, it was more about having an fun knowledgable host and seeing more of town than I would by walking.

Excellent Food and sightseeing tour of Saigon - Discovered XO tours surfing on the Internet, and gave the many positive comments on Tripadvisor, decided to try the ''Foodie''tour of Saigon.
10 minutes before the scheduled time,two charming young ladies dressed in traditional dresses,with very well maintained,almost new motorbikes picked us up at our hotel,and drove us to the first restaurant where other customers joined,we were about 13 people.
We were welcomed by the tour manager, Tai Dang , who was there during the trip, and who perfectly organized a very well planned and timed circuit that brought us to various restaurants and places of importance in different districts of Saigon (1,2,5,8,7 and 4)
The young ladies are very professional drivers, very cautious, and during the various stops at restaurants helped prepare the food.
There were also 4.5 ''bodyguards''that made sure we were in a safe environment.
I will certainly recommend this trip, it brings you to places you will never find alone.Of course 60 USD is a lot of money for Vietnamese standards but the organization and provided food and security is worth it, and hopefully the young ladies drivers, security and tour manager are paid a decent salary.
I will certainly recommend it to friends,of all ages,I am 69,my wife 65 and we enjoy it!.
Fun night - Great night meeting new people and eating interesting things. My guide was fab and spoke excellent English - we had a lot of fun talking, exchanging sayings and learning new things.

The highlight of my trip to HCMC - I took this tour with two friends on our first full day in HCMC. We did "The Sights" tour which included some of the main attractions we had planned to see while in town, along with some surprises. We felt very well looked after with our 3 young lady drivers and the support crew. I was very scared at first and my girl made me feel very safe and she kept re-assuring me throughout the drive to the first attractions. From then on she just made me laugh and shared stories as we drove around. We each got to see the city through the eyes of our drivers. Our tour guide Khoi was very knowledgeable. He had his iPad with history photos to show us as he talked about each sight. He was so relaxed in his style. Nothing about this tour was boring. It is the ONLY way to see the city. There is something quite magical about whizzing along on the back of a bike next to the locals. You will see it through different eyes. Plus it was seriously safer than walking! The photos they took during the tour to send to you later are a real added bonus.

Wow! Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - This is one of the best city tours I have ever taken. Motor scooters are really the only way to get around this city, and to be driven around by experts (lovely young ladies in traditional Vietnamese dress) just makes this tour that much better. You really get a sense of how people who live here get around. Because you are on scooters, you get a chance to drive down streets that you could never do with a tour bus or even a taxi. This group takes safety very seriously and spends a good amount of time at the beginning going over safety precautions up to and including removing jewelry that might be attractive to purse snatchers. There were nine of us in our group and each one of us had wonderful drivers - really one nicer than the next. We each get to know our drivers and get a little personal history from each. Really a great way to understand and learn a little more about this culture. We did a 3 hour tour and stopped at the post office, Norte dame cathedral, presidential palace, Chinatown and a few other sites. This really is a great way to see the city.

Super fun way to see the city with great lady drivers - Loved this tour! Ladies were super nice, picked us up from hotel on the motorbikes, took us to city sights, tour guide waited for us at each stop to tell us about the sights and some stories. Stopped at a drink stall for complimentary cane juice, also gave us some fruit to try which was refreshing. Ladies point out interesting features along the route. The ladies were great drivers, I felt very safe on the bikes! Thankyou XO tours

The highlight of our stay - An absolutely fabulous experience. We did the foodies tour and were met by two young Vietnamese girls who took us out on their mopeds into the night and traffic. On our first stop we met the other tour members and it was just a great night of fun, conversation and food tasting. We are in our 50's so don!t be put off by the ages of the girls or jumping on the back of a moped, it was a ball with absolutely no sleaziness or unethical practices. It was just fun fun fun!

Recommended way to experience Ho Chi Minh City - We were booked on a rainy Sunday for a night tour, but it rained so hard that even with poncho we are still dripping wet and we had to cancel. We were informed that we could call off the tour and rescheduled a date we agreed upon - which just showed good customer service. So came Dec 1, we started the night tour. The girls were great at driving the motorbike and felt safe. They were also knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Also they are cute, especially with their Ao Dai traditional wear. Went through different districts around the city, from tight alleyways to open free way. Saw different characteristics of each district, and learn more about the places. Stopped for some great food (choice of Banh Mi, vegetarian rolls, or pork with broken rice with sugar cane juice or beer) at a place where locals eat, it is not even a foodie tour but we were all full and satisfied. Then for every stop, the tour leader briefly discusses some facts and stories about the place. And final stop at another district for a yummy Vanilla pudding and milk flan with viet coffee. Plus cute souvenirs from them too.

Unique experience - Sightseeing, food experience, history experience, scooter experience all in one. A terrific way in one night to see and taste the real Saigon Vietnam. The women who ride the bikes are great ambassadors for their country.

Great tour for first time visitors! - I went for the Sights tour recently on the 5th of Dec and had a really nice time.
Great sights and excellent hosts who are very accommodating and very conversant in English. Highly recommended for first time visitors.
Amazing ladies - Great fun scooter tour. All the ladies are bubbly and very knowledgeable. Great way to see Siagon at night.

Foodie tour - This was without a doubt the best tour we have ever done. Our drivers were fabulous we felt very safe and the girls were so knowledgeable and not for a moment were we nervous in a city which is perilous to even cross the road. The food well.........incredible food at all stops. It was so well organized and I can highly recommend this tour and the professionalism of the company.

Excellent way to see Saigon - I booked the Food Tour with Xo Tours - it was worth every bit of it! The experience of sitting on the bike and riding through the city is so real and local and definitely worth it.

The tour is very well organized and they have the most friendly and welcoming staff. From the person who rides your bike to the tour organizer, everyone is so enthusiastic and excited that you are bound to enjoy yourself.

The girl who rode my bike was absolutely amazing and it was so much fun to talk to her while exploring the city.

The food tour part is well curated and they pace out the eating and make you try amazing authentic food at authentic local places. These are experiences that are hard to find otherwise.

Would definitely recommend this tour specially for those who love to explore a new culture through food and are willing to taste anything! Plus it is very well organized and well managed which makes the entire experience worth it.

Even though I went alone, it was a lot of fun as there were a lot of other travelers and everyone was very friendly and welcoming so you don't really feel like you are by yourself!

A Must When in HCMC - This tour was the highlight of our trip. We went around the city and ate stuff I haven't eaten before. We went to places where locals hang and eat. Was scared of riding bikes but I was able to conquer my fear of riding because of this tour. Our guides were very friendly and professional. Highly recommended.
Must do tour - Great experience. Very well organized tour, from the pick up to the drop off. Excellent drivers and tour guide, contagious smiles all over place. Truly recommend.

A Great Tour To Start Seeing Vietnam - This trip actually happened June of 2013, Yes I know I am very very late on this review. But better now then never. So start I must say XO tour is a very professional company that is customer service orientate that ensures all of the customers are having a great time. The tour started with them picking me up from my hotel and bringing me to a small outside restaurant that served a very light Vietnamese snacks and tea. After a few moments of orientation about what will our tour consist of, I was introduced to a Vietnamese female (forget her name), who would be my driver on the scooter. Must say a very well spoken and her English was amazing (she was very happy to practice her English as well), she showed me around parts of Vietnam and we shared stories. I was taken around areas of HCMC where if I was doing it alone I would of never found it. Now the best part starts is the food tour man o man, the food was amazing and plenty full as well. At each food stop XO Tour will sit us with different people that are part of the tour. I got mingling with them and some chit chat. This is definitely worth the trip this is a must trip for all newbies coming to HCMC

Great choice! - I really had a great time! The foodie tour is awesome: delicious food, good sights, great organization, the XO tours team is really focused on making sure you have a good time. Highly recommended.

Happy, Happy! - What an unforgettable experience riding through the markets and streets of HCM City with our lovely guides. We booked the Foodie Tour and can confirm that all the comments from previous reviews are absolutely accurate. Professional, informative, incredibly well organized, attention to detail (food preferences and allergies accommodated) - all that and so much fun, too! This tour will suit all ages, child to adult (we are retirees ranging in age from 60-69). Thank you so much to Tai and the young ladies for an excellent tour!

An absolute highlight - Prior to this tour i was apprehensive having never been on a moped before let alone on the back of one on streets as busy as saigon but this was easily the highlight of my trip and had so much fun, to make the tour even more enjoyable try engaging with your guide as they will try and teach you some Vietnamese words as well as more than the basic information about areas you pass through.

The food part of the tour was just as good as it was food i'd never tried before but would happily try again and some of the places visited are not in areas frequented by tourists, everything we tried was of a high quality and was never left waiting too long

Straight out FUN! - Do yourself a favor & book a tour with these guys! We did 2 tours during our trip. The first was 'the sights' tour which was a perfect way for us to orientate ourselves in Ho Chi Minh & tick off quite a few of the tourist sites.
The second tour we did was 'the foodie' tour & it was one of the highlights of our trip. We Cris-crossed the City & got to see areas that we would never have been able to see otherwise & got a real sense of what it might be to be a local here. And then there was the food! Great variety, great quantities & great quality! The scallops at our last restaurant stop were simply amazing.
Don't be scared about being on a motor bike - within 5 minutes you forget about it & just sit back & enjoy being in the middle of everything.
These tours are made extra special by the lovely ladies that do the driving - they are the heart & soul of the Business & we really enjoy being able to trade stories about each others lives, daily routines & families.
A 'must do' when in Ho Chi Minh!

Excellent - must do - Went on the tour about a year back and it was absolutely brilliant. The food was awesome and well curated but the tour was more like an experience with the bikes and traveling to different parts of the city. I had really enjoyed the tour and have even been recommending it to everyone else who visits HCMC.
I must add that my wife is vegetarian and the tour organizers having had advance notice were able to provide her an excellent vegetarian spread. Think she got an equivalent veg dish for every non veg dish I got.
So yeah great experience - definitely recommended

Absolutely great! - We booked two tours with XO, the "sights tour" and the "foodie tour". I have only great things to say about the whole team, from Ms Thai who did the bookings to the girls and the tour guide. They were all very polite and made us feel very safe during the tour.
We were really looking forward to doing the foodie tour but just a few days before the tour I found out I was pregnant and was getting very sick what made it pointless to do the foodie tour if I couldn't eat. I had to cancel the tour on short notice and Ms Thao was very kind not to charge us the cancellation fee. That was a very nice gesture. When the girls got to our hotel they were already informed I was not well and they did everything To make me fell safe and pampered. Very cute!! Despite the chaotic traffic, the girls are very careful driving and the whole experience of being part of this chaos is a lot of fun! Our tour guide, Khoi, was great telling us about the history of Saigon. They took us to a few historical spots of the city and also to a local market where we tried some homemade yogurt, Vietnamese flan with iced coffee and sugarcane juice. Everything was really nice and refreshing.
We highly recommend them and will definitely be back to do the foodie tour!
Thank you all for the very pleasant experience!

BEST TOUR IN VIETNAM! - I booked a private foodie tour for me and my two friends. We only had two days in Vietnam and I wanted to see and do as much as possible. Our tour was led by Nguyen (my driver) with Quynh and Dang. I can't say enough good stuff about these girls and this tour! We had a spectacular time and I would highly recommend this tour to everyone visiting Saigon. We saw way more than we would have on a traditional tour. Nguyen explained many cultural things to me during the ride. We felt incredibly safe on the back of the scooters. We had all the food we could possibly want (beer too). Everyone should do this in Vietnam!!!! And do yourself a favor and at least try the things they offer. What's the worst that happens, you don't like it and spit it out. I LOVED the food, all of it, and I loved these girls!! Thanks Nguyen, Quynh, and Dang for giving us the foodie tour of a lifetime!!!

Introduced to some amazing foods! - You are zipped around the astonishing traffic in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) on small motorbikes by good drivers, all female. You eat a variety of regional dishes at a number of small restaurants that a Western visitor might not take a second look at (most of which are located outside the 'touristy' areas of the city).

XO Tours provides some photos of your tour, as well as a security detail (which probably wasn't needed).

All in all, a truly memorable introduction to the city and some tasty Vietnamese food!

All of the staff were super friendly and put all of our group at ease!!

Ditto Ditto Ditto - These Girls are Wonderful - We went on the night tour of the city. It is crazy riding on the back of a motor bike through the crazy Saigon traffic with a little 90 lb. girl driving through the streets. Had a wonderful time. Was about a 3 hour tour through 4 or 5 of the districts in the city at night. Stopped to eat at an open air hot pot/bar b que venue. Hugh area with hundreds of people. Great experience and a different way to see the city.

Must Do in Ho Chi Minh - Do this tour! Awesome experience, my wife and I loved it. The tour guides really make this tour as they are constantly interacting and make it fun. We stopped in a few different places for food and the guides make it so you can just enjoy your entire experience. We stopped at a few other places in between the food stops where the guides gave us interesting factoids about Vietnam. Their English is great so you're not trying to decipher everything they say. It rained sporadically throughout the night, but did not ruin the experience, ponchos were provided and we had a great time. They incorporate some games along the way and kept the evening engaging. I initially thought it was a bit expensive, but the tour went from 1730-2200 (and it flew by) and it was worth every penny. Thanks!

Forget the rest do the best - awesome - We did both the city tour and the foodie tour a couple of days apart

Starting with the city tour I have never been on a motorbike before so this was a challenge in itself, add to that the HCMC traffic and the challenge was even greater. I should not have feared anything the girls were superb drivers putting us at ease very early on. This was just the start, the areas of the city we visited were perfect and using the bikes meant we got there so much quicker than on a coach. More than anything the fun in this was the XO girl drivers, they were witty, so professional and pleasant and they made the tour, this is a personal tour and nothing is too much trouble. Leave all your bags behind and cameras -they take photos and send them to you afterwards-brilliant. Take some money the girls deserve the tip. Thank you Trang and Thao you made the start to our holiday very special and great intro to HCMC, now the foodie tour . . . .
Tuesday night in rush hour with half the roads gridlocked after part of the roads closed made for an interesting bike ride but the girls Thao (again) and Tam were fantastic. I christened Tam -Carl Fogarty (Google him if you do not know him) she was ace buzzing around the streets, nothing phased her although I had a few "troi oi" (OMG) moments she did not. We went to 3 different eating areas and before we went we were asked if they was anything we did not like, we said crab, so when we got to the seafood restaurant they served us something else whilst everyone had crab, no problem. We tried all sorts of new food, frog (tastes like chicken-honestly), goat, quail, loads of seafood, and as much beer as you want. It was brilliant and the girls sat with us explained the food, cooked it sometimes, even fed us and at all times made sure we were enjoying ourselves. Their sense of humour and personality was 1st class and an absolute credit to them, they made the tour. Tam got my sense of humour straight away and we got on so well all night. Thank you girls you made our night

I cannot stress enough how good these tours are, we are lucky to have been around the world doing all sorts of tours, many leave something out or you find yourself only 90% happy, these tours are 2 of the best we have ever been on. Fun, fun, fun,

Do yourself a favour ditch any ideas about doing any other tour in HCMC book one or both of these, you will not be disappointed, check out my other reviews I do not do bull sh##, these are the best and tip them well they deserve it

Best Food Tour I Can Imagine! - We went on the foodie tour on our first trip to Vietnam. The organization was absolutely perfect, we got picked up by our wonderful tourguides perfectly on time.
Although one has to get used to the crazy traffic in Saigon, the girls were driving perfectly safe and were giving us all kinds of information on the city and answered all of our questions. The food was very good and we tried some new stuff as well, although no one was forced to eat tis stuff (frog, goat, infertilated egg).
The sea food was amazing and we hated an awful lot of it. There were bodyguards accompanying us, so even going to remote ant not very touristic parts of the city felt really safe.
The tour was a lot of fun and worth every penny! Would do it again anytime!

Deserves all the 5 star reviews! - This tour deserves all of these amazing accolades! My husband and I did the foodie tour on our trip to HCMC and could not have been happy with it. Our two guides picked us up on time right outside our hotel and were both sooooo friendly, nice, and funny. We had great conversation with them and they really helped us step outside our comfort zones with some of the food. We also learned about them personally, they were so helpful with tips for the rest of our trip, and they asked us about our life in the US! They are excellent drivers so don't be afraid of that. We never felt unsafe and it's so worth getting to experience this mode of transportation like a local. The places you stop are all so different and interesting, fun and delicious! We tried so many interesting foods, you won't be disappointed.

XO Foodie Tour - Fantastic! - Great experience! My boyfriend & I booked this tour our first evening in Saigon & it was the perfect introduction to the city. The girls were very sweet (Nhi is awesome) & made a great effort to make sure we were comfortable at all times. And riding around on the motorbikes in the crazy traffic was so fun! Every last detail was perfect. The food choices were adventurous & delicious. And our tour guide Hieu was charismatic & welcoming. Can't say enough good things! Thanks for an unforgettable evening.

Brilliant night - just brilliant - Well what can we say, we booked the city motorbike tour for our first night in Vietnam. My husband was keen on the tour as it had such good reviews and also what really appealed were all the drivers were female. They were excellent drivers and hosts. We also liked the fact that each guided tour had a driver who went ahead to set things up and keep an eye on the trip. We loved it. We got very wet, but would 100% say DO IT!!! There are some very nice touches during the tour and after which really add to the feeling of a personal tour and that they really go care of.

Good atmosphere, fanny evening, fascinating city - I did the Foodie tour with two friends on Nov. 26, 2015 ... everything is very well organized, it can be fixed easily by email or by phone and insurance is included ...The girls pick up you directly at the hotel and bring you by scooter around various districts of Saigon ... the leader, Anh, funny and agreeable, introduces to you every stop, then the girls have brought you in the city through street markets, avenues, buildings and narrow streets…The girls are very nice and friendly, they describe the food, teach you how to eat and what sauce to use, and during the trip, they tell you about the city, its customs and its people, with a way of doing so smiling and lovable that you will never get off the bike … My girl's name was Cindy and I immediately loved her, so adorable, funny and pretty … It isn't only a guided tour, the good atmosphere changes it in a funny evening with friends, able to make you taste local foods and give you an overall idea of ​​this chaotic, fascinating city ... absolutely to try, worth all the money spent ... !!!

Fun way to experience HCMC sights with delightful guides - We took the sights tour starting at 9am, fun way to experience Vietnam by the main mode of transport. The XO girls are great, very safe, very friendly. The tour visits the post office, reunification palace, burning monk memorial, HCMC museum and China town. Short stops for photos and a good explanation of what happened from the guide including tablet pictures. Fun 3 hour tour.

An unforgettable experience - My friend booked the XO Tour for our group of 8 for our second night in HCMC. We feel it would be a great way to kind of get our bearings and to kick start our trip. Boy were we right. The tour was so fun. At first, I felt iffy about these girls taking on scooters, but after a few minutes I could see that their riding skills were exceptional. At this point I just sat back, relaxed, and took in the scenery. We stopped at 4-5 stops throughout the tour and at each stop, Tai, our knowledgeable tour guide, gave us some information and insight about the area. The girls were super nice and fun to talk to while on the scooters and at the stops.

I highly suggest doing this tour if you're in HCMC. A perfect way to spend 4-5 hours to eat some food, learn a little, and of course, have some fun.

Thank you, XO Tours, for a great time!

The perfect way to see HCMC. - I traveled to HCMC with a large group of friends (8) and XO tours took us on our own private tour and it was a perfect way to start our trip.

First off, the girls on this tour provide you a great sense of comfort and safety while riding along the scooters; at no point did I ever feel like I was in any sort of danger.

The tour was absolutely perfect. It lasted about 4-5 hours and we stopped at about 5 locations. We ate at 3 different locations and were brought to 2 other locations for sightseeing. Tai, the tour guide, was knowledgeable and insightful - he provided some great local perspective that typical foreigners would not have been exposed to.

To the girls - these girls are nothing short of exceptional. Their politeness and enthusiasm really makes this tour what it is. They do everything to cater to the needs of their customers from driving us through the crazy traffic to serving us the local delicacies. They are also crazy funny and were so eager to join in our jokes. With a large group of guys traveling, it can be a little intimidating but they had no hesitation of joining in and joking right along with us. They were definitely the highlight of the tour.

I would recommend this tour as one of the first stops during your time in HCMC as they take you to many areas for you to see. It will provide you with a gauge of what districts you may want to visit during your stay. I couldn't have asked for a better experience and grateful that I got to meet some incredible people. Some of their stories are amazing!

Thank you so much, XO!!

Foodie Tour is a MUST!! - The Foodie Tour was the best thing we did in our 2 weeks in Asia. The tour guides pick you up from your hotel and you are whisked off into the bustling streets of the city! The food got better and better with every stop and the tour guides were the nicest people I have ever met in my life. They explain everything you are eating and even help you eat it! They are always around to get you another drink before you even know you need it. They were even waiting with hand sanitizer when we got out of the bathroom! The staff also takes photos and emails them to you which is so nice. We got to see so many things and eat so many things we wouldn't have if we didn't do this tour. HCM isn't the most tourist friendly place and this tour will make you fall in love with the city. Thank you so much for making our trip so amazing, XO!! We are quite critical people and we can't come up with one thing we would change about it.

Really fun and a great way to see HCMC - We took the foodie tour and had a great time. The food is pretty good, not great, though, and leans a bit toward unconventional (luckily the first dish fills you up). If you're adventurous this will offer some new things to try. What I most loved about it was the chance to see so much of the city and the chance to be part of the crazy traffic that I had to dodge like a pedestrian. The girls are all very sweet and you feel safe, for those travelers skiddish about the transportation method.

Foodie Tour...was awesome!! - Did the foodie bike tour & what a great experience. The girls pick you up from your hotel on their bike and then for the next 4 hours they take you on a tour of their city seeing amazing sites, on the way to various restaurants in many different districts to experience local food.
Great tour!!

The foodie tour is something I will always remember - Our guides picked us up from our hotel at 5:30 and we were returned to the hotel at 10:30. it was a fantastic evening and worth the money and a generous tip. As you are riding on a motorbike, women should consider bringing a purse and carry something small that can fit neatly on your person. Some of the bikes have a storage bin but it's a hassle to be dealing with a purse. Wear clothes and shoes (preferably close toed) you don't care about getting dirty or wet. We were caught in a downpour in the middle of our tour. They provided us with excellent ponchos that covered us from head to toe but we got soaked, especially our shoes. They also provide you with helmets but there is no covering for the face so i wore my glasses to keep the dust from getting my eyes. The tour took us through different parts of the city that we would never have seen on our own, we learned about life in the city, the economy, and of course were introduced to a wide variety of exotic and delicious food throughout the evening.

A great introduction to HCMC - We arrived in HCMC at 2pm after traveling for 24 hours so I was a bit dubious as to whether we would be up for it.

However it was a definite plus as HCMC is not a city for sleepers, the girls arrived on time at 5.30 pm and the tour was fantastic, food was great and the girls really enthusiastic about the city, food and everything else we where curious about.

Great start to a great trip, would recommend.

Great loss - I took the evening Saigon by night tour. I was picked up outside my hotel by a charming young lady. She spoke very good English and was very friendly and a great driver. Although traffic can be scary, she maneuvered it extremely well. Unfortunately we experienced two torrential downpours and got wet, even with the ponchos provided. Our guide was very knowledgeable and informative and even gave us his card with his personal cell phone number. Great street food. I highly recommend that your. Friendly and knowledgeable staff and great experience.

Highlights of our holiday! - We were on a cruise so booked a 3 hour custom tour. Booking was easy with great communication. From the second we met our riders we knew we were in for a good day as they were infectiously happy people! It is a very safe way of seeing Ho Chi Minh in such a short space of time. Thoroughly recommend it.

Memorable experience - We went on this tour having read other reviewers experience and we were not disappointed. The girls picked us up on time, funny, friendly visited, knowledgeable and drove us around several districts safely that we would not have otherwise.

Overall we had an interesting and fun tour of Saigon by night, while stopping to taste the local cuisine.

Great food tour- Ho Chi Minh City - We went on the evening food tour. Anh and his group of ladies exceeded all expectations. While the price may seem steep for Vietnam, it is well worth the money spent. I guarantee that you try a variety of Vietnamese food that you might not normally seek out. I would highly recommend this tour! Also, don't worry about riding on the back of a motorcycle. While the traffic is crazy, all the drivers are experienced and we feel safe the entire time.
Amazing - Very good. We had so much fun. The girls picked us from our hotel on time and gave us a quick safety briefing. Amazing food. The tour guides were helpful and cherry.

You need to do this tour in HCMC - Went on this tour whilst in HCMC after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor and a recommendation from a friend. Am so glad I did.

Tien my driver was awesome and such a lovely person. Really knowledgeable and a good driver. I felt completely safe on the bike and included in the group as a solo traveler.

The food was awesome and they catered well to my request for no seafood.

It was so good to see a different side to the city and to visit places many tourists often won't go.

Well worth the money paid to go. I loved it and would highly recommend.

Thankyou XO tours.
Great idea - We never did tours but decided to take a chance. This was great. Did the foodie tour for dinner. Highly recommend.

Probably the best tour experience I've been on - The XO come tours with huge acknowledgment based on reviews by the media and on Trip Advisor etc. So we were quite excited when we booked a Street Food Night Tour with XO on our second night in Saigon.

At USD 72 per person, it's a premium price. But it delivered on all fronts and was probably the best tour experience I've been on in my years of traveling.

For me, the best tours are made by the tour guides. In this case, the food was excellent. Cruising the town on the back of a motorbike / scooter was lots of fun. But the tour experience was 100% made by the guides and the girls in particular.

Each guest gets 1 dedicated girl all night to ride with, help navigate the food, and chat to. A lot of come tours with too high a ratio of guests to guides - here, a 1:1 ratio is spot on and you have a very personalized experience and really do end up getting to know your guide quite well!

My girlfriend and I had the lovely Nhi and Yen respectively and they were a riot. All girls are smart, bring great energy and passion for their country and its food and culture, they speak outstanding English, have a great attitude and want you to have a great time.

Yen and Nhi also had the right amount of sass to make the night so much fun, and it made the whole experience so enjoyable. They all get along really well which makes it feel like you're hanging out with a big group of friends.

We ended up having a bowl of bun bo Hue at our first stop, and then lots of grilled meats and beer at two other stops. Definitely try the grilled goat, the grilled frog (with skin on) and the crab. Also, it's effectively all you can eat so you won't go hungry.

I loved every minute of this tour and didn't want it to end. The food was delicious and along with the opportunity to see the streets of Saigon as the locals would, this is worth the price alone. The tour leader (Tai) was also very knowledgeable and led proceedings really well.

However, for me, this is all about the girls. They are great representatives of Vietnam today and I would encourage everybody to do the tour because Yen, Nhi and the girls make this tour.

A Total Home Run! - Just back from Saigon/HCMC where we treated ourselves (4 of us) to XO private tour. Highly recommend. This fun and entertaining evening is NOT TO BE MISSED. Who else allows you to taste a variety of local menus, gives you a district-by-district concierge-led city tour (where they do the driving thank goodness) and all hosted by the funniest, loveliest girls you could ever hope to party with. Not only that SO professional a company. Excellent marketing, communication, followup (they take photos and send them to you so you don't even need to bring your camera - how smart is THAT??). I just love this company. DO NOT MISS THIS.

Best way to get to know the town! Recommended!! - On time, very worried about our comfort and safety, extremely nice people, willing to talk about Vietnam and Saigon, careful skilled drivers :) best way to serve Hoi Chi Minh on a motorbike and get to know a bit more about viatnamese food, if you dislike something they are happy to fins alternatives for you! It was out second night there and we enjoyed it very much!

Fabulous - What an amazing time. A) You will never be able to see the city the way you can see it on this tour; B) the food is absolutely wonderful and unusual (goat, frogs, scallops on the half shell-but also tame food also; C) the women have great personalities.

Action-packed evening! - This tour was well worth doing just for the motor bike experience in the evening peak traffic. We had excellent lady drivers who taught us a lot about Vietnamese life during the course of the evening. It was a lot of fun and something we won't forget. I did not necessarily like the food very much as there was a focus on the bizarre and unusual which did not rock my boat but it was interesting nevertheless!

Awesome fun! - We did the foodie tour and couldn't recommend it more. Our drivers Phuoc and Nhan were really knowledgeable and fun, spoke perfect English and were great drivers and the team leader even arranged a birthday cake last minute for my wife! Would strongly recommend if you want to see a different side of the city and try some amazing Vietnamese street food (although I drew the line at the partially formed balut chicken egg!).

Exciting and Fun! - Went on the Foodie tour as it has such excellent reviews and we weren't disappointed - it was great! Its definitely an experience you shouln't miss and a brilliant introduction to Saigon.
We were shown areas of the city we probably wouldn't have seen otherwise. Felt very safe on the scooters, the girls were all excellent drivers, very friendly and good fun. The tour manager, Tai, was very informative and professional too, a lovely guy.
The food was 'interesting'! And all tastes were catered for.
A good mix of ages and nationalities added to our enjoyment of the evening. Had a great time and definitely recommend.

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - Would just like to say a big thank you to XO tours for a wonderful tour on Friday night. The foodie tour was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh. We got to see so much of the city as well as taste food we won't usually get chance to try. We were really impressed with the professionalism and high level of service we received throughout the tour. We had so much fun and were made to feel very welcome by the girls. I mentioned to my driver that it was my birthday the day before and at the last stop I was greeted with a birthday cake with my name written on it, I was totally gobsmacked it was so thoughtful. I would highly recommend this tour to everyone visiting Ho Chi Minh. nk you to XO tours for a wonderful experience! The foodie tour

Outstanding - a must - On the advice to Trip Advisor - my boyfriend and I booked this tour two days ago. It was everything that we hoped for and much more. The food was amazing, the staff knowledgable and friendly, and the experience of being on the scooter was unforgettable. I started out being disenchanted of the scooter, but by the end I was thrilled and having a great time. Highly recommend.

No better way to see HonChi Minh City! - This was a most unique and effective way to see a city ...move quickly and safely amid all the motorbikes, cars, bicycles and pedestrians of this city. We saw the sights, and were introduced to some local tasty eats and drinks...included in the tour! Guides/drivers were delightful....fun....cute...and spoke excellent English along with knowing everything about their city.

Fun and interesting - We did the motorbike tour where a local guide packs you and you visit different restaurants. Loads of fun and very informative. I like how they showed us District 7 and how different it was from the rest of the city.

Best way to see HCMC - XO tours do a fantastic 'foodie' tour but its much more than just the food. 5 districts are visited along the way, loads of local, unusual and tasty food, not to mention free drinks too. Its all you can eat/drink!
The XO girls are also great fun, very witty, quick with a joke, great English and very knowledgeable, my guide Ngan is a gem.
5* all the way. A must do if in HCMC.

Foodie tour - Wow what a fun night! Scooter drivers were great with very good English. Amazing experience negotiating traffic at night in city & food was another experience in itself...so very tasty!! Would do again...

Foodie Tour - Was an absolutely awesome experience. The food was great, all the girls for our group of 4 were just lovely & very helpful. Motorbikes were great fun - loved being among the crazy traffic in Saigon. Would do tour again.

Must Take This Foodie Tour - We took the night time foodie tour and it was amazing. Highly exceeded my expectations, everyone in the tour spoke great English and very easy to get along with. They also included some sight seeing in between so we can digest our food. That was the best, we got to drive around to the different districts and see how they vary so greatly.

Saigon, one-day tour - Amazing experience in HCMC on the back of a scooter. At first the traffic and the sea of ​​scooters can be overwhelming but I always feel safe with Nhung. At one point, we held a drink in one hand while holding on to the back of the scooter with another hand. At each stop, Khoi our tour guide spoke about the Vietnam history and we certainly learned a lot. His answered a lot of our questions along the way and he was certainly knowledgable. We will always recommend xo tours to our friends when they visit Saigon to learn about Vietnam and more importantly the culture on the back of a scooter.

Best Tour in Vietnam - What a fantastic tour! This is by far the best tour we have done in Vietnam. While we were initially worried about getting on the motorbikes, the two guides (Phuoc and Phuong) were very skilled and competent, and were extremely comfortable to ride with!

They also spoke excellent English, and were excellent to chat with. The food was varied and delicious, with a good mix of styles/flavors.

Anh, our group leader was very knowledgable. He spoke well and injected a good sense of humor into the tour!

If we had time, we would book again tomorrow night. Highly recommended.

Saigon Foodies - Have been to Saigon many times and not sure why I never did this. Girls were great! Friendly and competent drivers (regardless of your size). Very engaging tour and would highly recommend if you like adventurous food and want to explore the city! We'll be back! Thank you Thu and ladies!!

Excellent XO - I can honestly say the tour was one of the best things we did on our whole trip ! The traffic is heavy in Saigon but when you are on the back of the bikes you feel part of it! The girls were so much fun , my driver 'Money' was such a character but also was very informative and helpful, even shelling the sea food and cooking the BBQ food for me ! The guide showed us some areas of Saigon we would never have visited, and we tried some local delicacies?,,, they took great photos and emailed them to us , a brilliant experience!,,

The most amazing time - If you do anything in Saigon do this, it was the most amazing evening of my trip to Vietnam. The organization is wonderful, the girls speak great English and talk you through the sights and sounds of districts you won't visit, this gives you a real insight to the vietnam's day to day way of life. You are in a group, but it really feels personal, in fact it's as though you are out for an evening with an old friend. It may feel expensive on first impression but it is worth every penny.

The Coolest Girls in Ho Chi Minh - We have just come back from completing this tour and felt we had to write about it. We booked this tour last minute. So lucky we got in. After reading the reviews I knew this was the tour for me. I haven't been on the back of a motor bike for over 15 years so I was a little nervous. Huong (2) and Khan (2) were awesome. Huong was so professional and safe. I felt at ease straight away. The food was great and we got to see so many districts we would have never had experienced. The girls were friendly and interactive. They answered lots of my questions. An the guide was funny and informative. Well done XO tours

Totally professional and great fun. - What a wonderful tour my wife and I have just had with XO Tours. We went on their "foodie tour" and this completely exceeded our expectations. Initially a little concerned about safety...the traffic in Saigon is crazy....but we need not have worried. Our drivers, Vi and Ngu were fantastic and made us feel completely at ease.
We saw lots of the city we would never have reached ourselves and the food was great. Such a good, fun, evening in the company of the XO ladies and other guests who had taken the tour. We had a private video taken and were pleased we did as it is really something to remember.
We found XO to be completely professional and everything went so smoothly from start to finish. A must do tour for anyone visiting the city.

Sights Tour - I was undecided wether to do this Sights Tour not sure that riding on the back of a scooter in Saigon appealed to me, but was so pleased I did, it was absolutely brilliant. The girls were excellent drivers and So much fun. Anh was our tour leader and was full of information and we had lots of laughter .I wouldn't hesitate in recommending this tour. It was excellent.

A MUST in Saigon!! - Wow, this tour was soooo much fun!! Absolutely worth it!! My friend and I were doing a G Adventures tour through Vietnam, but had a free day in Saigon. My friend recommended this tour, and I was so interested by the Foodie Tour that I had to book it! The tour totaled approximately 4 hours and that's from being picked up to being dropped off to your hotel, so for our Foodie Tour, 5:30p - 10:30p. Be prepared for rain, it rains a LOT in Vietnam but they had ponchos provided for us. Rain doesn't bother me so I really didn't mind, just added to the experience.

Booking the tour was super easy, used PayPal and then maybe a couple of days, after received an email from a correspondent who answered all my questions and was very nice, even via email. I didn't know my room number for my hotel until I got into Saigon, but they received and responded to my email shortly after sending it, so they do keep track of all their guests and emails very well.

They picked us up right from our hotel promptly at 5:20p as they said they would. They even came in and saw us drinking by the bar, and said it was ok to take our time to finish our drink (I felt bad bc I misread the time and thought 5:30p instead, oops!) Our drivers were Nhong and Thuc (but I'm not sure if I'm spelling that right). They were the sweetest and most fun drivers ever! Nhong was with me and she would talk to me during the hectic drive and tell me about different parts and aspects of the city while keeping me safe among the hundreds of scooters surrounding us. Some people may get very overwhelmed by all the heavy and crazy traffic flow, but I find it most exhilarating!!! So exciting and so fun, I definitely appreciate that experience in itself!

*FYI don't think you can hold a camera or phone for pics/videos of the ride bc we were asked to put all our belongings (don't bring a big bag) in our drivers scooter compartment FOR GOOD REASON. Scooters were so packed that it would've been too easy to have an item stolen, even if it is strapped to your wrist, DON'T risk it!! Maybe if you had a go pro securely strapped to your chest, but really I think it's best to just play it safe. Pick pocketing and theft is HUGE in Saigon.

We stopped at 5 places total but ate only at 3 of them, which was nice bc it gave us a little bit of time to digest before eating more food. They were showing us different districts of Saigon to help us get a better idea of ​​what's in the city as opposed to staying in district 1&3 which are the tourists parts. Saigon is HUGE with I think 24 districts. All the places we ate at had only locals eating there, we definitely stood out but I love being able to eat what the locals eat. All food and drinks (including beer) are included in the tour. And they will make sure you are full by the end of the tour, they'll ask if you want them to order more so that you get your fill,so don't worry about it not getting enough food.

We started at a cafe for noodle soup, then ate in district 8 for BBQ, and finished the tour with seafood in district 4. The food was DELICIOUS! (well maybe all but 1 dish was delicious lol but I had to try it). The drivers also talked about each dish and prepare it for you (if it needs preparation) so that it's ready for you to eat. They even peeled the BBQ prawns for us! Talk about service! They loved joking around and being fun and we had good conversation with the whole tour group the whole time. They take pictures and email them to you after a few days too. There was also a couple games with small prizes and I won a little button. They also give you a little Vietnamese phrases pamphlet, an XO tour keychain and xo tour post cards! So cute and nice of them.

This tour definitely far exceeded my expectations and absolutely recommend it for anyone visiting Saigon. An absolute must.

Great experience across the street of saigon - The driver(I forgot the name again) has incredible rising skills & tour guide are excellent and friendly. They know every single thing about the city. You will get to know the city with different distinct & different story behind it.

Never regret to spend my night with this tour. I will definitely come back for another tour.

*Sorry boss.. thanks for the ride..
**jktan89@hotmail.com

Eating your way to Paradise, the local Saigon way (Foodie Tour) - We had been hosted to many expensive dinners in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), but this local way gave us the real taste of Vietnam, and was by far, the most delicious.

The tour around different districts was also fun. And, on the motorbike and with Saigon traffic coming at you from all directions, mine, what a thrill!

Thrilling Ride on 2 Wheels - We took the night food cum sightseeing tour from XO. The riders expertly navigated their way through the saigon peak hour traffic. Thoroughly thrilling and enjoyable. Tour leader Tai Dang was informative and entertaining, peppered the tour with his interesting anecdotes and stories. Highly recommended even for the faint hearted !

The best part of our trip to Saigon! - We had so much fun on this tour!

My guide, Yen, was great. We talked and laughed the whole tour, it was like we had been friends for ages - without being wierd at all :)

The food was also really interesting and good. We tried a lot of dishes that we wouldn't have tried on our own.
In the beginning we told them that we didn't like seafood (then they just order something else for you instead, no worries). However, we ended up trying nearly all the seafood they offered and most of it was actually really good (it didn't have the bad taste of sea/fish that you can often get when you have seafood in SE-Asia).

They also had fun games to play between dishes and a lot of good sightseeing as well, they take you to places most tourist don't go to or even know that exist.

Don't worry about travelling on a motorbike. We felt really safe with them, they are very professional.

It's a bit expensive but worth every penny, highly recommended!

Book your XO Foodie Tour! - Myself and two friends did the Foodie Tour last week - what a fun night! XO Tours were friendly and efficient from initial contact through to emailing photos after the tour. The girls were competent and safe riders as well as charming riding companions. A great way to experience this amazing city and be served fabulous food along the way! Would happily do again - loved it!

Loads of fun - We spent a fantastic evening with Kim, Tranh, Nhi and Tam as they drove us around Saigon on their motorbikes seeing the city from a totally new perspective in amongst all the chaos on the roads. Not once did we feel unsafe. Had heaps to eat, and got to try the local food, not the western (sanitised) version, with a great bunch of people.

We were really well looked after and I would highly recommend XO Tours and the foodie tour.
Night food tour - Absolutely the best way to see Saigon. Fantastic service from XO tours. Highly recommended. Best thing I did in this fabulous city. Thanks for an amazing night. Total professionals!

XO evening foodie tour - incredible - well worth the money! - We heard about the XO motobike tours from a couple in Hanoi as a must do, there are others around but this was the first tour that everyone copied. The girl drivers were very confident, competent and absolute delightful to deal with,the whole night was wonderful with excellent food at different restaurants and being taken to places that we would not have gone to. I am in my 60's an was last on a motor bike in my 20's but just loved it all. Congratulations to the person who thought of this idea - wonderful!

Super fun time! - This is a necessary tour that takes you to 5 districts in traffic you will never get to experience on your own. So great to see all the districts.
The girls were AMAZING!!! Our main guide had just gotten married the day before (i can't think of his name darn it!).
He was so great too! Great information about each district and Saigon in general.
We didn't take the foodie tour but we still had some snacks and dessert that were delicious! They also got me a cake for my birthday WOW!! Super surprised.
The were all super friendly and personable and I really hope that more people can experience the fun we had that night :)
Thanks XO Tours I will always remember that birthday!!

The Best Night tour - This was my game changer in my HCMC experience
As hue, our guide, and the lovely drivers took us around the untouristic sites of the city, I discovered a fascinating face of this vivid city
thank you guys, you were great

Best Tour in Vietnam!! - Did the city sights tours XO Tours Oct 2015. Just an amazing and outstanding trip. The highlights of this trip, apart from the sights, were the awesome young ladies that took us safely around the city showing us the great sights. The female riding team are just fantastic, they all have very kind and very friendly personalities, they chatted to you as you moved through the heavy Saigon traffic making you feel relaxed and at ease. If you want a great morning out, these are the gals to make it happen!! Excellent value. Thank you XO Tours :))

Excellent, best tour ever - This is the perfect way to explore and understand more about the districts of Vietnam. It's exciting, informative, great fun and very, very tasty. I can't speak highly enough of the team, they are thoughtful, intelligent, funny, take great care of you but also challenge you. Best thing in HCMC

A must-do!! - We did the night tour and any apprehension about scootering around HCMC was gone in 30sec. The girls are so friendly and are wonderful drivers and have impeccable English. It was an awesome way to see the city and was the highlight of our trip!

A shopping spree? Why yes! You MUST do this! - We made a very last minute decision to book a four hour shopping spree tour the day before we departed Saigon. It was well worth every dong we spent!! The tour operator I spoke to on the phone to book was friendly, helpful and very accommodating.

On the day of our tour, three lovely, traditionally dressed ladies met us at our hotel and invited three nervous lasses onto the back of their motorcycles. Accompanying them was our delightful guide who, as well as taking photos of us, carried our shopping bags and bargained for us. All this whilst traveling around the chaotic traffic of downtown Saigon.

This tour was such a highlight. Not only did we get to do our last minute shopping, but we got to experience the city like a real local. Markets, local stores and more fun than you could shake a stick at!!! Without a doubt this is a MUST if you are traveling to Saigon.

After our trip, we received an email with the photos that were taken of us, another reminder of a fabulous day in downtown Saigon. We only wish we were staying longer to do some of their other awesome looking tours!!

Three VERY satisfied shoppers!!

great to see Ho Chi Minh from the other side... - Looking for interesting things to do in Ho Chi Minh city (there are plenty) we came across the foodie tour on scooter. Having spent the past few weeks dodging scooters all over Vietnam we decided that on our last night it would be a great experience, not to mention we would get to try some interesting food. We were apprehensive to begin but once on the scooters were fine. All of the drivers were very safe and helpful and we were completely at ease. The food at all three stops was fantastic although we did say no to the delicacy at the final stop, but we had plenty of food, some great drinks and the host Anh was fantastic and knowledgeable and obviously loves his city. I could not recommend this experience highly enough and for the price it was very reasonable.

Best Tour Ever! - And coming from someone who doesn't like organised tours, that is a very big recommendation.

Hubby and I were heading through Vietnam for three weeks and our first night in Ho Chi Minh City I decided we needed to get on the "food wagon". So after hearing lots of positive thing in the forums here on Trip Adviser about XO Tours, I booked us into the Foodie Tour for our first night.

From first contact via the website right through to our drop off after our tour, these guys were nothing but friendly and professional. We were met outside our hotel right on time and met our two lovely young drivers - both girls spoke fantastic english and were just so warm, friendly and informative ... right from word go I knew we were in for a treat.

There were probably about another 15 or so on the tour with us that night and we all had such a fabulous time. Every stop was well though out and gave us a delicious taste of what to expect for the next three weeks on our foodie adventure. One thing I really liked is that they didn't just take us along to the places and feed us the usual "pho" etc - I mean you are in Vietnam, you are going to eat pho. Instead they introduced us to the food that the locals like to eat and that got us trying things we probably never would have done on our own.

What springs to mind for me is the bbq'd frog - I had tried frog legs before - but this was the whole frog and was truly delicious (and definately not something I would have tried on my own). All the food was amazing - although I did pass up on the balut.

Our tour guide Tai was just fantastic - full of great information but also cheeky and really funny. We all laughed a lot throughout the whole night and along with the amazing food and interesting history and fun facts - we enjoyed a few games and best of all got to know a little about our lovely drivers. They are just as interested in you as you are in them and it was fabulous to get such an insight into modern day Vietnam from these engaging young women. I also ended up getting some great recommendations on shopping and restaurants for our other nights in both HCMC and Nha Trang!

The time flew and before I knew it our time was up - at the last stop, if you are still hungry, they will keep ordering - but I was full as a boot. I can honestly say this is probably the best tour I have ever been on hands down and cannot recommend it any more highly. When I next return to Vietnam I plan to do the shopping tour with them.

If you do no other tour in HCMC - do this one!

FUN FUN FUN!!! - My entire family went on this excursion, and it was loads of fun for all! My kids loved the scooters, and the girls were all very sweet, with extremely good English. They also sent a separate tour guide to speak to us but really the entire group was very impressive. Their driving was as careful as it could be in a city of millions of scooters, and we never felt unsafe! The price is a bit higher than some of their competition, but remember, in HCM city as everywhere else, you get what you pay for! Would give highest recommendation! Wish we had time for the night tour.

XO Saigon by night - The girls are amazing- Khanh the tour leader is informative and a little cheeky. We got to see the districts that the locals see and eat with the locals. If you are looking for a different type of tour- do this one!

Ride of a lifetime - We did the sightseeing your on our first day which was great to get your bearings, drivers are very well informed and speak amazing English the tour starts at the post office then noted

Two words... Do it! - Do it do it do it.

The young ladies that taxi you from place to place are delightful, they will engage you in conversation until your ears hurt.

You will learn a little of what it's like to be a young woman in Ho Chi Minh, that alone is worth the price of admission.

Did I mention the food?

Do it do it do it.

Great Food Tour - We went on the night tour as we were recommended it by people we met on our holiday and so glad that we did. We had an excellent night being shown around the city on the back of a scooter and trying many new foods. Really safe and the girls are so lovely and helpful, making you feel at ease. Great Night !

Sightseeing Tour - Awesome tour, fantastic guides with some local treats thrown in along the way! Totally recommend this as a must do! felt totally safe the whole time, a must do while in Ho Chi Minh.

Brilliant tour of HCMC - We did the night time foodie tour. What a blast!
Riding through HCMC in peak hour on the back of a scooter was an experience in itself!!
All the girls were very attentive and sweet and were great drivers.
The different foods that we got to try were also what made the night - things we would never try ourselves.
The different districts that we visited were also a major highlight as it took us out of the touristy district 1 and showed the other fades of HCMC.
A must do!

Great night out - I went on this foodie tour after a recommendation from another tourist while traveling and couldn't be happier...Had a fantastic time, the food was great the girls were fantastic, competent and lots of fun...a must do when in Saigon, even if it does rain !!! adds to the excitement and adventure!! no fear of traveling among the thousands of motor bikes at all....awesome!!

So much fun and great service! - I went on the Foodie tour with my teen daughters. We all had a great time. The drivers are knowledgeable and excellent drivers. The food was fantastic. The guides were always concerned with our comfort and safety. It's the one must do for visitors.

Definitely Must Do - One must definitely do this if you are in Ho Chi Minh City. Everyone says it and after we do it even I will say it.its the most perfect way to explore the city. It is a different experience altogether.

Even the guides are young and knowledgeable. The experience is wonderful.

Thank you guys for a wonderful memory.

Excellent, must do!!!!!!!!!!!! - This tour was one of the best things we did the whole time we where in Vietnam. Just heard about it on the off chance, and so glad we did. It was ran by young kids 20-35, they picked us up from our hotel on their bikes and took us around 5 different districts, we got to try different foods, and never once did we feel uneasy. They all had very good English, they remembered all the 13 or so members of the group and they made sure we didn't eat any thing we didn't want to. They where intelligent, fun and such a pleasure to be with. So, so glad we did this and would recommend it to anyone.

Fantastic food trip on a motorbike! - My husband and I went on this trip and it was one of the best tours we have ever done. The staff were fantastic, very informative and humorous and the food was great. I don't eat meat and at each place we went they had arranged something different for me to eat instead of the meat.
Great Tour even in the Rain - My friends and I, take the night tour, it was raining heavily, lucky we were provided ponchos. The trip was wet and very memorable.

You have to do this tour! - One of the most fun tours I've ever been on! It was interesting, delicious, well organized and safe. Everybody in the XO team were super friendly and really easy to chat with. Being on the back of the scooter was cool and it gives you another perspective of the city. The XO team show you the 'real' Vietnam and we tried lots of foods I had never tried before. There was LOTS of food so nobody left hungry! They really make an effort to ensure people have fun and plan little games etc

Best thing I've done in Vietnam!

A Great Introduction to Ho Chi Minh - We booked with XO Tours because of their excellent reputation and thought that seeing Ho Chi Minh on the back of a motorbike would be novel, exciting and a good use of our short time in Saigon. We were met at our hotel by our two drivers who were friendly, funny, spoke excellent English and were great company. We were then whisked off to six different stops around four different districts. We thought that our drivers would be our tour guides but were surprised and impressed when we reached our first stop and were met by our tour guide who was on hand to give detailed information at each stop. His English was superb his knowledge broad (we asked a lot of questions). He carried with him a tablet which he used to show extra photographs and information giving extra context and relevance to the information.

Before we set out I was a little skeptical about how much you could fit into a three hour tour of such a huge city but was pleasantly surprised about how much we managed to fit in and felt that we had gained a much better understanding of the place in a short time. In between stops you don't just zip from A to B but pass through other districts and other places of interest to pack more into the tour. There was even a point when we stopped for about five seconds to pick up refreshing sugar cane drink in an almost drive by fashion.

The tours usually run in groups but were full when we tried to book so we chose to pay extra to have a private tour rather than miss out altogether and I'm glad we did as it was worth every penny. I'd definitely recommend XO Tours as a great way to experience Saigon and would definitely try one of the other packages such a the Foodie Tour or Saigon by night if we were to return to the city.

Fantastic evening in Saigon - Wonderful Saigon street food tour on the back of a scooter! The XO girls are very impressive young ladies - intelligent, articulate, independent and full of fun. The tour was a unique experience, we visited several very different districts of Saigon, we ate lots of wonderful food washed down with a few cold beers, and we had a LOT of fun! You can really engage the XO girls in a proper conversation about their life in Vietnam in the 21st century and you will gain a fascinating insight into how the country is changing. I'd definitely recommend this trip and I think for a 4.5 tour including unlimited food and drink this is decent value for money.

Best night in Saigon - Awesome! Although I wasn't the biggest fan of Saigon itself I just loved the Food Tour with the cute girls on their scooters, who make you feel like friends from the first minute.
We had quite some laughs, a few beers and food that could be described from weird to delicious...

Of course it is a little expensive, however it was worth every penny!

Safe a spot for me on one of your scooters so I ever her back to Saigon...

Thanks again for the great time!

The highlight of our trip to Saigon! - Book this trip! The Foodie tour was well organized, our tour guide Tai was entertaining and knowledgeable and the girls were amazing! Just getting on the back of the bikes and riding through the traffic in Ho Chi Minh city is enough to set your hearts racing. Seeing the different districts and eating the food was an added plus. We highly recommend this tour. Thanks girls!

If you've only time for one thing in Ho Chi Minh - this is it! - This is a must do experience! We had such a wonderful time on the foodie tour of ho chi Minh with Anh and his angels. I was apprehensive at first being mopeds in this crazy town but was instantly put at ease with my driver Hong when she picked us up at our hotel. She was a brilliant driver and gave me great information all the way along the drive. The experience was definitely enhanced by her. Lots of food and drink, so you won't be hungry after and you get to try delicacies that you wouldn't think to try by yourselves. If you only have one evening in Ho Chi Minh City this is definitely the thing you should do.

If you want to see the real Saigon, this is it! - The tour was fantastic and I have no regrets signing up for it. You'll get picked up and dropped off at your hotel. The XO girls (tour guides) were such good drivers and they are caring, professional and protective. I was not nervous at all riding on their bikes. The journey was very comfortable. The whole trip itself was lovely and you get to see local sites areas instead of the tourist sites; and you get to taste unique foods from the best local eateries. The tour leader was very knowledgeable and very informative. I had a lot of fun on the tour and meeting the other guests as well. Definitely made my Saigon trip a wonderful and memorable. Thank you XO!

Fantastic Day - What an amazing day we had. The tour company is top notch and the girls are very sweet. It is a great way to see this complicated city. I wish had the time to take the foodie tour as well. I could not recommend it more.

A Ho Chi Minh Highlight - Did not regret signing up the Foodie Tour with XO Tour to all the readers here.
Booking is seamless with their fast and accurate reply on every enquiries we have, before the tour starts. Getting picked up (on time) from the hotel we stayed and
dropping off (again on time) after the tour are such a hassle free experience. I would like to say that it is one of the best nights we have during our group trip in HCM.

We are amazed on how well the XO girls riding around the town no matter how bad the traffic gets! They are caring, professional, well-organized and protective. At first, I got a little bit nervous with the crazy traffic around, but when we resume our journey after the first food stop, I felt more confident and comfortable with the one-of-a-kind bike riding at the back experience.

The whole trip itself was exactly as described, a lovely ride in the city, get to taste few of the best local eateries. All of the food presented to us is tasty, unique, interesting and eye opening experience. Along the foodie tour, we were brought to
the local sites areas, instead of touristy sites destinations between the food stops. Tour Leader is a very informative and knowledgeable guide who is able to explain about the food and the insightful information about HCM along the tour. We all had a lot of fun in between each stops and during the bike riding journey as well!

Just sign up and do this tour, payment upfront includes everything: pick up, your
personal professional bike driver, helmet, tons of good food, drinks (beer included),
photos for memories, survival guide booklet, souvenirs and insurance!
A Big Thanks to Mr. Hieu Nguyen, XO girls, the video cam team and the rest of the
team who have helped to make our trip so wonderful and memorable in Vietnam!
Thank you so much for a real Vietnam highlight!

Extraordinarily Food Tour like u never experienced before - There are many food tours in HCM, but I decided to choose XO Tours to give it a try. I was not disappointed. Free hotel pickup & drop off. Throughout the whole food tour, the driver who was riding the scooter was very friendly & cheerful. Their English is very good. You don't have to worry about miscommunication. Food tour starts from 5:30pm to 10pm. Cost $72USD or 1,600,000 VND. 1st stop will be dinner & the leader of this food tour will give an explanation about the dish u eating & then will take a group photo which they will send it to you. There were 5 stops total. The food varied each tour. Give them a try!

The foodie. - Had a great time with an awesome driver which I unfortunately can't remember the name of.
I did the foodie tour and besides the great food you get to see alot of the city. It was a perfect start to my Ho Chi Minh trip.

Best Night in HCMC - My husband and I did the XO tour. The XO girls picked us up at our accommodation. They were so delightful and caring making sure we were ok with traveling on the motor bikes. They were very safe conscious. Soon we were on our way among the HCMC traffic. It was so much fun. We went all over the city visiting a number of different districts, stopping at different spots to eat and find out about life in HCMC. There was a group of people on this tour so at each restaurant we got to catch up with different people. The food was great so make sure you don't eat too much at the first few restaurants as you be too full to try all the food. Our XO hosts were absolutely wonderful. We talked about everything while riding around the city. They explained the food you were eating and helped by serving and cooking. It was their care and attention and sense of good fun that made the night so fantastic. An absolute must do. Stephen and Irene

Great night out in Saigon - Just do it! The scooters seemed scary at first but once you climb on back with one of these young people, the fear recedes. Funny, engaging guides who speak great English and care about how you enjoy their city. I learned a great deal about Saigon and how the city is changing and where they feel their place is in it.

Fantastic Night - A great big thank you to all at XO tours for a fantastic night. My wife and I went on this tour as we had read reviews previosly on trip advisor. We tasted so many different types of food and had a wonderful time. All the XO team do a fantastic job of giving you the real feel of HCMC. We met wonderful people and saw so many things we would not have thought to do. At the end of the tour XO team surprised my wife with a cake as it was her birthday and we just managed to squeeze it in as everyone had eaten so much.
If you visit Ho Chi Minh City be sure to book this tour.

#1 Things to Do in HCMC - Not a cheap tour by HCMC standards at $100AUD however this price includes everything & is worth every cent! My driver Tao was funny, super knowledgable & spoke fantastic English and the overall tour leader Anh was also brilliant. Highlights include seeing the lit up city by motorbike, a visit to Chinatown (the real Vietnam), a team chopstick challenge and more delicious food that you could possibly eat at places off the beaten tourist track. We also received a couple of cute little XO gifts to take away with us. If you do one thing in HCMC due to this tour, you will love it!

Fantastic 'Saigon by Night' tour - We were recommended this tour by a couple we met in Halong Bay, and, as promised, it was absolutely fantastic and great fun.

We opted to do the 'Saigon by Night' tour which involved heading down the Saigon Highway on a moped into some of the lesser-visited districts in Ho Chi Minh City. We felt totally safe in the hands of our drivers, who were both absolutely fantastic and were happy to chat and answer questions as they drove us around.

The tour itself was really interesting as we got to see some of the 'real' Ho Chi Minh City outside of District 1. Highly recommended to anyone visiting HCMC.

Great first thing to do to discover Vietnam's food and culture - Me and my wife took part on the Foodie tour and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

We signed up for the tour at the start of our 3 weeks trip to Vietnam and it proved to be a good introduction to HCMC and Vietnam as a whole. In a few hours, you go though, not only a food tour, but also a few explanations about different aspects of the modern HCMC.

The food is very diversified and excellent (this is Vietnam after all so it's expected :-)). What made this stand out to us were the conversations we had with our drivers. I can't speak for all the drivers, but the XO girls that were assigned to both me and my wife we thoughtful, funny and intelligent persons with whom we were able to have great conversations about life in Vietnam. This gave us a much more interesting view into the modern Vietnam, and if that's something that's interesting to you, you will appreciate the caliber of the employees of XO tours.

Highlight - We went on the sights tour as a large family group which include my 5 year old niece and 2 year old nephew. We were a little worried how they would cope but everyone had a truly fantastic time!!! The guide was great, friendly and very knowledgeable. Our lovely ladies that drove us were simply fantastic!! We felt safe and well looked after and they were fantastic with the kids, taking care of them while us adults could hear about the places we were seeing. The kids took to them straight away and really enjoyed their company, games and treats.
Honestly couldn't recommend more highly, this was the highlight of our time in Vietnam!
Very fun and delicious night out - What can I say that hasn't been said already... Foodie tour was Professionally run, fluent English, unlimited great food, just a really great time!

Best thing we did in Saigon - The best thing we did by a long way.

We did the "foody" tour, which was incredible. It took us to districts and made us taste food we would never have otherwise have done and are so happy we did.

The drivers are very safe, very fun and perhaps the most unsung aspect of the whole trip is being able to speak to a local about just about everything about Vietnam, HCMC and life in general.

I would recommend it to anyone.

A real experience - This tour is about more than just food. It is a full sensory experience. Driving on the motorbike gives you a feel for life in this huge city. We were taken to many areas of Ho Chi Minh that we would not have even known about. The guides were incredible, weaving their way in and out of traffic safely, while sharing information. I was very impressed with the care that this company took with regards to our safety. Along with our guides there were other bikers who followed along to ensure that the group stayed safe. The food was interesting. Nothing that I would prepare at home but a lot of new experiences. If you are a picky eater this probably isn't for you BUT if you love to experience a place, it's people and it's food do not miss this tour. A note: neither my husband nor myself had any tummy troubles after the tour. Always nice to know!

Seriously the Better than the BEST!!!! - We cannot stop talking and thinking about how much we loved this scooter/bike tour. If you do just one thing in Saigon - make this the No: 1 priority. It's not just a food tour. You will experience the city, seeing it in a new way and gain an insight that no one else will take the time to show and explain to you. Your ears are amazing. Let me repeat: you are AMAZING. The Girls who ride the bikes - you treat us like royalty. Wow - if I am lucky enough to return - I will do another tour with your company. The most delicious food experience and the most exhilarating fun experience. Riding in the rain. Who cares!!!! It was even more fun.
