Your drivers and security were 100% - safe, delightful, wonderful to talk to and so kind. Thank you all for going above and beyond. You took our experience to a higher level. Don't miss this tour with this company.

The most fun I've had in years ....... the highlight of our 6 days in Saigon. - We went on the 9am-12am Sights Tour. This was our first visit to Vietnam. On talking to other XO tourists, and if we had our time again, we would have gone on the Foodie tour on the first evening, just to learn more about Vietnamese food and then gone on the Sights tour.
For us this was a seamless operation. Our drivers were charming, fun and intelligent and the Guide you meet up with at various stops along the way gives you a great insight into what you are viewing - we would never have seen some of the attractions without XO (and we had done a lot of sightseeing and walking by day 4). At each stop the Guide will supplement his presentation with photos etc from an iPad.
I'm 2 meters tall, have not been on a motorbike for 40 years and my partner has never been on a motorbike. I would recommend XO to anyone under the age of 90 and don't worry about how much you weigh - their guidelines are well researched. This is an excellent company with a well-crafted product

Foodie Tour - We booked this tour after our son had done it. To say i was scared was an understatement. Im too old to be zipping around Ho Chi Minh on the back of a scooter. How wrong was i..it was the most fun, i never felt unsafe at any time. The food was amazing and the local knowledge made it a truly unique experience.

Super fun tour - My husband and I had a blast doing the foodie tour with Ahn and his crew. The food was amazing, the girl drivers were so friendly and courteous and the guides were very helpful and attentive. We saw the city in a way we never would have otherwise. Thank you!

Professional, safe and so worth it!!! - To be honest after being in Saigon for a few days and seeing the horrific traffic I was seriously worried about doing the XO foodie tour. I was literally shaking in my shoes about doing this tour and I told me rider when she picked me up. As such we rode at snails pace to the first meeting point. This was good as whilst I had heart palpitations at first I soon wanted to get back on the scooter to cool down.
The whole operation is a slick well oiled machine. Extremely professional riders and tour leader, all XO staff care and want you to have the best possible time and most importantly to be full ( no problems there ).
I don't want to give too much away but if you are in HCM then this is a must. Yes it is a little expensive in comparison to other attractions on offer but I felt completely safe throughout and went to areas that I would not have normally been to.
The ride through the market was great I just wish we could have stopped there for 15 mins to really see what was on offer.
If you are on the fence about doing the foodie tour just book it grest experience.
We got to try a few different things I wouldn't normally try only 1 thing I wasn't game enough to try.
Slick operation very impressed.

A great and unique way to enjoy Ho Chi Minh - My family of 5 and my parents in law had this tour by XO, Saigon by Night.
We had an enjoyable ride and had fun on the bikes. The drivers are charming, the tour guides speak good English and the foods are amazing.
We went to different districts of HCM and we're explained the different demographic of each districts. The ladies of XO tours really know how to entertain our family including my 6 years old.
An amazing tour and great way to start our trip to Ho Chi Minh. Splendid!

Must do tour - I went with a large group of friends. We were all nervous about jumping on a bike in Saigon but the nerves quickly disappeared as the girls were very competent and safe. We all enjoyed the food experience and tried things we never thought we would ever try! One of the best tours I have ever done and would recommend to anyone.

Awsome! Cant recommend more strongly - On Oct 22nd I and my two daughters joined XO's Night Tour. Wow, what a great, great time. What a way to see the city, just cant do this walking or from inside a van. While the motorcycle traffic in the city looks crazy, when you are part of it, being driven by skilled drivers, its amazingly calm, just going with the flow. We really liked our drivers/guides (Huong, Mi and Thanh), very engaging, knowledgeable, very good English, well prepared, etc. Felt very safe all the time, and when a little rain came the girls were totally prepared. Nice food stops to. If you don't do a tour like this, you are missing something interesting and fun in Saigon. My only advice, do this at the start of your trip as you get a great overview of the areas outside District 1 and that might change your plans. David, Kristina and Elise.

A fun night with amazing food - We love our tour guides, friendly and pleasant girls. i do not eat beef and lamb, and i thought that i will just skip these two dishes and wait for the next stop for other food. However, our tour guides are so tactful and brought me replacement food instead. All the food served was so delicious. A wonderful experience.

XO tours are excellent - I went on two scooter tours with XO in Ho Chi Minh City, The Sights and The Foodie Tour on 4 October 2015 and found both tours to be very good. This appears to be a well-run business. The scooter driver picked me up for both my tours from the hotel to take me to a central meeting place. The drivers were skilled and safe and I had every confidence in their ability. The drivers provided attentive care during the tours and were a lot of fun, especially on The Foodie Tour which was as much about enjoyment as culture. During the rides with the drivers they made commentary on traffic, life in HCM and the features of the city.

On both tours we were accompanied by a guide with a good knowledge of the places we were seeing and satisfactory English skills. The scooter drivers' English were less accomplished but nevertheless they were skills quite able.

The Sights tour gave an overview of the major sights in the city with some in-depth content at Notre Dame, the Post Office and the immolation sight. Other sights were viewed from entrance gates and an adequate description of the significance of the location was given.

On The Foodie tour we saw a range of foods in various parts of the city, mostly at local restaurants and we ate with the Vietnamese people at their restaurants and enjoyed food similar to what they were eating. The food could be as adventurous as you were brave enough to try or conservative if you wished. This tour was a lot of fun with a few drinks and plenty of laughter. It was also informative.

I strongly recommend these tours. Riding on scooters is a much more convenient way of getting around the city than potting around in slow-moving, heavy traffic in a bus. It also gets the adrenaline flowing.

Best tour in Saigon!!!! - Where do I start? My friends and I decided to do the foodie tour on our last night in Vietnam and what a way to finish our holiday on a high. The lovely ladies were excellent tour guides and I felt very safe on the bike (I was very anxious about riding around Saigon on a bike but after 5 minutes I was having the time of my life). I loved going to different districts and discovering the city. What can I say about the food other than it was amazing! So glad I was able to eat where the locals do and eat what they eat! It gave me a truly authentic experience. The variety of food was great too if you like meat and seafood you will be happy! Please book this tour if you are going to Saigon you will have a fantastic time and experience the real Saigon!!!!

XO pillion passenger tours Saigon/HCMC - Friends with family living in Saigon told us about this and how good it was (they also told us to take the speedboat up to the Cu Chi tunnels) how right they were on both counts.
We did the morning sightseeing tour with XO riding as pillion passengers with young women drivers (Our drivers were university students & very smart as well as great drivers). This tour was great. Super drivers, amazing traffic even in the mid-morning, really good guide/tour leader, pick up drinks along the way, saw things and places we might have missed or ignored. Recommended, especially for the experience of Saigon traffic & road rules!
Then we did the evening 'Foodie' Tour with XO as well. If the sightseeing was great, this was superb. We were in a small group with guides and guards! Right from the start we were told if you like the food and want more, just ask. If you want another drink, just ask. We toured numerous Saigon city districts from the rich and serene to the poorest. Once again we were taken to, and saw places, we would otherwise not have seen or considered.
We had three stops for 'street food'. The Vietnam BBQ was terrific, but the last stop in the poor District 4 for seafood was magnificent, with some of the best seafood we've had in a while. And we didn't need to ask for more or another drink it just arrived; and the young women who drove us also prepared the BBQ and shelled the crab etc. for us. This is a MUST DO tour if you are in Saigon and like your food and want to experience rush hour chaos on the roads safely, with a little bit of zest included. Couldn't recommend these guys more.

There's no other way to experience Ho Chi Minh City! - XO tours is a delight! We booked our night food tour with them the morning off and three lovely women, including Binh and Kun met us at our hotel for a fun filled evening.

We tasted a variety of different dishes, including bun, seafood, grilled meats while also touring across 5 different districts.

Xo ensures that you see the "real" Saigon, where the locals eat, how they drive etc. It rained on us for a bit and there were ponchos ready.

Trip highlight! - By far one of the best things we did while visiting beautiful Vietnam! Cruising around on bikes sampling local food we wouldn't have otherwise tried & seeing districts of the city we wouldn't have otherwise seen. You certainly get value for your money! My beautiful guide was Hong who spoke fluent English & I learned so much from her and our tour leader Hiew. We had such a fantastic night - highly recommended!

The best tour we've ever had - Had the best night ever on the Foodie Tour. We saw so much of Saigon and the food was amazing. The best part was the great team of young women and men who were and are the best tour guides ever. We learn so much and eat so much. We will definitely be doing this again. Thank you everyone at XO Tours for making awesome memories for us.

Best attractions in HCMC - Wow!!! Really great evening seeing HCMC from the back of a scooter driven by very well trained young ladies dressed in traditional dress. Five hours riding around parts of the city most tourist never see plus a guided tour AND unlimited food and drink from street restaurants that have been carefully vetted. Not to be missed and great value for money.

Fun & A Memorable Experience! - Touring around Saigon City at night was really fun and the girls were amazing with their driving skills!

It was great way to learn a bit about the city and taste some local food.

I will definitely do this again. A really enjoyable experience!

I love my tour guide Anh, she was really informative and easy to talk to!

As an explorer, here's my spin... - Researched this trip back home and was looking forward to it when we reached Saigon. Well, no disappointment here, well ran operation from pick up to the end.

The drivers definitely make the trip a they make feel like you are family and friend. Excellent skills for driving around these streets with crazy traffic.

They took us around 5 or 6 different districts, while we were driving she also gave a great tour. I work in a tourism business also, so i really appreciate all the details. The foodie tour is not to be missed even though i had a little stomach trouble later on. But you cannot blame the tour.

Cannot recommend the Saigon foodie tour enough! - Canh and Loan were our guides in HCMC for the Foodie tour and they were awesome! So lovely and friendly; they really helped make our tour. The tour leader, Hiew, spoke fluent English and was very informative and interesting. The whole tour was organized so well - we got to see parts of the city we never would have seen otherwise, and eat amazing food. There was no pressure to try anything you didn't want to, but I would recommend trying it all!

Must do when in Saigon!!! Only way to see the city!!! - This tour was a great experience to understand Saigon, by getting on the road you get a feel for the manic roads that you have built up the courage to cross. XO take you out of the backpackers district to more local places whilst teaching you about each district and giving you some amazing streetfood. I wish I had more time to do all the tours, we did the night tour and it was fantastic!!!!

Great loss - Great why to see a few of the different districts in Saigon.. the tour girls def make the experience enjoyable. They took us to a couple of places for local food & dessert. Best Banh Mi I had was on this tour.. couldn't find a better one in our 2wk trip.

Thanks Thuy & Tung (?). Very fun & enjoyable

Saigon by night with family - Highlight of our trip to Saigon - traveling with 10 /11 year old daughters and we had such an exciting / interesting time on the by night tour. Our guides were wonderful and made us feel very safe yet part of the night around us. Dinner was wonderful and we would recommend this as a must do in Saigon. We got the video - that's because we wanted to hold on and have something to show our friends.

A must do if in HCMC! Fantastic experience - We did the Saigon by night tour - its awesome!

You get taken on the back of a scooter around 5 or so districts in Saigon by very competent drivers - allowing you to take in the views whilst they explain everything about the areas you're driving through.

There are also a couple of stops for some food and drink - the food is amazing!

You get taken out if district 1, which is where most tourists stay - so great to see the real Saigon.

A must do for anyone visiting the city.

Takes about 4 hours

XO - YO! - Had a fantastic tour with the beautiful ladies of the XO tour in Saigon. Very safe, super friendly, engaging, interesting, informative, and most of all great fun! I was a little apprehensive about going on the moped through the traffic of Saigon before the tour but those fears were quickly dispelled - it was very exciting and a great way to see the city! Our city tour guide was great too - again, very knowlegdeable and good fun! Gutted we didn't have time to do the food tour - but it's something to do next time we're in town!

I couldn't recommend this highly enough and it is definitely worth the money!
Great! - Ms. Nhi was a great driver and took care of me very well! Food was yummy also. It's a great way to understand Ho Chi Minh City..

The best - DO NOT MISS THIS - The highlight of our trip to Vietnam - we had 8 in our party, and not only do you get your riders who are amazing and engaging, but also a guide who details the history in a fun and engaging way. We did the city tour and it was so much fun - wish we had time to do the food tour - that will be for our next visit! They made such a special effort of cake and roses for my daughters 21st birthday, that she will always associate being on a moto through the streets of Ho Chi Minh as being a great memory of her special day. I couldnt recommend this highly enough and its worth the money!

Must do experience - Had a fabulous night on the back of scooters touring various districts of Saigon that most tourists don't visit. We stopped off at a number of eating places and fed some great food including some more unusual things though no pressure to try these if you're squeamish. Drinks are included in the price.
The tour is completed in small groups. There were 8 in our group put together by the company. Everybody meets up and sits together at each restaurant.
Our drivers were Yen and Thiet, delightful young girls that were both safe drivers and very entertaining. Tour leader was Tai who provided regular local insights at stopping points along the route.
Photos of the night were provided by email a few days after the tour.
This is a must do experience and we cannot recommend the company and its staff highly enough. Great value for money.

Friendly, well & safely organized tour - My wife, me and our eight- and twelve-year-old children just came back from the Saigon by Night tour. It was a great way to explore Ho Chi Minh riding like the locals. XO only has female drivers. This was great as they drove carefully and took good care of the kids who by the way had their own drivers and bikes. Superthrill for an eight-year-old girl! The four charming young ladies took us safely to Chinatown, District 7 and many other places. We enjoyed a lovely street food dinner and a surprise dessert as part of the tour package. Well conceptualized tour, very friendly drivers and good value for money.

GREAT FOODIE TOUR! - Thanks to tripadvisor, I was recommended to choose XO Foodie Tour although they were more pricy compared to some others. But it's worth the money as the team did a great job. They were very professional overall. Safe drivers!

The tour guide Tai Dang -Tour Manager at XO Tours was really good including the ladies who drove us. They spoke well and were very friendly.

The food was great experiencing the local delights. We had great fun. They fetched us at 5.30pm and we were back around 10.45pm.

Tai was so nice to send us so many photographs he took on that night. I received them through email, a few days later we returned to Singapore, as promised.

Great Tour not to be missed!

Great food and lots of laughs - The XO Food tour was a fantastic night. The girls were amazing; great riders, and I always felt completely safe, excellent English, great knowledge of all things Saigon and the food and drink was great as well. The girls have a real sense of humor and the tour was heaps of fun. Thoroughly recommend it !!

Taste but overpriced - The great Tripadvisor rating of XO persuaded me they might be worth double the price of similar tours. After the event, I received an XO email touting for a good Tripadvisor score so they did work on that rating. Which means the guides are perky young women who thread their motorcycles skillfully through the traffic, and you get to try interesting food which arrives promptly when the tour group turns up at each location. No complaints there. However we didn't know what quantities to expect, so when the guides kept loading up our plates at the second stop (a local barbeque joint) we ate too much and didn't have room for the delicious seafood at the third and last stop. For me, the thrill of being among the peak hour traffic wore off after a while and so I could have done without the night sightseeing to suburbia. All in all, a good excursion, but not what I'd call a real foodies' tour, and not worth for the money. Do look at other operators.

High quality maintained. - I wasn't feeling great, and came close to canceling, but having used XO before I decided to go ahead although I chose to take it easy on the food (nothing wrong with it, I was just not particularly hungry after being unwell for a few days). I still had a great night and despite not being able to fully participate on the food front, it was fun to watch my fellow guests take in the experience. My driver "Ngan" was lovely company and very enthusiastic as were the previous guides I have met. I would urge anyone to visit Saigon to take a tour with XO; they aren't #1 for nothing.

Best, most fun tour we've ever done - anywhere! - Quite simply, XO Tours is the most fun you can have on two wheels in Ho Chi Minh City! It is so much fun zooming around like a local to all the different districts, places that you usually wouldn't go, and experiencing the true fresh local street food (so good!). But the best thing about the tours are the XO Girls, they are just truly wonderful! Thank you so much Loan, Kim, Thuy and Quynh - for making this the most fantastic night! We just really enjoyed the night - talking, eating, laughing and learning about the city from these lovely, intelligent, vibrant young ladies. They really are the most beautiful people! I felt like we had made new friends. Our tour leader Khoi was also great, at one stage the girls took the kids to get ice-cream while Khoi gave us a bit of a history lesson on HCMC. Our son Patrick is autistic and we were a bit apprehensive about putting him on the back of a motorbike in all the Ho Chi Minh traffic, but after meeting and talking to the girls we knew he would be OK (thank you Kim for looking after him - he had the most wonderful time!) The girls are all such great and safe drivers! Both our children have said that XO Tours is their favorite thing they did in Vietnam! Us too!

The Incredible Experience - An absolute must when in HCMC. First class experience,amazing food,the guides are extremely knowledgeable and the costumer service is impeccable. This is must do tour when in HCMC and believe me you won't be disappointed.

Amazing - foodie tour - Incredible service and tour - worth every cent and more! Great, safe drivers with plenty of local knowledge who care about your safety. Heard about this tour from a friend who also did the foodie tour - was absolutely fantastic. Had the best time.

One of our highlights- Do it your first night there. - We took the Foodie tour and this was a wonderful night. It has all the ingredients for a memorable evening, good people, good food and a good adventure. As anyone knows it takes more than good ingredients to make a good meal, it takes a good chef to put them together. The folks @ xotours did a great job of making this work. I am not sure how this evening could have been better. The "ladies" were a delight and I always felt safe on the back of the bike. The food and beer were very good and they took us to places we would have never seen.
My biggest tip would be to do this your first night there. I found HCMC much more enjoyable once I got my butt out of District 1 -- this tour will show you why right away.

Wow! A must do HCMC experience for all tourists who like authentic fresh food - Nhung your such a wonderful guide and beautiful person! The tour was amazing and the girls are all lovely and talented in many ways. The guys are all very good at their jobs and make you feel safe as you travel around with them following you. Wow we were treated to such an amazing side of HCMC that we had never seen before despite this being our forth trip. The men with us were skeptical at first but then were in awe of the girls riding skills. Lots of food and drinks - all prepared fresh and on the spot for you. It would be impossible to end this experience feeling hungary or unhappy. Keep up the amazing work and never give up making glitter wishes. We can all change the world with kindness.

Excellent - Had an amazing night with the xo foodie tour. So much fun and the girls are amazing so friendly and encouraging. My teenage were a little apprehensive about getting on the back of a bike in such a busy city but we all felt so comfortable and confident with the drivers.
Thank you xo tours for making our holiday so much fun

A must-try experience - My partner and I did the Foodie trip and enjoyed that whole experience. Each of us sat behind the well-experienced lady drivers as we went to different districts to get a taste of the best cuisines in Vietnam. We were picked up from our hotel and were given a brief orientation about safety on riding the motorcycle before we left. Aside from the delectable food, we were also given some information about the daily lives of the locals. The ladies made sure we had fun during the trip. We even had a game at the table after one of the meals.

Extremely Fun Night Out in Ho Chi Minh - The XO night food tour was a highlight in our 3 days in Ho Chi Minh. Our tour guides and drivers were Nhung and Thuc. They were both informative, funny and very good drivers on the hectic city streets. We traveled all over the city to many Districts and neighborhood streets we never would have seen on our own. We made many stops to try amazing local foods (beers also included) - and some really adventurous local delicacies. The entire XO team made the whole night a great experience.

Wonderful start from XO Tour to see HCMC! - Thanks to Thu Duong and her team for picking up my friend and I at our hotel on time and taking care of us for the night foodie's tour in Ho Chi Minh City during my visit. It was really a very great and fun experiences for me and my friend to explore HCMC with just a short period of time to experience different places and foods that we wouldn't have gone by our own.

Both of you were very friendly, fun and able to communicate well to answer our questions and to share about HCMC. Even the traffic in HCMC was crazy but still able to handle well through the traffic jam and make us feel safe.

The non-stop feeding during our tour also ensures that we will not go hungry and with the fun company to try on variety of foods was great too.

Thanks once again to XO tours! Cheers!

Amazing City Tour with friends - XO Tours took us on there scooters all around the dazzling HCMC. There were super friendly and showed some very cool places, an ordinary tour wouldn't do. Especially the short cuts they can only you can only do on a scooter give you a glimpse of hidden places just for locals you will never see. It has been really fun to be driven around by this cool girls.
Definitely recommendable.

Cheryl Pritchard - Highly recommend XO Tours we went on a foodie tour what an awesome time. The girls were beautiful & very informative as was the guide. Felt very safe on the bikes with these very experienced girls a great way to try different foods, & to travel & see different places.

Scary but fun - Complete the foodie tour as a family (wife and two children, 7 & 9). Pretty scarry dodging the traffic around Saigon, bt entirely worth it.
We got to have many different dishes and food types that we would have otherwise missed and also saw 6 different districts!

The drivers were really safe and I would recommend to anyone - the commentary with the tour made for food and cultural experience.

The Best Part of My Trip - We found this tour on TripAdvisor and this was by far the best part of our trip. It was truly amazing. We were taken to so many different areas and tried so many different foods on our night tour. The ladies were outstanding and made the evening the best night of our 5 days in Ho Chi Minh. They helped us with finding a taxi to our hotel after the tour and made us smile and laugh the entire time. If you have the opportunity to do one thing in Ho chi min, I would recommend the night tour.

Do not go to Saigon without doing this tour! - This tour was amazing. It was on par with going to halong bay as the best thing that we did in Vietnam. It was so much fun. There was so much food. Our guide was amazing. Seriously, if you only book one thing in Saigon, pick the foodie tour. Absolutely worth every cent!

Ho Chi Highlight - Well worth it although relatively expensive considering costs of food, hotels and wages. It costs more than a 5 star hotel for one night but when you weigh up what you see and do it is probably worth the amount paid.

Did not disappoint! - As a first-time visitor to Vietnam on business, I was glad I was able to sneak a day for myself to discover HCMC beyond it's modern hotels and business district.

Taking XO's "Sights" tour in the morning and "Foodie" tour in the evening let me experience the city beyond what most visitors get to see. These tours certainly go beyond the typical tourist destinations and surpass the standard tourist food options.

Guides Anh and Tai were fun and informative, and drivers Thuy and Houng-2 were incredibly upbeat and super-adroit in their handling of HCMC's crazy traffic. Everyone was so enthusiastic about sharing their perspectives about their city, country, and culture with me. Zipping along on the back of a scooter with these guides and drivers should be the only way to see this city.

XO had a lot to live up to from my readings of previous reviews; I'm here after taking the tours to tell you they do not disappoint on their offerings.

Thanks again to the whole XO team for such great memories!

Great safe tour - We had an amazing tour around Ho Chi Minh with our lovely lady guides, as a group of 10 ladies traveling together it suited us perfectly! Our drivers were knowledgable, considerate and most important very safe, looking forward to seeing our video when it comes through!

Perfect way to know Vietnam, best of all, on a bike! - This tour was recommended by colleagues.
My girlfriend and i joined the Sight Tour with XO on our 2nd day in HCMC from 9AM to 12PM. Here's our review.

On the Trip:
- The tour covered most of the must-visit area in HCMC with excellent briefing by the leader

On XO Leader & Ladies
- Both tour leader & ladies are engaging & fun, not only they can share with us the historical background of the places we visited, also happy to answer all other questions I had about Vietnam.

On the Ride:
- Traffic@HCMC can be horrendous at times but the ladies drivers are really good at maneuvering around and yet feels secured

For us, the part we enjoyed the most of XO guide & ladies' company throughout the tour. Would definitely try their food tour on our next visit to HCMC. Thank you Hieu & the ladies :)

Regards,
Carl & Seewen

Super fun tour - My wife and I did both a Sights Tour and a Night Tour, both of which were a lot of fun.

Hoping on the back of a bike and getting into that traffic is not something any sensible person would do, at least not if you hadn't grown up with it. But the ladies are all really exceptional drivers and you feel completely safe the entire time, and it's an absolutely incredible way to see the city. We had a ball.

The ladies are all extremely friendly and super fun, and we definitely saw things we wouldn't have otherwise come across.

Out of the two tours we did I wouldn't recommend one over the other. Because they are both, they're both different and both worth doing. If you're going to do a bike tour in HCMC, do it with these guys, they're amazing.

A must do - We would thoroughly recommend the 'foodie' tour. It's been a real highlight of our holiday in Vietnam. The team at xo tours were great and really helped make it a fun experience. I was a little nervous about getting on a scooter for the first time but I was put at ease straight away and really enjoyed it. The food and somewhat off-the-beaten-track sites were amazing and the team took photos throughout and emailed them to us a few days later, which we thought was a really nice touch.

Fabulous experience - We booked this tour many months in advance to make sure we had a booking as we didn't want to miss out considering the great reviews this tour gets. Did not disappoint.. A bit of trepidation at first in regards to navigating the traffic but once you hopped on the back of the bike with one of the lovely friendly girls we had the time of our lives. Poured with rain at the end but only added to the fun.

The highlight of our time in HCM!! - We had a fabulous time on this tour, the girls (Huong, Uyen & Ngan) were so lovely, great fun to be around, very knowledgeable about their city, great ambassadors for their company, and of course the food was absolutely amazing!! You will try things that you wouldn't normally try, and that's exactly what we were looking for. You will eat at places that you wouldn't normally walk into, just where the locals go. And the tour of the different Districts was great too. Thanks also to Tai, our tour manager who accompanied us on the tour, making sure we were all happy and well fed. This is a must tour to do whilst in HCM!!

Foodie Tour: Don't need to look elsewhere - Come on, ~2,500 reviews averaging ●●●●●? What more can I rave about this tour that hasn't already been mentioned? The tour started with a couple of very friendly XO drivers picking us up at the hotel. First thought, how in the world will these two tiny girls putt-putt us around town in their little scooters? Well, they answered that the moment we took off on their XOs (motorbikes). Our drivers/guide, Tuyết and Hā Tâm, could not have been more engaging and informative about HCMC. The rides were very safe as they skillfully maneuvered the streets of HCMC. They genuinely love their jobs and are proud to share about the city they live in. Unless you've been seeking out unique eats around Vietnam, I don't think you would ever get to experience most of the food that was offered on this tour. The noodles, meats, seafoods, veggies/fruits, drinks ... were all very authentic and tasty, albeit you may encounter a few "surprises", ha ha.

I have to also say that the entire tour group was managed by Tai Dang and felt that he was always watching over the group to ensure our safety and to have the best experience possible. We'd be riding along and he would surprisingly pull up his bike next to ours and ask "how is the tour so far? is everything ok?" I'm also amazed by his ability to remember ALL the tour members' names. Without going into too much detail, Tai and I were just casually chatting earlier in the tour that this tour was a birthday surprise for my wife. At the very last stop, Tai somehow arranged to have a cake, candles, and sparklers presented to my wife with the entire group singing Happy Birthday. That's what I call great service and going beyond the ordinary -- thanks Tai and crew!

This tour was the highlight of our visit to HCMC. I whole-heartedly recommend XO Tours to anyone considering a tour of HCMC. The bikes make it extra fun and these guys do not mess around. Why bother looking elsewhere when XO Tours have you covered for everything.

This is a must do!! - One of the best tours we did, experienced some local food which was delicious , and saw some of the out skirts of Ho Chi Minh which we wouldn't have seen otherwise .
The girls were very professional as was the whole tour.

Highlights of our Trip! - What a wonderful/professional tour service. We were picked up on time by the two loveliest tour guides that gave us a fabulous tour of Ho Chi Mihn. The idea of ​​getting on the back of a Vespa in HCMC is enough to give you a heart attack, but they were incredibly safe driver, giving us a safety overview before we started our tour. Our only regret of the trip was no booking the night tour. By the time we got to HCMC, it was booked for the week :( boohoo!

A Highlight of Our Trip---So Much Fun! - This tour was one of the highlights of our two weeks in Vietnam. We booked the city tour on line and had a blast! The drivers are all girls who speak excellent English and have great driving ability. Even if you have never ridden a motorbike, you can become part of the Vietnam traffic on the back of one of XO's bikes. Just hang on! It's fun and relatively safe. The tour uses a male guide to watch for problems and keep the motorcycles out of dangerous situations. The ride includes refreshments and visits to numerous points of interest, with another male guide providing information. We were picked up on time and returned to our hotel. Perfect! Hint: book in advance so you are able to get the tour of your choice.
Best thing we did in Vietnam!!!! - Fab time the girls were great fun. We went to places we wouldn't have gone to on our own. Had great food, and great company!

XO Tour – A Blast from the Past - I decided to return to the scene of the crime after some years away from doing my first XO Food Tour. My first tour was such a delight and the overall tour was one of my best experiences in Vietnam apart from meeting my wife. This time around I brought one of my closest friends to enjoy the XO experience. Let me say XO Tours is still without a doubt the most fun someone can have on two wheels and a novice in Vietnam can learn a lot from just conversing with their driver and the tour manager.

There were a number of enhancements that XO has made since I first went on the tour. First XO no longer use the cute yet antiquated Vespas to scoot you around the city. The vespa(s) need a lot of maintenance so the decision to go with modern motorbikes was the sensible solution. Another addition is a security element now. My first response was why do you need security for a tour and it was explained due to some hassles and threat of bag snatchers it would make the guests more at ease. Also I noticed a change of venue at the first stop for Bun Bo Hue – first time around it was outside and this time it was an inside venue. Also XO has a small useful Viet phrase mini book which could become invaluable to the intrepid traveler.

The food is outstanding and it gives you a glimpse into what the locals enjoy. The goal is to give food that you normally wouldn't have the opportunity to eat – so don't look for pho or springroll. Let me warn you to come with an empty stomach because you will seriously get a stomach stretching experience because they aim to fill you and then some. Not to mention there is a rule that you can drink as much lager as you want as long as you do not fall of the motorbike. ;)

The tour happens in the evening and you experience what is like riding on the back of a motorbike with small Vietnamese lady in an Ao Dai. I am sure most will be a bit afraid at first but once you gain confidence you will realize how really safe/cautious XO drivers are. Before long you won't even need to hold the back of the motorcycle if you are a lad or the driver if you are a lady.

The tour itself took you through the various districts in the evening time then made stops along the way for food and photos. There were 3 stops for food from soup to bbq to seafood/dessert with copious amounts of lager. Since I had experienced the tour before XO was also throwing me some new dishes to try in addition to the normal menu. I naturally shared the new dishes with the other tour guests since it was way more than what my mate or I could ever eat. I also experienced a detour from the normal route since I had already heard the interesting facts about District 7. My driver gave me a private tour around D7 rather than the stop which showed me a few more places I had yet to see before.

So I was curious to see what my mate thought of the tour and he equally enjoyed his time out for the evening on the back of the motorcycle. He was surprised how well the small ladies could drive and get westerners around w/ease in the heavy traffic of Saigon. He enjoys most of the food apart from anything coconut oriented, but the good thing about XO they will accommodate any food requirements. (just let them know and special requests can be accommodated) Once the tour came to an end and the ladies dropped us back at our hotel we gave them a nice tip even though none was ever expected.

In summary the best thing about the tour besides the various foods you try is the interaction and fun you experience with the drivers and staff of XO. I am unsure how XO does it, but they really find engaging staff who love the job they do and they aim to please their guests. These small XO ladies really do take care of you both on/off the motorbike. The tour is well worth the price of admission considering all you get out of the experience between transport, food/drink, guided tour around the various districts, photos taken, and the most important aspect friends for life.

If you are having a hesitation about doing an XO tour then my advice would be to just book it and you will have the time of your life. Remember the XO Tour is the first and best motorbike tour in Saigon – do not substitute other companies with XO and expect the same experience.

Excellent way to see HCMC - XO Tours were the highlight of our trip to HCMC. The girls were fantastic, their English was perfect and their driving skills were spot on. We felt very safe on a road full of madness. We had torrential rain for our tour but it didn't dampen anyone's spirits. We got ponchos to keep us dry. The restaurants we went to had lovely and usual food. Visiting the different districts was a great treat as well.

Awesome - We really enjoyed our Saigon by Night tour. Our guides were amazing and very friendly. I was nervous about taking our 11 year old but they really looked after us and made us feel safe while giving us an insight into the real Vietnam. A must do in Saigon.

Most memorable tour in Ho Chi Minh City - We really regretted not doing the tour on the first day of our trip! Our guides speak excellent English and had a great sense of humor throughout. What I really liked was that they provided sightseeing opportunities (in between food stops), and gave us a brief history of the different districts that we visited. I really recommend that you book the tour on day 1. We have been here for four days and really only saw "most" of HCM today. They have 1-2 "exotic" dishes, so don't be too surprised when they present you with the duck egg (I shall not reveal too much). Also, I think it would help if you stopped eating 3-4 hours before the tour. Thank you XO Tours!

Fantastic must do - If you are in hi chi min city don't miss this one fantastic value for money, back of bike a bit intense in traffic but girls are very good riders, variety of food great and guides were fantastic

Great fun! - We took the food tour in HCMC. This was the most enjoyable tour we did whilst in Vietnam. Not only did we have a great tour of the city on the back of the bikes, we also got to sample some great foods in various different stops in a number of different districts within HCMC. The girls on the bike were very funny and we felt safe at all times despite how crazy the roads are there!
If your in HCMC you simply must go on this trip!

Awesome fun for everyone! - As all the previous reviews have stated, this is by far the best way to see HCMC! We did the Saigon By Night tour our second day in town. It really helped us get a good idea of ​​what we wanted to do for our next week plus in town. Our drivers were absolutely wonderful, each and every one of the fourteen of them with our group! They are great with kids (all ages...I have an 8, 11, and 15 year old) and are very easy to get along with. This tour was definitely one of the highlights of our trip!

Wonderful - One of the best things I did in Vietnam. Wish I did the night foodie tour, but rain impeded. Will do next time. A must do. The girls are great and so friendly and happy. They seem to love their jobs and do it well. Our guide was lovely. Safe and the best way to see the city. I booked it the afternoon before and they were professional and picked me up from my hotel and were on time and made me feel safe and secure. Single female traveling and it was perfect and I met some other travelers. I booked a different tour the next day with a different company and they never showed up to pick me up and ruined my day. XO is the way to go.

Sights tour - a great way to see the city! - We took the city sights tour which started at 9am and lasts 3 hours. The lady bike drivers are brilliant and make you feel very safe on the motorbikes. They also speak brilliant English and give a very detailed account of the city.

The stop at the food market is pretty cool and you also get to taste some tasty deserts.

I would highly recommend this tour if you are in saigon!
Best way to see HCMC - This was absolutely the best experience. Our tour guides were all friendly and we always felt safe - even our 9 year old. We would all highly recommend xo tours.

AMAZING EXPERIENCED - I've done many tours and this had to be the most fun/unique tour experience. My tour leader Khoi and driver Thao were both knowledgeable about the history of HCMC.

The morning tour not only took us to main attractions, but also to places that tourists don't tend to visit (Chinatown and Flower Market). They let us try desserts and fruits along the way.

It was just an amazing experience and I would recommend to anyone!

Fabulous foodie tour. - This tour was recommended to us by friends and i would have to agree with their choice. It certainly was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon. My husband and I were picked up from our hotel by two delightful girls and after being given a safety talk and having our helmets strapped on we were off. Right into the middle of afternoon peak hour. We had already done a motorbike tour in Hanoi so thought we were well prepared. Saigon peak hour among the bikes is really something to be experienced. It was exhilarating. The girls are all very competent and safe drivers and even during the crazy experience of making a turn through the middle of a busy intersection I felt completely safe.

At our first food stop we joined up with a number of other people and we all traveled around as part of one big group. This added to the experience as we were from a variety of different countries.

We visited a large number of districts throughout the city and stopped for an informative talk by Tai at a number of places. The girls who drove us also gave us additional insights to the areas we were traveling through and life in general in Saigon.

There were three stops for food and what great food it was. The drivers sat with us and helped by explaining what the food was, what sauces to eat it with and even peeled the prawns and crab claws for us. The drivers and Tai were lots of fun and kept us entertained as well as informed.

As an additional service there were a number of places where Tai took photos of us enjoying the food and fun. These were emailed to us a couple of days later.

My husband and I are both in our late 50s and the others in our group were a variety of ages. We both highly recommend this tour. Don't take much with you. I had a small camera which I wore in it's case (I could have put it under the seat) and some money (which I didn't need as all food and drink was included). We wore a light spray jacket as it was a cloudy and rainy week and it did get a bit breezy on the bikes. The others however were just in light clothing. The jackets were handy if there was just light rain. If it starts to rain a bit more heavily you quickly stop and put on good strong ponchos complete with hood which do a good job of keeping you dry.
It is not a requirement that you provide a tip to the drivers but we found, as on other tours in Vietnam, it is always appreciated if you do so have the appropriate money with you when you set out if this is your intention.

Food Tour - We recently took a Foodies tour with Xo Tours. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. It was quite an extensive tour through districts that you may not normally visit. Not all the stops were related to food but were interesting and taught us things about Vietnamese culture we did not know. Our guides were polite, funny and extremely professional in their duties. At one stage it teemed with rain and they were well prepared
for this and it just made things a bit more interesting on the back of a scooter. The food was a great example of Vietnamese street food. We would confidently recommend this Tour.

The BEST food tour in HCMC! Well worth ever dime!!! - XO Tours is an excellent, well organized and customer-oriented company. In addition to the never-ending delicious dishes and drinks, and the fun and thrilling motor bike rides from D4-D8, our tour "adventure" we had tonight with Tai, (tour manager) Yen, Dang, Quynh, Vi, Thu (tour guides) and Khang and Danh (tour securities) just proved XO Tours placed customer's safety and customer's satisfaction beyond anything else. XO Tours is a great example for all tour companies to follow. Kudos to XO Tours!!!
Tai, our tour manager, is amazing if not the best tour guide we've ever had. His knowledge and insights of YCMC was uncanny! His English was unquestionably well understood! He was friendly, respectful and committed to his clients needs.
With all the advertised food tours in HCMC, we were extremely lucky to choose the right tour company, XO Tours. By far, the "foodie" tour from XO Tours was the best tour we've ever had, and we were so glad to have experienced this on our last night in HCMC. We were having so much fun not realizing it was our last "foodie" stop. As we all say... Time goes fast when you're having too much fun. (My only regret was I wish I reserved for a video tour ahead of time.)
With this well-worth tour service, we hope to see XO Tours expand all over Asia. Without hesitation, we will use XO Tours again. As well, we will certainly recommend XO Tours to all our friends and relatives on their trips to HCMC.

Thank you XO Tours!

Foodie tour, fun but..... - The food tour was a top priority on the trip with all the top ratings on TA.

First the tour portion, riding scooters through a city with millions of scooters is both exciting and scary, after the first few minutes the scary part fades though. There are 5 stops total, 2 tours, 3 food. Between the stops, your personal xo guide will also give you some history, information and just general small talk as you ride through the city. The 2 tour stops are at chinatown and "modern" hcmc which gives you a quick break between the food stops and more scooter time, which was the most fun part. Probably could skip the modern part of the city and add 1 more food stop in my opinion.

Food portion, they take you to unique food restaurants, not pho or bahn mi. The food is different and most likely you would never think to even try it if it wasn't ordered for you. The food is good though and you will be full at the end of the day. Also unlimited beer and drinks at the 2nd and 3rd spot. For that reason i am glad i took the tour but i do wish they added either a pho or bahn mi spot that locals go.

Highlight Of Saigon - I read about these tours while researching thing to “do” while visiting Saigon. I wanted to see more of the city in a short period of time. We picked the night time tour, as we had walked and seen most of what the day time tour would cover. This tour was the highlight of our tour of Vietnam, the girls were great, picking us up from our hotel, It is a fantastic way to see the city visiting areas you wouldn't normally see. Riding through the madness of the traffic was great, never felt worried at any point. This is a “must do” if you are coming to Saigon, it will make your holiday

Highlight of Ho Chi Minh trip - Great fun! - When looking for a food tour to join in Saigon, this was a clear standout due to the overwhelming number of excellent reviews. I have to say that the positive reviews are absolutely justified. My wife and I had an amazing time on the foodie tour last night.

Any safety concerns we had about sitting on the back of a motorbike and weaving in and out through traffic were quickly dispersed within a few minutes, as it became clear the drivers were very skilled and experienced. My wife and I felt very safe even in the wet conditions (it rained for most of the tour - raincoats were supplied).

Our drivers were very lovely and they spoke English well. You could tell the drivers enjoyed what they did and were pleased to be there.

The tour leader took care to provide us with information about the food at each of the food stops and encouraged us to try food that we would never have remotely considered eating if we weren't on a tour. It was fun to go in with an open mind to try all the dishes, although I have to say one particular dish was a bit on the adventurous side and I almost didn't eat it (I won't spoil it).

Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

Great food tour! - Took the foodie tour. The guide and drivers were AMAZING! So friendly and kind and great drivers as well :) the food was all very good and I liked that they stopped a few times to tell you more about the city(and let you digest) the staff really make this tour though they are wonderful!

Saigon by Night - I liked Ho Chi Minh City so much I wanted to get an idea of ​​the city beyond the District One tourist area (for my next visit). They also do gourmet (gourmand, I'd recommend!) and shopping tours. You can read the details on their website. You ride behind the young ladies (Hi Nung!) to different parts of the city, explaining aspects of life in Saigon along the way, where the tour director (Hi Khoi!) talks about where you are. A security guard accompanies the tour at all times. You've been to the night street food restaurants on each side of Ben Thanh markets? On this tour, one stop is where the locals eat, at places easily six times larger with a much wider variety of foods. You even pass huge Western style shopping malls! Highly recommended!

An Amazing Night Tour - We saved our night tour until the very last night of our trip and it was definitely worth the wait. Our drivers were extremely friendly, informative and made us feel completely safe and secure throughout the entire ride. We learned lots and saw parts of the city that we would never have seen on our own. Thank you so much XO tours! The tour was the highlight of my whole trip in Vietnam and I would recommend your tour to anyone and everyone! A wonderful experience! xx

Drivers are awesome, good foodie tour - We had a great time with our drivers on the XO foodie tour, and the rain that night did not dampen the trip at all. The girls had great English and definitely made the trip for us. All of the food that we tried was great, but we would have preferred to do more food stops as the sightseeing stops were a bit lecturey (for example, we in chinatown but did not have any food there). We would also have preferred for the tour to be a bit more adventurous - for example, instead of having our drivers cook our food for us at the BBQ place and practically spoon feed us, it would have been more fun to be shown how to order and cook for ourselves. But we were on the younger side for the tour group (late 20s) so the target audience may not agree with us.

Fantastic tour - absolutely recommended!! - Did two XO tours while in HCMC for the weekend - the day time and the night food tour. Had a great time on both of them with the night food tour being an absolute must for any visitor. Where to start - the drivers were an absolute delight, telling jokes, teaching about the different neighborhoods and making you feel completely at ease while zooming through the Saigon xe om frenzy! Anh was an awesome tour guide and really gave the group the inside story on all the districts we visited and I came out of my first day in HCMC knowing more than I would have ever learned on my own. And finally the food - absolutely terrific and not the usual tourist fare by any stretch. If you are adventurous and looking for a fun way to explore Saigon, don't hesitate - book a tour today. As a side note I did both tours as a solo traveler and had a blast getting to know everyone else on the tour!

a truly genuine experience - My partner and I did an XO Foodie tour at night of Ho Chi Minh City.
I had been to Ho Chi Minh before so was ready for the traffic but my partner was very nervous about getting on the back of a motor bike, but after just a couple of minutes was truly loving the experience.
The girls that ride the bikes are wonderful, the just glide around at gentle pace, which is often only 10 to 20km per hour, you quickly relax and start taking in the sights and that's for someone mid 50's and not ridden a motor bike.
Its way better than driving around in a taxi, we had 12 in our group and by the first stop there was a real buzz, the food was a great sample of stuff you mightn't normally get , the English of the riders was good and for the person who gave talks about history and locations his was very good. Cant recommend this enough, see their website, checkout the little film clips, more than happy to take private messages

A great way to see Saigon at night, absolutely loved it!! - We had a group of 14 and XO Tours accommodated all of us. We had an absolute blast on this tour. This is by far one of the best tours in Asia. Great food, beer and very knowledgeable and friendly tour guides. We all feel 100% safe with our drivers and escorts. I would recommend the "Foodie Tour" to anyone wanting to enjoy Saigon at night and those who want good food and beer.
Thank you XO Tours!!!!

Highlight of our trip to Saigon! - My fiance and I had a blast doing the Foodie Tour in Saigon -- it was absolutely one of the highlights of our trip! We tried a ton of foods that we probably wouldn't have known to try/been daring enough to order, neighborhoods we wouldn't have seen otherwise, and thoroughly enjoyed meeting our guides and the other people in the group. Our guides were very professional, met us right on time and made sure we had a safety briefing and our helmets before we got on the bikes, but they were also hilarious and a lot of fun. Riding on the back of a motorbike through the streets of Saigon at night isn't something we'll forget anytime soon!

It's been 3 years and finally enhanced how good XO Tours is! - It's been three years and I still remember what a great time XO Tours showed us in Saigon on a foodie tour of street food dishes. I highly recommend them. Our hostess and all of the other hosts and hostesses that we met that night were super friendly, super helpful and concerning that we had a good time and enjoyed our food. If you didn't like what you were offered (not the case for me), they'd try to find something that you would like. Their driving skills are first rate and I will do another tour with them in a heartbeat!

Brilliant fun - I did both the night tour and the morning tour and can highly recommend both. There is no better way to get the feel of the rhythm of the city or to see as much of it as possible. The guides and the bike girls are fantastic - friendly, professional and knowledgeable. I would love to do the food tour too but alas my time now has run out..

Great to be on the trip with XO Tours again! - It's another fun and exciting night tour with XO Tours!
This time I bought my family and friends to join me in the exciting Saigon Tour by Night after a great experience foodie night tour last year.
Well done once again! Keep up the good work for providing us another wonderful experience of Saigon.

LOVED IT! - Of our 2 week stay traveling Vietnam, this was our favorite experience.
We did the XO foodie tour led by Hieu and we had a fantastic time. We were picked up at our hotel by two women on motorbikes that quickly moved us to the first location to meet up with the rest of the tour. Although we rode through torrential downpours (thank GOD for the ponchos!) we had the best time. The women tour guides were knowledgeable, funny, and made the tour what it is. We tried some interesting and delicious dishes and were able to see many of the districts in HCM. This tour is a MUST.

Great fun! - We did a three hour morning tour and it was a fantastic way to see the city! Our scooter guides were lovely and it's nice to hear more about the culture from some young locals. It's also a lot of fun weaving between the crazy traffic and not being stuck in a car or tour bus. Highly recommend.

So much fun - Did the city sightseeing tour. Went on my own as partner unable to come along and so glad I did. It was so much fun. I'd pay just to be driven round town on a scooter never mind the sightseeing. Understanding the guide was very good, being knowledgable and a nice chapter. The trip was a good blend of sightseeing and scooter time. The sugarcane juice was delicious. Thuy my scooter rider was a lovely girl and very good at her job. There were 6 guests. Would do their tours again. This was the first thing I did in Vietnam and I was feeling a little nervous having read lots of horror tales of bag snatching and unfriendly people etc online. So glad I did this tour my first morning in Vietnam because it made me love HCMC and Vietnam and I have been loving it ever since. We are having a wonderful time here. XO are great ambassadors and I found it a great way to ease myself into a new country, city and culture.

The Best Morning - This tour was a highlight for us. Heading out into the mad traffic of HCMC was so easy & fun. Just hold on & go. The girls were charming with fluent English and the history and information they supplied was so good. Great to converse with these local students and understand a little of their lives in HCMC. Would highly recommend this activity - very safe as speeds are never great - its the volume of the Bikes & their horns !

Excellent - Went on this tour on 1st September and had a fantastic time. I have to admit we were both a little apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter around the streets of Ho Chi Minh but Tai and his team made us feel at ease and we had a great time. An experience never to be forgotten and Tai even e-mailed the photos to us that he'd taken throughout the evening. Highly recommended!!

Highly Recommended!!! - Best way to experience the roads of Saigon! The tour was also well-organized.

A must do when in Vietnam!

Absolute highlight of my visit to Ho Chi Minh City - This is a MUST DO if you visit Ho Chi Minh City. Can't speak highly enough of the staff, their approach as hosts, the experience, the food, the educational aspects and the fun. Incredible value for money with everything that was included. Felt safe in their hands at all times. I would highly recommend and would do it all again.

Fun tour in a thunderstorm - Two girls picked us up directly from our hostel on time. They were engaging and happy to share stories with us, which helped add to our authentic tour.

When we arrived at our first location, the downpour started so they donned us with our blue and white rain coat because we weren't prepared. We got to experience touring around the city during a storm and got very wet! It's incredible how they are able to drive in those conditions and I was glad to be in their very capable hands.

The banh mi was delicious at our food stop. Some of the tour seemed unnecessary as there wasn't much to see, but on the whole it was worth it!

Awesome screw - Definitely the best you can get in HCMC. All drivers are girls, they were very careful in traffic. Showed us diffrent parts of town, took us to dinner, later to a dessert. We had wonderful time. Must do.

Geordies meet Miss Siagon bikers - Picked up this city tour from Trip advisor. didn't have any idea what to expect. We had observed the constant traffic in Siagon and wondered if we had done the right thing. we chose the night tour, we were picked up at our hotel by 4 young ladies in traditional dress.The girls were very smiley and welcoming, and after a few safety rules we set off. we were told by our drivers that we would be meeting up with our tour leader at a central point. we all set off at a pace to join the traffic I Can only describe it as exhilarating. our drivers were chatting all the way giving us facts about the city asking questions whilst guiding us safely on our way.
we met up with the tour leader who was informative as to which districts we would be visiting. we set off at a pace which was brilliant and visited several districts our tour included dinner at a local eatery which was excellent it was fresh and tasty. the whole experience was absolutely amazing as were the lady driver/guides we never felt afraid of the traffic, just exited and thrilled to be part of this great experience. all credit to the team they were amazing and very friendly. one of our best ours ever. You must try it

Wow, Amazing Tour with XO - Certainly a must do, experience being part of the traffic in HCMC on the back of the motorbikes with the excellent drivers from XO Tours. Everything about the tour was extremely professional and a lot of fun with excellent street food and an opportunity to see parts of HCMC tourists don't normally see - the girls from XO were amazing. Highly recommended this tour.

City highlight tour - We cannot recommend this tour enough. We had a fantastic time and got to experience the real Saigon. The girls on the bike were lovely. Riding around on the bikes was such a wonderful experience. They are simply fearless! We are so looking forward to checking out the movie when it is ready. A really great experience and well worth it. Will definitely recommend XO tours to everyone we know that is coming to Saigon :)

A Must do - The XO foodie tour is a must do for travelers in Ho Chi Minh. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable & spoke excellent English.The quality & quantity of food was fantastic. We visited areas we would have never seen otherwise without a tourist in sight. The girls riding skills were excellent & at no time did we feel in danger although we were among thousands of other mopeds. In fact this was part of the great experience of the XO Foodie Tour.

Foodie Tour - The foodie tour is an excellent way to see the city and try heaps of amazing food. My brother and I did this tour on out last night in Vietnam.
Our drivers were a lot of fun and were able to tell us a lot about the city and the different areas we went through. Their English was fantastic, they pointed out all sorts of things along the way and answered all of our questions about the city and life in general in Vietnam.
The food was a great display of the variety Vietnam had to offer and they were extremely vigilant when it came to food allergies. True to their word there was no 'weird' food so I would encourage you to try everything! Only pace yourself. There is A LOT of food.
My only complaint would be that I was so full I couldn't eat any more of my favorite dishes.

Best way to see this amazing city! - This was a great experience, my sister and I did this the day we arrived in Saigon and absolutely loved it. We went in the evening and it was great to be out in the traffic experiencing the scooter madness while tasting delicious food. Definitely something worth doing when in Saigon. We were happy we did it our first night so we knew what food we enjoyed and knew the names in Vietnamese thanks to our tour guides!

Foodie tour! - Very nice experience! The guys of the staff are very kind and funny! They drive you around all the city, explaining to you what are you seeing while you are on the motorcycle. They make you try Vietnamese food and also introduce the plates before you eat.
I felt very comfortable with them, I tried everything and I loved this tour! Absolutely recommendable because you try the real Vietnamese taste and have the chance to know more about this culture.

Fantastic tour. Do yourself a favor. - As a solo traveler, I thought a group tour would be a good way to start my Vietnam adventure. I chose the foodie tour. Absolutely brilliant! You get to see a lot of the city. The guides were so friendly and funny. The food was brilliant. Having never been on a bike, I was a little scared so my rider, Loan, took it a little easy until I was comfortable. This was my favorite thing I did in Vietnam. I also had the video done which was just awesome. So fun to watch back everything of the night and to show friends back home. Do yourself a favor and take a tour with XO Motorbike tours. Thanks guys, I had a great evening with you.

Excellent Foodie Tour - Saw this tour on tripadvisor and decided to try the Foodie tour. Never regret. My pretty rider, Trang picked me up from my hotel and taught me how to get on the bike. She is really professional and can handle my clumsiness given that I was a true blue beginner to motorbikes. All the dishes introduced were amazing and really local..The portions were really huge. Halfway through the tour, it started to rain very heavily, we had to stop to put on the poncho. So they are very prepared for both rain and shine. I like that the tour brings us to different districts in HCMC which we might not visit by ourselves. And I enjoyed the explanations and stories from the tour leader.

All in all, It was an awesome experience.

Great experience & the perfect way to really see the city - Great way to see the city, experience the madness of the roads on a bike and taste some Vietnamese specialties. This was our first visit to HCMC and this was a great introduction to the city. The tour guides picked up us from our hotel, we didn't stop laughing from that moment, especially as my hubby and I are both over 5ft7 and 11st, we looked like giants next to the Vietnamese girls. Worried they wouldn't be able to balance us but they are pros. They were chatty and Super friendly. We went all over to different districts and saw different lifestyles, whilst learning bits a long the way about Vietnamese life. Some food I liked, others were more of a mind over matter to try, but all in good fun. I highly recommend XO Tours to anyone interested in touring the city by moped safely. We loved the city and the tour.

Amazing time! - Hard to add on to what others have already said. This tour was recommended to my wife & I by one of her coworkers and I might have to thank the lady with a bottle of wine. Our drivers were amazing hosts, they both were incredibly charming and knowledgable of the city, and its food. The entire tour group was friendly, funny and we spent a wonderful night with new friends.

August Night Tour - Absolutely wonderful experience! This was my first visit to HCMC and this was a great introduction to the city. The tour guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and humorous. After arriving in HCMC in the afternoon, I had time to unpack take a brief nap and be ready for the Night Tour which began at 6 pm. I highly recommend XO Tours to anyone interested in touring the city by moped (the most efficient way to get around).

Foodie Tour - The high reviews are deserved! - Booked the Foodie tour for a Saturday night. I was very, very apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter in the crazy Saigon traffic. I hadn't ridden on a motorcycle in 45 years. Man, was I wrong. It was EASY to sit and enjoy, and the crazy traffic was a wonderful experience. The food was fun/excellent, but the real selling points of this tour are (1) the perfect organization and conduct of the tour; (2) the ride through multiple districts of the city, getting out of the tourist destinations of District 1 -- so much to see outside of District 1; (3) your driver is like a personal tour guide - although the tour is managed by one person - and you are treated like a king/queen. I have to give a very, very special thank you to my driver, Ngan (a world class tour guide: intelligent, funny and comforting as I got into being a bike passenger), and Tai, the tour manager who kept everything organized and running smoothly -- giving us an overview at each stop along the way.

I have been on many food tours around the world; this tops them all. I didn't realize that it would be so professionally operated. In addition to your own personal driver (Ngan was great!), there's the tour manager Tai, and about 8 other assistants who come along to manage the bikes and film during the trip. This is a big operation, not just a tour where one guide herds you onto a bus to drop you off at various restaurants. There were a total of 13 tourists, including me and my partner, and about 20 XO personnel. So you are well-cared for, even down to the drivers peeling your shrimp and cracking the crab claws. This was quite memorable, and certainly spoiled me for other food tours.

I will definitely do this again. Don't let the four hour slot scare you off; it went by in a flash.

Recent Tour August - One of the best tours I did in all my travels. Saigon is a huge city and it's tough to leave district one on our own. This tour takes you around the city in a very fun way while getting to eat some of the best food I've had in Asia. The tour guides and drivers were so nice and great. This tour is a must.

Tick ​​all boxes - Fabulous tour & a great night out, see the sights & districts you wouldn't otherwise in the safe hands of these wonderful girls & guys. Loved the food, games & jokes this team had lined up to make it truly a memorable experience.

Fantastic fun. - Wow, what a fantastic night we had with all the people from the Xo foodie tour. We took our 3 boys 12, 15 and 17 and they had a ball, even trying the Balout (not sure if thats how you spell it) at the end of the evening. All the girls were such good fun and its great to see parts of the city that we never had gone to on are own a real highlight of our time both in HCMC and Vietnam.

Fantastic way to see the different districts - My husband and I booked a night tour with XO tours. Phuc and Anh from XO tours were fantastic. They both picked us up at the hotel as discussed. Not only did we get to see all the districts in one night, but we also got to try some delicious food. Ho Chi Minh was definitely one of the busiest city's we've seen, at first we thought the bike idea was not a great idea due to the traffic. But we felt super safe, and an added bonus is that they register you for insurance incase if anything happens.

An Outstanding and Exhilarating Experience! - Your team provides a true insight into the night life, the food and the challenges of driving a motor scooter in the congested streets of Ho Chi Min City (Saigon). I have driving vehicles in most Asian and Middle East towns and Cities and can say, from experience, that your girl drivers are some of the best that I have ever experienced. They are extremely well trained and I felt completely safe throughout the journeys. My only regret is that I did not do this tour immediately after my arrival in HCMC. I would wholeheartedly recommend this experience to every visitor. Roger Stokes

A night to remember! - I can't think of a better way to get oriented in Saigon, especially when you first arrive, than going on the XO Tour. Our family of four -- 2 adults and 2 girls, ages 15 and 12 -- chosen for the three-hour Saigon by Night tour, led by an incredibly informed and engaging tour leader, Thuy Nguyen. And within the first few minutes of hopping on the motorcycles, our girls were smiling and simply awed by the notion of being a part of Saigon's night life, weaving through a river of motorcycles and bicycles and cars. We made a few stops, and had dinner at a lively and aromatic street market where we wolfed down delicious banh mi baguettes and grilled pork, and gulped down some cold beers and glasses of sugarcane juice. We also passed through a lot of neighborhoods that tourists have never seen. All in all, the $45 US per person fee, meals included, seemed like quite a bargain for an experience that the girls will never forget!

Fantastic experience - We took the tour around Saigon by day with our 15 and 12 year old. It was just the best way to see the city and the children had a wonderful time! There were no complaints about sight seeing! Anh and the lovely ladies who took us safely around were so friendly and informative and we found out so much about the city. Highly recommended!

Fantastic - Went with family. You have to do this tour if you want to really experience the city properly. Went on night tour. Riders all friendly and professional as well as guides. Just go for it and enjoy.

A true Saigon highlight! Absolute must do! - After spending a week hanging around District 1, the XO Tour 'Foodie' was the most welcome change to the hoardes of Westerners in Saigon. Not only is the food absolutely incredible, but the sights of the city by night are truly breathtaking. It's great to get first hand knowledge about the city districts, including where to go (and not to go) and seeing sights that are off the beaten track. The tour takes you to one of the richest areas in Saigon (where there are no motorcycles but plenty of Bentleys) before taking you to the slums (which has the best seafood I have ever tasted). The scallops with peanuts have left a mark on me quite unlike any other place I have visited! It was my mum's birthday and the guys had organized a cake at the last stop! It is a great way to see the city, shame we didn't do it on the first night we were there to know the secrets! If you go, you MUST do it as soon as you arrive! Don't save this for the last night you're in the city - find out where to go straight up! Will recommend this to all my friends who are going to Saigon!

A fabulous experience with amazing people! - I can't think of a more memorable and fun evening, even while motorbikes make me a little nervous. Everyone made me feel fantastic and at ease, and the guides and drivers were so intelligent, insightful, quick-witted, real, and charming.

Great loss - We did the foodie night tour and had a great time. It was lovely riding around and seeing so much of the city that you would never do on your own. The girls were so nice and funny, felt like old friends. It's a great way to get to taste some of the local food and as much or as little as you want and plenty of drinks to go with it. Lots of information given and felt very safe, would recommend it to anyone regardless of age.

Go do it! - So I was a bit skeptical as to how a street food tour that costs over $100 AUD could be value for money in Vietnam - but I was wrong. It wasn't so much the food (which was fantastic) but the fact that for 4 hours I felt like I got a glimpse of the real HCMC. There is something totally magic about speeding through a city of 9 million+ people at night (and in my case, the pouring rain) amidst the bustle and color that is Saigon. The tour takes you to districts you wouldn't normally visit as a tourist and places the locals eat. My driver, Ngan, expertly drove through the traffic and looked after me all night - it was great sitting down together with the drivers and tourists all at one table. She was fantastic.

I won't give away to much but the tour moves through three phases - noodle soup, a BBQ and then a seafood feast. Alternative menus are catered for and there are a couple of surprises along the way. Highly recommend.
Young Girls - If you want Vietnamese young girls to entertain you, this is the tour have to pick. Lovely and very amazing girls that could really help you a lot with your vacation.

I want to go again! - The tour, the ladies, the food, the leader and even the 'body guards' made this truly a night we will talk about for a long time. Zipping through the insanely crowded streets or inching our way through the markets we always felt completely confident with our driver. They really know how to handle those bikes.
Each food stop was completely different and your driver spoiled you by preparing each new dish and making sure everything was to your liking.
I can't say enough about how wonderful the experience was.
This is one tour you can't miss!!

Fulfilled Expectations and More - Having read the reviews you would think it's difficult for XO to live up to their reputation. We did a foodie tour and it was even better than I expected. They don't force you to do anything horrible, but I enjoyed the frog and sampled the duck embryo which was not to my liking.

The three girls were expert riders and buoyant company, the security is subtle, and the general understanding of their customers' is exceptional. A clever showmanship permeates the whole experience drizzling it with a wonderful bit of magic, leaving you with an experience you won't forget for a long time to come.

Highly recommended!
