Fantastic night - A wonderful way to see the city at night. Was concerned about being on a motorbike in the middle of this busy city, but the girls were wonderful drivers and always felt safe while having a wonderful time. Would throughly recommend it.

Best tour experience - My husband and I had only 3 nights in HCM so I wanted to get the best experience possible and booked XO based on TA reviews. Not disappointed. We did 2 tours in one day. Shopping tour in the morning in which they took us to hey everything we wanted/needed and then foodie night tour.
The foodie tour is a MUST DO. Even my husband who is not adventurous at all with food tried frog which I would never expect him to do. I think it is because the guides/drivers put you at such ease and make you feel very safe and happy.
It was great tool listen and learn so much about all the districts in HCM and things about history and present day life.

Foodie Tour by XO Tour - Joined the foodie tour. I'd say that the Bun Bo Hue is excellent. Don't worry about the motorbike ride. It may be scary at first with the way the traffic is in HCMC but you're in great hands. It's safe and interestingly fun ride the whole time.

fantastic experience - went with a family of four (11 and 16 yr old included), and made decision to book based on other TA reviews. very impressed with experience. Delightful tour operators pick you up from hotel, make you feel very comfortable, chatting all along the ride. Catered to every need, ensuring that at each food stop, meal was appropriately prepared, explained, and just right for each customer (spicy/not). If you were willing to be adventurous, you could. If not, perfectly fine having more routine cuisine. Got to see much of the city, with explanations of how it all fit together that we didn't get from other tours. I would highly recommend this as a must do for the city!

Fantastic experience of the 'real' Ho Chi Minh City - We were picked up promptly by Tuyet and Hom (think that's right) for the Foodie tour and they immediately made us feel at ease about riding on the back of the motorbikes in the crazy traffic.

The experience of riding through parts of the city most tourists might not think of visiting was just as much of a highlight as the food itself. We tried a pho like dish at our first stop and were introduced to the other 'foodies' and the group leader Ahn who provided entertaining and informative insights at intervals throughout the night. We also visited a barbecue restaurant where we tried grilled frog, goat, beef and quail that had been cooked for us at the table by our hosts/drivers. The final stop was a seafood restaurant in district 4- not being a shellfish lover, I informed the tour prior and they were more than obliging with providing an alternative.

Half way through the tour the weather took a turn for the worse but this only added to the experience- we were offered the opportunity to head back but most of us continued as we were enjoying the experience so much. Ponchos were provided and I felt completely safe in the hands of the skilled female drivers.

Off the beaten track and with great people, this was a highlight of our holiday so far. The only downside was it is quite pricey. That said, very glad we decided to do this motorcycle tour.

Fantastic times in HCMC - As a solo traveler, this was my last hurray before sadly leaving Vietnam, and what a great decision that was. I took the foodie tour, and not only was it a good way to make sure I tasted as much as possible before leaving, it was an interesting and interactive tour. The guides are all very fun, sweet, and safe, and three hours flew by faster than I could have imagined! I would highly suggest this to anyone, even the "I-don't-do-tourist-stuff" travelers like myself...

Must do! - Great tour to try some beautiful local food and see some areas of Ho Chi Minh that you most likely would never go otherwise.
Very well organized, from the start the girls make you feel very comfortable, my girlfriend was very nervous about riding on the back of the bike but it didn't take her long to really start enjoying it.
Everyone spoke good English and the tour leader Ahn was very knowledgeable.
Food was amazing I wish I didn't eat lunch, could of ate the scallops and crab legs for days!, frog wasn't as bad as I expected either.
Thanks especially to Nhi and Hong our drivers, (hope I got your names right) and the rest of the xo staff!

Class act!! - My brother-in-law, and I, broke away from business, and took a private city and night food tour. We are two 50-60ish successful businessmen who got to act like kids once again. Fun, Fun, Fun! The guides are exceptional and go beyond expectations. For example, my eye was bothering me and they brought eye drops. Who would have guessed a couple of games during the food tour? And we had a fellow who I called a Vietnamese Mr. T (body guard) follows us on his motor bike. And then, to top it off, they took pictures and Emailed them within four days. Don't miss this tour. It's an experience you will never forget.

Experiencing the night lights - I went on the XO Foodie tour which was great and I didn't feel nervous on the back of the motor bike, my driver Thao was lovely and an excellent driver. This night tour is worth doing because they take you to all the various Districts and we stop and eat at various places. The food was very enjoyable and there was plenty to eat and drink. I visited Ho Chi Minh City on my own and don't be put off by your age because I am almost 67. The group I was with were a fun lot, all in all a very enjoyable night.

Awesome screw - My wife and I chose the night foodie tour,Tai and the girls were fantastic, we had a wonderful night with great food and what better way to see the real Vietnam on the back of a bike
This was the highlight of our trip and should not be missed.

Foodie tour is the best!! Don't miss out on this! - My friend went on the night foodie tour Aug 2015. When my friend told me it was a tour on motorbike's I was apprehensive! I was ready to back out but boy am I so happy we went through with the tour! The tour is worth every penny! Although the streets of Vietnam are scary in that you are literally rubbing elbows with the person riding in the motorbike next to you, our drivers Ting and Tam(boy I hope I spelled their names right) made sure we were safe and that we were having fun! i wasn't scary at all. And since all the drivers were female, there sent male escorts(men in black) to drive alongside to make sure that everyone was safe. I have an allergy to shrimps and crabs and they made sure to make up for whatever I missed! All the food and the drinks are on an eat all you can basis! How can it get any better than that? But the best part I would say is that you see the city for its entireity, from the backpackers area to the markets and to the business districts. And the food they have you taste is superb and not the common food you can get on your own. And the tour leader Huie Nguyen is the best. You speak clearly and he is very knowlegeable but keeps the tour fun. There were no dull moments. The tour can be a little expensive for but trust me it is worth it! I would not hesitate to go on this tour again and recommend this to friends and family!

Must do! - When I first read the reviews of the xo food tour, I thought it can't all be so great! There has to be some catch to it. But man, was I wrong! This is one of the funnest food trials I've been on. The tour started out at 525 PM sharp and the xo girls were on time. My guide, Truc can probably give the world's best tour guide a run for their money. Her English was impeccable and she was extremely friendly even with my hundred questions about Vietnam and it's culture. We did five different stops of which three were food stops and two sight seeing stops. The food was sufficient and the drinks (beer) were flowing as and when we needed them. We tried the duck egg embryo and BBQ frog which accounted for the exotic food on the trip. The last stop was at a sea food place on district 4 was the highlight of the evening. The riders were very safe and knew what they were doing. Great conversation, excellent guides, great food and definitely a must do tour! Thank you Truc!

Perfect way to experience Vietnam - We are so happy we decided to take this tour with our 2 boys (aged 8 and 10yrs). What a fantastic way to experience another side of Vietnam that we would otherwise not have had the opportunity to experience. The girls were absolutely brilliant and wonderful with our 2 kids. Their driving skills are second to none and I just don't know how they do it. The customer service and attention to detail to everyone's needs were top notch! Thank you to Pink and the other lovely girls involved in what was a fantastic experience.

Best Vespa experience ever - My daughter and I did the night Vespa ride with Ting and Thu as our vespa riders. They were absolutely wonderful, very knowledgeable and we felt very safe with them. Seeing different districts of Saigon at night was wonderful and eye opening. Ting was my driver and I cannot thank her enough. She was reassuring, experienced and wonderful. Thu, thank you for being a wonderful team leader. Gabby and Tamika

Don't miss that! - It's really something to do. You have the opportunity to go in different districts of Ho Chi Minh Ville and it's so nice to see the city and people around you on a motorbike. Cross the street as a pedestrian in Vietnam big cities with all the scooters is something you'll never forget. It's interesting to live the other way. We took the night tour and our group of 6 had a very good time with Huong and the XO sisters who drove well and safely and were very friendly.

Fun and informative. - I am so very happy I booked this tour. It was the morning sights of Saigon tour and although I'd never been on a bike before I was very comfortable and relaxed even in the crazy crazy traffic. My Husband has some bike experience and had great admiration for the lovely girls who were our drivers. Not only were they great drivers, they were fun and chatted away as they drove. Our guide, Thai, explains the city, buildings and events so well. As I knew quite a bit about the Vietnam war he made sure I got to see Pittman Apartments where the iconic photo of the helicopter on the roof tower and the American diplomats were climbing a ladder to get into it before the fall of Saigon. I had thought that photo was taken at the American embassy but now know I was wrong. We had the best morning ever with them and I would recommend it to anyone regardless of age.

Excellent way to see the city - We only had a few days in Saigon and decided to book the night tour to get a feel for how the locals get around. It was a great decision, we all had great time. The guides were very safe and knowledgeable. Our tour leader Huong gave us information about all the different districts as we were going through them. Her English was fine, the only problem I had was that it was hard to hear as you were zipping around on a scooter with a helmet on. The video option I would highly recommend. I just got the video and it is very well done. Best of all it saves you all the video editing if you were to try to do it yourself.
The way to see the city - Best tour ever. Fun and informative, the whole family had a blast. Thanks to Huong and all the girls! Definitely the best way to see Saigon.

One of the highlights of our trip - We booked the Saigon by night tour on our second day in HCMC. We were a bit apprehensive at first to get on a motorbike seeing that we had some experience of Vietnamese traffic. The girls quickly took any worries away by carefully explaining how to get on and off, how to hold on, etc. Safety first!

The tour itself was magnificent, we were taken to districts that tourists usually don't get to see. As a result we now have a much better understanding of Vietnamese society. The girls were chatty and spoke very good English.

The food that is included for this tour was very tasty.

This is definitely a must-do when you are in HCMC!

XO tours - Sights and Foodie tours the same day - Returning from Singapore to Hong Kong, I decided to book my weekend in HCMC on a whim. No headaches needed to plan my visit, I went on Tripadvisor and read the amazing reviews about XO tours. I therefore booked the Sights (morning) and Foodie tours (evening) online. In a nutshell, the staff is great, very nice, caring and skillful scooter drivers, as well as helpful, funny and resourceful tour guides. The Sights tour spans over about 4 hours and enables you to see the highlights of the city (historical monuments, buildings and markets). The Foodie tour shows some of the nice night sceneries in multiple districts, and also offers you the privilege to taste local delicacies (quite a lot actually). The main plus (apart from the great staff), a few pictures are taken during the tours and a few games and goodies punctuate the Foodie tour and make the experience much friendlier. Highly recommended if you have limited time to spend in HCMC!

Amazing food and thrilling scooter tour. - We had booked XO Tours - foodie tour at night from UK online. The cost of the tour is $32 for 4.5 hours and worth every cent. On the evening of our tour the heavens opened so we were advised by lady drivers who had arrived at the hotel that we should maybe wait to see if the weather improved, thankfully it did. It was thrilling whizzing around the different districts on the scooters that were driven so professionally and safely by the lady drivers, We visited 5 districts of HCMC that we had never been to before and big thanks to our guide on the evening Hieu Nguyen who was extremely knowledgeable about the districts, the markets and the food that we would be eating and even remember's name all evening.Each foodie stop was incredible with amazing food, goat, prawns, beef, jumping chicken !! (Frog) which was delicious. It was great to get together at each stop and chat with other people on the tour. We played foodie games and generally had a fantastic evening. Only slight downside was on arrival back at hotel 1 of our girl drivers appeared to change from being happy and bubbly to slightly irritated when we gave her a token tip. This won't put us off doing the tour again next time we are in HCMC. One piece of advice is it is possible best to do tour in trainers not flip flops !

Highlight of Hochi Minh City - We did the Saigon by Night tour and it was marvellous! We felt completely safe on the back of the bikes and our girls were incredibly friendly. We got to see a different side of Saigon and the girls were a wealth of information on anything to do with the city! We would highly recommend doing this tour, whether its your first night in the city or your last.

The food is also fantastic and you get a choice of one of three local specialities- we recommend getting one of each if you have enough people. Definitely skip lunch!

Sight seeing & Foodie tour - My husband & I booked two tours with the XO Tour company: the sight seeing city tour & the foodie tour at night. Both experiences were amazing & I would highly recommend them. The thrill of experiencing the traffic chaos is a must do activity and safer than it looks.

The foodie tour took us places in the city that you would never otherwise see. The food was delicious & I recommend you keeping an open mind & trying all dishes- it's worth it!
The tour guide & lady drivers were all very professional, friendly & informative - they even had a good sense of humour. The night tour also included male body guards for the protection of everyone.

Highly Recommended - We had booked the "Saigon by Night" tour and it was fantastic. The drivers were very well informed and kept us engaged throughout the tour. The food was great and the 3hrs were well spent.

Yes, you can do it cheaper (on your own or some other random tours) but given the quality of the tour and the social cause that it serves - I think it's worth shelling out an extra 5-10$.

XO tours helps empower Vietnamese women and provides a safe and meaningful way for them to earn a livelihood. They are great ambassadors for their country and add a touch of grace in taking care of the tourists.

Excellent tour - Such a great tour! The girls are so friendly and talk loads about the food, the city and culture. Their driving skills are excellent and you feel completely safe and assured driving on the crazy roads. We visited several different districts and ate in about 4 different street food places- amazing food! We would never have found those places without them. They talk to you about the food and how to eat it. Price includes all food and drinks. Would highly recommend.

XO Motor Scooter Tour of Ho Chi Minh City - My husband and I booked a 1/2 day XO tour of Ho Chi Minh - it was one of the funnest things I've done in my entire life - I'm quite serious. At first, I was very nervous to be on the back of a scooter in Ho Chi Minh City. Our drivers explained the rules and told us what to expect. They calmed our fears and off we went.

The tour guide was very knowledgeable about history, Ho Chi Minh City, and Vietnamese culture. My husband and I agree that we would do the XO Tour again, if we could.

I urge you to take the XO Tour - you will have a blast and never forget the experience.

I want to thank our drivers, Tuk and Tam. They made our trip memorable. I thank them for the care and extremely fun day. Best wishes!

Stephanie and Richard
SLC, USA

Night Tour of Saigon - We did the night tour of Saigon. It was truly brilliant. We had two guides Tring the group leader and Ning. These tour guides speak excellent English, their knowledge of the city and Vietnamese culture is outstanding and their driving skills are impressive. We loved this tour and would thoroughly recommend.

You feel safe the whole time on the bike, tasting the different foods was excellent and visiting different districts was like traveling to different countries at times. It was my husband's birthday and the last night of our honeymoon so Tring and Ning presented us with a beautiful cake complete with birthday candles and singing! So generous and so much appreciated by us. Thank you both so much it was a brilliant end to a fantastic honeymoon in Vietnam.

FOOD IS SO GOOD - An awesomely prepared tour is as delicious as it is interesting. Each traveler will ride pillion on one of their many female motorcyclists (who are prob extras in Mad Max) as they take you around various districts in Vietnam. The great thing about it is that these districts are really not places a random tourist would know about, let alone get to.

The highlight of the tour is definitely the food. Perfectly seasoned beef, chicken, seafood and other yummy food will definitely tickle your tastebuds. There are a few esoteric dishes but try them!-you may be surprised by how gd it is. The rest of the tours is sprinkled with anecdotes and tales about Vietnam which is really intriguing. Each of your drivers are also seasoned conversationalist who speaks great English and will ensure you have a great time

I'm still drooling about the District 8 beef now!

XO Tour Saigon by night - Highly recommended to enjoy HCMC! So much fun!

Drivers are very nice and friendly!

HCMC traffic is chaotic but they were really good drivers, so feel safe in the motorbike.
Foodie tour - An experience worth breaking your diet. They bring you to non-traditional spots to try local food that you wouldn't even think of. Impressed with their service.

A Must do! - Recommended by a friend, we decided to book the xo foodie tour as we only had two nights in Saigon. We met the girls at the opera house, and from the first moment they were wonderfully friendly and fun! We were hesitant about being on the back of bikes as the traffic is so chaotic, but we should not have worried, as the girls were so experienced and safe. Every location we visited had amazing food, even down to the frog! We ate so many wonderful dishes and many that we would not have tried normally. I would recommend this tour to everyone, as it was great fun, and a great way to see Ho Chi Minh.

Fun foodie tour!!!! - Did the foodie tour and Binh was my fearless Vespa driver in her traditional Vietnamese dress!!! She and her assistant picked me up promptly at my hotel and we met up with the group tour that stops at 5 districts. All the members of the XO team spoke excellent English, and the tour leader, Hieu provided clear and entertaining descriptions of all the location districts and the food that was being served. As an added bonus, many pics of the evening were provided via an email link shortly afterwards free of charge. Highly recommended. Unlimited drinks and food at the last stop !!

Fun foodie tour - Great time out with a bunch of girls in traditional style Vietnamese costume driving strangers on their bikes around 5 or so districts and stopping for different food or for the tour leader Ahn to have the opportunity to explain a bit about the area. Everyone bonds over the food experience and the beers, fabulous outing on my holiday. Definitely worth it.

Great fun and fascinating way to see HCMC - Recommended by friends while on tour of Vietnam. Managed to book tour for four and met at hotel by four very charming ladies with excellent English. Rode on scooters behind the girls and joined others at restaurant for first tasting. Total of about 20. Traveled around Districts, stopping for food or commentary. Felt completely safe - these girls know the city and how the traffic flows (blowed if we could see any method in the road madness). Even visited District 7 which is a charmless, sanitised suburb that few Vietnamese live in - generally ex-pats. Fascinating that the Vietnamese feel alienated in their own city. Finished tour at a market restaurant - wonderful food, hilarious company (the girls 'got' our humour) - then taken back to hotel. A really enjoyable experience.

Thrilling and delicious adventure - My husband and I booked a food tour with XO, and it's still something we talk about almost a year later.

Our tour guides were phenomenal - both in friendliness and in getting to our destinations safe and sound.

We remarked at how much we loved a certain sauce at one point and the next thing we knew the tour guide, Tai, had purchased one for us to take home. Awesome!!!!

Make sure you go to this amazing tour very very hungry. Try everything at least once - and if you're lucky, twice. We couldn't have loved this more.

Thanks XO Tours!!

Highlight of our trip - We arrived in Saigon last on our two week long holiday in Vietnam having experienced a lot of street food in Vietnam.
But this was so much more than a street food tour!!!
The food was delicious, simple and fun. No pho, no spring rolls, lots of new food including frogs and embryonic eggs!! But this was amongst plenty of familiar and delicious dishes. In addition there was plenty to drink.
Going through the different districts on the tour was fantastic. If I hadn't done this tour I might have ended up stuck in District 1 for my entire stay in hCMC. I loved the different areas.
The guides were fantastic. Super friendly, good English and very safe drivers. We were very impressed and enjoyed ourselves immensely.
An absolute must for all visiting HCMC.
Best Total - Highly recommend doing the xo foodie tour. The girls were great, felt completely safe. The food was FANTASTIC. Try everything.

Foodies in Saigon - Omg!!!!!!!!! So much fun with the girls. We participated in the tour in early July, yeh raining season. Before the tour started, it also started to rain. We had a chat with them about the rain, safety and so on. It was the most fun day in Saigon. Don't worry when its raining because we got ponchos !!!👍😄

This is THE way to see Saigon! - Based on previous traveler reviews on TA, and having only a spare 3 hours in a short business trip, I chose XO. Couldn't have picked better. Fun, exhilarating & informative 3 hours touring many parts of the city, experiencing most of the sounds & night sights. Hadn't ridden on a motorcycle for 30 years but felt safe only seconds in. Motorcycles are so key to the way this city operates, and there are so many of them, that it is the best way to explore it.

My guide (Ning) was a very capable rider - confident but controlled - was enthusiastic, answered every question and was great company throughout.

Can't recommend the tour highly enough.

You have to do this. - Wow. Thank you XO tours. I booked both the foodie tour for the Thursday evening and the attractions tour for the Friday morning. We are still talking about the tours, especially the foodie tour.
We were a group of x6. My husband and x2 teenage sons were on a Vietnam trip and we met up with my daughter and her friend who were back packing through Asia. We all still say that the foodie trip was one of the highlights, including my daughter who has experienced lots of tours throughout her travels.
We were picked up from outside the hotel, on time, by x6 wonderful, cheerful, English speaking, knowledgeable girl riders dressed in traditional costume with helmets!. They fitted us with our helmets and went through the safety rules and we were off. My husband and kids loved it immediately. Anyone that knows me is shocked that I booked this tour on the basis that I never did anything scary. In any amusement park I hold the coats....
Anyway, I only screamed for the first hour. Actually I LOVED it and although scared, the driver I had (Hoang?) was absolutely marvelous and made me feel safe and she giggled through my screaming. Bless her. The drivers were great because they chatted away on and off the mopeds to us all, including my teenage sons who not only thoroughly enjoyed the whole biking experience but also enjoyed the banter with the girls. The food was as described on their website, abundant and tasty. Beer flowed and laughs were abundant, even if it was usually about my fear on the bike.
You meet up with others on the foodie tour but as we were a x6 we seemed to stay as a group ourselves.
The Friday morning was the same in that the girls arrived on time once again to take us on the next tour. Once again the girls were brilliant and knowledgeable and fun. My rider that day was different. I think her name was Nim? She put me at ease. We had a great tour once more and what a fabulous way to see everything and be back at the hotel pool for the afternoon.
The girls took photos which were great and emailed them to me. All free and its this attention to detail that I would really urge you to these tours. Brilliant. Thank you XO tours and Tai especially for memories of a lifetime.

Free! - The xo tour was probably the best way to see a lot of things you'd never get to see or experience as a tourist. The guides were very friendly and perfectly fluent in English. We had a lot of fun and the food was absolutely delicious!!! Thanks again.

Great way to learn about the city! - I went on the "Sights" tour which was done via the back of a bike.

My driver was Ing who was an amazing driver and quite hilarious. Her knowledge and love for Australian slang is quite something. Made me laugh! I always feel safe with Ing as she deals with the crazy Siagon traffic.

The way it all panned out, I was the only one on on this tour. So, Ing drove me around and Hui (?) the guide, met us at all the stops to fill me in on all the information of the various stops. It was incredibly informative and fun.

As well as driving through the city looking at historic locations and discussing the past, we also drove through and stopped off at some great local places. We had a walk through one of the local markets where some delicious deserts were taken before jumping back on the bike, hitting the streets and driving through China Town (crazy!!) and the flower market.

I thoroughly enjoyed my day with both Ing and Hui, they are both great hosts who shared some amazing facts about their city.

Highly recommended.

Awesome start to our holiday - What a way to get to know a city! On the back of a vespa eating the local street food! My boyfriend and I had been in Vietnam for 1 day and was recommended we do this tour and we cannot recommend it highly enough. The girls who drove us were delightful and our tour guide fun and informative. Definitely worth it, lots of fun and we got to see parts of HCMC that wouldn't otherwise get to see. Oh and the food was delicious...

Foodie tour - Best experience I had in Saigon. This is the perfect tour to experience the less touristy parts of Saigon, as well as have good, traditional Vietnamese food. The riders were great, friendly, and always attentive. I always feel safe, although it could be a little scary to those intimidated by the motorcycle traffic in Saigon. Recommend this trip to everyone!

A Blast!! - My son and I went on the “Foodie” tour with XO and couldn't recommend them more highly. We explored over 5 districts and ate in 3. Even a lite rain could not dampen the tour. All the foods we tasted were delicious, but the highlight for us was the BBQ. One should not shy away from trying the whole grilled frog. Skin on, while not exactly like chicken, was fantastic. Everyone, from the ladies driving the scooters, to our host, did an exceptional job showing us their lovely city.

The experience you don't want to miss - I had a night motorbike tour with XO tours on July 10. The tour was excellently organized, which was an experience I will never forget and will highly recommend to any of my friends who will ever Ho Chi Minh city. From the route selection, the knowledge sharing, the food tasting, to safety, the tour was simply flawless and the entire XO team took care of every guest well. Every XO team member was friendly and so pleasant to talk with. Money was well spent and the tour was absolutely the highlight during my short stay in Saigon.

Awesome and Fun way to learn the city - My son (age 22) and fresh out of university ... had the tour forced upon him (by me) his father. The last thing he wanted was boring educational tour ... and well he didn't get that .... he got 4.5 hours of fun .... great conversation with our guides (all of them were awesome) ... funny ... eager to share their city with us. And our tour leader Anh ... he was a blast ... great sense of humor ... very knowledgeable ... we had so much fun we didn't realize we were learning

One not to be missed! - My fiancé and I have just returned from this trip and I can not recommend it highly enough. With only two days in Saigon we decided this would be a great way to see the city and we weren't disappointed. We covered more in 4 hours than we could have done in 4 days on our own. The girls are absolutely fantastic. Hong and Bihn were our guides and they were wonderful. Very informative and made our night extra special. Tai the trip leader was also great. He took pictures throughout the night and gave us a real insight into the city. The last stop on the tour was a real treat... If you like seafood this is a tour not to be missed. Thank you XO tours and Hong, don't forget if you make it to Manchester I will return the favor!

Best experience in Saigon - The best thing we did in Saigon. It's a fantastic opportunity to visit various districts - ones that you certainly would never have explored without the help of the fantastic tour guides.Our tourguides were fun, sassy, ​​and spoke great English - couldn't have asked for better companions during our tour through vietnamese street food. The food itself is really good and very authentic. Enough said - book a tour!

Loved it!!! Do this when you visit Saigon - I just finished the night tour and absolutely it loved. Everybody involved was so professional! I'm booking the foodie tour for my next visit. There is no better way to see Saigon than with XO.

Great night tour ever! - Saw the good reviews on tripadvisor and booked a night tour on their website. My driver was so nice. Love the feelings while riding on the busy streets to various districts and small alleys and still feel super safe with my skillful driver. We dropped by to try some local food sometimes. Other guests were friendly, too. Highly recommended activity to do in HCMC at night.

5 stars and well deserved! - We did the Saigon food tour and loved it. We would have normally looked up restaurants and found a lovely spot to eat but this gave us a back street experience that we were hoping for. We were picked up from our hotel and the girls were absolutely lovely. Our guides provide interesting facts about the city and the food were authentic and adventurous. We felt safe among the craziness of the traffic and loved venturing to districts we wouldn't have usually gone to. Highly recommended!

Great food tour! - You've read this review. People love this tour, and with good reason. I did the food tour, and it was a great experience. Saw parts of Saigon I definitely would not have otherwise seen and ate foods I otherwise would not have eaten. The motorbike driver and the guide were professional, safe and knowledgeable. This tour is worth the money!
Great experience - Really enjoyed, had much fun, highly recommend, good way to see the city that you would you never do on your own and experience different type of foods

Food and district tour on Vespas - What an awesome tour. Great girls who dink you around on a Vespa to different districts in Saigon. Different foods along the way. We tried crispy skinned frog, monkey brains and Balut. Food was lovely. Company was great. Experience was something else. Highly recommend this tour. Would definitely do it again. Food and drinks included on tour.
Fun Night - Good fun and informative for first time tourists. Everyone can enjoy. Good for groups or couples.

Fun night tour on bikes with the friendliest of drivers - My friend and her daughter were visiting Saigon for first time so I chose XO for a tour that had a lot of time on the bike and not too much food (since the daughter didn't eat much usually). It was the perfect choice for lot's of fun driving with the girls who have the best sense of humour, and just the right amount of tastes of local street foods - Banh mi, com tam, coffee, desserts, etc. Highly recommended.

I ate a dead duck fetus - Great tour we had j and t as our guides they could not have been better! Myself and j had a bit of flirtatious banter and i couldn't make sense of her sarcasm so I laughed and nodded a lot because she wore the pants in our relationship! If I'm back in Ho Chi Minh I think I'd do the shopping tour!

The best tour I've been on. - My wife and I both did the foodie tour last night and cannot stop talking about how good the night was. On pick up from our hotel the girls (both bright and bubbly) explained the night plans and went through some safety points. We then met our fellow guests at the first meeting point. Our group of ten was from all points of the globe so the evening was all the better talking with fellow travelers.
Along with the female riders there were extra men for security and service plus a great tour guide.
Throughout the night we enjoyed a mix of great food and drinks plus some interesting information on various areas of HCMC. A great night that I would recommend to anyone.

Excellent - XO girls very friendly, prompt, informative, chatty, relaxed and professional - really good evening - amazing way to see hoi chi Minh City - food was excellent and fun. Would recommend without hesitation.

Best thing to do in Ho Chi Minh! - I loved my Saigon city tour with XO tours. I had so much fun and would recommend this tour to anyone. I always felt safe and was not at all concerned about my safety.
Excellent tour company! Will recommend to my friends!

Great way to experience Ho Chi Minh - We would never have tried this if it wasn't for the great reviews as I thought it would be too scary for my teenage kids (and me). It was not scary at all and we did it in the rain and lightening. It was exhilarating being a part of the traffic and we felt safe at all times. The drivers were fantastic - answering all our questions and giving us insight into local life. We got a real appreciation of Ho Chi Minh and learned quite a bit about the food including trying frog and goat. When some of us said we weren't so keen on seafood they arranged something to be brought to the seafood restaurant from somewhere else. It was a night to remember - I don't think my kids will ever forget it for all the right reasons. Highly recommend

Family trip - Believe the hype! - We did the saigon evening tour with our daughters aged 7 and 9 and all had a fantastic time. The youngest shared a bike with me and the 9 year old went on her own with the driver. Before we set off she was a little apprehensive about falling off but soon relaxed and wanted to go faster!
We chose to do this on our first evening in HCMC as a way to understand the city better and get a feel for the 'real' Vietnam. We visited districts 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 I think. Being Friday night lots of Vietnamese were out with friends and family so it was a fun atmosphere.
The drivers were very friendly and made us feel very safe. They each gave us lots of information about the city and talked about Vietnamese life. We met up with a male tour guide who took photos of us at various points and explained bits about the history of the different districts we visited. I really enjoyed this but my kids weren't so interested but the drivers played with them so they were kept busy and happy. We stopped twice for food which my husband and I really enjoyed. The kids are fussy eaters but the guides did everything possible to accommodate them. We driving through the busy streets on a motorbike - so much more fun than in a taxi! In short we all loved the tour and would do another one anytime. Don't hesitate just book it!

The Foodie Sightseeing and Hidden Food - Great combo from Sightseeing and Food experience. Nice staff, good English and safe driving. Explanation of the various districts as well as food other that spring rolls and pho.
Book in advance.

IF YOU DO ONE TRIP IN HO CHI MIHN DO THIS!!! - We decided to take the foodie tour and we weren't disappointed. We felt safe in the mad traffic and saw some amazing sights and ate some interesting food. Our girls that took us round (Fifi,Trang,Chi2 and Quynh H) were exceptional and it felt like being with friends. We learned some interesting facts and Tai was great also. If you do one thing in Ho Chi Mihn DO THIS!

Hcm by Night - Choose the Hcm by night tour with my wife a few days before our departure and it was a trip to remember... Not only did we have the best "Saigon Gangster Thu Duong Leader" we had the best crew from being picked up from our Hotel to meet the rest off the tour in Chinatown.. every place was explained greatly... Also tasted a few traditional foods off Vietnam which was great.. Also photos and video were nicely put together.. Thanks for a memorable time guys..Looking forward to Christmas and the Food Tour..👍👌🚵🏣🏫🎇🎥

Nice but overpriced - We did the Foodie XO Tour as the last activity of a 3 weeks trip in Vietnam and we really enjoyed it. Our guides were very friendly and we got the opportunity to visit different districts in HCMC. Without that tour we would only have seen District 1 since it is not that easy to see the other districts without a motorbike. The food we tasted was delicious. You really get to discover real Vietnamese food.

However, we couldn't give 5 stars for 2 reasons.

1. It is really expensive and slightly overpriced in my opinion. Even if you get seafood and a well organized tour, we think that a fair price should have been around 50 to 60 USD per person. Considering the cost of life in Vietnam, it is hard to imagine how a couple could spend 144 USD in 4.5 hours by eating in local restaurants. Even with a guide and a rented scooter. Of all the foodie tours offered in HCMC this one is the most expensive. That being said, we were well aware of the price before joining the tour and we decided to take it anyways since the reviews were very good on TripAdvisor. As previously mentioned the tour itself deserves 5 stars. But if we could go back in time, we might choose a different company budget wise.

2. The second reason is because quite a lot of people on the tour were still hungry at the end, there was perhaps missing some more consistent foods such as rice. The last restaurant is where you can keep ordering food until you were full but it was bite sized things such as clams and little crabs so it would take many orders to really fill someone up. After the 3rd order of clams and crabs we stopped ordering. We would suggest anyone with a good appetite to eat a lot at every stop and not rely on the last one to be full. We shouldn't have paced ourselves even if we were suggested to by the tour manager. (FYI, we are lightweight, and we dont have an appetite of a 300lbs person)

The highlight of our holiday - We did the XO evening foodie tour on our first night in HCMC, and it was absolutely fantastic. The booking and collection were slick and very well organized, and the girls were very good fun (mostly bright graduates or even postgraduates who are keen to discuss their home town). What surprised us was how safe it all was, the staff (and therefore scooters) outnumbered the guests by more than 2-to-1 - we had security riders, a mechanic, photographer etc, so at no time did I feel any worry at all for the safety of my family.

HCMC makes sense once you see it from a scooter, it's not scary at all, and the tour changed the way we see both the city and the country. Afterwards, we were quite happy to try just about everything from restaurant menus, since we knew what we liked and what we didn't (very little of the latter, although I can't say I'll stand in line to eat duck foetus again).

This is very highly recommended, if you're going to HCMC then just book it.

Best tour in Vietnam! - I was a bit nervous about the safety of being on a bike in HCMC but my driver was fantastic. She and the other guides had excellent English and explained a lot about Saigon as we were driving round. They were also a great laugh and fun to be with, i really didn't want the tour to end. I am going to be back in Vietnam in a few months and will definitely be going on another tour with this company!

Amazing! See Ho Chi Mingh as a local not a tourist - No more spring rolls! The fodie tour will take you to the best places in town, where you can live as a Vietnamese.
You won't be forced to try anything you don't want instead you will be surprised of the good food in town.
They are very respectful with tastes.
The drivers are very nice!

Highlight of time in HCMC - Incredible. The foodie tour was spotted on. It really gives exposure to things other than banh xeo, pho, and bahn mi that the average Western may only try while in Vietnam. For foodies, these are usually new things you wouldn't find if you only stayed in District 1 for your entire stay.

Visited 5 different districts in HCMC and got a perspective of lifestyle, culture, and food. The theme of the food was seafood focused but there was plenty of meat too.

My favorite was clams in a lemongrass broth and the crabs. But also got to try goat, frog, quail, scallops, balut, and many other things.

My motorcycle driver was Phouc. She was awesome. Super friendly, speaks great English, and made the experience even better.

Recommend this to any and all. Even those aren't into food. Was worth every penny.

Free! - I was nervous but my driver Thao was so safe and she was a great guide also explained about all the different things we saw. The food was great and I enjoyed trying the frog and the embryo duck egg! Everyone was friendly and I had a great time. Big thanks to Thao she was excellent!

10+ Best Tour During 3 Weeks in Asia!!! (with kids too) - I just finished watching the 2 movies that XO Tours sent us from our 2 tours taken a few weeks ago in Saigon. Amazing! Great job! We took the night Foodie Tour and the City Tour (9am-12noon) on two different days. We were 2 adults with 2 kids (girls ages 6 & 10). It was our favorite tour during our 3 week trip in Asia. XO is an extremely proficient and professional tour company. They offer such a unique experience. They respond quickly to emails and getting a reservation was easy (but did so well in advance). The extra $35 for the video was so worth it (though I think you need to book way in advance for that also). For each tour we received a well-edited 8-10 minute video that arrived via email 2 weeks later. We even got to pick out our own music, though they can also do that. We are also picking eaters. No meat for 3 of us, mostly vegetarian and some seafood...and they were PERFECT getting us fabulous and amazing new dishes to try. The french fries with sugar and butter was quite a hit with the kids, as were the ice cream cones! The Vietnamese food was authentic, tasted delicious and very plentiful! The girl drivers were fabulous with the kids, entertaining them at the table. My husband loved the great service too. He loved the "girl guides" cracking and peeling his shrimp and crab. We were truly spoiled. Ty was our head tour guide for the Foodie Tour and made us laugh with all his jokes. It was the most special evening on the food tour. Something we will never ever forget. A huge thank you for making our trip so memorable. The price is worth it. And don't be afraid of driving on a scooter. The girls are great drivers. I can't say enough good things. If you are in Vietnam and never get a chance to ride a scooter, it would be a shame. This is the place to do it. An unforgettable experience!! (few tips: can store camera or small purse in seat of scooter when traveling, advised not to wear jewelry for safety and they carry great rain coats in case of light rain)

Delightful way to get the flavor of HCMC - We visited HCMC for the first time and I add my recommendation to this tour

The young women who drive the scooters are not only very safe drivers, they are kind hosts for your evening and want to make sure you are comfortable and having fun.

The tour manager also worked hard to make sure it's a fun party.

The evening lasts about 4 hours and it starts and ends with personal pick up at your hotel. We were 11 guests on our tour.

All is provided for you. Food. Drinks. Even rainwear.

Actually, I enjoyed the sights of the city and learned about the culture more than the food. The food offered is western in style mostly. With the exception of the fertilized duck egg (balut--but all eating is optional) this is not a bizarre foods tour which is good to know in case you want that or don't want that. It's right up the middle.

Foodie Tour - Fantastic way to see parts of Ho Chi Minh we never would've seen otherwise. Very friendly and knowledgable guides, intimate and personalized experienced and fantastic local food. Would definitely come again

Must do while in HCMC - was recommended to this tour by a friend who had just returned from HCMC as 'must do' for HCMC and I now see why.
Aside from the incredible food you taste, this tour is a great way to see some of the different districts of HCMC that otherwise you wouldn't see.
The tour guides were very informative and very happy to answer any questions we had about Vietnam
was great fun!

It's a must-have for food lovers! - As a hard core backpacker with a limited budget, this food tour was a bit out of price range for me. But as a dedicated lover of Vietnamese food and Saigon being the very last stop of my travel, I splurged, we all live only once, right?. It turned out that this was a very awesome way to end my travel.

The email correspondents were smooth, booking was easy, they were punctual, and most important... FOOD was PHENOMENAL. I got to try seafood, exotic food, and other dishes that I wouldn't have been able to find on my own. I loved that all the guides were female. GiRL POWER! The team leader and "body guards" were all courteous and fun! I won't give you what kind of dishes we had because that would spoil the fun. But I highly highly recommend this food tour.

An experience never to be forgotten!! - Our family of 6 (including 4 children aged 15 to 21) did 2 tours with XO - first a shopping tour and on another occasion a foodie night tour. What an experience. Having arrived the night before and witnessing the traffic we were a little apprehensive about getting in among it but honestly there is some method in the absolute chaos that is Ho Chi Minh!! The shopping tour was great and Tai and the girls were so helpful, helping with trying on things and getting us some good discounts. We went to areas we would never have known to visit ourselves.
The food tour was also exceptional as was the whole journey on the bikes. Not known to my family as a big risk taker (far from it!!) I did not feel any real concerns and in fact the young women made you feel so comfortable and safe that relaxing and enjoying the ride was easy. You get to visit many districts and see how diverse the city is. A big thank you to all the lovely ladies and guides. This would have to be one of the best things we have ever done and we would do it again and again if we had the chance.
Great value for money!!!

Awesome tour, awesome tour guides - My family and I did the shopping tour and foodie tour, what a fantastic experience. XO Tours is so well run, everything down to the tiniest detail is catered for. The guides were amazing, these tours were the highlight of my holiday. I feel very safe on the back of the motor bikes. I thoroughly recommend this company and wish they had offices in other parts of Vietnam. Thank you XO
Free! - Definitely worth the money . A must if you are in HCMC! Very fun, informative, great guides and most importantly excellent food. Thank you, xo tours!
Bike Night - Wonderful night out experience on the bike touring Vietnam with the girls. Brought us to the different districts to show us the differences. Great way to see HCM!

Awesome tour on mopeds - This would be the most exciting experience I have done. Totally enjoyable. We are a family of five. Email correspondence was great between countries. Reassured that the children would be safe whilst on the back of the bikes, our youngest is 10 years old. Picked up from hotel very professional. Explained the dos and don'ts and asked if there was anything that we wanted to see. Started off slowly. Amazing how they kept us all together. Great way to see Ho Chi Minh. Took us to the local attractions, a local market and through Chinatown which was exciting. Huong Nguyen our tour leader spoke great English and was knowledgeable about everything they showed us. All staff were friendly. Would highly recommend this experience.

The best birthday - My wife booked that tour for my Birthday in early July .. We had an amazing night. Great drivers. Great food. Great English and tour guide .. had a baĺl.. and thank you for the Birthday cake .

Super good stuff - excellent team ,, well organized took a good snapshot of th city kept us all engrossed , nice price as well
Minus - the guide supposed some singer or talent show participant was bit flat with his jokes , otherwise a nice team of drivers and Well organized

Amazing Experience! - We did this as a group of 10 guys (on a bachelor party trip) and we wanted to experience motorbiking in the craziness of the streets of HCMC.
We had an amazing time! The girls driving us on the motorbikes were very pleasant in chatting to us, even as we were driving they were telling us about the areas we were driving though. This food tour had some very decent food, what sticks out are the scallops for the seafood in District 4. It was fun cruising through several districts of the city that you would not normally go on your own....gives you a great feel of what it feels to be part of the bustle of the millions of motorbikes and people in the city.

I never felt unsafe once during the 5 hour tour...but they do repeatedly remind you to be careful about recording with your phone as you rode. This puts you at risk of someone riding and snatching your phone. Be safe if you do photograph or record while moving!

They do provide a main guide (we had Tai) who would discuss the background of each district, and he was very energetic and enthusiastic. They have other members ("body guards") that ride with you to just help keep any eyes out, and help take video footage and pictures.

Very well run operation! I recommend you do this!

Delivers the goods - Professional, informative and fun, XO Tours lives up to its reputation. To appreciate the traffic in Saigon is to be part of the traffic in Saigon, and XO does it all so well. Absolutely brilliant.

A Must Do! - Just returned from our XO food tour of Saigon....it was fabulous! My husband and I joined our two young adult daughters and 3 of their friends for this wild adventure. The young women who drive the motorbikes were amazing...their English was excellent, their knowledge and question answering skills were over the top, they were all cute and their driving was so skillful! I was initially somewhat anxious about riding on the motorbikes in that crazy traffic, but not once did I feel unsafe on the back of the bike. The male tour guides were both informative and funny. I would recommend this tour to everyone...it was worth every penny!

Worth every cent, amazing way to experience Saigon! - What a brilliant way to experience Saigon at night. We did the 4.5 hour, Saigon Foodie Tour at night. Our motor bike riders, Ngan and Quynh were extremely helpful, kind and entertaining. Hieu, our guide was also very informative. We would recommend this to anyone, while it is more expensive than other tours, this is the best tour we have done in Saigon by far! Especially if you love food :)

Amazing experience! - What a fantastic tour - only regret was that we didn't do it sooner, so we could have explored more of the places we were introduced to. We did the tour with our daughters, aged 13 and 10, and it was fabulous. The attention we received was first rate, the food was awesome and the trip was so informative.

One of the best city yours I have done anywhere in the world - This tour was fantastic! Saigon (HCMC) traffic can be scary, so why not immerse yourself in it on the back of a scooter ridden by a local lady in traditional dress. As we were not staying downtown, we got picked up at the opera house and were immediately put at ease by 2 young Vietnamese girls in traditional dress. We hopped on the back and they drove us 2 a local restaurant where the eating commenced. The tour takes you to the places the locals eat and to districts that tourists normally wouldn't see. The drivers had great English and explained a lot along the way. Tour takes over 4 hours and you get to taste your way around the city on the back of a scooter!

Free! - Had a great time biking through Saigon with Huong Nguyen and Huong #4! Both spoke great English, made us feel comfortable and safe on the bike, answered all our questions and showed up what life is really like here! They are so incredibly knowledgable. Have done a lot of tours in Vietnam and this was definitely the best!

Our highlight in Saigon - We struggled to fall in love with Saigon. Our only regret is that we did not do this tour on our first night to get our bearings and see much more of this big city. We wanted the 'night foodie tour' but apparently booked the 'saigon by night tour' and we were not disappointed. It allows us to see many more districts in Saigon and still managed to have some street food. These girls really pay attention to your needs and go that extra mile to provide a lovely service. My 12 year old said this was his favorite activity is Saigon and we feel the same..

No faults whatsoever - We got picked up in district 1 at saigon opera house as we were staying in District 2, the two girls Qui and Thai were so welcoming and accommodating making us feel so safe while riding around on the motorbikes! Between the games and the difference authentic stops it really made for a great night! Was worth every penny and would definitely do it again!!

Family trip, highly recommended for everyone. - This was a great insight into road travel and life in HCM, would thoroughly recommend as an introduction. Felt safe. We went on a weekend so traffic a bit quieter but we got a great look at how HCM residents socialize on weekends.
As you have your own driver for the tour you can build up a rapport, so while the main your leader gives you basic information you get to talk to your driver one on one.so our family of 3 get 3 lots of information. Well done and organised. Just one thing, if there. Are things you particularly want to see mention it as some on itinery weren't included. Booked on Internet prior, used PayPal, all prompts and professional

how to eat through HCMC in 4hrs - This foodie tour should definitively be on every traveler's route to HCMC. Sure, there are other options. They might even be cheaper. But this tour was worth every cent (or shall I say, dong).

I've rarely experienced such good service, anywhere -- from pick-up to the personalized email with pictures a few days later.

And I never would have seen and eaten as much as I did in HCMC without XO. On top of that, we learned more about contemporary Vietnam than I imagined I'd learn from my entire trip. It was the highlight of our visit.

If you're even vaguely interested, take this tour. You won't regret it.

Fantastic - We started off with the tour guides greeting us right outside of our hotels and explained to us the rules for riding with them. Tour guides are good drivers and it is very safe. They are friendly and very talkative. Great fun but very hot! If it's expected a hot day do wear shorts!!

Must do - lots of fun - We were picked up from our hotel by two girls on motor bikes. They put us at ease with the traffic and we felt very safe. The tour was extensive and great places to eat. Visited several places and they gave us a great chance to sample lots of Vietnamese foods that we may not of tried ourselves. We paid a little extra and had a video made of the afternoon showing us on the bikes through the traffic and some of the places we stopped to eat at. Worth it, great holiday memory.
Thank you XO Tours.

Knowledgable but for 20s backpackers - It was fun to be on the back of a bike and support women in their jobs but while the women rode the bikes the tour was conducted by a man. So it's not all females like their website promotes.
And their target market is the backpacker crowd in their 20s which is fine but if you aren't into that find another tour.

fascinating - We were recommended this tour company by a friend and it exceeded our expectations ten fold! I was super nervous about being on the back of a bike in this crazy city but our drivers were awesome and did a great job of distracting me and making me feel relaxed! We loved how we got to see a different side to Saigon that we definitely wouldn't have seen otherwise, and oh the food was fantastic! We would highly highly highly recommend this tour!

Foodie Tour is a must! Best way to see the city - This is a must for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh! We did the foodie tour which takes in at least five districts of the city as well as different stops to experience the best food around. And what's best is doing it by the only way to travel in this city - on the back of a motorbike/scooter!
We had three nights to take in Ho Chi Minh and there is no way we'd have seen as much of the city without this tour. In between food stops we took in some sights and learned about the different districts of Saigon.
We each had our own driver, which we all thought were great. They all gave their own take on the city as well as there opinions on the tour. Our tour guides which met us at each stop were very informative and entertaining. It is also worth mentioning that this tour has bodyguards following at all times, so there is no reason to feel vulnerable.

Their are several tour packages available. I highly recommend the foodie package to experience what Saigon has to offer. Without this tour I would probably have shied away from trying goat and frog meats and definitely would not have tried Balut!

XO also email free photos of your tour which they snap throughout the tour. This is a very nice touch rather than trying to squeeze more money out of you.

Thanks for an awesome time XO

Best tour we have been on!! - We have a 3 and 6 year old and this was honestly the best way for us to see the city!! The tour guides were fantastic - entertained the kids while we learnt the history of the places we went - Tam, Hoang and Hu are guided were very informative and such a pleasure to be around!!! Do it!! The kids LOVED it as did we!!!

great experience.. a must do - This tour should be on your list to do. We did the night foodies tour and it was fantastic. We were met early at our hotel by our two drivers, Ngu & Anne, beautiful local girls and expert scooter handlers! They were very attentive as we started out through the crazy traffic that is Siagon peak hour! We drove to our first food stop where we met the other 12 travelers and their riders. at this stop we ate beef noodle soup which is delicious and were told what was to come for the evening. 5 stops in total taking in 5 districts, most you wouldnt go on your own. Great service, food and staff. Cant recommend highly enough.

Highlight of Saigon - An amazing food tour and excellent way to experience authentic Vietnamese while learning all about Vietnamese culture and cooking. Our guides were fantastic and we all felt very safe as passengers on their mopeds. A definite must do. Our 13year old and 16 year old thoroughly enjoyed the experience too!

Foodie Tour is a MUST! - My friend and I recently did the food tour whilst in HCMC and it was definitely the highlight of our stay! The guides/ladies have excellent English and we were taken to sights we would never have found alone and learn new things about the city and culture! On top of this the food was quality and we both felt really safe on the bikes.

Exciting, vibrant & great fun - This was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

The girls are great, really knowledgeable, smart, funny and they make you have fun. Being driven around on the back of a bike in HCM also makes you feel like part of the action.

The food was all really good and the tour also provides you with exposure to parts of HCM that you wouldn't be likely to experience without a guide.

This is amazing, just do it if you are in HCM: don't hesitate!

What a fantastic night - We booked this tour after reading about it in the Lonely Planet guide and looking at tripadvisor. I can honestly say that this is a MUST DO tour when in HCMC. The girls picked us up from our hotel and for the next 3 hours it felt like we were part of their family. We laughed, saw some great parts of the city, that as tourists we would not have seen, and ate some fantastic food. The commentary from each of the girls added to the experience. We had a great time, Thanks XO Tours

Great shopping and foodie tour - We did two tours with XO tours- a "shopping tour" in the morning to have some clothes made and a foodie tour at night. Both times we had the same awesome tour manager- Tai and the girls were so wonderful on both tours. We felt completely safe, saw parts of the city we normally would not have seen and had a total blast. Our 9 and 11 year olds absolutely loved it too. Would highly recommend to families or people without kids.

Amazing food tour! - An absolutely amazing night. Will be one of the highlights of the trip. Tai and the team make you feel welcome and safe, and give you a great insight of the city!! There's also a lot of humor and banter as you make your way through the city. Was like hanging out with some friends and eating while you went.

We were concerned about the price but after the tour we could see why we paid so much. It was worth every cent! Do yourself a favor and go!

Great way to experience HCMC and their delicious kitchen! - We just came back from HCMC, we traveled for 5 days with our nephew (18yrs). We had a great Saturday night with the XO girls. We had a lot of fun and tasted the best food HCMC has to offer. The rite took us through different districts in the city. A great way to explore. Would definitely recommend this tour if you are a newbie to the city like my nephew.

Hair-raising but fun - Our family of four thoroughly enjoyed the street food tour of HCMC. You must experience the city by bike to get a real sense of it - however it is not for the faint hearted. There are literally bikes everywhere sometimes coming directly at you from all directions and the fumes are strong. My teenage kids loved it. The food was OK but what really made the experience was our tour guide Hue who told us a few interesting back stories about life in the city and pointed out things we may have never known about otherwise. At the first stop we sat and ate with the other tourists but on the 4 other stops, the guides sat by our side, helping to prepare the food. To me this felt a little awkward. Generally speaking the girls themselves were a bit worn out and I had to wonder if they were treated well by management of this company... but they were very sweet so I hope this is not the case. Hong very kindly followed up with me with a query I had regarding shopping immediately after the tour. Sadly their shopping tour was fully booked or I would have done that as well.

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City - I cannot recommend this tour company highly enough. It is certainly a must do while you are in this great city. I went on the shopping spree tour with Thao and Tai - what a wonderful experience. Certainly the absolute best way to see this colorful city. I was able to see things that I would never have done on my own and both Thao and Tai were extremely informative and such lovely people as well. The photos that they sent me definitely bring back great memories. As many of the reviews say - "Just do it".You certainly will not regret it.

Best time in Saigon - This was an absolutely wonderful tour with knowledgeable guides and the friendliest drivers! There is no better way to see the city. One of the best parts of our month trip in SE Asia and would highly recommend it!!!

Saigon by Night - Excellent way of experiencing the other parts of HCMC and its traffic, just as the rest had reviewed. Phuoc Le, our tour leader, was very informative, cheerful, and fun to be with. I wish the tour could have been longer; this is definitely the best highlight of our trip.

Oh, what a night! - XO Tours was recommended to us and we had a fantastic night. Our skills girls, Loan, Thi and Trang 3 were great fun and we were really impressed with their motor bike. We did the foodie tour last night and the food was exceptional, our guide was funny and informative and we met some lovely people. We were picked up at our hotel at 5.30pm and driven all over Saigon for 4 and a half hours, stopping at a number of local places to eat and learn about Vietnamese culture - a truly memorable experience that I highly recommend for anyone traveling to Saigon.

Best Tour in Vietnam - XO Foodie Mortorbike Tour - Our group of 8 adults did the foodie motorbike tour on our first night in Ho Chi Minh City in mid-June 2015. It was the best experience, and everyone had a blast! The girls picked us up right from our hotel (early), and took us on our first leg of the journey. A few travelers in the group were a little anxious about riding on the motorbikes with all of the HCMC traffic, but everyone was very comfortable by the 3rd stop - the girls were fantastic! We tried the most exotic foods and delicacies - definitely some things that we wouldn't have ordered on our own (ie Baalut (sp?) - baby duck egg, BBQ'd frog and goat). The girls and our tour guide were determined to fill us up on delicious food and beer! We made 5 stops in 5 different districts and had 3 restaurant stops and filled our bellies to the brim! Not only did they order everything for us, they also showed us how to eat it properly and what sauces to use and even cracked our crab for us...they totally spoiled us! I cannot recommend this tour enough and hope that everyone that visits HCMC takes an XO tour! Great, wonderful, amazing, perfect, spectacular...the list goes on - just do it! :)

Best way to see Saigon at night - Foodie Tour - Our drivers Tam and Nong were the most beautiful and gregacious ladies. Everything about the tour was high quality. The guide and our drivers provided interesting insights into the hidden aspects of Saigon that the average tourist would not have access to. The food was varied and tasty, and the conversation whilst whizzing around the five districts was stimulating and thought provoking. XO tours you should be very proud of your team as they did an outstanding job.

Wouldn't miss it. - This was definitely an entertaining night out. From start to finish the xo team make sure you are having a great time. The food the ride and the company were excellant. A very professional tour. Loved it.

Fun and a must do for first time visitors to HCM city. - My partner and I booked the Foodie Tour with XO and had a great time. They were very responsive to our emails and questions. The girls picked us up promptly at our hotel on their Vespas. My partner was kinda hesitant about riding on the Vespa but the girls were very safe and the ride was very fun. The tour starts at 5:15pm till about 9:15pm. We met up with 3 other couples and was taken to 3 different food spots and several famous neighborhoods. Our main tour guide was very knowledgeable about the city and did a great job. The food was very yummy and we never felt hungry. They did a great job spacing the food out so we were able to really eat all the different foods. We visited 5 different districts (4, 5, 6, 7, and 8). XO Tours' Foodie Tour was very fun and we highly recommend it for first time visitors. The price was $72 US dollars per person and yes you can eat for a lot cheaper but the whole experience was worth the money. My partner and I would not have been able to do this type of tour on our own so it was worth the money. XO Tours also provided 2 bodyguards at all times during the tour to ensure safety for everyone even though none of us ever felt unsafe. In all, we highly recommend XO Tours to everyone visiting HCM!

Not Much More To Say -- The Best Way To See Ho Chi Minh City! - I can't add much more than has already been said by others about XO Tours. To put it simply, the city tour was fantastic. The guide was great and had very interesting stories of the history of the various areas. Riding on the back of a motor scooter was a total blast, and of course, really the only way to get around anyway! The girls driving the scooters were a lot of fun, very friendly, and spoke very good English as well. You will be doing yourself a disservice if you go to Saigon and don't take this tour! We liked it so much that we are doing the food tour tomorrow night!

Excellent tour. - I fail to see how 'Are You Insane'
can review this tour when they admit they have never gone on it!
Trip Advisor should delete their reviews.
This is a great tour. The girls are so helpful and happy. They are careful drivers. We lived our city tour.

The Highlight of my Trip to Vietnam - I absolutely loved this foodie tour!! Probably one of the highlights of my 15 years of International travel. I participated in this tour on Saturday June 13th, the night after I arrived in Ho Chi Minh City. Unfortunately it was raining that night and there was a 1 hour delay. A lovely young lady named "Khuyen" showed up in the lobby of my hotel and introduced herself. I was a little intimidated by the rain and riding a motorbike in it, but she re-assured me that everything would be fine. After the rain lightened up, we decided to hit the trail and begin the tour. You just have to let go and trust your guide/driver to take care of you. The 1st stop was a visit to a noodle soup shop where I met up with several other guys participating in the tour with their own guides. A few of them were from the UK and one was from Australia. They were all super friendly and welcomed me with open arms. I also met up with "Hieu" who was the Tour leader. Super friendly guy who gave great information. The point of this tour, at least from my perspective, is to break the ice and get to know the other travelers and to try a more authentic Vietnamese food scene as opposed to Pho, Banh Mi or Spring Rolls. As the night progressed, we visited a few more stops including an outdoor BBQ restaurant where I sampled some goat and later we went to a Seafood restaurant where we sampled crab, clams, soup and a delicious coconut dessert. Make sure you come on an empty stomach, because they will feed you very well during the 3 1/2 to 4 hours. There was also a few stops where "Hieu" talked about the culture in Vietnam and life there in general. I really appreciate that aspect of the tour as well. It was a super fun night overall and I actually enjoyed riding in the rain. Made a hot and muggy night a lot cooler. I can't emphasize enough that this is a Must do tour in Ho Chi Minh City.

My new favorite mode of transport - I went on this tour on a Friday, to see Saigon by night. It was fascinating - we visited streetside markets, the new upper-middle class area of ​​the city ate from a big outdoor bbq cafe, had some traditional Vietnamese desserts in another spot. all on the back of a scooter driven by a very chatty girl who was great at driving and talking at the same time! Thoroughly recommend this tour - great fun.

The perfect way to experience Ho Chi Mihn City and the food it has to offer - We took both the Foodie Tour and the sightseeing tour.

The Foodie tour had you on the back of a scooter riding around HCMC at night. The sights and sounds were amazing. The guides, dressed in traditional Vietnamese dress, provided insights into life in HCMC. The Tour Leader made the tour fun and explained the Districts and took us to places that the locals liked to eat. There were heaps of traditional foods and drinks. This was the only way to experience HCMC at night.

The sightseeing tour was just my wife and I, so the tour guide customized it for us. We saw all the key sights and even managed to do some of the shopping for my wife. Having locals with you when shopping is an absolute must!!!

A big thanks to all the guides and tour leaders for showing us their amazing city.

I can't believe that other cities don't have something like this.

Too much fun - I highly recommend this tour. Our guides were fabulous, fun, informative and we felt very safe. It was great to see the lights of Ho Chi Minh and explore the many and varied parts of the city.

One of the best, if not the best travel experience ever! - I was in Singapore for work and decided to visit Ho Chi Minh City for the weekend as Vietnam is one of the few places in SE-Asia I had not been yet. XO tours as recommended by a friend and this turned out to be the best thing I did in HCMC and perhaps the best travel experience I ever had for very little $. Traffic in HCMC is crazy, so when my driver/guide Thanh arrived I was a little bit worried- but that worry was gone in less than a minute. After a short ride, Thanh introduced me to the tour manager Tai and the rest of the tourist group Tai was very informative and enjoyable and we enjoyed our first meal at that first stop, Bub Bo Hue, a noodle soup similar to Pho but better (and I ate pho twice a weak back in the US). Many other food and sightseeing stops followed, taking me through areas and district I would never see as a regular tourist. Most of the tourists were couples, but XO tours does a great job accommodating both couples and people traveling by themselves. My guide a Thanh was absolutely fantastic at making me feel comfortable while at the same time taking to me about the different areas we were driving through and she and the rest of the drives and Tai made the whole experience just perfect. The fact that the drivers are cute girls who speak very good English and clearly enjoy what they are doing does not hurt either ! Thank you Thang and Tai. I will definitely do this tour again if I ever get to visit HCMC again.

Excellent tour - I've actually been on the food tour 4 times with both family and friends. It's that good! Nothing like being on the back of a bike in HCMC being driven by a beautiful Vietnamese girl in traditional dress chatting to you about you're route and some history. Great conversation and food...what's not to like?!

Wholesome Tour - Went for the Foodie tour. It's worth every penny you spend! Hoang was the girl who brought me around with her motorbike. She has good command of English and is very well versed in Vietnam's culture. I must say I've gained a lot of knowledge on Vietnam simply by just talking to her. Not to mention, she's fun to be with!

The Captain, You were amazing as well! He's responsible and you will feel safe throughout the whole tour under his leadership. There was one tourist who injured himself during the tour and Anh made sure the tourist was taken care of. But don't worry, every tourist is announced when you sign up for this tour.

I wouldn't want to elaborate further on what is packed in this tour as I do not want to spoil the fun & surprises! A must try tour if you're ever in Saigon!

A great night out - Had numerous friends recommend the XO street food tour, and it lived up to the hype. Seeing Ho Chi Minh City from the back of a motorbike is great fun...especially when it's not you having to worry about dodging the traffic.

We tried various interesting dishes throughout the evening- some were delicious- others might take some getting used to- but all were worth it! (Frog was the surprise hit!)

Our guides were very friendly and spoke excellent English! Highly recommended for anyone looking to get a taste of the less-touristy Vietnamese dishes!

Evening foodie tour - Absolutely fantastic evening surpassing all expectations. Fantastic drivers, fantastic food, just the best night so worth the money. It was my husbands birthday and they even had a cake at the last stop. Do not miss this evening, the girls are just delightful and so attentive & caring. An amazing ride through several different districts of the city. A must in HCM City. 😄

Good Quality Tour - Overall, a quality tour. Even considering that it was higher priced (72 USD) than other food tours (45 USD), I'd still recommend this one.

The team leader was a Vietnamese young guy who lived in the US for 15 years or so. He had a couple of assistants who didn't say anything. The drivers were all happy Vietnamese young women dressed in traditional gowns. They spoke English well, but one of them seemed intent on going down her list of English romantic sayings to learn their meanings from her native speaker rider and customer. It seemed inappropriate - kind of getting an English lesson as well as immature. The lady drivers fed you at the table (a little awkward) and made an effort to keep the conversation going (quite commendable) while on the bike. However, I think they expect western people to be smiling every second like a cheerleader, so they ask you why you look serious/scary/not happy every 10 minutes (a little annoying).
