As advertised, they take you to a few different districts and bring you to tables to try several kinds of food (duck embryo and a lot of seafood). You could do all of this yourself...but you don't know where to go, what to order, or how to communicate with anyone along the way. So just pay the money and let them do it all for you. Some other tours might be fine, but I recommend this tour.

BRILLIANT! - When I booked the city tour with this company I thought it was a little on the expensive side but having gone on the tour I would say that it is worth every penny!

The ladies are all really lovely and incredibly knowledgeable. Their English is perfect and they are very friendly.

There is no other way than on the back of a moped to really get a feel for this city. Walking around the city the mopeds are terrifying when trying to cross the road and being on the back of one is exhilarating! A little trick that they have to make the journey safer is that they send along a guy who drives on the side of the group who basically stops the traffic so that we can all get through. Very clever and well thought out.

If you are going to go on a tour make sure it's on the back of a moped with XO!

Great fun and something unique in tours. - Me and my buddies went on this tour, have never seen a motorbike tour of the city like it, we had some great fun riding round exploring and defiantly went to places in the city we would never have seen or seen without these guys. Had some amazing local food, and loved Ho Chi Minh. Sorry cant remember the guides names but they were great fun, and we would recommend this day out to anyone Thanks D :)

Amazing tour - Did the research, and this tour was even more than we hoped for :) The girls where fantastic riders, and funny & friendly, we felt that we where more friends than anything at the end of the night. The food was only one element to a very informative evening. Funny and well thought out narrative, with a very insightful look from a tourists perspective. Our main guide was Tai, a very intelligent and polite man. He also interacted extremely well with the entire group. For a great look into the Vietnamese traditions & cuisine, don't go past this tour. And if you think the traffic is crazy, just close your eyes

If in doubt, do it! - Did the sights tour last week with family and I was initially worried as it's like motorbike mayhem in Saigon. Our team were brilliant and we soon settled and just enjoyed such a fun way of seeing the city. I actually feel sorry for the people on the bus tours as it looked so boring in comparison. We had a heavy downpour during the trip and the ladies just parked the bikes, produced rain covers for us and off we went again. We got to see the most popular places but also the little extras like the flower market and Chinatown made it even better. Well worth the money.

Fantastic fun - My family had a fantastic time on the foodies tour. Hieu is very knowledgable as the tour leader and the girls are so much fun, especially my driver Ngan, very smart and funny, thank you. The drivers navigate the crazy traffic with ease and at no stage did any of us feel unsafe. The places we rode through and the places we ate were fantastic, we would not have gone to those places otherwise. Highly recommend.

Exhilarating way to experience HCM - Thank you Huong for taking.me on an experience I won't forget! My husband and I loved this tour. It way exceeded our expectations. We saw parts of the city we would never have seen if not for this tour. The food experience was exceptional in that it was very authentic and typical of what everyday Vietnamese would have. We couldn't finish our meals there was so much to have! The girls were fabulous and the guides were very informative. My advise is do not skip this tour it is a must do and will be an experience you won't forget.at no stage did I feel unsafe on the road. Loved every minute. Thanks!

Fantastic in every way! - We saved the best for last - XO Tours was a fantastic way to end our two weeks in Vietnam. Tai, Hong and Ngan (5) were incredible guides and made sure that every detail was perfect (even if it was pouring down rain). This is worth every penny (or Dong) you will pay. Our only advice is to do it at the beginning of your trip if you have the opportunity. They take you to places you will probably never go on your own, but may want to return to after your initial visit with them.

Foodie tour - DO NOT MISS! - I think that this was probably the highlight of my Vietnam trip. The company was incredibly polite and professional, and the two ladies who picked us up were so full of character and had a hilarious sense of humor. They were very careful to ensure our safety at all times during the motorbike riding!

We met the rest of the group at the first restaurant, and I was struck by how well organized the trip was. The main guide, Tai, made everyone feel so welcome and incredibly managed to remember the entire group names (all thirteen of us) AND where we were from, in order to introduce us to one another. So impressive. Everyone got on really well, and we finished the evening as friends.

There was so much delicious food, and a few stops in areas of Saigon that I would definitely not have visited if we had not been on the trip. It was very interesting to hear about the history of the city in the midst of filling our bellies with as much food as we could eat, and as many drinks as we could drink! It was great to be introduced to so many Vietnamese dishes by such knowledgable people, and taught the best way to eat them. I would have been far too nervous to have chosen some dishes on the menu purely because I had no idea what they were, but after our foodie tour I came away with renewed confidence!

I will definitely not miss this tour as a brilliant way to see the city, meet some fantastic people, and eat some of the best Vietnamese food...and be ridden round on the back of a motorbike!!!

Different Way to See Ho Chi Minh - Went on the "Saigon By Night" tour which takes you around parts of Ho Chi Minh that a tourist will never get to. The girls that drive you around are extremely friendly and very safe when it comes to riding around the crazy streets of the city. Our group leader, Hieu, was knowledgeable about the different areas and you can even ask him some questions that are far from usual and he would know the answer. Overall, a great night!

Foodie Tour - Don't hesitate - just do it. Awesome tour of places and sights the usual tours don't cover. Travel and eat like a local. Rose and Luana were fabulous (as well as the rest of the ladies). Perfect english, safe drivers and wonderful hosts. Thanks for a fantastic night. We have already recommended to fellow travelers.

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We had such a great experience with XO Tours. We decided to book a tour during our honeymoon based on the excellent reviews here on Trip Advisor. We are so glad we did!

We did the Saigon by Night tour which was an experience! I was nervous about riding a motorbike in the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Minh City but our guides did an excellent job of reassuring me and making me feel more comfortable. It was raining during our tour so that definitely made it memorable! Until the tour, we'd only spent time in District 1 (like most tourists) so it was great to see other parts of the city. We made several stops during our trip in key places and a couple of stops for food (quite a lot of food!) and dessert. Our guides took pictures throughout the tour and sent them to us via email later which was great. Thu and Hoai were great tour guides, we highly recommend XO Tours for your upcoming trip to Ho Chi Minh City!

Brilliant - Did the foodie tour and morning tour of Ho Chi Minh, with my two daughters. We learned so much and we were treated so well. I felt like I gained a brilliant base knowledge about the city and people that live there. It was fantastic fun traveling by motorbike and we were given special gifts to remind us of our tour at the end. I will definitely do this again if I return to Ho Chi Minh.

Join Saigon's motorbike chaos - A group of six of us went on the Saigon By Night Tour and had a fantastic time. Picked up promptly at the organized time we dived head first into Saigon's traffic. The drivers were obviously experienced bike riders and none of us felt unsafe or had any worries in terms of Saigon's motorbike traffic. We visited all of Saigon's districts, had a couple of stops for food and were delivered back to our hotel safe and sound. Great way to see parts of Saigon that may ordinarily be missed. Thoroughly recommend.

Great local food experience - This was the highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh and we saw (and learned) more in these 5 hours than we did over several days. You can't compare seeing the city on foot or in a taxi to what it's like on a bike, surrounded by hundreds more bikes.

It was fantastic to try so much food and very reassuring having the girls run through what everything was before we tried it. I enjoyed everything that I tried and only avoided the last dish of the night (no spoilers).

My partner has coeliac and is not able to have gluten. These guys were absolute champions making sure all the dishes were safe for her to eat.

I rode with Hoa (excellent rider!) and my partner rode with Nam (sorry if I got this wrong). It was my first time on a bike and Hoa was very supportive and made sure I knew what I was doing. I felt very safe and secure and never had any doubts in Hoa's abilities. My partner absolutely loved Nam and was very sad when we parted ways at the end of the night (they were like best friends). We miss them both already.

The tour manager Tai was very friendly and on the ball. He went crazy out of his way to make sure that we were all looked after, well fed and we're having a great time.

We even got heavily rained on at the end of the night but no one cared because we were having so much fun. They had ponchos with them so it was no drama anyway.

This tour may seem like it's very pricey but we wouldn't hesitate to do it again if we came back to the city. I would say that you get more than your money's worth in our experience. I guess the reviews speak to all the above points anyway!

Fantastically hip way of seeing and experiencing Saigon - What a fantastically hip way of seeing and experiencing Saigon at night! We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and are glad we paid the USD$30 extra for a video of our experience. Our lovely female scooter drivers were friendly, engaging and informative and fun! Having never ridden on a motorbike before, I never felt unsafe.

It's quite an expensive tour, and we didn't get as much food as I expected, though overall, I would do again.
Amazing time in HCMC!! - Great staff and tour! Safe and a great way to see all the great sights. The guides were knowledgable and friendly. Motorbike is the best way to feel like a local!

Amazing overview of the city - This was the best decision we made on our 36 hour visit to HCM City! Two extremely friendly girls picked up my wife and I outside our hotel and talked us through how to safely get on and ride the bike as well as fitting us with helmets for the ride. When we reached each stop another guide talked us through the important political and historical significance of each stop. This was the best way to see all the sights of the city and have a blast riding on the back of the motorbike. The staff was also extremely knowledgeable and made the experience very fun with picture breaks and a sugar cane juice stop. We would highly recommend XO as a must-do for anyone visiting the city.

Food Food Food - We made the foodie tour and it was amazing , as well as eating that divine vietamese food it is a superb way to see the city . The girls you ride with are fantastic , they give you great information on Vietnamese culture and food ( thanks Bailey you were great ) One point i would like to make is the fact that at nearly 50 i have never even been on the back of a moped and for sure i felt a little nervous , after 30 seconds i had the time of my life . This is a great way to get to know Vietnamese food.

Highlight of Trip - We decided to do this tour on recommendations by friends despite being hesitant due to the price, best decision we made. This was by far the highlight of my three week trip in Vietnam. The tour is well organized, hosted by lovely and charismatic people and an absolute blast.

The food we experienced along the way was amazing and we tried things we never would have been brave enough to try on our own. They showed us a different side to Ho Chi Minh than you see as a tourist on your own.

I can't over state how amazing the women that take you around are, they have a wonderful sense of humour.

I felt very safe at all times, even when the bike I was on broke down in the middle of a busy rush hour intersection.

You won't regret it!

Brilliant - Night Foodie Tour - I was already into the second day of my stay in Ho Chi Minh city feeling like I haven't seen enough or haven't gotten the real feel of this city. I had booked for a night foodie tour for me and my partner and what an amazing experience it was. Two riders came to pick us up at the hotel who were very friendly, knowledgeable about the culture, places to visit and food in Vietnam and very safe riders. They also took so much care of us while eating like we were their guests.

The experience of dining at places where locals go out to eat among the hustle and bustle was amazing. The tour was also coupled with riding through different districts of the city with proper guidance on what the district is about to get a real feel of the city - which was a pleasant surprise.

The foodie tour is also designed very well giving enough time to move through the courses. And of course I have to say that the food was the best Vietnamese I ever had. Kudos to the team.

BEST DECISION WE MADE! - When my boyfriend and I arrived back at our hotel after taking XO's Foodie Tour, we told ourselves that that was the best thing we've ever done and we were so happy that we took this tour. It was by far, the BEST experience ever. and totally worth what we spent on it.

it was 4.5 hours of great people and great food. everyone was so nice, funny, and they just made the whole experience really relaxing and fun. they were really informative, really helpful, really great drivers! hahah we didn't have a problem at all on the motorbikes. at first when you experience their city, and see the traffic, you start to second guess yourself and wonder if you'd be able to do it-- and you can!

If you're not afraid to try the food and would really like to eat like the locals, then I definitely recommend them! they also gave us little souvenirs to remember them by, like postcards, keychains, and a handy phrase book that you'll be sure to use! hahaha

Try them out, they are the best of the best. You won't regret it. it was the best and most memorable experience we'll have at our stay in Saigon.

Foodie Tour - amazing!!! - I had the best time on the foodie tour. I truly recommend everyone experiencing Ho Chi Minh City to do it. You try authentic Vietnamese cuisine and experience so many different districts that I wouldn't have gone too otherwise. The guides were lovely and spoke English very well. I felt super safe on their fancy bikes and felt included with the whole group. I really want to do it again! Thank you XO tours

TOP NOTCH tour! So much fun for all (adult) ages! - We did the 3 hour nighttime motorbike tour, because it's too hot during the day...
We were very happy with our choice.

They only have university-aged girls driving the motorbikes, so you can feel safe and comfortable on this tour. The ladies are all so nice too! Dinner & dessert were included in the tour. They had a small amount of space in their motorcycle trunk to store a small purse for you if you need. Riding the motorbike was both terrifying and AMAZINGLY fun all at once! Even my 65 year old mother enjoyed it. This is a must on anyone's bucket list when visiting HCMC. Highly recommend.

Tip: bring a face mask from your home country, or otherwise make time to stop by a clinic before your tour because you will definitely want a face mask while whizzing around the city on the bike. It's not 100% necessary, but recommended & will also make you look like you fit right in :) Note that XO provides helmets.

An exciting and memorable Saigon experience! - We absolutely loved this tour! Our guides Thu and Nhien were fantastic - very informative and friendly (and excellent riders!) it was awesome to be in amongst the organized chaos of the Saigon traffic! We being loved able to see different districts of Saigon that tourists rarely venture to, as well as eating street food in popular local areas. Highly recommend this tour :-)

Just Brilliant - I went with a group of seven couples on this XO Foodie tour. It was sensational. We got to see parts of Saigon that we would never have visited. The food was good, and the young ladies were very helpful, imparting their knowledge of their city and lifestyle. I highly recommend the tour. BTW, I ate the duck embryo! Can you do it?

Sights and Foodie Tour-- Great way to experience Saigon! - It was my first time in Ho Chi Minh City and I pre-booked The Sights tour (in the Morning) and The Foodie tour (in the evening) for my first day. Riding on a motorbike with the XO Lady drivers was a great way to acquaint myself with the city! Even though the girls were petite, they had awesome control on their motorbikes, so I didn't find it scary as they navigated through the crazy HCMC traffic. Some of their destinations were non-touristy, as they thought these are spots uncommonly known to tourists (as compared to other tour groups which bring travelers to spots they can easily just go to).

The Foodie tour was a highlight of my trip as it featured not only some of the known dishes of Saigon, but also some exotic foods that one wouldn't normally eat. (It's your choice to be adventurous or not :) This tour was not only about the food, but also experienced Saigon's gastronomic adventure with other travelers. In this tour, we also went to different destinations and ate a lot in the span of 4 hours. Be sure to have a lot of space in your tummy before this tour; and to pace yourself while eating. Based on experience, I'm pretty sure you will have a lot of fun in this tour as long as you're open to eating and to enjoy your time with the other guests and tour guides.

Special thanks to the Tour heads Heiu and Tai; and to my lady drivers Thuy and Tam-- they were excellent in doing their jobs on providing information and history, as well as engaging us, their guests, in the whole duration of the tour. You guys are awesome!

I wish we could do it again! - In April, my husband and I traveled to Vietnam with my brother and sister-in-law. We had only one full day in Saigon, our first day in the country. After sight seeing on our own for the day, we took the night XO Foodie tour. It was fantastic! We saw and learned so much that we felt as if we had spent several days in Saigon. Besides giving us a good introduction to Vietnamese food and motorbike transportation, the girls and our guide made sure we had a very fun evening. While in Vietnam, we recommend the XO Foodie Tour to anyone bound for Saigon. Looking at our photos, makes me wish we could do it all over again.

Best ever! - If you do one thing in HCMC, do this. Best experience I have ever had in terms of fabulous food, local style and seeing the city from the back of a scooter. Our guides were funny, charming, smart and wonderful. Traveling through the open air just like a local will make you smile for days!! Just do it. 😉

Best tour ever! - XO tour was the first bike tour we had in Vietnam and we loved it! Touring with bike was totally different experience compared to tour buses cause we got to see and feel the streets of Saigon just like the locals in the shortest amount of time. It was fun and trill biking through the busy and chaotic traffic in the city into places where tourist usually don't go like the flower and fabric market in Cho Lon, secret CIA building etc. Our drivers, Ms Trang & Vu were courteous ,friendly and careful drivers. We also had a great time with their friendly and funny tour manager, Mr Tai for his clear explanation of the sites we visited. Along the way, we had a cup of tasty iced sugar cane with strawberry and some local fruits. At the end of the tour, Mr Tai presented us with some moments to take home. Few days later, we received via email several snapshots from the tour for free (practice your best jumping pose for the tour!). For sightseeing in the city, XO is truly the best option! Overall, we strongly recommend XO tours to everyone who is going to visit Saigon.

First activity of my trip - I went on this tour on the same day as I arrived. I went for the evening tour and it was amazing. To get a wider tour of the various districts in HCMC was a great intro of the trip. It also gave a good experience being on a motorbike in the midst of the crazy traffic like one of the locals. The cool evening weather made it super enjoyable as well.
The tourguides are informative, engaging and organized.
Highly recommend it and will try other of their tours next time I'm here.

The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We booked two tours with Xo. Sight tour was amazing, out of the box and gave us a feel for how locals move in this crazy city. We saw most important monuments and the girls and guide (Tai) were amazing!!!!!!!
Then that same night we took foodie tour and it was even better than sight tour. Food excellent, places picked very well. They took us through 8 different districts of the city and when we were done we were so full!!! Lots of food... So make sure to be hungry for the tour.
I 100% recommend XO tours for your next visit to this magic city!!

Absolutely do this tour! - Saigon can be hectic with so much to see, do and eat. However this tour took care of it all. We did the 'foodie tour' and loved it. Delicious food, lovely guides and great service. We'll worth the price as you get to see/do things you wouldn't be able to do normally.

A must-do while in Saigon! - This was our 4th visit to Saigon, & my father in law talked my husband & I & my parents into doing a night tour with the XO girls after another family member highly recommended it. We have a 14 month old baby (babysat by nanna on the night but the company were supportive of us bringing him in a baby carrier if we wanted to! :/) so chose the smaller 3 hour Saigon by Night tour, and it was a fabulous taste of what other districts of Saigon have to offer. The girls were highly informative, excellent drivers, & made it a fun night out for us all. We all highly recommend XO tours, it was a standout highlight of our trip!

Great way to see the city and experience the crazy driving - Liked that the riders are women and it felt very safe, I am a nervous passanger but I felt comfortable and never worried.
The girls are very friendly and fun. The food was so interesting if you want it , being vegetarian they went above and beyond for me and it was great.i would recommend this for your start of the trip to get a great feel of the city.

Best time ever - I just loved the motorbike tour. Stayed in district 3 so was able to be picked up at my homestay. The girl that drove me was the best. The streets are extremely busy and I had never ridden a motorbike before. A little instruction was given n off we went. Never felt so comfortable as I did on the back of this motorcycle. A guide came with our little group. He was very knowledgable and spoke good English. We were driven to all the highlights and then some. I had such a good time, so glad I chose xo for my tour of Ho Chi Minh.

Good fun and a social way to see HCMC - My girlfriend and I absolutely loved the evening foodie tour. We were well fed and well entertained by the girls and the whole team. What really added to the evening was the insights given by the people of the city. We got to see places that many tourists don't get to see and therefore feel like we have a more rounded view of this vibrant city. Would most certainly recommend this tour to anyone- one of the best tours/activities we have ever done! Thanks XO Tours!

Ho Chi Minh by bike - We traveled with the girls on their scooters and found the experience to be fun and educational. We had already spent sixteen days in Vietnam and this was the
Sat night before returning to Australia and we would rate the girl's tour as one of our best Vietnamese experiences.

Highlight of Saigon - This was by far the best tour that we did in Vietnam. We did the evening Foodie tour. Our guide was very informative and it felt like we learned a lot about Ho Chi Minh not on the typical tourist route. As for the girls....our drivers....I could not praise them more! Their English was brilliant, their driving incredible and it was like riding on the back of a motorbike chatting to a friend! They also assured we were well looked after helping to prepare food at each stop and encouraged us to try unusual foods. Would highly recommend and would go again if back in Vietnam.

If you only have 5 hours to spend in HCMC, this is what you have to do! - I was recommended by a friend to go for the foodie tour. Initially, I was rather skeptical due to its price. But after the tour, it was well worth it. I went for the foodie tour on the 2nd of June 2015.

When I was picked up by my guide, Yen, I was really impressed with her language as she spoke very fluent English. Her riding skills were even more amazing. The way Yen and the other female guides brought us around were really an eye-opener. The guides even explained to us about the significance of each place while riding.

Although it was a foodie tour, the ride provided many sights to the different parts of HCMC that a tourist would not usually see. Not only did we visit 5 districts, the guides and tour leaders, Anh and Khoi Nguyen, explained the traits and significance of each of the districts. These information were really cool and interesting.

Basically the flow is eat at a 1st district, go to 2nd district to talk about the place, head to 3rd district to eat, 4th district to learn about the place, and final district to eat before heading back. They also have security personnel who followed us through. Initially, I thought they were joking. But I realized that some of the places were known to be notorious. Yet we can enjoy the food with peace of mind with them around.

I was the only solo traveler in the group of 7, but the guides made me feel very comfortable. They were friendly, informative and very helpful, preparing the food for us while we ate. Well, the service comes with the price we paid. The way they explained also reflected how passionate they are about their work and their city. We also played games and engaged in conversations among the table, keeping each other entertained.

The food was amazing. From a soupy meal, to BBQ meal to finally seafood meal. Variety was presented. And what I really liked about their planning was that between the different eating places, they brought us elsewhere to introduce us about the place. This played a role for our stomachs to rest before we filled them up again.

I was reading some of the negative reviews here prior to the tour. And this is what I have to say after going for it.

This is not your typical tour that says "And on your left is blah blah and on your right is ...." HCMC is a beautiful city, especially at night. It is good to get out of your comfort zone and try their tour for an experience like none other. Free flow food and drinks, it is the same to buffet. How many times have we gone for a buffet and just felt so full, bloated and sleepy? This tour was informative, fun and tasty. Yes its pricey. But for myself and thousands of other reviewers, the money was well worth the experience.

Best thing we did in Vietnam! - A group of us went on the night-time food motorbike tour in Saigon and all agreed it was the highlight of our trip. The girls picked us up at the hotel on their motorbikes and took us to the first stop. We visited 5 different districts, got a good tour of the city (gorgeous city lights from the highways at night), and ate some amazing food in places we would never have managed to go to alone as tourists. Tour lasted around 5 hours. Ngoc, my guide was brilliant, and one of the highlights of the experience was getting to speak to a local girl my own age about life in Saigon while out on the tour. At the end of the tour the girls then recommended a bar for us to go to and dropped us off there (turned out to be a great rooftop bar with excellent views). Can't say enough good things about the tour, the guides or the food. I'd do it again in a heartbeat when back in Saigon.

Highlight of Vietnam - As everyone else says, this trip was AMAZING!! We did a private motorbike tour. We have 4 people, 2 children ages 10 and 14. I felt very comfortable with my youngest on the bike with the guide. We seeing loved it via motorbike. It is SO WORTH IT to get the video. We have watched our video probably 30 times since returning. If you do one excursion in Saigon, make it XO Tours!

Best memory of Vietnam - My wife and I did the sights tour in the morning and Foodie tour at night...what a brilliant day! Our drivers Hoang and Trang were absolutely fantastic so sweet and friendly and very informative. Cruising around on the back of a vespa is the only way to see and experience HCMC. For me personally being on the bike was the best part of the tours.
Our tour leader for the sights tour was Huong she made us feel completely relaxed and explained everything perfectly, Anh was tour leader for the foodie and he was equally good and very funny. I cant praise XO tours, our lovely drivers and expert guides enough!
After 2 weeks in Vietnam friends and family in New Zealand have asked what was the best part of the trip, our immediate answer is XO tours, I will return to HCMC just to do the tours again!
Thanks so much, Jarrod and Leisa

A must-do in Saigon. - Did a "Foodie" night tour on 31st May with my wife. Tai, our tour leader, was informative about the food and quite a joker. He was also constantly on the look out for safety during the motorbike ride.

The two ladies (i`m so sorry girls, i can't remember both your names) were also enthusiastic to give information on the various landmarks on location and food. Both of them spoke eloquent English.

If you want to have a fun night out with good food in HCM, book this tour!
Cheers

The only way to see Saigon - We loved this! Myself and 5 other well traveled companions did the foodie tour on our only night in Saigon. It was not only the highlight of our stay in Saigon, but of our 3 week SE Asia trip. We are still talking about it a week later. We are all avid travelers and avid Trip Advisor users and I can assure any reader that our experience was amazing. Not only were the XO girls honorable hosts to the city and safe drivers, they were personable, funny, intelligent, strong and independent - qualities we respected and appreciated. This was the most engaging and wonderful experience I've ever had in a foreign country. I always say the best way to learn about a local culture is through their food -- XO hits the mark.

Sign up for their tours ! You will not regret it! - The "Foodie" tour offered by XO Tours has got to be the highlight of my long weekend trip to HCMC. It's safe, fun, entertaining and we got to try some fantastic mouth-watering street food that HCMC has got to offer. Besides eating great food, we were also shown the other districts that most tourists would not visit. We learned more about HCMC and had a chance to digest our previous meal before moving on the next pig-out location ! Everything that we got the chance to sample tasted heavenly and the "balut" (Vietnamese version of the half fertilized duck embryo) was a nice surprise as well ! To Mr Tai (tour leader), my scooter angel (Ms Yen) & the friendly girls that ferried the 16 pax entourage between District 1-6-8-7-4, a big thank you to all !

A must-do in Saigon - I booked the Saigon by night tour. My guide picked me up at the hotel on time. Very friendly and bubbly girl with good fluency in English. She was very informative throughout the tour and answered everyone of my questions in detail with impeccable patience. Later We met our tour leader Anh, who explained the agenda for the trip. Very friendly guy and knows how to keep the spirit up for everyone throughout the trip. We had a light dinner at a local food place and continued the tour to other districts. We finished the tour with dessert. What's for dessert is for you to find out.. ;). Overall I would strongly recommend XO tours and it's something you can't miss when u are in Ho Chi Minh.,
Great way to see Saigon - Great tour of HCMC by night on the back of an expertly piloted scooter. Lovely driver, tasty food, thumbs up all round.

A great night out in Saigon - We had a fantastic time with XO tours. We had so much fun in the crazy HCMC traffic feeling incredibly safe at all times. These girls can ride!!! Even the thunder, lightening and rain added to the night! We got to go to places we would never have got to by ourselves and tried all sorts of amazing food along the way. To top the night off, our guides hastily arranged a surprise cake for our 25th wedding anniversary which left us feeling very spoiled! We would highly recommend this night foodie tour to anyone.
Thanks XO for making our night so memorable!

The most fun way to see Saigon! - We had such a great time on our 'Saigon by Night' tour last night. Two lovely girls collected my boyfriend and I from our hotel and, on one scooter each, took us to a meeting point where we joined to make a small group. Our very informative guide gave us a rundown in the night and we were off! We went to so many different areas we hadn't yet seen, covering a lot of districts and had local food and drink for dinner. It was one of the travelers birthdays and they even organized her a cake! All of the girls taking the scooters are so nice and chatty, with sparkly personalities, lots of information and great English skills. A must do and it was definitely one to remember!

Do this first! - I felt completely safe on the motorbike, and surprised myself by really, really enjoying the ride!
We drove through 5 districts on our evening tour, so received a great overview of the different areas. The food was good, inside information was fascinating, and there was (fortunately) a lack of political dialogue.
The photos were taken sent to us in a matter of days; ok, some were silly, but we were having a great time!
We had done a similar tour a few nights earlier - this was much better (although I'm at a loss as to why!)
A tour guide (Thu) with personality, and a great sense of humor - bonus!

Highlight of our trip - Wasn't so sure when my son suggested the tour but cannot speak highly enough of it, now that I have experienced it. We went for the night foodie tour and the day tour. They served us food till I thought my stomach was going to burst and they offered some food which I normally won't have tried but I think all the tour group was thankful for the beers in hand when we tried these (there was no pressure on anyone to try if they cannot do so). All the female bike riders were friendly, helpful, courteous, knowledgeable and spoke very well.

One of the Best Parts of Saigon - This was the highlight of our trip to Saigon. Our drivers were amazing as were our guides. The food was a perfect balance of the familiar (if you eat a lot of Asian food) and the exotic (frog and Balut). I would recommend the night foodie tour to anyone. AWESOME!

sightseeing in Saigon on motorbike - I have participated xo tours motorbike sight seeing tour in Saigon. I had a lot of fun and saw a lot of places in a short time. my bike driver was great and our tour guide was very informative. thank you.

Fanstastic tour with the nicest people - Loved XO tours and although the idea of ​​being on the back of a scooter seemed a little scary with the Saigon traffic, the girls were very safe drivers. We had wonderful tour guides loved and experienced some local culture/food. It's a fantastic experience and provides a lot of insight into the city. We wish we would have done this tour on our first day in Saigon instead of our last.

Great guides with personality and authentic local food - My husband and I traveled to HCMC in May 2015. We did the foodie tour, which took about 4 hours to complete from 5.30pm to 9.30pm. My guide instantly made me feel like a local and was incredibly easy to talk to. The food was good - no pho or banh mi on the menu, which is great (it's good to try new things) and overall it was a really enjoyable experience.

Amazing, fabulous and a must do! - This was definitely a highlight of our Vietnam trip. The education, experience, food and wider view of Saigon that we received was something that will forever be up there as one of the BEST nights so far.

2015-04-01T00:00:00 - Great way to see the City and surrounding areas, which you are unlikely to see if you were sightseeing on foot.
Got to try local street food. We were vegetarians and they made sure we were catered for.
Guides were fantastic! Made us feel very safe on the motorbikes, even though we were traveling through Ho Chi Minh at night when the roads were very busy. Each guide stayed with the person they were guiding. We could ask any questions we wanted to and were given an insight into living in the City.
Interesting to see all the different districts. Good length of time.
They took pictures that were sent to us by email afterwards. Great souvenir!

Believe the hype - This gets so many 5 stars you could be forgiven for thinking it is a scam. It isn't. Without doubt it is the single best travel experience I have ever had. The premise is simple: you ride passenger-style on a scooter around Ho Chi Minh City as part of a group and have various food experiences in different parts of the city. A simple concept. But there is magic in it. First you get to ride through HCMC. This is better than any adventure ride or theme park ride imaginable. It is insane but your driver does it with ease. You need to put your faith in your driver and just enjoy the ride. I would recommend this tour simply for the driving if nothing else. Secondly you will see and learn more about HCMC than any other way. You will go to parts of the city few tourists do and be all the better for doing so. Finally the food - to describe it as authentic doesn't quite to its justice, but whether it is grilled goat, delicious scallops or frog (best with skin on) you will never forget it.

Some caveats. Do this as early on in your stay in HCMC as you can. You will definitely see places you wish to return and see again so leave yourself time for these further explorations.

You will form a strange bond with your driver. You need to trust her and her friend. Be prepared to tip well - I did and am glad I did. Once in a lifetime is a cliché - at least two of our party had done the tour previously so it need not be just once in your life.

Seriously, do yourself a favor and book now.

Just do it you won't regret it - My wife booked this tour for the morning. I was a little nervous about riding around on the back of a scooter in Saigon. I need not have been as the woman that drove me around was very good. It is a great tour and a lot of fun. I especially liked meeting the 85 year old letter writer at the Saigon Post Office. He was a lovely gentleman and it was great to chat with him.

After visiting the Notre Dame Cathedral across the road we headed off to see where a Buddhist monk set himself on fire in 1963. There is now a statue and shrine there. Then it was on the bike to stop off for a cool drink of sugar cane and then a drive through the flower and fabric markets, We ended with a visit to the oldest Chinese temple in Saigon. It was a great day and I highly recommend it.

If you find the review helpful I always appreciate a click on the helpful button.

Great fun - My husband and I were apprehensive about doing the Foodie Tour as traveling around Hoi Chi Minh on a motorbike is not for anyone if a nervous disposition and certainly questionable for two people in thei60's and 70's. All I can say is what a great night in the safe and courteous hands go our tour guides Money and Wyn, thank you! This was an informative tour enabling us to see many of the districts of Hoi Chi Minh that we would have otherwise missed. The tour is accompanied by several male guides to ensure your safety and there is clear and knowledgeable information given throughout the tour.

As for the food it was lovely as well as unusual, enabling us to try the real dshes of thqe South of Vietnam. No rushing, good company and eating where the locals go. All in all this was a great night, highly recommended as a must do to all.

XO Tours Ho Chi Minh City - My wife & I only had a short stay in Ho Chi Minh City. A friend had recommended this company & we had booked two tours prior to our arrival. We were booked in for a sight seeing tour in the morning & a foodie tour in the evening. We were met in our hotel lobby & were really pleased with the tours coverage & knowledge. It was great to feel the buzz of the city on the back of the bikes, feeling very safe at all times. The locations we visited provided some insight into the real Vietnam lifestyle as well as its troubled past. A cold drink picked up on the go was a fun innovation. The staff were keen to talk and it felt like you came away with a much better understanding of their lives.
The foodie tour was even more fun with the nightlife providing a wonderful backdrop to some great food. You try dishes that are a bit different from the standard issue Vietnamese with plenty of variation. There is lots of food at each stop and no one goes hungry.
The staff could not have been more friendly or helpful & I would recommend these tours without hesitation.

The most fun and education you will get in Saigon. - This tour is the best activity I have EVER experienced traveling anywhere. The young, vibrant women were intelligent, fun, engaging. The ride was exhilerating with great scenery and sites--and, yes, the food was amazing. If you want to experience the city and the culture with your private tour guide--each person has a guide/scooter--you wont find anything with a better experience or value.

Not to be missed - We did this trip on our first night, the girls were on time waiting for us in the lobby. I found this tour was all that I expected and more, the girls were great fun, safe and very informative. Any other tour that we do in Vietnam has a lot to live up to. If we can fit it in we will book another tour with xo when we return to Ho chi Minh

Amazing!! - This tour group doesn't need another amazing review, it has so many already. But my friends and I had the most spectacular time on the foodie tour and it really is made by the female drivers who are so friendly and funny that you feel like you've known them forever!

Thai was our tour guide and he was great also. Well spoken English and very funny.

The food was some of the best I have ever eaten - definitely the best in Vietnam. A must do for anyone visiting HCMC.

Special recommendation is the scallops in the last restaurant - you won't regret it!

Voted best vacation activity by our family! - Such a great way to see Ho Chi Minh. What made it great was the outstanding job the 4 ladies did touring our family of 5 (3 kids ages 6-12). Ning was our group leader, and she along with her crew went way beyond what we could have expected in everything - safety, information, fun conversation, fun activities, informational tours. The food aspect was outstanding - every stop gave us a chance to try something different. We have one child who is allergic to shellfish, and Ning & crew seamlessly swapped out a shrimp meal for our daughter with some BBQ chicken that she now swears is the best she's ever had.
Like others considering this with small children, we had some reservations before booking. But, the XO drivers did such a great job talking to our kids about safety, and driving so safely through the city. Our kids were nervous at first, but within minutes were comfortable and having a great time singing pop songs with the XO girls. There were 2 men at each stop helping to coordinate things and keeping an eye on the safety of the group overall, which was comforting even if not entirely necessary.
We had done some other touring around Ho Chi Minh in a car, but this tour on a motor bike was far more exciting for all of us and a great way to see the city in an entirely different way.
Our family highly recommends this experience! I wish this was available in other big SE Asia cities.

Great tour and incredible service - I'm European but live in Asia so I I've been on a few tours and trips the last few years but this was the best to date.The girls were incredibly fun, polite and engaging but also witty and had great banter. I love great ways to see a city and experience it and this is without exception the best way to see Saigon

Best thing we have done here so far! - Great entertaining company with lots of useful information!! Non-stop laughs, great food, great people, drinks, and felt safe the whole time! Amazing one of the best things ever I have ever done on any trip actually!!

Awesome way to see all over Saigon at night - Highly recommend jumping on the scooters with these girls and flying around Saigon. We went on a private tour and they were very flexible to where we wanted to go and stop and it was simply awesome. The traffic, the night markets, the street life all laid out to experience from the back of a scooter and via the stops along the way. 2.5 hours went by too fast. We loved every minute of it. Being in the middle of the Saigon traffic on a bike was never dangerous and always exciting. Chatting away to locals wanting to speak English whilst flying down the roads was great fun. Stopping at various districts for street food was also a great experience. Saw most of the city and gave us a great setup for our 3 days in Saigon. A great experience !!

Fantastic Foodie Fun - One of the highlights of our time in Vietnam. Great to experience not only the authentic food on offer in this lovely country but also to get the chance to be one of the millions of motorbike passengers in this city of scooters. The women drivers were absolutely lovely and attentive, ensuring we had the very best time. A must do in Saigon.

Night trip through the suburbs - We had a group of Project Management final year students visiting us In HCMC and thought a good way to give them a feel for the pulse of the city would be by motorbike tour.
The girls (all female drivers) turned up on time at our groups hotel, the "vintage Vespers" have been changed to current model ones but that probably makes sense as the vintage ones had reliability issues.

Our group was mixed guys and girls with the tallest guy being 6ft 7. This didn't seem to present a problem to the 5ft 2 driver.

The tour itself was a lot of fun and all the group thoughly enjoyed themselves. I would highly recommend the tour for a feel of how to mix it up in Saigon

See Ho Chi Minh City like a local - Highly recommend this tour. It's great fun. Our lead guide was Thai. He was excellent, very informative and friendly. Excellent English. The girls who took us around on their bikes, Queenie and Jade were really great fun. Very safe drivers, excellent English and very informative too. We took their foodie tour also - a must do I would say.

Saigon by night motorbike tour XO tours - Had a fantastic time. The girls were lovely & friendly - were happy to share their knowledge of Saigon & seemed to enjoy showing us around their city. The bike ride was exhilarating, so much traffic but they were really good riders.
We stopped off at various attractions & got to see things we wouldn't have on our own.
Really great way to get a glimpse of life in Saigon away from just tourist venues.
Highly recommended

Great insight to HCMC and fun tour - Our family loved the Saigon by Night tour with Huong and her friends. Seeing and learning about districts outside District 1 from the middle of the street was an eye opener and experiencing tasty and authentic street food was memorable.

relaxing way to get an idea of ​​Ho Chi Minh - It is very comfortable to get an idea of ​​Ho Chi Minh city on the back of the motorbikes. When we went to HCM it was very hot, so I was happy that I didn't have to go on my own to explore the city, which might be more stressful. We did see a lot, but we didn't stop at so many places. I felt a little bit in a hurry. I was not so super impressed of the tour, maybe I had too high expectations based on the other recommendations. But check it out on your own.

Did this on our first night in Vietnam, great introduction - our girls were fab, nothing to be nervous about. We tried so much different food (you can so no if you wish). Saw so many different districts of the city, I would defo recommend to all!

Great tour!!! - Tofu is the best!

Well, I meant Thu and Phuoc. They are the two guides who had made our trip THE BEST trip ever.

My buddy and I are from Canada and visiting Vietnam the very first time. I would highly recommend to schedule this trip on your very first day. During the trip, Thu and Phuoc have given us very useful advice and tips to ensure you can enjoy your stay in Vietnam. They even give us a little booklet on some translations between English and Vietnam. So in case you are lost, or want to bargain for deals, you can always refer to the booklet.

Me and my buddy were on the private foodie tour on April 10th. It is again THE BEST decision we made. Not only we have a chance to be on a motorbike, understanding the culture and history of Vietnam, talking to our guide one to one, visiting different local places, we also had REAL local food. BTW, it is all you can drink and eat. If you are not full at the end of the trip, you can ask for more.

Thank you again Thu and Phuoc, the tour was amazing and for sure will visit Vietnam because of you two.

Hmmmm - We did the Saigon by Night tour and were picked up from our hotel by two delightful young ladies. At first I was quite worried as my driver didn't look very old at all but I needn't have worried. The drivers were extremely competent and we felt safe from the moment we set off. It was a fantastic experience to be part of the traffic in the city, instead of just trying to cross the roads. and I'm glad we did the tour. However, the stops on the tour were, if anything, a bit long and boring. We stood on a lot of street corners and chatted. Lots of photos and pulling funny faces - not really our sort of thing (almost like redcoats at Butlins!). We did stop for street food which was ok although after two weeks in Vietnam we'd had quite a lot of food experiences and it wasn't great.
So, I'm glad we did it for the scooter ride but probably would have to say it's not really worth the money we paid.

Absolutely 5 Stars - In the beginning we thought that it was a little expensive, but from the minute we met the lady riders that picked us up from our hotel we could see just how professional they were. They were very safe conscious very good riders and explained everything in detail before we took off. Before I go on any further we think that the experience alone with out the food included was worth more than we paid (US $72 per head). In all there were 12 people in our group, of course every person had there own personal lady rider. We also had male security riders along for extra security encase they were needed. The tour included all you could eat and all you could drink (I think all you could drink within reason). They did say that you must remember that we were on the back of the motor bike with a young lady rider so for the safety of both the passenger and the rider and fellow riders that it was advised not to overindulge too much.
There were I think about 5 different stops in all with different types of food at 3 of the 5 stops.
Some wonderful experiences were had by all. The head guide who was a very friendly bloke and very knowledgeable made sure we had all the food and drink we needed before heading off to the next destination. He also took some photo's along the way and emailed them to all on the tour within the next few days.
After a great 4.5 to 5 hour tour taking in some places we will have never gone to ourselves and tried food that we will have never tried ourselves the group all said goodbye and our lady riders took us safely home to our separate hotels.
What a great night out. THANKS XO tours and all your wonderful staff. Very Very PROFESSIONAL.

Good to see the districts not the best value however - Given I used TA for most of my planning I thought it pertinent to put some things on this is we recorded entirely on the strength of the reviews. Firstly the staff were fantastic both the girls and Anh (guide), very knowledgeable, very attentive. If this is the only tour you do, you could do worse. If touring around Vietnam however we found the street food tour in Hanoi much better value @ $25, and sampled much more food. Riding on the back of a scooter through the districts in HCM was a unique experience however at more than X3 the price I'm unsure we got the value out of this tour like we did the street food tour in Hanoi. If money no issue then worth doing. If on a budget then save the tour for Hanoi.

made our holiday - so good we did two tours - foodie tour and half day tour - I initially did the half day tour with my eleven year old son. We weren’t sure about being on a motorbike and not sure about HCMC traffic either.
The half day tour was good, we saw a lot of the sights and they were explained to us. Our drivers could speak English well and were fun and engaging. Although 3 hours long it was a very quick tour around. The traffic isnt as bad as it looks and after ten minutes I relaxed. Out tour had five people on it including us. Three Australians had dropped out because they were scared of the traffic. Look at the reviews- there are no signs of accident. I wouldn’t have taken my eleven year old on if I had thought that. Not to say it couldn’t happen but there are accidents in tour buses so are you ever safe ?
We enjoyed it so much we went on the “foodie tour”. There were twelve of us in total. Aged 30-50 (plus my eleven year old) . From UK , Australia and Germany. They say all you can eat and drink and they mean it, the beer flowed and the food kept coming. There was no funky type of food eg insects just local food . Lots of seafood plus meat. We visited quite a few districts and they were explained to us . Very informative and the food was excellent. They catered for dislikes or dietary issues eg no chilli or seafood. The drivers looked after us very well.
There is more traffic at night than during the day but even with the thousands of motorbikes there is an organised chaos. I had full trust in the driver. She had been driving in HCMC for 7 years and never seen anyone injured in an accident
I would love to do it again

Saigon By Night Tour - Awesome Night Experience! - My fiancee and I went on the Saigon by Night tour and had a blast! I forgot the names of the two women who toured us around (SORRY!) because it's been a few weeks since the tour. Regardless, the were incredibly fun and funny, consistently doing a great job keeping us engaged and entertained, We saw alot of the city that we wouldn't have seen otherwise and really enjoyed the all of the street food! The two of us were alone on the tour, which may have made it even better. All I can say is "AWESOME TIME"!

XO is Excellent - My Wife & I did both the daytime tour and night foodie tour. On both occasions, the girls were fantastic and the guys (tour guide) were very interesting and informative about the Vietnamese culture and way of life. When travelling on the scooters as a pillion passenger, you need to "zone out" on the overwhelming traffic and other scooters around you, otherwise you tend to tense up and make it more difficult for the girls to ride the scooter. Its certainly not for everyone, but if you lobe adventure and a little mystery, I strongly recommend both the Day & night tours. Keep up the great work guys & gals.

Fun! - We booked the foodie by night tour. I actually enjoyed the tour on the bike around all the districts more than the food element. That said the food aspect was good, we just weren't brave enough to try everything, but that was our choice...it's there for you if you dare! The tour is slick, professional, everyone friendly and engaging, everything has been thought through to give you an interesting experience. We were absolutely safe and our drivers (I've lost their names) were excellent.

Amazing! - A friend and I booked the "Foodie" tour after having read so many good reviews on Tripadvisor. We were not disappointed! Our guides were amazing at navigating the crazy traffic in Saigon. They also explained things about the different areas which you would not be told on a regular guided tour. We felt very safe with the girls at all times and had a lot of fun. The food was also great and we enjoyed meeting other travelers from all corners of the globe while dining. A special thanks to Tai for making sure that we could enjoy the entire tour after we realized that our flight left the same night and not the night after. Tai and the girls made sure we got back to our hostel on time to collect our bags and head for the airport. This was by far the best way to end our amazing trip to Vietnam!

The force is strong in Han! - Highly recommend this tour! The main guide, Han was very funny as well as informative, after a few well placed Star Wars jokes and 'meet and greets' we started a brilliant and fast paced tour of the city.
The girls in charge of the peds were very friendly and also very funny and had total control on the roads.
I felt very safe and well looked after, it was very well put together and highlight of my trip.
Thank you again Luke.

Fun Tour! - At first I was quite scared of getting on a motorbike especially in a developing country like Vietnam, but after watching the video of their site, I have a better idea of ​​how the road situation will be like. The fact that they only have female drivers and kids can also go on the tour makes me feel much better too.

The drivers are very cheerful young ladies who speak extremely good English. They are like tour guides rather than drivers as they tell you a lot about the city, their culture and their people along the tour. Sometimes I feel a bit nervous about safety as my driver talked all the way but I have to say they all very good drivers.

we only went on The Foodie tour which brought us to three local food places and a tour around several districts seeing local places like the wet market where people sell live chickens and frogs in cages, as well as the wealthy district 7 where everything is so clean and neat. The food is not the most outstanding in town but I guess it's good to try out as we probably wouldn't go to those places if we were to go by ourselves.

overall we are happy that we have joined the tour. It's definitely a memorable part of our trip in HCMC.

Excellent - I book the Xo tours for a foodies tour at night. It was expensive for the food we had but visiting some places around the city was nice. The tour guides are nice and gentle and they take really good care of the customers.

Best part of vacation was XO Tours! - My friend and I booked the Foodie Tour last minute - and I am so glad that we did! This was the perfect way to see Ho Chi Minh City and taste some local flavors! Our motorcycle drivers were amazing - so knowledgable, friendly and funny! And our main tour leader was perfect, guiding us through the evening and ensuring everyone was enjoying themselves. Book it!! - We booked both the Foodie Tour, and also the Sightseeing Tour with these girls and can truly say that both were utterly brilliant!

XO Foodie, best choice to really know Saigon at night - We took the Foodie tour and it was the better choice in excursions in all our journey.

Thank you for all the XO Team, especially for Vi and Ngar, "nuestras lindas chicas", for such a good time in Saigon.

What a great experience to get amongst the madness of Saigon - My husband and I took my mother in law on this tour. We were a little hesitant after seeing how hectic the traffic is in HCMC, but they completely put us at ease and we really enjoyed it. We did the sights tour and covered quite a lot of ground. Experienced some delicious treats and got in amongst the traffic in Saigon. Highly recommended.
Great morning out - This was a fantastic tour! The tour guide and drivers were very friendly and informative. I was a bit nervous about getting on a motorbike but my nerves soon went away.

The only way to see Ho Chi Minh city - We did the Motorbike sights tour and it turned out to be one of the most exciting and enjoyable things that we have done.

It was great to be zooming through the Ho Chi Minh traffic on the back of a moped and feeling like a local as we went between sights learning all about the history of the city.

Just brilliant! - First night of holiday & an amazing start. Neither of us had ever been on the back of a scooter before but after 5 minutes we were loving it.

For food great company & pure fun couldn't ask for more.

Did the Foodie Tour, great fun - My friends and I booked the Foodie Tour via XO and loved it. It was a great experience jumping on the bikes with the drivers and going through the craziness that is the traffic in Vietnam. The ladies that hosted us have great personalities as they take you from place to place.

My driver was Huong, (or Huong #3 as she called herself) and she was weaved through the Ho Chi Minh City traffic with ease. I never once felt nervous despite the closeness from other scooters and cars. Oddly enough the traffic seems *less* crazy when you're in the middle of it vs watching it from the sidewalk.

Trust in your guide's recommendations for food, no matter what it is. You'll be surprised at what you find tasty if you ignore your preconceptions.

Heuih was our main tour guide. He provided some great historical information on the city and made sure we all were comfortable and had enough to eat. And you certainly eat a lot. We also got to see some parts of Saigon that we otherwise never would have found or even imagined could have existed.

Bring your sense of humour. The drivers and security personnel like to have a bit of fun with the guests to keep things light. It's all in good fun.

You'll be interspersed with other groups doing the tour at the same time. It's a great way to meet other tourists from around the world.

We loved every second single of the XO Foodie Tour - My husband and I traveled to Saigon in March 2015 and booked onto the XO Foodie Tour in advance. We both loved every single second of this absolutely brilliant tour.

The below is a detailed account of our evening, so if you like surprises - SPOILER ALERT - do not continue reading and instead definitely book this tour, no questions, it is a brilliant experience and one that we will never forget.

At 5.20pm we were met at our hotel by two Vietnamese girls dressed in traditional Ao Dai. Both of them speak fluent English very well. They took us outside the hotel to where their mopeds were parked and told us some safety rules, then on we got the back and the four of us were off. The moped ride was brilliant! I found it really exciting and much safer being on the back of the bike than walking across the roads!

About 5 minutes later we arrived at the Dong Ba Restaurant (Nguyen Du street) an outdoor restaurant, still in District 1, where the rest of the group on the same tour was waiting for us. Our team leader, Anh, then introduced himself and explained where would be going and sights we would be seeing throughout the evening. He also explained that he would be taking photos of us whilst on the tour and that these would be emailed over to us over the next week (which I have included with this post).

There is a popular national dish in Vietnam called "Pho" (pronounced 'fuh') which is a beef noodle soup with chicken stock. Anh explained that you can get this everywhere in Vietnam and that instead we would be having a much tastier version that tourists wouldn't know to order. This was called Bun Bo Hue, which was also a beef noodle soup, but cooked with lemongrass, and accompanied with vegetables such as bean sprouts, shredded banana flower (I didn't know bananas had flowers, but this was tasty!) and a vegetable the Vietnamese love called "morning glory" (which had a spinachy taste to it). The Bun Bo Hue was absolutely scrumptious and something I would happily order again.

After we'd all finished with our first meal of the evening, we got back on our mopeds with our guides and rode to District 5 to see China Town. The marketplace in China Town was huge, busy, and full of food (both living and pre-prepared!). There were live chickens, ducks, fish, crabs, prawns and frogs everywhere wrought of mopeds (including ourselves) weaved in and out of the busy market streets. There were spices, nuts, fruit and veg in big baskets and other streets with clothes, hats, shoes and trinkets. The girls dropped us off at a quiet spot where I was waiting for us. He explained that whilst every country in the world has a China Town (including China!) that this was one of the largest.

We got back on our bikes with our guides and headed to District 8. We arrived at the next restaurant, "3Q", which was really busy and there was not a single tourist (other than our group) in sight. 3Q was an outdoor restaurant with lots of long tables with small BBQs spaced throughout each one. The girls sat with us and prepared the food on the BBQs and explained which foods went with each dip best, as well as which leaves to eat with them (we had mint, basil and 'fish leaf', which is indigenous to Vietnam, and was my favorite). First we had goat breast (He explained goat is one of the most popular meats in Vietnam and that this is eaten on special occasions) and okra. Next we had beef and prawns. Next we tried deep fried pumpkin flower, which was lovely. Finally, we had frog, with option of 'skin on' or 'naked'. The frog was a lot like little boney chicken wings and were also very tasty. For dessert, we had watermelon, mango and guava, which we were advised to dip in a little chilli salt, which was actually very nice.

After dinner, Anh explained that we will be going to District 7 next, and that it will no longer feel like we were in HCMC. We got back on the mopeds and rode to District 7, and could tell once we'd arrived, this area couldn't be more different from other parts of HCMC. It was quiet, peaceful and very well kept, the only mopeds there were the ones we arrived on. He explained that District 7 is the area where wealthy people live, and that many tourists have not even heard of this area, let alone visited it. It was a really interesting and insightful part of the tour. Anh then told us our final stop would be for one final meal in District 4, the opposite side of the Saigon River to District 7.

We arrived at Toan Phuong restaurant, a small outdoor seafood restaurant and first we started with grilled quail, then we enjoyed crabs legs and some very tasty scallops. The scallops were kept in their shell with spring onion and peanuts on top in a tasty sauce, which we had to shuck, very tasty. Next up was a not so nice surprise for us - duck embryo was served. We were asked whether we wanted 'original' or tamarind. My husband tried original and I went for tamarind, though neither of us enjoyed this dish in particular, which we were told was a delicacy in Vietnam. After this dish, we get our reward; clams served in their shells in a chilli and lemongrass sauce. We had to use the shells to scoop up the sauceand shuck the clams too. This was really delicious, and one of my favorite dishes of the evening. To end our exciting feast, we had coconut jelly and creme brûlée for dessert.

Once all the plates had been cleared, Anh gave us XO Tour postcards and a key ring to keep as a souvenir as well as a handy survival guide book with helpful contact numbers and Vietnamese phrases, which we actually used regularly everywhere we went throughout our 3 weeks of traveling around Vietnam! The whole evening was incredible. Anh and all the girls were very funny and friendly, they remembered all of our names all night and their English was incredible. We said our thank yous and goodbyes, then our guide rode us back to our hotel about 10pm.

An absolutley brilliant night with great food and lots of fun. Thank you XO tours! And a special thank you to my guide/rider, My, who was lovely company all night.

XO Tours Dinner - What an experience thank you to Anh and all the girls it was fantastic you get to see parts of Ho Chi Minh you will never see as a standard tourist and all the food was amazing.

Unmissable experience - Our visit to Ho Chi Minh City was scary at first, very apprehensive regarding negotiations the manic roads, let alone making my maiden pillion ride on the back of a young lady riding a Vespa 125cc. Wow! Great fun! - We were quite apprehensive about this trip as we had spent the day watching the very chaotic traffic in Ho Chi Minh! MUST DO - A great experience in HCMC. My husband and I did the Saigon by Night Tour and it was great. Loved it! - Well worth it... so much fun zooming around the bustling city. Through Chinatown was amazing, good food, laughs and great insight into Vietnamese life. Thanks Ning, Thi and crew xx Andrew & Alan

AMAZING Experience - Don't miss out - Our guides were so knowledgeable and incredibly friendly. It was a fantastic experience to ride around HCMC on motorbikes (the girls were excellent drivers). So much fun! - I can't think of anything negative to say about this tour company. My friend and I did both the sightseeing tour and the foodie your and we absolutely loved them both. Had the best night ever!!! - We did the foodie tour with XO tours in Ho Chi Mihn City! It was the best night we had during our stay in Vietnam! We are everything from Goat & Frog (+ a little surprise at the end 😱)! Would highly recommend this tour! The girls riding the bikes were so lovely! The tour includes some sightseeing as well. We met some lovely tourists as well! We definitely remember this tour for a long time to come!

XO must do - evening Foodie Tour - Very polished very safe awesome food. All the drivers were female, dressed in traditional Anai (sp?) and very friendly. Full of information, as was the guide who spoke at each stop. We stopped for food three times with about 5 courses - that was enough and there was no shortage of food or drink. If you are a backpacker on a budget AND short on time in Saigon, I would seriously recommend paying the cost of this. Thank you Ngang, Hieu. BUT books ahead as they are very popular. Not just for youngsters-!

Such a fantastic and fun Foodie tour, loved it! - As I was traveling by myself and limited on time, I decided to do the Foodie Tour as I thought it would be a great way to experience the city at night. Plus, as it was the beginning of my trip, I figured it would also be a safer way to try some Vietnamese food beyond pho and fresh spring rolls without the risk of getting sick. XO Tours delivered on those expectations and more.

My driver and guide was very friendly and welcoming, giving me a quick passenger safety rundown before we left from my hotel to join the tour group. At the meeting point, we met our tour leader for the evening who gave us a brief outline of what to expect over the next few hours as well as an introduction to our first dish: bun bo Hue (spicy beef noodle soup).

Over the next few hours, we hopped across four different districts of Ho Chi Minh City and a range of local eating places. The dishes included bbq goat and prawns, fried frog and quail, grilled scallops, stir fried crab, coconut jelly and tapioca pudding, and more. The more adventurous among us even tried the hot vit lon, also known as balut or duck embryo egg. Soft drinks and tea were included in the price but beer was available for purchase at most places.

I had gone the whole hog and chosen for the video when I booked my tour, partly because of the novelty and partly because when you're traveling alone you don't often get the opportunity to have photos and videos of yourself doing things. Plus it was really quite reasonable priced.

I had such a great time on my Foodie Tour that I would definitely consider doing it again the next time I'm in Ho Chi Minh City – and maybe even one of their other tours.

Food Tour - delicious and very entertaining - We booked the Foodie Tour because of the tripadvisor ratings and it was definitely worth its price.
