However, what makes this tour such a great experience are the XO girls. They were absolutely fabulous, very friendly and made the tour fun. They speak good English and are perfect entertainers/hosts. The rides with my XO girl Ngoc were absolutely fun and we had much to laugh about. We experienced an entertaining and amusing evening.

Highlight of our trip - Don't hesitate, book it now! This foodie tour was the undoubted highlight of our 14 night trip to Vietnam. I traveled with my wife and 16 year old daughter and we had an absolute ball! The entire team made it a great night and they all had great personalities and obviously enjoy their work. The food was awesome and we didn't want the night to end. We were taken into areas that most tourists don't get to see and it was such a fun, relaxing night. This is a must do tour while you are in Ho Chi Minh. There were people from all over the world on the tour and it was great to meet new friends. Awesome night :)

Fun, fun fun - This tour is probably on of the best organized tours we have been on for a long time. The bikes are new and the staff are picked for both their skill in handling the bike and in the friendliness and ability to speak English. We got to go all over the city and see all sorts of areas.. we should have taken this tour 1st thing on arriving.
There is no worry about the food or the safety.
Do yourself a favor and take this tour, it will be one of the highlights of your trip to HCMC

Don't miss this when in Saigon - We went on this tour with some friends. We did the foodie tour. I was a little nervous about hopping on the back of a motor bike in a frantic city especially seeing as I have never been on a motor bike. I was almost immediately comfortable. The girls are amazing drivers and gain your confidence easily. I did not struggle once to understand their English. Perfectly spoken English by all the girls and lead tour guide. We went into many districts of Saigon that we would not have known existed. The food was delicious I would not budge on my insistence not to eat frog. After some gentle persuasion from the girls trying to get me to change my mind, I still won't eat frog! I know the cost of tour seems expensive but it's totally worth it.

Best way to see HCMC - great food & very accommodating to vegetarians! - Do yourself a favor and book this tour if you want a memorable and unique experience in Saigon! I would have left Vietnam feeling like I missed out if I didn't do this tour - definitely one of the top highlights of my trip!

PROS

- amazing food - I am a vegetarian and the whole crew made sure I was well taken care of, got plenty to eat and nothing had any traces of meat or fish. All of my dishes (close to 10 total at the 3 food stops) were prepared and delivered separately - even sauces and vegetables to make sure nothing had fish sauce or was "contaminated". I'm not a crazy strict/picky veggie (although I prefer to not eat seafood most of the time) - but the amount of respect they had for diet restrictions was unsurpassable. And, everything tasted unique and amazing compared to most of the food I ate during my time in Vietnam (which was bland and always the same).

- all of the guides' English is perfect - all of the drivers (mine was Nhien) and the main guide Ahn spoke perfect english with hardly any accent. It was easy to have meaningful conversation even while riding the bikes!

- there was no shortage of conversation! The girls are all friendly, talkative and tell you about each area as you drive through, offering up interesting facts and stories.

- you will see a diverse assortment of neighborhoods from the locals to Chinatown to wealthy ex-pats and all are interesting in their own unique way

- your safety is their #1 concern - followed closely by making sure you have a nice time and you get enough to eat. They asked/confirmed multiple times about allergies and food preferences. There were 3 or 4 "body guards" who rode around with our group of 12 and always made sure we were safe both while riding and off the bikes. You are in good hands! I was very nervous at first to ride but was immediately comfortable with Nhien! The transportation in Saigon is organized chaos and you will quickly realize all of these girls are top notch drivers!!

- they video tape and photograph everything and email to you a few days later! You can relax and enjoy your time and don't have to worry about getting all of the photos you want - riding the bike, driving the bike (this one is faked LOL), eating, etc.

- all of the girls are unbelievably nice and accommodating - constantly smiling, making conversation, teaching you local games at dinner, cracking jokes, etc. As mentioned below in the cons, yes it can feel a bit rehearsed (and per another reviewer "over-organized") but I'd rather have this than a disorganized mess lacking a well thought out and cohesive plan.

- finally a tour that doesn't make you feel like you are being schlepped around like a tourist on a big bus with 50 other busses going to the same destination!!

- Some of the negative reviews complained about the "high" cost in comparison to the low prices on most items in Vietnam - but consider that these people are trying to make an honest and fair living so they can have a nice life and be comfortable. You want something dirt cheap? Take a look at how the people live who are able to offer you something dirt cheap - it is not a nice lifestyle. These girls work hard, are entertaining and bright (my driver was a Finance and Investment major!) and deserve a fair wage.

CONS

- some of the jokes and process feels a bit rehearsed - but hey, they do this every night so give them a break. And even if it is rehearsed, it's very well choreographed and has an outstanding cast.

A MUST do experience - The Foodie tour run by XO Tours is absolutely brilliant, this is the second time we gave been on it and I would recommend it to anyone.
I felt secure and safe the whole time we were on the tour, in traffic most would consider extreme ... We travelled with friends, one who hadn't been on a bike for 30 years, she had complete admiration for the tour and the girls afterwards and commented how comfortable she felt also.
The girls and whole team are great and I can't say enough about them, they make the experience what it is, and in case your concerned, they speak very good English.
Hieu, the tour guide, did an exceptional job and was very informative.

Also those of you who are a bit wary about eating the street prepared food, this tour definitely dispels those fears, well at least for the places they visit. The food is sensational. . . I've done this tour 5th center now and would do it again tomorrow.
We'll done Tung and the team.

Awesome Tour! Very Informative and fun. - I was in Saigon in early April. I went on two XO tours and they both were fantastic. They were fun, informative, and provided a fast affordable tour of Ho Chi Minh City. The Sights tour was excellent and the Foodie tour was a great value with many courses and beer! Delish! - The best way to see and taste the city! I loved every bite and would recommend XO for the unique experience.

As a solo traveler, I also enjoyed the opportunity to chat with other people on the tour. I can't recommend this enough. Don't miss out on this amazing experience!

Awesome tour of HCMC - This tour with professional and enthusiastic guides is a must. Tai the group leader keeps it all moving at a great pace as you see 5 different districts in the city and sample the local street food in places that you probably wouldn't normally visit. Vi, my driver was happy to chat about anything as she negotiated the evening traffic with grace and ease! At no point did I feel unsafe so there's nothing to worry about there. The trip lasted 5 hours and we were sorry that it ended. Great value as well. Do it - you will not be disappointed

My 2nd and 3rd tours with XO - Having previously done the Foodie in December 2013, on my next trip in March 2015 I booked them again. This time travelling with 3 others, we booked the Shopping for the morning and then Foodie for the same evening. 1 of the girls in our group pulled out of the Shopping tour that morning because of being unwell (epic hangover) and XO were fine with this. I phoned them from reception at the hotel that morning to ensure they didn't send the extra driver and waste her time.
The Shopping tour -
It was great. Our guide and drivers were all brilliant. We went to the sunglasses area, the shoes area, a market (where I picked up some kitchenwares), and the flower markets (my partner is a florist so wanted to check it all out), and at our request they took us to a monument/statue we had driven past and wanted to go back to. I can't fault any of the XO staff.
With this tour, just make sure you've thought about what you want to buy before you go, so that you can tell them first thing - they'll plan the day according to what you want to purchase. We had no idea!
The Foodie tour -
OMG. Nomnomnomnom. Delicious. We had this one filmed and the hungover member of our group made this tour (and kept it all down because it was that tasty). They knew they I had done the tour before so tried to mix the meals up. I also don't eat seafood so that mixed it up to start with. We only went to 1 venue that I had visited last time so I think they do change it regularly.
Everything is just so good. The best Bun Bo Hue I have ever had. The nightlife and being on the back of the scooter just adds to it.
USE THIS COMPANY!!!

GREAT WAY TO SEE SAIGON - We chose XO tours because of the great reviews on Tripadvisor. Our party of 4 adults and 1 child thoroughly enjoyed the scooter element of the tour and found it to be the best and most exhilarating way to see such a hot and bustling city as Saigon. Our drivers were lovely and very informative and were so caring with my 13 year old son, I only have the greatest praise for them and their amazing grasp of the English language. The Chinatown market was the highlight of the tour with so much to see you didn't know where to look. This said we all agreed that we wished we hadn't opted for the Foodie Tour as we also found that part of it a little contrived. We aren't the kind of people who go in for forced frivolity and we were constantly asked to pose for silly pictures and take part in the enforced Mot, Hai, Ba, Do! drinking game. This is not a criticism as such, I can see that most people enjoy this element of the trip. I just wish someone had warned us less jovial types that this would take place and we would have probably opted for the Sightseeing tour and given the Foodie a miss.

Foodie tour review - From start to finish the best experience in Ho Chi Minh City!
Communication via email including booking and additional questions was first class and responsive.
The actual experience, the fantastically professional young ladies were on time, impeccably presented and genuinely friendly throughout the evening. Tai was a great team leader giving good insight into the food and also background to HCMC.
Loan was my guide and was brilliant, not once were I or my group left to feel awkward. There was no 'up sell' or looking for tips like the rest of HCMC.
Worried about being on the back of a motorbike? These ladies are amazing riders, they are chosen for these skills and would put 99% of UK or European motorists to shame.
I cannot recommend this tour enough, fantastic. I would do it again if lucky enough to return.
Can't wait for the video and photos. Worth every Dong.

Foodie & City Tour in 24 hours! FANTASTIC - I was travelling to HCM for work and had 24 hours off in HCM city so thought as I love Vietnamese food, I would like to spend the evening scootering around sampling some REAL Vietnamese food and that I did with Xo tours. It was a really well designed tour which encapsulated the Vietnamese culture alongside some interesting facts about this wonderful city. The next morning, I took the city tour and once again was not disappointed. The tour guide and the girls were just fabulous, happy, helpful, informative and fun. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCM, next time I will bring the kids as from what I saw you could fit a whole family and their belongings on the back of a scooter!

So much Fun - Best city tours ever - I never liked organized city tour, where you may see a lot and receive a lot of information, but lack of experience.
When I had learned about the XO Motorbike tour and saw the photos and the smiling faces, I knew this must be fun.
At first I booked the City tour. It was sunshine, millions of motor bikes on the street as usual in Vietnam's cities, great precondition. The XO team leader made sure that we received interesting information about the city and it’s history, got a delicious drink, did some crazy jumps, and posed for the photos the camera man did, which should remind us later of all the fun we had. All drivers are female wearing a blue and white Vietnamese Ao Dai, which looks very sexy together with the helmet. My driver Vi is an excellent driver and and a very friendly person, I easily could trust her and felt just wonderful.
I was so excited about the first experience that I also did the Night Tour Saigon; same wonderful team, again best organized, same excellent driver, even more fun with special food, learning about Vietnamese eating habits, and a lot more information about living in the city.
These tours are a must do in Ho Chi Minh City. I had also asked for doing a video during the tour and can’t wait to see it. Thanks a lot to the team, you are great people.
Wilma, German, living in Yangon, Myanmar

Fantastic trip with the XO Girls... - From start to finish this trip was just perfect. All of the girls were so professional and i felt completely safe going round on the moped. It was a fantastci way to take in the sights of the city and see areas we probably would not have had the chance to see. The Market through China town was an amazing experience and like nothing i had ever seen before. The trip was informative with us stopping off in different areas and learning a bit of history along the way. The food was fantastic from the first stop of Soup with Prok Sausage and Chicken to the last stop with cocunut jelly!!!! We had goat, beef, frog (with and without skin), prawns, quail, clams, crab and of course a few of the group were brave enough to try the traditional Balut... If you're not a huge seafood fan they are happy to accomodate your needs and offer up something equally as tasty! Overall it was one of the best experiences i had in Vietnam. Thanks to all involved in XO Foodie tour...

Wake up and see Ho Chi Minh! - There is no better way to throw yourself in and experience Vietnam like a bike ride around the city on your first morning. We arrived late at night and had our tour booked to start at 9am the next day. After a quick breakfast at Pho 24 around the corner, we were met by our smiling guides at the front of our hotel. The tour was fantastic and great value. Even though I had been to Vietnam several times I still managed to see new things and I certainly learned a lot more. It was so much fun and certainly great for all ages. Only had to close my eyes a couple of times! The tour is so professional yet very personal to meet your needs. Hieu was a very knowledgeable guide with a wealth of knowledge to share. No other tour of the city compares, a MUST do.

Amazing experience - exciting, exciting, professional. - It seems redundant given their incredible reviews here, but I felt compelled to add that we thoroughly enjoyed our evening foodie tour. With two kids (6 and 3), we felt completely safe and taken care of. The kids had a blast, we had fun and the food was almost as exciting as whizzing around town on a scooter! Go do it, you won't regret it!
Loved it! - Thank you XO Tours for a great insight into Ho Chi Min! Loved the food and your very friendly and safe drivers! A great experience!

Over organized and contrived with less focus on food than anticipated - I did the foodie tour, clearly this tour suits many tourists but not me. Personally I am probably more of a "traveller" than a "tourist". I travel solo and enjoy doing day tours so that I get a taste of the city but also get a chance to mix with other people from around the world.
The XO food tour is really half tour, half food, I expected more of an emphasis on food. Having said that though, our first stop we indulged in a bowl of deliciousness - Bun Bo Hue, simply delicious. After that though it was just tastes of street food more than dishes and we only stopped at two other stops. Don't get me wrong I love street food, I just felt like there was something missing.

Each time we stopped we had to sit with the same 3 other tourists, with our motorbike riders on each side of us so we never had a chance to meet the other people in the tour group. At one stage I tried to go up the other end of the table, only to be told to come back because it was time for us to either "have a photo taken", "drink our drink together", "play a game with chopsticks", "be tricked with our dessert", "get on our bike in order so that we could have a photo together".
Whats wrong with letting us all sit together so that we can enjoy the food and get to hear other people's stories, with just a couple of guides to tell us what the food is?

Like I said this tour suits many people but not everyone.
XO, I am sorry that I didn't enjoy your tour but please respect my individual review and don't try to negate it with a negative response.

The best thing was to see Saigon. - Great experience, could have had rather more of the biking element in it though. The girls who drove us were knowledgeable and careful drivers., knew there stuff too....my son's only thought was that the bikes were underpowered! We both throughly enjoyed it.
Excellent tour - Did this tour 4/1/15 girls where great so friendly food was good all round great tour very safe for kids as well

Fab fab fab - Wow what a great night. The four of us were picked up at our hotel and set off exploring Ho Chi Minh on the back of a bike with our drivers all dressed in traditional Vietnamese costumes. All the girls spoke great English and were very informative, always smiling and joking on the way. So for the next 4.5 hours it was a constant, eating, drinking and chatting experience. Very highly recommended to all

Gotta do the "Foodie"! - We found XO Tours on line before our arrival in Saigon (HCMC) , and decide it sounded good .
At the risk of being redundant (most other reviews) it was much more than good !
My wife , having never been on a motorbike , and having observed Saigon traffic , was VERY apprehensive about this ; but within 5 minutes of our driver/guides , Ngoc and Ninh , picking us up at our hotel , she was into the experience , and loving it !
There were 16 of us on this tour , representing US , UK , Netherlands , Australia , Chile and Canada (us) . Lots of talk and laughter as we ate .
We visited 7 of the city's districts , including the most affluent (Dist. 7) , the least affluent (District 4) and Chinatown (where we drove through an amazing , vibrant street market). We ate in 4 of those districts , and had an endless supply of fresh , delicious Vietnamese food , not to mention unlimited quantities of beer .
The food included some dishes which were pretty exotic to our Canadian palates , such as goat , whole frog (skin on) and embryonic duck egg !
As well , there were soups , spring rolls (fresh and fried) , pork chicken and beef , LOTS of fruits and vegetables , giant prawns (eat the head !) … and , I'm sure , things I'm forgetting.
All in all , an unforgettable , highly recommended experience , and to cap it ,Tai dang , our entertaining tour leader tour leader sent us 9 photos as a souvenir of the experience .

Simply awesome - Awesome is the word if I have to describe it in one word. My husband, my 10 months old daughter n I had an amazing tour with XO girls n the tour leader. This is the tour I will definitely cherish all my life. We got picked up from our hotel by 2 beautiful girls and had a wonderful time. My daughter was taken care so well by them that I hardly felt any difficulty carrying her all the while. The best part was the variety of amazing food offered. It was so full of surprises and everything tasted absolutely delicious. If I visit Saigon again, I will definitely take a tour with them. Thank you XO for giving us such a wonderful memory.

An exhilarating night fueled by andrenaline and great food! - We were on the last leg of our fantastic Vietnam holiday and the XO tour was our last tour before leaving Vietnam. DO NOT LEAVE VIETNAM UNTIL YOU HAVE DONE THE XO TOUR!! You truly feel like a local whilst on the back of a motorbike in peak-hour traffic on dusk. We are a family of three and out of my husband, my 13 year old daughter and I - the most nervous, freaked award goes to... Yes me! This was before I met our wonderful female drivers. My driver, 'Hung' (sorry if I spell the name incorrectly) assure me she would drive as slowly as I like - or she could also 'drive really fast to shake the scared away'- as Hung put it. The girls explained some rules and ensured our helmets were securely fastened. As we took off, I really was contemplating a tuck and roll dismount off the back of the bike before we tackled the onslaught of peak hour traffic, but before I new it, Hung had me engaged in a conversation that I just couldn't rudely abandon. Talking to me constantly, I realized Hung was skilfully distracting me... and it worked! I was relaxed in no time, even looking back over my shoulder to see my daughter was traveling like a local - No hands!! OMG!! All three girls were very knowledgeable, kind and entertaining. We were taken through many districts of HCM City and would meet up with the rest of the group at various restaurants and eateries. This tour is very professional. They had about 4 body guards escorting us to ensure our safety. Tai was our guide at the restaurants and stops. He was fantastic. Tai arranged a special dinner for our daughter as she didn't eat prawns, even though there is so much food that she wouldn't have minded skipping a meal, but Tai insisted she did not go without. The food is varied and abundant. I could go on forever about this tour, but really I wrote this review to convince any other motorbike fearing mums that there is no need to be afraid. XO tours ensure you and your family are very safe and satisfied! The money is worth it!!
Annette, Darren & Charlie

Fantastic, exciting and not to be missed - What a great night...we did the night tour. After being picked up at our hotel we were taken to a central area and introduced to the tour guide Thu, she was excellent very friendly, good English and lost of interesting and funny information.
Our two drivers Khuyen and Tam (3) were fantastic, nothing was a problem or to much to ask.
As for the ride, for me it equates to a rollercoaster scary thrilling and so much fun. Anyone who goes to Vietnam needs to do an XO Tour.

One of the highlights of our 17 day tour of Vietnam. - My wife and I had a wonderful evening on the XO Tours evening "foodie tour". We were picked up on time by two wonderful motor scootered tour guides and the next 5 hours of eating, talking, and riding around the city of Saigon were fantastic. If you do get to Saigon (HCM) you owe it to yourself to book the Foodie Tour with XO. It will be one of the best parts of your entire Vietnam experience. That's a promise.

Marvelous food & very interesting tour - Loved this tour, so so good. Where to start!
Food - This was a great mix and off the beaten track for tourists after the first place where you get a very delicious noodle soup (not Pho!) originating from Hue. Then on to a locals BBQ place where a range of meats and prawns are prepared at the table for you by the girls. Finally into district 4 where some delicious sea food is served and for the adventurous, a duck embryo! This isn't pushed, just offered ;)
Tour - Hieu (our lead guide) was great, and introduced fun games with the other foodie guests and delivered some very interesting info on some of the areas of Saigon you wouldn't visit or even know about when visiting! From China town to the contrasting sector 7 and sector 4. Thanks Understanding!
The Drivers - great fun, darting round tiny market backstreets weaving through stalls and other bikes to feeling safe blasting along the main roads and negotiating junctions effortlessly. Also, it's really worth talking to your driver a lot on the way round, you can hear surprisingly well (as I'd not been on a bike before) and can learn a lot about there lives growing up in Vietnam which is interesting. It's nice having all your food prepared too, prawns pealed, crab claws cracked into. A big thank you to Binh and Nhun, a superb experience!!

Day Tour and Foodie Tour - I'm in HCMC for a few days for business and I had a free day to myself. I decided to book a couple tours and get acquainted with the city on my first day here.

I took the day sights tour and the night foodie tour. It was everything I expected from previous reviews. A very friendly scooter driver picks you up and brings you to a meeting spot where a tour guide shows you something and gives you some history and background information mixed in with some jokes to keep the fun energy going. You drive around some more and repeat. The best part is driving around town on the scooter with your experienced driver. I never felt like I was in danger. Great time.

Fantastic tour - This was my second visit to Saigon, and my second motorbike tour. XO Tours is heads and shoulders above the others. Our tour was well-conceived, well-curated, and the drivers/guides are awesome. On my prior tour, it was very poorly designed - the narration by the guide was terrible and full of political commentary, versus true history.

XO Tours' guide provides good insights, local color, and was careful not to inject personal opinions. The ladies who ride the scooters are actually secondary guides and offer their own fun information while navigating the wild streets of Saigon.

You can't take a trip to Saigon without going through the traffic on a motorbike. You certainly don't want to do with anyone other than XO Tours.

There is a good reason why this is No 1 in Saigon - We booked the "foodie tour" and had a fabulous time. The ladies who drove us around were very friendly and spoke excellent English. They sat with us while we were eating and we talked easily like new "old" friends. The food was mostly delicious and always interesting. Riding pillion on a scooter around Ho Chi Minh City is a thrilling experience and our drivers were competent and professional. The tour leader Ahn and the ladies gave us a lot of insightful information about the various districts we visited and we realized that HCMC is far more diverse than it seems on the surface. This was a really worthwhile experience and I thought it was excellent value for money.

What a way to end our trip! - This was our final evening in Saigon as we had to leave for the airport at 10.00 pm. We had a few hours to kill and X0 had been recommended by some other travelers so we booked on the 'Saigon by night'. It was totally brilliant!! The whole 3 hours were carefully planned, slickly executed and the best fun we'd had all trip. The girls are amazing - how can they speak such perfect English whilst hurtling (safely!!) through a city that boasts 9 million motorbikes?! It was so interesting to see so many different districts and we learned much more about the city and its people. Our only regret ... we couldn't do the full 'foodie' experience! We will definitely be back to do this one. Well done X0 - this is a total 'must' for all Saigon visitors.

Great introduction to HCMC on our first night! - We landed in HCMC at 11am and had our tour booked for 1630, after a power nap and shower we were out the door! Our guides were excellent, we felt so safe on the back of their bikes flying along the roads in HCMC dodging other bikes and cars! We met some great people on our the tour too and had great fun chatting over beer and food watching the world go by.
The evening food tour takes you through most districts and you try some great food, beef noodle soup, sea food, goat, and veggies and a few surprise dishes you can try too if you're brave enough!
We got a good insight into Vietnam, had such a laugh with the girls who drove us around and the tour leader was very informative and funny!
We also had some cool photos emailed to us from XO a few days after the tour! A nice finishing touch to a great tour! If you're not too sure if you should book - just do it!

Great way to see HCM - This was a really good way to see HCM and get a feel of the city on the back of a scooter. The best thing was the knowledgeable girls who are all so friendly and speak very good english.
The sightseeing tour was abit pricey for what it was, likewise for the foodie tour (although the foodie tour was a great experience overall as it was all u can eat and drink). So if u willing to spend abit more USD and have limited time, XO tours is a throughly enjoyable experience.

Simply fabulous - After having a bad bike accident and being close to 70 I was very nervous about getting on a bike.But I booked 2 tours for my daughter and myself and they were fantastic. We did the shopping tour and the city sights tour. On the shopping tour XO emailed me asking what we were looking to buy which is a great idea and I am pleased to say we shopped until we dropped.
Thank You XO tours for making an old lady very happy.
Alana and Lisa T

Tours 27th and 29th March 2015

Go, ride, eat! Can't recommend enough - a lot of fun. - My husband and I can't recommend these girls (and guys) enough, the night foodie street tour was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

We just had a ball whizzing around HCMC on the back of a moped, talking to a local about their lives and being shown delicious places to eat that are totally off the tourist trail in this enormous city, trying a variety of local food, drinking some beer and learning about the city and people in it. Our guides, Trinh and Thi, were superb drivers, making sure we were OK, chatting away about the districts we were visiting and teaching us little bits of Vietnamese, we both really enjoyed spending time with them.

He was a great tour leader; funny, informative and inclusive - he did a great job. I'm a vegetarian and separate food was organized for me, and it was all fabulous (and a lovely relief to not have to worry about eating meat at every meal).

The whole tour is organized unbelievably thoughtfully with plenty of photo opportunities organized by any and to keep the show on the road and there are a lot of funny, thoughtful touches (I won't ruin the surprise!) There are even outriders to make sure that everyone is safe and nothing happens.

Go, enjoy, eat!

Thank you XO!

We had a blast! - great night that goes super fast. the tour girls are great and the tour manager was excellent in providing advice and treating everyone like it was the first time.

highly recommended to try the foodie tour, but I am sure all of them are just as great

Highlight of our trip - I am late at writing this review but still had to let everyone know what a great experience this was. We took the city tour in the morning and the foodie tour that night. Both were great. The girls were prompt and super friendly! Being on the bikes in that famous traffic was exhilarating. So much fun and always felt very safe. The girls are pros. It was our first visit to Ho Chi Minh so the city tour was a great way to see the major points. Guide was very informative and interesting. They even provided a snack of local fruit and drink. Foodie tour was a fun way to see the city at night. Food was good and it was a great time. Food and drink were as much or little as you wanted. I highly recommend both tours and this company.

So much fun - Booked this activity thinking it looked fun, & my goodness it was!! We met the girls at Saigon Opera house, as our hotel was a little out of town. When i first got on the bike, i was absolutely petrified. A short 15 minute trip till our first stop & meet up with the group & i was getting used to it. Still shaking a little tho - that traffic - oh, my!!!
But, back on the bikes & off we went.
Fantastic night. Heaps of laughter & oh so much fun.
Would recommend to all - a not so normal activity - give it a go!!

A fantastic night tour of saigon by motorcycle - We had the best tour of Saigon by night on the back of a motorcycle. All the drivers are girls dressed in beautiful white Vietnamese traditional dress. There were 4 of us in our group and we traveled to the different districts of the city seeing the contrasts of such a huge city. Our drivers we're and careful in the busy traffic and also included was a delicious meal of local food.. The girls were very knowledgable, informative and had excellent English. I would recommend this tour as an ideal way to see the sights and learn about Vietnamese culture. By the end we felt as if we had made new friends and look forward to receiving the photos they took.

Most fun to be had on a motorbike! - Both the foodie and shopping tours were absolutely fabulous! All of our guides were super attentive and fun. I was a little skeptical about the safety of the motorbikes, but my fears were soon put at ease by our guides (who were all excellent drivers). I was so excited to go a bit out of the 'normal' tourist districts and try foods that I would have otherwise discounted. Thank you to Tai and the team for making our visit to HCMC so special, we will never forget it! :)

The only way to see Saigon - I did the Day time sights tour and the city night tour, Firstly the girls were very punctual when picking you up from your hotel.
When in Vietnam it is easy to look at the crazy street fight they call traffic and think being in the middle of all that on the back of a motorbike is just plain scary, But once you get into it on the back of an XO bike you feel 100% safe, My girls Thuong and Houng were excellent riders and navigated through the traffic without a problem, Such a fun day and night each stop holds a surprise and each site is explained to you in a fun going easy manner.
You get to see many sites that tourists just don't see, and get to make great friends too!
There is no other way to see Saigon..

Great way to experience Saigon - At first I was hesitant to book this tour, it seemed expensive and I was very nervous to be on the back of a scooter. However I am so glad I did, it was worth every penny! The food was delicious and abundant and the guide were great! In the end I didn't know if my belly was sore from eating too much or laughing too much. The foodie tour is a definite must!

Must do - On our recent visit to ho chi mihn we had the pleasure to do the food bike tour with xo tours I couldn't believe that I was on a bike in that traffic not only was it 100 percent safe it was one of the best things I've ever done taking you to places you would never would have been too and the food was amazing the girls the staff were excellent
Fabulous meals on wheels - A wonderful way to see Saigon on the back of a bike eating delicious food. Over four hours of fun weaving through the streets, So much fun.

A must do - What a fantastic night. Our 2 families, including 4 teenagers, had a great time on the foodie tour. The food was delicious, but not only that we got to see districts of HCM that as tourists we would not have ventured on to. The girls spoke excellent English, were informative and interesting and went out of their way to make sure we all had a great night. Kids had a ball and we all felt perfectly safe on the back of a scooter in the bustling HCM traffic. Drive through China town was an added bonus- so much to see, Can not recommend this tour highly enough. Thank you Khanh and girls.

Ex pirating Saigon - What a great way to experience the sights, streets & food of Saigon as you are escorted on motorbikes by the friendliest young ladies through the various & unique districts of this city. You can eat what you are comfortable eating. Just be comfortable with the mass of motorbikes traversing the streets & even sidewalks of the city.

A must do! - XO bike tour was a highlight of our stay in Ho Chin Min. A wonderful tour leader Huon who was a great motorbike driver and so informative. We learned so much and had great fun. Seeing the contrasts of the different districts was great.😃😃

All girl bike gang - loved it - With only a couple of days in Saigon we decided to do The Sights tour as an introduction to the city, and what a brilliant intro it was. My friend and I were picked up at our hotel by two of the girl bikers. You ride with the same one, and they kind of adopt you for the tour - they're really wonderful, taking any pics for you at the sites and offering refreshments.

We met others in the group at the Reunification Palace, as well as the guide who gave an overview of the tour and information about the palace. Our guide was very eloquent, informative and funny - offering just enough insight without it getting information heavy and tiresome.

Riding on the back of the bikes is an amazing experience - completely exhilarating and we never felt unsafe. All the riders are girls who wear the same uniform and they look like some wicked girl band - I loved the fact it was an all girl gang.

I felt time spent at each site was just long enough, and it was so nice to be offered drinks and fruit at the stops as refreshment. They also had a camera to take pictures, which I thought they'd try to flog us on a DVD for some mad price at the end of the trip, but instead they emailed them to you which was a very nice touch. I wish we had more time/money to do some of the other tours they provide!

Awesome foodie tour - great experience. Awesome night, with fantastic staff. Our host, Khanh Pham was great. Her English was great and she was friendly and informative. Our 4 girls who rode us around, were also great. We felt really safe. The tour took us too many districts, including a ride through the market. Very interesting. Our teenage kids loved it. Food different but tasty. Khan sent me photos of the night which was so nice. A must tour when staying in Ho Chi Minh City. Thanks XO xx

Shopping spree made easy! - XO tours is a wonderful tour experience. Our tour guides Loan and Kwin were very informative and full of information about the places we went. especially, Tay, who actually led us all over our shopping adventure. In the beginning we told them all the things we wanted to buy and by the end of the tour we successfully accomplished our shopping goals. The entire time riding on the motorbike I felt safe and comfortable. Overall I recommend them to anyone who wants to find all the shopping needs where all the locals shop for better prices and good deals.

Better than advertised! - We weren't exactly sure what to expect from the tour but the comments we had heard from other participants about their experiences were positive and the follow up from the head office was extremely professional. in the end, the entire evening exceeded our expectations in every respect. We saw parts of the city that we would have never visited otherwise. Of course what made the tour special was the work of the drivers/guides who were knowledgeable, friendly, fun and influential. Thanks to Tong and her team for a great evening! Highly recommended!!

Holiday Highlight - We went on the foodie tour on our first night in HCMC. We were both extremely apprehensive of the scooters and wary of being forced to eat weird things. However, It was absolutely wonderful.

The girls were brilliant from the moment that they greeted us at the hotel, Informative and fun. We both loved the scooter ride. The format and pace of the tour is spot on. Meeting as a group and having a briefing about where you are and what you are eating. Sitting and eating good food, being shown what the various accompaniments were and how to eat them, before another exhilarating ride to another wonderful location.

We cannot recommend highly enough. If you are in HCMC you must do this!

A fantastic way to see Saigon - My husband and I have just completed XO Foodies tour. It was so much fun. They introduced us to some unfamiliar areas of Saigon and to some unfamiliar foods. At all times we felt safe and secure.
I would highly recommend this tour for anyone heading to Saigon or for those of us who come to Vietnam regularly.

A great time! - I recently took the XO foodie tour with a friend while in Saigon. What a blast! Not only did we have the chance to taste some amazing local foods, but did so while touring the city by scooter - the only way to go! Would highly recommend this trip.

Great tour - Good time. Good company. Good vibes. You get more than just food on this tour.

I give 4 stars only because I was not 100% full at the end of the tour. However, i was by no means hungry and we had a great amount of food.
The manager seemed to really care about the quality of the tour and was very accomodating.

Unbelievably good....absolute must in Saigon - My wife booked the XO "Foodie" scooter tour around Saigon for our second evening in this fascinating city. Our family of four, mum, dad and two teenagers enjoyed an exhilarating ride around Saigon, discovering areas that you would not normally see. The hostesses (drivers) were extremely skilled and the management support team were there at every stop to interesting information and to ensure that each foodie location provided an outstanding display of real Vietnamese cuisine....the seafood and barbeque stops being our favorites. One plus we weren't expecting was the no limit eat and drink policy they have...absolutely no extras were charged nor were there any visits to tourist trap destinations where you are expected to buy "gifts". I cannot rate this tour highly enough, it was fabulous...

A Tour Like No Other - My son Jackson and I indulged in the Siagon by Night Tour led by Ning Ha. She made sure the tour was fun and informative with great food. The professional way the tour was conducted was a credit to the XO Tours. Our individual guides Ms Van and Ms Chi were a delight to travel with. They speak very good English and possess an abundance of knowledge. My 15 year old son and I had a sensational time. The other members of the tour all raved about how good the tour was. Most importantly we always feel safe in the hectic and erratic Siagon traffic. I will recommend this tour to anyone who will listen. I will also go on another trip with them when I return to Vietnam.

HCMC Night Tour - Arranged this tour with XO before leaving UK. I was a bit nervous having seen the traffic in Hanoi but was filled with trepidation on arrival in Saigon. I need not be worried. Two charming young ladies, Anh and Tam, picked us from our hotel and immediately put me at ease. They are very friendly and extremely competent. Soon I was zipping along pillion amidst a sea of ​​other motor scooters. We traveled through 7 districts of HCMC and were met at each one by a tour leader, Hieu. He provided us with an informative insight into Vietnamese culture and of the current economic changes taking place.

Thank you to everyone at OX for a most exhilarating experience.

sightseeing tour around Vietnam - We took an XO tours 'back of the bike tour' around Saigon. When we first arrived in Saigon.,we were discouraged of trying to cross the road amid the chaotic traffic. Two days later we were on the back of these scooters being driven around Saigon by two charming young ladies, Nhien and Thao. They collected us at our apartment, and drove us around visiting various sights. We had an English speaking tour guide who told interesting stories as well as furnishing us with historical details. She also took lots of photos and e mailed them to us later. We were provided with ice cold sugar syrup drinks English route and visited unusual places like the flower market. It made for a thoroughly enjoyable experience and well worth the money. We loved it so much that we are returning for a 'food tour' this week.

A must-try experience in Ho Chi Minh City! - Booked a night tour with my wife and myself during our 1st trip to HCMC after reading the many awesome reviews on Tripadvisor - and I must say the experience with XO tours was the highlight of our trip! We had great sights (places that were off the beaten tracks), wonderful food and most memorable of all, fantastic company! A big thanks to Thu (Tour Leader) and her guides for making our trip to HCMC a memorable one! Looking forward to visiting XO Tours again!

Make XO Tours your number one priority!!! - We did the "Foodie Tour" and it was truly a highlight of our trip. Our group of four was looked after by drivers Thuong, Ngan, Vu and Thanh and under the guidance of Tour Manager Tai who is very funny and was so informative at each stop. Having seen the traffic on arrival in HCMC I was a bit nervous but I can assure you that within seconds of being on the back of a scooter I had full confidence in my driver and had the time of my life. We were taken to some fantastic places which we would not have experienced otherwise and tried some of the best food...Do not eat before this tour - there is so much food!!! The whole night was so much fun with a lot of laughter - the staff were so enthusiastic and committed to making sure we enjoyed every minute. Be sure to book the video option (only one booking daily possible) for a small fee ... it is well worth every cent and we have loved sharing it with our family back home. We all arrived back at the hotel wishing we could do that all over again and certainly hope to have the opportunity of experiencing the services of XO Tours again.

Great night out! - We did the night time food tour on Sat 4th April. It was a fantastic night out! Traveled to several districts throughout the city. Riding pillion with our guides was a terrific way to experience the mayhem of Ho Chi Minh traffic! The young women who were our guides (Whien & Trang2) were very knowledgeable and helpful, giving vey interesting information about the districts and the city as a whole as well as lots of information about the food we ate. We tried a variety of different foods including goat, frog, crab, scallops. The tour leader Hieu was also very informative about the social & cultural nature of the various districts. Although the tour is somewhat pricey, we thought it was great value for money & a wonderful way to see parts of the city we wouldn't have experienced by ourselves. Highly recommend this tour to any one interested in food &/or the social/cultural life of Ho Chi Minh City.

Night Tour - Booked the night tour before leaving Australia, luck y I did, the tour was fabulous my guide Thuy Nguyen was great heaps of information and very good bike rider. we were supplied with dinner, and everywhere we went we were followed by a security guy on another bike, not that he was needed but he made sure we weren't angry by street vendor etc.
I tried the next day to try and book a shopping tour but they were fully booked for the next 3 weeks, so book before you leave home.
Don't miss doing these tours they are the best way to see Saigon, very well priced, do it.
Amazing! - Great experience. Very knowledgeable guides/drivers - Thu was our tour leader and she was great! Best way to see the city.

Great old - We did the foodie tour and it was thoroughly enjoyable. Food is excellent and all the guides speak English very well. Being among the mad traffic of HCMC is a thrill and I loved it that we visited many districts other than District 1. It is very professionally run, and while it is quite an expensive tour, we thought it was well worth the money

Wonderful wonderful wonderful! - XO tours are expensive but worth the price as they are flawlessly professional and really organized. We did the motor cycle city tour! Wow- what fun this was. We only had a couple of days in the city and this was a great way to see the best parts! You ride on the back of the mopeds and the guide has photos and an iPad with visuals to inform you of the history of each place. All of the tour guides speak excellent English. One of my highlights were the extras- we got to drink sugar cane juice on the back of the bikes and eat fresh fruit from the markets that we drove through! The girls also gave me shopping advice too. Well worth the 80 dollars for the experience if you are only in the city for a short while! XO tours- we will use your company again and recommend to anyone coming to Vietnam! Thanks so much :)

Great way to see HCMC - My husband &I did this tour last week. We Really enjoyed it .It was a great way to see the sights,the girls picked us up from the hotel rIght on time & we felt safe at all times.we also had a young guy as our tour guide for each stop he was extremely informative. I Would definitely recommend this tour
Definitely do it - Had a great time, saw a lot of famous sights. The drivers were very friendly and communicate well. Tip: PayPal a day ahead of time.

The best ever - Ok we were very apprehensive about doing this tour as we have a 10 year old son and had nearly given ourself heart failure just crossing the road ! Our 3 young ladies picked up from our hotel the next morning and went thro safety procedures , then off we went ! The girls put as at ease and we loved every second , our son thought it was awesome ! We saw the sights and tried sugar cane juice , fruits and made new friends - our guide Tai was very friendly and if you feel nervous there are body guards who accompany the group - it's exciting - stop reading this and book , you'll not regret it ! We want to do it again!!!

A MUST DO - Fun, fun, fun. Great food, great night, fantastic guides and the highlight of our visit to Saigon. We did the food trip and we are difficult eaters - but not a problem for this group. I don't eat meat, pork, chicken and my husband the same, but add no onion, garlic, chilli or dairy - but the girls looked after us amazingly well and we had probably the best food experience of our 2 weeks in Vietnam! The girls really look after you so well, not to mention their riding skills in the hectic traffic. We couldn't stop smiling! Do yourself a favor and don't miss this wonderful experience.

Fun, informative and tasty tour - I booked this tour on the advice of a colleague who did the tour a year ago, and I am glad I did. A most enjoyable experience. The tour company was very professional; driver arrived on time and provided a safe and informative tour. Besides the wonderful opportunity to sample a wide variety of interesting and tasty food, the tour included stops at locations in throughout the city,and short talks about the history and culture of the various districts in the city I saw places I would never had had the opportunity to see. My driver was a delightful young lady-- smart, witty, she spoke excellent English, and she was a most entertaining and gracious hostess. I couldn't recommend this more highly, and if I get back to Ho Chi Minh City, I would definitely do this tour again.

One fabulous night in HCMC - I was in HCMC on my own and wanted to see a bit of the city but was hesitant about wandering about on my own at night. The positive reviews for XO Tours drew me in - having all female drivers is a great marketing hook for solo travellers - and I booked for the foodie tour. On the day of the tour, I nearly talked myself out of it but I am so glad that I didn't.

Huang arrived promptly to collect me from my hotel. I've never been on a scooter before so I was a little nervous but she was very reassuring. The traffic in HCMC is crazy and at first you feel like there are no road rules at all but gradually you realise that everyone is following some some of code. Huang was a very safe driver and she gave me interesting insights into the areas we travelled through as we rode along. She also took me back to my hotel at the end of the tour.

Anh was our host for the evening and he was friendly and informative. The food that we had was lovely and there was no pressure to eat the more out of the way items (frog!) that were available for the more adventurous - I ate soup, scallops, clams, shrimp, quail, pork, and beef. Beer was served as well as soft drinks and tea.

The others on the food tour (8 of us in total) were really warm and friendly people. We were a diverse group - from US, Australia, UK and Sweden - but everyone was relaxed, happy and all seemed to have a great time.

A couple of days after the tour, the photographs taken by Anh through the evening appeared in my inbox which was a really nice reminder of a fun night out.

PS I would also have booked for the shopping tour but this has a 2 person minimum - I think XO Tours should allow single travellers to sign-up their interest and if anyone else in the same position does the same to be able to take this tour :)
Amazing tour! Well worth booking - Very professional and informative your! Girls were lovely and the food was incredible. Amazing experience not to be missed ;)

A must do tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh City - We booked this tour based on the trip advisor reviews and we were not disappointed, I think the reviews speak for themselves. We were promptly collected from our hotel by our two lady drivers Ngan '3' and Vu we instantly connected and had fun. Both ladies were very safe drivers. We booked the 'foodie' tour and both Ngan and Vu made the experience of eating new food enjoyable, even teaching us how to perfect our chopstick skills! We were also guided around the numerous different districts (poor and rich) by our tour leader Hieu Nguyen who was very knowledgeable about each area. Its fair to say we never would have seen the diversity of the city if we hadn't been on this tour. All of our hosts speak very good English. Thank you XO tours for a fantastic night.
In short book this tour and you wont be disappointed.

Food Tour was the Highlight of Vietnam Holiday - Just like every other review on written here- not much more to add than this is a superb night out. Went with my brother Kev & we just had the best time ever. The main reason I am writing the review is that I wanted to feed back to XO tours how lovely & charming my driver & guide was on the night. Her name was My (I think it is pronounced "Me") I hope that I have the spelling right.
Thanks again for a magnificent evening it was so good that I recommended it highly to a Canadian couple staying at the White 2 hotel, I really hope that they had as good a night as we did.

SERIOUSLY, JUST DO THIS TOUR!! - My wife and myself absolutely loved the XO Foodies Tour. The ride on the back of the scooter in the chaotic Vietnamese traffic was worth the price alone!! having said that the girls are experienced riders so you also feel quite safe. While riding you can chat with your driver and get the lowdown on anything you need to know about Saigon.The food is interesting and delicious, the beer is abundant and the guide Anh (or Bill) is very entertaining with his local knowledge and quirky sense of humor. A special thanks to my driver Huong who was charismatic and a pleasure to ride with. Make this one of your priorities when in Saigon.

Best Way to Sightsee and Save Money - A lot has already been said in other reviews about how great this tour company is so I'll be brief.

We visited Ho Chi Minh City for just one day so we wanted to see as much as we could. We booked our tour with XO online and they emailed us promptly so find out what kind of tour we wanted: sightseeing, food, or shopping. We went with shopping and they asked us specifically what we were interested in buying. When they picked us up, our tour guide had our list of what we wanted to shop for and had already determined the best places to go for those items.

Both of our drivers were super sweet and smart and safe (although a few intersections were terrifying) and would answer any questions we had. Our tour guide was very knowledgable about the city and took us to shopping places where he knew we wouldn't get ripped off. He also negotiated really great prices for us on dresses and luggage. I know we would have paid a lot more if we had just gone to the regular touristy shops.

Our experience was just perfect. I can't wait to do it again, Next time we go, we'll do a food tour.

XO Tours Saigon - This tour was recommended to us by a couple we met in Hanoi.We weren't disappointed
we have never been on motorbikes before.The Girls were amazing soooooo much fun,plus
lots of information about each district.We are vegetarian and they had amazing food for us.
Would recommend this tour for all ages over 16.would give *****

Great Fun - My wife and I did the sight seeing tour - it was a great way to see the city and get a real understanding of what it's like to drive through this crazy city!! The girls were fantastic, extremely engaging, informative and fun to be with. Highly recommended.

An amazing evening ... & learned a lot about Vietnam - We had real fun & saw bits of the city that we would have missed otherwise. The girls were great and very safe. We would definitely recommend you did this tour.

Absolutely awesome tour! - I saw this on trip advisor and so my husband and I booked the half day city tour. The booking was easy to do over the phone and confirmed by email. Two lovely ladies in very cute local dresses picked us up from our hotel on time and were extremely smiley and welcoming.
The two girls were an absolute pleasure to spend time zipping through the city with chatting and laughing, taking it all in. We made many stops to some key attractions but never too long which was great because sometimes tours can become so boring with too much detail and time spent at fewer places. The guide was very witty and knowledgeable too. We took some excellent selfies and pics at the key sights. There was also some really fun bits sipping ice cold strawberry flavored cane sugar juice whilst zipping between locations. A lovely day out and would highly recommend experiencing the city in this way riding pillion with this great team.

Great fun, great insight into Ho Chi Minh - We lived our first tour so much that we booked a second one the next day.
We took part in the sights tour and the foodie tour.
Both were well organized and informative, without being overloaded with sometimes useless information. We saw the sights and we were given a locals perspective on life and times in Ho Chi Minh.
The pace was great.the foodie tour was excellent(known as the fattie tour,because you get fed so much food)
Our brief was to be apart of locals life,see historically and culturally what was important,but don't get stuck in the tour bus.
I would highly recommend doing any tour that xo tours does.
When I come back to Ho Chi Minh, I will definitely use them.
Loved it

XO TOURS WITH YOUNG KID'S! !!! - My daughter's 7 and 5 years old give xo tours one million star's. . they want to go on another tour now! .. my husband and I have now done 4 tours with this company since 2012.. my children's first...not once did I feel unsafe and I had no worries or concerns for my girls safety.. we had a custom tour and had it filmed, for a small extra well worth it cost .... we tried some local food included in the price and we're taken to a few different places of historical and daily life value. ..don't even think twice book a tour you are treated wonderfully you have an amazing experience your children are in excellent hands!.. I can't seem to find the card with our tour guides names on it.. we remember your names but for the life of me don't know how to spell them.(sorry) ..you know who you are!!!!.. thank you for looking after us.. xxx

Soooo much FUN - This was the best adventure! Two young women picked us up on scooters and took us to the meeting place. We meet the others, have some yummy noodle soup and then off in rush hour traffic with our guides. Crazy fun! They take you to different districts. We ate goat, chicken, beef, okra, frog, quail , clams, crab, prawns.... All sorts of yummy things. They treat you like royalty , speak beautiful English! Highly recommend. Do not miss this if you like a little excitement and finding out more about Saigon and book in advance! Cheers!

Excellent - We did both the shopping tour and the foodie tour. What a wonderful way to see and experience Ho Chi Minh City. The guides were brilliant. The food is amazing. Fun times and great memories created by all. Highly recommended

What a night! - My wife and I are "old"--in our 60's. When we travel, the prime activity is eating locally. We were in HCMC for 2 days as part of a cruise itinerary and found XO tours online before we left the US. My main motivation in writing this review is to encourage people to take the chance and go on this tour. Sure, scooters can be a risk and HCMC has 5 million of them. Don't let that cause you to miss this best foodie experience you can have. Our 'pilots' were charming and really professional drivers. Between the eating experiences, we went all over the city with the 'pilots' giving a play by play over the shoulder as we rode. The food was great, the XO staff enthusiastic and the experience just wonderful. We were even picked up and dropped off.

Great tour, ladies, thank you! - This city sights tour was recommended to us and with such great reviews we had to give it a go. The girls are excellent drivers of the scooters and you always feel very secure with them. As a pedestrian I determined that these drivers obeyed no road rules however when you go on this tour you realize that they all operate under some set of principles which is why they don't have too many accidents.
It really is a great way to see the major city sites and avoids the on/off bus issues. You feel like you get some fresh air, well as fresh as it can be in HCMC!
A lovely experience for both myself and wife, many thanks.

Zip through HCM - Being 2 women touring SE Asia, I was really drawn to the fact the moto drivers were all women. The trip more then met my expectations. The tour itself was given by a very knowledgable (and funny!) guy - Anh. He had the right combo of historical information without bogging you down in all the textbook details and humor. The ladies who drove us around were kind, informative and super cute. Thank you so much Trong, I had a blast!! The only negative is we weren't in HCM long enough to do the evening food tour too!

Amazing experience - My wife and I did the night foodie tour on Monday March 16, we were collected promptly from our hotel my our two young female drivers, from the beginning the whole experience was great, the tour leader was very knowledable, the food was amazing and the ride on the bikes a truly great experience. We did lots of great things on our recent trip to Cambodia and Vietnam but this is truly a highlight and we highly recommend going on this tour, 5 hours of fun, laughs and great service, an amazing way to see Ho Chi Minh!

Highlight of the holiday - Just arrived back in the UK and on reflection of our time in Vietnam this has to be the highlight.
We read the reviews on this before we booked and thought we'd give it a go and were not disappointed!
All involved in the tour from the tour leader, the drivers and the out riders, could not do enough for us, we were looked after throughout. As well as trying out more dishes than I can remember you were constantly given information about the areas you were eating in and Ho Chi Minh and Vietnam as a whole. There was a good range of food provided - meat, seafood and vegetarian options and we were given the opportunity to try some local delicacies but these were optional.
We paid the extra for the DVD and cannot wait to receive it.
We had a fantastic time and would strongly recommend this to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh

Excellent! - ok firstly with a review rating of 1900+ excellent, its really just excellent. There is really nothing else to say but other than its an excellent tour, awesome guides, lots of fun, and fair pricing. We did the day time sight seeing tour. Took us to all the main sites, told us lots of information, provided us with drinks. The only place they didn't take us was the war museum, but thats because it requires a lot of time to go through and cant be squished into the tour packages.

The only minor thing is maybe they should provide masks as well as helmets during motorcycle ride.

Excellent tour of the city! - Excellent tour of the city! The guides were very knowledgeable and friendly. My husband booked this city tour and I was absolutely disenchanted. The guides take safety seriously and provide you with a helmet and instructions before you get on the motorbike.

We did the city tour, which lasted 2.5 hours. XO Tours picked us up from our hotel and we joined the other participants in the ciyt center.

Highly recommend this tour if you are staying in HCMC for a short while or if you want to see the highlights in just a few hours. Khanh Pham was our tour leader and very knowledgeable. She took the time to explain the historical significance of all of the sites we visited and also arranged a snack. Good value for the price. Highly reccommend XO!

Superb way to tour - One of the best ways to tour around Ho Chi Minh city using motorbike. All their drivers are females. Do not have to worry about these drivers for they are experienced and careful drivers as proven by the tours that I take (The Sights(morning tour) and Saigon by Night(night tour). You will see Ho Chi Minh city by day and night. Both tours are on slightly different routes.

The drivers that fetch me are Hoang and Loan respectively. They are knowledgeable in their work and are able to give you insights of the various districts that the tours cover. Any questions along the routes through various districts in Ho Chi Minh will be gladly answered by them except theirs). history on the place of interests given by the tour guides, Aah Pham and Tai Dang before starting of the tour.

You will get to visit a lot of places where you will not get to see by using other means of transportation than motorbikes. So it will be advised to remember the places of interest that you may want to visit later on since these two tours that I take will not stop at any one place for too long. Anyway the drivers will be very willing to recommend and will also advise you on any places of interest that you would like to visit Hoang who is ever willing to assist.

I enjoy these tours and will recommend that you give XO Tours a try and you will never regret the experience.

Brilliant! - I can only add to all the previous reviews, this was an absolutely fabulous trip. you get to see so much more of the city. The food was delicious, and the tour was very well planned.
I would definitely reccommend this tour, we loved it!

Awesome experience, you HAVE to do it - After reading so many positive reviews we decided to give it a try and let me tell you...it deserves every point in the maximum score. We took the foodie tour which took you in awesome motorbikes around various districts of HCMC exploring different tastes and trivia of the places you visited. Although we were a couple, interesting is also the fact that you get to know people from other countries that are also taking the tour with you and as the girl that drives the motorbike is always by your side explaining what you are eating and how to eat it, you could easily take the tour by yourself and would still be a very fun and awesome experience.

While at first the idea of ​​motorbikes sounded dangerous (as you look at the chaos of motorbikes on the streets), 1 minute on the motorbike was enough to notice the expertise and simpathy of the drivers and made it simply the best choice and the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We liked it so much that 2 days later we took the sight seeing tour. You will not regret this and will wish you had more time to do it again.

In trdible - The most incredible experience. Absolutely faultless. Guides are fun, knowledgeable and safe drivers. Truly authentic places
Visited and extraordinary food eaten. Opportunity to try adventurous dishes but most are very 'safe' for conservative eaters whilst still delicious. Incorporates some local information which enhances
Experience. Unmissable.

SUPER Experience! TOTALLY great! - We booked the evening foodie tour - 4.5 hours, 8 stops - 4 for food, 4 for little talks about the neighborhoods. We paid about $250 - $70 apiece for three of us, plus $35 for a video of our tour. We had an ABSOLUTE BLAST! The girls are very sweet and engaging, the food stops are fun and the food is great, it is just so exciting to ride around in Saigon's swirling motorbike traffic. We visited Saigon, Siem Reap, and Hanoi, and this was one of the very TOP highlights of our trip! The cost is so very worth it, and the video is a great memory - I STRONGLY recommend that you purchase the video - the videographer follows you and films you throughout, then they splice together the best bits - so worth it. DO NOT MISS THIS TOUR!

Fantastic tour - Did the foodie evening tour. Was as all the reviews state, fantastic. The girls and guys from XO are excellent and made the trip very special. Loved the bikes, don't be scared, it feels very safe. Had so much fun!

Yes, Absolutely Deserves this Rating - We have all seen some rather dubious local tour offers and tourist traps get very high marks from time to time on TA. Have no fear with XO, this is indeed a fabulous tour and worth every penny. You will see so much of the city and learn so much in a fun and exhilarating venue (once you ease into the frenzy of traffic and thousands of scooters hither and yon). We did the twilight tour for $40 per person. It lasted 3 hours and although not a huge variety of foods, enough that we had no need for dinner. Loved the places we ate. Suggest you book early to get the tour you want. The ladies who buzz you around on the back seats of their scooters are gracious with a sweet Asian sense of humor. The best three hours of our wonderful short three-day stay in HCMC.

The Incredible Experience - We went on a food tour on our last evening in SE Asia, and I could not recommend this experience more highly. The young ladies that picked you up at your Hotel were prompt, safe and extremely friendly. They were conversational and this gives you an opportunity to learn more about local life. The food and informational stops were both memorable. If you book this tour you will not be sorry. This was a real highlight of our trip!!

A Must Do in HCMC! - Travel through the infamous traffic of Vietnam where everything goes. It's a harrowing experience for those who are used to traffic lights and lanes but you get to travel HCMC in the way the locals do.

The guides were fantastic. Each person has a really bubbly guide who will make you immediately comfortable with them. They are really passionate about what they do and there's always a smile on their face. There's also a tour leader and two bouncers to make sure everyone is safe. They even take photos for you so you don't have to worry about dropping your camera while riding. Then again, you really should not take your camera out while riding pillion.

We went for the Saigon by Night tour and it was an opportunity to see how diverse and different the city is. You'll get to visit places most people don't get to, all while riding pillion and grabbing onto the back of your seat. It made me realise how complex HCMC is but also appreciated how diverse it has become.

There's also a foodie tour if eating is your thing. But in any case, I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC for the first time. Word of caution though, unless you really like the sun, it might be better to go for the evening tours. It can also get quite chilly at night, especially when you're travelling on the motorcycle.

Don't say why, say why not!!!!! - XO Tours are 10 stars out of 5, all of the XO staff I dealt with were fantastic I can't speak highly enough of them. We did the night tour with Ning and Quynh and the day tour with Anh, Thuy and Vu. They all were an absolute delight to spend time with their happy and cheerful personalities along with excellent english and knowledge was second to none. I walked away feeling like i had made friends for life.
XO Tours is not to be missed.

Just give a call to the hotline and I think will be enough for this service ! - Hey,
I just call the hotline to get more information and the guy who's answer was damn cold. I saw many reviews, all was the same, nice girls to show the city, bla bla bla. But the guy from the hotline need to be replace asap ! I didn't make the tour yet, it could have be fun but after this call, I won't book any tour !

Wow just Wow!! - This is something that if you get a chance to do it, do not hesitate.We did the nighttime foodie tour. It was probably the most memorable thing,along with a cruise on Halong Bay that we did in Vietnam.The two girls Trinh2 and Loan arrived at our hotel at 5.30 pm.We were in our mid sixties and had never been on a scooter before,so were a little nervous,they went through some safety things with us and off we went,talk about safe riders,they were fantastic,they were also beautiful people and had us laughing very quickly on our tour.The food along the many stops was very fresh and you get to try a huge variety,most we ate,couple we did not,the girls kept us entertained and cooked some of the food for us,plenty of cold beer as well.The tour manager Anh was also very friendly and the also have security guys following you as you ride along.Thank you XO tours for giving us memories that will last a lifetime.Thank you Trinh2 and Loan for keeping us safe,well fed and laughing,you are a credit to your company.We had our tour video'd and the result was fantastic.

The best tour we've ever done - Booked this tour last minute after deciding to stop in Saigon. The girls arrived at our hotel to pick my partner and I up and immediately we were all good friends. The foodie trip consists of 5 food stops with sightseeing in between. The food was amazing at every stop and included Vietnamese specialties which we would not of tried usually but we're amazing. The girls even prepare the various meats and seafood for you to eat. We were also taken to districts which tourists don't usually visit and we're given all the information we asked for in a perfect English response. The trips between spots were also amazing being on the back of a motorbike while getting to know your driver. If possible request to have nganh3 or van as your drivers as they were amazing girls and very funny. We will be doing it again next time round.

FUN! FUN! FUN! - This was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam....prebooked the trip before we left and
everything went flawlessly from our pickup at our hotel to the drop off 5 hrs. later. We were
met by Hee and Vu and were driven through many districts of Saigon for the sights and food for a total of 5-6 stops. The food was very good (I eat just about everything) and they made a huge effort for people who were vegetarian or had certain dislikes or allergies. I almost enjoyed the scooter ride as much as the food. The evening was a lot of fun and we both enjoyed it a lot! Our trip coordinator, Khahn Pham was also a kick , had made the experience informative and fun.

A delicious way to see HCMC! - I went on the Foodie Tour and had a fabulous experience - the guides were knowledgable and friendly, and very capable drivers in the incredible luck of HCMC traffic. It was my first time on a motorcycle and I felt safe in the midst of all the chaos, and was able to relax enough to enjoy the ride and all the sights, sounds and smells of night time street markets and local neighborhoods. The manager (Tai) provided informative commentary on the food and the different districts off the beaten track we visited. There was an abundance and wide variety of food which was fresh and flavoursome. Highly recommend.

Perfect Night Tour - If u want to see other Parts of the city and not only the tourist places, then this is for you! The drivers are really friendly, they answer all your questions, tell you a lot about each district and the ride is also very safe, don't worry. Totally worth it!
Keep on rocking girls!

Excellent way to get involved in the Mayhem! - We pre-booked the Night Tour in advance from the UK. and everything was faultless. We were met at reception in our hotel and whisked away on the most enjoyable trip of our stay in Ho Chi Minh. The girls in their traditional dress are the most charming (and cheeky) 'hosts' imaginable. We were taken around the various districts of the city and given enough but not too much information. It was as if you were being guided by a friend you had known for years very personal lots of chat about the tour and on a more personal level. I got to know that motorbikes can turn right on a red light in the city which probably saved my life! This was a truly memorable tour we only wish we had been staying another night as we would certainly have booked up for their Foodie tour. Finally don't worry about safety it is amazing the way they weave through the traffic and great to be part of the mayhem

Great fun, great learning experience - Not sure which tour I did, maybe Saigon by Night?! We were taken on the backs of scooters to several districts, learned about what made them distinctive and interesting, and had some great food along the way. Best thing was my driver/guide whose name I am sorry to say I have lost (Thu? Sounded like Two!), who was lovely, a very good and safe rider, and had a great sense of humour. Among the districts we visited was district 4, a poorer part of town that I would not ordinarily have visited, but I went back there a couple of days later to try some fantastic seafood at one of the street restaurants, and it was not only delicious but a unique experience as no one spoke English and tourists were nowhere to be seen.

Number One for Sheer Fun - Of all the amazing adventures we've had in SE Asia, XO's Foodie Tour ranks number one for sheer fun - not to mention delicious food. We would never have found these restaurants ourselves, and apart from Freedomland on Phu Quoc Island, this was the best food we had during 5 weeks in Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam. The girls driving are very professional (felt safe on the motorbikes the entire time) and charming to boot. Don't miss this tour.

Excellent way to spend a morning in this crazy city - My husband and I chose this tour based on TA reviews and weren't disappointed. Our 'drivers' met us at the hotel on time at 8.55am and gave us some safety instructions... With a good dose of friendliness and humour 😃 and off we went to meet the rest of our tour group at the General Post Office (1st stop). There were 6 in our group in total and every person had their own personal motorbike driver. All the drivers were really skilful and friendly, I felt like I was just on the back of a good friends bike... Very chilled out. Hieu (the main tour guide) was really knowledgeable, easy going and set a lovely pace for the tour. He spoke exceptional English was happy to take plenty of photos. I wasn't expecting the sugar cane juice stop, which was a beautiful surprise (not as sweet as you think it might be). I think this tour is well worth the money and I would definitely recommend it.
