We would definitely do it again.
Awesome night tour! - Superb night tour of HCMC with XO Tours! Great fun, great driver, interesting tour and good food all for a good price - book now!!

The best foodie tour advenure in Saigon - There are many foodie tour companies in Saigon but XO tour is definitely the best of all! The tour ,,girl" drivers will take you & your assigned group to different Saigon's areas where you will go by yourself. You don't need to be scared as you are accompanied by a group of guys ,,bodyguards" to ensure the security of the tour. The tour last for 3.5 hrs. Regarding the food you will be stopping on 3 stations (you will taste pho soup first, barbeque meat & seafood at the end) where are unlimited drinks (water, local beer & coke) included. All girl drivers speak perfectly English and I definitely book this tour again for my parents!

Food Tour Feb 2015 - My wife and i took the foodie tour February 26, 2015. We were picked up by two ladies who were excellent bike drivers and spoke English very well. We had a great time, the food was very good and the sightseeing at night through the streets on the back of a scooter was even better. We will take this tour again and have already recommended it during our tour through Vietnam.

Amazing cultural experience - From the beginning of booking the tour and to the finish, this adventure did not fail to impress. It really helped give us a great memory with our visitors from Australia!

The booking manager was very accommodating with my hours as I couldn't get to a 5:20 start for a group tour due to babysitting arrangements, and he helped us onto a private tour that started at 6pm at no extra charge. Also, being expats we got a 10% discount. We also organized a videographer (you must book this advance as they are limited to two a day).

The night was amazing. The tour guides who are all female spoke impeccable English, knew their culture and shared it well. The food was also a great cultural experience (you can specify food allergies/types and you are not forced to eat what you don't want to eat).

We were impressed that we were taken through about four districts that we as locals would probably never have seen. The Work Health Safety of the drivers and driving were also wonderful. You can also put your bag in a storage compartment under you in the bike seat so no fear of theft by other oncoming drivers!

We also received our photos from the evening a day later and they were great. No need to take a camera and you can focus on immersing yourself in the experience. We haven't received the video yet but I'm sure it will be a hoot and a great memory souvenir!

I was also happy that there was not much drinking involved in this tour. Don't get me wrong, beers etc. are fun but if you want to fully experience a cultural 'foody' experience this is it!

Sightseeing city tour 3 hours - Great sightseeing tour with the xo girls and the guide. The concept is great. You get picked up by a friendly and nice xo girl at your hotel. You meet other travelers. The guide explains everything with a lot of gear details. You drive on the back of the scooter to the next sightseeing and so on. They really take care of you and it's a great experience! Do it! The girls are really friendly and very chatty.

The Only Way to See Saigon! - Excellent tour and fantastic experience. We had wondered for a fortnight what it would be like to ride in the mad Vietnamese traffic and now we know! It was great fun and really interesting, Our drivers were charming and chatty and our guide was knowledgeable, informative and entertaining. It was just a shame that it was our last day or we would have done one of the other tours as well. The sugar cane juice (consumed while tearing through the streets!) and fruit was a nice touch and the photos that the guide took are a really nice souvenir of the day. One of the highlights of our trip.

Same adventure - Wow this was awesome. The girls were fantastic friendly informative and great riders. I was very apprehensive to get on a bike in this crazy city. The food was diverse without giving anything away TRY everything has a go. It's hard but leaves a bit in the tank for the final destination. This is definitely a must on your trip to this crazy paced city. Thanks again for the birthday cake special 50th celebration.

The BEST activity in Ho Chi Minh City! - I took two motorbike tours through XO, The Foodie Tour and The City-Day Tour. I was impressed with XO Tours before I even left on my vacation to Vietnam. I was a solo traveler on this trip, so I wanted to book myself on as many motorbike tours as possible. After I paid for my tours online, I received an email from XO letting me know that two of the tours I booked were very similar and that I should only do one or the other. Excellent customer service!

The Foodie Tour was amazing. I absolutely loved riding around on the back of the scooter, just like a local. I always felt very safe, and my driver/personal tour guide was very chatty with me as we drove around the city between food stops. The girls speak very good English, I you can tell they have been trained to interact with their passengers in a way that makes you feel like they are really happy to have you sitting behind them. The group of guides and the tour leader, who didn't have a passenger, had activities planned at each stop that really got all the group involved with one another. I especially liked the chop stick showdown at the street BBQ. The food offerings on the Foodie tour were authentic, local cuisine prepared the local way. There's enough "normal" food offered at each stop to fill you up, but I highly recommend trying the local fare such as grilled frog. If nothing else, it's something you can say you've tried! And go for the duck eggs.

The City-Day tour was also excellent. Again, your personal scooter driver answered questions along the drive and offered interesting comments as appropriate. The tour was fabulous.

XO Tours is the best way to see HCMC for any age. I highly recommend it and I will definitely book more tours with them any chance I get.

My only negative comment would be that XO Tours doesn't offer their Shopping Tour to solo travelers. You have to book at least two people on the tour, no exceptions. Since I really wanted to find the best fabric shops in HCMC, I was left to do the best I could on my own. I know it would have been a lot more fun and I would have gotten much better deals had I been with an XO guide.

Just Amazing! - If you go to Saigon, do not miss the XO Tours, Foodie Tour.

What's not to like? Motor scooter adventure in the insanity of Saigon's traffic, great tour guides, an abundance of amazing food, off the beaten path locations and facts, Tiger Beer with ice, Pho, BBQ frog, chopstick game and meeting lots of interesting people.

The XO guides are great, especially Pinky Tong, they give you great insight to what is Saigon; the food, the culture, plus they are super smart and witty. There was nothing about the tour that I did not like. Just GO, and go super hungry as there is more food than you can imagine. The tour lasted about 4 hours or so and we were all over the various districts of Saigon, tour begins and ends at your hotel.

BEST TOUR EVER! - We travelled in a group of 9, we were all in our late 50's early 60's and I must say that this tour exceeded our expectations. We had a fantastic time. The tour was awesome, the food excellent. I don't eat shell fish and the team leader made sure to have something different for me on the tour. The young lady that drove me around the city "Nancy" was excellent, she talked about the sights, the local food and was took away my fear of riding on the back of a scooter soi much that by the end I was ready to take the same tour again. It was a fun evening. Everyone should give it a go! Very professional and well organized from beginning to end.

Another great night - This was our second time doing the foodie tour as we enjoyed it so much 2 years ago. Our hostesses My , pronounced Me & Khuyen, pronounced Quinn were there to pick us up right on time and straight away the banter started which is wonderful as you hear of there lives and we speak of ours. First stop was for BunBo Hue, a different stop to last time but a wonderful flavoursome broth was served. Then a couple of stops before enjoying BBQ & seafood all washed down with icy cold Saigon beer or BaBaBa (333), all included in the price. All of the guests on our night seemed to really enjoy themselves and it's all thanks to the girls , our fantastic guide and off coarse the Kung-fu fighting body guards. Thanks again for a most enjoyable night.

Great city tour - I had a really great city tour with XO and my driver Than.. I had planned this tour as my first activity in HCMC to give me an idea of ​​where the interesting places are so that I could revisit on my own later. At each stop we were met by Hieu who gave a great overview of each sight along with interesting history. I hadn't been on the back of a motorbike for over 40 years so thus was almost a new experience. The sheer number of them and the traffic in HCMC is unbelievable, particularly as there seems to be few rules and even they are broken. Through all this Than was brilliant and safe so at no time did I think my choice was a bad one. Highly recommended.

A very cool experience! - We booked a Saigon by night tour and it was great: we could see a lot of different districts, get to know some information about them, and besides, we could chat with the drivers about Vietnam and its culture. Both me and my husband learned so much within just 2.5 hours! Driving by scooters was cool, you could feel almost local. One advice: please, give the masks and on windy days special glasses to the passengers.

One more suggestion is to offer some vegetarian or Muslim options for the food. While booking we specified that we don't eat pork meat but during the tour we only were offered meals with pork.

Still, we enjoyed the tour a lot and will definitely take some other package next time!

Fun Food Tour! - My husband and I booked a private Foodie Tour and had an awesome time. Our guides were fun, smart, friendly, and informative. They took us to a couple of establishments and neighborhoods that we wouldn't have ordinarily ventured to on our own given our limited time in Saigon. Going on a food tour is a great way to learn about the culture, to explore the city, hang out with locals, and yes, eat delicious food. We highly recommend!

Fun x 5 - Our family of 5 took the motorbike tour over the Christams Holidays. While it is typically not easy to please all of the family members (mom, dad, 25, 23, and 17 year old kids), I would have to say this did!! The tour leader was very informative and the drivers were engaging, knowledgable, and funny (and thankfully, very good drivers and navigators!!) The stops at the restaurants were just long enough, the food was quite good, and the side stops gave the leader the opportunity to give us information and answer questions about the city, the stops, and the neighborhoods in quieter surroundings. We saw much of the city as they really made quite the effort to bring us in or around the many districts. I highly recommend XO Tours for a fun evening.

Just the best. - it has been said time after time.. This is the number 1 what to do in HCMC..Great experience with fantastic girl drivers with professional backup imparting interesting local information at stops between eats..

Very, very cool! - What else is there to say that hasn't been said already? I've done the night foodie tour and it was simply awesome! The perfection of organization of this tour is simply unbelievable. I struggle to compare the attentiveness and quality of staff to any other tour I have ever done.
You get to see so much of Saigon that you would never see otherwise. Food is delicious! and the girls (and Hieu!!) are totally awesome! You get so pampered!
Even though it might seem a bit pricy - but totally, I say totally, worth it!
Guys, thank you! You are great! Keep up the great job!

Brilliant - We were recommended to this foodie tour and were not disappointed despite high expectations. We would never have seen so much of the city by any other means. The lady drivers were really professional and great fun to be with. The food was amazing. We loved it

Excellent way to see the city - Great introduction to HCMC, my driver(Yen) was excellent in the crazy traffic and funny with great English. The tour leader (Huong) was great as well, very knowledgable and always ensured everyones comfort and provided lots of interesting information on the sights we visited. Highly recommend tour.

Foodie tour - Lots of fun! - I'm so glad I was able to do this tour. Was able to join the tour on the last day before they closed for the Tet holiday. This tour was a lot of fun.

My driver, Yin, was really easy to get along with and very friendly. I came down to the lobby of my hotel before the tour time started and she was already there waiting for me. She even took me around on the bike before the tour started to show me around the area as per her suggestion.

Riding on the back of the bike was so much fun. Got to see the different districts and taste all types of food. If you're on this tour, I recommend to be adventurous and try everything at least once.

The guide, Tai was very informative and had a great sense of humour. All three of us laughed at the various local slang from each of our countries, like 'chow n plow'.

Definitely worth doing this tour while in Saigon.

Do this tour! One of the highlights of our honeymoon - Literally having just got of the bikes my wife and I wanted to post up a review! We absolutely loved XO and if your here for a day or two weeks my only advice is do this tour!

Firstly you see so much of HCMC that you will never get to see, the drivers are amazing, their English is brilliant and just so much fun but tell you loads of stuff you wouldn't otherwise know!

Whizzing around on a scotter just lets you see the city better than walking or aboad a slow tour bus would otherwise!

Also it is really well organized, I felt completely safe and we just had a brilliant brilliant time (at a really good price)

Only regret is that we don't have time to do another tour with them! One of the highlights of our honeymoon!
Must do for foodies and to see the sites through local eyes - Loved it! The ladies were all absolutely loverly. A highlight of our trip! Got to see all districts of Siagon

Great fun - We loved our tour with XO. It was surprisingly easy to feel safe in the crazy HCMC traffic and we learned a lot about the city. If consider doing another night-time tour with them but we run out of time. Definitely worth the money!

Putting the fun in foodie tour.. - It is true that the food that we tried on this tour was fantastic and, at times, a little out of our comfort zone but that's why we travel. For the most part it is food that we are very familiar with but they girls challenge us with frog (skin on and skin off) and the famous balut. Not sure I'd have either again but glad that I tried them.
The girls were the absolute highlight of the tour. They were friendly and cheeky but at all times professional. Their job is to make sure you are safe and enjoy yourself. I wasn't sure I'd feel safe on the back of a moped, at night, in the rain, in a city with over 10 million mopeds.. but we did at all times.
We had a fantastic night and would highly recommend this tour.

Easy to see why it's #1 - do not miss!! - Well, giving all the ratings for the Foodie Tour - I went into this with high expectations and I was not disappointed! Yes, it is more expensive than other tours in Ho Chi Minh City but it is worth every single cent! Not only is it easy to book online with very clear and informative instructions about pick ups etc. You are picked up promptly at your hotel door by your personal guide (beautiful and friendly young ladies who do everything for you all night like shelling prawns etc - so kind!). There are half a dozen or so spots on the tour all night, some food mixed in with tourist spots which is great to allow digestion to happen! Each meal was so different to what we had previously eaten - we tried the best soup, goat, frogs legs, crab, scallops, prawns... I was so full by the end of the night!

Given the craziness of the roads, I was nervous to go on the back of a scooter but the girls are fantastic drivers and within seconds I was reassured I was in safe hands. It is awesome to be a part of the roads rather than trying to dodge it as a pedestrian! The girls will tell you about things like you are scootering as well, and go out of their way to make it a great trip. Our tour leader for the night was Hieu who is charismatic, charming, informative and very kind! He was always joking with us and showing us a side of Saigon we hadn't seen doing the mainstream touristy stuff before. I would happily do this tour again and again and again - not just for the food!

Finally, they take photographs for you which are promptly sent to you a few days later. I was so busy enjoying the excitement I forgot to take many photos so I appreciate that they did that for us! Do yourself a favor - do not miss the Foodie Scooter Tour with XO Tours, honestly the best tour I have ever done! :)

PS - Definitely take their advice about when to use the bathrooms, some spots are nicer than others and the less than nice ones lack toilet paper so bring it along if needs be! :)

A fun way to see Ho Chi Minh city by night. - Our lovely lady drivers picked us up on time right outside our hotel and ran through route and safety, then off we went. I was a bit wary of being driven on a scooter around the crazy roads of Saigon but didn't need to worry at all. I felt perfectly safe. We met up with another couple and saw more of the city than we would have if left to our own devices for the two days we were there. The trip included a meal in a big, friendly eating house and photo opportunities. So glad we did this tour.

Fantastic Foodie Tour! - Had an amazing night from start to finish on the XO foodie tour. Traveling on a tight budget, it was a bit of a splurge for us, but on a friends recommendation and off the back of the great reviews on here, we decided to treat ourselves. We're so glad we did, it was a wonderful evening worth absolutely every penny. We couldn't fault a single thing from start to finish. All the team on the tour were so professional, enthusiastic and absolutely lovely. An entertaining, educational and very delicious night out, with some fun surprises and unexpected treats thrown in too. Big thanks to Tai, Trang and all the crew - definitely the highlight of our time in Saigon.

Best way to see HCMC - Seriously, the foodie tour is the most fun it can be legal to have in HCMC. Great food, good company, and sites you just wouldn't see on a conventional tour. My pilot, Huong2 was delightful. Huong took great attentive care of me, and was full of knowledge about and enthuiasm for her beautiful city. Seeing the city from the back of an XO is something I would recommend to everyone. The ride is exhilarating, alive with all the vibrancy that this city radiates. Do it!

Foodie was the best tour I've ever been on! - My driver picked me up at my hotel right on time and I had the best night of my stay in HCMC! Loan was such a fabulous driver/host! I was traveling solo but one of ten in the group going on the Foodie tour that night. This tour was the perfect mix of culture, history, information, and FUN - I think the best tour/activity I have ever been on. Group size is just right and XO picked wonderful stops.

All of the food was delicious, be prepared to try some exciting and unique dishes. Driving on a motorbike through Saigon is something everyone should experience in Vietnam. Going through Chinatown was a sight I will never forget and the scallops at the last stop may have been the greatest thing I've ever eaten.

Can't say enough good things about XO, make sure you sign up for a motorbike seat!

Had a blast! - We only had like 8 hours in Ho Chi Minh and I'm so glad the Foodie tour is the one thing we did. Riding bikes in crazy traffic was not as scary as I thought, my driver was just wonderful. At first I was like "stop talking and concentrate on the road!!" but we chatted (and sang) the whole time and I felt super safe. Our group leader was also awesome and adorable as well, she made sure everybody had fun and shared a lot about the city on the 2 sightseeing stops. As for food, there were 3 stops and ate so much good grub, from delicious noodle soup to seafood and frog and other weird but optional foods. And beer and rice wine and desserts and GOSH I wish I could go do it over again!

The wildest fun in Vietnam with your clothes on :-) - If you only do one thing in HCMC make the XO Foodie tour it. A memory we will keep for a lifetime, we had an absolute blast.
I have traveled all through Asia and this was the highlight so far for entertainment and value for money. It is a little bit more expensive than other motorbike tours but with insurance, yummy food, unlimited beer and the experience of a lifetime in the thick of HCMC motorbike 'night tango' Wow, Wow, Wow it blew us away. Amazingly we felt so safe in the middle of all that mayhem on the road, and the girls were fantastic. You won't be disappointed ..... A must :-)

One of the highlights of our time in Vietnam - I was hesitant to go on this tour because i wasn't sure about riding on the back of a scooter in that crazy traffic, but a few days before we got to HCMC, we met a couple who convinced us to try it, as he was a chef and they loved it. Well, we did too. Very well planned out, very safe, professional and enjoyable.

Hop on the back of the scooter with your driver and you will have a great time experiencing the sites, the ride and of course the food.

Saigon Scooter Foodie Tour - Wow! - What a fun way to see Saigon. I booked the nighttime foodie tour for the first night we were in Saigon so we could see a lot and get a feel for the city. We stopped about 7-8 times. Half were just to look around and learn about the city, and half were to eat at different spots (that I would not have discovered independently). Plenty of food, including incredible seafood, classic Vietnamese noodle soup (not Pho), and some interesting dishes that you won't find at your hometown Vietnamese restaurant.
Riding on the back on the scooter was the best part. The Saigon noise and traffic can be intimidating at first, but the drivers are all very responsible and careful so I never felt unsafe. It was exciting to be amid the craziness instead of just trying to cross the street on foot like we did the rest of the trip. Our drivers (Tam, Huong, and The) were the best part of the experience. Talking with them on the road and during stops made the whole experience worthwhile. I will do this again!

Fantastic Experience! - My husband and I recently had a fantastic time enjoying the Saigon by Night tour. Not for a single moment were we nervous as the girls expertly navigated through the busy streets, while we took in the numerous sights we otherwise would have missed. This is a really fun, interesting and highly professional tour for absolutely everyone. The girls and their team go above and beyond to make sure everything runs smoothly and that everyone's enjoying themselves. It was definitely our favorite experience while in Vietnam! Our only regret was that we didn't pay the extra $35 to include a video of our tour as we saw some truly amazing areas that I would have loved to have captured on film. I shouldn't have been surprised when a couple days later, some photos of us appeared in our inbox that the girls had captured while on the tour. Thank you for a very well done job!

One of the best travel experiences ever! If you do one thing in HCMC make it this tour! - My partner and I did the XO foodie tour and we haven't stopped talking about it since!
We were picked up by our guides, Thi & Vu and driven around HCMC where we stopped for delicious meals on the way whilst being shown the many areas of the city. The female drivers were a real highlight and took an interest in us and really looked after us. We too became really fond of them too! Thi really looked after me and she was just a joy to go on a bike tour with! She has some amazing driving skills in all that traffic. Anh the tour leader was a fantastic speaker and very very funny. He brought a comedy side to the tour but also gave us lots of information that we otherwise wouldn't know. Also thanks to the security guys who stayed close to us at all times but whose names I didn't know. It's nice to know that this tour is so professional and that they treat your safety as paramount. We really can't fault the tour and it's wonderful people. The fantastic food was a bonus to the whole event. I even tried BBQ'd Frog - something I never thought I'd do! But wonderful Thi was insistent that I should try it and I'm really glad I did!

Thanks XO for the fantastic experience and for showing us a side of HCMC and it's people we will never forget.

A must-have in Saigon - We took the foodie tour and for more than 5 hours we spent riding on a bike, knowing the city and having great food.
We stopped at three restaurants in three different districts.
The girls are awesome and speak very good English and will guide you through the city.

One of the highlights of our trip - We had a lot of highlights in Vietnam but boy is this a classy first rate tour. These girls take of everything for you. They are excellent drivers, knowledgable, fun and cater to your every need. They serve your food, cut the food, take scallops out of their shells, etc. we were introduced to foods we never would have tried and were pleasantly surprised to find we really enjoyed most of the foods. They also bring you on a tour of the city which was interesting and informative. We paid the small fee to have them take photos and videos during the tour and it is so worth it. I know this is an expensive tour by Vietnam standards but it was worth every penny. Absolutely loved everything about this tour.

An absolute MUST!!! - This would have to be the highlight of our 2 week holiday in Vietnam. No wonder it is rated as the number 1 thing to do in Ho Chi Minh. We ate amazing food, including things I never expected to enjoy. Experienced the unbelievable traffic in Ho Chi Minh on the back of a bike, feeling so safe I often forget to hold on, and enjoyed the company of 4 gorgeous, intelligent and witty girls who were our guides for the night. Tam (2), Khuyen the first, Thuong and Huong (6) are amazing women who somehow do this 6 nights a week and make you feel like it's as special for them as for us. We visited 3 different restaurants, went through the Chinese markets and visited parts of Ho Chi Minh you wouldn't normally get to see. Don't miss this great opportunity.

Best thing to do in HCMC by far - I can't believe I missed out reviewing XO tours after our Vietnam tour last year. I've only just realized, so here goes.
This is by far the best experience we had in HCMC, if not on our whole tour of Vietnam. The drive is quite exhilarating (rush hour in HCMC!) but we never felt unsafe and the girls really make you feel welcome and seem truly interested in both yourselves and that you are having a good time. Scooters turned up on time, were in really good condition, we got proper safety instructions, and they even had a spare helmet for my oversized head! We did the sightseeing tour and got to see pretty much everything that Tripadvisor lists as “must-see” in HCMC.
100% recommend this tour, especially if you only have a short amount of time, it pretty much covers everything.
Also a special thanks for introducing us to sugar cane juice so early on our trip. It was a daily treat from there on!

Very Common Tour - My girlfriend and I did the night tour. I would recommend the XO tour for the fun of being on the bike and the personal interaction with the English speaking guide. You would never see all the districts of Saigon without taking a Vespa tour and all of the time on the bike allows you to talk with your guide about life, culture, and customers for the local people. This to me was the best part.

My only criticism of the tour is that the dinner they served was not very good. It was street food - I ordered the broken rice dish and my pork was awful. That being said, I would certainly do the tour again because the bike is really fun and the guides are amazing!
Awesome experience. Really got a unique insight into the city. - I loved it! Felt like a local. Got a real sense of the city. Had so much fun! Learnt lots and tried some great food. Do it!!!

Do " tour - Did the foodie tour and it was simply fantastic, the girls who drove us were wonderful, spoke perfect English and were so funny. The tour wad very interesting and took you to places you wouldn't normally go. The food was good, but not the best I've had, but abundant and included drink and beer, it was fab sitting on the back of the bike and being taken very safely around.
It's been said but this tour is a must, we don't usually do tours. We like doing it ourselves, but this was such a laugh, it's a must do in Saigon. Thanks to everyone at CO for a great time.

excellent adventure- just do it!! - I (60 plus years old) was VERY hesitant going into the crazy Motor bike traffic riding behind a young (20 Plus years old) female driver. But my daughter had raved about it on her visit and insisted I step out of my comfort zone.
The first 15 minutes were tough, and if I was going to die I might as well die happily or so I thought...
Well once I relaxed, it WAS wonderful
the driver was most attentive to my fears as were all the staff
WE visited parts of th city so off the tourist parts that it and hte food tasting made it great

I had a truly wonderful experience and would highly recommend them

Tai Dang was our Tour Leader at XO Tours

Awesome !!!!!!!!!! - My wife and I did this tour for the second time just over 2 weeks ago. We brought along two friends who thought it was just amazing. My wife and I were given all the regular food included on the tour as well as some extra dishes to try, and at the end we were given a lovely Xo box containing table coasters. This really is an absolute MUST while visiting Saigon. Guaranteed fun great food, and the girls are an absolute delight. As soon as we return home we will book our flights for next year, followed by the foodie tour. See you next year Ladies xx Mike & Jenny xx

Fascinated fun - A wonderful experience. Girls were great fun but very informative. Found places and facts about Saigon we will never have discovered on our own. No tourist traps and we whizzed round the city seeing far more than if we had been stuck in a mini bus in the traffic. We were all a little nervous to start with but the girls were all extremely competent. By far the best way to see a city.
Foodie Tour was not quite what we expected but loved it. Girls go out of the way to show you the real Vietnam and introduce you to all kinds of eating experiences.
Would do that again!
This company is going places. Everything is so well organized and very professional

Great Experience :) - We did the foodie tour and absolutely it loved! The girls were brilliant and really fun and the guy organizing it was always coming around making sure everything was ok at each stop. We ate a variety of food we would never have tried if wasn't on this tour, although I backed out of the embryo egg! Was really good to see the city by motorbike and we got some great go pro footage. At each stop the tour leader gave us a talk about the area and history and made it really interesting and fun, and sent us some photos they had taken of us the following day which were great. Anyone stopping over in Saigon has to do this, thanks to the whole team for making our experience so memorable! Neil and Ewa :)

Excellent Way to Experience Saigon - We chose the "Foodie" tour. We were met at our hotel right on time by our wonderful guides Phuoc and Nhien. These 2 young women were amazing. Their energy was infectious. They wasted no time in getting us on the scooters and our our way to our first stop. I wish I had written down the names of all the dishes we were served throughout the evening. Traditional Vietnamese food, and not a single bowl of Pho. Riding on a scooter in Saigon is like swimming with salmon during spawning season. You just go with the flow. It was exciting, but not at all scary. They handle the scooters, and the extra load (us) like pros. This evening was a highlight of our entire trip. I highly recommend it if you want some adventure, and to see areas of the city, you'd not normally see.

Do it, FOODIE!!!!!!! - This is the best food tour I've ever been on. I'm not going to repeat any information from the comments already posted, because the awesomeness conveyed is all true, possibly understated.

New info: this tour -FOODIE- is special in that your driver (girl, expert) is also your personal consultant, explaining all the dishes at the many food stops...at least 20 dishes or more.

When I say personal consultant, I mean they physically sit at your side at the table, explaining, mixing sauces, cracking crab, grilling meats on mini table top bbqs, cracking jokes in perfect English, and encouraging games and conversations between guests.

The food, booze, and security is provided and served by three separate male assistants, and the tour guide (English, in our case) was funny and informative. He also secured an amazing surprise birthday cake for my wife on short notice, enough for everyone.

A note to the budget traveler...yes this trip is Vietnam-expensive, but it's worth it. Don't forget to tip (decently, not 100 measly thousand for 5 hours of specialness). Your amazing driver and tour guide deserve it, all great service does, and you will not find better service here in Vietnam. At least, I didn't, in my six-weeks here.

No Wonder This Is At The Top - i would love this company to grow, the level of professional service these people provide is second to none, the girls feel more like friends then someone providing a service and it was sad that the tour had to end sometime.

Thai our tour leader had good English but his humor was even better!

Do yourself a favor and book yourself a foodie tour, it is costly but worth it.

I truly would love this company to grow and provide more services beyond Ho Chi Minh City.

Great fun tour - We did the XO foodie tour of HCMC. It was fun and exciting and despite the crazy traffic in HCMC we all felt quite safe on the back of the scooters.
The girls that were driving the bike were so charming and great fun and helped make it a truly memorable night.
This was the foodie tour and we were all expecting some outstanding street food and i must say this was the only aspect of the tour that was disappointing. The emphasis seemed to be more on the ' different and strange' things that they eat rather that on the tastiest street food available.
we started with a soup that was fine and then moved on to a street restaurant where we were served grilled Squid , Goat , prawns, frogs legs and Okra which were ok but nothing special.
We then played some fun chopstick games which were a great laugh.
At the last food stop we were offered Duck foetus eggs which are clearly an aquired taste and not for me and finally we had some nice crab and scallops with peanuts and herbs which were the tastiest thing we had all night. We actually had the same scallop dish in Hoi An a week later at 'Cay Me' and they were in a different class.
As a tour it is outstanding fun and the girls are adorable but dont go expecting the best street food in Vietnam as the food is not that special.

Best fun ever! - This was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh city. My two children and I had an absolute blast! Our drivers were excellent and their professionalism in all matters was outstanding. The food was amazing, at places that I would not have thought of visiting, the sights interesting, everything was well organised. A big thank you to the security boys and tour manager for making sure everything ran smoothly. Have recommended to several friends already, planning to visit this year. Would do it again, no problem!!

Way to go, girls! - The ladies were excellent! I would not hesitate for a second to reccomend their tours to anyone anytime.
That was my first time on the bike and I felt safe and had wonderful time all the way through in the middle of the busy HCMC traffic. The ladies spoke perfect English, were very knowledgable and answered all our questions, and took wonderfull care of all of us as if were visiting family members. They took care of the tiniest details and for thet they have my gratitude.
Special thanks to my driver and the team leader.

So much fun and a great way to see Saigon! - I can't recommend this tour enough: 1. You are seeing so many different districts of Saigon that you would not normally see. 2. You are experiencing the way that the majority of Vietnamese commute, from a motorbike. 3. You're getting authentic Vietnamese street food and an intro to the country's cuisine.

Our girls were so much fun and very knowledgeable, and the tour itself was never boring. Nor did we gorge on too much food, which can be the case with other food tours. This was one of the best experiences we had while in Vietnam, definitely give it a shot!

Excellent Set - We did the morning tour of HCMC. It was great and all the girls were super nice. No real negatives except that they spend a good amount of time explaining the sights and the history when I personally would have preferred to spend more time just cruising around the city taking in the sights. Just personal preference though.

Bring glasses! Sometimes dust etc. can fly into your eyes.

Scary & Fun - XO food tour was a blast - must admit I was one in a group of four people. Everyone else had experience on bikes but not me. My driver and all the other drivers were masters of the conditions and handled everything in a professional manner. Would I do it again - me no but I would recommend it to others. Fantastic food at places the normal tourist wouldn't visit. Very well organized and thought out tour. Thanks to the security boys and the tour manager for keeping it all running safe.

Fabulous Experience - I never thought that I would ride on the back of a motor scooter, but I did and I loved it.
I took the night food tour and it was fabulous! Although I kept looking for pink scooters because that is what one sees on the website, I was not disappointed when white scooters showed up. I learned so much about the city, tasted food, met interesting people and was dazzled by the lights and sights of Ho Chi Minh City.
We were met at our hotel by our drivers. Because we were women, we were allowed to hold onto the waist of the female driver: men would just need to balance themselves and/or hold onto the back of the scooter. We went to a location where we met up with the rest of the night's tour. There were about 12 of us. We went to all different sections of the city. Some stops were purely informational. We learned about the particular area, who resided there and the nature of that particular community. Other stops were at street restaurants. The mix of restaurants was a good one and clear places I would never have known about had we not stopped there.
It started to rain heavily and we were provided with sturdy rain gear to keep us dry. It simply makes the experience more realistic. After all, most Vietnamese travel on motor scooter regardless of the weather.
Apparently, the women own their own bikes. At the end of the evening we were returned to our hotel where we paid our guides. I am so pleased that I participated and recommend this tour to all! Thank you for a delightful evening.

More than just food - Fantastic tour! Interesting local foods I would not otherwise have eaten. But also went to some interesting parts of Saigon I would never have thought to go to. We each had our own guide, and learned a lot about life in Saigon on the rides between restaurants. Seems expensive, but well worth it.

Amazing Night Food Tour - DId the night food tour and couldn't ask for a better experience! Would never have seen as much of Saigon if we didn't do the tour. An absolute must for your time in Saigon - as much for seeing the city as all of the great food itself

A good night in Saigon - How much can you expect from a bike tour? A lot.
It was fun throughout. Tour leader is informative. The XO guides are sweet. They showed us places no regular tourist would go. It was great.
Well organised. Fun ride. Exciting foods.
5 stars all the way.
Thanks guys. I'll be back one day.

Best tourist thing I've done, anywhere, ever - We went out with XO Tours on the foodie tour in a group of 14 people. I was a little nervous about being driven around in Ho Chi Minh City traffic on a scooter piloted by a tiny Vietnamese lady, not least because I'm a pretty big guy. Thu, my driver/guide, wasn't intimidated. She whipped out her phone and showed me a photo of her client from earlier that week: about my height, 200 cm, and about 40 kg heavy. So I stopped worrying!

The scooter experience really made the tour. From the sidewalk, the massive flow of scooters looks crazy, but there in the traffic, it all kind of flows. There's no cushion of personal space around you, but it's not scary once you get going.

The food: what an experience. We had no dietary restrictions, so we tried it all. We loved some things more than others, but it was a blast. The tour leader was great, our guides were great, the food was great, and everything about this tour makes me want to recommend it to others!

Top things to do if you want to experience Ho Chi Minh - Like everyone else has stated, this is a fantastic experience in the city. You get to travel the city on a motorbike and taste authentic Vietnamese cuisine in local restaurants. For the first five minutes riding the motorbike was a bit nerve racking but you quickly overcome that. While we didn't love all the food, it was all truly authentic and many items were fantastic. It was also great to talk with the driver for the five hours about life in Vietnam. Truly an interesting experience. If you don't have a bit of adventure and always prefer fine dining then this probably isn't for you. While it was one of the priciest activities we did on our trip it was well worth every penny...or dong. But I encourage you to be brave and you'll have a wonderful experience.
Foodie Tour - Foodie tour was top notch. Service, food, logistics were all flawless. Had faded, and felt safe the entire time.

Loved it! - My husband and I did the foodie tour which was over 4 hours and a really great night. I had a lovely young lady (sorry can't remember her name) drove me around several districts of Ho Chi Min and it was a great experience. I felt completely safe with her and she guided me beautifully through the night and the food. The food was good and drinks were included. The bikes were the best bit though, it made me feel part of this great place.

Excellent motorbike foodie tour - Our group was in Saigon for over a week and this tour was definitely the highlight of the trip. We saw a lot of the districts that we would not have seen otherwise. The food was amazing and talking with the drivers actually gave us a different perspective that I don't think we would have gotten otherwise. The girls were all very articulate and we were able to tell us things about Saigon and Vietnamese culture that I don't think we would have heard. Plan for this trip to take over four hours.

great food, even better experience! - if you want an overview of the city, a great foodie experience, and VIP treatment in a crazy fun format, then this is the tour for you! i cannot say enough about the young women who serve as tour guides, drivers, waiters and cultural ambassadors. i'm sure they are all great, but the 2 who guided us were amazing: Ngoc and Phuoc as well as the tour leader, Khanh Pham. While driving through the madness of the Ho Chi Minh city streets, we learned some cultural and informative facts all the while checking out several of the city's districts. as for the food, we enjoy such delicacies as goat breasts, quail with tamarind sauce, grilled giant prawns, grilled frog (not just the legs), crab claws with grilled chili, and scallops in the shell with peanuts and onions. and these were just the highlights. you can see from this list that this is not one of those tours that gives you a bunch of fried food, but rather some really great local foods of high quality. the stops are not true street food, but rather, are local places with real character. just cannot say enough good things about this tour.

The best tour in HCMC - Yes, the tour was expensive, but it was money well spent. Great for the biker/scooter enthusiast. The girls were expert riders. All we had to do was held on, while they weaved in and out of traffic. We saw many districts in 4.5 hours, which is most of HCMC. On the foodie tour, the guides catered to us, cooking and prepping our meals. The food was fantastic. The guides and tourists were all open-minded and willing to eat whatever was in front of them (mostly). This tour ended up being the best activity we did in Vietnam! Highly recommend it! And I will go on another XO tour for sure!

Fantastic time don't miss out - Had read all the reviews before booking this tour and was looking forward to this more then anything else we had planned . Was slightly nervous beforehand as the traffic is crazy and I'm a big guy not really suited to being on the back of a moped ! I didn't need to worry as we were met outside our hotel by two lovely tour guides who spoke impeccable English . They were fun and full of life and were very safe drivers who put you at immediate ease . We were on the foodie tour and the food was excellent , be brave and have an open mind and try stuff you never thought you would try ! The food and beer keeps coming as much as you want , I certainly took full advantage ! You are among a small group of others on the same trip and gives you a chance to interact with other travellers as well as talk to the girl drivers about life here in Saigon . 10/10 worth every dong , seems a little expensive but trust me it's fantastic and best trip I've ever done on a holiday . Thanks to the tour guide Thao and our two drivers from Mike and Petrina
The only way to see Saigon - We were very nervous about doing this when saw the traffic but trip was absolutely wonderful and utterly safe. If you only do one trip in Saigon this has to be it.

XO Tours - I would just like to join all the other satisfied customers that took the XO tours We did the foodie tour and were delighted great fun very informative and despite the slight trepidation(OK lots of trepidation) at getting on he back of a scooter in the Saigon street madness very safe. Don't miss this an experience of a lifetime wonderful girls excellent guide and worth every Dong/Dollar .Just for older folks we are not in the first flush of youth I'm 80 so don't be afraid get out and do it

The Only Way To Experience Saigon - The XO Foodie Tour of Saigon is the single most important way to spend an evening in Ho Chi Minh City. We made five stops in 5 different Districts which gave us a chance to get the feel for the food, the people and the vibe of the city. The girls who acted as our drivers spoke excellent English (all college educated) and gave you a real look at who they are and what it is like to live in Ho Chi Minh City today. Our guide who met us at every stop added the color and flavor of the city for us and gave us history and perspective as well. I don;t want to forget to mention that the food was terrific! This was no sanitized tour where you get a foreign named taste of something you could get any deli in Detroit. This was authentic cuisine. we were surrounded by locals!

Best Saigon Tourist Attraction by far - After seeing the daily chaos of Saigon roads we were a little nervous about booking this tour. We eventually booked on our last night in the City. I wish we had done this on the first night, as they gave you some really useful information about Saigon and even taught you a few useful phrases.
It was an incredible experience and our riders Hong and Ngan took really good care of us. They were not only our drivers, but our guides and entertainers. Their enthusiasm and sense of fun was really infectious. Our tour guide Thu was so helpful and friendly, and her knowledge of her home city superb. The tour lasted over three hours, including a short meal break and beer (included in the price), after which we were delivered safely back to our hotel. We will definitely do this again!

YOU MUST DO THIS!! - This is by far and away the best thing I have ever done while on holiday!! I did the foodie tour with my partner and it was incredible! If you want to know what actual Vietnamese people eat when they go out (not just Pho) then I implore you to book this tour! The tour leader was a very nice bloke call Anh (very funny and very,very nice) and my guide was called Vu and she was just brilliant! She was amazing at zipping around on the scooter, she was full of knowledge about Ho Chi Minh and just a properly lovely person. I would do this tour again in a heartbeat. And for $72US each (for all food and drink including beer) it is the bargain of the century. Thank you XO Tours!!!

So much fun! - We took the shopping tour by scooters. The drivers were so friendly and our guide was so helpful haggling on our behalf and helping us work out the money. We wanted areas locals would shop at and thats what we got. Beautiful fabrics, shoes, jewelry, good cheap street food and a spectacular restaurant for lunch. It immediately felt like we were all a group of old friends getting together.

xo tours foodie tour - a must do in ho chi minh - if you want to immerse yourself into the real ho chi minh city, do the foodie tour. I only know of district 1 where we stayed, but with this tour, you get to see the real Ho Chi Minh city. From the more affluent district 7 to the "poorest" district 4, to China town and 2 other districts. The girls will treat you like royalties and with street foods galore. Mind you, no Dominos pizza and Baskin Roberts for you. Seeing gazillions of motorbikes on the streets of Ho Chi Minh city is one thing, riding on one amidst the chaos of the city is an entirely different experience. 1000% recommended. The cost is well worth the 4.5 hour tour. Btw, there were 3 sets of foodie tours going on at the same time, and ours was the smallest with 12 bikes, others with 18 and 20. go figure

Great Experience best way to see SAIGON - What a great way to see Saigon by night - just finished a 2.5 hour trip wasn't sure what to expect but it was better than I imagined such fun - the girls from We met up with a rep from the company in Chinatown who was full of information, we then continued our trip stopping for dinner along the way, so for anyone visiting Saigon this is a great way to see many districts you normally wouldn't see. Thanks for a great evening would recommend this tour and great value.
Greatest tourist thing I have ever done - IF YOU GO TO SAIGON, YOU NEED TO DO THIS. So well organized, so much fun. You won't be disappointed.

one of the best things I did in saigon! - I loved my experience with XO Tours. My driver Giang made me very comfortable --- I was scared about having never been on a motorbike at the start. I felt very safe on the tour, and it was so much fun! It was great to see other parts of Saigon, and all the XO drivers were funny and taught us a lot about the city. We got to try a few delicious dishes, including broken rice and wet cake, which was delicious! I have recommended that you make sure to take this tour before leaving Saigon --- it's not to be missed! I will do it again in a heartbeat next time I visit, and I hope to see Thu and Giang (the best guides ever!) when I do.

Exciting Food and a Thrilling Ride - I picked this tour based on wanting to try food from a more local perspective. They took us to some great local spots all over Saigon and ordered food for us I would have never tried on my own. The whole time I felt completely taken care of. They were so friendly, fun, and knowledgeable. What fascinated me most though, were the rides through the different districts of Saigon. We went through almost every district and, even though I was in crazy traffic on the back of a scooter, I felt safe and could really soak it all in. We even had security guys with us along the way (although I never felt I needed it). I highly recommend this tour, it is totally worth the price.

One of the best things we did in Vietnam - Fantastic night out doing the foodie tour. The highlight was the girls who are friendly, informative and fair know their way about the manic saigon roads. If youre going to Saigon make sure you go on at least one of the tours.

"Amazing Night Out" - My wife and I booked this tour and had really high expectations because of all the great reviews,well these young ladies did such a great job,they exceeded or expectations. This is such a great way to see such an amazing cultural city. Never once felt unsafe or nervous riding through the organized chaos of the streets of Saigon. Food was also fantastic,and abundant,along with the beer! Your crazy not to take this tour if you ever in the city.

A fantastic fun way to see the city. - We were recommended this tour by people we met in the street and we were not disappointed in anyway. The girls on the bikes were great to talk about the city and Vietnamese life. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone of any age.

60 in Saigon! - i recently (Jan 10) did the XO scooter with Hieu and Truong and the crew. It was my 60th birthday and we had a group of 8 Australiana, including my wife and daughters. We had the best fun for at least 3 hours and we saw things we didn't know exand we ate things we never thought we'd eat!! By the end none of the female members of our party had any fear about the traffic and full confidence in the tour riders. The girls were great, the tour was very safe and well organized, and it was good value for money. Without a doubt the very best way to see more of Saigon than a tourist ever would in 3 hours, plus great food, fun and beer--Nirvana. Don't go to Saigon and don't do this tour!!
Cheers Gary from Perth Western Australia.

Don't think - just book XO now!! - A friend and I wanted to experience the best of the sights and food of Ho Chi Minh City so we booked the XO Foodie Tour based on their outstanding reviews both on Tripadvisor and a number of guides. The tour surpassed all of our expectations and was the highlight of our visit!

Our riders Thao and Jin were so professional, with their flawless English skills, and bright/fun personalities. They collected us from our hotel right on time, and took great delight in making us feel comfortable and welcome, showcasing the incredible sights and food the city has to offer. We joined a small group of tour guests at the first dining location where we met our very fun tour leader Ahn, and were whisked with great care by our riders to three very different kinds of restaurants to sample their cuisines - all delicious and fresh. Between each meal we were given a tour of 6 of the distinctly unique city districts; which gave everyone plenty of time to digest the food between sittings.

It was an incredibly safe, fun and memorable way to experience this vivid city - so trust the other hundreds of flowing reviews - and book the Foodie Tour immediately!!

3 out of 3! - 3 trips to Vietnam, 3 XO Foodie tours; Need I say more? No, but I will! People might wonder if I'd be bored with it by now, but if anything it has become even more enjoyable. The surprise elements of the first trip now make way for comfortable familiarity and the pleasure of meeting some of the people again (they gave me the same cheeky driver as last time, and I also got a chance to meet and say Hi to lovely Khanh who was our tour leader last year). For sure I know the routine by now, so on a couple of the information stops Yen (my driver) was happy just to walk around and chat, and help me buy some exotic fruits at the open air market while the rest of the group listened to the briefings given by the tour leader. Although we wandered off from the main group, we were always in sight of the security guys, so no problems there. Another happy memory tucked away, Thanks to Yen, owner Tung, leader Anh and the excellent but unnamed security team. Keep it going!

Great Experience - Perfect way to experience the life and vibrancy of this city. You are in safe and competent hands from the moment they arrive at your hotel. We did the foodie night tour and it was just fantastic. The tour ladies are enthusiastic and informative and really want to immerse you in the culture of the city.

Was our best experience in HCM and I have recommended it to everyone I know going there. Couldn't fault it at all.

Don't be afraid. - The XO Foodie Tour in Saigon is a tour of the city on the backs of motor scooters to visit several restaurants and scenic locations. Our party of 12 people were all asked before the tour started if we had any food allergies, food preferences, and apprehensions about spending a few hours zipping around the madness of Saigon traffic on the backs of motor scooters. The scooters were driven by polite young women who were very careful, patient, and cautious in the traffic and who all spoke English and were solicitous to a high degree. They explained the significance of what we were seeing and cooked for us and fed us as required. The food was excellent.

Amazing!!! - This tour had everything you wanted really. . We did the foodie tour which was 4.5 hours of riding around and eating while doing a little bit of sight seeing. The guides themselves were so helpful. . They peel the prawns for you and Crack the crab claws etc. I think being on the back of a scooter riding around ho chi minh was one of the best parts. So much fun. We went to eat at some districts you wouldn't normally go to and this was great to do. Well worth every dollar! !!

Great fun evening - We did the evening "foodie" tour. When the idea of getting on the back of a bike in the HCMC traffic was first suggested by my partner, my response was "Are you mad!". After reading TA reviews, I gained some confidence and decided that we should give it a try. The whole experience, was fantastic. Our cycle guides, Huong and Tuyen, were amazing. I concur with all the positive reviews and recommend doing a trip with professional company.

Foodie Tour Excellent!!! - My partner and I did a private Foodie tour on our last night in Saigon. Despite being to Vietnam before and already trying a lot of street food we absolutely loved this tour. The girls are fun, amazing and very knowledgable and the food is delicious and different to what we had already tried. Thanks for a fantastic night and full bellies!!!

XO Tours - the BEST way to experience Saigon - Our family of six took two XO Tours in The New Year. A daytime 'sights' tour and a 'Saigon by night' trip. Four bikes, four driver guides, maximum fun! It never felt scary though it was certainly an unconventional way to see the sights. All of the guides speak great English, a real bonus. The market and food stall interactions with a translator helping out were brilliant!
I would heartily rccommend this activity. Suitable for any age from five to eighty five.
The routine tours are a short half day (three hours or so). If you can afford the extra I would recommend you do a longer 'custom' tour- charged by the hour, you will see and do much more in this vibrant and fascinating city.

Best tour in Saigon.... Easily - This was the second time I've taken this tour & it never fails to impress. If you are only in Saigon for a night then you should take this tour!!
The girls are great fun, the bikes give you a great look at Saigon & the food is just incredible. This tour is worth every cent & you'd be nuts not to do it while visiting Saigon.

Worthwhile. - The girls are very friendly and sweet. They are great to chat with while on the scooters. I feel that the tour itself could have been an hour longer and visited a few additional sites such as the Opera House and maybe buzzed by a few more just to show us where they are like the War Remembrance Museum
But over all a lot of fun

Wonderful guide, wonderful girls - My girlfriend and parents chose for the morning city tour on our first day in Ho Chi Minh. The idea being we'd get our bearings.....
We didn't achieve that, but please do this tour it's a wonderful way to get around the city and get some official and unofficial insight into the city the people and the country.
My parents are both in their 70's and really enjoyed the tour. A surprisingly relaxing morning in a city where the scooter rules!

awesome - So pleased that we heard about this and booked it. Great night out and saw the city it a completely different way and many areas will have never seen on our own. Only thing we all wished for was less food.... It was lovely food but maybe we ate too much at the first stop :)

Awesome Experience - SO MUCH FUN! - Took this trip with my SO; we were promptly collected from our hotel by 2 lovely ladies who greeted us with terrific English.
We scooted off to the Central PO where we met 2 other tourists and our 'senior guides'
We took the "sites" tour - taking us to the PO, Notre Dame, Presidential Palace, Last Chopper out of Saigon, Burning Monk, Through China town, fabric market, meat/seafood market, to the Chinese temple.
Guide was extremely knowledgeable, answered all our questions, spoke fantastic English, took heaps of photos (that they then emailed us for free - not that common in the tourist world).
They bought us "drive-thru" sugar cane juice (delicious) and a heap of local fruits to try.
Was a lot of fun to fly around on the back of the scooter.
We were almost disappointed to return to the hotel.

This tour was a blast and I wish we had of had time to do the foodie one as well.
Also super easy to book through their website - prompt emails and easy cash payment at the end of the tour.

You are stupid if you don't do this - My girlfriend and I did the foodie tour tonight. It was
a great experience great people great food and also it is such a great way to have a look at the city.

XO the sights tour - Me and a friend took this tour on our second day in Vietnam. The traffic in Ho Chi Minh seemed insane when we first arrived so we were a little nervous to get amongst it on a scooter, but we quickly got used to it and felt very safe with the XO riders. They all were very fun and friendly and happy to chat and answer any questions as we drove through the city. We stopped at some major tourist attractions such as a monument to the famous monk who died by self immolation in protest against the Vietnamese government. We learned a bit about Vietnamese history and we tried some sugarcane juice as we rode. We had some fresh fruits and bottled water to drink as we went. There were no hidden fees or tourist trap activities. They picked us up and dropped us back at our hotel. Great service, it was very fun and I can't wait to get on another scooter!

Every word of praise is deserved - We chose this tour on the basis of many good reviews here and on many expat sites in Singapore, and it was the best choice ever. We, parents, grandmother and three kids (9,7,5) all loved it - the girls couldn't have been nicer or better drivers and all the food was delicious but we would have never found it ourselves. The motorbike traffic in Saigon is incredible and we are very glad we got to go on the Foodie Tour. So don't hesitate but book already as these ladies are very popular and do book out well in advance!

AWESOME! - We were lucky enough to have a foodie tour with the XO girls in early January.
At first I was apprehensive to get on the back of a bike on the crazy streets of Ho Chi Minh city. Nhi was my tour guide and she was SO much fun. A gorgeous girl who knew that everyone starts off an XO tour a little nervous. We jumped on the bikes and headed to our fist stop where we met up with other XO'ers for that night. We had a group of close to 20 and Khanh was our tour leader. Khanh works every night except Wednesday and is phenomenal at remembering names. She does it every night and rarely fails! Getting on the bikes becomes easier and before you know it, its a comfortable ride. Its incredible to be a part of the organised chaos.
We were taken to roughly 5 or 6 districts of Saigon, each with impressive things about them. The girls are constantly making conversation and ensuring that everything is comfortable. We ate frogs, goats and even a raw duck egg - not compulsory!
It is a must do for those who wish to experience all Saigon has to offer. The girls are wonderful and full of energy. Not a bad word to say.
Thanks again girls!

Fun - My wife and I did the Saigon by Night tour early Jan 2015. Our girl drivers picked us from our hotel on time. They were very friendly, chatty, spoke very good English and also drove very well. The tour leader Khanh Pham was also great and had a good sense of humor. Some of the information we got and places we visited were quite interesting. We made one stop for food. You are given 3 options to pick from. I picked chicken rice, which was good. My wife and a few others picked the vegetarian option but didn't like it much. The tour was quite fun and professional overall. However, there are a few things that need improvement.

First, they don't allow you to use your camera while driving due to safety reasons, which I can understand. There were only 2-3 stops during the tour so there were limited options to take pictures from your own camera. We were accompanied by photographers throughout the tour and were told that pics from the tour will be shared later but we only got 3 pics. They should find a way to let guests take more pictures of 'street life'.

Second, they should improve the vegetarian meal option.

Third, I think $40 is a bit pricey for this tour. We did a bike tour from Hue to HoiAn in the same price, which was an all inclusive tour and was an amazing experience. The XO tour is pretty good but not the same value for money. I think they should add a few more things (maybe one more food stop) to make it more value for money.

Amazing fun in Saigon! - This has to be one of the best things to do in Ho Chi Minh. Myself and my girlfriend booked on to the tour (we're both mid 20s). We did the 3 hour 'Saigon by night' tour, which shows off the old and new of Saigon, with many of the districts that don't appear on 'the beaten track'. We were taken for some amazing streetfood as well as seeing some really interesting and informative parts of life in modern Vietnam. The XO ladies are amazing scooter drivers, so would recommend them for sure even if you are overwhelmed by the intense HCM traffic! The guides all speak excellent English, and were all really enthusiastic (helped by a very fun group!). It was one of the most fun nights we had out of 2 weeks in Vietnam and was better value than other similar tours advertised. A special mention to Ning our tour leader, who was very knowledgeable and entertaining! Kudos to the team for speaking such good English that they were all comfortable cracking jokes in it too. My one bit of advice would be to book early and be brave and get on the back of one of the XO tour scooters!

A fantastic way to see Ho Chi Minh City - We took the Foodie tour in early Jan following all the great reviews on Tripadvisor. It is pricey at $72 per person! However it is extremely well organized, with lots of staff, and the girls who drive the bikes are brilliant - really funny and friendly - and very well led by the tour leader, Hieu.

To be honest this is a mix of a food tour and a sight seeing tour, rather than just a food tour. Going on a motorbike around HCMC is a fantastic experience and you get to see parts of the city you would never otherwise see. Also try food you would never otherwise try!

Would definitely recommend it as a splurge as part of your trip!

Your trip won't be completed with an XO tour - We did the two hour sights tour and it was such fun I wanted to do it all over again. The ladies were excellent drivers and guides and I felt completely safe and comfortable on the back of the scooter. They were very enthusiastic and were happy to take photos of and with us. It was fun from start to finish and is definitely a great way to experience Ho Chi Minh City.

Perfect way to finish off in Saigon - We booked the XO Foodie Tour for our last night in Ho Chi Minh and oh my god was it amazing! The girls were so friendly and took us to some obscure but amazing places that we wouldn't normally see in District 1. We saw the true beauty of the city at night and ate some of the most amazing food fresh from the markets. They wanted us to have the true Saigon food experience and we felt like we absolutely got that. Thankyou so much XO! Best way to spend a night seeing this amazing city!!!

Wonderful Experience - The reviews don't lie! Make this your first tour in Saigon. I was lucky enough to be the only one on my tour... so I had a private tour which was then adjusted to a combination of a sights and shopping tour. The guide was extremely informative and was also very professional.
I would suggest book in advance, as I tried booking the foodie tour a few days in advance and unfortunately they were fully booked!

Great introduction to Saigon! - I booked the "Foodie" tour for my family of 5 the first night we were in Saigon. What a perfect induction to the city. As others have said the tour takes you to many different districts all over Saigon that one probably won't see on their own. I am 6'4' tall and was a bit apprehensive that I would be comfortable on the back of the motorbike, no problem at all! The guides were wonderfull, easy to communicate with, and the different food stops were the highlight of the night. Highly recommend!

Great Fun - We did the Foodie Tour and Sight Seeing Tour and can't recommend these guys enough. A great way to see the city, experience the food and learn some interesting facts about this busy city. When we first arrived I didn't think scooters were going to be the best option but now I think this is the best way to see and experience The city and no better way than with such experienced, confident and safe drivers. Both tours were full of plenty of fun and laughter. Special thanks to the lovely lady drivers and tour leaders Tai & Hieu.

A fun way to learn about Saigon life - Such a fun tour! It's as much about getting to know the city outside of District 1 as it is about trying out new Vietnamese food. They make a point of introducing guests to foods they may not have eaten before - it's all delicious and the girls were so enthusiastic about making sure we enjoyed ourselves. We loved zipping about on the scooters! The girls are amazing drivers, chatting away as they negotiate the traffic. It's a fantastic way to see the city. Stops are made in areas such as Chinatown and the district where expats live - Khanh, the tour leader, is very knowledgeable and did a great job of telling us about life in Saigon. Afterwards, Khanh emails you a bunch of pictures of you and your guide/driver, which are taken over the course of the night - a great memento of a wonderful evening!

The best thing we did in Vietnam - My wife and I spent 3 weeks in Vietnam on our honeymoon and did the "Foodie" tour with XO Tours on the last day. I can confidently say it was the best thing we did.

The whole experience was mind blowing - the food was great, with many dishes I didn't expect to be able to try. We also got to experience different styles of eating, such a local BBQ restaurants and back-alley gems.

We also got to see FIVE different districts, all of which we never would've found without help.

The best bit though was just being able to experience Saigon at night from a completely unique perspective. Trust me, don't miss the opportunity to do it

Just do it!! - I guess all the previous reviews talk for themselves, this tour is just amazing. Went for the evening foodie tour and so pleased with everything from cute and safe guides, to all the amazing food and locations we got to see during the trip. Recommended for everyone and don't even hesitate! If we had more time in HCMC we would for sure booked another tour with XO tours since they offer several. The knowledge of local Vietnamese dishes and what to eat with what was very good to know for our further travel in the country. Thank you XO Tours!!

Best way to brave the traffic - The traffic, which is quite intimidating on foot, suddenly feels when you're on the back of a scooter. Quin and Loan were excellent guides, expertly weaving through the endless cars and scooters and stopping along the way to show us some of the main sights. If we had more time, we would have liked to take the foodie tour.

Truly memorable! - A perfect to see Saigon. Safe and fun. My 4th trip to Saigon. First time on a motorbike. Which I had done the tour sooner and will absolutely sign up for the night tour and the food tour on my next trip. The tour guide was great. So was my driver, Hoang.

Excellent!! - We were recommended to do this tour & were thankful we did! We did the night street food tour & it was awesome. We were a little nervous at being amongst the hectic traffic at first, but thanks to our excellent riders Vu & My we didn't feel at all scared! In fact it was a great experience. Not only did we enjoy lovely & sometimes interesting food but the girls English is fantastic & we learn't a lot about the area & the way they live! They took us to where the locals buy & eat their food, some of the places we would not have ventured on our own. We would highly recommend this trip as it was one of the best things we did in Vietnam. Thankyou to Vu & My and our tour leader!!

A must-do in HCMC - We were in Vietnam for two weeks and the XO tour was the highlight of our trip. Our drivers were safe, knowledgeable and so sweet. On the back of a bike, you get to see and experience HCMC like you wouldn't otherwise. Going on a moped is a must and we would do it again if we ever went back to Saigon.

Thrilling Motobike Tour of HCMC - As we were returning to our hotel from a self-guided walking tour of District One (courtesy of Lonely Planet), we noticed a group of scooters parked outside. They looked to belong to a group of young women in colorful traditional clothing waiting outside by the scooters. This is how we found out about XO Tours, which we were lucky enough to book for the following evening (our final day in HCMC). During the tour, you will be riding pillion behind your guide, on her very cool scooter, into the heart of the chaotic fray that is HCMC traffic. This alone was worth the price of admission!

We chose for the 'Foodie Tour', and during this harrowing but exhilarating evening tour we were taken around to five Districts in the city, with stops at various places to eat foods that would not be the usual suspects of Vietnamese cuisine, from noodles that were not bun or pho, to goat, clams, prawns and much more -- even for those brave enough to try -- balut (look this up before saying yes!). We were also taken to districts not often visited by tourists, including Districts four and seven (ie the 'Singapore of HCMC') and learned the raison d'être of those lawn chairs behind the gas stations. During the tour, our guides will speak with us while driving (an amazing skill given the non-existent traffic laws), providing us an insight into their thoughts on everyday life in Vietnam.

Three-and-a-half hours later you get dropped off at your hotel, belly full of amazing food, memory full of colorful sights and sounds. Especially if you are short on time in HCMC, this tour is a must -- you will walk away being unable to wipe the smile from your face...

Best tour we have ever been on! - we had so much fun on this tour. We are a mid thirties couple from USA and have traveled a lot. This was by far one of our favorite activities. The girls were very nice and loved to talk about their country and culture. They were so much fun on the tour and made sure we were having a good time throughout the tour. The food was amazing and we were able to try things we would have never tried on our own. Very authentic restaurants, not tourist traps. Tam was great as was my husbands driver. Khanh had an amazing memory getting to know the entire group names. We had a great group that we toured with as well. So much fun, I would highly recommend for any age! Safe and responsible drivers.

Yes, it really is awesome - We did the Saigon by night tour and we are really pleased we did. I found the traffic a bit overwhelming here ever to walk across the road, but once on the scooters with the XO girls it didn't take long to see they are very good drivers who know what they are doing. By the end I was loving it! The drivers have to do a driving test before they are employed, and they drive their own bikes so it is a bike they are familiar with. We were picked up on time and the drivers took us to Chinatown where we talked with the informative guide. We were driven through various parts of the city and had a few stops including for street food. Pretty much the only other foreigners we saw were others on xo tours, so it was a great way to see non touristy areas. The drivers were very chatty and clearly very experienced at putting people at ease. I suggest doing this tour early in your trip as it gives a good over view of Saigon and they offered helpful advice for the rest of our trip.

Fantastic! - we booked this tour based on all the fantastic reviews. And we're not disappointed. The lovely ladies picked us up on time and showed us how we need to get on and off the bike to avoid the exhaust pipe and getting a 'Saigon kiss' (burn) on your leg. They were fantastic drivers and we felt every safe. I will admit I'm not a foodie but my husband is and he loves the food and it just kept coming. They were very accomodating for my food tastes also and at each stop there were non seafood dishes for me. We visited many different districts to see the different areas of siagon which was great. All in all the night was fantastic!

Wonderful and unique must-do experience! - Me and my boyfriend Euan absolutely loved our two motorbike drivers, Huong and Nhien (sorry if this is spelt wrong!) They provided extremely interesting insight into an unconventional perspective of Saigon that many tourists would never get the chance to see, as well as were consistently safe and effortless drivers in the chaotic streets of the city. Although the price might be more than the usual tour in Vietnam, it is well worth it for such a unique experience - fun, personable and eye-opening! Wish XO Tours all the best and to keep getting the recognition they deserve. Also free flowing sugarcane juice/beer was provided!! BOOK NOW!!!

Wonderful experience - This was just awesome. The girls were super kind and excellent drivers. They took us through the places in HCMC we will have never seen, which was very interesting.
