They gave a lot of background information, which helped us understand and appriciate HCMC. The thrill of driving in the madness of the streets was truly amazing. A special thank you to Tam and Hu! Highly recommended.

The perfect way to spend a morning - An amazing way to get an overview of Ho Chi Minh city in under three hours. Drivers and guides were world class with exceptional knowledge of the city. An unmissable and exhilarating experience being amongst all the motorbikes in the traffic. Highly recommended, especially if time in city is limited

Great times in HCMC...made the trip!!! - We just spent 4 days in HCMC. The trip was amazing, but XO Tours scooters dinner tour was definitely the highlight of the trip. Starting with the girls picking us up at our hotel. Each one more adorable than the next. Driving on the scooters all over HCMC to various restaurants was so much fun. Learning about the foods we were eating and learning about each girls' life just added to the whole experience. You have to do this trip if you go to HCMC!!

Fabulous family fun. - We did this with our 2 young teens on the last night of our 3 week Vietnam holiday.It was so good and a real highlight of our entire trip.So professional ,with a great mix of activities and food on the foodie tour.Half my family don't like seafood ,so there were other options specially prepared .i was apprehensive but it was so safe and such fun.The girls are gorgeous.A must do activity.

Best Vietnam experience ever! - Our group of six booked a Custom tour to fit in with our conference schedule.
Out of all the activities and tours in Saigon this was the most fun and enjoyable.
Like most, the thought of joining the "madness" of Saigon traffic had us feeling a little nervous although this feeling passed within minutes of starting our tour.
The ladies were fantastic guides and soon had us all at ease, enjoying the sites as we weaved our way around Saigon.
Absolute fantastic was to tour Saigon.
3 words of advice... Just Do It!

Foodie Delight - We did the Foodie Tour on our last night in Vietnam, it was a great way to end the trip of a great country. Their were 4 of us (wife and 2 Daughters 17 and 10). The guides picked us up from our hotel they were there prior to nominated time, spending time to get to know us etc. We then headed off on the tour on the 4 Bikes, no issues what so ever for the 10YO on the bike (and this continued throughout the tour). We arrived at the first stop to meet up with the tour organizer Khanh, who was excellent throughout the evening, in total 12 people on the tour. We went to 5 different stops (3 where we ate food) and districts, the guides were great the whole time, answering questions about their lives in HCMC and explaining different sights. All the districts were away from tourist areas which made this tour so appealing . The 3 food stops were all very good with more than enough food to eat and drinks to drink. We were offered more food throughout so no issues with going hungry. Their was a very good variety of food some were a little different to what westerners may normally eat, however all very tasty and a great experience. At the end of the evening around 10pm (so 4 and a half hours in total) we were ridden back to our hotel. This is a very well organized fun tour to go on. Would thoroughly recommend to do while in HCMC.

You should do this foodie tour. - So much fun on our first night in Ho Chi Minh. Fun riding on the back of the scooters, delicious food. They take you through several districts and you eat some amazing food - that you may not think to otherwise try. And the girls are awesome drivers! - my partner is 110kg and his 40kg Vietnamese driver handles that scooter like a champ. Totally recommend to everyone!

Excellent tour of Saigon - This tour was definitely one of the highlights of our stay in Saigon. The girls on the bikes are so friendly and knowledgable. We met up with members of the group in China town and then went on to see several districts of Saigon. There is a stop off for food in a lively popular place were it is a good opportunity to chat to other members of the group and the girls riding the mopeds.
Riding through Saigon on the back of a moped is an interesting experience in itself let alone the places you get to see. You are picked up from your hotel and dropped back there. We did the Saigon night tour which made it all the more exciting driving through rush hour and whilst it was dark. Excellent trip and Thanks to all at XO!!

Wow, almost speechless! - We were recommended by a friend that this was the one thing you should not miss to do in Saigon. Although a little skeptical at the beginning due to the madness of the traffic and the fact we were on a motorcycle, it took less than 5 minutes to realize how skillful and safe this ladies were maneuvering around the city. We took our 3 teenager boys on an evening foodie tour and they can't stop talking about the incredible time we had. Extremely well coordinated, incredible food experiences, and an unbelievable immersion on what is like to drive in Vietnam. Thought the trip we were also escorted by 3-4 riders watching after us. Do whatever you want in Saigon but if you miss this, you've missed large!

Best part of our Vietnam trip - My wife and I took part in the "Foodie" tour as part of our brief trip to HCMC. The experience of traveling around on the back of one of the many motorbikes was a lot of fun. On top of that, the tour guides were very fun and informative. They made you feel right at home and helped you learn a lot of the Vietnamese culture. The food we had was both very local and great, and the sense of community that you built with you fellow tour goers was very enjoyable. I fully recommend this to anyone who wants to try a cross-section of Vietnamese food that is more "local" than what you've had at your local Vietnamese restaurants. Thank you so much for the great time!

Fantastic view and taste of Saigon - We have just returned from the night Food Tour and for a family of six this was an absolute thrill! The price is more than I hoped but as the night progressed I quickly became convinced it was well worth it. With our youngest child 9 years old I was apprehensive about safety, but the skill and caution of the riders allayed my fears and he was thoroughly spoilt with attention from the lovely XO staff. The food was interesting and varied with options for the more adventurous if desired (BBQ frog is delicious!) and plenty of explanation about the origins and preparation. My personal favourite was the seafood at the last stop, but the BBQ goat with fermented tofu sauce was a close 2nd. We were lucky to have a balmy clear night as we zoomed around the different districts of Saigon, including amusing and informative stops to discuss the city with our tour leader Anh. A big thank you to Thuy who showed her excellent traffic negotiation skills with a 90 kg passenger whilst happily chatting to me all night. It is evident that the staff enjoy their work and the fun interactions really added to the experience for us. So a five star rating is not something I give lightly but this tour certainly deserves it, as it was an absolute thrill for our whole family.

A Fantastic Experience! - My wife and I travelled to Ho Chi Minh for our honeymoon and the XO Tours was a FANTASTIC way to spend a night!
Having the girls come to our hotel to pick us up on scooters was so helpful and driving through the city in rush hour traffic was very exciting, before getting beautiful food (and many local beers=) all over the city. This was truly an experience we could not have had as first time travellers to Vietnam without the XO Tours.
I could not recommend this more!

Sights tour was great! - Did the Sights tour with XO Tours and had a great time.

First of all, I have to say that they have the most amazing staff when I corresponded with them. Both Thao Nguyen and Tung Do were extremely helpful with my requests. Thao was so patient, friendly and fantastic in explaining every little question I had about the tour and about Saigon in general. In fact, she also helped me with some additional information on hang out spots and restaurants in Saigon. She gets "5 stars" from me for being a role model for excellent customer service - friendly, warm, knowledgeable, patient, prompt in replying to emails and above all, treats you like a friend she has known!

I took the Sights tour on the day after I landed. The tour was great - very friendly people and knowledgeable in explaining each of the sights. I had a really good time throughout the tour and also the yummy food that I got at the end of the tour.

The price is a tad expensive but at the end of the day, I felt it was worth it for me. May be, they'll be able to attract more people if they lower the price point a bit.

Best tour of our entire trip - We were a party of 4 on a 2 week cruise through Southeast Asia. On our day in Ho Chi Min City, we contracted with XO tours for a 4 hour motorbike tour. We had no problem finding them at our meeting point. After some instructions, we boarded our bikes with our drivers and withdrew. This was the most fun activity we did on entire trip!! We went to all the major sites and they also took us to a local spot for lunch which was great. Our tour leader was Khanh Pham and she was excellent. She gave us detailed explanations at all our stops. I never felt unsafe during the entire trip and what better way to tour Ho Chi Min City than by motorbike. I would highly recommend this tour company to anyone visiting Ho Chi Min City. It is the perfect way to see the city.

Expensive, but worth it. - I took the foodie tour, at $72 its expensive for a four-hour tour in a developing country. But if you have the money it's worth it and I suggest you do it as soon as you get to Saigon.
The drivers are excellent, Whizzing around Saigon on the back of bike is a great little adventure in itself even if you are used to city traffic. The traffic here might well be unique and you will understand how to deal with and even enjoy it this way. You go places off the beaten track and get a wealth of insight into this city from the main guide Tai and in my case my wonderful driver Tam.
And the food is very good.

Deserves its title as no. 1 on trip advisor!! - We took the foodies tour, and although it was a little pricey, at the end of our foodies tour, we all thought it was money well spent. The girls were really keen to make us feel comfortable while tasting the more exotic foods or while riding the bike in the middle of the infamous Vietnam traffic, by giving us detailed and interesting explanations of each meal, joking around with us, and even helping us to peel the prawns! Service was impeccable. Food was fantastic as well. Best meals I have eaten in hcm!
Overall, deserving of its title as number one on trip advisor.

This was it! - Spent a while thinking about XO Tours and have, for my wife and myself, decided that it can only mean Xcellent & Outstanding!! We had such a ball! We did the morning tour which was basically a 2 hour overview of the main sites in District 1 with out tour leader Anh, a true fountain of fun and knowledge, and well worth doing to help you get your bearings in Saigon. Compared to our drivers My & Thi, their driving skills on scooters in that traffic is truly a jaw dropping experience but at no stage did we ever feel in the least apprehensive. On that basis, as we'd booked the evening Foodie Tour, we asked for the same girls, and got them. Wonderful! The Foodie Tour is something else! The girls chat away the whole time filling in all the Districts we are going through and the restaurants and food are truly local and an absolute blast. Having to put everything in someone else's hands and then just going for it is so liberating and the food and the variety is amazing. If you have an ounce of adventure in you, and you are in Saigon, go for it!!! You will never forget or regret the experience. I doubt it could happen anywhere else in the world, but I am happy to stand corrected! Khanh you were an amazing trip leader, thank you, Neil & Ngarita

What a way to start a trip - My husband and I, along with our three sons aged 17, 14 and 12 arranged a Saigon by Night tour on our very first night in Saigon. What a great way to start the trip! I was initially a bit worried about sending my kids off on the back of motorbikes in such busy traffic but once we got going, we were all fine, including me who was probably the most chicken out of all of us. The weather wasnt great with some rain etc but it didnt seem to matter, we still had fun. We enjoyed a stop for food and our drivers were all lovely girls, happy to chat with the boys and really made the experience enjoyable. It was quite pricey because there are five of us, but in hindsight, i think it was worth the money as it was a fantastic experience. The best part was zooming through the traffic, at night, with all the lights and other bike riders. You really did feel like a local! I initially would have liked to have done the foodie tour, but at 4.5 hours I thought it was a bit too long with the kids. This tour was a good amount of time, 2.5 hours and a cheaper price which was good. I would thoroughly recommend this tour. Very professional. They have sent through photos to my email address which i unfortunately cannot open up on my computer, but hopefully we will work that issue out!

Great intro to Saigon, awesome street food - What could be a more Vietnamese experience than riding through crazy traffic on a motorbike? This way you don't have to do any work, just hold on! The guides were great, very friendly and informative. We went to neighborhoods outside the typical tourist track and ate some of the best street food I had in Vietnam. I recommend the evening tour. The weather is cooler and the city lights are beautiful.

Good city highlights tour - We booked with XO based on a friend's recommendation. The food tour was completely booked for the week we were in HCMC so we chose the city tour option. The drivers collected us from our hotel and after a brief introduction we were on our way. The guides chatted with us as they drove us through the city and were happy to answer both personal and professional Qs. Phuoc and Hoang were our drivers and they were delightful.

The tour also included an additional male guide and a security person which I found confusing for a company that advertises itself as the 'first Vietnam tours company to offer Vietnam motorcycle tours with female guides leading motorbike tours' when the women were not the folks to provide any guide commentary at any of the stops.

Our tour leader Anh was a bit over the top with slang and idiom usage that just didn't work with his audience on our tour, but overall this was a very good experience. We were provided with bottled water, fresh fruit and a refreshing fruit drink while on tour.

Great Trip and the food was amazing - Great Foodie tour. We were a little nervous about traveling on the bikes but felt super safe the whole time. The drivers and the food were great. I would totally recommend the tour to anyone.

Great night out. - This was my 2nd time on the foodie tour but the first time for my wife and two boys. They were nervous as it was there first time on a scooter and of all the places to get on for the first time. My driver/rider was Phuoc and she was fantastic. Very happy to explain things to us and also a great sense of humour. The rest of the girls were so nice and took great care.of us, lot's of food lots of laughter. You have read all the reviews so I can highly recommend it as it was my 2nd and it was as good as the.first. Special mention to Khanh our tour leader. She was fantastic and also a great photo bomb!

What a wild way to eat our way through HCMC - The scooter travel in peak hour - coupled with rain, made it an extremely hairy event for a first time visitor to HCMC....but what an extraordinary experience it is. The food is delicious and the scooter ladies, delightful.

A must-not-miss tour while in Saigon!! - My boyfriend booked this trip and I didn't expect anything special about it. But it was incredibly fun and the food is excellent. It exceeded my expectations and I really had so much fun with the girls, the crews and the manager.

They speak fluent English and are always so cheerful. The girls make sure there's always food on your plate. And the guys were there to ensure your safety.

I must say this is the best tour I've ever been in my life. I would recommend to all my friends who want to visit HCMC. Thumbs up to XO!!

Way too much fun! - Having never been on a motorbike of any type before, I wasn't sure this was the place to try it for the first time...but I am so glad I did! Our drivers Nhi and Tham were awesome and even though the traffic could be scary crazy, they zipped in and out with no issues. The food was really good and we had a blast trying new dishes, plus seeing places we never would have seen. This is a wonderful way to spend the evening!

Great way to experience more of the city - This was definitely a highlight of our trip. The whole tour is extremely well organized and they ensure you see a fuller side of HCMC. At first the thought of entering the scooter chaos was quite daunting but it is actually quite safe and an immersive experience. The food itself is delicious and if you are brave (do it - it is all delicious) you will get to try what the locals eat. The drivers are knowledgeable and add great value to the event because they speak English well and you can ask them all the questions you've built up over your stay while you drive to your next food spot.

Fantastic tour for foodies! - We had such a good time on this tour (there were 4 of us). Not only did we see a lot of Ho Chi Minh City, we were also introduced to the most amzing(and sometimes bizarre!) Vietnamese food. We were safe at all times and it was lovely getting to know our personal guides on the back of their mopeds zooming around the city at night. Well worth the money!

Amazing experience! - The foodie tour was one of the best things we did on our trip to Vietnam and Cambodia. Our drivers were the best, Tao was especially great and it was really awesome to be able to see all parts of Saigon and not just the touristy parts. The food was absolutely delicious too and we were even convinced to eat frog and duck embryo which were both surprisingly delicious. I would HIGHLY recommend this trip to anyone visiting Saigon.

If you are visiting HCMC, book this tour. - As reflected in the other reviews, this was a very fun tour. While the HCMC traffic might be initially terrifying from the back of a motor bike, the riders are quite safe. This tour was well organized and there was never a boring moment. The guides had an excellent command of the English language and were able to respond to all questions while riding as well as sharing interesting facts about the areas as we rode through them. If you are visiting HCMC, this tour is not to be missed.

A side of Saigon you wouldn't otherwise see - We had a great time on our foodie tour, from the moment we were picked up by our lovely guides to the moment our heads hit the pillow four hours later, happy, full and a little tipsy.

We were initially worried about the price but the tour was so professional, informative, tasty and interesting that it proved to be pretty good value in the end.

I don't want to spoil the tour by describing in too much detail where you will go, just take it yourself and find out, you won't regret it.
Fun and well rounded - Loved buzzing around town on the scooter, getting one on one time with a local, and hearing from the guide about life in the city.

Great Tour - My wife and I traveled to Vietnam for a month earlier this year. This was one of the best organized and fun tours that we did during our entire stay. The drivers are friendly, funny and professional. The food is great and you can get an opportunity to try different food that you may never have before and it is a very cool way to see a bunch of the city that you wouldn't normally. I am not one to take a Foodie tour but if you skip this one you will be sorry.

Exceeded Expectations - When I saw 1000+ great reviews I was skeptical but I must say this tour is great.

I was traveling solo through HCMC and wanted a fun way to see the city and meet other people. This was the perfect combination. Not in the backpack price range for the budget consciouser but a fun experience if you are willing to pay $72.

Fun on the back of a bike - We went on a foodies tour and our guides Gai and Hung were so much fun and very accommodating from the get go. Experiencing the 'thrill' of riding a scooter through the streets of Saigon was second to none. We also got to see and learn about areas of Saigon we will never have visited! Food was good but as the guide said "its not the best in Saigon, but it is authentically what the locals enjoy". Bit pricey but worth it for the experience!!

fantastic experience - This was a great night. Our drivers Vi and Nhi were safe, funny, informative and generally lots of fun. Good was varied and delicious. It was interesting to see other parts of the city. Highly recommend it!

Fun Times & Enjoyable Company - Just finished the tour & would like to repeat the glowing sentiments already expressed thus far. It's incredible fun & being able to see Saigon in different perspectives, through different districts, was enlightening. They created a great atmosphere & kept the tour moving at a steady pace. The girls are a joy to be around with & there shouldn't be any problems with communicating in English. My favorite & most exhilarating part was weaving in & out of traffic to the districts. So much fun!

Evening foodie tour, great experience - Did the evening Foodie Tour. The motorbike riding was quite exhilarating and felt very safe. The food was varied and delicious. Tasted some different foods and visited areas of the city we otherwise wouldn't have. Tour leader and the drivers/riders were great hosts and just enhanced the whole evening. Would thoroughly recommend.

So much fun!!! - We really enjoyed the motorbike tours!

As the groups can be quite big, we decided for a private foodie and sights tour and enjoyed it a lot!
The drivers speak English fluently, know how to drive and are really funny. We had a great time.
During the foodie tour XO tours made sure to take care of our various food allergies so that we could fully enjoy without any worries.

I will always do it again!

One point could be improved: the girls follow their route and little is asked for the guests' preference. As we were on a private tour, we would have appreciated a tour that is a little bit more individual (in our case: we had seen some of the sights already, as during xo tours most are only visited from the outside, we could have skipped some.)

Fantastic - A great introduction to Saigon - We did the morning ride. Definitely worth it. Just getting amongst the traffic was a thrill. Never feel unsafe and the 'pilots' are superb. Our group of 6 was young and old but just as much fun for everyone.
A great way to get a taste of Saigon. Top recommendation!!

The most fun ever! - The most fun ever! I'd give this 10 stars if I could! My kids 6,8 & 18 had the time of their lives! The ladies were extremely nice and really took care of the kids. We felt safe and had a blast. A memory they will never forget! Plus great food!

Highly recommend - Choose this tour because it is the number 1 activity on Trip Adviser, recommended in Lonely Planet and friends of family had done it recently. Totally worth it. The girls are amazing. Food was so good and things we would have never tried on our own. Tai went out of his way to please everyone (also catering to my partners dislike of seafood). Awesome way to see the city and areas you will never get to on your own or know exists. Thanks so much. Danielle and Paul (New Zealand)

Everyone must do - What a great time we had out getting to see the City by motorbike and be submerged in the traffic, as well as eating some lovely local food. We felt completely safe the whole time and our drivers phuoc and chau were great fun as well as the tour leader tai aka banh beo ;)
I would recommend everyone to do this for a real taste of Ho Chi Minh City for how the locals live and to highly enjoy yourself.

Best of the best in Vietnam - We did this tour on the 21st with not much expectations. My wife was apprehensive having been seriously injured as a young girl in Saigon by a motor bike.

I must say the girls made her very comfortable from the get go and with the advantage of being able to hold on to her driver she lost her fear, although speaking the language was an advantage it by knowing means is a requirement as our drivers (Van and Trang) were quite capable in English.

We visited 5 or 6 districts which gives you a variation of dishes but more importantly a distinction in economic conditions which varies from poor to wealthy to poor again, the binding theme as explained by our guide Tai is the passion for food.

As for the girls, they are articulate, competent, and outrageously fun while still keeping their wits in the traffic chaos that is notorious in Saigon.

I have read reviews about the price being high but if you look at the tour length of 5 hours, the overall uniqueness, and the fact that they have to haul are oversized western butts all over town then they are a bargain.

A special thanks to Tai for catering to my Vegan diet, having to deal with severe gout i am very grateful

Thank you XO, you guys rock.

Robert and Mytrinh Martin

So much fun :) - Pricy but very worth it. Great food that we would have never tried on our own. Girls were fun, charming, cheeky and great moto drivers :) Everyone spoke perfect English. This was the highlight of our trip. Would recommend :)

Amazing - Best tour yet. I was nervous about the Vietnamese traffic and the scooters but it to put to be fantastic. The atmosphere, food, people, all amazing. My butt hurts a bit though, lots of riding around.

Super fantastic fun! - My Husband booked this telling myself and our 14 year old Son it would be fun! He was Soooo wrong it was AMAZING!!! Best fun ever, girls were super on the Vespas and great tour guides. While not all the food I would have chosen, it was an adventure. A definite MUST for this city.

Unique way to explore HCM city even if you've visited before - This was my third trip to HCM on a business trip. I was lucky enough to be there on a weekend and was traveling alone. The whole experience was seamless- online booking, confirmation, meeting my great guide, joining the rest of the group, the interesting info, selection of food and the real effort to make everyone feel welcome evening although you're essentially having dinner with strangers (solo traveler). Seeing the city by bike and joining the crazy traffic was exciting and it was so good to get out of the tourist areas to see parts if the city you didn't even know existed.

A tour on the first day - The best way to have a quick overview of the city. In the first day you can have a nice visit, with a very helpfull team. The drivers are safe and the guide takes you inside the secrets of Ho Chi Minh City. The must is the visit to China Town Disctrict, narrow streets with plenty of markets at open air. Nice place also to eat and completly outside of the touristic areas.

A must while in Saigon!! Believe the hype!! - We booked the Foodie night tour based on a friends' recommendation and its glowing reviews on TripAdvisor and it certainly lived up to the hype. We did this on our first night in Saigon and it was a great introduction to Vietnam food and traffic! All of the team at XO who went out on the tour with us were really friendly and professional and all about making sure you had a fun night. Not only did you try great food in local places, but riding around in the Saigon traffic with the girl's on the back of the Vespas was a lot of fun! You can tell safety is very important to them and we feel safe on the bikes at all times. Our host told us interesting facts at each of the different districts we went to and the girls who drove you around were lovely. Highly recommend doing this on one of your first nights in Saigon so you can return to any of the places you visited or get tips from the guys on where's good to go for different dishes.

Awesome time! Unique Experience - The ladies who run this tour are awesome -- super friendly, very knowledgeable, and amazingly gracious; they represent their country well!

At first you might be taken aback at the though of the slight women whipping through the city with someone of my size (80kg) in tow. But soon enough they have your confidence and you're thoroughly enjoying the journey.

Seeing the city from the back of the scooters is a truly unique experience as is the opportunity to try food that locals would be proud to eat.

Great experience! - Thoroughly enjoyed this experience and can fully understand why it gets such great reviews. The young ladies represent themselves and their country extremely well.

They are polite, courteous, knowledgeable and extremely safe on the bikes and our whole family did not want the tour to end! Truly the highlight of our stay in Vietnam...

Make this your 1st tour in Ho Chi Minh - Apologies for the lateness of this review - visited HCM late October 2014 and this tour is just the best - a great way of seeing the city and experiencing life in this vibrant place. My friend and I are both in our 60s - we enjoyed this so much - the brilliantly knowledgeable guides who were excellent drivers, so friendly with really good English. I can't recommend this enough, even if you only have a short time in HCM due to using XO. Would be great to find them in other cities as well.

It's a blast! - My husband and I took part in the group "foodie tour" and had a blast. We met our XO tour guides, Hong and Ngan, right on time in front of our hotel to get our night started. We met up with the rest of the tour group (about 12 others from all around the world) at a local restaurant to eat and drink some authentic Vietnamese food. Then we continued to do this at several other local restaurants around the city. The entire while, the guides explained the foods and traditions to the group and made sure we were all well fed and entertained. This tour company has thought of everything. It began to rain while we were on the tour, and they had ponchos and napkins for everyone to keep dry. I did not eat pork and they were sure to make special accommodations on a few dishes for me. They take pictures on the tour so you can enjoy the night away and within a few days, they email pictures to you directly. While you are directly assisted by your very own XO guide all night, they have a tour leader and extra personnel on site to ensure you are safe and EVERYTHING is taken care of. The entire night went seamlessly and we could not have had a better time. Our tour guides were safe drivers and extremely polite. We were able to experience the city with XO in a way we couldn't have planned ourselves. They take you to places that tourists would never venture to on their own and give you a chance to see the real way locals eat. Ditch District 1 and see what the real Saigon has to offer on the "foodie tour" with XO!

PERFECT for ANYONE! - I've been to Vietnam about 7 times around and I brought a mate along and it was his first time here. We decided to take the XO day tour. Our motorbike guides were fantastic and really suited towards our individual needs. They were talkative, vivacious and bright and could speak English or Vietnamese very well. Their driving was great and the tour's main leader Tai was also very informative and fun to have around and gave a lot of detail about the places we visited. I definitely learned a couple of new things! I would definitely recommend XO tours and it is no surprise they are #1 on tripadvisor. They truly deserve their ranking and all the more power to them!

Food flop - After living in Vietnam for over 10 years we thought we would try this tour. We were hoping for some new and exciting culinary experiences. What a let down. The tour starts off good with some lovely gurls picking us up and a delicious soup to whet our appetites. Then the next 3houes were spent going to beer joints set up outdoors where in tge heat we were served small morsels of various types of strange meats. What a disappointment. Vietnam has some amazing dishes for the traveler to try. Just felt let down

Highlight of our Trip!!! The Foodie Tour is a must! - We really went back and forth on booking the Foodie Tour because of the cost. We ended up meeting some people in Hoi An that had just done the tour a few days ago, and they convinced us. While easily the most expensive activity we did during our trip, it was worth the money!!! This tour is what we talked about when we got back home.
Our drivers/guides were absolutely wonderful. It surprises me that they could carry on conversations while driving in and out of the chaos. You can tell that they are truly good people who love what they do.
Our tour guide, Tai, spoke perfect English and was very funny! We learned a great deal about how they live in the city, challenges they have, the geography of the city, etc. We were driven all over the city, to places you won't see a single other tourist. I felt like we had a better sense of the heartbeat of the city once the night was done.
And the food!!! Oh you can't beat the food. Goat meat, shrimp, okra, squid, and the best scallops you will ever eat in your life. And of course the crazy egg at the end (it's a mind over matter thing and nothing to be scared of).
Don't think twice about booking this like we did. It will be the BEST decision of your trip!

The best way to see Saigon - The Foodie tour is one of the best tours I've ever been on, from the hotel picked up by our hosts for the evening, to the zipping in and out of traffic, to all the great food and company you get to enjoy. It's a thrilling adventure to be able to get into the heart of Saigon traffic on a scooter. The food was excellent and our hosts for the evening, Khuyen and Tam/Ngan made sure we were safe, entertained, fed and informed. Tai was a great tour leader and told us about the various districts we visited. If you only do one tour in Saigon, do this one.

Vietnamese hospitality on 2 wheels - We did the foodie tour on our 2nd night in HCM.

In the midst of the chaos in the streets of HCM, the ride felt safe the whole time, even when the rain poured during the middle of the tour. We can tell that our drivers were really very good and very used to driving in HCM. Other than the female drivers, we also have around 3-4 male drivers escorting the group, just in case!

The food was fantastic, best local food in HCM, you cannot find elsewhere.

Our tour leader was great, very knowledgeable and accommodating to the needs of the tour members.

Most of all, the drivers were very professional both as driver and guide. And yet, they are the most charming and friendly girls. My driver didn't just talk about the places we passed by, we also talked about all sort of things. The beauty of this tour is that it is personal. It is not just about a tour guide showing you different sights. It is more about knowing someone and you experiencing the warmth and hospitality of the Vietnamese people. And of course, did i say, excellent driving!

Great fun - but don't believe all the hype - First and foremost this is a lot of fun. The girls are nice and friendly and it is great fun to drive in the chaotic streets of HCMC.

We did the foodie tour. They will customize it for you. We didn't ask for any customization and I thought the food was a bit uneven. We started with soup that was awesome - really better than any soup I've ever had in a Vietnamese restaurant in the USA. But some of the other food was just mediocre - we should have taken the time to give them more information about what we like and don't like.

The girls are not the strongest drivers - mine had been doing this for about six months and apparently was one of the more experienced drivers. They are quick to say they have never had an accident while working - but clearly that is not true. Two of the people in our group were bumped by other bikes on the ride. Nobody was hurt and it was no big deal - but realize this has an element of danger - it's not really dangerous - but there's a reason they cover you with insurance.

There was a lot of discussion in the various areas where we stopped. We had three stops where we ate and then three additional stops just to talk about where we were and what we were seeing. There was also a fair bit of political discussion which I thought was surprising - not a problem - just interesting that the girls felt free to have such conversations.

Bottom line - I thought it was fun - but wouldn't do it again. Instead next time I would hire them as tour guides - pick the 6 places I wanted to go and have them drive me around and guide etc
Great :-) - Look all the other reviews say it all, great tour (not a rip off as you can get in vietnam) and definitely a must do!!

Feel the real HCMC in safety - This tour company has been operating for 3 yrs I believe. All motor bike riders are young women with excellent English and the quality to engage you and make you feel very special.
We did the Foodie tour were night and the Shopping tour during the day. both were 3hrs long and we felt solo safe on the bikes as the girls are trained to ride carefully. We were "guarded" by security guys and our tour leader Tai Dang was knowledgable and personable. Everyone's desires and special needs were catered for. The security keeps an eye on us all in case of trouble- none.
A very professional organization and honestly the best way to experience HCMC. i'm a frequent traveler to VN for work and this tour showed me places I never would have seen otherwise.

Foodie Tour - a fantastic experience! - We did the Foodie Tour with XO tours on our second day in Ho Chi Minh City. It was absolutely fantastic, and a great way to learn about the different districts of the city whilst also trying some weird and wonderful street food! I was a little nervous about riding round on a motorbike at first, especially after seeing what the traffic is like in Saigon, but my driver - Ms Huong was very safe and such good company. The Tour Leader Ms Khanh was also very friendly and knowledgable. Would definitely recommend this tour!

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City!!!! - On our first day in Ho Chi Min we booked this tour. Best way to explore the city and find out where to go and what to visit. XO picked us up at the Renesance Hotel on time. As a family of 6 they provided 6 fantastic female drivers who took us down the streets of Ho Chin Min. On top of this they provided an excellent tour guide (Tai Dang) who told us a lot about the history of Vietname and the city. No worries all save, excellent drivers, lots of fun! Reliable tour guides and we paid in advance and all OK. Must do in Ho Chi Min and make sure to book this at the start of your visit!

Absolutely fantastic - We did the foodie night tour which we both loved. XO tours are very friendly, fun and professional. Our drivers were lovely and very safe. A fantastic tour and great opportunity to venture outside District 1. We highly recommend this tour!!

The highlight of our trip to Vietnam - We have just arrived back at our hotel following the XO foodie tour and couldnt wait to thank the XO team and particularly Ms Hoang, Ms Luan and Anh (sorry if any of the spelling is incorrect) The tour was so much more than we had expected. We cannot thank you guys enough for giving us such a great and friendly tour of HCMC and the many secrets and flavors it has to offer on our honeymoon. If anyone reading this is contemplating this tour just book it - you cannot go wrong! - Tim & Michelle

Great, exciting way to see the city sights - Really fun way to see the city attractions. Tour guides and motorcycle drivers were very courteous and friendly. I went with a group of girl friends, many of whom visited Ho Chi Minh for the first time, and it was the highlight of their trip. Next time I will try their night tour to see sights outside of District 1.

The only to really see and appreciate this city - recommended By a friend's brother, we decided to take on the Vespa tour by XO tours. Their very user friendly website gave us 4 options and we picked the foodie (4 plus hours city tour plus street food experience). One of the most enjoyable experiences I have ever had in a South East Asian city. Vespas dominate this city so the truly fantastic way to get to know this huge place a little better is to jump in. They offer only female drivers, which I think is much safer. They also have some security bikes to make sure everything goes well. You get to see places you would never find or dare to explore on your own and the food is fantastic.

A tour not to be missed! - I am not one to take to organize tours but this has to be the best ever. From the moment the bike riders Ms Huong and Ms Van introduced themselves and gave my friend and I a run down on the Dos and Don'ts, to the time we got off the bikes at the end of the tour nearly 5 hours later, it was a well-paced evening of good local food, well spread out between rides through 5 different districts, with occasional stops for commentaries by Tai (funny chap who speaks good English) and great social conversation with Ms Huong that allowed me greater insights to the country and people. The evening of sight-seeing was definitely made more memorable amidst the excitement of riding pillion through the busy Saigon traffic in a tour group that is about 30 people strong. I would highly recommend the tour to anyone who comes here, the riders really took great personal care of each and everyone of us, great hospitality, great value for money, definitely not to be missed. Well done to the XO group for making the experience a great one through their very well -trained riders and guides, many thanks for the experience...Johnstone 9 Dec 2014 (Singapore)

Wonderful evening with Anh Pham and his 2 woman team of excellent female scooter drivers - What an enjoyable evening we just experienced with XO tours Ho Chi Minh City. Having been here 3 days already we thought we had seen everything HCMC. Had to offer - but not at all! We were promptly picked up from our hotel by 2 beautifully dressed young ladies who expertly manoevred us through the traffic to Chinatown's central market to meet our tour group- 4 people max. I was nervous to start but soon relaxed as I saw my driver confidently weave through the traffic of districts 5,6& 8 where we enjoyed a fantastic dinner. The tour continued through District 8,7(new town) and 4 before returning to our hotel.
Thank you XO tours for a great night! Highly recommended😃😃

Authentic, Excellent and Fun! - Definitely one of the best tours to take in HCM. We did the Saigon by night tour and it couldn't have been any perfect as an end to our Vietnam trip! The XO Tours Girls picked us up at our hotel and we drove through the rush hour traffic. The girls are chatty, funny and speaks excellent english. Very careful drivers so no need to worry about riding at the back. Anh, our "captain"/tour leader shared a number of stories and info about Vietnam. He was very animated and funny too! I recommend that you don't bring any bags, so you'll be more comfortable during the ride, but in case you have one, they got storage in the seat of the scooter. Taking out your camera during the ride is not allowed but I suggest you use a go pro and attach to your helmet or use a wristband.

We went around the different districts and it was awesome to see places which other tourists don't usually visit. My guide was really good and she shared many info about HCM and the different districts we went. Got the best tips on where to go and hang out for night life in Saigon too!

Great food tour at night - Excellent value for money foodie tour to some off-the-beaten yrack eateries. Food, tour guides and drivers were all excellent. Professional operation. There were lots of different foods to try but no pressure. I ventured outside my comfort zone with frog and baby duck eggs. Different

Expensive, but definitely worth it! - Foodie tour was great - we ate at 4 places in total, with 2 other stops of sightseeing in between. Amazing food! All of these places are local and authentic, outside of the touristy district 1. The guide and the girls (our drivers) are incredibly professional and nice, they made sure we are happy, well fed and well taken care of throughout. I was injured (very minor, my own fault) and every one in the team helped to make sure I was okay. Huge thanks to my driver (khuyen) :) who took great care of me. Definitely highlight of the trip.

Well organised and so much fun. - I really liked this tour and would highly recommend it. I went on the street food tour which is partly a.city tour too. Many people have commented on the price but I think it is fair. You are met by a young girl and she becomes your one to one personal guide throughout the entire trip. There is also a tour leader who provides the necessary commentary at some of the stops accompanied by a number of support staff. Your female companion rides the motorcycle and you sit on the back. We stopped 5 times, 3 food stops and 2 photo stops. Overall there was plenty to eat and we all tried many things we had never eaten before. After the trip pictures taken during the tour are e mailed to you.These are received pretty quickly.The best stop by far is the seafood restaurant at the end. Everything is really well organised, including stopping to put on rain cloaks when the weather takes a turn for the worst. The staff are engaging and speak very good English. I had been on a city tour the previous afternoon so I found the first photo stop a bit tiresome. It was dark and we went to the Chinese market which was obviously closed. It was a very long ride away...perhaps as much as 25 minutes..... and I did not see the need or reason other than to introduce the market location. This was clearly the city tour part. I am sure others in our group probably felt differently. You are really well taken care of and it's a great chance to meet other travellers. There are light hearted moments along the way too. My only other observation is that the girls who accompany you don't eat anything the entire night. This seems really disconcerting and I think it would be better if they at least tried something along the way. We were a big group of 14/15 people.

Excellent door! - This tour was great fun. All the scooter drivers were friendly, chatty and even a bit flirty! The food that we had on the Foodie Tour was excellent and included a range of things that we hadn't tried before, including just one that I wish I hadn't tried at all, but I will go no further as it would be a spoiler. The tour included areas of the city that you wouldn't normally go to as a tourist, but there were only a couple of stops that weren't associated with eating and it would have been nice to have one or two more, but then it would probably be difficult to fit it in timewise. So, an excellent evening and I would recommend it to anyone.

I can't say enough good things! - First of all when I initially contacted XO tours, they were unable to accommodate us, but took the time to answer some basic questions I had about Ho Chi Minh such as what cab companies to use, and areas to stay, it was unrelated to their tour, but surprising that they gave us that advice!! Then when we had the night tour, it was fantastic. They were on time. Speak fantastic English, very engaging. You get even more out of the tour than the tour itself such as a meal, a little gift and they take pictures and send to you later. I was super duper impressed, and I HIGHLY recommend XO tours to anyone. They will show you a unique side of HCMC, and a very cool experience of wizzing through traffic on the back of a motorcycle.

Great way to see the city (and eat, too!) - Our family of 4 really enjoyed the XO Foodie tour!! It was great fun to ride the motorbikes around the city - with very skilled and confident local drivers. Our drivers/ tour guides - all young ladies in beautiful traditional dresses - were exceptional: Nhung, Trang, Thuc and Thu - thank you so much for making this experience so memorable! Anh, the tour lead, guiding the group from place to place providing interesting facts and background. Overall, the tour was very well organized, we felt safe and cared for throughout. This is not the cheapest food tour in Saigon but it is definitely worth the money! I highly recommend it.

A few practical notes: we booked the tour on the same day and were picked up very promptly. The girls made us feel welcome and build rapport right away, told us a lot about the city and its culture during the rides. There were 4 other travelers in the group so it still felt pretty personal. Riding the motorbikes was really fun - and since we weren't driving it, we could enjoy watching the sites. Really liked the market place in China town - wish we had time to browse. The food was abundant and diverse so you could always find what you like. The clam soup (at the very end of the trip) was AMAZING!

XO - the way to go - We had the most amazing evening.
To be honest after traveling through Vietnam, we found Ho Chi Minh City the least interesting and District 1 is so international with all the Western food chains, it was quite a disappointment.
We decided to do the foodie tour with XO, never thought we would travel around Saigon on the back of a bike in that crazy traffic, but we felt completely safe.
Our guides were an absolute hoot, we saw different areas of Saigon we would never have visited otherwise, tried an amazing selection of food and had one of the best nights fun with our guides and the rest of the group. A back up security team followed us throughout the evening to ensure our complete safety and the tour leader took photos during the evening and emailed them to us which was a really nice touch.
You have to do this tour when you visit Ho Chi Minh City.

Highlight in Saigon - We are 2 couples late 50's to 70 who did both the city tour and food tour. The young ladies made this a day to remember. They were excellent drivers and treated us royally. I can think of no better way to see the city. Thank you XO tours for a wonderful day and the photos.

The Best Way to see the city & LOTS of fun! - We booked a private tour with XO just for a morning excursion and it was excellent!
My husband and I had a moped each with a young lady driving, they were very fun and excellent drivers!! We then had a tour guide who stopped at each point of interest, young chapter I think called An Pham ....he is hilarious and really made learning SO much fun! The 2 girls- I cannot remember their names were so much fun.

We saw and learned a lot and actually this is the best way to see the city especially if time is short or you have lots of other things booked to do!

I booked the trip before we left the UK via email, they were prompt in response, and very reasonable. This is an absolute MUST whilst in HCM!

XO Shopping Spree Tour - Mum and I have just stepped off of a couple of scooters from XO Tours. We had the absolute pleasure of being ridden around Ho Chi Mihn on the back of Vi and Nang's scooters while our tour leader Tai led the way (I hope I spelled your names right, sorry if I didn't guys). The sweet girls and very lovely Tai were not just super experienced riders - not once did mum or I felt unsafe or scared - we loved every minute of it, they catered to our shopping needs, were great conversationists and also looked out for us so we didn't get overcharged at local markets or shops. We would more than highly recommend XO Tours if you ever visit Vietnam. Our only regret, is that we didn't have more time to do their night tour or have more time to hang out with Vi, Nang and Tai who were heaps of fun! photos to come

Great trip in an otherwise mediocre city - This tour and the drivers made this city for us. Essentially for many, Saigon is a major entry point into Vietnam and most people spend a couple of days here with a side trip to the Cu Chi tunnels or the Mekong Delta here before moving on. It's a hot, dusty, dirty, snarling working city, the economic hub of the country and the major means of getting around is by moped. And that's the beauty of this tour, you're immediately dropped right into the heart of the traffic, zig zagging through main roads, side streets, markets and areas of the city you would not normally see. The girls were very smart, well informed, exceptionally polite and funny and very skilled drivers making my wife and I feel at ease. We did the evening tour on Saturday night at rush hour, more of an adrenalin rush than any rollercoaster!
It was a little pricey at and the city does not for me have as much to offer as Hanoi and that's the only reason I gave the tour 4 instead of 5. Full marks and more of course if i could just for the guides

Hands down, best tour I've ever been on. (Foodie) - I knew before we left for HCMC that the "Foodie" tour was something I wanted to go on, what I didn't expect was how it would exceed my expectations, or just how worthy it's ranking on tripadvisor is.

We were a last minute booking (my disorganisation) only calling the office right on their cut-off for the Foodie tour but Anh "whom we would find out to be the tour leader" was more than happy to have us along and briefed us what was required.

That evening we were met by two lovely ladies Huong and Thit (please accept my most humble apologies if I misspelled your names) whose friendly, educated and professional manner would make the tour even better.

As we drove to the first place to meet the rest of the group (including other tourists on the tour which adds another fun factor, as you can regale stories, share info and make new friends) the girls really make the effort to get to know you and point out things about the traffic/architecture or other things which you may not know about.

I won't list down each individual dish (as I can't remember the names so excuse my ignorance) but you get to eat a noodle dish, various types of seafood, goat and an interesting dish which I won't spoil by naming it (look forward to it though!). The beer/soft drink is ever-flowing which is an absolute treat (and had me quite inebriated by the end). The food is all so tasty and just like the beverages - as much as you can eat! You really get your moneys worth!

Along with the food they also take you to a few sight-seeing destinations and give you the history and some anecdotal facts on each. They will also takes photos during the trip and send them to you after free of charge, a great addition to an already fantastic tour!

The tour staff cannot be faulted, they ensure you really get the most out of the tour and are 100% enjoying yourself.

Once again I would like to convey my deep gratitude to the whole team for one of the absolute best times I've ever had on holiday!

Warmest Regards,

Liam & Samantha

Excellent street food, Excellent experience - Did an amazing street food tour last night. On the back of motorbikes through the streets of Saigon!! Great fun and great food. These lovely ladies looked after us well and drive very safely!!
It was raining a bit so our tour was (sensibly) delayed for 30 minutes. We were kept informed by email and it all went smoothly from there. Riding on the back of bikes in the mad traffic is so cool. I felt very safe. Food was great and they catered for my daughter's dislike of seafood - she was the one that missed out big time. The prawns, crab, clams, scallops were superb!! And our hostesses did all the dirty work like crushing the crab claws etc.
Did I mention that there were probably 4 security guys travelling with us all the time too.
This is an excellent tour - pricey - but it covers many things - experiencing Saigon traffic from a bike, seeing parts of this vast city that you probably would not, eating at places that you probably wouldn't mainly due to the language barrier & you won't have to eat for at least a day afterwards - totally worth it. Big thanks to Tai and his band of beauties (oh and the muscle men too!)
JUST DO IT!!

Wonderful Foodie Tour! - To begin our food extravaganza, Nicole and I met up with two lovely and impossibly thin college educated women in front of the old Saigon Opera house. They were wearing a traditional dress of Vietnam called the ao dai, this one was a particularly distinctive uniform, made up with a long white sheath and blue pants; we couldn't miss them. After some brief instructions, like you can't hold onto the driver and don't make any sudden moves, off we went into the insane traffic of Ho Chi Minh City.
Seated behind our young chauffeurs we were whisked away with a dozen other hungry tourists, to wind our way through the ocean of motorbikes and automobiles that choke the streets and alleyways of this city that is home to nearly 7,000,000 souls.

We started out with Bun Bo Hue. This delightful bowl of noodles and savory beef broth was a delicious introduction to Vietnamese cuisine. Next a barbecue restaurant where goat breast, frog and shrimp were served with a fermented tofu paste and more chili. Here, our charming drivers became personal chef and attendant. They cooked our food over small tabletop braziers, shelled the shrimp and placed these tasty morsels before us faster than we could consume them. Everything was flavorful and delicious.

The final food stop was a seafood extravaganza! Crab claws stir fried with chili and garlic, clams sautéed with chili sauce and lemongrass, and the star of the show, grilled scallops. The small, tender scallops were cooked over a charcoal brazier on the half shell with butter, scallions and peanuts. What an incredible treat this was. They kept the food coming to the table until we told them to stop.

They provided all of the food we could eat and as much beer as we wanted (just so long as we didn't fall off the scooter), it was a great trip and I recommend it to everyone interested in Vietnamese food.

A must when in Ho Chi Minh City - This was the best tour we did in Vietnam. I have never been on a bike before and was nervous and the crazy traffic of the city did not help. But once you're on the bike that nervousness goes and you have a good time.
We did the foodie tour and we loved it. The girls were amazing and did everything to make sure you felt safe and were having a good time and the tour guide, who joined you, was funny and very knowledgeable. The food was amazing and you have the opportunity to see more of the city that a tourist would never get to see. I strongly recommend this tour, you will have fun, eat lots and see more of the city.

Best introduction to Vietnam ever - Booked here on evening on arrival for a quick introduction to Vietnam and wasn't disappointed. Great food, lovely people, nice ride around the city and a genuine good time :)

Excellent way to experience some of the charm of Saigon - This activity gets my two thumbs up.

I expected a fun time and I wasn't disappointed. The Missus and I booked two tours for the same day which was our first full day in HCMC.

WE did the sights tour in the morning with one other couple on board and we continued in the evening with the foodie tour.

I regret I didn't write down the names of the ladies who drove us and alas, even the Missus with her iron trap memory is at a loss to recall.

An attempt of sorting name wise. The Missus has come up on the morning tour with the names Tune, and Tee. In the evening one of the two ladies has a name that sounds like voe.

The ladies while driving in the insane motorbike traffic of HCMC showed confidence and skill.

The ladies made us feel completely comfortable and I was only sorry when the time came that our tour was finished.

Don't miss this opportunity to step out of the standard tourist box.

Excellent!! - We did the day time sights tour, and the night time foodie tour, and by far the best tours we have ever done in any country.
Safe, crazy, fun and laughter are order of the day!
Highly recommended.

Xo Tour HCMC - My son and I did the City Sights Tour and it was really good. There was only 4 people on the tour....two girls from California and my son and I. What surprised me was that there was a whole support team to look after us, not just the two lovely young ladies who rode the bikes. Huong the tour leader did a particularly good job of explaining the history of all of the sites we stopped at. I would recommend the tour as the girls were great fun.

This one you'll remember - We did the Foodie tour and I don't regret any single cent spent on it. It's just fabolous. Riding on a scooter in HCMC traffic, having a driver, who is a girl maybe half a size of me ;) But I felt so safe and relaxed, just smiling to myself all the time, enjoying every second of this amazing tour.
Food was delicious, we could taste (at least those I remember) some soup from middle Vietnam (not Pho), goat, squid, frog, shrimp, crab, scallop, coconut jelly for dessert and last but not least, the (in)famous egg with duck embryo. Of course no one will force you to eat it :)
I don't like buying souvenirs from my trips, so I thought of choosing an option to have a video made of this trip. It's a nice option that'll help you recall all those fantastic moments you have during this tour and show it to your friends and family.

Dont hesitate - My wife and I did two tours with XO - the morning sights and the Saigon by night. Both tours were really amazing and the guides are super enthusiastic and really eager to ensure that you have a great time. Not to mention the highlight of zipping around town in scooters.

Every visitor to HCM should do at least one of the tours - between the Sights and the night tour - I would recommend the sights first and if you have time do the night.

I did the foodie tour in Hanoi, so was not keen on doing it in HCM again - although we did bump into the foodie tour and they seemed to be having a blast at a bbq joint! If we were in HCM for an additional night, I would have done that too!!!

Not to be missed and gives an excellent introduction to a very diverse city. Cant recommend it enough.

P.S - never once did we feel unsafe on the scooters.

fantastic fun - This is a must when in HCM. We were a group of 4 and had a fantastic night tour visiting areas we otherwise would not of seen. Tour guide Anh was very informative and the 4 girls were excellent drivers and we soon relaxed when we hit the road. We had a lot of fun and this is definitely the best thing to do when in HMC. Traffic really busy but don't let this put you off as the girls are very professional and put you at ease, and as we are of the older generation if we can do it so can anyone. So have a go and book up you will not regret it.

An Incredible Night's Journey with Fantasic Tour Guides - We just got back from a brilliant night tour with our amazing riders Jane and Hon. We were submerged into the HCMC traffic and saw everything at street level unencumbered by a metal cage. The food was spectacular and as local as it gets - incredible flavors, and all served to us with a smile. We were initially quite anxious about being on the back of a scooter in the traffic, but we felt as safe as houses whilst out there. The girls were extremely capable riders and extremely cautious. We can't recommend this experience highly enough.

Best experience in Vietnam! - We were in Vietnam for 2 weeks and the Foodie tour was by far the best experience we had!

The Foodie tour felt more like going out with a bunch of friends than being on a tourist tour. The drivers made us feel safe and comfortable, and the food we tasted was the best food we had during our whole trip.

We had so much fun and I would highly recommend XO tours for anyone who is going to visit Saigon!

If you only have time to do one thing in HCMC, then THIS IS IT! - Four of us did the night 'foodie' tour taking in districts that are off the beaten tourist track. Any safety doubts were soon put to rest by the highly able, confident and very friendly and playful female drivers. We had huge amounts of fun and regardless of whether you are on a tight budget (we paid US$72pp) it is worth every penny (cent!) and we will certainly remember the experience for a very long time to come.

Loved it! - Riding around Saigon at night on the back of a motorbike was a great way to see and experience parts of the city we wouldn't have seen on our own! Motorbikes are so much a part of the sights in the city it's a lot of fun to experience it first hand. would recommend!

As good as the hype - I was told by a workmate to take the tour. I did and I wasn't disappointed. The girls we had for my wife and I were just lovely. Really genuine and very informative. The food was really diverse as well. I did eat Frog but not a big fan of duck eggs. Don't be turned off by this as there is more food and drink available than you will need. It is a great thing to do as soon as you arrive. It gives you a good sense of the districts and how the city has evolved and works. Book now.

I highly recommend XO Tours. - Three of us did two private tours with the girls from XO Tours - The Sights and The Foodie tour. They were fantastic and the girls were very friendly and full of information.
A little nervous at first because of the volume of traffic but they soon put you at ease as they weaved their way through the busy Saigon traffic.
True professionals

What a way to see Saigon! - Must admit to being a little apprehensive at the thought of joining the millions (?) on a vespa or the like in HCMC! However my fear were unnecessary as I managed to survive not 1 but 2 tours with XO and my awesome guide Thao in one day! Starting with the city sites tour in the morning we managed a whirlwind trip around the major city highlights. A great way to get a taste and some ideas of where to spend some more time. Later in the evening I joined the foodie tour which was again fantastic and a wonderful introduction into the tastes of Vietnam. I love a good Pho however the noodles I had that evening were better than any Vietnamese noodles I have ever had - if only I could remember what they were called! Highly recommend these tours - the girls were lots of fun and gave a great insight into the life and history of the city. Don't be afraid...!!

The best way to see Ho Chi Minh city - We were a group of four ladies of different ages varying between 22 and 55 and this tour was a highlight of our 6 days in Vietnam. After spending 3 days trying to dodge the motor bikes in Ho Chi Minh we were very nervous at the thought of getting on the back of one for 2 hours. When we arrived and met our drivers we were even more nervous to discover they were four tiny little girls in beautiful traditional silk dresses. It probably took a good 45 minutes for me to relax on the bike and let the poor drivers shoulders go (I was holding on for grim death). The others relaxed within 10 minutes and were having a ball. The drivers were so confident and professional yet friendly and informative. We visited areas we wouldn't have gone to and learned plenty of history along the way. We stopped at some markets for dinner before heading back to the city. We all agreed that we would certainly do this tour again.

Great food and great fun! - The Saigon Foodie Tour absolutely lives up to its 5 star reviews by every other reviewer. The food is diverse, daring, abundant and excellent. The tour leader Anh promises that food and drink are unlimited and that it will keep coming until you beg for it to stop, and that is definitely the case. No pho nor banh mi on the tour, but rather lots of food that the locals favor that tourists will likely not discover. We tried grilled goat, grilled for us right at our table by the girls, frog, duck embryo, and plenty of less exotic choices. The venues were generally large outdoor establishments full of partying locals, so the atmosphere was electric. Beer flows and you learn the rowdy Vietnamese toast.

You are picked up by your personal driver who is like your own geisha for the night: Beautiful girls in their 20s dressed in traditional garb who drove you through Saigon's harrowing traffic to meet up with all the other girls and their guests at each stop. The girls are chatty, charming and attentive, preparing your food at each stop and attending to you and only you as if you were the only person on the planet. Our drivers were Hoang and Queen and they were adorable and charming.

The tour winds through seven districts (I think) which covers dramatically different views of Saigon. Two of the five stops are not food stations but rather they are interesting cultural contrasts from District 1. Tour leader Anh explains the significance of these stops, but mostly I think they are about food pacing. You will enjoy the inside joke about the lawn chairs behind the gas station. Pay attention for that.

I would suggest doing this tour soon upon arrival in Saigon, as it serves as a great orientation to the very large and diverse city.
Foodie Heaven - The girls were wonderful and anyone would like this tour. It was well organized and informative. Well recommended.

What a blast..... - If you are looking for a terrific way to see Ho Chi Minh City without stepping into a taxi or onto a bus, you must try XO Tours. All female drivers dressed in the traditional Ao Dai on motorcycles weave between traffic to take you to Reunification Palace, Notre Dame cathedral, through farmer's markets and tiny alleyways. All the while providing advice where to shop and not to shop safely and without getting ripped off. A male guide meets you at the attractions and provides information then it's back on the motorcycle and off to the next point of interest. It was a great way to become oriented to the city. Bottled water is provided and you collect a cool drink while still on the cycle.... a Vietnamese drive-through. Ladies it's a blast!!

Free! - We did the Saigon by night tour and really liked it. They drove us through different districts in HCMC, got us some street food, and gave truly interested commentary on it all. Our guides were Khanh and Thuy - they were excellent.

I think we would have preferred to do one of the food tours, and would certainly go on that next time in HCMC. This tour was awesome but I always want more food when in Vietnam. On this tour, we got our choice of a couple of entrees and then drove to an outdoor area to have our meal.

Was really great to be able to see different districts in HCMC. It was really enlightening and interesting to see.

Highly recommend!

Amazing foodie tour! - Yes, it is a bit pricey, but it is worth every penny and you get what you pay for! Amazing tour guides, delicious food, great fun! They accommodate your every request! I would love to do it again! Big thanks to our amazing drivers! ;)

Excellent Ladies - What an experience! Definitely a way to see Ho Chi Minh City, and nearly all of it. The ladies were excellent drivers and as a nervous road passenger I felt so safe on the bike. It is by far the best was to see HCMC! The ladies are great fun, informative and the food was fabulous !!

Must-do tour! - We booked this tour based on the reviews and were not disappointed. A moped tour is a must do in Ho Chi Minh! The guides were fantastic. The tour was well arranged. We saw so much more of the city than anything else we did. Very informative. They told us at the beginning that we could eat until we couldn't eat anymore. That was the case. The drinks flowed. We had food that we would never have experienced on our own. The drivers and additional staff were very fun and great to interact with. We will do this again if we get it back.

The Perfect Way to Celebrate my Birthday - Everything was perfect, the more I think about it, now I'm back in the UK, still jetlagged and just completed my first day back at work what a fantastic night and experience this was.

Tia our tour leader was informative, funny and still dont know how he remembered all the names. The girls were great fun, but special mention to my driver Thuy who was just a superstar. I felt completely safe at all times, she was great company and great fun. Sometime during our chats it came up it was my birthday, so for Thuy to arrange a surprise cake at our last stop was a complete surprise and was just a perfect end to a perfect night.

Wherever I went in Vietnam I told everyone I met how good the tour was. I used the phrase book where ever possible and this was a lot of fun.

If you're in Saigon and want to do something you'll never forget, do this, I know I wont. If you read this Thuy, I hope your birthday is as good as mine was with you and the rest of the team at XO Tours, thank you so much.

Thank You For A Awesome Night!!! - I just want to say Thank you to the XO ladies (and gentlemen bodyguards lol) for an excellent foodie tour. I emailed them in advance stating I only eat seafood and got a response back promptly stating that would not be a problem at all. The ladies picked me and my friend up from our hotel on time and off we went on our motorbikes in the night and crowded streets to meet up with the rest of the group. From then on everything was excellent. My friend teased that they did everything for us just short of putting the food in our mouth. LOL!!! This joke was meant in a good way meaning they did everything for you and you wanted or got up for nothing. They really took care of you. I felt safe the whole trip. This was our first trip to Vietnam (Asia period) and they definitely made it a trip to remember. Also I am a "picky" eater and I must say all the food I ate was amazing. This team is great. If I ever make it back to Ho Chi Minh I would without a doubt tour with them again and I will be recommending this group to others that will be coming to Vietnam. Thank you ladies!!!!!

Must Do - Top Attraction in HCM - We had a great night out in town with the XO tours. Great way to see the other districts in HCM apart from district 1. We booked the foodie tour which is a well paced trip with 5 stops along the way. 3 stops for food and 2 for attractions.
Beer is available and included at the 2nd and 3rd food stop.
The girls are excellent and safe riders and the entire experience is well organized .The Girls are just brilliant, hospitable and friendly .
The foods we got to taste were very exotic and unique. The time interval between the food spots is well spaced out and you can binge all you want.
We even received all the photos of our via email during 3 days of our trip.
Also the booking process was well coordinated via email.

The most exhilarating experience - The tour delivered more than what we expected - we did the Saigon by night tour which was great fun. Out of the norm to be riding at the back of a scooter in a busy place by safe for all and seeing places that you won't see on any other tour. The girls are excellent riders and we feel very safe riding with them. Great company, great food and plenty of it... Ning, Thanh and Trang - thank you for the most memorable experience in Saigon!

101% must-do in HCMC! - The team of lady riders are fantastic! Pretty, friendly, hospitable, fun and warm people. Exciting and very safe rides to many districts of HCMC which u probably wouldn't venture into on ur own. Gear up for a fun night out! Are u ready? :)

Best night out ever in Vietnam - What great fun this was, it was a very special evening doing something that under normal circumstances you couldn't do. This was brilliant, riding around a busy city on the back of a scooter seeing places that you won't see on any other tour. The girls are excellent riders and we feel very safe riding with them. Great company, great food and plenty of it... thanks girls!

Fantastic night out! - Many thanks to all the Girls and Anh our Tour Leader. We had a fantastic night out, the girls were great on the bikes, 110% safe and made the traffic look easy, you almost feel like a local when you are on the back of the bike! The food and drinks were great and there was plenty of both. A great tour that I will be recommending to all my friends looking to travel to Ho Chi Min City!

Great Tour - Did the sights tour in Ho Chi Minh with XO. Great organization, tour guide very good. Scooter driver Ngan was excellent. Very safe and enjoyable tour. Certainly I would do another tour with them. Great value for money.

Fantastic! - My partner and I had such a great time tonight on our tour! Food was delicious (thank you again for breaking all the crab), abundant drinks and the company from both the XO girls and other tour goers was awesome! Special mention to our wonderful guides Vu, Thi and tour leader Khanh, you really went beyond what we expected! Thank you sooooo much!

Huge Amount of Fun - Massive thanks to Yen, Ing and Tai - had an awesome private tour arranged for my girlfriend and I. Hadn't been on the back of a Moped in ages and whilst the prospect of becoming a HCMC road user was daunting the girls made verty light work of the traffic and we felt safe and in control the whole time.

Great inside knowledge delivered byTai and the girls in a really cool way that was informative and fun!

Couldn't recommend this highly enough.

Keep up the good work

Great night out! - XO tours really is a must do in Ho Chi Minh city! No need to be afraid of the traffic, the girls are great drivers and within minutes you'll love cruising around the city and being in amongst the thousands of other scooters on the roads.

The foodie tour is the most popular and I've no doubt it's a great choice but we went for the 'Saigon by Night' tour - a 2-3 hour drive around the city, taking you out into a variety of districts, each with their own distinct character. You also get to stop and have some decent street food for dinner.

We loved our experience with XO tours and can't recommend it highly enough! Do it!

Best tour! - Must do. This tour is fantastic! Four hours on the back of a motorbike. Authentic Vietnamese food tried frog and goat. Visit 3 restaurants and heaps of site seeing. You get to see the poor and rich sides of Saigon what a contrast! Well worth it. It

The 'Foodie' Tour was a highlight trip - We did 'The Foodie Tour' on our second night in Vietnam & loved it. Our guides were lovely, the food was delicious plus it was fantastic to hear from them what Vietnamese life is like. They took us to some great spots dining with the locals, sampling some delicious Vietnamese food. Well worth the money.

Great fun! - I had such a great time on the Foodie Tour! Touring HCMC on the back of a scooter is a MUST DO when visiting, it's all chaos but somehow it works and it has a certain charm.

Because our guides were ladies, we had our own group of bodyguards to protect us from possible bag snatchers too.

I would do it all again!

Awesome fun, you have to do it - We had an awesome shopping tour with the XO ladies, the video crew and Tai the tour manager. They are fantastic drivers and excellent English speaking guides. They took us to areas that catered for our shopping requests and when a shop did not have what we required, would take us to another shop.
