We loved the experience of riding on the back of the scooters, it is much less scary than being in a car in Vietnam. We enjoyed it so much we wanted to do the evening tour but unfortunately it was fully booked. We also had the video made which is a great memento of our tour.

Friendly & Fun - We were met at our hotel by our lovely chauffeurs/ guides for the much anticipated Street Food tour. After a quick introduction we headed into the traffic to the first stop where we met up with the rest of the group & tasted our first dish of the night.
The sights & sounds of Saigon from the back of the scooter is probably the highlight of this trip. I have visited the city on a couple of other occasions & have done the regular sights but this is by far my favourite. The tour is very well managed by Tung, we felt very safe in the hands of our lovely drivers and the accompanying security guys.
All of the food was delicious, I tried all but the balut dish, the frog was a little outside my comfort zone & definitely not my favorite but ok.
We were given lots of information about the various districts we visited too, not just driven from one point to another. Our drivers were all lovely, very well educated young ladies who engaged us all in great conversation & were like good friends at the end of the evening.
My bike got a flat tire on our way back to the hotel & there was someone to our rescue within 5 minutes & we were delivered back to our hotel safely & happy after a fantastic evening.
Great value for money in my opinion, 4 1/2 hours of personal service, care & attention. Riding through the city at night was amazing & I highly recommend this tour.

Fantastic! Do this!! - We had a fabulous evening with the ladies of XO Tours! Great fun, despite a little rain, and we never had a moment of regret. They are expert drivers, navigating the scooter-filled streets of Saigon, so nothing to be nervous about. Picked us up at our hotel right on schedule, and we were disappointed when it was over a few hours later. The pics and videos they sent us that were included in our package are wonderful, and I'm expecting we'll revisit our trip over and over again in the coming years :)
Thanks Thu for an amazing evening!

You gotta do it! - XO tours are doing the impossible: making you feel perfectly safe in the chaos that is Saigon traffic. My wife and I did the foodie tour in October. Fantastic experience. The highlight was definitely the riding. Our drivers were skilled, informative, completely relaxed and competent as only Saigon locals can be. The food was not high brow, but enjoyable nonetheless. If you do nothing else in Saigon, you must at least do this!

A slick and fantastic fun tour! - WOW - took the foody tour with my 12 3/4yr old son and husband on our last night in Vietnam and what a way to finish! We had so much fun, learned and ate loads and a great way to see Saignon too! My son made the final decision about which company to go with and we had no regrets - such a slick operation - BIG thanks to Loan, Thao and Thuy our drivers for safely transporting us and for all the laughs! Some great photos on our return was a real bonus! Thanks to our fantastic tour guide Pham too.

a lot of fun and a lot of good food - it was a vey fun experience side we went to districts in HCMC that otherwise you would never visit. The girls that drive the motorbikes were the cutest kindest nicest and really added to the fun and our tour manager was also a fantastic host. The food was different and with a lot of variety, a truly fun experience!

So much fun.....MUST DO - We did the foodies tour but I am guessing any of their tours would be just as must fun & insightful.....we only decided to book the day before......filled in the only form with in 10 mins received email reply......unfortunately the 530pm tour was booked out but they would add an extra one if we were prepared to go @ 430pm.......no problems for us & actually a bonus as there only ended up being myself, my hubby & Scott (we just met him on the tour) a private tour for 3.......from pick up we felt as if we were in great hands........my driver Tam chatted all night when we were on the bike asking me question & answering any question I had for her.........being on the back of a bike in crazy HCMC traffic was great fun (we live in Thailand & ride scooters but the traffic isn't this crazy)......the girls showed us stuff we would never have seen with out the local knowledge, nor would we have gone to the place they took us........the food was awesome @ each of the 3 stops & there was more than enough of everything.......extra thanks for getting the eggs for us even if we didn't eat them (I did try the soup but couldn't eat the little chicken).......this is a must do while here.....we will defiantly do it again next time we are here

Put this on your list! - I did the doody tour. 4 hours of fun with my guide and driver Pinky. 6 districts, four hours, free flowing food and beverages. How could you go wrong?!?

The tour company is appropriately called xo tours cause afterwards that's exactly what I wanted to do: give them a kiss and a hug!

Still got my phrase book which came in handy!

Cam On!

Best thing we did in HCM - I was quite anxious about getting on a motorbike but the guides are great drivers and motorbike is the best way to see this city - a few minutes in I was super comfortable. The guides, tour manager and security staff are so great and take really great care of you. We tried good we wouldn't have otherwise known was available, learned a bunch about HCMC and Vietnam, and generally just had a really fun night. Couldn't fault them.

Highlight of HCMC - Its rating is well deserved. Our family was pretty tired after a day at the water park and I had to talk them into this - but it was our favorite activity of our entire trip! We did the tour by night. Great guides - fun, engaging and informative. It was great to get out of District 1 and see a little more of HCMC with people who know their way around. Lots of fun and great photos emailed to us at no extra charge.

Definitely do this - Seeing Saigon by motorbike is way better than on your legs. The drivers and guides are professional and lovely. Food is good and they can cater to your specific requirements. One of the highlights of our trip

A must-do in Saigon! - Hands down the best tour of any kind I've been on. We went on the 'Foodie' tour, and had 5 stops, 3 of them for food. The food was great, our hosts were delightful, and the motorbike rides between the stops were great fun. Sure, jumping on the back of a bike seemed a bit scary at first, but our hosts were so careful that we soon enjoyed the ride and wished we were driving ourselves! If we had more time in the city, we would have tried our all their tours. Wish that this company were operating in Hanoi also so we could have done a tour like this at the start of our trip.

Great guide, awesome street food, loads of fun... - A friend and I booked the XO food tour in advance of our trip and were told that two girls would meet us at our hotel at a set time to pick us up...ideal.

They spoke great English and made us feel really welcome, they were great riders and knew what they were doing. We visited several street food places throughout the various districts and ate some tasty local food as well as some off the wall delicacy's including 'balut' a duck embryo cooked hard boiled in the shell....

The tour guide was great,he gave us lots of information about the history of Saigon and took us to parts of the city that the average tourist would not get to see. Getting round the city by bike is so much fun and adds a bit of adventure to the tour. Overall well worth the money.

Definitely a must - Wow what a great start to our Vietnam holiday. We traveled by taxi to the opera house where our drivers for the night were waiting. These ladies were fantastic and told us a lot about Vietnam in general and their lives. We visited a nun of different local food establishments and they were all great. You can be as adventurous as you like with your food choices. We felt safe at all times and whizzing around the traffic on the back of a scooter that was fabulous. We recommend this tour to all.

Foodie Tour - This proved to be a fantastic evening.
I was picked up at my hotel by Loan my motorbike driver, a lovely young Vietnamese lady in traditional dress, Ao Dai. She was fluent in English unlike me in Vietnamese. She also made me feel safe on the back of her bike as she negotiated the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City!
We started at a place where we had a hearty soup Bo Bun Hue simply delicious, barbeque at another venue and fish at another and also dessert. Unlimited beer for those who were interested.
We were also taken to some of the other districts which were off the beaten track.
Highly recommend this.
The tour guide Tai had great sense of humor as he led us on our adventure.

The best thing we did in Saigon! - I went to Saigon with my sister and 2 friends (we were 4 girls) and the XO girls picked us up at our hotel. They were elegant spoke great English and took us all over Saigon. We stopped in a traditional outdoor dining experience where there were only locals and got to sample some of the traditional Vietnamese dishes. It was the highlight of our trip and i would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a non traditional tour and is looking to experience living one night as a local Saigonian!! it gets your adrenaline going and was tons of fun.. would highly recommend it to anyone who wants a unique experience in Ho Chi Minh city!!

The must-do trip in the city - Highlight of my stay in HCMC. Travel the city beyond the normal tourist trail in district 1 on a moped and try the wonderful street food on offer.

No need to be scared of being on the bike. The girls are all great drivers and I loved being a passenger on Anh's bike. A great way to see the city.

Fantastic food with the scallops and clams being the highlight for me. The girls will try and talk you into trying the duck egg "delicacy" at the end of the night. I did it, but you can easily say no. They also check to see if there's anything you can't eat and will provide an alternative.

If you visit this city and love food you owe it to yourself to sign up for the foodie tour.

We had the most fun night in Saigon with XO Foodie Tour - The XO foodie tour was just as much about the fun as about the food.
The girls are lovely and professional. The security guards also helped put us at ease.
It was fantastic riding on the back of the motor scooters going from Saigon District to district and stopping along the way to try different street food. The girls are great drivers and at no time did anyone feel at risk. When we returned from holidays I was asked what was my best memory of Vietnam? This tour was the top few. Bye the way the food was pretty good as well. This is a seriously fun thing to do.

You have to do this when in HCMC!!! - My husband and i booked this tour after our daughter did it when she was on HCMC. So i booked it but then thought what am i doing as we are not young but it was one of the most fun and informative tours i have done and we felt super safe the whole time. Nothing was too much trouble and we got to see places of the city we would never have seen otherwise. AWESOME!!!!

Fantastic experience you must try - I did this night foodie tour as a solo traveller and encourage anyone travelling solo to book this trip. There were a number of other singles in the group and the one on one service you get from your driver/guide ensures a very inclusive experience. Tam was my guide and was friendly, great fun, a safe driver and spoke excellent English with a great sense of humor. She also made sure she pointed out sights along the way and even though it rained at the beginning we were provided ponchos and really, it just added to the experience. You will see parts of the city you probably wouldn't have otherwise and a lot of care is taken to ensure you are enjoying your experience. It is true when they say no one will leave still feeling hungry. Our group wanted to try some extra seafood at the last stop and this was no problem at all. I only went off the comments from TA in booking this trip and you can see from the positive comments it really is a great experience. I would recommend this to anyone and it truly was a highlight of my visit to Saigon. 10/10 from me...thanks Tam, Anh and crew...you made it an unforgettable experience!

A Fantastic Time - We are a group of friends aged between 60 & 70 and had the best time ever on our "Foodie Tour". I must admit we were all a bit nervous about the whole idea, especially experiencing the traffic and bikes in Ho Chi Minh City. The girls on the bikes were very friendly and experienced which made us feel safe and relaxed. It was a GREAT experience which we would recommend to everyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

Brilliant tour, lovely ladies - When hubby first booked this tour I had reservations about the cost and the motorbikes, having lived through the experience I would have to admit this was one of the BEST tours we had throughout our holiday! The girls on the bike rode with ease, really friendly and made the best hostesses when we met up at the restaurants. We got to see different districts within HCMC which we would never have known existed and the food was sensational. Would recommend this tour to both foodies and non foodies as the journey in the traffic is just as exhilarating as the food of Vietnam. Don't miss out and book this as a must!!!

Worth every cent - best fun ever! - I have to admit traveling in HCMC traffic on a scooter had me extremely nervous... However this was so much fun!! It didn't take long to realize the drivers knew what they were doing and made me feel extremely comfortable! By far one of the best things I have ever done whilst traveling! English speaking guides and drivers were easy to understand. We did the city sights tour - 2.5 hours well spent and just enough time at each place! Would definitely do another tour with XO if ever back in HCMC. I cannot wait to see our video!

Wonderful screw - Seriously not a fan, initially, of the motorbike idea...but this was a great experience. We did the foodie tour. Our driver/guides were over-the-top helpful, friendly and great company for the evening tour. The food was awesome. I did eat a baby bird, in the egg, which was strange...but trying everything was a goal. The seafood at the last spot was as good as any I have ever been. Really well done and a great way to get beyond District One.
Excellent - This is a great fun and informative food tour. The drivers are very professional and are very safe drivers. Excellent experience.

Best activity in Saigon - My partner and I did the 'Saigon by Night' Tour. Of a 5 week trip, it was by far a highlight!
The girls were knowledgeable and fun.
Couldn't have asked for a better way to spend my last night in Vietnam.

Fantastic, a must when visiting HCMC! - As a group of 4 friends we ventured out around HCMC with 4 of the most helpful guides, especially as I was a nervous passenger. All nerves were abandoned at the first stop & the team were fantastic at ensuring our safety at all times. Food was great & what an amazing way 2 see the city especially wiv traveling through the local market. This is a must when visiting the city & thanks to everyone at XO Tours!

Fascinating informative thrill ride! - My friend and I hopped on board two scooters in the tiny alleyway outside out hostel. Getting on and driving out to the main street was a bustling experience in itself, but we soon settled into the ride and our guides were so safe, reassuring and considerate. The food offered was unbelievably tasty, the tour guide so informative, and we saw areas of the city that really opened our eyes to life on the street/what its actually like every day in Saigon. We were only in the city one day so did the night tour, and it was the perfect way of understanding more about the country & its people. Can't recommend this enough.

Excellent XO scooter tours - My husband and I (late 40s) recently took two tours with XO and loved them both. We did the 2 hour 30 minute city sights tour and also the evening foodie tour. Both were excellent and considered I had really not had much experience on the back of a bike, let alone in Saigon traffic chaos, the girls made me feel relaxed and comfortable immediately. Both tours were great, the girls were knowledgeable and fun and it really is the best way to see Saigon. The foodie tour was an absolute highlight - we got to visit districts we probably would not normally get to, eat a range of food we would probably not have tried otherwise and have a night filled with fun, great food and laughter. Highly recommend to everyone - not matter what age.

A unique and fun way to experience Saigon - Not to be missed! - This was one of favourite tours of all time! If you love your food, dare being the streets of Saigon by scooter, and want to see a less known side of the city.. XO Tours is for you! First impression was that they were very professional - prompt, friendly and organised! We were picked up at our hotel by two lovely ladies (Tam and Duyen) dressed in traditional Vietnamese clothing, ao dai who we got to know well over the course of the night. The group met at the first destination and tried tasty alternative to pho, Bún bò Huế or bun bo. The host Ning was especially enthusiastic and informative as she introduced us to 5 different districts including district 1 (origin), China town, district 4. We got to have BBQ in a place locals go - sit in those small red chairs and outdoor tables while your driver prepared the food for you.. 1:1 service was unexpected but really outstanding.. We even had a few boys watching out for the safety of the group! We tried delicacies such as goat and frog amongst other good food like scallops and prawns. They were fantastic in providing alternatives for me as I had a shellfish allergy, and I can say that they were equally tasty! There was plenty of time to digest with time travelling and stopping at different districts. Beer was also included but I think were a well-behaved group. At our final foodie stop, we had more seafood and had the opportunity to try a SE Asian delicacy called 'balot'... I'll save that surprise for you to discover! It was a highly entertaining night - something out of the ordinary and a great way to experience Saigon by night! Special thanks to Tam and Duyen who we found to be absolutely fantastic and humorous! Best of luck to you both and thank you XO for the unforgettable experience!

amazing foodie tour! a true highlight of our trip - We had such an amazing experience with XO Tours. We did the Foodie Tour and absolutely loved it. If you are on the fence, don't be...just sign up. Here are a few reasons why.

1. the girls. so sweet, friendly and funny. they work incredible hard and deserve such kudos for the level of energy they put forth night after night (and guy! Tung was fantastic as well)
2. you get to see a side of Saigon that you could never achieve on a bus (would never take a tour bus, so this was perfect) they take you to 5 or 6 districts so you get a flavor of the full city not just the more touristy (District 1). such a different experience at night.
3. amazing food. we were so full at the end of the tour but we got to try just about everything under the sun and ate at places that felt authentic (we took the tour after 2 weeks travelling)
4. everything is so well orchestrated. XO even sent us pictures 3 days after the tour (no payment requested)

Great tour! - At first, my girlfriend and I thought the tour was a little pricey but soon found it was worth it. Firstly, the driver ladies were friendly, funny and outgoing making just driving around great fun. The detail and research that went into the tour has been much better than anything given in any other tour we've taken in Vietnam.

In short, do the tour. You won't regret it.

FANTASTIC FOOD TOUR!!! - I went on the foodie tour on my last night in Vietnam and what a way to cap it all off. It is an all round great experience. The food, the people, the areas you visit...I thoroughly enjoyed it all.

What a rush! - Great guides, great food and a zip-zooming ride through the ritzy as well as less-travelled parts of Saigon. I tried all the food (ok, except the balut, but we have that in the Philippines too) and it was good! Unlimited servings of food and drink (it's not recommended you get toasted while back-riding a scooter) and a truly long hours conversation with a well-educated and English-speaking guide are the main highlights of this tour. Shout out to Tung the owner, you have great staff as well as a great tour dude!

A lot of fun - We had the Foodie Tour, and it was Great! The girls were very friendly and drove carefully (as possible in HCMC), the guide Tai was great as well, and the food was special and delicious. the price is quite high for a 4 hour activity in Vietnam, but it was worth it.

FABULOUS FOODIE FUN!!! - This XO street food tour of Ho Chi Minh City was quite possibly the most delightful tourist experience I'd ever had. A fun-filled, thoughtfully organized event from the moment we were picked up on motorcycles by lovely and vivacious tour guides. The food and company were delightful as were visits to the city's diverse districts, peppered with an entertaining narrative of culture and history. There couldn't be a better, more memorable way to get to know this vibrant city!

The best fun we had in Ho Chi Min - The girls were lovely and made us feel very safe and consider I was ready to back out as I had never been on a moto before especially in traffic like this...it is a credit to them. We went on the day tour and it was great to be able to see the highlights so quickly as we were on limited time. Only recommendation is a bandana as fumes are horrible!!!

Fab time on mopeds - A really great evening. We did a private 4 hour food tour. The girls were great fun and it was really easy to organize. they really looked after and children ages 10 and 12 and made it fun for them. It's a great way to see the city if you only have a short time!

The best way to enjoy the city! - Tried 'Saigon by Night' & 'Sights' tours during my visit here. Both were fun in its own way with the former gives me the chance to see different districts in the city. I was totally surprised with district 7; a new built district with modernized infrastructure, variety restaurants and a high end mall. It's more interesting to learn that all these facilities are actually meant for 1,000 of its residents who can actually afford to live in this district. Be sure to experience Saigon at night by motorbike!

If you want to experience the buzz traffic of the city, the day tour will certainly allow you to do so. It's certainly a fun ride with the chance to learn the history and lifestyle of the locals. Overall, everything was taken into good care by XO tours and Tam (my rider) has done a fantastic job in ensuring that I'm comfortable throughout the tours!
Well Worth The Cost! - My wife and I had a fantastic time on the Foodie tour. We will definitely be recommending XO Tours to any friends that are traveling to Saigon.

Foodie tour - Excellent evening food tour with a really interesting variety of food, fun hosts and great bike driving!!! Vegetarians were well catered for on request. Seeing all the districts was great as well.

Most enjoyable experience by a discerning traveler ! - Booked this Foodie tour in advance due to its reviews and do no regret it!

We were picked up from our place by 2 lovely ladies in their traditional outfits. Both spoke wonderful English and were so kind and inquisitive about us.
They took us to great places for our 'street food' and everything was so delicious! (I did a street food tour in Hanoi after this and it didn't compare to this tour.)
A wide variety of foods; including goat, frog, bolut, squid, clams, beef, okra to name a few. I was worried about getting some sort of food poisoning following such exotic tastes but was absolutely fine. I especially liked how the provided guides hand sanitiser after toilet use as not many road side toilets offer a hand basin!

Highly recommend these guys and LOVE the photos they took for us. Will not forget it.

Pricey, but a lot of fun! - We did this tour in April 2014. The guides were all tiny enthusiastic girls, who were chaperoned by guys, all on motor cycles. As with most Europeans, sitting at the back seat of such a motor cycle in the buzzing HCMC is quite an experience. The girls knew that and proceeded accordingly. It was very fun to do this, we ate a lot of things we normally wouldn't and the other guests were equally enthusiastic. It's quite pricey, but nice to splurge on.

What a treat - I did the four hour Foodie tour with XO. It was an absolute delight. I ad already been in Vietnam for a couple of weeks so had managed to eat some pretty delicious food, so while the food in this tour was fine (delicious and plenty and varied), the really exciting part was riding around Ho Chi Minh on a motorbike by night! We visited several districts, which you cold never do on foot, and got to see a much bigger picture of this mad city! The young women who were our drivers were an utter delight....funny, cheeky, warm. this is not the cheapest food tour you can do in Vietnam, but definitely worth it. Another highlight of my time in this country.

XO Foodie Tour, Saigon - This tour was recommended by two different people and we also highly recommend it as well. Do not eat before you go there are heaps and heaps of food. The staff/drivers made sure we were always happy. I told them at the start of the tour that I didn't really like seafood but that I would try everything. Compared with 5 minutes notice they made sure that I had an alternative dish at each stop. They explain all the food and there is no pressure to eat things that are out of your comfort zone. However we did eat frog!! Good value got money, a great safe night out and bonus on top that they email you photos from the night. Do not miss this opportunity while in Saigon.

Worthy of all the hypes - When I booked the Foodie Tour for our group, I thought that it would be a fun tour for a large group, something different. However, I thought it might have been over-hyped by the TA community. I am glad to say that it the tour was terrific and the experience of riding on the back of a motorbike in Saigon traffic at night is indescribable. Your first thought is fear, as the young ladies in their ao dai looked more like school girls than motorcycle mamas. But they were all professional and EXCELLENT drivers. Once you loosen your grip on the seat and start enjoying the ride, the buzz of the city and its people is exhilarating. The tour was very well run, if a bit rehearsed. You get a bit of sightseeing, a bit of cultural information from the excellent tour leader, Khanh, and a lot of food. I also want to commend all the young ladies in charge of our group - fun, animated, enthusiastic, and lovely guides for the 4 hours.

Disappointing gives the high ratings and the price - We took the city tour and found it simply average, not worth the $40 pricetag. Maybe we would have been better off doing a food tour. Most of the sights they take you to are within walking distance of the hotels in district one, and while our guide did add value (showing us the secret CIA building and the place where the monk lit himself on fire), it was not worth it.The drivers were nice and sweet, and it was fun to be on a motorbike, but I would skip this tour.

A great introduction to Vietnamese food and Saigon - we decided to take this tour on our second night in the country and I am so glad we did. Not only were we introduced to a variety of Vietnamese dishes and food we were also treated to a terrific tour of the city and an intro to the culture. All this and with the fun of being on the back of a moped in the craziest traffic in the world!! But fear not as your driver and guide will make you feel comfortable and safe as they negotiate the madness that is Saigon's streets - including sights such as the wet market - which I thought referred to the fact it was live fish not that it would be under a foot of water - but again with amazing driving skills we didn't even get our feet wet.

There is the chance to try the unusual if you want, but there is certainly no pressure to do so. We had a great mix of nationalities and ages which made the small group of 8 even more fun and entertaining.

Special thanks to our drivers Huong 2 and Vu who both had a great command of English, knowledge of the City and patience with us. Also to the 'little fella' for his great commentary and loud jokes, he provided some really interesting information on the town and kept us entertained during pit stops - he completed a fantastic evening. The price may seem a little high but it's worth every penny, this company certainly knows how to look after its guests and its staff.

Our best night in Saigon! - We went on the night time Foodie Tour and had a lot of fun! We felt very safe (we were initially worried at I am 6'4 and not the lightest person) zipping around the city and got to see some parts we would never have found our way to without this tour. Alongside this we ate some awesome local food and had good banter with the knowledgable and witty guides, as well as the other tourists.

The commentary was a good mix between humor and proper local insight, touching upon social issues and norms.

We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon!

Fantastic Foodie Tour - We did the foodie tour on October 9, 2014. This was a highlight of our holiday. The girls were friendly, enthusiastic and spoke great English. The tour was run very professionally, and the tour leader checked multiple times if we had any food allergies. Getting on the back of a scooter was quite scary at first; however, the girls are very safe drivers and it didn't take long for the ride to become enjoyable. Enjoying the ride was important as a fair amount of the tour was spent checking out the city on the scooter. We were able to see many districts of the city that we would have never seen on our own. The food was delicious and different – ​​there were three food stops with over 10 different dishes to try. Lots of seafood. Beer or soft drink was included too. The tour had a fun vibe and is a must do when in Ho Chi Minh. Highly Recommended!

A must!!! - If you are a food lover and visiting HCMC don't miss the street food tour with XO tours. It will be one of the best experiences you will have in Vietnam. The tour will take you to places you will never be able to find by yourself, the food is amazing and the guides are professionals. It was a tasty 4 hours and except of the food it was a lot of fun and a great city tour of HCMC.

Great old - My wife and I recently went on the foodie tour and we had a great night. All was well organized the food was great and the tours girls just couldn't do enough for you. From the very beginning to the end nothing was left out. Make sure it is on your bucket list when visiting Ho Chi Minh.

A Return Customer - My brother and I did this tour when they first opened, it was expected and customer focused then as it is now. This is the ONLY motorbike tour company to use because this standard of service deserves loyalty
My husband and I this time have done the night tour, last time the scheduled tour.
A Plus in every way.

WOW - Best experience of our holiday! Most amazing food we have had in our lives, nicest girls and best atmosphere. Everyone was joyful and fun. We got to try the best foods of Saigon in just one amazing night. Definitely recommend!

Couldn't have been more fun! - Our stop in Ho Chi Minh City was one of our ports of call during a 17 day Asian cruise, so during the limited amount of time we had here, we had a few options available for experiencing as much as we could of this city - we could take an organized ship-sponsored tour, try it on our own, or take this immersive adventure with XO Tours. Before we'd left our home in Kansas City, we'd decided on the latter of these options, and were sure it was by far the best choice! We chose for the private tour as we wanted some flexibility with the sites we visited. They worked with us via email ahead of time regarding what would or would not be possible during the time we had available. Upon arrival, we used the ship's tour bus to Ho Chi Minh City from the port, and our XO guides Hoang and Ning met us promptly where the bus dropped us off, and we quickly started our adventure after a quick and concise safety lesson on how to safely ride as passengers on their motor bikes. These young ladies couldn't have been better drivers, hosts and guides for this visit, and no one could have done a better job of making our short visit both fun and informative. They were able to carry on conversations while driving, they drove with sensitivity for our comfort and safety, they advised us during shopping, their English was superb, and they obviously really had fun doing their job. There was also another young man who accompanied us on a third motor bike who took care of such things as the storage and transportation of things we purchased, parking of all of the bikes while weren't riding, and being there just in case of any mechanical or other problems along the way. We were pleasantly surprised to actually join the owner of XO Tours, Tung, for lunch (a meal of delicious authentic Pho), and were privileged to hear him talk about his very interesting life and how he started this unique and successful company. He also accompanied us for part of the tour after lunch and shared a lot of interesting historical information about Vietnam with us. While we were indoors shopping, the girls heard the sound of rain beginning, and we thought, "oh no, we'll probably have to stay inside until this lets up", but they said "no problem", and while we waited, they ran out to the bikes and got rain gear, brought it back and dressed us - we were ready to go. And there we were, comfortably riding down the streets of Ho Chi Minh City in a steady rain, while still hearing about the various sites. Also, during our visit to the central post office, we were privileged to be introduced to Mr. Duong Van Ngo, the last "letter writer" in Vietnam.

We can't think of any way that this tour could have been improved (other than having more time) - it was perfect. We had so much fun, we smiled so much, and would do this again without hesitation. XO Tours has a number of tour options that would satisfy just about anyone's needs, and their private tours offer the flexibility of customizing it as needed. They're well deserving of their #1 ranking. What a great group of people!

Great, easy way to explore HCMC - I was lucky enough to meet up with a friend and her daughter in HCMC at the tail end of my family vacation there. As a second time visitor I was well accustomed to Vietnam and it's motorcycling ways but as this was my friends first visit she was a little more wary.

As we both have teenage daughters we chose the shopping spree tour. It was a great way to travel around Saigon and see the sights. Tai and his team were also extremely accommodating. The shops/markets we visited were based on what we were interested in (that is what teenage girls like!). If I ever return to HCMC I'll definitely book their foodie tour as other travelers we met raved about it.

If you're wary about traveling by motorcycle I highly recommend XO as your first experience. They understand how scary it can be for first time visitors to Vietnam and have designed their packages accordingly. They also send through pics of your trip so you have a great little momento of the experience.

Highly recommended.

Great fun! - We did this tour on the recommendation of a friend of ours who did it a year ago !! All I can say is that it lived up to all our expectations !! Our drivers Mi and Houng no 2 were fantastic !! Spoke extreamly good English , very competent drivers which is no mean feat in Ho Chi Min , helpful to the extreme , peeled all the prawns , cracked the crab legs !! My husband was very impressed, wanted to know why undone do that at home for him?? !!but all in all a great fun night, where we saw a side of HCM that we would never have been able to do on our own, visited district 1,4,5,6,7 and 8!. Also ate what the locals eat ie goat , frog and quail ! But having said that if your like me and a fussy eater ie not into frog , fish etc they gave me alternative meals !! One of the best things we did in our 3 weeks in Vietnam !

XO Foodie Tour - "The Highlight of Our Trip" - This is a fantastic way to experience the many sights and different districts of Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a scooter. All the lady riders are extremely friendly, informative and are great motorbike riders!!! Special mention to DUYEN 1!!! The food we experienced was amazing and Tung Do's insights on each district was fascinating. The "foodies tour" is a must do for anyone visiting Saigon it was without doubt the highlight of our trip. Tony S from Australia.

Fantastic Foodie Tour!!!!!! Must do! - I did the "Sights" tour which was efficient way to see the city. I also did the "foodie" Tour which I enjoyed very much! I would highly reccomend the Foodie Tour. Dont be afraid to try new things...you may find them delish!

Book these tours!
Tai was a great tour leader for both tours!

Foodie Tour - Normally we do not go on tours but this is a unique one that really is worth it. Really good fun and food and drink included.

Had a great time, thanks.

Great way to experience the traffic - Had a great time seeing the city from a local perspective on the back of a scooter. Felt completely safe at all times. All the ladies are extremely friendly and very safe drivers. The various stops at local restaurant and a couple of sightseeing points are a great introduction to Saigon, recommend doing the Foodie tour early in your stay. We got out to a few districts that you wouldn't bother with otherwise, there are a few faces to this vast city.

A Blast! - Highly recommend this fun and exhilarating way to tour Ho Chi Mihn City. The drivers are excellent, and their English is very good too. Part history lesson, part tour, and lots of fun. Well worth it.

Best part of our entire trip to Vietnam! - This was by far the most fun of our entire trip! We visited Districts in the city that we would have never known to visit with amazing food and amazing guides. Also the motorbike experience is a must do!!! I usually don't like tours but this on is one of a kind and not to be missed!! Thank you XO tours :)

Greatest Time of My Life - On my wonderful trip to Vietnam and Cambodia, this was my favorite memory. I traveled with 11 peers and 2 teacher advisers. We heard this tour is a must and it was amazing. The girls that give the tour are so funny and speak perfect English. Go hungry, because there was so much yummy food. It is the perfect way to get to know and experience the city and the districts. I learned a lot and had so much FUN.

Foodie Tour FABULOUSNESS - This was without doubt the highlight of our recent stay in HCMC. Tung (XO founder/owner) has put together such a vibrant and authentic package and has selected superb young women as guides. So refreshing to be on a tour that shows you a real slice of life in a city. It was action packed and a great deal of fun. My 16 year old son loved it.

Exciting way to see the city - The Foodie Tour was recommended to me but after seeing the level of traffic up close, I must admit to some trepidation. However I am so glad we went as it was the highlight of our stay in Saigon. We were a group of 4 over 50's with no scooter experience but we had a ball! Even tried some of the more exotic foods. Very promptly received An email with photos of our tour. Thanks XO.

Foodie Fantastic!! - Anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City should jump on the back of a scooter with these wonderful girls on XO Tours. Zipping around in the traffic of HCM City and eating different foods in different districts was an absolute highlight of our trip to Vietnam.
A definite must do!

Another great experience with XO Tours in Saigon - We recently returned from our trip to Vietnam and having done the Saigon by Night Tour last time, booked on the Foodie Tour this time. It didn't disappoint. Our guides again were wonderful and keen to tell us about their city and the foods we tried along the way. It was very well organized, with more than enough food over the course of our three stops. Information about the city and it's people, Vietnamese phrase books and fun competitions with guests made it a great experience again. I would recommend this tour as a must do when you visit Saigon.

A Fantastic Experience – Don't miss it! - My wife and I were attracted to The Foodie Tour by the Tripadvisor reviews. We thought it might not be as exciting for us as it would be for first time visitors, as this is our seventh holiday in Vietnam. It was, however, absolutely brilliant and we loved every minute of it.

We were picked up at our hotel, right on time, by two gorgeous young ladies, Hong and My (pronounced Me). Their greeting was so warm and friendly we knew straight away we were in for a treat.

Off on the bikes and we soon met up with our group for the evening, there were 8 of us, 8 lady drivers, our guide, Tai, plus 2 or 3 others that went on ahead to ensure everything was set up properly for our arrival at all the destinations. Introductions all round kicked off the evening, after which 4 ½ hours of fun, food and great company followed.

Our guide, Tai, is a wonderful young man, speaks perfect English and did an exceptional job of looking after us all and explains the historical side as well. He obviously loves his job as he is so enthusiastic, always smiling and so helpful. The ladies are much more than your driver too, helping the guests with the food and explanations of the places visited. It is like being on a tour where every person has their own private guide.

Although on our seventh visit to Saigon, most of the places we visited were totally new experiences for us. Being such a huge city you wouldn't know they existed unless taken there. A lot of time was spent going from one area to another which was fabulous, safe and educational as the ladies point out the best shopping places and tell you about the areas you passed through. For example, we were astounded to discover there are places you can buy clothing at 1/3 the price of the main markets.

The food was sensational with several dishes we have never tried before and a few surprises. A fun game with chopsticks happens at one of the venues and by then the whole group was having the time of their lives.

At the final destination delicious seafood is served up. There is also the offer of a certain food for the adventure too. My wife surprised us all by not only eating this but enjoying it so much she requested seconds. I won't spoil it by explaining what it was but I couldn't even look at it.

If you are here for the first time or a regular visitor we highly recommend you experience this fantastic tour. Sure it is expensive compared to other tours but if you want the best, with very well trained personal guides plus the best foods then this is the one.

XO Vespa Tour Ho Chi Minh City - I was told it was a must to do a Vespa night tour in Ho Chi Minh City by friends who had visited. So after reading the reviews on tripadvisor for XO decided if we were going to do so, this was the company to go with as they sounded perfect for a group of middle to aged women who had never been on a scooter and who had a fear of any type of motorbikes!! We chose the 2.5 hour night tour rather than the foodie tour only because we were leaving one of our party back at the hotel who couldn't bring ourselves to risk it so didn't feel it fair to leave her for too long. One of our party was still extremely disappointed of going and didn't think she was going to be able to go ahead with it but after meeting the drivers at our hotel for our pickup who spent a fair bit of time with her talking to her and calming her down they were able to reassure her and get her on the bike! They were so wonderful with her I couldn't recommend them enough!!! They were patient and reassuring and her driver went above and beyond her call of duty!!! We all had a fabulous time and for me it was probably the highlight of our 10 day trip (Halong Bay rates up there quite high too!!). The food on route they recommended was great and to sit out in the street with the locals and eat local food knowing it was safe for our stomachs was a real experience. We went to places we would never have seen (and didn't) on our day trips and saw local food markets that had to be seen to be believed (headless skinned frogs still jumping!!!). Weaving our way through the traffic was an experience I will never forget. We paid for the extra option of having a video done while we were on the tour (which gets sent to you after 2 weeks) so we are looking forward to seeing that. They also send you some photos they took of you via email. We received those while we were still away and they were great! This is a definite must for anybody visiting Vietnam!!

AWESOME, AN EXPERIENCE TO REMEMBER - If you do only one tour in HCMC then this is a must. The young ladies that safely navigate you through the traffic are the most amazing drivers, great tour guides and truly wonderful funny and generous people. This tour is so well organized, it's not just about the food but you get a good feel for the city as you travel around through some of the districts. I will definitely do it again.

An absolute must - great fun and educational - I booked the Foodie Tour with XO before traveling to Vietnam, being a bit of a foodie myself and having read all the excellent review on TA. It didn't disappoint. I was staying in a private house rather than a hotel, however my guide found me at the allotted time to start our four hour evening. Smartly dressed in traditional garb, professional and courteous, it bodes well for the evening. We set off into the evening traffic and met up with the rest of the tour at a local restaurant. After all introductions done we had our first dish - a noodle broth called Ben Bo Hue - to be found all over Vietnam. Delicious. As we left to have a tour of China Town the heavens opened with thunder, lightning, the works - a monsoon-style downpour that lasted off and on for most of the evening. No one was deterred though, just thought of it as part of the experience! Then onto the next district and grilled goat, okra and squid, all washed down with beer of course. Ah, didn't mention the frog, hmm, an acquired taste. Our final district was district 4 where we had wonderful crabs, scallops and clams, all with delicious sauces, spices and herbs. I've cut the whole story short as the evening lasts for about 4 1/2 hours in total and includes information giving as well as eating. A great evening and highly recommended. Thanks to my excellent guide, Ngan, and team leader, Tai.

Moto fun - The reviews are spot on, this tour was so much fun. I am a little nervous on motorbikes but the young ladies soon had me loving the ride, the food was great and the guides super professional. I will definitely do it again.

So glad we did this! - 3 friends and i booked the "saigon by night" tour and we can't recommend it enough! you see so much more of the city that you will never have found on your own, taste amazing local food and have so much fun with the girls. worth every penny we loved it a lot! xxx

A must do - This was the best tour I did in HCMC. Its not just a great food tour but they give you a great overview of HCMC and the way people live.
You travel around all the different districts.
My lady Yen was so personable and a great person to chat to on the back of the bike.
The tour leader Tai was so enthusiastic and informative. It was like it was his first tour he was that good and into it all night
love love loved it
Thanks XO you made it my highlight in HCMC
Suzanne from Sydney Australia

EXCELLENT TOURS!! HAD THE BEST TIME IN HO CHI MINH CITY. - We decided to BOOK TWO tours at the last minute upon our arrival into Ho Chi Minh City. Now, we wish were in Ho Chi Minh City longer. We had such a FUN & GREAT TIME!!! We had tons of laughs, learned history, got DRENCHED in rain (XO had very durable & good ponchos for us). And, most of ALL, WE TRULY ENJOYED ALL OF OUR TOUR GUIDES. WE HIGHLY, HIGHLY, RECOMMEND XO MOTORBIKE TOURS if you're staying in Ho Chi Minh City. Out of all of our holiday in Asia, HO CHI MINH CITY, VIETNAM became our FAVORITE PLACE BECAUSE OF XO MOTOR BIKE TOURS... THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU so much XO Motorbike Tours!! Hugs & Love to all of you!!! :o)

City vibe enjoyed by scooter - This tour was awesome, it is quite expensive but there was nothing about that trip I would change, it was well worth it, very friendly, funny girls, great sight seeing and learn about history of Vietnam. It's a must do!

Worth it! - At first, me and my friend was kind of hesitant to try this tour because of the cost which is $40 for "The Sights", not cheap for a 2.5-3 hour motorbike tour, right? Anyway, we gave it a shot 'cause it's No.1 must try activities here on TripAdvisor. So okay, let's do this!

We were picked up by our lady drivers/guides in our hostel then we're off to our destinations. Although we've already seen and visited some of the sights that are included in the trip beforehand which we just did by ourselves (DIY) 2 days ago, we still went and see them again and try to find out what's the difference. And so, we came to this conclusion that it was much better with XO Tours compared to our DIY Day Tour. Because XO people were just informative and knowledgeable about the places and spots we visited. Through them, I've learned more about Vietnam's culture and history.

My lady driver/guide Loan was nice and friendly. Tai Dang our Tour Leader was cool. They made sure that our tour was fun, comfy and educational. Plus, they speak English well, so we had smooth conversation.

Truly, it's a fun and exciting way to explore the city. Can't wait to try the Foodie Tour on my next trip!

Great way to see the city in a snapshot - We had only a full day in HCMC and wanted to have a snapshot of the city including the main landmarks.
We found the XO tours on the internet and booked over the phone.
Two young ladies picked us up at our hotel on the bikes, for a 3 hours tour of the city.
The itinerary was perfect and well organised (enough stops, bottle of waters, rain coats).
The staff was very professional, educated, attentive, and spoke perfect English.
Highly recommended. Definitely great value.

Brilliant evening on the Foodie Tour - If you do nothing else in HCMC, you should do this tour! Was picked up from my hotel and driven round the city on the back of a scooter - which was an experience in itself! Add in fantastic food, knowledgable hosts and a few beers, and it was a brilliant night.

Foodie Tour- So Fun! - We booked the "Foodie" tour on our last night in HCMC- we were a bit nervous as we aren't usually tour people, but we booked anyways based on the Trip Advisor Reviews and we were not disappointed. The consistent excellent reviews are all true. We were interested in learning more about Vietnamese food and this tour was a good choice because they take you way beyond Pho and spring rolls and into some really interesting food territory. I won't spoil the surprise, but you get to try a lot of good food and visit other zones in HCMC that aren't necessarily on the tourist circuit. Also, the tour guides are very informative and easy to talk to- they can answer a lot of questions beyond food and about Vietnamese culture and politics, we were really impressed. The trip was special because it was our honeymoon and my husbands birthday, so I booked the private tour which leaves about an hour earlier than the other group tours so you aren't with other tours at the same time-which I thought was very clever. As well you basically have your own security team on the tour with you- all in all it is a very professional operation. XO marked the occasion with a surprise birthday cake at the last stop for my husband which was greatly appreciated. We got the option with the movie and photos and it was great not to have to worry about taking pictures because we knew we would have them all at the end. The pictures came about 5 days after the tour and the video about two weeks later. All in all if I am ever in HCMC again I would definitely do this tour a second time- it was a highlight.
Foodie tour. - Absolute must-do in HCMC. Highly recommended to anyone. Felt safe on the scooters and got to eat lots of new and delicious food from local eateries.

Foodie Tour a Must - Thankfully a friend recommended this tour. We did the Foodie Tour and it was amazing. We arranged everything by email. The ladies arrived 15 mins prior to departure. Right on 530 off we went. I was very unsure about riding on the back of a scooter, however, the ladies put me at ease. They sure know how to get around HCMC! Great service & they take such good care of everyone on the tour. It's a must do tour.

Authentic Saigon Tour - a definite if in Ho Chi Minh City - We did not know about this tour before we arrived in Ho Chi Minh City and to be honest, after our first day and seeing how many motorbikes there were and the 'craziness' of the roads, we would never have contemplated doing a motorbike tour! However, after reading the positive reviews on TripAdvisor we decided to give it a go......and so glad we did!!! The 'Saigon by Night' is a fantastic way to see places that you wouldn't know about unless with a local. In 2.5 hours we went through most of the Districts of Ho Chi Minh City - from Chinatown, Saigon River, markets to the wealthy expat area, stopping to have a delicious authentic meal! The expert female drivers were knowledgable, professional and made you feel very safe. This is definitely a must-do tour if in Ho Chi Minh City.

One of the best experiences of my life! - If you only do ONE thing in Vietnam, make it the XO Foodie Tour!

This was not just a highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Minh City, it was one of the best experiences of my whole life! I really cannot recommend this tour more highly. It's a "MUST DO" for everyone!

As a lone traveler, sometimes it's hard to find tours that really encourage a group atmosphere. The XO Foodie Tour was the exception! I met lots of new people, we played games and had great conversation. The tour guides were absolutely wonderful too - friendly, welcoming, funny, easy to chat with & SO MUCH FUN!

Did I mention the FOOD? Oh wow. Wow. WOW. This was some of the best food I have EVER put in my mouth. I also loved how the tour gave us an insight into the types of cuisine that I wouldn't have been able to find on my own in Vietnam (rather than just eating more rice paper rolls & Banh Mi). For those with an adventurous spirit, make sure you try the frog & Balut! Delicious!

I would do this tour again without hesitation! AND I'd make all my friends fly from Australia to do it with me! That's really saying something because I usually hate showing things to other people, as I'm worried that they will be disappointed with my recommendation. But this is different, because I have no doubt in my mind that EVERYONE will LOVE the XO Foodie Tour!

Best thing we could have done in Ho Chi Minh! - We only had one night in Ho Chi Minh and we booked 2 spots on XO tours through a recommendation from a friend.

Correspondence via email was great! Even after some unexpected thunderstorms, we were kept up to date and were told they would let us know if the rain would delay our trip. Fortunately for us the rain stopped and we had a perfect night ahead of us!

The girls greeted us at our door and my driver- Nhung was so friendly and we got along so quickly! As i have dont ride on motorbikes often i wasnt sure what to expect but the girls are experts! And at no single point throughout the night did i feel unsafe or scared!

Our tour leader Hieu was so friendly and made our night so comfortable and enjoyable. He gave us insights into life in Ho Chi Minh and its districts and made the night so much more than just the food.

And the food..... amazing doesn't cut it. If you're adventurous... you're in for a treat. Play it safe and theres still so much to enjoy. We rolled home by the end of it completely satisfied.
Would not have wanted to spend our night any other way!

Cannot recommend highly enough!

Thanks Hieu, Nhung and the rest of thr girls and guides for a great night!!

Great way to experience Saigon - We did the 'Saigon by night' tour on our second last night in Saigon, thinking it would be a good way to get out of District 1 and see other parts of the city. In addition to the tour we also got tips on where to shop, eat and help with our Vietnamese pronunciation and phrasing. Our only regret is that we didn't do this tour earlier in our trip!
I would definitely recommend the tour as an excellent way to experience the city, and get a real feel for what happens outside of the tourist districts.
We took our children (7 and 10) and felt very comfortable with the tour guides on the bikes - and the kids got a real kick out of doing something they would never get to experience at home.

Great Foodie Tour of HCM City! - This review is long overdue!. Great tour as they wiz you around on a motorbike visiting the different districts in Ho Chi Minh City. Great local food and the ride through the market was awesome! True it may be a little pricy but you wouldn't be able to experience the same stuff if you didn't have a local bringing you around.

An absolute must in HCMC! - Our little travelling group of 4, ranging in ages from 54 to 60 and of varying body shapes and sizes decided we would get really adventurous and take the XO Food Tour.
The end result was that this was right up there as probably the best experience we had in three weeks of travelling Vietnam.
The entire experience from booking, to pickup, the driving, the food, the fun and the safe delivery back to our hotel was faultless.
The girls who drive the scooters are extrememly skilled and well looked after the boys who ride with the group at a discreet distance making sure everything is going well.
Communication is not an issue and the girls made us all feel like long lost friends and joined in all the fun. They went out of their way to make sure everything was up to scratch and that we were well looked after.
The motorbike scene in HCMC is frantic but when you are in the throng you feel very safe and secure and it is thrilling to be part of it.
We saw so much more of the lovely city than we would have if we had stayed in tourist District 1.
All the food was of a high standard and drinks were provided freely.
Our tour started in fine weather but towards the end it began to rain. This was so good. The girls immediately stopped and had us in good quality ponchos which kept us dry for the remainder of the trip.
Great value for money and an experience that will stay with us for ever.
I even received photos via email a couple of days after the trip. Such good service.
Thankyou to Hong, Huong 1, Huong 6, Huong 7 and Hieu for a fantastic night. Hope to see you all again one day.

Foodie Tour for the adventurous - We want on the Foodie Tour - and what an adventure!!

The food is a bit on the extreme side - but again just arriving from Hoi An - taste and flavours do differ between the regions! Must say I had hoped for delicious streetfood not adventurous!

However with that said - this was the best night in HCMC!! The scooters took us through different Districts - the girl guide was ready to tell about the city as well as every day life...and at several stops the tour manager explained the history and politics of the area! This made the city come alive!! I will never forget the scooter ride!!!

Thank you for a great experience!

Most exhilarating way to see Saigon!! - This was one of the most exciting and exhilarating ways to see a city where bike is transport king!
No need to be nervous with these wonderful lady drivers - who are soooo friendly and chatty and very helpful with recommendations for places to eat!
We had a limited amount of time in Saigon ( still very much known as Saigon by the locals!) and wanted to see as much as we could. We booked the morning city tour and it was a great whistlestop tour of the city - as well as hearing and seeing sites that we may have missed that are not listed in the tour guides. We also got to taste some tasty local sweet treats at a local market.
We forgot our memory card (silly!!!) but the team gave us use of a camera and emailed us the photos a few days later! So helpful.

I would highly recommend this tour group to anyone going to Saigon! They also do food tours and evening tours - if we had time we would have tried them all.

Tour Guide Service Exceptional - We chose for the day tour that started in the morning and ended around noon.

The tour comprised of females in ao dai to show us the story of the Notre Dame Cathedral, Post Office, Outside Reunification Palace, drive through Cho Lon (Chinatown Market) and finally the temple.

The heat was relentless that day. But they provided us some sugar cane juice towards the end of the trip and water in between.

I learned that the drivers were extremely safe. At no time did I feel threatened or unsafe. Because Vietnamese I had an understanding of my country, it's history and culture. Everything that they showed us was something I knew but there were some surprises in the trip that I didn't know.

So basically you hop on your moped driver and meet with other groups. The moped drivers spoke English very well and were great riders. During the group meet there is a tour guide that follows. This tour guide is the principal person to tell the story and historical background of all of the stops. Somewhere in the group is a photographer that takes photos on our trip as well.

This tour group is the only one that carries their own insurance for everyone involved. I feel safe (which is the most important part of ANY tour).

After my tour I booked the Foodie tour for the next night. That's how happy I was with this tour guide. Unfortunately I fell ill before I can partake this and had to cancel last minute. This was the only regret I had on my entire vacation. They are known for the foodie trip and I didn't get to go. 😭.

My next trip I will book the foodie tour first once I land at the airport.

Fantastic time sight seeing and shopping. - This is a brilliant way to see the city in a similar way to a local (more than being in a car or taxi) and at the same time get some local knowledge on where to shop. We wanted to purchase some fabric, visit a tailor, purchase some lacquer ware and visit a local market.

With some research under our belt we asked for some recommendations and suggestions, we agreed on where and in what order to visit and jumped on the back of the scooters and were off.

The 2 girls and the guide were fantastic. The suggestions of where to visit were great. (the tailor, lacquer ware and locals market) We felt safe on the scooters and returned with all of our goodies. They made the experience more fun, friendly and enjoyable than expected.

A must to do when you are in town.

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - I did this tour on my first night in HCMC when traveling through Vietnam with my brother. I must point out that I am quite disenchanted of motor bikes but my brother is the opposite having traveled around the world on one! However the girls who drive the bikes are all confident and friendly and put me instantly at ease. I felt secure and comfortable on the bike despite the crazy traffic - the girl who drove me weaved in and out expertly through the traffic, never going too fast and was chatting to me the whole way. We met up with the other members of our group at the first restaurant stop. The guide who led the tour was very charming and likeable and to be honest the whole tour was very professional and slick and had a fun atmosphere - we visited parts of the city we would have never seen, learned and tasted various different dishes that are not your standard tourist dishes. You can eat as much as you like and drinks inc beer are included, so make sure you are hungry! The five hours whizzes past in no time and by 10pm we were dropped back at our hotel.

If I was being picky there was a strong emphasis on seafood which isn't to everyone's taste, and some of the food is a bit unusual, but that said it's still an excellent way to get a feel for such a vast and crazy city. I would recommend booking on your first night there - it's the perfect night out and gets you out of District 1 where most of the tourists stay. It's not a cheap tour, but it's definitely worth every penny. They also take photos for you on the night and email them to you, so you don't need to worry about carrying valuables like a camera or an iPhone - something they advise against due to risk of theft whist on the bike. The group is also accompanied by body guards who stay in the background and just check the bikes when they are parked and generally watch over everyone, so I really felt very safe the whole time. Highly recommended!

XO-lent, must-do night tour - This foodies tour was so much fun, not just for the ample food and drink, but for the atmosphere of the girls and motorbikes. It's a food tour, district tour and culture tour all rolled into one. The girls make you feel so safe on the bike, even in peak traffic. Definitely a must do night tour.

An absolute MUST if you're in Saigon! - Experiencing the city from the scooters is an absolute MUST! we did the Sightseeing tour in the morning and enjoyed the buzz so much that we booked the Foodie tour that evening too. It couldn't be faulted. The organization, content, friendliness, value for money, fun and food and sheer excitement. Definitely the highlight of our trip around Vietnam. Want to do it all over again!

I completely agree with all other reviewers! - This was one of the best organised tours I have been on - it has it all. It's very well organised, for a start. You are picked up by your very friendly and fun driver - who takes you to join the other people on your group. You are all briefly introduced - and meet your tour leader, who explains the ropes. (They even take photos throughout the evening, so that you can concentrate on eating, drinking and talking!) - you are brought to a variety of places throughout the evening - and get to experience the scooter world of Vietnam as a rider, rather than having to avoiding those things as you cross the street! A great mix of great food and drink, fun company, a variety of sights - all delivered in a professional, fun and engaging way. Top marks! (And as regards price - yes, probably a little pricey for Vietnam, but since this was a world-class delivered product, it felt like good value!)

XO Foodie Tour - Fantastic Experience! - We did the foodie tour on our first night in Saigon (and first night in Vietnam) after spending the day walking around District 1 and getting lost often.The tour was a great introduction to this massive city - we visited 5 different districts; 3 for food and 2 for sightseeing. The girls were fun, really easy to talk to, and made the night a great success. We all tried foods we'd never dreamed of eating - including goat and frog! And yes, frog tastes like chicken! Even our fussy 13 year old tried everything. We learned a lot about the girls' lives and became much more comfortable on the roads. Seeing the traffic in Saigon, the thought of getting on the back of a scooter was daunting at first but a great way to get around - we never felt in danger. We ordered the video so look forward to seeing it in a few days.

A really fantastic start to our Vietnam holiday that we will never forget. Do it.

So much fun! - We had booked the shopping tour and a private food tour. Unfortunately, we got sick before the food tour and they kindly gave us a full refund, no questions asked! Amazing service. The guide and the two young ladies who were our drivers for the shopping trip were absolutely wonderful. We were so well looked after and had a lot of fun without having to worry about the planning. Strongly recommend this tour company.

Don't miss this....the best foodie tour - All the review are correct, this is one of our highlights on our recent adventures in Vietnam. We are in our 50's and loved every minute of the foodie's tour. The girls were very knowledgeable about their food and also they were keen to learn about us. We had a video taken and it was worth every cent - not that is was very expensive. Nothing was too much trouble - do it...we would do it again in a heart beat.
Well done team...and thanks for a great night :)

Highlight of HCMC! - My partner and I only had two days in HCMC, so we were keen to make the most of it. After reading all of the glowing reviews on Trip Advisor, we booked this tour. Right from the moment we booked, the communication from XO tours was great.

Exploring the city on the back of a scooter is a unique experience. We got to see local markets, try local cuisine and experience several different districts from the richest to the poorest. Our friendly tour guides (Thuy and Loan) spoke fantastic English and were very informative.

I can honestly say that this tour was a highlight of our trip and an absolute must do for anyone thinking of traveling to HCMC!

If you have any questions about this tour, or my post, feel free to ask.

Do this tour! If u do anything in Ho Chi Minh, do an xo foodie tour. - This tour was fantastic, fun engaging and will deliver everything they say they will and 500% more. It was great fun and I would hate to spoil your tour by telling you the details. So book it now or like we did the day before, whatever you do don't miss an unforgettable night. I have appreciated trip advisor reviews many times but never bothered to write a review myself. There is a reason xo are number 1 and if you aren't a foodie just take a tour that sounds like you.

Inspiring! - I was a little bit concerned about going on the back of a bike at first. My guide reassured me and gave great instructions. My guide showed me some great places especially the markets. I would recommend this trip to anyone.

Yummy food and wonderful company! - I loved this food tour.

Adorable Anh was my lovely driver for the night. We had a great time and bonded, while eating and drinking delicious food.

The tour was led by another Anh, whose English was amazing, as he grew up state-side. He informed us of how Ho Chi Minh was evolving, ensuring we got plenty of pictures, as keeping the energy fun and light.

My friend, Jenn and I had a blast.

I encourage you to do this tour.

Best experience in Ho Chi Min City - The foodie tour was awesome. The team at XO could not have done a better job. This tour is for all ages children and adults alike and I would recommend everyone put it on their must do list when traveling to Vietnam.

Foodie Tour - Highlight of our entire trip in Vietnam - After being in Saigon for two days, to say I was a "little" nervous to actually get on the back of one of the motorbikes is an understatement. But, as soon as we met Tam and Ning, I was confident they were going to get me through the city safety (they did!).

In this tour you get to see 5 of the 7 districts of Saigon. Most tourists never see more than District 1, so it was great to see all the different areas of Saigon, from the modern expat neighborhood, to the last stop in a smaller neighborhood, and everything in between while on the back of the bike.

Of course, this is all about the food. Bun Bo Hue was a great way to start, then off on the bikes to our next few stops - all street food/roadside restaurant gathering places. They grill goat and prawns at the table for you, and course after course at each stop keep coming. You must go HUNGRRRRRY. They were also fantastic about accommodating my "no seafood" problem. Even down to getting me vegetarian fish sauce.

All in all, this is a lot of fun (times 10!), all of the tour guides are fantastic and informative. It was well worth every penny. We even said if we had more time in Saigon we would have gone again - that is how great this tour is. Highly recommend!

*Also we did the video option. It is a lot of fun for everyone and a great way to capture the awesome tour.

One of our best tours in Vietnam - We booked the food tour and city sights tour based on the recommendations on Trip Advisor. We can see why. From the expecable service we received by email months in advance to the service on the day. It was a fun and informative tour of Saigon and the districts while at the same time eating dishes travelers would not normally choose. This was our first time on motor bikes which was amazing and your drivers make sure you are safe. Thoroughly enjoyed the tours. Would definitely recommend even though it is pricey.

You should give this a try if budget allows - The tour guides are very friendly and they speak good English. So no issue with communication. Exploring the city on motorbike is a unique experience.
Prefer the foodie tour at night as compared to the sight tour in the morning. They will bring you to taste those not so common Vietnamese food but I prefer to go for more common & nice local food.
The tour is rather pricey though

Fun fun if just a little pricey. - Sept 13: A great start to out HCMC trip. Flew in that morning and was picked up at our hotel. The girls were very friendly as was our tour manager Hieu. 5 stops in total with 3 full dinners and all the beer you can manage. Lots of new sights explored and explained. Lots of new foods experienced. Yes, you could definitely eat cheaper but I doubt you could find and explore the different districts that were shown. All in all a great night out.

Fantastic Experience, expensive but worth it! - My father and I did 2 tours with XO and both were AMAZING! We did the Shopping tour and the Foodie tour. Both were great experiences. My father was especially nervous about riding on the back of a scooter around the city. After spending a couple days prior to the tour in the city and him seeing the apparent chaos of the streets; he was even more nervous. But even after a block or 2 on the bike he relaxed and had a great time. We never felt unsafe or in any danger and had a great time!

On the Shopping tour, our Tour Manager Tai found out what we were looking for while in Vietnam and took us to some amazing places, where we got some amazing things at incredible prices. Tai helped with translating and making sure we got a good deal. Our bike drivers were very friendly and engaging and made it a great tour.

The foodie tour was the highlight, however. This tour was 5 hours long and included 3 full dinners. It was way too much food but was absolutely amazing! We ate great food and even pushed my father, who is a very picky eater, into trying and liking new things. It was all very fun and Ning our Tour leader was excellent. Also, you see many parts of HCMC that you probably wouldn't see otherwise. It was all very cool and very memorable. We had a time constraint with our flight leaving so we paid for a private tour, which was very amazing. However, I think a group tour would have been fun as well. We started an hour earlier than the group and we saw them at the second stop when we were leaving and they were arriving; it looked like lots of fun all the same!

I will say this, compared to other tour offering out there, XO is on the more expensive side but I feel the tour was worth every penny. I can't recommend this more and I would do these tours again in a heart beat!

Brilliant experience! - We just finished our xo foodie tour and couldn't be happier! It was brilliant, from the mildly harrowing ride through the crazy saigon streets to the truly excellent and different food. I was astounded by the vast differences of districts of the city and thank xo tours greatly for allowing us to see a part of this amazing city we might not have had the chance to. The food was sensational, particularly the seafood and the grilled food... You HAVE to do this if you are in Ho Chi Minh. I want to go again!

Absolute Blast - Couldn't believe how much fun this ended up being. First experience on the back of a scooter let alone in the chaotic traffic of HCMC and felt completely safe and loved every minute of the driving. Got to experience eating foods I hadn't eaten before in great little local restaurants, had lots of beer and laughed. Loved the fact we got out of district 1 which we had already spent hours walking around and saw how the rich (district 7) and poor (district 1) lived as well.

Simply brilliant experience for the whole family - Having been traveling around Vietnam for a few weeks, we ended up in Ho Chi Minh. We found XO through Trip Advisor and decided to experience the city on the back of the mopeds - the only way to travel it seems!! With 5 of us including three boys (12, 14 and 16) this was one of the highlights of our holiday.

The tour guide and moped drivers (all girls dressed in traditional Vietnamese dresses) were so friendly, hospitable and welcoming.

You truly get an experience of Vietnamese life when on the back of the moped. We did a sightseeing tour for 2.5 hours and saw some of the key parts of the cities history. This included a 25 min drive around the city which included picking up sugercane juice on the move while driving through the narrow streets. We would totally recommend.

Great night with great people! - My boyfriend and I did the foodie tour. Huong was my fearless, funny and friendly scooter driver - I couldn't recommend her and the other girls highly enough. There's so many reviews here and they're all true - it was a highlight of our trip. We ate things I never thought I would and everything was done with much humor and kindness. Huong had an amazing knowledge of the city and happily answered all my (a million) questions. We went to many different districts that tourists would usually never visit and felt like locals - Chinatown was eye opening!

I was a bit nervous about riding on a scooter in the city but felt safe and secure the whole night. A big thanks to these beautiful ladies - I would recommend this tour to all my friends!

Do yourself a favor, and just book it. You won't regret it ;)

Loved it, best night out of our holiday - Just a great way to combine tasting more Vietnamese cuisine and finding out what it's like in the chaos of Ho Chi Minh traffic on the back of a vespa. We just spent the whole night laughing. Our guides/drivers were great hosts entertaining us at the 5 locations/restaurants we visited serving us food and starting off silly chopstick games.
Even when it rained it didn't dampen our spirits, out came ponchos to keep us dry. I loked like a peguin, my wife like a nun in The Sound of Music, hilarious!
All food and drink is included and different dietary requirements are catered for. The girls that drive you round speak good English and tell you about life in HCM City. They are safe drivers even for passengers like us who've never been on the back of a bike.
Just a load of fun, do try it.
