Take this Tour - Arrrived in HCMC and had booked the nite food tour followed by sightseeing tour next morning. Picked up at hotel by Nyg and we were off to the first stop. When you get there, you meet Tia who runs the tour. Everybody is so welcoming. Great food to try and experience local food along with info about each district that you visit.Girls are so much fun to interact with and do everthing they can to make your tour excellent.Highlight of my trip and would do it again. Thanks Tia and your staff along with all the girls that nite. What a BLAST!!!!!!. Also thanks for the pictures.

Definitely highlight of Ho Chi Minh !!! - After reading all the great reviews, we decided to give the foodie tour a go. Right from the beginning we were blown away by the great service of our tour guides as we were a bit hesitant at the start, having never ridden on bikes before. All the staff were extremely friendly, helpful and fluent in English. The bikes are accommodating for ALL sizes. Riding on the highway and passing through the market places, seeing all the different districts via the most common mode of transport was like nothing we'd ever seen before. The foods were a great representation of the traditional Vietnamese culture and made our short trip to Ho Chi Minh all the more worthwhile. Highly recommend !!!

A great way to see Saigon! - My husband and I booked a City Sights tour for our first morning in HCMC as a way of getting around a new city. We had also booked the Foodie tour for that evening so we could sample the street food with confidence. It's all been said before in previous reviews but I'll add that I cannot recommend both tours highly enough. The girls are very friendly and helpful, and are very safe drivers, the tour guides are informative and amusing. Great fun, well worth the money, and love the videos and photos they took. Don't hesitate - just do it!

Loved every minute of this tour! - Our family of 3 went on the foodie tour on August 21st. When I initially looked into booking this tour, I was a little hesitant due to the price. We paid $72 each, so X 3, that was a lot. I have to say that it was worth every cent & was one of the best things that we did in HCMC.
The ladies picked us up from our hotel around 5pm and took us to meet the rest of the tour at the first restaurant. We were nervous about being on the mopeds as the traffic is crazy, but right away, we felt at ease.The tour leader Tai introduced everyone to each other and then we ate our first meal, Bun Bo Hui which is a typical Vietnamese dish (I even had goat at the BBQ stop) We then went to all of the districts within HCMC (its way bigger than you would first imagine) and ate at various locations. What a fantastic way to see parts of the city that a regular tourist would not venture to. . At no time did we feel unsafe or that we were going to get ill from eating whatever we were given.
The tour lasted around 4 hours, it went so quickly, we had great fun & I would recommend this tour without hesitation. Within a few days Tai had emailed us some great pics that he had taken of us on that night. Thank you for a great tour!

The best way to see and eat your way through Saigon - What an amazing night! Tai was our host and he was fantastic and charismatic. We landed in Saigon that morning - it was the best way to experience the city on a local level plus eat some of the best food we have ever eaten. Hong and Nhu were our drivers and they were both unreal, spoke fantastic English to help us understand everything, we both felt so safe on the back of their motorbikes venturing through the city and they made our night special as a couple! If you want to experience the local Vietnamese culture I can't recommend anything better. Worth every cent. Thank you Hong and Nhu!

Yes, to what others are saying. - No need to say anymore here - I can see its all been said before and better than I could phrase it. Great tour, great girls, fun, safe, interesting, tasty. It rained but someone appeared with spotted plastic ponchos and we took off again. Photos were still taken - then they emailed them to you!

ITS A MUST DO! They cater for pretty much any age and size. Although I wondered how a snip of a girl would take my hulking great lad on the back of her bike - but it wasnt an issue.

Happy to recommend. Its a professional well organized tour. Great communication from the Owner Director Tung Do if you have any questions. xotoursvietnam@gmail.com

The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - XO tours was a fantastic introduction to Vietnam for us. We did the night tour within 5 hours of touching down and it was awesome. We ate some fantastic food and even met some new friends who we hung out with later in Hoi An! The girls are great drivers and you can pick their brains about anything while you drive. Great tour!
OMG!! What an experience. - THE best way to see Saigon. These girls are great, great, great!! Professional, safe, fun and interesting tour. Don't miss it. Simply the best!

Amazing! - We did the foodie night tour with Tai and the girls, and had the most incredible time. Thoroughly enjoyed every second (and every mouthful) and highly recommend this tour to everyone - a "must do" if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh City. An experience we will never forget!

If you lived your life and didn't do this tour, you didn't live your life fully - The drivers are simply amazing. Smart, educated and witty. You can have a very engaging conversation with your driver while she navigates her bike through crazy traffic.
And regardless of how much you traveled and how many different foods you experienced before, you will discover new tastes that you could not have imagined.

XO 'Foodies' Tour - We had two lovely ladies picked us up from our hotel lobby and they took us through the streets of Ho Chi Minh on the back of motor bikes. We visited many different districts outside District 1 and were taken to a 'local' place for dinner.
It was so much fun and the girls were wonderful.
I totally recommend it anyone and don't let the motor bikes put you off.

Best night out - Had a fantastic night out with these guys. There ended up being 13 of us, so it doesn't matter if you're traveling alone. Food was great and we were taken outside of District 1 and gave an insight into how the city works. The girls are fantastic and excellent, safe riders. It's a must do.

Best way to visit Saigon - XO tours was by far my best experience in Saigon. Very well organized and reliable. Since booking on line everything was taking care of, even special needs such as food preference or allergies. I did the sights tour and the foodie tour. Both excellent. The drivers where excellent and very safe. Very knowledgable about the sights and history of Vietnam. Great and fun personalities!
I would definitely recommend this company if you want a real and fun experience in Saigon.
Thanks XO tours for a wonderful and unforgettable experience!!

The best time in Ho Chi Minh City! - If you're a tourist in Ho Chi Minh City and you are not booking a ride with XO Tours, you're wrong. This is a great way to be introduced to the city and the food if doing the foodie tour. Highly recommended for everyone! Don't miss the opportunity to get a ride through the crazy traffic too...an experience in itself.

Highly Rated - We were first time visitors to Vietnam and wanted to get an overview of Ho Chi Minh city and so we booked the sight seeing tour with XO. My wife was very nervous about motor bikes and the idea of ​​lady drivers gave her a bit of comfort. She neednt have worried the girls are first class. We had such a great time we booked again to so the Foodie tour too. What a great night out that was trying new foods and spending the evening with the girls as our tour guides/drivers/cooks/entertainers was a great night out. Great value and a great idea if you like to see a lot in a little time.

HCMC by night - My wife and I participated in the Foodie Night Tour last weekend. It was a great experience and immense fun. Aside from the chance to eat local food at local sites, just the opportunity to see the city was worth it. The girls were outgoing and a lot of fun. Plenty of great conversation to match the food. We thoroughly enjoyed it and have already decided to do another one the next time in town...we may even try the morning tour.

A great way to see Saigon if you're lacking time/ are a young traveler - Due to a lack of time, my cousin and I (both young females) were looking for a safe way to see the sights within half a day. We are SO glad we stumbled across this tour. The girls who drive made us feel safe and told us tips about how to make sure we got the most out of our trip! They were very informative and helpful!
The motorbike ride itself was a big daunting due to the traffic but after a few minutes, the experience of the xo drivers was obvious and I felt very comfortable.
We did the half day sight seeing tour and I will definitely do it again just for the laughs.
The city by motorbike is a great way to really experience the culture.
It was my cousins ​​birthday and they even bought her a cake!
Great tour, well worth the money!

Motor Bike Extravaganza - Don't miss this! The traffic can be scary, but the guides do a great job of safely maneuvering around the other cars and thousands of motor bikes. We had so much fun riding around on motor bikes and learning some history.

Fun evening ride in Ho Chi Minh City - Heard good things about this tour, reviews are true!
Booked on the 2.5hr evening tour,
A bit apprehensive at first but after the 1st minute, it was fun all the way !
An amazing ride through the crazy traffic of HCM city, not just D1,
The guide/driver was superb,
She drove and at the same time introduced HCM in a fun and unique way.
The riders are well trained, safe and professional.
This is the highlight of our trip to HCM!

DON'T MISS THIS FOR THE WORLD!!!! XO Tours!!! FOODIE!!! - I was a bit apprehensive about this tour at first, but it was one of the best things I booked in HCMC. I and my family had such amazing time, they arrived on time outside our hotel, and they were all very professional and made you feel at ease.
We did the FOODIE TOUR! It was about 4.5 hours and time went so quickly, we ate at different street vendors, went to various districts, beer with meals and had some education about HCMC.
I can go on and on, but you need to experience this, I will let you decide!
A BIG THANK YOU TO, Hoang, Huong, Truc and Yen, these were Tour Guides and Drivers!!!

Great fun! - We did the city tour on the first morning of our arrival in Vietnam. What an introduction to Ho Chi Min City that was! The girls, all very safe and professional drivers, took us through the city and showed us some of the highlights. At each stop there was a tour guide giving us an explanation. The whole family enjoyed it, especially our teenage kids. I would really recommend this.

Just do the foodie tour. You won't regret it. - I don't have much to say that hasn't been said by everyone else, but the foodie tour was awesome. My only regret is that we didn't do this on one of our first nights in HCMC to get a proper culinary introduction to the city.

You're going to eat a whole lot of different stuff, so bring adventurous tastebuds and an appetite.

Amazing!!!! - What more can I say that hasn't already been said. The tours run by XO are exceptional. We did the Foodie tour and the Shopping tour. The Foodie tour is just awesome and a great opportunity to meet other travelers. The girls are just beautiful and we feel very safe on the bikes with them. Was definitely a highlight of our two week stay in Saigon.

Our tour leader Tai was exceptional. He remembered everyone's names and was very attentive to our needs during both tours. Thanks Tai!

Anyone who is considering booking tours with Xo should just do it. You won't regret it :)

Ps it is well worth it to pay the extra for the video. We have watched ours multiple times, just awesome!

Highlights of our Saigon trip - We booked the Saigon by Night Tour, and we were very happy about it.

Pros:
*The tour started on time. It was really worth every dollar.
*Very friendly tour guides, they are very accommodating to our questions. They also smile a lot and always ensure that you are having a great time.
*The tour itself was also very informative, you get to see the different districts of Saigon in the most exciting way. The tour guides would also share tidbits about the city and its people that you won't usually get from travel guides/websites/blogs.
*It was actually raining during our first part of our trip, and they asked us if we would like to reschedule the next day (they are very accommodating when it comes to this). Since we were very excited we proceeded with the tour, and lo and behold, they have very new and clean raincoats that we can use.
*The helmet that they let you use is not smelly at all.

Cons:
*well this isn't really a con, but we wished that the tour was longer. haha. :)

This is definitely the best way to see the rest of the Districts of Saigon! :)

Fantastic way to see the City - I did the sightseeing day trip had such a fantastic time. Got picked up from the hotel by my tour guide Thu would highly recommend her she was lots of fun, friendly and her English was very good. Not only do they show you the sights but they also give you information and each stop. Would highly recommend to everyone I've never been on a motorbike before but felt 100% safe the whole time. Next time I'm in Ho Chi Minh will definitely do another tour :)

Best Tour Around! - We did the Foodie tour which was simply the best! Everyone was so friendly and welcoming and you feel completely safe the whole time - the food is absolutely delicious and there was so much variety and so much food so make sure you dont eat much before you go! Its a great way to try food you may not usually think to try and a great way to see the different districts within Ho Chi Minh! Its a must if your travelling to Ho Chi Minh!

Best tour I have ever taken in the world! - My husband and I took the nighttime foodie tour after a day and a half of wandering around HCMC by ourselves. I'm so glad we did! It was a great experience - the motorbike was a really fun way to experience the city and it was so refreshing to get away from District 1. I am vegetarian and I have never been able to take advantage of the abundant street food stalls on our one month trip through SE Asia- but XO tours, especially Dang, Huong & Tai, really took care of me. Other food tours we had looked into in other cities had flat-out said they couldn't accommodate vegetarians or those with food allergies, so this was refreshing! The staff is young and fun, with a good sense of humor. Highly recommended!! One of the highlights of our trip!

Five stars isn't enough! - I booked the foodie tour for my first night in Saigon and couldn't rate it highly enough! Amazingly friendly tour guides who make everyone feel special and like friends. The girls are so polite, professional and friendly and really engage with you. You can tell they really love what they do. The tour manager on my night (Tai) was so amazing, and made everyone feel special. It was so good that I booked a sights tour for the following morning - and it was just as good as the night tour. It is very much worth every cent and I can't recommend it enough!

Brilliant way to see this lively city - This was our first time on the back of moped, and the craziness of HCMC meant that we were dropped in at the deep end. We did the morning city highlights tour, visiting interesting places such as the Central Post Office, Cathedral, Reunification Palace and a beautiful Buddhist Temple. The lady drivers were friendly, polite and excellent riders! We then did the evening Foodie Tour which was just amazing. We ate foods that we would never dream of otherwise eating (I won't ruin it for any prospective goers) and also restaurants that we probably wouldn't have chosen to eat in. We leave very full up and with excellent memories of a great day.

A Gastronomique Delight! - Wow!! This was the best thing that we did on our recent trip to Vietnam. Absolutely awesome!!!!!
You are picked up from your hotel by your hostess and transported through the city of HCM on the back of a motorbike. Imagine weaving in and out of the traffic and the chaos?? Stopping on the way to meet up with your group and sample authentic Vietnamese food. Yum. XO tours are the best. Go for it. You will have an absolute blast!

So much fun! - I did the Foodie Tour last week and it was one of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam. The girls were funny, informative and great motorbike drivers! The food was amazing - the best and freshest seafood I've ever had. We visited 5 different districts of Saigon which is great to get a feel for the different areas.
I highly recommend this tour for anyone who is not afraid of a bit of adventure and loves Vietnamese food!

Simply the best - What a wonderful time we had with the XO Team. Definitely one of the highlights of our recent trip to Vietnam. The girls who drove the bikes and the tour guide were superb, spoke excellent English and very entertaining and the time we spent on the bikes wasn't rushed. We spent approximately 5 hours touring the city at night visiting the different districts and stopping off to sample some delicious food at various locations. They also took the time to take some great photos and promptly sent them to us via email within days. I would recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see the city with a fun element and the personal touch.

Brilliant night out!!! - My friends and I had a great time doing the foodie night tour. The girls that drive you around are absolutely amazing, friendly, knowledgeable and a lot of fun! The team leader is great as well, it was one of the highlights of our whole trip around Vietnam. In short words, amazing food, amazing company, we couldn't ask for more. Definitely worth every penny, do not miss it if you are in HCMC!

Incredible way to experience Saigon - We booked the xo night foodie tour hoping for a unique experience and were not disappointed! Our guides were superb - friendly and professional. Most importantly they were excellent drivers through the manic Saigon traffic! The food stops were fantastic with a great range of food we would not have been able to try/ order by ourselves. The group tour was so well organized and we had a great night with great people. Thoroughly recommend.

Great way to see the city - XO offers a number of tours. I took the Saigon at night tour, which was fantastic. The driver was excellent, spoke English well, and had a good sense of humor. I felt very safe and learned about the history/culture of Vietnam. Everyone rides motor bikes in Vietnam--so a good way to see the city.

The best! - This has been the highlight of my stay in Saigon.The whole XO staffs are wonderful, guides can fluently speak English and funny too. Aside from the guides there are also security personnel that will guide the whole tour.All the foods are great. Experience was superb!! :)

The only way to see Ho Chi Minh - As it was my first trip to Vietnam I wanted to get a feel for the culture and the people rather than just staying in a 5 star hotel so I thought after reading the reviews on trip advisor to give XO a try.

I am so glad I did. After being awake for approx. 40 hours on my first night in Ho Chi Minh I did the foody tour. The ladies were beautiful and my tour guide was amazing. Not only did I get a feel of the real Saigon but I tried many dishes I would have otherwise been a little reluctant to try. We stopped in approx. 5 different districts and our tour guide will give us a quick 5 or 10 minute run down on where we were and the history of the district then we will move on to more food!!! On our last stop we were offered all the food we could eat until we couldn't eat anymore so ensure you are hungry when you go on this tour!

I would highly recommend this tour - thanx guys!!!

Absolutely fantastic night out - I wanted to do both the Saigon by Night, and the Night Foodie tour, but only had time for one, and so chose the former. Even though it absolutely bucketed down, I still had such a good time, There were 3 of us on the tour, and each of our hosts / riders were such lovely guides. Their English was great as was their knowledge of their city and culture. I have seen some comments on Tripadvisor about the prices, but you get what you pay for, and not everything in Vietnam has to be super cheap. Besides what do you get in the west for $40, an average meal and a beer, maybe! I will definitely be booking another tour with XO on my next visit to Saigon, which hopefully will be soon.

As said before, this is the best way to see HCMC! - Excellent value tour, close to 5 hours of non-stop fun. Exploring Saigon by night on the back of a bike is the only way. I have a very large appetite and it was very satisfied by a wonderful range of street food and local beer. We traveled through about 5 outer city districts which I would never have known to go to on my own.

Ace - A great way to see and hear more about Saigon/HCMC than you otherwise would. My guide Thuc was great fun and knowledgable. We did Saigon by night rather than the foodie tour but it was equally fantastic and included some great food and a welcome beer on a bald night. My only regret was not tipping Thuc! Due to thinking we'd be going through some slightly dodgy areas I only took the exact amount with me. Sorry Thuc! (Keep dreaming of Santorini and you'll get there!)

Best experience of my trip - These girls are amazing, the foodie tour is great value, you cannot beat the experience of being in saigon traffic on a bike at night. Felt completely safe bit exhilarated at all times :) this is a must

ONLY WAY TO SEE SAIGON - I was so unsure but it is the best thing I organized in saigon, the girls were so friendly, knowledgeable and very skilled drivers.

We did 3 tours in total, foodie, saigon sights and Saigon by night, they were all different and fun
I was very scared to start with, but they made you full safe at all times.

I have no regrets they even sent us some photos that they took. Eagerly awaiting my video

Highly recommended by both of us roz from melb me from sydney

Our second time with XO - We did the foodie tour 2 weeks ago.
It was our second time we had toured Saigon, last year we did Saigon by tonight this time foodie.
While it had some similar areas covered it was again great fun. My self and my husband don't eat seafood and we were more than covered with lots of other options.
You get the chance if your up for it to try some serious local food!!
Great company, wonderful caring girls and a fabulous way to see the real Saigon. Totally recommend!

So fun! Amazingly safe! - I was a little concerned about my 8 and 11 year old boys riding the motorbikes, but they did great! They didn't want to hold on even! It was exhilarating to ride on a motorbike through the streets of Saigon. I would also recommend the video. We got it today and it's very well done and a great keepsake!

Wonderful girls, wonderful food! - I absolutely loved this tour. Following a disastrous visit to a local salon, I called them near tears and asked them to change the pickup location. They did so, no problem. When the stylist wouldn't let me go but couldn't tell me how much money to give him until his manager arrived, the XO Tour girl patiently waited for fifteen minutes while I panicked. We took off down the rainy streets and she cheered me up within minutes with her bubbly personality.
From then on it was smooth sailing! The other two people in the group were funny and interesting, and all of the XO girls are just fantastic people. The information was detailed and entertaining. They showed us parts of Saigon you wouldn't find on any other tour, as well as try foods that you wouldn't normally see back home to keep it interesting! Highly recommended!

5 stars plus - This is a must see trip whilst in HCMC.
This is an exciting trip to see the real HCNC.
Riding on the back of scooters visiting places you would not have thought to visit. Eating food you never thought to have ate and a few surprises along the way.
We were picked up from our hotel by 2 lovely girls Huong and Thuc. Both spoke very good English.
We were then taken to our 1st meeting place meeting with 5 other people on the tour and meeting our chief Anh. Organised very well with Anh waiting at every port of call.
Plenty of food and plenty for non seafood eaters like myself.
Warning do not eat dinner we felt bad about how much we left.
Total cost about 75pd for 2.We personally think it was worth the money. 2 weeks later we are still talking about it.
Book this tour now before you go and you can pay on the day to the ladies.
Well done to xo tours. And special thanks to the 2 girls and Anh.

Fantastic,awesome a must do ! - My husband and I did the shopping tour in the morning and the Foodie tour at night both were fantastic. The shopping took us to some out of the way places and we found some great bargains not the usual trashy stuff. The night foodie tour was amazing , like all the other reviewers I can't find one fault . Food was sensational the guides outstanding we went to places you can only dream about. The tour is extremely professional and the most fun you can have . Only one thing to say JUST DO IT !!!!!!

Great service, great english, great experience! - We were quickly picked up from our hotel and taken on the 'shopping spree tour'. Our very friendly guides took us around to shops that weren't as 'touristy' as some of the main market areas meaning that we got the best prices possible. They were very informative of local information and were able to answer all of our questions about the area. We were even taken to a market where only the locals shop so that we were submerged into their culture, it was a great eye opener. Overall it was a fantastic 3 hour tour on the back of a scooter. Doesn't get much better than that!

Food tour was the best money I spent. - I had such an amazing time on this tour last week.

I went with a girl I met on a pervious tour and we booked the day before.

Not going to lie. I was scared out of my mind to go on the back of a scooter but it was so much fun I would do it every day if I could.

Our scooter girls were so friendly and great to talk to. They also drove with care.

Our tour guide was not only nice to look at ;) but he was very friendly and funny.

The food was so good and everyone in our group was cool, although we kept getting seated with the same people so we only really talked to an American couple. Which wasn't bad since they were really fun.

The food isn't the usual street food you would know but it's all very good.

I would suggest this for your first night in Saigon. I wish I had done this when I first arrived because you see so much of the city.

Thank you xo tours for such a great night.

A must-do activity - My sister and I took the Foodie by night tour the second night we were in Ho Chi Minh City (August 3). It was fantastic -- one of the best things we did during our whole trip! We saw a huge amount of the city on the back of a scooter while eating delicious food. The guides were friendly, fun, informative and responsible. They arrived at our hotel dressed in the traditional ao dai, our helmets secured on the scooters. Both spoke very good English. We then darted into the daunting traffic and were off for a lengthy tour that went by in a blink!. We toured neighborhoods that we never would have seen on our own and heard a lot about each one. We also had some of the best food that we ate on our whole nearly 3-week trip. It was worth every cent. I can't imagine our trip without it.

Best part of our trip in HCMC!! Simply a must do! - an overall wonderful tour!! nothing bad to say about XO food tour. Promptly picked up by two wonderful guides by bike. Cute and speaks English very well. Very talkative and informative about the areas. Traveling around HCMC for about five hours taking in some sites and eating delicious foods, and of course some beer. The food was great. possibly a little adventurous for some. Wife and I had a blast. so much fun!! dont miss out if your ever in HCMC!!!
Thanks to everyone at XO food tour. so much fun!!!!
Brian and Rie.

Absolutely fantastic! - We had a short stay in HCMC and chose to do this tour after reading reviews here on Tripadvisor.

It means seam a little pricey (around £40 each) but it is worth every penny! It was easy to book online and the staff were very careful to find out what we could or couldn't eat (1 vegetarian and 1 had shellfish allergy). This was checked on booking, when we first met up with the group and at the restaurants.

The girls were brilliant - they spoke excellent English and were friendly, funny and approachable. I have not been on a motor bike for years but felt very safe and had a great time. Tai (the tour leader) was fantastic and made us laugh a lot.

It was great to mix with a group from all over the world - it made the evening very sociable, interesting and great fun.

The food was absolutely brilliant - its more than you can possibly eat, but is great to share and to try local food. You don't have to eat anything considered gross - unless you want to!! Very funny watching others braver than myself.

The whole experience, from start to finish, absolutely made my trip to HCMC and I wholeheartedly recommend this trip.

FUN! FUN! FUN! Professional, prompt service. Amazing guides. - If we are to embrace the phrase, "when in Rome...," then, "when in Ho Chi Minh City...hop on a scooter!"

This is a professional, well organized tour operation. Their individualized customer service made us feel as if we were the ones attending the tour!

At the beginning of the tour we were met at our hotel by our two beautiful guides, dressed in traditional ao dai, who showed us around the city on their personal motorbikes. What an exhilarating experience to be among the throngs of scooters in the heart of the HCMC. Their expert handling of the motorbikes instilled complete confidence in our safety.

We took the Saigon by Night tour that wound us through many of the unique districts of HCMC. Even though it is a group tour, if felt very much like an individualized tour. We met up with the other tour members for an outside meal that was shared in comfortable camaraderie. This was a very unique experience unlike many other "city tours" we have experienced.

We loved it and highly recommend XO Motorbike tours!!

Love it! - It is the best way to explore HCMC at night, when it's not so hot and less people on the streets! The guides were so friendly and spoke good English! Also they were very good drivers, I felt safe the whole time!

Definitely a MUST do in HCMC! worth every penny!!!!!

Excellent Cultural Immersion through Food - Just had the foodie tour Aug 17 and it was an enriching experience. I never thought Vietnamese food really tasted good. Pricey, Yes but its definitely worth it. You can have your own foodie tour of HCMC but it wouldn't be as authentic and diversed compared to the tour.
Safe, organized, well-planned, genuine and not too commercialized. Its also a good way to meet new traveler friends.
Ms. Tam Ha and Mr. Tai Dang made the tour feel light and conversations free-flowing. They are Definite assets to the company; Passionate, speaks good English, and very knowledgeable.
My suggestion is to include Vietnamese coffee in the tour because it is definitely unique.
Food is abundant and they don't force you to eat weird food and finish your plate.

To sum it up:
Fantastic Food, Very Passionate Guides accompanied by body guards, safe destinations, tour doesn't feel rehearsed, forced and was not in a hurry to finish right away.

Absolutely awesome - During a business trip we booked the Foodie tour on our last night in Saigon. What an amazing experience! Loved seeing the city outside of D1 and tasting the local flavor. We had a blast with our ladies and Tai. Truly the best way to see HCM City at night.

XO motor bike foodie tour - We had our last night in Saigon and booked a foodie tour with XO. It was awesome. We have been to Saigon several times and really loved being driven around local eateries on the back of a motor bike. The girls were fantastic tour guides and showed us some fantastic spots. Food was plentiful and beer was flowing. A unique and memorable event. I would highly reccommend as a favourite thing to do in Saigon.

Great Fun and Great People - I travel to Ho Chi Minh City at least once annually and for the past few years running I've done The Foodie tour with XO Tours on each trip, most recently with some business colleagues in early August. If you haven't tried one of the XO Tours motorbike tours before I encourage you to do it on your next visit to Saigon. It's a load of fun; you're guaranteed to meet some interesting people - including other tourists from all over the world as well as the XO staff; and it's an experience that's unique and thoroughly enjoyable. The Foodie Tour spends a full evening traveling around HCMC with 3-4 stops for some unique cuisine and lots of fun. It's safe to say you'll visit areas of HCMC that you aren't otherwise likely to see, and you'll stop for food at places you're highly unlikely to experience on your own. The food and drink are abundant and no one leaves hungry or thirsty. The cost may seem a little high, but XO Tours is a highly organized and professional local business with trained and reliable drivers and support personnel. They work very hard to make sure everyone has a memorable, safe, and personalized experience. Highly recommended!!!

Best part of our trip in Saigon - Went with my wife on both the morning tour and evening sight seeing on two different days. What a great way to see the sights. Friendly, fun and so different to boring tours you can sometimes get roped into. The girls on both days were fun and intelligent with a good grasp of English with the captains on both days being exceptional. If you only have a few days in Saigon there is no better way and this should be first on your list of things to do. You have a group with you and feel safe at all times and even if your nervous to go on a bike the girls are so experienced you feel safe at all times. I only wish this company expand to other countries as it's an excellent idea. We'll done XO for your attention to detail and great ideas.

XO Foodie Tour is a must - Great night, yes pricey, but I'd say well worth it. Professional outfit, expert motorcyclists, good back up, excellent insight into HCMC and the way of life here.
I think food was excellent. We are well traveled and happy to eat all street food, but would have struggled to identify and order what we were given. Lots of food, lots of beer, you are full by the end of evening.
We were picked up at 17.30 , and returned at 22.30. Our 2 teenage kids came with us (15&13) and they had a blast.
Go for it!

Foodie Tour-Excellent and thoughtfully planned - I loved this tour! My boyfriend and I did the "foodie tour" and our guides took us to some amazing places. The tour was composed of around 12 people, which was a fun way to see how different people react to the food and stops we visited. The tour involved a wide variety of dishes - I think I had over 7 kinds of both meat and fish. We also had some unique Vietnamese offerings that only the brave tried. You learn about Vietnam and HCMC and we visited a lot of areas I wouldn't have gone on my own, but am very happy to have experienced. The guides we had were super knowledgeable and friendly. It was awesome getting to know them and explore the city in a new way!

Great ladies, but overpriced. - We loved the amazing ladies!

We've been traveling 4 weeks in Vietnam and street food and bike drivers are cheap and available on every corner.

We did an amazing easy rider tour which cost 60$ a day. And although the ladies are amazing 40$ for 2.5 hours is way too expensive.

Rent a bike driver, point at food you want and you'll have the same experience for 10$.

XO tours - awesome even for a non seafood eater! - We had a short time frame in Ho Chi Minh, this tour had been recommended to myself and my friend from a family who we'd met on our travels. We were picked up from our hotel, gave a brief explanation of how to sit on the bike and then we set off, a little apprehensive as the traffic is pure madness, actually its nuts! 😊 But my driver was amazing and I felt nothing but safe as we nipped in and out of the traffic! So much so I even rode like the locals and had my hands on my knees instead of holding onto the bike or driver! I can't recommend this tour highly enough, I don't eat seafood and while this tour is mainly seafood they certainly didn't leave me out. I had more food than I could eat, however it gave the others on the tour some extra Vietnamese dishes to try. You have to be prepared for a food coma!

So much fun, had a lot of laughs, told a lot about the city as we went around, had minders watching out for us in perhaps some of the rougher areas, but saying that never once was I concerned or worried for my safety, I have two girls aged 9&7, had they been with me I'd be more than happy to have taken them, in saying that both of them know how to sit on the back of motorbikes, so if you are traveling with kids and they can hold on, then take them! This was one of many tours my friend and I did in Vietnam and if I'm being honest the county on a whole is truly spectacular but this tour is my favorite and one that still makes me smile.

Amazing! I ate Balut?! - What an amazing and unique experience, me and my friend had really great tour guides in Hu and Thac. We drove around on scooters and felt safe. Started off in torrential downpour before getting to our first stop. While eating our first dish the main tour guide Tai was deciding whether to cancel tour because of rain if it didn't settle down with full refunds if so. This shows they were taking safety seriously. Luckily the rain stopped and we continued with our tour.
I am normally not a fan of seafood, which is key to this tour, but decided to try everything as the tour was well organized and slick so I felt I could trust them. There were vegetarians and those not eating seafood that were well catered for though.
Glad I tried the seafood as it all tasted great. The most unusual dishes were frogs and duck embryo eggs. Glad I can say I tried them once.
Would fully recommend. Our guides were great, knowledgeable, friendly and easy to talk to.

Must do while in Saigon!

Brilliant! - One of the most brilliant experiences of our stay in Vietnam! We have tried the evening tour "Saigon by night". For my husband it was his first motorbike experience. We loved it!!! The girls are very kind, friendly, pro, good drivers and ....beautiful as well! :-) The tour is very well organized and surprisingly secure. It is also nice to go outside the usual tourist areas, to have a delicious street food, to learn a lot of interesting things about the Vietnamese life and culture and just to have fun! We will certainly repeat this experience the next time! Thank you XO Tour!

Believe the hype! - This tour is definitely as advertised. We did the Saigon by Night tour. The girls are friendly, knowledgable and a great time. They spoke English very well and gave us a great overview of the city, cuisine and culture. We were extreamly impressed with the execution, organization and how much fun the girls were.

Highly recommend!!

Brilliant - Brilliant and a lot of fun. The girls do a great tour and look fabulous in traditional clothes. Went to a lot of places and had a great time in our 2.5 hours. Boys just remember ..... no touchy!!. Just hang on to the side of the seat, you'll be ok.

Great fun! Great food! - My girlfriend and I did the foodie tour. We each had our own lovely scooter guides who took us to various restaurants around Ho Chi Minh City. The ride itself was exhilarating, especially if you're not familiar with the traffic of the city (so many people on scooters/motorbikes!). That being said, our ride was still very safe. We tried out a variety of amazing Vietnamese cuisine (I recommend the Balut if you have the stomach for it). For a little extra, we were able to get a video recording of the whole experience. The XO staff were all very friendly and easy to talk to. All in all, a great experience. Highly recommend it!

Not overrated at all. It really is this good! - Every review is 5* but honestly this isnt just a fluke or people getting carried away. I myself am a tour guide and this experience was really quite sensational, unique, breathtaking, informative and simply unmissable. We weren't sure if it was worth the money previously as it comes in at quite a bit more than most other things in Vietnam but it was so SO worth it. The drivers are hilarious, friendly and laid back, whilst also being super safe and aware. The main guide is an incredible presenter, amusing and approachable. The stops you make are interesting and different, and the food is unlimited and amazing. It is a sociable, unique night out with great local guides where you get to see so much more of this huge sprawling city than you otherwise would. An absolute must.
the best tour in Ho Chim Minh - The was the best tour we had in Vietnam, a must do if you go there and also do the four tours at night

One of the highlights of my Vietnam trip - Absolutely loved this tour (the Foodie). My young motor scooter driver (Tam/Tom) was charming, safe, knowledgable, kind and had excellent English. I'm sure all the girls/young women are wonderful but I feel I was lucky to have such a terrific person as my guide for the night. And Tai, the tour leader was wonderful as well - funny, knowledgable, inclusive ... can't say a critical word but many complimentary ones. And the tour - great sights, fantastic food (and authentic) and fun!
so much fun - was brilliant staff were hilarious and so knowledgable. By far the best thing we did our whole trip what a great experience

An absolute must when visiting Saigon!! - My friend and I spent a couple of days in Saigon in late July. Through a recommendation of a friend who lived in Saigon for 18 months we booked the foodie tour. I definitely think everyone visiting Saigon should do this tour, what an amazing experience!!! Like others we were a bit scared about being on the back of a scooter in the crazy Saigon traffic but the girls made you feel so comfortable. Its very professional and well organized and you have minds who are watching over to ensure your safety. Our tour leader was funny and personable and the girls great English. We stopped at a couple of local restaurants and tried amazing food (there is an abundance of food so don't eat a late lunch like we did). We got to visit districts we will never have ventured out to see on our own and got to learn a bit about the history and culture. We had so much fun that we would definitely do it all over again!

XO girls show you the town - We arrived a day late in Saigon due to Qatar airways screwing up and feared we might one of our two XO tours. Fortunately, they rearranged it and we had both the Sights and the Foodie on consecutive days.
We went as a family of four - me, the wife and two sons aged 18 and 15. Both tours were brilliant fun, highly entertaining and educational. The tours are well organized, you get to meet some fellow travelers and dip into the culture of Saigon. The English spoken is excellent, everything is clear and very, safe - have no worries. This is the way to see the city!
If, like me, you're not into seafood, they lay on some special meaty substitutes but in fairness you don't get the full value of the foodie tour which is particularly seafood oriented. I wouldn't mark it down for this, my family enjoyed everything and we spent the whole time smiling and thoroughly enjoying ourselves and the girls' company.
Our tour guides were Anh Pham for the Foodie and Tai Dang for the Sights - each tour had a very different flavor and emphasis and it's well worth doing both if you have time. Do the Foodie if you only have time for one. We had the photos through within a couple of days and am waiting now for the video which we requested of the Sights tour - cannot wait for that.
I'm trying to think of any negatives... nope, none.

Absolutely amazing, highly recommended, the best tour. - XO tour Saigon by Night was absolutely the best tour we did while in Vietnam. The most fun, beautiful hosts, so funny and entertaining. Such awesome drivers, made you feel so safe in the crazy road conditions that the drivers in Vietnam have too encountered all the time, would do that tour again in a heartbeat...cant wait to go back :-)..Debra & Keryn

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh - Wow - initial concern about wobbling around of the back of a moped in the clogged up and crazy streets of Ho Chi Minh City were soon forgotten. Me, my Wife and two grown up sons headed out on an evening foodie tour on 24th July 2014.

The girls were brilliant fun, keeping always up informed and were superb drivers. We stopped many times to try different foods which were all explained to us. My wife being a vegetarian was catered for well too. Options of trying all types of non western food were offered. I tried everything and was glad I did.

Another driver was tailing, watching over us to ensure all was well and took photo's for us at various stops on our own camera and also his, which he kindly emailed over to us a couple of days later.

If there is one thing you should try, try this tour. Absolutely superb.

Glad I did this tour - We did the shorter tour as the foodie tour was all booked out, and it was great.
Our guides were very friendly, informative & had a great sense of humor and most of all were very good drivers. We saw places that we wouldn't have gone to while in a HCMC, dinner was great and we had lots of laughter with our guides. I'm so glad I did this tour as I overcame my fear with the city traffic as I realized they don't speed & there is respect on the roads, not like what we have in our Melbourne traffic.

Highlight of Saigon - My partner and I had very high expectations after all the good reviews and we were not disappointed! Huong 2 (second Huong to work there) was my driver. Not only was she an excellent driver, she was also gifted with English and we were able to share pleasant dialogue during our trip. Tai the tour leader shared the same enthusiasm and was very charming and funny. My partner was her driver Thuc was just as pleasant. All of them shared shared useful information about the city. Try to book in advance because it would be best to do early in your stay, a lot of their knowledge could have helped us early on. However, if like us, you leave it until the last minute do not be discouraged, it is more than worth doing. These girls are the best! Don't miss out!!

Well worth the money... - Did the foodie tour. Had a fantastic time, a very slick and professional outfit - I agree with the other positive reviews people have left. Make sure you only have a light lunch the day you go so you have plenty of room to eat!!

Highlight of Entire Trip! - My husband and I spent a few weeks in Asia, and this was by far the highlight of our trip and one of the experiences we first tell people when describing our vacation. We are pure foodies but are also budget travelers, so we were a little hesitant about booking the tour at first. However, after going on the tour, I'd have to say that it was worth that and even more! Not only were both of our drivers fantastic-witty, welcoming, and knowledgable, but they took you to places you wouldn't otherwise go while in HCMC. We even tried balut! It's a foodie tour, but also a history/sight seeing tour, and they take you to lots of the different districts and explain the history. They also send pics to you after the tour is over so you can remember your night. We love XO Tours and highly, highly, highly recommend them to everyone!!!!!

Money well spent - This tour is particularly great if you just have a short time in Vietnam.
Make sure you do this at the start of your trip and take notes of what you like and don't!
The girls are super witty, if not a bit corny, and overall it was a great tour, very little to fault!
It is a bit expensive but worth it, it's not just about the food but some culture, you go to districts you probably will never venture to on your own as a tourist.
I had a vegetarian menu on 'The Foodie' tour and by god there was so much food, impossible that I could eat it all myself.

So much fun! - Husband and I were hesitant at first due to the crazy traffic scenes we had seen of Vietnamese motorbikes. Turns out, we were completely wrong! Motorbikes are the best way to get around HCMC and the guides are great drivers. The foodie tour took us around parts of HCMC we would've never visited and tried foods we probably wouldn't have gotten to on our normal tourist route. It was a memorable experience, the food was great, and it left us with a deeper appreciation of Vietnam and it's culture.

Foodie tour a must - One of the absolute highlights of a 9 day trip throughout Vietnam.
An absolute must. Girls are a great laugh and the food is so so good.
Do it!!!!

Number 1 thing to do - Very professional running business. Had a fantastic time n tried lots of good local food. We did the foodie tour n sorry I didn't get a chance to do the other tour options available.
Never been on a motor bike before but the girls make u feel very relaxed n comfortable so u feel really safe. Tam my driver was excellent n looked after us all nigh. My with had Yen n she was great also.

The tour group leader Khanh was excellent n made the whole night fun. All the girls speak good English n have great personalities to ensure u have a great time. Will do this trip again when back in Saigon. Also great value for what u get.

Awesome screw - We spent 2 1/2 hours on the back of two bikes zooming around the very very busy city of Ho Chi Minh in the safe hands of two lovely riders. We were taken to 7 attractions around the city which was a bonus and to be part of the mad traffic was a fantastic feeling. We felt completely safe the whole time. the tour guide was great and there was also a minder who followed us for extra safety. Can't recommend highly enough.

The best foodie tour - Me and a friend did the foodie tour on the 3rd August i was very impressed with this tour and would recommend it to anyone well worth it and I can say I will be doing it again and again and again it's that good

XO Tours - Foodie motorbike tour - This was without a doubt the highlight of the HCMC visit.. We spent 3 days sightseeing and doing the usual tours.. BUT we were recommended this Foodie bike tour.. Sensational time. The fact you are on the back of a motor-scooter feeling incredibly safe and participating in the mayhem that is HCMC traffic is just fantastic.
The girls who collected my wife & I were very polite, informative and just made our evening a whole lot of fun.. Special mention for our two female guides - a big thank you to Chi & Nyng and our Captain who was always waiting for the group at the next destination was Anh.
We were promptly collected at 5.30pm at Rex Hotel and were very responsively whisked off to meet our group of 10 at a restaurant near by. We covered various districts and enjoyed a wide but unusual variety of food which was all adding to the HCMC experience. The key is the promise is you will not go home hungry - Good food & always a nice cold beer at each location. There were a few non-seafood people - they catered for everyone's personal tastes and needs

Thank you to all the XO tour team for making our first night in HCMC unforgettable and I can strongly recommend this tour as a 'hands down' best tour there

An amazing HCMC tour - We loved this tour - the riders were the sweetest, most extroverted bunch of ladies with excellent English skills and a great knowledge of the city. the food was seriously yummy and food I have not tasted in the rest of my Vietnam stay despite trying to eat traditional Vietnamese cooking every day. The ladies took us to many parts of the city, many districts which would be unvisited by many tours. My husband was nervous about a motorbike tour in a city with such crazy traffic but he loved it in the end.

I would recommend this tour to anyone. Don't eat lunch.

XO Tours - My wife and I did the Saigon by night tour on a Friday night in late July.

Put simply, it was an absolutely fantastic night. I would without doubt class it as one of the best tourist experiences I have had.

The girls are fantastic, both with the information they give you and their driving abilities, they are the sea of ​​calm in the midst of Saigons crazy moped storm.

It's invigorating, eye opening and a whole lot of fun.

If you're going to Saigon do it, you really won't regret it

Best experience in Vietnam! - My husband and I just got back from the foodie tour. There are no words to describe how AMAZING it was! The scooters are the sweetest girls I've ever met, the manager tried everything to make it a memorable tour. Even satisfied my vegetarian taste buds. I couldn't wish for more, this was an amazing experience what I will never ever forget!

Thank you so much XO tours for the unique night! Special thanks for my driver for being such a nice person! :)

Fantastic experience - Yes, it was a little expensive, but money is best spent on experiences, and this was well worth it. The guides were fantastic, spoke English incredibly well, and Van (my driver for the evening) was full of wit and sarcasm that made the night highly entertaining and quite enjoyable.

The food in general was delicious and among the best I've had during my 3 weeks in Vietnam, and Tai, the tour leader, was also very entertaining. Great way to eat some good food, see parts of Saigon you probably never would have otherwise, and just spend an enjoyable evening. Highly recommended.

Outstanding Tour! - I took "The Sights" tour and thought it was great. Aside from seeing all the main spots of Ho Chi Minh City, it was awesome driving around on the back of the motorbike. I was worried about that aspect of it and I'll admit that I was anxious for the first minute or so, but I quickly calmed down and really enjoyed the ride.

Really good fun and a great mix of history and moped-ing! - Traveling with two teenagers, this was the perfect way to tour the city - a great mix of seeing the sights (especially going to the places where iconic photos of Saigon were taken), learning the history, and zooming around on mopeds.

The girls are great fun - chatty and bubbly - and really make the trip.

And then a few days after the tour, they sent an email with photos from the trip, which is a really lovely touch and makes you think about it all over again!

Fantastic experience! - We traveled through Vietnam for a little over two weeks and this was certainly one of our highlights. My driver's name was Sylvia (english name). Her and Thoo (unsure of spelling) were very knowledgeable and funny! The local street food they took us to was delicious and it was great to visit a number of different districts to see the different way the locals live. Will certainly do the food tour with XO when i next visit HCMC.

Definitely worth it! - Took the foodie tour and it went way beyond my expectations! The food was definitely great, but coupled with the insight on Saigon and Vietnam as a whole, leveled up the experience. Thanks for giving me easily one of the best nights of my life! Special thanks to Ngan for driving me around safely and making sure I was stuffed by the end of the tour! And Khanh for doing a terrific job as the tour leader the night I joined. I definitely learned so many things and my taste buds were beyond satisfied! Highly recommended! -Bem

Don't avoid the motorbikes, ride them instead! - Simply riding around on the back of one of the motorbikes made the tour well worth the money paid (which was reasonable). Add on to this awesome food, a great group of people and very interesting talks throughout and you have yourself a great evening in Saigon. My wife and I, on our honeymoon, really enjoyed the "Foodie" tour and would certainly do it again.

Excellent - My two friends and I went on a tour last December 2013 and we absolutely loved it - the girls and tour guides were so friendly and helpful, they really made our stay in Ho Chi Minh, we would definitely recommend you go!

Sights Tour: A Trip Highlight! - During a month of traveling through Southeast Asia, this was one of the highlights of our trip. We only had one full day in HCMC and we started it with the morning Sights tour and it was just fabulous. I felt safe in the bike the entire time. The guides spoke excellent English and gave us a fantastic overview of the city. If you only do one thing in Saigon, make it an XO Tour.

Do it! And early in your time in Saigon - I am not brave when it comes to motor bikes and wouldn't ordinarily do this but we loved this tour
Not only was the food great but the information along the way by our guide so helpful. Do this early in your time in Saigon as it gives you a great overview of all the different districts from the backpacker to the upmarket districts.
Scared as I was it was well worth the money.

Highlights of our holiday! - We did the city sights tour on our first full day in Saigon - what an excellent way to get our bearings in a hectic city! The girls were incredibly friendly and keen to share their culture and life stories with us. Equally our tour guide was very nice and provided an informative introduction to Saigon. We felt very safe at all times on the bike and enjoyed all of the stops on the tour.

We would recommend it to anyone visiting Saigon. Next time we'll do the food tour :)

A highlight in Ho Chi Minh - I used XO Tours twice while in Ho Chi Minh - once with my children (7 and 8) on the sights tour and again on the foodie tour by myself.

Like everyone else - I couldn't fault their enthusiasm, friendliness, knowledge and riding ability! The photos they took and sent out for free are really good too.

The kids loved it - it was very safe for them - and the girls treated them like rock stars too, which helped.

The foodie tour was just what I needed to get a taste of things outside District 1 - my only complaint would be that it had to end!

Highly recommend this for children - they are still raving about it!

The very best food tour - The tour provides an excellent introduction to Vietnamese food with the added interest of being ferried from place to place on a motor scooter piloted by a lovely Saigon girl! Can't beat that!
The tour takes you to 5 districts of HCMC after picking you up from your hotel and meeting with the rest of the tour. The food is very good and abundant and is of excellent quality - particularly the seafood.
My driver, Anh was very skillful and could really handle the Saigon traffic which could be wildering to an outsider. The tour leader, Tai impressed immediately with his ability to recall everyonbe's name instantly and was very friendly and professional.
There are no tourist locations visited, just authentic Vietnamese eating places.
I would recommend this tour without hesitation.

Street food indeed! - Pro: the girls are really welcoming and doing their best.

Con: food are disappointing and we were truly worried about the hygiene... especially the last stop - seafood....I think it is overpriced.

Spectacular way to see the city! - First arriving in Saigon we were a tad nervous about the amount of crazy scooter activity... All these worries faded as soon as we saw who we were driving with!

We had 3 amazing ladies to take us on our 'Saigon by Night' tour who spoke English perfectly! They briefed us on all safety factors and took care of our bags, we got provided with appealing but also suitable helmets and we got going.

For $15 extra we got our tour on video, well worth it, a fourth scooter weaved in and out of the hectic traffic to score video footage of us in the bustling Saigon City. It is also an amazing way to capture the sights, like the markets in Chinatown, that you couldn't take a snap of yourself.

All of our tour guides were extremely friendly and talked to us about everything throughout the ride. History of the city, bargains we got on items, the districts of the city and even the wages of people in various places around the city were all topics covered between my tour guide and I!

A couple of stops were weaved in on the way (to prevent sore bums!) to have dinner, get photos, and get an in-depth explanation of the area.
3 options are available for dinner and even more if you're vegetarian! All meals were amazing (as we got all 3 options among the 3 of us) but we definitely recommend the 'Broken Rice' as our all time favourite!

XO tours is a great way to get away from District 1 and explore the vast city of Saigon. All the drivers are so experienced driving in the crazy traffic that I never once felt unsafe! The drivers are some of the friendliest people we met and it was our highlight of Saigon!

Great fun! - The previous reviews say it all really! Fantastic hosts and great fun. We did the foodie tour. The only thing that I wish to add is that, if you are a vegetarian, although you will be very well catered for, they will give you an enormous amount of food! It is impossible to eat all the food they provide, especially if you are the only vegetarian in the group. I felt a bit guilty for leaving so much, even though some of it was shared out amongst the rest. I wish we had also done the daytime sights tour with them as the guides were brilliant and super friendly.

BEST. TOUR. EVER. Enough said! - My boyfriend and I took the "foodie" tour my second night in the city. It was a fantastic experience! The food was AMAZING! But not just the food, the people were fantastic too, and really made the tour! They showed us 5 different districts within Ho Chi Minh City, with four different food stops, including all the food you could eat and beer too! They were fun, knowledgeable, interesting, friendly, and really created a unique experience we have found no where else. Tai, the tour manager, and our motorbike drivers, Fu and Nu (please forgive me, I don't know the correct spelling of their names) were just wonderful and the other guests on the tour were all so fun as well. We are so glad we did this tour early in our trip, and would love to have all our family and friends come for this tour someday as well. Very well organized, a ton of fun, just a phenomenal experience!!! Thank you so much!

An unforgettable trip 😊 - We booked the foodie tour when we got to HCMC, so convenient and your driver picks you up from your hotel! Although they did forget about us but this was rectified quickly and we even hotbthevtour for free in the end! Drivers are excellent, tour is brilliant. Got to try so much genuine & authentic Vietnamese food where all the locals eat!! A must for all foodies or anyone who just wants to get to see the city from a different angle!!

A MUST!! - This was the best thing I did in HCMC! What an experience! I did the morning sights tour which is about 2.5 hours. My driver, Hoang, was so sweet and then there is a tour guide who is so knowledgable, friendly and fun! The tour is incredibly organized and a great experience ti ride around the city on a scooter - I never felt in any danger. The only con for me was I would've had liked to walk through the markets in Cholon. If I were to go again, I would try the foodie tour, which I heard is fantastic. I highly recommend this! Incredibly fun!

Fun, fun, fun - Before I went to Vietnam this time I saw this company on TA and decided I wanted to experience it for myself. I have been to HCM so I expected not many surprises, but I was wrong. I took The Sights tour and the local insights gave a great perspective. Also it is a lot of fun being on the back of a motorcycle in the middle of what appears to be a great chaotic traffic situation, but the girls all have great skills and move you around the city very safely.

Can't wait until I get my pics that the guide took during the tour. Especially one from "jumping" in front of the Reunification Palace I want to see.

So much fun! - My husband and I usually do at least one food tour per visit to a new city. We want to eat like a local but need help. Not only was this a food tour but it was an amazing city tour as well, all on the back of a motorbike - I don't think there is a better way to be with the locals than on a motorbike in HCMC. I was apprehensive, having never been on a motorcycle, but after our first stop I felt perfectly safe, even when it started raining. The places we stopped at to eat were very good and were places we would never have gone to on our own. The entire XO team was very organized as well as fun to be with.

My husband and I were staying outside of town and needed to get a taxi after the tour. Our drivers took us to the Opera House where there are a lot of taxis and helped us find one who was willing to take us. During the discussion with the taxi driver another person from XO arrived to make sure everything was ok. She also asked us to call her as soon as we were safely at the hotel. From my initial email to XO to our last call saying we had made it back this company could not have been better or more customer focused.

Fantastic.... must do in Hoi Chin Minh - Did the Foodie Tour and what a great night out with the family, food was amazing and be prepared to be adventurous. The girls were very accommodating especially traveling with a 5 year old and she loved it. A great way to see the night life in Saigon. Visiting all the major districts. The girls make the night, they are very entertaining. The night ended with an evening storm at the last restaurant and arranged taxis back to the hotel and the leader escorted us back, great service and will definitely do again, one of the top 3 highlights whilst traveling in Vietnam. Highly Recommended.

Fantastic - You get picked up and dropped off
You get driven around the district's you'd likely never visit
You get plenty of good Vietnamese cuisine, although some may baulk at the last delicacy!
My guide was very chatty, maybe I was lucky but there is good banter throughout
They provide photos also for you to download
A must while in HCMC

Amazing experience - Just did the Foodie Tour last night. What an amazing tour! Well worth the money!!! We drove through many different districts and learned about the culture, not to mention all the different foods we tried. The tour leader and girls were fantastic! Very well organized! I had so much fun...definitely would do it again! Even the rain couldn't dampen our spirits. And we're receiving photos that were taken of us in about a week...an added bonus!

Fun and fantastic - Had an absolute ball on my birthday. Surprise cake at the end of tour great surprise. Staff very friendly and made the whole experience memorable. Did the city tour and saw all the amazing sights. Even the rain couldnt stop the fun we had.

Free! - This tour was awesome! We - a couple from Switzerland - booked the Foodie tour in HCMC. The drivers and the tour leader were very charming and friendly. They drove us to a lot of different places around the city and had a lot of interesting stories to tell.

Best tour ever - My wife and I have just finished our XO dinner tour. It is the very best tourist experience either of us has ever had. We saw the city in a fascinating way and felt very safe doing it. We ate interesting and varied food and learned a little about Vietnamese people while enjoying the truly friendly company of our guides. It is the personal touch that really makes the evening special.

Had a great time! Lives up to the hype - Went on the foodie tour by might with my wife and two of or friends.

Things started by us being picked up from our apartment by our tour guide. They explained to us how we would ride the bike, gave us a helmet and off we went to our first destination. We met us with our friends and were seated together. They really went out of there way to keep us as a group.

Coming from Australia it's strange to see the roads full of motorbikes and my wife was scared to be riding on the back of the bike. I have to say that it wasn't scary at all being on the back of the bike. The girls rode very well and I never once thought we would crash.

All the food places we went to were great and our tour guide was excellent.

Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.

The Sightseeing Skooter tour..... XO tours is a must do - If your looking for a fun but local way of seeing the sights and sounds of local Saigon, then look no further than XO Bike tours. From the time we met our Moped tour hosts to the final goodbyes we felt safe and more well educated on the sights and sounds of Saigon.

In the morning, we boarded our new Scooters with our lovely hostess tour guides to see the sights of Saigon. Without spoiling your fun we visited some of the coolest and most influential sights in Saigon. The country is so rich in history so each visit gives you some real perspective on the true Historical moments through the war torn era.

The format runs with one main guide who arrives at each destination first and then provides each group with detailed/interesting historical points in a lecture style format. After 3 hours of zooming and weaving through the traffic in Saigon, drinking and eating some local snacks you get dropped off back at your hotel or a destination CLOSE to your hotel. Check out the largest shopping, ben-thanh-market for some cool and cheap clothes, home wares and jewelry/shoes if that's your thing! If your looking for the coolest, most fun way to see Saigon look no further. The whole tour is well organized, the bikes are all new and very comfortable, the lady hostesses who zoom you around on there bikes are super friendly, well versed in speaking English and give you some cool tips about things to do whilst in there home town. Overall this tour is a "must do" for anyone who can handle being on a scooter and being in local traffic for 3 hours. The sights and sounds of true Saigon on a bike are awesome.

Some tips: 1. Do the morning tour before it gets hot, 2. Makes sure you wear sunscreen and put on insect repellent before you leave, 3. Get a face mask (Surgical Mask, to cover your mouth and nose just to prevent dust while zooming around), 4. Wear sunglasses, 5. Take a small backpack which can be worn front and back to keep your valuables safe whist walking around and take a small compact camera/GoPro to record your memories. As always when you receive such amazing personalized service show your appreciation with a tip to your scooter drivers, 100,000 to 200,000 dong is well received so don't hold back, it means a lot in a place like Saigon!!!!!

Great Night for all family - 2 teenagers, 2 parents, hard to keep everyone happy but this tour did!
Easy to communicate and book, they were on time to pick up at hotel, this is a very well oiled tour company. We did the night time food tour. The girls were lovely and engaging. They managed to have fun with a 15 year old boy and 17 year old boy and talk about make up, life in Vietnam, uni and dating plus food. The tour was interesting and we felt very safe with the drivers, the food was more like a lets show us your weirdest food rather than a gourmet food tour, so if you understand that you won't be disappointed. They catered for the seafood only daughter.
I read that some feel uncomfortable with the women's role as a hostess, l didn't feel this way and felt like l was having an intelligent conversation on lots of things globally and locally that affected her. The male tour guide who met us at each point however has a certain view of australians and his jokes were often a little sexually oriented and crude and not necessary. That was only minor and the night was well worth it

Ratings Speak For Themselves - Just Book It! - It's not often you find something as highly rated on TripAdvisor, and it's for a reason, XO Tours is incredible! We booked this on our very first night and it was great to get the lay of the land and especially to get out of District One and see the city. The girls are fantastic and it is very safe. One of the pleasant surprises was that most of the stops were not run-of-the-mill pho, spring roll or bahn mi dishes but a far wider range of delicacies and dishes I had never had before. Finally, the people at XO were so easy to work with, responded promptly via email during planning and were nothing but beyond hospitable. We sprung extra for the camera crew and the results were pure gold. Bravo XO Tours, you have an amazing thing going. Stop looking and just book it already!

You just have to do this! - I am an extremely nervous passenger, even with experienced drivers, so seeing the traffic in HCMC made me a little apprehensive about this tour. How wrong I was! My "girl" put me at ease from the first moment on the bike. Strangely, I feel better to be in the crazy traffic that just watching it or trying to cross the road.

So nerves settled, we were off on a fabulous tour of the city and some local restaurants. The food was great, with plenty of variety and in places we would never have seen, or gone to on our own. The girl drivers are so interesting to talk to, you gain a real insight into their daily lives, chatting to them while navigating the busy streets. You traverse the city and see all different parts that you probably will never go to on your own. The guide fills you in on the history and specific details about the areas at each of the stops. Our guide was Ahn and my driver was Nga (I hope that's right).

I happened to mention that it was my husband's birthday and they surprised him with a decorated cake with sparklers at the last restaurant. That just really topped off a fantastic night.

I can't recommend this tour highly enough, it's probably one of the best tours I have ever done and I will tell everyone about it for many years. My husband is not a terribly efficient person, so for him to say that he will have done the tour again the following night says it all!

I needed to reschedule our tour from one night to the next as our plane was delayed. The boss on the phone was quite helpful, if a little bit abrupt. But this certainly didn't take any shine off the tour as all the people with us were wonderful. For those wondering about safety, there are a few male staff who accompany you on the ride to make sure everything is all ok.

In summary...you just have to do this tour!

A must-do tour - Went on 14ht July having pre-booked in UK. Wife vegetarian. XO Tours ensures ALL her very wide variety of dishes were tasty and varied. She was scared of the bike idea but the girls were patient and explained everything to her and she had a great time. You cannot experience Saigon without the local food and the bikes through the Saigon traffic.
I could not fault the tour, the excellence of the girls riding skills and helpfulness and the guide Anh's knowledge of the different areas of the city that a tourist so often misses.
Absolutely recommended.
XO Tours Fantastic - We had an amazing Foodie tour with XO tours. We thoroughly recommend this tour. It was fun, well organized and a great way to get around Ho Chi Minh.

Fun tour - Not cheap but worth every cent.Girls are fantastic,chatty and informative.Locals were amused to see us in the traffic.Virtually all you can eat/drink.Food was great,not what you'd find back home.

What a Blast!! - My husband and I and two teenage girls took "The Foodie" tour near the end of a 16 day trip to Vietnam and Cambodia. I cannot emphasize enough how much we all loved this tour. In fact it was a highlight of a wonderful vacation. The beautiful young women in traditional dress who picked us up on scooters in front of our hotel spoke excellent English. They were knowledgeable about their city and great fun to be with. They were also very skilled drivers. Although we all felt a little nervous at first zipping through the busy Ho Chi Minh City traffic on the back of scooters within five minutes we relaxed, placed our trust in our excellent drivers and thoroughly enjoyed the thrilling ride.

The food part of the tour was also amazing. Over a four hour time span we got to visit a number of Districts that we would never have visited on our own, ate at places that tourists do not frequent and tried dishes that we would not have otherwise ordered. My husband and I are foodies and really enjoyed the variety of different foods that were placed before us (including the frog that one of our drivers grilled for us at our table). However, I must admit that we did decline the duck embryo. Our teenage girls also ate and enjoyed the majority of the food. The food was abundant and the cold beer flowed freely. We were certainly extremely satisfied by the time that the tour ended.

The entire operation was seamless from the original internet booking to the time that our drivers safely returned us to our hotel. We were even sent photos of our group on tour within a few days of arriving home.

This tour is worth every penny that it costs. If you only have time to do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City take a tour with XO Tours. You will not regret it.

OMG, A must do - We have just finished our tour. It was the most amazing experience and I would say that it is a must do for anyone visiting HCMC. The staff were amazing, the women we had as our guides and drivers were lots of fun and very knowledgable. We saw HCMC in a way that we never would have with any other tour, we did the foodie tour and ate things that we never would have experienced if we stayed in the main tourist areas.

Our teenage daughter had an absolute blast and I think will put this down to her best experience in our whole trip through Sumatra and Vietnam.

To anyone who baulks at the price, just do it, you won't regret!!

Amanda, Heidi and Jessi

Good but careful with foodie tour seafood. - The guides were lovely and very good drivers. They take you to a diverse range of places you would be very unlikely to visit otherwise. For the foodie tour they mainly take you to street food restaurants. They serve ALOT of food and your guide sits next to you and "feeds" you. Which we found a little uncomfortable. Unfortunately, we came down with severe gastro the next day. They were very apologetic.

Do this first! - This tour is pretty pricey for Viet standards, but we'll worth it.

I brought my wife here since it's her first time visiting Vietnam and she loved every minute. She really got to bond with her driver on her ride.

We did the night tour the first night and they drove us through the many different districts. I am Vietnamese and have visited before in the past and going with a professional tour is so much better than having family drive us around. I saw new sights and had a nice history lesson behind many of the places we visited. You should do this tour and take note of the places you'd like to visit for the rest of your trip so you can go at your own pace later on.

We also did the daytime sights tour and that was a bit more boring since it was a lot more of a history lesson, but it was very informative as well.

My wife absolutely loved riding around on the scooter through the traffic.
