For those of you who think this is a bit expensive, here's what we got for our daytime tour. We were the only 2 on the tour, but we had our 2 drivers, a tour guide, and another support staff. The support guy keeps an eye on the scooters and also acts as a buffer to the beggars and can pickpockets in the crowded markets. So all in all, I think the fee for the tour was worth every penny.

Fantastic people and super fun! - The guide and girls were amazing. They were most informative and accommodating to any needs we had. Even with nervous passengers, it turned out to be some much fun in this very hectic traffic. They even carried our shopping and went out of their way to bargain for us as well!
All smiles and super chatty these guys were amazing. I found it really "out of the box" and it added a very different element to our holiday in Vietnam.

Worth every dollar - We decided to go on this one due to the positive reviews and I must say it was definitely a highlight of the trip. The guides were great and a lot of fun and the food was amazing.

Amazing experience - Would highly recommend your foodie when you first arrive in Vietnam. Great information about local food and so many delicious things to try! I don't eat chicken or red meat and the guides were more than accommodating, I left completely full and was able to try some amazing new dishes!

The guides are lovely and riding on the scooters in Vietnam is a great experience. They even take photos and email them to you so no need to worry about taking your camera and finding photo ops. Great fun!

Wonderful, even in the pouring rain - The consistent, positive reviews on Tripadvisor are completely accurate. We saved this tour for our last night in Vietnam, and we quickly learned that there truly is no better way to see the city than via motorbike. The guides are good drivers, they have male bodyguards (to protect the guests/female guides if need be), and the tour takes you to a variety of districts that you would never otherwise venture to.

If you find yourself having booked this tour and the weather is not ideal, do not be deterred! 1/3rd through our tour, we found ourselves caught in a huge intermittent storm. They had ponchos ready for us, and it was absolutely exhilarating zooming throughout the city with lightning overhead. I never felt unsafe on the motorbike in spite of rainy weather conditions. ( just silly :D ) At the end of the experience, they even offered to refund us $10 due to the unexpected weather. Little did they know - the weather only makes it that much more magical!

O, and don't worry about snapping pictures - they take pictures of your group throughout the night and send them via e-mail after a few days. This allows you to just focus on the food, the city, and the experience!

Very Fun! - This is well worth the money! Our tour got cut short due to the weather, but it was a blast all the same. The guides are fantastic, and driving through the crazy traffic is a blast! Take this tour or another offered by XO, you will not be disappointed!!

XO Sights Tour - Great way to see Siagon - We did the Sights Tour today and loved it. Felt relaxed and comfortable throughout, even in crazy traffic. Great way to see the sights of the city and has clearly been planned very thoughtfully to give you knowledge of the history, local people and way of life. Including some interesting and quirky facts. The girls who drove us around were really friendly and good fun, as was the tour guide who met us at each stop off. I was skeptical about the $40 price but have come away thinking it was well worth it.

Excellent - MUST DO the foodie tour while in Ho Chi Minh, we had a fabulous night, loved zipping around the streets with our guides. Very safe, great food & knowledge tour. It has all been said before, a must do & would recommend it to everyone.

The best Vietnam tour and one of the best ever! - We literally just finished the tour as I wrote this review 8 July.
My wife and I were blown away by this tour.

The Staff
The staff were absolutely fantastic. Both our drivers spoke really good English, I dare say they spoke English better than 99% of hotel staff I've met in Vietnam. They shared their perspective of their city which we wouldn't have known or read about. Great to here local knowledge. Everything was very well organized.

The Food
I am a 110kg man and I'm full. They offer a lot of variety some really good, some extremely delish and of course the strange by Australian standards. There's food some will like and some food you may not like but for me I absolutely loved it. It was the food you wouldn't ordinarily order by yourself but on the "foodie" tour it was done for you so you wouldn't have to do that internal battle of "I should try cos it's what the locals eat but what if it's bad or I don't like it". Come for the food, it's the best I've tasted in my 20 days of Vietnam.

The Tour
We visited 5 District of Saigon (HCMC). It was really well done. We wouldn't have been to see these Districts if it wasn't for this tour. The Districts are very distinctive with its own character and story. I won't spoil the tour but this was apart of this wonderful tour. This tour is a lot of fun with many jokes thrown in. To get the most out of the tour have a chat with the guides/lady drivers.
I admittedly was nervous about being on the back of a scooter in Saigon. The ladies were wonderful, very skillful drivers that made my wife and I feel very safe and comfortable.
It did cost a US$72, a high price by Vietnamese tour standards however it was worth every cent. Just thinking about it you get a guide per passenger ratio and you get a security detail for the group and a tour leader. Oh I forgot, you get unlimited food and drinks. But be warned to pace yourself with food..... I got filled by the 2nd food stop.

All I have to say is, I hope the owner is paying these tour guys and girls very well because they are going above and beyond.
MUST DO!
Simon and Cate

A must-do in HCMC! - We literally just stepped off the bikes and I had to rave about how amazing this tour is!

The girls are amazing! Perfect English and a lot of fun! Their driving is phenomenon and we felt safe the entire time!

The food was just WOW! Well organized so you are never left waiting long and so flavoursome! Beer is available and very cold! They cater to everyone (including vegetarians) and is overall a great experience!

A must for all travelers! We had a blast!

Favorite part of my trip! - The XO Food Tour was easily my favorite thing we did in Ho Chi Minh City - we did the 4 hour tour in the evening. It was the best way to see all the Districts and to experience many local street food vendors you wouldn't have otherwise gotten to visit. The girls on the bikes were incredibly sweet and I felt safe riding with them (as safe as you can feel with hundreds of motorbikes around you!). The 4 food stops were unbelievable; I think two of them even provided some of my favorite foods I've had in my life (and I'd consider myself a foodie): (1) the first stop had an amazing bun bo dish with a very flavorful lemongrass tough (2) District 4 seafood, can't say enough good things about it.

The coordination of the tour was flawless and we learned a lot about the city, the people, and the foods. I would definitely recommend this tour and hope to do it again if I go back to HCM.

Best night of our travels - The ladies at xo tours do a fantastic job. We did the foodie tour and zipping around Saigon eating all the street food you could handle was great fun. It's no pho or bahn mi that you'll be eating. We stuffed ourselves on both the delicious and the bizarre. In between food stops they give you a tour of the city. We did the tour on our first evening in Saigon and it was a great way to get acclimated to the city and the amazing food culture in Vietnam. I wish that I remember the names of the girls who were our guides (our drivers and the tour leader) but they were great. Bryan and Carlene thank you!

Great short tour to experience Saigon - We loved this tour.
The girls are funny and speak great English. The guide Tai was knowledgable and friendly.

I was disenchanted on the scooters - for no reason as it was completely safe! The traffic is just insane!

Best thing about the tour wasn't just the food but getting to see all of the different districts and experiencing being among the crazy Saigon traffic!

Food was also good - my husband tried some more adventurous things like duck embryo and frog but I wasn't interested :)

Food included BBQ meats, noodle soup, deserts, seafood (amazing!!!).

Make sure you are well rested and hungry as this finishes late and you eat a lot!

fascinating - You should not leave Saigon without doing an XO Tour. So much fun with excellent guides. We did the Saigon by Night tour through a thunderstorm which just added to the fun! It's the best way to see how different the districts are from
each other and experience some delicious food and drink.

A must do; - We did the foodie tour with XO- we had a fabulous evening. Great tour leader, fantastic individual guide/driver, fabulous food and service.
Even when the Sky opened up and poured on us, they continued on with professionalism. And lots of laughs and fun...
I really wish I had done the shopping tour with them; but we ran out of time.

XO feasting fun - The XO Foodies tour was an absolute gem. Zipping around Saigon at night on the back of scooters was a blast, the girls were a joy and sensational hosts, and the was food surprising and seriously delicious - some of the best we've tasted in Vietnam. It was a true life experience and one not to be missed when visiting Saigon.

Just Do It - An absolute must! - We have been traveling in Vietnam for over two weeks and had a fantastic time, there have been many highlights, but this tour is by far an outstanding experience. The XO ladies were fun, friendly and knowledgable - sharing information as we road along. Our young children, 5 & 7, absolutely loved the bikes. It was safe and a great way to see the city.

Great way to tour the city and try the food! - We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with XO Tours!. It was our last night on our trip and we had a limited time in Saigon. This was a terrifically fun way to see the city on the back of a scooter in the crazy traffic. The girls were wonderful and kept us well fed with a lot of unusual dishes that we probably would not have experienced otherwise. Would highly recommend this!

We Loved our XO Tour! - Eight of us took the night tour of Saigon our first night there. We flew in from the US and had been up over 24 hours. We were all tired but soon forgot about that as we boarded the bikes with the guides and drove out into the Saigon night traffic.

XO Tour was the perfect way to start our trip in Vietnam. The girls were so friendly, articulate and interested in talking with us about what were seeing and doing. They definitely showed us parts of Saigon we not have seen on our own. They skillfully handled the bikes - I'm 6' 4" 250 lbs and my driver seemed to not notice my size.

We loved the tour and are so glad we found them. Every night at dinner over the next 2 weeks we would all share one thing that stuck out as our best part of the trip so far and for my teenage kids XO Tours always was mentioned as their favorite.

We recommended XO Tour to every traveller we crossed paths with who was headed to Saigon.

Enjoyed the ride than the food - We went on their Foodie tour. These girls/women who take you on a ride (no pun intended) on their scooters are rather too eager to please, and entertain, and you later realise it is a cover up for lack of substance. We went to three eateries ate different stuff, listening to hyped up description of them, and laboured jokes. Well they had to do their job. It lacked spontaneity and looked contrived.
They treat you like a child, and believe that the best way to make you happy is to have photos clicked in various poses, holding a crab leg and grinning, or posing as if you are riding the bike.
But I salute their great skill in riding the scooter, so effortlessly wading through the chaotic traffic. I must say I felt safer sitting behind them on the scooter, than crossing any street in Ho chi Minh.
That said, if you have $70 to spare, for which amount you have the option of half a dozen full body massages in Vietnam, go for this, enjoy the ride.

City tour... Just brilliant - The girls are fantastic. We took the tour I. The morning. A lot of fun for all of the family. The tour leader was knowledgable and we managed to stay away from the usual crowds. Being on the bake of a moped brought the tour alive. This was excellent.

Best tour ever! - My husband and I booked the foodie tour after a recommendation by a friend. I am so glad we did! It was the highlight of our 3 week trip to Vietnam!

The girls are fantastic guides. My guide, Yen, was extremely interesting and had loads of facts to share. They also all have great sense of humor!

It was awesome to see a completely different side of Saigon. We especially enjoyed trying all the different types of food since this was the beginning of our time in Vietnam and it helped us throughout the rest of the trip since we knew what a lot of foods were that we never would have known about otherwise!

It was a particularly nice touch that they sent you photographs of professional quality after the tour is completed. I would recommend this tour to anyone of any age. We had an absolute blast!!

Fantastic from top to bottom - I can't say enough good things about this tour. They do an excellent job giving me tastes and experiences in the city I relied on the courage/know-how to get on my own. The staff all had strong English and are very service oriented. If you do one thing in Ho Chi Minh, do this.

Highlight of HCMC! Best tour by far! - The foodie tour was hands down the best tour I have been on, anywhere, ever! The girls were exceptional and well spoken. Tourism at its finest. Truc was awesome and with the other girls, assured myself and my friends had an amazing night. Highly recommend!!! Oh, and try all the food even if the sound of it puts on the edge of your seat.

Safe, fun and yummy foodie tour - What a fantastic tour of Saigon and it's food. My wife and I were met in our hotel's laneway by our guides Anh and Thanh, two beautifully dressed and spoken Vietnamese women who made us feel comfortable immediately by showing us how to safely ride as passengers (and also how to be appropriately being a male passenger behind a woman driver). They were excellent drivers and guides, always working to keep my wife and I together while riding and during visits to restaurants. Khanh was our group's host and she was great - very entertaining and knowledgeable. Each person on the tour had very attentive, individual service from his or her guide and there were also other riders (male) who stayed with the group the whole time to keep us and the guides safe - so, no hawkers approached us which was a nice break. The food was very adventurous, not what we'd eaten in district 1. The whole set up was perfect and we'd recommend to anyone. Just don't say that the food is 'Yum' - as Anh told me, that has a very different meaning in Vietnamese!

A must-do tour. - We did the Saigon by night tour. We had a great time, and the girls were friendly, knowledgeable, and experienced riders. Very exciting way to be a part of the crazy traffic and see parts of the city that we wouldn't have thought or known to visit. No guide book can replace local knowledge. A great thing to do if you visit Ho Chi Minh City. Highly recommended.

Awesome Family Fun - We did the city sights with our 3 kids aged 7,9 and 11. We all loved the tour and felt very safe. Something the kids will never forget and a great way to interact with some gorgeous locals

Best part of our stay! - Myself and two friends decided to do the foodie tour, every person involved was amazingly nice and fun and encouraged us to enjoy ourselves. Everyone spoke great English and the girls riding the bikes were absolutely beautiful and we loved getting to know them! I'm glad we went on this tour or we never would have tried all these crazy foods but it was all amazing! Felt like such an authentic experience and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh, even if you only have one day to spare, worth every cent! :)

Loved it! Best experience in Vietnam! - This was by far the best experience I've had in HCMC! The girls were very sweet and so much fun to hang out with. The food was great and although HCMC traffic is terrifying I felt very safe. I encourage everyone to do this tour.

Best part of my trip! - I chose to participate in the evening foodie tour. It was absolutely wonderful. The tour guides were all so nice and their English was some of the best I heard while traveling. Not only did I get to see parts of the city that I'd never go to otherwise, but the food was different and great and we learned so much about what it's like to live in Ho Chi Minh City.

The food was awesome as well. Instead of eating food that I'd had previously at Vietnamese restaurants in the states they showed us many uniquely Vietnamese dishes I was unaware of. You will definitely be full when the night is done. Some of the dishes we had were crab claws, a soup (that was not pho), okra, goat, frogs, clams, coconut dessert, beer, and so much more.

Everyone should participate in an XO tour. Riding on the back of the motorbike made it a complete Vietnamese experience. I loved it.

Evening foodie fun - Great authentic food experience while being ridden around by lovely Vietnamese girl on a scooter meet up with a group to share the experience. Felt totally safe and enjoyed all they had to offer visiting 5 districts including china town and new districts with seafood, meats and vegetables at various locations. Everyone should do this tour.

XO Foodie Motorbike Tour - Awesome - The Foodie Motorbike tour was one of the highlights of our visit to Ho Chi Minh City - the variety of food was incredible, but getting to experience the city on the back of a motorbike was something we will never forget. Thnaks to our 2 great driver/tour guides - Yen and Phuoc - thanks girls - absolutely amazing.

Excellent women - A perfect introduction to Vietnamese people and culture. Our scooter guides were so friendly , chatty and helpful and the tour leader held it all together with interesting presentations and just the right touch of humour.
We enjoyed the foodie tour so much that we booked the sights tour the next morning.
Well done and thank you XO tours.

Regards David

Absolute must in Vietnam - On the first day of my tour in HCMC i was told if I have a spare night I should do the foodies tour through XO Tours.

I'm so glad I did. Riding on the back of a vespor, being explained about everything I was seeing was simply outstanding. To top it off, my driver was even my own personal cook.

The drivers are all female, excellent in English and extremely good drivers. Cannot recommend highly enough. 4 1/2 hours of highlights never to be forgotten.

Oh, and don't forget to try the Balut....as they say, when in Vietnam, do as the Vietnamese.

Great way to see the city - I did the Foodie tour and greatly enjoyed it. The stops are all very interesting and you do have the ability to try foods and see places that you would probably not try normally. The tour leader, Tai, was very entertaining and organized. My driver was very sweet. I was on the tour by myself and my driver helped me to feel part of the group. It was also very fun whizzing through the streets of HCMC! The drivers help with some of the dishes like removing the flesh from the crabs and cooking the barbecue items.

Recommended dishes: The clams in District 4, goat's breast at the barbecue place.
Tips: don't put much/any of the chili sauce into the Bun Mam at the beginning of the tour. The soup is delicious but the sauce is very hot. Also, being able to use chopsticks is very helpful.

Lots of fun, great way to spend a few hours - I did the day tour. Had lots of fun on the bike. The tour guides are very friendly with great English speaking skills. They can give you lots of recommendations as well. Great way to get an overview of the city, find the places you want to spend longer in and go there on your own.

The tour guides also take photos of you and email them to you (no extra charge) which is really nice unlike other tours.

If you only have a day or two in Saigon, recommend this for a few hours.

An absolute must-do in Saigon - There is a reason why these amazing women got over a thousand "excellent" reviews on tripadvisor: they are that good. They speak very good English, have a wonderful sense of humor, are safe drivers, and know how to show you interesting aspects of the life of the city. We got to see parts of town we wouldn't have ventured to by ourselves, and at all time more people from the team where with us to keep things very safe. And, last but not least, the tour is great fun!

The Original Bike Tour Group & The Best - If you only do one activity in Ho Chi Minh City then this activity to do.

XO Tours was the highlight of my holiday, it was a fantastic night and provided a great way to see the city.

I did this activity with my girlfriend and we both loved the whole experience. The girls are very safe drivers, great fun and very informative. Our drivers were Ning and Hong and I do recommend asking for them when you make your booking they are awesome girls.

This is an affordable experience with memories that will last a life time.

Authentic way to see Saigon! - From the ladies to the motorbikes, this is truly one of the best ways to experience Saigon. The girls are so friendly, and it's awesome to be able to communicate well with young Vietnamese people about their culture and their city. We saw a lot of the city that we would have otherwise not seen, and were given local drinks and fruits along the way! Loved the tour and had a great time!

Epic! - Went with 3 of my good bros (all just graduated college) on this and we had a great time! Food was great. Drinks were great. Ladies were great. Tour guide was great. Would be in top 3 things I recommend to anyone traveling to Saigon!

Do it! - We had so much fun on this tour and it was the highlight of our stay in Saigon. So glad we booked this tour. A great way to see a huge city. Saw and visited many areas we never would have made it to. Our drivers were fantastic!!! The food, the scenes and the guides made it a tour to remember.
Great experience! - Excellent fun, covering 4 food destinations as well as some other lesser-known highlights. Very safe, very friendly and very tasty stuff!

Amazing! - I went on the foodie tour in May 2014 and Iit was brilliant. I was picked up by my driver from my hostel and then taken to the first restaurant for the evening where I met the rest of the group for the evening and our guide. Not only did we eat so much delicious food, but we were also taken around to see the different parts of the city, for instance driving over the river at night and the China town market. I don't really like seafood, and they were really accommodating and my guide arranged for other options for me. My driver and guide were both wonderful, they took pictures throughout the night and emailed them to me which was nice. It was a great way to spend the evening and learn more about the city, food and culture!
Fabulous!! - Our drivers were honorable. Food was tasty. The ride was superb. The thrill was out of this world! What else can I say??

Absolutely hilarious! - An experience I will never forget thank you so much to xo tours for looking after me and my partner and especially Damn my driver who was amazing.
This is one tour everyone should take when in Saigon.
I was a bit scared of being on the back of a bike as I don't like them but am so glad I did it. Dam my driver was amazing and made me feel very relaxed almost instantly and I trusted her completely, I made the mistake of telling her this as she then said do you want to go faster and on saying yes she put her foot down and jokingly told me it was her first day as a driver she was laughing when I screamed at her. The whole trip was so much fun with her.
My partner forgot to tell them when he booked that I didn't eat meat and so the first food stop I was given a beef dish but they couldn't do enough for me to put this right as soon as they were aware of it.
An the tour operator was always on his guard to make sure you were safe and ok he even carried a bottle of sanitiser and was right behind you when you came out of the toilets to clean your hands. The whole tour was perfectly planned and your safety and your experience were their number one priority. Thank you so much for an experience both myself and my partner will never forget.
You must try this you will regret it if you don't like you get to see a lot of Saigon.
One of the coolest nights of our vacation - It was well worth the cash. I only wish it had lasted longer! The drivers were very safe amid the crazy Saigon traffic!

Highlight of the trip - We just finished our foodie tour. We had cancelled as I was afraid to ride on the bikes. But then I got my nerve back, and we signed up at the last minute. The food was fantastic, so many different flavors. Delicious seafood - crab, clams, scallops. Goat. Frog. Taste as you like, no pressure to try if you are not interested. Vegetarian options. Our two guides, Tam and Tien were great. We felt safe at all times, and the ride was exhilarating. The conversation was stimulating. A great look into Vietnam culture if you care to get to know the girls. Han Gap Lai. Thanks, XO.

Don't miss this opportunity - Don't listen to advice to stay way from bikes in Vietnam. Do it with these experienced and safe rider gals and you will be so glad you got to experience the action up real close! We did the morning tour of 2.5hrs While the attractions you visit are all interesting and great to see, the highlight was definitely just sitting on the back of that bike in the middle of the chaos that is Saigon! Loved every minute. The added security of two male guides to follow behind and also assist with information was great. The girls were all informative too (4 in our party). Really great value.

The ultimate progressive dinner, don't miss this! - We had the most amazing adventure whizzing through the back streets of Ho Chi Min City and through various districts to taste authentic Vietnamese cuisine. There were five stops, with three stops for delicious food along the way. By the end of the tour we felt stuffed to the gills! The tour manager Tai was very friendly, helpful and welcoming. The girls who drove us around were particularly lovely, chatty and warm. On the tour we met a small group of other tourists, such as ourselves and that made for great conversation. It was so much fun riding on the back of a motorbike and also a great relief from the heat as the wind in our face cooled us down as we drove around! Whoever dreamt this up has amazing creativity. Just do it, it is great!

Superb - We went on The Foodie Tour.

This was an excellent tour, probably the highlight of our visit to HCMC.

The women drivers were friendly, pleasant. It was nice to talk with them re their lives in VN.

The tour organizers were extremely accommodating re food restrictions in our group (one vegetarian, one person no pork).

We tried Hue soup, BBQ goat, squid, prawns, various fruit, clams, shrimp, duck embryo, frog and a coconut dessert.

Emails were answered promptly.

Group pics were emailed within 48 hours. Pics were excellent, especially considering night tour.

Highly recommend!!

Brilliant! - Having seen the traffic in HCMC, I was initially hesitant to conduct a tour on the back of a motorbike. I must say though, it truly is the best way to see HCMC. Our tour guides, Khanh & Tien, were safe, extremely informative and put simply, wonderful hosts. They took us to places most tourists wouldn't think of going. They shared many key facts about the history of HCMC, which I loved.

XO Tours were clearly one of my key highlights of my two week trip to Vietnam. I look forward to going back to conduct other tours with them!

Night is the best - Went on night trip. Absolutely fantastic. Started off in the rain. Then start with noodle soup, goat and okra, frog, duck eggs. It was optional to try all on offer, but why live on Macdonalds. Won chopstick challenge. Felt safe at all times and I'm classed in Australia as a senior

Our best time in Vietnam - We booked this tour a few months before coming to Ho Chi Minh city after reading so many wonderful reviews on Trip Advisor. My friend and me were not disappointed. It was a lovely night to disvover city and tasted excellent food organized by XO tours . Our tour guides are wonderfully friendly, extremely knowledgeable, and very experience driven that made all our worries disappear. I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking for a scooter tours in Vietnam !

Charming XO ladies in charming Saigon - Riding a motorbike around Ho Chi Minh City with these charming ladies in their traditional dresses is the best way to see Saigon!
I am not new to this city but it was my first time to try XO Tours (I did the 2.5-hour morning tour) with my sister and even if I've seen some of the sites before, I loved the tour. There were some secrets of the city that I still got to discover and Saigon became more exciting because of this tour.

I loved it that they gave a balanced tour -- some of the most popular tourist points, a temple, a very local bustling market (and Vietnamese desert sampler which was perfect for a hot day!) a couple of taken-for-granted spots which turned out to be very interesting!

I tried the bike tour from another company before but I should say XO is much better. Although the other company used nice old Vespas (which honestly created noise pollution!), our XO tour drivers were more organized and and all the drivers in the group spoke English well and they were just lovely; so it was always a good feeling to ride with them. Our drivers gave us interesting facts about the city's culture and people while on the motorbike.(The other company only had the tour guide speaking English, the drivers didn't).

Anyway, I will for sure try their foodie tour next time, when I have a chance to tour Saigon next time! I love Vietnamese food!

A must-do!! - We first did the morning sightseeing tour and we were so impressed. It was a wonderful way to see Saigon and the girls were professional and fun. We didn't know if it could be beat. Well it was. The nighttime foodie tour was amazing!! To be in the crazy nighttime traffic is a true experience. Never for a moment were we worried about our safety. Then came the food and more food and still more delicious food. This was a perfect way to end our time in Saigon.

The Best Way to See Saigon! - With only 1 full day to see the sights of Saigon & daunted by the size & motorbike mayhem, booking not 1 but 2 XO tours proved to be the perfect solution! These wonderfully smart, savvy, funny girls showed us both places of historical & cultural interest in a most entertaining fashion that made you almost forget the heat & forgive the sudden torrential downpour. My husband & I were made to feel very welcome & we were quickly at ease with the girls riding skills. A truly memorable experience! Thankyou Khanh & the rest of the girls - it was a privilege to meet you all!

Great Tour - We did the XO Foodie tour the first night we landed in HCMC. It was a blast! Very fun to be in the midst of the crazy motorcycle traffic and see many of the districts in the city outside of just the tourist areas. The girls were great drivers, very safe and confident and a TON of fun. We enjoyed the unique food and the instructions on how to eat it properly. Surprisingly the duck embryo eggs were extremely tasty, recommend giving them a try.
Booking the tour was easy, great communication from the company, and the girls showed up at our hotel right on time. All-in-all, a fantastic experience and highly recommended.

amazing girls that make you feel at ease - I have to say I was a little worried about booking this tour mainly due to be being on the back of a moped. I need not have worried, the girls were wonderful, Binh my driver was great and our first destination was within 5 minutes of the hotel which helped us get use to bikes. The girls own the bikes themselves so believe me they are not going to take any risks.

The food was wonderful may different options, especially strange things such as duck embros and frogs but you are never made to eat any of these you are just given the option try if you want, we did a couple see the picture below, frog tastes just like chicken. We don't eat any seafood or fish but this was accommodated so well by Kang the tour leader that other dishes just appeared for us as the seafood came. We were never made to feel like we were a bother at all and they all genuinely sought to ensure we had a great time.

If you are going to Ho Chi Minh City I cannot recommend this enough it also gives you some history of the city and local life not just food.

Had a blast - Our friends Tim & Kath told us about this attraction and said whatever you do in Vietnam make sure you do this one. They thought it was the highlight of their previous trip to Vietnam. So we did on the 2nd night (15th May) upon arrival in Ho Chi min City. We had an absolute ball. Very well organised and fun fun all the way. Our accommodation was outside the boundaries that they normally pick you up (Hotel) s it was arranged to meet our motorbike drivers at The Opera House in City Central (Zone 1). Worked like clockwork. Over a period of 5 hrs we were taken all over the city to various districts stopping periodically to sample various foods including BBQ Goat, Frog, chicken, finishing with a duck embrio egg if you were game (of course I tried the lot). Mix that with some games and great company (we had Patrick from the US that shared most meals with us) the night was a blast. Sitting on the back of the motorbike was no trouble for someone who has had very limited exposure - in fact there was a couple of times I was able to do some video whilst in transit. The girls (drivers) were fantastic - making sure our experience was a memorable one. Talked to us continually on the motorbike pointing out various things of interest along the way and at the same time getting feedback about ourselves and what we were doing in Vietnam. XO Tours also provided security persons who made sure we weren't hastled at stops and oversaw proceedings (riding) along the way. Was a great way to kick off our holiday.Would not hesitate to recommend this company. There are other Foodie Tours available with different companies but from what we experienced I would be confident in saying you would struggle to find any better than this one. Excellent value for money - only US$144 for the 2 of us (option to pay ahead of time or on the night which we did).

Great Food Tour - We went on the foodie tour on 5/16 and we had a great time. The staff was very friendly and professional and they spoke English extremely well. The different sites they brought us to were all interesting and unique. We enjoyed the food selections they provided a great deal. It was also fun to ride on the back of a motorcycle, which was a new experience for us.

Tai, the tour manager, as well as both of our drivers, were also knowledgeable about cultural issues that went beyond just the food, which we found quite interesting as well. It was a great introduction to the city because we were able to see several districts beyond district 1 where most tourist attractions are located.

All in all, it was a great experience and we would recommend it to anyone interested in Vietnamese food and culture.

Fantastic Tour "Sights" - We went for Sights tours, it was fantastic.
Before a trip I have doubts about safety, but girls are great drivers, who were very careful in briefing you on the bike before you got on.
It was super fun to see all interesting places of Saigon on a motorbike with best girls ever :).
Most important our guide was funny, knowledgeable, and told us many fascinating stories.

Don't hesitate! Just do it! - I never thought in my wildest dreams that I would enjoy zipping around Ho Chi Minh city after dark in the back of the scooter! It was such a fun adventure! The girls and the 2 male minders are so professional you won't want for anything. Houng #2 was my guide/ driver and she was beyond excellent. But to be fair so was Tam and I guess everyone in the group. We did the Foodie tour and hubby who is not too adventurous with exotic food ate everything! My advice go for it and trust your driver. They know what they are doing and they will look after you. Just enjoy!

Brilliant!! Loved it!! - A true highlight of our time in Vietnam and every bit as great as the other reviews suggest! The girls were fantastic and took us to some spots we would never have been able to find on our own...would recommend it again and again :)

Fantastic Tour - Went for the tour on our second day, and it was well worth every cent. Understanding Vietnam is not just about staying in the popular touristy areas, but also seeing how the locals go about their daily life's. My group did the foodie tour that lasted 4 1/2 hrs. Bringing us to areas such as Chinatown, District 4, trying the Balut for the 1st time. The tour guide was fantastic, and so were the girls on the bikes. We were just traveling and traveling, and talking and talking....it was just like a personal tour guide for that 4 1/2 hours. Ask as many questions about Vietnam and they will be able to answer you. My motorbike rider's name was Ngam or Ngern, sorry cant remember the exact spelling, but she was a very well spoken friendly girl. I was actually very apprehensive as the traffic in HCM was just so busy, but she gladly took those afraid away with her chit chat as well as her confident biking skills. The tour is on the high side, but definitely worth every single cent. Thank you XO Tours!

Best experience in Ho Chi Minh - We went on the Foodie tour and were extremely impressed with the whole experience. We were a bit apprehensive about riding on the back of scooters in this manic city but we were completely put at ease by our amazing drivers. The food was brilliant and we loved being able to witness other areas of Saigon that we otherwise would have missed out on. All the staff on the trip were extremely friendly and informative and we had a really good laugh with them- especially over the 'chopstick challenge' which was brilliant. We would recommend this trip very highly and a few weeks on we still find ourselves reminiscing over what brilliant fun it was. This trip is definitely a must!

I loved this tour! - I did the evening foodie tour and it was a definite highlight of my whole trip to Vietnam! It was at the end of my first full day in Vietnam and weeks later, i still remember it fondly!

All the other reviews state it--good, interesting foods at real places (all Vietnamese people), including adventurous foods like goat, frog, and balut!

My guide, Phuoc, was WONDERFUL. She was a great driver, a really smart girl, a fantastic conversationalist, knew everything about Saigon, and was really really fun! We totally bonded and chatted most of the 4.5 hours. She even helped me book a tour for the next day on my way home to the hotel.

Phuoc is a delightful guide, as were several of the others, including the trip leader, Khanh Pham.

I love XO tours!!! I will recommend this to everyone I know who visits Vietnam!

Wow, what a ride! - The best introduction to Ho Chi Minh city I could have imagined for this first time visitor. The Saigon foodie tour is four hours of exhilarating riding through several districts of the city on the back of a vesper; each scooter driven by a friendly lady from the XO team. From the tourist District 1 to the mayhem of Chinatown, our bikes weaved through alleys and sped down streets stopping off at local street vendors and restaurants to enjoy delicacies including traditional beef pho and noodles to clams, chili crab, frogs legs, BBQ shrimp, quail and even the infamous Vietnamese 'blue egg'. From the time I booked here in Australia before I left to being dropped back at my hotel by Anne after the tour, the service was excellent. Photos taken by our tour leader during the trip were emailed a few days later as promised - a nice touch. Good security, good company (there were 9 people on my tour with one driver each plus fabulous tour leader Anh and two security guys) and such great food, it's a tour that deserves its high praise and a must do when visiting this exciting and diverse part of Vietnam.

Great way to kickstart your visit of HCM city - We arrived in HCM city that afternoon and went on the night time Foodie tour for that evening. We met two lovely girls ( our drivers ) at the lobby and after some introductions and safety instructions, off we went on our 1st stop where we met the rest of our group for that evening that included 6 other people. It was our first time riding a motorbike and my wife was initially apprehensive about the idea but after a few minutes of riding with her driver she got into it and had a really fun time. Our group also included a couple of guys ( our bodyguards ) that provided logistical support and the owner, Mr. Tung who was our guide for that evening. The tour was about 4.5 hours where we rode to several districts of the city and made about 5 food stops along the way. Very interesting and tasty stops with Mr, Tung providing insight into the area and the food we were having. Don't worry about the food, they will accommodate you if you're not into seafood or if you're a vegetarian. The girls (drivers) are all charming, and spoke English very well. Riding with them around the HCM city on a motorbike was a fun experience and a great way to kick start our visit to HCM city. We felt safe the whole time and thorough enjoyed it. We would definitely do it again .

What an AWESOME way to see the REAL Saigon! - I booked 2 private tours as we were on our Honeymoon! OH MY I am so glad we did this!!! What an awesome experience...

First we went on a sightseeing tour... We got to see a bunch of amazing places as well learn SO many interesting facts that you would never learn on your own...

Next day we went on a food tour... again amazing and incredibly TASTY and SO much fun! (oh my god i ate frog!!!!)

Would do both tours again in a heartbeat...

Tai (Tourguide) is SO well spoken and very educated in all things Saigon - he made everything interesting... All the girls that drove us around were so sweet, fun, helpful and most importantly VERY safe drivers... I am amazed that I felt safe on a scooter in one of the most crazy traffic places I have ever seen in my life...

You have to do 2 tours and you wont regret it! Money well spent - so fun and educational at the same time... There was not a dull moment!

Highlight of our Trip! - We did the Saigon by Night tour and it was AWESOME! The girls picked us up on their motorbikes and we took off into the traffic. It is one thing to cross the street in HCMC, or watch the motorbikes and traffic, but it is another thing to be IN the traffic on a motorbike! I think that it is the true HCMC experience. I was a little nervous at first, but the driver put me at ease right away, she was so safe and took turns with care. It was so amazing to see the different areas of the city and we talked the whole time. She told me about her life, work, and little tidbits about where we were going and what we were seeing. We stopped at a few places for street food and it was nice to take a break to stop and talk.

The end of the tour was the real highlight.... I don't want to ruin the surprise (not sure if other TA reviewers did already) but it was so nice. At the end of our tour, I had tears in my eyes, it was such a special experience and the girls were just amazing!

Please don't miss out on this one of a kind experience!

Felt the Fear, but did it anyway - We were unable to do the Foody Tour, but XO put a good afternoon one together for us. My wife isn't the best on bikes let alone a scooter, and after seeing the traffic in Ho Chi Minh she was a bit nervous. Khanh and Ngan really put us at ease, I'm not the smallest person and that did not effect them at all. They were a wealth of knowledge and we got a chance to have a real taste of Vietnam, so thanks to them both. We had a great time, the traffic was mind blowing and I'm not sure if I will get her on a scooter again, but it was an experience not to be missed and our two guides were experts on their country, their culture and awesome riders. We were able to try a few things I believe we would have missed if we hadn't done this tour.

Had a ball

Excellent Sights and Night tours - My first morning in Saigon I did the sights tour and quickly signed up for the Night tour the following day. Sights was a great overview and start of a trip, and the Night tour takes you out to some of the other districts which is really interesting to see. The tour guides and drivers were fantastic. Would highly recommend this to anyone.

You don't know what you're missing until..... - We joined the evening food tour. Two beautiful young Vietnamese girls dressed in traditional Vietnamese dress in scouters came to our hotel to pick my wife and I up. After we put on a helmet, saddle up and off we go. I have never ridden on the back of a scouters before. Ho Chi Ming city is a city of scouts, they have more scouts than population. We rode in a sea of ​​scouts. Actually, it makes you feel safer than riding amount speeding cars. You really have to experience this to understand the thrill of it. According to the driver, their safety record is exemplary. We were taken to an alley first where all the tour groups (from different hotels) were assembled together. We had some Vietnamese noodles first before we set off to the next food stall. We were taken through a number of districts and each one has its character. The food variety is good. It's not gourmet food but tasty and they are all local stuff that local people eat every day. It was a 5 hour tour, well worth the money and gave you an unforgettable experience. The tour guide / driver was a university student, spoke excellent English. The service was very good too, you don't have to do anything but to put food into your month, they do all the rest. If you visit HCM city, you should try this, highly recommended.

Awesome Experience!! - My husband and I did a combo of site seeing and shopping and we absolutely loved it! The guides were so nice, spoke great English and were an all around blast. We visited so many different areas and it was a wonderful experience! My husband also hired them to get our tour on video which will be an awesome reminder of our time there (especially getting caught in rush hour on the motor bikes)! This is an absolute MUST if you are visiting Saigon! They tailor your experience specifically to what you are looking for. Thanks again!

Wonderful tour, engaging guides - We only had one night in Saigon, and we were both so glad we were able to make the street food tour. The drivers and guides are fun, informed, curious and engaging. We had good conversation and a perspective of the city and what it is like to live there as well as sample some of the wonderful food. Thoroughly enjoyable, thanks guys from Paula and Jason

The highlight of my trip to HCMC - I have to say that this was an amazing experience. At first I was a little concerned at the price, but after doing the tour, I would have paid more. My friend and I were picked up at our hotel by two lovely guides and taken to our first location where we met the rest of our group and had a fantastic soup and a brief introduction to the program by tour leader Tai. I was so lucky to have Tam as my tour guide. She was HILARIOUS and told me all sorts of interesting things about HCMC and Vietnam and the different kinds of food we were eating. She was knowledgeable and professional. All of the other guides were really great to speak to and you can tell they are all actually friends outside of XO.

It was fantastic to see other districts outside of district 1 (the tourist district) and eat some truly delicious food. The food was really fantastic--I got to try things I never would have had on my own and am glad I did. Everywhere we went the restaurant staff seemed really welcoming, which showed that the XO group had done their research and built relationships---it is not easy to have a group of 14 people come into your place all at once, when you are a small, local business.

I feel like I have a far better sense of HCMC because of this tour and talking to Tam than I would have if I had just stuck to the basic tourist routes. My only regret is that I didn't do more tours with them! Highly recommend this trip. They accommodate for food allergies and preferences with ease and have bigger helmets for those of us with a bit larger noggin.
Great Way To See Saigon - Great time on the back of the bikes. The girls were awesome and we tried all types of different food. Must do and talk as much as you can as it will add to the experience!

Absolutely awesome - This was one of our highlights for Vietnam. We did the Foodie night tour. The girls we had as our drivers were fantastic. The tour was well run and we enjoyed all of the stops. We paid an extra $30 to have our night recorded on video, well worth the money. Highly recommended tour.

Amazing tour of Saigon! - We had an incredible time with XO tours: the girls are so friendly and really tell you a lot about the culture in Vietnam and Saigon. We felt safe at all times on the motorbike with them.

The food was incredible and we went to places we never would have clicked without the tour.

It was truly brilliant. I would highly recommend to anyone!

Excellent options for a weekend trip - I was in Ho Chi Minh City just for a weekend, and did both The Sights & The Foodie trips during that time. Both are brilliant options if you're only in town for a short time, as you can whizz around the sights much more quickly!

The Sights tour went to the Notre Dame cathedral, Central Post Office, Reunification Palace & Chua Ba Thien Hau pagoda. You also drive through Chinatown & a local market, along with swinging past places where some of the famous war pictures were taken (including a stunning memorial to the first self-immolating monk). You get a chance to go into all of the attractions other than the Reuinification Palace. You are driven around by a girl who will be able to give you information on the way around, plus there's also a tour guide who travels along with you & gives more detailed information at the stops. Overall, a great option to tick off the major sights in the course of a morning & get your bearings around town.

I then did the Foodies tour in the evening - this went for 5 hours so actually quite good value for money. You stop for 3 meals on the way around, so don't have a big lunch! There's also 2 stops where the trip guide will talk you through the district you're in as a bit of a break in between meals. Interesting choices as well, they don't take you for the usual such as pho, spring rolls etc etc. Instead for some different food such as BBQ goat, seafood & a different noodle dish which I can't remember the name of for the life of me! The crispy frog is optional :) Also, beers are included in the 2nd & 3rd restaurants so make the most of your money on the way around!

A must in the first couple of days - Girls are fantastic, speak great English, very knowledgable great riders through the city and just a great way to see everything. We did this on our final day and should of done in our first couple of days there. Would highly recommend this tour well worth the money.

Most fun I had with my Dong in Vietnam. - Everyone in our group on 7 loved this experience. Even the few that were disenchanted of riding on the back of the scooter.

The Iceberg Principle states that the ice that is visible is only 10% of the actual berg... the rest is underwater. When visiting HCMC it is easy to stay in District 1 and only see the visible 10%... XO Tours will take through the rest of the 'iceberg' on a scooter.

I doubled the weight/size of my tour guide driver, and she had no problems speeding us around the city and maneuvering us through the markets.

Finally, the food was amazing.

If you only do one thing in Ho Chi Minh - then the Foodie night tour is it! You get picked up by friendly English speaking girls. The ride on the moped feels safe. The girls are so funny, the conversation is easy going and they are all about showing you a good time! They take you to many different places through all the districts of Ho Chi Minh, these are places you will never visit on your own. The food is delicious and they will encourage (but never force) you to try new foods you'd never eat on your own. Beers are free flowing, the conversation is good, I cannot recommend this tour enough!

A Must-Do Experience!! - My husband was very apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter however after a very short amount of time he felt relaxed and safe with a driver a third of his weight...
We enjoyed a variety of food and experienced areas of Saigon and food we would otherwise have never ventured to.
We were in a group of 9 people a lot were single travelers.
We were very impressed by our "body guards ( (men that followed our tour)we felt safe the whole time and were never approached by locals... The women drivers are just wonderful and I am sorry I can't remember our drivers name... I think Nguyen and Nu.. Sorry if wrong
But Anh in charge of our group...Well done you are an asset to this business...

Saigon by night - immerse yourself in HCMC! - Went on this with a group of 6 friends, was such a fun time I couldn't stop laughing and smiling. We all enjoyed ourselves, Thoung and the rest of the girls were fantastic, shared many interesting facts, very funny and likable. Street food was great even for vegetarians like me :) HCMC is such a city of contrasts and the back of a scooter is the best way to see it in my opinion.

Wonderful screw - I did the Saigon by Night tour as I was traveling by myself and wanted to experience the city on a motorbike but would never dare to get on one myself! I loved the energetic enthusiastic guides who were incredibly welcoming and it was very interesting to see the districts that I hadn't been able to access on foot. This is a great way to see Ho Chi Minh and have a positive experience with locals learning about Vietnamese culture in the city. Lovely ladies!

fantastic tour, well worth your time! - My partner and I (we are mid 20's) chose the foodie tour, which we thoroughly enjoyed! The tour guides were friendly and informative and it was great to meet other tourists within the group. It was an excellent opportunity to see districts of Ho Chi Minh which we would otherwise probably have missed! Food was delicious!

To do before anything else in Saigon - Did the night foodie tour on my 1st night in the city. All of the girls were very knowledgeable and spoke pretty good English. I felt at ease on the bake of the bike as we sped through the traffic, as my guide was extremely cautious at times while zipping across the city. The food was abundant and varied, with beer flowing freely. I'd recommend this tour as an introduction to the city and it's fantastic food. I just wish I'd noted down the names of the dishes for future reference...

See and Understand Ho Chi Minh in a Nutshell - We joined the morning city tour and it was an awesome way to get acquainted with Saigon's culture. We were picked up in our hotel on time and the motorcycle ride wasn't scary at all. The head tour guide was a great storyteller and spoke English really well. As for the XO ladies, they were very friendly and would really make sure that you're comfortable while cruising along Saigon's crazy traffic in the middle of the intense daytime heat (so make sure to wear sunblock, and don't forget to bring sunnies!). It's the coolest history class I've participated, that's for sure!

One of a kind experience! - Wow! Where do I begin! After being very very nervous about riding around through Ho Chi Minh City I was soon put at ease by my driver. My partner and I did the Saigon by night which was a great way to see the city as we were pressed for time. The girls were awesome very professional and had great English but also had a great sense of humour, such a fun night was one of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam!

The fast, fun and safe way to know Saigon - I and my wife had only two days to know Ho Chi Min so we have decided to book sightseeing tour in the morning and foodie tour for late afternoon. We just love it! Those program were the best part of our two week trip to Indochina. The girls are friendly, can manage the motorbike in a safe way although the high and crazy traffic of Saigon and teach you about the history of this city. The foodie tour was excellent to be introduced to Vietnam cuisine in a funny way in many places were local eats. Frogs, goats, shrimps, eggs with baby duck inside were some of the menu we have experienced it. However, ir you have food restriction, no problem, just let the girls know.

Brilliant - Foodie tour - OMG, what an amazing experience. Guide Anh Pham is funny, knowledgeable and reported to all on the tour. We ate, we toured on the back of scooters, we ate some more. All female drivers (Trang and Yen), with very good English ensure you get safely around the city. We tasted a large variety of foods, including local delicacies and sampled a wine. A highly recommended tour, safe and enjoyable. A must do early in your stay in HCMC.

Fun motorbike tour, really nicely done - We took the daytime motorbike tour with Anh as our tour guide and two wonderful motorbike drivers. Everyone was really nice and easy going, they took us to multiple locations around Ho Chi Minh, gave us fruit to eat and sugar cane drinks during our ride. I'd recommend anyone visiting for the first time to ride on the motorbike tour and get them to video it. We learned history of the area and highlights within 3 hours. Definitely worth the time and money!

Brilliant fun on 2 wheels. - Being on the back of a bike in Ho Chi Minh City is an experience but doing it at night is crazy and the girls from XO Tours do it so well and make you feel completely safe and enthused. We did the night tour and had the best time we had in the city at night. We saw several districts and experienced how different they are. The ladies were sensational and very polite, fluent in English and very aware of westerners needs of what could or couldn't be eaten or drank. I don't think we were ever scared, probably the opposite, but we were in total amazement on how the city works. An amazing experience with a great company and people.

The only way to see Saigon - Excellent fun by my daughter and I who wanted to see that little bit more of the real Saigon. Yes the traffic is crazy but what a great time we had and never felt concerning. The girls were the most pleasant and genuine tour guides you could ever have. It felt like they were your new best friends by the way they interacted and they spoke excellent English throughout the entire trip on the bike. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone with a heartbeat. You've just got to do it. Do the night, the day or the foodie whatever you have time or money for. Thank you to The girls for a great time.

The best fun in Ho Chi Minh - I could not imagine being on a bike in the craziness of Ho Chi Minh traffic but I decide to do the "Sights Tour" with XO Tours. I had so much fun zipping around the city that I also booked their most popular "Foodie Tour". The girls are fantastic and bring to all the good sights and also take photos which then email on to you, Khanh was our tour leader and she was fantastic. The foodie tour is great fun.. There is so much food.. but time between stops as they take to you different districts which normally you wouldnt get to see. The girls are fantasic drivers and never for a moment did I feel unsafe. The food was amazing.. including goat, frog and of course the coconut surprise :) I cant recommend this tour enough.. not only a great way to see the city but heaps of fun.. thank you girls!!

This is number 1 for a reason - What a great way to experience Saigon. Our lovely ladies were enchanting, informative, polite and very friendly. Our family of four (including 2 teenage girls) had an absolute ball. This is truly the best way to immerse yourself in the traffic and get to see most of the tourist sites in 2 hours. I would do it again in a heartbeat. Don't miss the opportunity, book it now.

Tons of fun! - I was highly hesitant about going on the back of a bike in crazy Saigon traffic but decided to give it a try as the perfect way to see Saigon at night and hit the most number of districts for food. The ladies were excellent hosts, fluent in English and totally hospitable in every way. Can't say it wasn't scary at parts but I felt safer than in a cab in NY, Taipei and Shanghai. For both your and the ladies' safety, relax and don't fidget at the back. My top recommendation.

Not to be missed, highlight out Ho Chi Minh - My husband and I just enjoyed a Foodie tour with Xo. Our tour guides were lovely. They were very smart, sweet, and very professional.

The food tour started in a great way as our tour guide met us at our hotel lobby, promptly.

We were greeted with a kind smile which we loved about the Vietnamese people.

Our motorbikes were clean and before our adventure started we were giving a very short safety recap. Every need and concern that I had was met as I asked for a mask for the ride in the "congested" streets. My tour driver, gave me a clean and new mask and even helped me put it on. She also took my bags and put it on a safe place as she was always concerned about safety and my personal possession.

The first place they took us to served a delicious noodle soup. I won't even mention the name as I am sure I will misspell.

We then had more tours and a second food stop. Along the way we say their version of Chinatown and went through the narrow streets.

Final stop was at a really cool street vendor which served a delicious crab which several of the tour operators cracked for me. I didn't even get my hands dirty. They offered beer as much as we could drink. There was a delicious clam dish and a grilled quail. My husband tried the Balut egg. I was not so bold.

Overall they took us to several different parts of HCM…and though the food was good, the best part was my driver and the tour. Getting to know the real people while driving around town on a motorbike was thrilling…. I could feel apart of their world….in all it's craziness but also it's beauty. This was the best tour of our entire 2 weeks in Vietnam and we will not forget how lovely the people were….and also their sense of humor.

It's a great way to see HCM…..navigating through the narrow streets, seeing how the locals get from point a to b…and mostly to see the realness in it's people. A lovely tour…well worth it. We loved it so much we wanted to do it again…..

Must do HCMC experience - We did the foodie tour on our last night in Vietnam, after a recommendation from a friend. It was a fantastic way to end our trip, but it would have been an even better way to start.

It would be a great introduction to Vietnamese street food, as well as Ho Chi Minh City.

The xo girls are professional and enthusiastic, and are great tour guides for their city and food!

Must do! (Foodie Night Tour) - Well worth the money spent. Spent 4.5 hours cruising sitting behind on a scooter into various districts of Ho Chi Minh. The food was fantastic, tried dishes I've never had before and drank to get silly. We were stuffed by the end and the ladies who took us around were so nice and made sure we had a good time.
This is a must when in Ho Chi Minh.

Excellent Tour - I was a bit leary getting on a motor scooter at first but my driver was such a pleasure to ride with that any reservations faded quickly. I would recommend this tour to anyone. A+ job all around.

Live like a local for a few hours. - This has to be of the best experiences ever. After reading reviews of this company, we booked a tour and we're not sorry. So professional and so entertaining. The drivers called their foodie tour a feeding tour, and sure, the food is interesting, but the experience of being driven across Saigon, being entertained and informed by the ladies and looked after by the gentlemen was second to none. Do this tour people!

All the reviews are true! - We did the foodie tour on the evening we arrived in HCMC and the sights tour the next morning.
Both were terrific and the girls were all fabulous. They obviously love their work and are very informative on all aspects of Vietnamese life.
As mentioned elsewhere here the "foodie" tour was a bit pricey and Australians may want to note that it could be better described as an "authentic Vietnamese cuisine tour" as at home "foodie" is often associated with a creative gastronomic event.
With that said I would make both tours a"must do" in HCMC - Anh especially make the sights tour informative, poignant and moving.
The girls and guides are obviously highly trained and the leadership of the company is to be applauded for their understanding of how to exceed customer expectations.

A birthday I will never forget! - My amazing girlfriend arranged the "Foodie tour" for my birthday. It was an amazing evening and a birthday I will never forget!
XO Tours will hands down be the most professional and organized company we have encountered in SEAsia. The drivers are all very personable and fun and they all speak great English.
After my girlfriend had told them it was my birthday when booking, XO Tours took it upon themselves to organize a birthday cake(with my name on as well!) for no extra charge! If that's not the best customer service ever then I don't know what is!!
An absolute must do in HCMC!!!

Serves top billing! - XO tours really does reserve the top position on TripAdvisor and I would recommend anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh city to join in the fun of their evening tours.
Service and hospitality of the girls was exceptional, with excellent choices of places to eat authentic specialties and a brilliant way to see the city. This is a fun and exciting tour a little spirit of adventure required which will be justly rewarded by the great experience! I hope they decide to operate one in Hanoi too!:-)

Worth every cent! - We had such an amazing time on our XO Food Tour. After 5 minutes on the tour we knew that it was worth every cent. My driver Tam was a wealth of knowledge and we had a great time chatting away while we were driving along with Tam pointing out lots of things as we went. I am not used to scooters but Tam always made me feel safe amidst the chaos of HCMC. Our tour leader Thuong Pham gave us insightful information along the way. The meals were things we normally would never have tried but with the encouragement of our guides we gave (nearly) everything a try!

This was the most professionally run organisation we've seen in a long time!

I would highly recommend that everyone go on this tour, preferably early on in your stay so that you can try some of these things later on.

Great tour - I booked online a couple of days before doing the day touristy-type seeing the sights tour. Good communication and fast response online.
The tour itself was fantastic. Anh (sp? Sorry if I got it wrong!) was wonderful, very knowledgable and entertaining. The girls who drove us around were extremely safe and completely fearless! Can definitely recommend it.

Great fun & food - We joined the 'foodie' tour on our first night in HCMC. It was simply an amazing tour which started off with us being picked up at our hotel by the young and lovely girl tour guides dressed in traditional 'ao dai'. The girls were very professional and spoke fluently in English. They took care of us the full way and were very friendly and informative. Their driving manner was very good taking us safely from place to place for great food and sightseeing. We would have much difficulty in finding these locations in the various districts and may not have had gone by ourselves. In addition to the girls, the tour manager, Tai, and his team of 'body guards' also traveled with us throughout the tour, prearranging everything and keeping us safe. Tai gave us very detailed description on the places we visited and he was very humorous with his presentation. It was a fun four hours tour and I highly recommend it as a must do in HCMC.

Great Food and Fun - I would wholeheartedly recommend the foodie tour to anyone who is visiting HCM. My partner and I thoroughly enjoyed this. We were picked up from our hotel by two lovely girls in traditional garb. It was exhilarating riding through the traffic (it seemed safer on the back of a scooter than trying to cross the roads on foot!) The girls were very informative and great fun, explaining the food and show us how to eat it. The director of the group, Tai, was also very funny and informative. Best of all, the food was great!

Great way to experience Saigon - Tour was very well run - our drivers were prompt, friendly and safe. We also appreciated having a couple of guy employees at the various stops for safety. It really is a great way to explore the different districts of Saigon, some of which we will never have gone on our own. We ate at three different places - a noodle stall at an alleyway, BBQ at an outdoor local restaurant and seafood in District 4. You know you are eating where the locals eat when you sit on the short chairs and tables. In addition to stops for food, we also stopped at Chinatown and District to get a glimpse of the different aspects of living in Saigon.

The few areas that prevent me from giving this an excellent rating- whilst the BBQ and seafood restaurants were good, the noodle stall was rather ordinary. Also, it is rather pricey.

Having said that, we were glad that we did it. On hindsight, I would have brought a head scarf to wear under the helmet.

Just plain awesome!!!!!! - Don't visit HCM without booking this, if you don't admitly you will never know what you are missing but if you do you will have something to remember for the rest of your life! The best way to see and experience so much of HCM in such a short amount of time and complete FUN all the way. The tour guides are delightful and whizzing around the streets on a motorbike among the locals feels so right. The complete highlight of our trip. Just book it and experience for yourself.

Fun but pricey - We honestly really liked this trip which we did on our second day in Vietnam. It was great to sit on the back of a scooter and see parts of Saigon we wouldn't have found on our own. The girls were lovely and spoke good English. But having just returned home and paid our credit card bill I now realize that £45 per person was really a bit overpriced. I have read all the responses XO has given to other people's comments about the price and accept the high quality of the company and the tour. But we went on a couple of other tours in Vietnam which for us were just as much fun but nothing like this price. (eg I think a good cooking class is fun and informative about food and you get taken to local markets. These are generally about £10-£15 per person). I would not hesitate to recommend this company, but for people on a budget there are loads of other ways to have fun in Vietnam.

An experience not to be missed - We did the XO foodies tour - 12 of us in total. It would have to be one of the highlights of our holiday. 12 beautiful ladies in traditional Vietnamese attire took us on an adventure not to be missed. Very professional, well English spoken, elegant and interesting ladies who know how to show you good fun and keep your mind off the "traffic" on the tour. All the food we tasted was fantastic and we got to see parts of Ho Chi Minh that we probably wouldn't have seen otherwise. If you miss this - you are missing a very good part of HCM! 20 out of 10 rankings from me.

A Must-Try in HCMC - We did the "Sights" tour and it was excellent. The tour guide is fantastic in explaining the history of the attractions to us. Our riders were wonderful, very lovely and sweet. We felt very safe with them. Would definitely recommend them.

What FUN!! - We chose the XO tours based on the reviews on TA and we were not disappointed. Our drivers were so knowledgeable and really sweet. We thoroughly enjoyed the food especially the sea food which was so tasty. We got to see districts we will not have visited on our own. Very professional outfit and They even sent us photos via email.

What a great adventure - We did the XO tour last night in HCMC on the recommendation of a friend. It was excellent. Well organized. Safe. Friendly. And most of all fabulous food. Wouldn't miss this tour for anything. Highly recommend it.

Fantastic ride of a lifetime - We did a food tour in the evening with 4 other couples racing around HCM on little vespas with beautiful ladies dressed in traditional Vietnamese flowing dresses. All the guides we're very experienced and speak good English, and they were interested as well as interesting. Although the food and booze wasn't flowing, it was an ideal amount and we tasted some traditional dishes we wouldn't normally have the opportunity, so we really relished the experience.

What a great tour - We chose the XO tours for both the reviews & because we wanted a short tour, & we were not disappointed. The tour guide was very knowledgable & our drivers were wonderful.

Would definitely recommend them.

I will recommend them - We tried to book an XO tour but they were totally booked. They recommended a competitor' s tour which we took and thoroughly enjoyed. I would not have known their competitors even offered motorbike tours and I am very grateful they recommended them. To me it shows this company is really first rate. Thank you

GREAT FUN - We did the sight seeing and foodie tours on successive days. Both were great fun. The girls were informative, knowledgeable and funny. We visited and ate at places we would probably have missed if we didn't sign up for these trips. Highly enjoyable and thoroughly recommended.

Best tour in Vietnam - This tour is well organised and the tour guides are great. Our drivers Trang and Loan were great fun. Would recommend this trip to anyone visiting HCMC. A great way to see different districts ! I was scared at first but after about 15 minutes felt relaxed and enjoyed it tremendously. As a vegetarian I was well catered for and the tour guide went out of their way to make sure I was well fed!

Can't wait to do it again! - This was the equal best thing we did in Vietnam (with Bhaya Cruises and Le Vietnam Travel cycling tour being the other equal best) - and I can't wait to take my wife and daughter next time.

My son and I felt completely safe and thoroughly enjoyed the tour, the food and the drink. This is a really authentic way to experience HCMC and the awesome Vietnamese hospitality.

Highly recommended!

Outstanding Tour Worth Every Cent - This tour was brilliant. What a way to get around the city for 4-5 hours.
The girls were superb, very polite and genuine in conducting general conversation.
The food was awesomme.
These people are right up there for customer service and making this one of the most memorable tours you could ever do.
You wont be dissapointed!

Tour and Girls were AWESOME!! - If there's one thing you need to do in HCMC, this is it!! Best way to see the place and enjoy great food with the XO girls, a word of warning though - these girls are feeders trying to get you fat, they succeeded with me!!
Hoang (pronounced Heng, hopefully...) you were wonderful and made this night so much fun!

Geat way to experience everything outside the tourist zone of district 1.

Well done XO Guys and Girls!!

Best thing i did in Vietnam - Wow.... this tour was as good as all the reviews say if not even better.
This was the highlight of my 3 week trip to Vietnam.
Anh my driver was absolutely brilliant, she was so lovely and sweet and drove really carefully through the chaotic traffic, I felt really safe with her and it was so much fun chatting as we weave through the traffic between each stop..
There is so much food and many different weird and wonderful things to try and they cater for everyone's specific needs, and will make sure there's always a replacement dish if there's something you don't eat, nothings too much trouble.
All the girls are so lovely and speak excellent English and the group leader is fantastic, learning everyone's names (over 25 people) within the first 5 minutes and making the tour interesting and fun for the whole group.
Can't recommend this experience enough.

Excellent, Excellent, Excellent! - We had a great time! Everything is very professional. The tour guides are required to have good English skills. My tour guide knew how to keep a conversation going and allow it to flow. My partner and I were both very comfortable on the bikes, in the environments, etc. If you want to get out in that Ho Chi Minh traffic, hit some back streets for local foods, hang out with some very sweet accommodating people and forget life for a while....then this is it! Expensive, but all inclusive, and when you factor in the quality and all of their costs...it's money well spent. ;)

Great way to see the city - This was super fun! a great way to see the city and eat new stuff.
You don't have to eat the weird things they give you and there is plenty of normal food.
it really was a great way to see the city, culture, etc. Everyone spoke really good english! I highly recommend!

A Saigon Highlight - My wife convinced her sceptical parents to join us on the XO Food Tour.
(actually they weren't given a choice).
After a slightly nerve wracking start in the Ho Chi Min traffic my mother in law relaxed and we all had a fantastic evening.
(She was later heard to say "This has been the best experience of my life")
XO tours really do have things well organised and the young lady drivers were delightful company and attentive hosts at each location.
Apart from the obvious (Great Vietnamese food and fun on scooters) we also got to see several different Districts of Saigon.
Without the tour we probably would have only seen District 1 and not realised the variety.

This tour is simply a must do in my opinion!!

Simply Brilliant - My husband and I (mid-40s) did the "Foodie" tour after using tripadvisor to plan our trip. I haven't been on the back of a motorbike for many years and was a bit nervous about the traffic, but our tour guides were brilliant and we always felt safe.The food is sensational and the tour guides have outstanding English and a great sense of fun. Worth every cent - highly recommended.

A Fantastic Experience - We did the foodie tour on our first night in Saigon. What an experience! We were travelling with 3 children aged 11,12 and 14 and they loved it, although not all of them tried every delicacy! The drivers were friendly and competent drivers and no point did I feel in danger despite the Saigon traffic. Would recommend this to anyone, worth every penny.
