Must do! - Wow. What a great night. Really I can just echo all of the other reviews. We where a little nervous of the thought of traveling in the Saigon traffic but the girls were great. Safe and with great personalities. Ning, who was our tour leader, I thought was special however I am told by my 3 companions that they thought the same about each of their guides. We are all in our mid to late 50's but I can say from personal experience that if you are at all concerned that it may be a little risky/dangerous don't be. It will be a highlight of your tour if you go with the right spirit. We will certainly be back another time.

Excellent Tour - We did your foodie as part of our honeymoon round Vietnam. From the start, the communication with xo was first class. We were escorted round with Foo and Houng, they were excellent. Very friendly, and helpful and put you at ease on the back of a scooter. Very informative information provided. The food may not be to everyone's taste, but this isnt just a food trip, it really does give you a good view of so many different parts of Saigon. So pleased we did it. Thanks guys.

Must do activity in HCMC - I had the best time on this tour. Riding around the city was so much fun. My guide and driver was Miss Chi - a journalism and communication graduate who loves her job and is an excellent guide. she made me feel calm and confident in the mad rush of night time traffic in HCMC. The food was fantastic too!

DO THIS FIRST - This was one of the best tours that I took while in Vietnam. The ladies who ran the tour were very friendly, understood western humor and spoke the best English of the tour guides I had my whole trip.

We did the Saigon by Night Tour and it was a really good way to get to see the city. It was the last tour that we did but even this didn't mean I was looking at things I had seen before as the ladies rode us out to places that I hadn't gotten to.

Saigon traffic is something amazing in itself but I always felt the ladies had it totally under control. Even the fact that I am quite a bit heavier than my rider didn't make a difference. They are truly great riders.

The "Survival Guide" they gave me was very helpful and I can tell you was used the next day in the markets ;) and the key ring they gave me is now the one I have my car keys on at home.

I totally recommend this tour and suggest to people to make this your first tour. It will help you understand the city and get a feel for the place first.

A real MUST DO in Saigon! - Have been a bit slow to post this review (we were there early March) but a huge thanks to these guys for our sightseeing tour! My wife (who hates motorbikes and mopeds) my daughter and I could not have been in better hands whilst on the back of the mopeds, safety was never in any question during the tour but the girls do enjoys themselves and want to make sure the clients do too! Would highly recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to take tours too seriously but get to feel they have mingled with modern Vietnamese transportation. Thanks guys!

4.5hour foodie tour - A brilliant way to see HCMC at night and thankfully with out having to drive yourself. The girls are excellent safe drivers and spoke the best English we have encountered in SE Asia in the last 3 months. The food is also an experience with frog and duck egg embryo on the menu. We were also accompanied by 3 "body guards" to ensure everyone's safety.
Driving around HCMC by moped is a experience not to be missed and will take you to places you wouldn't go your self.
It looks comparatively expensive but worth every dollar.

A tour not to miss! - After reading a few reviews and looking at the video on their website we decided that this tour was worth looking into. The "Foodie" tour appealed to us the most as we like to try local dishes. I can only echo the reviews of everyone else here and say the tour was amazing and one of the real highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

They strike the perfect balance between being very professional and extremely good fun. My partner was nervous about going on the back of the scooter as she had never been on one before, this was forgotten within about 5 minutes of meeting the girls and being helped and reassured.

The girls not only managed to drive through insane traffic everywhere but also talk and explain about different sights and culture as you drove past them. Your guides stay with you throughout the night as you go from one great meal to another. They like to throw in a few surprises but you only have to eat what your comfortable with!

The atmosphere the tour created was just excellent and your left at the end of the night just wanting more. They even have their own photographer who takes pictures of the night and sets you up doing poses throughout the tour, they then send you the photos by e-mail later on.

Our only regret is we didn't book these guys for the city tour as well, If that's anything like the food tour then it would be a great way to see the city. If you have any doubts check their website, read their reviews and just book it as I cant recommend it enough!

EXCELLENT - Myself and three girlfriends did the shopping tour and it was great. We did it the first day in Ho Chi Minh to help us get a feel for the city and it was a great way to spend the first morning. We were picked up on time, we were taken places we would not have seen on our own and using motorbikes was a smooth and quick way to get around. The tailor was great and the end results were great. The drivers and teh two support riders were great - very friendly, extremely helpful and spoke excellent English. Even though we dawled in some places they were really pleasant. They provided plenty of water and an excellent coconut drink form a market stall. We had some photos emailed to us very promptly and will use them again, maybe for the night tour, when in Ho Chi Minh city again.

This tour is the best. - This tour is just fantastic, informative and lots of fun for all. Traveling as a family of four with 2 boys almost 15 and 13, I was slightly concerned about the prospect of them on the back of motorbikes weaving in and out in the Saigon traffic. I needed not be as the gorgeous Vietnamese girls that drove us from district to district to try different food in those areas were so very careful and drove very safely.
The different local food was fantastic. Despite trying to pace ourselves knowing we would be tasting so many dishes, we still filled up very quickly and were struggling to fit in the last dishes which I think were the best of all.

For those who are not very adventurous, there are a few 'foodie challenges' .....and you should try them as why do the tour if not to explore and experience their amazing food culture. Our boys to their credit tasted everything even though there were a couple of dishes even I baulked at trying...but did.
This is tour was definitely a highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Our boys and my husband and I were interviewed about our experience for a Japanese TV news piece during the course of the tour which seemed a little bizarre at the time but added another dimension to our interesting evening. Everyone on our tour had a fun and fascinating night. Highly recommended.

MUST DO THIS! - So, this is amazing! What a great way to see the city. You definitely have to do this. The three girls met us at the hotel and whisked us away on a great tour! Great food and great laughs. Such charming ladies, you have to see/experience the city this way!!!!!

I'm so glad we did this - I hesitated as I am the anxious type and have two teenagers to worry about. I am so glad we went for it because this was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We all absolutely loved it. After the first 30 seconds, even I managed to relax and enjoy the ride. Traffic is a bit chaotic, especially once we got into Cholon but as we were never going very fast, it never felt dangerous. We went on the Saigon highlights tour and saw and learned things we would not have seen or learned had we not had the tour. All in all an excellent thing to do in Saigon.
Two suggestions: we were given bottled water to drink but the were no seals and the bottles had been opened already. As travelers, I'm afraid we are somewhat conditioned not to drink from unsealed bottles and as I wasn't 100% sure of the source of the water, I didn't drink it even though I was hot and thirsty. I did thoroughly enjoy the sugar cane drink we received - it was a thrill to ride through Saigon with a delicious local drink in hand.
Another small suggestion for the founder: the logo could use with some updates. The profile of the XO driver is made to be kind of sexual and that isn't in keeping at all with the wholesome and happy spirit of the drivers and guides.

You have to do this! - I went on the XO Foodie tour with 3 friends. We were picked up at our hotel by 4 young ladies on their scooters. We were straight out into the peak hour traffic. After a bit of nervous apprehension we sat back and enjoyed the ride. It was so much fun! We joined the rest of the tour group and the guide, who entertained and educated us all night. We went to 4 different food spots, with a couple of other stops of interest. The food was awesome and there was a lot of it! My friend who is allergic to shellfish was given great alternatives. They gave her so much we got to share too. Our guide took photos which he emailed to me within 2 days. At the end of the night we were whizzed back through the quieter streets to our hotel. The girls were funny, clever and friendly. It was great to spend an evening with a group of locals and learn about their lives. We laughed a lot on this fantastic tour.

Best way to best food and sights - My wife and I did this tour on the first day we arrived in Saigon. After being ripped off by our cab driver and the aggressive sellers at the markets, our expectations weren't flying high.

Then these two girls on their bikes showed up and it transformed everything! The girls were super friendly, super chatty and full of enthusiasm.

The tour was extremely well organized and took us to places we wouldn't have been able to find ourselves.

Then there was the food. As described, we didn't get any Pho or Bahn Mi. Our favorite is the Bun Bo Huey (you need to get on this tour to find out what it is).

A must-do while in Saigon - My partner and I did the foodie tour as recommended by a friend. The girls riding the bikes are super friendly and very informative. The XO tour was the highlight of our time in Saigon!!

BEST TOUR EVER!!!! - Me and my partner did the foodie tour tonight and it was by far the most fun thing we have done in our whole trip around Vietnam!!! It was so amazing!!! The girls are awesome and the food is to just amazing!!!! So much fun! A MUST DO in Saigon!!!! Can't wait to do it next time
Fantastic tour OX tours! - One of the high lights of my trip to Vietnam! Fantastic tour with lots of amazing and different food and informative tour guides. Great introduction to Saigon.

Well Organized and Great Company - XO Foodie Tour Review - 03-12-14
Website: xotours.vn

The XO Foodie tour girls came to our hotel a bit early but we were ready for them. My wife and I will be attending the tour that night with 10 others in the group from the States, Australia, France and one more country.

The diminutive Vietnamese woman that would be having me as her pillion passenger probably weighed less than 100 pounds and me well over 200 pounds. Trang didn't seem to have any concerns, so we boarded the motorbikes and off we went to our first meeting point. I immediately noticed that Trang had an excellent command of her motorbike and understood Ho Chi Minh city traffic. If you can ride a motorbike in Ho Chi Minh City, you can drive a motorbike anywhere in the world. She gained my confidence immediately. Besides, the tour girls do not drive that fast, perhaps 40 kilometers per hour on the straight and faster roads.

Besides being a tour of different foods and food areas in and around Ho Chi Minh City, it's a cultural tour and tour of the different districts. From the poorest areas of the city to the upper middle and upper class District 7 and Phu My Hung, the tour provides one with a quick education of foods, classes, and culture. District 7 looks like any other affluent living and shopping area in the world.

The tour starts out with a stop and consumption of Bun Bo Hue, a spaghetti type cylindrical noodle served with beef or pork and broth cooked with the same. The condiments served with Bun Bo Hue can be numerous. The dish originated in the northern coastal city of Hue, where it is simply known as beef noodle soup. In addition to the noodles and beef, the soup will contain lemongrass, shrimp sauce and a sweetener like sugar to taste. Diners will also place all sorts of condiments into their bowls like squeezed lime juice (lemon) fresh cilantro, green onion, morning glory cabbage, mint, basil, coriander, chili, and more. To say this dish is popular is an understatement. It can be found all over Vietnam.

Losing my consciousness of districts quickly, the next stop found us at a large outside eating area with hundreds of tables and diners. On the menu this evening was Goat (Goat, pronounced; 'Yeh'), Squid (squid pronounced; muck), Grilled Frog with either skin on or off (I tried both), Grilled Shrimp (grilled shrimp), and Grilled okra (grilled okra). Grilled okra tends to put a lot of diners off the food as it can be sort of 'slimy'. The grilling takes care of that and the tofu sauce served with this made it quite tasty. At some point in this part of the tour we had (and tried) some high-octane countryside spirits purported to be 35% alcohol. Indeed, it was quite high. I was offered a second small cup but had to pass. Guys on this tour cannot place their arms around the XO Tour women, so I didn't want to lose my grasp of the support bar behind me.

For our last stop of the four hour tour, we went to District 4, perhaps the most dangerous district so we were told. Again, an open air restaurant and there was plenty more to eat and consider. What most of us did not consider eating was the balut, or duck embryo in this case. One of the guides tried her best to convince us to eat it, and a couple of bold Australian folks sipped some of the embryo liquid, which apparently tasted like 'chicken soup' according to them. But there was more to be had that evening.

A serving of grilled quail came out, something we could all eat and most of us tried it. There wasn't much quail on the little bones but what we ate was quite tasty, and we could order more. Next came the crab legs, and the XO women went to work breaking shells and giving us plenty to eat with dipping sauces. About the same time or before, we also had scallops topped with peanuts and onions on their own shells, and it was very tasty. Last, bowls of steamed clams cooked in lemongrass and ginger came out. (We were all getting quite full but weren't finished yet.)

Last we had a desert of fresh watermelon, guava, water apple slices, followed by a caramel flan type of desert. Quite frankly, I was quite full two or three dishes earlier but we were encouraged to eat and order more at no additional charge. It was all included in the price.

A couple weeks after we returned home, we got the link to download the video taken of my wife and me during the evening. They condense everything down to 10 minutes and well worth the extra money. It will also serve as a great memory of the trip. Thanks to all the staff at XO Tours!

Richard

A food tour out there! - Incredible night out! The girls, team and tour guide were fantastic: they made the tour special by reminding everyone's names, sharing tips on eating Vietnamese food, giving a snap shot of HCMC and its history, exploring a range of districts and being truly friendly. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone who would like to eat real Vietnamese food and have a fun night out seeing the city. Thank you to the team at XO - you have created a memorable night for us :)

So much food! - I did the foodie tour and had a great time. Make sure to go on an empty stomach! All of the food stops were really good and drinks were included. The drivers and the guide were all a lot of fun. They show you around the city a little bit too, which is enjoyable. Overall a great experience.

Fantastic! - This was certainly one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday! We had a private sightseeing tour which we enjoyed so much. The girls were absolutely fantastic, along with Tai, who magically appears ahead of you each time you arrive at a different location! I was a little nervous to begin with, but Hoang was a FANTASTIC driver and before long I was drinking strawberry sugarcane with one hand and hanging on with the other! They also took some photos of our trip which they kindly emailed as well. You really must do this, with XO Tours, if you are in HCMC, you won't regret it!

A must do - even if you are not a "foodie" - A definite must!! - Had a great tour (actually 2, the shopping and the food tour) both were exceptional. The guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and competent without being pushy. The food tour especially was a must do! Our driver ladies were beautiful, proficient and lovely company. The food was excellent and they catered for Laura's Mollusc allergy with ease and the alternate was equal to the scallop's specialty. Enjoyed meeting other people on the tour and one suggestion would be to change chairs during the meal to talk to others. Thanks to XO tours for a very enjoyable evening. (Heads up - take your Vietnamese motorcycle license with you!!

Best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh - We did the Foodie tour, which was loads of fun. The traffic in the city is full on, but we felt safe in the hands of the confident female guides we had. The tour leader made an effort to learn everyone's names and all were friendly. The food we ate was abundant, varied and tasty - cannot recommend highly enough.

The tour of Ho Chi Minh included in the Foodie evening was great, really felt we wouldn't have seen so much of it under our own steam. The guides also took photos throughout the evening and emailed them to us a few days later with a personal message; a really nice final touch.

Unforgettable! - This was an absolute highlight and one of the best things we did in Vietnam. It was so exhilarating riding on the mopeds. We did the foodie tour and it was fantastic! The guides (Hoang and Tam 2) were really funny and great company- I felt truly sad to say goodbye to them at the end. We felt safe at all times and would recommend this to anyone. Thanks for a brilliant and memorable experience we will never forget! Harriet and Tom

Fantastic Shopping Spree Tour - Monday 7 April we were picked up right on time for our Shopping Spree Tour. What a fantastic Tour, our expectations were surpassed. Everything we had asked for when we booked the tour online was met. To our surprise not only our two girls turned up but Tai along with them who guided us through everything that we had asked for. 1st stop was a Tailor where we selected our fabric, measured and made up for a very reasonable price. 1st fitting was the following evening and then picked up the cloths the following day. Everything fitted perfectly .
Tai,s knowledge of local pricing saved us many thousands of Dong. The girls were very knowledgable and filled us in on many locale places of interest.
We felt very comfortable on the bikes even though my husband is in his 70th year and me with a broken wrist. We would highly recommend this company to anyone. it was amazing.
Thankyou XO Tours you get a AAAA+++++ rating from us

Sharon Calderwood

Excellent introduction to Saigon - Had a great time weaving through the traffic and exploring the various districts of Saigon with the lovely XO Tour guides. Would recommend the Foodie Tour, the food was excellent and certainly different, didn't go home hungry! Yes the traffic is crazy but I felt I was in safe hands. The drivers were brilliant throughout and really great fun.
Wow - Fantastic service "interesting" food. Well worth the dollars. Great way to see Saigon. Make sure you come on an empty stomach.

That was fantastic - A fantastic trip from start to finish. We took the morning sightseeing trip which has got to be the finest way to see Saigon. Our drivers were fantastic, polite and have heaps of recommendations for some of the other places we were visiting in Vietnam. Not only that, they were really brave, diving into the traffic when a thief tried but was thwarted from stealing one of the helmets. Bravo!

Don't miss this fun!!! - Traveling with family, children 17,15,12 and 12. The 3 hour sightseeing tour on motorbikes is a highlight of our trip. The girls were safe drivers and we felt confident and comfortable on the back of their bikes. See so much more of the real Saigon by going down the local streets on bikes. Gives you a locals perspective of life riding around such a busy place on bikes. Would definitely recommend this companies tours but book early from Australia or you may miss out as it is very popular.

A must - I would definitely recommend booking an XO tour! I did both the sights and foodie tour and loved it. I would recommend getting the optional video of the tour for $30, if you want to book it make sure you get in early as I tried to book it for the foodie tour but another couple had booked before me but I was able to book it for the sights tour. The video is not of the whole group but focuses on you and your travel partner if you booked together.

Also note they don't recommend that wearing a bag so they will store your bag in the compartment under the scooter seat. The bag that I brought was too big to fit so I had to return it to my hotel room. All I really need to bring is a camera anyway as drinks, tissues etc are provided. Also as part of the base rate they will take photos throughout the tour and then email them to you in a week or so.

A trip highlight - A night out on the back of a scooter eating GREAT street food - it doesn't get much better !!
Tai was a great host for the night and the girls were skilled riders and friendly, informative hosts.
We quickly relaxed into the bike riding despite the initial trepidation and enjoyed zipping around the city with the rest of the traffic.
The trip will take you off the 'beaten track' which is a real bonus and an opportunity to see a little more of this city. A wide range of street food is offered so there will be something for everyone.
Don't miss the chance for a great night out!!

Fantastic Time - This tour was well worth the money.
I took two tours with this company (1) the food tour (2) the sightseeing morning tour.

The guides were professional and courteous and appeared to be very interested in ensuring that you were safe, comfortable and having a great time.

You are assigned to a young lady who will be your driver and guide while on the tour. She will operate a scooter through the crazy traffic as you go from sight to sight on the various tours. There was no funny business and everyone seemed to be quite respectful of the ladies when we were at the various sights so that was good. The two ladies I had the opportunity of riding with knowing what they were doing as far as operating the moped. While it was a bit unnerving at times given the haphazard nature of the traffic, I always felt safe and there were no close calls. I must say that it was a really cool experience zipping in an out of traffic and going through the crazy intersections on a scooter in Saigon. That was certainly the highlight of my trip.

The guides speak perfect English and had an answer to every question plus recommendations.

Throughout the tour I felt quite safe. The tour provides quite a few bodyguards. These bodyguards seem to form a subtle perimeter around us when we sit in the alley restaurants. So it felt safe to pull out the camera and be casual, place camera on table etc., so no thought required in that area. As well, during the day tour when we were standing in high traffic areas the security would keep beggars etc., away from us. It was all very subtle and non intrusive. Kudos' to the company for thinking of this. I only noticed this because the guide pointed them out to be. So double kudos'.

The other cool thing is that the scooter driver is really your personal guide. When we go to the restaurants, during the food tour, they will explain the foods to their respective guests, even peal the shrimp and cook the BBQ, and tell you how to eat the food. I cannot remember the name of my driver/guide but she was amazing!!! She was hilarious and constantly had me in stitches and was professional throughout. Quite bright and mature for a 23 year old.

This was the same thing for my driver/guide during the day trip. So you are not on your own. Each person on the tour has this personal attention by their personal driver. Then above your driver is the general tour guide who addresses everyone when we reach various destinations. and when he is done, your personal driver/guide takes over and the bespoke component of the tour begins. A fantastic system.

I highly recommend the food tour. I paid extra to have my food tour videotaped. I actually just got the tape today lol. It is amazing and well worth the extra $30.00. Note that they only video tape 1 person per tour so if you know you are going to Saigon and want to go on this tour then book early and request video recording at the earliest opportunity bc it is only for 1 person per tour.

Best Event in our SE Asia Visit - We took a cruise vacation visiting SE Asia in April, and decided to take the XO tour on our own. We were thrilled with the experience, and the professionalism of all the staff. Tai Dang, our tour guide was on top of every move, and the young ladies did a super job driving us older tourists around in crazy HCM City traffic. We did the Shopping Tour, but Tai modified it to be a downtown tour with a little shopping mixed in. The ladies stuck to each of their charges like glue, something my wife really appreciates. The lacquer store was a great stop, as was the local city market. Tai also helped us pick out a good and "safe" place for lunch (for Western tourists).

A 'must do' in HCMC - Fantastic night out in HCMC, made extra special by the girls and the tour guide. You get the true Vietnamese experience, by visiting places you may never have come across on your own, and on the back of a very well ridden moped. I can't recommend this foodie tour enough and if you are in any doubt as to whether or not this is for you, then take it from a fifty year old woman who has never been on the back of a bike before, who will do it again tomorrow!

So much fun! Brilliant introduction to this crazy city! - Brilliant evening on the back of a scooter, zipping along main streets across several districts of the HCMC. The guides were delightful and really made the tour worthwhile. Tried lots of different foods, even some weird ones!!

XO Foodie Tour Saigon - My Fiance and I had been looking at things to do before we left australia once in Saigon. This foodie tour took our fancy so we made sure we booked a tour when we arrived in Siagon. Wow how glad are we that we did. We had so many laughs, ate local delicacies, unusual and normal to a certain degree, Had a few drinks at dinner stops and I haven't laughed so much with a bunch of strangers than I did this particular night. The tour manager Tai was amazing, friendly, funny spoke very good english and encouraged my fiance to taste cuisines that shouldn't or should I say wouldn't be eaten here in Australia. Our guides V and Nhung were full of enthusiasm, very knowledgable, fantastic sense of humour and made us feel so warm and welcome, a trip we will never forget and would do again in a heartbeat. Leanne and Peter

Great relief from the heat and a good way to see the city too. - I was pretty nrevous about going on the back of a scooter but it was great fun and by the end of the tour I was very relaxed. We did the street food tour. The food was good not great but the girls and our tour guide made our night out. We got to see parts of the city we would never have seen on our own and being on the back of the bike meant we could cope with the searing heat. Its a great thing to do if you find yourself with a free night in HCMC.

Really great experience- highly recommended! - We are a couple in our 50's (young 50's :-), and had a wonderful time. Ahn was our guide - he was very good and fun. The drivers are very smart English speaking young women dedicated to censuring a safe drive plus provide all kinds of interesting information about the city and Vietnam life. We took both the morning sightseeing tour and the evening foodie tour- both were excellent. Thank you XO tours- this was one of our most memorable experiences of our Vietnam trip.

One of the best tours in Saigon - Was impressed with the wide range of places we went. Seems like we covered the entire city! The ladies who take you around the city are super friendly and very safe. Great variety of food and the guides really know their city. A definite "must do" when in Saigon.

Absolutely fantastic. Must do Vietnam experience! - Was a great Tour with very kindly and experienced young drivers.
Food was awesome. We ate at typical locations were usually only locals eat. The Food had a very good taste and quality. You get several Vietnamese courses. Meat and Seafood. It is highly recommended for Ho Chi Minh visitors. The traffic is really crazy but here you get an authentic insight.

Best activity in Saigon - While staying in HCMC for our honeymoon we decided to book on the foodie tour after seeing all the recommendations on trip advisor. I was worried it wouldn't live up to the hype but it surpassed our expectations.

This was, without doubt, the best thing we did in Saigon.

The girls and tour leaders were so welcoming and fun, the food was incredible and the motorbike ride, whilst slightly terrifying at first, was an incredible experience.

A brilliant way to see a different side to the city. Thank you.

It made our weekend in Vietnam! - I stumbled across XO tours and after reading the testimonials, it was non-negotiable - my boyfriend and I were going to have the experience of these lovely ladies being our guides whilst in Vietnam. We booked the Day and Night tours. They were great fun and completely safe. We saw more than we would have on our feet and our feet were grateful at the end of the day. I loved the Night tour as it was a great way to see the different Districts, experience different Vietnamese dishes and feel very exhilarated.

The girls were amazing - beautiful, funny and obviously loved their jobs.

We plan to return to HCMC as we didn't manage to see everything and will book another tour.

Don't hesitate - just book, you won't regret it - we didn't. Worth every dollar.

The XO girls will take you on a ride of a lifetime - When you come to Saigon you will see the XO girls everywhere, there is a very good reason for this, they are amazing and they are the best at what they do.

Saigon has some crazy traffic, scooters, cars and pedestrians all traveling in all different directions, I call it organized chaos!

My wife had her reservations about getting onto the back of a scooter and traveling around the streets of Saigon but I told her that I cannot find anything bad written about the XO girls and convinced her that we were going, so myself the wife and two children 9 and 12 all climbed aboard with the XO girls for a trip of a lifetime, we did the Saigon by night tour.

The

​

After a short while you become very comfortable with the amazing skills of the

The Saigon by night tour takes you to a number of destinations all something different and exciting about Saigon with a stop for some of the famous local tastes but it is the ride that the XO girls give that is what makes this a truly remarkable journey and one not to be missed!

There is no better way to see Saigon other than to jump onto the back of a scooter and wrestle through the hoards of scooters all busy traveling in their own directions, XO makes this safe and possible, thank you XO for a trip of a lifetime!

Run..don't walk..to spend an evening with XO Tours!! - We loved every minute of our evening Foodie tour!..from the moment we met our guides at the Opera House ..to our final goodbye 4 hours later. We ate lots of fun tasty local foods in a casual happy ambience during our three stops in different places around the city..and quickly adapted to the thrilling experience of riding behind our attractive and extremely capable motor scooter drivers around Saigon at night!

Really .... this was the highlight of our 21 day trip to China,Korea Hong Kong and Bangkok...go for it!

Barry and Tineke. Pasadena.California

Best thing I did in HCMC! - I love this. Beautiful, professional and lovely ladies in traditional outfits driving us around many parts of the city to sample great food. So much fun on the back of their motorbikes. Truly exhilarating experience.

Best Experience In The City - I found XO Tours on Tripadvisor then had another friend utilize their service. What everyone says is true; it is a great experience. What they don't have on their website is you can do any of their organized tours as private for only $30 more per person. We did this with the foodie and it was worth every penny! There are a few cheeze things they tried to do with you (pose for pictures, a little shock value with some of the food) but that didn't take away from it. The food we had was amazing and it was very nicely spaced out over a 4.5 hour time frame. The guides are very knowledgable and a lot of fun. I highly recommend it.

Great way to stay cool...no scary - I loved the tour. I was concerned that I would be scared and hot, but not at all. The drivers are much less aggressive in Vietnam than in the USA, so being on the back of the motorbike was not scary. Saigon can be hot, and the wind from the bike is a great way to stay cool. As for the tour and the sights.. top notch. It was interesting, informative and just fun. The women have great senses of humor and are very knowledgable. This tour was one of my favorite things I did on my two week trip of Vietnam.

A fun and food-filled evening in HCMC - The Foodie tour was such a fun way to experience the food (and roads) of HCMC. Our girls Tam and Vy were great - easy to talk to, and very safe drivers. There were amazing dishes and there were good dishes - it was a shame to leave so much unfinished! It's on the pricy side, but we feel it was well worth it, and an experience we will never forget.
A Must - Should be your no1. on Saigons To-do-list! A slight introduction to Ho-Chi-Minhs pulsating, vibrating life. Definetly much more than an ordinary sightseeing tour.

Amazing - We did the sights tour and it was excellent. The drivers were so nice and their English was very very good! The information that was provided was very interesting and beyond the usual tourist stuff. We are happy to have taken the tour. It was worth every penny. Thank you very much!

Above expectation - Having written reviews I've never even come close to listing 5 stars but this was worth it. Each restaurant is authentic and rustic with tasty food well explained. The girls are great fun, teased my girlfriend and I constantly and we felt very safe.

Pros - relaxed motorbike pace, security guards followed us the whole way, worth the money

Cons - may not appeal to quiet types

Magical Mystery Tour. - For our last evening in Saigon we booked the XO Foodie tour even though we had never been on a motor bike (Scooter) before and had no idea where we would be taken. It really was a magical trip. The girls are superb drivers. We felt very safe sitting behind them as we interweaved all the other motor bikes and scooters on the road. Exhilarating. We were taken around parts of the city we would never have seen on our own and at each stop Thuong gave us a short interesting lecture about the area. The highlight of the evening was the fantastic Vietnamese food we were indroduced to in mostly open air cafes.( We had such fun we cannot remember how many.) All the food was absolutely delicious and in very large portions. The girls were very attentive and wonderful company. It was reassuring to know that all along the route we were watched over by "the minders" who indroduced themselves at the end. Thank you XO Tours for a wonderful experience which we will never forget.-- from two 'not so young' travelers.

Great way to see and eat your way through Saigon in a few hours. - The tour guides were awesome! Vy was mine and she was really nice and a super good and safe driver. Khahn did a great job leading the group and the rest of the girls were equally awesome. Very personable, knowledgable, and fun. We visited various districts in the city and ate a lot of different local food I otherwise would not have known to order. All the food was so delicious. Make sure to go with an empty stomach because you will eat a lot. It is on the pricier side, but worth the splurge.

It's brilliant - Just back from our brilliant trip with Thu Duong as our irrepressible tour leader. Their enthusiasm makes this the best tour we did in Saigon. Went with our two boys aged 15 and 13 who loved it. A must do! Thanks girls!

The best night in Saigon! - Had the very best time on the XO foodie tour tonight. Thanks to Anh and the amazing girls for a great experience. Good beer, sites and company and authentic Vietnamese food. Would highly recommend this tour that suits both the young and young at heart (even if like me you have never ridden on the back of a scooter let alone through chaotic streets like in Saigon).
Thanks again. Sheralee & Martin

If you can still get your leg over........ - Brilliant - if you can still get your leg over.....the back of a scooter, of course!
Having had a 65th birthday the day before, my wife and I (she is little younger) had a brilliant experience with the XO team. Yes we can still sit astride a scooter and this is the only requirement to have a wonderful exhilarating experience. We had previously visited Saigon and been to all the tourist attractions so wanted to do something different. The company owner, Tai, was given a free hand to show us some of the less popular sites of interest in the City. He and the lovely lady drivers did not let us down. We had the most exciting and memorable time of our time in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Thailand and Singapore. Unfortunately, because we were on a shore visit from a visiting cruise ship, we could not stay longer to experience the Foodie tour but would love to do this at another time, This tour should be a must do for anyone visiting the City. Everything about the arrangements and the tour was done very professionally.We can't wait for the video of the tour to arrive!

Too much fun! - Thank you ladies for I had a great night. My guide was early and magically maneuvered us through the busy streets of Saigon. I was apprehensive at first but she quickly showed off her negotiating skills and I felt safe and relaxed. The food was more abundant, delicious and safe. Our tour leader is funny and informative. We played games, we laughed and we tried some interesting new food. I would happily recommend this tour to everyone. They take you to parts of Saigon you would never see otherwise and provide you with an insight into Vietnamese culture and daily life.

Fantastic way to spend the day in HCMC! - My family (2 adults, 1 child) had a wonderful time on our XO Tour. We chose for the "Sites" tour, and we had such a great time I wished we had booked another tour with them, too. The tour guides were all spoke fluent English, and very knowledgeable, but even more impressive to me was how nice they were. My son rode in front of the driver, and I never worried about him falling.

Out of all the activities we did in HCMC, our tour with XO was by far the best. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend a tour with them to anyone traveling to Saigon.

Oh what a night! - Oh what a night! This tour deserves all the rave reviews you will read here and if you have limits on what you can do in Ho Chi Minh City then this tour should be very high on your list. The food is fantastic and quite different to the standard tourist fare (No Pho); the places you will visit are well off the beaten track and the opportunity to learn something beyond the usual experiences is amazing. However, topping all that and the real highlights are the combination of the exhilaration of weaving in and out of the traffic perched on the back of your scooter, the skill and friendliness of the drivers and the enthusiasm and professionalism of the tour leader. On our tour our drivers were Chi and Tram, both young students with a great sense of fun who were eager to converse and practice their very good English - they were fantastic. The tour leader was Tai, a vibrant young man with great humour and energy who always seemed to end up at our destinations well ahead of us and well prepared. The group we were with consisted of 16 really diverse people including a family of four, couples, friends and solo travelers the age range was from 13 to approximately sixty and the skill of the tour leader and drivers was to create a really fun atmosphere so that all felt welcome and included. This was an absolutely fantastic tour.

Not to be missed - During our recent trip to Vietnam we did some pretty amazing things but there can be nothing better in HCMC than an XO Foodie tour.

My partner and I were picked up outside our hotel bang on time by Huong and Hong, two very sweet young girls, and we were quickly on our way to the first food stop, which is also where you meet with your fellow foodies. The girls are so much more than just your mode of transport, they are your companions for the evening. At food stops they organize your seating, drinks, help you with your food and even cook it at one stop. Having someone shelling delicious cooked prawns for me is something I could definitely get used to! The girls' English is excellent allowing the conversation to flow both on the scooters and at the food stops so, as you also get to know your fellow foodies seated around the long tables, the evening develops into a fun and enjoyable social occasion. As a winner of the chopstick challenge, I am yet to test the promise that my champions badge can be exchanged for 100,000 USD :-)

The journey around the city is an experience in itself, mingling with the hundreds of other scooters that seems so chaotic, but the girls ride very well and very safely and at no time did I or my partner feel nervous in the slighest. In order to try the best and most authentic local foods, the tour does visit one or two of the less salubrious areas of HCMC but the guys who accompany the tour ensure that everyone enjoys a safe and secure environment.

The cost of the tour is perhaps a little on the high side for Vietnam, but it really is worth every penny. I have never been on such a professional and well-organized tour anywhere in the world and I think any visitor to HCMC should do it because you will not regret it.

Fantastic fun, great food and a must do in Saigon - Had a great time, great to be ridden around Saigon at night and enjoy great food. The hosts and riders ensure a great time is had by all. Great way to meet other tourists.

Best Time Ever - I recently did the Sights tour and the Foodie tour with XO. It was the highlight of my trip! The drivers are so professional and friendly and for a first timer on the back of a motorbike they make you feel at ease. The girls also love to have a laugh and make the trip extremely enjoyable.

The amount of food provided in the Foodie tour is extraordinary - unlimited food and drink. You really need to pace yourself otherwise you will never fit it all in! I can't wait to go back and do it again.

A MUST!! - This was definitely one of the most enjoyable parts of my trip when I went to Saigon. We joined the Food Tour, my first ever food tour. Our guide (Khanh) was simply awesome. We zipped around all over Saigon with no hassle trying all sorts of different food. Both our guides were informative and friendly and we had an amazing time. I have been recommending this tour to my friends who want to visit Saigon and I recommend it to you as well. I will give the other tours by XO a try next time I'm in Saigon for sure.

You MUST do this!!! - We recently went on the Foodie Tour with XO and it was our favorite thing we did on our trip. The food and beers are unlimited (just be glad the pros are handling the driving!) and so delicious. Even better, though, are the attention, passion and enthusiasm of the guide and drivers. We felt at ease and looked after the whole time. Great fun and a must do for any visit to Saigon. I'll be recommending to all my friends!

very interesting - A fun and interesting tour of some of unusual food spots in Saigon. I can't say the food was delicious because it definitely wasn't and some of it was enough to turn the stomach. But of course you don't have to eat that and the purpose of the trip is to show you the real Vietnamese food eaten by the locals. This is not a 'foodie' tour. The best bit is being driven headlong into the traffic by your moped girl. It should be terrifying but fortunately due to the combination of all you can drink local beer and the girls' excellent driving it was only slightly scary. You'll get the most out of the trip if chatting to the girls on the way. They speak great English and give a real insight into the lives of the local population.

just do it ! - Well it is worth every penny spent. Extremely well organised - everything was delivered timely and properly. Very nice and friendly girls - drivers, very good guide. Being on a scooter with tens of thousands of Vietnemese people at the same time is a really unfogettable experience. However in this extremely chaotic traffic we always had a feeling that we are in good hands. And this was the case. Plus fantastic food in very interesting places. Clearly one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

Great experience! - We did two of their tours: The Sights Tour and the Foodie Tour, and were quite impressed. It was definitely a fun and unique experience going around the city on a motorbike. The Sights Tour was a little light on attractions, but the Foodie Tour was extremely heavy on food and drinks! They have very friendly and well-versed guides and drivers who provide extra tips on how to make the most of your stay in Ho Chi Minh City on top of the history they already share. I'd say this is the only way to experience Saigon if you have limited time in the city.

MUST do XO Tours!!!!!! - We booked all three XO tours at once, the foodie tour, the city sites and the shopping tour. The foodie tour was AMAZING and was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We not only experienced food at different locations we learnt alot about culture and played all sorts of fun games ... it was the best part of our trip. The shopping tour was awesome as well, we had a group of 4 and were lucky we were the only ones on the trip and our guide Tai took us to places we specifically asked for. The city sites tours is good as they take you to all the places in the city which mean something to Vietnam without going in all of them which is just enough if you arn't into museums. The tours were great and the girls were fun and exciting and they were included in everything we did. The photos we got were awesome and sent within a week. The tours are not cheap but trust me they are worth every cent!!!! Thanks Tai and the girls we had a great time :)

The highlight of our Vietnam trip - We did three of the four tours that XO tours offer and we loved every moment of them. The girls are great but it's the guides that make the experience awesome. You get to experience true Vietnamese food on the foodie tour without the concern of if you are eating something safe or not. The shopping tour is worth every cent. XO take you off the tourist walk and if you are chasing something specific they research and have it lined up before hand. Our guide Tai was a true gentleman and carried our bags for us as we shopped up a storm. The girls make you feel safe and they have a lot of fun.
The photos they take are excellent and become a fantastic memento of the trip.
If you are going to Vietnam make sure an XO tour is at the top of your list.
xo tour - awesome, pricy but totally worth it! the food was great, the staff was courteous, and a great city tour of all the districts in saigon!

You Simply Must Do this Tour - If you choose to do anything in Ho Chi Minh, the Foodie Tour offered by XOTours should be at the very, very top of your list. Not only is an immensenly great time, buy you get to see parts of the city you normally would not visit, sit (safely) on the back of a scooter while weaving in and out of traffic, eat a wide variety of yummy foods, and spend a few wonderful hours with some very sweet and intelligent young women.
We did this tour during our brief stay in the city in March and it was an absolute highlight. The girls make the evening - they have great a great sense of humor and are very keen to make this a wonderful experience for the group. We chose for the private tour since there were 4 of us and it was excellently organized and thoughly engaging. It is definitely worth it. See more stories and pictures at our blog (www.no-fixed-address.blogspot.com)

Incredibly Fun Foodie Tour - My husband and I had an absolute blast on the night foodie tour! This was our first time on a motorbike, so we were quite nervous at first. My husband is 6'5" and built like an American football player, so I was really concerned about whether the driver could handle someone his size. This was not an issue at all! Both of our drivers were incredibly safe and skilled, and we quickly grew comfortable with zooming through Ho Chi Minh City on the back of the bikes.

I am not the most adventurous eater when it comes to seafood, yet I enjoyed all of the dishes (even the seafood options) at our stops. We had such a lovely variety of food, and the drivers were incredibly entertaining and funny During each stop. We loved the silly games that we played, and it was an amazing way to see parts of the city that a tourist would not normally see. As an added benefit, the tour provides free pictures to its guests, which were high quality. Thus, I left my purse at home as well

, and had an enjoyable accessory-free evening.

Half Day Tour of Saigon - Great tour, the girls made it for us! They make us feel safe and welcome. They were keen to tell us stories about themselves and their lives as well as tell us all about the city. I feel like I made a friend for the morning. It's less scary on the back of a scooter then it is trying to cross the road. The tour was well organized and the guide took photographs for us which he sent through a couple of days later.

The Foodie Tour is a Lot of Fun and Professionally Done - The XO Foodie Tour was a great tour to do in HCMC--it was surely one of the highlights of my 10 days in Vietnam. I would have given it five stars but I feel there is still a bit of room left for improvement.

First of all, it's a bit pricey. While it was within what I could afford (I didn't mind the splurge), someone on a budget might not feel he or she got their money's worth. Secondly, there are only three actual food stops. An addition of one more food stop would earn this tour a fifth star. In addition, I felt a little rushed at the end of the last two food stops. I guess this tour needs to be an extra hour long (and an extra hour would justify the price).

The last point I would like to make is about safety. The young women are indeed good motorbike drivers and I have no doubt they make every effort to ensure their customer's safety; however, there are factors that are beyond their control. By taking this tour, you should understand that you are increasing your risk of injury (maybe it's this increased risk that makes the tour more exciting). There were a couple of times where had I not pulled my knees in closer to the bike, I would have been hit. For me, the risk was within my comfort level, but it might not be for everyone.

All said, I do highly recommend this trip--I will definitely do it again.

More like a night out with friends than a tour... - A must do if you are in Saigon. From the time we booked our tour, till the end we were so impressed with the professionalism and friendly staff. Our tour guides vy and delicious were fantastic and took special care of me as I was pregnant. It truly was a unique experience and that we would advise everyone to experience.

WHAT A FAT NIGHT - XO Foodie Tour, We arrived in Saigon about lunch time our foodie tour was to be that night, was feeling a bit tired after flight but decided to go that night and not reschedule. Without a doubt the best most fun tour my wife and I have done. The girls riding the scooters gorgeous, the traffic insane, advised the girl to put more air in tyres as I am not what you could call skinny.
The places we went to eat and the food we had was superb, although what is with the tiny plastic chairs.
A fantastic four hours of great food, great company, and lots of fun.

Highlight of our Asia Tour - Best Experience Ever - Phenomenal! Fun, Easy, Unique, Great Story for Friends. This is the best tour at any price. We got to see more of Saigon in one evening. The team was fantastic. The scooter girls were well-educated and available to tell us a lot about the city during our ride. We got to have some of the best meals at places we would have never found. My wife and I were on our honeymoon and we'll never forget the experience. The organization, experience, and everything were beyond perfect. If you only do one tour, make it this one.

Amazing!!!! - Just back from a wonderful 2 weeks in Vietnam and Cambodia. Our party of 4 decided to take the foodie tour with xo tours and we are so glad we did. It was a real experience and one that we'll never forget, firstly just to experience the true Siagon on the back of a moped was amazing. We were all very nervous at first due to how much traffic there was and the fact that there seemed to be little to no rules. The girls put is at our ease and took things at our pace. We went to our first stop where we met the rest of the group and our tour leader introduced us all and made it easy for us to get to know everyone. There was so much to eat at the stops and no shortage of beers to go with the food. All stops give us a true experience of the food locals would eat and I found myself eating things that I never thought I'd ever try!!!!

Again it was one of the best tours I have ever been on and I could not recommend it highly enough to anyone that is visiting Siagon....

Highlight of my trip to HCMC - I can not rate this tour highly enough! Being a solo traveller this is by far the best way to sight see & experience the traditional food of Saigon! Many travellers wouldn't cover the districts we did by motorbike tonight. The tour guides are also very friendly, knowledgeable & speak fluent English, the company was awesome & the food is to die for :)

Best tour ever -brilliant - Exciting, interesting, fabulous and would do it again.

We did the saigon at night tour and it was just so exhilarating. Friendly guides picked us up on time from our hotel and it was straight on the bikes and non stop. I couldn't stop grinning.

We went through areas I never would have got to and watched with wonder as we weaved through the traffic. The drivers looked after our safety and took us somewhere to eat and the food was amazing. Had chilled sugar cane and cumquat juice.

It was well organized and just so much fun. I would do it again.

Thank you xo

Great!! - My wife and I had a great time on the foodie tour. My driver was Thu (I said I would mention you is this review!). Plenty of food & drink. Girls love chatting on the bike. They show you a few sights and you cross over several districts. Girls understand English well and great tour to do early on your holiday as they will answer your questions and give you ideas on what else to do. Met others from different countries. Thanks from Ralph & Sandy

The Foodie Tour was definitely a highlight for us! - My partner and I are big foodies and decided to take this tour on our second night in Saigon. It was worth every penny!!! Not only did we experience a great night of wonderful food, but we had so much fun and got to see and experience parts of Saigon that the average traveler is likely to miss, especially if you don't have long in the city. The tour guides speak great English, are fun, friendly and go out of their way to make the experience as personal and memorable for everyone as they can. I would highly recommend this and any other tour with the company. We'll certainly be doing it again if we return to Saigon :)

Unforgettable - After reading all the rave reviews about XO Tours here on Tripadvisor, we were greatly looking forward to our night tour through the streets of Saigon. Our smiling tour guides picked us up at our hotel promptly at the start time listed in the reservation email. All of them spoke exceptional English and had great senses of humor. Having already spent a week in Vietnam and seeing motorbikes operating from a pedestrian point of view, I had white knuckles and sweaty palms for at least the first fifteen minutes of the tour. After riding through a small alleyway packed with vendors selling fresh produce, meat, and live seafood, I was so enthralled with my surroundings that my nerves quickly faded. Once the nerves were gone, I could chat with my guide and soak up the city in a way the locals do everyday, from the back of a motorbike. The quick street food stop gave us a chance to try a few new things we had not yet sampled and the fruit juice that went along with the stop was a refreshing surprise. If there is one thing you do in Ho Chi Minh City, please do it this. Amazing guides and the exciting opportunity to see Saigon from the back of a motorbike make this tour a truly unforgettable one.

XO Custom MotorBike Tour - From the moment I had first booked I could tell this was an organized company. My husband and I had limited time in Saigon and didn't want to go on a bus tour but just saw a touch of the city. This tour was perfect! Being both on our mid to late fifties didn't stop us from thoroughly enjoying the two and half hour tour. Our guide Tai Dang was extremely knowledgeable and the girls told us many interesting facts as we raced around the city on scooters. At no time did we feel unsafe in the traffic -In fact I would recommend this tour to all ages. Thanks again guys it was worth every cent and will become one of our fondest memories of Vietnam.
Regards
Ruth & Len

Foodie tour was the highlight - My husband and I did the foodie tour the second night in Saigon. We emailed the office 2 days prior to our arrival and received a quick response to say we were able to make a booking. My quide tam speaks excellent English as well as the rest of the girls on other bikes. We went to places that we never would have known about had we not booked this tour. Food was fresh and tasty. We felt safe the entire time as male guys also traveled with us. Lots of humor along the way. This is a must for anyone traveling to Saigon.

Exciting - We are 3 mature age ladies (45-50) and had 1 full day in Saigon & wanted to see as much as we could in a small amount of time !! We loved this tour it was fun, informative & we felt safe. The ladies were easy to understand & we laughed all day. It was one of my friends birthday & the ladies surprised her with a cake :)
Don't think about just book this tour & treasure the memories !!

Best tour ever!! - Our "foodie" tour was the most unique and fun activity ever! We've never experienced anything like riding on the back of the scooters through the traffic in Ho Chi Minh and the stops for food were amazing. Our drivers (Ngan and Thi) were wonderful young women who did whatever they could to make this a wonderful experience. Their English was great, had delightful personalities, and they were very skillful drivers so we felt safe all the way. At the restaurants, they served our food expertly and were very considerate of our individual tastes (eg not too spicy). This tour is a "must do" experience that I would recommend to anyone with a sense of fun and adventure!

Best city tour ever experienced. - Just finished most exciting tour ever. Spent 4 hours plus doing their Foodie Tour of HCMC on the back of a moped in the most chaotic traffic anywhere in the world and had the most wonderful food at various restaurants all over the city. My wife and I were a bit wary at first never having ridden on the back of mopeds before though we were quickly put at ease by our wonderful guides Y and Vy. I cannot recommend this trip highly enough and was worth every bit of the 72 US dollars we each paid for this.

Highlight of the trip - Highly recommend this fun and informative tour. The guides were funny, friendly, charming and their English was amazing. Felt very safe on the back of a scooter through crazy HCM. Tai Made a real effort to make everyone feel welcome and involved despite being complete strangers at the beginning of the tour. Would have definitely gone again if I had more time!

XO Excellence - We did two tours with XO yesterday 11th March 2014.
The Sights and the Foodie....
Greeted by the friendlies, welcoming, lovely Riders looking so lovely in blue and white traditional dress Ao Dai.
There is no need to fear getting on the back of a scooter with these girls, they ensure your comfort and are super experienced at navigating.
First destination greets the tour guide (ours was Khanh :)) with introduction to other tour participants.
I was really impressed with their memory to remember everyone's name and country they come from...I can barely remember what I had for breakfast.
The tours are full of fun and laughter with again amazing memory for all the information relayed.
Also amazed how the riders get to know you as they duck and weave without a break in friendly chat to us on the back.
The Foodie Tour highlights traditional Saigon districts and dishes...sends the taste buds dancing and the company of the girls explaining each dish wonderful.
I would say this tour is a must for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City...fullheartlyhas both mine and my hubbies recommendation
Cam o'n XO...Thank you!

Comedy Gold and Tourist Sights Too - I loved my first tour with XO so much I went back a second time. Solo traveler and I did the Saigon Sights morning tour first and then because I liked it so much, the Saigon by Night tour (not the foodie tour). The gals had me in STICHES. I don't think the reviews capture how funny they all are. (Maybe I just got lucky with my guide, Thu, but based on my conversation with some other folks on the Saigon Sights tour, their guides were funny too.)

Let me allay any concerns anyone might have about doing this. Maybe you think you're too old or too whatever. DON'T!! This is equal opportunity fun.

They are very safe drivers.
There are plenty of bathroom breaks and the bathrooms are fine although maybe bring your own toilet paper.
They do an excellent job of feeding and watering you. On my Saigon Sights tour, we were each given a bottle of water and then we did a little fruit tasting at the temple in Chinatown.
They bring "heat" with them that watch the bikes during the stops. You store your stuff in the seat of the bikes and they are very good about reminding you to be careful, etc.

My personal challenge is that I am 5 ft 3 (1.6 meters) and not the most flexible -- my own fault -- so getting off the bike for me was a little challenge but it was fine really and I managed.

BUT! I digress. This was pure, unadulterated fun. They will teach you a bunch of useful Vietnamese words (the Vietnamese "Oh my God" is my favorite) and you will learn more about the history, culture, and food of Vietnam.

Honestly, a no brainer. Do it!

Done it before, I'd do it again! - A recent reviewer called their entry "A Tour For Those Who Don't Do Tours" - and that is just about the perfect description of the Foodie Tour; I did the tour a year ago, and did it again tonight; when (not if) I come back to Saigon, I'll take it again. It's not so much a tour as a get together with a group of friends you didn't know you had. Do not be afraid to be on a motorbike despite your first impressions on arriving here; to be among the traffic is a lot less afraid than trying to cross the road through it! The security guys who come along are great, the lady drivers are charmingly cheeky, intelligent, and within a few minutes of their skillful driving under your belt, you'll wonder what you were ever worried about. Don't think twice, book it.

AWESOME NIGHT - My husband and I did the foodies tour on recommendation of our neighbors who had been on it in January. We are so glad we did because we had the best night of fun in HCMC. Our drivers were fantastic fun, spoke excellent English and were very safe drivers. Even though the chaos of the traffic seemed daunting we were at ease the whole time. Seeing Saigon at night on the back of a bike was awesome.The food on the tour was a highlight- beautiful and abundant. I would never have eaten frog or goat breast(udder!) but I tried everything and it was delicious. Our tour manager on the night was TAI??. He was a lot of fun and has a phenominal memory and remembers every single persons name who was on the tour from start to finish.This tour was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Well done XO Tours, you deserve to be number 1.
From my little phrase book you gave me- Thank you!

Better than Excellent! - My partner and I decided to go on this tour on our second day in Saigon and let me assure you it was the BEST fun we had. We were lucky enough to have Tung, the tour owner as our guide and with his knowledge and great sense of humor made our tour all the more enjoyable. The food was fantastic, we ate are at places and street stalls we would normally not look twice at and ate all sorts of foods, it was all delicious! The all female drivers were also awesome, we had a great chat inbetween stops! Over all we cannot rate this tour highly enough. Be sure to do yourself a favor and book in this tour!

Excellent Tour - We did the foodie tour in February and had such a great time. This tour was definitely one of the highlights from my 7 weeks in Southeast Asia!

Our tour leader (Khanh) was very professional and knowledgeable, and our drivers (Ngan and Yen) were lovely and always kept us feeling safe on the motorbikes. We had so much fun with all the staff!

The food was exceptional and definitely one of the best meals I've ever had. XO went above and beyond to cater to our dietary restrictions as well.

Prior to the tour, I emailed XO to inform them that it was my friend's birthday the day of the tour, and at the end they surprised her with a large birthday cake. It was so kind and completely unexpected!

Thank you XO!

MUST DO TOUR! - We were only in Ho Chi Minh for 2 nights and was told (not suggested) TOLD to do the foodies tour by a friend. When we arrived my husband was freaking out about the traffic and the idea of a tour on bikes scared the life out of him and wasn't keen to go at all! (and he is an adrenaline junkie eg bungy jumps etc) anyway i insisted and he and i both loved every minute of this tour! Very professional, my husband is a celiac and they had a good understanding of his illness and accommodated for him and made him feel at ease. The girls are amazing and are amazing drivers. Great way to experiance culture, see the city at night and taste amazing food. Cant say enough about it was one of the best things we have ever done. Thank you XO!!

A "tour" for those who don't do tours - After just returning from a 3 week tour of Asia, this is probably in the top 3 of memories that I bring home with me. We had a blast! This company is well run and the girls make you feel as welcome and secure as could possibly be. It is amazing how you come away from the experience feeling as though you've truly seen Saigon and had a taste of the local culture. The food and drinks were amazing and gave us a terrific sampling of different cuisine. They were super attentive and flexible to the fact that I don't like seafood. At each stop a special alternate was offered. We laughed through the entire 4 1/2 hours and fell into bed, stuffed and smiling from ear to ear. Well done XO Tours - Thank you for adding so much to our adventure.

XO Foodie Tour - no better way to see the city - Having walked earlier in the day, spending the evening on the back of a scooter watching the world go by while being driven by a charming young woman was by far the better way to see the city. On your own you just wouldn't see anywhere near much. So it's not just about food, this more about seeing the whole city in a fun way. Not doing this tour is something to regret. HMC/Saigon is the city of the bike. Thank you very much to my guide and the whole team.
Daniel from London

Ho Chi Minh by Night - I've been to Ho Chi Minh City countless times in the last 8 years and have never been on a bike.. What an experience! We had lovely guides, Thu and Phuong, and a wonderful tour leader, Truong. The girls were lovely, friendly and genuine. And the tour brought us off the beaten track, we ate the most delicious broken rice and savored some fresh fruits and amazingly refreshing sugar cane and kumquat juice! We finished the night off with light desserts before heading back into District 1.

It's no wonder XO Tours has been rated so highly in the past, and that it continues to be highly recommended!

Believe the hype and just go on it! - Thanks girls and Tai for such a great evening! We three girls loved our girl riders and came away feeling that we had seen the city, tasted great authentic food (a lot of it!) and met some really good people. For anyone reading the reviews and thinking about going on the XO Foodie Tour, stop contemplating and just do it! It will be the best thing that you did in Saigon.

Brilliant!! - We were so glad we stumbled across this tour before our trip, it was a brilliant way to see the city and chat to local guides; whose English is fantastic!

My Guide, nickname Miew Miew was a fabulous host in this great city! Our tour leader was also great! We also had a problem with our original tour date and they were more than happy to work with us to rearrange.

One warning, eat a light lunch!! There is plenty of delicious food throughout the evening! Can't recommend enough, it was brilliant and worth every penny, thank you!!

What a Fun Night!!! - The ladies running this tour were so much fun! My partner and I did this on a Friday night and saw parts of Saigon we never would have seen. Yeah, it's touristy and your group will take some odd gazes from the locals, but Who Cares!!! You're on vacation in Vietnam! We laughed the whole night, connected well with the others in the group....overall, I highly recommend this to anyone looking for some real adventure. The street scenes and shear madness of the 6 million motor bike culture in Saigon is unbelievable. The night starts off rather tame, and the food gets more interesting as it progresses. I cant say Im big on frog skin, but the meat was good.....tastes like......nah, Im not gonna say it. Just go do it, guaranteed good time. My guide was Tien, she was great! Lots of different foods, the beer was cold, the ladies were fun. How can you go wrong with that???

Fabulous Foodie Tour - We were extremely keen to take this tour after reading great reviews on here and it didn't disappoint! Everything about this tour is well managed. It's informative and most important - FUN! Our drivers for the evening were the loveliest girls who safely whisked us all over the districts of Saigon, weaving in and out of bumper to bumper traffic of which I had never seen the likes of before, while giving us information about all the sights we passed by. We were given the opportunity to try many different foods both yummy and interesting, although we did choose not to try the balut egg. The tour manager Tai, who met us at all our stops was fantastic in his role of co-ordinating our group of 10 or so and keeping us entertained while telling us stories about the different areas we stopped at.
This tour really is a must do and truly was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon.

Foodie adventure must do! - So much fun! So much food! Such a great way to see Saigon! My driver was awesome, informing me along the way. Tried some new foods and they were all amazing! I passed on the Balut egg. The tour operator was an excellent business man and really was interacting with the group, whipping out his IPad to show us pictures and explain facts about Saigon. The food tour is a must do! Loved riding all around this city on the back of a motor bike like a true local and eating things such as goat, frog and quail for my first time. Bravo XO tours! I know you will be successful for many years to come! You are a fantastic company who knows how to cater to tourists and adventurous seekers!

Awesome experience x 2 - We tried both the sights tour and the foodie tour over the last couple of days and each of them were exceptional experiences. The girls are very cautious and friendly as well as being expert drivers in the maniacal HCMC traffic. My wife was very nervous when I told her the night before that I had booked the tours but she was immediately at ease on meeting the girls and enjoyed the whole experience. The guides on both days were excellent, relaxing and informative -there is no doubt why this is no 1 attraction in HCMC, it is a must do whatever your age! Thanks to all the XO team.

Truly awesome and adventurous experience - All I can say is "Wow!" This was one of the coolest things we've done in a long time. In a single night, we eat more crazy types of food than I normally eat in a decade. We made great friends with our guides who were smart, ambitious ambassadors of their city. We learned about the Vietnamese economy and why so many of the fancy apartment buildings are empty (hint, inflation). We dodged in and out of more motorbikes than I've ever seen, all the while feeling safe and secure.

We did the Foodie tour and while I'm sure the other tours were fun, this seems like it is the flagship tour for a reason. The service is out of this world. If only I could always eat shrimp and crab where someone had already cracked the shell for me. If my beer was starting to dip below 1/3 of a can, another magically appeared. It was awesome.

Yes, it is expensive, but this is a memory we won't soon forget. Our guides were Thuy and Vy. They made us feel at home and were cracking jokes, but also gave us insight into the real-world of Vietnamese urban dwellers. These guys are number one for a reason.

Awesome screw - From Australia, it was good to finally have a good Vietnamese guide who can speak really good conversational English. I went with two other friends and we got picked up at our hotel. We then proceeded to go on the tour with a variety of food and tourist stops including having frog legs and visiting Chinatown! The bike ride itself is great as you get to feel what it is like to be a bikie in Saigon traffic. I'd recommend this highly!

A Highlight of Our Trip - I booked a private foodie tour and a shopping trip for myself and hubby and was going to book night tour but was told that i did not need this as the foodie tour took in all the sights, so its probably worth paying the extra for the foodie tour as it was a bargain, loads of food and loads of laughter. The girls are completely professional, bubbly and beautiful and very funny .
The foodie tour is really more geared up for groups but we thoroughly enjoyed our time with all 4 girls.
To get the most out of your shopping try and plan what you would like to buy in advance to get the best out of your tour
I had not been on the back of a bike before but was put at ease within 5 minutes, and to be totally honest is the best way to travel around Vietnam.

Absolutely Awesome ! - My wife and I went on the foodie tour on the 19.02.2014, what an amazing night we had. Firstly our two lady guides Anh and Yen were absolutely fantastic and spoke perfect English, they were such good fun to be with. They were excellent drivers on the bikes, my wife had never been on a motorbike before so was pretty nervous before hand, however after a few minutes with Yen felt completely relaxed and safe. Khanh the tour leader for the evening was also very informative and funny, always cracking jokes in perfect English. The girls traditional dresses are beautiful and they all looked stunning. We visited parts of Saigon you would normally never get to see, and ate some weird and wonderful food all the time being entertained by the lovely XO girls .This really was one of the best nights of our holiday ! Then at the end of the evening the girls dropped us off at our favourite bar in district 1. We will do this tour again next year when we return that's how good it is. Thank you soooooooooooo much xo tours !

A Valentine's Day To Remember! - We will never forget Valentine's Day 2014! We booked the Foodie Tour last August as an independent shore excursion from our cruise ship. We met our most personable guides, Tho and Tam, at the Saigon Opera House and set off on the backs of their motorbikes to taste foods we have never experienced. Although we were fearful in watching the traffic patterns, we never once worried about our safety on an especially crowded holiday night. For the next 5 hours, we rode through the streets of five districts, seeing parts of the city that our fellow cruise ship passengers never came close to. We made 2 stops for sightseeing and 3 stops for food from street stalls, where we enjoyed new delicacies with the locals. All the while, we gained an appreciation of how the Vietnamese people live, work, and eat. We especially loved getting photos from the tour leader, Khanah, a few days after our trip. Don't miss this experience and book early!

What can we say that hasn't already been said!!! - Went on the Saigon by Night tour, wonderful ladies picked us up at our hotel. Toured thru all districts of the city stopped in China town, for an evening Vietnamese dinner and various other points. The ladies provided an amazing educational overview and perspective of the past history and current life in HCMC.

The tour guides are absolutely amazing, impeccably organized, professional, informative, kind, respectful, and have a great sense of humor.

The tour may be a bit pricier than some others but worth every penny. Make sure you Tip them well!!

Adorable- wonderful- just do it! - My fiancé and I signed up for the sights tour with XO one morning on a whim. We did it quite late in the evening so I was worried we waited too late to sign up- but the girls arrived promptly the next morning- finding our tiny little hotel with no problems. They introduced themselves, briefed us on the tour, strapped our helmets on us and adorably told ME I could hold on to my guide on her shoulders or waist... and told my fiancé he could hold on to her shoulders... only. (smile) So cute.

If you think about it- this is really a brilliant operation.
