You have these sweet girls who wouldn't intimidate anyone- but the company and reviews instill a lot of confidence in them- even with the crazy driving all around the city. (They're claiming... no worries.) They drive you to locations as a group and a guide meets you there- he speaks great English- gives you the details and lets you wander about for a bit before sending you on to the next place- always beating you there.

My favorite part was when he introduced the wonderfully refreshing Vietnamese sugar-cane drink- asking us at one stop if we prefer the orange or the strawberry- and then hopping on the bikes and winding through these tight little allyways and having someone standing there with my drink- passing it off to me without us even stopping!

Everyone is always in awe of the structured chaos that is Vietnam traffic- and by the end of their visits- they sort of wish they'd had the guts to hop on one of those bikes- just for the experience... Just do it.... it's momentarily terrifying- but so so wonderful and an experience you'll never forget. Sure- you can hire some random guy on the street- but I'd rather do it within the safety of this awesome tour company- feeling confident of my safety- and learning about the city along the way.

First Rate Tour By Any Standards - There is so many great things to say about this tour company it is hard to know where to begin. Everything about the Foodie Tour and company is first class. It is truly the best combination of adventure and safety I have ever experienced. The food choices are very strategically picked and give you a great variety of choices throughout the city. They take you to truly local places and give you local (some adventurous) food but everything feels very clean and safe.

The motorbikes and drivers are also excellent. Once again a great combination of adventure, but with a sense of safety. It is hard to notice, but I think the tour has a set of "under cover" security that follows the tour around to make sure everyone is safe at all times.

This tour is a must for all ages, cultures, walks of life... Seriously the best organized tour I have ever been a part of.

Xo tours foodie tour is awesome! - I think it's obvious from the outstanding ratings on trip advisor, XO's foodie tour is worth every penny! A big thank you to Vi and Tai, they really made the foodie tour exceptional for me, and the tour lived up to all of my expectations. Not only did we eat great food, we also were offered a lot of local delicacies to try, which were really tasty too. It was great to experience being on the back of the bike in the insane traffic and Vi was a terrific driver, I always felt safe.
Definitely a highlight of my visit to HCMC, I would recommend the foodie tour to anyone who is adventurous and wants to see more of HCMC that just the tourist areas.

If you only do one thing in Saigon, so this. - Awesome experience, you can see why this is number 1.

We booked the night tour and must say were a little apprehensive when we saw how made the traffic was in Saigon but what an exhilarating experience.

My wife and I were met outside our Hotel by our ladies and they did not disappoint us, we felt completely safe and this is the only way to see Saigon, going through the various districts and at certain points stopping and being educated on certain areas and life in Vietnam.

Our lady drivers were great fun and we had a really enjoyable night. Had we been longer staying I think we would have probably booked another of the tours and would recommend this to anyone of any age.

Thanks for a great night

Fastest way to see a city - We did the Saigon by night tour. We were short on time so it was the fastest way to see the city.
People from India need not waste their time on this as you will have seen it all in India with some differences. The price was a little high for this kind of a trip.
What was worth it were the tour guides, very lovely ladies who chat/ give info about the city all through the 2.5 hrs of this trip. I will rate this trip as excellent only because of their service and attitude (full of fun and energy). They include a meal as part of the trip. If you are not used to bikes then this might hurt a bit.

A little pricey, but a great tour! - Overall, my morning tour of the city was a great experience. The women were exceptionally friendly and I was able to get a great sense of the city. The little touches, such as the use of an ipad to show historical pictures and the sugar cane juice and mangosteen fruits, were very welcome and added a great deal. As well, they very helpfully dropped us off at the market at the end of our tour, instead of back at our hotel.

The only part that was a little odd was that at times there felt as though there were too many tour guides. There is a main guide with the group, but then each driver also acts like a guide, accompanying you at the sites. Though I appreciate the effort to provide individualized attention, given that there were three people in my group, it felt like a little much when we would have three guides with us at each point.

Great way to check out HCMC and get a taste of Vietnam - Last night took the XO 'Foodie Tour.' It was the first time for my husband and me to ride scooters/motorbikes in Ho Chi Minh City. Although we were a bit apprehensive at first, once we got on the bikes with out respective guides/drivers, our fears disappeared-well faded considerably anyway.
After a couple of email correspondences with the tour management/owner, I arranged a booking. Very prompt responses were appreciated! In addition to the basic booking, I also asked if something could be arranged to help celebrate my husband's birthday. Mr. Tung replied that they would be happy to do that.
We were picked up promptly at our apartment at the appointed time (5:15) by our two drivers, Huong and Y. They were accompanied by a photographer (since I also booked the helmet cam). The young women were dressed in the traditional Vietnamese outfit, very beautiful. Both spoke English very well and were quite chatty and friendly. After an introduction and a couple of photos, we got on the bikes and were driven to the initial meeting point which was the first street stall for soup. There we joined about 8 other people. We had a Hue soup, not pho, which was very good. Our main guide, Tai, explained the ingredients in the soup and some of the other vegetables that were provided to add. He also talked about the different kinds of cuisines that we would sample during the evening.
After eating the soup, we got back on the bikes and drove about 10 or 15 minutes to another district. Got off the bikes, and Tai was there again to explain about the district and the food we were about to eat. This time it was barbequed goat and shrimp. When we all were seated at the table, each of the participants was seated by his or her driver. The drivers served also like personal assistants, helping to describe and/or prepare parts of the meal for each of us.
After this course, we saddled up again and drove for 20 minutes to China town. Also took a spin through District 7 and ended at a seafood stall in District 4. At the seafood alley, we had delicious scallops served on the shell, clams and crab. Also got to try a local duck egg favorite, for those who were interested. On top of the dessert served (a coconut kind of jelly/pudding), there was indeed a birthday surprise, accompanied with the birthday song. It was truly a fun and delightful surprise for my husband.
In all I would say, that the best part of this tour was experiencing Ho Chi Minh scooter traffic behind the hands of an expert! The young women drivers were very personable and very safe drivers. They made the entire experience fun.
If you're looking for a gourmet food tour, this isn't it. What it is, is a chance to experience what millions of Vietnamese experience every day-riding a motorbike/scooter in crazy traffic, getting to see different parts of this city that you wouldn't normally see, and also getting to sample food in places that locals frequent. Tai and the drivers do their best to make sure everyone is safe and are enjoying themselves. You get to learn a little bit about the city, the food, and have a good time as well. Very nice to get the 'personal touch.'
At 63, we were the oldest in our group by far but had a really great time. Looking forward to seeing the video and photos. We were returned back to our apartment around 10pm.
One piece of advice, probably don't need to bring your camera since the XO staff take lots of photos of everyone, including specific photos when requested. Also, as recommended by Tai, leave purses, backpacks, jewelry and anything valuable at home. Tai and the young women guides were very clear about keeping valuables out of sight or reach (like on the back of the bikes) of would-be snatchers.
Cost $72usd pp plus $30 for helmet cam video (they operate camera and produce the video). The video camera is optional. Photos are emailed to participants at no cost.

a must while in saigon - great girls, who are very knowledgable and fantastic drivers,
We did the foodie tour which was amazing and gave us a great insight to Saigon as a city and also the local cuisine.
You certainly wont be hungry by the end of this trip.
It was my birthday when we did the tour, which my husband mentioned to his driver, and when we got to the last eating stop they had arranged a beautiful birthday cake. What a lovely touch and a great time was had by all.

I know why it's the highest rated! - I fully understand why this tour is rated so high! Anh and virgin were awesome!

Boyfriend and I did a sight seeing your today. We had a blast. We had our guides every step of the way to give us a local perspective of the city and point out things we never would have seen! Aside from all this, the guides, as well as the other people joining the tour are fun minded.

We stopped by a local market and even sampled some homemade yogurt and flan. So delicious!

Safety was a big concern of theirs too, and I learned that in one district that we drove through there had been reports of bike mobs robbing tourists. While there were no threats, our guides did take precautions to protect us...traveling in packs etc.

Such a great tour, and worth every penny spent! There are cheaper options out there, but do yourself a favor and treat yourself to this.
Excellent - Really good fun tour. Did it first morning and it sets up your stay. Girls had good English and helped make a good start to the holiday. Just do it

Awesome Night! - We did the XO foodie tour at night. We went as a family and were picked up by 6 girls on motorbikes at about 5pm from our hotel. Each of us got our own driver for the night. They were all wearing their traditional Vietnamese attire in white and blue. We covered off 6 districts and probably traveled roughly 40km in one night around HCMC. We tried every kind of food that was on offer from quail to fertilized duck egg to 'jumping chicken' (frog). There was plenty of seafood to go round and the deserts were also great. Some of the places we went were places we would never pick on our own so it was good to try something off the beaten track! We never once felt unsafe, the girls drove well and they also spoke very good English. Such an awesome tour, I would recommend to anyone going to HCMC to book this. We had group of about 12 on our tour and everyone enjoyed it, all the girls and the tour guides were very hospitable and made the evening very enjoyable.

Best Total - Done this tour last night 2/9/14 had a fab time. If you want to see the real HCMC tonight this is the only way. Lots of food, loads of fun. I've been on dozen of trips over the years and this was the best ever. Didn't want it to end 10/10 guys and girls.

Great experience!!! - Went with a buddy of mine and of course did the most popular Foodie Tour. We totally had a blast! The girls are very friendly and of course pick you up and drop you off at your hotel! Super convenient! What I liked most from the tour is that they take you to different Districts in HCM and gives you a feel of what HCM is like, very valuable information to first time travelers to HCM. Dining experience was super fun, trying out different food! Be warned that you'll be eating where the locals eat so make sure you're prepared with a strong stomach! Special thanks to Vy3 and Trang!

Suberb - We took an XO tours foodie tour a few days ago and had a great time! I would seriously recommend this for anyone visiting Saigon, even if they are not a foodie. In fact the food itself, while very good, is not the reason I would recommend this trip. By far the best thing about the trip is the experience and service provided by the girls and the tour leader - they are just sooo much fun and so professional! Everything is orchestrated around entertaining customers to ensure they have the best possible time. Our drivers (Thu and Thanh - Thanks ladies) were that good that we are actually still feeling guilty that we didn't leave a big enough tip, even though the one I left would be considered quite substantial by Vietnamese standards! They really exceeded our expectations in every way. Great job guys, thank you!

The BEST!!! - Our group of four did the Foodie Tour at night. What a great experience! You get to see a lot of Saigon and eat some incredible food. This is a must-do activity for anyone age 8 to 80 visiting HCMC. The videos and photos we took are priceless.

Robert Bris - Just spent xmas in Vietnam and did the foodie tour with a 10 year old and two teenagers (all girls), oops dont forget the wife. Girls were apprehensive about the motorbikes in HCM but the girls put them at ease very quickly. Can't fault it. Girls were great and the food was delicious. Cant wait to go back to Vietnam, had the experience of a lifetime. Shedding a tear as I write this.

Take a safe conscious walk on the wild side - Jack Nicholson eat your heart out - Politely put I am a voluptuous fifty plus and I wondered if I'd fit on the back of the bike. I had a wonderful time on my tour for one - so much so I am going to book another one. Tien my driver was the ultimate professional and I was immediately at ease with her driving skills which were such that within minutes I could just enjoy the ride. Tai was my tour guide and I really felt that he was on my side when it came to taking me places and negotiating for me. I gave him a list of what I wanted to do (spectacles, power plus, fabric etc) and he made sure he understood what I was after, There was no pressure to do anything from either of them. These two young people were professional and a delight to be around. Their aim was to make sure that I had a good time and that I was happy with the service they provided and I was. The money I saved by going shopping with these two more than paid for the tour. If you are thinking about taking a tour - DO IT.

Foodie Tour with the Best! - Our group of 8 spent one evening on the back of the XO motorbikes and it was one of the highlights of our trip.

We went to 4 or 5 different places over a 4.5 hour evening and had an amazing choice of some delicious foods and some strange and new foods that we had never tried. The girls took care of us like our mothers did when we were little and I loved it. They peeled the seafood and cracked the eggs and cooked the goat meat on the small barbeque.

If I had to pick my favorite night in Saigon, this would be it!

Beyond your expectations - I did the Foodie tour with XO, and not only was it my best experience in Saigon but it was one of the best experiences I've had in my life. Tourists in Saigon are mostly confined to District 1. This tour takes you to the outer districts and shows you the way of life in Saigon. The main differentiating factor in this trip is your own personal guide and driver in the form of beautiful Vietnamese girls! They are witty, cheeky and never afraid to have some fun. Rather than drab tour guides who just recite rehearsed lines on cue, the girls actively engage you in conversation while explaining the significance of different districts and places.

I'm a big foodie, but the food part was signed to 2nd place when touring around with this group. They just make the entire experience so fun and memorable. But if you care about the food than the experience, you won't be disappointed either. The places and dishes are pretty well covered everywhere, so I won't go over that again, but the scallops with peanuts, chille and lime was just fabulous. The girls also shell your crabs and peel your prawns for you! There's some fun group games with chopsticks as well while waiting for the dishes. And plenty of photo ops if you're into that.

The tour itself was slightly pricey, but at the end of it I was so happy that I paid $30 extra (to round it off to $100) to my guide, Tien.

So much fun!! - This is an awesome way to see the city. The tour guides are a great bunch of people and put in a big effort to make sure you are safe and have a good time. There is more than enough food and as much as you can drink. Go for it!!

Excellent way to sample the food culture - We had a great time zooming around HCM city on the back of a scooter, eating and drinking as much as we could! The guides are fantastic, the selection of food is amazing, and being out among the locals on the road is a great way to experience the city and its culture.

Our highlights of Ho Chi Minh - Kate UK - What a fantastic experience. From the time the girls picked us up from our hotel, to the end of the experience it was amazing. I was apprehensive about getting on the bike, but within minutes loved it. The girls who ride the bikes are great fun and happy to talk about their lives and families. They really want you to have a great time, and get fat!! You get to see a lot of the city and get to eat some tasty food and optional more exotic treats!!! This is not a food tour it is a chance to understand what life is like for those that live in the city. The tour manager Tai was also very friendly and the whole thing is run in a very organized fashion.

fascinating - I took the evening "foodie" tour with XO and can't recommend it enough! My driver Vee was brilliant - charming, warm, spoke great English and took great care of me all evening. There were probably 10 or 12 people on the tour but because at each stop you sit with your driver to eat, the experience feels very personal and you have loads of opportunities to chat and ask questions. They show you several different districts and the buzz of zooming around bustling HCMC by night is so much fun. And of course the food is amazing - probably the best I ate on my whole trip to Vietnam. Steamed clams with lemongrass, stir fried crab with chilli, crispy grilled frog, grilled scallops with peanuts and herbs, grilled goat and more...and all of it absolutely delicious. XO takes you to places you will never be able to find by yourself and it really feels like you are hanging out with a bunch of friends. I would recommend XO tours without hesitation - they are friendly, fun, professional and worth every penny!

Fun ride in Ho Chi Minh City :) - Our girl guides picked us up from the hotel and we had four-hour fun ride tour around Ho Chi Minh. It was really something that everyone should try when they are in HCM. The girls were very friendly and helpful (when our son was playing around they always kept eye on him :)) so we could listen to our guide. The tour was hectic but thanks to that we saw a lot. I would really suggest everyone to do it.

Best tour and tour guides in Vietnam - I wish I had done this my first night in Ho Chi Minh City. My girlfriend and I went on the evening food tour. For four hours our awesome guides whisked us around the city and introduced us to delicious and unique Vietnamese food. We got to experience and hang out in parts of Ho Chi Minh you just wouldn't be able to find as a tourist. The food ranges from adventurous to just downright delicious. But most importantly, the guides were knowledgeable, safe, and just super fun. I keep looking back to this awesome night wishing I could re-live it. I can't recommend this experience highly enough.

XO Foodie Tour - After spending a week in Vietnam, I was to say the least nervous about getting on a motorbike in HCMC. However, after a short period of time, my guide had me completely at ease. The whole experience is one I will remember forever. The food, the sites, the company made for a delightful evening. I thoroughly recommend this tour as it is run professionally, safely and the highlight is the FOOD. Well Done!!! I will tell this to all my friends. And thank you to my guide Ning.

My XO experience - Although I know what to expect through reviews and photos, it was more fun than expected. My chaperon was very knowledgeable, careful and a safe rider. The food was amazing. Being a small eater, I must warn everyone NOT to eat all the noodle as you will need space for the other goodies. Kudos to XO Tour for putting much thought into the planning and fine details. BEST EXPERIENCE EVER!!!

Helen Tan, Bathurst NSW

Perfect! - This was definitely the highlight of my Ho Chi Minh travel experience. It was very fun and the food was amazing. Totally worth the money. The tour guides are very knowledgable, speak very good English, and are all very sweet. The motorbike experience might be a little bit scary at first, but you start to enjoy it after you get used to it. We definitely learned a lot more about Saigon from them than we would have on our own. One additional advice thought. Please do put away your belongings if it fits in the compartment. My friend was wearing a cross body fanny pack and it got snatched away by two motorbicyclists. Thankfully, he was not dragged down and hurt in any way. Otherwise, please do give this tour a try. I guarantee you won't be disappointed!

Fun and Fabulous way to see Saigon - This was a wonderful highlight of our trip to Vietnam. We were lucky enough to have two lovely riders, who were both safe, fun and knowledgeable. All the team we met on the foodie evening tour were great. Undertaking this trip made us realize the sheer size of HCMC, something we would never have experienced otherwise. We were picked up promptly from our hotel, given a safety instructions and then we were off. Having never been on a bike before I was a little nervous but soon found myself able to relax in the confidence of my driver. We ventured to street stalls we would not have found ourselves and we treated to some excellent food - the seafood was amazing. The most adventurous I got though was frogs legs and goats udders (surprising not bad) - the balout was offered but beyond my sensitivities! We were well fed and thoroughly entertained. We loved it and if back in HCMC we wouldn't hesitate to do it again.

Fantastic experience - We were a party of 8 which included 4 young teenagers and we did the foodie tour. A great experience with plenty of interesting and tasty local food to be had. We found the girls to be very safe riders and fun to be with and our tour guide very knowledgeable and engaging. A great way to experience the local traffic.

The No. 1 tour in Saigon - Totally Brilliant. See beyond District 1 and get a real flavor of Saigon in the company of smart, funny and utterly charming tour guides as they whisk you round on their motorcycles. I can't recommend this highly enough.

a bit campy but a fun and unique time - foody tour great food - If you are interested in visiting local street food restaurants, this is a great way to do it. We booked a private tour, but if large crowds are your thing, we passed by a larger XO tour that had around 15 people in it. In addition to the good restaurants, the guides also gave us good insight into different neighborhoods of the city we rode through.

The food itself was great. Lots of diversity, and more than you can eat/drink.

The guides were super fun. They somewhat seem to be intentionally playing into the stereotype that most visitors would want to see (giggling when you make a joke, a bit qoquetish), but if you can get beyond that (or if you don't notice it), they are there to make sure you have a wonderful time, and they do a lot to make sure that you do. (I don't mean this as any explanation of our guides, who I thought were excellent. Just making the observation.)

There are a few male staff that ride in the background and help get things moving along. They act as bodyguards and help with flats, etc. Kudos to them too because they were also into making sure we had Laughed.

Thank you very much XO!

Awesome!! - Awesome morning with the XO tour girls, my tour only went for 2.5 hours but I wish it went for longer, they spoke English very well and were really nice, very interesting and extremely fun!!

Foodie Tour - best tour i have ever been on! - This tour did not disappoint one bit! Riding around Ho Chi Minh city was a great experience eating and drinking like a local. Venturing into the different districts allows me to really understand the different Vietnamese culture and living standards. Tung Do the tour manager is an absolute gentleman he explained everything very clearly + all the girls made everyone feel like family! Overall it's a very very safe, fun and enjoyable experience, wish the tour was a bit longer! hehe - Will definitely return and do other XO tours in the future

Worth the 5 Stars - My wife and I booked and paid for our ‘foodie’ tour a month before we arrived in Saigon. We received prompt replies from Tung the Owner/Director at XO Tours confirming our booking and pick up details.
As promised in our confirmation email we were greeted by our drivers Ngan and Trinh outside our hotel at 17.15pm who briefed us with the do’s and don’ts of pillion riding.
Riding through Saigon on the back of a motorcycle IS the only way to travel. Sitting in an air conditioned taxi just does not compare. I’m 6ft 2in tall and Ngan (or Trinh.......can’t remember which through all the excitement) had no trouble negotiating her scooter through the barrage of oncoming traffic. Ive ridden bikes for years and wouldn’t even dream of riding through this sort mayhem. Nerves of steel these girls
First stop was an introduction to the rest of our group at a noodle shop with a bowl of Pho Bo and a brief from Khanh our tour leader. We were with a group of 8 people so it was not too crowded.
Back on the bikes and off to our next stop for Vietnamese delights such as barbequed Frog, Goat marinated in coconut, Ocra (lady’s fingers) which if i remember was with a fermented bean curd, sate & chilli oil dip. I’m sure i will be corrected on the ingredients but that was fantastic. All this was cooked on a pot BBQ at your table by the girls giving an in depth method on how the above is to be eaten Vietnamese style.
Next out was big Tiger Prawns on sticks barbequed with a salt lime and pepper dip. Spot on!!!
Back again on the bikes for a drive through Chinatown market which has a totally different look at night. Looked at the posh part of district 7 with some photo stops.
Last stop was another roadside restaurant which i think was district 4 for grilled clams to die for. We were given the choice for duck embryo/foetus which is a Vietnamese delicacy. Cunningly disguised as a boiled egg you get to eat the fore mentioned contents. Surprisingly didn’t taste too bad...... strong chicken soup and liver pate. Stopped at the third mouthful.... sorry girls
We were dropped off at our hotel at around 22.00pm and said our goodbyes to the girls.
If you have a short stay in Saigon (or long for that matter) you can do no wrong spending your cash on this excellent value for money trip. It gives a great insight into the Vietnamese food culture and a fantastic whistle-stop tour of this great city.
I may have missed some bits out and sure to be corrected but i did not even get a chance to get the cameras out as we were too busy eating (and drinking)
Tung.... please pass on a big thanks to the girls who drove for us. Unforgetable

Foodie Tour is A+++++ - Wife and I recently joined XO Tours for their foodie tours. Booked it based on its #1 ranking on Trip Advisor - I can definitely see what the hype is all about. It was extremely enjoyable in all respects. It was a fantastic way to see Saigon at night and visit neighborhoods/districts that you might not normally see. We really enjoyed the food part of it as well with many different local entrees - it's basically all you can eat/drink although you probably don't want to drink that much since you are on the back of a scooter in the streets of Saigon.

The best part of the tour for us was spending a few hours with the locals and having a better understanding of their city and culture. They were extremely friendly and open - after 5 minutes on the tour, it was just like talking to a friend that you're visiting. I really enjoyed my driver, I thought she was hilarious.

One of the ladies took pictures for us throughout our trip and it was sent promptly just a few days later (which is a great bonus and allowed us to really enjoy the trip without having to worry about taking pictures).

A bit on the pricey side, but thought it was totally worth it. Highly recommend!

The absolute highlight of our trip to Vietnam - If you do nothing else in Ho Chi Minh City make sure you do the Foodie Tour with XO Tours. We absolutely loved it. They picked us up from the hotel (all of the drivers are girls) and I was terrified to get on the back of a motor bike in this city but they were fantastic. We did 5 stops (3 restaurants and 2 scenic stops). You meet up with other people at the first stop and then travel together from there. The entire night was faultless and our drivers were amazing, they were so gorgeous I wanted to bring them home with us. They did everything for you, and were such great fun. You try amazing food and go to places you would never go. We felt completely safe and well looked after. I was so sad when the night finished but we had so much fun.
Do this tour, it is fantastic!! And if you don't want to do the Foodie Tour do another tour but make sure you do it with XO Tours, I have no doubt all the tours they do would be awesome!!

Fun and worthwhile experience - My husband and I did the foodie tour. This was most enjoyable and highly recommended. I was a bit apprehensive having never been on a bike before. The girls put us at ease at once and we felt so safe in their hands. What a great way to experience HCMC, we sampled the traditional food in places across town we would never have visited on our own. It's not only a food tour we had a few stops including Chinatown and district 7 the "modern" HCMC.
The food was great and my guide Yuen (hope I spell it right) even got me to try the frog!
Tai the tour manager and his team made sure we were well looked after, well fed, safe at all times and most of all guaranteed a fun evening for all. Highly recommend this experience.

Do it. - My brother and I heard about this food tour from some other travelers. We were each paired with a young lady and a motorbike. The food tour lasts 4.5 hours. The manager Tai did a great job explaining the different types of food during the night and remembered all the names in our group of maybe a dozen. Our drivers, Yen and Chew chauffeured us around town to each of five stops. These two ladies were sweet, educated and spoke very good English. It's basically all you can eat/drink. While pricey by Saigon standards, it was a highlight of our week in Vietnam. Would definitely do it again so i return to Vietnam. One word of caution...i didn't feel unsafe, but the back of a scooter may not be for the faint of heart. And you may not want to try ALL the foods offered. But i enjoyed most everything we had to eat!

If you only do 1 Tour - Do XO's Foodie Tour - Exceptional - My Partner and our 12 yr old daughter did XO's Foodie tour & Personal Shopping tour. I've been to 65 countries - the foodie tour is in the Top 3 tours I have experienced. I couldn't find 1 thing to complain about. Tai and his team of wonderful girls are just exceptional - fun, knowledgeable, wonderful food & sights and nothing is too much trouble. You go places most Westerners dont see all in a night combined with fresh, delicious food that makes Vietnams cuisine so amazing. If you are daring options await you - my daughter now loves Frog - we had it several times after first tasting it on this tour, if you are less adventurous no problem - plenty of other delicious options exist.
We then did a personal shopping tour with Tai - he and another team of his girls asked us what we wanted to buy & took us shopping - it saved us a couple of days of slogging around ourselves - my daughter had a very select list and the XO team met and ignored her shopping spree wishes - with lots of fun laughs along the way.
I cannot recommend XO tours highly enough - Just book it!

So much fun ! - I took this tour with my teenage daughter (who has never ridden a motorbike before, let alone in a city with crazy traffic like Ho Chi Minh) - and we both had a blast ! The girls are great safe drivers and my daughter's driver put her completely at ease. There is an abundance of food, both well-known food and the slightly more obscure (Balut eggs). The food keeps on coming until you can eat no more. It is great to cruise around town and they take you to parts of Ho Chi Minh you would probably never see unless you venture out with a local on a bike. The girls are so nice and it's a great experience to spend the night with them, finding out more about how a local lives and a chance to ask many questions. The manager Tai is a charming, very funny young man who is running a very tight ship. Truly recommend this trip - just go ahead and book it !!!

Great exciting tour. - Our group of 6 joined the foodie tour mid January. What a way to experience Ho Chi Minh, on the back of a bike and through that chaotic traffic. This was a well organised, gastronomic delight. The girls who drive speak beautiful English and are loads of fun. Must do!

great morning out - Had a great morning out with these lovely ladies (anh for me) with the mrs and our friends.We did the morning sight seeing tour,they picked us up from our hotel and took us out and about stopping at places of interest in Saigon.They were excellent drivers and we all felt safe as they weived in and out of the mad traffic there.Wish we had done the evening food tour now and will next time we go there.Many thanks for a great day ladies.
nick,sue,kev and julia

As amazing as everyone says - This was one of the greatest tours we've ever done. There's nothing quite like riding with the locals in HCMC and seeing first-hand how the flow of the bikes weave in and around the city streets.
Our guides were great - friendly, knowledgeable and funny. The XO staff go out of their way to make this an outstanding tour, and they accomplish this with ease. It's fun, it's exciting, and it's a glimpse of HCMC that the average tourist wouldn't have if not for XO.
We started our tour 3 hours after we landed and thought it was the perfect way to start our trip in Vietnam. The food was awesome - there was lots of delicious items to try and a few exotic ones as well. I tried frog for the first time, and it really does taste like chicken!! :)
Don't hesitate on booking this - it is truly as good as everyone says!

So much fun! - We decided to do this tour to get our bearings in the city when we first arrived. So glad we did! They girls are amazing. Not scary at all. My 7 year old was on the bike with me and my other 2 children had their own bike. Great history and interesting locations. Do this tour!

Great Tour and Great Food! - My daughter and I took the XO Tours evening "Foodie Tour", as well as "The Sights" tour the next morning. Both were wonderful, but the foodie tour was particularly great. Riding / touring on the scooters is a thrill. The scooter driver/guides spoke great English, were knowledgable and very engaging. The food was varied, interesting and absloutely delicious, including some wonderful beer. They also plan the timing so nothing was hurried and the whole experience was at a fun, relaxed pace. In addition, between courses, we stopped to see a number of interesting sights. I also selected the option where they make a video for you and that turned out to be great - - I'm very glad we did that. I have plans to return to Saigon in the next year and I will absolutely do the Foodie Tour again - - maybe more than once!

An interesting take on Saigon - Thuong Pham picked me up at my hotel. She was on time and immediately made a joke to put me at ease. I think that if you want to really know a country, then it's better to have a knowledgable guide. Ms. Pham was exactly that. As we zipped through the busy streets of Saigon, she Was quick to point out the sights and history of the different sections of the city. Very interesting facts that I would have never know. Ms. Pham also had a quick wit about her. Always joking and making me laugh. I wish I'd booked a longer tour, but I have another tour for early tomorrow morning. Thank you Ms. Pham for the insight. If I happen to have time before I leave Saigon, I'll try to book another. Thanks again.

XO Foodie Tour - Excellent - It'd be hard to believe that you could see so much of the 'real' Saigon without doing this tour. The food was fantastic ( some good recipe ideas gained along the way) the girls acting as our drivers/guides/hosts do their utmost to see that every guest has a great time. The girls driving my wife and I spoke fairly good English & chatted freely about anything and everything. In short, our hosts were absolutely charming and even if you just go for the night time sightseeing I cannot overstate what a great tour this is.

Take on the traffic !!!! - This was simply the greatest tour!! We did the city highlight tour. We experienced the traffic of Ho Chi Minh City with very experienced and delightful leaders. Thanks to Ahn and our three great young women. The drive through China town with the fabric and food markets was exceptional. Lots of fun and my teenagers couldn't stop laughing and smiling - it was a real highlight

Best experience in Ho Chi Minh - My partner and I did the XO Foodie Tour, after what one could call an 'enlightening morning' in Vietnam consisting of continuing feeling ripped off, this was the best decision we made. Picked up directly from our hotel by two of the friendliest girls we've met, off we went on the back of their scooters (I am usually a terrible backseat driver but something about these girls just makes you feel relaxed and safe). We experience some of the best food Ho Chi Minh has to offer (it is so refreshing to eat street food and has zero consequences). I highly recommend XO tours, Tai (tour manager) and the girls we're very friendly and professional we got a mix of food, sightseeing, local culture all in one tour! Well worth every cent plus more!

XO Foodie HCMC - Our family of five (including 3 adult children) did this tour on our second night in Saigon. Everyone was exhausted after a long day of traveling and touring around and wanted to skip this. However we pushed through and thank goodness we did! Everyone agreed that this night was the best on our holiday! The food was copious, adventurous and delicious and they catered to all the likes and dislikes of our picky family. The Vietnamese girls were friendly and cheeky and made us feel comfortable among the chaos of HCMC. Loads of information about the areas we also visited added a non-foodie aspect too. Highly recommended. DO NOT MISS IT!

XO Scooter Tours of Ho Chi Minh City - This was the highlight of our trip! I was completely disenchanted at the thought of racing through that amazing traffic on the back of a scooter, but within a few seconds the terror abated. The girls were so lovely - friendly, vivacious, knowledgeable and most important, wonderful riders. The best fun was the 'drive through' sugar cane juice that was waiting for us just before we headed into Chinatown. You can't visit Ho Chi Minh City without doing this tour.....

Free! - My wife and I arrived in Saigon on a Saturday afternoon and I had booked the Saigon by night tour for the same evening to jump right into our experience. Well in turned out to be the best part of the 21/2 days we stayed in Saigon. The two girls who picked us up where Ken and Trum. As soon as they saw us I knew it was going to be a great time. They both had such an enthusiastic attitude and where two of the nicest people. The night tour was great. Riding on the back of a scooter through the different districts in Saigon at night was amazing. We made a few stops too see a few things and picked up some food (broken rice with bbq pork which was the best pork I think I ever had) and stopped at an open air party area (i''m not to sure what its called) where locals hang out, dance, drink and eat. It was awesome. The whole time Ken and Trum where extremely informative about the city, had a great sense of humor, and were so personable. When they dropped us off at our hotel, my wife and I were sad our tour was over. It went so fast. Saigon is a huge city and it can be tough to figure out where to go and what to see. XO knows where to go and what to see and they have local knowledge. Looking back I would have done at least one half day tour a day when we were there.

Best part of my trip - We went as a group on the foodie tour. I can't explain how incredible the experience was. We were picked up at our hotel by 4 lovely English speaking Vietnamese tour guides who absolutely made our night. The food we tried was fantastic and was definitely things that we wouldn't have been able to find ourselves. Tung, the owner of xo tours actually acted as the guide for our group and he was knowledgable, funny and an all around great guy. Do not go to saigon and skip this tour, you will regret it!

Welcome to Saigon! - Such a great way to take in a large city like Saigon, on the back of a motorbike, with a charming, knowledgeable, fun group of local ladies. The food was good and interesting, but the real highlight was seeing all the life and neighborhoods of one of the world's great cities that I normally would have never seen.
The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - I went on this tour with 4 friends, and everyone had a fantastic time. The food was great, the guides were fun. Such a good time. Do it!

xo Foodie Tour Saigon at Night :) - Thank you Tai & xo Girls you are all beautifull. What can I say but Awesome!!!!!!
Experience a must when visiting this beautifull COUNTRY, Definately the highlight of our stay in Saigon.The traffic at times crazy OMG ! Tro`'i o'i. Thank you Tai (Tour Leader) and our very cautious beautifull young ladies, very informative, amazing food and great company.

C`am o'n!
(Aussie Family)

Now this was FUN! - After spending a week in Vietnam and witnessing some of the most messed up traffic we've ever seen, it was so much fun to actually be in amongst it all on the back of the bikes of these experienced lovely ladies who were our tour guides! FUN FUN FUN!
Our four kids, aged 12 - 18, loved it and so did we. We actually booked a Shopping Tour because we weren't sure what to do. Our awesome tour manager was TAI, he made sure at the start of the trip that we were going to go to places of interest to us - finding out what type of shopping we would like to do and what suited everyone in our group. We all put on our helmets and jumped on the back of our personal guide's motorbike and set off! Seriously, we could have just rode around the city on bikes for 3 hours it was just so hilarious!
First stop was a street of shoe shops! Converse shoes for $11 I think so! OK, so I know they're fakes, but these were around $25 in Thailand so at this point I was on a high. Back on our bikes and off to a street of sports stores! My husband loved it - very good quality sports brand shorts and shirts at extremely cheap prices ($6-7 for sports shorts). Tai would even bargain with the owners for us and always got things a little cheaper. From there we visited one of the local markets which was a shock to us all - the food section was very interesting and we took a lot of photos!
One of the highlights of the trip, besides Tai, was the wonderful ladies who drove us around. All of them spoke English well and chatted away to us the whole time. Even the 12 year old was engaged in conversation for most of his time on the bike - and he's not really a conversationalist!
Awesome trip - just the six of us in the group - would recommend this to everyone!

Highlight of our visit to Vietnam - My teen-age daughters and I are fortunate to have done quite a bit of international travel, and I can honestly say that our tour today with XO is one of the best we have ever had. The girls were wonderful & funny, the guide was interesting - it was truly an incredible day and a real highlight of our 10 days in Cambodia/Vietnam (which has been an amazing trip, overall). We cannot recommend it highly enough!

I will do this again and again and again - I found XO Tours on here and thought yup sounds fabulous. Did some research. Yup signed up. My friend and I did the Foodie Tour on our 2nd night in Saigon and it was fantastic. My driver/rider was Vy and she was the nicest, sweetest, most helpful, lovely lovely person. I had a brilliant night. I dont eat seafood and a lot of the menu is seafood but as I had informed them of this on booking, i had dishes specifically for me when others were having seafood. Delicious. We paid the extra $30 and had the video made and i highly recommend doing this. Great quality and every time i watch it it takes me straight back there. I will do it over and over again.

Must-do tour, simply the best. - We did both the sights and foodie tour and had a fantastic time on both. Only recommendation I have is to book early for the foodie tour as it gets booked out. Nothing but praise for these tours.

Awesome screw - I booked both the Shopping and the Foodie Tours with this company, and both were amazing! The Shopping Tour was a private tour and completed tailored to what we wanted - we got to visit plenty of shopping places where the locals go (and where prices are a quarter of the price when compared to the exhausting tourist markets!) and picked up some great bargains. The Foodie Tour was also amazing, and we got to try lots of interesting new foods as well as visit several different districts of Saigon. The guides were great and really new their stuff - they seemed to really enjoy what they did, which was really refreshing. I would highly recommend these tours to anyone who wants to see more of Saigon than the touristy District 1 :)

One of the highlights of our trip - XO tours did a great job -- my 12 year old son & I thoroughly enjoyed the 4 hour Foodie tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Girls are cute & friendly -- we ate plenty of great food, and also traveled quite a bit through the city visiting 5 different districts of the city. Tony runs a great operation. Highly recommended.

Great fun! - Went on the foodie tour as a family of four (older children), with four others - all of us Australian! LOL Our hosts were all young girls, with good English skills and careful drivers. We had a great time, not only sampling the variety of food available around Saigon, but zooming around on the motos seeing lots of the city (including District 4 LOL), and chatting with the girls. Food ranges from great to weird, with plenty of everything available. Highly recommended!

A do not miss experience - Don't know what I can add that hasn't already been said. The tour was a great experience. The girls are wonderful, friendly, funny, good drivers as well as good company. The tour was a lot of fun and while not the cheapest certainly a great experience and a most memorable part of my trip. I highly reccomend it and really can't imagine anybody being disappointed.

A truly memorable experience - both the Sights & Foodie tours! - My mother and I booked both the Sights & the Foodie tours in the same day - our first day in the city. I can't imagine a better, more convenient and incredibly memorable way of seeing and tasting the city. Our guides in the morning (Thu, Ngan and the tour leader Anh) and those in the evening (Huang, Nhu and the founder himself, Tung) took such good care of us, giving us everything from tips on where to get the best Banh Mi to where to shop and how to bargain. They combined knowledge with humor - we were constantly engaged and often laughing through the tour!

Being avid foodies, we asked a ton of questions on the food preparation during our foodie tour, and our guides were not just knowledgeable but actually passionate about the dishes. What I loved most was the care and attention they gave to my mum - she couldn't stop raving about the ladies and how hospitable and thoughtful each of them was. Mum ended up trying dishes that I couldn't have ever imagined her tasting! Compared to my 2 other food tours done previously in SE Asia, this one was the most well-organized and made for an informative learning experience.

The ride on the scooter was the icing on the cake, it was fun, safe and just a super convenient of seeing all parts of the city in a really short time. This is a company built around passion, hospitality and fun - and I recommend the tour to anyone looking for a highly personalized and thoughtfully-crafted experience that takes you off-the-beaten path. To every XO tour guide who made our first day in HCMC one that we will never forget, a very big Thank You. You made the start of our trip far more special than we could have ever imagined.

Great fun! - I can see why this is #1 on trip advisor. We did the night foodie tour. Had a fabulous time scooting around the crazy saigon traffic to districts we never would have seen on our own. This was our last night in Vietnam so a great way to end. Probably would be better for one of your first days in Vietnam as we had been in Vietnam for 3 weeks at this point so had tried most of the food on offer - was still delicious, just not out of the ordinary for us. The girls were great (special thanks to Nhu).

Must do - This tour is a must do if you are in Saigon. Definitely a highlight of Saigon. Our group did the foodie tour and was lucky enough to have Tung the director lead our tour. I've been to Saigon before and this your took us to places I didn't even know existed from the past visits here. Great staff and very knowledgeable about the city and the food of the city. Not only will you have a great time driving through the city in scooters, you will have a lot of laughs and you will have many story material for awhile. Must do!!

Pricey, but worth it you're experiencing Vietnam for the first time. - I booked the foodie tour at the recommendation of friends who went a few months prior to my trip.
I went with two other buddies and can say it was a good time. Although it is a bit pricey, at USD$204 for the three of us (USD$68/person), and it is up to USD$72/person now at the time of writing this review, it is a good time.

It was my first time to Vietnam, but I'm no stranger to Vietnamese food.

We got picked up by three XO girls on scooters at our hotel. Ready to roll. Now we were already used to riding on scooters by this time, but if you're not then hang onto the rear handles for your safety. Guys aren't allowed to hang on to the XO girls.

The first place we were brought to was a street vendor stall that specialize in Bún bò Huế, a spicy soup with noodles similiar to spagetti. I've had better Bún bò Huế in my hometown, so has my friends, so we were thinking if this is what it's going to be like, then we were not in for a good night.

The next stop I believe was in Chinatown and at the market there, which by coincidence my friends and I had been there in the afternoon, so it wasn't all new for us haha.

Next was an outdoor BBQ place. Now this was more like it. The food was great here. BBQ and beer, just my thing! Would have liked to have stayed here longer.

Next was stopover in district 9, I believe, which is where the newer buildings, with high rises and expats are. Housing here is expensive is the district is the most westernized.

Next was off to the hood, district 4 I believe, where it is the most dangerous are in HCMC, apparently. It's good that this tour shows you all the highs and lows of HCMC. Don't worry though, there are XO body guards to make sure you are safe. There is a big entourage with XO tours.
This is your last stop for food. I won't spoil the surprise that you get here for food. I just suggest trying it in the tamarind sauce.

It was my first time in Vietnam. My friend and I have relatives in HCMC, and so was already brought to a few places in town, rode their scooters, and ate a great local places.
The foodie tour was still great and my friends and I enjoyed it in the end.

The tour guide, crew and the XO girls were great, very friendly and courteous.

I would definitely recommend the foodie tour to anyone visiting Vietnam for the first time and aren't afraid to try new cuisine they haven't had before. You get to experience HCMC on the back of a scooter, and get driven around town, so much fun. I miss the scooter rides.

I would only suggest to XO tours to find a better Bún bò Huế place.

The Ho Chi Minh experience - Amazing tour gives you great information about Ho Chi Minh taking you across the diversity of each district and feeding you a mountain of street food you couldn't get yourself without the tour.

Guides are very friendly.

Excellent - I did the foodie tour on my first night in Vietnam and found it to be an excellent way to experience what it's like to be eating like the locals. The tour guides were extremely friendly and made me feel like if I've got friends in this foreign country. They also got a great sense of humor which made the evening entertaining. If you are not someone with a big appetite, I'd suggest you to just sample the food earlier in the night instead of trying to finish everything on your plate, as I got really full by the end and didn't have room for the last few dishes.

Best night out in Saigon - Just back in tonight 12th January after the foodie tour with XO. By far the highlight of our trip so far. The girls were informative, enthusiastic and treated us as if we were one of their own, we truly felt as if we were out with friends, their skills driving the manic roads of Saigon were brilliant.
If you get the chance due to this tour. A very big thank you to my driver and the tour leader Khan pham
Craig and michelle from scotland

Foodie Tour - We loved the concept of this tour and are happy we did it on our first night in HCMC but for the price we thought it was average. The girls that drive you around on scooters are the highlight of the tour. Very professional, friendly and accommodating. My husband and I both loved our individual drivers/guides. No regrets of taking this tour but I do think the price point is a bit high for what you get. $68/person is a lot to spend on any tour, but especially one in Vietnam. There was no shortage of food and beer is free flowing, but really, how much food/beer can a person consume in 4.5 hours when a decent portion of that time is spent driving and getting acquainted with different parts of the city? My one other criticism of the tour would be that the format at the dining table is a bit awkward. You sit with your individual driver/guide so that she can make sure you know what foods you are trying and you get enough to eat and drink but she does not participate in the dining experience. Instead there's a certain amount of force feeding that goes on. As one of the few women on this tour I found it awkward though I noticed my male counterparts seemed to enjoy and take pleasure in this aspect of the tour. It appears that the girls had been coached not to eat with us even though several of us
offered to share our meals. Our tour leader Kai was very knowledgeable about the food and his city and spoke excellent English. This tour is well executed and XO Tours is a well-run tour operator.

No need to think about it, JUST BOOK IT! - If you are ever in HCMC, my husband and II cannot recommend this tour enough to you. It is executed perfectly. Lovely, smart, funny girls with excellent English and driving skills scooter you around HCMC on a street food tour. The owner is Vietnamese and went to uni in the US. He and some other guys come along the tour, providing commentary and support if bikes break down and increased safety with the girls (we had absolutely no problems at all but this is the explanation and nice added comfort). Seriously the best way to see and experience HCMC culture! Best tour we have ever taken as a tourist and we are well traveled.

For 68 USD we did the Foodie Tour. I booked well in advance but the regular sessions were all full for the 4 days we were in HCMC. No problem. They are so popular and had so much interest they ran another session starting at 4 pm. The tour is 4 hours. We had other couples on our tour from NZ, Australia, Switzerland and Singapore. The tour is for 4 hours and we saw many districts of Saigon, receive lots of information and commentary and friendly interesting chat with the team and the guests. We ate delicious and interesting food and had lots of beers. No one will make you eat anything you don't want to eat and they will make sure you go home satisfied. I had yummy fresh tea, beers, a delicious soup, goat, prawns, scallops, frog, crab, Vietnamese wine, and probably more!

The whole tour is excellent but the girls need a special mention. They are such lovely girls and perfect hosts. They are what makes the tour. xoxox

One of the highlights of our trip. - Our group (3 couples) chose the foodie tour. I made the arrangements for this tour through the website. I always had prompt responses. We were picked up at our hotel as promised and introduced to our drivers. Then we set off for our first stop and were joined by another group of 6 or 7 from the Philippines. Our guide explained how the evening would work and then we enjoyed our first meal, some of the best soup on the whole trip (I can't remember the name, and it wasn't Pho) but I couldn't eat the whole bowl since I knew we had many more stops. Once everyone was done we headed off for the next stop. This was a long ride through the city. It was truly amazing to experience the traffic from a front row seat. At our next stop we had grilled prawns, goat, frog, okra... I can't remember everything. Some I loved, some were just ok but I tried everything. Then off we went. We rode through a market and stopped in a couple places so they could explain about the different areas. Then our last food stop, more great things and then dessert. The drivers were so informative, they would answer any questions we had as we rode along and then they would also help with each food stop. The whole evening felt like it was spent with long time friends. I would highly recommend this tour.

I'd go back to HCM, just to do this again! - In a nutshell - A night I wish that could have gone on for longer!

Our guides, Ms Huong & Ms Vuong (My spelling may be wrong) were at the entrance of our hotel by 1720hrs (pick up was at 1730hr). After a safety brief and a check on any dietary restrictions we may have, we were off! It has been at least 10years since I was last on a bike, and our guides made me feel like I was in good hands, maybe coz we really were!

3 food stops + 2 sight seeing stops

1st stop : What sounded like - Boom Bo Hoi ( Noodles and a great chance to meet and chat with your fellow tour participants)

The 2nd and 3rd food stops were really interesting. The food is not overhyped and it's hygenic. It really is good and clean. How do I know? Coz I had something similar the following nights at other places, and the phrase "same same but different" couldn't have been more accurate. Same dishes tasted different, and the morning after was, well, different also ;) So trust XO tours to choose credible establishments! If you aren't too adventurous with food, don't sweat it, the guides don't force you and there are tons of "safe" stuff as well (Not that the rest are dangerous). And when they say all's included, it's true. I was expecting the usual "Oh, if you want this, you have to pay extra", that we hear all the time, but not with XO, if you can eat 100 frogs in 30mins, they'd cook up 101 frogs for you! Frogs and beer...free flow! I asked for more on several occasions and I got what I asked for! These guys are for real!

It may have been a tour, but I must say this - I saw another tour group, the run-of-the-mill tour that brought their tourists into a Pho joint I was having lunch at with my wife, and the feel and vibe of that group and guide was totally different. Sombre, at best.

But with XO, the guides, coz it's 1:1, were really attentive, and the entire evening was full of laughs, burps, great food and a chance to interact with other members of the tour! Games, prizes, good food, good company plus sight-seeing thrown in! There is a very obvious guide profile and culture that this company has!

The chief guide, Tai, was also really professional and he was worlds apart from all the other tour guides i saw during this trip. He looked like he was really enjoying himself and not out to make you buy cheesy stuff (like many other horror guides & experiences that you read about here at TA)! Same goes for the tour we were on and I have a feeling - XO Tours on the whole!

If and when I ever go back to HCM, I'd do the foodie tour again at the drop of a hat! I'd probably go back to HCM JUST to do the foodie tour again! haha!

Good job XO! You guys & gals are the real deal! Serina and I had an unforgettable evening!

Till we meet again! ...............Mot Hai Ba! YO!!!! hahahaha!

Sensational - Without doubt one of the best tours I have done anywhere in the world.

The staff are friendly and pay a lot of attention to detail.

Even if you are not interested in the food, the tour is worth it just to ride around the many different districts of Saigon.

Fantastic night! - We went on the foodie tour on the 6th of Jan. We were picked up by Tam and Yen, two fun and really great girls, and then met up with Tai our tour leader (who was really good) and the rest of the group at the first stop. We then went riding all around Saigon to different neighborhoods to eat some fantastic local food and see a different part of Saigon, places you would never think to go to. That's why this tour is so great. Plenty of food and drink. No problems about the bike riding and traffic as well, the girls were really safe. These guys run a really fun, professional and organized tour. Don't miss it!

Amazing tour, fun and informative - My wife and I visited in March and did the evening foodie tour. It was amazing and one of the best things we did on our trip. Ben is a great host and our guides were wonderful. They were friendly, professional and had a great sense of humour. The foodie tour takes you to experience different areas of Ho Chi Minh city and eat more than enough local food. The food is excellent. I can't say enough good things about this tour.

Foodie Tour - First time travelers to Vietnam, 12 year old son and veggie wife! No problem at all for XO Tours.

Great friendly staff both before and during the tour. My wife was really nervous about biking in general and food in Vietnam but the tour guides were perfect. They made sure we all had ample food too.

The guides are all lovely and very knowledgeable about Vietnam. The main tour leader also brings the whole tour together and gives some good insights into the rich and poor side of Saigon.

Highly recommended!

Thanks guys!

What a great way to experience Saigon - We were collected punctually by our guides looking gorgeous in their traditional Ao Dai. After a brief discussion on what was to take place we took off into the frantic Saigon traffic. Being a bit of a wuss I was a bit concerned about how I would go on the back of a motor bike but never once did I feel concerned or scared. It was a great feeling zipping through the chaos on 2 wheels! We arrived at our first local restaurant and waited for the other couple of guests who would make up our group of 7. We enjoyed some tasty noodle type soup and while getting to know the others in the group the patter of rain began on the tin roof. Before too long it was bucketing down so we stayed there for a period of time hoping it would stop or at least ease up. Unfortunately that wasn't to be and the tour leader was busy on her phone trying to work out some sort of plan. Finally she announced that our next stop, Chinatown, was completely flooded and that it was unsafe to continue the tour due to the extremely wet conditions (of course this was the first rain we had experienced in nearly 3 weeks!!) Everyone was very disappointed and the guide tried to rebook everyone onto a different tour however this was not suitable for any of us. After another couple of phone calls a compromise was made, we could continue our tour leaving out Chinatown. We were all ecstatic with this news, donned our ponchos (supplied) and off we raced into the torrential down pour! It was hilarious, we were all dripping wet, our legs and feet were soaked due to traffic whooshing past and huge puddles of water splashing up and everyone really had a ball! We traveled past Chinatown to pick up the frogs that were BBQ'd for us at the next restaurant (tastes like chicken - seriously!). It really was very badly flooded.
All of the food we sampled was amazing, so fresh, tasty and deliciously cooked, most at our table on a mini portable BBQ. We especially enjoyed the banter with the locals trying to out do them with our "One, Two, Three, Cheers" in Vietnamese! We were the only westerners in each of the restaurants we visited, which was awesome. We had a couple of beers and also some rice wine which we all dutifully skulled, just like locals! We tried all the food, even the balut egg and we are now the envy of our friends for trying it, and it really wasn't that bad!
The rain eased up by the end of our tour so the trip back to our hotel was dry. Our drivers were great, so friendly, spoke excellent English and really made the trip so much fun. We have since received the photos via email and it is a great memento of what was a trip we will always remember.

Excellent in almost every way - Everything they had promised and more. We had originally booked for two but as my girlfriend was sick had to cancel her tour the day before. No problems with this and money refunded. Arrived at my hotel on time and off we went. Traffic is manic but feels safe with my girl. Her English was good and answered questions about the city. Also happy to translate at the chemist so I got the right stuff for the sick girlfriend. The only complaint I would make was that they were booked out so we could not do the food tour. Excellent and well worth it.

Excellent experience! - shopping tour - Professional, safe, most importantly fun and bubbly!
Highly recommended.
They even bargain for you and ensure you get the best deals!
If we come back to HCM. We are definitely booking them again!!!
Thanks Tai, Thu and Ning!!!;)

Amazing!! - If you can get on a tour (they are booked solid since they are so popular), this is amazing!! It is so unique. We were traveling from NYC with a group of four. They picked us up from the Park Hyatt and dropped us off. The women were very professional and most importantly, safe!! I was worried about being on a motorbike, but my driver (Yen) made me feel very comfortable. She was very interesting to talk to and very nice!! I am a vegetarian and she (along with the tour guide) made sure that I had plenty of food to eat. It was so much food!! It's a very unique way to see the city and loved going through China town. Overall, the food was great, the experience was very unique, and you get to see a lot of different parts of the city that you might not necessarily get to see unless you are on a bike!! Would highly recommend.

Great that the tour brings us to non-touristy areas - Went on XO tour after I landed on 4 Jan. The tour is quickly booked, so I would suggest to make your booking 2 weeks prior to the tour. I was only given the tour slot because someone canceled it last min.

I went for the night street food tour, and i was quite glad that they didn't bring us to try to obviously Pho. instead it brought us to the different districts, and what the district is famous for (for example seafood in district 4 i think, mutton in district 8). Although i wish i could try something more local (the mutton and clams werent that special or fantastic either), i still quite much enjoyed myself riding at the back of the bike, being whisked away to the different districts in HCMC to enjoy good food. we even had the chance to try balut, which is the duck egg embryo!

The tour is quite big, we had about 11 people, accompanied by 11 tour guides, so you can imagine the size of the entourage. so it would be better if the size could be smaller, but the tour guides tried their best to provide a personalized service.

Great tours - Very good Saigon city tours. We had Saigon by night and liked it a lot. Nice and friendly girls, guide put a hard work into choosing interesting places and facts for us. A really pleasant surprise on our first day in Ho Chi Minh

Highlight of our south east asia trip so far! - Highly recommend the foodie tour to anyone coming to HCMC! The tour is a fantastic way to see the city and you get to go to five different districts and try heaps of delicious local Vietnamese food. Tai was an amazing tour host! He really made us all feel welcome, remembered all of our names and explained the dishes and a bit of background history extremely well! Our motorbike drivers - Binh, Ngau and Tcau were incredible! They came and sat with us at the tables, taught us some Vietnamese and kept us laughing the entire time. We all felt really safe on the motorbikes as well! Would definitely recommend to anyone! Thanks once again XO tours!
Excellent - The tour was very entertaining and informative. Excellent tour leader. A must do in HCMC. I would highly recommend it.

One of the best tours we had in SE Asia - The food tour is fairly expensive in local terms - but it's worth every cent. We had so much fun winding through the busy and packed streets of Saigon on the back of a moto - and thus reached great local places for food we would never have spotted on our own and ate things we would not have dared to try.
The driving girls are really experienced on their motos and very entertaining. As they usually share the table with us it didn't feel like a typical organized service, but more like driving with local friends. But don't get this wrong: the organization of the tour was extremely professional! Besides the girls (and the other four participants) a tour guide and two supporting guys (all on motos as well) accompany the group and make every stop easygoing and smooth.
The food was more than enough and very tasty. Among others we had a local soup; plenty of grilled meat, seafood and vegetables as well as a variety of boiled local dishes and tasty deserts. And after a few days our stomach still confirms our initial impression: local but safe food!
Besides the food evening tour we also did the morning sightseeing tour - but this was shorter, with much less driving time and just visiting (no dive-in experience like the food) and thus we really preferred the night tour.

Great way to see the city - I went on the sights tour the first morning that I arrived in Saigon. It was the perfect way to get an overview of the city and see the major sights. My driver was great and even took me for a traditional lunch after the tour finished.

Excellent! - This is hands down the one must do activity in Vietnam. Went on the "sights" tour with my father, and my 2 children ages 10 & 13 - everyone loved it. Each driver ensures our helmets fit snugly and ensures their passenger's comfort every step of the way. Each guide and driver was cool, lovely, and spoke outstanding English - you get to see all the main attractions with the benefit of brief explanation.

Book ahead - people in our hotel wanted to go, but they book up well in advance. If you only have one day in Ho Chi Minh this is how you want to spend your morning. Great fun for our family ages 10-67!

Amazing Customer Service - Because of weather and scheduling issues I was not able to take this tour but I can tell you they tried very hard to make sure I had an enjoyable time in Vietnam. Tung did an outstanding job of keeping me informed of the changes and even helped me book a similar tour in HoiAn. The next time I am in the city I will definitely try again.

Best Food Tour Ever. - The Foodie Tour is a MUST do in Saigon. As an American Viet, I truly appreciate the food, history, complete tour and the genuine hospitality of our tour guides, Huong (Both were named Huong!). They spoke perfect English and were excellent drivers. In addition, Khanh Pham did a phenomenal job hosting the night. It was very entertaining and I felt safe on the motorbikes throughout the night. I was pleasantly surprised with the structure and organization of the tour.

I ate things on the tour that I had never eaten before and everything was simply delicious! The girls prepared the food for us and made every moment enjoyable. Both Huong's were very sincere and made sure you had enough to eat. The drive through the different districts was also exhilarating. It was a nice experience driving through the streets like a local.

(One advice: Have “Gangnam Style” song readily available for the losers to dance to ☺). I would highly recommend this tour without a doubt to everyone who visits Saigon.

Good Job XO Tours! Well Done!

Best tour in Saigon - The Foodie Tour from XO Tours gives anyone a reason to visit Saigon. Tung and his team do an amazing job. They are very knowledgeable about the city, the culture, and of course the food. Each guest gets their own personal guide who takes you around Saigon on the back of a scooter stopping at various local food spots to eat. I was lucky enough to get paired up with Hoang. She was intelligent, spoke great English (I'm from the US), passionate about Saigon, its culture and history, and incredibly funny. She kept the jokes coming all night long. If you have an evening to kill in Saigon, take this tour. If you don't have an evening to kill, cancel your plans for the night, and take this tour. This is by far the best tour/tour operator in Saigon.

Absolutely Awesome... Foodie tour is a must in HCMC!! - Couldn't have asked for a better evening, it's a great way to see the city and submerge yourself in the local cuisine!! The girls are so polite and make you feel so relaxed as they navigate the chaotic traffic of the city. Each food stop was a different experience and all the food was so tasty, I tried things I never thought I would, including the EGG!! My girlfriend is particular with what she eats and they couldn't be more accommodating in making sure she was ok. The main guide was very knowledgeable and very funny with it creating a good group atmosphere. Would definitely do this again and it would be great to have then in every city around the world. XO Tours is knobero UNO!!

Best thing we did in HCMC - This tour was fun and exciting. We were a little nervous at first due to the many motorbikes on the road, but our drivers Ann and Thu were great and put us at ease. The tour was informative and fun and the drive through town gave you a different perspective.
I would book this company again if back in HCMC and would recommend for anyone traveling to Saigon.

A Must Do in Ho Chi Minh City! - This was by far the best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh.

You get to try really authentic Vietnamese food in authentic restaurant/street settings. The tour guides and drivers speak great English and are very knowledgeable. I learned more about HCM on this tour than anywhere else.

However the best thing about this tour is that you get to tour many districts of HCM on the back of a bike like a local. It is an amazing experience like no other.

Excellent Tour - This was a great way to do a quick tour of HCMC. The women guides were very fun and informative. The tour is done in the early morning to beat some of the traffic and heat. The girls are very good riders and we feel very safe. It's also a good way to experience the insanity of riding in the city without the fear of riding yourself. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Love the Foodie Tour! - Second time I have done the foodie tour and it was even better! Love the guides - so nice and kind. And the food is just amazing. Yummy at every stop. Nice to also have explanation of what everything is and eat what the locals eat. The motorbike tour allows you to see places of the city you will never get to including cruising through the market in Chinatown. Thanks again for another get tour and hope to get to do it again soon! It's a must do in Saigon!

Great experience! Helps tourists become travelers - Did this tour in November .Organization extremely efficient-girls great drivers / hosts.Operation is slick and well planned with the tour in tune with what people want to experience.Got the impression XO enjoyed showing off their city and we certainly enjoyed not having the pressure of navigating,choosing restaurants or dishes.The owner also through in some interesting insights into HCMC-definitely recommended!Richard and Clare Grant

An absolute highlight of our tour of Vietnam - I booked the foodie tour for our family of four, based upon the many positive reviews on Tripadvisor and lets just say that my wife and our 15 year old were fairly nervous and a bit reluctant. We now all agree that this was one of the absolute highlights of our 2 ½ week trip from north to south of Vietnam!! The girls did a fantastic job of navigating through the chaos and never did we feel unsafe in the traffic. All up, I think that there were 15 visitors on the tour and right from the outset the XO crew made everyone feel comfortable and all quickly joined in the fun atmosphere. Tai is an excellent tour guide (very impressive how you remember everybodies names and city & country of origin) and combined a very informative tour with plenty of humour. The food venues were very good and thanks Anh, Thu, Van and Tam2 for making this a great evening (and Im sure that all of the other XO girls and the support crew did just as good a job as well because everyone else was also having a ball). Your gentle persuasion goes a long way: prawn heads are crunchy, frog is like chicken (sort of) and balut egg-well it was actually OK (and I still cannot believe we ate that!). This is a must do for any visitors to Ho Chi Minh City and next time we are there, we will definitely be doing it again. Cannot wait for the video :)

A great way to get out of the touristy area and try things you wouldn't normally! - Although the XO tour was a bit pricey for us backpackers, we couldn't have spent the money better! It was such a fantastic experience to get to go on the back of a scooter through the traffic. I felt very safe at all times with my scooter driver Ngun! She was so nice and very lovely to talk to. We got to try some very interesting food I wouldn't have ever ordered. Ended up feeling very full and it was a great night!
