The tour we wanted originally was fully booked so they made a 430pm group so we were very grateful we got to do it a bit earlier! Overall, this is a must when you visit Saigon!

Ignore your fear - this is AMAZING! - I'll admit, I was a little nervous at booking this experience, because I'm not that confident on a motorbike or scooter, and I'm quite a large lady. However, I'm so glad I did this!
It was the BEST experience we had in all of Vietnam.
We did the Foodie tour, and it took us to places I would have never seen otherwise, and we tried such an incredible array of food!
The scooter girls were absolutely lovely. So very helpful and polite, and they are very excellent drivers. Driving through rush-hour traffic on the back of a scooter in Vietnam certainly should be on everyone's bucket list, it's an experience in itself!
We had the DVD created, and they did an amazing job, we love watching it to re-live the experience. The entire crew were so professional and checked on us regularly to make sure we were ok.
If you're wondering if you should do it, then the answer is yes. I would recommend it to everyone, young and old!
Thanks XO for giving us the experience of a lifetime.

A highlight of our trip! - We did the food tour and it was one of our most favorite things we did while in Vietnam. The girls are fantastic and the guides knowledgeable and funny. We felt safe on the bikes and it was great to get out of District 1 (the tourist district). We learned so much about Saigon and it was awesome to see the various districts and eat where the locals eat. You wouldn’t know of these places otherwise and it was all incredibly delicious. You will try several cuisines and your driver will prepare everything for you. You just eat and drink and have a fantastic time. They accommodate for diet restrictions, so if you’re picky, you can still go. We highly, highly recommend this tour. You will not regret it.

Brilliant! The Foodie is Recommended! - This was our last night in Saigon and I'd been looking forward to this since arriving in Vietnam and it really didn't disappoint!

This was the Foodie tour which starts around 5:30pm and ended sometime after 9pm.

The girls picked us up from our hotel on time and were incredibly friendly. We really felt safe on the scooters and Saigons traffic means that you can't really build up much speed anyway. I think we were going between 20 & 30km/h for a lot of a the way from our hotel so even if you're a little nervous or its your first time on a bike its a really easy going ride.

We met up with a larger group, around 10 in total, and it was a really good night out. All of the food and drink is included in the price and you can have as much or as little as you like.

The tour goes around a few different stops, around 30 minutes at each location where you can chat to the other tourists and the scooter girls.

There were some things on the menu we hadn't had before and some things that we had.... all of it was amazing. The food is really good and if you're interested in trying a few different things then the Foodie is definitely worth a go.

The girls were really chatty and it was nice to have a chat as we travelled between places. The group has a few guys who go ahead to secure parking etc and they also hang around the edge of the group at stops when people are taking photos etc so we didn't get any bother from street sellers etc.

The tour felt really well setup and very professional. We had a lot of fun. Highly recommended.

Best experience in HCMC! - We absolutely loved this foodies tour. My partner and I took the tour on Monday evening right in the middle of the chaos of the evening traffic. I specified the vegetarian option for myself and was definitely NOT disappointed! I tasted numerous delicious dishes and my partner also sampled some interesting foods that he wouldn't have otherwise had the chance to taste. All staff were extremely friendly and spoke excellent English. We felt comfortable the entire time chatting with our drivers as we zoomed in and out the traffic. This is an absolute MUST and when we come back we'll definitely be going again! Well worth the money as you get to visit many district areas and see the real Vietnamese lifestyle.

Felt very safe despite crazy traffic etc - We took the morning tour. Our riders were charming and very competent, and there was also a tour leader, assistant tour leader, and a big silent guy who discreetly got between us and anyone trying to sidle too close to our possessions. All these personnel for a group of 4 adults and 2 kids, made us feel that we could relax and enjoy the sights without worries. The scooters can buzz in and out of the traffic nicely. Don't get stuck in a boring old bus or car when you can see HCMC like this.

Do NOT miss this! - As you can tell by all of the previous reviews, this is the best activity in HCMC! My husband and I signed up for the Foodie Tour and absolutely loved it! I am usually a bit fearful about riding on motorcycles/scooters but my driver Ai was very skilled managed to put me at ease. My husband who is an accomplished rider really enjoyed the fun of riding through the crazy traffic. Our program leader, Tai did an amazing job explaining the different districts of this big city and of directing all of the food stops. Oh and the FOOD - excellent quality and lots of it! Majority of the dishes are seafood-based but this can be adjusted for non-seafood eaters (let them know at the start of the tour). If you only have time to do one thing in Saigon, this is it!

An amazing foodies tour! - We took the foodies tour last Saturday evening and it was a great experience as we had the chance to taste some of the best local eating places and different types of food and at the same time we visited several districts of the city.
The girls and the supporting staff at each spot were very friendly and always talking to us during the ride and ready to explain any doubt.
This is an amazing way to get a deeper contact with Vietnamese food and locals!

Nice motorbike ride with excellent food - After looking for some adventure in Saigon I decided to take The foodie tour with XO tours. This company is managed by girl drivers which gives you a different tour style.
Bing was my driver and guide assigned. She was exceptional good driving and taking care of me. All the team are very enthusiastic and make me feel very comfortable at all time. We drove around the different Saigon Districts facing closer the daily and tasty local food.
They took pictures and promise to send them to my mail.
Considering the food is cheap in Saigon I find the tour a little expensive $68 per person but if you want a quality service sometimes is better to pay a little extra.
Very good tour and highly recomended.

Foodie tour - It's a must.
The beer the shot of wine all the food you can eat
Add with
Education

This tour is hard to match. The young lady who comes to get you is nearly with you the whole night. They tell you about each district we go to, explain about the food.
I really loved it
Thanks guys and gals
For me it was solo but there was a young child there

Have to do this! - Probably the best thing we did in all the two weeks of our holiday in Vietnam. The friendliest people you can imagine take you around to numerous districts in Saigon and provide you all the food and beer you could want!

Absolutely amazing - Did the foodie tour with three friends and it absolutely blew me away. The price was great and super affordable. It honestly should have been more expensive for what it was. All the food was great and stuff I wouldn't have tried otherwise. The tour guide Tai was a great guy and so funny, and all the ladies we were paired with were so fun to talk to and hang out with. It was really like going out with a group of friends; they had no qualms partaking in our frequent banter throughout the night and they were all so funny. Shout out to my driver Nhi who was a pleasure to talk to and very friendly. Would absolutely recommend it to anyone traveling in Saigon.

Unforgettable Saigon experience - I don't think I have been on a better tour in any country. My three friends and I booked the foodie tour to get more than a glimpse of Vietnamese cuisine. I think that we were able to experience so much more, from the personality of each of Saigon's districts, to hidden cultural gems spotted around the city. Tai (the main guide) was extremely knowledgable, and I Definitely enjoyed his humor. I have never felt safer on a bike, and Huang was a great driver and guide. We ate more like friends, engaging in humorous banter and having an excellent dinner. It didn't feel like a tour at all. They are very accommodating to dietary requirements, and I tried some excellent dishes ranging from frog to baluts.

I cannot recommend XO tours enough, and I think this is an essential part of visiting HO Chi Minh city - for the perspective from a motorbike, to the food and the hospitality of the company!

Great food tour - We had a group of 4 guys who jumped on the back of the xo tour girls' bikes and had a great time.

Got to taste local delicacies and get outside the tourist districts. Our guides were amazing - spoke English well and were very informative, the food was amazing, and if I head back to Vietnam again I will do this again too

Fun, fun, fun! - My husband and I were in Saigon for 2 days prior to boarding a cruise up the Mekong river and looking for something different to do. XO Tours was the answer! We booked the 4 hour "Foodie" tour and oh my was it a blast! Were we nervous about the insane Saigon traffic? Yes, but the highly capable, charming ladies of XO put us at ease immediately. Were we hesitant about eating street food that was definitely not in the "tourist zones"? Yep, but the food stops were outstanding and so, so tasty! The girls explained how to eat the various dishes and fed us like we were royalty! We learned a bit about Ho Chi Minh City, ate lots of awesome food and shared laughs and fun with our group and drivers. Don't hesitate, just do it!

A must do!!! - Took the wife to Vietnam for the 1st time, and managed to get her on a motorbike for the 1st time! We did the morning sights tour to give my wife a feel for this amazing city on our 1st day, and we both loved it. Lovely ladies driving the bikes who spoke excellent English, completely safe drivers, and explained lots of history of the city.
We loved zipping around the city, seeing the wonderful sights. If there is one thing to do in Saigon - surely this is it??!!
A few days after the tour we received an email from them with several souvenir photos attached which was a lovely surprise. We would like to have done the foodie tour or night tour as well, but had so many other things to cram in too!

absolutely do NOT miss this! - Such a wonderful night....absolutely completely felt safe on the scooters. The food was delicious, and my husband's weird food requirements were totally taken care of. A really wonderful evening and worth every moment of precious vacation time.
Don't miss it!

The most delicious thing to do in Saigon! - My cousin and I did the food tour and we didn't really know exactly what to expect, but we were so chuffed with the experience. The riders were absolutely great-super friendly and very funny-and the tour leader was really excellent at his job. We tried a lot of food, the vast majority of which you wouldn't eat unless a local gave you a tip, and saw parts of the city where there are virtually no tourists. I'm not sure if I would eat a fertilised duck egg again, but at least I can now say I've tried it. Everyone should do this tour-it was a huge highlight. Congratulations and thanks to XO Tours for an unforgettable experience.

Super Guides and Very Well Organized Fun - We did the Saigon by Night tour and had a fabulous time. Guides were outstanding and the food stops were great. The route the company has worked out gets you out of the District 1 tourist zone, which is well worth doing.

Although 2.5 hours might seem short for $US38, they are providing the food, guides a cut above what we experienced with another company (problem factor was drivers, male, too aggressive) and you'll be pretty well ready to call it a night after zooming around for that length of time.

Because of the traffic conditions in HCMC, you really need to go with an outfit committed to driving safety. XO seems to really work to take on Guides that really drive very well, wants you to have fun and feel safe. I felt very well taken care of by my Guide Trang, who was a super driver and a charming lady to boot. Highly recommended tour and tour provider.

The guides are the best part! - We just finished the foodie tour and had an awesome time! Our favorite part was just chatting with the guides about life. They're all so lovely, and the food was exceptional too! Totally worth the money. They take good care of you and you learn a lot about HCMC and Vietnam. The tour leader, Tai, is great too. Very witty and knowledgeable

So much fun! - While the Foodie tour is a little pricey for what it is, it sure is a lot of fun! I enjoyed conversation with my driver, Yen, the entire trip. She was super friendly and sweet with excellent English skills. She also did a great job showing me sights along the way and explaining some Vietnamese traditions. I went on the trip with my husband and a friend from Holland who also had a great time and really enjoyed their drivers. I highly recommend this tour to visitors from all over the world and to my friends who plan to visit.

Great Tour - I did the tour with my wife and this was our first time on a bike, considering the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City it was relaxed and we felt quite safe. My wife is vegetarian and they easily catered for her while I ate most of the food offered (too much to eat it all). A great way to see the city while enjoying some great food and great company from the girls

One of the BEST things we did in Vietnam - We only had 1 day in HCMC (Saigon) and wanted to see some of the city... we found xo tours and couldn't have been happier! Not only did we get an amazing tour of the city, on the exciting and crazy motorbikes, we got to feel like part of the people who live there. We did the foodie tour in the evening and highly recommend it!

The guides were awesome and we couldn't believe how easily they navigated the traffic and were able to drive us around! The were awesome! We added on the video option and had our own camera crew video our tour!

Do not hesitate to do this... in fact I don't think your visit to HCMC would be complete without doing this!

Jump on and experience the BEST way to see HCMC!!! - I really wanted to do a motorbike tours while is Ho Chi Minh city. We picked this through a friends recommendation. We definitely weren't disappointed. The girls who ride the bike and so sweet and friendly and take real good care of you. I had some great conversation with them (whilst they were riding the bike!) The tour guides were lovely very knowledgeable and made the whole experience fun. We even enjoyed drinking the sugar cane juice whilst on the bikes. I would definitely recommend this company.

Definite Thumbs Up! - My boyfriend and I have just spent 5 days in Ho Chi Minh City and took advantage of the Sights, Shopping and Foodie tour with XO. The team were fantastic, punctual, informative and full of energy.
Being on a scooter in HCMC puts a totally different perspective on things and we had the insider information to go with it.
The foodie tour is definitely the highlight - some interesting dishes but such fun!
No hesitation in recommending them! Brilliant!

Excellent food tour - We did the night foodie tour with XO Tours, and it was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon. This company is very well organized, and booking was extremely convenient and fast. Tai, our group tour guide, did an excellent job explaining what was going on and always made sure we had all of the food we wanted. Our two drivers, Hoang and Van, spoke excellent English, and were extremely friendly and informative, and also very safe drivers. The tour took us to multiple districts within Vietnam, and really gave us a sense of how different the areas can be. The food was all around fantastic, and the variety you get to experience is really interesting. We're really glad to have done this tour and wouldn't hesitate to do it again.

Great tour, great food and a fantastic insight to the city - We went on the "foodie" tour. It was really a fantastic experience.
We drove through many districts of ho chi minh.
This really allowed us to see the actual city. It was very interesting and it is definitely worth looking beyond district 1 .

We stopped at 3 places for food. All of which were great. I ate many things I usually would have avoided

The only thing that I found slightly annoying was that the security measures by the tour leaders is slightly over the top. Crossing the road with you and accompanying you to the bathroom takes it slightly too far. But I guess better safe than sorry!

Great Tour! - Tried both The Foodie and The Sights tours and they were awesome! Tour guides were super friendly and the motor ride was so fun! The Sights tour is an excellent way to first familiarize yourself with Ho Chi Minh before you decide to start exploring on your own. It was very well organized and the time flew by so quick, The Foodie tour is another great option. The food they serve you is not your typical "tourist" food, but more authentic local cuisines that tourists won't necessarily try or be aware of on their own. The Foodie tour also showed us other parts of the city that were a lot less known to the the tourists.

One of the highlights in HCMC - We booked this tour based on the reviews on the internet and did not get disappointed at all! Our two drivers, Truc and Nhan, made us feel very safe and comfortable in the traffic chaos of HCMC. They also gave us a lot of interesting information about the districts we were driving through. The trip was well organized and the food was really tasty. We would definitely recommend this tour!

Great way to see the city! - I did both the Foodie Tour and the Sights Tour. I would recommend doing the sights tour 1st when you get to the city as you don't get to go inside some of the sights in which you need to pay. The food tour was great and that was a larger group which is nice, especially when you try different foods. I did pay to have both taped video tours which was an added bonus. Touring HCMC on a motor bike was a great experience and both of my tour guides were very knowledgable about the city and we're fluent in English which was nice since I was traveling alone.

FACED MY FEAR AND WILL NEVER FORGET IT - My husband has tried many times to get me to do a motorbike tour in Asia, and I have always resisted as I thought it was too dangerous. However, while browsing through things to do in Saigon on TripAdvisor, XO tours came out tops. I read through all the reviews and, in a spur of the moment decision, booked it! When we met our beautiful lady drivers, I was instantly put at ease. Truc was so reassuring. After 5 minutes on the back of the bike, I had completely forgotten by fear, the crazy traffic that is Saigon, and any worry of falling off the bike! The girls are so friendly and informative, they speak fantastic English, and were great fun. We did the Saigon by Night tour which included a choice of food from a street vendor. It was delicious!! I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. I was on a high for hours afterward! Thank you thank you thank you XO tours.

Cultural and gastronomical delight - This was one of the most entertaining and enjoyable trips in my travels so far across Vietnam. My tour guide Ngan was both knowledgeable and careful on the rides between districts and the food we had was second to none and much more authentic than what we would have tried otherwise. This combined with a few cheerful lessons about every day life amongst the Vietnamese and some history about the districts made it a perfect tour for newcomers to this wonderful country. Would definitely recommend for everyone

The no 1 highlight of my holiday in HCMC! - This was definitely the best thing and most enjoyable activity I did in HCMC. Prior to the trip, I have corresponded with Tung via email to follow up and finalize my bookings. The responses were alwags prompt and courteous.
We were picked up in front of our hotel punctually at 525pm by our two excellent guides, Vy and Truc. Despite the heavy traffic conditions in HCMC, we felt very safe and comfortable as our drivers maneuvered skillfully and safely through the traffic. Our guides were very engaging and took very good care of us, watching out for our safety and valuables as well as serving us food (peeling our prawns and crabs etc ). Aside from the delicious food, we were driven through 5 districts and I really appreciated the opportunity to see the lifestyle of locals in these districts (Where tourist would usually not wander into). The tour was very professionally conducted and well organized. Our tour leader Tai did a great job with the comentaries and made sure to connect with each and every guest throughout the evening. Well done xotours!!

Well Organized. Fun & Furious. Tasty Food - Did a foodie tour with 7 others tonight. Highly recommended!

- Well Organized: From booking to payment. Tour Guide was with us the entire night, explaining various things at every stop. My driver (Dhun?) was polite and spoke fluent, conversational English.
- Fun: Besides sampling a range of Vietnamese food, we also played games and poked fun at each other!
- Furious: Not a fan of motordups in Vietnam and I was scared in the first 20 mins but Dhun was a safe driver and it was a great way to see other parts of Saigon at night.
- Tasty Food: You get to eat what Vietnamese people eat, not food made for "foreigners". For me, I just couldn't stomach the duck embryo!

Thrilling Way to See and Taste in HCMC - Our family of three took both the Foody Tour and Sights Tour and enjoyed them both immensely! Our sweet scooter drivers did the safest job weaving in and out of night traffic to each food destination throughout different districts of the city. When we arrived, great food and drink waiting! The next morning we took the Sights Tour where again our dear scooter drivers got us safely around the hectic city to see the wonderful sights. The guys gave us the history of what we were seeing and this information was very insightful. I would recommend to anyone visiting the city!

XO Foodie Tour - Decided to book this before we arrived and what a great decision this was well worth the money, a superb night out made more so by the girls and staff who look after you throughout.
Met outside our hotel at 5.30 by two lovely ladies with there bikes Nhan & Van who were our drivers for the night and made it so much fun chatting away with us during the tour as we drove around the city.
Tried a few new dishes goat, frog to mention two but passed on that egg towards the end of the night as much as I was tempted is was not for me, left that to one of the girls who enjoyed !!

Thanks to Nhan, Van and not forgetting Tai who was a lot of fun keeping all involved.

If we visit again XO will be on our must do again list.

Fun and Delicious! - This is a review of the foodie tour that XO offers. The tour was great!

Let's start at the beginning - our tour guides picked us up right on time and we hopped on the back of their scooters to the first meeting spot. We then met up with the rest of the tour group. The tour had great support staff that made sure everything was taken care of by the time the group arrived.
As the website describes - we ate food that i wouldn't even begin to know how to find if it were up to me. Frogs legs, the most delicious scallops ever, clams, goat, prawns, etc.
The tour also included a good bit about the history and landscape of Saigon.
It's a little bit expensive compared to everything else in vietnam, but you feel like totally taken care of the whole entire time you are with the tour.

Great fun, don't be put off by being on a motorbike! - I'm not sure I can add a lot to the previous comments, this is a fantastic idea and delivered extremely well. My wife and I had never been on motorbikes before but you felt safe immediately. The girls who drove us around and the tour leader were charming and a lot of fun. Learnt lots about Saigon as well as having a wonderful experience - we did the foodie evening trip and I genuinely believe its something we will never forget.

Worth every penny! - In Vietnam terms, this is not a cheap tour by any means and that almost put me off. However, it is worth every penny and was certainly the single highlight of my time in Ho Chi Minh City.

You are picked up by your personal female driver, wearing a traditional Vietnamese Ao Dai uniform, from your hotel and driving around outer HCMC on motorbike visiting various street food areas and points of interest. The tour lasts for 5 hours in total and is a great opportunity to get outside of the tourist-laden District 1 area and see the more local side of HCMC. You get to enjoy some fantastic food and drink, including grilled frog, prawns and the infamous Balut egg...close your eyes, get over the texture and just enjoy the rich taste!! It all tastes delicious!

All of the guides are friendly, knowledgeable and, perhaps most importantly, safe drivers in what has to be one of the most densely populated cities in the world for motorbikes.

Don't miss this!

Great fun from a different perspective - Did the Food tour and it was 4.5 hours of fun!

Met at the hotel entrance by 3 cute girls who were to be our guides for the night.

We were taken along 5 districts in Ho Chi Minh and there were 3 food stops that i can recall!

The highlight was most definitely the very chatty girls zooming expertly through the city traffic.

I would whole heartedly recommend this to anyone!

Those 4.5 hours will fly by and you'll have a belly full of food at the end of it.

*RIBBIT*

Believe the hype - What a fabulous way to see the city, meet some wonderful people and eat some adventurous food. We did the Foodie Tour.
Pick-up from the hotel was prompted. The 3 girls we had looking after us were absolutely fantastic. Not only did they drive us everywhere, but at each restaurant they were constantly tending to your every need (ordering more drinks, peeling your prawns, cooking your goat).
Word of warning - the food is a bit out there, so be prepared. But its properly authentic and that's the whole point. Also, my wife can't eat shellfish and the staff went out of there way to substitute her seafood meals with other dishes (which were often better!!).
Takes a little while to get used to being in the chaos that is Saigon traffic, but the girls really are wonderful drivers.
Highly recommended - enjoy.

Best social experience (Foodie!) - We had this tour on our last night in Saigon. I should say we made a good decision on this. The best thing to finish our Saigon trip!

We selected the Foodie tour.Via email, the manager 'Tung' was very quick to respond to our inquiries.The scheduled pick up time is 5:20PM and right on time two ladies('Tam' and 'Y') in bikes arrived in front of our hotel.

The foodie tour consists of 5 stops, 3 food stops and 2 area stops. Being true to their word, all these stops are outside the tourist area. The setup is that a lady(in my case, 'Tam') will be the one to drive you to the locations, they will also be the ones to prepare food for you and they will sit beside you while you eat and chat with other guests. The ladies were very fluent in English which really helped with the conversation. They are very friendly and so much fun to be with. To top all this, they really drive the scooters very safely.

It is a very good experience venturing the city and the different districts not well known to tourists.
For sure this won't be the last. =)

amazing experience - If you do any tour in Saigon, make sure to go with these guys. The foodie tour was by far the best tour I've ever done anywhere. The girls were fun and informative, and the restaurants we visited were amazing. DO THIS.

Saigon By Night Tour - My wife and I did the above tour and found it well worth while. The girls were friendly, helpful...and great drivers! The tour was well organized, pick-up was on time, and the places visited were interesting.

Fun, food, and zippy bikes - Found out about this foodies tour from a usa travel agent & then checked it out on trip advisor. The girl drivers were friendly & safe as they dodged the traffic. We got to see districts 7 & 4 where we wouldn't of gone - a great way to see all the parts of Saigon. Tried some different foods - but not all. Would highly recommend this - lots of Laughs. Thanks to Vi3 & Hou?.

Best thing we have done in 3 months of traveling! - We had a fantastic night on the Foodies tour. The night seemed to have been organized with military precision and we tried many delicious new foods. Our tour leader Tai was great and taught us a lot about Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnam in general. My guide Tsui was hilarious and we both really enjoyed spending time with all the girls working that night. We have recommended this tour to anyone we have spoken to since as we had such a great time!

Even with a 4 year old--Excellent! - Went on the day time sights tour with my 4 year old son. Had a great time and was able to enjoy the tour while my son got to enjoy the scooter ride and was well taken care by the rest of the crew! Great way to take in many of the most popular sights and get to see where many things are in District 1 before setting out on our own.

Why haven't you done this tour already? - My husband and I just got back from the foodie tour. Can someone please roll me over? So much delicious food. I am vegetarian and my husband does not red meat, and we were more than catered for. We didn't feel like we were missing out, if anything we felt like we were getting more. We weren't scared of being on the back of the bike, we felt more than comfortable. Very safe and secure. Girls are lovely too. Thanks guys!

If you only do one thing in Saigon, do this tour - Did the night time foodie tour, and it was the best decision! Absolutely incredible form start to finish. The communication before hand was great, the pick up was on time. Tai, our tour leader, was fantastic and very funny. My driver, Vy, was amazing! I had a great time chatting to her, and I felt safe on the roads. It's amazing to see such tiny girls hauling bikes and people around.

I got some amazing pictures, saw so many places, ate SO much food. Definitely some food I wouldn't ever try by myself!

I can honestly say that I will never forget the feeling of winding through traffic, and the sight of Saigon at night over water. Incredible.

Thank you SO much to everyone at XO

Fantastic Trip - We did the “Sights Tour” my wife was nervous of going of the scooter despite me riding a motor bike back in the UK. When the time arrived the girls put here at ease and she thoroughly enjoyed the evening. We stopped at a couple of times, once to choose our food from the street vendors. Later all the bikes stopped for us to eat and we got chatting with the other 6 people on the tour. A fantastic trip. On the upside the wife has agreed to ride pillion bike in the UK so thanks very much XO!

No question - The highlight of our visit to Saigon - We did the Foodie tour as a family of four last weeks, our youngest son being 11 years old. We had some reservations about whether the 11 year old would be okay by himself on a scooter before the tour began, giving the traffic in HCM. However we needn't have worried as we were in great hands all night and within minutes he felt completely at ease. Tai and all the girls are fantastic - engaging and humorous. My driver, Ninh and I chatted, laughed and even sang (badly) our way through the evening.

For us it was definitely the highlight of our vacation, both our boys have been talking about if for days afterward - high praise especially coming from a grunting 17 year old male.

If you do only one thing in HCM, do the foodie tour with XO!

So fascinating! - Just another glowing review. We had such an awesome night with Yen & Trang, and the XO crew. Delicious food and brilliant memories. A really fantastic night, if you can afford to treat yourself then book this tour in. Amazing to visit all the different districts that we wouldn't have seen otherwise. It was so nice talking with Yen & Trang, they were so lovely and funny, so many laughs after some monkey wine! The only thing I might suggest is to finish in district 1 near all the hotels so that if anyone did want to keep the party going (perhaps with another duck egg) it would be possible. Other than that tiny thought - so so good. Loved it!

Great insight into delicious street food - We went as a group of 5. It gave us a great insight into delicious street food, as well as an entertaining evening. Our guides were friendly & professional, and very safe drivers. We had over 5 hours of riding around HCMC, eating, drinking & chatting. Well worth the money.

Just do it! - I am a grumpy old man (my wife's description) who done it all and doesn't like organized tours, but I do like food. I wasn't sure about the motor bikes, so I did have some concerns but I loved it!

Tai the tour guide is a hoot, and my driver Tien was an Angel who looked after me as we glided in and out of the traffic. She even sat next to me at the food stops and peeled my prawns, BBQ my goat, put the right things on each and every dish. What a fun evening. They have a number of 'guards' who ride with the group, it seems their role is to direct the traffic when 15 scooters leave a food stall, guard the bikes when parked and generally act as waiters.

Tips
1) Book before you arrive otherwise the traffic will scare you to death, and you won't book.
2) You will be challenged to eat some 'interesting' things but they do accommodate vegetarian and those who don't like spice.
3) You may think you're too old, we had an 80 year old celebrate his birthday on our tour. If you can get your leg over the bike you can do it.

If you do 1 thing in HCMC make it this! - We chose to do the night Foodie Tour our very last night in Vietnam after a 30 day trip. What a way to end. We loved it! None of the previous reviews are exaggerated. Wonderful from start to finish. We had delightful guides in Tam and Tram. Their driving was safe, their conversation interesting and interested and the food was sensational. Peter even tried the Balut. His fault apparently for telling Tam that he would eat everything! We had 3 absolute highlights of our trip to Vietnam and this was top of the list. Don't fret about being on a motorbike, or eating street food, just DO IT!!

Not to be missed - XO tours really is as good as the reviews here.
When you arrive in Ho Chi Minh City just crossing the road looks daunting, the hundreds of motorbikes and scooters might even look scary at first sight.
These lovely young ladies will take good care of you as you weave through the congestion and ride through the streets amongst the rest of the pack, now add into the mix all the carefully thought out places they will take you to visit and their local knowledge of each one.
They make it seem easy but rest assured XO Tours is a slick operation which will exceed your expectations, do it.

FANTASTIC! - We read about this tour online and were amazed by the reviews, so we signed up. First contact with the company was really impressive - I received prompt replies from Tung, and they were also flexible as I had to swap days for the tour due to other tours canceling.
The foodie tour itself was outstanding - the girls arrived to pick us up from the Opera House and we immediately felt at ease within 5mins of being on the back of the scooters. They were very calm, patient and spoke extremely good English. The food on offer was a fantastic variety and really did embrace the true Vietnamese culture. The scallops are still fresh on my mind! The girls are like your personal chefs - they peeled the prawns and fed you and guaranteed you were well hydrated at all times!

Second time and still amazing!!! - My husband and I did the night foodie tour with XO tours last year. I was very hesitant to do the tour, because of two things, first being that I had never really been on a motorbike/scooter before, and the second reason being the traffic in HCMC. But I can assure you, there was no reason to be worried, this was one of the best tours that we have ever experienced. So good, that when we returned to HCMC again this year with a couple of friends, we just had to do it all over again, and let them have the same experience. Of course, they loved it as well. A very professional company with lovely friendly girls, and a great way to see the city, not to mention the variety of food included. I cannot recommend this enough. I will definitely do it a third time!!!

A super fun evening in Saigon! - We ran into two separate groups of people in our travels in Vietnam who had earlier gone on an XO Tours tour that were raving about it. So when we finally got to Saigon in the latter part of our trip, I immediately emailed to see if there was availability for a tour that night. The only option available was the "Foodie" tour, and I am so glad that we went on this! It was a super fun night! The girls who drove us around were very friendly, with excellent English, and it was so fun to cruise around the city by motorbike; it's not scary at all riding with them either. All of the food we ate at the various places was excellent and we had such a great time. They also took pictures during the tour & emailed them to us about 7 days later. We got to see so much of the city that evening, and riding on motorbike, like everyone else in the city, was a big hit for us. Plus the food we got to experience, we would have never been able to try on our own. Well worth going on a "foodie" tour with XO Tours; such much fun! Postscript - after our tour was over, we hung out with others who went on our tour and quickly made friends with all of them. That evening in Saigon is one we won't forget!

The best thing in Saigon! - We absolutely loved every minute of our tour and cannot recommend it enough! The girls are super friendly and expert drivers. We were both a bit nervous at first but within a few minutes felt completely at ease.

We liked that you meet up with a group to explore sights more. Ben the tour manager is brilliant and really made the tour special. He's also an excellent photographer - we love the photos that he took of us and were really impressed when they were emailed so quickly afterward. It's really a five star service!

The sights tour is the perfect way to learn more about the main sights, get your bearings in Saigon and feel like you've become a local as you zip about on the back of the bike drinking sugar cane juice - a once in a lifetime experience!

One tip, we thought it wouldn't be safe to take our good camera on the tour but learned that the girls' bikes have space under the seat to keep things safe. We wished we'd taken our SLR camera....

By far my favorite part of our trip to Saigon - Loved everything about this tour. It was one of the "pricier" things we did on our vacation, which isn't saying too much since the entire trip was very inexpensive, but it was well worth it. Saigon was our first stop on our trip to Vietnam so this was a great introduction, but there were several other people on our tour that this was the last part of their trip and found it to be a great way to end their vacation. You hope on the back of a scooter with a guide in traditional dress and they speed you off to several places in the city. It was a great way to see parts of the city you might never see otherwise. We got to try a lot of different Vietnamese cuisines, some more exotic than others. They took some pictures for you and emailed it afterward, which is a nice bonus. The guides are fun, knowledgeable, and speak English very well.

Great fun and very professional! - My girlfriend and I had one day in Ho Chi Minh City. Rather than waste a whole day just trying to navigate around an unfamiliar foreign city searching for the main attractions, we chose to do a private tour with XO Tours to see the key points of interest quickly and easily.

The two ladies on the scooter bikes arrived at the front of our hotel on time and were very professional, knowledgeable and friendly. They spoke very good English and were able to tell us a lot about their city as we rode around between attractions.

My girlfriend was initially apprehensive about doing a tour on the back of a bike as she was concerned for her personal welfare, but the tour guides driving the bikes were very skilled, safe and steady in the traffic, and my girlfriend felt safe at all times.

I really liked how we would stop at what would initially appear to be a nondescript street corner or location. Tung the tour leader will pull out his Ipad and show us a black and white photo from the 1960's of what had actually occurred at that exact location, and then the significance of what we were looking at became apparent.

As we rode around, Tung even got us a sugar cane drink and native Vietnamese fruit to eat. And we got a small surprise free gift at the end of the tour.

This is an extremely professional and well run operation and I can confidently recommend it to other tourists who have some time to kill in HCMC. The real stand out of the tour though is the young ladies that ride the bikes and chaperone us around the city - they are intelligent, friendly, fun and have real personality.

Thanks!

The best tour in Saigon - We just got off the city tour, not really knowing what to expect, but as with the rest of the reviews, do yourself a favor and go. Great staff, great interaction, great knowledge, good English language, and great fun. We did not feel unsafe on the scooters and we are over 50 years of age!

Having a blast on the streets of HCMC - Did the Saigon by Night tour tonight together with my two colleagues. We had a blast zooming around five districts of HCMC with our super-charming, cheeky driverettes. We zig-zagged through a crowded market in Chinatown, whizzed past the lovers' "lounge-chairs in the bushes" hideout before taking a parade-drive down the glitzy avenues of District 7. All while feeling totally safe and thoroughly entertained. And along the way, snacks and deserts were served, all of which were really tasty. My personal favorite was the delicious sugarcane juice. We discovered that all the hype about XO on the internet is fully deserved: The XO Tours experience strikes that magical balance between being reassuringly professional and at the same time a bubbly, personal, blast of a two-wheelin' good time! I will head straight for the full Foodie tour next time I am in HCMC!!!

Must do if in Ho Chi Minh - We did this on the second day of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. The guides turned up at the time they said and were very friendly and spoke great English. They drove very safely and took us to places where we wouldn't normally have gone - Chinese Temple and Local Market. They knew their history very well and the 2.5hours flew by. Well worth the money paid.

Do this first! - Th night food tour is a MUST for any visitor to Ho Chi Minh City. You will see places not accessible to other tourists and experience foods you never imagined. The driver-guides are charming, smart, hospitable, fun, and very safe motorbike drivers. Tai, the group leader, is entertaining and thorough. The tour was very well-designed, well-organized, well-executed, and worth every penny. I can't think of any way to improve it!

The Best Tour - The 2 tours I did with my 12 year old son is something I will never forget, the tour guides are absolutely amazing, Tai looked after us so well on our shopping tour, I am having trouble finding words to match my gratitude to Tai for the love & care he showed us. The food tour was awesome, sooo much food, the beautiful guide my son had really made it an enjoyable experience for him, he is very shy, however, she managed to bring him out of his shell & he radiated with confidence.

Everyone visiting Saigon must do at least one tour with XO, it will be a truly unforgettable experience!!

All that is good in Vietnam - I have to agree that it is no.1 thing to do in Ho Chi Minh and even Vietnam.
If you have a sense of adventure book up the foodie tour.
Met at hotel my the beautiful England. Great guide and good English. Made me feel at ease on a moped during rush hour in Ho Chi Minh!
Very interesting to chat to. Full of questions and answers. We ate everything on offer. We are big lads and we had more than we could eat and lots of 333 !
Deep fried frog, goat, sea food, chilli crab and the dreaded Balut. This is the half developed duck egg. It tasted ok but the texture and sight of it was not so good. Once but never again. This is a tour you have to throw yourself into. We had a couple from Germany on our tour that were lots of fun and a few Americans. All had great times.
If you do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City, do this.

Sensational! - I don't even know where to start! This tour is a must-do and the best way to see Ho Chi Minh.

My husband and I, as part of our honeymoon, decided to do the Street Food Tour. The tour guide were so helpful when I told them I was vegetarian and arranged special meals for me.

Our two lovely drivers for the evening were just so polite and friendly, they told us about the city as we whizzed through the different districts and answered all of our questions.

The food was.... to die for. Everything we ate was so delicious that I have a hard time picking a favorite!

The tour itself is very safe and the whole time we felt extremely well looked after.

It was just so much fun, more than just being a tour it was an experience and one my husband and I really enjoyed and REALLY recommend. Thanks so much for showing us your lovely city!

For more reviews and stories from around the world check out my website: littlegreybox.net

Brilliant, just BRILLIANT! - After traveling for a month in Vietnam I have to say, the FOODIE tour we did on our second evening in Saigon turned out to be the best tour of the whole trip. Two lovely tiny Vietnamese ladies (girls) collected my wife and I on their scooters and off we were whisked to meet another few people and spent the next 4 hours experiencing real authentic food in real authentic settings.

I found it really funny that my driver asked me to hold on to the scooter on the rear handles whilst my wife was allowed to hold on around her drivers waist! Argh well... :-)

Really, you MUST do this tour. It's foodie-fab!

Fun on two wheels - Have just had a great morning out on two wheels doing the Sights Tour, on the back of Milkys bike( sorry for the spelling) it was fab! Your in the traffic rather than just watching it gobsmacked. We did some stops at interesting places and learned some things about Vietnam and it's history in a fun way, had a dessert at the markets and had a great time. It isn't scary it is just really with doing. If I were in town another day I would do the Foodie Tour. The girls are great and it is very professional.

A great way to see the sights! - This tour was a lot of fun! We did the Street Food Tour and were picked up from our hotel by two of the loveliest and funniest girls who spoke fantastic English. Our first stop was our first food stop where we had an amazing beef soup, where we had all the introductions of everyone else in the tour group as well as our tour guides. Very informative and funny too! The drivers looked after their guests and drove us so well, I have to admit I was scared to get on the back of a scooter at first but after my first ride I wanted to be right on that scooter again!! We had a fantastic night, but just wished we had a few more food stops as we thought there would be a little more food during the tour. Well done XO Tours, keep up the great work!

So much fun! - From the moment of booking through to the follow up email with photos from the evening Xo Tours has been simply fantastic. What a great way to see Ho Chi Minh at night and experience Vietnamese cuisine! The food was wonderful, the guide, drivers and all the staff brilliant and the company was a pleasure. We had so much fun and enjoyed a laugh with the other guests.

This is one tour you don't want to miss out on - Foodie Tour.

Great way to see the major sights - The Sights tour is a great introduction to Ho Chi Minh City, allowing you to see the main attractions in a unique and adventurous way, whizzing in and out of the many millions of scooters accompanying you along the way!
It also forms a starting base to understand what there is to see and do around the city, such as, individual visits to the War Remnants Museum and China Town.
Highly recommended!

Foodie Tour - By far the slickest tour we did in Vietnam, each person has a driver who speaks perfect English and is good fun, supported by a small team of support staff, it runs like clockwork. it's great fun and the food is fantastic. I was skeptical at first as other similar tours we cheaper but afterward was very satisfied we picked the best tour.

Best tour ever so does it right with their great people, cycles and food - Motor biking in Ho Chi Minh city is an experience not to be missed. So exciting to be dodging other cycles and vehicles and being next to Vietnamese families on their cycles. All young bright girls driving their own bikes with us on the back. Felt safe and secure. And the street food was to die for. So many unusual foods all of them delicious and zero tourists except for us at the places went. Free beer as much as you can drink. 4.5 hours of absolute delight

XO Motocycle Tour- Ho Chi Minh City by Night - If you make it to Ho Chi Minh City, don't miss this adventure!!
The tour picks you up at tour hotel, one person per motorbike, driven by a lovely young lady in the traditional Oa Dai dress. Everyone wears a helmet and the tour stressed safety first--we even have a cadre of 3-4 male "bodyguards" who accompany us, mostly in case of a motorbike problem.
This was such fun--we saw all areas of the city at night, stopped at restaurants specializing in street-food cuisine and mostly talked non-stop with our sweet, chatty twenty-something drivers who were beautifully fluent in English but hungry to learn more. They talked about their life in the city as we whizzed thru traffic and sat and outdoor restaurants. They introduced us to street food and helped us as we learned to eat it. We began with the traditional soup, but quickly moved on to scallops, prawns, goat, frogs and even balut-duck embryo eggs.
Food was presented well-all you could eat. No limits on beer and non-alcololic drinks.
The food was good, our male guide leader was great, our night ride though Ho Chi Minh City was unforgettable, but talking to the young ladies for 3 hours was the highlight.
Having never been on a motorcycle, I had no idea what to expect. The SE Asian motorcycle traffic is a masterpiece of choreography when you watch from afar. Riding in it is an all time trip. An experience not to be missed!
Book in advance--the groups are small and you pay in cash at the end.
I brought my camera--but kept it close in front when we were in traffic.
I took a small backpack but it was a nuisance.
The trip leader asked me to remove my earnings and necklace--just in case.
And we had no issues, felt perfectly safe, comfortable on the bike and just had a ball. A really well run trip and exceptional young women guides. Amazing bright and fluent ambassadors for the city--many of whom go back at 10 PM to finish homework before their college classes the next morning.
Can't say enough to recommend this outing.

Best experience in all of Vietnam - Every traveler in HCMC who has ever done XO Tours or have heard travelers experience XO Tours, ALL say the same thing. MUST DO. XO Tours has their own unique way of experiencing Siagon. I did the foodie tour. I won't spoil it for you, but it will be an experience of a lifetime. Very professionally run, friendly staff with great sense of humor. Our tour leader Khanh and my driver V (very cute) were very personable and loved sharing their knowledge on Siagon cuisine and culture. Girl Power:)

What a great night out! - We loved the experience of seeing Ho Chi Minh city on the back of a scooter. Perhaps not for the faint hearted - but what an adventure! We enjoyed seeing the attractions and tasting lots of great food on the Foodie Tour. Thanks ladies!

So much fun! - Have to say, I wasn't 100% convinced that this will be THAT good as many people wrote on here, but I was wrong.

We are a couple in their early and late 20s, and this was our first authentic Vietnamese experience. I have no doubt that I tried probably the best seafood I will ever have for a long while.

It was great also being taken to other districts and seeing the wider Saigon. We went in a group tour, which I think is much better than a private. So much laughing all around.

We have the tunnels and delta tours coming up, but I don't think they will top this.

Great time... Great experience - Ok where do I begin! It was my first time in Vietnam, and first time in HCMC. I love food and wanted to see the city. Lurking the many things that HCMC offers, i settled up on the highly rated XO tours.. and it did NOT disappoint. Very easy to book; a few emails back and forth. Hotel pickup is included.
A great tour of the city that took us to the various districts, providing a brief and tasty history of things. Would have definitely not seen as much as I did without the fun people at XO. This tour was, well, a lot of FUN! it really was. Winding through the steets of HCMC on the back of aa little moto is an experience in itself; and a true representation of what HCMC is like.
The tour leader was hilarious and created for a great atmosphere.
The XO girl that took me around was Thuy. She was so nice and extremely easy to talk to. Really engaging and gave me a good idea of ​​what people in HCMC are like. I really thank her for making this tour what it was; and the food was great too!
I can safely say that the food on this tour was some of the best food I have ever had in Asia!
Thanks XO ! keep up the good work.

Best activity we did in Saigon - Wow...I imagine what life would have been like without us booking our dinner with XO tours and it's bleak. We had such a fantastic time with these guys that we still talk about it. At first, the thought of being part of the frenzied stream of scooters in Saigon's traffic threw me in cold panic. Very though soon, i realized my tour guide was confident and experienced, and i had nothing to worry about. I can't think of a better way to get a taste (literally and metaphorically speaking) of the various districts of the city. Saigon is big. There are may be places where perhaps you'd like to linger a lil longer, but there are also places you want to see, but not necessarily stay too long in (eg i was grateful I got to see the Chinese market without having to go through it by foot).
The XO team made our night. They gave us confidence on the road, took care of us at dinner by showing us how to eat and cook the food (my guide actually fed me!), friendly, smart, witty. Add to that amazing street food and great weather and you have a perfect evening. I now recommend this tour to everyone who asks me for travel advice in Vietnam.

Can't book - Is this group too cool now? I tried to book via email but no reply. It was a late booking but even if they were fully booked an email advising this would have been appreciated. Got a private tour for one third the price. Too bad XO.

Fabulous night out! - Have been on a similar tour with another company during my last trip to Ho Chi Minh City.
XO Foodie Tour is by far better and much more fun. Tour Leader Tai has a great sense of humor and easily passes on his vast knowledge of the city to his clients. From the time of pick-up at the hotel until drop-off the girls make you feel comfortable and safe, it was a shame it had to end. There was lots of laughter and social interaction among all on the tour. Good luck to all at XO Tours.

6 out of 5 for sure - Unfortunately we were only in Ho Chi Minh City ' in transit' during the day, and couldnt do the night 'foodie' tour, but the day tour (9am) was still fantastic, if not very hot.
We actually arrived a day earlier than our tour booking, however Tung and the girls sorted this out quite quickly, and were so accommodating to send over two extra guides and catch us up with the main group only 15 or so minutes later.
Thuong and Anh were absolutely fantastic - couldn't say enough positive things about these girls. Thuong buzzes around on her scooter (which I was told was only a couple of months old) like a pro around extremely busy streets, and you never feel like you are in any danger at all, even while holding on by one hand while drinking a lovely sugar cane and kumquat juice in the other !
Great sites, history and stories from Tai - but the highlights are no doubt the girls and the scooters - an aweome way to see the city.

Thanks Thong and Anh.

Private Foodies Tour for Brian's 60th Birthday - Fantastic Fun!
This tour had been recommended by a work colleague and was booked prior to our departure from Australia, as a surprise for my husband's 60th Birthday.
We were collected from our hotel by Khanh, Ngan, Truc & Y - four gorgeous girls who made us feel very comfortable on the back of their motor scooters in busy Ho Chi Minh City, showing us around their wonderful city and feeding us some amazing food that we may not have eaten elsewhere!
Highly recommend this tour to anyone considering a night of fun and sightseeing.
Thank you to the gorgeous girls for a great night and the lovely birthday cake that topped off a very memorable night for Brian's 60th Birthday!
The photos and video are an added bonus that will continually remind us of a fun night with some special friends.

Best thing to do in hcmc - Perfect, for 800 000 dong /person a lady comes to your hotel and takes you to your group.

You spend approx 2.5hrs touring the city (which appears crazy for a first time visitor like myself!) weaving in and out of traffic to each meeting point. Your guide explains things on the way- which is then expanded on by tour leader.

Get to sample local fruits, drinks an see the sights. The tour guide takes pictures of you too. A very fun, entertaining and believe it or not safe way to get sights done in a quick manner. Couldn't rate it better.

Absolutely Fantastic - Foodie Tour - We had this tour recommended to us prior to leaving Australia. We spent 2 weeks in Vietnam and this tour rated very highly among all of the activities that we indulged in. I would recommend this tour to anyone wishing to get a close to the food culture in Saigon. Thanks to the XO tour team for a fantastic and fun filled evening out on the streets in Saigon.

SPLENDID!! - Splendid! The exact word that describes the tour and our two tour guides: Thuong and Hoang. We took the Saigon by night tour and drove around different districts, provided by interesting information by our tour guides and explored the Vietnamese street food which was delicious! We can only recommend this tour, don't be afraid (like i in first instance was) from the horrible traffic with scooters. Both tour guides are amazing scooter drivers, securing your safety all the time. This was a highlight of our honeymoon! Best regards, Véronique

Awesome, awesome, awesome - We just got back from the foodie tour with XO tours and it was without a doubt the best way to see Ho Chi Minh and get a feel for what life is like living here. The food was both interesting and delicious. The guides were brilliant, really friendly, easy going and great at letting you know what real Vietnam is like on a day to day basis. My guide was in her second year at uni and took on this job to help pay bills. So she was able to give me some real, life insights into Vietnamese culture. This is a must do if you come to HCMH!!!!!

A must do! - My friend and I did this tour and liked most if not all reviews were the best time in Saigon.
No need to repeat the same stuff but everyone in the group had smiles from ear to ear.
Call or email in advance. My first choice was booked.
Don't eat a late lunch. You will get full!
Thanks Tang and Tom you girls were great!

Deep Experience - If your time is limited in HCMC, make sure you fit in an XO Foodie Tour. The girls are exceptional drivers, very safe and confident. They all speak English very well and are easy to communicate with. The variety of food was amazing, but by the end I'm so full! Lots of fun a good introduction to Vietnamese food.

Fun and safe way to see the city by bike - XO tours:
Anh is my lovelyl 22 yo driver. She grew up in a village in the far south and has been doing these tours for a year.
(1) Bun Bo Hue noodle soup
(2) BBQ at table - squid, okra, prawns, goat breast, frog; two delicious dipping sauces + fruit with chilli & salt. Plus Saigon beer and a shot of banana wine.
(3) marinaded BBQ quail; chilli crab claw; beautiful scallops in the shell with peanuts, spring onion and fish sauce; clams in hot & sour broth; 333 beers. There's also fertilized eggs but I'm good with only once this trip; wow, it looks sooo much worse watching it eaten under bright light. Dessert is coconut jelly; egg custard with caramel sauce.

It's a nice way to have a safe bike tour of parts of the city by night and is family friendly. It is pricey compared to simply going out and eating (and the food isn't nearly as good as the street food tour that I did in Hanoi) but it's a pleasant way to spend an evening in Saigon without having to think too much.

"What more can be said!!!" - I just read some of the past reviews and I am running low on additional superlatives for this truly exceptional experience! Every aspect of the Foodie Tour was expertly orchestrated by a fun and energetic team led by Ben. The young ladies driving the scooters are not only excellent drivers but terrific hosts - they are engaging, fun, full of humor and wit and will ensure that you do not leave a table hungry or thirsty. There is also a full support crew to make sure everything runs smoothly and of course our lead host, Ben, who is incredibly insightful and influential - you will learn much more about the food and cuisine as you visit some of the lesser visited districts of Saigon. You will also meet a bunch of other fun and more adventurous travelers. And, if it happens to rain, all the better! I only wish that XO had a tour in Hanoi (or that I had a second night in Saigon!). Thank you again Ben, Trang and the rest of the XO team for a memorable experience! Jeff Hauser

Amazing Experience! - What a fantastic way to spend a night in HCMC! My boyfriend and I did the XO Foodie tour last week and it was one of the highlights of our 3-week trip. I've been a long time user of tripadvisor but just opened up an account to give some positive reviews for really well deserved organizations. From start to finish, the tour team was professional, friendly and charming. The 4.5 hour tour led us to 3 delicious food stops and some sight seeing. The food is not your usual (pho, banh mi, etc) and is genuine local cuisine. It's a great way to see parts of the city you probably wouldn't venture into as a tourist and it's great fun seeing it from the back of a scooter. The tour leader (Tai) and his team (especially my guide, Ngan) were so enthusiastic about sharing their city with us. This tour is a must if you're visiting HCMC!

Must do while in Ho Chi Minh - After reading the rave reviews I didn't really think the experience could live up to the hype, but our experience was fantastic. We did the street food dinner tour, absolutely excellent. The ladies driving you around are charming and intelligent uni students, and the tour guides are well informed and show you parts of HCM city you will never have the chance to see. Not to mention the delicious street food. I strongly recommend this experience to anyone visiting HCM.

Chopstick Champion! - We really didn’t know what to expect for the Night Foody Tour, but had read great reviews from past travellers. I was so glad we got to experience Saigon on motorbike, it was the best introduction to Saigon and truly our highlight of our time there. Our guides Hoang and Ngoc were very knowledgeable about the city, and spoke English well. The information they gave us was delivered with personality which was really refreshing - usually chatting while on the bikes. We had many laughs along the way,, played some fun games, got drenched in a downpour (they gave us ponchos!) and tasted some amazing and adventurous food… I was not brave enough to try the duck embryo, but it was fascinating to learn of the food culture of the Vietnamese and eat with the locals. All the people on our tour were great fun, the guides were real larrikins and we learned a lot about each of the districts we travelled to. We felt very safe on our bikes and with the group. Tai was a great Tour Leader who took pictures to send to us all, and kept the momentum going despite us all being so full we could barely move :-) I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the real Saigon.

First experience on a motor bike - I'm hooked! - The reviews for this company were so amazing I went ahead and booked two tours in our first day in Saigon, The Sights and The Foodie Tour and both were great. We were both nervous about being on a bike in that Saigon traffic but I felt very safe. There were scary moments were someone cuts across you but I never felt in danger. Starting the holiday with this experience has meant that we've found space for more motorbike tours in the rest of our time in Vietnam.

The girls are all so charming and take such good care of you throughout the whole tour. I often find it difficult to make conversation with strangers, but the girls just made it easy and comfortable - we talked the whole time. They're so funny and very kind.

If you only do one thing in this city, make sure its an XO tour.

i can't eat anymore! - Excellent tour on my first night in HCMC. Did the night Foody Tour.
Guides are excellent and the ladies driving each person around speak very good English. They picked us up at the opera House and took us to meet with the rest of the group. We were afraid of being late due to rush hour (many of the schools in the area let out at five) and the rain began to do a heavy pour, but we called the guide and he assured us that our drivers would just have us join the group whenever we met up.
Some of the conversations about food at each location were very scripted, but I assume that was for quality control and keeping on time for the night. The guides will engage in conversation during all other times on the bike and meals, so feel free to all their questions!
Besides one exception, most of the foods shouldn't be too exotic for most travelers, and you can always opt out of any dish. Very meat oriented.

One aspect we weren't expecting is that the women guides will sit with you and clean, prep, cook, your food for you (like grilling the meat, de-shelling crab/shrimp), so it was a little awkward to be taken care of in that manner.

So good I did it twice! - Brilliant fun, you'll learn a bunch of new stuff, find out other stuff you thought you knew was wrong, meet great people, and have a smile on your face for the rest of the day. The day time sightseeing tour is great for taking pictures, the night time tour more of a cruise with fewer stops. And if you're a bit scared about riding on a scooter in such a busy city, don't be. I'm a big wuss and I was fine!

Fun + Insightful + Delicious - My fiance and I visited in October 2013, and this was our first official tour during our trip. It was hard to beat!

There are 3-4 food stops, as well as a number of informative stops to give you contrasts between different parts of the city and to give you insight into the lives of the Saigon/HCMC people. Besides the food being amazing and sometimes weird (I don't want to spoil the surprise for you, since that truly's half the fun), what makes this trip are the motorbike guides and the overall tour leader. They aren't just fun and really informative, THEY are having fun with you which makes the experience so much more genuine and enjoyable compared to your typical tour.

The more you are having fun and interacting with them and learning from/about them, the more fun you will have. On top of it all, its "all-you-can-eat" and drink (although I would suggest being prudent on both accounts, since there are a LOT of food stops and the traffic is nuts...which is also half the fun).

If you are going to Saigon/HCMC and you MISS this... I'm sorry but you are either stupid or truly unfortunate

Worth every last "dong" - The ladies that took us around were excellent guides, and really had fun and helpful conversations during the tour. The food was all delicious- not much for the vegans or vegetarians out there, but perhaps they would be able to accommodate, you never know. We drove around on the back of motorbikes on our way to the various food stops, and got insight on the different district neighborhoods in HCMC. This was so helpful for the rest of our days of the trip, so I'd recommend doing this food tour in the beginning of your trip to HCMC. Loved this - great food, fun sightseeing, and great guides! Way exceeded my expectations. Great for anyone- single ready to mingle, couples, families, friends, business, etc.

Simply WOW! - Had read great reviews about this tour so decided it was a "must do" on our first night in HCMC. What a fabulous experience from beginning to end. Pre tour emails and contact brilliant, punctual meet and very professional instructions from the start. Then the fun begins.....! Joined up with 6 million scooters in HCMC! Just go with the flow and trust your lovely guides and drivers to get you to all destinations. Met up with 12 others from all over and had a laugh from beginning to end. Our companions, An and Tru were so friendly, caring and informative. There was total care and attention from start to finish. Full marks to Tung for such a brilliant and ingenious tour. Great introduction to local food and specialties, especially the Saigon version of KFC - the VFF!!! Also thanks to security guys for road crossing patrol and muscle! If you only do one tour in HCMC, do it with XO Tours as it can't be bettered.
great experience - get to feel how it's like to ride a motorbike through HCM traffic. Lots of good food and places that tourists don't know. lots of information about the city.

Go with the best - I had a great time despite a small mistake.

Like everything else in life, accidents happen and I don't blame anyone. I had a lovely time.

I rely on the team for taking care of me and I am very touched by everyone's concern.

This is why you want to go with the best tour in Vietnam - I don't believe I will get the same customer service elsewhere and I will definitely recommend this company to my friends. The mark of a good company is not when everything is fine and dandy but rather when things go wrong, how will they handle it.

Got the pictures from them during the trip and I love it.

Must-do tour! - We did the Saigon by night tour recently and it was the highlight of Ho Chi Minh City for us. We had our 2 kids aged 8 and 14 with us and they LOVED it! The girls were fantastic, Ty was an excellent guide and the food was awesome! The kids are still raving about it now we are home. I definitely think this tour is a must do. Seeing all that traffic is one thing, but actually riding in it is such an amazing thrill. Thank you XO, I totally recommend this tour!

Don't miss it! - We recently took a "Saigon by night" tour - 4 women on 4 scooters - and the 2 1/2 hours sped by. This was a fantastic thing to do. The guides were intelligent, funny, charming and knowledgeable. They were so polite and engaging. This was a fantastic start to our Vietnam experience.

Best night in Saigon - Went for the Foodie tour and it is amazing! Everything is great - the ladies driving the motorbikes, tour leaders and everyone helping out with the tour is just doing an amazing job to give you the best experience of the city, the food and the motorbikes in Saigon!
The Foodie tour is great because you get to try the delicious food but also see the city on motorbike at night. A must do on any Saigon visit!

Easily the highlight of my trip - i am not surprised this is the #1 attraction, i chose the foodie tour on the first night i arrived and it was the best decision of my trip.

highlights
1. the food - 3 stops at places where there were no other tourists, only locals. completely authentic and everything explained...but most importantly DELICIOUS. so many new dishes, just make sure you come hungry!
2. the staff - probably should have listed this as #1, you get someone assigned to you and they just take extremely care of you the whole time! super friendly, and everytime you meet up with the group everyone is just having a good time. extremely impressed with the team that took us out...they look like they enjoy their jobs a lot
3. traveling the city by motorbike - if you havent been then you really cant understand what this means, ive never seen so many bikes in my life! to experience the city on a bike is an absolute must, cannot be stressed enough.

the amount of positive reviews dont lie, this is a MUST DO!!!!!!! thank you XO tours!!!!

So much fun! - After my first tour with XO Tours (Saigon by night) I immediately made a booking for a second (The Sights). I highly recommend both tours - the exhilaration of riding along stretches of highway and seeing such greatly different aspects of the city at night is matched by a wonderfully informative tour of the city's most interesting landmarks.

A very unique experience - We went on the foodie tour with XO Tours and were very pleased with our experience. This is a relatively safe way of living the scooter madness that is Saigon, on the backs of motorcycles driven by lovely local ladies.

The tour enabled us to see many different districts of the city that we would not have normally seen on our own, taste some very interesting dishes we had no clue existed, and learn more about Saigon and its way of life from the very personable ladies driving our scooters. We also got to know some other visitors on the tour with us and had pleasant chats with them during the stops.

The manager, Tai was following the fleet of scooters closely at all times and giving us information about each area and what we were about to sample whenever we stopped for our next bite. He was very professional, just like all the ladies, and made our experience a very smooth and pleasant one. Highly recommended for all those who would like to explore the street food culture of Saigon and/or experience the city on the back of a scooter, just like the rest of Saigon's 8-million residents do every day.

No better way to spend an evening in Saigon - With the family away on holiday, I flew up to Saigon for a long weekend. Decided to do the Foodie tour with XO and had an absolute blast. Saw much more of the city than I would have any other way, ate some wonderful street food, and met a lot of great people (both fellow travelers and the guides). I'm not an experienced solo traveler, but doing organized group activities like this made it an easy and enjoyable time. Highly recommend XO tours.

Saigon Foodie Tour - A friend and I had taken the nighttime Foodie Tour with XO Tours in September this year and I can honestly say it was the most fun we had in Saigon on the trip.

The girls and the Tour guide, Ben were friendly, funny and informative. The food most importantly was also amazing!

I had great memories with XO Tours and I wholeheartedly recommend this tour to anyone who has some extra time in Saigon.

The must do tour of Ho Chi Minh City - We have just returned from our foodie night tour and WOW what a night. Immense fun, the girls Vy and Binh were wonderful, charming and friendly and of course very skilled riders, always felt safe. What an experience on 2levels firstly to see the riders point of view of Saigon and all the differing districts and secondly the food was the best we've had so far this trip, all the dishes explained and food that real Vietnamese eat. There were a few culinary challenges but I encourage you to try them you will be surprised. My husband doesn't eat meat and his food was equally delicious. The time just flew by, I wish this wasn't our last night in Saigon because we would definitely do another tour. DO NOT MISS THIS TOUR! We can't wait to see the photos and tell our friends all about it. A most professional and organised tour. IT WAS AWESOME!

An absolute must do! - The foodie tour was a highlight in a trip which included so many highlights. It is run incredibly smoothly, the guides are charming, smart, funny and excellent at safely steering you around the crazy streets of Saigon. The food was amazing and plentiful. They would tailor it to your dietary needs and level of adventurousness. Seeing the many quarters of Saigon at night from the back of a motorbike is an experience not to be missed. Do this tour!

I'm Still Smiling. - Had my doubts that a 4 and a half hour Foodie Tour would keep us entertained for that length of time, but booked it anyway. All the reviews were great and I wanted something to surprise my husband with. He had no idea until our guide led us to our bikes and handed us some helmets. Luckily all nerves were dispelled in the first few minutes as our drivers seamlessly entered the traffic outside our hotel. From then on, it was just so much fun and those hours just flew by. Being on the back of the bike was exhilarating and our guides were highly educated and very affable. It was so easy to book online before leaving Australia and we felt we were in good hands in HCMC. We didn't even need a camera, as the company took photos and emailed them to us not long after the night. Everything was included in the price, so we didn't need money either. The only money we took was for a tip and this is optional. Many thanks to Ben, Vy (3) and Hoang. All the best for your future endeavours.

Great experience for all the family - Vietnam and motorbikes go hand in hand but looking from the footpath is just not the same as being among it. Our family (including two boys aged 13 and 10) chose the night tour and had a great time exploring the different areas of Ho Chi Minh. The girls (Khanh, V, V and T) were very professional and we always felt safe. Looking forward to watching the video when it arrives and will definitely do it again if we ever make it back.

World Class! - I went to Ho Chi Min City with 4 big Friends and the highlight of our trip was the experience we had with the Xo Tour girls. WHAT AN AWESOME EXPERIENCE. they are sooo cool and dedicated to explaining every single step of the tour, great english. Great food and very safe. I highly recommend it for everyone!

XO Night Tour was fun - My sister and I thoroughly enjoyed the XO Night Tour, the guide was informative, the drivers were delightful, and the food was excellent.
