Really was worth doing and I would highly recommend to anyone who enjoys food and can swing their legs over the back of a motor cycle, getting in amongst the traffic and seeing a wider view of in Ho Chi Minh City by night.

An absolute must do activity if you are in HCMC - XO Tours is a very organized & professional organization and it lives up to all the fabulous reviews given by others. Our group of five had a wonderful time on The Foodie Tour. The night ran very smoothly thanks to the expertise of the fabulous tour manager Ben Chua. Our five lovely ladies (in particular Chi) were wonderfully skilled drivers on the chaotic and busy roads in HCMC. They where very friendly, insightful and went out of their way to make our experience the best it could be. The food was fabulous, in particular the BBQ meats and seafood.
Thank you to Tung, the director of XO Tours who went out of his way to accommodate us when we had some difficulties with payment for the tour.
This was a night we won't forget for all the right reasons.

Safe, exhilarating, fascinating ! - I took the tour yesterday. I've never been on a motorbike before and I'm not that adventurous with food. This was a brilliant tour. Exhilarating on the bike as you are taken through the streets to the different districts. Always feel safe as the girls are great with the bikes and a group of guys with Ben the tour leader chaperone us around town too. Never intrusive, it really is a very personal experience. Food was good. Went to some places I'd not go on my own and eat some things I'd never choose to eat. Nothing too extreme and no pressure to be macho. A must-do tour.

Special mention to my guide, Trang July, who was great fun, kept me safe and made me laugh with stories and even singing on the back of the bike ! A great night. Highly recommend.

Great fun - ok youve seen the reviews and its all true.What can i add a great tour.Must do.I have to add more words tho i see. Mmm Great start to our trip to get the flavor of the city and indeed Vietnam .Do early in tour stay

The Best - I have been on tours in USA, Europe, etc. But this tour is the BEST and MOST FUN ever!!!! We did both the City tour and the Foodie tour! The girls were friendly and outgoing and Ben the tour guide knew his stuff!!! It was our first time in Vietnam but both tours had us around the whole place and we saw lots more on this motorbike tour than we would ever have if we had taken the bus or car.

Best travel experience for a long time - Yesterday my family and myself did the Saigon by night tour. Having 2 older people who have never been on a motorbike I was slightly concerned they may not want to go, as soon as the young ladies turned up they we're put at ease by the easy going manner, excellent English and general kindness in making them feel welcome not to mention loving the traditional Vietnamese outfits. The tour itself was excellent with the girls all being very knowledgeable and we thoroughly enjoyed the evening. The food we stopped for was also great. If you are thinking about booking just do!!

Amazing - We did the Saigon by night tour and we're not disappointed, lovely girls with perfect English, safe drivers, funny stories, delicious street food, a visit to five different districts, the perfect way to see Saigon. Loved it, thanks so much.

A MUST DO!! - Wow- this tour is amazing!! Previously we had eaten a lot of Vietnamese food and we had driven around Saigon on scooters- but this tour just blew everything out of the water! The girls are savvy with a great sense of humour, they drive safely and ensure an amazing evening for all. Ben (the tour manager) is a bundle of information and an absolute pleasure to meet. The tour organisation is professional and does everything to ensure fun & safety. I couldn't have fitted another thing into my belly! Thank you XO for an amazing experience. <3 Stuey

Brilliant - We did the tour wi XO Tours and had a private guide. From beginning to end it was perfect. Speedboat up the river, did the tour which was amazing, shot off a few rounds on an Ak47' and an M30 which was awesome
Great catering as lunch was provided.
Chi - our guide from XO tours was the best ever- well informed on the political and historical context of the country
You can pay less and do this tour by bus but if you can afford to do this tour by boat I would strongly recommend it as it was just brilliant

THANKS CHI

Brilliant - We saw lots more of Ho Chi Minh City on the back of motorbikes than we would have otherwise, by doing this tour. We stopped at about four locations to try local delicacies which included a lot of foods we would not have tried otherwise. The girls that rode the bikes were fun, funny and delightful and thankfully excellent drivers in the congested traffic. The food is included in the cost of this tour.
Would recommend this to Everyone going to Ho Chi Minh City as it was a main highlight of our two week holiday

Welcome to Vietnam! - This was the first thing we did in Vietnam. Landed late at night, quickly slept, woke up at 7(!!!) and deliberately got on the motorbike. I was so nervous but you very quickly became quite blasé about it because you have no option but to trust your driver... And they don't give you any reason not to.

Had a great time, felt it was worth every penny. We are not big on tipping generally but we were very keen to tip because we were so happy with it. We did the half day tour and it was a great intro. They gave us bits of fruit and some drinks, were very attentive, very smiley.

Could not recommend it more highly. Unforgettable experience. My only issue was that we had no idea what a normal tip was. We gave 100,000 dong to each driver and to the gentleman in charge (I think his name was Ben but the trip was a while ago) but we still don't know if that is generous or not.

Hands Down The Best! - I had visited Vietnam a few times before, but never felt like I got a true taste of the HCMC. I had a few free days at the end of a trip and found XO Tours and scheduled their infamous Foodie Trip. Best decision I had ever made!! I felt comfortable and safe throughout the night and had great fun with all the tour guides and other tourists. You are well protected with male tour "bodyguards" as you cross streets and the female tour guides are very fun and outgoing. I went alone because my parents felt too old to go, but next time I am going to convince them along because this is an experience suited for people of all ages! I watch my video of the experience often just to remember how great it was. You get a real ride through the districts and get to eat authentic local food without having to worry if you're picking the right thing :)

Great tour, do it when you arrive it will make your stay even better - Thanks Ben & the Girls from XOtours, had a great time getting to know HCMC, the different districts the people & the food. Lots of good food, great company and a wealth of good information delivered with good humour. A must do trip, I suggest do it early, get your bearings around HCMC and you will know what to eat and where whilst in town, you may also get a little better at crossing the road and learn about the traffic, then again maybe not :-) but its safe, educational and a lot of fun.

Great Experience and First Class Service - We took the Shopping Spree and Foodie Tours and all I can say is what an incredible adventure!!!. The girls and the staff were very friendly and very good drivers too, they weren't the same for both tours, so, we met a lot of people from XO and all of them were very nice. In the Shopping Tour they tried to meet all our requirements so we drove through the city looking for specific stuff to buy and we finally found what we were looking for. They took us to a local market where we tasted an exquisite and refreshing juice (the weather was very hot). The girls answered all our questions about culture and customs and the trip on the bike was very fun. In the Foodie Tour we had a lot of fun discovering the typical food that Vietnamese eat, we traveled along Vietnam and its dishes in a very familiar environment with people from many other countries. We could taste all the local beers and wines, and also the staff explained us all about the dishes and its origin. The traffic was crazy at those hours so it was very, very exciting to be riding on the bike. You cannot leave Saigon without doing any of these tours, I highly recommend the Foodie one because it is a long trip around the city sharing its culture, food and people. We took the tours and also hired the video option, so we received a lot of photographs and the videos from our adventures with very good quality.

I enjoyed it a lot! - How I miss the fun while touring around HCMC with the XO group! The day after my Chu Chi Tunnel tour, I was riding bike with my driver Krung! And Ben was great tour manager, giving us information in and around the area. Thumbs up!

Krung was very patient with me since I had difficulty riding the bike and taking off the bike during the first few stops. Lol... But I got the hang out of it as the tour progress.
From meeting others from the group to ending our tour. All I can say is "no wonder it is No. 1 in tripadvisor!

You get what you paid for!

Heaven's Angels... - At least that is what we felt about our two young, female scooter drivers during our morning tour of Saigon.

Neither of us having not been on "2 wheels" of any description for over 40 years, we were rather nervous prior to the start of the tour but within 5 minutes both of us felt completely at ease and just enjoyed the freedom to look and see in every direction as well as enjoy the thrill of being a part of the chaos of Saigon traffic.

We got quite a few odd stares from tour bus tourists which turned into admiring glances when we left attractions after they did and arrived before them.

We also paid for a video of our tour which brings back great memories of what is the highlight of our time in Vietnam. Highly recommended.

Many thanks to our drivers, Milky and her colleague.

Defiantly a must do - Fantastic way to get a feel for hcmc in a safe and fun way. Kids loved it as traffic is mad and you see some amazing sites. Got to eat some street food that was delicious. The girls are friendly and knowledgable. Camera option worth doing as get video and stills after. We also had a Vietnamese tv station filming us which was a bit bizarre!

A super way to see the sights! - With only one day in Ho Chi Minh the 'sights' tour was the perfect way to experience the thrill of a trip through the traffic and see all the main tourist spots of the city. The drivers were delightful and friendly and I would highly recommend this tour company to everyone!

ABSOLUTELY THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP - Well what a tour. It was raining heavily about an hr before we were due to go on the foodie tour. The company contacted us and kept us well informed of the changes to our tour. It was only postponed by about 40 minutes. We were greeted by 2 lovely girls and 2 guys that were filming our experience.

The girls, tour guide & staff were just amazing. The girls explaining things as we were riding and the staff making sure we had everything we needed.

We visited different districts of Saigon which were great to see from the rich to the not so rich areas. The food was great very tasteful, I even tried frog with the skin on and goat. The frog believe it or not was really nice. Because I am allergic to fish the tour guide made sure I had extra dishes to accommodate my needs.

The weather cleared up and we had the best night. This tour is a MUST to do.

Thanks to everyone especially the girls xxxx

Big Thanks XO - We did the sights tour on a rainy day and really enjoyed it. Tai is on top of his game and the young girls navigating us around were very friendly and fun. As soon as we got going I was straight way comfortable with their bike control on the wet and mad Saigon roads. The tour was interesting and fun, I'd recommend XO to anyone. Next year we'll do their night food tour, see you again Tai :)

Great Food, Great People - My husband and I just returned from our trip and this tour was one of the highlights. Picked up from our hotel by our lovely guides, we were taken to our first foodie experience where we met everyone else on our tour and our tour leader. It was excellent to try foods in the different districts and learn about the history and day to day running of these areas by our friendly and lovely guides. I was a bit scared about getting on the motorbike after seeing the traffic but it was nothing like I expected, very smooth and my guide put me at ease - very professional and safety conscious. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC - it will allow you to see parts of the city that you might not have seen without being on this tour.

Highlights of our holiday. - Just back from two and a half weeks holiday in Cambodia and Vietnam with my husband and have to say this was one of the main highlights of our trip. Looking at all those swarms of motorbikes from a tourist bus is one thing, sitting on the back of a motorbike right in the middle of it is another. Wow what an experience, once I got over the shock I just hung on and enjoyed the ride. The girls were lovely and great fun chatting away as we drove to each eating venue, Ben our tour guide was full of interesting information about the different areas we visited and also explained about the food we were eating. He took photos of us along the way and we received them by email two days after we arrived back - there is no charge for these. Oh and by the way this is not just for the young ones, I am 61 and my husband is 65. Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC. Thank you Ben and girls for an experience I will never forget.

last night ride - This was by far the most exhilarating thing my daughter (10) and i have done on our trip.
We have saved this for the last night of our trip and it was totally awesome.
10/10 for every detail the girls were real cool and we are very good at representing the best time ever. we loved it U will love it also.

"Much more than Food" A must do in HCMC - My partner and I found this tour whilst looking around on line and decided we would take the tour when we got to HCMC. We had spent time in Hanoi and had a terrific experience with a walking street food tour there and then spent time in Hoi An before arriving in HCMC. This tour is much more than a lot of laughs and some great food.
We felt safe and looked after the whole 4.5 hours we were in Tai's and the groups care. The girls were extremely friendly and enjoyable even though the bike ride unsettled me a little on the first leg but after that it was all good. (I am 100kg and was worried about throwing the bike around)
As I said, this is more than a food tour as you will get are real insight into Saigon's various districts with great dialogue.
Sorry Tai for not eating the egg but at least you enjoyed it......
Without doubt this was the best organized event we had in Vietnam.
Well done team.

Foody and great fun - After experiencing the motor bike traffic on foot, we were looking forward to `seeing' it from the other aspect. Wow, what a professionally run team, Ben and his team were outstanding. The places we visited, the foods we all ate, the insights, both serious and fun were to the point. Our lady drivers were chatty, fun, but very responsible and that made for an outstanding nights entertainment. Anyone who overlooks XO Bike Tours, does so at their own peril, and at their great loss.

Best night in Ho Chi Minh - Without a doubt the most fun I had in Ho Chi Minh! Tried foods I never thought I would eat and it was all so delicious!! The girls were lovely and it was a great opportunity to talk about each other cultures whilst racing around the streets on a motor bike. Tai the tour leader was hilarious and very kind. The places visited are restaurants I never would have gone to on my own and it was a great way to taste some of the best Ho Chi Minh has to offer! I will definitely go on this tour again next time I visit!

Must do! - I can't say enough good things about the foodie tour. We did it our first night in Vietnam and it's been the highlight of the trip. Firstly the tour guides and managers were brilliant. The girls were chatty and good fun with very good English, and the tour manager made everything move along absolutely seamlessly and was great for taking pictures of us!

One of my favorite things about the tour was getting to see the less touristy parts of Saigon. We only had a few nights in the city and it helped us access areas we'd never have had the time to see while experiencing some authentic Vietnamese dining experiences.

At $68 each for the foodie tour it may seem relatively expensive to other activities but when you factor in the food, drink and experience it's an absolute bargain!

If we had more time we'd have done one of the sightseeing tours as well. This is an utter gem of a tour company and was a perfect introduction to Vietnam. If you do one thing on your trip to Saigon I urge you to do it this!

XO Street Food Tour - Fantastic Experience and Safe - This was a little expensive but so glad we did it. I was alittle nervous having seen all the traffic but once your on the bike you soon build up confidence and feel safe.

All the ladies spoke good English and were very pleasant and informative. This is the best way to the many districts of HCMC and try the wide variation of food. I'm not a brave eater but still eat much of the food except for the fetal egg, however my husband did and it's not so bad as it looks, well once you have spat out the odd feather and bone!!

A good way to meet other travelers and learn about the city, i would recommend this trip.

Absolutely amazing! - This was my second time on this tour and it just got better and better! The people are phenomenal! Our tour leader Tai was awesome, so helpful, informative and fun. My driver Thu was beautiful. The food that you try is wonderful and extremely local. Each place is clearly authentic and the food is abundant! The food is fresh, a great variety and a great way to taste the flavors of Vietnam. We were the only "white" tourists in each place we visited. Beers are served Ice Cold and as you finish one another one is ready for you on the table. The girls are extremely attentive and safe on the motorbikes. I could do this 100 times over and still be satisfied! 100% recommend! Oh and ps try the Balut at the last stop, it's really a true cultural experience and not as bad as you think it will be, they will love you for it!

Best thing I did in HCMC - I really cant say emphasize how much i enjoyed the tours conducted by xo. I did both the 'sights' and 'by night' tours and both were brilliant for different reasons. The night tour in particular is something i will never forget!

Well organized, fun, interesting, got to try local foods, safe, quirky...i could go on.

The tour managers and the bike girls were excellent. If you are visiting HCMC i couldn't recommend this highly enough.

Fantastic night in HCMC - We did the foodie tour back in early September and it was fantastic! All the staff were excellent; very friendly, lots of fun, and great insight into the local life and culture, which made for a wonderful tour. It was completely safe on the back of the bikes, and such a great way to see the streets of HCMC - and great fun being in the thick of it! The food was amazing, and always so much of it! Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting HCMC.

Our Foodie Tour - Ok, let me get this right out of the way- this is an expensive tour!! And as a couple, doubly so. Three and a half hours on a motobike with four food stops in between where you consume a total of about 15 USD of food makes very little "value proposition" here.

That being said, it was an utter blast! We had so much fun! You go individually on a bike, but travel and eat as a group. Our group was great so that certainly added to the experience. The girls were also tons of fun. Ours were young local university students, spoke great English, and were quite outgoing. They tried very hard to make everything fun and an adventure in itself. A few of them put on a little dance performance, and then there was the chopsticks competition!

The foods we ate were great- no Pho to be found! Let's see if I can remember what we did have- as main fare there was local beef noodle soup, grilled goat & prawns, clams, fish, crab, fresh spring rolls, vegetables & sides, desert, and... Balut- a developing duck embryo that is boiled alive and eaten in the shell. I know I'm missing some but you get the gist- there was a lot of food. My girlfriend doesn't eat seafood, so for every seafood offering she was given a separate dish of local foods.

What made is so fun was the totality of it all- wizzing around thru most of the Districts in Saigon in a group, the girls, the others we met on the tour, and the food itself, prepared by the girls and explained to us as we ate. And they sent us pictures of our night to boot!

Best night in HCMC - Foodie - This tour was great. The guides we had really made the tour for us. Right from the introductions to the final stop we felt we were in good hands. The manager Ben has great people skills and a great sense of humor. This is also the case with the guides we had, who kept us informed throughout the evening. This was the highlight of our short stay in Saigon and is a must even if you are not a Foodie. Thanks again to Ben and his team :-)

Great for the whole family - Literally just off the bike and couldn't wait to let families know how great this is for kids, best intro ever to this city. Great drivers who also share a lot of history about the city. Don't miss this tour, we did the morning sightseeing tour and if we had more time would do the night tour and the shopping tour. Thanks for a great family friendly experience.

Foodie Tour is awesome!!!! - This is one of the greatest Saigon experiences I had. Admittedly, I was scared to ride the bike in the busy streets of Saigon. However, the girls made us feel comfortable all throughout the journey. I admire my guide, Tho. She was very engaging in our conversations. In addition, she was able to juggle driving and talking about Saigon history and culture. T'was a tough job to do! I received already my pictures from the tour and I am excited to see my video. Thank you girls, you truly made my vacation blissful.

PS Tho, I hope you had an awesome birthday celebration ;) You rock!!!!

A Real Saigon Experience! - A very well-organized night of food and fun combined with a very informative tour. I felt very safe and comfortable with the tour guides and gained a better understanding of the city and its development. On top of it, we got to try some authentic food and drinks! I would recommend this tour for anyone who is looking to get a real feel for the city!

Tour for foodies - Combining great, authentic, local food, with an opportunity to immerse yourself in one of the city's great features -- mind boggling motorbike traffic -- and a look at a cross section of the city, going from the pristine to the gritty, this tour offered for the senses to take in.
Traveling on the backs of scooters ridden by girls in traditional outfits just added to the charm.
The two girls who served as guides for our family were excellent, telling us not only facts about their city, but shared anecdotes and gave us a glimpse into their own lives.
Thoroughly enjoyed this and it's made us want to look for a food tour everywhere we visit now.

A tour of firsts - the foodie tour! - This was one of my best experiences in saigon - from the moment we were picked up by or two lovely guides, to the moment we were dropped safely off at our hostel, fed, watered and truly amazed! This tour is a must. If you enjoy trying local cuisine and meeting local people, and have a little thirst for adventure, then just do it! You really get a sense of the multiple facades of saigon, and our tour guides were some of the most wonderful people I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. Worth every penny :)

Awesome foodie tour - My girlfriend and I took the foodie tour and it was money and time well spent. The girls are lovely, funny and speak a very good english. Not only do you taste typical vietnamese food but you also visit a good part of Saigon by night with fascinating explanations on the different neighborhoods. Driving is very safe and once again the girls are funny and witty, chatting with you and explaining many things while driving. Also congratulations to Ben for caring to everybody and being able to remember the names and nationalities of 16 people!

It's all been said before but - I simply must add a review for this company.
I first went on the private city tour and then the following night took on the foodie tour .
Both tours are brilliant and it would be hard to pick between them ,if I only had time for one.
The city tour gives you a good grounding of the city if you have just arrived , so good to do first .
The girls are lovely , speak good English and above all , are fun.
The tours are conducted with security and saftey being. Priority , so fear not .
The tour guide will meet you at various places and explain why they have taken you there and are
Well informed
If you are reading reviews of this experience then you are obviously interested , so Just Do It.
Peter and Kittiya

Great start to our trip in Vietnam - We booked the night foody tour and this trip was great fun and the best way to see the city. We were apprehensive about the tour as crossing the road in HCMC is an achievement in itself never mind going on a bike. However, this is really the best way to see the city. The girls were great drivers, explaining the sites on the way. They take you to a number of different districts – most tourists don't venture outside of district 1. Tai the Tour Leader at XO is funny and informative giving you a wealth of information about the visited districts. Then there is the food, this is amazing, the girls really look after you explain what they are preparing, how to eat it etc. The food was lovely, lots of amazing sea food, however, if you have any allergies or dislikes XO tours offer alternatives.
This tour is a must do – you see parts of the city you wouldn't normally get to see and to eat food that the locals eat. Besides that it was a fun night where the XO girls and Tai did everything they could to make our night one to remember.
Hang On!!!! - What a great way to end our vacation and pump us up. Great company, great guides! As exciting as being in a shark cage...the driving in this country is insane! But we made it out alive.

What a great way to see Ho Chi Min - I did 2 tours, the city tour with Khahn, and then that night the foodie tour with Thu, as part of a group of 12.

Both Girls were amazing, funny, witty and interesting. They were also excellent scooter drivers. I saw places I wouldn't have and ate food I definitely wouldn't have.

I am so glad I did these tours. If you are thinking about it, book now!

Highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Minh - It's a great experience riding on a motorbike, just the way the locals do in HCM. I really like how XO Tours goes all out to make us experience a really Vietnam experience. It's very adventurous and adrenaline-pumping to ride on a motorbike with hundreds of other motorists on the road. The tour guides are very skillful in riding a bike, which relieved me from worrying about my safety. Generally the motorists and drivers in Vietnam are careful in their driving.

I enjoyed the detailed explanation on HCM, revealing the interesting stories of Vietnam which is otherwise not known to the tourist. In our foodie tour, we visited many places in HCM which are usually off limit to tourist. Our tour guides are very friendly and insightful in sharing everything about Vietnam. Our tour manager is also very friendly, making sure that every details is taken care of.

XO Tour is really awesome in letting us try the local food which is off our usual limits. The food recommended by XO Tours is very tasty, but unique at the same time. It pushes our limit in what we usually define as food. There won't be any usual pho or spring rolls as the tourists can easily order these on their own. Nevertheless, I do feel satisfied having tried the yummy and interesting food.

Overall, great experience in gaining more insights of HCM's food, culture, people, places of interest, economy and favorite leisure activity. Definitely recommended for travelers to HCM.

Foodies Tour Ho Chi Minh City - This is a MUST DO while visiting Ho Chi Minh. Had the most amazing experience on this tour. We got to experience first hand a variety of foods and venues that the locals eat in and an insight into each district of Ho Chi Minh City. The girls are funny, knowledgable and easy going. They couldn't do enough for us and they are also very entertaining. Our tour started in the rain, but it did not dampen our experience, will be raving about this experience for years to come. AMAZING!

Awesome - We only had a short time in Ho Chi Minh and this was the best way to see the sites. Despite feeling a little apprehensive about being on a motorcycle in HCM once we were on our way we felt we were in very safe hands.

A great way to experience HCM from a local's perspective. We would highly recommend this tour when you are in HCM.

JUST DO IT!!! - I have nothing but praise for xotours. My friends and I took the day sightseeing tour and the night foodie tour and I found everything perfect. The best part of xotours is the people-they are polite, friendly and took amazing care of us. It was great fun going around Saigon on a bike. In fact, that's the only way to see Saigon! The night foodie tour is especially worth it-as you get to see more of Saigon-going out of District 1-as well as trying food places you wouldn't normally get to try as a typical tourist. Food was fantastic, and I loved riding over the bridge and seeing various places at night, knowing you're well taken care of. Kudos to xotours for maintaining the great standards they seem to have started with. I don't normally like tours but this one is special.

Free! - We booked on the basis of Trip Advisor reviews and were not disappointed. Traveling with 2 adults and our two young daughters (8 & 6) we were a little apprehensive about the safety factor as I booked 4 bikes. The gilrs were all on time, and after a safety briefing we were on the road. We chose the Saigon by Night tour. Within about 60 seconds of starting our journey our concerns about safety faded away. The girls are excellent riders, and as the traffic is heavy in HCMC you rarely see the speedo above 30km/h.We stopped quite a few times to listen to various explanations about the city, and also for dinner roadside - which was delicious (especially the pork chop on broken rice).

Our tour leader is Thuong Pham who was courteous, professional and spoke very good English. In fact all the riders we had engaged in excellent conversation as we rode, describing points of interest and taking a genuine interest in any questions we asked. They were excellent with our two girls who described this trip as one of the best things they did on holiday. My rider 'Milky Way' was a really good rider and english speaker and clearly knew her way around HCMC and its sights.

The tour was first class.....easily the best way to see HCMC.
Excellent - Excellent experience, lady driverd (Dee and Anne, not sure if i spelled the names correctly), owner (Tung Do), and guide(Tai Dang)!!!

Brilliant - What can I say, from the time I emailed XO Tours, only 1 day before we wanted to go on a shopping tour, until the time we waved good bye, everything was fantastic. Tai (our tour leader), Anh, Binh, Vinh and Binh (yes there were two Binh's), were exceptional.

After 3 weeks in Vietnam it was time to go shopping. Right, so we do this on our own, I guess we could have, but we decided to book XO Tours. Yes, it was the right decision, they not only picked us up on time, they did all our bargaining. The cost of the tour plus our video was well and truly paid for with the prices that they got for us.

Thank you so much guys, we will definitely be back next year to do some sort of food tour. Again thank you very much you were marvelous.

Amazing. Amazing. Amazing. - I am not sure I can do justice to XO Tours with my simple adjectives and vocabularies. From the beginning of how they handled my booking to the end of the tour with them, everything was just top of its class.

We joined XO Tours on its Foodie Tour (Evening), and very much expecting to be driven around dining on some of the best food offered by Ho Chi Minh City. However, we were very delighted to find out that the tour was more than that. Our tour manager, Ben is absolutely awesome. Not only did he introduce us to some of the best food Saigon has to offer, he also shared with us very interesting facts about the city which I deeply appreciate. These are stuffs you won't find on Wikipedia or a Lonely Planet book, but yet, knowing them and hearing it from someone who knows the city intimately makes it all very profound. I am grateful for the experience.

Our guides who drove us around where also the best! They kept us safe and struck up interesting conversations with us which we really appreciate.

All in all, it was the best time I had in Saigon :)

A must! - We went on the foodie tour based on reviews here on trip advisor and it did not disappoint. I've been to HCMC many times before but never seen it like this! It's true, they'll take you to where the locals eat. Real authentic. And theres no Pho in sight, you'll get to try new things rather than the usual suspects. And the food is only half of it. The ride itself is so much fun and the tour girls are very engaging. They take you to the outer districts, stop and explain really interesting facts about the area. I learned so much. I would definitely recommend this tour and have been to all my friends. Can't praise it enough.

A must do! - I took my mother and myself to Ho Chi Minh city for three nights and booked the foodie tour. We found that this tour was an excellent way to see the city and taste the food. The group leader Tai was very professional and knowledgeable and the tour itself was incredibly well organized. My 56 year old mum felt comfortable on the back of the bike as the girls were all very safe and inturn, made us feel very safe. Overall, a great way to taste the food that you might not be game to try on your own, or even pronounce ;)

Best experience we had in Saigon! - In a city that can be very full on for a tourist this experience was fantastic. We did the evening foodie tour. The girls that took us on the ride were intelligent, witty and excellent moto riders! This tour gives you insights to Saigon that the average tourist doesn't get- taking you out of District 1 and into Vietnamese life and eating. Food and drink were abundant and all included. Would recommend this to anyone- we hope to get back to do another of their tours one day!

Justin and Katrina.

Sydney

Won't disappoint! - All the great reviews don't lie - this tour was fabulous! did the "Foodies" tour that combines "Saigon by night" with authentic food choices.. it was fantastic. I would recommend this tour to everyone visiting HCMC. Worth the cost - book early to avoid disappointment!

A brilliant way to see Ho Chi Minh City - Did two tours while in Ho Chi Minh City. Both were excellent. Shopping and Foodie Tours, both highly recommended. Always felt very safe, great information and excellent locations!! Highlight of trip :-)

eXtraOrdinary tour with lots of xo :) - I am so lucky to get the booking done just one day before arrival, all thanks to Tung (owner and founder of XO Tours). super blessed to have Thu & Thuy (tour leader) as the guides for our
"Saigon by Night Tour", they were very friendly and spoke good English. I felt safe with them on the bikes despite the crazy traffic and mayhem of the evening rush. pictures taken during the bike tour will be emailed as promised on the website =) Thumbs up for the great hospitality and warmth.

the bike tour was really awesome! tasted some of the Vietnamese street foods like
"Banh Mi" (Vietnamese baguette sandwich), "Banh Uot" (steamed rice noodles with pork sauce and sweet fish sauce) and "Com Tam" (grilled pork chops on broken rice). They were so delicious especially the Banh Mi!

I highly recommend this bike tour even though its a little pricey... but the experience was way beyond the price that u've paid for! definitely the highlight of my HCMC trip and it always brings a smile on my face whenever I reminisce ;)

Tons of fun! - We toured with two terrific young ladies in Ho Chi Minh. They were very safe drivers through busy traffic and showed us all the highlights in town. I can't imagine being able to see half as much by car or bus. Shopping was no problem either, they have a courier pick up your packages and deliver them to your hotel. I bought a couple of custom dresses and assorted books and toys. This tour was one of the highlights of our trip.

The real Saigon! - Wow!! From the moment the girls picked us up, they were friendly and truly excited to take us around the city! We felt safe on the bikes with them on the crazy roads, and they spoke to us while riding, telling us all about the city. It really did make our stay in saigon!! Thanks very much :-)

Highlight of our trip - This was the best experience we've had during our trip to HCMC. It gives you a comprehensive look at hcmc beyond the usual tourist spots. Food was excellent and the girls and tai dang were great. It's like having your own concierge on a bike. Being part of a group also gives you a sense of security amidst the chaos of hcmc. I highly recommend this.

Great way to end my stay. - My last day in Saigon I was picked up by a lovely young girl called Chi, at my hotel and off I went for a 4 hour Foodie tour of Saigon.s 5 districts , all on the back of a Vespa Scooter.. 10 of us rode around in the madness and mayhem of the evening rush ,safely and confidently with our guides, all lovely, fun young girls in traditional dress and all seemed to speak perfect English and were determined to give us a really great time. .We stopped for a course in at least 4 in the various districts, and also heard a lot of interesting facts about the areas, with tour manager, Ben Chua giving a hilarious and informative commentary. The food was great and at times interesting!!! If in Ho Chi Minh city, this is a must do trip... a great way to end my holiday..Thanks Chi and Ben..

We had a blast!!! - We did the morning sightseeing tour with XO and I have to say it was a blast! Fun and interesting. The guides all speak English well and you can tell they were experienced and professional on the motorbikes. And the best part was that in addition to all the historical information about each stop, we also got to learn more about life in Saigon through a local's perspective. We had a great time and already recommended this tour to friends!

Foodie tour and the shopping tour - both fantastic! - We did the shopping tour on our second day in Ho Chi Minh, as I wanted to get a few work dresses made and knew this may take a few days. We were picked up punctually by our lovely guides and tour leader, Tai. They asked what we were interested in looking at/buying and did all the hard work for us (bargaining, transport and a bit of a tour too). I got four dresses made (and am very happy with the quality, given they were only $40 each), bought beautiful lacquerware (that runs rings around the cheap stuff in the markets!), sampled some local markets and more. I was so impressed by our guides that I requested them for our foodie tour the following night. My driver, Normally, was, in particular, wonderful!

The foodie tour the following night was simply fabulous - lots of fun and loooots of food! As we were traveling on after Vietnam, I had been reluctant to try street food. However, knowing that these places had been scrutinised and considered safe for us weak-bellied folk meant that I could have a taste of Vietnamese street food without the possibility of feeling ill afterwards.

All up, both tours were just fantastic - the best we experienced during our time in Vietnam. Thank you, XO!

Great time! - Well if you are looking for something different this is it.The young ladies turn up at your hotel dressed in traditional dress and tell you what the trip involves.Their English is great and we paid at the end.We were driven around quite a large area stopping twice to experience local attractions.Its great fun being driven among the madness of Saigons moped mania.The girls are superb drivers and we had kids in our group, very safe.Also my husband is 17 stone and it wasnt a problem for the young lady !

Nighttime Tour - Absolutely fantastic! - Wow - what an absolutely incredible tour, from start to finish, this tour was both exhilarating and professional.

After reading the reviews on TA I couldn't wait to go on this tour and wasn't disappointed. I emailed Tung several times to ask about timings / dates etc and she couldn't have been more helpful in sorting out my booking.

We chose for the nighttime tour as we were busy during the day and both myself and my mum (58) had a superb night.

The tour is run extremely professionally - but at the same time does not feel contrived. The places you stop at are interesting and there is the right mix between stops / and spending time on the bikes. I really feel after this tour that I had a much better understanding of where things were in the city.

I was pretty dismayed about going on the back of one of the bikes but my girl (Ngan) was absolutely lovely and made me feel such at ease and not silly for being scared. She was so funny and her English was brilliant. I really feel like I had made a friend by the end of the tour!

The dinner was lovely too and had a good choice of what you could eat.

My only regret about this tour is that I didn't go on the daytime tour too!

XO are the best tours ever!!!! - I did 3 tours with my 2 sisters, all in our 50's and never ridden a motor bike. A fantastic, fun time and the only way to see Ho Chi Minh. The girls are just brillant, and all the XO staff are an amazing asset to an amazing tour company.We did 2 tours with the fabulous Ben as our guide, his second job could be like a stand-up comic !! Not only was he so very informative, he made it humorous as well. We did the Shopping tour and had the wonderful (and very cute )Tai as our guide. The Foodie Tour is an absolute MUST, and it's great to be taken to places away from the tourist traps. All the staff speak near perfect English, and go out of their way to ensure you have a fantastic time.

Shopping Tour.........THE BEST - I did this trip with my daughter (14) yesterday. What an amazing day!!!!! When you book you let the company know what you are interested in. Our girls were amazing, so fantastic on the bikes and just so lovely and friendly. Tai, our guide was just amazing. He went through with us before we headed off to make sure what we were interested in. I mentioned fish and off we headed to a street full of aquarium shops. Picked up plants to take home for a fraction of the cost. Went to off the track markets, got material and having 3 dresses and 2 skirts made. Tai and the girls do the bargaining and get such a better price than you can get, especially me, I suck at bargaining. Thank you for a fantastic day and I will do this tour again in a blink of an eye.

Xo Foodie Tour was superb - Don't even hesitate! A truly amazing experience touring and eating and relaxing in many HCMC districts, rich to poor, sampling so much wonderful food.....getting around to all of it on motor scooters driven by expert drivers whose English was impeccable. It was great fun, even for two parents in their mid 60s who had never been on a motorcycle. The hosts and drivers know so much about HCMC, and the many selectable dishes of Vietnam. There is even a crew on hand to guide you on and off the bikes. We met other travelers too from far off places Unforgettable and highly recommended.
Great fun! - Well worth the price tag! A great way to take in the different districts of Saigon, trying food that we wouldn't ordinarily order (or know how to order!). Highly recommended!!

Great morning out and intro to Saigon. Really knows how to provide a memorable and safe fun experience. - Loved my tour. My tour guide was outstanding. i think her name was Hoang. I'm nearly 50 and haven't ridden a motor bike for 20 years. Saigon was quite a different experience when I was amongst the traffic in contrast to walking around the traffic. We went to cathedral, post office, rectification cathedral, pagoda and drove through choline market area etc. :-)))))))

A fantastic experience - We had a fantastic night on the Foodie Tour. The girls were perfect hosts and we felt perfectly safe on the back of the scooters and food was to die for not sure about the Duck embryo not to my taste. A very enjoyable 4.5 hours spent in the evening. Will definitely do it again and thanks for emailing photos of tour

Bike-tastic - What a superb experience - there were five of us ... and five of the most wonderful bike babes in the world! We had so much fun it's hard to describe - suffice to say it was the highlight of our HCMC experience!

Great way to see the city. - The girls on our trip were wonderful. They spoke English very well and could answer any questions we had.
I felt very safe on this tour and thought it was a nice way to see the sights of HCMC.

Don't miss this! - My boyfriend and I have been traveling Asia for 8 months and had my Dad and brother meet us in Saigon.
This tour was such a great way for us to see the city and show my family the 'real' side of Saigon that they will never have seen!

We did the night tour and it included a delicious dinner, sugar cane juice and loads of local fruit.

Seeing a few different districts was so interesting and our beautiful guides were so happy, chatty and lovely. They made the tour SO much fun!

Loved the survival guide book you get to keep at the end of the tour - it's going to come in handy for the rest of Vietnam!

I'd 100% recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon. It's a fun night out and really interesting.

Awesome! - Having arrived in HCMC after our 16 hour flight we knew we would be awake early due to the time difference so we had booked the shopping trip with xo tours to get to see the city and the shops ... we are a family if 3 .. myself my husband and our 19 year old daughter.. we had an awesome tour with these guys and tung was a great leader ... his girls are so much fun and very informative we left as friends and booked a further two trips .. the sites tour the following morning and the night tour .. we had different girls on each tour and can honestly say they were all amazing and a credit to saigon..the final tour had to end early due to rain as tung thought it dangerous... he got us a taxi home and didnt charge us an absolute gentleman to deal with .. you MUST include this tour as part of your sightseeing trip of saigon..it is a crazy crazy city and when we arrived we couldnt even cross the road now we are pros at dodging the traffic on a motorbike ..theres a first time for everything!! thanks again guys for making our trip to saigon a wonderful one :-)

Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City like a local - This was the best way to travel around the city - fun and exciting, also very informative. My daughter and I did the "Night Tour" - what a way to see how the Vietnamese live in their own environment. Great tour guide, amazing experience - highly recommend this if you have a couple of free hours to spend seeing the sights from a different vantage point!

Excellent, fun introduction to Saigon and Vietnamese food - We are a couple in our 60‘s and took the food tour on our first night of a three week trip in Vietnam. We were so glad that we did! The tour was fantastic and made an impact on the rest of our trip because we were able to order some of our favorite dishes as we travelled. We found that it was easy to locate restaurants with those items in other towns. Our guides were fun and informative. It was great to see so many districts in the city. We highly recommend this tour as an excellent and fun introduction to typical Vietnamese food that one doesn’t get at the restaurants back home.

Best thing I did in HCMC - This is an amazing tour! I had the pleasure of having Binh be my tourguide, she not only explained many things about HCMC, but encorouaged me to try things I never would have! Ben is a fantastic manager, very enthusiastic and eager to show people a side of HCMC that they might not otherwise see. Fantastic food and overall tour, I learnt so much and met some wonderful people. I travelled on my own so was nice to be warmly welcomed and be shown how warm and inviting people in Vietnam are!

Super fun! - This was one of the most exciting, fun things my husband and I have done in our travels!

Basically, you ride through the city of Saigon on the backs of motorbikes, through crazy traffic and busy markets, flanked by an entourage of XO staff- it was awesome. We got to taste the different foods, see parts of the city that tourists don't normally see, and even participate in a local temple. The staff were extremely well-informed, intelligent, capable, and just plain fun to hang around with!

Although this excursion may seem somewhat pricey at first, it is an amazing deal for what you get.

One thing to note is that I do NOT recommend this activity for children, or anyone with a disability. I would also not recommend it for anyone overly clumsy or who has an extremely poor sense of balance- it really could be dangerous if you fell off one of the bikes. That said, my husband and I are are in our thirties and fit, and we had an amazing time!

Wonderful whistle stop tour of Saigon - A fast, educational and engaging whistle stop tour of Saigon.
Lovely girls drove us around the sights of the city whilst our tour guide talked us through each of the sights. We saw more that we could have possibly tried to see on our own and it was fun and engaging.
I highly recommend for a fabulous overview of the city!

Highlight of our stay in Saigon - Just got back from a conference in Ho Chi Minh and we decided on our second last day to take one of the shopping tours. It was fantastic. The girls are great and once you get over the fact you are riding around on the back of a motorbike with millions of other people in this bizarre form of organized chaos, it's just fun. We highlighted the things we were looking to buy and everything we were after was found in 3 hours. Just a shame we didn't have time for any of their other tours. Couldn't recommend it more and it'll be the first thing we do next time we are in town.

Worth more than what you pay for - At $68 a pop for a 6 hour 10-12 course local Vietnamese cuisine may sound extravagant but as they say the experience is priceless because the tour guides make it a very memorable experience from the drama they create and tid bits of information they share of the local culture.

I will be honest and be the first to admit that I am a tight fisted traveler. We were a group of 6 friends who took the tour. It took some convincing and debate before we decided to take the tour at the last minute. The owner was very accommodating and squeezed us into a special schedule.

I come from the Philippines where motor bike accidents are a daily occurrence so you can understand our apprehension. In HCM, it may look chaotic but there is order in their madness. Cars and riders give way and observe the speed limit. Cars stay on the left of the bikes while bicycles are on the right. We were very concerned that we might end up as headlines if we got into an accident backriding on a young Vietnamese lady. That would be hard to explain to the Mrs. The rationale of the owner was that ladies are more careful drivers than men hence their company's claim to fame - The only all female bike tour.

The food trip was not in the usual tourist area or commonly known Vietnamese food except for the first noodle stop which was walking distance from our hotel- Eden Saigon.

The 2nd stop was in China town to see the wholesale market where all the stuff in Ben Thanh and Saigon Square but you will need to buy in bulk.

The 3rd stop was in an open air restaurant that specializes in grilled goat meat, jumping chicken, (which I love) and shrimps . Here, we feel like royalty and being millionaires in Dong sitting on kiddie chairs (commonly used in HCM side walk resto) because our guides prepare our food from peeling the shrimps to help us win the chopstick contest and generally make us feel happy with their amusing humor and food trivia.

The next sight seeing stop was in District 7 where we can see a big difference in development from the modern skyscrapers versus the antique French colonial buildings commonly found around the city. It was too bad we were only showed a picture of the most ambitious project in District 7, the Crescent Mall but its a food tour anyway. We also learned that Vietnam suffers from very high inflation so people invest in property.

The last stop on the tour was in a seafood market in one of the "poorer" and "unsafe" district. We had crabs with lots of spice and garlic, scallops with peanuts, and sugar cane juice. The dessert was a unique coconut jelly and leche flan. Here the guide tells us we can eat as much as we wanted.

You may think the food list is not much because it is from the way I wrote. (I am not a food critic) The whole experience of having personal guides that can tell you a lot about the country and its people is a great way to enjoy the local cuisine.

"Fantastic" - The Foodie Tour was a highlight on our holiday in Vietnam. Beautiful evening, amazing food, great company and four lovely drivers that were fun and helpful which was the recipe for a most memorable evening :)

Fantastic way to see the city...highly recommend it! - My friend and I were only in Saigon for a few days nad a friend had told us about XO so we decided to give it a try. We did the city tour at night and had a great time. Our drivers were extremely nice, professional, safe, helpful, and funny! Not only did we get to see parts of the city that we otherwise wouldn't have, we also enjoyed some great food! This was the hghlight of our stay in Saigon for sure.

Awesome - Fantastic way to see around Ho Chi Minh.
We arrived in Vietnam the early hours of the morning, and spent the day walking around, seeing some of the sites. The scariest thing was learned to cross the road. There are so many mopeds! You just have to walk out into the road, and walk very slowly, hoping that the traffic will go round you. Going on the XO vespa tour, meant that we could see the traffic from a different perspective.
The girls were fantastic drivers, really friendly , and full of loads of information. The whole tour was such fun and a brilliant way to spend our first evening in Vietnam
I would highly recommend this tour

The best! - Believe the hype, this was the best thing we did during our stay in Saigon. I've never been on a bike before but the girls made us comfortable very quickly and the time flew by. For anyone thinking of doing the foodie tour, I highly recommend it. It was the perfect mix of sightseeing and wow did we eat a lot of food. I absolutely love the food stops and ate almost everything they offered. It's a great mix. Thank you girls for a great evening!

So much fun! Just do it! - Where do we start? .....We were so looking forward to our pre- booked Foodie tour but a downpour put a dampener on our night - however within minutes of our lovely guides leaving we received a phone call at our hotel from Tung the owner/ manager who asked if we would be able to fit in a tour the next night at a slightly earlier time as the tours were fully booked. Thank you Tung for your phone call as we then also booked a Saigon sights tour.

Our wonderfully fun and charming guides - Ning & Dinh arrived with big smiles to show us around Saigon next morning. We were complete novices on bikes but relaxed once realising how professional and competent drivers our girls were. Ben unexpectedly was our on- site tour guide and he filled us in with information that guidebooks just can't provide. Thanks Ben for your recommended strawberry & sugar cane juice too! Haven't come across another one since!

The Saigon sights tour is a great way to start getting your bearings and a feel for the city. The chaotic traffic is a breeze once you become immersed in it.

Our Foodie tour was FANTASTIC! We knew we were in for a fun night after reading all the reviews on trip advisor but nothing prepares you for it or how full you are as a result. Our girls - Tu and Hoa came back from the night before and the fun began!
We would never have eaten the food we did that night in the areas we went to without this tour. Everything we ate was delicious! Without giving too much away there were a few firsts with regards to what we ate.

Tung - owner/manager was our on-site guide and went out of his way to ensure everything ran smoothly - if unable to eat seafood or there are other dietary requirements - don't worry you will be taken care of.

We haven't stopped raving about both tours to anyone we meet and planning a visit to Saigon. We have left with many happy memories. These tours are extremely well organised and the girls and guides we had are outstanding ambassadors for their country. They exude enthusiasm, happiness and a love of their jobs.

Our only warning is you will roll into bed and may not want breakfast the next day!

Excellent, the Fish Philosophy is here! - The whole experience reminded me of the Fish Philosophy: in providing amazingly superlative customer service, one must remember 4 things: Be There, Play, Choose Your Attitude and Make Their Day. Well, the Fish Philosophy is alive in XO Tours!

Be There: There is 1:1 tour guide cum motorbike driver for every guest. It is so personal it feels like royalty, literally you'll be a king for one night. I thank my guide Phuong Anh- wonderful ride, always there to make me feel special!

Choose Your Attitude: They came and they came happy and ready to serve their customers. They were excited to see you around, although they've done the tour several times already. The energy and excitement is still there like you are experiencing the tour together for the first time. Really amazing!

Play: The tour is not like any job for the girls on motorbike, including the entire team of "bodyguards" and Tai, the team leader. They know how to enjoy, to have fun while working. The fun spirit is contagious- even though it was raining and my companios were afraid to ride the motorbike, the fear was gone in no time because of their playful ways. This is not to say that the girls were reckless drivers. They were careful and gentle. The foodie tour was not all about food, too. There were games and entertainment. It also includes some serious socio-political and economics stuff, mind you.

Make Their Day: As I said, the tour was full of surprises. They gave us nice keepssakes before the tour was over, and a promise to email all our photos in 7 days (that part I wish they could make sooner, with digital and email, who needs 7 days to complete the task?) It was dark, it was raining, but we all had fun. It surely made our day and made our visit to Vietnam very memorable. You should try it too!

Congratulations to the whole XO Team. I know it takes a lot of team effort to pull this amazing thing off. Keep it up.

Recommended - A great way to orientate yourself in this diverse city. Relaxed and fun. The girls were really nice, friendly and educated. Regular breaks along the way meant you weren't sitting on the bike the whole time dodging traffic.

FUN FUN FUN - who cares if Daddy took the T-bird away? - Our first time in Vietnam but we will definitely be back.

First and foremost the BEST thing about all of Vietnam is the beautiful, friendly people.
We always try learning a few words in the local language (start on the inbound flight) and find that helps.

This event was the highlight of our trip. The girls were such accomplished riders and their company was so much fun (more fun than golf caddies) and as big a part of the trip as the food which they explained and expertly cooked (when we had bbq). Riding through the night traffic was awesome (we NEVER thought we were going to die!), They even gave us tips for buying designer clothes the next day. We have become facebook friends. I would thoroughly recommend this. You get MORE THAN you pay for and well worth the expense. Lots of great food - frogs legs, chicken embryo, rice wine...who can forget??? There were also simpler dishes!! :)

Take the $30 video optional add on.

-----------------------
Mature age Aussie couple.
Have traveled everywhere including lots of Asia.
Best ever - Riding on the back of motorbike through the streets of Saigon. It is a must do on the tourist hit parade. Good safe fun.

Lots of fun - If you don't already know, SGN has thousands of motorbikes on the streets. People might describe the motorbike traffic to you before you go, but until you get there, you really can't comprehend how much it resembles a free-for-all. So, I was not excited -- at all -- when my daughter suggested that we go on a motorbike tour in Saigon. I couldn't imagine that I'd be able to survive being in the traffic, let alone enjoy it.
But, it turns out, the XO motorbike tour is terrific. The drivers are all ladies, and it feels like they are picked for reliable, consistent, calm driving. Everyone is required to wear a helmet and it's the real thing. If you are a woman, you can hang on for dear life to your driver, but my driver was so lovely and clean, and I was such a sweaty mess (from the weather, not the driving), that I didn't want to mess up her traditional dress, so I ended up holding on to the seat-holding-on-bars. When we started, I had a death grip on the bars and was so tense and tight on the back on the bike that I'm surprised my driver could navigate, but as she drove calmly and deliberately, I started to loosen my grip on the bars and move a little bit with the bike as we turned and stopped. It was actually kind of fun to be a part of the traffic, rather than at odds with it.
In addition to driving around Saigon with someone who knows what she is doing, the tour includes touring several districts, and eating at several stops. We started out with some traditional pho from Hue' which was quite good. Our next stop which was part of the outdoor food market in Cho Lon which we drove through on our motorbikes. After that, we got to eat at one of those outside restaurants that you see all over SGN, where the chairs are made for 2 year olds pulled up at long silver tables. We grilled our own meat on tiny grills and drank local beer (both very good). After that, we visited to Singapore, I mean District 7, where the ex-pats live, and then went on to our last stop which included some very tasty seafood. At each stop, our guides prepared and showed us how to eat each dish to get the most authentic taste, and if something didn't agree with us, there was no pressure to continue. It was really fun to chat with our guides about life in Vietnam, and they seemed to enjoy talking to us about our experiences in Vietnam.
XO Tours is a very well run, very enjoyable experience. I have a friend who is visiting Vietnam this November and I've strongly encouraged her to try XO while she's in SGN. I hope my review will tip you to try XO Tours, too.

Highlight of our trip - We went on the foodie trip and can't recommend it enough. As the weather was not great on a couple of the days we had this booked this trip and XO were more than happy to postpone. When we finally went on it the girls that picked us up were very sweet and professional and never once made me feel uncomfortable or unsafe on the back of the bike. They were very knowledgeable and extremely helpful. XO had everything planned perfectly, even down to taking photo's for you and sending then through.

The food was fantastic and in ambundance and as where the drinks. This was a highlight of our trip and would thoroughly recommend them.

Must do while in Saigon - We took a tour with the girls, they took great care of us and showed us the sights around the city. The tour guide met us at each site to provide us with information, he was professional, knowledgeable and spoke good English. Riding through the traffic in Saigon with an excellent company like this is a must, well worth the money

Foodie fun! - Absolutely brilliant. The company of the girls was so much fun and as big a part of the trip as the food. Riding through the night traffic was awesome (once you realized that you weren't going to die!), the evening markets etc colorful and exciting. I would thoroughly recommend this. You get what you pay for and well worth the expense.

Cant recommend XO tours enough!!! - We joined the Foodie tour in 7 Aug and it was the highlight of our trip in Saigon. The manager Ben was professional and the girls were knowledgable and friendly and the food really good and interesting. They even surprised my wife with a cake for her birthday :D
You just have to experience Saigon traffic from the back of a motorcycle . Keep it up XO tours!!!

Could perfect get even better? - I took the Foodie Tour 18 months ago and it was a perfect experience. Great Food...Great Guides...a perfect introduction to the city.

I recently revisited Saigon and again, on the first night there, I went on the XO Tours Foodie Tour. Still perfect!!!

I would advise anybody visiting HCMC to do the same!

Highlight of Vietnam vacation - a must do for anyone traveling to Saigon - The reviews are right!
This tour was a highlight - incredible attention to detail made every moment a great experience. Credit to the lovely staff - one on one service from the beautiful local ladies who speak brilliant English, are well educated, charming and a pleasure to meet.
This is the experience most tourists are looking for - the real Saigon with opportunity to see, try and discover the food and districts away from your base hotel.
Can't recommend highly enough.

AMAZING - Cant recommend this tour highly enough. I did the foodie tour. My guide was fantastic her english was very good and she was great to chat to on the bike. All of the foods were very interesting and always explained and served well. Absolutely fantastic night I will recommend to everyone coming to ho chi minh city :) thank you

AMAZING - The reviews don't lie, this tour is absolutely fantastic. We did the Foodie Tour on our only night in Saigon and simply loved it! The girls are incredibly knowledgeable, sociable and a delight to spend the evening with, and the food is just delicious. As we only had one night in Saigon it was an excellent way to see the lay of the city and a few different districts. This tour was the highlight of my trip in Vietnam. Hands down. Stop reading and start booking!

attractive - Absolutely brilliant. The best thing we did in our 20 days in Vietnam and Cambodia. The girls were very skilled in the art of handling Saigon traffic, had excellent English and were very knowledgeable about their home city. They were also very interested in us and what we had seen etc.
I would highly recommend the Foodie Tour, the girls, the sights, the sounds, the smells, the traffic, in fact just do it, you won't regret it.
A stand out.
No wonder it is number 1.

Excellent - XO Tours are as of now the #1 rated activity for Ho Chi Minh City here on tripadvisor, and if you join in on one of their trips you will see why.
I did the foodie-tour, and had a great time. I doubt there is a better way to experience the city than from the back of a motorcycle. Particulary after dark. The guides were all great, the food was amazing... I guess the only complaint I could have was that I wished it had lasted longer. Time flies when you're having fun I guess

Fantastic Night Great People - My husband and I did a lot of research on tours to do while staying in Vietnam and we were very impressed with the reviews about The xo Foodies Tour which was ranked no 1 with good reason. From the time we booked on line this tour was first class. We were picked up by two lovely ladies on motorbikes who greeted us with a smile and told as a little about what to expect on this tour and made sure we were comfortable on all aspects of the tour. There was a group of us doing the tour so you meet people all over the world. We were taken to different districts to experience authentic local cuisines and stopped on the way where we learn't about the customs, culture and the Vietnamese people. We really experienced a lot more than just the food. Experiencing Saigon all lit up at night while traveling to each stop was a beautiful sight to see. Our tour guide Tai was very friendly and welcoming and was a wealth of information which we found to be very helpful for the remainder of our trip. We can recommend the xo foodies tour and can honestly say it is one of the most amazing things we have ever done and was the highlight of our trip.

This is a fantastic tour. - After a three week backpacking trip through Vietnam, the standout experience was the XO motorcycle and food tour of Ho Chi Minh (saigon) city. We each received a friendly Vietnamese guide who made us feel immediately at ease riding pillion on their motorcycle; they were competent, cautious and always in control. The back of a motorcycle was an exhilarating way to absorb the city sights, all the while swapping stories, and learning about life in saigon from our entertaining guides. I appreciate Saigon in a new way, as we toured through the poorer parts, glitzy new districts, culturally diverse regions, and swarming local markets. Finally, the best part was the amazing food, we ate SO MUCH FOOD! everywhere we went we were introduced to unusual, authentic and completely delicious dishes. This was an unforgettable experience, you couldn't find a better way to experience this amazing city, its sensational food, and friendly people!

Fun while learning - a perfect combination - It was so much fun and I would recommend this to anyone, seriously! I thought I might be nervous being on the moped, but not at all. Go for it - it is an awesome way to get to know this city and its culture. The Sights tour also stops at some relevant and interesting places in the city, along with some fun photo shoots, some local fare, and small history lessons - which were made very user friendly by the pics on the guide's iPad she will show to us. We were all over Vietnam and Cambodia during this trip, and the XO Sights Tour ranks as one of our very favorite things we did.

Unforgettable! - The XO night foodie tour was the highlight of my trip to HCMC.

From the beginning when the girls picked us up at the hotel, until we were dropped back off later, we were treated excellently. Ben was a great host and Too (sp?) my driver was lovely, all the girls were.

I was unhappy before I made the decision to go on this tour. And when I had trouble with keeping my food up, I was offered to be taken back to the hotel which was 30 minutes away, which was very kind. I refused and kept going because I was having such a great time, and I felt better. My friends who aren't foodies absolutely loved the tour and couldn't thank me enough for booking it.

XOllent Tours!!! - After reading TripAdvisor reviews we thought we would do the day time City Sights Tour. The tour was excellent. Such a great way to get around most of what is wort seeing in HCMC. We had such a good time we booked in for the Foodie tour. This was one of the best things I have done in a long, long time. Thoroughly recommended and don't hold back on trying the adventure offerings, they are all extremely tasty!! Don't go to HCMC and don't do one of these tours.

Well-priced, safe, and fun. - My husband and I joined a sight seeing tour and really enjoyed this. It is a great way to see the main sights without the hassel of transport or navigation if attempting to do so independently. The guides are friendly and informative, I would recommend this attraction without hesitation.

Wonderful time - We always wanted to try the street food but were never sure what to eat and where to go. This tour solves that problem. We had an excellent time with the XO girls! They came to pick you up at your hotel and the same girl stayed with you throughout the 4 hours. You can tell that they have done this many times and they make a point of looking after you, asking questions and answering yours. They were extremely professional and safe in driving us all over Ho Chi Minh City. You go to several districts and try amazing street food at each stop. Places where you would normally never unless come you had a Vietnamese friend guiding you. On this trip it felt like Tai was our special Vietnamese friend. He was so great at reminding all our names and made the group feel welcome when we first came together. He also makes sure that he gives a little background to the districts and food you are eating. The tour begins with a soup from central Vietnam and then several other amazing meals which you share with the other people on the tour. I will keep the surprise of all the meals but do pace yourself. This tour is slightly pricey but was definitely a highlight of our trip! We love Vietnamese food and always wondered what it would be like to drive through traffic here in the evening. I was slightly worried because traffic is so hectic but this is very well organized. We loved it!

HCMC Highlight - We heard about the XO Tours by a chance meeting with a traveler from Ireland at the Imperial City in Hue. He recommended the Foodie Tour and when we got back to our hotel, I promptly booked it. So glad I did because it was a definite highlight of our Vietnam holiday. I getting loved to ride on the back of a motor bike, going into different districts beyond District 1, seeing the city at night, and trying different and delicious food. Tai was an excellent tour leader and our guides were great. We were surprised how much you could chat while riding on the motorbike. This was a fantastic experience!

Highlights of Saigon Trip - We were picked up by two Vietnamese girls...have to apologise cause we forgot their names. Friendly, informative and attend to all your questions. Met up with the rest of the group and also managed. The entire trip has been amazing going into different districts where normal tourists would never venture into. Food was an experience and I don't think I should say anything more just to give you the suspense if you are doing the trip. Price is slightly pricey but all I can say is it is worth every cent. A special thank you to the two girls and ben as well as the bodyguards that protect us throughout the trip...yes..we feel 100% safe...

Saigon night tour - It was heard to choose what tour to do but with 14 and 12 year old nieces I decided on the Saigon by night tour. Wow - it was perfect!
The XO girls are so friendly yet professional. The tour itself was well executed - we saw some great places then we had dinner at a very interesting open air restaurant - the best hot pot in Saigon.
Then we were back on the bikes for maybe another hour to see some more sights.
My nieces had a wonderful time and thought it was the highlight of their trip.
thanks XO for a memorable experience. Xxx

INCREDIBLE! - I would return to HCMC just for this Foodie Tour. I had never ridden a motor bike before - and Thuy gave me an excellent introduction. It was exciting getting the feel of the traffic flow in the city and she made me feel comfortable and safe in about 3 minutes! The places were all interesting and Ben gave us a great explanation at each stop. The ladies spoke excellent English, were able to carry on conversations as they guided us through the endless stream of motor bikes! The whole experience was more than we expected thanks to the organization of the tour but it was made extra special by our guides, Thuy and Hue.

The highlight of my entire holiday!! DO NOT MISS THIS!!! - I have had the benefit of traveling to many countries, both for work and vacation. This vacation alone, I visited Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam. My Foodie Tour with XO Tours was the highlight of my entire holiday and one of the best things I have ever done anywhere. Yes, it was THAT good, and no, I do not work for XO Tours! I just believe that when something is this wonderful, the world needs to know!

The owner/operator, Tung, is a Vietnamese American (when you hear him speak, you will realize he is very much American) who takes a hands on approach to the tour. He greeted us in person at the beginning to let us know what was in store for us, and he also showed up at many of the stops. He made it clear that we would not be eating the standard tourist fare (no pho!) but rather what real Vietnamese people eat. In fact, he did not choose the place we would go or what we would eat. He left this up to the staff. The places we were to visit are places they would go to themselves.

Frankly, the experience of zipping through the streets of Saigon on the back of a motorcycle was worth the price alone. Super fun! But when you combine this with some of the most delicious, authentic (and if you so choose, daring) food you've ever had the pleasure of eating, and as much of it as you'd like, there is very little not to love about the experience.

However, I have not even mentioned the best part, yet. The drivers are all amazingly wonderful - super relaxed, super cool, super knowledgeable, super friendly. In one word, they are simply SUPER. And I was lucky to have the beautiful Huong as my driver. I would have thoroughly enjoyed my tour without her, but having her show me around really made it all the more special. By time we were finished, I felt I had made a friend. How often can you say that about a tour? All in all, a truly wonderful experience with a wonderful guide.

Tung told me that it was a challenge living up to the very high ranking on tripadvisor and the great expectations this leads to, so he probably would rather I not be so effective with my praise. But the fact is that if you're in Saigon for at least one evening, you will really be missing out if you weren't to do this. It really is that good!

The XO Foodie Tour - NOT TO BE MISSED!!!

Night Tour on Scooter with XO - Best activity on our trip - We recently did a night tour of Saigon with XO Tours on our first night in Saigon.

Truthfully, I was a bit apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter around the busy streets of Saigon, but I felt completely safe and really enjoyed the night. So much, that it turned out to be my favorite activity on our trip to Vietnam.

The tour is very well run, you spend about 1.5 hours riding around on the scooters, but only in segments of around 20 minutes each, with breaks to discover more about the areas of Saigon you are visiting.

You also stop for a delicious meal. While it's called a snack, we chose the Com Tam (Broken Rice), which we had with Palm Sugar juice and local fruits. It was so delicious and more than enough for our appetites.
