The tours are run by girls, and they were so friendly, helpful and informative. They have excellent English. A top trip, make sure you take a look at their website and fit it into your visit to Saigon.

The Hype Is Right - Tripadvisor has a serious crush on XO Tours, which, after our tour last night, seemed deserved. The guides are all wonderful women who speak good English and do an excellent job keeping the evening entertaining. The food experience gets one out of the rut of spring rolls and pho and offers the chance (totally voluntary) to get a bit weird (balut, for example). Riding on a moped in HCMC at night is a worthwhile experience in and of itself. The tour offers a third element in which it's also a tour of modern HCMC and its various districts. Add those three things together, throw in a few beers just because, and you've got a great night in HCMC.

A must do if you are visiting HCM - We really loved our tour with XO, we did the Saigon by Night tour with our guides. The girls spoke excellent English and were so friendly, we were both chatting away and laughing with them for the whole tour as we were driving along. Also a big thank you to our tour leader who told us so many interesting facts about the different Districts we visited. For anyone who is nervous about going on motorbikes in crazy HCM traffic, don't be these girls are excellent and very safe drivers, and we felt completely at ease.

A must do! - We did the "Sights tour" and "Saigon by night", it was awesome! The scooter girls were very warm and very friendly. I was with Ngan during the day and we had lots of fun while going through the streets of Saigon. Our tour leaders Tai and Tuong said some very interesting facts about Saigon. The night tour was exciting as you will get to see the different districts of the city, each has a personality of its own. This is the most exciting tour I have done so far. I will come back to Saigon and will do this again! I will also try their foodie tour! Dont miss XO tours if you are in the city! xx

A NOT TO BE MISSED EXPERIENCE - exhiliarating, exciting, fun, exceptional, entertaining and great food - just some of the words which describe this fabulous food and sightseeing tour in HCMC.

If you are going to be in HCMC don't miss this experience- it is the best you will have in Vietnam.
Everything about XO Tours is so highly professional.

You will feel perfectly safe so no need to be nervous as they take such great care of you

On the Foodie Tour which is over four hours, If you would like to, you can try exotic foods as well as really delicious stuff that you just may never have had the opportunity to try before.. don't eat too much all day as there is a huge amount of food (and drink) throughout the evening.

The owner, Tung is so helpful from the moment you contact him, and nothing seems too much trouble even after the tour.

Ben the tour leader does an amazing job and is so knowledgeable about everything HCMC (as well as being enourmous fun)

And then we have those gorgeous girls....so charming, caring and fun. They just make you feel so special.

I would advise paying the little extra to have your whole experience captured on video

I cannot wait til my next trip to HCMC (next year) to do it all again-

Amazing Foodie tour - every City should have these! - My Dad and I were on the same tour as the family below - and couldn't agree more! We did this tour on our first night in Saigon - and it was a fantastic introduction to the city.
Our guides - Ngan and Vi were fantastic - so friendly, very safe drivers and made us feel very comfortable. The girls really are the ones who make the tour awesome!
The food itself was great! There were a few things that I wasnt too fond of and I didn't try the Balut.... but it was still awesome fun watching everyone else try it! The chilli crab and the Bun Bo Hue were our favourites!
I cant reccomend this tour enough! I fell in love with Vietnam and can't wait to come back and do this tour again and try the other tours offered by XO!!!!

Book the Foodie Tour, very professional, very friendly - I would book this tour again just to see the people again. The tour guides were so nice and made every effort to make sure we were comfortable. I don't like sea food and Tai, our main guide was lovely enough to order me different dishes throughout the tour.
If you are in Ho Chi Minh, you should definitely book this tour you wont regret it.
We did it as a couple and even if you were alone or as a family you'd love the tour.

Family of five on foodie tour - My husband and I took our three teenagers on the foodie tour a few days ago - what a fabulous time! I won't spend time repeating all the wonderful things said about the lovely ladies, and wonderful host, the fabulous food and professional organization. Instead, I'll highlight the fun we all had individually and as a family. The boys, of course, loved riding on the backs of scooters with beautiful Vietnamese girls driving - And daring the rest of us to try everything set in front of us - even the nearly developed duck still in it's shell! The girls did a fabulous job keeping us all together en route, so mom didn't get nervous wondering where everyone was in crazy traffic. My husband said that it was one of the most fun things he has ever done. Definitely, the best thing you can do with your teens in HCMC.

A MUST DO!!! - We started our Vietnam holiday with XO's Foody tour and it was a highlight! The girls picked us up at our hotel and gave us a tour of HCM City by motorbike. We stopped at many different eateries along the way, and were able to sample some of Vietnam's delicacies, most of which we never ever would have ordered on our own. All the guides spoke excellent English, and were very engaging and witty. I wouldn't hesitate to do this tour, or another with XO Tours, again.

Just perfect - We had an excellent guide who spoke good English.
Great food and great tour, we had a very good time.
Thanks !

The ratings say it all - great for solo travelers, couples, groups - I went on two of the XO Tours adventures - the City Sights in the morning and the Foodie Tour at night. Both were Great, seriously Great!

The City Sights tour was a terrific way of settling in and seeing and learning about some of the most famous buildings and places in Ho Chi Minh City. I found this tour very interesting and enjoyable.

The Foodie tour however is even better. It has to be one of (if not the) best tour I have ever been on. I was traveling solo so went by myself and i was so glad I did. The XO Tours ladies are excellent and the food is out of this world good - both in quality and quantity, and the other people on the tour were there to have lots of fun time which guaranteed we all had a great time. Super Highly Recommended!

Almost everyone doing the tours signed up after reading Trip Advisor and the high ratings are a true reflection of how good XO Tours are. Whether you are traveling solo like I was, or a couple or a group etc you will love it. And by the way, it is very safe.

Don't think about it. Just book it in.

Best food - Heard about the tour from people in our resort and booked it the next day. Its about $70 US dollars but its well worth it for the food and the tour you take along the way. The Girls who drive you around are fantastic and the places you eat are not on the food map but the spread is brilliant. But you must attack the food with an open mind because some of it is a little random but very tasty. Well worth the look.

Wow - madness made easy on the back of a scooter - What an outstanding tour. We chose for the sightseeing tour and was guided through the bike madness by our delightful and very skillful female riders. Along the way we stopped often and were greeted by a tour guide who explained the sight and its back ground. We loved it so much we immediately booked for the foodie tour the following evening. Equally enjoyable and a chance to sample the local delights as well as enjoy the city by night. Fantastic

Loved, loved, loved it!!!! - This was the best tour in Vietnam! The staff were amazing and so much fun! My husband booked us on a private foodie tour. Really worth paying that little bit extra. They were so friendly and we had so many laughs - not to mention the amazing (and interesting) foods that we were able to try- ten courses of it! Needless to say we were very full of it. This was definitely the best way to see Vietnam and try the street foods that we weren't comfortable trying on our own. It was also great to see the other parts of Saigon on the back of a bike! We feel very safe with our excellent chauffeurs.

Very professional, but very relaxing and fun at the same time. They went out of their way to make us feel comfortable, but safe and secure at all times.

Thank you so much to Tien, Truc and Tai for such a memorable evening.

Top marks! - I did the foodie tour and being a foodie, it was outstanding! Ben was very hospitable and knew everyone's name (13 in tour) in 3 minutes - well done Ben! At first a bit hesitant being on the back of a bike when it was raining but my guide was an expert driver. Great insight into other districts other than district 1 with a nice history tour thrown in too. The food: great! Beef noodle soup, frogs, scallops, prawns, to name a few. Basically unlimited beer. Perfect length of tour, always interesting and my absolute highlight of HCM.

Best experience in HCMC! - I went on the foodie tour and it was seriously amazing! At first it may seem a little pricey but it is worth every penny! You can eat and drink as much as you like! Choosing from the many different foods they bring but I don't think anyone would need more, its seriously a lot of food! Our tour guide was Tai Dang, he was amazing and made the trip so enjoyable!! He is extremely funny and really knows his stuff, communication isn't an issue his English is very fluent! You will also receive an email with about 8 photo's from the night which was a fantastic surprise! I have experienced motorbikes in HCMC before but I have never felt more safe than with the Vietnamese drivers on this tour. You learn so many facts about Vietnam that you just wouldn't learn otherwise. You cannot miss this amazing tour!!!

Highlights of the trip so far - We had heard great things about XO so made sure to book the foodie tour before we left home! We were not disappointed, we had a great night. Such a well organized and smooth running tour. The girls are amazing drivers/riders, we felt safe the entire time, even in such a frantic busy city. They kept us entertained as well as educated and looked after us too. We felt quite spoiled with the girls peeling our prawns and filling our bowls with food. They never leave you hungry, always getting you drinks and more than enough food. Our tour guide Tai was great too.
All in all this was the highlight of our trip so far and highly recommend you give it a go!

The best thing in HCMC! - I can't say enough good things about this Foodie tour! The experience itself is so great and very interesting. You get to see a ton of the city that you probably wouldn't see, and the guide tells you a lot about the city. The drivers are great, and all of the food is delicious and local. The customer service is also really fantastic. I went on this tour in November 2012 and loved it so much that I brought a group of visiting friends here in July 2013. When I booked the tour, I mentioned that I was a return customer, and at every stop along the tour, our guide gave me two options of food since he knew I had been before. I also had a friend come along with lots of allergies (shellfish, coconut, and nuts), and they were incredibly accommodating!! Love the XO Foodie Tour and would recommend it to anyone in Saigon - it is one of the best experiences ever!

Great Tour...and the absolute best way to see HCM! - This is a must do tour! We had a group of 7 do this tour in early July 2013. We were all very excited about the motorbike aspect of this tour, although also a little nervous after watching the motorbikes around town. However, after a couple of minutes on the bike with your tourguide, you feel completely safe. Seeing HCM on a motorbike is awesome! And the tourguides/bike drivers are great..they totally make this tour. You get to see so many different parts of HCM and they tell you all about it. Everyone in our group was very impressed and it was one of our favorite things we did while in HCM. About the food...while it was not the best food we had while in HCM, they do offer a huge variety of food and are very accommodating of allergies. You truly get to experience all the different types of local food. Overall can't say enough good things about this tour!

Highlights of our holiday! - We did the evening foodie tour. We were picked up from our hotel by 2 lovely girls that took us to our first stop where we meet the rest of the group and our tour leader. Our tour leader was Ben. He let us know at each stop about the food we were eating. We stated our tour with Bun Bo Hue, which was a noodle soup dish that was alot nicer that Pho.
Our other stops included grilled okra, grilled goat, crab, squid, scallops. More food than you could eat. You also had the chance to try grilled frog and duck embryo if you choose to. You can drink as much beer/soft drinks as you want.
Our tour leader Ben was a very funny and enthusiastic fellow. He would explain about each stop we ate at as to what we were eating as well as explain about the parts of Saigon we stopped in.
While the group was riding from place to place we had 2 other men that would travel with the group to make sure we were safe.
The tour is very organised and we had a fantastic night!
Definitely a must while in Saigon!!

Excellent - We did the 4.15 foodie tour, communication before the tour was great, guides arrived on time as promised.
Tour was fun and more than expected. Great tour of the different districts, knowledgable guides and they really look after you, always on the lookout for your safety/security and enjoyment. Great english and a good sense of humour.

The food - places we would never have thought to try but wow what an experience, a real mixture. Everything is included, even the beer! They also carry hand sanitizer for you!
Your driver stays with you and helps you prepare your foo and explains everything to you.
4.15 was a great time, home around 9pm.
Make sure to have an early or small lunch as food is plentiful.
Have an open mind, be willing to try new things and enjoy!

Highlight of HCMC - Doing the Saigon by Night tour on our first night in HCMC was the best way to orientate ourselves with the city, experience local life and to visit the districts that we would not normally get to see. Everything about this tour was amazing! Despite the insane traffic, we felt extremely safe on the back of the bikes. The drivers were lots of fun and were very informative. The street food that we tried on the tour was extremely fresh and probably one of the best meals that we had in Vietnam. Would highly recommend XO Tours for anyone travelling to HCMC!

See the best of Vietnam in just a few hours in a fun way - I did the morning sights tour with Ngan, and she was fantastic. As a history buff I loved to see the things you otherwise would be so oblivious to as a tourist! For e.g. the secret CIA base right near the war museum... Included is a sugar cane drink and some fresh tropical fruit.

The girls were wonderful drivers who were very careful in briefing you on the bike before you got on. I would definitely recommend this for anybody, even a person petrified of bikes! It's a good place to start since they're so professional.

For me, as a young female traveler, it was so wonderful to have another girl the same age be my driver! We gossiped and laughed and the whole group was happy and upbeat. The pace of the tour is great, so even somebody who gets bored listening to a tour gets the benefit of a high speed bike ride between stops.

The girls are chatty, speak great English, and the main tour guide has probably the best local English speaker I've met in Asia and is really knowledgable.

Afterwards Ngan recommended some good Vietnamese food and dropped me at the restaurant near my hostel, making sure I knew how to get home.

All round great service with a high regard for your safety, and we learned about very pivotal parts of Vietnamese history. There's a reason these guys are rated so highly, well worth the money!

Best thing to do in HCMC - I did the tour with my 15 year old daughter and it was the best thing we did in HCMC. We went on the Foodie tour had great food in some really out of the way places a tourist would never find and had great company. The girl riders were really great and really sparky and spoke really good English. The back of the bike is as safe if not safer than crossing the road yourself in HCMC :). A great value evening we will never forget ........ Unfortunately my daughter now wants her own motorbike!

Amazing, satisfying and Fun!! - I really wish I could rate these guys higher. There isn't one thing I would change about this tour. From even before we arrived to Vietnam, we were in correspondence with Tung. He is professional and helpful.

On the night of our tour, 2 girls arrived to pick us up. After a brief intro, we were off. There is no better way to see Saigon than on the back of a moped. The girls were fantastic, informative and so sweet. Special thank you to Dy!!!

On our first stop, we met everyone else and Ben our your leader. They were so conscious of our dietary preferences and so helpful.

This was just so much better than anything I ever expected. I am actually at a loss for words. If you are a foodie....do this!!!!!

Absolute Treat - Fantastic Adventure - A Must for Foodies - The XO Food Tour was the best tour on our visit to HCMC. For any person out there that enjoys trying a variety of street foods - this is for you!! Full stop. We made our booking four days in advance as this is the time limit required via the Internet once we had arrived.
Four days later at our given start time four well dressed women rode up to our Hotel, parked their bikes neatly on the footpath. After introductions we were paired with an English speaking driver who then informed us of the do's and don'ts on riding a motor bike (as passenger)....we were then whisked away to our first food destination and introduced to our main host for the night - in our case it was Ben.

Ben gave us the run down on what was ahead of us in this food adventure. Where we were going and if there were any special eating requirements.

Now remember, this is a food tour. So, you try something at one location then you are driven to another location through the streets of HCMC given a one on one update/advice/information on the area travelled by your driver - and included in this is the experience of being equal with the locals.
Nothing beats it. Full stop!

On this night our group sampled; soup, BBQ goat, okra, BBQ prawn, BBQ calamari, various green leaf, beer, BBQ frog, more beer, crab, scallops, clams, quail, 14 day old duck egg more beer....and finally a birthday cake as one in our party celebrated their birthday. What an adventure. It was fantastic.

XO Tours did a great job - this tour is well worth every cent. A must for all foodies!

Thank you Ben - it was great.

Most Bodacious Tour - XO tour in Saigon was an excellent and most bodacious tour I have had. I was extremely pleased from the commencement when booking to the conclusion of the tour.
I took the foodies tour with a video of the event.
Communication was outstanding throughout the entire process, it was fluent and succinct.
I was most impressed by the young lady Hung who managed quite safely to manage the motor cycle through the maze of traffic, and being an experienced rider on Asian roads I know how intensely challenging and taxing it becomes, to safely and effectively manage a bike in that type of traffic.
Hung was also quite communicative throughout the process, and again compliments on her and the fluency of the conversation and informative information.
Tai Dang was our tour guide, He introduced us to various parts of the city and an insight into the foods, which was very informative and he was the person who guaranteed the run the night like well-oiled machine, perfect to the very end.
The photos and video production was well beyond all expectations and can't express how pleased I was with the effort of all involved to have a well-executed evening that has quality memories for the future.
From the initial communication with Tung to the conclusion I couldn't be happier and would highly recommend XO tours for your next adventure in Saigon.
I would extremely recommend; as a good well valued service and enjoyable way to see the sights of Saigon.
Thank you to the team at XO Tours for fantastic and memorable evening.

ADRENALIN and FOOD - What can i say, this was the most exciting tour i have ever done. The girls that road the bikes were so friendly and professional and the team that supported them were exceptional. I Love these guys they gave me a reason to be absolutely exhilarated and excited and kept satisfied with food and drink for 4 hours. I love my driver Hailing she was awesone, Ben the organization for the night and all the others looking after us. This is a MUST DO if you travel to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh) by yourself as a favor.

Nice introduction to the city - We booked the morning city tour based on recommendations from TA and fellow travelers we met during our trip. It was a good way to get acquainted with the city and see the most popular sites. We felt very safe on the scooters. The tour is very well organized. Our two drivers met us at the hotel and we met with one more fellow participant at our first stop. The guide wasn't in charge of driving anyone and was always a step ahead of us. Her English was perfect. We didn't get a chance to see everything that was listed on the site – we didn't go to Cholon. We did visit it on our own after and don't feel like we missed much. I wish we had time to do the Saigon by Night food tour with XO too.

Great introduction to Saigon - We started our first visit to Saigon with a Private tour (all other tours fully booked during our stay here). We were already expecting a great time as the email communication prior had been efficient and the planned tour offered fitted our requests well. Tung Do, the Director, was fantastic in organizing it all and even managed to find time to be part of our tour.

The girls were absolutely wonderful - perfectly safe, despite the mayhem that is traffic in Saigon. We felt in safe hands, even with our 10 year old on a scooter! Maybe it helps that both my husband & I have bike licenses in Australia... We certainly got to see parts of Saigon that we wouldn't have ventured too. We also started our holidays with our favorite part - eating local street food.

Highly recommend this tour, especially if you're worried about taking children (only 1 I found with full insurance). Service was impeccable and it lives up to its publicity. If you can afford it, the Private Tour is a great way to tailor the event to your needs, but next time we really want to do the Foodie Tour!

An experience of a life time !!!!!!!!!! - After booking this trip whilst in Thailand I was horrified to arrive in Siagon and see how the Vietnamese drive around the city center. It looked extremely dangerous and made me so nervous. When the time of the tour arrived I was picked up by a wonderful lady by the name of Nhan Nguyen who spoke fluent English and within minutes of being on the back of her bike she had made me so relaxed. Not only was she an excellent driver but she had so much knowledge of her city and the history of Vietnam which we discussed while touring the City and enjoying some fine foods. It was a pleasure to meet all the tour guides on the trip and the tour manager Ben Chua, all of them were so friendly and helpful. The whole experience on the Foodie Tour from start to end was out of this world and one I'll cherish forever. I recommend this to anyone.

My favorite tour in Saigon! - This was my favorite tour in Saigon! You get to see so much of the city and try different local foods. All the food was great and the locations were safe and clean. I'm a vegetarian and they were able to accommodate my dietary restrictions. Ben, the tour manager, was excellent and took pictures along the way. Driving around on the mopeds gives you a truly authentic experience. You also make some stops along the way to learn about the city and take pictures. The staff all spoke excellent English and were very friendly. I highly recommend this tour, even if you aren't a foodie! It's a great way to see the city.

The perfect way to see Saigon. - This was a perfect way to see the major sights of the city, with a excellent tour guide who explained the history and background of the places at the various stops we made. I went on this following a recommendation from a fellow guest in the hotel I was staying in and was not disappointed. I honestly don't know how the lady drivers weave their way through the traffic, but don't worry you are in capable hands, it feels very safe and must be the best way to see Saigon. It is great looking at the shops and streets from the road whilst having all your questions answered. I have visited Saigon before and seen some of the tourist stops but usually alone, so it was great to get such a knowledgeable explanation at each of the stops. Our group consisted of 3 of us each with our own driver and was a nice group size. The timing was just right too, enough to see the places and understand the history but not a boring walk around for hours. Over all I think the trip was around 3 hours and included visiting The Central Post Office and Notre Dame Cathedral, where we started. A stop at the Reunification Palace, the Jade Emperor Pagoda, the Secret CIA Building - from a distance ! Then to see a local market and finishing at the Thich Quang Duc memorial before being dropped off at my hotel. Not forgetting all the motorbike trips in between! Highly recommended.

Great Orientation night - We had booked XO Tours 2 weeks prior to leaving NZ. The 4 girls turned up at our hotel to pick us up on time and the whole evening went like clockwork. We had booked the foodie tour - 4 hours of scootering around Saigon and stopping to sample the local cuisine. All four of us thoroughly enjoyed the scooter rides and felt completely safe in the busy streets - XO tours provide a security escort with 4-5 guys on scooters travelling with us. They were very security conscious and even asked one of the women on the tour to remove a necklace - so that she wouldn't attract undue attention.The food was great and we ate in places that we would otherwise overlook. It felt very authentic. One of the best features of the tour was that all the girls we were riding with spoke very good English and you could ask questions while on the back of the scooter - this gave you more of an insight into Vietnamese life. Photos of the evening are sent to you after the tour via email. WE would all thoroughly recommend this experience and can see why they are already so highly rated.
Great tour! alittle expensive but fun!! - Great tour, ben the manager and the girls are realy nice. abit expensive though... but other than that is very recommanded.

A wonderful experience - What a wonderful experience it was. I took the Saigon by night, the tour guide was very fluent in English & had very good overview of all aspects of the places we rode. One of the best experiences I have encountered in visiting many countries. Great going, keep it up!

Best Night in Ho Chi Minh City!! - This tour is absolutely fantastic! We participated in it June 6 2013. You are driving around on the back of a scooter with your own personal driver for the night. All the drivers are female and speak excellent English. They were all absolutely friendly and courteous. The girls will pick you up at your hotel, take you to the first spot of the night, where you will meet the guide for the night, who is also very friendly and funny! You are also greeted by security guards, because you do go to some poor parts of the city, BUT even without those security guards, I felt completely safe the entire night. The security guards help you cross the street (a bonus in HCMC) and follow you on your scooters to make sure everything is completely safe. At each spot you are sat down to excellent food, even better conversation and great entertainment! I still brag to my husband that I beat him in the cashew/chopstick challenge! My husband really enjoyed that they in between food stops, they stopped in various districts in the city and really showed you beyond the tourist trail of what HCMC looks like. No need to worry about allergies or general dislikes as they are accommodating as possible! My husband is allergic to most seafood and they provided him with chicken and pork alternatives! BUT this is a food tour so expected to expand your culinary horizon. Their staff also take pictures throughout the night and after the trip they are emailed to you as a souvenir!
Our time with this tour was well spent, it made for an absolutely fantastic evening in HCMC and highly recommend it!! A very well organized and well run tour!!!

Be one of the cool kids for a night! - We did the food trip and it was fantastic. The girls pick you up in their traditional blue and white uniforms and you're off, straight into the thick of the Saigon traffic! It is exhilarating! The girls are very confident riders, giving a running commentary on the areas we whizzed through. We stop for food where the locals eat, as much food and drink as you want. Lots of Laughs and a wonderful way to see the city. Don't hesitate. Book it.

Great time with great guides!!! - We were celebrating our honeymoon, and as chefs we had to try the "foodie tour". From beginning to end we had a blast! The guides were great giving information about the city and making jokes. It was so comfortable the whole time, and we felt like family. The food was great and they had some interesting choices for us. They order everything for you, all you have to do is sit and eat!! Amazing experience, amazing people, highlight of our trip!

A must-have in Saigon! - Last night we went on a trip of a lifetime! Five of us -- myself, an adult friend, my two kids ages 10 and 9 and our 10 year old cousin went on "Saigon by Night." What a blast! It is such a fun, unique and exhilarating way to experience the city, learn about the culture and see the sights. In fact, you will be taken places you probably will never go on your own or with a traditional tour. The motorbike guides are fun, professional and knowledgable. Although a little scary in the beginning, you soon realize that they know what they are doing and you can relax and take it all in. Touring China Town and stopping for street food were highlights, as was seeing the motorbike free expat area. My advise: don't hesitate and do it!

One of the highlights of our holiday - After plying me with dribks my wife persuaded me to book this scooter tour whilst staying in Saigon. I was glad she did even tho it was a little bit daunting for someone more comfortable on 4 wheels. The girls that met us outside were really friendly and chatty and once we had the pre ride briefing we were off! We chose the evening tour of all the different districts and this was a real eye opener as it showed us all the different sides to a metropolis like Saigon. We also took in a snack stop (we had made our choices in advance) from a couple of street vendors and the snacks were ready for us at our break point. We got to meet the owner of the company at one point and we chatted about the concept he was bringing. He took some photos of us and emailed them onto us when we got back home so no need to take your camera. Then it was back off to our hotel and memories of a wonderful night. As we are going back to Saigon next year we will definitely be doing another one of their trips!

Only the Best Joyride! - If you want to feel the crazy Vietnamese motorbikes traffic and also try some delicious food, this is the right activity! We did the Saigon by Night, my friend, my wife and me. The girls are funny, gentile and make you feel safe and welcome. They take you to other areas of Ho Chi Minh City outside the tourist circuit and explain a lot about the city, there are 3 options of food and a lot of fun and photos! Unforgettable experience! We miss you Girls!

The foodie tour much more then just food! - Where do I start? My sister and I arrived in HCM on Wednesday morning, our flight got in at 7am and by 8.55am we were on our sights tour around HCM. The girls were so friendly and spoke excellent English, we hopped on the back of the Scooters and off we went. They took you to some of the most interesting places in HCM not the most touristy, which was really refreshing, we went to go meet an old man who has worked in the post office there for about 60 years, random but great. So...that tour was so good we decided at the last minute to book the foodie tour. Now if you can only go on 1 tour with these guys, make it this one. Pickup outside our hotel, again, 2 very nice and friendly girls greet us and take us off to our first eating stop to meet the rest of the tour group. You are immediately greeted by Ben, the Tour Guide. He is such a sound guy, very knowledgeable, speaks excellent English and impressively remembers everyone's name. The food is excellent as you would expect from a tour named 'the foodie tour' but the tour is much more of an experience then that, your tour guides are all young Vietnamese people, you get to understand a little bit about life in HCM and you realize that although your in a communist country, you can identify so much with those who drive you around. My driver Binh was really friendly, and we were singing songs, talking about clubbing, politics, movies just about everything. You get so much more then food out of this tour, nice people, a really fun drive around the city, good atmosphere, excellent guides and just and excellent view of how HCM really works.

Im 27 and my sister 25, we are both pretty fearless, but id happily suggested to my parents who are in their 60's to go on these tours, I couldn't have felt safer if they picked me up in a tank! Its so much fun, do it!

Expensive for Saigon standards but worth it - Although $68 may seem expensive for Saigon, XO is way above any other tour we did in Saigon (or any other place for that matter) and well worth the money. For the foodie tour, you get multiple tour guides, transportation on mopeds, body guards (apparently the last area you go to is not so safe for your tourists on their own), pictures, and as much food as you can eat. All of the employees were very polite, personable, and provided insight into Saigon that you can only get from a local. Riding on the moped was scary at first, but you quickly get use to the craziness and ends up being a highlight of the tour. The foodie tour was great because, not only do you try a wide variety of food, the tour is designed to show you contrasting parts of the city. The food itself was also very good. A wide variety was available, and I think most people would at least try everything. Weirdest thing was probably balut, but if you're filipino then it's no big deal. Conclusion - no joke, all the high ratings it already received on TripAdvisor are well deserved. No scam going on here.

Awesome way to eat different things in HCMC - We had such a fantastic time with XO Tours. We did the foodie tour which was our whole evening on the first night we arrived in HCMC and it was a great way to see the different areas of HCMC and of course... eat different types of food! I know it seems a bit expensive, especially compared to what you're normally paying for food and transportation in HCMC, but we really enjoyed the experience, especially with our fluent English-speaking tour manager, Ben.

The different varieties of food were great and they're right - we were NOT hungry at all by the end of the tour. We really enjoyed learning more about the different districts of HCMC and Ben was excellent in explaining things. Each person had a driver and they were all very friendly and open to share about their experiences growing up and living in HCMC.

Honestly, one of the best guided tours we have ever done and this was the highlight of our Vietnam trip!

A smooth flight through Saigon with the XO hostesses! - We booked this morning-tour after reading the many recommendations and . . .
it was beyond expectations. Early in the morning we were greeted at our hotel by the very friendly XO-hostesses and off we were, to meet with a small group of tourists and the tour-host on a central place.
The ride was smooth and it was exciting to be part of the hectic traffic without the responsibility of driving. The girls were great drivers and easy to talk with in between and during rides and we were also very well taken care of and informed by the tour host.
We also booked the optional personal video, which we received a couple of days ago and our only response after seeing it first time was, WOW!!! What a great souvenir and so well done. So much effort was put into it, the filming, the editing and the music. Thank you XO!!! We now have close to 9 minutes of unbeatable memories that puts a smile on our face every time we watch it.

The best part of our holiday! - This tour was superb! My 6 year old daughter had the time of her life, as did we. Seeing & doing things we wouldn't have been able to on our own. Especially loved the meal in district 4.

Best experience ever. - This tour should absolutely not be missed. From the moment we started, we all had a great time. Everyone learned our names instantly, and we all hung out as one group for the whole night. The food was awesome, but truly the best part was just riding around saigon at night on a scooter and seeing the entire city. We have been traveling throughout Southeast Asia for a month now, and this was by far one the best memories we've made. Xo tour takes the time to deliver this high quality experience - do this tour!

Thoroughly enjoyed the tours - Tung and his team make you feel safe and welcome. We went on the foodie and the city tour - learned a lot about the city and the people. Everyone spoke good English and we had plenty of laughter. The girls love their work and it shows. The video and photos we had taken were excellent and the video has been great to show our friends HCM city. We will be recommending this experience to anyone that is going to HCM/Vietnam

Oh What a Night! - I joined the XO Evening Foodie Tour on my second night in HCM city. I was still shell shocked by the noise, hustle and bustle, millions of scooters!
This very young lady arrived at my hotel to collect me to spend 4 hours or so driving around HCM city on the back of her scooter! Naturally, I put all of my trust into her and off we went...
There was no looking back after that; I had SO much fun. We tried lots of different food; goat, frog, and that scary egg with the partially developed chick - not mandatory of course!
It was just a great night with like minded people.
I asked for the video option and it has been great; lovely to share with friends and family at home.

Amazing shine - When I think about my honeymoon trip this brings fond memories back.
The guide and the girls were amazing. You get to try some tasty food as well as enjoy scooting about town. It was all very safe and great fun.
The girls make you feel at ease throughout the trip and speak very good English, they are a lot of fun to be around. At the end of the night there were smiles all round and the whole thing was a great buzz.
A bit pricey but worth every penny

Food, glorious food and scooter fun - must do in HCM. - Loved this trip/experience - the 4 hr Foodie Tour!
If you can, please do it - it was one of my highlights of our trip.

While HCM hadn't gronw on me during our stay I can honestly say that while riding along ton the back of the scooter, the city finally makes sense!

Our capable riders made us feel at ease, while the XO Tour handler ensured every ran smoothly. Great friendly, welcoming people who made us feel like honoured guests - our riders, E, Ding and co were amazing and we left witha real understaning of VN hospitality.
4 different sites w/ a variety of VN foods you may never see at home served in amongst local markets/outdoor cafes etc. The variety, quality and taste was amazing.

Get out and about in HCM, eat with the locals and see the city beyond the hawkers and toursit traps. We would have done the shopping trip with the girls as well if we had more time in HCM.

Thanks XO tours - this was awesome.

An unforgettable experience - My partner and I booked 3 XO Tours while staying in Ho Chi Minh City. I can not begin to describe what a terrific experience we had. The tours are professional, everybody is exceptionally friendly and it is amazing to say we felt totally safe on the back of a motorbike in the frantic Vietnam traffic with our gorgeous female guides. The first tour was the sight seeing tour, this introduced us to the chaotic life of the Vietnamese people. The second tour was our favorite tour, the foodie tour. We tried traditional Vietnamese foods we never thought we would eat, while travelling from district to district on a motorbike. A wonderful night of laughter and excellent food. The last tour was the shopping tour, this was fabulous but our tip is to know what you are interested in before you set out. We can not speak highly enough of the experience we had with XO Tours. Highly recommended and we would do it all again.

If only they have this everywhere! - With almost all the reviewers here giving a thumbs up to their experience with XO, what does that tells you? I’m not gonna irk you with details but it was this inimitable experience that defines my first whirlwind trip to Ho Chi Minh. I’m definitely bringing my kids the next time I’m here!

First class!

Explore, Saigon-style - Nothing beats getting to know a city than feeling it, smelling it and tasting it. XO Tours gave me all of that and then some with opportunities to build authentic discussions with young Vietnamese. We took the Day tour and the Foodie tour and found the tours appropriately structured, giving sufficient time for photo ops, building rapport with your Vietnamese hosts cum drivers and buying a few souvenirs. The tour guides give interesting narratives that put into context the various places we visited. The stories they told were not the drab historical narratives rather they picked personal stories of Saigonese and Vietnamese individuals that made me feel the history come alive.

The Foodie tour - all 4 hours of it - highlighted new flavors that I did not know Vietnamese cuisine produces. You can choose to eat and stuff yourself in the first meal but more is coming. We did not taste the usual pho' but we were introduced to other noodle dishes that were equally good and uniquely flavorful. The pacing of the courses (they took us to 3 different places, in different districts, and served us at least 8 different dishes and unlimited beer and drinks. We were full at the end of the night but we were not stuffed - it was perfect.

The only thing that I must warn interested people is that you will be behind a bike that will be swerving trough Saigon traffic and that you will be eating outdoors with all the heat and humidity that Saigon offers. If you're up for the adventure, this is a must.

Excellent tour - best way to see Saigon! - We really loved our tour with XO, I think it has been my favourite part of my SE Asia trip so far! My boyfriend and I did the Saigon by Night tour with our guides Binh and Thui (I hope I spelled these correct!). The girls spoke excellent english and were so friendly, we were both chatting away and laughing with them for the whole tour as we were driving along. Also a big thank you to Thuong who was our tour leader and told us so many interesting facts about the different Districts we visited.

For anyone who is nervous about going on motorbikes in crazy HCM traffic, don't be these girls are excellent and very safe drivers, and we felt completely at ease.

A must do if you are visiting HCM, an excellent way to see the city :-)

A must do experience for first time visitors! - Myself and my girlfriend did the Saigon by night and the sights tour. The tour guides we had Thuong, Tram, Kang, Thuy and Ben, were highly knowledgable and fun. Feeling just like one of the locals (riding on the back of a motorcycle), the girls make sure you feel safe on the bike and that you are well looked after. This has been an unforgettable part of our trip in HCMC and we will treasure these fantastic memories for a lifetime. We both highly recommend this tour, especially to those who are first time visitors in Vietnam! 5 STARS!

Super awesome!!! - I did a foodie tour the day before yesterday and everything was amazing!!! Loved the motorbike!! Loved the girls and tour leader! And also loved the food!!! I had a chance to eat balut and surprisingly, it was soo yummy!!! I fell in love at the first taste! ( now I know why Vietnamese eat it! ). I will recommend this tour to everyone!! So worth it!!

A Perfect Ending to our Asian Adventure! - It has all been said before and we are glad we listened to the advice of a Trip Advisor regular and booked in for the XO Foodie Tour.

A huge thank you to the wonderful XO crew who made our last destination an experience that we will cherish and remember for a long time....

Ho Chi Minh traffic is well known for the "WOW" factor when you first visit, so to be out and about amongst it was a blast! I could have stayed on the back of the bike with sweet Thu for hours, enjoying saying Hi and Xin Chau to all around and feeling safe and secure.

Then there was the food... heaps and heaps of tasty dishes in a variety of HCM districts at local spots. You will certainly not be hungry by the end of the night!

Next time we will be checking out some of the tour options available as it is worth for money and the guides are brilliant and we would love to spend more time chatting and learning from them.

You must do this! - Brilliant tours - I did both the sights and the foodie tour. Probably tearing around Saigon on a Saturday night is more exciting and they take you off to districts no tourist goes.
Loved it! - An excellent tour. Everything is so well thought out and done. We did the foodie tour and was an absolute blast! Can't recommend enough!!

A must do! - It has all been said in other reviews and it is all very well deserved!

We did the foodie tour, and it was one of the highlights of our whole trip..we felt very safe and loved every minute. The girls are lovely and well educated, chatting to us the whole time and we feel like we really got to know them and experience their city.

Book it in advance! Awesome experience!

Best tour company! - We booked both the sights tour and the foodie tour and we are so glad we did! From the start the girls were polite and did their utmost to put us at ease and explain what was going to happen. Their driving skills were brilliant and we were converted to the joy of travelling around HCM by motor scooter. Their knowledge and passion for their country's history made the sights tour a real pleasure and it was both informative and fun. The foodie tour was simply the best thing we have ever done, great food, great company and a brilliant way to see areas of the city that you wouldn't normally see. The food is some of the best that i have ever eaten and all i can say is if you are in HCM, you MUST book this tour, XO are amazing and really made our holiday to vietnam extra special.....thanks to you all. Phil and Jaron. Ps get the video done as well........great fun.

MUST DO SHOPPING TOUR!!! - This is our third experience with XO Tours last year we did the foodies and sights tour ( both excellent) The shopping tour was just as good the girls Binh and chi were great safe riders and i felt at ease their English is excellent. Tai the tour leader is a well spoken charming young man that has everything covered especially your safety on and off the bike. He deserves to go far in his career. They take you to local markets, (not the tourist traps) bag stores, laquerware whatever you want that's obtainable in ho chi Minh eg brand name bags sunnies shoes jewellery (hello kitty everything for my girls!) the best thing is everything is CHEAP no scams no rip offs and your tour guides help you with the price. well worth it to do your shopping with XO. Im a type 1 diabetic, when my sugar level went low they took such good care of me Im so grateful XO tours and its crew are wonderful. I will do the shopping tour again next time Im here! We also were treated to some local food a drink a spring rolls Yum!!
Sarah Melbourne

Well worth it! - My husband and I went on the night tour and day tour. We both loved!!! We enjoyed the night tour more because the heat was not so impressive! I was a little scared before we took the tour about riding on a motorcycle in Vietnam but can honestly say the girls are very safe. I never even had a close call.
The night tour took us to places that we would have never gone to. Both tours provided us with great information. The girls arrived at our hotel on time and was very professional. We ordered the video on a night tour and can't wait to see the footage. The video guys were on top of every minute of our experience. For sure....I would recommend the video. We also received photos from the company via email of photos that were taken on our day trip.
It started raining during our night tour and they provided rain ponchos for us. I would recommend for the day tour wearing pants or at least longer shorts because when you stop at the palace and other stops the seats heat up quickly and will burn your legs!
We both loved our tours and would highly recommend both! We did hear that the food tour was great. We wish we could have done it but ran out of time.

Great for teenagers - Our family of 4 (2 teens) have just done the XO Sights tour and it was such a great way to see the sights, get some history and have some fun. The kids absolutely loved it and I am looking forward to the family photos that Tung will email us in the next few days. We did not once feel unsafe on the bikes and the girls are great drivers and very friendly.

A foodie tour is a must! - I went on the foodie tour, on the recommendation of an Australian couple who couldn't praise it enough, I must say I agree with them 100%!
It was the best tour i went on in Vietnam, the guides, Ben and Tai were very knowledgeable, informative and informative and made everyone feel welcome. Khanh, the young lady riding the bike, was so friendly and navigated the traffic safely and with ease. She was amazing!
The 4 hour tour takes in nearly all the districts of Ho Chi Minh City stopping of at some great places to eat which i would never have found by myself.
So if you want to see the sights, eat the food and drink the beer.....and have a great laugh with fun people, then look no further! 11 out of 10 :-)

Fabulous and fun - Just returned from the sight tour with XO a few minutes ago !Our ladies were lovely and so friendly. The tour manager Ben was amazing and very clear when giving us the history behind each site. We got to visit the eldest pagoda in Chinatown and so much more ! Felt very safe on the back of the bikes. That in itself is amazing considering the madness around you. Somehow it works well. Anybody coming to his amazing city must do this tour. Thank you to Ben and the girls!

If you need to splurge ONCE, this is it! - Wow!

Up until this point of my now two-week vacation, my friend and I had not splurged on one thing. We lived in "comfort budget" hotels, we rarely spent more than $5 on meals, and we never did a guided tour activity. However, when I saw the ratings and reviews of this activity, I knew that if we were to splurge once, this had to be it. I was not wrong.

Yes, it is pricey for not only Vietnamese standards, but even for us. But everything about it was great from the first minute we met our lady riders, all the way to the drop-off. It's always good to be pleasantly surprised, so I won't talk details. What I can say though is the trip was extremely organized, I learned things that I would never have known, and it was just plain fun. I would especially do this if you want a chance to ride on a motorbike......you see it everywhere, you might as well try it.

We can't all be wrong, go do it!

A must do when visiting HCMC!!! - Although I use Tripadvisor all the time, I have never found the desire to write a review but after our tour with XO Tours I knew I had to express the amazing time my husband, our two adult daughters and I had on our foodie tour. Our scooter drivers were absolutely delightful! They are so sweet, informative and so much fun to be with. We became very fond of them and hated to say goodbye at the end of the tour. Ben and Tai are equally amazing. They even surprised our daughter with a birthday cake during our tour. I especially like that they emailed us awesome photos of our tour without charging us for them. Make XO Tours a priority when visiting HCMC!!!

Great foodie tour - Very good way to experience both city and some of its districts and the food. Felt very safe on the back of the bikes, we had two excellent ladies looking after us.. Chi and Y both excellent drivers. Fun way to do a food tour in a very large city. Ben the manager did an excellent making sure everyone who has food restrictions got lots of alternative food to meet their requirements. Very well organized tour. My husband was very happy the beer was included!

Kick off your Saigon adventure with XO Bike Tours - Our group of 10 went on the XO Foodie Tour, which was much more than just food. Beers, lots of Laughs, gorgeous girls, duck eggs with foetus inside, city tour etc.

Great way to see the city & have a ball at the same time!

Amazing food and service. - I have been a professional guide for over 20 years and can be quite critical of service oriented operations... these guys were top notch. From the e-mail sign up, prompt and friendly pick-up, excellent guides, informative hosts... and the food!!! the best I have ever eaten on many aspects. Driving around on a motorbike with a local girl in traditional clothing was pretty sweet too. Educational, exciting, and oh so delicious! A must for anyone going to Vietnam who enjoys eating.

Best birthday ever! Best tour ever been on!! - I went on the 4 hour foodie tour and the service from the first minute to the last was exceptional. The tour guides were wonderful and Ben, the tour manager I think, was amazing. The whole experience, being taken through multiple, and very different, districts of Saigon, and the huge range and amount of food!! was an 11 out of 10 experiences. It was my birthday and I had only mentioned it quietly in conversation to the girl who was my driver about 1 hour into the tour. By the end of the tour, they had told everyone and presented me with the most beautiful cake with my name on it and organized for the entire street restaurant to sing happy birthday!!! It brought tears of joy to my eyes. This team is amazing. I will be recommending to everyone and will do this tour on my return to Vietnam! Thankyou to all the guides at XO! xoxoxoxo

Great Tour - When I first read this page, it looked almost unbelievable that the reviews were so positive, but I can now see why!

The tour was great. The Vietnamese girls were incredibly friendly and the manager (Ben) was attentive and eager-to-please. My wife is quite particular with food and he went out of his way to purchase extra things for her so that she could try as many things as possible.

Definitely a recommended activity in HCMC.

great tour - this tour was an excellent way to experience local food in local districts that you wouldn't otherwise have known exists. the guides were really friendly and the food was amazing. Although the tour is a little expensive for Vietnam prices (around $60 each) you definitely get your money's worth on the 4.5hr tour and they're always happy to get you more of your favorite dishes if need be, i'd definitely do it again

Would do this again - Everything about this tour is professional. Was traveling alone and looking for day trips in and around HCMC, this was by far the most fun I had while there. The evening was very informative, entertaining, and tasty. I ride motorbikes myself and can assure you these girls (who are the stars of the show) are very competent, the lovely Ni negotiated the chaotic traffic smoothly from pickup to drop off.
Xo tours - No words can describe the amazing night we had never wanted it to end the tour guides were so friendly and looked after ever need we had. Its a must

The XO Foodie Tour was So Much Fun! - This was a real highlight of our two weeks in Vietnam. I'm a real scary-cat when it comes to doing adventurous things but I was convinced to book my husband and I on this tour for our last night in Ho Chi Minh City, and I'm so very glad I did. The beautiful girls who ride the scooters are very confident riders, great conversationalists and provide a wonderful way to see the city. I didn't feel worried at all as we rode in busy traffic at dusk and then into the night around the city, stopping several times for delicious food and great commentary from the tour guides. We learned a lot and had a wonderful night - thanks so much to the tour guides Ben and Dai, and the lovely girls Ni and Khan who rode our scooters.

Amazing Foodie Experience!!! A must do when in Ho Chi Minh... - If you like traditional Vietnamese food and like to experiment and branch outside of the norm this is the tour for you! Ben and his team provide an amazing experience that combines fantastic food with an excellent way to see the difference in the districts of Ho Chi Minh, on motorbike! JUST DO IT as you will not regret!!!

Do this tour! - We did the foodie tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh and so glad we did! We absolutely loved it and are telling everyone about it. The whole tour is planned so well. You are picked up and dropped off at your hotel by the lovely female drivers. We ate at places we never would have thought of, my husband ate food he would never have even considered normally, and loved it all! There was no pressure to eat anything, only if you wanted to. I am a vegetarian and I was catered for so well. All the food was delicious and there was more than enough food and drinks. We were so full by the end of it. We were taken all over HCMC to areas they don't really tell you about in the tourist information. We wish we had of done the tour earlier in our stay as they told us the better places to shop at. The drivers were fantastic and knew a lot about the area and food. We felt very safe the whole time. So if you're worried about being on a scooter in HCMC and security, don't be! Just do it - you won't be disappointed! Tung the director meets you at every stop and is very informative and has done a fantastic job with these tours.He even emails photos of your tour to you. If we ever go back to HCMC we will definitely be doing another one of the tours.

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - We are a married couple too close to 60 on our 3rd trip to HCM. Decided to give this a go after reading TA reviews and wasn't,t disappointed. As per previous reviews one is well looked after by the girls and gives you an opportunity to get down and dirty amongst the Saigon traffic. Personally haven't done much on the back of a bike but Binh my driver made me feel very comfortable. I rate this experience as one of life's best with lots of fun,interesting food and even a couple if ba ba bas as well.
Unsure? As one major sports wear maker would say Just Do It!

Superb Foody tour with excellent guides.... - This tour was number 1 on our list of things to do in Saigon based on TA reviews.

My wife and I booked ahead by email as the tours fill up quickly and we did not want to miss out.

The booking proforma asked about anything we could not eat due to allergy or did not eat through choice. Also, they asked for us to let them know our room number once we checked in at our hotel.

The two girls arrived at our hotel 10 minutes early so keep a look out if you are waiting in your hotel lobby.

They were immaculate in matching traditional outfits and brought with them extra crash helmets for us. The helmets all matched, were in as new condition and sported the XO logo. Helmets are a legality on motorcycle/scooters in Vietnam.

Promptly on time both scooters set off into the crazy Saigon traffic and expertly weaved their way to our first stop. The girls were very safe and smooth and put us both at ease immediately with their skills. Have no fear when riding with this outfit, it was both exciting and safe.

At our first stop we met up with the rest of our group which was about 8 folk total I think.

Our tour guide for the night introduced himself and each other member of the tour, he had all our names memorised after only being told the once.

I will not name any of the foods we ate all night, but will say that all of it was well presented in authentic surroundings. This situation along with our girls wealth of knowledge of the food and Saigon in general only added to our adventurous spirit to try the foods on offer.

At one point I was a bit nervous about what was on the menu at our next stop. No sweat though as our guide phoned ahead as we were riding and had a backup meal cooked for me, top man. As it turned out I ate both the items on the menu and the backup dish, my personal boundary was expanded that night foodwise by a long way. No coercion or pressure was applied by the way, it was just good food. Don't get wrapped up in the unusual source of the nutrition.

All food and drink on the night was included in the price and as such was a massive bargain. We would not have dared even to sit down at some of the places let alone eat the food being served without the girls from XO.

As a small bit of detail that had concerned me prior to my tour, there are ample "restrooms" on the tour so no sweat there. Plus, if you had not brought your hand sanitiser out with you our guide had some with him.

If you are at all concerned about breakdowns or any hassle then have no fear. The tour always runs with two outriders who serve as security/photographer chaps. We received our photos from XO after the trip and were impressed at the quality of the shots, I will include a few of them in this review.

At many points throughout the five hours we were with them our head guide gave fun and informative short talks on the area we were in at the time. The guide was very personable and connected very well with all members of the tour we thought.

Most people put this early in their review and I can't put it off any longer, this tour was the highlight of our trip to Saigon. They have this experience nailed down so tight by offering great food and very astute guides who put you at ease so quickly. You can not help but make friends with these girls and the head guide.

This combination added to the chaotic traffic and glittering lights/backstreet eateries is a clear winner. From leaving your hotel to Chinatown and back plus everywhere in between this foody tour will open your eyes to places and food most tourists do not see. Shrug off your occidental preconceptions and give it a go, we did and thoroughly enjoyed it from start to finish.

Take a look at our travel map, we joined TA late in life and only review the places we have been to since joining. You may wish to trust our judgment on this unique food tour in a fine city.

Best Tour Ever - Our group of 6 friends did the foodie tour late April and it was the best way to experience HCMC hands down. I've traveled to Saigon 4 times already but this was the first time I actually got to experience the city outside of the touristy areas. The tour group picks you up directly in front of your hotel and drops you off there at the end. The food is excellent and they make sure you are fully satisfied, feeding you and providing as much beer as you can handle. If you won't have a chance to experience riding on a motorbike, "Honda", then this is the perfect opportunity to explore the city and the cool breeze on a hot, humid night. The girls were a lot of fun and always entertaining. The best part is the small bits of history that our tour guide Ben gives at each stop. It keeps the tour interesting til the end. We also opted to get a video recording of the tour, and it ended being the perfect way to re-live the moments on the tour. The video is high quality and the cuts are professionally done. We even asked them to do a re-edit and they were glad to do it. Great Service indeed!!! I highly recommend it, whether you go as a couple, group of friends, or family.

Nice Way to See Saigon at Night! - This was such a nice tour. The girls are awesome. I had already been on the back of a bike in Hanoi and Da Nang, but my friend (new to Saigon) had not. I insisted she do this tour because the drivers were all young ladies and she would feel more comfortable. I was right and they did not disappoint! They helped me and my friend with our limited Vietnamese. Saigon is an amazing place and practically everyone speaks English. Saw parts of Saigon I probably would never have known about. So for those about to visit. Shop in District 5! I will know that when I return. Definitely take this tour. They are so helpful pointing out tips (like shop in District 5!) and telling you where to eat. By the way, the food was great and I am Vegan! This was my last day here, so I couldn't get the food again, which I would have wanted. And the nuoc mia (sugar cane drink) is definitely worth trying! Please take this tour - you won't be disappointed. Hen gap lai!

Fantastic Tour of Saigon - We are a famiy of 5 that visited Saigon in April and did the sights tour with XO Tours and it was one of the bast things we did on our whole Vietnam trip. The guides were fantastic, arrived promptly and were all really nice and very skilled drivers. We were taken to great places and really drove around the city alot. The kids loved it and it was much nicer than sitting in a bus or van!! We REALLY recommend this tour in HCMC.

The Best tour we have ever done! - This tour is amazing, words cant describe it!

WE did the foodie tour and were so glad it wasnt booked out!

We were picked up at our hotel and taken to a cafe to have a beautiful soup i can't remember the name but it was not Pho! Ben remembered everyone's name and made me and my fiance feel really comfortable and he was also funny!

My tour guide was Thao and she was AMAZING! She made me feel so comfortable being on her bike ( i was sooo nervous!! ) and we didn't stop talking the entire 4 hours! She asked me questions and i asked her questions and it was honestly what made our trip to HCMC amazing!

We learn't so much about history, about the locals and best of all about the food!
Thao assured i was having a great time and made me feel safe and even escorted me to the ladies room!

The food you eat is amazing and definitely not things you will be used to. For example we had cockles, frogs, belut ( okay i didnt try it but Thao ate mine for me ) and so much more! Please don't eat before hand because there is more than enough food and drink (even alcohol) for you to enjoy!!

This was honestly the best tour i have ever done as we were taken to parts of HCMC you wouldnt normally visit, and Ben gave us information about all the locations and the girls gave us information about all the food! Im sitting here getting excited reliving it all! My fiance and i are still raving about this tour!!

I have such a sensitive stomach and i was not sick the day after! We will have done the day tour the next day but we had another tour booked !

Thanks to Ben and Thao and the girls this was such a great experience and the photos afterward were awesome!!!

Fun! - This was a great tour to do while in HCMC/Saigon. I did the morning sights tour and was taken to places I never would have thought to see on my own. A special touch were the pictures they took that made it very memorable for your photo album.

Great people make for a great experience - I have been living and working in Ho Chi Minh City for the last 6 years, and to be honest Vietnamese cuisine is not my favorite. Surprisingly these facts did not take away anything from a terrific experience with XO Tours Foodie Tour. We were picked up outside our office by two very friendly girls dressed in the traditional long dress of Vietnam (The Ao Dai), who spoke very good English and always had a smile on their face.

We took the foodie tour and it was 4.5 hours of trying interesting food, it was the first time I had goat meat (not bad!) and several other local dishes. As I am a bit picky with my food (no seafood etc.), they really tried hard to order other great dishes for me and I went home really full.

I had never been to any of our food stops before and also got to see some new parts of HCMC during the tour. The girls and the team leader were all fantastic, really knowledgable, friendly and attentive.

The service level really stands out in Vietnam, XO Tours has built an incredible team of great people to show you the best of HCMC. I highly recommend that you go on one of their tours if you are living here or just stopping by.

Don't think...Just do!!!! - OK, you've heard about the crazy scooter traffic in HCMC and you're thinking "I don't think I wanna do this?!", but ignore that voice and do it first thing. That way you won't have time to process the traffic and perhaps chicken out! The girls are careful, professional, knowledgeable and love what they do. We had reservations about taking our 12yr old daughter but there was never any danger and she loved it. Of course that is only a decision you can make yourself regarding children....but we all thought that it was the highlight of our HCMC holiday.

Awesome experience makes sure you do it when you first arrive. - These girls are amazing so knowledgeable and friendly. Got to see all different parts of Vietnam with a local who can point everything out. Learn some great tips and was given some pretty good tips to survive here. Make sure you do this early on!! Thanks

A "must do" in HCMC! - We did the foodie night tour that took us on an exhilarating motorcycle ride around several districts in Saigon and allowed us to sample different types of street food in 3 street dining locations. Our girl guides were very safe drivers, charming and knowledgeable in their work ... very helpful too, especially in serving our food and drinks at each stop. We had the famous bo bun hue, then a lot of grilled stuff capped by seafood processed at the last stop ... unlimited beer and soda too. Not to be missed, this one!

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh City! - I must say, I booked this tour twice in 2 days. The morning tour and the night time foodie tour. The foodie tour is definitely a must do! You eat unique food at local spots you otherwise you wouldn't find on your own.

The tour guides and leaders are super friendly and knowledgable. And riding on the motorcycle with the locals is super fun! Especially in the congested traffic-light-less streets! It's a thrill! I would highly recommend this to all my friends!

Great fun, do it - We did both a day and night tour with XO. We were a group of 6 and it was a lot of fun. The riders were excellent, shared their knowledge of Saigon and the Viet culture easily. You see and travel through many of the districts in the city, stopping at local stalls, markets etc... Which was great as I don't think we would have seen a lot as we did on bus tours. The scooters are first class and as mentioned the riders/guides are excellent and make the tour such fun, very friendly , nothing is too much trouble. Saigon traffic is crazy but it's a blast watching it all so close up, all very safe though as the riders are very well trained and professional. You will be picked up from and dropped off at your hotel. During the tour you ride through the suburbs and stop at points of interest, markets, temples etc...where you will be met by Tung, the owner of the company and he will provide historical and cultural insights about Vietnam and it's history. A great way to see and experience Saigon, a must do.

Thelma and Louise experience - Our adult daughter booked the tour for our family of four- Mum and Dad in the fifties and two late twenties. The hubby was a bit reticent about going on a scooter but willing to give it a go. I have to say this tour was THE highlight of my holiday. Being on the back of a scooter in the middle of downtown Ho Chi Minh with traffic unseen in Australia was fantastic. I feel like Thelma and Louise! The all women drivers, mostly uni students, where amazingly friendly and wanted to talk to us about everything. Our safety was paramount at all times to them and being taken to the little street cafes was great. The food was delicious and was explained well and how to eat dishes by adding ingredients set out. The drivers cooked some of the food and served us all night. There was plenty of food to eat and lots of laughter. Thorough recommends this tour. Just do it!

A new look at Saigon - What a fantastic & educational 2.5 hours in Saigon. Our tour guides & director were very educational keeping us informed about many different aspects of the districts traveled through. Experiencing the traffic up close was an adventure that many tourists have never enjoyed. Our riders were very safe even when we were riding through a downpour. I would highly recommend XO Tours to any one wanting a unique adventure in Saigon

A very different view of saigon, you should have a go at it - We booked the saigon night tour with XO tour group recently on April 28th and it just changed our entire experience and view of Saigon. Our tour guides and the tour leader were really great in introducing the different districts in Saigon which I don't think we would ever get to see without the locals bringing us there. During the trip when I was on the motorbike, the guide was really professional as well and really friendly explained to me about saigon, totally made me feel very comfortable. We had a dinner where we get to choose out of 3 different types of local street food and sat by the side chatting and having dinner together with the other riders and the tour group.

I personally highly recommend this tour to those who want to see a different view of saigon and personally I think night time would be harder for non-locals to explore, so why not join this tour to just have a feel of being on a motorbike on the busy streets and exploring the different districts. Overall, it is really awesome for me and my friend.

Unforgettable - The positive reviews say it all. Bun Bo Hue is my new favorite thing. The drivers were terrific and gave us a good understanding of the ways of Vietnam traffic which helped us later as pedestrians. Cultural insights were well explained and we now have a much broader understanding of Saigon life. The food was brilliant. The tour leader Ben was fun and cheeky and knowledgeable, he reminded me of Aussie comedian Anh Do.

Lesley & Jo, Perth Western Australia - Just completed the private XO Cycles City Tour of Saigon on April 27, 2013. I am 62 and 5ft and my travel buddy was 34 and 5ft 11in. We had little to no experience on bikes before this. We did the city tour in peak hour and I highly recommend the experience. The girls spoke very good English and were charming, skilled and safe drivers. Tung Do meets us at each location giving a very professional, balanced and thorough overview. We both felt very safe throughout the tour and it was a real buzz to be in the thickness of it. I would encourage older tourists to give it a go! We saw a lot of the city in a short period of time.

Ho Chi Minh Highlight - The XO Tour was the highlight of our Ho Chi Min City experience. I booked the tour via email prior to leaving Aust. and this was done with no fuss and extreme promptness. The evening food tour began with prompt pick-up by our guides from the front of our hotel. The selection of food, drinks, locations were fantastic, and all inclusive. It got us out of District 1 and seeing sites and eating Vietnamese food we wouldn't have experienced on our own. The XO Tour is a brilliant evening and must to get to know HCMC more in 4 hours than days on your own.

So much fun.....do yourself a favor and book this tour - The foodie tour was absolutely the most fun I have had in years. My fiance and I were collected from hotel by two beautiful girls in their traditional Ao Dai outfits, given a complete safety briefing, fitted with our helmets and then on our way to the food.

I'm not going to list all the foods we ate on the night, enough to say everything we tried was amazing and without this tour I would not the confidence to order by myself.

My driver, Ms Vy, was a fantastic rider and tour guide for the evening. I felt completely safe on the back of her bike, even though I am triple her size. Her English was impeccable and this made for an extremely informative night.

At each stop the tour manager, Ben, provided an interesting commentary on the local area and told a few great jokes as well.

I highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. The traffic has to be seen to be believed and there is no better way than on the back of a motorbike.

One of the best tourist adventures available, anywhere! - Went on the XO street food tour on our second day in Ho Chi Minh and cannot speak highly enough about the organisation (email communication from booking enquiries through to the hotel pick up and drop off) the selection of venues and sights, sounds and culinary and cultural experiences on offer. Minor concerns about being amongst the throng of traffic were quickly alleviated by the driving expertise of the girls and the exhilarating nature of darting about Ho Chi Minh City in the 'cool' of the evening. It has to be one of the best tourist adventures available in any city, anywhere. You would be mad not to take an XO tour if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Best motorbike foodie tour in HCMC - a must to check out - I booked this foodie motorbike tour with XO Tours for my husband and myself. I highly recommend it. I rode on a motorbike a few days earlier so I was pretty used to it. Let me put it out there that driving on motorbikes in HCMC can be exciting and crazy at the same time! The XO drivers are very safe and you get comfortable pretty quickly.

We were picked up promptly at our hotel and headed to the first stop. There we met the lead tour guide. He was so organized and fun. He explained what foods we would try, where we would go and why they selected the foods for us to try. We could not have been more pleased. We had our first meal and it was fantastic. We also met a bunch of great people from several different countries who were also taking the tour. It was a blast.

All the foods we tried were really good. I would list here what we had, but for me not knowing what we were going to eat, until they told us, was part of the fun.
