The main guide told us they take you to try authentic street foods that the locals crave and splurge to treat themselves to so you won't be eating pho and vietnamese sandwiches. They let you choose your beverages and you can drink and eat however much you want. At one stop they let you try something pretty exotic which I will not say - I did not have it, but my husband tried it and surprisingly said it wasn't bad!

I loved the food, I loved my driver, and I loved seeing all the sites at night in all the different districts. It's really unique seeing the city on the back of a motorbike and also with professional locals who know where to take you and explain a lot about what you are seeing. Taking this tour is probably also the safest, most adventurous way to exploring this neat little city! This is a tour definitely worth checking out.

Must Do in Saigon - What can l say, having been away for three weeks this was the outstanding highlight of our holiday. We did the night tour with 2 adults and 2 kids aged 11 and 14. The tour guides we had ( Thu, Van, Chi and Khanh) were amazing and their sense of humor was outstanding along with their command of the English language. Our 11 year old is quiet nervous and shy when trying new things outside his comfort zone,but by the end of the night had a smile bigger than the Sydney Harbour Bridge. Thu our lead guide was really informative and had a fantastic sense of humor that she displayed when giving us information about the city on the frequent stops.The 4 girls were all smart and engaging and had the best personalities, our only disappointment is we would have loved to taken the girls out for dinner as they were so much fun. You are taken to districts where normal tourists never go, like China town which is one of the largest in any city outside China. Even in the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Minh you quickly feel at ease with XO tours and we would recommend a tour with them. Another highlight was tasting an authentic vietnamese dish and a sugar cane refreshment.

Foodie tour a must do in Saigon - I recently did the xo foodie tour in ho chi min city (Saigon) with five friends. It was a fantastic tour from start to finish. The girls are beautiful, modest, smart, fun with good English and even better at navigating the busy streets of Saigon on a scooter. The tour give you a good taste of some of the other districts that the ordinary tourist may never get to visit and some fantastic food.

Ben the guide master was informative and very professional. The food was excellent and plentiful the whole night was brilliant from start to finish.

If you are in Saigon I can't recommend this tour enough.

Highlight of our trip - We loved this tour. My husband is a chef and it was the highlight of our trip. Food was excellent and it was great meeting other travellers. The girls are funny and smart and Tai was a great tour guide. It was booked out on the only day we could go however they accommodated us and organised another tour for the day which started at 1630. The communication via email was excellent and the staff were quick to respond. On the last stop try a sugarcane drink. It’s amazing! Lots of beer which made us happy campers and photos were sent as promised. This is a must tour to do and a great way to see the city if you have never been.

A MUST IN SAIGON! - My husband and I did the night food tour. It was the most amazing experience! This was on the second day of our 3 week adventure and it was definitely one of the highlights. Traveling through the chaotic traffic was a real experience - not scary at all as the girls were excellent drivers. The staff on this tour were what made is so special. They went out of their way to make sure you had fun - and of course the food was fantastic. I'd highly recommend this tour - but book early!

You are never too young or old to tackle the streets of Siagon - Do yourself a favor- book one of the XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City before you go, and see the city from the back of a motorcycle. We cannot thank the XO Tours team enough for the amazing evening we had on the Night Foodie Tour – mum and I can't stop telling people about how great it was. The tour was delivered with a high level of professionalism by all staff involved and was so well organized, but still retained a truly personalized approach towards each and every customer. We could not have felt safer, and loved learning about and experiencing the much loved street food of Saigon through the eyes of locals, and feeling like you are part of the motorcycle culture that is Vietnam. We had no idea what to expect, but all I can say is, when your 68 year old mother is beaming from ear to ear, feeling completely safe on the back of a motorcycle in Saigon despite the traffic, eating some of the best street food on offer, that is priceless. They also send you photos of your experience

The best way to see the real Saigon - XO tours let us see parts of Saigon you may not usually go to. After arriving in Saigon , my family and I were a little worried that we had booked a morning sight seeing moped tour before we left the states especailly after seeing Saigon traffic. My teenage daughter was disenchanted. When the young ladies arrived at the hotel to pick us up I let them know about our worries, especially my daughter's. One of the young ladies right away began to work with my daughter to ease her anxiety. This young lady made sure my daughter went on her bike and by the end of the trip was daughter was leaning back in her moped seat without even holding on. She made her feel at ease and spoke to her throughout the tour.
The tour itself was amazing, at each stop the tour manager Ben was there to give us information about the location. We traveled through the local markets and chinatown. Included in the tour was a sampling of local fruits we don't have here in the States and a delicious sugar cane drink. This drink we saw locals throughout the rest of our week drinking. Each of the young ladies will speak to you on the rides and let you know what we were passing by. These young ladies are extremely good drivers and we all feel very safe, even with the chaos of drivers around us. We took the tour on our second day to get a sense of the layout of Saigon and get a preview of local attractions we would like to see more extensively in the coming days of our trip. XO tours is a must if you want to see the heart of Saigon.

All Positive Reviews are Legit - No need to write a lot here, as it's probably all already highlighted and touted. This was certainly a highlight of my 24 day journey throughout SouthEast Asia. Be sure and try the balut!

Likes: I purchased the video of our tour, but, it had a glitch in production and the owner chose to refund us our money - even though we still got a produced video from what remained - very classy of him and certainly attests to the high level of service; and on that note, the guides and the whole team were engaging, friendly and competent on multiple levels; the variety in the food and getting to visit many, varied sites around the city; accommodating our interests and preferences.

Dislikes: none.

Great tour, great fun... - This is an excellent tour. The women are very good and safe riders and Ben is an excellent guide at all the stops recreating many incidents and events from Saigon's past, especially during the American War. You also get a complementary strawberry sugarcane smoothie while you ride and then fruit at the last stop.
I wish they had this tour in Paris or Rome. It'd be five stars if it was in one of Europe's great cities.

Great Food, Great People, Great Service, Great Time! - I've heard about this tour before coming and had high expectations. To experience it in person was even better. The tour manager was knowledgeable and spoke great English. He provided insightful uniqueness of each location we visited and the food we had...no extra charge for additional beers made it even better! All the girls also speak great English. The girl I rode with was fun, beautiful, and made great conversations. The tour also had bodyguards that rode with us to ensure safety and the ride was safe, never reckless. The motorbikes were clean and in good condition. With all the locations and traffic we went thru, I felt comfortable the whole time. These guys also accommodated special needs (let them know when booking)...there was a vegetarian in our group and there were special dishes made for him at each of the stops...real, good, vegetarian food, not just a scoop of coleslaw. Just bring your appetite! This is a must when in SGN...A+++. Dave

Not Same, Same......Best, Best!!! - The foodie tour = the BEST tour by far!! From beginning to end, outstanding customer service from everyone associated with XO tours. Think of it as a combo tour....food, drink, nightlife, city tour, a motorbike ride experience thru Saigon all rolled into one.

Even before we booked, excellent customer service was evident. Had various emails with Mr. Tung Do, the owner, and I advised him of very specific food allergies. Emails were responded to very quickly and to my surprise, XO recommended that I DO NOT take the tour out of concern for my well being. Different from other tour companies that just wanted my tourist bucks!! 

The day of the tour, customer service continued from beginning to end. Our hotel was just outside district 1 and pickup was on time. The three girls were so polite and took care of some safety precaution issues.....asked my son to remove his jewelry from his neck and for me to properly strap on my camera bag. 

Security was great as well. Trailing along with the guides are a number of male "guards". They stay in the background so well that we didn't even notice at the beginning of the tour. Although the bikes are in pretty good condition, the bike my teen son was on did breakdown. But again, XO pulled through with great customer service. A guide on another bike drove up and kept me updated of the situation and within minutes a secondary bike was provided to my son and his driver and they caught up to the rest of the pack.

Super fun whizzing around Saigon at night......much better than sitting in a bus. Felt safe at all times, drivers were excellent and drove at safe speeds. Tour provides you an opportunity to see parts of Saigon you would not have an opportunity to see or may not want to venture to on your own. The food was quite good as well. All stops are outdoor dining. Good variety including "exotic" balut eggs, lots of seafood and they bring more if you request. XO remembered my allergy issue and brought me a custom made dessert....wow!! Fantastic experience for all ages. Lasting memories and keepsakes as XO sends you a set of photos of your tour a few days later.

Note: If traffic fumes bother you, bring a surgical mask.

TA needs to set up six stars!

Highlight of our Trip - There are a few companies that do motor cycle tours around Ho Chi Minh but we chose this one because of the reviews on TA and one of our friends had done a tour with them a few weeks earler. We were not disappointed. Email communication was fast, our guides were exactly where and when they said they'd be, we felt safe the whole time and also got a bit of a history lesson and even learnt about the life of Saigon locals today. I learnt and saw more in the 2 hours (we did the Saigon by Night Tour) than I did the other 4 days of our stay. Its well organised and the food was great. We did eat street food, and we didn't get sick! I would recommend this to anyone going to Ho Chi Minh, even the ones that are a bit chicken about riding on the back of a motor cycle :)

*The tour guide also said you can take your child on the bike with you too! (We didn't)

Best Experience I had in Vietnam - Two of the most important local experiences to be had in Vietnam are: riding a motorbike and eating at street stalls. The problem is a lot of people don't know how to drive a scooter and are worried if they eat from roadside vendors they'll get food poisoning. XO tours has come to the rescue! On the foodie tour you get zipped around Saigon on the back of a motorcycle (driven very responsibly) to amazing local food joints. It's a little pricy if you're a backpacker on a tight budget, but it is absolutely worth every penny. XO takes you to places you would never find on your own.

Read more about what your night with XO will be like: http://backpacktress.blogspot.com/2013/04/vietnam-how-to-safely-try-street-food.html

value for money tour - As 2 old codgers in our 60s we throughly enjoyed the foody tour we met some very nice people
of all nationalaties and we allgot along together.The tour was well organised visiting many districts of saigon the average tourist never sees the girls riding the scooters very informative with a good sense of humour my guide milkyway explained what we were eating and the different districts
we visited with great patience and humour all in all a very enjoyable evening

Exciting Fun & Funny Food - We did the foodie tour on Saturday 13th April. We pre-booked from Australia before leaving for Vietnam and we paid cash for the tour on the night. The whole booking process was easy and we were kept informed as to where we would be picked up and and what time.
Right on time our guides picked us up from our hotel foyer. The girls were very professional and explained how the tour would work and gave us a few safety tips before we set out for our first stop.
Our guides were expert riders and we felt completely safe. My wife was taking pics while holding on with one hand. At time did we feel unsafe.
We met our tour leader Ben and the rest of the tour at our first stop. Ben introduced everyone and immediately everyone started chatting and sharing experiences. We had a mix of people from all over the world on our tour so it was very interesting. All in all we loved the tour. We tried lots of different dishes laughed all night and had a great time. Highly recommend that you do this tour.

Sights, food, beer, traffic & great guides. - We did both the foodie and sight seeing tours. The foodie tour was the highlight for us as you get to try some very interesting foods, and spend more time getting to know the guides and other guests. The tour was even able to cater for dietary requirements & tastes at the same time as they guaranteed you tried plenty of new sensations.
The guides were accomplished at flowing smoothly through what at times appeared to be chaotic traffic, and at no point did we feel in the slightest bit concerned. It was actually more fun the crazier the traffic was.
Do yourself a favor and book in!

First time in HCMC, get on this tour... - For any first timers in HCMC, this tour is a must. You get to see the various districts which I doubt you will do if trying to explore the city by yourself, and also sample the various specialty foods of each district. There is plenty to eat and drink over the four hours, so you won't go hungry or thirsty in any way.

The tour leader Ben was a character and had a fantastic sense of humor! His also a truly nice bloke as a week later, we bumped into each other in Hoi An while he was on holidays with his wife and he still remembers us.

Our scooter handlers, Kim and Thanh were very pleasant and informative. They took the time to explain things, had very good English and their riding skills were second to none.

Overall, the tour was a great way to kick start our holidays in Vietnam!

Great Whirlwind Tour of Saigon - We originally booked the daytime tour as we would only be staying one day in Vietnam.

The number of sites visited is a little overwhelming, but perfect if you won't have too much time in the city or just want to first take in all the major sites before you really explore the city.

We had a bit of an accident, but XO tours quickly contacted us and offered us a free tour that night.

The night tour was much more interesting than the day tour. Definitively for those that enjoy Vietnamese food!

Overall I would recommend this to the more adventurous and forgiving!

Highly Recommended!! - Stop researching and just book it - This is one of the best tours we did in Vietnam, which gave us a great insight to the city and the experience to try out the local delicacies. 2 lovely girls on bikes picked us up from our hotel and were taken to our first food stop where we met Tung the owner. We visited a few districts in Saigon (which I would otherwise not have been able to visit), from District 7 (accommodates many expats and touted as the future face of HCMC in the next few years) to District 4 (a no go district for tourists).
Unlike other companies, XO Tours are extremely professional and put the safety of their clients first. The girls on bikes are fully trained and licensed (you will be fully covered under your insurance). There were a bunch of blokes on bikes as our security guards. We felt safe at all times.
We went back to our hotel happy and smiling. With a full belly and memories to take away, this had to be the best night. I strongly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon. I can't think off a better way to see what this lovely city has to offer. You will not be disappointed! ☺

Great tour, people, and food! - Excellent tour - we did the Foodie Tour.
We got chance to see several districts HCMC that you probably wouldnt see on your own.
We made 3 food stops where we had a different style of food at each and then a 4th stop to look at a very different side of HCMC. I wont spoil it but was very interesting and food was great. Also got chance to sample some local beers! The tour leader Ben spoke great English and made it fun and personal. Our drivers Pe Fifi and Thuy were very good, again spoke great English and were very professional and smartly/traditionally dressed. I would highly really recommend this tour with XO.

Best Tour Ever - We did this tour on the second night in Saigon with our friends. After witnessing the traffic for a couple of days I was a bit nervous getting on the back of the bike, my tour guide Bin, put me at ease and I was enjoying myself in no time. Ben the tour Manager is very informative and remembered everyone's name and where we came from. We went out of the tourist area to experience other districts and it was amazing. The food was delicious and our tour girls cooked and virtually spoon feed us, I could tell our men were in love! I would say this tour was the highlight of my holiday and I'm so happy I found it while searching though tripadvisor.

Exotic food, Out-of-the-beaten itinerary... Very, very fun evening! - My husband and I took the XO Foodie tour at the end of January and enjoyed it tremendously.

On the day of our tour, two pretty guides (Ánh and Khanh) came to our hotel on their scooters and took us to the first stop to meet the other members of the group.

During the evening, we traveled from the center of the city all the way to the west end to see Chợ Lớn (China Town) and Bình Tây Market, then swung all the way south to see the new city Phú Mỹ Hưng. We covered a very large geographic area in scooters, and we visited many out-of-the-beaten paths that are unknown to tourists. It gave us a different perspective of the city even though this is our fourth time visiting Saigon! Despite the sometime busy and chaotic traffic, our XO guides, Ánh and Khanh, proved to be very skillful drivers and we felt safe riding with them.

Along the way, we had a lot of delicious street food, but not the common kind such as Phở. The food stops chosen are thoughtfully planned to expose us to a variety of dishes that are popular with the locals, yet not well-known to westerners. At our first stop we had bún bò Huế which is a noodle soup originated from the center of Vietnam. Even though it is also cooked with beef, the noodle, the broth, the lemongrass seasoning, and the accompanying herbs make the soup totally different from Phở. At the second stop, we had grilled food: from seafood to goat breast. At the third stop, we had clams cooked different ways. Then if you are brave enough to try the fertilized duck embryo, you will be offered balut sautéed in tamarind sauce, which some people in our party found surprisingly exquisite. (My husband also loved this and had to have it again many more times through the rest of our stay in Saigon.) Dessert comes in the form of a coconut containing a delicious fresh and sweet coconut gelatin.

My husband was very wary when it comes to “street food.” He gets food poisoning easily whenever we travel to a foreign place. But he had no problems with the food chosen by the XO Tour.

Throughout the evening, we each were pampered by our personal guide! My guide, Ánh, peeled off the skin of the shrimps for me, cracked crab claws, put food (along with the accompanying herbs) into my bowl, etc. the same way my affectionate mom did it when I was little.

I highly recommend this tour because:
1. The food is exotic
2. The food is safe (in term of cleanliness) even though it is street food. You just need to control/pace yourself because you are offered A LOT to eat
3. The itinerary allows you to truly explore the city
4. The tour is informative and fun: it gives you an interesting view of Vietnamese life (you experience it through the food, the drive, the scenery, and the guides’ facts and stories)
5. You get to ride on a scooter to explore the city
6. You get to see Saigon by night
7. You get pampered. Aside from being charming, witty, and knowledgeable, the XO guides take very good care of you. The 5-star service will make you feel special.

In summary, a wonderful and fun way to spend an evening in Saigon!

A must do even for the faint hearted! - scooters in Vietnam are scary.. Let alone watching them or even trying to cross a road.. The idea of ​​getting on the back of one driven by a girl younger than my daughter seems suicidal. HOWEVER... this was one of the BEST things we did in Vietnam. Prompt pick up no time to THINK of what you were about to do.. I soon relaxed and trusted the youngster. We were taken to parts of Saigon we hadn't been to and the owner - Tung even turned up to give us the low down on the districts and information about them. It actually was a very thrilling experience amoungst the 1000s of bikes on the road. We were fed and watered in a street cafe, handed out a little book on what to do and not to do in Vietnam. All in all a GREAT EXPERIENCE
Great fun in HCMC! - Motorbike is the only way to see the city. I went on the Foodie tour. Organization, drivers and food were all excellent. If you have some free time in HCMC then do it!

Amazing Saigon by Night - We did the Saigon by Night tour on our first night in Saigon and absolutely loved it. All our emails were answered quickly by Tung, the owner. The girls were waiting outside our hotel 5 mins before the time and we had a quick introduction and safety briefing before setting off into the crazy traffic. The reason we picked this particular tour was the route, we liked the fact that it would show us some of the other districts of Saigon that most tourists don't know about, and it certainly didn't disappoint. Some of the areas were a total surprise with the huge shopping malls and busy shopping areas, then we also had an amazing ride through the street markets of Chinatown with live fish and frogs for sale on the street. Included was a snack meal and delicious sugar cane juice, then back on the bike again for more touring around. The girls are gorgeous, so friendly and cheerful. Not sure how they do it but they chat away the whole time while still managing to navigate around the traffic. We loved the fact that we got to meet Tung the owner, who gave us information at some of our stops, took photos and generally just made us feel so welcome. Thank you so much to our drivers Khanh and Nga, you were amazing. Even though the traffic is quite chaotic, I felt completely safe and loved the experience. Would totally recommend this tour and company, can see why they are ranked No 1 on Trip Advisor.

Safe and delicious - The foodie tour is a must do. It is safe and easy to ride on the back of the scooters as they don't go particularly fast due to the traffic. Doing this tour was the only way we would ever have had the chance to see parts of the city that tourists don't easily have the opportunity to see. The guides are friendly and knowledgeable, and the food delicious. Don't research what's on the menu too much- be surprised! Highly recommend Uyen and Khanh- thanks for such a memorable experience!

My best experience in HCMC and VTN - I took 2 tours - the HCMC day tour, which is good for general orientation in the city, and the nightly foodie tour, which was by far my best experience in this amazing city,

The foodie tour in perfectly organized, each visitor is assigned with a lovely driver-guide, Tung (the company's owner) joins the tour and gives most educational information about the city, local habits, etc., plus 4-5 assistants who ride with the group and give a good feeling of security which is important for Western visitors,

The tour passes in areas of HCMC where visitors will not be able to reach by themselves (away from disctrict1), the very well-picked street restaurants were all excellent, food was delicious and kept flowing in, all dishes were local, typical to the place, delicious and very generous in quantity,

The most enjoyable part was the motorcycle ride in the bustling streets, for foreigners traffic seemed like a total chaos and experiencing it is a wonderful experience,

All crew members are extremely friendly, but I mostly appreciated the willingness of the drivers ("the girls") to chat and to answer my endless (and probably a bit tiring) questions about the daily life in modern VTN,
Tung, Chi and the crew - Thank you very much for a lovely evening and a great educational experience,

Best tour in Ho Chi Minh - wow what a fun thing to do , we were so lucky to have the Boss host our tour the girls were so much fun the food was great but not just a food tour but a trip all over the city District 1,4,7,8and there are only the ones i remember, all with a short description about the area a couple of food stops and the last district 4 the poorest part of HCMC but they have the bet food, A must do in HCMC thank you XO so well done
the girls on the bikes are Such good riders there fun and safe

Best Way to Weave Yourself Into the Cultural Fabric of Saigon - Want an adventure? This night time foodie tour is not to be missed. Hop on the back of a scooter and trail blaze 7 of Saigon's 24 districts at night while sampling local cuisine along the way. Why let Saigon pass you by when you can be part of the street vibe navigating through alleys and food markets. Food choices push you to expand your normal palette, but nothing too crazy unless you want too. Our tour guides -- Angel & Devil -- gave us personalized VIP treatment by opening our eyes to the city they call home.

Highlight of HCMC! - If it wasn't already obvious from the many excellent reviews, this is really a must do in Saigon. We did the Foodie Tour on our second day in Vietnam and had a brilliant time! The girls met us at our hotel, did a quick introduction before we were off on the bikes. I was a bit nervous after witnessing the motorbike traffic on the taxi ride from the airport to our hotel, but they made me feel completely comfortable. We stopped at three different locations for food, all of which we would never have seen or known about on our own. There are a few cultural/informative stops along the way which also help to learn a bit more about Vietnamese life. We were in a group of about 10 people (+ drivers and the owner, Ben), which seemed like a good size group. We got to try all sorts of food and had an excellent time laughing and chatting with everyone!

Ben also made a point of taking lots of photos on his camera which he mails to you afterwards, which i thought was a great touch too. Do not miss this on your trip to HCMC!!!

Your tours are addictive! - Now I know why XO Tours is # in TA!

6 hours after checking in at our hotel and with only 3-4 hours of sleep, we were already at the back of the scooters of our very friendly and charming drivers for the Sights Tour.

I traveled to HCMC with my 64 year old mother and I was quite hesitant at first to book a motorbike tour since it will be her first time to ride a motorbike. I asked Huong (I was having problems pronouncing her name, so I called her Fifi) to stay close to my mom's scooter but after only 10 minutes I already saw my mom smiling and laughing while talking to her driver, Thu.

The tour was a great way of introducing the city to tourists and the best way to overcome your fear of crossing the streets of Saigon. Being part of the traffic, you will learn how the motorbike drivers maneuver and avoid the crossing pedestrians. I thought crossing a street in HCMC was a daunting task but after the Sights Tour, crossing the streets on your own wasn't really that terrifying.

On our Foodie Tour the following night, my mom was really happy that she had Thu again as her guide/driver. I've been calling my driver "Ting" and soon found out that her name was Tien. Sorry, Tien! =)

What else can I say? The girls were really very friendly as if you're traveling with long-time friends. I can feel that Thu, Tien and Fifi are really enjoying what they're doing. It's not just a job for them, they have passion on what they're doing - meeting new friends and showing them around their beautiful city.

I was tempted to book the Shopping Spree on our last day in HCMC but I'm pretty sure it's already fully booked so we decided to just do the shopping on our own. We spent the entire afternoon at the co.op mart, saigon square and tax center.

After a week, Ben, the tour manager, sent us some pictures taken during the tours. Ben shared to us bits and pieces of Vietnamese history in every place that we visited. Good thing I was listening! =) I was able to share those stories to friends and relatives when I showed them the 400-500 pictures that I took when we were in Vietnam.

Thanks Tung, Ben, Thu, Tien and Fifi! You guys made our stay in HCMC a very memorable one. You rock! Keep it up!

No wonder why it's #1! - Saw it here, reporting back!

This company is amazing. Tung Do, the owner will answer your emails directly. No middle man to answer all your questions.

You're better off booking directly through their website since it is really up to date and functionning compared to others.

We did the Foodie and the City Tour.

The Foodie: They pick you up at the hotel, give you a security briefing and hop you go to join the others at a central place. I'm not going to reveal anything about the food or the scotter experience but you'll get full, don't worry. They even say that if you're not full, they'll make everything to fix this.

The girls are young and cheerful, they also know how to drive! You are in good hands and they'll take care of you.
I had "Ni" as a guide/driver, you can see her in the promo video (glasses with blue sides). I had a really good time, many thanks!

One thing to note is that they are really on time. You get picked up a time Tung Do said in the email. And you are back at the right time too! Pretty amazing in such a traffic jammed city!

We did the City Tour the next day and it was as good! You get on a scotter and another guide (still a young girl part of the team) is waiting at the location to teach you a little something about it. We had time to visit the main museum the day before by foot so they were able to show us different things we had'nt seen yet which was a good complement for us.

A big thanks to all the team of XO Tours, you are very professional and we agree, you are the #1 attraction to do in Ho Chi Minh City. Good job to you all!

See you soon!
Simon & Marilyn

The high light of our trip to Saigon - My wife and I did the foodies tour with XO tours in Saigon. We were both well into our sixties and had a great time. We went at night time and saw parts of saigon which I don't think many visitors saw, We experienced the traffic which was fun, the girls riding the bikes did a really good job. The food was real Vietnamese food and delicious. The tour guide did an excellent job of reminding all of our names, he was very informative. Worth the money. This was the highlight of our trip to Saigon

Cannot be missed! - Learn a lot about the history, current economic scale and different districts of residents living in Saigon. Awesome tour leader Ben and his angels Milkyway and Ee are so chatty you won't be finding any awkward moment during the 5 hr foodie trip. My husband and I had a great time eating delicious food such as peanut clam, grilled crabs as well as trying out some strange cuisine like goat udders and half developed eggs. Highly recommended, I will join the tour again if I decide to visit Saigon next time.

Best tour in Asia. - I have been all over Asia and I would have to say this was the best tour I have been on. I had some questions before the tour and Tung was very quick to reply to my emails. I did the foodie tour which took about 4.5 hours. Our guides arrived 10 minutes early and were very organized. Also, Ben the tour manager was very knowledgeable and friendly.

XO Tours is the best way to explore Saigon. You get to visit many districts and areas that you would have never thought existed in Saigon. You don't eat the usual Vietnamese foods like pho and bahn mi, but you get to try many of the foods that the locals enjoy. The best part is that there is no limit to what you can eat or drink. Everything is included in the price, and you will definitely get more than you could ask for.

Our guides' names were Tien and Van. They were very friendly and not hesitant to answer any of my questions. I know it gets crazy on scooters in Saigon, but these guides were very safe drivers and I did not feel nervous at any point. I strongly recommend doing this tour. It is difficult to get around Saigon, but this tour will definitely allow you to see many of the amazing things that Saigon has to offer.

Exciting and Educational - Our morning city tour was a huge success.
It was on our first day in Vietnam and when we arrived the night before and we saw the traffic I thought - Oh no, what have I done, booking this tour, I must be mad !!!
However within a couple of minutes of riding behind our competent young lady driver I was able to relax and really enjoy the morning.
It is such a quick easy way to get around the city and we saw farther than we would other wise have had time to. Plus it was such fun joining all the other bikes zooming around HCMC.
Ben (and his photographer) met us at every stop and he was a wealth of information about the sites, also little stories of interest.
We are in our 60's and had a ball, so put it on your list of things to do in HCMC.

Just do it - experience the real Saigon - Wow, what an experience. We did the foodie tour..... If you like your food and are not adverse to a little adventure then this is the best way to spend 5 hours of your holiday in Saigon. First and foremost the tour is well organized and safe and Ben the manager explains what is going to happen and this puts you at ease....my wife has never been on a moped before but loved the whole experience.

You get to see the real Saigon by getting out of district 1 and riding around at night which gets the adrenaline pumping. There is a good balance between eating/drinking and riding....you could not consume all the food we ate in one go and there was sufficient time spent traveling in between so you had room to go again! You get to eat dishes that you won't get in the restaurants of district 1 with lots of sea food, unusual meats together with more traditional dishes such as bun bo hue. Local beers....Saigon and 333 also flow freely which is never a bad thing!

The girls were fantastic, they were fun and bubbly and were knowledgable about the areas we were riding through and the food we were eating....it was defiantly the highlight of our trip.

I would recommend you book well in advance....they were fully booked for at least 2 weeks ahead which I not supported about giving our experience.

Brilliant night out on the Foodie tour - My wife and I enjoyed an amazing private Foodie tour last night. It really is a first class experience and highly recommended.

We were picked up from our hotel by our two drivers who were charming and spoke excellent English. The first 10 minutes on the mopeds is a little scary as you learn to trust your driver but also all the other drivers which make sense of the madness on the roads. Once we settled in, however, it was a fantastic way to see Saigon and very easy to enjoy.

The first stop was only 10-15 minutes which allowed us to take a breather, get our first tasting (Bun Bo Hue) and meet our guide. Our guide (Tai) entertains us at all the stops with plenty of background information. As you ride on the mopeds there is also constant chat with your driver. We also had 1-2 "bodyguards" with us who help organize the food at the restaurants and generally keep things moving smoothly. You certainly feel there is plenty of attention for you.

Three things in particular stood out to make this an amazing experience.

First, the restaurants are all local, street food style. Despite being in Vietnam for over 2 weeks already, we ate plenty of new dishes and they were all terrific. If you are feeling adventurous you can also try your hand at a few exotic dishes (I won't spoil any surprises here). All night we ate and sat with locals and enjoyed a ton of food (and drinks) at each of the three food stops.

Second, the night is a great tour of Saigon as well. We saw parts of the city outside normal tours and enjoyed two additional stops where our guide filled us in on the local culture, economy and history (and gave our drivers a little break). Driving through the Chinatown market in full swing was a highlight.

Third, the interaction with the guide and the drivers. The three of them had great feelings of humor and rapport between them. It was like going for a night out with your new best friends. Plenty of jokes, discussions, games and more. We laughed plenty so the great food and scenery was enjoyed with great company.

One of our highlights of our entire time in Vietnam, the Foodie tour is highly recommended.

Fun - Do these guys really need more good reviews? It was a blast! Everyone had a great time, the drivers were excellent and very pleasant, the team that went with us to describe the event, food and places were fun, friendly and knowledgeable.
We were picked up from our hotel (the girls arrived early and were waiting for us) we got on the scooter and whizzed off to our first restaurant. I was a little apprehensive at first - my driver couldn't weigh more than 1/3 of what I did and I was sure she wouldn't be able to handle me screaming in terror on the back of her bike as we cared through the wild streets of Saigon - but, no, not a problem. We stopped at our first restaurant, an alley off of a very busy street - I would never have stopped there on my own, I'm cautious about street food - but after sitting with a group of another 10 or so people, we were served excellent food that I would not have tried otherwise.
Off to the next "restaurant" - there was never a roof over our heads, so not exactly restaurant I guess - and we were sitting in a huge parking lot where we had a BBQ bucket brought to our table, with little plates of various spices. Oh, and the beer started flowing freely... Needless to say, the trip picked up from there on!!!
3+ hours zipped by - exploring the city and various food establishments - only to be dropped off back at the hotel at the end of the night.
I'm looking for these guys in every city I go to from now on!

XO Tours - Great Tours! - On the basis of reviews I booked both the Foodie tour and the morning sights tour before leaving--all e-mails promptly responded too--sooo easy!
Met outside our hotel by two lovely young ladies --Hoang and Ngan- and the fun began. What strikes you first and most about HCMC is that travel is by moped/scooter--and here you are thrust staight into the action-no watching from the sidelines--What an introduction to the city. Visited several different areas, sampled lots of different food-all accompanied by explanations from the guides whose English was very good. Took a second 'sights' tour the next morning with Tien and Huong and was equally impressed!

By now you are all fed up with the rave reviews--As the Nike ad said---Just Do It !!!

Thanks to the girls and all the organizers for a great time!

Nick and Nicola

Foodie Tour - My husband and I took the Foodie Tour of Ho Chi Minh City. I cannot recommend them enough. I was very apprehensive about getting on a scooter but they quickly put that to rest. We thoroughly enjoyed the entire evening. Very professional and well run. Ben and Thai made us feel safe and secure. The only recommendation I would make is for them to collect payment at the beginning of the tour as we felt a little uneasy paying the girls at the end in front of our hotel as we were concerned for their safety.The food was awesome, we stopped at 5 places for food and drinks and ate and drank all we could .The tour lasted about 4-5 hours and really painted a picture of life in Ho Chi Minh City. Well worth the 65 US dollars.Thank you XO tours for an awesome evening!!

Great Fun with XO Tours! - If you are staying in HCMC I highly recommend the XO Foodie tour. The tour is 4.5hrs and includes great food and sightseeing on the back of a motorbike (Moped). The drivers pick you up from your hotel and drop you off. During the evening the tour covers a number of districts/suburbs and the tour guides are very knowledgeable.

I was particularly impressed by the safety conscious XO team - they had careful drivers and additional staff looking after security.

There was plenty to eat and for those who like beer you can have a few drinks with meals on the tour. We were eating street food but all really good quality/hygenic and no ill effects from the food/trip.

Finally, an email was sent to everyone after the tour with photos attached. Really great - well done to the XO team.

Best experience in Ho Chi Minh City - Fantastic guides, a great way to see the city and with fantastic food to boot! This was a brilliant way to see Ho Chi Minh in a short four hours and get a sense of the city, the people and Vietnam. This is the tour to do the first night off the plane as it will whet your appetite, open your eyes and calibrate your senses for the vibrant and exciting place that is Ho Chi Minh!

Just perfect! - We took the foodie tour on April 3. The tour was fantastic! Here are the advantages,
1. Safe! I was very worried about the security in Vietnam and tried to avoid all taxis N strangers there. But the foodie tour was very safe! My driver and guide Truc was a very safe driver n she drove steadily. At first i was so scared i tried to grasp her waist (First time on a motor bike in my life) but she told me to relax. then i learned how to sit properly ni had a relaxing time. Moreover they had hired body guards to accompany us during the tour. I felt safe and relaxed all times.
2. My driver and guide was very informative, she kept on telling me about all kind of facts in Vietnam and she had good English.
3. Truly a tour that u can learn about Vietnam. We went to places that only locals go. It's a very non tourist experience and it was fun!
4. The food served was very local. We sat in open area and had BBQ. The girls were very helpful and they were trying to feed us with all the food. They even helped us to take the meat out from the crab. Thumbs up!
As a conclusion, I cannot fault anything for this tour, our guide Ben was informative n funny. My driver was friendly n helpful. We saw the local life n tasted the local food, it's a very unique experience. One tip is to book the tour really early if u can. I booked the tour a week ago but I still couldn't get the cam video. I was really upset about this. If u also want the video, please book it as soon as possible.

xo tours worth giving - shared this experience with my family of 6 adults. Great experience, very professional and friendly company from the first enquiry. Wonderful girls who make you feel comfortable and very safe on the back of the bike.(my parents are in their mid 70's too!)It was great to experience the food as locals do without the worry of where to eat. No stomach bugs caught on this tour. A must do activity in Ho Chi Minh. Thankyou very much Xo Tours

A must do in Ho Chi Minh! Best ride evah - This was an amazing experience of our stay in HCM! We were being picked up at our hotel by the girls and drove to the first food stall.There we met with the other foodie guests. First dish was a delicious noodle soup. The traffic worried us a bit at the beginning but Trang and Ngan were amazing drivers! Second stop was a BBQ meal of shrimp, crab, octopus, goat tit, frog, okra and chicken. we also made a stop at china town and shot some photos. Trung (Ben) was an amazing host: hilarious and very sweet and concerning. the last stop was in the poorest district of HCM where we had the best food of our entire stay in vietnam: crab, scallops, delicious chicken and the fertilized duck embryo (only for those who want to try). It cost 68 dollars (all the drinks you want) for two and we were out for 5 hours... if you are a vegetarian please mention to them in advance so that they can make adjustments. This is a great way to spend an afternoon and evening in HCM!

Trang and Ngan

A must-do when in HCMC - We did the group XO foody tour on our first day in HCMC and I have to say it was one of the main highlights of our trip. I was initially a little apprehensive about hopping onto the back of a bike, when you see how crazy people drive in HCM but don't worry as the drivers take it at a steady pace. Our divers collected us from our hotel and brought us to the first stop to sample some local cuisine. The food was nice and every thing was fully explained to us. It's a great way to get a feel for the city as they bring you to the main districts of the city and explain everything while there. Plenty of food and beer and well worth the money. Our guides were very friendly and gave us an insight into life in Saigon. Also the principal guide gives a brief overview on the economy which is also helpful. It is a must for all visitors and a great way of getting a feel for the city. They take photos which they email to you later, nice touch

the one must do in Saigon - We did the saigon by night tour with xo tours just recently.If you only have one night in saigon this is the thing to do.We booked well in advance to make sure we didn't miss out and all emails were answered promptly and booking done without fuss.
The owner Tung was very informative and professional when he caught's up with you at various stops as well as being a lot of fun. Our drivers and personal guides Hoang & Tram could not of been more helpful as well as great fun to be with.Felt safe at all times and even my wife relaxed very quickly with Hoang after a little nervousness in the traffic to start with,so a big thank you to Hoang and Tram for a great night out.
We stopped at various places and tried different things as well as going to parts of the city we never would of by ourselves.Our only regret is we didn't do another tour with them.
Overall this is a must do of any visit to Saigon and could not recommend more highly.
Thanks guys and hope to catch up again in the future,
Lynne and Bernie

Excellent experience! Worth to try! - As recommended by friend and I have no regrets. I joined "the Foodie". It was awesome. The XO girls are nice and speak good English. A good way to understand the local culture and lifestyle. Tried different dishes and explored different district under a very well organized and secured team. They have extra manpower to ensure the safety. It was impressive.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO THOSE WHO WANT A DIFFERENT EXPERIENCE IN HCMC!!!

A highlight of our Vietnam trip - If you've done your research, you'll know that the motorbike is the main form of transports for the locals. To experience it is a must-do in HCMC.

XO tours were so easy to deal with at booking. On the day, the girls arrived on the dot and the tour itself was FANTASTIC. Both the owner, Tung, who explained the sights to us, and the girls who acted as your driver and your personal tour guide spoke excellent English (which was great as some other tours we did mentioned to have had english speaking tour guides but they were so difficult to understand or could actually barely speak English!).

XO Tours go way beyond to please. They even included a stop over so we can taste Tung's favorite drink and we got to try some local fruits.

I wish we had more time in HCMC so we could have tried the other tours they do, such as the food tour. Instead I will console myself with recommending them to anyone and everyone.

Best part of our trip! - Two friends and I went on the foodie tour during our stay in Vietnam. The lovely ladies met us outside our hotel and introduced themselves and shared some tips about traveling around Saigon and how to ride on the back of the bikes. At our first stop we met our tour guide Ben who was the warmest and funniest guy. We met up with several other aussies as part of our tour group and Ben remembered everyones names and where they were from as he introduced everyone. He was tops!
There were also a few security guys as part of the XO tour team which made you feel extra safe.
Riding around Saigon was an absolute thrill and you felt very confident with the girls. The places we went to eat were excellent, we tried so many awesome dishes!
The whole XO team were all very nice and really fun, so many laughs. It was the best part of our whole time in Vietnam.
Super Highly recommended! You have to do this tour!!

Amazing Experience! Highly Recommended! - We heard about this tour through Trip Advisor & decided to give it a go on our first night in Saigon. What a fantastic introduction to this amazing City! Ben and the girls were great fun. The girls constantly provided us with interesting information whilst driving effortlessly among the HCMC traffic. It was a bit intimidating at first to be on the back of a bike amongst what felt like chaos but I can honestly say after just 5 minutes I felt incredibly safe and was able to just sit back and take it all in! We learned so much about the City, food and people that we wouldn't have otherwise been able to have we tried to attempt this on our own. Ben and the girls made everyone feel so comfortable and the food was superb. Throw in some games and great senses of humor and you have the perfect tour! Highly recommended.

Excellent Way to Discover HCMC and its local delicacies. - Glad that the good reviews here have somewhat made this into one of the 'MUST DO' thing in HCMC. I really enjoyed the foodie tour (which also includes a city tour around the other 5-6 Districts). Food and drinks were served in abundance and staff (motorcycle tour guides and tour leaders) were professional with their roles and responsibilities. My colleagues were also impressed with the tour contents. Special mention to Tai Dang (our Tour Leader) and Vi (my guide) for their impressive job! Money and time well spent!!!

A great way to see the different sides of Saigon - This tour was recommended by a friend and was well worth it. I would not have been game enough to sit in the poorest district of Saigon and eat seafood from a street stall so this is a must if you want to truly experience what the locals eat. It is also a great way to see the city screaming along on the back of a moped weaving in and out of traffic.

Fantastic - Ben and the girls were amazing. They are really fun, informative and helpful. Thrilling from the first minute to the last. You see some really different and interesting sides to the city and the food is delicious. We went on the foodie tour and loved it. Don't let the bikes put you off. They are excellent riders and it is safe and fun.

The foodie tour was outstanding! - We literally had about 1 hour for our initial exploration of our district before being collected in the foyer for our XO Foodie Tour. I discovered this tour group on TripAdvisor, and we had a fantastic night out. These tours happen on the back of scooters in groups (or privately, if you prefer) and you are taken to various outdoor eating places throughout the city over a period of about 4 hours (with about 4 of the stops being eating stops). All the drivers are young women in traditional Vietnamese dress, all are excellent moped manoeuvrers through the crazy Saigon traffic, and our particular hosts, Thuong and Tram, were attentive, witty and fun girls who made the night so very memorable.

Our guide for the evening was Ben, the owner and tour manager; and his charm, humor and knowledge of this city and its food were spot on (and being vegetarian proved no obstacle – our needs were catered for). When booking this tour from Australia, we were tossing up whether to go with a group or on our own, but are really glad we did the group tour – being with a whole bunch of people fanging along on the backs of the bikes grinning like dogs with our heads out the car window was terrific fun!

During the various courses, our scooter drivers even acted as our personal servers, making sure we were getting the best pieces of food and plenty of it! They escorted us back to the bikes, holding our arms and watching traffic like hawks so we didn't stray into the path of oncoming vehicles after consuming too much local beer! We were definitely in safe hands!

An important thing to note is that security was very good as well – while the girls always keep a sharp eye open for any possible risk, there are several buff young men on their own scooters as our guard. This company has thoughts of everything! For us, this was the perfect way to introduce us to Saigon – in amongst it all, driving through many of the districts, seeing the sights and meeting new and interesting people while huddled over bowls and plates of an endless supply of delicious street food.

JUST DO IT!! - We booked this trip in Australia after reading all the fab reviews on TA. BUT once we got to HCM and experienced the traffic from a taxi we thought we were crazy considering getting into it from behind a motor scooter, almost losing our nerve and canceling. I am so glad we didn't like this was a major highlight of my 3 week trip to Vietnam. There were 6 of us for the Saigon by night tour. The girls us collected on their scooters from our hotel, wearing their traditional Vietnamese dress. From there we rode for about 40 minutes to Binh Tay area where we were met by Adam who was our guide (and owner of XO). What a great guy, told us lots of interesting information about HCM, took photos of us and took our orders for dinner. I have to recommend the Broken Rice dish - it was one of the best meals I had in all of Vietnam. We headed off on the bikes again, inching our way through the crowded markets, the girls pointing out some of the more unusual delicacies being sold, stopping some time later at a roadside stall where we collected the baguettes some of us ordered for dinner and tasting some Vietnamese cakes. Back on the bike and on to a large open aired eating place where our table waits for dinner and a delicious glass of sugar cane juice. We went through some more districts after dinner and said goodbye to Adam before the girls took us back to our hotel. I cannot stress what an amazing night we had and recommend everyone do this tour to get another perspective of HCM. Don't be afraid, the girls are excellent riders, they know what they are doing and we feel completely safe and comfortable with them. Most of our group are in our 50's. After the trip Adam emailed me photos too. Thanks XO, you are awesome!

Brilliant experience - Booked the tour prior to leaving UK. On seeing the 'carnage' that is Ho Chi Minh traffic on arrival in the city, began to have second thoughts. However, we stuck to the plan and are really glad we did.

The young lady drivers picked us up at the hotel on time and took us to the meeting point. Felt really safe at all times, they seem to have a sixth sense! They gave a running commentary as we went around the city.

Great tour around the city sights, through Cholong and beyond.

Excellent leadership and organization of the tour by Ben Chua who was really informative. Took great account of food likes and dislikes and provided alternative dishes as appropriate. Had three separate stops for food and a couple of others to give some local knowledge of what we were seeing.

All in all good fun, good food and would highly recommend it.

Special thanks to Ni and Jayne our drivers, you made it a great evening.

This was a blast - An exciting,wonderful "must do" when in Saigon. The trip was well organized in a safe and exciting manner.Our ladies (Scooter Drivers) were excellent hostess explaing all the food ,culture,and sites as we traveled about. This is defentily one of the highlights of our three week vist. Book eraly and enjoy

Best tour in Saigon - While visiting Saigon the highlight of our 5 days was the XO Tours we experienced.
Our first day we took the sightseeing tour a great way to see the highlights the staff were wonderful english speaking commentary along the tour very informed young women.Amazing driving abilities as this was my first time on a scooter I felt safe at all times I didn't want the tour to end.
The next night was a foodie tour in different districts of Saigon once again nothing but professional service picked up at your hotel by a beautiful young woman. We will be telling everyone that mentions they are going to Saigon not to miss out on this experience. The owner Tung was very involved in the running of the tours not just there to receive the money he genuinely cared about your safety and happiness. If you do one thing make it an XO experience.
The service this company provides is a credit to Tung and the team .

Great way to experience the city and the amazing food - Lovely organization and tour.
We were picked up at our hotel and driven around Saigon for almost 5 hours. We made 5 stops, and ate in 3 different places, having the chance to sample many local dishes from sea food to barbecue. The ladies driving the scooters are usually young students who want to practice their english, they can provide useful information on the city and a glimpse of a local view of Saigon.

sight, sound and taste ~ all in one! - Prior to a trip to HCM in January, I did some research online on what to expect in the visit. While going through the net, XO Tours kept popping up with rave reviews and I thought I'd check them out for myself. There were 3 of us in the group and we booked ourselves on the Foodie Tour and the Sight Tour. I must say, without a doubt it was the best local group tours I have ever signed myself on. My personal favourite was the 4.5hr food fest from district 1 - 8. One can only imagine the cocktail of sights, sounds and tastes we had in one night! Not overwhelming... just a good balance of it. A fab welcome to HCM as we had booked the tour for our first night there. The girls and tour host on the XO Tours were very accommodating and attentive. Everything was taken into consideration - language spoken (they do have cantonese speaking guides as well), food allergies/preferences, spot on information on local topics... etc. It is important to feel safe and welcome in a foreign land; we got that (and more!) from the professional services provided by XO Tours. I would have no qualms recommending this to anyone looking to taking in what HCM city offers; especially if you are on a limited travelling schedule.

Food and fun on two wheels - I was visiting HCMC for business and had very limited time to experience the city outside of work. I checked this out after reading reviews and I am so glad I did. I booked the 'foodie tour' and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to experience a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Riding a scooter in Vietnam is definitely best left to professionals. But sitting on one for a night is great fun! The food stops were great as well. But the highlight of the tour is by far the friendly tour guides who really do an excellent job of making everyone feel welcome. Hats off especially to my own tour guide Milky Way who was so attentive and kind; and to Ben our Tour Manager whose energy and enthusiasm were contagious. Solid concept, excellently executed. Thank you all very much!

A highlight of any trip. The foodie tour. - We did this our second night in Ho Chi Minh City. It's still one of the favorite memories of our honeymoon. Seeing HCM at rush hour on the back of a scooter was worth the price of admission alone, but that was just the beginning. We traveled off the touristy path into 5 different districts, eating what the locals eat, where they eat it. The guides were very friendly. Its a delicious and enlightening way to see any new city. You'll be talking about it for years.

Unique Fun Experience - Having booked with Xo Tours in England after reading the TA reviews I wasn't disappointed. Our female drivers were there early to pick us up from our hotel before the adventure began. I would never have had the nerve to drive a moped myself in HCMC so this was a great opportunity to experience that excitement in the safe hands of someone else sampling whilst some weird and wonderful food. Our drivers were fun and informative about the City and really looked after us at each individual street food stop. As well as some delicious meat and fish we enjoyed goat, frog and the well known delicacy of duck foetus which was an acquired taste I guess!

We went to a number of contrasting districts that tourists don't often visit district including four which is one of the poorer 'no go' areas that we could experience safely in the hands of Xo Tours. The eatery there served some of the best seafood in the city - the scallops were divine!

Book this experience - you won't regret it!

previously enjoyed - My husband and I booked the Street Food tour with XO tours several months in advance, but due to bad jet lag and confusion we got our dates wrong and ended up missing the tour we had booked. Luckily XO Tours were very understanding and were able to book us into another tour.

I'm so glad they did! What a fantastic experience it was. The mopeds are driven by young women with great English, lots of local knowledge and fantastic attitudes. They picked us up from our hotel and we joined with other tour-goers at the first restaurant. I hadn't realized that we would travel through and visit so many districts within HCMC, which was very welcome as most tourists don't go beyond the 1-3 Districts and it gave us an excellent overview of the city. Ben and our guides kept us excited and interested with their energy and enthusiasm.

All food and drink was included in the price, and we were told that we could have as much food as we liked. We tried a lot of dishes and enjoyed a few ice-cold beers with the other participants. Each restaurant we visited was already set up for us - numbered so our guests could guide us to our seats. We covered a lot of ground and ate a lot of food but we never felt rushed, just involved and affected.

The food we ate was tasty, different and a great introduction to Vietnamese culture, but definitely the best part of the tour was navigating the crazy HCMC streets with our guides and Ben's explanations of the different areas and how typical Vietnamese live. A must do!

Best night ever! - I had looked at this tour before going to HCMC and was really interested. We love our food and wanted to see a bit of the city. 4 of us went on the Foodie Tour without really knowing what we would see and to cut a long and wonderful story short, I don't think I wiped the smile off my face for days after this experience.

We all had lovely hostesses who drove us around safely and confidently on their motorbikes, laughed and joked with us and prepared our plates as the food arrived to the tables. Cannot rate the friendliness highly enough.

Ben was an amusing host and ran the evening thoughtfully and professionally. We saw things that we definitely wouldn't have had the opportunity to see otherwise and got to see the city through a local view. For a person who is afraid of motorbikes at the best of times, it was one of the most exhilarating things I have ever done. Cannot recommend this enough.

A "Must Do" - With the current overwhelmingly positive reviews on TripAdvisor, adding one more "great" review seems almost superfluous... But I'll add my opinion anyway. We had been recommended to do XO tours by someone we met in Laos in a cooking class- so we'd booked ahead, online, before we arrived in Saigon. We did this the first night we were there, thinking it would give us an overview of the city, which it did. From the on-time pickup, to the fun we had seeing the city from the back of a motorbike, to the amazing and weird food we tried, it was all a ton of fun.

The guides give good information about the city, from a unique perspective, and we appreciate this. It was very real, and our guides were very enthusiastic about their city. We saw parts of the city we will never have seen, staying in the area around our hotel, in District 1. Good food, had fun with our guides and the rest of the group, all very well planned, safe, fun. Must do!

Foodie Tour - We arrived in Ho Chi Minh City at 2pm and at 5.20pm we were picked up at our hotel by our lady drivers who took us to meet up with the others who were joining the trip that night. We had our first sample of the wonderful food while Ben, our tour guide gave us an overview of where we would be going. We were then taken for a fantastic, informative, and exciting drive around all districts of the city including the vibrant night market. We stopped off at various places for some very tasty food, and were given the opportunity to try some things that were very different.

Our lady drivers were fantastic and fun, they looked after us, told us about the food we were eating and encouraged us to try the many different things.

Since coming home we have received photographs of our trip and we are very much looking forward to receiving our video. It will be a great reminder of the trip.

Fantastic Street Food Tour - HCM is a city dominated by bikes and scooters and famous for its street food. This tour combines both. We met the two young women guides at the Opera House and set off across the city on the backs of their bikes. We met up after a short drive with about 15 other tourists. It was great - a good mix of English speakers. We all chatted about what we had done and were planning to do. We changed our plans based on what others had experienced.

After the first stop (dont eat too much soup/pho) we had a longer ride to another streetfood place - possibly near the chinese market - where we had some fantastic seafood. We then went to district 7 (singapore to the locals) and Ben told us all about it. We then went onto another eatery elsewhere

The food just kept coming (as did the drink) we abstained but still ate a lot. Some of it - the scallops, prawns and ladies fingers were fantastic - some of the best food we have ever had. The guides are great - give you loads of advice and practice their English with you - asking you some of those questions you cannot answer - why do we teach Shakespeare?

The tour helped us understand how Saigon's noodle soup of traffic - patic how the bikes work. It got us to taste food and go to places to eat we will never have visited. If you want to learn more about the locals and how they live and have fun in a place that can be difficult, try the tour

Absolutely amazing!! Def a must do in Saigon!! - We have just arrived back to our hotel from doing the 'foodies' tour! We were nervous about doing the tour due to the Saigon traffic, but the moment we were picked up by our girls 'Ding and Van' we knew we were in great hands and felt comfortable straight away! We then left our hotel and met a group of ten other tourists and their drivers. Ben the manager was so welcoming and entertaining and always assured that everyone was enjoying themselves! The food was absolutely delicious and was enjoyed by all! This tour is a must do! Thank you to all the XO staff that were there tonight and a very special thank you to our lovely drivers 'Ding and Van' . This was def a highlight!!!!!

Must do in Saigon - Highly recommend this tour of Saigon.No need to be scared on a motorbike.It was very safe,great drivers and very informative tour of city.Cant say enough about these great ladies ,great food and great company. Xo tours are not to be missed

What a brilliant tour!!!! - My wife has already done a review on the fantastic XO Foodie Tour we did to celebrate my birthday a couple of weeks ago - and I'm adding five more stars to what is an absolute MUST DO if you are visiting Saigon.

See if you can request the fabulous Hoang to be your guide. She is the most beautiful girl in all of Vietnam, speaks perfect English, drives slowly and safely on her very shiny bike at all times (even when on her own), cooks great goat, belts out raunchy "rock chick" Karaoke and with a little practice and some monkey wine could become one of the great street dancers of our time.

On this tour you will learn the (non-existent) local road rules and get a slant on modern Vietnamese culture that you won't see on the regular tours. You will laugh a lot and eat delicious morsels of very odd things. What you may not get is a slice of yummy fluffy chocolate cake - thanks again Ben for the outrageous surprise!

Definitely! - A must do.
This is fantastic tour that involves a tour of some of the best street eateries in Ho Chi Minh City.
There is more food than what you can eat so pace yourself.
In transit between eating, you also get a taste of the city's various districts by riding on a vespa in the middle of city traffic. An experience worth doing on its own.
The guides are all fantastic, are extremely polite, friendly and knowledgeable. My guide "Milky way" was awesome.
The tour guide leader, Ben, was also fantastic and very happy to help, knowledgeable and has a terrific memory for names!

I'm sure all these positive reviews might raise an eyebrow, but... - I know all these positive reviews might cause a suspicious person to be doubtful, but thinking about the 2 XO tours I took 15 months ago, I still consider them highlights of my 5 weeks in SE Asia. Tung, who was our tour guide, has a hit on his hands, but he has the humility and discipline to keep a win-win situation going. The tour guides are chosen for their driving skills -- safety is a first. They get to work on learning new languages ​​while showing off their city. The history lessons from the The Sites Tour were interesting, and my girlfriend and I are so glad we did the Foodie tour in the evening as well. A model tour operates in a fantastic city.

Awesome ride through Saigon! - We have just returned from 16 days touring through Vietnam and Cambodia and whilst there decided to take a trip with XO Tours. WOW it was fantastic. The girls picked us up from our hotel on the bikes and the fun began! They took us to places we would never have seen otherwise and were full of information about the places we visited. We ate the most wonderful food sat on the side of the road Saigon style! We felt completely safe on the back of the bikes being driven through the crazy rush hour traffic. The girls made it seem so easy. This was definitely the highlight of our holiday and would recommend anyone visiting Vietnam take time to do the tour. Its amazing fun. You'll love it, we did...

Best way to see and taste Saigon - After seeing a recent article about this service in the travel section of a newspaper, I decided to book a 'foodie' tour with them while my son and I visited Saigon. It was one of the best things I have ever done. The booking was easy through their website, and there were follow up emails to check on last minute details.
The service was excellent, the girls (they exclusively use women riders on late model scooters) turned up promptly at the appointed time, gave us a few simple instructions before leaving the hotel, and continued to chat with us while riding. They were very friendly, spoke fluent English, and were very capable riders - which is very reassuring in Saigon traffic! The tour lasted about 4 1/2 hours, and covered 4 of the 8 districts in Saigon. The whole experience was so well organized. When we will arrive at the selected restaurant, places had been set, and either the serving or the cooking food will begin straight away. We were told what the food was, how it would be made (a lot of it cooked/prepared in front of you) and sometimes a brief history of the dish. We ate until we could eat or drink no more. So many interesting dishes and places to visit, and just a full on good time! We were also accompanied by a male tour leader at all times, and another fellow riding 'shotgun' through some of the seedier areas, so we always felt completely safe.
The total cost for the two of us was $184, which I thought was very reasonable given the level of service, amount of food and drink and the whole experience in general. If you get the chance to go, just do it! The company also offers other tours which I am sure would be excellent. Their website is xotours.vn

IT DOESN'T GET BETTER THAN THIS ! - We had one of the best nights of our lives doing the XO bike foodie tour. It was 5 hours of being safely submerged in Saigon's way of life. We stopped on three occasions for abundant meals of noodle soup, BBQ and wonderful seafood, along with plenty of ice cold beer. Handsome Tai and our three very beautiful, funny and knowledgeable drivers gave us so much information about the city and food of Vietnam. They also skillfully chargrilled the freshest of meats, serving us platefuls of spicy crab, scallops, pipis and prawns. If you only have time for one thing in Saigon it's this tour experience - just do it 'cause it's yum and the most amazing fun!

A stunning tour....thank you XO tours - My husband and I only had three nights in Ho Chi Minh city so we needed to see as much as possible in a very short time and XO tours did just that. We only booked the tour late the day before and they were fantastic.....the girls arrived on time cheerful,friendly and ready to part with information and inquiry about your life. At our first destination we were met by our main guide and he was warm, friendly, funny with a wealth of knowledge. At every destination he will connect with us, give his tour and then meet with us at the next place. What struck me most was not only this tour well run, what struck me most was that they were always friendly and always concerned about your well being. I would definitely use XO tours again....it is the only way to see this city and have fun doing it. Thanks guys and thanks for the pics,a stunning touch sending us pictures of us on the tour...I loved them.

Even better than expected! - I did the Foodie tour and it was even better than I expected. Ben has a slick well run team and everything runs extremely smoothly. After signing on I questioned my sanity as I am not that interested in food in general and can't tolerate anything spicy. There were so many interesting choices that I had no trouble finding lots to fill up on (and the beer was abundant). My guide took good care of me and made sure there were no peppers in my sauces. We traveled to 5 or 6 different districts in the city and had several "tourist" stops in between the sampling of the food. Talking to my charming guide as we biked around the city and as we ate was a good way to learn a bit more about the culture. They have a photographer that followed us around snapping shots at all the stops. I was pleased with the 8 pictures they emailed me. They were much better than the ones I took! As has been said before it is a pricy tour by Saigon standards but well worth the money.

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - Had a wonderful time and saw a lot on the back of a motorbike. It was such fun. The guide was in formative and my driver was nice, friendly and a very safe driver in crazy traffic. Highly recommend this tour.

What more can I ask for? - I didn't know what to do in Vietnam upon buying the air tickets.
All I saw was this tour being rated first!
Had this Foodie tour and everything is just so fabulous!
Awesome guides we had. They were so sincere and passionate in their work :)
It's definitely worth every single of your cents :)

This is The A1 Tour of Vietnam - Insightful, funny, amusing, good value, cultural, educational - in 30 years of globe trotting this would have to be our all time favorite tour that we have ever engaged in....we were the Foody's doing the Foodie tour with Ben and the girls....when we are back in Vietnam again we will do this again....we booked directly on line and we had fourteen 'foodies', multiple nationalities and multiple age groups. Your never too old to do this one and it makes you feel young at heart, as well as very satisfied in the food department, no-one went home hungry with a smorgasboard of food from different regions of Vietnam and refreshments in abundance....thanks to all the Team at XO it was a highlight...and the photos you provided tell the story (everyone has a smile)...

Don't miss this tour! - by far the best thing we did in Saigon! Ben and the girls were fantastic and went out of there way to make sure we had a great time. The price is fairly high for Vietnam but the tour is worth every cent! The food and the venues were of the highest class and you get to try things that you have only heard of and some things you have never heard of!!!
Getting on the back of the bikes was daunting at first but you relax into it very quickly and then you just have 4 hours of fun and laughter. Lots of great information on Saigon as well on the history of the city plus useful information on where to go and what you should pay etc.
Do this tour when you 1st arrive as it will help you learn about the city and you can then tackle this amazing city with confidence.

If you are only doing one tour in Saigon, make sure it's XO Tours!!!

Best way to experience Saigon - If you want to get right among the traffic of this crazy city, this is the tour. The girls are fantastic (you always feel safe) while the experience of weaving in and out of the traffic is priceless. And the food !! Yum. Our tour was one of the highlights of our holiday. Going to Saigon ? My advice, book an XO tour.

WOW! What a Tour - Foodie Tour - We booked this tour directly from the website - the communication was brilliant.

Picked up at 5.30pm and set off to meet the rest of our group. There were 10 people in our group of different nationalities - we had great fun together. Our drivers were How and Tung and our group leader was called Tai - all lovely people, spoke very good English and had a good sense of humour.

We thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of the tour - the ride through China Town was unbelievable. The food we had and the restaurants we were taken to, we probably wouldn't have tried on our own. This was our first time on a motorbike. What a great overall experience.

Very highly recommend.
