Just amazing! - The best way to explore night living in Vietnam...we took the foodie tour and it was more than "tastefull"!The girls driving , the managers and the staff are very kind with great sense of hospitality!So many things to see and taste in four hours that worth every single dollar you pay!
Propably the most amazing sight seeing tour I have ever experienced!Do not eat everything the hole day before the tour!!!

Must-do tour! - After having read the reviews on Trip Advisor I had high expectations of this tour, and I wasn't dissappointed. I was greeted, on time, at my hotel by my guide for the evening, a very friendly and knowledgable Vietnamese girl. We then joined the rest of the group to sample some of the best culinary experiences of Siagon, taking in areas that tourists rarely venture. If you do no other tour whilst in Siagon I can thoroughly recommend this one. Book in advance though as it does seem to get booked up.

So much fun! (Foodie Night Tour) - This will change your perception of HCMC! We spent a day walking around District 1 and I knew there was more to HCMC and this was a perfect way to see it. The traffic and the motor bikes in HCMC is an attraction in and of itself. It's amazing and terrifying at the same time, and I was really nervous to get on the back of a bike and experience it for myself. But, I'd read all the reviews and trusted I would be safe. Just like everyone else has written, the girls are very safe drivers and it is such a thrill to be driving in HCMC on the back of a bike. We got to see many different parts of the city and eat some delicious food. I especially liked the clams, crabs, and scallops at the last stop. The girls were friendly, entertaining and informative and Ben made everything run smoothly. Definitely do one of the XO tours when you are in HCMC, even if you are scared at first. You'll love it!

XO foodie tour.......a must - If you are in HMC this tour is a must.........(even if not a foodie). Great fun riding around HMC at night, great company, fun tour guides that make it very interesting, not to mention great (and sometimes interesting) food.

You gotta do this!

Great way to see Saigon - We booked the Saigon by Night tour for the second night we were there. After 24 hours of travel, we were quite tired and had reservations about doing the tour. Am I glad that we did! it was one of the highlights of our 4 week tour of South East Asia, and it was on the second night! Our skills guides were fantastic and I got the impression they were students or recent grads and their language were excellent. Their knowledge of the areas that we visited was outstanding. Our tour lastest 3 hours and while I'm sure there was more to see, my knees were shot by the end of the tour. LOL And I did have to close my eyes a few times when we were merging into traffic. HIGHLY Recommended.

See Saigon like the Saigonese - The undoubted climax to our time in Saigon. Although we are in our later 60's, we felt entirely safe plunged in among the 9 million motor scooters of the city. The girls scooting us were delightful: chatty as sparrows and decorative as orioles. The food was superb, much of it sea-food, and entirely without adverse effects. We were given perspectives on Saigon we would never have discovered by our selves: the Chinese market where the pavements are heaving with living food; the new city was built by the Taiwanese; wooing on the long chairs etc. Nearly five hours passed like a tropical twilight. Miss everything else, but not this tour.

Life in the Fast Lane!! - Saigon's scooters are part of the fabric of the city. The BEST (and safest way) to get the thrill of driving one, is on the back of a scooter driven by XO tour guides. This beats a city bus tour any day! I was picked up at my hotel by the lovely driver Bin, who introduced herself, before whisking me on the back of her motorbike. We meet the other tour goers and our historical guide Ben, at the first attraction-Notre Dame Cathedral. At each point of interest, Ben provided the requisite background info and kept the pace of the excursion moving along. Bin and all the other scooter chauffeurs are charming - they all seem to work as a team to run this tour smoothly, efficiently, and in a light, entertaining manner. This company gets it! -prompt email responses, on time pick-up, friendly and adorable scooter chauffeurs, excellent English speaking guides, and a sense of humor, all made my city tour a blast. I saw the 'highlights' of District 1 and looked forward to getting to each one! The scooter ladies drive their charges around safely and provide a worry free experience. I was smiling for the whole 2 hours.. Do this XO tour, or try them all! You will have a blast!

A Saigon "Must do"! - Take the foodie tour whilst you are in Saigon, and book it before you go so that the crazy traffic with no rules does not put you off!
You don't need to be motor bike rider before taking the tour, just sit back and relax as the CO crew take you to places that you will otherwise never see or experience. The food is fantastic, the atmosphere electric and they make this such a great experience.
We took a personalised tour which made it a unique experience, and our team leader Tai Dang was waiting for us at each food stop to ensure that everything was ready for us, and explaining things about the location and the food. We also had two guys on another bike taking a video of our adventures and an outrider who keeps the traffic away,. There is lots of food so please don't have lunch otherwise you will not enjoy what is on offer, the frog tastes like chicken, goat tastes like rubber chicken, but the whole egg when broken to reveal a chick complete with feathers which you eat whole we passed on, we maybe wild 50 yr olds, but there is a limit .
In between, the bike riders Ngan (Milky Way)and Ni were safely navigating the traffic and telling us about the areas we were passing through, which gave a great insight into the culture of the city. If you get chance to use this team do so, as they are friendly, fun and speak good English.
Don't leave Saigon without doing this, it is not number one for nothing!

Great experience - An overall great experience and one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. In a city of over 10 million people and 5 million scooters/motorbikes, there can be no more authentic way to experience the frenetic city of Saigon than on a motorbike yourself. The tour was very well organized, efficient, friendly service from booking through to the tour itself. We booked last minute but were impressed with the speed and efficiency of the process and how friendly everyone we dealt with was. Would highly recommend!

Don't miss this experience! - Fabulous experience! An Australian couple I met in HaLong Bay recommended this tour and I am very glad I signed up. I was disenchanted some of the time as I am not used to being in such heavy traffic on a motorbike. But my driver/escort Trien deftly manouvered thru traffic and got me back to the hotel safe and sound. A visitor to Ho Chi Minh City could never find the areas and restaurants we visited.

It is a great and exciting five hours and in addition to sightseeing HCMC by night, you will have some fabulous food. Your driver/guide will point things out, but at several stops tour leader Tai Dang and his assistant will explain things further. So you really have three guides.

As mentioned, the food is excellent and you must be brave when you try some of the more unique items like “jumping chicken” (frog), goat, quail, huge grilled prawns, coconut jelly and a bunch of other stuff. I was especially impressed with how easy it was to reserve and the fact that Tai Dang substituted two (no-chili!) dishes for me due to personal preferences.

The tour is well organized, you get lots of information, you get your very own (and cute as a button) driver/guide/escort who will explain the food and show you how to eat it.

If there was another tour to different restaurants, I would have signed up a second time!

Don't miss this experience in HCMC!

A must do - We did the Saigon by Night tour, which involved seeing parts of the city that tourists don't normally visit.
You get a choice of three types of street food which are picked up a;long the way. We particularly enjoyed the pork with broken rice.
They take photos which they email to you later.
For those who don't want to do the Foodie tour, this is an excellent alternative. You definitely should do one or the other.

Not to be missed - This is a not to be missed attraction. We went on the dinner "cruise". After seeing HCMC traffic from the curb, I was a little concerned that my pre-booked evening was a mistake. Neither my wife or I have any use for motorbikes in our lives in the US. If I was nervous, my wife was scared out of her wits. But we took the plunge and climbed on with two of the cutest, nicest young ladies you would ever want to meet. What a great night we had and the daunting traffic was almost fun by the first dinner stop, Do not miss this!!!! And book well ahead, a month or more to insure a spot.

Some are cheaper but I'll still choose this - This was the highlight of my trip to HCM. My tour guide Chi Mai was the best! She told me lots of things about the city and even got to talk a bit deeper about personal things because we are of the same age.

The food was awesome! I love exotic food and this was the perfect tour. They will surprise you definitely because this not just a plain tour. You will have fun I promise!

Next time i go back to HCM, i'll book this again! I loved those goat breast!

Great insight into Saigon food. - We are a mature aged couple from Australia, and wanted to experience the foodie tour. We are so pleased that we joined the experienced riders from XO tours who took us on a safe and trouble free tour that was such a blast! .Ben Chua is the consummate tour guide who kept us up to date with the progress of our tour and information. Well done to all. We have great pleasure in recommending this tour for all people. Gazza and Hells

Perfect blend of personal and professional! - We thoroughly enjoyed our Foodie Tour with XO Tours! Our hosts Trang and Thu made us feel like we were on a night out with friends and tour manager Ben kept the night running smoothly with great information and an amazing ability of remembering peoples names!

The food was great, plenty of variety, and my husbands prawn allergy wasn't a problem for them - they had substitute meals on hand. The best part was zipping around Saigon on scooters - something we wouldn't have had the nerve to do on our own!

A real highlight of our two weeks in Vietnam, our only regret is that we didn't have enough time to take another tour with the girls in Saigon!

Do Not Leave HCMC without taking this tour!! - I took the evening Foodie tour with my husband and parents. We all had no previous experience on a motorcycle, and we were thrilled with the experience!! If you only do one thing in HCMC this is THE thing to do. I could write a novel about all the reasons to take this tour, but I think the 600+ excellent reviews on TA have that covered; instead here are some tips about taking the tour:

1. On first sight the hordes of motorcycles in HCMC can seem very intimidating, but don't be discouraged. It feels a lot less chaotic when you're a part of the "horde", and from beginning to end the staff at XO go out of their way to make you comfortable. I strongly recommend taking the tour on your second or third day in the city after you've had a chance to grow accustomed to the organic, unstructured flow of traffic.

2. Pay the extra $30 for the video. We didn't order this option when we first booked the tour, but once we saw how central motorcycles were to the HCMC experience we realized that we definitely wanted a video to capture it. Unfortunately, another group had booked the video component by the time we requested it, so we missed out. Don't make the same mistake.

3. Travel light and only bring what can fit in your pocket. As your guides will explain, it is not uncommon for people to have jewlery and bags ripped off their bodies while in motion. Unfortunately there are some poor and desparate people in Vietnam who need to steal to survive. Better to leave your valuables behind in your hotel safe, than to try to tuck them away while you're on the tour. We still carried a camera in our pocket, but the tour guides take photos all along the way and email them to you after, so that wasn't entirely necessary (although I would sitll bring it along if I did the tour again).

Very organized - Arrived at hotel on time. We met the other couples/groups at the first restaurant and then travelled as a pack, which included two extra male drivers and the tour leader. This as a precaution in case of incidents in the less safe areas. We visited 5 different districts, all away from the standard tourist area of 1 and 3. It gave a great few of Saigon at night and the food was good and interesting. Not the usual choices of westerners! This is a terrific way to see a lot of the city and get a feel for it.
Great fun - Was a great morning, zipping around the traffic like a a bee. 7 of us on the tour that day. Well run tour, nice people, safe and good value. Would recommend

Great Experience, much more than I expected. - I was really looking forward to this trip. Being on a motorbike in HCMC seemed like a rite of passage to really experience the place. We were picked up by the girls right on time and from then on enjoyed a mix of motorbike riding and Vietnamese cuisine.
What made this trip exceptional was the incredible staff and well thought out schedule. The guides were talkative and made you feel like they were truly interested in your holiday experience. They fussed over us all night, made sure we tried all the food, participated in the activities and took lots of photos.
I was actually disappointed when their night ended. Thanks for a great night.

AMAZING - I can't say enough about the foodie tour we just returned from tonight. Traveling through all of HCMC and surrounding Districts is the way to go to get a true sense and feel of what it's like getting around and eating incredible Vietnamese food. The staff are very entertaining, personable, knowledgeable, safe, and treat you like royalty. I didn't want it to end. This is, hands down, the best tour I have ever been on in my traveling experience. Highly, highly recommend!

Super Fun in Saigon - I had no idea that this was #1 on trip advisor of things to do in Saigon when we booked, but I sure understand why it is now.
The communication and booking was prompt and efficient and the tour was really great. The bikes and girls were so fun and it was really with doing this tour.

Stop reading reviews - BOOK NOW!! You won't regret it, you'll love it!! - My friend & I went on the XO Tours Motorbike Foodies Tour two nights ago & we haven't stopped talking about it since. To say it was a highlight of our trip to HCMC is an understatement - it is a highlight of all my world travels!!

Our guides picked us up right on time. So professional, courteous & friendly. They gave a quick run down of how to sit on the bike etc & then we were off! Darting through the crazy HCMC traffic with a certain ease and grace that made me relax on the bike in the most unlikely circumstances with only a couple of minutes!! It was so much fun!

We visited several districts over 5 hours trip, place we would never have seen during our 3 day stay without going on this tour. Our guides speak fluent English and told us a range of interesting facts as we drove side by side with the Saigon locals! The food was fantastic & there is opportunity to try a few tastey treats that one might not usually!!

Please - do yourself a favor - book now! It is an unforgettable experience!! You will LOVE it!! We did. 10/10 - professional, fun, super interesting, unique!! Just brilliant!

Highlight of our trip - We have to say that this was one of the Highlights of our trip to Vietnam even though we did it on our second night of the holiday.What a FANTASTIC way to experience HCMC and discover such wonderful street food. The excitement of traveling all around the city on mopeds (the main form of transport in HCMC and Vietnam) and being escorted by such charming and delightful guides was just incredible. We felt safe and secure at all times and experienced eating like never before. If you miss this tour you are essentially missing 3 of the vital elemenents of Vietnam, Mopeds, Food and Delightful young people. Our Guides were Chi, Ding and Tai. we were the only people on our tour as we booked an individual tour (well worth it) but they have done groups of 19. Do Not Miss This.

Just Awesome - I did the Foodie Tour with 7 Friends. Due to our group size, we had our own tour.
The feeling to be part of the chaotic Vietnamese traffic is just stunning. The female drivers are very experienced, communicative and good drivers at all. I felt safe every single minute even in this traffic chaos.
The domestic food which was served was delicious and very special.
I just can recommend this tour to feel the beat of the city in an amazing way.

You must do one or all of these tours - We did the foodie tour & sites tour, the tours were fantastic! On time, organized, fabulous riders who speak very good English, it's the best way to see the city, explore hidden treasures and get to experience the real Saigon! We had fantastic food, as much as you can eat, they even catered for my food allergies. We laughed and ate all night, I will do more tours with them next time.

Simply go! - I was picked up ahead of time by a worringly slight young lady called Thun, (embarrassingly, I got her name wrong half way through the evening, but she just tutted and laughed at me, no offense taken on her part).
No need to worry at all just follow the very simple pre-ride instructions and you'll have a ball. Remember that however chaotic it may seem to an outsider, this is everyday stuff for these lads & lasses, so sit back and trust them to do their stuff, you'll be fine. Thun (my guide) was able, confident and would probably give Valentino Rossi a run for his money in terms of tight traffic management. Bright, charming and very informative all evening, she along with the other individual guides plus tour leader Ben made this a very quick 4.5 hours; all the staff that I met on this evening out were very good company. If you have any worries about being in traffic on a motorbike with these girls - forget it, it's a pleasure. They met with great approval from everyone I spoke to on our tour, ladies and gents alike. Oh yes, and we had some very pleasant food too, which I think was supposed to be the point!

History easy listening - We enjoyed it much to learn something about Vietnams/Saigons history in such a funny way as Ben has done that. He knows the nice spots, nows where to get lovely food and has the nicest drivers/girls of all of them.

The night foodie tour - definitely do - it's fun + food! - I did the night foodie tour and would highly recommend it. You travel on the back of a vespa/motor bike with the Vietnamese girls driving.They are fun, really do look after you and have good conversation. It's a real pleasure.
The food is sensational. Fresh, delicious and authentic, not like 'Vietnamese" back in your home cities which has been altered to "suit" the western pallet, this is the real stuff. It's good to eat the food that the locals eat as part of this trip, and try different foods (frog, not to mention the duck embryo) and experiences.
Don't do Saigon without going on this trip.

Brilliant! - Do the Foodies. Great way to see Saigon at night. Great way to experience the real Vietnamese food. This is not a tour for someone wanting "starred" restaurants. You sit on plastic chairs eating with the locals.

We also did the Sights tour. This is again a good way to see a few key sights and some of the less famous ones. You go from location to location, get a history lesson in a fun, but factual, way. I would prefer the girl driving to be more of a guide, so see more of the city, with less stopping.

If you're not used to motorbikes or busy, Asian city traffic, it may be scary at 1st, but the girls drivers are confident and professional.

Best foodie tour ever - We arrived in Vietnam and when looking on the trip advisor site on how to cross the road I thought might be an idea to do a tour. Our daughter is into cooking so after reading the reviews decided this was for us. It was very informative, the girls were great on telling us all about the city, the food was fantastic delicious in fact. My only advise is dont have lunch be very hungry as there is so much food to try and by the end we were so full. Was so much fun and we are 50, felt safe at all times. Well worth the money

A must do - We wanted to do the XO Foodie Tour the day after we arrived but that was the beginning of Tet. So glad we decided to do it half an hour after arriving by plane. Absolutely unforgettable. A must do in Saigon. The girls were not only very good riders but gorgeous and terrific fun with excellent English and pointed out sights of interest on the way. By the end of the tour we had a good feeling for the city. Our leader, Tai Dang, was knowledgable and also great fun. We laughed through every meal. The food experiences were varied and yummy and in places we would never have gone by ourselves. The back up person was so well organized. We always had a table waiting for us even in the most crowded places. Great team work, great service (the girls even peeled our prawns for us) great fun. If you only do one thing in Saigon this is it.

Highlight of our Vietnam Trip! - Having read the reviews here, we booked the Foodie tour before we left home and were we glad we did! Best way to experience the sights, sounds and tastes of Saigon. Fun from the moment the XO tour guides picked us up until they dropped as off 4 hours later. Wonderful range of food all beautifully prepared and explained. As we drove around the city the guides pointed out places of interest and then off to the next food stop. This tour is not to be missed if you are planning a trip through HCMC.

Must try! - Did The Sights Tour and The Foodie Tour in August 2012.

Covered lots of places and very informative. Some places normally non-Vietnamese won't go.

Tung Do and the girls are a great bunch for the trip!

Highly recommended.

Absolutely excellent! - Did the foodie tour with xo tours. Initially was very skeptical as it was quite pricey for a short duration but after completing the tour, it was worth every cent. The guides were girls and they were so friendly and nice. There was never a dull moment. Two guys also accompanied us as bodyguards. The girls were very safe riding the bikes n kept the conversation going. They took us to several districts and along the way we stopped at several areas to learn more abt Vietnamese culture etc. Food was amazing! Each stop had different kinds of food. All in all we roughly stopped at four eateries. Food was clean n delicious. The guide girls served us food n made sure we had more than enough to eat at every stop. Food was served with beer or any other non alcoholic beverage of your choice. You can specify your meal preference prior to the trip. so this tour is suitable for the gastronomically adventurous and even those poor eaters. As we were dining and riding with the locals it was definitely a very unique and memorable experience. We laughed so much that night and it was the highlight of our short trip to Vietnam. It's a must do when travelling to Saigon.

Best Vietnam-Experience you could get - The XO-Foodie Tour was an unforgettable experience and by far the most interesting and inspiring part of our trip to Vietnam. I can only recommend every Saigon-visitor to book one of their tours, you won’t regret it! The ladies that showed us around were excellent drivers and a great company during the trip. The food that was served in the different locations was an absolutely new experience and tasted excellently no matter which meal you tried. It was amazing to have the possibility to try local specialties such as frog or fresh seafood. All in all, the Foodie-Tour really made our trip to Vietnam, an absolutely stunning experience!

An Excellent Way To Spend A Morning in HCMC With XO Sights Tour - We only did this tour as an after thought on our last morning in HCMC before flying back home the same day. We booked on the strength of Trip Advisor reviews and were not disappointed.

Booking was very easy and stress free and I got very prompt replies to my e mails and managed to organise the trip at very short notice.

We were picked up at the hotel and the girls were great. We felt very safe and looked after and the conversations we had were very interesting and informative. We joined a couple more people and met Ben who was also really engaging. We learnt so much about HCMC in just a few short hours and we even got to try a little street food. Ben also took some photos and sent them to us after we returned to the UK, which was a lovely touch.

If we had more time we would have loved the evening food tour, it is a great way to experience the City.

simply the best - best tour ever, must do in HCMC. I did the evening foodie tour (also ordered the video filming), it was excellent, the guides are very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful, I had a great evening. During my stay in HCMC, I did several tours and XO tour is the best. The staffs are all very professional and fun. Highly recommended, do it when you are in HCMC!

Highlight of 6 week tour to SE Asia. - Just great. Such friendly drivers and guides, and getting to see parts of Ho Chi Minh City we never would've experienced otherwise. Food was great too. Highly recommended.

Just a great way to get an understanding of Saigon and enjoy food - We had a brilliant night with another couple who were quite nervous about taking a scooter tour of Saigon. We booked the foodies tour and it was over four hours of great times. We would recommend XO Tours and when we go back will travel again. We tried many different foods, and got to see this amazing city with so many different areas. It was a full on exploration. Cannot wait to return. The Ladies who drove were fantastic and we felt safe as they had other staff along the way that seemed to keep a close eye on things.

Awesome first night experience! - I went on the Foodie tour on the first night of my trip and 7 more days in, I still haven't had an anything as tasty. My guide, Milky Way, was so sweet and really informative about Saigon and Vietnam in general. We talked as we rode thru the streets of Saigon, which may sound scary but she was such a careful driver. You definitely see much more than the guidebooks will ever take you to. You make 3 food stops and 2 more 'information' stops. At each one the tour manager, Ben, gave us descriptions of the food and the areas were in. Definitely pace yourself as there are many dishes to try and you can eat and drink as much as you like. Also, I asked to try some vegetarian food so Ben had 'special deliveries' for me to try in addition to the other pre determined dishes. The girls sit with you and explain each dish in further details and deshell, wrap, or grill, for you and show you how to eat all the dishes.
This was one of the best tours I've ever been on anywhere! Thank you so much Milky Way and Ben for making my first night in Vietnam so tasty and memorable!

As simply as possible - do it. - My wife and I did the night scooter tour and loved it. Once you're on a scooter, inside it all, it demystifies what looks like chaos from the outside. The food was also great and the owner was more than willing to go the extra mile.

Excellent food tour - We joined XO tours on a 4.5hrs foodie tour on a motorcycle, traveling to different parts of HCMC to savor different street food. This is where we experienced first hand chaotic city riding and to join in the locals in their drinking and merrying. We enjoyed it very much and would recommend it to anyone who is looking for an authentic gastronomical experience in the shortest time.

Awesome way to spend our first night in Saigon - In four hours you pack in heaps. The girls chauffeur you on their bikes, there's heaps of chat along the way, a great insight into vietnam life, the awesome variety of street food, the crazy rules of the road and Siagon as a city. Ben your guide does a bit of stand up at each stop, takes plenty of pix and then emails them after. If you've got time do it :)

An excellent way to see and taste the real HCMC - My Fiancé and I took the "Foodie Tour" of Saigon and had an amazing time. We found XO tours to be an extremely professional company with enthusiastic and knowledgeable tour guides. I organised the tour about a month prior to our visit by e-mail and had swift responses to all my messages. On the evening of the tour we were picked up from our hotel by our guides on the Mopeds and first taken to a street stall to group up with the others on the tour. We were all given an introduction about the evening and about what we were about to eat. Throughout the night we made a variety of stops including 3 food stops. The tour of the city was great especially being on mopeds which is the only way to really experience the city properly. The girls were great tour guides and drivers, and when we ate they sat next to us explaining the food and preparing it for us. You can eat and drink as much as you like and try a wide variety of the local food. They emphasise that it is not a gastronomy tour or even that they will take you to the best restaurants; it is a tour of what the locals really eat which is exactly what we wanted. Even if you aren't too bothered about food, the tour of the city is excellent as well and you really get to see parts of the city outside of District 1 that you probably wouldn't normally venture to.

All in all, I can't recommend this tour enough and it is easy to see why it ranks #1 of things to do in the city. It's a great chance to see the local life whilst having an English speaker to explain everything. We did this tour at the beginning of our stay in the City which meant that on the following nights on our own we were a lot more knowledgeable about what to try and where to go.
As a final bonus, the guys took some great pictures throughout the night and e-mailed them to us free of charge.

XO Scooter Foodie Tour - A great way to see the town like a local - If you want to see Saigon like a local this is your best bet. Riding among all the scooters all over town and eating local food, is an experience not to be missed! Being in the symphony of scooter traffic is an experience by itself and having local tour guides to show you the right way to eat the different foods made this tour among my top 3 favorites. I was nervous when my husband booked this tour because I am not fond of riding on motorcycles but once we got started I forgot all about my anxiety... try it, you'll love it!

Best tour decision ever! - This was the best decision we made ever! booking the foodie and sight tour with XO. The foodie tour especially is a must, you get to sit and eat with the locals and its just a great way to see the sights.
Travelling on the back of the motorbikes is a bit scary at first because of all the bike traffic, but the friendly lovely girls that also speaks English are very good riders, they actually explain the rules before getting on the bike; ( have you been on a bike before, don't lean side to side, get off on the left hand side of the bike etc etc ) for an adrenalin rush its fantastic! word of advice wear a mask. Its not just the great food on the tour, Ben the tour leader gives good insight about the districts you visit and Vietnamese culture which he speaks passionate about.

The 2 hr 30 min sight tour is a quick and easy way to see the tourist spots, rather than walking around from A to B which could take a full day, plus everything is explained in English and they also take you to a local market for a yummy dessert. Though its a morning tour 9am to 11.30am please cover up, as it gets pretty hot. Also Ben the tour leader takes photos of you and sends them via email as an extra added bonus I thought!

Was one of the best tours I've done - Evening Food Tour:
A great way to see the city and eat some local food. Our guides were nice and as others wrote, motorcycle speed was perfect for beginners (think at best we hit 35km once). Basically the guides help serve you and order, chit chat and guide you through what you are eating.
No hesitation to recommend to anyone, you will have fun and all the food is very manageable in terms of not too strange - unless you ask, then you can be a bit more adventurous.

Perfection xo - Did the foodie tour last year with my best friend. We has a amazing time, loved every minute. The girls are professional and speak beautiful English. The camera men did a excellent job (u can pay to have a DVD done if the trip, they edit it so its amazing. Heaps of fun to watch) the manager was accommodating and met us at certain points of the tour to welcome us and provide us with interesting information of different districts. I cannot rate this company highly enough. I am booking it next year again to take my mum for her birthday. Beware if imitating companies xo tours are the original trail blazers for this kind of tour in Ho chi Minh city. U won't regret it best tour We did in Vietnam, did not want the night to end.

don't miss this one! - I love experiencing the real culture of any country I visit. What better way to cover ground than on a motorbike?? To tell you the truth, I was nervous but couldn't ignore all the wonderful reviews on TA. What made this activity even more special for me was that I'm Vietnamese and it helped me feel more connected to a country my mother and father called home.

Booking process was simple, we chose for the Foodie Tour which took us thru the different districts in Saigon. Our friendly drivers met us at our hotel and explained the do's and don'ts of riding on the back of a motorbike. My knuckles were white from holding on so hard to the back of the bike but this only lasted 10 minutes. My driver, Phuong (my name too!) was so friendly and really interesting to talk with. She spoke both English and Vietnamese to me which I really enjoyed. First stop was bun bo hue on the roadside. Everything was already laid out and we were introduced to everyone else (I think about 10 other people) in the group. Loved it. Each food at every stop was explained as well as background history. All in all we visited 3 restaurants and a couple of notable sites. We always felt very safe as there were extra motorbikes following in case anything happened. Every time I use the bathroom, my guide will come to me. No biggie to some people but to me this was a nice touch to insure my safety/comfort. Another nice touch was they took pictures for us that were emailed a couple days later.

I can speak Vietnamese and was a little skeptical of this tour but very happy we chose to do it. I saw things that even my mom wasn't aware of. There wasn't one moment I felt unsafe or bored. Well worth the money and it's something we'll remember forever.

The Best Thing We Did in Vietnam - Easily the best tour we went on in Vienam by a country mile. Self, wife and 2 teenage daughters did 2 motorbike tours with XO on the same day. The "Shopping Spree" in the morning and the "Foodie Tour" in the evening. Us 4 were introduced to our bike riders who were all young attractive Vietnamese women in traditional costume by the Tour Captain who came on his own bike to make sure everything went well. Their names were Mr Tai for the Shopping Spree and Mr Sam for the Foodie Tour. They were both excellent. In the shopping tour you just tell the Captain what you want to buy and the will take you to the places where prices and quality are best. Mr Tai and the girls gave advice on pricing and stopped us getting ripped off on more than one occasion. I feel very confident that there were no 'kick backs' to the XO People. They were very protective of us in the markets to ensure we did not get picked pocketed. We bought many bargains and easily saved the cost of the tour on our shopping purchases. We also got to see a good part of the city from the back of the bikes that we would otherwise not have seen. Initially, when the girls 'dive' into the frantic traffic it was a bit scary but they were excellent riders and after hanging on with white knuckles at first we relaxed as our confidence grew in their abilities. XO also sent another guy on a bike just to carry our shopping bags which was a great help. Determinetly worthwhile doing when you first arrive in HCMC to orient yourself to the area and slip into the Vietnamese way of life in this city.
Having completed the Shopping tour we arrived back at the hotel at about lunch time and prepared for the "Foodie" tour in the Evening. This time we were picked up by 4 different girls (they were all lovely and spoke excellent English) and taken to our first stop where we met other members of the tour, had some delcous soup and moved off in convoy to the next stop. Being seasoned 'bike passengers' by then we really enjoyed seeing HCMC from the back of the bikes at night. A whole new perspective on the city. We made about 6 stops to have various foods which the girls cooked for us at the table in several instances. Where seafood was involved they cracked the crabs and peeled the prawns - it was like having your own butler helping you! They were a lot of fun and we had may laugh with them. The food was excellent (except the snake wine spirit which I will pass on next time). They also had several "outriders" acting as security for our group who provided a protectve cordonaround us, unobtrusively, when we stopped at hawker type centers. Excellent organization and control by Mr Sam to ensure the guests went home with a smile. We also paid the extra US$25 to have another driver and Cameraman video our Foodie Tour. Great to share with friends and professionally presented when Emailed to us a couple of weeks after our return to Australia. If you could do only one tour in Vietnam Regardless of your age, fitness or size my whole family would recommend you do the XO tours - I would go back to Vietnam tomorrow just to do the Foodie Tour over again!!

Amazing experience - A must for anyone visiting HCM, I cannot thank the guides enough for the experience they gave us, the booking process was easy, I have never been on a motorbike before but my fears were soon calmed when we took off into the busy street and my lovely guide chatted and pointed out places of interest. The food we tasted was amazing we certainly wouldn't have tried some of it if we didn't go on this trip. I would have done it all again if we had time !

Way above any expectations I had! - This was the highlight of our stay in Saigon. To ride on the back of a motorbike in the busy, chaotic traffic, visit 4 Districts and experience the different cultures, street food and socio economic areas was not only a spiritual experience it was REAL! Thank you Guys you really showed us what is in the core of Ho Chi Minh City.
My daughter and I did a private tour and were made to feel like royalty! We got to try food that we never imagined we would try in a million years and meet the most amazing people you only meet when you are a local!
Do yourself a favor and don't leave HCMC without this experience.

Motor biking in Saigon - "Insane" said my husband, "thrilling" said my daughter and I! What a great way to get the feel of this happening town and experience the city at night. The food stop was perfect for us as well. The young lady drivers were well educated and spoke flawless English. If I had more time I would have done the food tour too.

You must do this! - I recently returned from Vietnam and I have to say this tour was the highlight of my trip. I had a fabulous time. The guides were friendly and very knowledgable and spoke English very well. By taking this tour you get to see so much more of Saigon than just District 1. The food was local, authentic and so delicious! You were invited to eat as much as you want. Pace yourself as you will be full to bursting by the time you finish. You have three food stops and two more informational stops. You are on the back of a motor bike and that can be terrifying if you have ever seen Saigon traffice but also exhilerating. Just close your eyes at the intersections. LOL. Excellent value for the money.

A little bit special! - If you're in Ho Chi Minh City this is a must. Take the Foodie Tour (there are others but didn't do so can't comment) but this is a solid 5 hours of fun on the back of a scooter in the City, interspersed by food stops in places you wouldn't find on your own and knowledgeable insights into this vibrant city and its culture. The girl riders are nothing short of amazing, and if you've seen traffic in HCM you'll know exactly what I mean, and these guys don't miss a beat. I got lucky with Miss Huong who was very bright, knowledgeable and good fun all rolled into one neat package. Should also mentionTai Dang who was a great host, with a great sense of humour. Oh yes and the food was varied, good and certainly different. Duck embryo your thing, not a problem on this tour. Not to be missed!

XO Fantastic Foodie Tour - We booked the foodie tour for Christmas evening after reading a lot of great reviews on Trip Advisor. The tour was better than we expected, the girls were wonderful they were so friendly and put you at easy despite zipping around HCM on a bike amongst the very chaotic traffic. Each stop was really will organised and the guides that told everyone a bit about the area were equally great and welcoming. They remembered the small things like our names which was a very nice touch. We really enjoyed ourselves and the food was wonderful, such a great way to see the city at night, get a bit of a snapshot of the different districts and eat such a variety of food. We would recommend it to everyone!

Thank you all so much for making the experience fantastic.

The MUST DO tour in Saigon - I usually never go on organized tours, and typically prefer to travel independently. Despite this, my girlfriend and I tried XO tours, and were so delighted with the Saigon by Night tour that we went on the Sights tour the following day. The tours are set up so that you have a genuine experience, and Tung was an excellent guide in giving us a nuanced sense of life in Vietnam. There were many very pleasant surprises- from the delicious food we ate to the little Vietnamese phrasebook Tung gave us (which became invaluable) to the photos Tung sent us, which were some of the best of our two week holiday. As an addendum, we went on a tour of Halong bay while in Hanoi, but unfortunately the tour seemed canned and formulaic in juxtaposition with the XO tour we went on, so I can only hope Tung considers expanding his company up north (a bia hoi tour would be awesome). All in all, I would say in hindsight that you should take this tour as soon as you arrive in Vietnam, as it will enhance your entire vacation. I fully plan on trying the foodie tour and others on my next trip.

Don't miss it! - I have been using TripAdvisor for a while, but this is the first time I felt like I had to write a review. XO Tours was so good! When I first found out about it on TripAdvisor and learned more on their Website, I thought it was a brilliant idea. The actual experience last week was even better!

Reservation
I reserved their Foodie Tour through their Website, and I received the confirmation right away from Tung Do (Owner/Director). I had a few follow-up questions via email, and Tung got back to me immediately each time. This timely and professional communication made me very comfortable ahead of using XO Tour for the first time. This is very important to me, as this was my first trip to Vietnam, and I wasn't sure what to expect from a stranger, especially those who target naive tourists.

Hotel Pickup
My excellent guide / driver, Ni, was already at the front of my hotel waiting for me when I came out 10 minutes before the pickup time. Again, by being early (I like being early), XO Tours completely eliminated anything to worry about.

Ni greeted me with a huge smile and an introduction. She explained to me a short list of tour rules, then off to the meeting place, the first place to eat. There, our group met for the first time. We had single guys, couples, and a family -- 12 altogether. Ben was in charge of our group as the lead guide, and he got us started with his fun and informative introduction.

Tour highlights (I won't write any specifics here so that you can experience all new and fresh.)

Food: We had plenty of different type of food to eat (pace yourself!) at different locations. Each dish and accompanying condiments / herbs were well explained. The selection was good, and I enjoyed all of them, as each tasted very good.

Scooter Ride: This was definitely more exciting than any rollercoaster rides, due to the nature of Saigon driving! Our driver was safe and excellent. I felt safer on a scooter driven by her, than crossing any intersections in District 1 on my own.

Areas: We visited 5 or 6 different districts, some of which are quite different from where I stayed, District 1.

Guests: From literally all over the world (Asia-Pacific, Africa, Europe, North America). Everyone was friendly and happy. XO Tours must bring happy people!

Guides: Our lead guide, Ben and the assistant guide, Tai were great. I particularly appreciated Ben's take on the current state of Vietnam.

Guides / Drivers: We traveled quite a bit on this 4.5-hour tour, so I had lots of time to ask all kinds of questions on Vietnam while on scooter, and Ni answered all of them intelligently. I even had a short lesson of Vietnamese language! Speaking of language, Ni's English was excellent, and I assume all other guides/drivers speak excellent English.

We sat with 3 other guests and their drivers, and 2 drivers whom I sat close by and had a chat often, Tien and Ngan, were equally pleasant and fun to chat with.

Photos: Ben took photos and we received a nice collection of photos via email a few days later. This must be a logistic headache, as they need to sort out photos by the participants and send the correct photos to the correct email addresses, but they just do it. What a customer service!

The only complaint was that it was too short, even after 4.5 hours! Time flew by. Well done, XO Tours. Don't miss it! You will thoroughly enjoy it.

Most fun I had in Vietnam - My friend and I are 66 year-old women so we were a little worried about riding on the back of a motor bike especially after we saw the traffic on the streets of Saigon. But not to worry our XO tour turned out to be the highlight of our trip. The reservations were made by e-mail from the states and very easy and efficient, the guides were so sweet with perfect English and made us feel comfortable from the moment they greeted us. Tung, the owner and director of XO tours, met us half way through the tour and went to dinner with us. He was charming, fun and informative. I forgot my camera, but he took pictures of us and e-mailed them to us. We went on the Saigon by Night tour because we thought the food tour was way too much food for us but I thought either tour would be great and the food tour might be better because it is longer. If you want to feel like part of the culture get on a motor bike like the rest of Vietnam.

Great way to experience Ho Chi Minh City. - Right from the beginning with the communication of the tour owner, Tung Do, I knew that I had made the right choice. The tour girls, the tour leaders and the tour itself is incredibly fun and informative! What an experience.

I did both the "Foodie" & "Sights" tour. The foodie tour is simply fantastic. I highly recommend that you at least book this tour. It will show you places of HCMC that you probably wouldn't have seen and eat things you would have probably missed. They also provide photos with the tour, so there is no need to stress about getting or missing photo ops.

I can't stress enough how awesome the tour guides and tour leaders are, they keep it fun and make it a very memorable experience. They even offer you their help, if needed, outside the tour. You can tell that Tung and everyone that works there really care and enjoy what they do.

Definitely a highlight of my visit to this city. I will be doing another tour next time I'm in Ho Chi Minh City.

Brilliant! - This was one of the hightlights of my 11 month journey around Asia.

I took the foodie night tour, The food was amazing and not the 'normal' tourist food.

High quality seafood and other dishes from all corners of Saigon. Plenty of refreshments on

tap, beers, soft drinks etc.

The girls who drove us around were smart, funny and very able motorcyclists.

They also helped serve us food and teach us about life in Vietnam.

A really slick operation - book well in advanced!

(I took another tour which was good but this was a different class!)

scooter Foodie Tour - It was well worth it. Very different way to see the city. Food was great and plenty of it.
Girls are very knowledgable and proffesional scooter drivers. felt very safe in the midst of the chaotic roads. Our Guide ben took lots of photos and emailed us copies which was nice.
The worst part of the trip was having to say goodbye to the guides at the end of the trip.
The food you eat is served at several street stalls in different provinces . This means the food is fresh and very tasty.One thing I would say is remeber to take some tissues as the bathrooms to not provide them.
A highly organised trip and would highly recommend it.

What the hype about? - If you visit trip advisor, you will see XO tour ranked as no.1 with excellent reviews from all corners of the world. You might be wondering what the hype about when the other tours company are receiving good reviews as well. Well..... There must be a reason I reckon.

We took the foodie tour which probably cost 1/3 of the Vietnamese tour earned in a month. Still, we went ahead & book the tour. What followed was probably going to change my mind.

1st, the booking went very well. We had a quick reply email from the boss Tung Do. After we
reached HCM, we informed him thru email our room nos & again we got a quick reply to assure us the pick up time. We went to our hotel reception early & surprised to see our guides already
waiting for us outside the hotel. The ladies were fast to make us comfortable & a short safety briefing to the bike & the ride.

From the 1st meeting with the guide to the 1st dish introduction from the boss to the support team male riders. We could feel the serving to us was truly coming from the heart, that our safety are taken care of most important, our tummy next... ;-), lastly our desire to absorb very drop of experiences gathered from the 4 hour tour.

We highly suggest to book this tour on your 1st day in HCM if you have never been here before as
we quickly get accustomed to the local culture & especially the traffic! (you will know what I mean).

I wish to thank my guide Thuy & Tung Do as the imprints created will last as long as my memory is running.

Fantastic tour around Saigon - I was so pleased that booked sightseeing tour. The best time I had in my 4 days in Saigon.
Being on motorbike with lovely Milkyway (name of my guide) was fun and safe (they have bodyguard motorbikes too so u are very safe).
Tung (owner of tours) is amazing guide with so much interesting information about city. Can see he is very passionate about what he's doing. Did feel very welcomed and looked after.
Would definitely book with them food lovers tour if I'm back in Saigon one day. These guys are amazing!
Explore Saigon on motorbike - be a part of crazy traffic and visit places not in the usual tours too. And have some funny photos with your driver-girl too. :)

Not a tour - THE EXPERIENCE - Saigon By Night Tour is not a tour, it is an amazing and wonderful experience. If you want to see Saigon this is the tour to do. Our guides Ngan and Ni were just wonderful and we had hard time to say goodbye. I know that if I ever go to Saigon in the future I do XO tour again. My wife wanted also the shopping Spree tour. Completely different experience but worth doing if want to buy something or not. Our guide Tie was ready to accommodate any of our requests. The girls riding the bikes are amazing and you feel safe and secure. In the end I would like to say thank you to the owner Tung for creating an excellent opportunity to enjoy Saigon and for being our personal guide at Saigon By Night Tour. Also huge thank you to Tie our shopping spree guide and all the girls from both tours Binh, Thuong (Sunny), Mgan ( Milky Way) and Ni.

Exhilarating and informative - a must do! - The XO tour was one of the highlights of our visit to Saigon. Seeing Saigon from the back of a motorbike gave us a real sense of what life in this vibrant city is like. The tour was very interesting. Ben, our guide, had some fascinating factoids to impart. Would highly recommend.

DO THIS!!! You won't regret it! - I am so happy I stumbled upon a blog that talked about this! We had SO much fun! The girls who picked us up at our hotel were both funny, outgoing and super knowledgeable about Saigon. It was such a fun way to see the entire city, there is something that is just freeing being on the back of a motorbike. Each food stop was incredible and everything was organized and ran so smoothly. They take the best care of you and you really are treated like royalty! I think my favorite food was on the last stop, some super delicious scallops that I am going to try so hard to recreate at home this summer. You will not regret booking with XO! They have a great program and do it right! They left us with business cards and keychains - nice touch!

Excellent tour - Do it! - We booked this trip in mid Jan and thoroughly enjoyed our tour with the lovely, informative and fun Vietnamese 'biker chicks' who were our guides for the 'foodie adventure'. We enjoyed amazing local food, excellent commentary and great company. Best of all was having the opportunity to see so much of HCMC safely on the back of a well driven moped. Very well done. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the area as it is such a great way to experience the real Vietnam. Thanks to all the team, it was fabulous!

Worthy of repeat - Had so much fun on a previous tour with XO that I rebooked on a subsequent visit with my work colleagues. As much fun as the first time, plus they were kind enough to introduce some variations to the menu so that I could try some different fare on my 2nd visit. Guides and hosts were friendly and informative. Very much recommended!

It's the only way to go - Mid January I took a couple of rides with the girls at XO tours. I started off with the Saigon sights tour. My guide spoke very good English and explained the sights in a light way as we rode around HCMC. This was a morning tour so the temperature was not too not. Seems that the others riding along with us enjoyed this type of tour as much as I did . On days 2, I took the Saigon by Night ride. Again the guide was lots of fun. It gave me a different perspective of Saigon as we cruised to some of the outlying areas of the city - probably places that most tourists would never experience.
Both tours were fairly small , 5 or 6 bikes. This gave it a personal touch . Its the only way to see the city sights. Beats being herded on and off of regular tour buses.
It's the only way to go!!

One of the best tours of our trip round Vietnam! - What an amazing 'foodie' tour! Girls were lovely and very safe drivers! Food was amazing and I tried many things I wouldn't normally eat. Good few hours on the motorbike seeing various districts in Saigon! This tour is a MUST if you stop in Saigon and want a fun night out experiencing the sights, sounds and tastes! Thanks team for making it so enjoyable!

Exciting, memorable experience - The XO tour was our highlight of our Vietnam trip. Every person had a personal tour guide who took you around the best local eateries around Ho Chi Minh City. The guide, food and drinks were all included in the price and they picked you up from your hotel. There was a group of about 12 of us who each had a driver/tour guide, so making new friends was easy. The food was excellent and exciting and so was riding the back of a scooter.

Lots of fun - Got to see lots of the city and the girls were safe drivers, the guide was really knowledgeable and spoke good English. What I found strange was that the guide would suddenly appear out of nowhere as would the girls when the time came but we never rode with him, ie the girls drove us and then the guide would materialize and the girls would vanish. We were constantly waiting up and told where to stand and ordered, around albeit in a polite way, so it was funny but very strange! I would recommend this tour as a good introduction to HCM.

BEST TOUR EVER (Tu and Toe with two in tow) - We booked the Foodie tour on the basis on the reviews we saw on TripAdvisor. It was one of the best things we ever did on any vacation anywhere in the world. Even if you have never been on the back of a motorbike, after the first few minutes you will become at ease as the drivers really know what they are doing. The drivers , TU and TO, (all woman in traditional ao dai dress), arrived on time and after demonstrating some safety tips, including on keeping our personal belongings safe, we were off in the midst of rush hour traffic. You will only be scared for the first minute as you enter HCM traffic as the drivers know what they are doing. Our first stop was a streetside café and we met up with other tour members. We were served some delicious soup with beef, pork sausage, and vegetables. Ben, the tour leader met all of us at the first restaurant and told us what the rest of the night would entail and where we would be going. After the soup, we went to District 8 which is pretty far from District 1. This is where the shopkeepers all over Vietnam buy their merchandise wholesale. From here we went to an outdoor restaurant which had long tables set up with tabletop grills. Our drivers cooked food on the grills while we drank Saigon beer (or you can order soft drinks). We had shrimp, baby goat, okra, squid, and frog. We played a chopstick game which was fun. Then to District 7 which is very upscale and does not seem like Vietnam at all. Our last stop was in District 4, which most tourists never go because it is far and less modern. The outdoor restaurant was featured seafood, outdoors again, where we were served spicy crab, scallops, clams, quail, coconut jelly (like a jello) and flan, and, if you were brave, you can even get a balut. This was a great way to get a look at HCM and enjoy great guides and great food. Would definitely do it again and recommend it to everyone.

Fabulous Foodie Tour Jan 2013 - I have never been on a motorbike before but the girls soon made me feel comfortable. They are friendly, helpful, informative and lots of fun. The tour is well organised and interesting. Ben is an exceptional host. we had always wanted to try the delicious Vietnamese street food but were never brave enough. This tour took us to interesting places, the food was delicious. We highly recommend the foodie tour with XO tours.

my favourite tour - My Husband and I booked a tour with XO Tours for our second night in Vietnam. It was a wonderful way to start our holiday as it was an amazing night. The girls that met us were absolutely delightful and as I had never even sat on a motorbike was a little apprehensive to start. They were so reassuring that by the time we had been going about 5 minutes I was not hanging on at all and felt absolutely safe. The whole experience was amazing as we got to see many different districts in HCM that we would not have seen and tasted all sorts of wonderful food. I could not recommend a tour with XO highly enough. It was professionally run but the food and friendliness of the girls made this a memorable experience and worth every cent.

Foodie tour on back of a moped - Great idea you see parts of HCM that you normally wouldn't see as a tourist. Scary at times in the traffic on the back of a moped but girls are great drivers. Food good, some interesting options offered....tried most.

Well organised and fun! - Thanks to Tai and the girls for an amazing trip around HCMC. This unforgettable trip takes you into several districs, gives you plenty of local dishes to sample and is a great laugh. The girls are lovely, experienced and calm riders. My wife was very nervous at first but the girls drive fairly slowly putting the passangers at ease. My two teenage children wanted to do the trip again the next day as they enjoyed it so much.
After we got home we receved free photos on our email taken on the trip. What a service!

A great way to see and taste Saigon. - Wonderful package put together.
Great food, sights and experiences.
I ate far more than i would normally but the food and company was so good i just got carried away.
The girls were just fantastic - so helpful and all my questions were expertly answered by them in perfect english.
All in all very happy to recommend this trip.

On a slight down side, Saigon and esp District 1 where we went is rife with mindless exploitation of women and I do not believe XO tours should use their 'beautiful women' as an advertising tool as the experience is about the city and its cuisine. XO tours (Tung) i believe should stand out from the crown in this respect.

Worth the extra $$$ - We did the night foodie tour and although more expensive than other tours advertised, the experience was second to none. The guides were friendly local girls with excellent knowledge, the food was some of the best we've experienced in Vietnam. They were also able to cater for a vegetarian diet.

WOW, WOW, WOW!!! - We did the 4 hour foodie tour and then the 2 hour sights tour. We tried to book the foodie tour 1 week before arrival but our chosen dates were full. Luckily Tung arranged an extra tour, thank goodness he did!!! This is one of the best excursions we have ever been on. The girls were brilliant very chatty, friendly and great fun. The food was fantastic, scallops, prawns and crab claws. The 2 hour sights tour although very different from the foodie tour it was very informative and fun and covered some great sights in Ho Chi Minh.

What ever you do in Ho Chi Minh make sure you book on a tour with XO....

Foodie tour November 2012 - This is a fantastic tour if you want to see Saigon at night, and try some of the local food. The tour manager was excellent as was the girls who looked after you throughout the tour. They speak great English, and are great at making you feel relaxed and special.

However although a great tour, I would recommend you try and get something from the pharmacy to help you cope with the street food, as both the wife and I had a bit of belly fat for the next few days which was not good.

Believe The Hype - We did the 4 hr foodie tour in our trip just before xmas and it was brilliant. The girls were great fun, the tour took us all round the city, and the food was just sensational. The scallops we had were the best I've ever tasted. The photos they took and emailed you a few days later was a nice touch. The only criticism is that it is fairly expensive by Vietnamese standards but its clearly priced for the western market and in that respect it is great value. Highly recommended.

Adventurous eats and great times - Tung has done a great job putting together a terrific tour. We did the Foodie tour on our first night in HCMC. All of the stops were great and by the end we were stuffed. Our drivers were great to talk to and their English was impressive. It poured out during our tour and the staff quickly broke out ponchos. Also, the scooter on which my wife was riding got a flat tire/broke down. To be honest I don't know the extent of the damage because they had her on a new scooter before you could blink! One suggestion would be to bring a facemask/hanky to cover your mouth as it gets pretty smoggy when riding in heavy traffic.

Thanks for everything Tung!

Fabulous, fabulous, fabulous - What a great experience - a definite highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Weaving our way through the streets of HCMC on the back of scooters, learning much about the city and best of all sampling the delights of the fare on offer. The guides were delightful. We felt safe moving through the traffic (and we are no spring chickens) and enjoyed the company of Ben and his team immensely. A totally awesome night out!!!

Wonderful Tour of District 1 of Saigon - I had high expectations for the 2.5-hour Day Tour and I was not at all disappointed. Tung (the company Director) was a knowledgeable guide who blended historic details of Saigon with a great humorous tidbits.

My girl driver also speaks very good English. She was courteous, professional and safe. In addition, there were a total of 7 of us in the Day Tour (3 Americans & 4 Australians) and we had a great time together at the 5-6 stops we made throughout District 1.

District 1 is small enough to walk by yourself but take the XO Tours first. You will love it!

HCMC Fun with XO Tours - I went on a 2.5hr city tour with XO early Jan 2013 off the back off a recommendation from a friend. What a fun, informative experience - the girls were super lovely and great drivers and we learned so much about the city. It was a great thing to do on a first day in HCMC so you can get a feel for the place, identify the key sites and work out where you want to go on and visit later on.
Apparently their foodie tour is great also.

Be warned you need to book early to secure your place.

Alex.

Best trip in Vietnam! - Do yourself a favor and book this tour!!!!!!! Excellent food, well organized tour, the girls driver are so nice and the male staffs are so kind too. They take you to very interesting places: night markets, local restaurants, different suburbs. You eat and learn a lot about the Vietnamese cuisine and culture. Highlight of our trip in Vietnam.

Not to be missed! You'll never look at the amazing traffic the same way - We took the 3-hours city tour recently and felt that it is a must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! Instead of looking at the horrific traffic wondering how you will survive it, flow with it on this city tour! Recent motorbikes of excellent quality. The driving crew of beautiful local Vietnamese ladies are all very competent and very decent English speakers. At each stop, a professional guide will give you the necessary explanation and details.
Not to be missed at any cost!

Highlight of my entire trip - Do yourself a favor and book this tour now.

XO tours are rare opportunity to explore the real HCMC. It's amazing street food, it's people and it's traffic!

The company's foodie tour was easily the best four hours of my entire holiday in Vietnam.

I tasted dishes I'd never thought to order like frog and goat. I experienced the place like almost 5million city dwellers do every day - on the back of a motorcycle. Fantastic!

What's more our guides couldn't have been better. Insightful, diligent and fun.

Don't forget to tip your guides generously!

Highlights of our HCMC trip - We booked the Foodie tour and couldn't have been happier with the experience. We enjoyed some of the most delicious and memorable dishes of our trip at places that we would never have stumbled upon on our own. A huge thank you to our guide Ben and our amazing hosts for introducing us to the tastiest of Saigon street cuisine.

We'd love to do it again!

A must do when in Ho Chi Minh City - Don't think, just book!!! - This is a must when you are in HCMC (Ho Chi Minh City). Don't even think about the price or comparing to other tour guides, its no.1 on tripadvisor for a damn good reason. My advice is just book as early as possible, and also pay upfront via Credit Card as opposed to Cash (unless you want to carry a roll of cash with you along the way which is a hindrance).

I'll keep it short and sweet. I went there with my brother on 1/3/13, went on a earlier Foodie Tour cause the 5:30pm one was booked out, so Tung (the XO Tour boss) made another session at 4:30pm. Was in a group of 6 with another cool family from England/Sth Africa, went for 4.5 hours, ate at 3 different locations, was food games along the way, saw a lot of HCMC besides the touristy District 1 (went to the Chinatown district, District 7 where all the expats are and the rich end, to District 4 the rough end). Food was sensational, lots of BBQ, seafood and of course beer and you will be full by the end of the night.

Overall, a fantastic experience and I highly recommend this. What makes this extra special though are the staff from XO Tours, and they shine from the moment you first meet them. The tour guides are all female and know how to show you a great time, speak great English, very knowledgeable and super friendly. Also mention to Tai which takes excellent photos along the way and he took the photos I uploaded. I hope they expand to other cities, cause these guys have got something good going on here.

FOODIE TOUR - Definitely A MUST-DO - My husband and I plus our 12 year old son had so much fun. The girls were delightful in every sense. It was informative, the food was good, and very exciting riding around Saigon on the back of a bike at night. Ben the host was really good. I was nervous at first, but it took no time to realize how competent the girls were. The price of the foodie tour is very reasonable.

Fantastic. Book early - before arriving in Vietnam if you can. - I start by repeating other comments already here. Book early. I would love to have done the foodies tour but it was already booked when I tried before leaving my home country. I was successful in being able to get The Sights Daytime Tour and LOVE LOVE LOVED it. As an oldie [woman] I wondered about my sanity in booking it truly but it was fantastic.I felt completely safe the entire time. The girls are so so friendly and share so much information and chat about HCMC and Vietnamese life in general as you drive along. Yes, you can hear them! Ben was amazing at each stop with his informative information and toook photos which he will email to us later. All my prior emails in my planning were answered extremely promptly - some I saw were answered in the middle of the ngiht- and I was met at my hotel exactly on time. Truly until you've been on one of these bikes in and out of the HCMC traffic [which is something you have to see to believe] its hard to actually explain the experience. A great tour. Worth every cent/dollar/dong.

Great introduction to HCMC - We booked both the sight seeing and foodie tour prior to arriving in Vietnam and the owner was very efficient in responding to any queries we had.
We had a great time, ate good food and the girls put us at ease as this was the first time on a motorbike.
We would recommend this as a great introduction to HCMC and value for money.

Amazing - would give it 6 stars if possible - What an awesome tour. We were greeted by two extremely friendly and fun guides when we arrived and loved it from start to finish. Our guides were so nice and so funny and even teased us about being wusses with food. The tour manager Ben was perfect. He spoke perfect English and told us loads of interesting stuff about Ho Chi Minh that we would have never found out without this tour. By far the best tour we've ever done. Thank you so much to all of xo tours for such an awesome night of food and fun. Will definitely come back again if we are ever back in HCMC.

Best part of our stay in Saigon! - Book early! We waited until we were in Vietnam before booking this tour. We wanted to do the day tour and night tour. The night tour was booked. We didn't have enough time in Saigon to schedule on a different day. We did the day tour and absolutely loved it. The girls are very friendly, personable, and offered an insider's view of life in Saigon. They are very safe drivers. It was so different experiencing Saigon on the back of a moped as opposed to walking or in a car. Ben was a great tour guide at the sites. He has a wealth of knowledge and his English is very good. We will definitely book one of the night tours when we go back to Vietnam!

The best way to see the city! - I organized a private three hour tour for me and my boyfriend. The reviews were right XO is the best way to see the city. You hit all the tourist spots, and still get to see places off the beaten path. The girls were absolutely lovely and had a blast zipping up and down the streets of Saigon. They took us to their favorite spots for fresh spring roles and Nuoc Mia (sugarcane juice), and to a fruit market where they bought us exotic fruits such as mangosteens and longan. Last but not least, they took lots of pictures of us throughout the journey and sent them to us after the fact.

Fantastic Foodie Tour - We arrived in Saigon early December and decided to take the evening food tour on the day of our arrival. What a great introduction to Vietnam. Absolutely wonderful. The girls were great - my driver even managed to get me to sing while we were whizzing along the road. Food was delicious, and the tour really did take us to parts of Saigon we would otherwise not have dared to go to on our own. Highly recommended.

Just do it - My partner was not sure of sitting on the back of a motorbike but had a great time. You get a real understanding of how the chaos that is the traffic here actually works - nothing better than being right in the action. We did a 3 hour city sites tour and they went out of their way to help us. Good insight, some crazy pics. The girls are awesome and give a different insight of things as you travel along. A guide gives more formal information at each stop. Great way to start our Ho chi Minh trip and get a feel for the area. Beware that each stop is quite quick so you might need to go back later if you want to have a more on depth look. Highly recommended.

The best thing we did in Vietnam - We took the Saigon by night tour in December 2012 and had a great time. Our guides were very knowledgeable, spoke excellent English and were always ready for a laugh.

The tour took us away from the touristy areas and gave us a chance to see a little bit of the real Saigon.

This tour was hands down the best thing we did on this trip. Our only regret was not having enoigh time to book a second tour! I finished the tour with a huge smile on my face and keep smiling every time I think about it.

Still number one! - Thu and Huong deserve all the praise they can get. They did a fantastic job and safety is priority number one!

I recommend everyone to make this trip and it is a reason for all the great feedback!

Keep up the good work!

Xo motor bike tours vietnam - I can't say enough good things about the Ho Chi Minh foodie tour we did with xo tours. The tour leaders are funny and informative, the guides are excellent and the food was really good. The thing we also loved was how much of the city we got to see and I don't think we would have without this tour.

Foodie Funtastic! - It's difficult to write a review when it seems that others have said it all. There aren't enough superlatives to describe this amazing tour experience. THIS is THE way to see, feel, smell, touch and taste Saigon in one excellent four hour tour. My tour guide Thuong was not only a brilliant and careful motorcyclist, she was the best fun I've had in years. Take the advice that's given at the beginning and pace yourself! Also, although it's perfectly acceptable to decline dishes that are not to your taste, the whole point is to give you samples of the best street food available today. Don't have a second thought about safety on the road, or cleanliness of the kitchen - this is a very professionally run outfit and deserving of its honour as the number one tour in Ho Chi Minh City. What a brilliant and innovative idea that is executed so well. Eat, drink and get to know people. Thanks for a great night, Thuong!

Top tucker tour! - We did this tour as a family ( ages 21-24) and we all loved the experience.You get a real insight into Saigon how the locals live and the food they eat the different districts and we all ate food we would never normally attempt! The girls are great fun and their English is amazing.The tour was one of the high lights of our trip to Vietnam and we would all highly recommend doing it.The whole tour is very well organised from the booking to the girls picking you up to all the food being ready at the various stops also 2 of us didn't eat fish so alternatives were arranged all in all great tour with Top Tucker!!!

Wow good stuff - The foodie tour was really amazing. The food was plentiful and tasty, and reflected a side of Vietnamese cuisine beyond pho, banh mi, etc. I got to see a large portion of the city which I never would have on my own. Do this tour.

I always smile when I think back to our foodie tour! - This is a wonderful wonderful wonderful experience! Do yourself a favour and book a tour with XO tours. Everything is well organized, the food is delicious, the girls are so nice, And the owner Tung and other members of his male staff are present and around you all the time! We felt like VIPs and we had fun, we learnt about Saigon and the food and how to eat it. No time to loose, you will be very happy after the tour!

Come hungry - The reviews are accurate. This is a professional run, fun, filling tour. I got picked up at my hotel exactly on time and spent the next few hours riding between districts, having great conversations about everything from food to social standards to emigration with my driver, seeing beautiful night time sights, learning about Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnam as a whole from the guides, learning about the various foods, and eating. So much eating. My guide explains each item we were eating, from sourcing to preparing, and then preparing them for me - be that adding sauces, demonstrating shelling a prawn, or roasting skewers over a fire at the table. My drinks were included.
I had a blast, and I couldn't eat another bite at the end. Even though this was one of the more expensive things I did in Vietnam, it was also one of the best choices I made.

If you had to choose just 1 tour in Saigon this would be it - This tour is simply brilliant and completely throws you in the thick of Saigon life. All the girls look the part, are really nice and speak good English. I was paired with Ngan who was incredibly cheeky and a reall laugh. We went to five different districts and to areas where you would not go on your own, but in a group like this you sat in among the locals and it was truly incredible.

The trip was made extra special as Tung the founder of XO Tours came with us as the business was two years old today. Cake was served and a discount was given to everyone. Great work Tung you have something unique and all of your staff are brilliant, thank you.

Highly recommend, unique tour with exceptional service - good for families too - We visited and booked the foodie tour, had a fabulous time, 3 adults and 7 year old
