The lady drivers are excellent. It's a thrill, but felt safe the entire time. Visited some places with great food that likely would never find on your own.

The tour leaders reach the restaurants in advance, so everything was ready at each arrival. Thoroughly organized and exceptional service.

Best time of our trip - Wow, wow, wow. We did the foodie tour. It was absolutely stunning. We went with our 2kids (16 and 19) and this is the activity we prefered. The food was great and it was a fun way to visit Ho Chi Minh. Tip: don't eat lunch as there is so much food during the tour. We never been scared on the bike too, they are very nice ladies! Have fun and go for it!

Highlight of our trip - Taking you to outdoor eating outside the comfortable folds of District 1, this tour is the best I've been on. We were definitely taken to places we would never have been able to find ourselves and the food was so good that the Pho restaurants of District 1 seemed bland and conventional by comparison. The guides were charming and friendly and it was nice to be spoken to as a vitsitor rather than a tourist. It was also a great way to meet like-minded travelers willing to try something a little bit different. If your in HCMC and want to get out of Distinct one and eat some real food you have to go on this tour.

Great tour! Great fun! - I signed up for XO Tours based on the TA reviews, my love of adventure and trying something different. My husband had no idea what he agreed to, so he was very surprised and skeptical at first!

I appreciated the prompt pickup at the hotel by our lady motor cycle drivers a quick rundown of the proper way to ride the bike, helmets and off we went! Much to my husband’s disappointment, the first “meet the group” food stop didn’t come with beer, but the next three eating venues did and they kept the beer coming, so he was happy!

The young Vietnamese drivers were fluent in English and attempted to keep up a conversation while driving, but between their accent, the street noise, and my concern that I was distracting her from driving, I gave up on trying to listen to guiding information and responding to multiple conversational questions posed by her. Helmet mics might be helpful. I really enjoyed zooming through the streets from one district to another and seeing lots of sites. The food stops were fun, good, plentiful and we had explanations prior to digging in! Loved the food and no nasty after effects the next morning!

The only negative aspect for me was at each stop our group of 14 people had to sit in the same order, across the table from the same people, surrounded by our guides. We had a hard time conversing with the people we were grouped with and I would rather of had the opportunity to know some of the other group members, by mixing the group up. This may be because XO Tours took lots of pictures, which will be sent to us at a later date and they needed to keep people straight! Other than that one small complaint, it was really fun and my normally non adventurous husband really enjoyed himself!

My only suggestion….wish there was some information on their web site regarding tipping…I know it’s a “personal” matter and that tipping in Vietnam isn’t common, but these ladies work very hard at helping you to have a great time thus I did tip, but was really unsure what’s appropriate. There is also a “guide” for the group who explains some of the sites and lots about the food…wondering if he should be tipped??? The tour is “all inclusive” so other than tipping we didn’t pay a penny more, but I think other tourists would appreciate knowing what a proper amount is, should they choose to tip or knowing that a percentage of the profits goes to the lady drivers above their normal salary as a tip.

Do book early as they fill up quickly! Mr Tung Do is very good about answering emails and explained that if you pay ahead, it’s totally refundable if cancelled within a reasonable amount of time. Great tour! It's very well run, professional and great fun!

XO Foodie Tour is way beyond fabulous!!! - My wife and I did this tour in early December 2012. We were totally immersed into the culture and food of this enchanting city in a 5 hour period that seemed like 5 minutes. All the words of praise every written in these reviews can't begin to do justice to what you will feel with this experience. If you will be in HCMC, DO NOT CHEAT YOURSELF BY MISSING THIS EXPERIENCE!!!!!!

Best fun ever!! - We had an absolutely amazing time on the Foodie tour with Ben, Tai and my lovely guide Milky Way! My friend and I are both 20 and found this to be a great way to mingle with other travelers and locals, and sample some delicious local food.

We felt super safe at all times, the girls know exactly what they're doing on the bike and only travel at a certain speed so we always felt very comfortable - it was great to travel as the locals do!

You will have the chance to try some delicious foods! Come with an open mind as there's foods like (spoiler alert!) quail, frog, clams, balut egg, squid, goat, prawns, crabs and so much more! All absolutely delicious! The girls cleaned everything that had a shell and the food was unlimited. Maybe skip on lunch to fit it all in.

Ben is absolutely hilarious, Tai a legend, the whole team is very personable and you can tell that the whole night has been planned to go off without a hitch. We were never waiting around for food to arrive, it seemed to come to the table as soon as we got there. Ben was always giving interesting bits of info, as was Milky Way as we drove along.

I honestly can't recommend the foodie tour and XO enough. Everything from initially booking the tour with Tung right through to the night and then being emailed the photos that ben had taken during the tour was done promptly and professionally. A well run company and an amazing experience... :-)

Thank-you guys so much!

Best in HCMC - We (6 adults ages 42 to 75) took "The Foodie" and "City Sights" XO tours, in mid-November 2012. It was the highlight of my 3 week tour of Vietnam, Cambodia, and Thailand. The guide and the beautiful young ladies were delightful, informative, and charming. Motor scooters are the main mode of getting around in the country and XO was an excellent way to experience buzzing around the city without actually having to do the driving. Having a personal driver/hostess was an extra bonus as it provided the opportunity to find out about life in Vietnam (my driver was a University student majoring in Economics). If you want a fun, delicious, and rewarding introduction to the big city in Vietnam, sign up for the XO tours!

My Second Experience with XO Tours - Excellent! - I first tried XO Tours Foodie Tour one year ago while visiting HCMC in December 2011 and absolutely loved it. I returned to HCMC this year with my son and had to do it again. We had a wonderful time - the young ladies were excellent drivers and guides, there was great conversation with the other participants and our guides, the sights were fascinating as we traveled through HCMC at night, and of course the food was excellent. Tung Do has created a simply outstanding experience for those who want to do something a little different. Everyone is completely professional and XO Tours delivers on everything they promise, and more. I don't see how you could ask for any more. When I return to HCMC next year I plan to call XO Tours again! This is truly a 5-star operation. Highly recommended.

Awesome!! - This was probably the best organized tour my wife and I have ever done. We were picked up at our hotel, given helmets, and driven on the back of a bike to meet the main guide at the historic post office. We also visited the Notre Dame cathedral, turtle pagoda, a few places where famous photos were taken, and to a market where we were treated to 2 delicious Vietnamese desserts.

All along, the girls were wonderful to talk to and the guide was super informative and speaks perfect English. We learned so many interesting facts that we never could have known visiting on our own. The traffic in HCMC is intimidating, but the bikes don't really go that fast and you always feel safe. Oh, and a few days later, they send you free copies of all the photos they took during the day. I highly recommend this tour!!

Very fun first night in Vietnam ! - We found this tour on trip-advisor and decided to do the foodie tour the first night we got to Vietnam! It turned out to be a great idea, it is a good way to explore the city and get to know Vietnamese cuisine. The drivers (girls) are very nice, have decent english and knowledge about the city. They took us to 3 local restaurants and we experienced lots of different kinds of vietnamese Food. Make sure you are hungry, it really is a lot of delicious food ! The tour takes about 4-5 hours and we spent most of it driving around different districts of Saigon. Although we would recommend this to everyone, make sure you have a proper insurance, because to be fair, it is not the safest sightseeing tour of HCMC.

A tour that get's under the skin of Saigon!! - We booked two bike tours with XO and both were exceptional!! The best way to see all the sights in the city (morning) as not only is there an informative explanation of them upon arrival but our riders were very fluent in providing information along the way.
Speaking of the riders, they are exceptionally friendly and very skillful. At no time did we feel unsafe. In fact, we requested the same riders for the evening 'foodie' tour and they were happy to oblige. Very competent with speaking the English language, there was no shortage of conversation and laughs along the way!! They really made both tours very special.
Now, it's clear why the 'foodie' tour is their most popular!! OMG, we were so stuffed by the end of the evening. We went to five districts of Saigon and to places where only the Vietnamese go!! The food, company and service were amazing.
I can't speak highly enough of this company, a truly special memory of Saigon!!

Most fun on two wheels in Saigon. - I have been considering using XO tours since I first heard about them a few years back. I only took the plunge after a mate of mine did a tour and highly recommended it. After experiencing a tour first hand my first thought was why didn't I do this sooner?? :DI really have new appreciation for how the locals get around and how smoothly traffic runs with all of those scooters/motorbikes running the street. It looks very crazy, but having traveled first hand on one I now know it all works beautifully.

I did my initial inquiries with Tung – the owner of XO Tours and he couldn't be more responsive to emails and he is very friendly to boot. He explained the tours and answered every question I had so I booked the Night Foodie Tour, priced at $65. Tung was in constant contact and confirmed the day I chose and time the driver will be there to pick me up. He also explained I will pay the driver the tour price at the end of the night. I also added the HD video option which is another $25.

All of the motorbike guides are female and they wear traditional Vietnamese outfits (Ao Dai) as they are taking you place to place. There is one rule and that is do not hold on to the guide as you are scooting around Saigon at night. Not big deals since you have the back of the seat to hold on to and in time you will be comfortable enough to not need anything to hold.

The night arrived and Anh (driver) was at my hotel early. She was extremely friendly and personable guide who in all honesty was a pure delight to get to know. We walked out to the motorbike and she gave safety tips, prevent from being burned, fitted helmet and general dos/don'ts. Then we scooted off to our first stop where we met Tung who personally chatted with each client. He made small chat and basically told us he would be with us the entire night giving us various tidbits of information about the various places we would stop. There were 3 food stops that we made as we were driving around the various districts of Saigon. We also managed to stop a few other times for Tung to highlight a part of Saigon that he thought we would find interesting and also take photos with our drivers.

The food stops - well let's put it this way you better come with an empty stomach because the food keeps coming and coming. The types of food as Tung explained are out of the ordinary Vietnamese cuisine. He didn't want to give us food we could get back home at a Vietnamese restaurant. First stop was a unique noodle soup stand, next was a traditional BBQ spot serving squid, shrimp, goat ect. The last stop we were treated to clams, squab, frogs legs, crab and Viet Balut. (baby duck embryo) Then for dessert we were treated to coconut jelly. Oh and every stop you were served as much lager as you wanted. The only caveat is that you are not legless that you fall from the motorbike. :D There was also a competition - drop the cashew in the bottle. Basically using chopsticks you are passed a cashew from your driver and must drop in bottle. Winner gets the title of champion. (bragging rights)

XO also offers a HD video service where they film you while we are riding around the streets of Saigon, and at the various locations either eating or using still shots. The great part about this service is that they will mix in music that you pick or bring specifically for this purpose. The video editing is really wicked. The 10 min video costs around $25, but its well worth it because they really do a wicked job editing and the memories produced are well represented.

If you do a tour in Saigon you should choose any of the XO Tours and make sure you go. The guides are top notch because they know how to have fun and show you the city. I am happy to say the guides are very friendly and they take care of you. You actually learn heaps from them while chatting on the way to each stop about their lives and Saigon in general. I know personally I have gained a good friend which gives the tour extra special meaning.

In summary GO GO GO and make sure you don't hesitate to book a tour early since XO Tours are quite popular!!!!!!! Congrats to Tung for having a great tour company and a lovely guide like Anh.

Western efficiency with Vietnamese hospitality and charm! - Best tour of its kind in SE Asia right now! The girls and the rest of the team that are on the motorbike run are brilliant. TIP: Go for the foodie in the evening, it's seafood heaven and a great way to see some districts and spots you would never see otherwise.

best local tours we ever had - We joined both the foodie tour as well as the sight tour. Our guides are fluent in English, very friendly and informative. Being on a motorbike with a guide, we managed to go about in leisure as well as thru all the local streets with ease.
The tours were well organized, We felt safe.
The best thing was to try all the local food with our guides explaining all the details.
If I were to visit Ho Chi Minh City again, I definitely would sign up for the XO foodie tour again.

Extraordinary experience - From our point of view an absolute MUST DO for anyone visiting Saigon. We did "The Sights" tour Dec 14th, 2012. Driving through the city with excellent, experienced drivers on the back of a motorbike: Feeling like a local. Getting lots of interesting information and in-depth insights into Vietnamese life - thanks to our tourmanager Ben (!); we saw places we would not have found by ourselves.

A fantastic way to see parts of Saigon, you won't see on your own. - We saw XO Saigon motorbike tours on here and the idea really appealed. The riders turned up well on time and were really friendly and amusing. You could tell they truly liked their jobs. They took us to areas of Saigon the usual "tourist mini bus tours" don't go to. They explained about each area and kept it interesting. We went to a couple of street stalls to pick up some authentic local food. I strongly recommend to BBQ pork chop with broken rice. Absolutely delicious! The whole experience was fun, safe and never boring or awkward. A must for Ho Chi Minh sight seeing.

The only way to enjoy HCM City - As manic as traffic is in HCM City with all of the motorbikes, trucks, and buses trying to intimidate each other to take the lead (and many ignoring any traffic signal), the only way to really enjoy the sites of the place is to jump on the back of a motorbike and join them. XO Tours is the originator (from my understanding) of the back-of-female-driven-motorbike tour and in my eyes, the best. You have your choice of a number of tours, the sights tour, the shopping spree tour, and the foodie tour. I had planned to go on all three but was only able to make the first two (long story, but I was staying about 40 minutes away from HCMC and driver I had arranged to bring me to HCMC bailed at the last minute). The next time I go I'll definitely do the foodie tour. Bring a backpack to hold your things (especially if you go on the shopping spree tour) and bring a means to take digital movies. Any jitters that you might have will disappear in seconds once you get started and you'll see that it's easy to hold on with one hand while you use the other to film the mania that is Asian traffic.

fascinating - I have to admit that I was quite apprehensive about riding on a motor bike in the midst of the chaotic traffic here. My husband was very keen and I agreed to go but wasn't convinced I'd enjoy it. Anyway from the moment the two girls picked us up from our hotel, I immediately felt more at ease with the whole prospect. They were friendly and charming and my driver assured me that she was safe and experienced with this unbelievable traffic. She personally owns two of the 7 million (according to her) motor cycles in the city. We did the sights tour and our first stop was the Post Office where we met Ben our tour guide. What a gem. He is very knowledgable and imparts his knowledge with a real sense of humor making it all very entertaining. All up we stopped at six different sights including a market where we got to try two very refreshing desserts. So much fun and something we'll always remember. A definite highlight of our trip.

Foodie fun - Brilliant - really enjoyed the scooters around Saigon, and it isn't as heart stopping and reckless as it looks (if you have mastered crossing the road you will be fine). Guides are lovely and the food good.

Do yourself a favor! - Last night we went on the Foodie Tour offered by XO. This has been our highlight experience of our trip so far!

We were so impressed by the professionalism of this tour company. Our chaperones Huong and Tauy picked us up from our hotel and took us to meet tour manager Ben at our first stop. Both Ben and the women spoke impeccable English and were so knowledgeable and friendly. They all also had a sense of humor which really contributed to our enjoyment of the night.

Not only did the tour take us on a number of food stops but also other locations to give us background and knowledge of local Vietnamese culture and communities. The food was absolutely amazing and we would recommend that you go on the tour as hungry as possible! There was sooo much food and we didn't want to stop eating! To get the best experience we would recommend stepping outside of your comfort zone and be prepared to try things that don't appear in Western cuisine, we did and don't regret it!

For $65 AUD this tour is worth every cent! A must do activity in Ho Chi Minh! We wish we could do it again!

Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City - What a fantastic way to see a part of the city that is literally on the move. With over 7 million motor cycles, not for the faint hearted, but just don't look. The female drivers are chosen for a reason - they are SAFE. Try it, get out of the comfort zone and have a blast. They take you to some of the sights, Notre Dame, The Post Office, Reunification Palace, The Jade Pagoda and a non commercial, fascinating market, which would otherwise take a long time to see on foot or taxi. The girls are courteous and charming and Ben is knowledgeable and professional. It's fun!!!!

Book before being too late - Population of Saigon is more than 10 million people, and every two people have one motorbike, it means there are over 5 million motorbikes in this city. Now you book a tour on “two wheels”, put your life into a strange female driver, and zip into the chaos of traffic in Saigon to see traffic waving around you. “Is it easy for you to decide to book this motorbike tour while the motorbike accident rate in Vietnam is so high?”. It is not easy for you and for me to decide, but when I looked at the excellent reviews through the Tripadvisor, I thought I must try.
My female driver is also my tour guide. She is young, friendly and very good at speaking English as well as having excellent local knowledge. As all the previous reviews mentioned about the tour with its contract between district 1 and other ones, daily night time and amazing street food… All I want to say is just in a word: “Perfection”

Ho Chi Minh Foodie tour - Fantastic - This is a great way to see the real Saigon in a completely different way. Firstly you are picked up by your beautiful hostess, we had Thuy and Thu, both very friendly, funny and knowledgeable and then taking to the meeting point for the night.
Our tour manager Ben kept everything moving, with his humour his easy going nature as well as helping understand more about the heartbeat of Saigon.
Do yourself a favor, take the foodie tour and see things you won't see hanging around district 1.
By the way you also get chaffeured around on the back of a moto for 4.5 hours amongst the flow of the Saigon traffic.

Jason D, Sydney Australia

Put it at the top of your list... - If you're like me then you're sitting at your computer and thinking, 'This can't be true'. This is the best rated item I have seen on Trip Advisor and after surmising that 500 reviewers couldn't be wrong I booked my husband and I on the Foddie tour. And I can tell you after being on the tour XO and the girls are truly deserving of all their accolades. The company takes great pride in being very organized and professional -which can be difficult to find in tour companies throughout Asia.

The whole process was seamless and the girls were so friendly and very safe drivers. Ben is very knowledgeable about the area and had some really interesting information to share that gave a tourist a true inside into Vietnamese food, culture and future. I won't say too much about the tour as I think it is best for the individual to experience. Initially, we were a little apprehensive about price at $65 per person but as the say goes, 'You get what you pay for' and this tour was one of the best things we did on our 3 months traveling through Asia. You won't regret it.

Must do!!! - My wife Michelle found this unique way of experiencing Ho Chi Minh city by reading a trip advisor review. We hoped that our experience would live up to the great reviews. I'd safely say our expectations were exceeded. We did a city night tour but we met up with a large number of tourists doing the food tour (very popular). Our girls arrived at our hotel before the scheduled time and after a brief introduction and rundown we joined the busy street traffic. Michelle was a little nervous to start with but soon was confident enough to snap off a few photo's as we cruised the streets. We met up with the owner of the business Tung (and the others doing the food tour) near the Chinatown wholesale market. He explained where the girls would take us, organized our meal order, we said goodbye to the others and off we went. The girls were telling us about the places we were traveling through and answering our questions, all while expertly manoeuvring safely through the busy street traffic. We stopped at a local roadside eating area where Tung again caught up with us to eat and he and the girls taught us some local phases. We continued on through other Districts - it's a city of great variance, before Tung again caught up with us. He seems to spend the night criss-crossing the city ensuring that his patrons we being well looked after. We were but appreciated his enthusiasm which is shared by his riders. We were safely returned to our hotel with additional confidence to push further out into the city exploring the next day. The bikes are the only way to travel, the tour was fantastic and we have been telling all our friends that when in HCMC it is a must do.

Laugh a minute!! - Should have posted way earlier but having PC probs.Me and hubby went on "Siagon by Night" in early Oct with 2 great girls and Tung the owner of the company.We were still a bit jet lagged & hungover but had the best time.The girls (sorry forgot your names) were a right laugh and had some great chats as we rode through the streets.You don't just get the normal tourist talk they talked about day to day life for the people of Ho Chi Min .Tung was always at hand to tel us about the different areas we visited for the official talk and also to talk to hubby about his beautiful restored bike he had.We were a bit nervous of eating street food until we went out with Tung and the girls and after this we couldn't get enough!!Thank you so much the trip with you guys was superb and I can't recommend it enough !!!

Fantastic Tour - We went on 'The Sights' tour and can't say enough good things about it. The girls arrived in ample time to collect us from our hotel on new and modern scooters and were so friendly, knowledgeable and approachable they made the trip a pleasure. Nothing was too much for them.

It was my husband's first time on a bike but despite the chaotic traffic we felt so safe as the girls were very competent drivers and really seemed to love what they did.
We were driving around the city, stopping at the main places of interest as well as some hidden gems, off the beaten track. Once there we were joined by Tung, the owner, who provided us with the history as well as an insight into what it's like to live in the city. He was brought up in America so speaks perfect English and like the girls he is so knowledgeable and friendly.

We would recommend that you do this on one of your first days in the city as it helps to get your bearings and gives you a fantastic insight into what is worth seeing and doing.

Our only regret and it's a big one, is that we didn't have time to go on 'The Foodie Tour'
XO Tours thoroughly deserve their top ranking!!!!

The food, the conversation, the camaraderie! These are enough to convince one to get on the back of a motorbike! - It was definitely the highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh and will always be my most cherished memory of our 5-day stay there. I'm such a foodie, and you'd always find me at the head of the line trying out food delicacies of whatever city or country I'm visiting. And the tour definitely brought me to places with so much amazing street food that definitely satisfied my tummy and with such colorful history as told to us by Sir Tung that satisfied my curiosity about the city.

If ever I visit HCMC again, I'd definitely get myself another spot on XO Tours' Foodie Tour.

Sweet and fun - The girls operating the scooters are talkative and nice. Riding on the back of a scooter through the controlled chaos of Saigon motorbike traffic is not for the faint of heart, but it was the most fun I had during my brief visit. Ben Chua, our tour manager, did a very nice job guiding us to the main tourist sites of Saigon's district one. Very interesting and informative.

A Magical Night in HCMC - It was our last night in Vietnam and we wanted to go out with a blast. I'm usually skeptical about tours, but with so many great reviews there was no way we were going to miss out on the foodie tour. In the end, I wish I could give XO higher than a five.

We were picked up from our hotel by our excellent guides Ngan and Uyen. Then off we went into the dense evening traffic. I feel like you don't become part of HCMC until you can calmly walk into the middle of traffic and can ride on a motorbike without closing your eyes. In the capable hands of our guides, we soon felt like doing tricks on the backs of those bikes.

They zipped us across town for food, history and a glimpse of how the true locals live. There are no fancy restaurants that appeal to the average tourist. You're getting out there for some amazing street food. As the sun sets on this great city, you get to experience something special that you'd never see if you stayed on top of the Rex.

From booking the excursion with Tung to getting great information from Ben on the tour, things were organized and run with the upmost professionalism, but without skimping on the fun. Again, I can't say enough good things about Ngan and Uyen. It was wonderful getting to hear there stories and walking away from the evening with two new friends.

We're looking forward to a trip back to HCMC and another foodie tour with XO Tours!

Wow! What a great tour - We recently went on the foodie tour with xo tours. We were greeted by 2 female drivers who were picking both of us up from our hotel. And let me tell you, from the moment we got on those bikes we laughed, smiled and had one of the most memorable times within our holiday.
The two women took us to our first street food stop and we were greeted by Ben, who was our official tour guide. He had such a wealth of knowledge about not only the food we were eating but about the history and the different areas we visited. Although the food was wonderful and one of the best we had tasted in Vietnam, the tour was more than just about the food. It was about Saigon! As we got taken around we stopped around different districts of Saigon we wouldn't have otherwise gone to.
Ben and our scooter riders were great company through the evening, i cant remember the last time we had so much fun.
At first i was a bit nervous going on the back of a scooter, having read how high the motorbike accident rate is in Vietnam but our drivers made us feel at ease and safe. I also made a dietary request of no gluten within my meals and they honored this throughout the night. On our first stop, I had a completely different dish to my fellow tour comrades but Ben took care in explaining to me personally the aspects of the dish.
This is the must do tour within Vietnam, we will certainly be booking again when we revisit.
Thank you XO Tours for such a memorable, fantastic and fun evening we wont forget!!

Awesome Night Foodie Tour! - We had a great time on tour foodie tour. The tour guides were wonderful. The female drivers were fun, educated, and helpful. They have really thought of everything with this tour. We loved everything about it. Tip: Bring a small hand held camera with a strap. We had an expensive camera with us and someone tried to steal it off of my husband while he was on the back of the motor bike. Leave your big camera at home... not needed as they shoot great photo's of you and send them to you a couple days after your trip! One of the highlights of our trip!

Awesome Tour A Must Do - It's not hard to see why this tour is number one on things to do in Ho Chi Minh what an awesome tour. My husband & I did the foodies tour & were a little bit weary about eating street food, every little bit of food was fantastic we tried things that we would not normally eat and the best part no stomach problems. Ben & the girls were absolutely fantastic, we visited 5 different districts & the whole time the girls & Ben are constantly informing you of the area & the food you are eating. This tour is a must if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Wonderful way to see Saigon - I read about these tours and decided it would be a great way to see Saigon. When we arrived in the city and saw the traffic, 7 million motorbikes and all seemed doubting to be on the streets at the same time, I have to admit we hads. Motorbikes drive up and down the pavements, go straight over junctions and just seem, well, totally uncontrolled. We are both over 60 but fit and active so thought we would take the chance. The experience was fantastic, we had two charming students driving us very competently around although at a few junctions we just didn't look!!!! Every so often we stopped and met a guide who gave us a very good understanding of the history of the city. I would really recommend this tour, great experience, great people and a great feeling of exhilaration. Try it!!!!!!!!!!

Great Time (Foodie Tour) - My wife and I had a lot of fun on the Foodie tour on Nov 23rd. Our drivers were really nice and gave us a lot of interesting information about the city that we wouldn't have gotten elsewhere. The food was excellent, and I liked that the option to be more adventurous with eating options was available but those who wanted to stick to more mainstream meals could do that as well. The best part may have been just talking to the drivers and our guide throughout the night and getting a better feel for how the typical Vietnamese student/young worker lives and what they want to do in the future---Very cool experience

An absolute blast..! - We chose for the foodie tour and we can't rave enough of about this tour. The female drivers/tour guides were entertaining, courteous and fun. They take care of yourself at every second. They're your chauffer, chef and entertainment coordinator all in one. We highly recommend this tour company!

The highlight of our Saigon trip! - My sister and I really really enjoyed the Foodie tour. It was my first time to ride a motorbike but our tour guides were very good drivers, our fears disappeared in an instant. Foods were great, drivers/tour guides were amazing.Tung, owner, was very helpful and accommodating, he patiently answered all our email queries Definitely the highlight of our Saigon trip!

A must-do tour! - We did the Foodie tour on our first night in Vietnam. We had made a previous visit to Southeast Asia and were very intimidated by the street food - where do we go, what in the world is it? - but really wanted to try more of it this trip. I was apprehensive about being on the back of a motorbike, but the women were great drivers and I quickly felt much more comfortable. We were able to chat a lot during the ride with our respective guides, who were wonderful and very entertaining. The tour visited five different districts, stopping several times for different foods or information about the neighborhoods. We felt like we learned a lot about Saigon that we wouldn't have otherwise. Everything that we ate was delicious and we tried a wide variety of items, both tame and adventurous. Make sure to pace yourself - I was completely stuffed by the end. Drinks (including beer) were included.
We didn't choose the video option thinking we weren't really interested in a video of ourselves. After the trip I wished we had gotten it just for the scenery we saw on the way - the traffic, the markets, the local neighborhoods. They do email pictures taken during the tour to you afterwards.
At the end of our three week trip full of great experiences, this was definitely at the top of the list of our favorites!

Incredible experience - I really do not know where to start to describe the fantastic experience I had with XO Tours without it sounding like plagiarism, as I am sure the same things have been said in many different ways by many people prior to my review.

Given that we had only a short period of time in Saigon, I wanted to quickly get a feel of the place and an understanding of where things are located throughout the city; so what better way to do this, thought I, than on the back of a bike. Therefore I booked two tours with XO: The Sights and, for later in the day, The Foodie. I made the bookings on the XO website, paid using PayPal, and refined the arrangements for the tours with Tung (the owner of XO Tours) who delivers a masterpiece in customer service, dealing with any questions I had, including a special request I made for my wife, without fuss, clearly explaining what was going to happen in terms of logistics. We were picked up from our Hotel right on time at 0900 by our two very pretty girl riders, looking very smart dressed in their Ao Dai, and after a quick briefing we were off. At this stage I have to confess to a little bit of apprehension prior to setting off as I am more used to riding a motorbike than being a pillion passenger, but within a couple of minutes on the back of the bike, my fears evaporated and I just relaxed and enjoyed the ride and the conversation. These girls are extremely competent riders which is not only a testament to the girls but also to the skilful management of the company in terms of selecting the right people. I also booked the video option, so we were joined by another bike complete with rider and cameraman who followed us around throughout the tour. On arrival at the first destination, we were introduced to the rest of the folks on the tour and to Ben, the tour manager, who proved to possess an encyclopaedic knowledge of Saigon and an uncanny ability to remember people’s names. I will not list the places we visited during the day, but I will say that it was more than thorough enough to achieve my objective of orientation, and more. The tour ended with us being taken back to the hotel after the morning tour just in time for lunch.

We were picked up again for The Foodie tour at 5.30pm by two different girls, equally bright, attractive, and competent, together with the video bike, and taken off to enjoy the various culinary experiences lined up by XO which started a local restaurant well off the tourist trail where we again met with the omnipresent Ben and his incredible memory. The tour continued to several other districts and restaurants, though markets, residential and shopping areas - with interesting narrative being provided by the girls on the way, and by Ben at some of the key locations where we stopped. We were certainly looked after throughout the whole evening; this even extended to peeling the shells off the seafood we were given and to ensure that enough beer was provided to keep the conversation among our fellow XO tourists well lubricated. Although the bias is towards seafood, there is enough of a variety for those having an aversion to crustaceans, such as my wife, so do not let that put you off. As with the morning tour, we were dropped back off at our hotel by the girls.

In summary: both of the tours more than exceeded our already high expectations. We both had a wonderful time, we would not hesitate to book either of the tours again, and I have no reservations about giving an unconditional recommendation to XO tours. Thank you girls, video guys, Ben and Tung for making the whole experience such a memorable one.

first Rate - I took the Saigon tour in the morning and liked it so much that I asked the owner, Tung, if there was room on that evening's Foodie tour. It was full, but he made a spot for me anyway. Tung is extremely knowledgeable about HCMC and provides some very interesting history. As I took two tours, I had two drivers. Both were extremely competent, safe and delightful young women.

I highly recommend both tours as a way to explore HCMC and its food.

when you are in saigon, do as the saigon does... - Great night touring HCMC by bike. We've seen the hoards of scooters in the city when crossing the street, now we get to see it from the other perspective. That was really one of the best parts. Exciting, but completely safe.
The food was great. It was fun to have an explanation of all of the different issues. Even when you try to go to the 'local' establishments yourself, you don't get the same variety and information on the dishes. This was a great way to do it with the locals.
And the guides were great as well. Fun, young, and very attentive. It was great to talk to them during the meals and find out a bit more about them. That was a great unexpected highlight as well.
Overall, a bit pricey, but definitely worth it as it was a great experience.

Not To Be Missed! - If you're a first-time visitor to HCMC (Saigon) then treat yourself to a first-class, and fun, tour with XO Tours.

The owner, Trung, is a personable and knowledgable young man, raised in the States, who returned to his home country to create a unique tourist business: Lovely women - chosen for their friendly personalities, English proficiency, driving skills, and love for their City - whisk you safely around town aboard a scooter which, in this town's crazy traffic, makes getting to your tour stops most of the fun.

We booked the "Sights Tour" and in two and a half fun-filled hours we got a great sense of, and introduction to, the City, it's history, and the people.

We were treated like friends, not tourists, and the sincere smiles of our drivers were alone worth the incredibly cheap price of $35 per person for the tour.

In a world of dull tour promoters and vacation rip-off artists, XO Tours stands out to restore one's faith that quality travel service can still be delivered by caring, friendly people. Our only regret is that we didn't have time to book an additional "Night" or "Foodie" tour.

I realize this review might strike some as over-the-top, but that is EXACTLY what we received: An over-the-top experience that we will never forget. Nice going, XO!

A must-do and experience. - We booked both the food and shopping tours for our first day in HCM City and so happy we did. Tai asked me what I would like to buy, took my list and worked out a route to the shops we needed to explore to purchase my items. My female driver was friendly and full of local information. We visited a local market, supermarket, cosmetics shop and an Optus shop, picking up everything on my list and they even shouted me to a fruit drink at the markets.
The food tour was the highlight of our stay in HCM City. We learned more about the Vietnamese culture in five hours riding across the city to our foody destinations than we would with two weeks of bus tours. The food was amazing and abundant.Your need to pace yourself or towards the end you will find it hard to consume the best dishes on offer.
Our only suggestions not criticisms would be that stools not little chairs should be supplied to tall heavy people as my husband found it difficult to get in and out of the chairs and got stuck once. Also, as a memento of the experience a printed list of the places we visited, with the dishes we ate, the Vietnamese name with an English version of how to pronounce the dishes so we could order them at a later date. However, the whole experience we have rated as highly recommended and to be done in the first couple of days after arriving in the city.
A big thank you to Ben our Tour Manager, Tai our Tour leader, and our friendly and safe drivers
Chi and Trang for an unforgettable night.

Glenda (XO chopstick champion) & Warren

Nothing short of brilliant! - Went on the foodies tour and was a little bit skeptical as to what to expect but the tour was brilliant. It was the perfect balance of information and food (and good food at that too!) My driver was brilliant to chat to and even though they didn't know where my apartment was in D5, she went out of her way to find out where it is and drove me back, albeit getting lost but it was just like an extended tour. Was a brilliant tour and I will be recommending it to my friends that will be coming to HCMC later as a must do.

Great fun - We did this on our second night in Ho Chi Minh. After a mix up with our hotel address the guides found us and we were on our way. The food was great the guides we wonderful and we had a great time. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Thrilling and delicious - Lives up to all the reviews. Absolutely brilliant way to get into the action of HCMC. Organization was great - like clockwork. Felt completely safe in the hands of our brilliant pilots. We did the foodie tour and the food was amazing. Was brilliant to eat at places where tourists don't usually go.

If you are in HCMC you must try this!

Saigon Lesson from A Bike - I normally don't do tours thing. But exploring Saigon with XO Tours was the best decision I made on my first time ever visit here. From super friendly cheerful guide name Binh who absolutely remarkable to Ben and his team members who gave outstanding information that most people don't know. I even get lucky to met a 85 y.0 man who works at the central post office since he was 17 yo as the letter translator from english/french to vietnamese. Cathedral, Central Post Office, Reunification Museum, Traditional Market, Jade Pagoda, ex CIA building.. Yep,I've seen Saigon Now and Then from a motorbike. Superb!

What a fantastic introduction to Vietnam – and such a fun night! - After reading the reviews we decided to book 2 of the XO tours. The first one being the ‘Foodie Tour’ on our first night in Ho Chi Minh and the second the following morning was the ‘Shopping Spree’ Tour (we had wanted to book the ‘The Sights’ Tour however that was full). We were really glad we picked these tours at the beginning of our time in Vietnam, as it provided a great introduction to the place.
The Foodie Tour was really enjoyable, even though I was initially worried about the type of food that could be on offer and being on a ‘moto’ in the crazy traffic, I soon started to relax about both! The guides are knowledgeable with good English and very skillfull at handling the ‘motos’ in the busy traffic.
I had a dietary requirement that I may not have especially mentioned except that Tung asked if we had any food allergies or things we can’t eat when making the booking. I wasn’t expecting any special food to be provided as I thought I would just eat what I could of what was on offer. To my surprise I could eat more of the food than I expected plus there was some extra dishes (or dishes in place of something the rest of the group was eating) especially prepared for me that were very tasty.
This tour was so much fun (group size is ~ 10) and we got to see another side of Ho Chi Minh by getting out of the main tourist area to visit other districts and try some different food. So you learn a bit about the district you visit in addition to the food. The food is specially chosen as food that you would not commonly find easily in the tourist areas.

I thoroughly recommend the Foodie tour and booking video of the night, which I thought would be a general one for the whole group but turns out to be your own personalised video (camera follows you around), which is really great to look back on when you get home (you can also request what music you want added to the final edit (video is approx. 10 mins)).
As a bonus everyone gets a few photos of the tour emailed a few days later.

For the ‘Shopping Spree’ tour I didn’t realise that it’s a private tour rather than a group tour. This is great because XO Tours will tailor the tour to the types of things you are interested in buying, so be prepared and have some things in mind you want to shop for! I was curious as to how the shopping would be carried but that was all looked after by our guide (on a separate moto), who carried it for us. Our guide hunted down particular places we wanted to visit.
Both tours we were picked up directly out the front of our hotel.

Please note, that if you are interested in the tours I would try to book more than a week in advance if possible. The Foodie Tour we managed to get the last 2 places on and were lucky to get the video booked too (both tours were booked with less than one week’s notice).

Great Tour - Not usually one for tours, but this was excellent.

Plenty of information about HCM and Vietnam along with all the food.

Highly recommended!

The only way to see HCMC - Having seen the 5* reviews we thought we'd take the plunge into riding the streets of HCMC and we're so glad we did! Our chauffeurs/tour guides were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable and made the entire experience. We did the foodie tour and had some of the best food on our entire trip to Vietnam - the last stop is in a "ropier" part of town but the Scallops were the best I'd ever tasted! All in all, a fantastic trip, and well worth the price.

Top things to do in HCMC! - What a fantastic evening - very professional, guides were great fun, food was fantastic and overall one of the top 3 things to do when in Vietnam!
If you love food, culture and something of the beaten (touristy) track you should book this - very easy via email .
Also the fact that they follow up after the trip with feedback and photos!

Best tour we did in Vietnam - just a note to thank the girls and ben from xo tours, we traveled from saigon to hanoi and spent time at many destinations in between ,but for six aussies the xo tour was the most memorable .

if you visit saigon dont miss out on this great experience

the girls were fantastic
this will be the first thing we book when we travel to Vietnam next

This tour is so worth it!! We had so much fun!! - This is a well thought out, well planned night out. Its the best way to experience Ho Chi Minh - The food, the city, the people. The guides are friendly, funny and outgoing and they really make this tour such fun.

Magnificent experience - We had a night tour of Saigon with XO tours. Its a really fun experience, and you will see parts of the city that you simply don't get to see normally, because you simply don't know they are there.
The city is divided into districts, and one of them (District 4 I think), is where the ex pats live. Its like being back in a London. Then you go to a really poor distict, where they don't stop, as it is not safe to do so. But you see the comparison. The tour stops at one place for an evening snack, and if you are veggy, like us, then they also cater for that. Being on the back of the bike is a fun experience, and the girls are excellent drivers, so you never feel unsafe. They are also really very pretty. A definite bonus for guys.

If you do the city, then do XO tours - You won't regret it.

THE best tour group, real talk. - I did the "Saigon by Night" tour, and I couldn't be more pleased. Such an amazing way to see Saigon. It's one thing to watch the millions of scooters swarming round the roads like bees, but to BE one of those bees is an entirely different experience! A little scary at first but the tours guides are excellent drivers and have you at ease in no time.
The drivers are all beautiful local girls, speak fluent English and are really friendly.
For a small fee you can also get a video taken of your experience, which they edit up and send you a link to download.
If you're looking for a great way to see Saigon, this tour isn't to be missed!

lots of fun - We did the foodie tour with xo tours in october. I had a great night. The tour guides were lovely, very chatty and friendly. The food was great, really interesting and not just the standard Vietnamese food. The tour around the city was fantastic, we saw lots of other districts that we wouldn't have seen on our own. We felt very safe and well cared for.

Absolutely Brilliant - We did the sightseeing tour and it was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

The girls were fantastic, on time for our pick up, explained everything and we were on our way. Terrified for the first minute in the Ho Chi Minh traffic but after that we had no fear and the experience was fantastic.

We were a family of four adults and there were no others on our tour.

They took us to all the sights we wanted and many others.

The girls all spoke good English. At each stop we were also met by Tung the organizer who explained in good detail about all the places we went and was our personal guide at each stop. We learned so much local knowledge that we would have never had if we had not done this tour.

A waring, as soon as we finished we tried to book some of their other tours but they were all booked out for the time we had in Saigon. So make sure you book early. They were also very easy to communicate with and very prompt in replies via email.

Awesome - Without a doubt this is a must do while in Ho Chi Minh. Very well organized and the girls are terrific. Felt totally at ease on the back of the scooter as we weaved our way through parts of the city that are amazing. Food is amazing and we tried things I would never have thought of. Everything from the grilled goat and frog, to the scallops, shrimp and crab, is all prepared and waiting when you get to each place you are stopping. You also learn a little about the history of this great city and the different districts (like suburbs) that you visit throughout the tour.
Congratulations to Tung Do and the girls on running such a great tour and I can highly recommend this to anyone. Will definitely do it again on my next visit.

Tony - Australia

A laugh and a half, plus some great food - We did the XO Foodie tour with a group of 9, plus 4 others.

The tour was great, getting to see some of the other districts of Saigon and a try a collection of different food. The guides really turned the tour from an interesting sightseeing trip with some tasty food into a terrific experience - my lady was hilarious and offered me a real insight into current day Vietnam.
Some of the impact was taken away for us as we did it at the end of our stay in Saigon as the first few days couldn't accommodate a group of our size (we booked late), and we had taken a fantastic tour of the Mekong the day before, but overall I highly recommend it.

If you've got any sense of adventure, love food or are curious about contemporary Vietnam, do yourself a favor and get on the back of a motorbikes with lovely ladies of XO.

Great experience! - Absolute quality. The tour is really well organized, none of that follow me I'm waving a flag business, you feel like you're on a bit of an adventure and especially being on the back of a bike taken round a city where the traffic is mental. It's weird you feel so safe among the madness but you do. The tour guide and all the drivers are really friendly and chilled and want you to have a good time and take lots of pictures and enjoy yourself. We had ours videoed which you can see on this link. The quality is really high and this was all for about $40 I think

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UVVmrbulXQ&list=UUvshhfGoUAmqfHlPF3xpouA&index=2&feature=plcp

Worth a trip to Saigon - Stated simply: you HAVE to do this if you're in Saigon. My wife and I were a bit apprehensive about riding around on the back of a motor scooter with a young Vietnamese girl, eating street food of unknown parentage for the evening. But put your mind at ease: this is a VERY professional operation, run tightly by a Vietnamese American (Tung Do) who has moved back to Vietnam to find XO Tours. The food is superb with the locales and menus preselected and awaiting us, so very punctual and lacking in dysentery. Best scallops we've ever had (not to mention the grilled goat and frog, surprisingly good). We also got to go to many districts of Saigon we will never have ventured to, learn about the history, cuisine, and culture of the city. Our drivers spoke good English and were very engaging, and after about 30 seconds on the road, I relaxed and enjoyed the incredible weaving in and out of the 7 million scooters in Saigon. No safety concerns. A bonus is free photos provided via the web and a reasonably priced video of the whole adventure. You MUST do this and get the video!

Highly recommended - In the end we only ended up doing the morning tour. This was very well organized and extremely good fun. Its done in the morning so you get out of the sun before it gets too hot. We also chose for us to be video'ed on the tour which came back extremely proffesional and reasonably priced.

Refreshingly fun tour - I've never been to a tour before that I actually enjoyed. I found this on Trip Advisor and took a chance in booking their Foodie & The Sights tour (having seen that they're highly rated). Unfortunately my mom and I had to cancel the Foodie tour at the last minute. (I will def. try this when I get back to HCMC!). The Sights tour was really fun. There were only four of us (a couple from Australia joined us) so it makes it easier to pay attention to the tour guide. The lady drivers were really fun to be with the entire tour as well. My mom and I had a great time and I will definitely recommend this to anyone who will be visiting HCMC.

SO MUCH FUN!!!! - My boyfriend and I took the XO Foodie Night Tour and it was probably the most fun we had in Saigon. There is a reason they have so many great reviews, the owner Tung has thought out every detail of the tour. The girls that drive you around are so sweet and knowledgable about the city and they are GREAT drivers! They take you to so many different districts that you will never see on your own. Also the food was delicious. We are still talking about the scooter tour and we have been home for two weeks now :) It is a MUST DO in Saigon!!!!

A Blockbuster Food Tour - My travel companion (TC) and I enjoyed this foodie tour. We likened the entire experience with having all the elements of a real blockbuster - action: you are in a motorbike for 4 hours, suspense: you are not quite sure of what you will really eat...
check out details of your review at http://www.80before60.com/2012/10/our-best-food-tour-so-far.html

Fantastic! - I am such a scaredy cat but when I read the other reviews of this tour I thought I just had to do it. I am soooo glad I did. What a fantastic night! It is well thought out and planned. The girls are so confident and capable you lose any nervousness in about the first 5 mins. They are lovely and friendly and really worked hard to ensure you have a great time.
I am quite a big person and the girls are quite tiny but I was never made to feel awkward or embarrassed and I really appreciated that.
We laughed all night and had a ball, we got to see so much of the city we would never have done otherwise and the food was great too.
Definitely worth doing!

Brilliant! - Wow! What a wonderful way to see HCMC! We did the Foodie Tour, and have been back in Sydney for 3 weeks now - but we are still raving about this!! We saw so much more of HCMC than we could ever have dreamed of - the girls were delightful and informative, and riding on the back of the scooters was exhilarating! Highly recommend! Thanks Tung, Ben and team!

brilliant! - We did the foodie tour, which takes in the night tour as well, It was great to get out of district one and Ben, the hos guide, was funny and informative and fun. The girls who we rode with were fantastic, informative and helpful. The food was sublime, we were familiar with a lot of it as we had been eating street food only in Vietnam, and this tours shows that street food is the best!
The tour was so well organised, well run, always fun, plenty of little gifts and beers and food. We were a couple and the tour had 14 in total, all Australians, who were so friendly and fun and relaxed in the Aussie way.
The locals we met as we ate were so friendly and smiled a lot. We loved being on the bikes among the local traffic - quiet an experience, but we felt safe and had fun.
A great tour to open your mind to this interesting an lively city.

The best way to experience HCMC - My wife and I took two tours with XO (city tour and foodie) and both were excellent. The guides were very good in their explanations and were very safe drivers. The foodie tour is a must as it was some of the best food that we have ever tried. HCMC is a very big and crowded city and the bikes are the best way to get around. The tours are organized and good value for your money.

The perfect way to see the city! - Tung Do (Owner/Director) was wonderful and always answered his emails promptly. He is fluent in English and is easy to understand. We had two beautiful girls pick us up at the hotel in the morning and the ride was about 3-4 hours. They took us all around the city looking at local monuments and areas of interest. We visited local markets and tried local foods along the way. We did this our first day in Vietnam, and it really helped us get our barrings around the city, and is a great tour if you only have a few days in Vietnam. Tung Do will also email you pictures taken through out the day, and you have an option to have a video made. My husband and I did have a video, and it came out perfect. The video is set to music and shows you the various places that you will see through out the day. You have 60 days to download the video, and I unfortunately missed that deadline. I emailed Tung Do and explained what happened, he of course, emailed me immediately and I had the availability to upload the video again the very next day! Wonderful Experience!

A Must-Do Tour! - My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed this tour. The girls were great riders and we felt very safe on the busy streets of HCMC. The tour guide was so knowledgeable and we learned so much. We booked a few months ago on the net and the service from day one was impeccable. I urge anyone to plan a trip to HCMC to take one of their tours, we did the morning city tour.

Up Close and Personal - Starting the tour at 5.00pm in Ho Chi Minh city during peak our is an experience to behold for someone who has rarely been on a motor scooter let alone be amoungst the thousands on the streets at this time. The girls are very experienced at manoeuvering through the traffic. There were five stops in all . The first was in an allyway in some obscure part of HCMC and the food was typical street food and sensational. It was the start of one of the most interesting food journeys I have ever encountered. To be prepared it might be a good idea to miss lunch as the quantity and quality is very high. The type of food is what the locals eat and in addition the crew from OX explains the food and also gives a fair comment on the bikes whilst traveling from site to site. It certainly explores HCMC across most of the districts. The last stop was interesting as the girls got involved in the cooking of the food (little stoves on the tables) and once cooked they peeled the prawns and shelled the crabs for you, no messy fingers. Also at the last stop we were talking about a local food, I think it was called a Balat, it is a duck embrio in the shell. They had it on The Amazing Race as a challenge to eat. One of the girls volunteered to eat one in front of us. It looks quite disgusting but the worst thing was the smell, I really don't know how they can eat it. It was good entertainment though.
All in all a great night and I would recommend anyone who visits HCMC to put it on their must do list.

Great night out - I did this tour with a group of my mates (7 in total), the drivers and tour guide were most obliging for such a large group, and we felt like royalty for the night, girls were peeling our prawns and crabs and were always making sure we were never without a beer. The food is very intersting and tries to demonstrate different dishes from all over Vientnam, the guide gives you lots of local history and the drivers keep you well informed as you drive through this amazing city. The tour doesn't race you from one place to the next and drives you through the many districts that make up this great city, and gives you a great insight to areas that most tourist wouldn't see. A thorough and solid recommendation from me, and a bit of advice don't have a big lunch prior.

Great introduction to Ho Chi Minh City - I had an amazing time on the foodie tour and it being only my second day in Saigon, the tour made me feel like I didn't waste a second of my short time in that beautiful city. It was so much fun riding around on the back of the bike, and having extreme balance issues did not pose a problem for me, my rider made the ride so smooth and safe, I didn't even have to hold on to the bike! The food was amazing, especially the first and last stops! It's mixed in with some interesting observations of the different districts and their unique features. Tung and Ben, our guides, speak perfect English and have an awesome sense of humor while explaining everything really well.

Best part, I didn't get sick! Being a newbie to a developing country, I had heard my fair share of horror stories about street food but it's all safe and vetted carefully by the tour owners - even the balut went down well! I will definitely be going on this tour again when I get back to Ho Chi Minh City!

If you do nothing else - you have to take this tour! - There are some adventures in the world that people rave about, but really most of them have personal meanings and can be a bit subjective, BUT NOT THIS ONE.

This is a tour that should not be missed. Tung who owns and operates the tour is a wealth of knowledge. Its not the usual information that you get on tours - its about the culture, the economy of the city, the fun spots (and there are a couple ..) and the dynamics of life in Ho Chi Minh city.

The city areas that you visit on the tour are where the locals of Saigon eat - so you get to experience the food and culture through their eyes. Its busy and chaotic and exciting.

But the stars of the XO food tour are definitely the girls who drive you on their motorbikes. They are intelligent, articulate, knowledgeable and loads of fun and they completely spoil you from the moment that they arrive to pick you up, to the moment they drop you back to where you are staying.

If you do nothing else in Saigon, you have to take this tour. It is the best fun you could have and a total must for anyone of any age.

Don't Miss This Tour - We were lucky to get a place on this tour as they are so busy and now I know why. It is by far one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The girls are so informative as was Ben and they made the night so much fun with games and photos and nothing was too much trouble. They even emailed you all the photos of the night. The food was amazing, and driving in peak hour traffic at 5.30pm was amazing. The girls make you feel very safe. If you do anything in Saigon then do this tour, you won't be disappointed. Thanks guys for an awesome Saigon experience.

A must do tour in HCMC - The Foodie tour run by XO Tours is absolutely brilliant, I would recommend it to anyone.
I felt secure and safe the whole time we were on the tour, in traffic most would consider extreme ...
The girls and whole team are great and I can't say enough about them, they make the experience what it is.
I would say to those wanting to go take a small camera, by all means, so long as it fits in your pocket and it can be kept relatively secure, although the team take photo's and will send them through.
Also those of you who are a bit wary about eating the street prepared food, this tour definitely dispels those fears, well at least for the places they visit. The food is sensational. . . I'd do this tour again tomorrow.

We also did the shopping tour with XO Tours, if you want to shop for anything specific, ask and XO Tours will arrange to take you along, even help with a translation. My Fiance wanted to look for wedding dresses and I can't say enough about the girls and the assistance they gave as well as the time they spent with her whilst buying a dress was unforgettable, we ended up buying the dress and will remember them all in June next year when we get married.

To Tung, Ben and the girls who spent time with us on both tours, thank you, it was a pleasure .... If there was any tours I would recommend in Ho Chi Mihn this would the first ....

If you only have one night is HCMC, you must do this! - We were recommended this trip by friends and it surpassed our expectations. Not only a foodie tour but an amazing and insightful tour taking in many districts of Vietnam and displaying the diversification the HCMC has to offer. We learnt allot about not only the history but of the future plans of HCMC. The food and dining experience was something we would never of done if traveling by ourselves. I was worried about my husband as he is very conservative with his eating and doesnt like to try new things often. It my surprise and delight he said it was some of the best food he has ever eaten. I cannot rave enough about all the dishes and the amazing flavours. This is a must do if traveling to Saigon. Thank you Ni, Kim and Ben for an amazing night. Katherine and Stephen from Melbourne.

Never a dull moment! - I booked the popular "Foodie" tour and I was not disappointed. The entire itinerary was very well organised and the lovely guides will keep you entertained, serve you with food and drinks, barberque and even pluck the prawn shells for you! Tung the owner and Ben the tour manager will ensure that you are having a fun and educational time as we explore a few non-touristy districts in-between feeding. Worth every cent paid!

What a Night....Fantastic - What more can be said about this tour that hasn't already been said. .... it was in a word ....'Fantastic'.....we were picked up by our guides on bikes and got straight among the most hectic traffic we've ever seen for the 'Foodies Tour of Saigon'...from start to finish the best tour in Saigon...bar none.....We were taken to the most out of the way places for some of the best food we had in our entire time in Saigon....
Ben & Tung deserve a lot of credit for such a great tour.....but the real stars are the girls....their knowledge of Saigon....& their approach to making you feel comfortable & confident on the bikes is outstanding...if you are looking for a tour that gives you an insight to Saigon...topped with some great food and company...then this is for you...

Memorable Experience Without A Doubt - Came to Saigon with my parents for vacation. Got to know this tour via Tripadvisor earlier. Can't believe it till I experienced it myself! Joined the Foodie Tour on the first night of my arrival to Saigon city. Receive warm welcome by those XO ladies. The boss, Mr Tu Dong and his partners were very pleasant and friendly. Encountered with the issue of accidental overcalculated trip fee. The next day, Mr Tu Dong the gentleman emailed me in advanced and returned back the excess cost overcharged by mistake. Honest businessman. Hey, what else can u say to that. The price is fair enough. The XO lady who took me? "Tien" I have to jog this down here, well, thanks for taking all the pain to drive back to my hotel the next day to return me the cash. Would recommend this tour for anyone who comes to Saigon city. Thumbs up, not just one, but TWO!

The highlight of our Vietnam Honeymoon!!! - My wife and I only had 3 nights to spend in Ho Chi Minh as part of our time in Vietnam, so we made sure we got the most out of it by doing the Shopping AND Foodie Tour with XO. We did a lot of research and couldn't go past XO Tours after reading all of the fantastic reviews on here.
The Shopping Tour was a blast with Hoang, Binh (our personal negotiator!) and Tai (he got the job of carrying all the shopping bags!!). We went to some of the markets off the "beaten track" and saw where the locals go and got fantastic bargins as well. The best part was how much fun we had doing it with these girls (and guy) from XO.

The Foodie Tour was a blast!! We got to see several Districts (that we probably would never have gone to on our own!) and sampled great food (and beer) as a bonus!! Uyen and Thuy were our "Tour Guides" and it was amazing how safe we ​​felt on the back of the scooters, in what could only be described as organized chaos!! To top it all off, we even paid a little extra and got our Foodie Tour videoed. Its a great laugh to have a look back and relive the memories! Last, but certainly not least, a big thank you to Tung Do, the owner of XO Tours. He is a brilliant man to deal with and could not do more for us when we were organizing our tours with him. Very glad we got to meet him in person on the Foodie Tour as well. Fantastic Service. Fantastic Price and treasured memories.

The best! - This is by far the best tour. We did the foodie and it was all amazing. Great food, great guides and very well organized. The girl drivers are all very friendly. They are also awesome drivers. Never felt in danger at all - very safe. Don't miss out and try this, it's heaps of fun.

XO tour - fabulous! - Well, what a fabulous and fun insight into HCMC!

We took a four hour private tour on our first morning in the city. The two ladies who drove us around were very informed, great fun - and excellent safe drivers.

Ben joined us at the various stopping points and gave us a great understanding about the history of Vietnam and the city.

We really enjoyed the tour and can't recommend it highly enough!

A winner in HCMC! - After reading the reviews before we left we did the unprecedented thing for us and booked a Foodie Tour with XO Tours before we arrived. We booked for our second night in HCMC and it was the highlight of our stay. The tour girls, tour leader Ben, the bikes, the city, the traffic and the food all meshed together into a fantastic fun night!

The best way to see Saigon and an adventure you'll never forget. - I did the XO Foodie tour with a large group of MBA classmates on December 10 and had an absolute blast! This was by far the best thing I did during my weeklong stay in Vietnam. Our female tour guides/chaueffers/interpreters were very sweet, entertaining and highly attentive to everything we needed. They will point out interesting sites along the way and always help us with our choice in meals and beverages. XO's owners Tung and Ben came along with us on the tour and gave us the royal treatment even taking us to some parts of Ho Chi Minh City that you won't find on any other tour and gave us very detailed background information on those areas. I will definitely visit Vietnam again and probably do at least two different tours with XO on my next visit. Be sure to ask for ThuThu - she's my fav!

Brilliant fun on the foodie tour - We had such a brilliant time on the XO Foodie Tour - everything the other reviewers have said is spot on. We'd been a little nervous to eat some of the food from street stalls (not to mention getting on a moto -the streets in HCMC are crazy!), but felt completely safe and tucked in with gusto at the stalls and restaurants the XO team took us too. We tried a few things we hadn't widely seen at other restaurants (but are apparently eaten by all the locals), including grilled frog! Plenty of more mainstream options to try as well, and all are equally delicious.

Tung's team of gorgeous female drivers were so likeable and well informed, and good fun too! Would definitely recommend this to anyone with a love of good food, culture and a taste for experiencing a different side to HCMC. It's a very slick and well run operation, and the photos they emailed us afterward are a nice touch too.

The Best Night in Saigon :) - We have such a great time with 'Saigon by Night Tour' !
It was our first time in Saigon, and thanks to my supportive friends, they agree on for this tour!
The 2 of my friends, they have never ride on a bike before. The girls in charge took extra care of them, and they had such a great time.

It was a eye opener I must say. Having to be in the other sectors of Saigon, one will view Saigon to a different era.

You can even come back and brag, because not everyone, will see Saigon like you do ;)

The girls, they are fun and informative. I was happily singing along while the bike was on the move! THEY ARE THAT FUN :)

I must applaud Tung, the manager of this tour. He works night and day with no rest day for himself.
He will make sure everyone is safe and fully understand the tour and introduction of Saigon.
He is funny and he speaks really good english.
Your service & dedication its admirable.
Your staff have high respect for you, and they only qoute words of praises if we were to ask about you :)

With such reasonable price, unexplainable experience, Beautiful Bikers & a responsible Manager, what more can we ask for? :)

I say, give them a try!

We shall have you again XO Tours :)

Say HI to the girls for me Tung ;)

XO Tours - The Foodie Tour, Ho Chi Minh City - My wife and I did this tour on the evening of 21st October, and after only being in HCMC for some 6 hours. I doubt that we have ever had more fun on a first evening of a holiday anywhere in the world, nor a better introduction to a country and its people through the charming young women who expertly drive you around on their motorcycles, and the owner of the company Mr. Tung Do who accompanies you around the whole tour, and who gives appropriate and welcome information at various stages during the evening. Our two young ladies, Miss Tii and Miss Kim, both university students, looked after us superbly well, and were great company and great fun. We went places on this tour that we would never have found on our own in a million years, and we ate food that we would never have dreamed of doing before. We would urge anyone to take this tour - such a good time!

A great way to experience the culture of Saigon! - We took the Sights tour on our first morning in Ho Chi Minh and the Foodie tour the next evening. The sights tour was an excellent overview of the primary attractions in Saigon, especially for our group members who were visiting Asia for the first time. We felt safe on the motorbikes, welcomed by the girls and educated by the tour leader. They were great about answering questions and we got quite a history lesson as well. We were especially impressed with the historical pictures used to explain the history of some of the sights. You can certainly see these sights on your own but this was a much easier and more educational way.

The Foodie tour was even more fun. We felt like we got a taste of what life in Ho Chi Minh was like and what life would be like on a motorbike! The food at the 3 stops was terrific. There was a lot more time on the motorbike than we expected which we enjoyed! We will never have seen so many different sections of town on our own. We had been a little concerned about eating what was described as "street food" but that concern was misplaced. Tan runs well-planned and well-executed tours. This is really a "must do" tour if you want to experience local culture (and have a great meal)!

TIP: Payment can be made in either USD or VND at the end of the tour.

Birthday Foodie tour - Went on the Foodie XO Tour on my birthday after living in HCMC for two months. To say it is the best tour I have every participated in would be an understatement. From the moment the girls picked us up from our apartment to the minute they dropped us off the service was amazing and attentive without being overbearing.. Tung (owner of XO) has recruited very well and trained all the guides to an extremely high standard.

We joked with our guides all night, and ended up being their adopted parents. We had Bad Daughter (Thuy) and good daughter. The girls played their parts as hosts with professionalism and friendship, their comical banter and the way they played off each other was magical. We even received a text from one of the girls the next day, to ensure we enjoyed ourselves.
At the start of the tour my wife mentioned that it was my birthday. By the time the tour reached its climax in district 4, out came a birthday cake. We didn't organize this, it just magically appeared. The service cannot be beaten.
I couldn't recommend this tour highly enough, for those with only a limited time in Vietnam, this is the tour for you.
