You will get the chance to taste some incredible street food, ride on a scooter through the maze of traffic that is Saigon, meet like minded tourists, and for those who have lived in HCMC for sometime you will see the hidden gems of this alive city.
Book ahead don't be disappointed, we have told all our friends who are visiting this is a must do when they arrive. Some 500 positive reports cant be wrong. Added bonus is that photos are taken during the night and emailed to you, so no need to bring your own camera. Tung has thought of everything.
Thanks good and bad daughter for giving me a memorable birthday.

A must-do in HCMC! - My fiance and I took the shopping + foodie tour(private) and those were truly the highlights of our trip! As I was looking to buy an Ao Dai, the girls brought me to a shop(in Ben Thanh market) owned by the government(the sales assistant would usually be dressed in a blue uniform top) so that I won't have to pay a ridiculously marked up price. No haggling is required as the prices in these government shops are reasonable. The wonderful thing is that the girls will help you to haggle for a good price at the non-government owned shops and if they think that the after discount price is still very expensive, they will let you know. That's good for tourists because we may think it's cheap but it could still be marked up by 200% and there could be cheaper alternatives. You can also tell them specifically what you are looking for and they will take you to the market which has the items that you want. I can't even begin to start writing about the foodie tour! IT WAS AMAZING! We took the private tour and it was well worth every cent! We went to places that the regular tourists would never be able to find because you won't even know how to search for these places and they are so uniquely local. That was a very important criterion for us when we booked the tour. The food was superb, the sights, beautiful and the girls and Tai even more so wonderful. Did I mention that you don't have to worry about taking pictures because they will take pictures for you and send it to your email? So what are you waiting for when you have everything planned out for you, coupled with the best hosts you can ever find(which hosts would de-shell shrimps and crabs for you)? Book now and enjoy the best of HCMC!

PS: Tung, Tai and the girls, if you are reading this, when we go back to HCMC, we're definitely taking the tour again! :)

A Night in Saigon to Remember - I did the Saigon by night tour on Friday, October 12. The entire experience was great. My tour guide was a very pleasant young lady who showed me the great sites of Saigon by way of motor bike. If you have never been to Saigon just watching the traffic from the sidewalk can be an adventure. She was an experienced guide who really knew how to handle the bike and the traffic. I felt incredibly safe with her operating the bike. The group of four decided for some traditional Vietnamese cuisine. The food was very good and the entire experience was a night to remember. The manager of the company Mr. Tung Do really goes out of his way to ensure that you are safe and you thoroughly enjoy yourself. He even accompanies the group on some of the journey. Highly recommend this tour.

Still the best thing you can do in Saigon - As another reviewer has said, I also think that you should make this your first experience in Saigon.It gives you a great orientation of the city. My husband and I did (and really enjoyed) the evening tour at the end of August in 2011 and this time, when we returned to Saigon in October this year with some friends, we couldn't wait to book another tour. This time we did the morning city sights tour which was different from, but just as good as, the night tour. Our friends were so impressed and loved every minute of the tour, just as we did. Coincidentally, "my" girl was the same girl that my husband had last year and she even remembered him and the fact that he was a teacher. Our guide, Ben, was informative and interesting, giving just the right amount of information and absolutely none of it was boring. I really loved the market stop off where we sampled some melt-in-your-mouth yogurt . Next time (I am definitely returning to this wonderful city) I can hardly wait to do the Foodies Tour. Tung has worked out some magical formulas for his motorbike tours: the girls are very personable, as well as being relaxed, which helps you to feel relaxed on even the busiest roundabout in Saigon with the traffic intertwining all around you; the sites you stopped at are very well chosen and the information given is really interesting and definitely not the run-of-the-mill stuff you would get from other guides or tours.

A must-do experience! - The best way to see Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) with time restraints. The local girls will pick you up from your accommodation on their motorbikes and and take you to visit the big must see of the city! For those who are slightly cautious never fear the girls are experienced and take it nice and easy for foreigners. At each location you are met by a guide who will show you around and explain the key history and meaning behind where you are and what you see. This is without a doubt a must do. The experience itself is one thing but the knowledge and stories you get to hear from the locals is something else entirely!

make this your first experience in saigon! - I wish that we had! My 9 year old daughter and I took a 'saigon by night' tour on our last night in town... and I wished we had the opportunity to do it the other way around (book early!)... it was not just a really great way to see the city at night, but the advice, history and demography offered to us by Tung and our guides seemed like a valuable wealth of information if you were planning to spend a week here in saigon.
Thankyou to you Tung and your gorgeous guides... it was a brief, happy time and my daughter talked like it was the only thing we did in nearly a month in Vietnam... good luck to you!

Kids had a ball. Mum and Dad too. - Once you have done this tour everything else will seem second rate. This was possibly the highlight of our 2 weeks in Vietnam. The kids would have preferred to keep riding but the sites were fantastic too.

Great night tour on the bike - We had a fabulous night on the tour and agree with all the other positive comments from other reviewers. Very easy booking online, we were met promptly outside our hotel and started our evening trip through the streets of Ho Chi Minh/Saigon to various local food places where we tried various dishes and were given explanations into the specialties. Riding on the back of the scooter with the girls was fantastic, we weaved our way through traffic and got the real travel through traffic experience. The food, drinks and entertainment were fantastic, I would highly recommend this tour.

Foodie tour - The foodie tour was heaps of fun. I was initially a bit apprehensive on riding a motorbike through the crazy Saigon traffic, but the XO girls were all very skillful in making it a safe and enjoyable ride. The food we sampled were not the average 'pho' or spring rolls etc and we got to taste very different types of Vietnamese food. My favorite was the 'bun bo hue' (beef noodle soup hue style). It was so good, that we went back again the next day for breakfast!

The tour is also very good if you have limited time in Saigon as we went to various districts to taste food and to also see different parts of Saigon. I highly recommend this tour as it was such a fun thing to do and definitely made my Saigon visit memorable.

City Scooter tour Ho Chi Min City - Experience with XO tours was the best and most unique tour I have ever done. The attention to detail and information provided by the influential and friendly staff and management was excellent. My personal driver and guide Anh was friendly, knowledgeable, informative, fluent in English (not sure how many other languages), fabulous driving skills, communicative, and professional. All the other guides were as attentive to the requests and questions of the customers. The manager constantly demonstrates his knowledge and professional attitude, as well as being attentive to all the needs of the tourists, the guides and the staff at the visited sites. The owner's presence at various times of the tour highlights the passion that his whole business exudes. This touring company is a must for any 1st, 2nd time visitors to Ho Chi Minh City. The scooters are in great working order with spare equipment and drivers on call so there be a problem (there were no problem, but the security of back up was welcomed) Felt safe and secure at all times and would highly recommend this trip to anyone.

Craig
Sydney Australia

Oh, what a night! - This was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. On our last night in HCMC we were collected from our hotel by our gorgeous guides in their traditional white outfits and their scooters. I never once felt afraid as we glided through the mayhem that is the traffic in this city, even on the bigger roads. The night foodie tour is a great way to see parts of HCMC that the tourist would normally not get to see. The food experiences along the way are fantastic - from the Ban Bo Hue soup in a side alley, the table top BBQ in a car park to the street side seafood in Q4 (the scallops were amazing!!). Thank you to Tung and his fantastic team - especially the girls who share their city with us from the back of their scooter. It was so much fun and a very special experience. I'm going back to do the shopping tour!

Ho Chi Minh Highlight. - My wife and I did this tour late September and so glad we did it on our first night in HCMC as suggested by others on Trip Advisor. It was bloody fantastic and could've done it 2 nights in a row. Excellent girls on the Scooters, Tung fantatic set up mate and I had a ball. Great sightseeing, great food, great company with people from all over the world on the tour. I cannot rate this tour highly enough. We will be back to Vietnam next year and 'WE WILL' be doing this tour again. Tung and Crew-THANKYOU!!!!
PS Tung - Don't you ever make me eat one of those Blue duck eggs again- I cannot still believe I actually ate that thing-feotus and all-never again!!!
See you all soon
Jas & Deb

Truly memorable - We loved this. We did the Sights tour. It was outstanding. Insightful. Fun. Brilliant. Then, the next night, we did the Foodie Tour. This was even better. I can't rate it more highly. Five of us. Two grown ups. Three younger travelers. 18, 15 and 9. We rate it as one of the best experiences of our lives. Thank you. Generous, wonderful hosts.

A tip - The previous reviews pretty much sum up the excellence of this tour. I'll just say something about payment. At the end of the tour, you pay the girl that drove you around and took care of you. PLEASE TIP HER WELL!!! The girls that took care of my buddy and I were very nice and waited on us hand and foot. We tipped each girl somewhere between $20 and $25 bucks. They worked hard for it and were well deserving since they were very talkative (ie, informative) and made sure our glasses and stomachs were full and that we were individually engaged in the night's activities.

BTW, the good was truly AMAZING! We were VERY surprised at how good it was. In fact, I can't think of a trip where I've had better...this includes millions of trips in Europe, South America, Asia, and many other places. What a gem of a country...foodwise.

Hugo from Texas

Loved this - I am by definition not a tour person. This experience, however, might change my mind. The girls picked us up promptly at 9:00 for the standard tour, and from the beginning it was a great morning. Our drivers/guides were sweet young women, very funny, smart and engaging. The motobike gave a great platform from which to see the city, and the whole thing was a smooth operation. Ben, the actual guide who met us at each stop, was informative, funny, and put up quite patiently with the antics of two scattered girls that wouldn't stop interrupting him or wandering off to take pictures... I cant recommend anything more highly. The only thing I am disappointed about is that I didnt book the other two options as well.

Thoroughly Recommended - Did the tour a couple of nights ago and was really impressed with all aspects and agreed with the many positive comments posted. Great to see the enthusiasm of girls, Tung, Ben and all staff continue as though they are taking tourists for the first time and out to impress. My partner had never been on a motorbike before but felt very safe and comfortable from the start of our great night.

Awesome, one of the best things we did in HCMC - We did the evening Foodie tour where we ventured outside district 1 and ate where the locals ate.
The girls (our drivers) were just gorgeous and we felt so safe. We were a party of 6 which included a toddler, a 12 and 15 year old ..... So much fun seeing HCMC from the back of a motorbike .... Being in the middle of the hustle and bustle. If you get the chance to do this do spend the$25 and get the video ..... We couldn't wipe the smiles off our faces after watching it - so professionally put together.

Best tour ever! - This is a tour which truly exceeds expectations!! The team are fantastic - lovely guides who know so much about Saigon and make the whole evening a fun experience. Great to see a manager and owner take such pride in the experience from the timely, personalized emails to their participation in the evening. I lost count of the number of different foods we tried and all were excellent in quality and flavour. Upon picking us up our guides learn we had already tried one of the dishes on the menu. They rang ahead to arrange a different meal for us instead. This is just one example of the above and beyond service you will receive on this tour. This is a great tour to do early in your stay as it is a great way to orientate yourself to the city and you will likely want to book another of their tours. We plan to do another thing before we go home! Thanks XO tours.

The standout tour of my trip to Vietnam - We did the foodie tour and it was worth every penny. The food was amazing, the sites they take you to in the city are incredible, the tour guide speaks excellent English and are great drivers. I honestly cannot recommend this tour enough. If you only have time for one tour, this should be the one.

A MUST-DO in Vietnam! - XO Tours is a "must-do" when you're in Ho Chi Minh City, especially the "Foodie Tour". It's 4.5 hours of non-stop sight seeing, local authentic food tasting and knowledge about Vietnam. The food locations they take you to are places visitors would never know to go. Delicious, local, hole in the wall restaurants that you will enjoy.

Tung and his girls do a great job with the tour. It starts out with you hopping on the back of a scooter with a female tour guide dressed in a traditional Vietnamese outfit. Then you cover many of the districts on the scooter while making 3 stops for food and 2 additional stops for sight-seeing and information.

Although riding on a scooter in Vietnam may seem scary, it's a ton of fun once you're actually on it. I highly recommend this tour.

Very interesting and informative, very professional, well worth it!! - The ladies came to our hotel and were instantly friendly and very professional. They were very safe drivers, the tour was very interesting and informative. A great morning out. Would definitely recommend this tour for all ages.

A must-do tour in the city! - What can I say but an amazing time was had on these fabulous tours. When we arrived at Ho Chi Minh City we could not believe the volume of motorbike traffic, and we had booked tours but we need not have worried.
On the morning tour we were met by our guides at the hotel Thu and Ngan, what a delight it was to be driven around the fabulous city and told by them information about the city and its sights, We were met by the boss of the company Tung at various stops who then went into excellent detail of the particular location. The girls are great drivers who you will feel safe and at ease with. We sampled the delight of sugar cane juice which I promise you will never forget thanks Tung for that looking for a supplier over here!!!
The next day we went on the night tour and were driven around by Tien and Thoung, I was paired with Tien what a crazy girl great fun and a total chatterbox but what a charming girl who told me so much about the city, and their cultures, again we were met by the boss Tung at locations what a pleasure he was considering he does this every day he is a credit to himself as what a sterling job he does.
So what else can I say that if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh City you must do these tours no if no buts it's a must do !! Do them all if you can manage enough time, the experience will live with me forever excellent service throughout from booking until we got home when we received photos from Tung as an extra reminder of our tours thank you guys for the experience!!!

No regrets! - It's very easy to see why this is a top tour to do in Saigon, my husband and I did this tour on a whim a few weeks ago and am sooooo glad we did. This was one of the highlights of our four week trip to Asia for sure!

The owner, Tung is friendly, incredibly organized and is prompt in replying to emails, organizing our trip on very short notice. Our tour guides Ben and Tai were so much fun and really very sweet girls, on a rainy night they made sure to help us in and out of our plastic rain coverings at each stop. We had a little entourage from XO accompanying us throughout the journey, and it really made for some great conversation. The whole trip was so much fun! We love food and this was the perfect way to get out of the tourist district.

This is definitely a tour for people who love trying new foods, but I have to say half the fun was whizzing through bustling Saigon and learning about day to day life and sharing cultural differences with Ben and Tai.

Great start to Vietnam holiday - Wow - what a great way to start our Vietnam adventure. We started with the foody tour the day we arrived it opened us up into eating as the locals do and we delved into some great Vietnamese dining throughout our trip as a result. The girls are arwsome and make you feel safe on the bikes in what seems to be crazy traffic to foreigners, but for the girls it is a breeze. And the shopping and phrase tips helped us have a very sucessful trip.

XO tours is a must do, and would suggest as an early part of your trip,

What a great way to see the main sights of HCMC! - I heard about this tour from an Australian guy I met in Hanoi - so I booked it online for my last day in Vietnam, in Saigon. My female driver, Trang, was delightful and drove the scooter like a pro - I felt totally safe as soon as we set off. We saw lots of sites in 2.5 hrs, stopped off for sugar cane juice (delicious) and managed to continue in the rain (she supplied me with a plastic cape). Two others on our tour had done the evening eatery tour and praised it highly. Wish I had time to do it. Try it - it's a unique and fun way to see the city!

Great introduction to HCMC - We did the night food tour on our first night at HCMC and loved it! Great way to get a feel for the city and it's surrounding districts. Felt very safe on the back of the motorcycle.....crossing the road in HCMC is more challenging. The girls and Tung, the owner, are fantastic and happy to share their knowledge of this amazing city and it's night markets and food stalls. The food was very good and plenty of it. Our group had a lot of fun and we would highly recommend this tour.

No other way to see HCMC - What an amazing experience. You can read the other reviews for the official download, but this is by far one of the best tour companies I have taken. The service is fantastic, the women are cute and super friendly (they even serve you food!) and the staff makes it a safe and enjoyable experience. I felt like Anthony Bourdain after going through all the food areas - sampling all the wonder Vietnamese delights.

Fantastic - thank you Tong!!!

I did both the Food Night tour (didnt want it to end!!) and they day tour (good way to get a sense of HCMC before exploring on your own)

Getting right in there amongst it! - Talk about giggles and smiles from beginning to end!! From the minute we met our gorgeous guides to the drop-off at our hotel we knew we were ( and had been ) on a winner. Another gem we were led to by Trip Advisor. Our group of four did the Saigon by night tour which took us through the thick of evening traffic, through amazing local markets, street food stalls, "lovers lane" ..... there was so much to look at, listen to and enjoy. Our guides were knowledgeable, competent and above all - happy! Woo hoo!

The best way to see the city by night - Excellent night out. Highly recommended if you want to experience Vietnamese food and culture with a thrilling scooter ride around Ho Chi Minh City. The food was typical of each district within the city, lots of flavor and variety. The frog is recommended, if you like chicken. Don't let that put you off as the dishes provided are suited to the western pallet.

Highly Recommended!

Pricey but Memorable - First time for me to ride a motorcycle and in Saigon was most memorable -rush hour was certainly an exhilarating experience! You'd really sink into the culture. You'd ride around then stop and eat Vietnamese favorite local food-- noodles-- grills (from goat meat, shrimp and frog!-- and seafood. I enjoyed seafood the best-- crab and scallops and wish more servings there--they served it mixed spices and nuts w fish lime sauce. Even the balut with these spices tasted yum. Wish they explained a bit how the dishes were made or gave out recipes so we can attempt to prepare the same foods back home. Want a motorbike too..

A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City! - We did the sights tour on our first day then the foodie tour the next night, worth every cent. For 5 of us it was $175 aus dollars for sights and $335 aus for foodie one. Seriously the best way to see Saigon, experience the sights, sounds, food, culture. We had 2 adults, an 18 yr old, 15 yr old and a nervous 9 year old and all of us had the best time! The girls are fantastic at making you feel safe, the traffic is crazy but it feels very safe with them. An incredible experience we will treasure the rest of our lives.
My fussy eating 9 year old ate goat, frog and lots of other stuff! Amazing tour.
Thank you XO tours you really made our stay in Ho Chi Minh incredibly memorable! If anyone is traveling there it's seriously a fantastic thing to do.

A unique tour in Vietnam - Beside the good food, the exciting part is really the motorbike ride across the different districts in Saigon. It was better than a roller coaster ride with all those motorbikes nearing collision. Your in good hands with the pretty lady guides/drivers as they steer you through the busy streets. The tour will let you see districts where tourists don't normally go but this is where the good food can be found. It is a little bit pricey though but this will be the highlight of my Saigon trip.

My first encounter with Ho Chi Minh City - Amazing experience, the highlight of my trip to HCMC. I did the sights tour as well as the foodie tour. XO team is very friendly and Tung, the big boss, knows a lot about Saigon history. I highly recommend this tour. Enjoy.

Great culinary experience! - I did the foodie tour and I highly recommend it. The tour was a great way to see the sights of Saigon while eating amazing local food. I cannot speak highly enough of Tung and his team. Thanks for a great night.

Interesting tour, highly recommended - Our tour started off with a prompt pickup by 2 girls in modern motorcycles. We went to our first stop after a short safety briefing. First stop was for some Bun Bo Hue, which was amazing, probably the best that I've had so far. The other foods that we sampled were grilled goat/okra/frog/Balut (absolutely disgusting ... duck embryo) as well as some seafood. Not as much food as I expected, but interspersed were some stops to a couple of interesting districts and a short history lesson on each. Our guides not only included the girls in Ao Dai's but also the tour's owner and a few 'security' personnel.

All up a very well run tour. A tad pricey given the price of food/labour in Vietnam, but would recommend if you can afford it!

Pros :
1. Well thought out itinerary, and well planned
2. History lessons along the way
3. A chance to experience Vietnam as it should be experienced (on the back of a bike!)

Cons :
1. Needs more food/more variety of food
2. Price

Did 2 tours best experience you could hope for - The XO team are fantastic, we had a ball with them, we did the morning sights tour and the amount of knowledge not just from our girls Yeun and Dink (hope spelling is close) but also from TUng himself is amazing, I admit the first 2 minutes of heading into the crazy Saigon traffic is scary but exhilarating but from there the girls make you feel so safe that you forget about the hustle and bustle of all the other bikes, the morning tour took us on a fantastic tour around the city and was really interesting and passed so quickly. We had also booked the night tour but Yeun and Dink told us to do the foodie tour as it would be good, so on their advice we contacted Tung who easily accommodated us and changed us over and the girls were right, absolutely fantastic once more, the tour took 4.5 hours and we ate some amazing food, lots of seafood, goat and frog, I admit I was hesitant when. It came to the frog but the girls were so encouraging I couldn't let them down so I gave in and yes I admit it was worth trying, so if you are heading to Vietnam ensure you book with XO tours, we were lucky enough to get our same girls both times which was wonderful and as I say one of the best tour groups you could find in Vietnam could not rate them any lower than 5 stars would give the. Higher if there was a chance........don't be afraid of the traffic, book it now

Unbelievable, huge fun. - Perhaps the most fun I've ever had on a city tour, anywhere. You go to places you would NEVER visit as a tourist, and get some great street food along the way. Any concern about being on a scooter goes away after 15 seconds or so, and you're immediately pulled into the fun of being on the street. The guides/drivers were great. Just go.

XO - Totally Awesome :) - I did the XO Foodies tour on the 15/9/12. Totally awesome!
The XO team are fantastic. It was raining lightly when the tour started (Wet Season in HCMC) but we still had a fantastic time. At no time did it feel unsafe riding behind on the scooters with these young ladies behind the wheel. The food was great; so much to eat and a friend who had a shell fish allergy was looked after with meals just for her by the team at XO.
Would totally do a tour with them again! Book in advance as they are VERY popular and it was easy to see why :) Foodies tour $65.00 US/AUS and $25.00 if you want the crew to video your adventure. Other tours other prices. Check out their web site and the videos they have posted.

Foodie tour is awesome intro to Saigon - My wife and I went on the foodie tour back in June (I've been slow to write the review). This was a great way to see the city and try some unique food in places you will never find on your own no matter how savvy you are. The bikes are in great condition. The girls are wonderful and (probably more importantly) safe drivers. They also had great energy and were very enthusiastic about what they were doing and what you were seeing. My stomach was actually a little funky from something I had eaten earlier in the day but I still had a great time sampling from the places we stopped at. My wife dove right into everything, grilling up frog legs on the street like she'd been doing it her whole life. I really can't say enough great things about XO Tours. My suggestions; do the foodie tour and go the first night you are in Saigon. It helps getting acquainted with the layout of the city.

Highlight so far, expected to be the highlight of our trip - I had to secretly book this tour, because my partners largest fear of Vietnam was the traffic. Not once did we feel uneasy, although it its a little exciting being part of the Saigon traffic!
The girls speak with you throughout the tour and it really is a fantastic way to see Saigon and the different districts and introduce yourself to the delights and delicacies that Saigon has to offer (we did the foodie tour obviously!)
Last but not least Tung Do, the tour owner is something else he kept up communication after the Tour and offered assistance with any queries or problems we may run into throughout the course of our trip.

Thanks again Tung and the girls!

What a lot of bikes - This was probably the highlight of our trip to HO Chi Mihn City. The tour guides and drivers of the motor bikes were exceptional. Riding in the City is something to remember. There are no rules of the road and everyone cuts in front of each other. The girls skills were comforting. This tour provides an insight into the best of what Saigon had to offer. Areas you wouldn't usually venture to we're on the route. The food wasn't bad either. It was a most enjoyable 4 hours of evening fun. Would recommend to everyone.

Fantastic Food Experience - I booked up the Foodie tour for myself at the start of September. There was only me and one other person on the tour, as it was the low season, so it was a very personal tour (which I thought was great). My guide (Ann, if I remember correctly) picked me up from the hotel and spent a few minutes teaching me the basics of sitting on the moped, as I've never ridden a moped or motorbike before.
I have to admit, after spending one day in HCMC I was very apprehensive about being on a moped among the crazy traffic, but Ann was an excellent and safe driver and we didn't have any incidents or near misses the whole night. In fact, the moped aspect of the tour really is fantastic, just so you can see HCMC up close and personal as you drive about the districts.
I'm a huge fan of Asian food so the tour was right up my street. We stopped off four times and each food we had was completely different. All of the food was extremely tasty (with my favorite being the scallops). Both of the guides and the other guys along with us on the tour were super friendly and we had a good laugh. They even egged us on to ask for the Vietnamese delicacy Balut (look it up before you decide if you want to ask for it). I'm stressed that this was not part of the food menu, but an extra we asked for. The girls showed us how to eat it and it was truly a unique (if pretty messed up) food experience.

All in all I would definitely recommend this trip as all of the staff were very friendly, all of the food and drink (even the beer!) was provided in the price and it gives you good bearings for HCMC.

Loved, loved, loved it!!! - The Saigon by Night tour was easily one of the best tours I've ever been on! Great fun, wonderful guides and we got to see so much of Saigon that we would never have known existed. Riding through the madness of Saigon traffic is a real experience. The food we got was delicious too! This is an absolute must-do when visiting Saigon - if you have time
for only one activity here, do this tour!

The highlight of our Saigon trip! - I never thought that we would be comfortable zooming around the city on a motorbike - especially since we were too nervous to even cross the street. But the girls at XO Tours made us feel great and the nervousness ceased as soon as we took off. The ride was great, we saw so much of the city we hadn't seen before and we learned more about Ho Chi Minh.
Tung was awesome and really has this operation running smoothly. We loved it and couldn't recommend it more to anyone. It's the #1 thing I would do in Saigon! Can't wait to do it again :)

A-M-A-Z-I-N-G - Have just returned from a 3 week holiday (Saigon, Siem Reap & Phuket) and have to say that the XO Foodie Tour was absolutely the hilight of the trip. The girls were so good that I never felt unsafe or threatened at any time. There were 4 of us and we are all a little older but found that this experience is for any age. Just a word of warning, don't eat for 24 hours beforehand. We found that by the end of the night, we were so full but so exhilerated. Would definately recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon. Would do it again if the opportunity arose and probably try one of their other tours as well.

So fun!!! - I met a couple on another tour that were raving so much about this Foodie Tour, that I found the XO company and signed up. What a fun evening. This is a great way to see the huge HCM city AND to taste different foods. The best part was that all of the food was vetted by the owner, so no need to worry about the different restaurants! The girls were great hosts. Best tour of my entire vacation. Good value for the money also.

XO Tours - Awesome experience - We had research this trip and made a booking before we left for Ho Chi Minh City. So we had pretty high expectations for this tour. We did the 4 hour night food tour which started at 5.30pm! We were a little weary after a 4.30am start to the day seeing the floating markets at Cai Rang in the Mekong but as soon as we hopped on the bikes any sign of tiredness vanished!! We were meet by our lovely and friendly drivers Tien & Thuy. Both of these young ladies spoke wonderful English and we had funny conversations while zipping from place to place. As other posters have mention you head to various districts that the normal tourist might not even see or hear about, to enjoy many and varied dishes. The owner Tung met & welcomed us at the first restaurant to tell us how the night would unfold, before we enjoyed a noodle dish. After which we rode through the crazy traffic to district 3 and beyond. The girls are excellent drivers and it's a great way to see and enjoy the city. We stopped for some pictures at the Cholon markets taken by Ben & Tai who escorted us throughout the night and are also great fun and entertaining. So more stops more food and beer (Bia) made for a truly amazing night. The owner Tung has a created a great business that gives any traveller a unique experience. His staff that hosted us (Tien, Thuy, Ben & Tai) made us feel like old friends by the end of the night. Can only say that this is a must do in Saigon. Thanks Tung to you and your team. Brilliant!!!

XO = AMAZING!! - I arrived back from Hochi Minh yesterday and am still on a high from the experience! XO food tours was hands down one of the greatest travelling experiences of my life! The food, the scooter girls, the owner and the other male staff that are along for the ride are all such beautiful people! The night food tour is the way to go, awesome way to see the city and felt perfectly safe in their hands, beautiful local food and so much fun! Hot tip try the Balut at the last stop will not regret it!

Unexpected Surprise - Before visiting Saigon, I researched various tour companies and places to see. Even after reading the amazing reviews on XO Tours, I was hesitant so I decided not to book with them. I thought the motorbikes and girls in the traditional Vietnamese dress were played up for tourists. Upon arrival into Saigon, I met up with a friend who is a frequent visitor to Saigon and he highly recommended XO tours. With no plans for that evening, I called up XO Tours and booked a 2.5 hour tour of Saigon by Night for $35 per person. We were picked up by the girls on their motorbikes at our hotel and off our tour started. Both spoke great English and were very friendly as they explained the sights and districts as we rode by. It was a great way to see the city on the back of a motorbike with the breeze our face and the buzz of the city around us. Most tourists stay in District 1 but we were able to see many of the Districts that make up Saigon and the contrasts of each of them. We made a few stops where the owner met us to provide us with some additional historical and cultural information. Moreover, we had 3 choices for dinner that were picked up on the side of the street so we were able to try some authentic Vietnamese street food. We then drove to a table on the side of the rode and enjoyed our meal with some refreshing sugar cane juice.

Overall, an XO tour on the back of a motorbike was a great way for us to get our bearings in a new city. I also applaud the owner for starting a company that gives the new generation of young Vietnamese women the opportunity to be tour guides and more independence.

Best experience in Vietnam - My friends and I recently went on the foodie tour. It was a great opportunity to sample some foods we would never have found on our own, in a setting we would never have found. The girls were absolutely delightful. All college students or graduates, very intelligent and great conversationalist.

Strongly recommended. Next time I'm back, I'll try another XO tour.

Highly Rated - If you have just one thing you can do in Saigon then this is it. It combines what Vietnam is known for (all those motorbikes) and the excellent food. We had friends who were admittedly anxious about riding around Saigon in the back of a motorbike but the girls' proficiency put us at ease to the point where you forget you are even riding a motorbike. The girls are superb at navigating through the chaotic streets and are the perfect hosts. The owner Tung grew up in Texas so his English was excellent and he was with us at every stop explaining little known facts about each area we visited. We get a real sense of how the local Vietnamese eat and get around. To top it all off all the food and drinks are included in the price of the tour. There is absolutely nothing to buy. A wonderful and memorable experience and something not to be missed.

Fantastic experience - We we're picked up at our hotel by the girls
Fantastic morning lots of information
Given by the girls
The owner kept meeting us a various points and providing additional information
A fantastic introduction to this city.
Fun informative and a must do if you are in the city

Absolutely fantastic - We arrived in Saigon on August 17th and having little experience in Asian travel were overwhelmed by the chaos and madness of the traffic, not to mention the instant fear after already booking the tour from Australia and knowing we now had to get on the back of a scooter and venture into it! We were met at our hotel by two of the most gorgeous Vietnamese girls, Bo and Dong who quickly assured us we'd be safe and have a great night. How true that was! Within minutes of being on the back of the scooter and entering the chaos, we felt safe and had the most amazing experience and saw parts of Saigon we would never have seen, eaten at places we'd never have dared and fell in love with these two tiny girls who made us laugh all night. We met up with a dozen other girls and their passengers and the company director Tung Do who was also great. Since leaving Saigon and continuing our travels in Vietnam we have recommended to everyone we've met to do an XO tour as we can't speak highly enough about them. Well done Tung Do for creating a great company with great staff who really knows how to give travelers a great and informative experience in Saigon

These guys are so highly rated for a good reason! - This tour is perfect for getting your bearings in HCMC and is a great way for the cautious tourist to venture out of District 1. We had Tien and Ngan as our guides and both girls were well informed and amazingly confident drivers. As well as seeing the varying demographics of HCM, you're also given a snapshot of real day to day living as expressed to your guide. They happily pointed out famous and not so famous landmarks and were quick to share personal anecdotes about living in Vietnam. We loved riding around the city, learned a bit of localized history and were each treated to a traditional Vietnamese dish. I cannot recommend this tour enough for people visiting the city!

Best night in Ho Chi Minh - We found XO tours through Tripadvisor, and booked directly before we arrived as they seemed to be extremely popular. I am glad we did as it was the best experience we had in Ho Chi Minh City!
We were collected at our hotel by two lovey ladies by the name of Phuong and Ngon, who took us to the main meeting point to meet with the rest of our tour and to meet the owner, Tung Do. Having never been on a motorbike before, Ho Chi Minh City is probably the last place on earth to start, but the 2 ladies drove us around with great care, and never once did we feel scared! It was great to visit all the other districts, and see how different they all are from each other, the food was absolutely fantastic(especially the seafood restaurant) and Phuong and Ngon were exceptionally attentive and informative. Well done to XO Tours for your professional and well thought out tour experience! Highly recommended!

Fantastic Foodie Tour In "Saigon" - The XO Tour didn't disappoint me, got the tour information from TA and decided to go for it. Just a 'WOW', cute bike, lovely ladies and a friendly tour manager -Tung - .Local foods and market was awesome, it was delicious and each station / district will have a surprise. Will join the tour for my next visit. Awesome.

The Foodie Tour - Foodies love the details, attention payed to the preparation, knowledge/history of the ingredients, and that makes the meal experience all the more rich. Well, the same can be said of how Tung Do (not "Tong") has set up your XO tour experience.
He has payed attention to the details: the hotel pick up, the stops, even some games, the staff is charming, have strong english skills, caring, and attentive. He has planned out the preparation, and you reap the rewards: the locations, getting out of D1, the food stalls are hand selected for quality. The knowledge he has about the city and the food is impressive. He personally made 3 stops to explain all the ingredients how the food is prepared, the history and growing issues of the city, a sense of how the youth feel about living and working in HCMC, and historical areas important to the city and he explains why. This all makes for an excellent tour. You will have a full belly and a full heart. We did. My only advice, skip lunch. You will want to be starving.

A Must-Do Experience In HCM! - About a week before we left for Vietnam, Tung and I exchanged a couple of emails to confirm availability of the Foodie Tour for myself and my husband, how/where to meet and how/when to pay. As detailed in Tung's prompt emails, the Foodie Tour went exactly as planned. Two lovely and enthusiastic XO ladies (Holly and Cheng) met us outside our hotel at 5.30pm and took us to our first destination, where we were introduced to Tung, the rest of the tour group (ten of us in total) and the other XO girls.

The food we tried in every location was delicious (even the balut because we wanted to be 'adventurous'!) and were dishes we probably would not have come across by ourselves. The locations they took us to were so varied (again, locations we most likely would not have discovered by ourselves) and Tung gave us such a wonderful insight into this beautiful and chaotic city. Throughout the evening we enjoyed being right in amongst the HCM traffic, feeling very safe in the very capable riding skills of our XO ladies who were also so very hospitable, fun and entertaining, they felt like great friends by the end of the night. At the end of the evening, we paid for the tour direct to the girls once they had dropped us back at our hotel just after 9pm.

Everything was so well organised. Tung takes a few photos of the group throughout the night and emails them afterwards. You can also arrange to have your tour filmed for an extra fee.

I highly, highly recommend this tour whether you are staying for only a couple of nights (like us) or longer, it was such a fun experience and really gave my husband and I such a positive perception of HCM!

Great Experience - I found XO Tours on Trip Advisor, and decided to book both the night tour of Saigon as well as a day tour. After a few emails with the owner/operator Tong, we were all set to be picked up at our hotel in District 1 for our night tour. The girls who picked us up were great and had a wonderful sense of humor. Traffic seems a bit scary to outsiders visiting Saigon, but the girls did a fantastic job maneuvering through the chaos. Tong met us at the first stop in China Town, and accompanied us for the rest of the tour. He took us to some fantastic places in the city that most tourists would not visit. We even picked up some of the best street food I have ever had and had a picnic mid way through the tour. At the end of the tour, we were so impressed with our tour guides, we wrote to Tong and asked if we could have the same girls for the tour the following morning. Needless to say, he was happy to oblige.
The next morning, we were met by the same smiling faces at our hotel and the day tour began. We visited some great areas within the city and even had treats waiting for us at the market. Again, the girls did a terrific job at maneuvering morning rush hour traffic.
I can give my highest recommendation to XO Tours and Tong! My wife and I had a great time and will take another XO tour when we return to Saigon. Thank you for the memories and the fantastic photos that you sent to us.

Best you ever done - Did foodie tour and what a great night it was, Tien & Dung were great guides but not only that they were great people who we will stay in contact with as they made us feel so well come and we had a lot of fun with them, the tour took you to a lot of places you would not normally see as a tourist, food was fantastic and it was great to see how the local people really live and eat, Tung runs a fantastic company full of great people who really love there work. This is a must do tour.
Regards Greg & Caroline (Tasmania)

Wonderful Tour with a Personal Touch - I emailed back and forth with Tong, the owner of XO Tours, prior to arriving in Saigon. I scheduled a solo Night Tour, since I was traveling alone and concerning that my shellfish allergy would make the Foodie Tour difficult or unenjoyable. Everything was set up after a round of emails back and forth. About a week ago I arrived, Tong reached out and let's me know that no one else has signed up for the Night Tour. He suggested I take the Foodies Tour, which is an extra 2 hours and about 30 bucks more expensive. But his suggestion is that I join a group that's quite large and he'll let me take this tour for the price of the original tour. I paid the normal price anyway, but was totally blown away by the amount of care he took to ensure I had a great time.

The tour itself is a mix of whimsy (riding on the back of a motorbike, driven by an impossibly cheerful Vietnamese girl), history lesson (we stopped at several key points between food stops for Tong to give us a bit of information) and authentic tasting menu (everywhere we went, we were the only tourists--so we really enjoyed local flavors).

The girls were motor-bike priestesses, guiding us safely in and out of the cacophony of Saigon traffic. They stayed with us at food stops, attending to our every need. And my taste, Nang, was awesome! I love listening to stories of her life in Saigon as we motored between stops.
As a solo traveler, I appreciated the opportunity to see the city with others and Tong was a great facilitator: making introductions, reminded us by name and the highlight for me was arranging an alternate dish for me at each stop that served shellfish. That level of attentiveness is the reason why I have sung their praises far and wide in the 3 days since I took the tour!

So you can't be on the fence after all these great reviews. I have only 2 words to say (although, repeatedly): DO IT, DO IT, DO IT!

Food tour even better! - My second XO tour this time with my wife. We took the foodie tour. Tons of fun, great food, and cold beer! Couldn't get much better. Driving in the rain at the end of the tour just added to the experience. Along with our tour was one single guy, and a family of 4 with teenaged boys. All had a great time.

Most fun we had in Ho Chi Minh City - We did the Saigon By Night tour.
The guides where outstanding, and the tour of the city was so much fun!!
If you are only in the city for a short time, this is a must to get the full Ho Chi Minh experience!!

Super Experience - Great service, great company and great food. Traveling on the bike might appear a little scary, but as other reviewers have mentioned, once you're on it - it's a breeze (The girls are very skilled at negotiating the traffic!). Perfect way to see the city. Very good value for money - would recommend!

XO Tours - Kudos to Tung Do who started XO Tours. Besides my visit to Cu Chi Tunnels (which I just had to do), this Foodie Tour is my most memorable! While expensive, it was well worth it. I noticed NO other tourists at all the stops we made (other than other XO tour groups dropping by). And the condiments that came with the food were by far the best I had. Thank you so much for even asking for some of that chilli salt that I so loved at our BBQ stop. I merely asked where I could buy some, and off they went to get me a bag! ? We had games along the way - so fun, and pics taken too. It's touristy.. BUT you want the pics. And, they are truly a hardworking bunch. Congrats again, Toss! May you extend this to Hanoi soon, I will jump on another scooter there to eat until I drop. =)

Foodie Tour - Amazing! - There's not much to say that other reviewers have said. If you have any apprehensions about riding on the back of a motorbike, don't: once you're on it, you realize that everyone is going so slowly that it is actually quite safe, and while the traffic looks like chaos, there is a method to it, and these girls know it.

I took one other food tour while in Vietnam, and one thing I liked in particular about this one is that they assume a base knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine abroad: no pho, ban xeo, bahn mi... things I already know and have tried. At the same time, it wasn't about testing your limits, either-- sure, I tried some frog, but other than that, most of the meats and seafoods were relatively mainstream by western standards, just different preparations we might not know how to order when first landing down in Vietnam.

We were a bit hesitant about the price at first, which is very high by Vietnamese standards, but by the end of the tour we were 100% convinced it was worth every...uh... dong.

Unique experience I've ever had - The girls (bikers) are so niceeeeee,funny and warm. We took foodie tour, the tour is about to explore some of district such as Chinatown, district 7 (the place for rich people in Vietnam) lots of apartments in this area, district 4 and etc. hmmm anyway this tour is also about to eat and eat hehe so save some space for your tummy before starting the tour. Fully recommended!

The Highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City - We booked the Saigon by night tour and we were collected from our hotel promptly by 2 delightful young girls who then took us on our tour and we met up with Tung and his advance team who were all delightful! Tung convinced us to change to the Foodie Tour at no extra cost and although I was dubious at first this was such great fun. The whole group of staff are so professional and the tour is organized so well. They are all so charming and friendly and really informative and the food is fantastic. You eat things you wouldn't dream of eating but everything was so tasty and served to us by the girls who drove us around town and saw to our every need. This tour is a must so don't hesitate!!

Anyone can do this! - Family of 6, we booked both the HCM day tour and night tour.
Both tours were fantastic and provided a different view of the city in both day light and switching to night.
Dont be afraid of riding among the traffic: as hectic as it looks the road rules work! The girls never speed or do anything to put you (or themselves) in danger: primarily sticking to the right of the road so faster cars and bikes can wizz past you.
The day tour is recommended as you can get your bearings of the city and suss out what you would like to check out more indepth another time. You are taken to main sites in HCM but also to places that most tourist groups are either rushed through due to numbers or dont even get to experience!
The night tour we were driven a long distance, stopping at times to be shown a site/history. The ride is fun and exciting: you feel surprisingly right at home among the hustle of the traffic. The girls themselves and tour guide were incredibly helpful, funny and engaging: they genuinly want you to experience the 'real' HCM!
Would do again in a heart beat.

Should be on the 1000 things to do before you die lists. - I haven't had so much fun for years. Did the daytime sights tour first - very interesting and great explanation of the places you visited by Tung Do and the girls - but the Saigon by night was awesome. If you only do one, go out at night. Zipping safely through the manic HCMC traffic is an unforgettable experience. By the end you will be smiling and shaking your head with disbelief at what you've just done.

A must-do in Saigon - XO tours is a must do in saigon if you want to see the sights and get amongst the traffic and chaos that is saigon. My wife and i organized the sights tour before we left australia and all details were prompt and proffessional. Having been to saigon before walking around sightseeing can be draining because of the heat. XO picks you up from your hotel, girls who are in traditional costumes are fantastic, my wife who was apprehensive about climbing on the back of a bike and getting amongst the chaotic traffic was quickly put at ease by the girls and within five minutes on the bike was relaxed and at ease chatting and taking in saigon sights. The tour takes in all the major points of interest with tung the owner of XO meeting you at each stop and providing history and details of each site. The information given made the tour so much more interesting, we also went out of district one to china town and market (great). Along the way we stopped for a drink stop of sugar cane juice fromlocal vendor (tasty). One thing we loved was that youwere not taken to any souvineer places ect where you were hassled to buy, all in all a great experience being in the middle of all the action, this is a great tour for all ages. thankyou Tung and girls for such a great experience, next time we will do the foodies tour.

XO Tours - The Best! - This tour is everything you are reading and more!
The bike ride, although terrifying, is a must. The traffic in Saigon is unlike any in the world...and you will experience it first hand. I didn't want a video...we never watched these later. But half-way through the tour I wish I had arranged for one to be made. You cannot convey the real traffic experience to anyone - still photos do not do it justice.
Tung, the owner was great. As he was raised in the US, his reflections on Vietnam were very interesting to me. He also incorporated "western" standards of safety.
We went to places a tourist would NEVER go to on their own.
The rest of our Vietnam experience was with Vietnam Today Travel and they were EXCELLENT -however this foodie tour was a real highlight of our travels!

Went for 'Saigon At Night' and it was simply wonderful! Two Thumbs Up!! - I just came back from Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam and we took 3 tours during our stay there. 1 day Mekong Caibe & Vinh Long tour, 1/2 day Cu Chi Tunnel tour and 'Saigon At Night' XO tour. Out of the 3 tours here, I'd rate XO tour the highest as we had a wonderful time during this tour.

My friend and I decided to take this tour on our last night in Saigon after reading rave reviews on tripadvisor and we were definitely not dissapointed. We were brought to places outside of District 1 and learned a lot about Vietnam and the people there. The young and pretty XO girl that was assigned to me was very kind, gentle and friendly. Most of the Vietnamese people I met before that were rude and temperamental so it's good to know not all Vietnamese are like that. Fortunately for me, the XO girl knew how to speak Cantonese and Mandarin (her English was good as well) and being a Cantonese speaker myself, it was another plus.

Mr Tung who is the director and owner of Xo Tours is a nice person and he explained to us clearly things that were happening in Vietnam, brief history, the many disctricts in Ho Chi Minh, the big gap between the poor and the rich in Vietnam, etc. I also learned from my friend that Mr Tung & his XO guide bought him a drink without extra charge when my friend was asking where to buy a drink. My friend wanted to pay them back for the drink but they didnt want his money. Excellent service here.

As for food, we were given a choice to choose a meal out of 3 options. I chose Banh Mi but Mr Tung went beyond my expectations and ordered an extra meal for us (xoi ga i believe) for us to try. And during dinner, my XO guide offered to buy me another drink when i finished my first drink. Two thumbs up here.

I highly recommend this tour to anyone going to Ho Chi Minh for a holiday. It was definitely my favorite time while in Ho Chi Minh and I'll be recommending this to my friend's brother and sister-in-law when they visit Ho Chi Ming next year. Thanks to Mr Tung and the XO tour girls for giving us the best time there on our last night!

For foodies and more - Great fun seeing the various districts and trying local foods and conversing w/our scooter guides. We met a family from Latvia and had a great time even with the rain. Highly recommended.

Foodie tour in Saigon! Solo Female - I booked xo tours very excited to attend the foodie tour by night. My guide promptly was outside my hotel on time and I also opted for the extra rider to capture my adventure!

The tour is definitely great with a few nice stops along the way. We enjoyed bun bo hue at a local food stall where we also met the owner of XOTours - a very nice Vietnamese-American who went back to Vietnam to open up his own business.

My tour guide was named Nga - we got along great! A young feisty sweet girl with tons of personality. It was amazing riding along the streets with her! So FUN to be able to get on the back of a motorbike here!

Overall - great tour and I wanted to book a city tour the next day but they were all booked! PRE-BOOK EARLY!!!

Foodie Tour is a Fun, Unique Experience - I highly recommend the foodie evening tour. You spend about half the time on the bike and the rest at various street-side eateries tasting all the delicacies (and beer) you can stomach. For me, the highlights of the tour were the food, seeing different neighborhoods, and talking with the women.

First, food. We had 10 different types of meat over the course of 4 hours. There's seafood, beef, pork, and even some things you probably didn't know that people ate. The tour guides explain everything, and it's a really great way to sample a wide variety of Vietnamese cuisine.

Second, the neighborhoods. You see several neighborhoods in this tour, including Chinatown, an upscale part of Saigon, a part where the lower-middle class lives, etc. The city is really neat seen from the back of the motorbike, and I'm not sure how we would have gotten to all these neighborhoods without this tour. For me, it really opened up the city and made it come alive.

Last, the ladies. I travel a fair amount, and 9 times out of 10, I'm interacting with men---male drivers, male tour guides, etc. I found it refreshing and insightful to get a female perspective on life in Vietnam. You're on the back of a motorbike with one woman all night, and the topics range from personal life to politics to school to ambitions and so forth.

For those worried about the safety aspect---the drivers are all very good, and they don't go that fast (maybe 40 mph max). You also wear helmets. If you have the chance---I highly recommend this tour!

The best way to start in Saigon - Book The Foodie tour! you will be so please you did, and get the camera on helmet, you really want to show this to everyone back home!!!

My wife and I, booked The Foodie Tour during our 3 nights stay in saigon and it was amazing it was the best thing we did in saigon.
Saigon traffic is one of the craziest in the world and with this tour you will experience this at first hand, the food is delicious and is a great introduction to some of vietnam best dishes.
All drivers are women that mean you always feel safe on the bike.
They look after you like a king the service you get from them is second to none.

Thank you Tung Do, Ding and Ting for an unforgatable experience.

A great introduction to Saigon - A great introduction to Saigon and it's variety of street food.
We pre booked the Foodie tour for our first evening in Saigon (first in Vietnam) and were so glad we did, the tour is like a one on one guided tour with your lovely driver as your guide. There were only seven of us on the tour that evening, which gave us an opportunity to more than just say hello to each other. As well as the food we had a tour of a number of districts of the city and had a glimpse of how the have's and the have not's live.
The owner manager, Tung also accompanies the tour, giving us background information on the food and the places we visited. The food as good and surprisingly varied, but the real stars of the show are the girls. They are fun, friendly and really tell you a lot about life in the city and their lives in general. Thanks for a great evening,
Tim & Kathy
If you only do one tour whilst in HCMC make it an XO tour

Don't leave Saigon without (doing) it! - In any city I visit, a foodie tour is always a must. Not only does it allow me to savor the most authentic of local cuisine, but it also gives me the chance to experience a slice of ordinary life as the locals go about. In Saigon, they do just that and more - riding atop a motorbike, that is! Just as I told the other tourists who took the same night activity with me, the experience is both empowering and eye-opening. Since motorbikes outnumber 4-wheeled vehicles by a ratio of 10:1 in this place, riding one gives the guest a different view of the road. But enough of that, the star of the whole thing is the food. From hot flavorful noodle soup (not "pho") to delectably grilled meat and prawns to spicy & delish seafood with a dash of sweet dessert creatively presented in front of my eyes, Four hours seem to pass by so quickly. And with the help of very friendly and well-spoken Vietnamese ladies as guides, what more can I ask for? A very knowledgeable tour leader! And that's where company owner Tung enters the picture. This American-sounding guy gives everyone a clear and witty description of each and every important pit stop.

So if you plan to spend a vacation - however long or short - in Saigon (or Ho Chi Minh City if you will), don't give XO Tours a miss. Otherwise, you'll regret long after once you read all the glowing reviews here.

By the way, here's a big shoutout to my wonderful guide Phuong who was just perfect!

one of the best decisions ive made - was a little apprehensive at first because i was going for the tour alone but decided to go with it in the end..and im so glad i did because i thoroughly enjoyed the tour. it was raining slightly but it only added to the "romanticism" of exploring hcmc at night. Mr Tung addressed all of us by name and I thought that was very nice because not many people would take the effort to remember everyones names. We were given bite sized information about different locations in the city and I learned so much that I wouldn't have otherwise learned if I hadn't gone on the tour

However the highlight of the tour really was my guide - Thu. She was really friendly and it like hanging out with a friend. Her English was excellent and even though I was alone, I never really felt lonely.

I think XO tours is one of the must-dos in Ho Chi Minh

Should be top of your To Do list - A phenomenal tour, not to be missed. I was really impressed with the professionalism and organization of this tour - everything happened so smoothly. A great way to experience the real Ho Chi Minh City as the tour covers not only District 1 but a bunch more. My highlight was probably eating an incredible dinner cooked by a street vendor and eating among the locals at a street side sugarcane juice stall. If I had had time I would have done another tour with XO. Not to be missed!

A must do - You simply must take at least one of the tours that XO offers when in Saigon.

My family of four including 20 year old daughter and 16 year old son absolutely loved our tour and we all agree that it was a highlight of our Vietnam trip.

We were booked to do a morning sights tour as well however we missed our connecting flight the previous night as our Scoot plane from Australia was late into Singapore. If the night tour that we ended up doing was any guide, we really missed a great experience not doing the day tour.

We did the night tour instead of the Foodie tour as we are a family of vegetarians and it was great.

I was a little worried when I booked that the girls would be able to carry me as I am over 130kg however I was assured that it would be fine and it was. We were collected from our hotel on time by four friendly girls and we were soon scooting around 7 very different districts.

It was a great experience being in amongst all the other scooters on the streets of HCMC and didn't I attract some attention from the locals, being a large westerner being driven around by a smaller Vietnames girl. Everyone was staring and having a laugh. It was great fun.

The vego food was awesome and we ate it at a roadside stall washed down by freshly crushed sugar cane drink.

At the end of our trip, we got delivered safe and sound back to our hotel with memories to treasure for the rest of our lives. Don't think twice, just book it!

Experience not to be missed- Saigon At Night - I researched this activity previously, and just before booking, the owner replied to my email, letting me know that it was covered by their insurance as well, which was very good.
We got collected at our hotel (4 adults, family group). The girls were all smiley, and very friendly. However, they went over the serious stuff first, about helmets, how to sit on the back etc, then we were off.
What an experience, going through all the streets. The girls, true to their word, went at a good pace, with safety in mind. We met another couple and the owner, who joined us for the remainder of the trip. My driver, talked all the time, pointing things out, but also chatting about things in general, her English was very good.
Half way through, we stopped at a street restaurant, where there were seats waiting for us, and we had a meal (which was not expected). The good thing about this, I have been on other trips before, where the guides left you to eat along. But, the girls joined us, and the chatting continued. I liked this, as we got to talk with the others as well.
The trip continued again, just as good.
We got collected at 1750, and got dropped off just after 2100. Well worth the money, I would do it again, and certainly recommend it to others.
The owner, Huong, took heaps of photos throughout the night, and we retrieved them a few days later via email.
Fantastic experience, thank you XO Motorbike Tours.

Foodie tour - a must do in HCMC - I think all the other positive reviews highlight what a great tour this is in HCMC. I did the foodie tour which was very informative and extremely fun. I was actually surprised how good the food was, as I was a bit skeptical and hesitant at first. Some of the first time eats for me were goat, frog, quail, balut, and other types of shellfish. I didn't have a single dish that I didn't like or thought was gross. A must do tour...you won't regret it!!

Worth the drenching - Was a bit apprehensive booking tour as had never ridden a motorbike and everything I read about the traffic was a bit off putting. But glad I took the plunge on the reviews by other non-bikers who had taken tour. It was very safe and despite being drenched from the rain that started after the first stop it was a very enjoyable and tasty few hours.

The Foodie Tour - a must do when in Ho Chi Minh City!! - We read about XO tours on Trip Advisor as they were ranked no.1 of things to do when in Ho Chi Minh City. This is definitely true!! We did the foodie tour which is the longest and most popular tour. Our guides took us all over Ho Chi Minh where we got to sample loads of delicious food and also learned about the history and day to day lives of the city's people. Our guides were lovely, very good drivers and very open and friendly - you can ask them anything (and they will have lots of questions for you too). XO tours gives you an insight into Ho Chi Minh that you won't get anywhere else and lots of great memories to take away. Highly recommended!!

Unreal!! Amazing - We did this last night, and it was unreal!! The girls were amazing and it was really cool hearing about the life of a girl about the same age as me growing up in Vietnam. We did the night tour and I ate the best Vietnamese sandwich ever!!! Went to some really cool places and saw amazing things. I would recommend everyone coming to Saigon do this!! From Mel and Lewis!!

Ho Chi Minh City Highlight - We did the dinner tour. Simply stated, it was the highlight of our long weekend in Saigon. We were picked up in the hotel lobby by our driver/guides, two cute and bubbly young gals who immediately put us at ease. After a quick safety brief, we rode off to the first of 4 eateries for the soup course and to meet the other 6 folks in our tour group...2 aussie gals and a family of 4 from Malaysia. The whole evening was delicious, educational, and entertaining. The tour company owner , Tung Do, came along, taking time to explain all the little cultural details of each course, with a little Viet history thrown in. It was a great evening and we'll be sure to try the city tour next time we're in Saigon.

Fantastic tour with the greatest company! - I had only one full day to explore Saigon and after talking with Tung on the phone from the states, I chose both the Sights tour AND the foodie tour. I am SO completely impressed with Tung, his guides, and the way he runs his company. He runs the most thorough and detail oriented company- from the best staff and customer service, to the most knowledgable and cultural tours...and with complete follow thru on photos, videos, and goodbye souvenirs. I can honestly say that if every company ran this way, the world would be a better place :)

I always felt safe on the scooter and had a different guide driver for the morning and night tour- both delightful, fun, knowledgable young women (Ans and Huang). For the site tour, I saw all the main sites in town, and during the tour, Tung met me at each spot and gave me all of the important history. The drivers take photos of you and quickly become your friends. It was a great experience.

For the Foodie tour, I had a complete blast. I was worried that doing 2 tours in a day would be too much touring, too much scootering, or even boring, but just the opposite! I couldn't wait for them to come pick me back up at night. We met Tung at all the spots, and again, he explained so many interesting facts about the area, the culture, and the cuisine. Even though it was sprinkling that night, they offered me a poncho and as the drivers are so experienced, it never felt unsafe. I loved the foodie tour- you really get to see and taste the cultural foods of the country. We went to countless spots and not only see great areas, but also get to try the amazing and different food. I ate until I couldn't eat anymore- ranging from beef soups, to goat, scallops, and frog, and even though I have very sensitive intestines, I never got sick. I did however get incredibly full (pace yourself).

As I was a solo traveler, I decided to splurge and hired the video guys (Lun and Thai) to film both tours for me. Having them join us really added to the trip- they are great guys and lots of fun- and I never worried about taking photos or videos. I was able to enjoy the moment knowing that they were taking care of recording it for me.

The drivers/guides, video guys, and Tung all made me feel incredibly safe and as if I was traveling with friends. I had such a fun time with them that I was sorry to part ways. They know the best spots and the best ways to get there. Since I have been back, Tung sent me photos from the trip and my requests for songs for my videos. I would give them 100 stars if possible. You cannot go wrong with any tour with Tung's XO company.

Immerse yourself in the seemingly chaotic traffic ! - Ho Chi Minh by motorbike...I never thought I would persuade my 8 year old daughter to come with me. When we first arrived in HCMC she refused to leave the hotel ! It was absolutely amazing...the rules of the road make much more sense when you are part of the ride.... We had two lovely girls riding with each of us as pillion passengers and also selected for the video so another motorbike following our every move. Our tour was totally flexible so we started with a meal in a restaurant that wouldn't have gotten a second glance from me...( because I don't know very much about the cuisine ) Turned out to be extremely tasty, fresh food. The place was packed with people....not many tourists which I think is a good sign. Then off to shop. I didn't want to go to the markets so we went to Saigon Tax Center and because Nha was with me, I got some gorgeous lacquerware for a really good price. My husband had also wanted to do the tour but had to stay back with our other daughter. Nha very generously did a swap after about one and a half hours so that he could enjoy the experience too...brilliant service. The girls are very good guides and it feels as though they truly enjoyed their time with us. My daughter adored her guide and they were 'best friends'...having a big hug at the time to say goodbye. I would encourage anyone to try this tour and would do it again in a flash.

Best tour in Vietnam - We had an amazing tour on one of our last nights in Vietnam. We had done a couple of other food tours in Hanoi and this was so much more fun. Our drivers, Phuong and Hoang were great. They helped with helmets and even had an extra large one ready ;-) While on the motorbike they pointed out interesting things about the city and were answered any questions we had. They were both excellent drivers and I even stopped holding on super tightly. Then when we sat down for food, they both made sure we had plenty of our favorites, quickly replaced empty beers and even got us to try the "hopping chicken". We got to try a lot of different foods that you normally wouldn't have found just wandering around. Our second food stopped it started raining, hard. They moved us inside but our group decided outside was more fun so they moved tables around to help protect us from the rain and they gave us ponchos when we left. The beer was free flowing, the food was extremely tasty and the girls were great fun... couldn't ask for a better tour.
Oh and ladies, when the girls offer the restroom, use the one they offer.

Foodie tour was a good as its- a unique view of the city reputation and it's cultures - I was quite skeptical of a tour where I was the passenger on a bike but this was a perfect way to experience a fascinating, developing city.
The guides were friendly and fun, the food was incredible but the insights into different sides of the city (the old china town, the impoverished areas, the sanitized zones populated by foreign workers) were stunning. I'd recommend it to anyone.

Fantastic tour, informative about the city and culture, amazing lady drivers and brilliant food - We had a brilliant time on the foodie tour, we had a little rain but it was no problem - ponchos were at the ready! We booked for three adults and all of us have said the same. We tried food that we wouldn't normally order in a restaurant, so it was a great opportunity to try lots of different dishes and have some fun too with a couple of games / challenges! We've received some great photos from the tour too and we went for the video option too which is worth it. I really enjoyed seeing a different side of the city too, eg in district 7 - we wouldn't have had the insight given on the tour if we had just visited ourselves - really interesting and made us want to learn even more about Vietnam culture.

Totally recommend both the "Sights" and "Foodie" tours - I had booked the Foodie tour several months ago, thinking it would be a great way in tasting and trying local food and I wasn't wrong. Both my husband and daughter are not that adventurous when it comes to trying new foods hence by joining this tour and with the help and encouragement of the lovely girls, we all got to try lots of different dishes including frog, goat, crab, morning glory to name but a few.

As we only had one full day in Saigon due to it being the entry and departure point for our Cambodian holiday, I decided to book the "sights" tour as well at the last minute. This was a great move as it gave us a great introduction to Saigon and Vietnam. While I am sure we could have visited the sights using the lonely planet book, having Tuang meet us at each stop to explain was so much more informative. We also got to taste "street food" which I am sure we would not have been game enough to try as very conscience of not upsetting our stomachs so early into our trip.

Being on the back of the bikes was fun, never felt in any danger, and after traveling from NZ the day before, it was great just being out in the fresh air, enjoying the warm weather.

The rain stopped just 15 minutes before my foodie tour started. PERFECT - THANK YOU. I thought my foodie tour would get canceled because it rained hard starting at 4pm. It stopped raining only past 5pm, when my foodie tour was to start at 520pm. It was the BEST experience. The rain helped cool the humid HCM weather, and it was a nice and cool tour.

1st, different food selections in different districts. Word of advice. You may be tempted to eat everything on sight in the first 2 eating stops. Don't! Leave space in your stomach for the other eating stops.

2nd, the foodie tour is not just about food, but also the different sights that are not touristy: chinatown, side streets of the poorer districts to the new district 7.

3rd, I don't know how the female guides maintain their poise the whole tour. For over 4 hours they maintained their cheerfulness, their infectious smile, their personalized service.

4th, aside from experiencing the different "non-tourist" eating spots and the explanations given by both the female guides/drivers and the very informative explanations provided by the owner himself, you get to experience how HCM traffic gets during rush hour from a motorcycle point of view.

Again, this is an excellent tour. Next time, I won't eat lunch. I need more stomach space for the foodie tour.

Exceptional experience! Great fun - I have no words to express my feelings after the Foodie Tour!
