First of all the idea is amazing, it was something that I felt I was missing in Cambodia and here in Vietnam, the understanding of what and how people eat here. I wanted to try the food so much but I was always scared to eat without knowing what I'm eating or without being sure it is fresh... 
Second of all the girls, you get picked up by spicy, intelligent and fun girls! They were amazing!!!! I fell in love with Ho Chi Minh city because of them! The conversation with them was great! I learnt so much, things I could never learn on my own. And things you cannot read on the internet! Things about the everyday life! They were so nice, kind, warm, intelligent, funny and generous.  I wanted the tour to go on and on. Oh and they were very good drivers!!! At the beginning I was scared and after 2 min on the bike I felt completely safe.
Third, the opportunity to try new things I have never eaten before and to find out it is very good!
And forth, the amazing service you get from the beggining till the end from the entire crue involved! I think the schedule was very good, with the stops on the way, I enjoyed so much talking to local people that know English, the girls took care of everything for us from a to z without missing the smallest detail, we felt like its important to all of them to make us feel good. And after traveling in south east asia for 5.5 months i have to say this is not an obvious thing!
It was a pleasure!
Thank you soooo much, Tung Do and the amazing girls!

no regrets - Had the intention of doing the Foodie tour but chose to do the Saigon by Night tour and I have no regrets. We were picked up at our hotel. It was drizzling at the start but it did not stop the fun and we were provided with ponchos. They also took pictures of and sent it to us.

The ladies were great. They spoke good English and they knew how to engage in conversation with us throughout the trip. I learned how to read the district signs!

The traffic may seem to be a chaos but do not worry. As much as I do not think females are the best drivers in the world (I sense lots of rage), it is an exception for woman in Vietnam. The ladies maintained a steady speed and I did not worry one bit of falling off the bike :P

The tour was informative and the owner, Tung, met up at different stops to feed us with information about Ho Chi Minh including juicy ones. We had one stop to have dinner and it was street food which was DELICIOUS and my tummy did not complain the day after.

This is something worth trying when you're at Ho Chi Minh. My hats off to you Tung.

An absolute highlight of our time in Saigon - We read the trip advisor reviews and decided to book the city tour for our first morning in Saigon. We were thrilled with our tour, the girls picked up our group of 12 and gave us a truly enjoyable and memorable tour. We loved this tour and will go so far to say that it's a must do in Saigon,,

Great time on a 2-wheel tour - This tour was one of the highlights in the city. We had great tour on the back of motorbike. The female guides were lovely and passionate. They know every corner of the city and they are also masters of the local food. What a great tour!

Must do - Just fantastic tour.. Different than any other tour that I've done. It was fun and safe. The food was a bit weird at times but i guess this is part of the experience. The drivers were very friendly. We even got a bit of rain during the tour, but it was still great.

Fantastic Experience!! - This was the best trip we booked whilst in HCMC. We chose the night tour and were picked up from hotel around 6.30pm at night. The girls were all lovely and could speak very good English. They drove us through all the various districts in the city, giving us appropriate information on the way. We stopped half-way through for supper at a local road-side seating/eating area, where we ate a lovely local dish with our motorcycle girls. Photographs were taken and then we were on our way. They were very careful drivers and we learned and saw things that we probably would never have managed on our own. This tour ended at the back of 9pm and the girls dropped us off at our hotel again.

I would have no hesitation in recommending this trip - go for it!

Best time in HCMC - This tour is undoubtedly the best tour I've done. You can see parts of the city otherwise you wouldn't see, and even people living in HCMC never visit. The food is very good, varied and abundant. Thanks to Phuong (the driver) I heard about hundreds of things about the city and made the tour was very entertaining and useful, apart from fun. Congratulations to Tung for the idea of ​​the company and the tours by bike inn HCMC and thanks a lot to Phuong for sharing her knowledge of the city and making the tour very enjoyable.

Great start to our Vietnam trip - Organized the Saigon by night tour before leaving NZ, fantastic communication and an even better experience once we were off on the back of the bikes, the traffic is simply mind blowing but never felt unsafe at all, the girls all spoke good English and the owner met us at various locations giving good information on the workings of Ho Chi Minh city. A perfect start to our trip.

Best time ever! - What an amazing time! You must go in with an open mind. This is not an upscale dining experience. What it is, is a local and cultural experience that blew my mind! The girls that drove us around were so cute, fun, and smart.

Best time in HCM - My wife and myself have rated this as one of the top four highlights of our trip to Vietnam and Cambodia. The girls are great with lively chat and knowledge, and the route chosen to HCM highlights more than satisfied our curiosity of the city. They are great drivers in a city of surprising cohesive traffic flow. This is well organized and is a fun time for all ages. Hang on and away you go.

Informative, Entertaining, and Excellent Food - I've never been on a tour of any sort before, so I have no frame of reference to make a comparison. However, I can say that this tour was outstanding.

The staff were incredibly nice, professional, knowledgeable, and spoke English. The tour was safe, fun, and visited many areas in Ho Chi Minh City that tourists probably rarely venture to on their own. However, we didn't visit touristy areas. Rather, we saw parts of Vietnam that were very local and not easy to find without a local guide.

In all, we visited three places where food and drinks were served. At each one we were given ample portions, encouraged to try everything, and shared stories and jokes with the guides and other guests. Along the way, the tour operator met us at various locations (some that didn't serve food) to provide us with some insight into Vietnam in general and Ho Chi Minh City in particular. The tour operator spoke fluent English, has a great sense of humour, and seemed to genuinely enjoy hanging out with tourists.

The food was outstanding and not the ordinary run-of-the-mill Vietnamese cuisine. (e.g. Pho and salad rolls.) Aside from normal dishes, like barbecued squid, we also tried some unique items, like duck fetus. (The guides even peeled our shellfish for us. A big plus if you're a messy childlike eater like me.)

Each guest was matched with a tour guide and a motorbike. We had ten guests, ten tour guides, the tour operator, and two other tour operators who provided assistance where necessary. The tour guides drove us through the city, spoke with us in English as we traveled around, answered our questions, and provided a very comfortable atmosphere.

At one point, the motorbike I was on broke down. One of the tour operators quickly rode up behind us, swapped motorbikes with us, and we quickly caught up to the rest of the group. The tour operator showed up at the next stop with the motorbike so I'm assuming he was able to fix it without issues.

The cost was $60 USD per person, payable at the end of the tour. We also tipped our guides about $7 USD since they were so great. They dropped us off and picked us up at our downtown hotel. In total, the tour went from about 5:30pm to about 10pm.

All in all, I highly recommend this tour.

best tour in town! - the "Foodie" tour is an unique experience when in saigon... if you are a fan of unique, original ways to explore a new city, and enjoy blending in with the locals - doing what they do, eating what they eat - this is the way to go!... highly recommended, will do this every time in town!..

Foodie tour #1 experience of vietnam - XO Tours are defiantely #1 MUST DO tours while in saigon. My fiance and I booked the foodie tour to do for the 2nd night upon arrival in saigon. The tour was amazing, Mr Tung and all the girls driving us on the motorbikes were great, it was such an authentic way to experience local saigon food and culture. The traffic is crazy hectic, but when you on the bikes with the girls you feel so safe, so if you feel nervous about getting on a bike, dont be its soooooo much fun !!!
Tip for anyone thinking about booking with XO tours DO IT!!! you will kick yourself if you don't. Also do it early in your stay, it arms you will lots of local knowledge.
A big thankyou to Mr tung and the girls , keep doing what your doing because it is truly great

olivia & nathan

Brilliant - We did this tour on our first night in Vietnam, so braving the traffic on the back of a motorbike was a little daunting. From the outset we were made to feel confident in the ability of the girls, and the very first stop were reassured the food was to die for.....The whole experience was amazing, we would not have seen this side if saigon if not for this tour. It was my husbands birthday so a cake was arranged too (also delicious but difficult to fit in after the abundance of food!) The girls were fun and could definately handle a person of any size on the back of their bike. I would love to do another XO tour.

Amazing Tour - This food tour was the highlight of my trip to Vietnam.
Girls on scooters picked us up from our hotel, they were energetic, confident and sociable which made the experience unforgettable. we traveled around on the backs of their scooters to many districts around the city stopping to have the most amazing food which we would have never had chosen to eat by ourselves. The girls peeled our prawns, cooked our chicken and frogs legs and even fetched us beers during our many feasts.
I would definately do it again, and recommend it wholeheartedly.

This is everything you need in Ho Chi Minh! - Wow! Just arrived back to our hotel from this tour and words cannot describe! This is THE BEST way you can 1: see the sights and districts of Ho chi Minh and 2: eat the best food that the Vietnamese people would eat, not western-ized Vietnamese food. The girls are soo friendly and professional and helpful. They really help you understand the areas, the traditions and the food. They really made this the great tour that it is.
Then there is the food! There are some adventurous foods for those, who like me, want to try things out of the ordinary! But all the food is all brilliant and I strongly suggest that any one traveling to Vietnam should do this! YOU SHOULD NOT MISS THIS! Josh from Hobart, Australia!

Top tour. - Can't really add anything new to what has already been said. This is an excellent tour that puts you right in the thick of things. The traffic in Saigon is amazing : the amount of traffic on the roads and the way it all seems to work, and then the fact that you are in the middle of it is quite special. The drivers are very careful and confident with excellent conversational skills. It gave us the confidence to do further motorbike riding in the country areas of Vietnam. Our holiday in Vietnam had so many highlights and this was one of the best. Other great tours for us were Saigon Hotpots, Taste of Hoi an, Hue adventure riders, and Hoi an motorbike adventures. Well done guys on a great tour.

The best "Saigon food sampler" available! - Without doubt, Saigon's #1 attraction is its unique and delicious food. I know - I live here, eat here everyday, and always enjoy my eating adventures.

The only real question is the best way to find and sample Saigon's amazing foods. My personal style is to travel the small streets and alleys of Saigon on a motorbike with my partner in search of the city's best hidden eatery gems. If you're a true travel and eating adventurist - do the same and enjoy!

But, last week I joined a "foodie tour" at XO Tours for an evening. What great fun! I think it offers most travelers the most convenient and fun way to enjoy Saigon's unique foods. Jump on a motorbike, and be shuttled around 6 Saigon neighborhoods, learn a bit about the history of each area, sample some very special and delicious foods, and be pampered by some sweet young local women along the way. What's not to enjoy! I can't think of a better way to spend an evening in Saigon.
Joe
www.eatingsaigon.com

A great night in Saigon - My fiance and I started our trip to Saigon immediately with the Foodie tour and it did not disappoint!

Prior to booking the trip, I was quite nervous about riding on a moped in the congested streets of Vietnam. If you feel this way, let me assure you right now- there is nothing to worry about!

The ladies drive wonderfully and they take great care in making sure that their passengers feel safe. Riding at night along the highways of HCMC, with some cool breeze blowing as I took in the sights, turned out to be one of the highlights of my South East Asian tour.

The food that we were brought to eat was fantastic. No stomach problems here at all! The conversations with the guides and Tung were also top notch, and the other guests on the tour with us were also lovely people.

My fiance and I went on to travel a few more countries after leaving Saigon, and we met lots of other travelers. We have very enthusiastically recommended XO tours to each and every one of them along the way.

This was truly a tour worth doing. I wish the ladies and Tung all the best!!! Thank you Anh and Nhi and Tung for your lovely company that night and for showing us a side of Saigon we would have never seen otherwise.

Enjoy!

Believe the hype! - Just to add to the already glowing reviews... this is definitely worth it on a trip to Saigon. Tung was very informative and took us all around the city. The girls were great entertainment and its amazing how they ride around the 'organized chaos' of Saigon, especially considering I am over 100 kgs!
My girlfirend and I both throughly enjoyed the tour and would also highly recommend the video as well. Tung put together an amazing video of us on the bikes going around the streets which just added to our whole experience.
Its a must!

Xo Foodie Tour - If you are in Ho Chi Minh City then this is a "must do" tour. I was so impressed with the ride through HCMC and to eat some incredible food in the market atmosphere and not in some western hotel. My guide and rider, Hoang, quickly gave me complete confidence she knew what she was doing as she guided us on 2 wheels through the busy streets. She was also a fantastic hostess throughout the whole evening. When next I am in HCMC, I am doing this tour again!!!!

Well-deserved #1 !!! - XO Tour is number 1 on TripAdvisor not without reason! They deserved it.

I participated in the tour on my first night in Saigon. Unfortunately, it was drizzling. But that did not reduce the amount of fun we had. Including myself, 10 of us turned up for the 4.5hr foodie tour.

Tung is wonderful! Not only did he bring us to good food places frequented by mostly locals (I think we were the only foreigners at every location), he also told us a little about each district, bringing us to district 7 just to show us another face of Saigon, as well as the spot couples go to get a little privacy & intimate time. So interesting and that tells me more about the family life in Vietnam. He also promptly sent photos of me after the trip.

The hosts were lovely & fun-loving too. I prefer not to use the word “driver” because they were much more than that, more like a friend. My host Hoang is my new friend, and we had long conversations about our countries and life. Even though it was drizzling most part of the tour, she was a careful driver (all of them are), I felt safe and didn't have to hold onto any part of the bike or her.

The food is another highlight. I love the grilled goat meat, both the desserts (coconut jelly & caramel pudding) and all the seafood!

Lucky for me I started my trip in Saigon and made this tour my first activity. I never got to try any of the food throughout the rest of my 11 days trip. I highly recommend XO Tour and if your trip starts in Saigon, best way to know Vietnam through their food culture.

Money well-spent!

Awesome Bike Trip! - This was a highlight of our 4D3N Vietnam trip. My Best Frn was not keen on this trip however I convinced her that Trip Advisor strongly recommend it & it’s a MUST! It was easy to arrange online & u get prompt reply from Tung. On the actual day ,we were promptly picked up by our riders in White Clean Vespa, mine was Ngan while I cant remember my Best Frn’s rider (Sorry). Both were so lovely as they were wearing Ao Dai's. We set off for the 1st spot of the tour ( where we met Tung ,the owner ) & met another group of 2 from HK (New founded Frns) . We had a truly great night riding through the streets, while talking to our riders, to many locations to eat excellent food with the locals. Esp at the stop in District 4,it was my favourite, the scallops were divine!
XO Tour is very well organised motor bike agency and Tung the owner accompanied us throughout the tour and he has a wealth of knowledge on his country . On every stop we make, we get to learn about different districts in the city from his humorous yet informative narrative.
I notice he is always ahead of us at every spot we stop , ensuring all is running smoothly and everyone is having a good time, as well as taking photos which will be emailed to you within 1 week after the trip.

In this 3.5hrs tour , u not only get to enjoy the food, drinks, making new friends & also get to engage in conversation with the gals & other tour guests which is great! Not forgetting the night riding- it was so much fun. I felt very safe on the bike as all the riders are so used to this and are experienced. Just do it, you won't regret it, I'll be there again on my next Vietnam trip on another tour with XO Tour !

Had a blast! - My friend and I did the Foodie Tour and the Shopping Tour. We had a blast!! Our drivers were fantastic - their driving was safe, their English was great and they were super fun! I can't say enough good things about the drivers - I was a pretty stiff passenger on the back of the bike but my driver really put me at ease (thanks Bing!). The Foodie Tour stops were really yummy...this coming from a person who is a picky eater. It was really fun having a number of XO Tours staff with us, including the owner Tung - no one else had signed up for the tour with us so we essentially had a private tour. But it was nice to have more people along with us. We got to eat food we hadn't yet had (despite already having been in Vietnam for two weeks) and neither of us got sick from any of it. It was great to eat with locals - we were the only foreigners in any of the locations! The Shopping tour was also good - it's a great way to effectively shop for products you want at great prices. The girls also helped us get really good deals! Know what you would like to shop for before going on this tour to maximize your time (ie specific brands of products, watches, etc). Also, don't bother bringing your camera - they were great about taking pics and emailing them after. Our time with the XO Tours drivers, Tung and staff was a highlight of our trip.

WOW! A not to miss experience! - I am a 67 year old female, traveling by myself and had done quite a bit of research on XO Tours. finally feeling adventurous enough to book it.(the foodie tour) I am so very glad I did. It was one of the highlights of my short visit to Ho Chi Minh City. Guides were very professional and learned an enormous amount about the culture of Vietnamese people in the foodie tour. Just wish I had enough days to do the other tours. A MUST do for anyone wanting to experience the vibrancy of this wonderful city.
As the owner of a travel agency in the US, I will definitely recommend to my clients.

Best thing to do in HCMC - As the first Dutch costumer of Mr.Tungs Foodie tour, I felt obliged to write something for my fellow Dutchmen.
But where do I start... Should I say something about the great food or about the several districts you'll pass, or maybe something about the wonderful girls that take really good care of you and make you instantly feel safe at the back of their motorbikes.

You should experience it for yourself, I'm sure you won't regret!

Exhilarating! - I went with my 65yo mom on the Foodie tour and found the experience very enjoyable. It was exhilirating (yet very safe) to ride on a motorbike and roam across 6 districts in Ho Chi Minh City. Our guides were very talkative and attentive to our needs, couldn't possibly ask for more. We got to see the many aspects of the city and the food was very interesting. The owner of the company is a Vietnamese Amercian, he's very hospitable and really understands what the western tourists are looking for. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who just wants to have some fun and enjoy every bit of what this city offers. FIve stars!

Best thing to do in HCMC! - I've been to Saigon twice now and this is definitely the best way to experience the city!

My husband and I booked the Foodie tour which lets you eat and drink your way across many districts of the city between 5:30 - 10:00pm. With Tung as our host, we flew around on the back of motos ridden by beautiful, ever smiling girls who brought laughter and fun to the whole evening. They even talked my husband into trying a duck embryo still in the egg and with those smiles who could resist!!
They food was great and we were stuffed by the 2nd stop but pushed on because it was one delight after another. My particular favorite were the grilled scallops - words cannot describe so you will have to try them for yourself. Unlimited beer was also included which is a bonus.

This is something that we will be recommending to all our friends.

The Real Vietnam Experience - Where do I start? We were picked up in our hotel by two lovely ladies on Vespas. It was raining and they had raincoats ready for us. Our first stop we ate a bowl of spicy beef noodle soup. And Tung started explaining things to us. Tung was very kind, funny and honest about Vietnam. From the moment he started speaking perfect English I knew this tour was going to be good.

I rode with Tien, and if you want a fun, cheerful and smart driver, ask for her. She speaks English better than most Vietnamese people I tried talking to.

Every stop Tung will give us the hard truth of the area (i dont want to spoil anything) very informative!

We had so much fun with this tour since we were joined by other guests as well. With us were 4 people from UK, 3 from California, and 1 from Singapore. The tour's price is very reasonable since not only did we get the honest view of Vietnam but friendships were formed, that is priceless!

The only thing I feel bad about is that I wish we did this tour on our first day here!

Best thing we did in Vietnam - Booking our night time foodie tour was the best thing my husband and I could of done to break the ice when we arrived in Vietnam. We had just experienced some pretty stressful traveling situations on the way to Vietnam, a trip we had planned for 9 months and thought we were unable to make the trip, so by the time we got there we were quite tired and stressed. This tour put all of that behind us and helped us to break into the street food of Siagon and start to enjoy our long awaited holiday. first the girls arrive on there scooters at your hotel, you get your own lady who is dressed in traditional Vietnamese costume. They then proseed to, and I might add safely, navigate the streets of Siagon and show you all the sights as they take you to your first food experience. You get to go to about 5 different food places and take in all of the districts on the way with stop offs, little facts and info here and there and lots of photo opps. It takes about 5 hrs Wich goes too quickly because your having so much fun. U dont get sick because they take you to all the better street vendors and all food and drinks are included of the one price. by far one of the better things we spent our money on during our stay in Vietnam. Oh and by the way get the reception of the accommodation u are staying at to ring and book them as then it doesn't get charged to your room as well. Enjoy!!

Family Experience with XO Tours - We simply rang up the company and they promptly picked us up the next morning for a fabulous bike tour of the city. They could not have been friendlier or nicer to us all expecially our 8 year old who had the best time. The girls were really lovely and spoke good English and the guide showed us some interesting places as well as he had an indepth knowledge of the areas. This was an excellent introduction to Ho Chi Minh city and gave us a good over view of the various areas to later visit. Thankyou ladies for a wonderful time and for taking care of us and our child.

A night to remember with XO foodie tour - This was a highlight of our month long Vietnam trip. It was easy to arrange online and we were promptly picked up by our riders, How (phonetic spelling) and Binh, who were so lovely and we set off for the meeting spot and first eating place. We met our interesting tour group and had a truly great night riding through the streets, while talking to our riders, to many locations to eat excellent food with the locals or to stop and learn about different districts in the city.
XO is very well organized and owner Tung is there every step of the way with his offsiders to ensure all is running smoothly and everyone is having a good time, as well as taking photos that are later emailed to you.
The girls look after you so well, sitting with you and organizing the food and drinks, and just talking to them and the other tour guests is great, let alone eating the food- delicious- and the night riding- so much fun. I feel very safe on the bike as all the riders are so used to this and are experienced. Just do it, you won't regret it, I'll be there again on my next Vietnam trip.

Lots of fun! - This tour was probably the highlight of my brief stay in HCM. I was picked up in the late afternoon from my hotel by a gorgeous girl in traditional Vietnamese dress who then took me to our meeting point on the back of her Vespa. From then on our group were expertly ferried around town tasting everything from soups to goat and onto shellfish! I had a great time. My rider An was lots of fun and between her and our guide Tung there wasn't a question they couldn't answer. When I was finally dropped off back at my hotel I was just disappointed it was all over! Pretty good value, recommended.

A highlight of my Vietnam trip - I booked this tour as a guy I met on another tour recommend it to me.
Great choice. I had an excellent time with my guide scooting all over the city. I did the 'foodie tour' last night the food was great and the tour also included other random Saigon facts!
Thumbs up from a solo traveler.

Great Times in Saigon - We did a tour with Tung's team in May, and had a great time. The tour was on time, perfectly organized, and a great way to see Saigon, safely on the back of a bike. The drivers/guides were really nice and excited to take us around. We saw the major sites, got some great history of each spot from Tung, and overall really enjoyed the day out. There isn't a better way to see the city.

XO Tours Rocks Big Time - I went on the Foodie Tour with XO Tours when I was in HCMC and it was the Highlight of my stay in Vietnam, and the most memorable moments I had in the 2 months I was away in Asia.
The Tour is very professional run and the Girls are just so much fun and full of excitement and information about HCMC. I was picked up at my hotel and taken on a foodie adventure of a life time, but it was also a very informative tour, we visited many places along the way on our foodie adventure.
We were met by the owner Tung at our first stop and he is just a really genuine guy, who absolutely enjoys what he does, and that makes a difference, The Girls who took us around all night drove very safely and nothing is a problem for them.They treated us like Kings all night. I didn't want the Tour to end.
When you are In HCMC you need to do this Tour to experience the real HCMC and experience the bustling city at night and the amazing food they have on offer, out in the other districts, away from the tourist street.
Thanks again for an amazing night and a memorable experience that will stay with me forever. I look forward to doing it again on my next visit.

Simply the best way to see Ho Chi Minh City - From the moment we were picked up from our hotel by the XO Girls it was obvious to us that the night was going to be amazing. Instantly once we hit the roads on the back of the Vespas we truly felt at one with the city, weaving in and out of traffic, up close and personal with the locals on their motorbikes, it was great fun. The food stops that Tung has selected were fantastic starting with Bun-Bo-Hue then Vietnamese BBQ and then various Seafood dishes and dessert the food was sensational. The XO Girls were dishing the food faster than you could eat it, ensuring you didn't go hungry!! The opportunity is there to try Balut eggs if you dare. Over the course of the night with the sun setting on HCMC and the street markets opening up you get a great feeling of how vibrant Vietnam is.
This is another tour that will definately be done once again, when we visit HCMC next, it may not be for a while, but Tungs company will be around for a very long time. Tung and the XO Girls=AMAZING!!
Dont hesitate this was a definate highlight of our 4 week Vietnam/Cambodia trip!

Food Tour - If you've seen Anthony Bourdain's No Reservations, this is the best amateur reproduction of that experience. I got to see parts of the city that I'd never ventured in, got more cultural and political education that I was planning on, and ate some of the most amazing food from my entire Vietnam experience. You do not have to be an extremely adventurous eater to enjoy this experience, but I am, and they really indulged me. The balut was amazing. To a westerner, the traffic laws in Vietnam appear to be non-existent, but the drivers were so great you could ride no handed. This is really a must do thing. I also had 2 friends go on the shopping tour and city tour after me, and they all said it was fantastic. Thanks so much!

One of the highlights of our Vietnam trip!!! - It is not surprising XO Tours is #1 in the HCMC tours list. My boyfriend and I did the Foodie tour and we both enjoyed it. Tung and all the ladies were awesome! The best way to experience 2 of what Vietnam is known for: delicious food and remarkable local hospitality. The food, which was eat-all-you-can (and believe me, I ate all i can!), was actually the bonus part!!! What's really great is that you get a city tour to other districts of Vietnam that few tourists venture into plus you do it the Vietnamese way - motorbike... I can't emphasize enough how wonderful the ladies were - we rode with Ngan and Ting (I apologize if incorrect - i have limited brain capacity when it comes to names) They give you information about HCMC and even some of their personal interests, experiences and opinions.. it was nice to get some insight into the Vietnamese way of living... and they do all that while driving the motorbike! what a skill! :-) All the ladies are friendly and lovely, really gives you the impression that they enjoy and love what they do...

I recommend this tour to anyone who visits HCMC :-)
Foodie Tour - What a great way to see Saigon at night. The motorbike ride was a blast and the different food was very interesting. I did this my first night in Saigon and glad I did.

Be part of the real Saigon! - Absolutely the best part of our whole trip - we got to eat, hear, feel and see the most authentic and local bits of Saigon...the girls were really friendly and have some funny sense of humor so endearing! And it's very safe to ride although I was looking forward to get to ride the bike :)! We went for the foodie tour and it's def more than the food - which I m not going to reveal coz you are so going to try it if you are planning to travel to hcmc! One suggestion: strong and empty stomach is key!

The best! - This was an utterly fantastic experience. I only wish I had booked a different tour for each day! My partner is a big, very tall man and we were initially worried he would be too heavy for the bike and our guide. No problem! His driver Nga (about a third of his size) scooted in and out of the city traffic like a moto GP driver (a very safe one anyway). We were the only two on the foodie tour, so we were very spoilt. My driver Binh was great - we chatted away about anything and everything while whizzing through the traffic. Loved all the food and drinks, and also enjoyed seeing different districts of Ho Chi Minh City. This really is a must do and I can't wait to come back again and do every tour offered. Plus, you get photos! Thanks Tung, and thanks Binh and Nga. You girls are the best!

I only have 1 day... - I had 1 full day in Saigon to relax and go back to work the next day...I researched tours on trip advisor and sure enough XO was highly rated. And all reviews are right on! Had a fun time learning about the different districts of HCM and seeing, eating and going where locals go! Tung, the owner of the tour, actually rides with us giving us his perspective of the city. He is fluent in English and overall just a nice guy who enjoys what he does. The drivers are friendly, courteous and so attentive! I can't wait to return and come back with some friends!

"Oh what a night............to remember forever" - We went on the Foodie Tour, we had a small group of fellow foodies which was just right. Tung and the girls are fantastic, the girls are just lovely, the food was awesome, the experience of being on the back of a motorbike on our 2nd night in Vietnam was exhilarating to say the least. Not once did I feel nervous on the bikes, either did my husband and 13yo son, you could not get the smiles off our faces. You get to see many parts of HCMC that you would not normally even venture to and Tung has many interesting things to tell you. The girls are so sweet, very caring and always trying to have a chat, although at times I found it a little hard to hear them over the traffic sounds, it is most definately one of the best if not the best tour I have ever done in all my years of travel. I wish Tung and the girls much success with the tours, which I know they will receive, as I believe Tung has got the right mix for an extremely successful future in tourism. An absolute must do for anyone visiting HCMC I can not recommend XO Tours enough, absolutely excellent in every way possible. We also had a DVD made of the tour and Tung even delivered it to us on our return to HCMC 6 weeks later, what more could you ask for, and the DVD was great, many happy memories to cherish forever. Thankyou Tung and Girls.

Great way to see the city and have life explained by a local - Seeing Ho Chi Ming by motorbike and with a local who speaks good English is a must. I've ridden on bikes around the city before, but being driven around with a guide to speaking English is much different. My guide (Phuong) was great and had a wonderful sense of humor. All the guides are attractive women in their twenties and enjoyable to talk with about life in Ho Chi Minh and Vietnamese society. I did the Saigon by night tour and next time will probably do the foodie tour. They really take you to the places that most foreigners don't see and with a personal guide you can learn a lot about life in Vietnam. I would recommend this trip to anyone. Also, they are very good drivers on the hectic streets of Ho Chi Mihn.

You won't regret booking this tour.

Wonderful Experience - We waited until we arrived in town to book the tour and they were starting to fill up for the week so we finished up booking the foodie tour for our last night in HCMC. The tour was great, the ladies were entertaining and accomodating and, the owner was very informative. The food was incredible and so different from anything I have had in Vietnam. Seeing the city from the back of a moped is a must. The tour was one of my favorite highlights of an incredible trip.

Best experience in HCMC! - This is the best way to break through the tourist traps and have a look at the "real" local foods as well as unique sights of HCMC. My wife and I did the food tour at night (our favorite) AND the sights tour during the day(also a GREAT tour but gets hot towards the end). I cannot stress enough how great, fun and authentic the tour guides are and how great of a guide the owner, Tung, is. Awesome guy! They take you to places every visitor would love to see but wouldn't even know about these places existing on their own. This is a MUST. We will do the food tour again next time we are back because it was so much fun :) Great job XO!

Do It! - This was a great night out and a fantastic way to see Saigon by night. The girls were all wonderful and Tung was very informative. Gives a great insight to the city and way of life here. Plus, the food was great! A truly wonderful experience.

A night out with the girls -X- cellent foodie tour - A must do in HCMC to get a real flavor of the local life in more ways than one!

Book on line a week in advance and pay at the end of the tour. 2 absolutely lovely girls dressed in traditional Vietnamese dress picked us up from our hotel and looked after us all evening. They are really careful and considerate drivers and negotiate the city traffic with consummate confidence. The tour takes you out to China Town night market and other outlying districts of the city that you wouldn't get to see as a tourist. This is not a gourmet tour but a taste of local street food in a variety of street locations. It does include some unusual dishes such as goat and quail but you don't have to eat anything you don't want to. The noodles and seafood are highly recommended. The girls give you an insight during the tour of their life in Vietnam and Tong, the guide at each stop, imparts his humourous slant on Vietnamese history and life. There is a lot of time spent on the bikes but it gives you the opportunity to see so much of the city and get to know the girls better. The beer and soft drinks flow and all the girls join you at each food stop which makes each eating experience an opportunity to chat with them and the other participants. The girls also cook for you at the BBQ stop and peel your prawns for you. Even in the rain , free ponchos provided!, this was a memorable trip and such fun. Thanks Tong and all your lovely girls. X

Fantastic tour - Really enjoyed the morning city tour, it was very informative and fun. The tour guides spoke good English and were most attentive, did not feel at risk on their extremely busy roads. Tung the owner accompanied us throughout the tour and was a wealth of knowledge. Would highly recommend this tour.

This Is A Must Do! - We booked this tour in Australia before departing for Vietnam and are so happy that we did...as I suspect that when we saw and heard the traffic chaos, we would have decided not to bother, it wasn't worth it, too dangerous, too noisy, why go on a motorbike tour to taste all the wonderful food that is readily available......well, we are in our 60's (surely not !!) and well travelled (lucky us), but we are happy to say that this was one of the best experiences we have had in a long time ! Our drivers/guides/companions what would you call these two marvelous ladies Thy and Thien, took us on the ride of our lives ! There was about 8 of us, followed by our cameramen (we are awaiting our DVDs with bated breath) and Tung the owner operator to ensure all went smoothly. At first lift off, I think I screamed as we launched into the teaming mash of traffic, but then very quickly began to enjoy and feel secure in Thy's expert and careful driving. I absolutley loved it. As we approached death defying roundabouts, I grinned with glee and anticipation. The food was devine, though how Thy got me to eat frog, I still cannot comprehend...we drove to different and such diverse areas of Ho Chi Minh, I had no idea of the difference that would unfold throughout the evening both in food and culture. This was the highlight of our holiday, no contest, dont hesitate, book this tour now. If only we had more time, I would loved to have gone on the shopping tour, never mind, next time when we repeat the foodie tour, the shopping tour will be organised too !
Perfect way to experience Ho Chi Minh City - Lovely guides, interesting food, safe and fun. A perfect way to spend an evening in Ho Chi Minh City.

Recommended! - My partner and I really enjoyed this tour. Although it was raining that night, we still decided to go ahead with the tour and were given plastic ponchos to try and keep dry. Although we still got a bit wet, it was definitely worth it, getting lots of fresh air on the back of a motorcycle, trying heaps of yummy food. My favourite would have been the scallops. All the girls seem really friendly .
Has to be done! - It seems mad when you arrive, and it is, but its the best way to see Ho Chi Minh City, a lot of fun.

Absolutely loved it - My husband and I went on the tour tonight and we highly recommend it - the tour is well organized, the route is well thought out, the guides are professional and the owner of the company accompanied us all along, riding on his own motor bike. Choice of food and restaurants is quite unique and you probably won't find the same outside Vietnam. The guides are so well trained they made you feel safe and relaxed even riding on such chaotic roads!! They really are "pros". It is a tour with "a heart". Trust me, I didn't want to go at first because I was worried about the traffic but my husband is very adventurous so I tagged along and in the beginning I was a scared passenger but only for the first 5 mins and soon I started to really enjoy it after adjusting my helmet and foot rest. You could not experience HCMC like this. So do not leave HCMC without taking this tour - you will not regret it.

Outstanding food tour - a trip highlight - I did the Foodie tour, and was picked up from my hotel by Thu. It was my first time on the back of a scooter, but despite the crazy Saigon traffic I felt very comfortable all night, thanks to Thu! We went and joined the rest of the group, where we had our first taste, and were given an introduction by the very knowledgeable and funny Ngan. The food at each location was excellent, and the girls were all very sweet and interesting to talk to. I've been on a few tours where you can tell that the guides are tired of the whole routine, but our guides were enthusiastic and bubbly. The tour covers a lot of districts in Saigon, giving you a great overview of the city. The scallops at the last stop were the best! The freaky duck egg thing was also very tasty.

Fun and exhilirating evening - We were picked up on time from our hotel by two young ladies in Ao Dai's and scooters to take us on the foodie tour we had booked. We met up with others on the tour at the first eatery we stopped at. There we met Tung Do who runs XO who gave us a most informative and tasty evening. There were stops in four or five districts to try different foods. Some we loved, some we didn't but between us we tried them all. Frog is strangely delicious!!!! The girls are charming and helpful and help get the food ready for eating wherever you go, the stop in District 4 was my favourite, the scallops were divine! Can't thank An and Ang (I think and hope her name is) enough for the evening, money well spent. I would probably do their city tour to get around SaiGon and get the information necessary. Ang's English is really terrific, I learned a lot about not only the foods in Vietnam but something about life there too from her. Highly recommended.

Good fun and good food! - Thanks to Tung and the gals for a great evening! A very unique way to see different areas of the city and to sample a variety of street foods - very tasty! The drivers were fun, full of energy and very confident and skillfull navigating the traffic. A special shout out to Tien (my driver) :-). I enjoyed getting to know my fellow foodies on the tour. I sprang for the video of the night's adventure (the camera guys were a hoot) - can't wait to see it once the editing is done. This tour was one of the best tips I received from a fellow traveler. A definate "MUST" when in Saigon.

XO foodie tour - Coming from someone who can’t ride a bike, imagine how nervous I would be getting on a moped and leaving my life in a girl racer hands. Well, I’m glad I did because the girls took great care of me: D and I got to experience the outskirts and street food of Vietnam. Being a tourist, you only really get the chance to explore what is nearby but with XO they took you downtown, explained the differences between districts and you really got to experience their lifestyle and culture. The girls spoke good English, had a great sense of humour and they pointed out the hotspots such as shopping malls, universities, the make out park lol, trendy and bargain areas. They zoomed in and out of the markets and you could see frogs hopping, fishes flapping and tonnes of souvenirs traded. The tour ended with a nice baguette and sugar cane juice, my favourite, and how I miss it so in London (UK). I would highly recommend XO tours because you don’t realise how much culture, experience and cuisine you’ll miss out on.

Fantastic night adventure - This was a brilliant introduction to the the chaos they call traffic in ho chi minh city. Our drivers were friendly, very talkative, fully of fun and made the experience fantastic. Their driving skill was excellent and not once did we feel uncomfortable or nervous. We had two stops, the second gave us the opportunity to sample street food and a cane sugar drink - both delicious and had no side effects :)

Simply Brilliant - We were greeted by two beautiful girls who were so bubbly and friendly, they were fantastic!
We set off to meet the other crew of 12 and so the night begins. It was brilliant. We ate amazing different Vietnamese food from all over the city and we had just the right amount of food as we were stuffed.
Tung the tour guide loves his job and his company is a testament to his passion for Vietnam.

Saigon by night on a motorbike - I did the Saigon by night tour and it was great fun.
Doing this tour, I was able to go beyond District 1 and see more of the new and old Saigon.
The guides are all nice and gave you information as you go cruising by different parts of the city.
Tung, the director was also there to make sure everything went smoothly and also provided background about Saigon and the culture.
This also much safer than hiring motorbikes with guide off the streets.
A must-do!

Come on be brave... - This an exhilarating motor bike tour around Saigon - with food included. The girls were delightful and I felt safe even in the craziest traffic.Tung met us at different points and gave very interesting commentary. Starts off well with a bowl of delicious noodle soup ( it isn't pho don't recall name - just that it had pineapple in it) however after that although Tung will organise some meat dishes for you unless you eat seafood ( it is a seafood lover's delight) it's not so great food wise ( I just couldn't rate it tops) there is plenty to eat though and plenty of beer...
Definitely worth doing for a good look at HCM and an allround 5* experience.

Excellent way to discover Ho Chi Minh - Last April was my second time visiting Ho Chi Minh, and although I was already charmed by the city, XO tour further amplified my love for HCM. I had not gone out of District 1 before, so this tour is an excellent introduction to the other districts that tourists would not otherwise venture to. My guide, Tui, was uber-friendly and chatty, it almost felt I had known her in my past life. She made me feel comfortable and safe, as well as kept me well-fed and well-informed about our surroundings throughout the journey. It is also a huge plus, that Tung, the tour director followed us around to share intimate details about the different districts and lifestyles in HCM. I would definitely recommend the foodie tour to anyone willing to get on the bike and experience the organized chaos of HCM traffic, as well as, have a go at their delicious street food.

Great way to see the real HCMC - I had read the reviews and had signed my husband and I up for the Foodie Tour. As we spent several days in Saigon before actually going on the Foodie Tour, my husband was a little worried about being on the motorbikes in the craziness that we had seen around the city. His fears were put to rest pretty quick and we became comfortable with the whole thing almost immediately. The girls are skilled drivers and very knowledgable and so sweet. We loved trying the different foods, drinks and of course, seeing the sights. I was a little concerned about some of the food and how it would agree with our systems but there was no problem at all and the food was delish! I wouldn't miss this tour. You see lots of Ho Chi Minh City and you see the real side - mixing with people and enjoying life. Don't miss out!

Quick view of HCM in the most unique way - Selected the Saigon by Night tour since we do not have much time in the city. The ride driven by the friendly young ladies were fantastic. It was a unique way to have a quick view of Saigon at different district. And these are places where our friends will not bring us to.
The most enjoyable part of the trip is the short ride thru the local night market near Chinatown and the short break near the highway, enjoying Banh Mi like what locals do.
Tung & his team make sure we are not left out alone. Thanks to Tung and his beautiful team..

the best way to understand the traffic 'system' - We organized this trip via email and were met on time at out hotel. We had only been in Vietnam for 3 hours. We went on the foodie tour. The drivers were very friendly and chatty and you felt safe on the back of the bikes. We went to several different areas sometimes stopped to eat a range of unusual and tasty food, sometimes just getting information about the area we were in. all food and drink is included and you can have as much as you like. We met one elderly japanese couple who didn't get out of District 1 until they found out about XO and then went on three trips one after the other.Thoroughly recommended, an excellent introduction to Vietnam. After the trip, the owner sends you photos of your trip, free of charge.

The best way to see all the sights! - We were greeted by the lovely ladies from XO bright and early and set off for a jam packed day!

The tour was interesting and informative from start to finish!

Our guide and director of XO Tung gave us so much interesting local knowledge we could have listened to him all day!

This is so much fun - don't miss out :)
One of the best memories of Vietnam, for me. - Loved this tour... Will do another, or two, next time.

Great way to see Saigon - XO Tours was a great way to see the city. I highly recommend you take this tour. I arrived in Saigon late one night and the following morning XO was at my hotel right on time. The tour guides were very knowledgeable, friendly and fun. Great way to get familiar with the city in a very short amount of time.

Must Do in HCMC - We did the foodie tour.
Riding on the back of a motorbike in downtown HCMC at night may not sound like fun for some people, but don't worry, the girls are great drivers and even though this was our first pillion ride it didn't take long to start enjoying the ride.
Three all you can eat and drink food stops, two information stops and a ride around the city make this tour a must do in HCMC. The girls are fabulous giving insights into their city and helping relieve any nervousness.
Just received our photos from the owner Tung who was on the touralways making sure everything was going smoothly.
Well worth the money

Fabulous idea - Brilliantly executed - When I read the reviews of XO tours on TA there was no doubt in my mind that I would have to take at least one tour. Pretty Vietnamese girls dressed in ao-dais chauffeuring me around the city on motos? SIGN ME UP!
Promptly at 08.55 Binh showed up at my District 1 hotel, handed me my helmet and off we went to join the throngs of motos which jam Saigon’s streets day and night.
I had arrived the night before and spent some time at a cafe in front of my hotel just watching the streams of traffic that went by. It was like watching an action movie - there was constant motion and an ever changing cast of characters: the family of four on their moto, the office girl in high heels on the way home, gaggles of students talking on their mobiles, the woman with a dog perched on the back seat. Motos are THE way to transport yourself and are the lifeblood of the city. It all looks chaotic - motos going the wrong way on the street, cutting in, pulling U-turns, riding on the sidewalk - but it’s not. There are rules but YOU DON’T KNOW WHAT THEY ARE and THAT’S why it looks chaotic. If you go to You Tube and search for ”Saigon motos” you’ll have an idea of what the traffic looks like. The main rule seems to be keep your eye on everybody else. In the month I was in Vietnam I NEVER saw a single accident. I’d be willing to bet I could cross any street with my eyes closed and not be hit simply because everybody would avoid me. But I digress.
Binh and I had a little chat on the way - this was the morning ”Sights” tour and I was the only guest - although it is slightly difficult to hold a meaningful discussion in Saigon traffic. We pulled up at the central post office and then she announced that I would be meeting her boss. This was news to me as I expected that she would be doing the tour alone. Instead I met Tung Do the director and owner of the outfit. Tung is Viet Kieu - sorry Tung don’t have a Vietnamese keyboard - born in Vietnam but emigrated to the US. After growing up in Texas and spending time in the world of finance he returned to Vietnam and started XO tours. Tung of course is fluent in English and proceeded to explain in detail about the post office architecture and Binh and I went in for a look see. We then proceeded on to the Reunification Palace - Binh and I on one moto, Tung on another and again Tung gave some background. This was the pattern that was followed for the next couple of hours. Binh was my driver and Tung my guide. Tung has an intimate knowledge of the city and you will get to see things close up that you just won’t otherwise see. We went to a market in Cholon - not the Ben Thanh market which exists solely for tourists - where Tung sprang for a couple delicious desserts - a flan and a yoghurt which really hit the spot. All-in-all a fabulous tour which ended all too quickly as Binh delivered me back to my hotel at about noon.
Well I HAD to take another tour so the next evening Tuyen picked me up at 17:55 for the ”Saigon by Night” tour. We met up with Tung AGAIN - this man works day and night - close to another wholesale market, this time with another tour - the ”Foodie” tour. We had a chat about how the market functions and then off we went our separate ways - the foodies to eat their way through the night and my group (well, there was ONE other person) to explore five other districts of the city which ordinary tourists NEVER see. The highlight here - for me at any rate - was the new district (district 7?) which had been built and catered to foreigners. If you didn’t know what country you were in and somebody blindfolded you and drove you here and then took the blindfold off you would think you were in LA. We took a short break and Tung sprang for some nuoc-mia (sugar cane juice) at a local stand and had some time to talk while we ate the sandwiches that he had bought for us previously. Just driving on a moto through the endless streets of Saigon even at 23.00 on a weekday was exciting as there is so much commercial activity.
During the course of both tours Tung or the girls take pictures which he then forwards to you as an extra service.
So - in summary - do not miss this tour. The girls are all careful drivers and once you get the hang of sitting on the back of a moto you will relax and be able get out of District 1. You will become a part of the action and see sights that you came to see in Vietnam - real people and off the beaten path sights without having a window between you and life.

Amazing Experience! Highly Recommend! - My husband and I did two tours with XO, the "Sights" and the "Foodie" tours. They were both amazing experiences that we will not soon forget. Not only were our lovely tour ladies knowledgable and well-spoken, but they were very friendly and always attentive to our safety and needs. We were greeted and given additional information about the city by Tung (the owner), who clearly enjoys meeting tourists and sharing details about the city that we would never have known had we just ventured out on our own. We also highly recommend having one (or more) of your tours videotaped. We couldn't have been happier with how our video turned out and we're looking forward to sharing it with our friends and family so they can get a real glimpse of Vietnam in action! This was our first trip to Ho Chi Minh City and we couldn't have imagined seeing the city any other way! Big thanks to XO Tours, the ladies, and Tung for making our trip so memorable!

Fun, educational and filling :) - Best experience in my trip to Ho Chi Minh. We did the Foodie Tour. The girls picked us up in our hotel then brought us to this noodle place where we ate our first meal and met with other members of the tour. After that we go around Ho Chi Minh city to different districts and learn about each district and its history. We went to two others place to eat afterwards. All the food are delicious. I tried everything from the frog to the embryo egg. So much fun. The girls are nice, speak very good English, very attentive to our needs and know a lot about HCM. After this tour i know way more about Saigon and my tummy is full with great food. Must do tour.

Tons of fun! - I took the city tour on the morning of April 15th! I cannot say enough how much fun it was driving through the chaotic streets on the back of the bike. My guide was excellent and Tung the owner was with us almost every step of the way to provide insight into the city and culture of Ho Chi Minh City. Really worth double what they charge.

A perfect combination of fun, culture and learning - Me and my boyfriend have done a foodie tour on our second night in Ho Chi Minh and it proved to be a highlight of all the trip. As a tourist you are normally hanging around in the first district because you simply feel like you don't know where else to go. This tour was so much more than food - it showed you the real Saigon - the places you would have never visited on your own. And it was not just about the places - it was about the stories behind them that Mr. Tung had to tell.

All in all - a fantastic experience!

The BEST tour we've ever done - We read the tripadvisor Foodies tour reviews and thought surely it can't be that good.....well it is. Tung and the girls are just great - the ride, the info, the tour, the sights, the sounds and of course the food! Even our unadventurous 9 year old tried most dishes. XO Tours go out of their way to make it the best experience that they possibly can and they are good at it!

OUR BEST NIGHT IN SAIGON - What a thrilling and fun way to see Saigon! My husband and I did this Foodie tour because we love trying out new and interesting cuisine. This did not disappoint! This tour is AMAZING! My driver was very good and I felt safe the entire time. We had fun talking along the way and it was nice getting to see Saigon from a "local" perspective. The ladies are all so cute and have such a fun personality. If you don't smile and enjoy yourself on this one, there is no hope for you!

Best tour ever - Our best experience in Ho Chi Minh was the Xo Tour, I'm sure our guides had as much fun as we did! Felt safe, despite initial trepidation, and enjoyed great food and learned more about Vietnam in this 4 hours than the other 6 days we spent in the city. Diane and Rob, Thanks Tung for a wonderful tour. Diane and Rob.
You haven't seen Saigon until you do this tour - Tung and his staff are first rate. Can't praise the experience enough.

Excellent Customer Service - Mr. Tung, the owner of this business, speaks fluent English. He gives prompt reply, and is very upfront about what the company can or cannot offer.

I experienced a one-of-a-kind adventure when I booked XO Tour. I appreciate the fact that they did not require me to wire a down payment in advance. Less hassle on my part.

This is a wholesome adventure for fun-loving groups. We experienced the Foodie tour, and we loved it. In our other tours where we were pampered with Mercedes Sprinter, we were outside looking in. But in this tour, we actually went out of our comfort zone and immersed with the locals. How I wish there are tours like this in everywhere I go.

The guides are young, vibrant and fun to be with. Some of their English are hard to understand, but in Vietnamese standard, it was already good. Expect to be talking and listening to your guide a lot as you ride with the wind all over town.

If it is your first time to ride a scooter, expect your bums to hurt. Men are also not allowed to hold the guides during the rides (no hanky-panky please!), and will need to hold the back of the seat until you feel comfortable enough to let go.

When you take this tour, try to limit your personal belongings. a belt bag or a small body bag will do.

The washrooms in this tour are definitely unclean. So if you are squeamish, I suggest you inform Mr. Tung about it. Maybe you can go on a detour for your potty break or something.

For more information about my personal experience in this tour, you can check out my blog at http://shandawanda.wordpress.com/2012/04/19/an-extraordinary-xo-evening/

My favorite part of our visit to Ho Chi Minh City - We met another couple on our travels who were raving about the XO foodie tour, decided to check it out for ourselves and were so pleased we did!

The guides were incredibly fun, enthusiastic ambassadors - who really give you an insight into what it's really like to live in this vibrant, crazy city. Zipping around on the back of a moped you get to experience the place in a way that just can't be explained on foot.

Tung did a great job of explaining the different parts of the city you visit - so not only did we come away with a new perspective on vietnamese food and culture, but also a much more rounded view of the city as a whole!

If we make it back there any time soon - will definitely be trying out the other tours!

And shout out to our awesome guides Tien and Ngoc - all the girls were fab, but these two especially!

Pricey but worth it - On the foodies tour we were greeted at our hotel by two friendly girls who took us on their scooters. We started off with a bowl of noodle soup and were taken to several different districts around HCM. It was great to look around districts other than district 1 where the tourists seem to be restricted to. We got a chance to try different types of interesting food and were left very full by the end of the tour. All the girls were very lovely and Tung was very knowledgeable. Its quite pricey compared to other tours but its a good way to enjoy HCM.

Just do it - Went on the foodie tour last night 14/04/12 and must say that it was one of the best tours we have been on,Trung was out standing and the girls on their bikes could not look after you better.they ride well and are very knowledgeable on the area we visited,great fun you must try.By the way the food is fantastic !! Wife booked next day for shopping tour and said that it was great,as the title says JUST DO IT!

XO Foodie tour - If you want the best way to experience Saigon, the sights, the people and the food - this tour is a must. We booked and paid for this tour in Australia, and also arranged to have our group of friends videoed during the night. We were met promptly at our hotel by the girls (who are well educated, knowledgeable on things Vietnamese and speak good English) and headed out on the back of the bikes. Our restaurants did not adhere to western standards of design or atmosphere, and this is what made the experience special. Our first stop was dining at a group table in a lane way, served from a portable servery. The food was superb - but beware of the chilli (it is hotter than you realise and creeps up on you). The soup (which was flavoursome and satisfying) is a favorite of Tung, the owner & creator of XO tours. We met the owner of the company (who stayed with us throughout the night) who made us feel very welcome by introducing all the tour members. Unlike other tours he made us feel like one big friendly family.

Whizzing through the traffic we went across town and our next stop was a roadside diner where we ate outside and enjoyed grilled goat, frog, okra and shrimp. The XO girls catered to our every need - getting us drinks, peeling our shrimp and making sure we were entertained (loved the singing girls!!). There was nothing they wouldn't do for us.

We traveled so much around the city and what we were able to see from the back of the motorbikes was impressive. We saw the old, the new and the ugly districts of Saigon - all with a commentary from the drivers as we traveled along. If you have a question they are very happy to answer it (on the spot).

Our final eating spot was in the poorer part of town - but the food was very fresh and bursting with flavour. I'm not that keen on the duck embryo, but it is available for you to try!! We were provided with crab, scallop, quail and a delicious coconut dessert cooked by my driver. The flavors were amazing and so diverse. Not too hot, or spicy - so moorish!! Unfortunately for me, my stomach could eat no more........maybe another visit, another time.

The tour is great value for money and on the night went for 4 1/2 hours.

I recommend this tour company, they were well organized, hospitable and lots of fun.

exotic night wonderings in Saigon - splendid food sampling tour. Very innovative. Being driven around on a bike by lovely and super friendly young ladies was worth the price. To sample some great food in places that we would have never seen on our own, made it an extra special night. our guide was extremely informative and told us a slew of interesting facts about the city. Highly recommended

A real HCMC experience! - My girlfriend and I had one of the best tour experiences with XO tours.... ever!

We did the "Foodie Tour", which basically entails you sitting on the back of the scooter, while your excellent driver takes you around the districts of HCMC showing you where the real people of HCMC go to eat.

Throughout the tour, the owner will do a short talk about a couple of the places where you are visiting, and this is a very insightful narrative on what it is to live in HCMC.

Our female drivers were amazing hosts too! We can't begin to describe the enthusiasm that they showed, and how they really made the trip so enjoyable. They take particualar care to ensure that you are as safe as you possibly can be within the crazy-ness that is HCMC's traffic.

Thanks XO... we had an awesome time!

Gareth and Sarah

A great way to experience HCMC - We went on the foodies tour and it was fantastic. The booking process was easy and efficient. The director, Tung, was very professional and shared some interesting insights into HCMC during the tour. Our tour guides were wonderful girls, who made you feel so comfortable and relaxed from the start (even when negotiating the crazy traffic - an impressive feat!). It was fascinating to hear about life in HCMC and see areas that we never would have visited on our own. And last but not least - the food was abundant and delicious (mostly - the duck egg embryo excluded!). A must do trip for anyone visiting Vietnam.

Lives up to all the hype - My 72 year old mother and I did the foodie tour and it was a fantastic way to introduce her to some of the delicious local cuisine. She came away from the experience so much more adventurous with what and where she was willing to eat on our holiday. Our tour guides were very attentive and fun. My only criticism is that motorbike safety gear wasn't up to Western standards. I think it would be really good if they used International Safety Standard approved helmets and offered customers the option of protective clothing and gloves.

Must Do tour!! - All I can say is WOW. This is a must do for anyone travleing in Saigon, or frankly Vietnam! My wife and I booked the foodie tour. Our first tour was canceled due to a massive storm, however Tung was able to rebook us the following night.

What makes this tour the best, is the people! Tung joins the foodie tour, and you can tell that he loves to tell you about the food and the city. The girls on the scooters do an amazing job giving you a true tour of the city. When else will you have a chance to ride on the back of a scooter in a major city like this! You can tell that the girls truely enjoy thier jobs, interacting with guests and showing off thier food, discussing thier culture and city. We learned so much about the people and the city that you would not learn on any other tour.

The girls are great drivers and negotiate the traffic, when you are on the scooter somehow the nightmare traffice seems to flow and work.. My wife and I always felt safe and had great time. Thanks XO Tours!!
(I cannot beleive someone would give this a rating of Very Good, this tour was above Excellent!)

It you have time for only 1 thing to do in HCMC. DO THIS! - Don't hesitate, Book this tour! You will regret it you don't!

We had so much fun on this tour ( one adult and 2 teens). We did the Foodie Tour even though my girls were unsure about trying "strange food" But we all loved it and we all tried nearly everything!!! Besides the wonderful, wonderful food, we learned much more about the city! You really get to see the Real Saigon... Our guides were very knowledgeable, funny, polite and safe drivers!

Outstanding Fun - My wife and I did the Foodie tour on Valentine's Night this year. What an absolute blast. It is a brilliant way to see the city and the food is excellent. Tung and the team are brilliant and a credit to this wonderful city.

If you really want to test your culinary courage, try the duck eggs at the last stop. They are not quite cooked. Oh, and fertilised...

Good luck!!

Best Tour in Town - The best way to get in contact with an other culture/country is to tast their food. We did it with XO Tours and it was so amazing! So delicios food, so friendly drivers and so much fun on the motorbike. We can recomand this tour to all visitors of Saigon. Enjoy this 4-5 h trip through Saigon with it's food

A different vantage point - I went on the XO tours last April 6,2012, and I can say that the trip was well worth it. It is a perfect combination of the sampling of Vietnamese local cuisine coupled with a historical and contemporary insights of the country. The motorbike ride was fun-- and it actually felt safer than crossing the streets of Saigon. My personal guide was very attentive as I felt really spoiled as she made sure I had a generous sampling of everything on my plate. Although the food is certainly not for the faintest of hearts, it is a cultural and gastronomic adventure that will certainly give you a different take on Vietnamese culture. Pho lovers beware though-- no Pho on this tour-- but the noodles we tasted we're even better. I would certainly recommend it to friends and even do it again :)

Don't dream it, just do it! - this is our second visit to Vietnam. I wanted to do something that gave me a more authentic experience of local life. through TAI read about the "foodie" tour that xo offers. made contact with tong before we left home and booked a tour. the girls picked us up on time and were the two most delightful young people we've met - 'Whitney' and 'Lun'. the tour gave me everything, and more, that I wanted! I wanted to see parts of hcmc that only the locals knew about or went to, I wanted to try the street food and I just wanted to hand out with the local kids. I got it all in spades! it was the most fun and exhilarating experience and I would do it all over again. plan to stay in touch with Tong, Whitney and Lin as well!!simply awesome group of people. Jennifer and John from Australia

This tour was the highpoint of my stay in Saigon. Tung's team of guides along with his knowledge made for a fun, informative and delicous evening.

Great Night in Saigon - We´ve booked the "Foodie Tour by night" based on the recommendations here on Tripadvisor. And it was really great! The driver-ladies were super-friendly, they drove super-safe and chatted a lot with us :-) The meals were fantastic, really local and sometimes hard to try (if you wanted). We learned a lot about Saigon and the culture and had soo much fun. Try it and don't be afraid of driving through Saigon on a Vespa, thats the best part and I'm not a motorbike-driver at all.

Fantastic! One of the best experiences I had in Saigon - After reading all the positive reviews on TripAdvisor, I decided to book the Foodies Tour. I had the mentality of, "How great can it be?" and by the end of the night, this tour certainly exceeded my expectations.

The tour guide, Tung, was very professional, personable and knowledgeable. He grew up in the US and came to Vietnam a few years ago, so for those who are concerned about language barriers, there's no need to be in this case. Tung was very helpful via e-mail in quickly addressing some of the questions I had previously.

I was always hesitant to join tour groups when I'm traveling solo as sometimes I feel like the third-wheel in a group of five other couples. However, this tour was perfect for solo travelers or people traveling with partners or friends. At the start of the tour, Tung was able to remember everyone's names, and introduce everyone to each other. By the end of the night, everyone was mingling with each other at the dinner table -- no awkward silences or the feeling of being left out.

The great thing about Foodies Tour is that you get to explore out of the touristy District 1 and have a taste of the other districts. We stopped at some of the other districts where Tung gave us an introduction of the location and what it's famous for. The information and his anecdotes were interesting and amusing -- unlike other tours guides where conversations often feel impersonal, scripted and monotonous.

I would definitely recommend XO Tours for other travelers going to HCMC. Due to book early as the Foodies Tour was booked up already a week ago.

We thought it was absolutely wonderful! - Our first trip to Saigon and we took the Saigon by Night tour. Tung and the girls were friendly and so professional and took us through the traffic to parts of Saigon we never would have discovered. Fascinating! Since returning home to England we have been telling everyone we know that if they are ever in Saigon they must take the XO Tour!
Only wish we had had time to book the Shopping tour as well.

Gooooooo XO! - XO Foodie tour was fantastic, the ultimate tour of Saigon! We met our drivers and tour guides Ahn and Foon in front of the opera house  and commence our tour promptly at 5.30. The girls privided us with brief scooter safety instructions and helped us fit our helmets then we hit the very busy roads of Saigon. Our first destination was happily not very far away where we were met with an ice cold drink, four other travelers and Toung the owner of the tour company. He explained the we would not be eating the typical 'Melbourne' Vietnamese food but real everyday food that locals eat every day. The food we ate at every stop were fine examples of this. I highly recommend this tour, it was one of the highlights of our vietnam vacation

Food tour - Absolutely brilliant!! - We just arrived back the food tour and have to say it was one of the best tours/experiences I've had on holidays - ever! The girls are very professional and knowledgable but extremely funny and welcoming. The experience of cruising around on a scooter in Ho Chi Minh itself is amazing, but add in exceptional food (and ridiculous amounts and varieties) with free flow or beer or any other drinks you'd like - just makes for a wonderful night. The guides filled us in on interesting facts about Ho Chi while ensuring all our needs were met. The food is absolutely delicious and authentic. The tour shows you around all the districts of Ho Chi Minh. I never write reviews but this tour is too good not to. DO NOT MISS THIS TOUR!

MUST DO IN HO CHI MINH CITY - I am an American-born Vietnamese and had never been back to Vietnam. My husband and I went to Ho Chi Minh City as part of our honeymoon to experience Vietnamese culture as my parents had when they lived here.

Our first night in HCMC we decided to do the XO Foodie Tour. And let me just say, the rest of our trip couldn't really live up to this trip!! Our guides, Thu and Thi were punctual in picking us up at our hotel. They were so sweet and both spoke English. Although I speak Vietnamese, it's not great so that was a plus. Getting to know our guides and the other girls during our meals was so enjoyable. The girls were so fun and so sweet!!

We visited all the different districts of HCMC. At each stop, the owner, Tung, would tell us about the different districts and for what they were best known. He was really informative and shared a lot of his knowledge about living in the city.

As a Vietnamese-American, I have eaten plenty of Vietnamese food and foolishly, I didn't expect to experience anything new. However, to my pleasant surprise, I tried new dishes on the tour that I had never had in the States! I'm excited to tell my parents about the new foods I tried on the Foodie Tour.

Days later, as our honeymoon has come to an end, my husband and I still talk about how great of an experience our tour was. It was one of our favorite experiences while in Vietnam. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who visits HCMC!

Great couple of hours around Saigon - We went out on the morning tour around Saigon with my wife. The young ladies were friendly and informative.
Tung meets you and gives you a detailed description of the building and locations we stopped at thoughout the morning.
We booked the shopping tour for 2 days later.
Enjoyed the madness of Saigon traffic from the back of a scooter.

MUST DO - If you visit Saigon then you must do this tour

We were taken to parts of the city that we will never have seen

We ate the most amazing food and dined with people whose smiles were as big as the Saigon River

Thank you Tung and the XO Tours team
