What a fantastic way to see Ho Chi Minh City! - My husband & I felt that this tour of all the tours we went on while in Vietnam was by far the best tour of them all! The girls that rode us around on their scooters for the day were sooo lovely & genuine! Tung, our tour guide & owner of the company was just fabulous! Loved every moment of the day on this tour! Thanks so much to XO Tours for making our trip to Vietnam a memorable one!

A Must do in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) - We had the absolute pleasure of being shown the sights and tastes of Ho Chi Minh City by the ladies of XO Tours on two occasions. On our 2nd day we were promptly collected by Nga, Hoang & Tien who were fantastic as their friendly enthusiasm soon got us all excited about the tour. Our 9 and 7 year old daughters absolutely enjoyed every minute of the tour and were well looked after while Tung (XO Tours Director) provided the commentary. They tailored the tour to our tastes somewhat, which was that little bit extra special. We never felt unsafe on the motorbikes either, even when we went on our second tour, Saigon By Night. That too was incredible as we got to see another side of Saigon that few tourists experience. All in all, XO Tours were incredible and I highly recommend at least one tour with them on your visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

You have to do it! - This is my 2nd time doing a tour with XO tours and it's an awesome experience! I contacted Tung Do, who is the director of this company. He responded very promptly and our tour was booked! For this trip, we did the night tour. I brought along 5 other friends who flew to HCMC with me and everyone had a blast and agreed it was definitely the highlight of our trip (besides savoring delicious food). The drivers were safe drivers, chatty and beautiful people and very friendly.

On this tour, we explored places that are indeed unknown to tourists and it was really insightful and fascinating. Before the tour, we saw HCMC as a city that is still developing. However, after the tour, we saw the gap between the rich and the poor. We also gained a deeper understanding on the people's living conditions, lifestyles and their aspirations.

We had a lot of fun on this tour, taking tons and tons of photos! As I knew my driver from my 1st visit, we quickly warmed up. My driver did crazy things like bending down slightly while driving so I can experience the thrill of pretending to drive in HCMC's busy street. I screamed like mad as I didn't have a driving license. But it was really funny and it was really fun as well. My friends and the other drivers were all laughing as they drove by.

We also eat street food! I think it's called Banh Er and had lemon sugar cane drinks by the road side! It was really awesome. The noodle dish was delicious and everyone loved it!!

It was such a memorable experience that my friends and I shared together and we had a blast!

Thank you XO tour!

super fun. super yummy. best way to experience the city!! - highlightlites:
- while this is a food based tour, you get to see many parts of saigon via motorbike.. quite the unique and very fun experience.
- knowledgeable tour guide, fantastic hostesses
- great arrangements for food sampling.. pretty full after the tour, but very satisfied with the well rounded gastronomics.. you defintely get the most out of your time on this tour..

i stressed, this is a MUST DO while is Saigon.

Must do tour when in Ho Chi Minh City - The only way to really see the city is on the back of a motorbike. Our two guides picked up us on time in front of our hotel and we went to a central spot to meet the rest of our group (another couple from Australia and Tung Do, the owner of XO Tours).

We hit all the major city sites within the next couple of hours. There were plenty of picture opportunities with your camera or theirs. A couple of days later, we received an email with all of the images and all free of charge. Our guides/drivers (don't worry, they do all the driving), were excellent and spoke very good English.

My best advice would be to book this tour on you first day to the city. You'll get a feel for where you'd like to go back to during your stay and spend more time.

We loved it! - We loved our tour! The girls were fun and professional! We just wish we had gone on this tour the first night instead of our last night! Next time we will go at the beginning and the end of our tour! The food was excellent and it was one of our fondest memories of Vietnam!

Unforgettable experience of Saigon. - We joined the morning tour next day to our arrival from Tokyo. As a senior couple we were a bit tired as arrival at the hotel was past midnight (day of our tour!).
Although highly rated in TripAdvisor, at first we were not sure what we will get from this tour. We were picked up at the hotel by charming young girls dressed in the traditional Ao Dai, taken to the meeting point and there Tung Do, owner and guide of XO Tours introduced us to all the other participants and the tour began. The girls were not only very good drivers but always safety conscience and were efficient tour guides with great knowledge. Within few minutes we found out that Saigon streets are better on a motorcycle (back of a motorcycle with a good driver to say) than walking. Tung Do gave us explanations at various points of interest. It was not like a normal sightseeing tour just going around the city but full of historical information and guidance to understand Saigon and its people through everyday life.
We were very much impressed so decided to take the Foodie night tour also. It was at short notice but fortunately there was a cancelation and Tung Do squeezed us in. This tour took us to various places other than the touristic Saigon that we could have never been on our own and full of local foods we would never have experienced. In every respect these tours were inspiring, enlightening and great fun. Experiencing Saigon from the back seat of a motorcycle (with a charming and good driver) was a wonderful and unforgettable experience. Thank you Tung Do and thank all the girls who took care of us. We enjoyed the tours very much and of course will highly recommend them.

The best way to see the essence of Saigon. - We felt totally at ease in Saigon from the moment our motorcycle drivers picked us up at our hotel. In the morning we completed “The Sights” tour where we went all around the major “must-sees” of Saigon including the Central Post Office, the Reunification Palace, the Notre Dame Cathedral and several markets. We loved the morning tour so much that we signed on and spent another five hours with the drivers to do their highly acclaimed “Foodie” tour. While it was great to see the major sights and sample a variety of different foods, the best part was just being able to relax on the motorbike to really take in the hustle and bustle of Saigon. Every member of the staff spoke terrific English and their knowledge of each landmark was quite impressive. While many tour companies will simply make things up when they can’t answer questions, the XO staff stayed honest about what they knew and what they didn’t know. Tung Do, the founder, told us point blank: “I tell all the women who work for me this: If you don’t know the answer to a customer’s question, don’t make one up. Only honesty can prevent misinformation from being spread and only honesty will preserve the true spirit of Vietnam.” For these reasons, I recommend the XO Tour to everyone. Even those who have been to Saigon many times.

Must XO Tour or leave with regret...in HMC - I and my boy (Marcus) went on Saigon by Night with Hoang and Anh (pretty ladies wearing Ao Dai) on 25 Feb with XO Tour - we had the most fabulous fun throughout our whole trip in Ho Chi Minh City for 4D3N

During our tour, we visited all the district in Ho Chi Minh and ate the specialties Banh Mi & Banh Uot which recommended by Tung (Tour Leader / Boss of XO Tours) - my boy loves the Bant Uot very much. Also a treat from them Sugarcane juice.

Many HMC secrets will be revealed with XO Tours - Shh! Just ask them any questions and they will answer...

Must add the video option - its another experience after you received the video and they mixed with awesome music.

A great way to see Saigon - I'm not really one for tours, but the Foodie Tour with XO Tours was excellent.

Tung and his team were fantastic. Cruising through the streets and frantic traffic of Saigon on a back of a scooter, I felt totally safe. We got to see a couple of districts, which we would never have seen as tourists. We also tried a variety of local dished and all were delicious and tasty (even the frog).

I whole heartedly recommend doing a tour with XO Tours and if you get Nga as your driver, you're in for a treat, she is both hilarious and knowledgeable.

The only way to experience HCMC! - My girlfriend and I went on a private "foodie" tour a few days ago (16th March) and it was the experience of a lifetime. Over the past 7 years my girlfriend and I have worked for Carnival, Princess, Holland America, and Royal Caribbean and have been on literally hundreds of tours. Nothing compares to what we experienced in 4.5hrs with Tung and our 2 tour guides. Our guides were ambassadors to HCMC and Vietnam! They were polite, friendly, on time and funny! Tung (the Owner) was a pleasure to meet and made our excursion even more enjoyable. At the end of the night we were speechless and in awe of what we had seen. Next time we're back we plan on doing one or two of the other tours.. I literally asked Tung for a stack of business cards and handed them out to a few other travelers at the Intercontinental Saigon.

I don't want to spoil any surprises but the food was incredible as well.

A great way to see Saigon & eat along the way!!! - My husband & I, are foodie lovers so we joined the XO Food Tour. It's one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The experience of riding a motorcycle (1st time for us), driven by young, beautiful ladies dress in Ao Dai, on busy, crazy streets of Saigon was exciting and adrenalin producing ride! We enjoyed every minute of it, and a good way to see many districts of Saigon and eat the best foods where locals go. You'll eat plenty & won't be hungry.

Dung, the owner, is very nice & give us brief information of each of the 7 disticts we visited. He will also take your photos and email to you. Our female drivers (forgot their names), pampered & spoiled us: grilled our food, peeled our shrimps, loose clams, etc so all we have to do is pop the food in our mouth. They are very engaging, love to talk and practice their English with you.

Definitely include in your MUST DO List in Saigon

Yummy and fun! - i did the foodie tour. it was yummy and fun! a must if you are in saigon; especially if you speak zero Vietnamese like me. i shared many laughs with tung and his entire team. was going to do other tours are well but they were all booked so reserved early.

Turning experiences into fond memories. Wonderful people, wonderful time - I have to say that I had such a wonderful time on each tour I did with XO and I did 4 tours. They were punctual, informative and really friendly Each one felt like I had a local friend showing me around their city.
You stop seeing Ho Chi Minh from the side walk and become part of the exciting chaos that is the real city traffic. My friends and I all feel very safe on the back of our tour guides bikes. XO have given me experiences that form many of my fondest memories of Ho Chi Minh.
I would highly recommend the Foodie tour if you have limited time and can only fit one in. I thought being a vegetarian I may still be a little hungry but I was begging at the last stop for them to please stop giving me so much delicious food.
Highly recommend to all. One of our tours had kids of about 8 and 10 with them and then another trip had someone celebrating their birthday in their 60's.
Recieved the photos by email as promised too :-) They have a facebook page and I will be putting some of our photos up on it to share with the people we met rather than here.

Wonderful people.......wonderful time.......

Fantastic intro to Ho Chi Minh & it's food & districts - a must do! - I highly recommend the foodie tour as one of the first things you do in Ho Chi Minh!

We travelled through various districts in the city & had the opportunity to try a variety of foods that the locals would eat. There was ample food & drink, our drivers Nga & Ni were fantastic, fun & provided us with commentary throughout the ride. Despite the hectic pace of traffic we felt totally safe & comfortable on the
bikes.

Yes this tour is #1 for a reason - it's flat AMAZING!!!! - Ok, truth be told I didn't want to do the foodie tour. Yes, I was wrong!

Everything was just perfect. I mean, who drew this up?
Beautiful Vietnamese girls driving us around on scooters thru Saigon at night!

The owner (who cruised with the group) was raised in Texas and then as an adult, moved back to Saigon only to create this amazing business idea.

There was 8 scooters in our group and we were taken to where locals would dine.
The girls prepared a number of the dishes at the table ( nice touch ) and since I'm a food baby, their smiles and encouragement did a lot to help me overcome!
Wow and glad I did too, the food was amazing!

We are not tour people at all but since this was rated #1, the thought was to give it a go.

So here's how we felt about the whole experience.

DO NOT MISS THIS!
Sorry about yelling but seriously, it's the most fun you will have on a tour in Vietnam.

The BEST thing we did in Vietnam - This tour is a must. The guides are friendly speak english well and most importantly are are good motorbike drivers. This tour give you an opportunity to see the real Saigon outside the tourist areas while experiencing the city on a Vespa driven by beautiful Vietnamese women. The food and experience was absolutely our trip highlight!!

Novel way to experience Saigon, you GOTTA try it !! - The XO girls have superb driving skills, and are VERY conversant in both English as well as the Saigon neighborhoods. My guide Anh kept up a delightful conversation thru'out the trip. I took the Saigon by night tour, and enjoyed it thoroughly. Just love how Tung meets up with the tour group at selected stops, and adds a level of unmatched detail on the culture and local lifestyle of Vietnamese. You cannot get a better perspective, given he is a Vietnamese who grew up in USA...

The best way to see, taste and get a true feeling of HCMC - My Fiance and I did the food tour on our trip to Vietnam. We thought it was hands down the best way to experience HCMC. The girls were so polite and friendly and showed us a really great time. Getting picked up from our hotel at the start of the tour during peak hour traffic was an exhilarating experience in itself. We got to visit several districts all over the city, each one so different. The best part of this tour is all of the food stops. The girls take u to where the locals eat and where there are no tourists. They teach you all about local Vietnamese food and how it's eaten. If you're brave enough you might even try the BLUE EGG!! go for it we did. One thing for sure is that you will finish the night with a full stomach and a sore face from laughing and smiling so much. The most fun we have had on a city tour!! WE LOVED IT!!

Free! - Best way to see the city! The girls are great drivers very safe and informative! Did the night tour and it was beautiful! Saw lots of things we would've otherwise not known about!! Thanks!! XO

Great trip around the city! - Me and my girlfriend booked the night tour, and we were picked up right in time.
The guides were very friendly and knew alot about the city. Me and my guide talked alot during the ride about all kinds of things, how we live back home and her life in Vietnam.
We met up with the owner Tung outside the Cho Binh Tay market and then we visited different parts of the city together with Tung and his guides. Tung knows alot about the city and is very informative in a way that makes you want to listen to him for hours :) Later on we tried some delicious street food with some cane sugar juice in ice, very nice!
The ride felt very safe even if the traffic is chaotic sometimes, the guides are excellent drivers.
The owner Tung and his guides were really nice to us and the trip was one of the highlights for our stay in Vietnam.
We wish Tung and his team all the best with XO Tours!

/Stefan & Charlotte, Sweden

Unique and fun! - I booked the tour thinking that since the main transportion in Saigon is by motorbike, then it would be a great experience riding with populace. It was an enjoyable tour, My guide Ana was very entertaining and quick to serve during the several food stops. Mr. Tung Do will also meet us in some areas to give his insights on the city. I highly recommend this tour to everyone coming to this city.

This is a must of all things to do in siagon - My wife and I went on the foodie tour with the lovely girls and another 6 tourists. WOOW this experience was fantastic we got to see quite a bit of the town and taste some food that we would normally not ever try, the guides are friendly cheerful and a make it a look of fun.

We were in Vietnam for 11 days and this tour was the highlight of the trip and there are a lot of good things to see elsewhere.

Thanks XO

Tony and Trish
New Zealand

Worth the money - My husband and I both did the foodie tour and I did the shopping tour on my own. The girl took me shopping, negotiated prices with the vendors, and I never would have found the places otherwise. All of the food was great and all things we never would have known to order on our own. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves on both tours and would highly recommend them. Only negative is the price, but when it comes down to it, we will do them again in a heartbeat.

Fantastic way to discover the food culture and sights of greater Saigon - My girlfriend and I had a great time with XO! My gf was a bit apprehensive of riding on the scooters at first but once she met our lovely tour guides all those fears were laid to rest!! We both had a fantastic time going around and trying the food, and now have a new favorite Vietnamese dish (Bun Bo Hue). Would recommend this tour.

Well worth making the effort - just a quick note to say how much I enjoyed the foodie tour, I often like the idea of ​​trying the local food, but lack confidence in knowing what to order, if its safe etc etc. The tour was great and I'd highly recommend it to anyone wanting to get away from the tourist traps, and do something different.

Wish this was the first thing I did when we arrived Vietnam! - We did their foodie tour but we got more than just food, we received an amazing Vietnamese experience. First you get picked up by XO's lovely women on a motorbike (the only way to travel in Vietnam) and they take you to 3 different places you would never even think of eating at (because you're too scared to, or you just didn't know about it). You also get taken to other districts of Ho Chi Minh and learn about the culture and history from the owner of XO himself. Both him and the girls are very well spoken in English and know their city like the back of their hand. Definitely a must do if you are there, and definitely something I would do when I go back.

What a great introduction to Saigon - riding around on the back of a bike - Our flight was scheduled to arrive late at night into Saigon so we decided to pre-book 2 tours for the following day with XO Tours (via their website). The owner, Tung, was very prompt and efficient with his responses to our emails and it was very easy to communicate with him.
Our first tour was to see the City Sights in the morning and we found ourselves in the care of 2 beautiful young ladies. They spoke good English and put our minds at rest about the traffic as they skillfully drove us around. Tung joined us and explained some of the history and culture surrounding the key places we visited. A great overview of the city.
In the evening we had selected the Foodie Tour and, again, we were not disappointed. In fact, it was the highlight of our time in Saigon. The 3 different street venues we visited all had great food and it was good fun to share the experience with a small group of other tourists and their drivers. Tung and his girls were all wonderful and attentive, explaining about the food we were eating and showing us how the flavours combine to make a truly memorable meal. The locations were not aimed at the tourist so it gave us a much better idea of 'real' Vietnamese food and we had a great variety to try and plenty of it. Tung had enabled us to see around his city in the very best possible way. He also forwarded some photos to us to remember our time with them.
In fact we had such a great time, that when we returned back to Saigon at the end of our trip last week, we booked the Shopping Spree tour that they also offer. We had a great time visiting a local market with Nga and Anh and managed to pick up a few bargains without being constantly hassled by the shopkeepers. The girls helped to make it so much fun for us that our time was up all too soon!
After taking 3 tours, we would not hesitate in recommending XO Tours to others and hope that they have as brilliant a time as we did. Tung also invited us to contact him if we needed anything during our stay and it was very re-assuring to know that we had someone to call on should we need to.

Food tour on 2 wheels = AMAZING! - My husband and I did the XO food tour in mid-February and I must say it was the highlight of our trip to HCMC. The tour began at our hotel around 5.30pm and ended around 10pm. The girls arrived promptly, introduced themselves, strapped on our helmets and off we went. Our first stop was a food stall that we never would have found on our own (I won't ruin the surprise but it was tasty!). Once there, we sat down and were joined by another couple and the lovely owner of XO Tours, Tung. Tung introduced himself and explained what we were eating and what would happen next as well as a brief overview of what to expect that night. He had the first course (and yes, there are MANY) with us and once finished, we departed for our next location. I don't want to say much about the different venues we visited throughout the night because that is part of the fun, but we ate a wide variety of delicious foods that night. You're not forced to eat anything you don't want too--not even the duck eggs ;-) We stopped at some hidden gems throughout the night; places we would NEVER find on our own.
The girls took to the streets with complete ease and made us both feel comfy on the back of their bikes. They were great tour guides, very chatty, fun, kind and had a great sense of humor. We really enjoyed spending time with them and learning about the city & it's food from the back of a bike. Tung was really great throughout the booking process, the night of the tour and even sent us a few photos from the night. He's extremely knowledgeable about the cuisine of HCMC and was happy to answer any questions we had and even offered to help us should we need it during the rest of our stay.
A huge thank you to Tung and the girls for a memorable time! We'll be sure to do the food tour again on our next trip to HCMC!!

John & Marcia

What a great few hours - What a great laugh this was ! Got met dead on time at the Hotel and greeted by the very friendly motorbike driver.Then got whisked off to the first stop to rendevous with the others and the owner Tung who was also the very knowledgable tour guide who accompanyed us throughout .
It´s a well thought out concept taking things very easy and the girls always laughing and joking making the trip very relaxed ,everyone on the trip seemed relaxed and chilled out .Felt 100% safe on the back of the bike despite the somewhat different traffic conditions here in Vietnam :- )
I booked up straight away for the night tour, it was that much fun ! It´s no wonder every review here has given it 5 stars as excellent !
I wish Tung and his team all the very best for this relativley new venture and am very sure it will expand.
Thanks
Simon

MUST DO TOUR!!!!!!! - I just did the sights tour. AMAZING! The thrill of riding on the back of a motorbike in HCM is something you will never forget. The tour is run professionally and the girls are truly kind and helpful.I feel safe from start to finish!!! I can not wait to do the foodies tour which i assume will be beyond amazing. thankyou to everyone at xo tours!!!

the best way to start a trip to Vietnam - We arrived in HCMC at lunch time, checked into our hotel and had a few drinks and then were picked up by XO tours from our hotel (EARLY!). The foodie tour takes you through areas of HCMC you will not ordinarily get to see and food you will not ordinarily get to eat.

At our first stop we had delicious soup and were introduced to the others on the tour. The second stop we were taken to china town to see the outside of the Ben Thanh markets and were told about the area. It was the only place our guides were concerned that we kept our bags in front of us and our eyes open to people around us. At our third stop we were fed BBQ goat breast and okra and prawns and BBQ frog. If you like chicken you'll LOVE frogs. On the final food stop we ate seafood. All of the food was delicious.

The best part of the tour were the guides. Tung has hired wonderful women to drive you around the city. they have fantastic english and are engaging and chatty. it's a four hour tour and you spend a fair chunk of that time on the back of a motorbike with your guide so it's great to get to know them and what they do outside of driving motorbikes. All their bikes are their own and they pay for their own fuel. They are funny and ensure that if there is a lull in the conversation that there is something new for them to tell you or ask you about your life. My guide was Kim, and i'm so pleased to have met her, she was amazing.

If we hadn't done this tour we would have been nervous of traffic the whole time we were in HCMC but as it is we discovered all the honking of horns is not in anger, it's to let other drivers know that you're there. The speed limit is 40km per hour so although the traffic looks crazy it's not.

It was amazing also to get out of district one and eat food locals eat.

If you don't do this tour whilst in HCMC you're robbing yourself.

Must do! Experience Ho Chi Minh like a local - Wonderful experience! From the motorbikes zooming you through all the districts in Ho Chi Minh, to the lively, friendly and engaging girls driving them, this tour was just amazing. The wonder is very knowledgeable and has set up an experience that you just can't get through conventional tour companies. We did the foodie tour at night, and ate and drank local fare that we would never have been exposed to in areas that we would have never known or attempted to venture out to. It was quite possibly in my top 5 travel experiences ever.

Excellent - The best way to see Ho Chi Minh city, and if you do the foodie tour, a great way to try some different Vietnamese food.
The tours are professionally run from start to finish, Tung and his team are clearly passionate about what they do.
So book already!

A perfect way to pack in a lot in a short visit to Saigon - The young Vietnamese ladies who drive you around are engaging and fun. The owner is very knowledgable, especially about easily overlooked history. We did the morning sights tour and ended up booking the foodie tour too because we enjoyed it so much. They emailed us pictures from the trip to supplement our own. It was a perfect way to experience Saigon in a short amount of time.
Great old - XO are excellent. The girls are fantastic. The food was great. We did it on our first night in Vietnam, and it was the best start we could have had. Just eat and drink as much as you can!

Awesome - Did the foodie tour with my boyfriend after reading the reviews on trip advisor. Definitely the best tour we did in Vietnam. The guides speak great English, are friendly, funny and very nice. The tour really gives you an insight into life in Ho Chi Minh city. It was so refreshing to get out of district one and see other parts of the city. Riding on the motorbike was lots of fun and it was great to see the city from a different perspective. The food is amazing - especially the seafood stop! Overall I would highly recommend it.

Lots of fun and very tasty! - I did the foodie evening tour and it was a great way to get off of the beaten path and experience HCMC. The food was amazing - everything from grilled meats to fresh seafood to spicy bun bo, all eaten at places that would've been really difficult to find as a tourist. Our group visited multiple districts and had interesting commentary both from the drivers and from the owner Tung on the differences between the neighborhoods, and on how the city is changing. My driver was very careful and I never felt endangered at any time while riding on the motorbike. A very fascinating and tasty tour, highly recommended!

LOVED IT! - We took the foodie and city tour with our 15 and 10 year old children. Our youngest child doesn't like seafood and we read that there was a lot of seafood on the tour so I asked if they would be able to get rice or noodles for my daughter. They could and had arranged for a different type of dish that our youngest could eat at each of our stops. The guides were great and made everyone feel safe as they helped tell us about the different districts in Saigon and helped us sample new foods. Everything about the trip was great and every person in my family loved it...even the teenager:) It was the highlight of our time in Saigon!

Fast fun, Fabulous food ... and great gals! - As one who rarely, if ever, takes part in 'touristy' tours, I made an exception by booking the Foodie tour with XO, and had an absolute blast. Everything - from the response to our initial enquiry, to the final drop off back to our hotel and photos sent through to us after the night - was done with the utmost professionalism, and a good dose of fun. They even allowed a friend of ours to join the tour at the last minute, which was much appreciated. For one, you get to see far-flung parts of HCMC that you'd probably never get to on your own. Throughout the trip, our trusted guides were enlightening us with information about the various neighbourhoods. Not for a moment did I feel unsafe on the bike, they made certain that you were taken extremely good care of so you felt at home in their city. Then there was the food. We were hosted in a lighthearted, entertaining way - and were treated to enough street food experiences (and quantity of food) to satisfy the most voracious foodie appetite! The girls were truly sweet and a lot of fun, the food delicious and varied. And they always made sure you had something on your plate to try - we ate to the point of bursting. This is one tour I would happily encourage everyone to take part in. Thanks for providing one of the most memorable experiences of our trip ... And I'd do it all over again!

Fantastic motorbike tour of Ho Chi Minh city - I like to start by saying, the 'Sights tour' is unique because Tung, the Tour's creator and principal tour guide is an Vietnamese/American who offers you interesting insights into the some architectural and historical aspects of the city.
The tour was fun and engaging because we were ridden around the city on motorcycle scooters by lovely Vietnamese girls who were friendly and obliging. I rode with Binh and she was really professional and happy to tell me a little about her life in Saigon. As I have learned Vietnamese it was a great opportunity for me to have this conversation in Vietnamese but I could have had the same conversation in English because they all spoke great English. Also we were picked up and dropped off at our hotel.
I was able to book and pay for this tour through Paypal which was convenient for me. Tung was quick to confirm via email. This tour is a must do when in Saigon.

Brilliant! - XO tours foodie tour was one of the best organized tours we've ever done. Amazing food.
As female travelers having the girls as our guides was fantastic and was a definite selling point.
We saw so much more of Ho Chi Minh than we could have possibly seen on our own.
Great value, food, guides, experience.
Thanks again.

I couldn't be happier! - I have never been out of the USA before my January trip to HCMC. I scheduled the Foodie Tour for my very first night there and I am very glad I did. Traveling alone and not being experienced, I probably would have been really worried about venturing alone into these strange surroundings. XO Tours to the rescue!!
I walked out of my hotel at 5:30pm to be greated by the beautiful Anh and she immediately made me feel comfortable and ready for my new experiences. What followed was 4 1/2 hours of great food, great conversation, and meeting friendly people from every corner of the Earth.
I plan on traveling to a different country every year and I will always remember XO Tours as the very first experience that started it all.

Absolutely essential - Great set up with these guys, e girls on the bikes are smiley happy charming and happy to all about hcmc and their lives, the tour guide Tung is extremely knowledgable and wants everyone to have. Great time. Lots of stories and bits off the beaten track. Eg we got to the emerald pagoda and it was so touristy he just got us back on e bikes and went to a market where we were the only foreigners there. Top stuff. Do the tour on your first morning - you get your bearings, see the main sights and then the bike girls will drop you off where you want to go next, or tell you where you should go for the afternoon according to what you want to do! Summed it simply - the best money you'll spend in hcmc. And a bit of fun on the back of the mopeds, crazy roads, but never felt in danger.

Most magical memory....fantastic!!!!!! - I traveled solo and initially started researching things i could do in HCMC city at night as i didnt want to be locked up in the hotel room alone for the whole trip nor was I confident enough to bar hop or walk around the streets late at night.
I stumbled across XO tours on tripadvisor and could believe the excellent reviews. well, BELIEVE them. They are FANTASTIC.
The website is easy to navigate, Tung the owner and creator responds to inquiries in a flash! I couldnt decide on a tour, so i booked two!
The foodie tour caught my eye, FOOD and CULTURE, mixed with a motorbike, knowledgable guide and laughter...it was more than i could ask for.
From the moment my guide Phuong met me at the hotel i knew it was going to be a fun night. With a warm smile she greeted me, explained the safety aspects of riding the motorbike and away we went. It was incredible, being a part of the crazy, unpredictable and overwhleming traffic, The gorgeous breeze, the beeps, wonderful conversation with Phuong and laughter, plenty of laugher.
I dont want to ruin the surprise of what you will eat - but trust me - not only was it delicious and authentic - but i also NEVER felt unsure or unsafe. While no-one is going to 100% guarantee that you wont get sick from consuming food or beverages while traveling (not just in Vietnam) Tung and his lovely and professional guides treat you like family and close freinds. I trusted them from the moment I received their first email.
And the food....oh WOW...the food. Not just pedestrian, tourist fodder...this was scrumptious authentic food. Food that locals eat and eat with locals....the hustle, the bustle, the insight into the true Vietnam. We stopped at about 5 different places to eat a plethora of diverse delicacies........and drove between many many districts and got to see what most tours dont. One of my fave memories is drinking beer and cleaning prawns hot off a little bbq....scrumptious. This city is ALIVE after dark. Tung met us at the stops and was very informative about culture, history and had an answer to any question i threw at him! In a fantastic touch, he took photos of Phuong and I on the tour and emailed them to me a few days later! Such a special memory.
The tour ended with a drop off at the door of my hotel...and I was sorry to say goodbye to my lovely guide.
The next day i was up and early and had booked a Shopping tour.....what a great concept! Tung asked me to email a few ideas of what i was interested in purchasing or viewing and his experienced guide.Nga spent the tour taking me through culture, history, while also shopping up a storm. It was like hanging at with a gal pal....shopping, talking, shopping, laughing......totally worth the time and the money....... Nga took me to some wonderful local shopping secrets!!!!
I have recommended this company to EVERYONE i know......please dont be put off by the motorcycle if you are a bit concerned, I feel safer on the back of the bike than i did walking on my own !!!!!...dont wait, book, book, book. it truly is the BEST thing you will do while in HCMC!!!!!

fun, professional, and DELICIOUS! - I did the foodie tour and highly recommend it. The staff is professional, speaks good English, and has a good time along with you. It has been the highlight of my trip so far. I only wish I had stayed an extra day to do the sightseeing tour. Nga was a delight to spend time with! It was a wonderful way to kick off my trip, and very educational.

Only regret is missing evening foodie tour too! Morning city tour awesome... - Best part of trip to Saigon HCMC - made my soul sing! Owner said foodie tour booked 4 days out, so plan ahead and do both!

Amazing food, amazing experience - We had the best time ever. We picked Foodie tour and were taken to most amazing steet food stalls in the city.

Imagine roaming on tha back of the bike thru crazy city traffic with stops at places that you will never find yourself.

For less than $60 you get great soup, BBQ, sea food and deserts at the end.

I would love to go back right now!

Fun, Exciting and Educational!! - Amazing! I learned a lot about Vietnam during the tour and had a blast doing it. Similar to most, im not a huge fan of tours, but I would recommend this one to everyone!
The staff is outgoing and friendly. Each stop on the tour is full of history. You can spend as much or as little time as you please at each place, and every question you have will get answered.
Need something to do for a few hours, take the tour! You cant leave Saigon without saying you rode on a motorbike!

A unique HCMC experience - Last night my husband & I did the Xo Foodie Tour. Wow. Imagine 2 middle aged Aussies on the back of bikes whipping around peak hour Saigon! White knuckles you may ask? Initially, & then we settled in to a truly magical night. The girl drivers were excellent negotiators of the traffic & fantastic & helpful guides with cheeky senses of humor. The food was a sensational mix of local fare & great quality. We went where we have never been before, & this is our 4th time in HCMC! A fun filled & unique for the adventure traveller.

Best part of my stay in HCMC! - I'm not really sure what else I can add to XO Tours' stellar reviews except to say that it was the only organized tour where I felt like I got a real sense of Vietnamese street food. I've heard that tour guides aren't allowed to take tourists to real street food for health reasons but Tung has seen several food stands that are authentic and delicious. If I ever return to HCMC, I might try the Foodie Tour, but Saigon By Night was really impressive.

On the back of a motorbike by night is definitely the best way to see Saigon!

The best! - Of all of the tours we took in Vietnam, this was the best! The guides are all so sweet. Best of all, they are smart- they all seem to be college students bound for success. The owner of the company is Vietnamese American and super friendly, as well. I will definitely book another tour with them upon returning to Vietnam.

Five Stars on Two Wheels - Wear your helmet, a huge appetite and a sense of adventure. XO Foodie tour is more than an encounter with various foods, it's a dynamic social experience. There's something about the mix of: the randomness of who you end up dining with; the mode of transportation around the city; and the combination of tastes and textures that makes this a not to miss tour. I had a delicious and fun evening – one of the highlights of my time in Ho Chi Minh City. Tung, the owner of XO offers an extremely well-organized and thoughtful tour, replete with guides who are fluent in English, enthusiastic and knowledgeable about their city, and, perhaps most important of all, conscious of the safety of their passengers on the back of their motorcycles.

Saigon has an astonishing density of restaurants, and choosing which to go to, besides the usual tourist haunts, can be overwhelming. It's nice to have a local make those choices for you. The tour stretches beyond District 1, into areas that are not as frequented by tourists – and via the food tour, you can see the way of life in these varied districts. Also, Vietnamese cuisine is very diverse, and it's a good idea to expand ones horizons beyond pho, bun and salad rolls – to taste at least a few of the wide variety of dishes available – which derive from different regions in Vietnam and some which are influenced by the culinary traditions of other countries.

BEST way to see Saigon - so glad I did it! - We did the Foodie Tour, and what a tour it was. So much fun, the girls (drivers) are so sweet and friendly, and their English is great, too. My boyfriend was a little apprehensive about going on the motorbike. Although, as many others have said, as soon as you hop on, you feel extremely safe. It was great to go to places off the beaten track, away from the main streets as you really got a feel for the culture. The 3rd stop had the best seafood I have ever had. This tour is definitely a must! Thanks to Tung and the girls!

Great Morning - My two Daughters and I did the City Sights Tour on January 19, 2012. The girls that took us were fun and it was a great way to see the sights of downtown. We feel safe at all times and it is an excellent way to experience the buzz of the city. We were limited with the time we had available so this was a perfect way to see everything we wanted and to have some fun. Everything went according to plan so I have no hesitation in recommending this Company which is well run by Tung Do and his staff.

Real experience of Saigon! - It is very good opportunity to have experience of real food and local life that we are never able to find by ourselves. We truly enjoyed sight seeing and motobiking and of cause great Vietnam food. Also the ladies said many things about Vietnam while we are moving from place to place for new food. Don't miss it!

Fun fun fun - We were greated by some lovely young ladies at our hotel who took us on a great tour of the city along with some tasty food. This is a tour that you must not miss. Going along with all the other motorbikes is a real experience. The food was great and the diversity is just right. The guides were very knowledgable and made the night special with their smiles and hospitality.

Don't miss this tour!! - We took the Foodie tour. If you do one thing in Saigon, this is what it should be. You get an amazing feeling for the city by seeing it on the back of a motorbike, the streets pulsate with people and movement. The drivers are excellent, and skillfully navigate through the traffic. The food was very good, and eating in local restaurants that a tourist would never find a real treat. The barbque restaurant feels like a German biergarten, with people enjoying life under the stars. All food and beer was included in the cost, and we really covered a lot of territory seeing the city streets.
Our drivers were so kind and helpful, and answered our every question as they drove.
Thank you, tripadvisor reviewers, for helping us to find this tour!

Best Tour in Saigon - Did this Tour with my wife. We did the foodie tour, got picked up at the hotel by the girls. They introduced themselves and we got to know each other along the way. This is by far one of the best Tours that you can do in Ho Chi Minh City and you get to see a little of what the locals see which is far more interesting than just knowing what the regular Tourist sees. We got to eat some foods that the locals do which is a little different from what the regular Viet tourist would know. Being Vietnamese myself, I wasnt too keen on visiting local street food knowing how dirty it usually is but the places we were quite clean and I havent been sick yet :-) . The girls are really welcoming and were happy to answer any question which we threw at them. Will definitely recommend this to all my friends.

A must-have experience! - Did the foodie tour with my wife and was one of the absolute highlights of our 5 and a half week holiday of South East Asia. The operator of the company Tung was extremely informative and friendly, and our drivers were just fantastic! Despite the hustle and bustle (or mayhem) of the roads in Ho Chi Minh we felt 100% safe and the food we ate was delicious and interesting. I would do this again in a heartbeat if we had a chance to return to Ho Chi Minh.

Must do when in Ho Chi Minh City - Very nice way to explore HCMC. The ladies that picked us up for the Saigon by Night tour were very kind and drove safely in the heavy traffic. Everything was well organized and the drivers showed us different parts (districts) of HCMC.

XO Tours Changed My LIFE! I got engaged on the tour and it was perfect! - I wanted to propose to my girlfriend (now fiancé) and since we were going on a holiday I thought when would there be a better time. I thought about so many different ideas but I thought I'd try to organize something with XO Tours because they had so many good reviews.

We went on the usual tour and then Tung organized something special for us in the end. Lets start with the usual tour. It's amazing! We went and tried some of the best food we ate in all of Vietnam, in the back alleys of Ho Chi Minh. We would have never discovered these places frequented by locals. The girls we rode with were so friendly, their English was better than mine and we got to see different areas of the city that go beyond just the frequently touristed areas.

At the end of the trip, Tung organized for us to go to a restaurant on an island in a lake in the city, once we walked off the boat everywhere was decorated with photos of my girlfriend and I, with a massive bouquet of flowers, a violinist and champagne. The organization was perfect, she said yes and we all celebrated.

If anyone I know goes anywhere near Ho Chi Minh I will definitely be telling them to try XO Tours. Don't miss out, you'll regret it!

Highlight of my Vietnam adventure - I took the Saigon By Night tour mid January and it was the best thing I ever did. It was amazing to say the least. I am quite an anxious person but I feel extremely safe the whole time. My driver, Bien would have to be the nicest person I have met in Vietnam. All the girls spoke English very well and were very lovely.
If I ever go back to Ho Chi Minh City I would do it again and again!
Thanks XO Tours!!!

The best way to see Saigon! - Saigon is a motorbike city and these tours allow you to be part of the vibrancy of the city, rather than an observer.

My friends and I did both the Sights and Foodie tours. The Sights Tour was great, but if you only do one - I strongly recommend the Foodie Tour. Even if you don't consider yourself a Foodie, the tour goes to areas of the city that tourbooks don't mention and includes time to talk and ask questions of the amazing girls (the drivers). You need to go on this tour to realize just how much you hadn't yet seen (or eaten)! Tung is a great guide and the girls are fun-loving and really made the whole experience.

Some people may hold back for fear of being on a scooter, but the girls are excellent drivers and you'll realize you made the right decision in less than 5 minutes. Best thing we did in Saigon!

Great loss - We were met at our hotel by the "girl's. All dressed in traditional costume. Just gorgeous! We had 3 adults and 3 children. When I signed up to do the tour I didnt really appreciate the amount of motorbikes that would be riding along side us. I guess you just have to witness it! We all were assigned a girl who drove us around for the morning to see the sights. We felts completely safe and had an awesome time. I would highly recommend it to anyone really wanting to experience Ho chi Minh city just like the locals do! It was loads of fun and the girls are just so lovely. Tung (the boss) would meet us at various destinations to explain I must do in HCM city!

Great Introduction to Saigon - We took The Sights Tour the morning after we arrived in Saigon. We had travelled from the airport to our hotel by taxi the previous afternoon and marvelled at the crazy traffic. However, once we were on the bikes with the girls, we felt completely safe and even enjoyed being amongst all of the other bikes.
Our two guides were lovely friendly girls who love their jobs and obviously enjoy meeting people from all over the world. We met Tung a little way into the tour and his knowledge and enthusiasm for his country and city is infectious. The tour took us to some parts of the city which otherwise we would never have seen.
A fabulous introduction to Saigon.

If you only do one thing in vietnam this is the one - XO Tours what can I say? You are brilliant. We arrived in HCMC and were overwhelmed with the traffic. What had we go ourselves into, we were going to get on the back of a bike in all this traffic we must be mad. Tung you and your girls gave us the most amazing experience we had all holidays. We are all still talking about the foodies tour you took our group of 13 family and friends on. From the moment we sat on the back of the bikes we all felt safe in the hand of these amazing young ladies who took us to the most wonderful sites, we ate so much food, food we have never eaten before at places you only dream of visiting. We covered so much in 4.5 hours seeing parts on HCMC that were off the tourist track. It was like being in your own TV documentary. Tung we have only praise for your knowledge, professionalism and incredible amount of effort you put into your tours. You have the loveliest, funniest , most special tour guides,who kept us entertained the whole tour. They are the best in Vietnam . If in HCMC go on an XO tour, its a must.

Very nice trip - good food - Congratulation Tung your girls are fantastic.
For the others . We were a couple, 2 friends and 2 solo travelers and very quickly due to the girls a good group and had a fantastic evening and yummy food. It was one of my best evenings during my holiday. The ride on the motorbike during the rush hours is without words. But you see also another Saigon as you come to see many districts.Crazy buzy China town and an area which looks even wealthy. So many different views to Saigon and the food and drinks are a lot and good. You can try some strange ones as well.

Exhilarating and informative! - We were novices a riding pillion on motorbikes but our friendly guides were very skilled and professional. Tung, the tour leader was also very informative, joining the tour at the stops we made. We saw parts of Ho Chi Minh City that we wouldn't have seen otherwise. The street food provided was also great! Highly recommended way to see Saigon like a local. We felt like we were leaving friends at the end of the tour!

Definately a must do in Saigon! - My fiance and I had five full days in HCMC over New Years 2011/2012, and we booked the Foodie Tour for our last full evening... even though I knew it was going to be good, I still couldn't believe how amazing it was. Tung was a fabulous host and his explanation of the different districts, complemented with the girls' local knowledge and cheeky comments made the tour enjoyable and informative. And how could i forget to mention THE FOOD.... WOW. Definately smashed my expectations to smithereens.. frogs legs, crab, goat, scallops... and thats just to name a few of the amazing culinary delights we got to try. DEFINATELY woudl recommend to anyone interested in getting to see beyond the 'usual sights' in HCMC. Five stars.

A Tasty Adventure... - We took the Foodie Tour on our 2nd night in Saigon. What a fabulous introduction to this amazing vibrant city. Our beautiful hostesses met us at our hotel and after a brief safety induction we were on our way- merging into the traffic like one of the locals. The girls are absolutely charming and friendly and the best motorbike drivers in Saigon- they make us feel safe and comfortable all the way, speak excellent English and ensure that we enjoyed 5 star care all night long.
We sampled some of the best street food that Vietnam has to offer including an abundance of seafood and discovered the hidden gems of Saigon. Tung and his team are very knowledgeable about the local life and culture. Lighthearted, entertaining and exceptional value for money. Will definitely do more XO Tours on my next visit!
Losh, Pregs & Darshin

Best tour in Vietnam - This tour was absolutely amazing and I would recommend it to anyone going to Saigon. We will definitely be doing another one of their tours when we are back in Saigon. We did the city sights tour and our drivers were wonderful and the tour guide was also great. Thanks so much XO tours!

Highlights of Saigon Visit - We did the foodie tour and it was worth every penny. Two lovely girls collected us from our hotel and whisked us away for an evening of eating delights. The girls were so nice and very engaging, I was sad to leave them at the end. Not only do you get to experience some great street food, you also get to experience parts of Saigon tourists don't get to see - from the back of a moto! I felt very safe, the girls were excellent drivers. Our guide was very informative but only joined us sporadically, leaving us with the girls - which was perfectly OK. The BBQ and seafood were great. I can't recommend this experience enough.

Great Tour - did not disappoint - This is a fantastic tour, especially for those unfamiliar with HCM city. It was our first time to the city and we were a little wary about going out at night so we did the Night Tour with XO Tours. It was great - we got to see sections of the city we wouldn't ordinarily see and got to tool around on the back of a scooter - the only way to see HCM! Definitely book in advance as this tour is so popular spots go quickly! You won't be disappointed.

Best activity we did in Vietnam - Don't Miss! - We went on the night time "Foodie" tour on January 5th, 2012. This was the absolute BEST activity we did in Vietnam throughout the whole 2 weeks we toured around the southernmost part of the country. Tung Do, the owner of XO Tours, has set up a wonderful business that gives tourist a locals view of Ho Chi Minh - traveling on the back of a scooter and eating at local, street restaurants. Although the tour is $60 per person (which in Vietnam would be considered steep) it is so well thought out and well put together that the cost is truly a bargain and we had absolutely NO complaints about any part of the tour.

The tour guides picked us up at our hotel on their scooters promtly at 5:20 pm and dropped us back at our hotel a bit after 9 pm. The women who drive the scooters are safe, informative and, above all, FUN! Our drivers were Binh and Phuong. We felt completely safe on the back of their scooters as they deftly manuvered around the busy Ho Chi Minh traffic. They spoke excellent English and we could understand everything they said off the bike but sometimes the Ho Chi Minh traffic drowned out some of the conversation so listen closely when you're riding. We were taken through 5 different districts from the high end district all the way to the poorer neighborhoods, stopped at 3 different restaurants to eat, stopped in Chinatown to taste some rice paper (delicious!) all while the women gave us informative information about the different areas. They take photos at each location so if you don't want to bring a camera Tung will email you the photos of your trip. We did take along a small video camera which was great for filming the crazy traffic in the city as we zipped by on the scooters. However, you can rent a "helmet cam" from Tung to capture things a bit better.

At every restaurant stop we had the most delicious food. There was absolutely nothing that we didn't like. Very high quality, fresh cooking. At one stop the restaurant actually puts a small grill right in the middle of the middle of the table and your drivers grill the food right in front of you. They teach you how to eat Vietnamese food, what sauces to use with which items and tell you how to cook them. They fed you a lot of different types of food and we were completely full by the end of the trip.

We did this tour at the end of our stay in Vietnam but I wish we had done it first because we would have booked additional tours with XO. Tung offers several including day tours. Although we did take a walking 1/2 day city tour and a tour out to the Chu Chi Tunnels and they were both very good, I think we would have gotten a much better sense of the city itself with XO.

Congratulations to Tung Do and our drivers Binh and Phuong for giving us a fantastic time that we will always remember!

Liz Stelz and Keith Huguet
Tour Date: January 4th, 2012

Fantastic way to spend the evening - We just got back from a weekend break in HCMC and the Foodie tour was by far the highlight. Such an amazing way to discover the city & don't be put off by the thought of being on a scooter in the crazy traffic - the girls are very safe drivers and it's all part of the experience!

Xo Tours also had amazing attention to customer service & even took a camera with them so we were sent pictures of our trip 2 days after going on it. The food and drink were all free flowing so you get real value for money.

Highly recommend this if you have a spare evening.

Extraordinary and unconventional! - I should start by mentioning that when I travel, my top priority is to feel how life is like being a local in my destinations. The second is to try local delicacies. Not ones that you can only find in elite restaurants, but ones that people commonly have everyday.

I just knew about XO Tours 2 weeks before my departure to Saigon. I was surprised to find its 200+ Excellent reviews, making it top the list of tours in Saigon on TripAdvisor. I decided to see whether they were as good as the reviews hinted. I booked the Foodie tour, as I was interested in its premises to bring us to parts of Saigon infrequently visited by other tours, as well as to places where locals often gather to have meals.

During the tour, we rode through several districts in Saigon, passing by the Saigon river, through crowded market, new developing area, old overcrowded districts... and we stopped at a few locations, such as across Ben Thanh market, district 7, etc, where Mr Tung Do, the owner and the lead guide, would explain about the history and recent developments of those particular places. The street meals that we had were also superb! We tasted local delights made from scallops, crabs, shrimps, quails, etc. Some of them were close to what we often find in my hometown in Indonesia, so it was quite unexpected that I had a nostalgic feeling. It was also the first time I tried hột vịt lộn, or internationally known as balut.

The girls were knowledgeable guides, as well as smooth and safe riders. Thanks to them, I can boast the experience of being a part of Saigon's famous heavy traffic, which is dominated by motorcycles, to my friends. Also, when having meals, they were really outgoing and fun to be with, as they often joined the banter among the guests. They were also open, and didn't mind to share a bit of their backgrounds, or how they generally felt about living in Saigon.

I stumbled upon Mr Tung Do and some of the girls again a few times after the trip, when I had a stroll with my friend around downtown Saigon. I was impressed that they still recognised me and were willing to have short chit-chats with us.

Expectations were met.

BTW, as a person with an IT background, I found that their website has a nice design, so this is certainly a good representation of the company.

While I can only make a review based on my short experience with them, I can recommend XO Tours to those who visit Saigon.

wonderful experience! - We did two of their tours, the Sights in the morning at 9 am and the Foodie tour at 5:30pm. We had Phuong and Tien in the morning, and again Tien and Ni at night. All of them were extremely safe drivers. It's my first time riding on a motorbike and it only took me a few minutes before I got comfortable on it. They answered most of our questions about the city and how the Vietnamese people lived/worked. We got to see the major sights around District 1, like how most of the locals do (via motorbike). Their boss, Tung, came with us on some parts of the trip and gave us an insight on how Vietnam was before. The ladies were super nice, they even took us to an authentic Vietnamese coffee store when we requested it. They also brought us to their favorite Pho place when we said we wanted to eat Pho. In the evening during the Foodie tour, we got to eat, I think for me, the best noodle soup ever (and it's not Pho)! We also got to taste different kinds of food (goat meat, frogs legs, shrimp, scallops, among other things). We saw parts of Chinatown and zoomed through different districts. The girls and other tourists were great company as well. We learned about each other, about their culture and way of life. It gave us a completely different, but positive perspective of Saigon. Truly a great way to start a trip to the city!!
Time! - 5 of us went on the sightseeing tour, it was insightful and educational, the riders could speak very good English and they were very friendly and engaging. Definitely recommended!

fun fun fun - I was quite daunted when I saw the traffic in HCMC and was almost sorry I had booked a scooter tour, but it was an awsome experience. I never felt unsafe despite being quite nervous on the back of the bike and was extreamly sorry the tour was not longer.it was informative and a fun way to see the sights and I will do it again in a heartbeat.

You won't ask your money back! - Enough has been said already, no need to further spoil the surprise.
I highly recommend the foodie tour.
Xo tours fully deserve to be Saigon's #1 attraction. We had a private guide to visit the city one day before but the XO Tour was far better.
Just do it with closed eyes!

Fabulous foodie tour - The foodie tour offered by Xo tours was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. It showed you Siagon by night, taking you all over the city. In truth, it was one of the best meals I have ever eaten - in particular, the scallops with sweet fish sauce and peanuts was delectible. Our guide, Tung, was knowledgeable and passionate about his business, the city, his staff and the customers. The girls on whose bikes we rode, concentrated to us as if we were royalty, humerously passing along anecdotes, peeling our prawns braaing the goats meet and ocra. It truly was one of my most memorable travel experiences. Many thanks and I am certain you will not be dissapointed if you book with this fabulous fun, innovative and organized tour comapny. worth every cent!

highly recommended - "If you cant beat them join them." Thats how I felt after feeling totally intimidated by the sea of ​​motor bikes in Ho Chi Minh City. The Saigon by night tour was the best thing I could have done to change my mind about the city. The girls are really fantastic , full of life and great hostess and make you feel it all so easy manouvering their way through the traffic with me sitting behind, at first petrified but within a few minutes I was loving it all. Its a great way of seeing the city and getting a different view of it. They met us at our hotel and brought us back. The tour is very well organized with a great fun, spirit and energy. My husband and I are almost 60 years old and both felt completely at ease and had an amazingly wonderful time. I wouldnt hesitate to recommend it,

Highlight of Our Trip "Foodie Tour" - We only stayed for 2 days in Saigon but this Foodie Tour makes us feel we've seen Saigon for a long time because they make you see, eat, feel and the information about the city is very helpful..The motorbike ride is very safe and the girls are truly nice people. Don't worry the food is served with care and authentically delicious " I Love Saigon x

Highlight of my trip in Ho Chi Minh - The Saigon by night tour was absolutely amazing! The girls were incredibly friendly and easy to talk to, and they were great tour guides. The feeling of being on a motorbike was indescribable and I highly recommend it to all. The food and drink places that we visited were also delicious. There was honestly nothing that I disliked about this tour!

What a fun way to see Ho Chi Minh! - We took both The Sights and Saigon by Night Tour. Both were great. The girls were wonderful and Tung was a wealth of information. So much fun to be one of the crowds of motorbikes on the road. Would love to see more tours like this throughout Vietnam and other areas of the world!

Foodie fun, join in all that makes this city vibrant - Our family went on the Foodie tour on the last night of our Vietnam holiday and what a way to farewell this vibrant city. The girls were wonderful and we always felt very safe as we joined the orderly chaos that is the scooter stream of HCM streets. The information about the different districts, foods and daily life is very interesting and the food wonderful. It would have been great at the beginning of our visit, but there is no bad time for this tour.

Saigon by Night tour is awesome! - The Saigon by Night motorbike tour was fantastic - you get a sense of how vibrant and exhilarating Saigon is. It's incredible to be amidst the sea of ​​motorbikes and really feel like part of the heartbeat of the city. The food is delicious - if I go back I might try the foodie tour! I would recommend this tour to everyone - the girls are incredibly friendly and the owner takes pride in his company, and met us on the tour to give us some history and information about the areas we saw. Also, I'm a scaredy-cat and I didn't feel unsafe at all. Awesome!

Best way to experience Saigon! - We did the Night Tour, which was a great way to explore Saigon and see places we didn't even know existed! The girls were fantastic guides and very safe drivers. It was really interesting and good fun... Best of all there's nothing quite like being on a motorbike in the crazy Vietnamese traffic!

Great experience, not to be missed! - My husband and I really loved the Night Sights tour; it was a great way to experience HCMC. The girls were great; they were excellent guides and safe drivers. We got to see places we didn't even know existed. All in all it was great fun and nothing quite compares to being on a motorbike in the crowded Vietnamese streets.

A really fun way to tour Saigon. - We did the daytime tour and had a great time. Several of our group had to be persuaded to go on the motorcycles, they were very nervous about being on a motorcycle in the crazy traffic. Once the tour started they had a lot of fun and weren't scared anymore. The girls are excellent drivers, very safe. They all had lovely, vivacious personalities and a real sense of fun. The tour covers some of the major sights and, in our case, included a few places we had specifically requested to see. We were met at each stop by Tung, the owner of the company, a Vietnamese-American. His background gives him an interesting perspective on Vietnam, as well as insight into the people and culture. Tung will explain at each sight, then the girls will drive us to the next. The girls also took pictures for us - they turned out to be the only group shots we had, since our kids never wanted to pose for pictures. I wish we could have done the nighttime tour also, but it was already sold out. Tung was also helpful providing some suggestions of other things we could do in Ho Chi Minh City. We would highly recommend XO Tours for a really fun way to see the city!

What a fun way to tour Saigon - When you see the motorbikes from a car it looks like a crazy way to travel, but in the middle of all the motorbikes it really is a work of art. Our guides were careful and very good drivers and we enjoyed seeing the city sights up close. We stopped at all the places and had time to walk around a bit and they took lots of pictures for us. Definitely the way to see the city!

Amazing fun and would highly recommend! - I did the shopping tour with Nga and I would say that was the highlight of my trip! I was looking particularly for sewing fabric and she knew exactly where to take me. She could speak to the vendors on my behalf and got me some pretty good deals. It was so exciting to be on the motorbike traveling the way other Vietnamese people do and I felt safe the entire time I was with her. Nga took me for some amazing bun bo hue (beef noodle soup) and even taught me a few phrases like "choy aoi muk wa" (oh my god, that is too expensive!!) :P

I did the Saigon Night tour as well but I had to cut it short to 2 hours instead because I had another appointment. Tung and Nga were more than accommodating and took me and my friend on a quickly revised version through the city which was still pretty fun. They really know how to show a girl a good time!

I would really recommend this tour to anyone that wanted to experience true Saigon from the back of a motorbike!

By the way, I learned if you wanted to pick up cuties all you need is to have an awesome bike and make kissy noises! Hahah :D

Foodie Tour is a must! - My partner and I went on the 'Foodie' night tour. Our guides were fantastic and very friendly and informative.
We excellent places and ate wonderful food that we would never visit find on our own! The tour was excellent value for money and definately a highlight of our entire trip!

Amazing tour - a must-do when in Saigon - My husband, 12-year-old daughter and I took the Foodie Tour that runs for about 4.5 hours and combined the Saigon by Night Tour with a gastronomic feast, visiting several local restaurants, serving traditional dishes. The girls were very safe and we loved it so much, we're booking another tour when we go back to the city at the end of our trip. It has been the ultimate highlight for my daughter, who absolutely loved the ride and requested some very unusual foods while on the tour! Thanks Tung and thanks to our lovely drivers!

A really fun foodie tour! - My wife and I were able to do the foodie tour on short notice (although only due to a cancellation) and it was definitely our gain. We were nervous about getting on the back of a scooter, I am a big American and my driver was a small Vietnamese girl, but my worries were completely unfounded. We zipped around to three great restaurants and in between saw some parts of Saigon we definitely wouldn't have seen otherwise. The food was great and I really can't speak highly enough of the group of girls who were our group (3 couples) drivers. They chatted us up and made our experience really unique and fun.
Definitely worth doing.

Biker fun in Saigon - My boyfriend and I only had one night in Saigon and took the Saigon by night tour based on the reviews on Trip Advisor and can completely guarantee that all you read is true. We had a fantastic time with our 2 guides - I rode with Ting who had great banter and gave me a great insight into the Vietnamese culture. The street food that you get along the way is delicious and would be a great introduction in buying street food for the rest of your journey through Vietnam. I can't recommend this tour more. If only they could set up in various other cities around the world!

Amazing night tour! Great guides/Drivers! Must do in Vietnam! - Fantastic experience, felt very safe on the bikes and would recommend to anyone looking for something different to do in Saigon!

Chantelle - Melbourne, Australia

One of the best things we did!!!!!! - When coming to Ho Chi Minh in November we didn´t really know what to do. Then we saw the good ratings here at tripadvisor and therefore decided to book XO tours and we must say it was fantastic !!!! One of the best things we did during our whole trip!!!!! Would defenitely do it again, thanks to the girls! Regards Christina and Michael

AWESOME AWEOME HIGHLIGHT OF OUR HOLIDAY - The XO Tours Saigon Foodie Tour is absolutely awesome! I am usually disenchanted of riding on a motor bike but at no point during the trip did I feel that I was in harm's way. I loved riding around the city on motorbikes with the girls as our guides.Tung and his girls take safety seriously and are very skilled at handling their mopeds. The girls are so very charming, friendly and knowledgeable. The food was excellent and the tour took us to different districts to try different types of foods. The 1st stop was the best noodles, 2nd stop was a BBQ at which point the girls cooked the meat and seafood on open coals. They made sure we were fed first before they had something to eat themselves. We loved the last stop the best as the seafood was just delicious. We finished the night with local desserts. The girls then took us back to our hotel with a sad parting for our tour. We would like to thank you Tung for being such a good guide and allowing us to experience such a great tour. I could keep writing and writing explaining this tour but it would spoil it for anyone going on the night. If you are planning to visit Saigon then I would HIGHLY, HIGHLY recommend adding this tour to your To Do List !! You will be so glad you did!!

Absolute "Must do"!!! - We did the night time Foodie tour on our first night in Ho Chi Min, and loved it!
As four middle aged adults, who were awed by the traffic, we were nervous at first but everything was great. Girls were gorgeous and fun, Tung was always there to answer questions, and the 4+ hours flew by. Absolute value for money, and the only way to see the city as locals do. The photos and video of the event are also included in the price (sent after) and that is a whole new reminder of the fun we had!

Awesome, the best way to see Ho Chi Minh city. - My husband and I took a 2 day trip to Saigon. After reading about XO tours on Tripadvisor, decided to give it a try. We started the day on "the sights tour. They were one time to pick us up at our hotel. Riding on the scooters was a lot of fun, and our Russian and English drivers were great. We met up with Tung (the owner) on the tour, he was very knowledgable and really cared about our experience. We had so much fun we signed up for "The Foodie tour" that night.

A 'must do' in Saigon - This is a 'not to be missed' experience in Saigon. There is so much to love about our three weeks in Vietnam; and Tung's fabulous tour of Saigon by Night is a contender for no 1. Certainly no. 1 in terms of the urban experience (Van Vu's tour of the DMZ running out of Hue is my no. 1 non-urban experience). We only stumbled across XO on our last day in Saigon so only had the opportunity to do the 2 1/2 hour evening tour - and what a roller coaster that was! Experiencing Saigon in that famous traffic from the back of one of those scooters was a real privilege - a brief time where the tourist became part of the local collective bustle. Tung is a smart and generous guide who has recruited top class staff who are students and appears to truly enjoy sharing their town and stories with you and your family. I have recommended this experience to anyone who would listen in the final two weeks of our trip through Vietnam including a group of English travel agents we met in Hue - I do hope they recommend this experience to their clients - it would be a shame to travel all that way and miss out on a truly memorable moment.

Great foodie tour! - I loved riding around the city on motorbikes with a really fun girl as my guide. We got to see a lot of the city and learn about it, all places without any other tourists. They offered so much food! There was a little pressure to keep eating and eating. They were actually peeling the prawns for each person. I'm vegetarian, and they didn't do this tour for vegetarians, so they were very kind in accommodating me. They offered me so much vegetarian food it was mind-boggling. My guide actually went to places nearby to bring back food for me where others were. Honestly, I wasn't a huge fan of the veggie food (lots of fake meats, like in the Chinese style). I'm usually adventurous with food, I just think the textures and flavors were extremely odd for a western palate. However, those eating meat loved every bite, and they went out of their way to give me tons of food options and try some unusual items. I had a great time, and no one was wanting for food or drink. The guides were amazingly sweet. Highest recommendation.

Fabulous way to eat great local food and see the neighborhoods! - I loved this motorbike foodie tour. I am generally not one to do group tours but XO Tours was great: it was a small group and for a foodie like me I loved the fact that I could go to neighborhood places where I would have normally never eaten on my own. Plus, when else do you get the chance to ride on the back of a motorbike through the neighborhoods of Saigon. I totally enjoyed this experience and would do it again!
Such a great introduction to Saigon!! - This was an incredible tour. Our guides were terrific, bright and helpful. Our first day will always be a highlight! Thank you Tung Do and friends!!

One of the most fun and interesting travel activities I've ever done. - This was an amazing experience, and I'd recommend doing it one of the first days you arrive in Saigon. The owner of the company, Tung Do, is a young Vietnamese-American man who has a keen sense of the city's history, everyday life, and urban development. You get to see many places where you're the only tourists around a sea of locals, which is a nice change from District 1.

Even though we did the foodie tour, It was informative about both food and the city itself--where people buy their groceries, where certain immigrant and minority enclaves are (both the poorer and the wealthier), and where people hang out to eat and drink beer. It was like having one of your smart friends show you around the city on a motorbike, pointing out things like which malls were started with foreign investment and what kinds of Vietnamese people go there, and where college students go to karaoke.

The food was great--my favorites were the bo bun hue, a noodle dish, and the scallops with peanuts and scallions. The drivers were fun and do their best to answer questions. Also, my friend was a vegetarian, and her driver curated a whole vegetarian meal for her! It was so thoughtful for them to accommodate her, since it's not something they normally do. I was so grateful they did, since this was one of the most interesting ways to see a city--on a motorbike with the nighttime skyline going by.

Best food we ate in Vietnam - We did the Foodie evening tour and it was one of the best things we did on our whole trip.
