The girls who rode us around made us feel very safe, had so much personality, and spoke fabulous English. The food we ate had so much flavour and variety. Much better than in any restaurant. It is great value and we were so full by the end of our trip we could hardly stand up from the table (try not to eat lunch before you go!). Tung even met us at the last food stop to help find my partner some quail as he couldn't eat all the amazing seafood (his loss!). Its also a fantastic way to get out of the tourist district and see the city at night.

A great way to see Ho Chi Minh - We chose the Foodie Tour on our final night in Ho Chi Minh. From the moment we were picked up from our hotel by the lovely Binh and Van we were having a great time! The girls were great company and very good drivers. We got to try some amazing and different food away from the tourist hub. It was great to see the different districts of Ho Chi Minh which we'd probably have not seen if it wasn't for this tour. Next time we're in Ho Chi Minh we'll be trying another of their tours! Thank you Binh and Van for making our last night in Ho Chi Minh so much fun!

First-rate, high-quality, fun tours - I did the Sights and the Foodie tours, and both were excellent. Tung runs a first-rate operation, and the guides he hires are all friendly, sociable, and most importantly, great drivers. Tung himself is easy to talk with and extremely knowledgeable about all things related to his tours, whether it's the sights he is showing you or the different districts and foods of Saigon.

With the Foodie tour, he has pulled off a near-impossible feat: He has created a tour that will appeal to both the foodie snob and the non-foodie alike. The food is excellent while also being accessible, in the sense that you are eating from roadside places that Saigon residents are also eating at. So it is neither 'ultra-exclusive' food that a non-foodie might wince at, nor it is at all 'tour group' food, which the foodie snob would most certainly be rejected by. That's a delicate balance to pull off, and Tung does it exceptionally well. And getting to drive through the different districts at night on the back of a motorbike only enhances the experience!

You won't be disappointed with any tour offered by Tung. I liked both my tours so much that I will definitely book again when I am back there.

One of our favorite activities in Southeast Asia - My husband and I went on the night Foodie Tour. Tung was so helpful in making the tour work for us despite a calamity of events that through off our schedule earlier that day. The experience, food and company were a highlight of our trip through Vietnam. The girls make the bike rides incredibly safe and you would be missed if you went to Ho Chi Minh City without riding on a motorbike! We got to try a sampling of great authentic Vietnamese cusine which we may have otherwise been scared to try! All of it was delicious and we felt like royalty as they took care of everything along the tour. They even peeled our crab legs for us! I just wish we would have had more time and I would have done all of their tours. Don't miss this one and book early, they fill up.

Incredible tour!!! - The XO Tours Saigon Night Tour absolutely ROCKS! I am an adrenaline junkie - back in the States, for my fix, I ride a suped up 1500cc Suzuki Hayabusa and a heavily modified 600HP Dodge Viper for "fun" - however neither compares to riding the streets of Saigon on the back of a moped during the infamous evening weekday traffic - this was a total RUSH!! Flitting in and out of traffic, which seemed to operate by no rules of the road I could readily observe, was AWESOME! And to note, at no point during the trip did I feel that I was in harm's way - Tung and his girls take safety seriously and are VERY skilled at handling their mopeds. Additionally, they are very charming, friendly and knowledgeable - my driver and I chatted and laughed throughout the ENTIRE tour. If you are planning to visit Saigon then I HIGHLY, HIGHLY recommend adding this to your to-do list!! You will be glad you did!!

Best tour in Saigon, dare I say...Vietnam! - First off, happy anniversary to XO Tours. Second, I hope Tung and the girls forgive me for taking so long to write a review. It was my most memorable tour of Vietnam and I will try to do it justice without revealing too much of the thrills.
I was visiting Saigon for the very first time and didn't have a clue what to do or where to go. Luckily, the very detailed XO Tour website was available to give me some insight and help me choose the foodie tour. Couple emails and I was set (kept changing hotels on Tung who was very patient and professional the entire time). This two wheeled FIVE meal night tour is all over the city in 4.5 hours...thats a lot of food. Imagine my surprise when I was picked up in front of my hotel promptly at 5:30 by a cute petite guide in ao dai. I'm a heavy 190 lb. guy and I told my tour guide if she wanted to cancel the tour it was fine by me. Anh smiled pleasantly, politely helped me with my helmet and gave me the coolest white knuckle ride of my life through Saigon's chaotic city streets...she was awesome and she spoke English! We meet up with Tung and other XO tourist and their guide counter parts at each food stop for culinary background as well as history of the city. The foodie tour also took me to sites that other city tours tend to miss which I really look for when I travel. I just wish I brought my camera which I realized I forgot at the hotel, Anh told me not to worry, XO Tour has a photographer on all tours and pictures are emailed not long after...sometimes even posted on their facebook page. At one point of the tour it began to rain and in the blink of an eye the guides got everybody into rain ponchos. XO Tour company must definitely be familiar with the book Raving Fan because they think of everything when it comes to safety, professionalism and customer service. I fought the urge to book the other tours available on the website but I wanted an excuse to take the tour again the next time I visit Vietnam.
It would be great if tripadvisor.com allowed me to give XO Tours 10 Stars because it is an absolutely do not miss tour if you are in Saigon with sites, sound, food and....adrenaline. The guides are cute, sweet and intelligent. Food is delicious and even better...you won't get sick the next day. The sites are beautiful and astonishing with insightful historical lessons. And the service is world class. XO Tour is the best tour in Vietnam (there I said it).

A MUST on your first day in Ho Chi Min - We did both market tour and night food tour, and Strongly recommend to visitors to the city. I am a conservative scardy cat was on holidays with 8 yo daughter and my 75 year old mother, husband and brother in law, at first I was Terrified after seeing motorbike swarm through the city. However the riders are fantastic, friendly and experienced. We all loved it and through the 2 tours explored almost all of the city that helped orient the rest of our stay.

I was delighted to see my 8 yo old and mother safe, HAPPY and loving it, The marker tour was lovely short drives, the night tour did include long stretches of riding that to us after day riding was a bit much but was still mostly interesting.

The tour riders are WONDERFUL and work hard to make you feel special. I personally would modify the night food tour a bit less talk more eat however both I recommend to visitors to Ho Chi Min City especially in your first day or two!

truly interesting - My husband and I took a night tour with XO Tours during our honeymoon, while visiting HCMC, and it was a really good choice! We really enjoyed the visit, and it's so different, you truly taste the real night life of HCMC...and beeing on a scooter on those busy roads is very nice! The girls drive very carefully and take you to different places of town, to discover what's happening at night, not just touristic places. We absolutely recommend these tours, we didn't get the chance to take the day tours, but it seems as interesting...and it's so easy, they come to get you at your hotel and take you back at the end of the evening. You even get to taste some really good food from a stall in the street, verry nice!

Get to see and eat more of Saigon - Did the foodie tour. It's a steep price you pay, but worth it, I don't regret a single Dong. I was very lucky as I was the only foodie tour customer that night and got to spend the whole evening with charming Ms. Phuong alone ;-)

The food was really great and interesting - if you're on the more adventurous side you also get to eat embryo eggs and quail's heads. This is not compulsory, though ;-)

However, what I thought to be even more interesting (and wasn't expecting beforehand) than the food was the tour through the different districts. You really get to see different faces of Saigon, that you would never see otherwise or wouldn't even know existed. Many thanks for that! My only regret is that I left the same evening and didn't get to re-explore those parts on my own...

Thanks to Tung for the excellent organization and to Phuong for a wonderful evening with many interesting conversations.

PS: Thanks also for the food for the journey. Camre in very handy as breakfast the next day!

A well deserved no. 1 top tour!! - We read the reviews and decided to brave the traffic of HCMC on the back of the bikes, thank god we did; this tour is truly amazing! My partner and I opted for the night tour; this took us outside District 1 and into Chinatown and the new town. My guide was Tien, her English was excellent and she provided lots of interesting facts about the city. The trip now includes food, this was amazing and I wish we had time to go back and do the 'foodie' trip. This tour deserved to be at the top spot!

It’s a food tour and more! - Fantastic way to check out the city at night and get your grub on! No need to be intimidated by the city’s traffic madness. I felt perfectly safe in the care of these experienced Saigon scooter veterans.
The food was mmm, mmm good and the guides were friendly and super hospitable. Only regret was not doing the tour sooner in my trip, as the info sprinkled throughout the night was both interesting and helpful. Would and HAVE recommended it!

Best Tour of Our Trip - My girlfriend and I took a tour with XO in Hanoi after spending a few weeks in other parts of Vietnam.

First, I would absolutely recommend getting a tour guide of some sort for Saigon. The day we didn't we spent in a bit of a daze. And second, I would recommend XO as they were hands-down the best operator we encountered in our 2+ weeks in SE Asia.

The owner, Tung, Is American-Vietnamese, raised in Texas who came back to Vietnam to start a tour company and reconnect with his roots.

It's a great concept, really: Take a city that is absolutely overwhelming at first landing, offer tours of sights and sounds not on a massive, obnoxious bus but on the back of one of those ubiquitous scooters you keep getting almost run over by but secretly yearn to ride on to be a part of the action, then add pretty girls who speak fluent English and take clients to sites that not everyone gets to go to. Our favorite was an outdoor market that locals go to, rather than the overpriced famous ones. The prices were a fraction of those elsewhere and we were the only whiteys in sight. Tung is also quite knowledgeable about Vietnamese current events and how they fit into the history of the country. He's a smart dude.

Just do it. It's affordable and really fun.

Excellent evening for anyone interested in exploring the real Saigon - This was an extremely well organized and fun night. The girls are all just wonderful, funny and full of information. We did the foodie tour and got to try a variety of terrific Vietnamese foods in a number of interesting locations. I would highly recommend the foodie tour to anyone interested in seeing more of Saigon than District 1 and trying some new foods. Could only be improved by having a map to work out just where we went as we covered a great deal of Saigon and ended up completely confused as to where we actually were (although the girls did deliver us safely back to our hotel)!

A nice touch was the birthday cake that turned up for my daughter's 20th birthday. We had discussed her birthday with the girls at the start of the night and then a very impressive cake, complete with her name, was delivered a couple of hours into the tour. Tung seems to think of everything to make the night memorable and enjoyable for all.

Very Cool Experience - I went on the Foodie tour during my visit to Ho Chi Minh City. I've visited HCMC quite a few times and I always try to do something new each time I come back. Another tourist in Hanoi mentioned XO Tours and I looked them up online and got booked ahead of my arrival. The tour was absolutely great. The food and the company of the group couldn't have been better. My eyes were definitely opened to the opportunities for eating in Vietnam that I typically pass by. Everyone I met from XO was friendly, helpful, professional, and clearly committed to providing a quality experience. I highly recommend XO!

XO Tours - feel the essence of Ho Chi Minh on a motorbike. - With the friendly people of XO Tours you will travel the main sites on a motorbike.
Or better described as floating like a leaf in the ocean of motorbikes
At each location you will stop to hear first hand stories from Vietnam people as they see the events that have shaken the world in the past and will shape the future for all of us.
If you want to see Ho Chi Minh City and you are not of the crowd bus tour.- this is the tour for you!
Roni. Israel

Awesome exprience and great customer service if that - I can't not rate this place a 5! 5+ if there was more. The tour was fun, entertaining, educational, and exhillerating! We had 5 doods on the tour and like everyone else was a little apprehensive about the traffic. The girls knew what they were doing when they had to manuever through traffic but kept us in a pack so we weren't one on one. They'd catch up or slow down to keep up with the group and keep the group dymanics fun.

Tung the owner personally gave us the overview of everything and melded the different groups of foodie tourists and coming from SF/SJ area, we knew the dishes being presented and none of them were disappointed. I had seafood allergies as well as another tourist in the other group and Tung made sure that at the end we had enough food to supplement the seafood we couldnt eat--even had one of the beefs that I loved from the famous 7 course beef in SF.

Everyone had so much fun that by the end of the tour, if felt like the girls and everyone were just long lost friends that were just hanging out to grab bites to eat. I highly recommend XO Tours. They won't dissapoint. I'm sending friends over their way when they visit and I would definitley meet up with everyone again if I visited. We had a great experience and made new friends. What more can you ask?

-M

Totally worth it. A fantastic experience. The best way to experience the real Saigon. - We booked a night foodie tour. I was a little apprehensive as the traffic in Saigon is something else but it turned out to be a fabulous evening and I felt perfectly safe. The girls are excellent riders and go through a rigorous testing program before being able to work for the company. We were met by our beautiful guides and taken to meet the manager of the company who made sure every part of the well thought out tour went smoothly.

This is the best way to see the real Saigon. Prior to doing the tour we had really only walked around the touristy areas near the back-packer district. This tour, not only introduced us to the best of local food, but we got to see parts of the city that we would have never experienced.

This tour was great fun and excellent value for money. XO Tours is a very professional company that offers a great one of a kind tour.

Fun experience - Felt safe the entire time, my guide Binh is the sweetest girl, loved venturing out to districts I have never bothered going to before (especially Chinatown) and it was great that Hung the owner joined us. The 'Angry Birds' cafe was a highlight!

I have been around HCM on scooters many times in the past however it was interesting to hear about Saigon's history from a proper guide.

Thanks for a fun and interesting night.

Cheers
Mai

An incredible way to see Saigon! - Really enjoyed our Foodie Tour in Dec. Tung and his guides gave us an authentic Saigon experience, covering five districts, and showing us some of the best local food spots. Not only did they put together a very well rounded meal, they gave us a great tour of the city along the way, with a lot of history and local insight into the bustlng city. And if you're worried, you don't do the driving - you're in the competent hands of local veterans. The food portion started with far and away the best noodle soup of our trip (and we had a lot during our 3 days!). Next, we had an unforgettable BBQ, with the guides helping us cook a variety of meat and seafood, and teaching us how to enjoy the traditional sauces and condiments. We closed with some of the best seafood of our life, and finally a few delightful local desserts that they picked up for us along the way.

The XO team was very knowledgeable, friendly and accommodating. From the moment we started out, it was the most comfortable, friendly and enjoyable tour we've experienced to date. More like hanging out with new friends, than touring a city with for-hire guides.

If you're going to Saigon, I can't recommend XO enough. You really will have an amazing time (and get amazingly full on the best Vietnamese cuisine you've ever had). But do book early, as their quite busy.

A Great Way to Experience the City - We were picked up by two ladies who would be driving us (safely) during the tour.
Mr. Tung (Owner) joined us and would be acting as a guide and giving us insight in the place we visited and some historical perspective (He speaks perfect english as he lived in the US). This combination of fun and some history gave us a better understanding of the history of the City and was really fun and interesting.

The group size was very small as it was only me and my friend. Further it was great that Tung was also making pictures and these were later provided to us by email.

We saw the most important places in the city in a short time frame and really loved the tour and would recommend it to anyone!!

Couldn't ask for a better finish to my vietnam trip - With the crazy traffic in saigon it might sound like a bad idea but i felt totally safe and enjoyed every second. You can actually see places in saigon you never thought existed.
The girls and the owner were great, smily and gave a lot of interesting info.

Cheers from Sophy :-)

Foodie Tour - What an experience - all on the back of a motorcycle!! - We went to Ho Chi Minh having been advised this was a "must do trip" and what a trip. We met our beautifully traditionally dressed guides outside the Opera House as arranged and from then on it was a night full of surprises. The restaurants and small street cafes visited offered authentic food. Tasty treats such as clam, frog, scallops (these were the best!!) chicken, prawns and a BBQ at one of the local city restaurants not usually frequented by tourist. The owner of XO Tours, Tung was very affable and willing to share the history and highlights of the city as were the girls as we drove to the outskirts of the city amongst thousands of other manic cyclists. Never did we feel afraid to be on a motorcycle which surprised me. If you have time - do this tour. Great value and a wonderful experience. Bob & Leonie

An absolute must for Ho Chi Minh City! - This tour was such an amazing experience and a great way to see the different districts of Ho Chi Minh City. My sister and I did the night tour and wish we had time to also do the foodie tour! The girls were great. They speak perfect english, are very knowledgeable about the city, are safe drivers, and truly want you to have a fun time. Tung (the owner of the company) also joins the tour and offers further insight into the city. We were a little scared to first get on the motorbikes, but the girls made sure we felt comfortable and drove slow at first. Over the course of the night you drive through a few different districts and stop at a few points to learn more. Also, you stop for dinner and a sugar cane drink along the way - very yummy! The girls pick you up and drop you off at your hotel. I would recommend this tour to anyone who visits HCMC!! Very well down and great way to learn about the city from locals!

We Felt Like Locals! - I am always a little weary of taking guided "tours", but this was an EXCELLENT experience and definitely the highlight of my trip to HCMC!

My sister and I spent 3 days in the amazingly vibrant city of Saigon last month and ended our trip on the XO Night Tour. I think I learned about/experienced more of the city in these 2.5 hours than I did the whole rest of the time! The tour takes you through the real parts of the city that would be very difficult to navigate on your own. You are right in the middle of all the action while scooting around with the locals! The owner, Tung, went along with us and gave great insight into life in HCMC. Tung is a sincerely nice guy, speaks perfect English, and offers a wealth of information and insider tips on the city! The girls driving the scooters are fantastic too!

*I really wish we would have done the food tour too!!!

*Also we felt totally safe on the scooters. They don't go very fast and the drivers are very cautious.

Highly recommended to all!

2 1/2 hours of fun! - This was the only tour we did while in HCMC and the only regret was that we did it the night before we left. This was a great indoctrination to the various districts and wished that we did this early on so that we may have ventured outside of District 1 during our one week stay. We did the night tour which was promptly and professionally booked by Tung.

The girls were lovely....my driver was Hoang who I can't say enough great things about. She was very warm, sweet, and informative pointing out various landmarks and giving me background information as we toured. I was initially nervous since I've never been on a motorbike, but Hoang was very careful with my safety assurance that I was comfortable throughout the trip and I felt very safe in her caring hands.

My husband also liked his tour guide and he also had a great time. We were so happy we did it! Being in the thick of traffic (though that sounds weird) was a lot of fun and I felt like I was part of the big, crazy city that HCM is.

Experience of a lifetime! Loved every minute of it. - Just back from Saigon night tour with XO tours and still on a high from the experience. It was an AMAZING tour and I really feel like I've experienced the real Saigon even though we are just for the weekend. can't praise this tour highly enough. The drivers we had were so so lovely and friendly and very good drivers. If u do one thing on ur trip to Saigon make sure it's this. You will not regret it! I wish we had more time so we could do it again!

Your attendance is mandatory - If you are in HCMC for a day and you have a slightly adventurous streak, you owe it to yourself to take one of their tours. The foodie tour was superb. We sampled a number of flavorful local delicacies in distinct neighborhoods. I won't include what we ate because it spoils the experience.

Above all, Tung was very professional, knowledgeable and looks after every detail to ensure that you will have a memorable experience. Above all, he hires fantastic tour guides like Anh and Thu. These ladies were honorable hosts and treated us like family. If this review does not provide sufficient assurance that you will have a memorable experience, then feel free to read the other 158 reviews (and counting). If you're still not convinced, you need help.

The best two and a half hours we spent in Saigon - We took the "night tour" after an enthusiastic recommendation from another couple in the hotel lobby. I asked about best thing they had done in Saigon. Dude handed me the XO business card. Thanks dude!
Though we booked the morning of, Tung was very accommodating, responding to my request almost immediately. Anh and Phuong picked us up right outside the hotel. After a quick meet and greet, we jumped on the back of their scooters and were carted of into the hectic streets of Saigon. We'd witnessed the Saigon traffic (mayhem) as pedestrians for a day, and were anxious about zigzagging into the frenzy without the advantage of seat belts or forgiving crumple zones. Our fears were quickly allayed by our skilled drivers. Ahn and Phuong were cheerful, talkative and knowledgeable about the city. Within minutes, they had transported us from the tourist center of District 1 into nooks were other foreigners were not to be seen. Cruising on the back seat was exciting and also the only way we found of keeping cool while outdoors in the city. The ride was punctuated by occasional stops where Tung and our guides described the neighborhoods and fed us delicious food. I won't spoil the plot, but I'll say we were thrilled to have the opportunity to view HCMC from a local's perspective. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCMC. Next time we're in town we'll be signing up for the "foodie tour". Keep your calendars open Ahn and Phuong!

Highlight Tour In Vietnam - Having used TA for quite a while, I've learned to be skeptical and not purely go on the top rated items as sometimes they are overrated. XO Tours is not one of those as they are truly authentic and top notch in service and experience in every sense of the word. We did the night foodie tour and LOVED it. In fact, we were having so much fun we wanted it to go longer! When I booked, I almost did the shorter Saigon by Night tour thinking the foodie tour might be too long....boy was I wrong and am I happy we did the Foodie Tour. From start to finish it was excellent. Owner Tung is kind, professional, and knowledgeable. Nga and the other girls are educated, speak excellent English and make this operation run smooth as silk. Some of the food we had was some of the best street food in Vietnam.

I literally think pretty much anyone would have a great time on this tour. Highly recommended and cheers to the XO Team!

Wish I had done more motorbike tours - What a ride, I prebooked the city sightseeing tour before leaving home. We arrived in Saigon late on the night of the 28th, and were delighted to see the lovely ladies waiting outside our hotel for us promptly on the morning of the 29th.

This is a ride you will not forget, the ladies and the owner were so helpful and so much fun. The absolute best way to see the city. A must for everyone.

If we had been in Saigon longer, I would have booked every tour they had. Next time.

Thanks guys, you did an amazing job, and special thanks for emailing me the pictures you took. That was special.

Foodie Tour with XO Tours is a must when visiting HCMC - We choose this tour company because of its brilliant reviews on tripadvisor and were not disappointed. My sister and I were met at out hotel by our beautiful and very friendly guides Bin and Van. They spoke excellent English and put us at ease very quickly with their careful driving and friendly chit chat. The girls were full of interesting information about HCMC and the five districts that we visited. All the food we tried was fantastic. My favourites were the frog and scallops. The owner of XO tours, Tung, met up with us at several of our stops throughout the 4+ hour tour and was happy to answer all of our questions and give us insight into life in Vietnam. I would definitely recommend XO tours to anyone wanting to see HCMC outside of the tourist area.

Must do - Motorbikes in Saigon are mad! There are motorbikes everywhere and you wouldn't be able to drive since there are no rules. We wanted to experience this madness. Hence, we booke this tour and we didnät get disappointed. The girls drove very safe and told us a lot of interesting things during the drive. We took the Saigon by Night tour which was very nice since we got to see parts of Saigon we wouldn't have seen otherwise.

Incredible experience, a must for anybody visiting HCMC - My wife and I chose for the night tour. The girls were on time and we hit it off well with them immediately. Basically, you ride through the crazy HCMC traffic on the bike as the girls explain the sights to you. If it were only that, it would already be a pretty cool and fun experience. But it's much more. Getting to interact with them on a personal level is incredibly rewarding, as they are extremely nice and you get to talk about anything and everything with them. We also got to sample some local food, something we didn't really know would happen, so it was a welcome bonus. All in all, you'd be crazy to pass this up. The only reason we didn't do some more of their tours is that we were leaving the next morning. So do yourself a favor and sign up for this experience, you won't regret it if you go, but it'll eat you up inside if you miss out!

In HCMC eat what HCMC people do - This was the second time we visited Saigon. This time we stayed for 3 days only and we thought that we should do something extraordinary. So we chose XO tours' Foodie tour. It was worth it without a question.
We were riding motorbikes (I mean: we were sitting behind a helpful and kind Vietnamese lady). It was also a funny way to visit some areas in Saigon you would normally not see. Tip: wear suitable clothes for motorcycling.
We stopped at several places to enjoy real local food - so not the ones you are served at the touristic places. It is up to you what you want to try and what not. Everything we had was delicious, and even the weird looking things (fried frog, duck egg) tasted really good - you should also try that.

Fantastic way to see the city - Given that I was going to be in Ho Chi Minh City for 3 days, I wanted to see and learn as much as possible about the city in a limited amount of time. XO Tours turned out to be the perfect way to do this, as we saw all the important sights and sounds in an entertaining and informative manner. I highly recommend booking a tour with XO Tours, it was definitely one of my best experiences thus far in my 3 weeks of travel.

Last but not least, the female guides are absolutely gorgeous.

Awesome HCMC experience! - We should have done this night tour with the XO gals on our 1st night... Those gals shared a lot of information for 1st timer... The next time round we may pick up their shopping tour to save more $$ on shopping :D

Excellent Tour - Me and my wife had a great time on the Foodie tour around Saigon and the surrounding districts. The staff are very friendly and make you feel comfortable right away. We got to experience nice food, ride on the back of motorbikes, and see parts of the city we would have not thought of going to otherwise. Definitely the highlight of our trip!

Learn about HCMC from the local's point of view! - We stayed in HCMC for 6 days. My partner suggested that we see HCMC on a scooter, an idea I laughed at after seeing the traffic condition and was quick to say no. Little did I know, that he has already arranged a shopping tour with XO Tours. When the girls arrived, I reluctantly hopped on - lured by the temptation of shopping!

Surprising after 5 minutes on the scooter, I felt very relaxed and was even brave enough to let go of the guide from my ninja grip. The girls were terrific and accommodating, they were very patient while I haggled and negotiated for my shoes and handbags. They even helped with the translation!

The tour was very personalized as we didn't waste time looking at things we were not interested in. They asked exactly what we wanted and immediately, provided us with a list of recommendations. This is to allow us to say no to the places we have already seen like Ben Thanh.

While traveling to the destinations, the girls told us about life in Vietnam and explains about various land marks we came across but most important where to eat as cleanliness in different restaurants can vary.

We booked for a second tour when our first tour finished. However, the second tour had been canceled for safety reasons as the destinations we wanted to go to had started raining profusely. Even though the second tour was canceled, I am very happy they had put our safety first rather than going through with the tour like most other companies would for monetary reasons.

A great way to break the ice - After gazing with awe at the bike traffic in HCMC my daughter and I took the night trip and became part of it. The girls were lovely and made me feel completely safe. They did their best to get this 63 yo dad to enjoy the experience, and Dung the manager helped us to see the city as it really was. Fun and interesting at the same time.

John G

Unexpected Street Food Galore on the go! - I've never been a fan of anything with the word 'tour' in it, But the moment I saw the sweet smiles of our gorgeous tour guides welcoming us I knew we were in for a great experience.
And then I saw the scooters... Small... the girls... smaller. Yikes! Can they carry my weight??
I mean they were really easy on the eyes, but fear for my life made me hesitate.
But the scooters were amazingly steady and the girls navigated the streets with extreme skill and ease. My fears all melted from the moment we set off. Traffic in the streets tends to crawl as well... usually not more than 40km/hr.
The tour brought us from the overly familiar District 1 of Ho Chi Minh City to the lesser known districts (including Chinatown which is the 2nd largest Chinatown in the world). The girls are great guides, giving copious details on the districts and daily activities of the locals as we went along.
But even more amazing was the food. My God I feel so cheated I've always only known Pho noodles all my life. I now have the sinking feeling Pho noodles is a marketing ploy borne of a capitalist conspiracy. The noodles we tried were so extremely delicious in an un-Pho like manner. And my fiancee is dreaming about the grilled scallops now.
All I can say is we have no regrets trying it and will be back for more. No more Pho for us.
Many thanks to Tung Do, Phuong and Binh for the amazing trip! Hope to see you guys again soon

Do Believe The Hype...! - Call me a cynic but I'm always a bit wary when something is overpromoted on Tripadvisor. But as a many time user and a first time poster - I can assure you that XO Tours met all our expectations and more!

We did the Saigon by Night tour and saw parts of Saigon that we would never have seen on our own. It was fantastic. We were only in town for a couple of nights and this was such a memorable experience. Tung and the girls were warm, friendly and very knowledgable.

I'd highly recommend XO tours - it's a bargain and will be an experience you'll never forget!

FOODIE TOUR - A MUST IN HCMC - Just returned from a wonderful, unique tour - driving around Saigon this evening on motorbikes driven by our guides, Thu and Binh, along with our photographer, Ni.
We saw the different sides of the city, tasted delicious food, learned more about the city from our guides than we ever expected, and generally had a wonderful and memorable time.
There were five motorbikes in all making the tour this evening and with the other tourists and guides, we all laughed and ate our way through the city.

We recommend this to everyone!

Thanks to all,

Ellen and David

Definitely a Must Do - I did the Foodie Tour one evening recently and had a great time. I concur with everything positive that has been written about XO tours in past reviews. The additional comments I have, following my 3 week stay in Vietnam are: (1) You are introduced to some great food on this tour. I am still thinking about the scallops we had. (2) Unlike many of the people whom you will encounter and unlike all the guides I had during the remainder of my stay in Vietnam, Tung's perfect English makes the experience even better. He can answer your questions, which is hard for many other guides to do, given their limited English capabilities. You will find that "fluency" in English amongst the Vietnamese is not what we would normally characterize as "fluency".
I had a great tour with XO and my only regret is that I did not have more time in Saigon to participate in additional tours.

An absolute must-do! - We went on the Foodie Night Tour...in my top 5 things of holiday activities that I've ever done! I am scared of everything...snakes, spiders, heights, flying...the list goes on. But after spending the day walking round HCMC watching the crazy bike drivers, I thought I had another thing to add to my list...

However from the moment Anne and Fung nothing arrived at our hotel they did but put us at ease about going on the bikes and we were whisked away after our quick safety briefing....one of the most exhilarating things ever! Anne and Fung both spoke amazing English and explained about where we would go. You get to see 5 districts on this tour which I don't think any other tour offers...the 5'ish hours whizzed by.

Visited a mixture of places from street side cart vendors, for an amazing noodle soup (not Pho - I forgot the name, but it's even tastier!); next stop we called near China Town where it's an outdoor BBQ venue where we ate delicious goat, okra, shrimp and frogs (deeelish!) - and got to watch a Michael Jackson impersonator! We also ate at an amazing seafood restaurant as our last stop on the tour where we ate spider crab, scallops and quail...the scallops are the tastiest we have ever eaten anywhere! Finally, Tung (the owner who came on the trip too) brought us some Vietnamese desserts of coconut jelly and bahn flan (a bit like creme caramel).

The thing that made the night just that bit more memorable was the tour guides girls and Tung. All of them were so helpful and really wanted to make sure we were relaxed, happy and most of all stuffed with food! Don't worry if you don't like spicy food, since I told Tung in advance about my allergy to chilli we had arranged at each place either an alternative or a non-chilli version with no fuss at all.

Thank you Anne and Fung for being such amazing drivers! We will be back when we come next year and will do one of the sight-seeing tours!

Highly Rated - Had a great time on this 'Saigon by night' tour and seen parts of Saigon that I wouldn't have had the opportunity to otherwise!

The girls were lovely and my driver (sorry, can't spell her name!) was so friendly that she put me instantly at ease.

The traffic in Saigon is crazy, but I feel safe at all times as the girls are excellent drivers.

Will definitely be recommending this tour to any friends who will be in the city.

Experience the real HCMC! - I was apprehensive about taking my wife and two children--aged 11 and 14--on a motorbike tour, especially in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC). My 11-year old son was not keen, especially after having to navigate crossing the road as a pedestrian. But, leaving with a free Sunday evening, my sense of adventure got the better of me and, with the support of my daughter (yes! behind every successful decision is a young lady... Haha) we finally signed up the family for the tour with a day to go. Mr Tung, the owner, managed to accommodate our last minute request and, right on the dot, 4 yound ladies on motorbikes turned up to pick us up on Sunday evening. The city tour itself is not that spectacular but what was worth the money is navigating through taffic like a local and, more importantly, learning about the local culture. The commentary given by Nga, my guide, enabled me to learn more about HCMC culture than I ever did in my previous four visits to Vietnam. If you really want to learn more about local life in HCMC, take this tour. My family learned things about local habits and nightspots that we wouldn't have discovered on other tours and we had the chance to find out that we were able to consume Vietnamese street food without tummy trouble. My apprehensive 11-year old became a convert and describe it as AWESOME. To Mr Tung, Nga and the team at XO, thanks for the family experience--you made the trip to HCMC memorable for the family. For my daughter, it was THE highlight of the HCMC experience!!!

Amazing experience - Crossing the street in Saigon is a scary experience but we felt very comfortable on this tour. the drivers are a very enthusiastic and charming bunch of girls who make the trip a lot of fun. They really take good careof passengers and make us very comfortable. We encountered a tremendous thunderstorm in the middle of the tour and the girls were fully prepared with ponchos. We rode for a while before they made a rest stop and treated us to an amazing Vietnamese dessert. I was with a group of 8 friends on a convention (this is a great group activity) and when we told folks about it others went the next day. they were grateful and the lady told me this was one of the most exciting things she had ever done.
This is an experience not to miss in Saigon and an incredible value for the price.

An absolute MUST DO when visiting Saigon - My friends and I did "The Sights" tour with XO tours after discovering them on Tripadvisor. It was a last minute decision and they were able to accomodate us the following day.

We had a fantastic time on the tour. The girls showed up promptly at our hotel and we were on our way. Riding on the motorbikes was fun, but also safe. The information we received from the girls and from Tung was very informative. It was also a nice touch that bottled water was provided and Tung offered to take photos with his camera.

The only regret is that we did not know about this soon enough so we could have also done the Saigon By Night tour. (It was fully booked by the time we inquired.)

I would highly recommend XO tours. They are a very professional and fun group of people and seeing Saigon by motorbike is an unforgettable experience.

Different exploration on 2 wheels!! - For a short span of 5 hours on the Foodie tour, we experienced the touristy Saigon which is district 1, the native Saigon n the rich Saigon in district 7. The 2 girls, Lien n Ant that picked me n my girlfriend from the hotel was well versed in English, especially Lien. With the chaotic traffic in Saigon, the girls were very expert in riding throughout the journey, they never stopped chatting. This feels good n they really make me feel at ease. The pho that we ate at the 1st stop was excellent!! After that, we were brought to a native place that was fantastic, especially the interesting food that was BBQ for us. Kudos to Tung who gave his personalized service, to his team of pretty n friendly girls who took good care of us throughout all the way. I will strongly recommend XO Tour to everyone visiting Saigon n try all their tours if time permits.

Felt like I was part of the city. - This was a really nice way to see areas of Saigon that you just wouldn't get to if you were staying downtown in a hotel. It was fun to cruise around at night on a motorbike with the rest of the population of Saigon. Had some great street food! The tour was very well organized and the drivers incredibly pleasant. Thanks for a great last night!

3As: Awesome, Amazing, Adventurous - A different way to travel around Saigon at night. Being able to move around by bike and "squeezing" in between other vehicles in a busy street was such a great experience which i don't think we can experience elsewhere. Our riders speak good English and we salute them for being able to take us as a pillion. They are very friendly and skillsful in their riding skills. *Thumbs up* We were also well-informed about history of each district that we had visited during this tour. Kudos to Mr. Tung Do. Superb experience for first timer like us to saigon. We highly recommended them.

Top quality tour - a must for any vistor - We booked this tour of the basis of the recommendations on trip advisor and a perusal of the website. We made the booking last minute and, despite being very busy, the owner (Tung Do) managed to accommodate us. Tung was born in Vietnam but was raised in Texas, USA.

The staff are terrific. The girls who drove us around were lovely and very careful drivers. My girlfriend and i felt very safe the whole time, even amongst the chaos of HCMC's streets. We chatted the whole time with the girls as we were scooting between sights. At the sight Tung would give us a comprehensive explanation of the history. The tour was loads of fun.

30 minutes after our tour ended i received an email from Tung with restaurant recommendations based on a discussion we'd had.

I couldn't recommend this tour highly enough.

Absolutely fantastic - wish we could have done another tour with XO! - I think this is the perfect way to see Saigon and will be recommending XO tours to anyone I know who visits. The girls are incredibly friendly and fun to be around, your time will be well spent with the right amount of time at each site, your guide will speak perfect english and you will have a blast on the back of a bike. This was hands down one of my favorite tours in Asia!

Book in advance so this doesn't sell out. We wanted to do the food tour after doing the city tour, but it was too late!

Experience the real HCMC! - I was apprehensive about taking my wife and two children--aged 11 and 14--on a motorbike tour, especially in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC). My 11-year old son was not keen, especially after having to navigate crossing the road as a pedestrian. But, leaving with a free Sunday evening, my sense of adventure got the better of me and, with the support of my daughter (yes! behind every successful decision is a young lady... Haha) we finally signed up the family for the tour with a day to go. Mr Tung, the owner, managed to accommodate our last minute request and, right on the dot, 4 yound ladies on motorbikes turned up to pick us up on Sunday evening. The city tour itself is not that spectacular but what was worth the money is navigating through taffic like a local and, more importantly, learning about the local culture. If you really want to learn more about local life in HCMC, take this tour. My family learned things about local habits and nightspots that we wouldn't have discovered on other tours and we had the chance to find out that we were able to consume Vietnamese street food without tummy trouble. My apprehensive 11-year old became a convert and describe it as AWESOME. To Mr Tung, Nga and the team at XO, thanks for the family experience--you made the trip to HCMC memorable for the family. For my daughter, it was THE highlight of the HCMC experience!!!

Saigon - Sightseeing Tour - Recently my wife and I did this lovely tour....being taken around Saigon and having the cultural sights being shown and explained was really fantastic.....Tung and has workers are really helpful and go out of their way to make your experience worthwhile...give them a try., you will not be disappointed.

Fantastic experience, lovely hosts - We went on the XO Foodie Tour (4 hours) and had a great time. The girls picked us up from our hotel on their motorbikes and took us to the first stop where we had the best pho I've tasted.

While we were eating, it started to rain heavily and we were unsure of whether to continue, but the girls pulled out plastic ponchos and off we went to experience the sights, sounds and tastes of Saigon at night.

We ate heaps of food (frogs and excellent seafood included :) and there was plenty to drink.

Tung was very approachable and told us a lot about life in Saigon, the girls were simply lovely and excellent motorbike riders!

We recommend this tour if you're in Saigon.

Flick and Matt (Australia)

Go for it! - First, it is a great experience on the bike. It's amazing to see how they drive in such heavy traffic (in Saigon, it means crazy traffic). I didn't expect the drizzle to become quite a heavy rain but it made the ride all the more unforgettable.
Second, the food is simply delicious, especially the seafood.
Finally, the service provided was excellent and they had been very informative.
I will go on this tour again if I'm coming to HCMC again.

Best tour of our trip! - We loved this tour! Tung, the guide, spoke American English and was very knowledgeable, helpful and was able to be flexible when it started to rain (actually poured). We rode on the bikes with the girls and each girl was nicer than the next. They were adorable in every way - sweet, thoughtful, helpful and friendly. We became instant friends and I felt as though we had a much more personal experience than any other tour we took on our trip. I was only a bit nervous for the first block riding on the back of the motorbike. After that, I had so much fun I wasn't even thinking about being in all of that traffic. It was just fine. When we later got in a cab after the tour, I found that was much more nervous racking than being on the bike. We zipped through the city and saw what we would have visited on a tour bus. When it looked like rain was coming, the girls stopped the bikes and pulled out ponchos for all of us. We did get a little wet but it didn't matter.

Worth the trip to Ho Chi Minh just for this - While traveling round Asia I found myself with a couple of days in Ho Chi Minh and nothing to do, so booked this food tour to fill the time. I am so pleased that I did.

If you only have a short stay in the city and, like me, have not planned an itinerary, then it is a great way to see the city, the sights the smells and most importantly experience the exquisite cuisine, plus get you away from the majority tourist population of District 1.

Tung is extremely knowledgeable, as are the girls - who are also amazingly outgoing and all are friendly and welcoming. I will go back to Hi Chi Minh just to take the tour again.

The best way to see & taste HCMC - This was indeed an amazing way to see the many different districts of Ho Chi Minh City and taste Viet cuisine unlike what you will find in District 1. The girls picked us up from our hotel and were very friendly and chatty. It was a plus point for us girls that we would be riding pillion with women as riding with men may have made us more uncomfortable. The tour brought us through many different districts showing us the other parts of HCMC which we would not have seen, and wasnt just a plain foodie tour as the name goes. Tung Do and the girls were very accomodating as well - i couldnt eat seafood and although one of the stops featured mainly seafood, they ordered different Viet food for me to sample and they made sure we were VERY well fed! Halfway it rained but our tour guides were well prepared with disposable rain coats. It was so much fun! We also requested for a video recording of the tour (additional $20 but very worth it!) and the videographer sat on a different bike to film us. All in all, this was the highlight of our Saigon trip and a MUST DO! I have been recommending this to all my friends since I got back. Worth every dollar :)

Highly enjoyable way to discover Saigon by night - Phuong and Ly proved to be excellent drivers and tour guides showing us the sights of Saigon by night. Peak hour was no issue for these women who display poise, good humor and patience throughout the tour. Would recommend for people of all ages as a great way to experience Saigon outside District 1 (Q) and adds a real thrill to your time here.

You would be a dummy not to do this! - So I found this on tripadvisor and decided that I had to do it. I wasn't able to get myself in one night and was really bummed about it, so I decided to change my flight so I could get a chance to do the Foody Tour. Worth every Dong or USD you spend. My friends and I decided that this tour was the best part of our trip. The girls are excellent riders and are masters at getting through the city unscathed, the food is amazing, all the beer you can drink (huge bonus in my book), and the girls also speak English very well. The only bad thing was realized it was going to end. Simply amazing, and like I said, you would be a dummy not to do this.

Great Experience - All the reviews on TA urged my wife and I to book the "Night Tour" and I'm so glad we did. We thoroughly enjoyed the tour. The best part is that you get to go off the beaten tourist track and get to see areas that most tours wont do. The scooters are great, you feel completely safe and our guides Phuong and ThuThu wre fantastic.
Tung, the tour leader is a really nice guy who explained the foods we were trying and talked about the areas we were riding thru.
If you go to HCMC make sure you do this tour its a blast!!!

The safest yet enjoyable way to tour HCMC - My wife and I was a bit uneasy about touring HCMC but thanks to XO Tours (very responsible Tung Do and his extremely friendly "girl guides") we got acquaint to enough of HCMC with two sessions of XO tours - "The Foodie" and "The Sights". We had a wonderful and enjoyable holiday!!! Unbeatable in terms of enjoyment!!!

Amazing way to see Saigon - This was the best activity I have done on my trip! The girls who drive you around are very safe, speak good English and explain what you are seeing. The food tour is great because you try foods you would never think of and it's all amazing. It's a way to get off the beaten path of tourists and see something else. Great way to meet people and they take lots of photos for you! Don't miss this! Owner, hung, is awesome guy!!

You will have a memorable, yet safe, adventurous. - The cab driver tried to talk us out of this trip. He said we were old enough to ride on the motor bikes (age 61). Of course, he wanted to show us around. He couldn't have been more wrong. Our guides were friendly, polite and knowledgable. They seemed to have as much fun as we did. It seemed safer than walking. This was an experience we will always remember.

One of the highlights of our trip! - My Dad and I were traveling together in Vietnam for a few weeks, and decided to do the Foodie Tour. Pick up was prompted, and off we went with two very bubbly female riders and Tung, the owner. My 'chauffeur' was Nga, who also managed the small tour company and was responsible for planning the foodie route! She was SO much fun, with decent English (amazing considering she had only been studying for 10 months!). We had such a good laugh the whole way through the tour, and her bike riding was impeccable, I felt totally safe among the unbelievable traffic of HCMC.

There were 4 food stops in total, with food ranging from beef+noodle soup, bbq goat meat, huge prawns, a seafood spread of crab, scallops and clams, and dessert. All of it was delicious, and all street-side 'restaurants'. Even when it rained, we still had fun in our rainy macs. Tung was a great tour guide and really informative. But Nga gets my highest recommendations, she really was great.

All in all my dad and I had a great time, laughed a lot, ate a lot and I can't recommend this tour highly enough. Tung took lots of photos and emailed them to me a few days later, which was a really nice added touch. Thanks to Tung, Nga and the girls for a super evening!

The only way to travel around hcmc and see a different side to the city - We were met promptly outside our hotel by Anh and Phuong in traditional Vietnamese dress at 6 pm for the night tour of HCMC. After introductions we were off into the chaos of the rush hour traffic.

It was exhilarating and great fun. We were taken around 5 districts in total in 2.5 hours. We ate 2 Vietnamese specialty foods and drank sugar beet juice. During the ride our guides pointed out points of interest and we also met up with Tung at different meeting points and he explained points in more detail.

Everyone's English was excellent and the whole trip could not be faulted except that it ended!

Keep up the great work. Thank you again

Wonderful way to see Ho Chi Minh City - This is my 5th visit to Vietnam and this will have to be up there as one ofthe best tours I have done. On this visit I went with my mum who is in her early 60's and was looking at a way to show her the real Saigon in a short period of time.
Tung Do and teh girls from XO Tours were wonderful; they made us feel extremely relaxed and full of information and excellent English. I would like to thank them for giving my mum and I a wonderful experience.
I will definitely recommend this tour to any friends and family heading to HCM.

Great fun, great experience, must try! - I signed up for the Foodie tour, and it was an awesome experience. After sitting in cars and buses for the other tours on my trip to Saigon, I finally got to experience what it was like to ride on a motor bike in the busy traffic. It was not scary at all as my guide, Nga, was a very safe driver. She picked me up from my hotel right on time, and it was great fun from there on. I was in a group with 4 other members, and all the girls and the boss (Tung) were the friendliest guides I have ever met. The tour felt like I was just hanging out with friends! We went to 3 different restaurants that night and ate until we were more than full. We got to learn a little bit of history, drive around the different districts, as well as sample the different types of food. It was a great experience from start to finish and I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone traveling to Saigon.

Experience Saigon in local style - Began a two week trip through Vietnam with a tour with XO and loved every minute! I even booked a second trip- the night food tour which I highly recommend. The girls were great, the food was amazing and it was a great way to see the city local style. This is a must do if you are in Saigon!

Wonderful experience, smooth running operation - Being a mature solo female traveller who has not been on a motorbike for years I found XO Tours were a wonderful way to experience HCM City when I only had one full day there. The pickups were prompt, the female drivers delightful, knowledgeable and very competent. Tung was extremely professional and oversaw the tours with panache. To any one considering XO Tours, do not hesitate. A word of advice, if doing the Foodies Tour, take your appetite. You eat wonderful dishes among Vietnamese without a tourist in sight.

Awesome experience - My fiancee and I did two tours with XO in October. The first tour we did was the "Saigon by night" tour. What a fantastic way to see the city. We were both really nervous at first, but our tour guides were both fantastic drivers. It was nowhere near as scary as we thought it would be. The tour was fantastic, a great way to see areas of Saigon other than district 1. Our drivers were fantastic to chat with, and gave us great insight into daily life in Vietnam. Tung the tour company owner was also great and gave us lots of interesting information about all the sights.

We enjoyed the tour so much that we booked the shopping spree tour for another day. This was also great. When we tried to go shopping in Saigon by ourselves we found it quite daunting due to the language barrier, not knowing where to go, it being too hot to get around different locations, and the off putting over the top sales pitches. Having the tour guides take us on their bikes was a great way to get from one location to another, and the ladies translated for us and got us great prices. They also knew exactly where to take us to get what we wanted.

I highly recommend taking a tour with this company. You won't really experience Saigon if you don't get on a motorbike. The ride itself is an awesome experience, and the ladies are fantastic safe drivers.

Must See! Must Do! Experience It! - I planned to give my girlfriend a surprise during our holiday. I did a lot of ground works and read reviews about HCMC. It was our first time visiting HCMC, based on the excellent reviews in TripAdvisor, I decided to book three sessions "The Sights, The Foodie and Shopping Spree" from XO tour. A week before our trip, I e-mailed Tung, the owner and requested a special activity in "The Foodie". Tung responded immediately, and agreed with my request.

First day, "The Sight", Tung and our guides (Fong and Luan - i hope i spelled correctly) arrived at the hotel and explained our schedule. Tung and the girls were very knowledgeable, Tung explains the histories of the places we visited. At the beginning, we're nervous! It looks crazy riding a motorbike in the heart of HCMC - crowded traffic. It is awesome! Most important of all, we'll feel like hanging out with friends! i added one more hour in our tour and is worth it!

Second day, we went for "The Foodie". Riding motorbike at night was completely different comparing to day time. The night scenes are colorful and amazing. You guys must do it! Also, the foods are great and you will not have the chance to taste it without any local people to guide you! XO Tour can! Tung arranged something special as per my request earlier. I proposed to my girlfriend to marry me and she said ......YES! Wow! Thank you very much for XO Tour - Tung and the Girls. It is a surprise to my fiancee and she is very happy! This is an absolutely memorable experience!

We went for the "Shopping Spree" on our third day morning in HCMC. Nga and Luan are amazing friends! They help us to negotiate for the best price and the places we went are awesome! My fiancee bought a tradisional Vietnamese Ao Dai and the owner delivered the Ao Dai to the hotel we stayed-in on the next morning. This is great where you can buy something that fits you.

We highly recommend taking a tour from XO Tour! It is guaranteed to be one of the memorable experience of your trip in HCMC.

We visited HCMC on the end of September 2011.

XO Bike tour is highly recommended! - We are a couple in our early 30's arrived in Ho chi minh or Saigon by Cruise ship super star virgo on 13th sept'11 ,we had booked XO tour through mail much b4 after reading positive reviews..we had only a few hours in the city and wanted to make most of the time although it was advised by tour manager Mr. Tung So that tour starts at 1pm its better to start on time else we will miss on things but unfortunately we will hav reached city only by 2pm so we requested to accommodate the timing as they could not pick us up frm the lotus port due to many issues, parking and identification among thousands of guests. we were asked to meet at Siagon opera house which was closer frm ben tanh market where our tour bus frm port would drop us we took cab and reached Opera house by 2pm, we were greeted by Mr tung Do and our bike riders Loang and phuong , they provided us with helmets we were on motorbikes,the tour started..it was fun we explored the city they explained us all details in English Mr. Tung Do has deep knowledge on each place we saw opera house, various historic places some amazing French architecture, City hall, the main post office(we bought some souvenir frm post office) , local Saigon market, Chinese pagoda, notredam cathedral church and reunification palace and were dropped back to our bus pick up point Ben tanh market by 5:30pm.about tour we were really happy on whole with the XO tour, our mail queries were replied to promptly, all guides were really nice took care of us, drove very safely even bargained for us when we bought some stuff from local market. In short this tour was really worth it if only we would have had more time on hand we would have definitely extended XO tour to Saigon by Night.Saigon traffic is chaotic if you are exploring in bus you would be stuck in traffic Jams we were more than happy to be on bikes with nice tour guides ,we could see so much. Can end by saying thanks Mr tung Do, Loang and Phuong for making our visit to beautiful Saigon special…we would definitely recommend this tour if you want to explore Saigon with expertise of locals!!

Anyone visiting Saigon must do this... - We were a party of 5 women on a hen weekend from HK. In one day we did the shopping tour and the foodie tour. The former in the morning 10am-1pm and the latter 5pm until 10pm.
I must say I expected to be dismayed as I am not a bike rider and am an awful passenger preferring to drive. The girls are all extremely proficient in the handling of their bikes and I felt very relaxed and confident amidst the hectic chaos that is HCM traffic.
I would suggest being very clear of what items you intend to shop for as the time flies by especially with a large party. I liked the fact that the girls helped out with bargaining so that we were not unduly ripped off!
Their knowledge of the city from a local young persons perspective was refreshing.
I really enjoyed both tours but thought being on the bike so long for the last tour was too long and we were all exhausted. However, we got to try some very local delicacies and learned how to combine the meat/fish with the herbs and sauces to create some surprisingly tasty morsels. Food, water and local beer are included in the foodie tour cost and water in the shopping tour.

Can't go wrong with Tung in charge - On my short visit to Ho Chi Minh City, I went on a Saigon by night tour. I wanted to go on the foodie tour, but as I was the only person booked for the foodie tour I had to go on a night tour instead.

At first I was bit nervous about getting on a motorbike going through the busy streets. However the drivers were very professional and they were very cautious.

The tour was very exciting and was the best way to explore Saigon. I was especially surprised to meet Tung during the tour as most owners are behind their desks. I can see that this tour can not go wrong it Tung in charge. He and his guides were very fun and informative.

Thanks for the great tour and I'll definitely come back for the foodie tour.

Must see and do - My partner and I booked two tours - Saigon by Night and Shopping Spree. Both were really insightful and lots of fun. I would recommend doing the Saigon by night tour when you first arrive in HCMC and the shopping tour before you leave or just plan a shopping day.

Both Tung and the girls know how to make you feel safe, have fun and learn a little more all at the same time.

Fabulous tour - This was one of our highlights when we stayed in Ho Chi Minh City. Initially, I thought it might be a little scary after seeing the traffic on our first couple of days. It wasn't. The absolutely beautiful girls are confident, enthusiastic and just really good fun. The tour was fantastic as it went to parts of the city that, as a family, we probably would not have seen. These included some really great night markets (for locals) and an area of the city where ex-pats and seconded employees tend to reside. Really very interesting. The American (Vietnamese born) who runs it is incredibly knowlegeable and provided really great information about Vietnamese culture at each of our stopping points. Would highly recommend this tour.

Foodie fun! - My husband and I went on the Foodie tour with Tung, Nga and Voon (spelling?) in late September 2011. It was the first day we rode on motorbikes, and given the traffic situation in HCMC (everyone for themselves), we were a little nervous.

Turned out to be very safe (Nga and Voon were great drivers), eye opening (they took us through various districts of the city with commentary on local life), stomach satisfying (absolutely fantastic street stall food that we would never have found otherwise) and extremely fun! Tung provided a great idea for tourists to see the real city, and the girls seem to enjoy their jobs genuinely. It was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam, and well worth the cost of the tour.

Well done, Tung and girls, and keep it up! We definitely plan to join again next time we visit HCMC!

You have to book this tour! - I booked the foodie tour and it was absolutely fantastic! The places you see at night are amazing and the food is out of this world! If you want to see the real saigon and eat like locals do go on the foodie tour. Very informative and very safe driving. I would never have gone or even found the places you visit had I not booked this tour. Thankyou for a wonderful time. Highlight of my trip. A++++++++

Fantastic, informative, fun, great hosts, a must do!!! - Just arrived back at hotel from 2 1/2 Hr night tour.
Have been in HCM for 5 days now and have done a lot of random walking around and thought I had a fair idea of ​​the "real" HCM.
How wrong I was. This tour gives a great insight into the many different areas, old a new of this amazing city. So many wonderful sites to see.
Although what makes this tour are the hosts. I was a bit nervous about getting around on the back of a bike, especially knowing we would be going on some busy roads. Need not of worry. My driver was professional, informative, SAFE and most of all alot of fun, she was great as were all the drivers.
Not a big "tour" person but would highly recommend this one.

Thanks to Tung and all his great staff.

May squeeze in a food tour before I leave!!!

Amazing! - I don't think there's much more. I can add to what has been said. I did the foodie tour and it was absolutely Amazing! My tour guide (Russia) had great knowledge of the city was incredibly intelligent and absolutely gorgeous. Great driver too! great way to try different food and see heaps of hcmc!

Saigon by scooter? XO Tours!! - A truly enjoyable and unique adventure. If you are considering a scooter tour in Saigon I strongly recommend you go with XO! A wonderfully enthusiastic and informative group of young women dressed in traditional Ao Dai will skillfully escort you through the traffic-congested streets of Saigon in style, revealing hidden pockets and intimate details of daily life in this amazing city that you might not otherwise experience.
The tour operator Tung and the young guides truly love Saigon and take great delight in sharing their city with you. The Foodie Tour was fantastic, a gastronomic journey across 5 distinct districts of this vast city, with a stop in each district to enjoy a unique local dish at a street food stall or restaurant. Tung even specially organized a few extra dishes after I expressed a desire to try some frog and snails. Cruising through the amazing Chinese Night Markets was also highlighted.
Best tour experience I had in Vietnam. Thanks XO.

a very unique experience - never would i have thought that i could be riding on a motorbike in HCMC! it was my first time riding on a motorbike and was a little scared a first, but my guide made me feel really safe and i felt the thrill of riding on the bike through the busy streets of HCMC.

truly unique experience!

Awesome experence; Complete confidence in our drivers! - My boyfriend and I were in Saigon last week on Holiday and friend recomended the Saigon By Night tour. It sounded interesting but I was skeptical when I heard the drivers were all small women; My boyfriend and I are not small people. I emailed the owner of XO Tours who assured me everything would be fine... and he was right! We felt completely at ease with our drivers and we got to see parts of Saigon we would not have seen or known about otherwise. Great job Tung and XO tours. Thank You!

Top notch tour to see the REAL Saigon! - My wife and I contacted XO Tours on our South East Asia honeymoon because of their stellar reputation on TripAdvisor.

We were promptly contacted by the owner Tung who helped us organize two tours for us, the Shopping Tour and the Foodie Tour.

We were met by Tung, Nga and Thu in the afternoon of our tour and were taken to two excellent shopping locations in HCMC. A market frequented by locals where there were some GREAT deals, and a designer clothing store that showcased up and coming Vietnamese designers. I think Tung wanted to take us to a few other shopping locations but my wife was so enamored with the designer Vietnamese store that she ended up spending almost two hours there!

They dropped us back at our hotel and after a short two hour break we were ready for our foodie tour, and we were picked up again by our lovely drivers and taken to a hole in the wall noodle location. WOW! We had one of the best noodle dishes arriving in Vietnam (rivaling the famous "soup lady", and certainly the best bun bo hui I've ever eaten in my life. We met a few other foodies at our first noodle stop, and soon after we were flying across the different districts of HCMC in a combination night tour and food indulgence tour of the city. We sampled some BBQ goat and shrimp, had some excellent seafood (scallops, cockles, clams, etc) and saw much of the city that most tourists. would never see.

Tung's tour guide/drivers are very safe drivers, polite, and very lovely company to be around for a long evening eating great food :)

Tung, who is American-Vietnamese, takes pride in HCMC, and his company and truly cares for his drivers/guides. I would hesitate to tell all of my friends who were going to HCMC to go on XO Tours and taking ANY of their tours because they will be guaranteed to have a safe and excellent, entertaining time.

Foodie was excellent! - We had such a great time on the foodie tour, it was the highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh. Communication to set up the tour was great. They said they were full on the nite we wanted, but emailed later and said they could accommodate. Picked us up right on time and although some of us were a bit scared of the motorbiking part, once we started we had zero problems. Girls were fantastic, food was excellent, and the sights and the tour were great. We had a blast. Would certainly do it again.

Do it - you won't regret it! - Our foodie tour was the highlight of our ten day visit to Vietnam. XO Tours is professional, fun and the best way to experience all that HCMC has to offer. I booked the foodie tour for my husband and I on our first night in the city, and what a great introduction to the food and culture it was. Our guides Van and Thu were adorable and looked after our every need. The food stops were varied and abundant and even when the heavens opened it didn't dampen the fun we were having. The owner Tung came along too and filled us in on life in Vietnam and the girls snap photos of us on the move.
This was such a fun and memorable way to experience Ho Chi Minh City - put your nerves to one side and jump on the back of the bike. You won't regret it.

Great opportunity to see the "real" Saigon! - My boyfriend and I booked the Saigon at Night tour with XO Tours on October 3, 2011. Nga and Anh, our guides, were amazing and really knowledgable about the city. Throughout the tour, they explained the highlights of the districts we passed through and also provided insight into the daily routines and living conditions of the Vietnamese in Saigon. Tung, the company owner, was also great at providing insight into life in Saigon.

On this tour, we drove through Chinatown in Districts 5 and 6, which was really busy and interesting to see. Apparently this is the area where the locals go to buy their food and supplies, which they then sell to tourists in District 1 at a higher price.

We also passed through the district where a lot of expats live (can't remember the district number) which looks very different than the hustle and bustle of District 1. This area has wider streets, a lot of condos and shopping malls, and a much more "cleaner" look and feel.

Along the way, we also stopped off at three street vendors to pick up Banh Mi (Vietnamese sub), a rice noodle and sausage dish, and sugarcane juice - all very yummy!

Tung and his team know how to cater to tourists and they really do know that providing great customer service is what's important to keep people coming back for more.

Overall, this was a great tour and we were really glad we decided to book this at the last minute after having read other reviews on Trip Advisor. There's no way my boyfriend and I would have traveled outside of District 1 on our own, so I'm very grateful we didn't miss out on seeing the "real" Saigon. Thank you for a great time and experience XO Tours!

You Have To Do It! - It was my first time visiting HCMC. After reading a lot of excellent reviews, I decided to book "The Sights" tour a few days ago. First of all, I e-mailed Tung the day before I wanted to take the tour, and he responded immediately. Fast and smooth reservation process.

The day of my tour, it was raining hard on and off throughout the morning. Tung and my guide (Thu - hope I spelled her name correctly) gave me a chance to delay or reschedule my tour TWICE. I decided to continue the tour since no one was really sure if it was going to rain the rest of my stay in HCMC. They provided a poncho for me just in case. Happy that I decided to continue with the tour! Tung and Thu were very knowledgeable, explaining the histories of the places we visited. Both of them were fun to be with. Tung even treated me to one of his favorite desserts in Binh Tay Market. Thu helped me buy a traditional Vietnamese Ao Dai as a gift to my niece . Wow!

If you are nervous about riding a motorbike in HCMC, don't worry - you have to convince yourself that it is organized chaos and drivers avoid hitting each other. Safety comes first with XO Tours. Thu gave me safety instructions and advice before we started - basically, told me to relax, not shift my weight suddenly, and let her maneuver the motorbike. No close calls or worries at all during my tour. Thu even helped me cross the street a couple of times by going first and shielding me!

I highly recommend taking a tour from XO Tours. It's guaranteed to be one of the highlights of your trip to HCMC.

Saigon foodie tour - Its our first time in Saigon. Booked the foodie tour and it all went really well till the last 1hr, it rain heavily but nonetheless poncho was provided through out the tour. The guides were all really friendly, cheerful and knowledgable. We all had a great deal of fun and laughter with the guides.

Overall experience with XOtours was AWESOME! A must do tour in Saigon! Cheers

Such an amazing experience! - My partner and I did the Siagon at Night tour with XO. Such a brilliant experience! The girls picked us up at our Hotel. They took us through some of the other Districts past the Large Market the locals shop at. They bought us food street food and introdcued us to sugar cane juice!
I would recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. We enjoyed it so much we even tried to book in again for a second tour when we returned to Ho Chi Minh before we left to come home to Australia, but unfortunately Tung and the Girls were already booked out!

The best way to see Saigon! - Tung and his team of lovely guides provide a fantastic introduction to the sights of Saigon. They were extremely knowledgeable and friendly and they made the tour a lot of fun as well as answering a lot of our questions.

We had so much fun on the sights tour we went back and did the Saigon by Night tour, another birds eye view of Saigon. We even got to try some delectable street food!

We would thoroughly recommend these tours to anyone visiting Saigon and if we return will be due to one of the tours that we missed.

Seniors Tour - My wife and I just completed two of the most enjoyable tours (of the many we've taken over the years) with Tung Do and the "girls". We are 72 and 68 years respectively and, needless to say, we were a bit apprehensive about being on the scooters with the wild traffic. However, it was not a problem at all!
