The girls are great drivers, very safe and very thoughtful of the surrounding conditions. The 2.5 hrs day-time "Sights Tour" and 4.5 hrs the evening "Foodies Tour" gave us a complete feeling and understanding as to how the local people of Saigon really live. Seeing the various sights during the day-time tour fills in the history of Saigon and the North quite nicely. We considered this trip based on the reviews we read before entering the country and we were not disappointed. No wonder XO Tours is rated Number #1 on TripAdvisors.

Ed and Gail, Austin Texas

awesome way to see ho chi minh - i had a short ohm car ride with a friend in hcm last 2010 during my first visit to vietnam and that was the best local experience for me. i wanted a repeat and i saw a lot of reviews regarding this tour. i booked the saigon by night tour and it exceeded my expectations! just being on a car ohm already is an awesome experience, riding it with the lovely, friendly and skilled tour guides made it a more pleasant experience. this is something that i can do over and over again in hcm. thanks xo tours for the wonderful experience!

The highlight of our Saigon visit - I chose this tour based on Trip Advisor recommendation and I was not disappointed.

It was easy to book online and although I booked it 2 days ago there was no trouble in arranging it. Tung (the owner) sent confirmation emails that were friendly and informative - his English is excellent!

I was initially nervous as I had never ridden on a bike before however I soon felt relaxed and confident, as the lovely ladies (Van & Hoang) were expert drivers and were very friendly. Tung traveled with us on a separate bike and then provided us with information about each of the sights that we visited. His knowledge was excellent and he made learning about the sights fun.

Our lady drivers looked beautiful in their outfits and I admired Van's heels and color coordinated nail varnish!!

We chose the 'sights' tour. It was a really fab way to see the top sights. We visited the post office, cathedral, Rex Hotel, City Hall, Jade Emperor Pagoda, Reunification Palace, City Hall and a market (a much better one than the Ben Thanh market... we even had cake there!) Tung is flexible to your requests too so I'm sure you can tailor the route to fit your needs.

Tung and the ladies took photos for us and have emailed them to us since our visit, especially useful as during the tour we experienced a heavy downpour and Tung's camera is waterproof!

During the rainy spells we were provided with ponchos which we greatly received. Tung even gave us the option of postponing the tour due to the weather but we wanted to continue with it as it was our last day.

The tour cost $25 and it was well worth it. We were so pleased that we did it and not only did we see the sights in a unique way but we also got to learn more about life in Vietnam through chatting with our guides.

Highly recommended.

Thanks to Tung, Van & Hoang for a fabulous and memorable experience :)

A great way to see Saigon! - We just got back from a fantastic 2.5 hour Saigon by Night tour. We were picked up at our hotel by our very friendly guides who then drove us around Saigon. I felt very safe despite not having been on a motorbike before. Our guides talked to us while driving and pointed out interesting sites that we would not have otherwise known about. We went to a Market and a few street food stalls before continuing on through other districts. It was great to see the contrast of different districts and get away from the tourist areas. We stopped at a roadside cafe to eat our street food meal before being dropped back at our hotel. This tour was definitely the best tour we have been on during this trip as the guides and the company owner gave great insights into the Saigon lifestyle. We highly recommend it!

The best way to see it is all in action - We just got back from touring Saigon city with Tung, Thu and Phoung from XO tours.

What a great way to tour the city and get amongst it. We had done this in Hue as well and loved it so thought this might be the ticket for HCMC as well.

The owner Tung has a fast knowledge of the city and took us to all the best spots for a history lesson as well great spots to take photos.....which we took plenty of.

The Opera House, Reunification Palace and Than Dihn markets to name a few.

The girls are really sweet and handle the bikes with ease. Its the only way to travel around in the city and all the more fun with great company and guides to talk you through it all.

I can highly recommend this tour and 3 hours just flies by...or perhaps scoots by.

Most thrilling and heart-pounding experience you can have in Vietnam. - Tung and his girls are very cordial and punctual. Not only do they know a lot about their city for which you'll know since they constantly give you details of the business areas, districts and roads, they can maneuver in the streets that were plagued with traffic!! T'was like a roller coaster ride.. Also, they gave us an interesting dinner of Vietnamese bun and Banh Uot, splashed down with Sugar Cane juice laced with Cam Quat.. I definitely enjoyed every minute of it and would definitely recommend it to my friends.. ^_^

You have to do it, Vietnam exceeded all my expectations - I just got back from my first trip to Vietnam. I can only sum it up in one word, AWESOME. Vietnam surprised me and awed me. I did not know what to expect from this country and I did not know what to expect from Ho Chi Minh City, better known as Sai Gon to the Western world. It would be very hard to properly describe all the fun in this post, but in short, the trip was all about having a great time, drinking, meeting exciting people, shopping, sightseeing, and doing the XO Tours, ahhhhh and did some work, but you do not want to hear about it.

Anyway XO Tours was one of the crown jewels in my trip. The trip took me and my friends on motor-bikes throughout the city introducing to us a slew of cultures, different lifestyles, local food, and experiences, which may not be easily attainable for Westerners. Anyway, while doing all these cool experiences you are riding behind a very cute and adorable Vietnamese girl, which finds her way around the city in great ease and elegancy.

The girls will try to engage you in a conversation asking you personal and general questions. Then Tung Do, the boss, will tell you interesting bits of cultural and historic information as you go through China-town, the food market, and a number of districts of Ho Chi Minh City. Sai Gon has 24 districts, each one depicting a different lifestyle and cultural development. In China-town you will be asked if you want a spicy or non-spicy version of the local delicacy, the Banh mi pate sandwich. In district 7 you will sit down at a random street intersection and eat the sandwich while enjoying a fresh cup of sugar cane juice and talking to the nice XO girls

Be careful to not fall in love with one of the girls, like I did . Anyway, enjoy Ho Chi Minh, and take the XO Tour of the city.

Excellent - a really fun way to see the sights - This is great fun and I recommend doing it. I am not a tour fan however this is 1 on 1 and the staff are really knowledgable and will adapt the tour around your preferences.

A must do !!

The "Must-Do" tour of HCMC - There's only one way to see the sights of Ho Chi Minh City and this is it, and the sooner you take the trip the better IMO.

We stayed for a week and only went on the last night of our trip, but with hindsight it should have been the first thing we did. Tung and his girls have plenty of information about the city and its sights, the tour was a great way to see the lay of the land and awesome fun.

AAA operation run by enthusiastic people with a passion for what they do!

They are like friends.... - Wonderful experiences, tried 3 tours, sightseeing, foodie and shopping.

Very patient.passionate.Join them if you want to see the real HCM city.Foodie tour is great,we don't see tourists in our tour and will tell you you are into their daily routines.

Marvellous team,felt very very safe on the bike despite the "wonderful" traffic.Knowledgable guided tour.

You will feel like a local once you are on the bike.You have to try it to understand.Not the typical commercial guided tours with read from the script experiences.

Keep it up XO tour, you guys will grow big for sure

VERY ENJOYABLE - Did this on a weekend break to Ho Chi Minh with my boyfriend and my dad who was visiting. Was picked up from our hotel which was very convenient. Tung and the girls are great hosts. Very informative about all attractions and the girls were brilliant at taking photos for us as well as being excellent and conservative motor bike drivers. Again excellent at putting us at ease as it was my first time on a motorbike and extremley patient with my elderly dad! Several visited attractions, they took us through the local markets and helped us with buying bits and pieces! Overall Tung and the girls have such a pleasant manner and I would highly recommend this trip to anyone!

Full of fun and excitement, Must-have tour in HCM! - I took a day tour on the first day I arrived HCM. I personally prefer short trip so such like Cu Chi full-day tour or My Tho full-day tour weren't what I'm interested in for. It was my 2nd time of riding a motorbike(the 1st was in India!) in my life ever so I was a little scared , but the lady who took care of me was so nice and made me comfortable all the time on riding. Once we reached at the first site and Mr Tung the XO Tour came to show and explain about the history of the buildings and sites. The tour was only about 3 hours maximum and it was just perfect to see and cover the touristy sites in HCM. I had full of fun and excitement so I decided to take a night tour on the same day , luckily there was one spot available! Night tour was another excitement and curiosity! While riding a motorbike, I was enjoying talking about gossips with the nice lady who speaks very good English.
I am glad that I took this tour on my own. Everyone at XO Tours was very nice and friendly.
I would recommend this tour to everyone of my friends who visit HCM.

Best way to visit "Saigon by Night". - Really, it was a good decision to go in this tour. They know how to be a hostess of their city. The drivers are woman, very well dressed and they do it with pleasure. We visited places out of District one and tasted street food. Before going I was afraid of the motorbike because I am not used to it, but they are well prepared for doing their job. I and my husband recommend to you.

Amazing experience! Must do in HCMC! - The title probably says it all! Great bunch of people - my tour guide was awesome! I did the night tour for $25 and it was definitely worth it. You'll see sights that most tourists don't see, get dinner (Inc vegetarian option) and pick up/drop off to hotel. The best part is the personal touch that the owners and girls put into the tour. You will not regret it.

Best way to experience Saigon (Ho Chi Minh) - personal and up close! - On our first night in Ho Chi Minh, my husband and I took the "Foodie Tour" and on our third day, we took the "The Sights" tour. We absolutely enjoyed every minute of it! Riding a motorbike and having your very own tour guide definitely beats going on a bus tour! We got to see the city up close and the tour was very personal. It was certainly the best way to experience Saigon. We got to ask questions, learn about the culture and even the everyday life in Saigon. The tour guides/drivers are very friendly and fun girls -- we fell in love with them instantly! They made us feel very safe and comfortable! We got to experience the streets and scenes in a real, personal way.

The night foodie tour was one of a kind experience. They took us to places where we wouldn't be able to go as tourists. It was mostly locals eating in those places -- that's how authentic it was! We loved, loved, loved it! The sights tour was also very informative - we got to see and learn about the most important and historical places in the city.

As I write this review, I find myself missing Saigon (Ho Chi Minh). That is how wonderful our experience was, thanks to XO Tours.

Even better than I thought! - Having read the reviews for this tour before booking it I was really looking forward to it, but it exceeded my expectations. It was the high point of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. The girls were enthusiastic but made us feel safe in the crazy Saigon traffic. It felt like being shown around a new town by old friends.

Tung, the brilliant tour guide, not only told us really interesting about the main monuments and pagodas, but took us to places that aren't mentioned in any guide books, as well as to a market where he made us try delicious drinks and snacks that we wouldn't have even noticed without him. They are charming, knowledgeable and entertaining and I could not recommend them more.

Absolute No.1 - I tried with my wife and 2 boys. Tung consulted with us a detailed tour plan and it indeed exceeded our expectations. Safe ride, feeling like a local and I had no doubt no tour could beat them. I strongly recommend to book in advance. Let them decide what to eat and where to go, we all experience true Hochiminh. Thank you once again. XO team!

Fantastic experience for all the family -we did 3 different tours. - Our trips with XO Tours were insightful and very fun way to see HCMC. The ladies were brilliant riders on the bikes -we felt in very safe hands and the infornation provided was excellent. The night tour was fascinating and gave a real insight into the buzz of this dynamic city after dark. It was great to see different districts and try some street food. My husband loved the food tour -a vast array of flavours and local dining experiences. We also did the day tour with our young kids and they were thrilled. The tour guides were fantastic with the children and kept them entertained on many of the stops. Safety helmets were a bit hard to find in kids sizes but we eventually got them near Ben Market so it was possible to do the tour with little kids but we had been on motorbikes on Con Dao Island (the only way to get around there) so our kids used to being motorbike passengers.

Amazing experience - the best part of our trip to HCM - My partner and I had the most amazing time on the Foodie tour offered by XO tours. Our experience pretty much sums up why they are the number 1 and "Must do" tour in HCM.

Tung do is courteous, friendly, prompt (all our emails and phone calls explaining the tour , concept, costs etc) was communicated in a non pressured speedy friendly manner.

We originally wanted to do the Saigon by night tour (as my partner is vegetarian) and we felt the foodie tour may be wasted on her, but alas it was not meant to be, and again it highlights why it is so important to book spaces on this tour in advance (we actually didnt book in advance, and were trying to squeeze in somewhere once we are already in HCM!). Anyway long story short, we bit the bullet and went on the evening foodie tour.

We managed to squeeze onto the foodie tour on our last nights stay in HCM (and again Tung Do kept us informed reliably as it was raining quite heavily and it was touch and go if the tour would go ahead). But come 6.30pm the rain stopped falling and we were picked up from our hotel in District 1, by Tung and one of his girl drivers/guides.

We had a blast! The girls are great fun, very friendly, and above all reassuringly safe drivers. My partner enjoyed herself immensely and she didnt even eat anything on the tour!! (Tung was sweet, and constantly asked if she was ok/hungry etc, and offered various vegetarian alternatives). And this is what makes this great tour, an amazing tour!! the level of personal touches, flexibility, taking on board customer suggestions, its easy to see why we can only reiterate the views of everyone else on this forum.

I myself had a great time, enjoyed eating the beef noodles, grilled goat meat, and of course -the highlight of the tour- the plentiful seafood (crab claws, scallops). The girls are sooooo nice and not only merely drivers, but good hosts, they engage in funny conversations, and even shelled the prawns/crab claws for me (and as much as i love eating shellfish, I hate shelling them! LOL).

Not much more i can add really. Perfect 10, and cannot recommend Tung and his girls enough.

The only regrets we have is that we didnt book early enough, and that we should have pre-arranged videoing of the tour via Tung!

Embrace the madness - We rode with Tung and his crew in mid-August. Having done a far bit of walking around the streets of Hanoi and Saigon, we must admit that there was much trepidation as we hopped behind our respective scooter drivers (part of an all female driving crew) for this tandem joy ride around Saigon. However, within minutes of starting, our minds were set at ease as our drivers, adorned in traditional Vietnamese dress, skillfully and carefully traversing the madness that is Saigon's traffic. Our drivers were lovely, bubbly girls who kept us entertained with interesting historical and cultural commentary throughout the tour, which took us away from the tourist traps of District 1 as we scootered around the less traveled parts of the city. The slow drive through the Chinatown markets was a memorable experience, as was enjoying some Banh Mi (Vietnamese pork roll) and fresh sugar cane juice on the side of the road. Tung also took some complementary photos of us on his own camera, which was a nice personal touch.

The tour was the highlight of our time in Saigon and we recommend this to all.

Experience the REAL Vietnam, off the beaten track! - My husband & I did the Foodie Tour and had a whale of a time. :) Despite our very limited experience on motobikes, we felt that we were in the best of hands with our bike ladies, Van and Anh. They also proved to be the sweetest guides - we were showered so much TLC, it almost felt like we were out with (very nice) family instead, heheheh.

Our 4 hour tour was a whirlwind of activity where we were brought to various districts across HCM. I especially loved the ride through a night-time wet market - live frogs and chickens next to bushels of fresh vegetables, what fun!

As this was the FOODIE tour, our trip naturally included stops at authentic Vietnamnese food spots. (We would never have found these places on our own and even if we had, we would not have a clue about what to order, so thank goodness for Tung spicy and the girls!)

Our pit stops included:

- A lovely Pho stall (noodles in a broth)
- An authentic Hotpot & BBQ outdoor restaurant (BBQed goat anyone?) and finally
- A street-side Seafood restaurant (THE best razor clam & morning glory dish ever!).

XO Tours is highly recommended - you won't regret it! :)

The best way to experience Saigon - XO Tours were extremely professional and well run. The team were great fun and showed us parts of Saigon that we will never have experienced. The tour guides rode really safely, allowing us to sit back and enjoy the sights and smells of the city.

This is a tour for people who don't like motorbikes as the traffic in Saigon means you rarely go faster than 30km/h. I would strongly recommend that you do the shopping tour before going on any shopping sprees, and the foodies tour is a great way safely experience the food of Vietnam as the guides take you to their favorite food stalls. The flan (creme caramel ) we had from a street stall was much better than what we got at our 5 star hotel.

The highlight of our trip! Absolutely fantastic! - Not only is this an extremely well-run company (excellent website, extremely responsive, professional drivers), but the experience exceeded our expectations even considering the positive TripAdvisor reviews. Tung Do, the owner, is a great guy. He joined us on our tour because he was training some new drivers. He goes the extra mile to ensure that his customers are having a memorable time.

My wife and I are new parents so safety was a big consideration. In fact, I admit that I had to talk my wife into this tour. But at no time did we question our safety. Not only are the drivers knowledgeable and friendly but they're also great drivers.

We did the "Saigon by Night" tour. One thing I value most about the experience is that the tour exposed us to different areas of Saigon that we likely wouldn't have seen otherwise. Our night tour also included some street food, which was fantastic!

As you can see by our pictures, we got caught in the rain for a short period of time. But they were prepared and we had fun with it!

Loved it! Went TWICE - Had two amazing tours with XO Tours! Did a shopping tour first, and got to go to some great little markets wouldn't of normally got to.
My favorite trip was our Saigon By Night Tour. About 30 minutes in it started pouring rain, but it was still so much fun! Even who flooded the roads the girls drove like pro's, and I felt safe the whole time! I think I enjoyed it MORE with the rain! All the guides are so friendly and funny, it really is a must do in Saigon! If you go with any company, go with this one! Thanks guys

Wish we had time to do all the tours - We did the night tour and met up with a couple who had also booked for the same night.

The drivers were both skilled at navigating traffic and were lovely and even put up with and played along with my husband's crazy sense of humor and excessive videoing! It was sometimes hard to hear my driver with the wind and quiet voice but still managed to understand 80% of the tour commentary. I thought I was going to scrape my leg with another driver on several occasions but this never happened so I put this down to good driving on Anhs part!

As it started to rain, we all donned raincoats which the guides had ready to go. We had a choice of light dinner options and received a sugar cane drink and we found these all tasted amazing! These are things we'd never know to ask for usually so it feels like we'd opened up a new, possible world of food in a foreign city.

Next time we are in HCMC we will check out the foodie tour for sure!

Amazing tours! - I thought this was the best way to see Ho Chi Minh! Tung and the girls brought us to different districts I would have never known about had I not joined the Foodie tour. I enjoyed it so much I booked them for the Sights tour. Much easier then getting in a cab or bus tour!

Absolute must! - Was recommended this tour by a great English couple we met in the Elephant Bar, Raffles Hote in Siem Reap Cambodia. Booked online and received very good communication from the manager. The tour we did was the Foodie Tour which entailed around four hours of traveling around Saigon on the back of a moped Sampling the local dishes (not the touristy stuff, more of what the locals eat). The moped riders (all Vietnamese girls) were excellent and their riding skills put everyone in our group at ease in a very short time. The tour guide travels with a helmet camera operator so that the whole adventure is captured on film (a DVD can be purchased for a very reasonable additional fee). The sights, sounds and tastes of this amazing city were fantastic, the staff were brilliant and could not have been more helpful, a must do for anyone visiting Saigon.

Fantastic tour! - I cannot recomment thios tour highly enough. All the staff were incredibly professional, whilst at the same time being friendly and entertaining. They had thought of everything to make the experience authentic and comfortable. Lovely, lovely people and a great tour. Do it!!

Excellent way to experience Saigon - XO tours was an an excellent way to get a feel for the city and the way the organized chaos of the traffic just seems to work. I was apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter but Angie A was an excellent driver and she made me feel very comfortable. Tung the owner of the company followed us on the tour as he was training a new driver. He spoke excellent English and both he and Angie were very Informative on this day sightseeing tour. My family and I had visited on vacation back in March but we went on a Mekong delta tour and tunnel tour so we did not get an overview of Saigon itself, XO tours allowed me to get a better understanding of Saigon and let me feel like a local for a couple of hours.

First thing to do in Saigon- take an XO tour and see the city as the locals do... on a motorbike - Our three adult daughters took the XO Tour when we visited Saigon in May 2011 and were absolutely enthralled by the guides as well as the unique experience of seeing the city while riding on the back of motorbikes. We couldn't stop raving about the sights and shops that they visted and how the English-speaking guides of XO daughters Tours were great in picking just the right spots for them to top and explore. The ride is completely safe - - all the guides are experienced motor bike riders and know the city by heart. XO Tours offers a variety of tours, so you can easily pick one that suits your need, whether it's tasting street food, shopping, or seeing the city by night.

Tung is a delight to work with and his all-female crew of guides will come and pick the passengers up directly from the hotel. We consider this tour a great value for the money and the best way to get acquainted with Saigon. If you are coming into Saigon for a visit, you should definitely take this tour first thing in the city and then explore those parts of the city that entice you most.

I had so much fun doing it twice! - I did the sights tour in the morning and enjoyed it so much that I asked Hung if he had room for me that evening to do the night tour. Both of these tours were great and i felt completly safe the entire time. Hung and the girls truly made my HCMC experience a memorable one. The girls are so sweet and Hung is a great guide and so personable. i would recommend this tour to anyone! Thanks Hung!

A must-do in Saigon/HCMC - have fun but feel safe. - My husband and I did the night tour after reading the good reviews. It certainly lived up to our expectations, It was a fun night, Our female escorts were great company and we felt safe and relaxed with them. The route was great and we loved the street food we bought along the way. It was delicious! Our guide Tung was very informative and he made sure that the tour went smoothly.

Fantastic experience, a MUST do in HCMC! - Prior to the tour, I had been emailing XO tours and the owner, Tung, was so ever patient with my never ending questions and handling my fickle-minded-ness very well. Mine was a customized shopping trip and I sent pictures of the items I wanted to get. Surprisingly, the guide did research prior to the trip and I managed to get everything I wanted and even squeezed in time for some shopping at Saigon Square! All I need to do was to point and choose what I want and the lovely guides would do the bargaining for me. It was awesome.

It was a fantastic experience to ride on the bike and it was extremely safe. Don't be alarmed by the traffic in HCMC! The drivers are very considerate and they practice good driving manners.

XO tours is a MUST DO tour when you visit Ho Chi Minh City. You can't afford to miss it!

Great tours highly recommend them - We chose for the shopping tour as a way to ease my daughter into the chaos of HCM shopping. The team were fantastic and took us to Saigon Square 2 which I think is the best shopping in HCM They helped negotiate very price and made our first afternoon a real highlight. We really enjoyed the experience on the bikes and really felt safe - my daughter originally wasn't trilled with the idea but loved it. We would have loved to have done other tours with them but didn't book early enough!
This is a great way to see the city with friendly courteous local experts – we will certainly use them next trip

It went too quickly! - Having spent several days watching (and sometimes wandering through) the swarms of motorcycles in Saigon I felt that my visit would be incomplete if I didn't get involved. Decided on the 2.5 hour Saigon by Night tour with XO Tours and it was great!

I was alone but joined 4 other people and we went around as a group with our drivers and Tung (the owner & guide), stopping off several times to sample local food and drink and to learn about the local areas. Got to visit places which I would never have known to go to as an ignorant tourist.

The girls and Tung were fantastic company - friendly, lots of fun and willing to answer questions at any point during the ride (in excellent English). They also took photos of us to send by e-mail at the end; a lovely souvenier.

Unfortunately the time passed too quickly and I don't recall ever feeling so sorry to say goodbye to someone I'd only known for a couple of hours as my lovely driver/guide! I want to go again, and I'm sure you will too.

Don't miss this!!! An Absolute Must, - My son, aged 9, and I did this tour (as a culinary and city) introduction to HCMC.

WOW - one of the most fun and best things I have done. Felt very safe with the riders (I am a rider in Australia and not a good pillion), loved the choice of food and experiences.

The guides were so lovely to my son and he just loved the time.

I cannot recommend this highly enough.

Great Fun...exciting yet safe...Best way to try the local food - I went on the foodie night tour with my wife.She was a little hesitant initially but eventually enjoyed herself.The girls are fun loving and professional.The Best!!

Awesome Birthday MotorRide with XO TOURS ♥ ♥ ♥ - The Lady Driver-Guide was early on pick-up time in our hotel ! . The Saigon By Night tour was interesting discovery of the inner city of Ho Chi Minh. What amazes me most is that the lady driver is multi-tasking- driving and talking and makes you laugh alot!!! and mind you they speak English fluently. Along the way we get our delicious but cheap food which is included in the tour fee !!! And the best part they gave me a Birthday Cake ! so sweet and deeply appreciated !!! I can say that its really a NIGHT TO REMEMBER!!!! Thanks to XO TOUR TEAM for my unforgetable birthday!!!! Two Thumbs UP for XO TOURS

So Much Fun!!! - We first arrived in Saigon at 4 o'clock in the morning, got ripped off by our cab driver and finished our night on a table. So when our guides showed up at 9 to pick us up, we really weren't feeling up to it and yet somehow they made it happen.
The tour lasts about 2.5 hours and ours took us to the most important landmarks in Saigon, it's a great way to get a feel for the city and learn how to find your way about. The girls are amazing, they are dynamic, very knowledgeable, eager to share and hilarious. We had a great time. On our tour the owner, Tung came along. He is very professional and pretty funny! Thank you so much guys!

Do an XO tour as soon as you arrive in Saigon - I was not overly excited when my partner booked us on the XO Saigon by Night tour but I am happy to admit that it was one of the best things he could have done. We booked the day before and had a very prompt confirmation from Tung, despite our last minute booking. Our two delightful guides were at our hotel early and took great care in ensuring our helmets fitted properly before whizzing us into the bedlam that is Saigon traffic.

My guide (I am hopeless at names but she designed the XO logo!) made me feel safe and comfortable at all times. My biggest regret is that we didn't do the tour earlier as she gave me so many shopping tips which I didn't get a chance to follow up on as we left for Dalat the next day. If we had done the tour earlier in our stay we would also have gone back to some of the areas we saw, China Town in particular.

We were part of a group of 5 and the interaction between the female guides was lovely and you really did feel you were out with a group of friends. Tung, as lead guide, gave us loads of general information and our individual guides provided more local and personal information as we drove along.

Our street food was lovely and we really enjoyed going to two different places to pick up people's choices and then going to a third venue to enjoy the food with delicious sugar cane juice. It was one of our group's birthday and XO Tours provided cake for everyone, which was a really kind touch.

The Saigon by Night tour gave us an excellent overview of the city and was hugely fun. If you can do one of XO's tours early in your stay in Saigon - we really feel we would have got more out of our stay if we'd done the tour earlier and not on our last night.

Unforgetable experience in HCMC!!! - We didn't know what to expect, set up a tour cuz of the reviews. So glad we did!!! At first we were scared w/ all the traffic buzzing around. 5 minutes in we were comfortable and safe w/ the experience driving by the girls. The girls were informative on the attractions hit. Even without the sightseeing places, this was worth it. They even help us bargain at the market. Don't miss out on it! U won't regret it. Thx; Tung, Nga n Tu

unique and interesting must do in HCMC - we were 2 of 5 people who made up this tour. we had a couple from australia and a fellow malaysian based in China.The experience was one of a kind.All the comments from the previous travelers are true. no need to comment anymore except to highly recommend XO for a taste of true HCMC. thank you Ngin(my guide/driver) and tung for a really memorable night.

Just Do It, Do It! - Our XO Tour of Saigon by motorbike was perhaps the best thing we did during our 5 night stay in HCMC.
Tung Do the owner of the business and accompanying guide was utterly charming and offered us a wealth of interesting and useful information.
We both felt completely safe behind the lovely young women riders in their beautiful traditional costumes. Our route was customized to bypass all the big ticket city attractions that we had already visited on foot.
Our only regret was that the evening "Foodies" tour booked for an evening later in the week had to be canceled because of heavy rain. Thankfully Tung was not prepared to put our safety at risk even though he knew how excited we were about our second XO Tour.

A must-do in Saigon - On my arrival for the first time in Vietnam and Saigon i was a little unsure about the trip i had booked with XO once id seen the traffic, but i could not have felt safer or enjoyed the tour more.
I chose the evening food tour and loved it, Tung the owner joined us on the tour and was very informative along with my driver, im sorry i cant recall her name but she was great fun and would like to thank her for getting me around safely.
A great wait to see the city and sample the cuisine, i would highly recommend it.

Superb Motorbike Tours - It was my first trip to HCMC and first time on motorbike tour. Very exciting and enjoyable ride i must say. Mr Tung the owner and the sweet girls dressed in traditional Vietnamese dress are amazing drivers! We did a shopping spree. They took us around for a spin. I managed to get what could not be found in Ben Thanh market in terms of quality.I'll definitely do it again when I get back to Saigon in November.Perhaps 'Saigon By Night Tour' or a bit offtown should be interesting. I highly recommend XO Tours if you are ever in Vietnam and strongly suggest you to do it FIRST UP coz it's money worth, fun and informative too.

Amusing, interesting and different tour of HCMC by night! - Since you are reading this you are considering XO Tours. Just go ahead and book a tour, book two or three if you want to try them all. Do it now.

Me and a friend of mine went on a motorbiketour of Ho Chi Minh City for 2.5-3 hours from 18:00 on saturday the 23. of July 2011.

First of all I felt a lot safer as a passenger on a scooter than as a pedestrian in HCMC. The girls were not only great guides, but very nice to us and last but not least excellent drivers. I really felt like the tour took us places in HCMC that tourists normally do not see and that we learned things about HCMC and Vietnam we would never have otherwise. Since you have 2.5 hours with your own guide on a motorbike you also get to ask any question you like - still; if you had no questions I have no doubt that the guides will have things to tell you constantly anyway.

I was initially a bit sceptic to this but it turned out to be one of the best evenings we had in HCMC. The guides were great, their boss also followed on a motorcycle and had some lengthier historylessons in the different parts of town. I guess he also followed to make sure that there is no funny business from the customers, this simply adds to the company's overall proffessional approach to the tour.

Most important; No unwanted stops at 'random' shops or anything at all similar to such classic travel-guide tricks. We decided to buy a baguette and eat and drink sugar cane and thats it.

XO Tours is both interesting and great fun and it is professional without any of the classical tour-guide shop tricks (at least ours were). As you can see, I highly recommend this to anyone - have fun=)

Great Fun - We didn't know what to expect just basing our decision on the reviews on tripadvisor, and we were not disappointed. The girls were great saw lost of interesting places, and places we otherwise wouldn't have gone to. Ate some very nice but different fruit at the local market. Tung Do and the girls spoke great English and made our trip not only enjoyable but insightful, Cheers for a great day Micka & Ange

Highlights of our HCMC stay! - The Night tour was absolutely awesome. Tung and the girls took us to a lot of districts not usually on the tourist map and provided interesting and unique commentary along the way. It was great fun to weave through the traffic and experience the city in a very different way. The girls were extremely friendly and spoke excellent English. We even stopped for some delicious street food and refreshing sugar cane juice. I would definitely recommend this tour as one of the "must-dos" in HCMC.

The best introduction to Ho Chi Minh City - We were very pleased with this tour. It's the perfect way to see HCMC. Our guides were punctual, adorable, honest, funny, and friendly- more importantly they were safe and knew how to handle their bikes. They took us to places we would not have normally seen or ventured out to. If you plan on being in HCMC, take this tour as soon as possible so you can get a glimpse of what the city has to offer. XO Tours can also customize your tour to focus on your particular areas of interest. I highly recommend them!

Fantastic!!!! - We have a fantastic time with Tung and the girls. It is a very unique experience, riding motorcycle around the city. They took us to all the important sights in HCM. Treat us with a very delicious sugar cane juice. It was really a great experience.

Brilliant. Can't recommend highly enough. - Tung, Nga and An took us on a fab trip around Saigon.
Even with all the bikes and crazy traffic we felt really safe!
Took us to great sights, bought us a cup of delicious sugar cane juice and really looked after us.
Great value. Also got video optio which will be edited and sent to us.
Big thanks to the XO team!!!

Fantastic tour - the best way to experience Saigon! - I had a really fantastic experience with XO Tours! It was a truly unique and enjoyable way to experience Saigon.

While I was planning my trip Tung Do was very helpful and quick to respond to emails. He gave great advice and helped me to set up a special custom tour so that I could try some Vietnamese food and see parts of the city which were "off the beaten path". It was well worth it and I had the added bonus of Tung Do accompanying me on the tour, as well as the lovely female driver. I learned so much about the city and the Vietnamese people.

I only had a couple of days in Saigon and doing a tour by motorbike allowed me to see so much more of the city than I would have had time for otherwise. It was so much fun being in the midst of all the crazy traffic - but always felt completely safe.

Really can't recommend this tour highly enough!

Do It! - As other reviews mention, this should be the first thing you experience in Saigon. Not only will the driver and guide drive you to the famous sights but they also take you to the real Saigon-markets, temples and unassuming buildings associated with the war.
The drivers are lovely and the guide informative. The rush from darting through the busy streets was well worth the ticket price!

Fantastic Trip - Highlight of HCM!!! - I am usually not a "tour" person but I am a food fanatic and thought the foodie tour sounded cool. This tour turned out to be the absolute highlight of my trip to HCM. Everything about XO tours is top notch - I had actually booked for the incorrect day and the owner, Tung Do, called and emailed me until he reached me and made sure to accommodate me even though it was my mistake.

Tung and one of his fabulous ladies picked me up from my hotel right on time and the feasting began! We visited several restaurants and markets and sampled a variety of incredible food - with lots of time in between stops for our stomachs to rest and recharge. My favorite stop was a local restaurant where we cooked goat and okra tableside on individual grills - it was fantastic! The coconut coffee flan for dessert was also incredibly yummy.

Tung made sure we learned a lot about the city and what we were eating without it feeling like a "tour" and his fabulous ladies took excellent care of us. I would have done this tour another night if I could have - it was that much fun! I was also very impressed refund at the end of the night - our food was less expensive that night than the tour price so he actually gave me $10 right on the spot at the end of the tour. It's very hard to find a tour operator who is as honest and dedicated as Tung.

Because of the mistake I made in booking, I took a day tour with another company the previous day. XO beats the pants off of this other company in every way. I don't have enough great things to say about XO - just go!!!!! You won't regret it.

Just do it! Great fun -- and great intro to HCMC - Really can't say enough about these folks. My wife and I are 60-ish, not-altogether-adventurous Americans and had a WONDERFUL time. Not only did we have two totally charming and knowledgeable young women driving us around and providing commentary, but on our trip, the operator of the business, Tung Do, who spent much of his life in the States, accompanied us and offered great info and insights.
We took the trip on our first full-day in HCMC, so it was kind of a highlights tour and a really good way to see the most important sights and get your bearings in the city. If you've already seen a bit of the city, I'm sure they can tailor a trip to suit your desires.
Though HCMC traffic is truly intimidating to a first-time visitor, you won't believe how safe you feel with these young women driving. They are experts. (The real saving grace of the local traffic is that it never moves very fast.)
In addition, they take photos of you that they will provide later by email.
We were lucky to be able to arrange the trip on the day we called, but it is advisable to book in advance. They do book up.
Just do it! It will be one of the most memorable days of your trip.

Unique & fun way to see HCMC - I have recently returned from a month in Vietnam culminating in HCMC. I booked 2 tours, Saigon by Night and the City Sights tour from Australia. Both tours were excellent, with good drivers able to navigate the crazy traffic of HCMC, which was an experience in itself. The city sights tour was a good introduction to HCMC, as it covered all the major sights, including a visit to a local market. with commentary by the guide at each point. Saigon by Night provided a different and exciting view of the city as we travelled through the various districts, seeing Cholon and it's night market, the amazing new Saigon District 7, the cityscape lights and Saigon River. Interesting anecdotes provided by Tung, gave an insight into daily life in HCMC I also had the opportunity to try some street food and sugarcane juice which rounded off a very enjoyable evening. I opted to have a DVD made of the evening tour which is a great souvenir of this unique experience. I highly recommend both tours to anyone contemplating a visit to HCMC even if you have never been on a motorbike. It is fun, really safe and very reasonably priced!

Great way to see the real city, not just district one. - I had three tour guides (Di, Nzan and Tien) that took me around the city and showed me all the things that I'd been missing. They were all very informative and friendly. I recommend the night tour for sure.

Get amongst the locals and see it all at street level - We originally booked an evening tour with Tung, the owner, however due to some severe thunderstorms the tour was canceled. We were able to rebook on the following day, and had a great tour of the city sights, local markets, some great food and some good laughs. We had 3 lovely ladies escorting us on their bikes, who chatted and kept us amused for three hours. We were shown temples, churches, places of interest from the war years, and some very interesting local markets. The experience takes you right among the madness of city traffic and Tung actually taylored our tour so not to duplicate what we had seen on foot on previous days. The girls handle the traffic with ease, and had no problem with me (110kg) on ​​the back of the scooter. Definitely a must do whilst in HCM.

Highlight of Saigon - Fantastic tour guides with the knowledgeable Tung there also to provide extra background and information about Saigon. Loved the day trip of the sights so much, we booked to do the night time tour as well. Day tour was a great way of seeing the sights, and the night time tour was an amazing experience of China Town at night, tasting delicious street food and seeing the parts of Saigon that are not on the regular tours. The girls are very friendly, and we had a great time getting to know them. Felt very safe on the bikes and it really felt like we were being taken around Saigon by friends rather than a tour operator. Highlight of our stay in Saigon.

Xo tours... Loved it! - My friend and I recently took a day tour of HCMC with tung and his lovely tour guides. The sights were beautiful and the conversation interesting. Best part was just feeling the city whoosh by as you zoom thru the streets of HCMC. Definitely recommend this. Would have gone on a second tour with them if there had been time. Thanks for a very memorable time, xo tours!

XO tours - an experience to remember. - The Vietnamese lady guides might not have the best English, but they easily make up for it with their enthusiasm, knowledge and awesome motorbike riding skills. Felt safe throughout the whole scooter ride, and being among the maddening HCM scooter crowd was quite an exhilarating experience to say the least. :)

Highly recommended tour. Just do it.

The best way to see the city and laugh along the way - Ho Chi Minh is a crazy town, and the best way to see it is to embrace all the action. we had such an amazing time on this tour. Thanks so much to Tung and all the girls. It was such a blast to be in the middle of the action seeing all the sights, especially when we whizzed by a bus of board looking tourists.
Gaining local insight, getting our bearings and pretty much laughing all the way made this one of the best tours that I have ever been on (it also helps you get over the initial fear of the completely insane traffic in this city).
Extra touched like having photos of our trip emailed to us and being bought local treats along the way means that I would recommend this as a 'must' for anyone to do (especially on one of your first days in town).

Thanks so much!

XO Tours Is the Best Tour In the Whole World - I have traveled to many countries, trying to look for the best tours, after reading about XO Tours on trip advisor, I thought of giving it a try, and I did on the 22 June 2011. I called XO tours and my call was answered by Tung Do, and was explained about the tour in detail. Was picked up from my hotel lobby by my cute rider with an awesome light weight bike which is 101% saved. And then went for the city tour, I managed to do all the locations which I missed earlier in just 2 hours, Bought lots of helmet's my rider assisted me in bargaining.

Good things about this tour is that you get to ride on a motorbike and have the real feeling how people travel in Ho Chi Minh City. No hidden cost and yes if you are booking the tour take the video package it's awesome.

Finally I tough I won't go to ho chi minh anymore, but now thinking about it I have made a plan to go again just to try XO tours with all my family of 10 pax's.

Tips: Book early cos its not only you who wants the best of the best, there is a long q infront of you, so don't be disappointed if they are fully booked.

Regards,
Deepak Josen

This is a Most to Do in Saigon!! - You never gonna feel and know how the everyday life goes on Saigon until you take this tour.

The attitude of the staff is awesome

I went alone to Saigon, and this tour was like going with my best friends discovering this incredible city.

I strongly recommend you to do it as your first activity in this city.

THE BEST Way to Experience the City! - To join the chaos of the streets is a MUST, and the best way is with the Tung and the girls at Xo Tours. They are clever and funny - they will keep you safe and entertained the whole time. I highly recommend this company. They are organised, punctual, communicate well and if you want to see it, they will get you there! And yes, they took photos for us too. DO THIS!!!

Best tour in HCMC - Thanks TUNG and Staffs Anh and Nga for making our stay in Vietnam the fun and wonderful trip!

Since my friend and I arrived in Vietnam, we been 'slaughtered' when we went shopping be it souvenirs or food or even taxi fare!!!

Thanks to XO Tours, they not only brought us to those must visit historical sites (with very in-depth explanation), they also brought us to Market knowing that we loved to eat local food. Not only that they also helped us to bargain for good price!!

We were impressed with their good service and decided to use them for the second night. It was raining cats and dogs. We were in raining coat. They were very attentive and took good care of their clients! And the dining places they brought us, not only delicious but also very very cheaper, far more cheaper than what we had ourselves earlier on!

Thanks TUNG and staffs, we did hv the best moment in Vietnam:)

Great adventurous trip- must try - It was a great and memorable trip I had in HCMC! It was my first time to go tour on a motorbike! Fun and yet adventurous!!

Tung and staffs were punctual and well conversed in English. Very friendly and accommodative.

My friend and I at first only booked for a slot on our first day to HCMC. However, with their professional and fun sharing on the historial sites/ buildings and a few must see places etc, we decided to use their service for the second day for night sight seeing.

On the second night, I asked my 'tourist guide' Nga Tran to bring us to a must-try Vietnamese food area, end up she brought us to have the best durian-blended drink! And she went and bought us nice local vietnamese food while we enjoying our durian drink even it was raining at the moment!! She sneaked out without we even noticed it and returned to gv us surprised!! After tht she brought us to eat our fav seafood one hidden place. Guess what, for the first time we ate seafood near a 100 year old grave!!! And the food was marvellous! Heard tht famous model and celeb will go there to eat as well!

Thank u Tung and Nga and Anh for making our Vietnam trip the most memorable one!!

If you do one thing in Saigon - Do This! - Saigon has nearly 5 million motorbikes and a 100,000 cars, everyone is crazy and would be banned from driving in the UK. So its pretty scary just watching the traffic.
My wife after much persuading agreed to go on the XO motorbike tour. And after 5 minutes she was elated and glad she did and felt completely safe. The girls who drive the motorbikes are the most friendly, excellent drivers and beautiful you could wish to meet and they speak great English. My wife mentioned it was my birthday and one of the girls bought me a cake with my name on it and a happy birthday hat. Totally unexpected and out of the blue. How about that!
We did a lot of trips while in Vietnam but this motorbike tour of Saigon was definitely the best and most memorable. Just do it!

Best Tour on a Motorbike. - We visited Vietnam May 2011, did a night tour of Ho Chi Min City with XO Tours.
Was just the best, the girls were wonderful, lots of fun, and we felt very safe being on the back of a bike with them. Was one of our highlights of the trip.

Great time & unique way to see the sights of Saigon! - We booked the morning sightseeing tour for 3 people. It lasted almost 3 hours and we had a great time. Best points:

- great service and very friendly female drivers/tour guide. Tung, the owner, also met with us and joined the tour. Very nice guy.
- the girls spoke good English and were also snapping away pictures which were emailed to us after the tour.
- as a tourist you see thousands of motorbikes through a car window but being in the middle of the action is something unique and worth doing
- safe and careful female drivers took care of us and it was much easier to balance than we imagined. My mother came as well and she loved it!
- the price is right at about USD 25 per person.
- definitely recommended

Do this first in Saigon! - Safe, friendly, value for money. Leave your tour of Ho Chi Minh City to these locals. Plenty of photos & a video of your tour. Brief stops with commentaries of history & photo opps, & stop for a refreshing sugar cane drink - freshly squeezed. The best way to see the city thanks heaps guys.

Not wanting to raise expectations too high but....this was a great tour - This is an excellent way to see the sights of Saigon - traveling way the locals do. Not as scary as you might think - Nga my driver and guide soon had me feeling I was in safe and friendly hands. The added bonus was that Tung Do the owner of the company joined us as well, so I was partly lucky. He is keen to make sure that quality is maintained - always a good sign. In fact he is a little concerned about the rave reviews here in case expetations get raised to high.

In brief the pluses of this tour:
- arrived to pick me up bang on time
- tailored to what you want to see
- you get to see much more than if traveling by car or on foot
- great local knowledge
- ideal if you have limited time in Saigon - but even if you are staying a while.
- great value

Best Tour I've Ever Been On... - Fellow Tripadvisor fans....I was so excited to get home from this tour so I could write a glowing review. I travel quite a bit - I've been to some 30 countries in the past two or three years and this is the best tour I've ever been on.

XO Tours was awesome! This is the most amazing way to see HCMC/Saigon. I don't where to begin. First of all, Tung and his staff are amazing. My girlfriend and I booked a 4 hour tour and we got three tours in one thanks to having Tung and our two amazing drivers all chiming in and explaining the sites and different must-see spots throughout the city.

If you're nervous about riding on scooters through Saigon/HCMC...don't be. I never once felt nervous and within minutes I was taking pictures and videos with my camera and forgot I was buzzing through traffic on a scooter.

Here was our route which we covered in less than four hours...and were not rushed... 1. Chinatown, 2. Vinh Nghiem Pagoda, 3. Tan Dinh Market, 4. Cholon - Binh Tay Market, 5. Chau Quan Am Temple, 6. Blac Lam Pagoda, 7. Cho Ban Co, 8. Emperor Jade Pagoda, and a few other quick stops based on last minute requests.

For $10 an hour you can book your own customized tour. That means you don't have to go to the typical tourist spots and have to worry about not seeing the "real Vietnam." You go where you want, when you want on this tour. I picked out some 8 spots and sure enough....we went to all of those stops and were able to stay as long as we wanted at each destination. The only detours we went on where to stop for a drink (which Tung bought us and to grab a snack at a market....again Tung treated us)!

I could go on...believe me...but I'm in HCMC as I type and we have plenty more places to see. The fact that I'm writing this literally minutes after getting done with the tour instead of having another Vietnamese coffee or another bowl of Pho should show you how amazing this tour is!

If ya don't book this tour, it really is your loss. You'll know you're set for a good time after you got the first email from Tung. He's prompt, honest, and excited to help you set up a tour!

A must-try tour in Ho Chi Minh - A very unique tour and a fun way of seeing the popular tourist spots in Ho Chi Minh city. The female XO drivers/tour guides are very friendly and accomodating. Truly an experience to remember.

a tour without feeling like a tour - This is my second visit to Saigon and last time I walked around the city for 3 days and saw some great places but this time in a couple of hours I saw fantastic places I wouldn't have got to walking or even on another tour. My guide, Nga, was delightful and informative and with us on the tour, on another bike, was the owner, Tung Do, taking photos on the way. I had a great time and next visit to VN I'm going to do longer tours. Thanks Nga and Tung.

Best Tour Ever! - i don't usually write reviews for anything, but we had such a fabulous time, I thought it was worth a few minutes of my time to review this tour compnay. We booked this tour after reading the reviews on trip advisors and sure enough, the tour exceeded our expectations. Tung and his group are incredibly fun, informative, and ridiculously fun! This tour might have been one of the favorite parts of my trip in Ho Chi Minh City!

My friend and I did the site-seeing tour of Ho Chi Minh City. They started off by picking us up at the Hotel, where we embarked on our 2.5 hour tour of the city. The bikes used are well maintained and the girl Ngan who was my driver (who was also extremely cute and funny), was a very safe driver. I think the main strong point of this tour is that you actually see the city through the eyes of a local, which I think is what most of us are looking for when we explore a new city. The girls are very kind, they ended up purchasing some local foods for us when I looked curiously at a Vietnamese waffle/cake street vender. Tung is extremely knowledgable and prepared during the tour, he had even packed bottles of water for us incase we felt dehydrated (he is a bit like a boy scout...).

The tour was totally worth it, I would do it again in a heartbeat!

The Best Tour in the Whole WORLD-- XO Tours or nothing! - I realize that the title of my review may create high expectations, but even with high expectations you're sure to be impressed after a few hours with XO Tours. The lady drivers are fantastic-- they're fun to be around while also maintaining an excellent standard of professionalism and hospitality. My boyfriend and I had been in Vietnam for a couple of days before taking our tour (a Build Your Own Tour: a combination of Saigon by Night as well as the Foodie tour). Up until the tour, we hadn't had such a great experience with Saigon nor the quality of service (even though we were staying at the reputed Hotel Majestic). The XO Tour company owner and founder, Tung Do, was extremely helpful and has trained his staff (the girls) to maintain an extremely high standard of service-- a VERY rare thing in Vietnam. I suggest emailing Tung (tung.do@xotours.vn) to inquire about booking your tour. He is very quick to respond to emails and, of course, speaks English very well (he lived in the US from 1975 to 2010). Furthermore, Tung has perfected the XO Tours by researching what's missing from other tourist experiences in Vietnam and making sure XO Tours is as close to the perfect tourist experience as can be. For example, XO tours use modern, well-running motorbikes. They also make sure you feel safe and comfortable on the bike by telling you about it before you get on, and then constantly asking you how you're doing. The girls are excellent drivers, and we were put at ease in a matter of minutes even though it was our first time riding on a motorbike let alone riding one in Vietnam. On this tour you get to see Saigon from a whole different perspective. You'll get to go to places where there are no tourists in sight (but you'll always feel safe), you'll get to eat where the locals flock for the best food in town, and you'll hear about the history and current events that make Saigon what it is today. The price is so reasonable: $30/person for a 3-hour custom-made tour + $10 for a DVD documenting your tour (they follow you around on another bike with a small camera and edit it for the final product). That same "bike camera" will take still-shots for you, so you'll actually have pictures of you on the bike. I have traveled all over the world and have been traveling through Australasia for the last two months. I have been fortunate to participate on some of the best tours around. However, this was the most genuine, fun, and exhilarating experience I've ever had on a tour. If you're in Saigon or planning to visit soon, start typing your email inquiry to Tung now because it'll be an experience you'll never forget!!!

ps if your tour itinerary includes stopping by for food, be sure to bring about 250,000 dong per person (aka $12.50/person). This will probably be too much, but just in case you want to buy something extra while you're on the tour... We were taken to a great place packed with local patrons and ate delicious seafood and drank sugarcane juice for a VERY reasonable price. Tung and the girls helped us order, and we LOVED it.

Feel like a local - Great experience, warm smile, safe rider!!!

The only way you can see the whole of HCMC! I didn't know HCMC is so different in term of Districts!

I would recommend to anyone who visits HCMC!

Thanks Tung and Ms Nga!

I'm back!

A great way to begin your trip in Ho Chi Minh City! - My girlfriend and I took the XO sightseeing tour on our first day during a 10-day trip to Ho Chi Minh City. It was definitely a good way to start our trip and introduce us to the city! We got to see all of the main tourist spots, like the Opera House, the Reunification Palace, the Notre-Dame Basilica, the Central Post Office, and the Binh Tay Market in Chinatown. Also, a little bit of history was explained to us as we stopped at each sight. Our guides were super-friendly and polite, and the girls were wearing aodai (a Vietnamese dress) which looked quite lovely.

Getting to ride on the back of a motorcycle throughout Ho Chi Minh City was definitely a fun and unique experience. I have no complaints about my tour, and I would recommend an XO Tour to any kind of traveler! I will definitely do it again if I return!
Awesome XO Tours - The tours are awesome and the guys are professional and friendly, you will never regret if you do that.

Highlight of Ho Chi Ming Shopping - I took a two hour shopping spree bike tour.It was my last day in Ho Chi Minh and I had limited time. I wanted to take home some authentic Vietnamese gifts for family and something special for myself. Having been to this fantasy city 5 times ago, I wanted a shopping experience that was unique and I found it. Tung and his guide were friendly and fun. They took me to places i would never have known about. I couldnt wait to tell my friends about this cool experience. Thanks Tung!

An absolute must for all Saigon visitors!! - There are some things in Vietnam that you just can't see without having to endure the billion hour bus rides and overly rehearsed tour guide spiels. But if you want to see the city from a local's perspective then you really have to go on an XO bike tour!!

Our beautiful guides were absolutely lovely girls with the most contagious smiles and laughter you could possibly imagine! They got a good feel for the kinds of things we wanted to see on our tour (including the closest thing to Saigon's 'red light district' - the lake side make-out strip) and also showed us some of their own favorite spots. After a 30 degree day, cruising through the bustling Saigon streets in the cool evening breeze was awesome! It was great to just be able to soak in the surroundings without necessarily visiting 'tourist sites' - the city truly does come alive at night, and when you're on the streets on a bike you're more 'amongst it all' than you can possibly be!

We also got a DVD of our experience (a third member of staff follows you on another bike with a camera, so you get to re-live the tour when you get home) and watching it has made me want to go back so badly!

And if you're worried about safety - we were too! But once we met the girls and got on our bikes we felt completely at ease, they were very safe.

All in all - I don't think my trip to Vietnam would have been the same without this tour. It's a total must!

The Best Way to Experience Ho Chi Minh City! Fun Fun Fun! - My husband and I really enjoyed our scooter tour of Ho Chi Minh City! Our hosts and hostesses were fun, enthusiastic, professional, and very knowledgable about the city's best sights and history. There is no better way to see and experience the city than to do it the way the locals do -- on a scooter bike! The scooter bikes were so easy to ride and felt completely safe! We highly recommend this tour-- it's a must do!

An absolute must do! - We were advised by a local friend to take this tour and were pleasantly surprised.The girls were more than proficient in the city traffic and were cute to boot! The tour gave us a good feel for the layout of the city center while the major attractions were highlighted by our guides. I would have no hesitation in recommending this tour to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City, excellent value for money. If it's your first time in the city this tour should be at the top of your list of things to do.

See Saigon the way the locals do! - XO Tours offers one of the coolest and most authentic ways to see Saigon. Tour operator Tung and driver Nga take you on a motorbike tour with Tung following behind filming the intricate weave and navigational skill it takes to brave Saigon traffic. I chose for the Shopping Spree tour and was not disappointed. As a single woman traveling alone they made me feel completely safe. Tung and Nga took me to out-of-the-way places I would never have found on my own, located the best exchange rates, bargained prices for me and when I ran out of money Tung even lent me some of his own! They even had rain gear stowed away when it started to rain. They thought of everything. It was the most unique and worthwhile tour I did in Saigon and the DVD they provided is the only way people would understand what traffic and trying to cross the street is like. Great job Tung!

Unforgettable iconic view of Saigon - Booked the XO city tour on my last day in Vietnam. Opted for the $10 extra to include a video. I was surprised when 2 motorcycles arrived; one for me and the other with a rider and Tung Do to record the video. Great value for money.
My rider was a very pleasant young lady with good English... and her navigation of the traffic was magical. Tung was the perfect guide, and his English is impeccable.
My lasting memory of Vietnam is the crazy traffic of HCMC. This tour is the perfect way to capture this unique experience. XO tours were very professional and actually over-delivered on my expectations... not always the case in Vietnam. Highly recommended.

What a thrilling Saigon experience." - XO Tours", what a way to start or finish your stay in Saigon (HCMC). We booked this tour last minute after seeing their business card in the hotel lobby. Tung, the Proprietor, contacted me within a few minutes and confirmed the evening "Saigon by Night" tour for the next day for my friend and me.

The girls arrived promptly at 6 pm as scheduled along with Tung. He had his his helmet mounted camera as we had opted for a DVD for an additional $ 10 USD. Nga and Ngan, our Saigon tour guides, dressed in their traditional Vietnamese Ao Dai's looked picture perfect. The motor bikes looked pretty new, no dings, dents or scrapes that I saw. Both ladies were very pleasant, spoke English very well and assured me that they were "very good drivers". They gave us a few do's and dont's such as where to and where not to place our our hands and feet and then we were off for a 2 hour exhilarating tour of Saigon.

We started off on some quieter streets with the girls talking to us as we went along giving us some local info and asking us if we were okay etc. They were very good at driving and getting us familiar at the same time with "their way" to navigate the streets and intersections which they do for the most part without stopping. None of the traffic stops. It is just one unbelievable continual MERGE and we mingled our way through the busy intersections without incident. The first few were scary, I must say, especially when we went head on towards a bus and then veered calmly around it. Afterwards I was laughing as I could not believe that I was actually doing this. I, for one, am not a bike rider but after 10 minute or so, I was pretty relaxed, the girls were great and I welcomed the more challenging busy intersections. There are a few traffic lights in the city but most of the time we were on our own. It was an absolute BLAST. One of the best and most unusual tours I have ever taken. We would stop here and there for photos and then we were off again traversing through several districts throughout Saigon, Vietnams largest city, and doing it on two wheels. WOW.

The entire experience was a huge thrill with lots of great memories and photos. It is an experience that I am sure anyone who opts for this tour will be glad that they did. It is highly recommended.

Tung and the girls were fantastic. For $ 20 + $ 10 " if you want the DVD" it is a great and hassle free way to see Saigon. I cannot wait to go back again and do it all over again. XO tours is a one of a kind tour in Saigon.

Thanks, Tung, Nga an Ngan for a wonderful experience, I hope to see you again soon.

No better way to see Saigon. Period. - Seeing the brochure on the guesthouse counter, my curiosity was piqued instantly. I thought to myself, "what a cool way to discover the city." I set my expectations high and scheduled a tour.
I am happy to say that those expectations were exceeded by far, to the extent that, as I was dropped off after the day tour, I immediately scheduled the night tour, which was even crazier, as I had escorted not one but three lovely ladies me around HCMC to show me things that most tourists don't get a chance to see. A Tour with a Difference! - During my 2 weeks stay in Vietnam I traveled to many places and booked many tours. The highlight of my trip was infinitely the "Saigon by Night" tour provided by XO Tours. This was a tour with a difference! I got to see the lights of Ho Chi Minh City, the well known crazy congestion and all the beautiful architecture. A motorbike tour is the best way to get around and if you're pushed for time, XO Tours can tailor your tour to your liking. Nga and Ngan were beautifully dressed in their traditional dresses and were very informative. The girls were fabulous and were great guides. I feel very safe on their bikes and if you think they can't carry you, think again. If I had more days in Saigon, I would have loved to book a day tour with them....definitely next time. I highly recommend XO Tours!! You won't find any tour like this one!

The highlight of my trip to Saigon! - During our stay in Saigon, my friend and I decided to go on XO Tours for a trip around the city. It was one of the best decisions we made during our stay there!
